<span class="e2">sarva</span>–All <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">nānā</span> <span class="e2">yukti kare</span>–engage in various pursuits <span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–for the sake of happiness. <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span> <span class="e2">bhitare</span>–Within the world, [some] <span class="e2">tarka kare</span>–study logic, [and some] <span class="e2">yoga kare</span>–practise yoga. [29]
In various ways, all souls pursue happiness. In this world, some souls study logic, and others practise yoga.
সুখ-লাগি সংসার ছাড়িয়া বনে যায় ।<br />সুখ-লাগি যুদ্ধ করে রাজায় রাজায় ॥৩০॥
sukha-lāgi saṁsāra chhāḍiyā vane yāya<br />sukha-lāgi yuddha kare rājāya rājāya [30]
<span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–For the sake of happiness, [some] <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leave <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–home [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">vane</span>–to the forest. <span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–For the sake of happiness, [some] <span class="e2">yuddha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–wage wars <span class="e2">rājāya</span> <span class="e2">rājāya</span>–between nations. [30]
For the sake of happiness, some leave home and go to the forest, and others wage wars between nations.
সুখ-লাগি কামিনী-কনক পাছে ধায় ।<br />সুখ-লাগি শিল্প আর বিজ্ঞান চালায় ॥৩১॥
sukha-lāgi kāminī-kanaka pāchhe dhāya<br />sukha-lāgi śilpa āra vijñāna chālāya [31]
<span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–For the sake of happiness, [some] <span class="e2">dhāya</span>–run <span class="e2">pāchhe</span>–after <span class="e2">kāminī-kanaka</span>–women and wealth. <span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–For the sake of happiness, [some] <span class="e2">chālāya</span>–study <span class="e2">śilpa</span>–the arts <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">vijñāna</span>–sciences. [31]
For the sake of happiness, some run after women and wealth, and others pursue the arts and sciences.
সুখ-লাগি সুখ ছাড়ে ক্লেশ শিক্ষা করে ।<br />সুখ-লাগি অর্ণব মধ্যেতে ডুবি মরে ॥৩২॥
sukha-lāgi sukha chhāḍe kleśa śikṣā kare<br />sukha-lāgi arṇava madhyete ḍubi mare [32]
<span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–For the sake of happiness, [some] <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–give up <span class="e2">sukha</span>–on happiness [and] <span class="e2">śikṣā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–learn <span class="e2">kleśa</span>–to be miserable. <span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–For the sake of happiness, [some] <span class="e2">ḍubi</span> <span class="e2">mare</span>–drown [themselves] <span class="e2">madhyete</span>–in <span class="e2">arṇava</span>–the ocean. [32]
For the sake of happiness, some give up on happiness and learn to be miserable, and others drown themselves in the ocean.
নিত্যানন্দ বলে ডাকি’ দুহাত তুলিয়া ।<br />“এস জীব কর্ম্ম-জ্ঞান-সঙ্কট ছাড়িয়া ॥৩৩॥
nityānanda bale ḍāki’ duhāta tuliyā<br />“esa jīva karma-jñāna-saṅkaṭa chhāḍiyā [33]
<span class="e2">duhāta</span> <span class="e2">tuliyā</span>–Raising [His] arms, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">ḍāki’ bale</span>–calls, <span class="e2">“jīva</span>–“O souls! <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–Give up <span class="e2">karma-jñāna-saṅkaṭa</span>–the misery of exploitation and renunciation, [and] <span class="e2">esa</span>–come [with Me]! [33]
Raising His arms, Nityānanda calls, “O souls! Give up the misery of exploitation and renunciation, and come with Me!
সুখ-লাগি চেষ্টা তব আমি তাহা দিব ।<br />তার বিনিময়ে আমি কিছু না লইব ॥৩৪॥
sukha-lāgi cheṣṭā tava āmi tāhā diba<br />tāra vinimaye āmi kichhu nā la-iba [34]
<span class="e2">tava cheṣṭā (haya)</span>–You are searching <span class="e2">sukha-lāgi</span>–for happiness. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">diba</span>–will give <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that [to you, and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">la-iba nā</span>–will not take <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–anything <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">vinimaye</span>–in return for it. [34]
“You are searching for happiness. I will give that to you, and I will not take anything from you in return.
কষ্ট নাই ব্যয় নাই না পাবে যাতনা ।<br />‘শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ’ বলি’ নাচ নাহিক ভাবনা ॥৩৫॥
kaṣṭa nāi vyaya nāi nā pābe yātanā<br />‘śrī-gaurāṅga’ bali’ nācha nāhika bhāvanā [35]
<span class="e2">nāi</span>–There will be no <span class="e2">kaṣṭa</span>–trouble. <span class="e2">nāi</span>–There will be no <span class="e2">vyaya</span>–loss. <span class="e2">pābe nā</span>–You will not undergo <span class="e2">yātanā</span>–pain. <span class="e2">bali’</span>–Chant <span class="e2">‘śrī-gaurāṅga’</span>–‘Śrī Gaurāṅga’ [and] <span class="e2">nācha</span>–dance <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–without <span class="e2">bhāvanā</span>–concern. [35]
“You will not undergo any trouble, loss, or pain. Simply chant, ‘Śrī Gaurāṅga’ and dance without a care.
যে সুখ আমি ত দিব তার নাই সম ।<br />সর্ব্বদা বিমলানন্দ নাহি তার ভ্রম” ॥৩৬॥
ye sukha āmi ta diba tāra nāi sama<br />sarvadā vimalānanda nāhi tāra bhrama” [36]
<span class="e2">ye</span>–The <span class="e2">sukha</span>–happiness <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">diba</span>–will give [you] <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–has no <span class="e2">sama</span>–equal. [It is] <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–eternal, <span class="e2">vimalānanda</span>–pure joy. <span class="e2">tāra</span>–Within it <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">bhrama”</span>–illusion.” [36]
“The happiness I will give you is unparalleled. It is pure, eternal joy, free from all illusion.”
এই রূপে প্রেম যাচে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />অভাগা করম দোষে তাহা নাহি চায় ॥৩৭॥
ei rūpe prema yāche nityānanda-rāya<br />abhāgā karama-doṣe tāhā nāhi chāya [37]
<span class="e2">ei rūpe</span>–In this way, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">yāche</span>–begs [everyone] to accept <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love, [but] <span class="e2">abhāgā</span>–the unfortunate, <span class="e2">karama-doṣe</span>–as a result of [their] sins, <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not <span class="e2">chāya</span>–want <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–it. [37]
In this way, Nityānanda Prabhu begs everyone to accept divine love, but the unfortunate, as a result of their sins, do not want it.
“গৌরাঙ্গ নিতাই” যেই বলে একবার ।<br />অনন্ত করম-দোষ অন্ত হয় তার ॥৩৮॥
“gaurāṅga nitāi” yei bale eka-bara<br />ananta karama-doṣa anta haya tāra [38]
<span class="e2">ananta</span> <span class="e2">karama-doṣa</span>–The unlimited sins <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of anyone who <span class="e2">eka-bara</span>–once <span class="e2">bale</span>–chants, <span class="e2">“gaurāṅga</span>–“Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">nitāi”</span>–Nitāi!” <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">anta</span>–destroyed. [38]
The unlimited sins of anyone who once chants, “Gaurāṅga! Nitāi!”are destroyed.
আর এক গূঢ় কথা শুন সর্ব্বজন ।<br />কলিজীবে যোগ্যবস্তু গৌরলীলা-ধন ॥৩৯॥
āra eka gūḍha kathā śuna sarva-jana<br />kali-jīve yogya-vastu gaura-līlā-dhana [39]
<span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–Everyone, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–please listen [to] <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">eka</span>–another <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">kathā</span>–subject. <span class="e2">dhana</span>–The wealth <span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–of Gaura’s Pastimes [is] <span class="e2">yogya-vastu</span>–something appropriate for <span class="e2">kali-jīve</span>–the souls of Kali-yuga. [39]
Everyone, please listen to another confidential subject. The wealth of Gaura’s Pastimes is appropriate for the souls of Kali-yuga.
গৌরহরি রাধা-কৃষ্ণরূপে বৃন্দাবনে ।<br />নিত্যকাল বিলাস করয়ে সখী-সনে ॥৪০॥
gaurahari rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpe vṛndāvane<br />nitya-kāla vilāsa karaye sakhī-sane [40]
<span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari, <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpe</span>–as Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">vilāsa karaye</span>–plays <span class="e2">sakhī-sane</span>–with the sakhīs <span class="e2">nitya-kāla</span>–eternally <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–in Vṛndāvan. [40]
Gaurahari, as Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, plays with the sakhīs eternally in Vṛndāvan.
শাস্ত্রেতে জানিল জীব ব্রজলীলাতত্ত্ব ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ-নিত্যলীলা ব্রজের মহত্ত্ব ॥৪১॥
śāstrete jānila jīva vraja-līlā-tattva<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-nitya-līlā vrajera mahattva [41]
<span class="e2">śāstrete</span>–Through the scriptures, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–the souls <span class="e2">jānila</span>–understood <span class="e2">vraja-līlā-tattva</span>–the nature of the Pastimes in Vraja. They understood <span class="e2">mahattva</span>–the greatness <span class="e2">vrajera</span>–of Vraja [and] <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-nitya-līlā</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa’s eternal Pastimes [there]. [41]
Through the scriptures, the souls understood the nature of Pastimes in Vraja, and the greatness of Vraja and Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa’s eternal Pastimes there.
কৃষ্ণনাম কৃষ্ণধাম মাহাত্ম্য অপার ।<br />শাস্ত্রের দ্বারায় জানে সকল সংসার ॥৪২॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma kṛṣṇa-dhāma māhātmya apāra<br />śāstrera dvārāya jāne sakala saṁsāra [42]
<span class="e2">śāstrera dvārāya</span>–Through the scriptures, <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the whole world <span class="e2">jāne</span>–understood <span class="e2">apāra</span>–the unlimited <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–glories <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–of Kṛṣṇa’s Name [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-dhāma</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s abode. [42]
Through the scriptures, the whole world understood the unlimited glories of Kṛṣṇa’s Name and Kṛṣṇa’s abode.
তবু কৃষ্ণ-প্রেম সাধারণে নাহি পায় ।<br />ইহার কারণ কিবা চিন্তহ হিয়ায় ॥৪৩॥
tabu kṛṣṇa-prema sādhāraṇe nāhi pāya<br />ihāra kāraṇa kibā chintaha hiyāya [43]
<span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, [souls] <span class="e2">sādhāraṇe</span>–in general, <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–divine love for Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">kibā</span>–What [is] <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–the reason <span class="e2">ihāra</span>–for this? <span class="e2">chintaha</span>–Consider [it] <span class="e2">hiyāya</span>–within your heart. [43]
Still, in general, souls did not attain divine love for Kṛṣṇa. What is the reason for this? Consider it within your heart.
ইহাতে আছে ত এক গূঢ়তত্ত্ব-সার ।<br />মায়ামুগ্ধ জীব তাহা না করে বিচার ॥৪৪॥
ihāte āchhe ta eka gūḍha-tattva-sāra<br />māyā-mugdha jīva tāhā nā kare vichāra [44]
<span class="e2">ihāte</span>–In this regard, <span class="e2">āchhe</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–there is <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">gūḍha-tattva-sāra</span>–highly confidential subject <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">māyā-mugdha</span>–bewildered by Māyā <span class="e2">vichāra kare nā</span>–do not consider. [44]
In this regard, there is a highly confidential subject that souls bewildered by Māyā do not consider.
বহু জন্ম কৃষ্ণ ভজি’ প্রেম নাহি হয় ।<br />অপরাধ-পুঞ্জ তার আছয় নিশ্চয় ॥৪৫॥
bahu janma kṛṣṇa bhaji’ prema nāhi haya<br />aparādha-puñja tāra āchhaya niśchaya [45]
[When souls] <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">bahu janma</span>–for many births [but] <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–do not develop <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love, [then] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">āchhaya</span>–they have made <span class="e2">aparādha-puñja</span>–offences. [45]
When souls serve Kṛṣṇa for many births but do not develop divine love, then certainly they have made offences.
অপরাধশূন্য হয়ে লয় কৃষ্ণনাম ।<br />তবে জীব কৃষ্ণপ্রেম লভে অবিরাম ॥৪৬॥
aparādha-śūnya haye laya kṛṣṇa-nāma<br />tabe jīva kṛṣṇa-prema labhe avirāma [46]
[When] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls, <span class="e2">aparādha-śūnya haye</span>–free from offences, <span class="e2">laya</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then [they] <span class="e2">avirāma</span>–quickly <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–divine love for Kṛṣṇa. [46]
When souls, free from offences, chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, they quickly attain divine love for Kṛṣṇa.
শ্রীচৈতন্য-অবতারে বড় বিলক্ষণ ।<br />অপরাধসত্ত্বে জীব লভে প্রেমধন ॥৪৭॥
śrī-chaitanya-avatāre baḍa vilakṣaṇa<br />aparādha-sattve jīva labhe prema-dhana [47]
<span class="e2">baḍa</span>–The special <span class="e2">vilakṣaṇa</span>–characteristic <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-avatāre</span>–of Śrī Chaitanya’s descent [is that] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">prema-dhana</span>–the wealth of divine love [even] <span class="e2">aparādha-sattve</span>–while they are offensive. [47]
The special characteristic of Śrī Chaitanya’s Pastimes is that souls attain the wealth of divine love even while they commit offences.
“নিতাই চৈতন্য” বলি’ যেই জীব ডাকে ।<br />সুবিমল কৃষ্ণপ্রেম অন্বেষয়ে তাকে ॥৪৮॥
“nitāi chaitanya” bali’ yei jīva ḍāke<br />suvimala kṛṣṇa-prema anveṣaye tāke [48]
<span class="e2">suvimala</span>–Pure <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–divine love for Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">anveṣaye</span>–searches <span class="e2">tāke yei jīva</span>–for souls who <span class="e2">bali’ ḍāke</span>–call out <span class="e2">“nitāi chaitanya”</span>–“Nitāi! Chaitanya!”<span class="e2"> </span>[48]
Pure divine love for Kṛṣṇa searches for souls who call out “Nitāi-Chaitanya!”
অপরাধ বাধা তার কিছু নাহি করে ।<br />নিরমল কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে তার আঁখি ঝরে ॥৪৯॥
aparādha bādhā tāra kichhu nāhi kare<br />niramala kṛṣṇa-preme tāra ā̐khi jhare [49]
<span class="e2">aparādha</span>–Offences <span class="e2">bādhā kare kichhu nāhi</span>–do not at all obstruct <span class="e2">tāra</span>–them, [and] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">ā̐khi</span>–eyes <span class="e2">jhare</span>–cry <span class="e2">niramala kṛṣṇa-preme</span>–with pure divine love for Kṛṣṇa. [49]
Offences do not obstruct such souls, and their eyes cry with pure love for Kṛṣṇa.
স্বল্পকালে অপরাধ আপনি পলায় ।<br />হৃদয় শোধিত হয় প্রেম বাড়ে তায় ॥৫০॥
svalpa-kāle aparādha āpani palāya<br />hṛdaya śodhita haya prema bāḍe tāya [50]
<span class="e2">svalpa-kāle</span>–Within a short time, <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">palāya</span>–leave <span class="e2">āpani</span>–on their own. [The souls’] <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">śodhita</span>–purified, [and] <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love <span class="e2">bāḍe</span>–develops <span class="e2">tāya</span>–within them. [50]
Within a short time, offences leave on their own. The souls’ hearts become purified, and divine love develops within them.
কলিজীবের অপরাধ অসংখ্য দুর্ব্বার ।<br />গৌরনাম বিনা তার নাহিক উদ্ধার ॥৫১॥
kali-jīvera aparādha asaṅkhya durvāra<br />gaura-nāma vinā tāra nāhika uddhāra [51]
<span class="e2">aparādha</span>–The offences <span class="e2">kali-jīvera</span>–of the souls in Kali-yuga [are] <span class="e2">asaṅkhya</span>–unlimited [and] <span class="e2">durvāra</span>–unavoidable. <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–There is no <span class="e2">uddhāra</span>–deliverance <span class="e2">tāra</span>–for them <span class="e2">vinā</span>–without <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura. [51]
The offences of the souls in Kali-yuga are unlimited and unavoidable. There is no deliverance for them without the Name of Gaura.
অতএব গৌর বিনা কলিতে উপায় ।<br />না দেখি কোথাও আর শাস্ত্র ফুকারয় ॥৫২॥
ataeva gaura vinā kalite upāya<br />nā dekhi kothāo āra śāstra phukāraya [52]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">kalite</span>–in Kali-yuga, <span class="e2">dekhi nā</span>–I do not see <span class="e2">upāya</span>–any way <span class="e2">vinā</span>–without <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">kothāo</span>–anywhere, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">phukāraya</span>–proclaim [this]. [52]
Thus, in Kali-yuga, I do not see any way without Gaura, and the scriptures proclaim this.
নবদ্বীপে গৌরচন্দ্র হইল উদয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপ সর্ব্বতীর্থ অবতংস হয় ॥৫৩॥
navadvīpe gaurachandra ha-ila udaya<br />navadvīpa sarva-tīrtha avataṁsa haya [53]
<span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–appeared <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">avataṁsa</span>–the crown <span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha</span>–of all the holy places. [53]
Gaurachandra appeared in Nabadwīp, the crown atop all the holy places.
অন্য তীর্থে অপরাধী দণ্ডের ভাজন ।<br />নবদ্বীপে অপরাধ সদাই মার্জ্জন ॥৫৪॥
anya tīrthe aparādhī daṇḍera bhājana<br />navadvīpe aparādha sadāi mārjana [54]
<span class="e2">anya tīrthe</span>–In other holy places, <span class="e2">aparādhī</span>–offenders [are] <span class="e2">bhājana</span>–recipients <span class="e2">daṇḍera</span>–of punishment, [but] <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences [are] <span class="e2">sadāi</span>–always <span class="e2">mārjana</span>–forgiven. [54]
In other holy places, offenders are punished, but in Nabadwīp offences are always forgiven.
তার সাক্ষী জগাই-মাধাই দুই ভাই ।<br />অপরাধ করি’ পাইল চৈতন্য-নিতাই ॥৫৫॥
tāra sākṣī jagāi-mādhāi dui bhāi<br />aparādha kari’ pāila chaitanya-nitāi [55]
<span class="e2">dui</span>–The two <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brothers <span class="e2">jagāi-mādhāi</span>–Jagāi and Mādhāi [are] <span class="e2">sākṣī</span>–evidence <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of this. [They] <span class="e2">aparādha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–committed offences [but] <span class="e2">pāila</span>–attained <span class="e2">chaitanya-nitāi</span>–Nitāi and Chaitanya. [55]
The brothers Jagāi and Mādhāi are evidence of this. They committed offences but attained Nitāi and Chaitanya.
অন্যান্য তীর্থের কথা রাখ ভাই দূরে ।<br />অপরাধী দৈত্য দণ্ড পায় ব্রজপুরে ॥৫৬॥
anyānya tīrthera kathā rākha bhāi dūre<br />aparādhī daitya daṇḍa pāya vraja-pure [56]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">rākha dūre</span>–Let alone <span class="e2">kathā</span>–talk <span class="e2">anyānya tīrthera</span>–of other holy places, <span class="e2">aparādhī</span>–offenders [and] <span class="e2">daitya</span>–demons <span class="e2">daṇḍa pāya</span>–are punished <span class="e2">vraja-pure</span>–in the abode of Vraja. [56]
Brother! Let alone other holy places, offenders and demons are punished even in Vraja.
নবদ্বীপে শত শত অপরাধ করি’ ।<br />অনায়াসে নিতাই কৃপায় যায় তরি’ ॥৫৭॥
navadvīpe śata śata aparādha kari’<br />anāyāse nitāi kṛpāya yāya tari’ [57]
<span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–In Nabadwīp, [souls who] <span class="e2">kari’</span>–commit <span class="e2">śata śata</span>–hundreds and hundreds <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–of offences <span class="e2">tari’ yāya</span>–are delivered <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">nitāi kṛpāya</span>–by the mercy of Nitāi. [57]
In Nabadwīp, souls who commit hundreds and hundreds of offences are easily delivered by the mercy of Nitāi.
হেন নবদ্বীপধাম যে গৌড়মণ্ডলে ।<br />ধন্য ধন্য সেই দেশ ঋষিগণ বলে ॥৫৮॥
hena navadvīpa-dhāma ye gauḍa-maṇḍale<br />dhanya dhanya sei deśa ṛṣi-gaṇa bale [58]
<span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–The sages <span class="e2">bale</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">ye sei</span>–the <span class="e2">deśa</span>–land <span class="e2">hena navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–of Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">gauḍa-maṇḍale</span>–in the district of Gauḍa [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span> <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–most glorious. [58]
The sages say that the land of Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām in Śrī Gauḍa Maṇḍal is most glorious.
হেন নবদ্বীপে ভাই যাঁহার বসতি ।<br />বড় ভাগ্যবান সেই লভে কৃষ্ণ-রতি ॥৫৯॥
hena navadvīpe bhāi yā̐hāra vasati<br />baḍa bhāgyavāna sei labhe kṛṣṇa-rati [59]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">yā̐hāra</span>–souls whose <span class="e2">vasati</span>–residence [is] <span class="e2">hena navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp [are] <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–very <span class="e2">bhāgyavāna</span>–fortunate. <span class="e2">sei</span>–They<span class="e2"> labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-rati</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa. [59]
Brother, souls who reside in Nabadwīp are very fortunate. They attain devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
নবদ্বীপে যেবা কভু করয় গমন ।<br />সর্ব্ব-অপরাধ মুক্ত হয় সেই জন ॥৬০॥
navadvīpe yebā kabhu karaya gamana<br />sarva-aparādha mukta haya sei jana [60]
<span class="e2">yebā sei jana</span>–Souls who <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–once <span class="e2">gamana karaya</span>–visit <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">mukta</span>–freed <span class="e2">sarva-aparādha</span>–from all offences. [60]
Souls who once visit Nabadwīp are freed from all offences.
সর্ব্বতীর্থ ভ্রমিয়া তৈর্থিক যাহা পায় ।<br />নবদ্বীপ-স্মরণে সেই লাভ শাস্ত্রে গায় ॥৬১॥
sarva-tīrtha bhramiyā tairthika yāhā pāya<br />navadvīpa-smaraṇe sei lābha śāstre gāya [61]
<span class="e2">śāstre</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">navadvīpa-smaraṇe</span>–by remembering Nabadwīp <span class="e2">lābha</span>–you attain <span class="e2">sei yāhā</span>–that which <span class="e2">tairthika</span>–pilgrims <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">bhramiyā</span>–by visiting <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–all the holy places. [61]
The scriptures say that by remembering Nabadwīp you attain that which pilgrims attain by visiting all the other holy places.
নবদ্বীপ দরশন করে যেই জন ।<br />জন্মে জন্মে লভে সেই কৃষ্ণপ্রেমধন ॥৬২॥
navadvīpa daraśana kare yei jana<br />janme janme labhe sei kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana [62]
<span class="e2">sei yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Souls who <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–see <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana</span>–the wealth of divine love for Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">janme janme</span>–birth after birth. [62]
Souls who see Nabadwīp attain the wealth of divine love for Kṛṣṇa birth after birth.
কর্ম্ম-বুদ্ধি-যোগেও যে নবদ্বীপে যায় ।<br />নর জন্ম আর সেই জন নাহি পায় ॥৬৩॥
karma-buddhi-yogeo ye navadvīpe yāya<br />nara janma āra sei jana nāhi pāya [63]
<span class="e2">sei ye jana</span>–Souls who <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp <span class="e2">karma-buddhi-yogeo</span>–even with a materialistic motivation <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not <span class="e2">pāya</span>–get <span class="e2">nara</span>–a human <span class="e2">janma</span>–birth <span class="e2">āra</span>–again. [63]
Even souls who go to Nabadwīp with a materialistic motivation do not take a human birth again.
নবদ্বীপ ভ্রমিতে সে পদে পদে পায় ।<br />কোটি অশ্বমেধ ফল সর্ব্ব-শাস্ত্রে গায় ॥৬৪॥
navadvīpa bhramite se pade pade pāya<br />koṭi aśvamedha phala sarva-śāstre gāya [64]
<span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">śāstre</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">bhramite</span>–while walking <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–through Nabadwīp <span class="e2">se</span>–they <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">phala</span>–the result <span class="e2">koṭi aśvamedha</span>–of ten million horse sacrifices <span class="e2">pade pade</span>–with each step. [64]
All the scriptures say that while walking through Nabadwīp, such souls attain the result of ten million horse sacrifices with each step.
নবদ্বীপে বসি’ যেই মন্ত্র জপ করে ।<br />শ্রীমন্ত্র চৈতন্য হয়, অনায়াসে তরে ॥৬৫॥
navadvīpe vasi’ yei mantra japa kare<br />śrī-mantra chaitanya haya, anāyāse tare [65]
<span class="e2">yei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–reside <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp and <span class="e2">japa kare</span>–chant [their] <span class="e2">mantra</span>–mantra— [that] <span class="e2">śrī-mantra</span>–holy mantra <span class="e2">chaitanya haya</span>–comes alive [and] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">tare</span>–delivers [them]. [65]
Those who reside in Nabadwīp and chant their mantra—that holy mantra comes alive and easily delivers them.
অন্য তীর্থে যোগী দশবর্ষে লভে যাহা ।<br />নবদ্বীপে তিন রাত্রে সাধি’ পায় তাহা ॥৬৬॥
anya tīrthe yogī daśa-varṣe labhe yāhā<br />navadvīpe tina rātre sādhi’ pāya tāhā [66]
<span class="e2">tāhā yāhā</span>–That which <span class="e2">yogī</span>–yogīs <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">daśa-varṣe</span>–after ten years <span class="e2">anya tīrthe</span>–in other holy places [is] <span class="e2">sādhi’</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attained <span class="e2">tina rātre</span>–in three nights <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. [66]
That which yogīs attain after ten years in other holy places is attained in three nights in Nabadwīp.
অন্য তীর্থে ব্রহ্মজ্ঞানে যেই মুক্তি হয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপে ভাগীরথী স্নানে তা ঘটয় ॥৬৭॥
anya tīrthe brahma-jñāne yei mukti haya<br />navadvīpe bhāgīrathī snāne tā ghaṭaya [67]
<span class="e2">tā yei mukti</span>–The liberation <span class="e2">haya</span>–attained <span class="e2">brahma-jñāne</span>–through knowledge of Brahma <span class="e2">anya tīrthe</span>–in other holy places [is] <span class="e2">ghaṭaya</span>–attained <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">snāne</span>–by bathing <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–in the Gaṅgā. [67]
The liberation attained through knowledge of Brahma in other holy places is attained in Nabadwīp simply by bathing in the Gaṅgā.
সালোক্য-সারূপ্য-সার্ষ্টি-সামীপ্য-নির্ব্বাণ ।<br />নবদ্বীপে মুমুক্ষু লভয় বিনা জ্ঞান ॥৬৮॥
sālokya-sārūpya-sārṣṭi-sāmīpya-nirvāṇa<br />navadvīpe mumukṣu labhaya vinā jñāna [68]
<span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–In Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">vinā</span>–without <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge of Brahma, <span class="e2">mumukṣu</span>–seekers of liberation <span class="e2">labhaya</span>–attain <span class="e2">sālokya</span>–residence in the Lord’s abode, <span class="e2">sārūpya</span>–a form like the Lord’s, <span class="e2">sārṣṭi</span>–opulence like the Lord’s, <span class="e2">sāmīpya</span>–association with the Lord, [and] <span class="e2">nirvāṇa</span>–absorption into the effulgence or body of the Lord. [68]
In Nabadwīp, even without knowledge of Brahma, seekers of liberation can attain residence in the Lord’s abode, a form like the Lord’s, opulence like the Lord’s, association with the Lord, and absorption into the Lord.
নবদ্বীপে শুদ্ধভক্ত চরণে পড়িয়া ।<br />ভুক্তি মুক্তি সদা রহে দাসী রূপ হৈয়া ॥৬৯॥
navadvīpe śuddha-bhakta charaṇe paḍiyā<br />bhukti mukti sadā rahe dāsī rūpa haiyā [69]
<span class="e2">bhukti</span>–Enjoyment [and] <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–bow <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta</span>–of pure devotees <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">rahe</span>–remain [with them] <span class="e2">rūpa haiyā</span>–as <span class="e2">dāsī</span>–maidservants. [69]
Enjoyment and liberation personified bow at the feet of the pure devotees in Nabadwīp and always wait upon them as maidservants.
ভক্তগণ লাথি মারি’ সে দুয়ে তাড়ায় ।<br />ভক্তপদ ছাড়ি’ দাসী তবু না পলায় ॥৭০॥
bhakta-gaṇa lāthi māri’ se duye tāḍāya<br />bhakta-pada chhāḍi’ dāsī tabu nā palāya [70]
<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">lāthi māri’</span>–kick <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">duye</span>–them [and] <span class="e2">tāḍāya</span>–drive [them] away <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">dāsī</span>–these maidservants <span class="e2">nā</span>–do not <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–give up <span class="e2">bhakta-pada</span>–the feet of the devotees [or] <span class="e2">palāya</span>–run away. [70]
Although devotees kick them and drive them away, these maidservants do not leave the feet of the devotees or run away.
শতবর্ষ সপ্ততীর্থে মিলে যাহা ভাই ।<br />নবদ্বীপে একরাত্র বাসে তাহা পাই ॥৭১॥
śata-varṣa sapta-tīrthe mile yāhā bhāi<br />navadvīpe eka-rātra vāse tāhā pāi [71]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">vāse</span>–by spending <span class="e2">eka-rātra</span>–one night <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, [souls] <span class="e2">pāi</span>–attain <span class="e2">tāhā yāhā</span>–that which [someone] <span class="e2">mile</span>–gains [by residing] <span class="e2">sapta-tīrthe</span>–in the seven holy places <span class="e2">śata-varṣa</span>–for one hundred years. [71]
Brother, by spending one night in Nabadwīp, souls attain that which is gained by residing in the seven principal holy places for one hundred years.
হেন নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />কলিতে আশ্রয় করি’ জীব হয় পার ॥৭২॥
hena navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />kalite āśraya kari’ jīva haya pāra [72]
<span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [is,] <span class="e2">hena</span>–as such, <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the best <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma</span>–of all abodes. <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Souls [who] <span class="e2">āśraya kari’</span>–take shelter [here] <span class="e2">kalite</span>–in Kali-yuga <span class="e2">pāra haya</span>–are delivered. [72]
Thus, Nabadwīp Dhām is the best of all abodes. Souls who take shelter here in Kali-yuga are delivered.
তারক পারক বিদ্যাদ্বয় অবিরত ।<br />নবদ্বীপ বাসিগণে সেবে রীতিমত ॥৭৩॥
tāraka pāraka vidyā-dvaya avirata<br />navadvīpa-vāsi-gaṇe seve rīti-mata [73]
<span class="e2">vidyā-dvaya</span>–The two forms of knowledge— <span class="e2">tāraka</span>–knowledge which liberates (the soul from anarthas) [and] <span class="e2">pāraka</span>–knowledge which fulfils (the soul’s desire for divine love)— <span class="e2">avirata</span>–constantly [and] <span class="e2">rīti-mata</span>–perfectly <span class="e2">seve</span>–serve <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsi-gaṇe</span>–the residents of Nabadwīp. [73]
The two forms of knowledge—that which liberates and that which nourishes—constantly and perfectly serve the residents of Nabadwīp.
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-পদছায়া যার আশ ।<br />সে ভক্তিবিনোদ গায় পাইয়া উল্লাস ॥৭৪॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā yāra āśa<br />se bhakti-vinoda gāya pāiyā ullāsa [74]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sings [and] <span class="e2">ullāsa pāiyā</span>–rejoices. [74]
Bhakti Vinod, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, sings the glories of Nadia and rejoices.

Chapter Two
The Nature and Dimensions of the Dhām
জয় জয় নবদ্বীপচন্দ্র শচীসুত ।<br />জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দরায় অবধূত ॥১॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa-chandra śachī-suta<br />jaya jaya nityānanda-rāya avadhūta [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śachī-suta</span>–to the son of Śachī, Śrī Chaitanya, <span class="e2">navadvīpa-chandra</span>–the moon of Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">avadhūta</span>–to the renunciant <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī, the moon of Nabadwīp! All glory to the avadhūt Śrī Nityānanda Rāy!
জয় জয় নবদ্বীপ সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />সে ধামের তত্ত্ব বর্ণে সাধ্য আছে কার ॥২॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />se dhāmera tattva varṇe sādhya āchhe kāra [2]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–to Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–the best of all abodes! <span class="e2">kāra</span>–Who <span class="e2">sādhya varṇe</span>–can describe <span class="e2">tattva</span>–glory <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">dhāmera</span>–of this abode? [2]
All glory to Nabadwīp, the best of all abodes! Who can describe its glory?
নবদ্বীপধাম গৌড়মণ্ডল ভিতরে ।<br />জাহ্নবী-সেবিত হয়ে সদা শোভা করে ॥৩॥
navadvīpa-dhāma gauḍa-maṇḍala bhitare<br />jāhnavī-sevita haye sadā śobhā kare [3]
<span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–shines <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternally <span class="e2">bhitare</span>–within <span class="e2">gauḍa-maṇḍala</span>–the district of Gauḍa, [and] <span class="e2">haye</span>–is <span class="e2">sevita</span>–served <span class="e2">jāhnavī</span>–by Gaṅgā Devī. [3]
Nabadwīp Dhām shines eternally within Gauḍa Maṇḍal, and is served by Gaṅgā Devī.
এ গৌড়মণ্ডল এক বিংশতি যোজন ।<br />মধ্যভাগে গঙ্গাদেবী রহে অনুক্ষণ ॥৪॥
e gauḍa-maṇḍala eka viṁśati yojana<br />madhya-bhāge gaṅgā-devī rahe anukṣaṇa [4]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">gauḍa-maṇḍala</span>–The district of Gauḍa [is] <span class="e2">eka viṁśati yojana</span>–one hundred and sixty-eight miles [in circumference]. <span class="e2">gaṅgā-devī</span>–Gaṅgā Devī <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa rahe</span>–continuously flows <span class="e2">madhya-bhāge</span>–throughout it. [4]
Gauḍa Maṇḍal is one hundred and sixty-eight miles in circumference. Gaṅgā Devī continuously flows throughout it.
শতদল পদ্মময় মণ্ডল আকার ।<br />মধ্যভাগে নবদ্বীপ অতি শোভা তার ॥৫॥
śata-dala padmamaya maṇḍala ākāra<br />madhya-bhāge navadvīpa ati śobhā tāra [5]
<span class="e2">maṇḍala</span>–Gauḍa Maṇḍal’s <span class="e2">ākāra</span>–form [is] <span class="e2">śata-dala padmamaya</span>–made up of a one-hundred-petalled lotus, [and] <span class="e2">tāra madhya-bhāge</span>–at its centre [is the] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. [5]
Gauḍa Maṇḍal is a one-hundred-petalled lotus, and at its centre is the extremely beautiful Nabadwīp.
পঞ্চক্রোশ হয় তার কেশর আধার ।<br />পরিমলপূর্ণ পুষ্প যোজন চত্বার ॥৬॥
pañcha-krośa haya tāra keśara ādhāra<br />parimala-pūrṇa puṣpa yojana chatvāra [6]
<span class="e2">tāra</span>–Its <span class="e2">keśara ādhāra</span>–whorl <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">pañcha-krośa</span>–ten miles, [and its] <span class="e2">parimala-pūrṇa</span>–fragrant <span class="e2">puṣpa</span>–bloom [is] <span class="e2">chatvāra yojana</span>–thirty-two miles. [6]
In circumference, its whorl is ten miles in circumference, and its fragrant bloom is thirty-two miles.
বাহির পাপড়ি তার শতদল হয় ।<br />একাধিক যোজন বিংশতি বিস্তারয় ॥৭॥
bāhira pāpaḍi tāra śata-dala haya<br />ekādhika yojana viṁśati vistāraya [7]
<span class="e2">tāra</span>–Its <span class="e2">bāhira</span>–outer <span class="e2">pāpaḍi</span>–petals <span class="e2">haya</span>–form <span class="e2">śata-dala</span>–a one-hundred-petalled lotus [that] <span class="e2">vistāraya</span>–extends <span class="e2">ekādhika viṁśati yojana</span>–one hundred and sixty-eight miles. [7]
Its outer petals form a one-hundred-petalled lotus that extends for one hundred and sixty-eight miles.
মণ্ডল পরিধি হয় সেই পরিমাণ ।<br />যোজন সপ্তক ব্যাস শাস্ত্রের বিধান ॥৮॥
maṇḍala paridhi haya sei parimāṇa<br />yojana saptaka vyāsa śāstrera vidhāna [8]
<span class="e2">maṇḍala</span>–Gauḍa Maṇḍal’s <span class="e2">paridhi</span>–circumference <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">parimāṇa</span>–size. <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–The verdict <span class="e2">śāstrera</span>–of the scriptures [is that its] <span class="e2">vyāsa</span>–diameter [is] <span class="e2">saptaka yojana</span>–fifty-six miles. [8]
The circumference of Gauḍa Maṇḍal is that size. The scriptures state that its diameter is fifty-six miles.
ব্যাসার্দ্ধ প্রমাণ সার্দ্ধ তৃতীয় যোজন ।<br />মধ্যবিন্দু হৈতে তার হইবে গণন ॥৯॥
vyāsārddha pramāṇa sārddha tṛtīya yojana<br />madhya-bindu haite tāra ha-ibe gaṇana [9]
[Its] <span class="e2">vyāsārddha</span>–radius, <span class="e2">tāra</span>–which <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be <span class="e2">gaṇana</span>–measured <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">madhya-bindu</span>–the centre, <span class="e2">pramāṇa</span>–measures <span class="e2">sārddha tṛtīya yojana</span>–twenty-eight miles. [9]
Its radius, measured from its centre point, is twenty-eight miles.
মধ্যবিন্দু নবদ্বীপধাম মধ্যস্থল ।<br />যোগপীঠ হয় তাহা চিন্ময় বিমল ॥১০॥
madhya-bindu navadvīpa-dhāma madhya-sthala<br />yoga-pīṭha haya tāhā chinmaya vimala [10]
<span class="e2">madhya-bindu</span>–The centre point <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–of Nabadwīp Dhām’s <span class="e2">madhya-sthala</span>–centre <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">yoga-pīṭha</span>–the Yoga Pīṭh. <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–It [is] <span class="e2">vimala</span>–pure [and] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual. [10]
The centre of Nabadwīp Dhām is the pure, spiritual Yoga Pīṭh.
চিন্তামণিরূপ হয় এই গৌড়মণ্ডল ।<br />চিদানন্দময়-ধাম চিন্ময় সকল ॥১১॥
chintāmaṇi-rūpa haya ei gauḍa-maṇḍala<br />chid-ānandamaya-dhāma chinmaya sakala [11]
<span class="e2">ei gauḍa-maṇḍala</span>–Gauḍa Maṇḍal <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">chintāmaṇi-rūpa</span>–made of wish-fulfilling gemstone. [It is] <span class="e2">chid-ānandamaya-dhāma</span>–a spiritual, joyful abode: <span class="e2">sakala</span>–everything [within it is] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–made of spiritual energy. [11]
Śrī Gauḍa Maṇḍal is made of wish-fulfilling gemstone. It is spiritual and joyful: everything within it is made of spiritual energy.
জল ভূমি বৃক্ষ আদি সকলি চিন্ময় ।<br />সদা বিদ্যমান তথা কৃষ্ণশক্তিত্রয় ॥১২॥
jala bhūmi vṛkṣa ādi sakali chinmaya<br />sadā vidyamāna tathā kṛṣṇa-śakti-traya [12]
<span class="e2">jala</span>–The water, <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–land, <span class="e2">vṛkṣa</span>–trees, <span class="e2">ādi</span>–and so on, [are] <span class="e2">sakali</span>–all <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual. <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-śakti-traya</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s three energies (sandhinī, saṁvit, and hlādinī) <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–exist <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternally. [12]
The water, land, trees, and so on, are all spiritual. Kṛṣṇa’s three energies exist there eternally.
স্বরূপ-শক্তির সেই সন্ধিনী-প্রভাব ।<br />তার পরিণতি এই ধামের স্বভাব ॥১৩॥
svarūpa-śaktira sei sandhinī-prabhāva<br />tāra pariṇati ei dhāmera svabhāva [13]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāmera</span>–The Dhām’s <span class="e2">svabhāva</span>–nature [is] <span class="e2">pariṇati</span>–a manifestation <span class="e2">tāra sei</span>–of the <span class="e2">sandhinī-prabhāva</span>–sandhinī power <span class="e2">svarūpa-śaktira</span>–of the Lord’s personal energy. [13]
The Dhām is a manifestation of the sandhinī aspect of the Lord’s personal energy.
প্রভু-লীলা-পীঠরূপে ধাম নিত্য হয় ।<br />অচিন্ত্য শক্তির কার্য্য প্রাপঞ্চিক নয় ॥১৪॥
prabhu-līlā-pīṭha-rūpe dhāma nitya haya<br />achintya śaktira kārya prāpañchika naya [14]
<span class="e2">dhāma</span>–The Dhām <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">nitya prabhu-līlā-pīṭha-rūpe</span>–the eternal site of the Lord’s Pastimes. [It is] <span class="e2">kārya</span>–a function <span class="e2">achintya</span> <span class="e2">śaktira</span>–of [the Lord’s] inconceivable energy; <span class="e2">naya</span>–it is not <span class="e2">prāpañchika</span>–material. [14]
The Dhām is the eternal site of the Lord’s Pastimes. It is a manifestation of the Lord’s inconceivable energy; it is not material.
তবে যে এই ধামে দেখে প্রপঞ্চের সম ।<br />বদ্ধজীবে তাহে হয় অবিদ্যা-বিভ্রম ॥১৫॥
tabe ye e dhāme dekhe prapañchera sama<br />baddha-jīve tāhe haya avidyā-vibhrama [15]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Still, <span class="e2">baddha-jīve</span>–the conditioned souls— <span class="e2">tāhe ye</span>–those who <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">e dhāme</span>–the Dhām [to be] <span class="e2">sama</span>–the same <span class="e2">prapañchera</span>–as the material world— <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">avidyā-vibhrama</span>–bewildered by illusion. [15]
Still, the conditioned souls are bewildered by illusion and see the Dhām to be material.
মেঘাচ্ছন্ন চক্ষু দেখে সূর্য্য আচ্ছাদিত ।<br />দিবাকর নাহি কভু হয় মেঘাবৃত ॥১৬॥
meghāchchhanna chakṣu dekhe sūrya āchchhādita<br />divākara nāhi kabhu haya meghāvṛta [16]
<span class="e2">chakṣu</span>–Eyes <span class="e2">meghāchchhanna</span>–covered by clouds <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see [that] <span class="e2">sūrya</span>–the sun [is] <span class="e2">āchchhādita</span>–covered, [but] <span class="e2">divākara</span>–the sun <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">kabhu nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">meghāvṛta</span>–covered by clouds. [16]
Eyes covered by clouds see that the sun is covered, but the sun is never actually covered by clouds.
সেই রূপ এ গৌড়মণ্ডল চিদাকার ।<br />প্রাপঞ্চিক জন দেখে জড়ের বিকার ॥১৭॥
sei rūpa e gauḍa-maṇḍala chid-ākāra<br />prāpañchika jana dekhe jaḍera vikāra [17]
<span class="e2">sei rūpa</span>–Similarly, <span class="e2">prāpañchika jana</span>–worldly people <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">chid-ākāra</span>–the spiritual form <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">gauḍa-maṇḍala</span>–of Gauḍa Maṇḍal [to be] <span class="e2">vikāra</span>–a formation <span class="e2">jaḍera</span>–of matter. [17]
Similarly, worldly people see the spiritual form of Śrī Gauḍa Maṇḍal to be a formation of matter.
নিত্যানন্দ-কৃপা যাঁর প্রতি কভু হয় ।<br />সে দেখে আনন্দ ধাম সর্ব্বত্র চিন্ময় ॥১৮॥
nityānanda-kṛpā yā̐ra prati kabhu haya<br />se dekhe ānanda dhāma sarvatra chinmaya [18]
[But] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–once <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">kṛpā haya</span>–blesses <span class="e2">yā̐ra prati</span>–someone, <span class="e2">se</span>–they <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–the joyful, <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode <span class="e2">sarvatra</span>–everywhere. [18]
But once Nityānanda blesses someone, they see the joyful, spiritual Dhām everywhere.
গঙ্গা যমুনাদি তথা সদা বিদ্যমান ।<br />সপ্তপুরী প্রয়াগাদি আছে স্থানে স্থান ॥১৯॥
gaṅgā yamunādi tathā sadā vidyamāna<br />sapta-purī prayāgādi āchhe sthāne sthāna [19]
<span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–The Gaṅgā <span class="e2">yamunādi</span>–Yamunā, and so on <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–exist <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternally. <span class="e2">sapta-purī</span>–The seven cities (Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Māyā (Māyāpur, Haridvār), Kāśī, Kāñchī, Avantī, and Dvārakā), <span class="e2">prayāgādi</span>–Prayāg, and other holy places, <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–are present <span class="e2">sthāne sthāna</span>–throughout the Dhām. [19]
The Gaṅgā, Yamunā, and other holy rivers exist there eternally. The seven holy cities, Prayāg, and other holy places are present throughout the Dhām.
সাক্ষাৎ বৈকুণ্ঠতত্ত্ব এ গৌড়মণ্ডল ।<br />ভাগ্যবান্ জীব তাহা দেখে নিরমল ॥২০॥
sākṣāt vaikuṇṭha-tattva e gauḍa-maṇḍala<br />bhāgyavān jīva tāhā dekhe niramala [20]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">gauḍa-maṇḍala</span>–Gauḍa Maṇḍal [is] <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭha-tattva</span>–a form of Vaikuṇṭha <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span>–itself; <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–fortunate <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–thi<span class="e2">s niramala</span>–clearly. [20]
Śrī Gauḍa Maṇḍal is Vaikuṇṭha itself; fortunate souls see this clearly.
স্বরূপশক্তির ছায়া মায়া বলি’ যারে ।<br />প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় নিজ প্রভাব বিস্তারে ॥২১॥
বহির্ম্মুখ জীবচক্ষু করে আবরণ ।<br />চিদ্ধাম-প্রভাব সবে না পায় দর্শন ॥২২॥
svarūpa-śaktira chhāyā māyā bali’ yāre<br />prabhura ājñāya nija prabhāva vistāre [21]
bahirmukha jīva-chakṣu kare āvaraṇa<br />chid-dhāma-prabhāva sabe nā pāya darśana [22]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ājñāya</span>–On the order of the Lord, <span class="e2">chhāyā</span>–the shadow <span class="e2">svarūpa-śaktira</span>–of the Lord’s personal energy, <span class="e2">yāre</span> <span class="e2">bali’</span>–who is known as <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā, <span class="e2">vistāre</span>–extends <span class="e2">nija</span>–her <span class="e2">prabhāva</span>–influence [and] <span class="e2">āvaraṇa kare</span>–covers <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span> <span class="e2">jīva-chakṣu</span>–the eyes of the averse souls. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–They <span class="e2">darśana pāya nā</span>–do not see <span class="e2">prabhāva</span>–the glory <span class="e2">chid-dhāma</span>–of [the Lord’s] spiritual abode. [21<span class="e2">–</span>22]
On the order of the Lord, Māyā, the shadow of His personal energy, extends her influence and covers the eyes of the averse souls. Thus, they do not see the glory of the Lord’s spiritual abode.
এ গৌড়মণ্ডলে যাঁর বাস নিরন্তর ।<br />বড় ভাগ্যবান্ সেই সংসার ভিতর ॥২৩॥
e gauḍa-maṇḍale yā̐ra vāsa nirantara<br />baḍa bhāgyavān sei saṁsāra bhitara [23]
<span class="e2">sei yā̐ra</span>–Souls who <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–always <span class="e2">vāsa</span>–reside <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">gauḍa-maṇḍale</span>–in Gauḍa Maṇḍal [are] <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–the most <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–fortunate souls <span class="e2">saṁsāra bhitara</span>–in this world. [23]
Souls who always reside in Śrī Gauḍa Maṇḍal are the most fortunate souls in this world.
দেবগণ স্বর্গে থাকি’ দেখে সেই জনে ।<br />চতুর্ভুজ শ্যামকান্তি অপূর্ব্ব গঠনে ॥২৪॥
deva-gaṇa svarge thāki’ dekhe sei jane<br />chatur-bhuja śyāma-kānti apūrva gaṭhane [24]
<span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–The gods <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–living <span class="e2">svarge</span>–in heaven <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see [that] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–they [have] <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">chatur-bhuja</span>–four-armed <span class="e2">gaṭhane</span>–forms <span class="e2">śyāma-kānti</span>–with a cloud-like lustre. [24]
The gods living in heaven see that they have beautiful four-armed forms with a cloud-like lustre.
ষোলক্রোশ নবদ্বীপধামবাসী যত ।<br />গৌরকান্তি সদা নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনে রত ॥২৫॥
ṣola-krośa navadvīpa-dhāma-vāsī yata<br />gaura-kānti sadā nāma-saṅkīrtane rata [25]
<span class="e2">yata ṣola-krośa navadvīpa-dhāma-vāsī</span>–The residents of the thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp Dhām [have] <span class="e2">gaura-kānti</span>–a golden lustre [and are] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">rata</span>–engaged <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–in chanting the Name. [25]
The residents of the thirty-two miles of Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām have a golden lustre and are always engaged in chanting the Name.
ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবগণ অন্তরীক্ষ হৈতে ।<br />নবদ্বীপবাসীগণে পূজে নানামতে ॥২৬॥
brahmā ādi deva-gaṇe antarīkṣa haite<br />navadvīpa-vāsī-gaṇe pūje nānā-mate [26]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">antarīkṣa</span>–the heavens, <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">deva-gaṇe</span>–and the other gods <span class="e2">pūje</span>–worship <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsī-gaṇe</span>–the residents of Nabadwīp <span class="e2">nānā-mate</span>–in various ways. [26]
From the heavens, Brahmā and the other gods worship the residents of Nabadwīp in various ways.
ব্রহ্মা বলে, “কবে মোর হেন ভাগ্য হবে ।<br />নবদ্বীপে তৃণ কলেবর পাব যবে ॥২৭॥
শ্রীগৌর-চরণসেবা করে যত জন ।<br />তা সবার পদরেণু লভবি তখন ॥২৮॥
brahmā bale, “kabe mora hena bhāgya habe<br />navadvīpe tṛṇa kalevara pāba yabe [27]
śrī-gaura-charaṇa-sevā kare yata jana<br />tā sabāra pada-reṇu labhiba takhana [28]
<span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">bale</span>–says, <span class="e2">“yabe</span>–“When <span class="e2">pāba</span>–I attain <span class="e2">kalevara</span>–the form <span class="e2">tṛṇa</span>–of a blade of grass <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">labhiba</span>–I will attain <span class="e2">pada-reṇu</span>–the foot-dust <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">jana tā</span> <span class="e2">sabāra</span>–of everyone who <span class="e2">sevā kare</span>–serves <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-charaṇa</span>–Śrī Gaura’s feet. <span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">hena</span>–such <span class="e2">bhāgya</span>–fortune <span class="e2">mora habe</span>–be mine? [27<span class="e2">–</span>28]
Brahmā says, “When will I attain the fortune of becoming a blade of grass in Nabadwīp and receiving the foot dust of the servants of Śrī Gaura’s feet?
হায় মোরে গৌরচন্দ্র বঞ্চনা করিয়া ।<br />ব্রহ্মাণ্ডের অধিপতি রাখিল করিয়া ॥২৯॥
hāya more gaurachandra vañchanā kariyā<br />brahmāṇḍera adhipati rākhila kariyā [29]
<span class="e2">hāya</span>–Alas! <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">vañchanā kariyā</span>–deceived <span class="e2">more</span>–me [and] <span class="e2">kariyā</span> <span class="e2">rākhila</span>–made me <span class="e2">adhipati</span>–the emperor <span class="e2">brahmāṇḍera</span>–of the universe. [29]
“Alas! Gaurachandra deceived me and made me the emperor of the universe.
কবে মোর কর্ম্মগ্রন্থি হইবে ছেদন ।<br />অভিমান ত্যজি’ মোর শুদ্ধ হবে মন ॥৩০॥
kabe mora karma-granthi ha-ibe chhedana<br />abhimāna tyaji’ mora śuddha habe mana [30]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">karma-granthi</span>–entanglement in the reactions to my previous actions <span class="e2">chhedana ha-ibe</span>–be cut away? [When will] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–give up [its] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride [and] <span class="e2">śuddha habe</span>–become pure? [30]
“When will my entanglement in karma be cut away? When will my heart give up its pride and become pure?
অধিকার বুদ্ধি মোর কবে হবে ক্ষয় ।<br />শুদ্ধদাস হয়ে পাব গৌরপদাশ্রয়” ॥৩১॥
adhikāra buddhi mora kabe habe kṣaya<br />śuddha-dāsa haye pāba gaura padāśraya” [31]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–mentality <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–of proprietorship <span class="e2">kṣaya habe</span>–be destroyed? [When will] <span class="e2">haye</span>–I become <span class="e2">śuddha-dāsa</span>–a pure servant [and] <span class="e2">pāba</span>–attain <span class="e2">gaura-padāśraya”</span>–the shelter of Gaura’s feet?” [31]
“When will my mentality of being a master be destroyed? When will I become a pure servant and attain the shelter of Śrī Gaura’s feet?”
দেবগণ ঋষিগণ রুদ্রগণ যত ।<br />স্থানে স্থানে নবদ্বীপে বৈসে অবিরত ॥৩২॥
deva-gaṇa ṛṣi-gaṇa rudra-gaṇa yata<br />sthāne sthāne navadvīpe vaise avirata [32]
<span class="e2">yata deva-gaṇa</span>–The gods, <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–sages, [and] <span class="e2">rudra-gaṇa</span>–Rudras <span class="e2">vaise</span>–live <span class="e2">sthāne sthāne</span>–throughout <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">avirata</span>–eternally. [32]
The gods, sages, and Rudras live throughout Nabadwīp eternally.
চিরকাল তপ করি’ জীবন কাটায় ।<br />তবু নিত্যানন্দ-কৃপা সে সবে না পায় ॥৩৩॥
chira-kāla tapa kari’ jīvana kāṭāya<br />tabu nityānanda-kṛpā se sabe nā pāya [33]
<span class="e2">kāṭāya</span>–They spend [their] <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–lives <span class="e2">kari’</span>–performing <span class="e2">tapa</span>–austerities <span class="e2">chira-kāla</span>–for long periods, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">pāya nā</span>–do not receive <span class="e2">nityānanda-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of Nityānanda. [33]
They spend their lives performing austerities for long periods, but they do not receive the mercy of Nityānanda.
দেহবুদ্ধি যত দিন নাহি যায় দূরে ।<br />যত দিন দৈন্যভাব মনে নাহি স্ফূরে ॥৩৪॥
তত দিন শ্রীগৌর-নিতাই-কৃপাধন ।<br />ব্রহ্মা-শিব নাহি পায় করিয়া যতন ॥৩৫॥
deha-buddhi yata dina nāhi yāya dūre<br />yata dina dainya-bhāva mane nāhi sphūre [34]
tata dina śrī-gaura-nitāi-kṛpā-dhana<br />brahmā-śiva nāhi pāya kariyā yatana [35]
<span class="e2">yata dina tata dina</span>–As long as [their] <span class="e2">deha-buddhi</span>–identification with the body <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–does not <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away, <span class="e2">yata dina (tata dina)</span>–so long as <span class="e2">dainya-bhāva</span>–a mood of humility <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–does not <span class="e2">sphūre</span>–appear <span class="e2">mane</span>–in [their] hearts, <span class="e2">brahmā-śiva</span>–Brahmā and Śiva <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-nitāi-kṛpā-dhana</span>–the wealth of Gaura and Nitāi’s mercy [although they] <span class="e2">yatana kariyā</span>–strive [for it]. [34<span class="e2">–</span>35]
As long as their identification with the body does not go away and humility does not appear within their hearts, even Brahmā and Śiva do not attain the wealth of Gaura and Nitāi’s mercy, although they strive for it.
এই সব কথা আগে হইবে প্রকাশ ।<br />যত্ন করি’ শুন ভাই করিয়া বিশ্বাস ॥৩৬॥
ei saba kathā āge ha-ibe prakāśa<br />yatna kari’ śuna bhāi kariyā viśvāsa [36]
<span class="e2">ei saba</span>–All these <span class="e2">kathā</span>–points <span class="e2">prakāśa ha-ibe</span>–will be described <span class="e2">āge</span>–ahead. <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">viśvāsa kariyā</span>–Faithfully [and] <span class="e2">yatna kari’</span>–carefully <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen. [36]
All these points will be described ahead. Brother! Faithfully and carefully listen.
এই সব বিষয়ে ভাই তর্ক পরিহর ।<br />তর্ক সে অপার্থ অতি অমঙ্গলকর ॥৩৭॥
ei saba viṣaye bhāi tarka parihara<br />tarka se apārtha ati amaṅgala-kara [37]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">parihara</span>–Give up <span class="e2">tarka</span>–argument <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba viṣaye</span>–in these matters— <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">apārtha tarka</span>–inappropriate argument [is] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">amaṅgala-kara</span>–inauspicious. [37]
Brother! Give up argument in these matters—inappropriate argument is very inauspicious.
শ্রীচৈতন্য-লীলা হয় গভীর সাগর ।<br />মোচাখোলা-রূপ তর্ক তথায় ফাঁপর ॥৩৮॥
śrī-chaitanya-līlā haya gabhīra sāgara<br />mochā-kholā-rūpa tarka tathāya phā̐para [38]
<span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-līlā</span>–The Pastimes of Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">haya</span>–are [a] <span class="e2">gabhīra</span>–deep <span class="e2">sāgara</span>–ocean. <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–There, <span class="e2">tarka</span>–argument, <span class="e2">mochā-kholā-rūpa</span>–like a banana flower’s husk, [is] <span class="e2">phā̐para</span>–troublesome. [38]
The Pastimes of Śrī Chaitanya are a deep ocean. Argument over them, like a banana flower’s husk, is simply troublesome.
তর্ক করি’ এ সংসার তরিতে যে চায় ।<br />বিফল তাহার চেষ্টা কিছুই না পায় ॥৩৯॥
tarka kari’ e saṁsāra tarite ye chāya<br />viphala tāhāra cheṣṭā kichhui nā pāya [39]
<span class="e2">cheṣṭā</span>–The endeavour <span class="e2">tāhāra ye</span>–of those who <span class="e2">chāya</span>–want <span class="e2">tarite</span>–to cross over <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–world <span class="e2">tarka kari’</span>–by arguing [is] <span class="e2">viphala</span>–fruitless. [Such persons] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">kichhui nā</span>–nothing. [39]
The endeavour of those who want to cross over this world by argument is fruitless. Such persons do not attain anything.
তর্কে জলাঞ্জলি দিয়া সাধু শাস্ত্র ধরে ।<br />অচিরে চৈতন্যলাভ সেই জন করে ॥৪০॥
tarke jalāñjali diyā sādhu śāstra dhare<br />achire chaitanya-lābha sei jana kare [40]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">jalāñjali diyā</span>–forgo <span class="e2">tarke</span>–argument [and] <span class="e2">dhare</span>–follow <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–the sādhus [and] <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">achire</span>–quickly <span class="e2">chaitanya-lābha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–attain Śrī Chaitanya. [40]
Those who forgo argument and follow the sādhus and scriptures quickly attain Śrī Chaitanya.
শ্রুতি স্মৃতি তন্ত্র শাস্ত্র অবিরত গায় ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য নিত্যানন্দের আজ্ঞায় ॥৪১॥
śruti smṛti tantra śāstra avirata gāya<br />nadīyā-māhātmya nityānandera ājñāya [41]
<span class="e2">śruti</span>–The śruti, <span class="e2">smṛti</span>–smṛti, [and] <span class="e2">tantra</span>–tantric <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–scriptures <span class="e2">avirata</span>–always <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia <span class="e2">ājñāya</span>–on the order <span class="e2">nityānandera</span>–of Nityānanda. [41]
The śrutis, smṛtis, and tantras always sing the glories of Nadia on the order of Nityānanda Prabhu.
সেই সব শাস্ত্র পড় সাধুবাক্য মান ।<br />তবে ত’হইবে তব নবদ্বীপজ্ঞান ॥৪২॥
sei saba śāstra paḍa sādhu-vākya māna<br />tabe ta’ ha-ibe tava navadvīpa-jñāna [42]
<span class="e2">paḍa</span>–Read <span class="e2">sei saba</span>–all these <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–scriptures [and] <span class="e2">māna</span>–honour <span class="e2">sādhu-vākya</span>–the words of the sādhus; <span class="e2">tabe ta’</span>–then <span class="e2">tava ha-ibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">navadvīpa-jñāna</span>–knowledge of Nabadwīp. [42]
Read all these scriptures and honour the words of the sādhus; then you will understand Nabadwīp.
কলিকালে তীর্থ সব অত্যন্ত দুর্ব্বল ।<br />নবদ্বীপ তীর্থ মাত্র পরম প্রবল ॥৪৩॥
kali-kāle tīrtha saba atyanta durbala<br />navadvīpa tīrtha mātra parama prabala [43]
<span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–During the Age of Kali, <span class="e2">saba tīrtha</span>–all the holy places [are] <span class="e2">atyanta</span>–very <span class="e2">durbala</span>–weak. <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–The holy place <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp <span class="e2">mātra</span>–alone [is] <span class="e2">parama</span>–greatly <span class="e2">prabala</span>–powerful. [43]
During the Age of Kali, all the holy places are very weak. Only Nabadwīp is greatly powerful.
প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় সেই তীর্থ বহু দিন ।<br />অপ্রকট মহিমা আছিল স্ফূর্ত্তিহীন ॥৪৪॥
prabhura ichchhāya sei tīrtha bahu dina<br />aprakaṭa mahimā āchhila sphūrti-hīna [44]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–holy place [was] <span class="e2">aprakaṭa</span>–unmanifest <span class="e2">bahu dina</span>–for a long time, [and its] <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–greatness <span class="e2">āchhila</span>–was <span class="e2">sphūrti-hīna</span>–not revealed. [44]
By the will of the Lord, this holy place was unmanifest for a long time, and its greatness was not revealed.
কলির প্রভাব যবে অত্যন্ত বাড়িল ।<br />অন্য তীর্থ স্বভাবতঃ নিস্তেজ হইল ॥৪৫॥
kalira prabhāva yabe atyanta bāḍila<br />anya tīrtha svabhāvataḥ nisteja ha-ila [45]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">prabhāva</span>–the influence <span class="e2">kalira</span>–of Kali <span class="e2">atyanta</span>–greatly <span class="e2">bāḍila</span>–increased, <span class="e2">anya</span>–the other <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–holy places <span class="e2">svabhāvataḥ</span>–naturally <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became <span class="e2">nisteja</span>–powerless. [45]
When the influence of Kali strongly increased, the other holy places naturally became powerless.
জীবের মঙ্গল লাগি’ পুরুষপ্রধান ।<br />মনে মনে চিন্তা করি’ করিল বিধান ॥৪৬॥
jīvera maṅgala lāgi’ puruṣa-pradhāna<br />mane mane chintā kari’ karila vidhāna [46]
<span class="e2">puruṣa-pradhāna</span>–The Supreme Lord <span class="e2">chintā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–thought <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within His heart [and] <span class="e2">karila</span>–made <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–an arrangement <span class="e2">lāgi’</span>–for <span class="e2">maṅgala</span>–the welfare <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of [all] souls. [46]
The Supreme Lord reflected on this and made an arrangement for the welfare of all souls.
“পীড়া বুঝি’ বৈদ্যরাজ ঔষধ খাওয়ায় ।<br />কঠিন ঔষধ দেয় কঠিন পীড়ায় ॥৪৭॥
“pīḍā bujhi’ vaidyarāja auṣadha khāoyāya<br />kaṭhina auṣadha deya kaṭhina pīḍāya [47]
<span class="e2">“bujhi’</span>–“Understanding <span class="e2">pīḍā</span>–a disease, <span class="e2">vaidyarāja</span>–a good doctor <span class="e2">khāoyāya</span>–prescribes <span class="e2">auṣadha</span>–medicine. [For a] <span class="e2">kaṭhina</span>–strong <span class="e2">pīḍāya</span>–disease, [he] <span class="e2">deya</span>–gives <span class="e2">kaṭhina</span>–strong <span class="e2">auṣadha</span>–medicine. [47]
“Understanding a patient’s disease, a good doctor prescribes medicine. For a strong disease, he gives strong medicine.
এবে কলি ঘোর হৈল রোগ হইল ভারী ।<br />কঠিন ঔষধ বিনা নিবারিতে নারি ॥৪৮॥
ebe kali ghora haila roga ha-ila bhārī<br />kaṭhina auṣadha vinā nivārite nāri [48]
<span class="e2">kali</span>–The Age of Kali <span class="e2">ebe haila</span>–has now become <span class="e2">ghora</span>–severe, [and] <span class="e2">roga</span>–the disease [of the souls] <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–has become <span class="e2">bhārī</span>–serious. <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">kaṭhina</span>–strong <span class="e2">auṣadha</span>–medicine, <span class="e2">nāri</span>–I cannot <span class="e2">nivārite</span>–check it. [48]
“The Age of Kali has become severe, and the disease of the souls has become serious. Without strong medicine, I cannot check it.
অতিশয় গোপনে রাখিনু যেই ধাম ।<br />অতিশয় গোপনে রাখিনু যেই নাম ॥৪৯॥
অতিশয় গোপনে রাখিনু যেই রূপ ।<br />প্রকাশ না কৈলে জীব তরিবে কিরূপ ॥৫০॥
atiśaya gopane rākhinu yei dhāma<br />atiśaya gopane rākhinu yei nāma [49]
atiśaya gopane rākhinu yei rūpa<br />prakāśa nā kaile jīva taribe ki-rūpa [50]
<span class="e2">kaile nā</span>–If I do not <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–reveal <span class="e2">yei</span>–the <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–Abode <span class="e2">rākhinu</span>–I have kept <span class="e2">atiśaya</span>–completely <span class="e2">gopane</span>–hidden, <span class="e2">yei</span>–the <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name <span class="e2">rākhinu</span>–I have kept <span class="e2">atiśaya</span>–completely <span class="e2">gopane</span>–hidden, [and] <span class="e2">yei</span>–the <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–Form <span class="e2">rākhinu</span>–I have kept <span class="e2">atiśaya</span>–completely <span class="e2">gopane</span>–hidden, <span class="e2">ki-rūpa</span>–how [will] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–the souls <span class="e2">taribe</span>–be delivered? [49<span class="e2">–</span>50]
“If I do not reveal the Abode, Name, and Form that I have kept completely hidden, then how will the souls be delivered?
জীব ত আমার দাস আমি তার প্রভু ।<br />আমি না তারিলে সেই না তরিবে কভু” ॥৫১॥
jīva ta āmāra dāsa āmi tāra prabhu<br />āmi na tārile sei nā taribe kabhu” [51]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–The souls [are] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–master. <span class="e2">āmi nā tārile</span>–If I do not deliver [them,] <span class="e2">sei</span>–they <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span> <span class="e2">taribe”</span>–will never be delivered.” [51]
“The souls are My servants, and I am their master. If I do not deliver them, then they will never be delivered.”
এই বলি’ শ্রীচৈতন্য হইল প্রকাশ ।<br />নিজ নাম নিজ ধাম লয়ে নিজ দাস ॥৫২॥
ei bali’ śrī-chaitanya ha-ila prakāśa<br />nija nāma nija dhāma laye nija dāsa [52]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Thinking <span class="e2">ei</span>–thus, <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">prakāśa ha-ila</span>–appeared <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name, <span class="e2">nija</span>–His <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode, [and] <span class="e2">nija</span>–His <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants. [52]
Thinking thus, Śrī Chaitanya appeared with His Name, His abode, and His servants.
প্রভুর প্রতিজ্ঞা এই হয় সর্ব্বকাল ।<br />“তারিব সকল জীব ঘুচাব জঞ্জাল ॥৫৩॥
prabhura pratijñā ei haya sarva-kāla<br />“tāriba sakala jīva ghuchāba jañjāla [53]
<span class="e2">ei pratijñā</span>–The promise <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sarva-kāla</span>–eternal: <span class="e2">“tāriba</span>–“I will deliver <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls [and] <span class="e2">ghuchāba</span>–end [their] <span class="e2">jañjāla</span>–suffering. [53]
This promise of the Lord is eternal: “I will deliver all souls and end their suffering.
ব্রহ্মার দুর্ল্লভ ধন বিলাব সংসারে ।<br />পাত্রাপাত্র না বাছিব এই অবতারে ॥৫৪॥
brahmāra durlabha dhana bilāba saṁsāre<br />pātrāpātra nā vāchhiba ei avatāre [54]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">avatāre</span>–In this appearance, <span class="e2">bilāba</span>–I will distribute <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–throughout the world <span class="e2">dhana</span>–wealth [that is] <span class="e2">brahmāra</span> <span class="e2">durlabha</span>–difficult for Brahmā to attain, [and] <span class="e2">vāchhiba nā</span>–I will not consider [who is] <span class="e2">pātrāpātra</span>–fit or unfit. [54]
“In this appearance, I will distribute throughout the world wealth that is difficult for even Brahmā to attain, and I will not consider who is fit or unfit.
দেখিব কিরূপ কলি জীব করে নাশ ।<br />নবদ্বীপধাম আমি করিব প্রকাশ ॥৫৫॥
dekhiba ki-rūpe kali jīve kare nāśa<br />navadvīpa-dhāma āmi kariba prakāśa [55]
<span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">ki-rūpe</span>–how <span class="e2">kali</span>–Kali <span class="e2">nāśa kare</span>–devastates <span class="e2">jīve</span>–the souls, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">prakāśa kariba</span>–will reveal <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām. [55]
“I will see how Kali devastates the souls, and I will reveal Nabadwīp Dhām.
সেই ধামে কলির ভাঙ্গিব বিষদাত ।<br />কীর্ত্তন করিয়া জীবে করি’ আত্মসাথ ॥৫৬॥
sei dhāme kalira bhāṅgiba viṣa-dāta<br />kīrtana kariyā jīve kari’ ātma-sātha [56]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–In the Dhām, <span class="e2">bhāṅgiba</span>–I will break <span class="e2">kalira</span>–Kali’s <span class="e2">viṣa-dāta</span>–poisonous fangs, <span class="e2">kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–perform kīrtan, [and] <span class="e2">ātma-sātha kari’</span>–collect <span class="e2">jīve</span>–the souls. [56]
“In the Dhām, I will break Kali’s poisonous fangs, perform kīrtan, and collect the souls.
যতদূর মম নাম হইবে কীর্ত্তন ।<br />ততদূর হইবে ত কলির দমন” ॥৫৭॥
yata-dūra mama nāma ha-ibe kīrtana<br />tata-dūra ha-ibe ta kalira damana” [57]
<span class="e2">kalira</span>–Kali’s<span class="e2"> damana</span>–destruction <span class="e2">ha-ibe ta</span>–will happen <span class="e2">yata-dūra tata-dūra</span>–to the extent that <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name <span class="e2">kīrtana ha-ibe”</span>–will be chanted.” [57]
“Kali will be subdued to the extent that My Name is chanted.”
এই বলি’ গৌরহরি কলির সন্ধ্যায় ।<br />প্রকাশিল নবদ্বীপ স্বকীয় মায়ায় ॥৫৮॥
ei bali’ gaurahari kalira sandhyāya<br />prakāśila navadvīpa svakīya māyāya [58]
<span class="e2">bali</span>’–Deciding<span class="e2"> e</span>i–this, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–revealed <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">svakīya māyāya</span>–by His own power <span class="e2">sandhyāya</span>–at the eve <span class="e2">kalira</span>–of Kali-yuga. [58]
Deciding this, Gaurahari revealed Nabadwīp by His own power at the beginning of Kali-yuga.
ছায়া সম্বরিয়া নিত্য স্বরূপ-বিলাস ।<br />গৌরচন্দ্র গৌড়ভূমে করিল প্রকাশ ॥৫৯॥
chhāyā samvariyā nitya svarūpa-vilāsa<br />gaurachandra gauḍa-bhūme karila prakāśa [59]
<span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">samvariyā</span>–held back <span class="e2">chhāyā</span>–the shadow [of Māyā, and] <span class="e2">prakāśa karila</span>–revealed <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa-vilāsa</span>–His own eternal Pastimes <span class="e2">gauḍa-bhūme</span>–in the land of Gauḍa. [59]
Gaurachandra held back Māyā’s darkness and revealed His eternal Pastimes in the land of Gauḍa.
এমন দয়ালু প্রভু যে জন না ভজে ।<br />এমন অচিন্ত্যধাম যেই জন ত্যজে ॥৬০॥
এই কলিকালে তার সমভাগ্যহীন ।<br />না দেখি জগতে আর শোচনীয় দীন ॥৬১॥
emana dayālu prabhu ye jana nā bhaje<br />emana achintya-dhāma yei jana tyaje [60]
ei kali-kāle tāra samabhāgya-hīna<br />nā dekhi jagate āra śochanīya dīna [61]
<span class="e2">dekhi nā</span>–I do not see <span class="e2">tāra yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–anyone <span class="e2">jagate</span>–in the world <span class="e2">ei kali-kāle</span>–during the Age of Kali <span class="e2">āra</span>–more <span class="e2">samabhāgya-hīna</span>–unfortunate, <span class="e2">śochanīya</span>–pitiable, [and] <span class="e2">dīna</span>–fallen [than] <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–someone who <span class="e2">bhaje nā</span>–does not serve <span class="e2">emana</span>–such [a] <span class="e2">dayālu</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–merciful Lord [and] <span class="e2">tyaje</span>–rejects <span class="e2">emana</span>–such [an] <span class="e2">achintya-dhāma</span>–inconceivable abode. [60<span class="e2">–</span>61]
I do not see anyone in the world during the Age of Kali as unfortunate, pitiable, and fallen as someone who does not serve such a merciful Lord and rejects such an inconceivable abode.
অতএব ছাড়ি’ ভাই অন্য বাঞ্ছা রতি ।<br />নবদ্বীপধামে মাত্র হও একমতি ॥৬২॥
ataeva chhāḍi’ bhāi anya vāñchhā rati<br />navadvīpa-dhāme mātra hao ekamati [62]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother! <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Give up [all] <span class="e2">anya</span>–other <span class="e2">vāñchhā</span>–desires [and] <span class="e2">rati</span>–attachments, [and] <span class="e2">ekamati hao</span>–be devoted <span class="e2">mātra</span>–exclusively <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–to Nabadwīp Dhām. [62]
Therefore, brother! Give up all other desires and attachments, and devote yourself exclusively to Nabadwīp Dhām.
জাহ্নবী-নিতাই-পদছায়া যার আশ ।<br />সে ভক্তিবিনোদ করে এ তত্ত্ব প্রকাশ ॥৬৩॥
jāhnavī-nitāi-pada-chhāyā yāra āśa<br />se bhakti-vinoda kare e tattva prakāśa [63]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">jāhnavī-nitāi-pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of Jāhnavā and Nitāi’s feet, <span class="e2">prakāśa kare</span>–reveals <span class="e2">e</span>–these <span class="e2">tattva</span>–glories. [63]
Bhakti Vinod, whose aspiration is the shade of Jāhnavā and Nitāi’s feet, reveals the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Three
Instructions for Circumambulating the Dhām
জয় জয় নবদ্বীপচন্দ্র শচীসুত ।<br />জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দরায় অবধূত ॥১॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa-chandra śachī-suta<br />jaya jaya nityānanda-rāya avadhūta [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śachī-suta</span>–to the son of Śachī, Śrī Chaitanya, <span class="e2">navadvīpa-chandra</span>–the moon of Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">avadhūta</span>–to the renunciant <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī, the moon of Nabadwīp! All glory to the avadhūt Nityānanda Rāy!
জয় জয় শ্রীঅদ্বৈত প্রভু মহাশয় ।<br />গদাধর শ্রীবাস পণ্ডিত জয় জয় ॥২॥
jaya jaya śrī-advaita prabhu mahāśaya<br />gadādhara śrīvāsa paṇḍita jaya jaya [2]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–to the worshippable <span class="e2">śrī-advaita</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Śrī Advaita Prabhu! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar Paṇḍit [and] <span class="e2">śrīvāsa paṇḍita</span>–Śrīvās Paṇḍit! [2]
All glory to the worshippable Śrī Advaita Prabhu! All glory to Gadādhar Paṇḍit and Śrīvās Paṇḍit!
জয় জয় নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />যেই ধামসহ গৌরচন্দ্র অবতার ॥৩॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />yei dhāma-saha gaurachandra avatāra [3]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–to Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–the best of all abodes, <span class="e2">yei dhāma-saha</span>–the Dhām with which <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">avatāra</span>–appeared! [3]
All glory to Nabadwīp Dhām, the best of all abodes, the abode with which Gaurachandra appeared!
ষোলক্রোশ নবদ্বীপ মধ্যে যাহা যাহা ।<br />বর্ণিব এখন ভক্তগণ শুন তাহা ॥৪॥
ṣola-krośa navadvīpa madhye yāhā yāhā<br />varṇiba ekhana bhakta-gaṇa śuna tāhā [4]
<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–Devotees, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">ekhana varṇiba</span>–I will now describe <span class="e2">yāhā</span> <span class="e2">yāhā tāhā</span>–everything <span class="e2">madhye</span>–within <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–the thirty-two miles <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp. [4]
Devotees, listen! I will now describe everything within the thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp.
ষোলক্রোশ মধ্যে নবদ্বীপের প্রমাণ ।<br />ষোড়শ প্রবাহ তথা সদা বিদ্যমান ॥৫॥
ṣola-krośa madhye navadvīpera pramāṇa<br />ṣoḍaśa pravāha tathā sadā vidyamāna [5]
<span class="e2">ṣoḍaśa</span>–Sixteen <span class="e2">pravāha</span>–rivers <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–exist <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternally <span class="e2">tathā madhye</span>–there, within <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa pramāṇa</span>–the thirty-two miles <span class="e2">navadvīpera</span>–of Nabadwīp. [5]
Sixteen rivers exist eternally within the thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp.
মূল-গঙ্গা পূর্ব্বতীরে দ্বীপ-চতুষ্টয় ।<br />তাঁহার পশ্চিমে সদা পঞ্চদ্বীপ রয় ॥৬॥
mūla-gaṅgā pūrva-tīre dvīpa-chatuṣṭaya<br />tā̐hāra paśchime sadā pañcha-dvīpa raya [6]
<span class="e2">dvīpa-chatuṣṭaya</span>–Four islands <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">raya</span>–exist <span class="e2">pūrva-tīre</span>–on the east bank <span class="e2">mūla-gaṅgā</span>–of the original Gaṅgā, [and] <span class="e2">pañcha-dvīpa</span>–five islands [exist] <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">paśchime</span>–on its west [bank]. [6]
Four islands are on the east bank of the original Gaṅgā, and five are on the west bank.
স্বর্ধুনী প্রবাহ সব বেড়ি’ দ্বীপগণে ।<br />নবদ্বীপধামে শোভা দেয় অনুক্ষণে ॥৭॥
svardhunī pravāha saba beḍi’ dvīpa-gaṇe<br />navadvīpa-dhāme śobhā deya anukṣaṇe [7]
<span class="e2">saba</span>–All these <span class="e2">svardhunī</span>–heavenly <span class="e2">pravāha</span>–rivers <span class="e2">beḍi’</span>–flow <span class="e2">dvīpa-gaṇe</span>–throughout the islands [and] <span class="e2">anukṣaṇe</span>–always <span class="e2">śobhā deya</span>–beautify <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām. [7]
These heavenly rivers flow throughout the islands and always beautify Nabadwīp Dhām.
মধ্যে মূল গঙ্গাদেবী রহে অনুক্ষণ ।<br />অপর প্রবাহে অন্য পুণ্যনদীগণ ॥৮॥
madhye mūla gaṅgā-devī rahe anukṣaṇa<br />apara pravāhe anya puṇya-nadī-gaṇa [8]
<span class="e2">gaṅgā-devī</span>–Gaṅgā Devī’s <span class="e2">mūla</span>–original [stream] <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–always <span class="e2">rahe</span>–flows <span class="e2">madhye</span>–through the centre; <span class="e2">anya</span>–the other <span class="e2">puṇya-nadī-gaṇa</span>–holy rivers [flow] <span class="e2">apara</span> <span class="e2">pravāhe</span>–in separate streams. [8]
Gaṅgā Devī’s original stream always flows through the centre of the Dhām; the other holy rivers flow in separate streams.
গঙ্গার নিকট বহে যমুনা সুন্দরী ।<br />অন্য ধারা মধ্যে সরস্বতী বিদ্যাধরী ॥৯॥
gaṅgāra nikaṭa vahe yamunā sundarī<br />anya dhārā madhye sarasvatī vīdyādharī [9]
<span class="e2">yamunā sundarī</span>–The beautiful Yamunā <span class="e2">vahe</span>–flows <span class="e2">gaṅgāra nikaṭa</span>–near the Gaṅgā. <span class="e2">sarasvatī</span>–The Saraswatī, <span class="e2">vīdyādharī</span>–the carrier of knowledge, [flows] <span class="e2">madhye</span>–in <span class="e2">anya</span>–another <span class="e2">dhārā</span>–channel. [9]
The beautiful Yamunā flows near the Gaṅgā. The Saraswatī, the carrier of knowledge, flows in another channel.
তাম্রপর্ণী কৃতমালা ব্রহ্মপুত্রত্রয় ।<br />যমুনার পূর্ব্বভাগে দীর্ঘধারাময় ॥ ১০॥
tāmraparṇī kṛtamālā brahmaputra-traya<br />yamunāra pūrva-bhāge dīrgha-dhārāmaya [10]
<span class="e2">pūrva-bhāge</span>–To the east <span class="e2">yamunāra</span>–of the Yamunā [are] <span class="e2">traya</span>–three <span class="e2">dīrgha-dhārāmaya</span>–long rivers: <span class="e2">tāmraparṇī</span>–the Tāmraparṇī, <span class="e2">kṛtamālā</span>–Kṛtamālā, [and] <span class="e2">brahmaputra</span>–Brahmaputra. [10]
East of the Yamunā are the three long rivers: the Tāmraparṇī, Kṛtamālā, and Brahmaputra.
সরযূ নর্ম্মদা সিন্ধু কাবেরী গোমতী ।<br />প্রস্থে বহে গোদাবরী সহ দ্রুতগতি ॥১১॥
sarayū narmadā sindhu kāverī gomatī<br />prasthe vahe godāvarī saha drutagati [11]
<span class="e2">sarayū</span>–The Sarayū, <span class="e2">narmadā</span>–Narmadā, <span class="e2">sindhu</span>–Sindhu, <span class="e2">kāverī</span>–Kāverī, <span class="e2">gomatī</span>–Gomatī, <span class="e2">saha</span>–and <span class="e2">godāvarī</span>–Godāvarī <span class="e2">vahe</span>–flow <span class="e2">drutagati</span>–swiftly <span class="e2">prasthe</span>–on the west side. [11]
The Sarayū, Narmadā, Sindhu, Kāverī, Gomatī, and Godāvarī flow swiftly on the west side.
এই সব ধারা পরস্পর করি’ ছেদ ।<br />এক নবদ্বীপে নববিধ করে ভেদ ॥১২॥
ei saba dhārā paraspara kari’ chheda<br />eka navadvīpe nava-vidha kare bheda [12]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–All these <span class="e2">dhārā</span>–rivers <span class="e2">chheda kari’</span>–cross <span class="e2">paraspara</span>–each other [and] <span class="e2">bheda kare</span>–divide <span class="e2">eka navadvīpe</span>–the one area of Nabadwīp <span class="e2">nava-vidha</span>–into nine parts. [12]
All these rivers cross each other and divide Nabadwīp into nine parts.
প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় কভু ধারা শুষ্ক হয় ।<br />পুনঃ ইচ্ছা হৈলে ধারা হয় জলময় ॥১৩॥
prabhura ichchhāya kabhu dhārā śuṣka haya<br />punaḥ ichchhā haile dhārā haya jalamaya [13]
<span class="e2">prabhura ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">dhārā</span>–these rivers <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">śuṣka haya</span>–go dry, [and] <span class="e2">ichchhā haile</span>–when the Lord wills [it], <span class="e2">dhārā</span>–the rivers <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again <span class="e2">jalamaya haya</span>–fill with water. [13]
By the will of the Lord, these rivers sometimes go dry, and when the Lord wills it, they again fill with water.
প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় কভু ডুবে কোন স্থান ।<br />প্রভুর ইচ্চায় পুনঃ দেয় ত দর্শন ॥১৪॥
