prabhura ichchhāya kabhu ḍube kona sthāna<br />prabhura ichchhāya punaḥ deya ta darśana [14]
<span class="e2">prabhura ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, [they] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">ḍube</span>–submerge <span class="e2">kona</span>–some <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–portions of land, [and] <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–by the will of the Lord, [they] <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again <span class="e2">darśana deya ta</span>–reveal them. [14]
By the will of the Lord, they sometimes submerge portions of land and then again reveal them.
নিরবধি এই রূপ ধাম লীলা করে ।<br />ভাগ্যবান্ জন প্রতি সর্ব্বকাল স্ফুরে ॥১৫॥
niravadhi ei rūpa dhāma līlā kare<br />bhāgyavān jana prati sarva-kāla sphure [15]
<span class="e2">dhāma</span>–The Dhām <span class="e2">līlā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs Pastimes <span class="e2">niravadhi</span>–eternally <span class="e2">ei rūpa</span>–in this way [and] <span class="e2">sarva-kāla</span>–always <span class="e2">sphure</span>–appears <span class="e2">bhāgyavān jana prati</span>–before fortunate souls. [15]
The Dhām performs Pastimes eternally in this way and always appears before fortunate souls.
উৎকট বাসনা যদি ভক্তহৃদে হয় ।<br />সর্ব্বদ্বীপ সর্ব্বধারা দর্শন মিলয় ॥১৬॥
utkaṭa vāsanā yadi bhakta-hṛde haya<br />sarva-dvīpa sarva-dhārā darśana milaya [16]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–When <span class="e2">utkaṭa</span>–intense <span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–desire <span class="e2">haya</span>–arises <span class="e2">bhakta-hṛde</span>–in the heart of a devotee, <span class="e2">sarva-dvīpa</span>–all the islands [and] <span class="e2">sarva-dhārā</span>–all the rivers <span class="e2">darśana milaya</span>–reveal [themselves]. [16]
When intense desire arises in the heart of a devotee, all the islands and rivers in the Dhām reveal themselves.
কভু স্বপ্নে কভু ধ্যানে কভু দৃষ্টি-যোগে ।<br />ধামের দর্শন পায় ভক্তির সংযোগে ॥১৭॥
kabhu svapne kabhu dhyāne kabhu dṛṣṭi-yoge<br />dhāmera darśana pāya bhaktira saṁyoge [17]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">svapne</span>–in dreams, <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">dhyāne</span>–in meditation, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">dṛṣṭi-yoge</span>–in their vision, [devotees] <span class="e2">dhāmera darśana</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–see the Dhām <span class="e2">bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">saṁyoge</span>–through [their] devotion. [17]
Sometimes in dreams, sometimes in meditation, and sometimes in their vision, devotees see the Dhām through their devotion.
গঙ্গা-যমুনার যোগে যেই দ্বীপ রয় ।<br />অন্তর্দ্বীপ তার নাম সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কয় ॥১৮॥
gaṅgā-yamunāra yoge yei dvīpa raya<br />antardvīpa tāra nāma sarva-śāstre kaya [18]
<span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">nāma kaya</span>–call <span class="e2">tara yei</span> <span class="e2">dvīpa</span>–the island [that] <span class="e2">raya</span>–exists <span class="e2">yoge</span>–at the confluence <span class="e2">gaṅgā yamunāra</span>–of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp. [18]
All the scriptures call the island at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā Antardwīp.
অন্তর্দ্বীপ মধ্যে আছে পীঠ মায়াপুর ।<br />যথায় জন্মিল প্রভু চৈতন্যঠাকুর ॥১৯॥
antardvīpa madhye āchhe pīṭha māyāpura<br />yathāya janmila prabhu chaitanya-ṭhākura [19]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–Within <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is <span class="e2">māyāpura pīṭha</span>–the abode of Māyāpur, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">chaitanya-ṭhākura</span>–Lord Chaitanya <span class="e2">janmila</span>–appeared. [19]
Within Antardwīp is Māyāpur, where Lord Chaitanya appeared.
গোলোকের অন্তবর্ত্তী যেই মহাবন ।<br />মায়াপুর নবদ্বীপে জান ভক্তগণ ॥২০॥
golokera antavartī yei mahāvana<br />māyāpura navadvīpe jāna bhakta-gaṇa [20]
<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–Devotees <span class="e2">jāna</span>–know <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">mahāvana</span>–Mahāvan <span class="e2">golokera antavartī</span>–in Goloka [to be] <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. [20]
Devotees know Mahāvan in Goloka to be Māyāpur in Nabadwīp.
শ্বেতদ্বীপ বৈকুণ্ঠ গোলোক বৃন্দাবন ।<br />নবদ্বীপে সব তত্ত্ব আছে সর্ব্বক্ষণ ॥ ২১॥
śvetadvīpa vaikuṇṭha goloka vṛndāvana<br />navadvīpe saba tattva āchhe sarva-kṣaṇa [21]
<span class="e2">śvetadvīpa</span>–Śvetadwīp, <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭha</span>–Vaikuṇṭha, [and] <span class="e2">goloka</span> <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Goloka Vṛndāvan [are] <span class="e2">saba tattva</span>–all <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–always <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–present <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp.[21]
Śvetadwīp, Vaikuṇṭha, and Goloka Vṛndāvan are always present in Nabadwīp.
অযোধ্যা মথুরা মায়া কাশী কাঞ্চী আর ।<br />অবন্তী দ্বারকা সেই পুরী সপ্ত সার ॥২২॥
নবদ্বীপে সে সমস্ত নিজ নিজ স্থানে ।<br />নিত্য বিদ্যমান গৌরচন্দ্রের বিধানে ॥২৩॥
ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśī kāñchī āra<br />avantī dvārakā sei purī sapta sāra [22]
navadvīpe se samasta nija nija sthāne<br />nitya vidyamāna gaurachandrera vidhāne [23]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–The <span class="e2">sapta purī sāra</span>–seven great cities— <span class="e2">ayodhyā</span>–Ayodhyā, <span class="e2">mathurā</span>–Mathurā, <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā (Māyāpur or Haridvār) <span class="e2">kāśī</span>–Kāśī (Vārāṇasī, Benares), <span class="e2">kāñchī</span>–Kāñchī, <span class="e2">avantī</span>–Avantī (Ujjain), <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">dvārakā</span>–Dvārakā— <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">samasta</span>–all <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–exist <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">nija nija sthāne</span>–in their respective places, <span class="e2">gaurachandrera vidhāne</span>–by the arrangement of Gaurachandra. [22<span class="e2">–</span>23]
The seven great cities—Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Māyā, Kāśī, Kāñchī, Avantī, and Dvārakā—exist eternally in Nabadwīp in their respective places, by the arrangement of Gaurachandra.
গঙ্গাদ্বার মায়ার স্বরূপ মায়াপুর ।<br />যাহার মাহাত্ম্য শাস্ত্রে আছয়ে প্রচুর ॥২৪॥
gaṅgā-dvāra māyāra svarūpa māyāpura<br />yāhāra māhātmya śāstre āchhaye prachura [24]
<span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–The true form <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of Māyā (the city), <span class="e2">gaṅgā-dvāra</span>–the gateway of the Gaṅgā, [is] <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur (of Nabadwīp Dhām), <span class="e2">yāhāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–glories <span class="e2">āchhaye</span>–are stated <span class="e2">prachura</span>–repeatedly <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–throughout the scriptures. [24]
The true form of the city Māyā, the gateway of the Gaṅgā, is Māyāpur, whose glories are stated repeatedly throughout the scriptures.
সেই মায়াপুরে যে যায় একবার ।<br />অনায়াসে হয় সেই জড়মায়া পার ॥২৫॥
sei māyāpure ye yāya eka-bāra<br />anāyāse haya sei jaḍa-māyā pāra [25]
<span class="e2">ye sei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">sei māyāpure</span>–to Māyāpur (in Nabadwīp) <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">pāra haya</span>–cross over <span class="e2">jaḍa-māyā</span>–material illusion. [25]
Those who once go to Māyāpur easily cross over material illusion.
মায়াপুরে ভ্রমিলে মায়ার অধিকার ।<br />দূরে যায়, জন্ম কভু নহে আরবার ॥২৬॥
māyāpure bhramile māyāra adhikāra<br />dūre yāya, janma kabhu nahe āra-bāra [26]
<span class="e2">bhramile</span>–If a soul wanders <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur, [then] <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–the influence <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of Māyā <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–goes away, [and] <span class="e2">janma nahe</span>–they do not take birth <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–ever <span class="e2">āra-bāra</span>–again. [26]
If a soul wanders in Māyāpur, then the influence of Māyā goes away, and they do not take birth again.
মায়াপুর উত্তর সীমন্তদ্বীপ হয় ।<br />পরিক্রমা বিধি সাধুশাস্ত্র সদা কয় ॥২৭॥
māyāpura uttara sīmantadvīpa haya<br />parikramā vidhi sādhu-śāstra sadā kaya [27]
<span class="e2">uttara</span>–North <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–of Māyāpur <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sīmantadvīpa</span>–Sīmantadwīp. <span class="e2">sādhu-śāstra</span>–The sādhus and scriptures <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">kaya</span>–explain <span class="e2">vidhi</span>–the procedure <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–for circumambulation (of the Dhām). [27]
North of Māyāpur is Sīmantadwīp. The sādhus and scriptures always explain the procedure for circumambulating the Dhām.
অন্তর্দ্বীপে শ্রীমায়াপুর করিয়া দর্শন ।<br />শ্রীসীমন্তদ্বীপে চল বিজ্ঞ ভক্তজন ॥২৮॥
antardvīpe śrī-māyāpura kariyā darśana<br />śrī-sīmantadvīpe chala vijña bhakta-jana [28]
<span class="e2">vijña</span> <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–O wise devotees, <span class="e2">darśana kariyā</span>–visit <span class="e2">śrī-māyāpura</span>–Śrī Māyāpur <span class="e2">antardvīpe</span>–in Antardwīp [and then] <span class="e2">chala</span>–go <span class="e2">śrī-sīmantadvīpe</span>–to Śrī Sīmantadwīp. [28]
O wise devotees, visit Śrī Māyāpur in Antardwīp and then go to Sīmantadwīp.
গোদ্রুমাখ্যদ্বীপ হয় মায়ার দক্ষিণে ।<br />তাহা ভ্রমি’ চল মধ্যদ্বীপ হৃষ্টমনে ॥২৯॥
godrumākhya-dvīpa haya māyāra dakṣiṇe<br />tāhā bhrami’ chala madhyadvīpa hṛṣṭa-mane [29]
<span class="e2">godrumākhya-dvīpa</span>–The island known as Godruma <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">dakṣiṇe</span>–south <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of Māyāpur. <span class="e2">bhrami’</span>–Walk <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–there [and then] <span class="e2">hṛṣṭa-mane</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">chala</span>–go <span class="e2">madhyadvīpa</span>–to Madhyadwīp. [29]
Godrumadwīp is south of Māyāpur. Walk there and then joyfully go to Madhyadwīp.
এই চারিদ্বীপ জাহ্নবীর পূর্ব্বতীরে ।<br />দেখিয়া জাহ্নবী পার হও ধীরে ধীরে ॥৩০॥
ei chāri-dvīpa jāhnavīra pūrva-tīre<br />dekhiyā jāhnavī pāra hao dhīre dhīre [30]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Visit <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">chāri-dvīpa</span>–four islands <span class="e2">jāhnavīra pūrva-tīre</span>–on the east bank of the Gaṅgā [and then] <span class="e2">dhīre dhīre</span>–slowly <span class="e2">pāra hao</span>–cross <span class="e2">jāhnavī</span>–the Gaṅgā. [30]
Visit these four islands on the east bank of the Gaṅgā and then slowly cross the river.
কোলদ্বীপ অনায়াসে করিয়া ভ্রমণ ।<br />ঋতুদ্বীপ শোভা তবে কর দরশন ॥৩১॥
koladvīpa anāyāse kariyā bhramaṇa<br />ṛtudvīpa śobhā tabe kara daraśana [31]
<span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–Peacefully <span class="e2">bhramaṇa kariyā</span>–walk through <span class="e2">koladvīpa</span>–Koladwīp [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">daraśana kara</span>–see <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–the beauty <span class="e2">ṛtudvīpa</span>–of Ṛtudwīp. [31]
Peacefully walk through Koladwīp and then see the beauty of Ṛtudwīp.
তারপর জহ্নুদ্বীপ পরম সুন্দর ।<br />দেখি’ মোদদ্রুমদ্বীপে চল বিজ্ঞবর ॥৩২॥
tārapara jahnudvīpa parama sundara<br />dekhi’ modadrumadvīpe chala vijña-vara [32]
<span class="e2">vijña-vara</span>–O best of the wise, <span class="e2">tārapara</span>–thereafter, <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–see [the] <span class="e2">parama</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beauty <span class="e2">jahnudvīpa</span>–of Jahnudwīp [and then] <span class="e2">chala</span>–go <span class="e2">modadrumadvīpe</span>–to Modadrumadwīp. [32]
O best of the wise, thereafter, see the wonderful beauty of Jahnudwīp and then go to Modadrumadwīp.
রুদ্রদ্বীপ দেখ পুনঃ গঙ্গা হয়ে পার ।<br />ভ্রমি’ মায়াপুর ভক্ত চল আর বার ॥৩৩॥
rudradvīpa dekha punaḥ gaṅgā haye pāra<br />bhrami’ māyāpura bhakta chala āra bāra [33]
<span class="e2">bhakta</span>–O devotees, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">rudradvīpa</span>–Rudradwīp, <span class="e2">pāra haye</span>–cross <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again, [and then] <span class="e2">bhrami’ chala</span>–go <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–to Māyāpur <span class="e2">bāra</span>–once <span class="e2">āra</span>–more. [33]
O devotees, see Rudradwīp, cross the Gaṅgā again, and then visit Māyāpur once more.
তথায় শ্রীজগন্নাথ-শচীর মন্দিরে ।<br />প্রভুর দর্শনে প্রবেশহ ধীরে ধীরে ॥৩৪॥
tathāya śrī-jagannātha-śachīra mandire<br />prabhura darśane praveśaha dhīre dhīre [34]
<span class="e2">tathāya</span>–There, <span class="e2">dhīre</span> <span class="e2">dhīre</span>–slowly <span class="e2">praveśaha</span>–enter <span class="e2">mandire</span>–the abode <span class="e2">śrī-jagannātha-śachīra</span>–of Śrī Jagannāth and Śachī <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">darśane</span>–to see the Lord. [34]
There, slowly enter the abode of Śrī Jagannāth and Śachī to see the Lord.
সর্ব্বকালে এই রূপ পরিক্রমা হয় ।<br />জীবের অনন্ত সুখপ্রাপ্তির আলয় ॥৩৫॥
sarva-kāle ei rūpa parikramā haya<br />jīvera ananta sukha-prāptira ālaya [35]
<span class="e2">parikramā</span>–Circumambulation <span class="e2">sarva-kāle</span>–always <span class="e2">haya</span>–happens <span class="e2">ei rūpa</span>–in this way, [and is] <span class="e2">ālaya</span>–a source <span class="e2">ananta sukha-prāptira</span>–for the attainment of unlimited joy <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for the soul. [35]
Circumambulation is always done in this way and is a source of unlimited joy for the soul.
বিশেষতঃ মাকরী-সপ্তমী-তিথি গতে ।<br />ফাল্গুনী পূর্ণিমাবধি শ্রেষ্ঠ সর্ব্বমতে ॥৩৬॥
viśeṣataḥ mākarī-saptamī-tithi gate<br />phālgunī pūrṇimāvadhi śreṣṭha sarva-mate [36]
<span class="e2">sarva-mate</span>–Unanimously, [it is] <span class="e2">śreṣṭha</span>–best <span class="e2">viśeṣataḥ</span>–in particular [to circumambulate] <span class="e2">gate</span>–from <span class="e2">mākarī-saptamī-tithi</span>–the day of Mākarī Saptamī (the seventh day of the waxing fortnight in the month of Phālgun) <span class="e2">phālgunī pūrṇimāvadhi</span>–until Phālgunī Pūrṇimā (the full moon day of the month of Phālgun). [36]
Everyone concurs that it is best to start on Mākarī Saptamī and end on Phālgunī Pūrṇimā.
পরিক্রমা সমাধিয়া যেই মহাজন ।<br />জন্মদিনে মায়াপুর করেন দর্শন ॥৩৭॥
নিতাই গৌরাঙ্গ তারে কৃপা বিতরিয়া ।<br />ভক্তি অধিকারী করে পদছায়া দিয়া ॥৩৮॥
parikramā samādhiyā yei mahājana<br />janma-dine māyāpura karena darśana [37]
nitāi gaurāṅga tāre kṛpā vitariyā<br />bhakti adhikārī kare pada-chhāyā diyā [38]
<span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi [and] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">vitariyā</span>–bless <span class="e2">tāre yei mahājana</span>–the great souls who <span class="e2">samādhiyā</span>–complete [their] <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation [and] <span class="e2">darśana karena</span>–visit <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">janma-dine</span>–on the birthday [of the Lord]. [They] <span class="e2">adhikārī</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–make [them] qualified <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–for devotion [and] <span class="e2">diyā</span>–give [them] <span class="e2">pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of [Their] feet. [37<span class="e2">–</span>38]
Nitāi and Gaurāṅga bless the great souls who complete their circumambulation and visit Māyāpur on the birthday of the Lord. They make them qualified for devotion and give them the shade of Their feet.
সংক্ষেপে কহিনু পরিক্রমা বিবরণ ।<br />বিস্তারিয়া বলি এবে করহ শ্রবণ ॥৩৯॥
saṁkṣepe kahinu parikramā vivaraṇa<br />vistāriyā bali ebe karaha śravaṇa [39]
<span class="e2">saṁkṣepe</span>–Briefly, <span class="e2">vivaraṇa kahinu</span>–I have described <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation [of the Dhām]. <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">vistāriyā bali</span>–I will elaborate. <span class="e2">śravaṇa karaha</span>–[Please] listen. [39]
I have briefly described circumambulating the Dhām. Now I will elaborate. Please listen.
যেই জন ভ্রমে একবিংশতি যোজন ।<br />অচিরে লভয়ে সেই গৌরপ্রেমধন ॥৪০॥
yei jana bhrame ekaviṁśati yojana<br />achire labhaye sei gaura-prema-dhana [40]
<span class="e2">yei sei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">bhrame</span>–traverse <span class="e2">ekaviṁśati yojana</span>–the one hundred and sixty-eight miles [of Gauḍa Maṇḍal] <span class="e2">achire</span>–quickly <span class="e2">labhaye</span>–attain g<span class="e2">aura-prema-dhana–</span>the wealth of divine love for Gaura. [40]
Those who traverse the one hundred and sixty-eight miles of Śrī Gauḍa Maṇḍal quickly attain the wealth of divine love for Gaura.
জাহ্নবা-নিতাই-পদছায়া যার আশ ।<br />এ ভক্তিবিনোদ করে এ তত্ত্ব প্রকাশ ॥৪১॥
jāhnavā-nitāi-pada-chhāyā yāra āśa<br />e bhakti-vinoda kare e tattva prakāśa [41]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">jāhnavī-nitāi-pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of Jāhnavā and Nitāi’s feet, <span class="e2">prakāśa kare</span>–reveals <span class="e2">e</span>–these <span class="e2">tattva</span>–glories. [41]
Bhakti Vinod, whose aspiration is the shade of Jāhnavā and Nitāi’s feet, reveals the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Four
Śrī Jīva Hears the Glories of the Dhām
জয় জয় নবদ্বীপচন্দ্র শচীসুত ।<br />জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দরায় অবধূত ॥১॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa-chandra śachī-suta<br />jaya jaya nityānanda-rāya avadhūta [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śachī-suta</span>–to the son of Śachī, Śrī Chaitanya, <span class="e2">navadvīpa-chandra</span>–the moon of Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">avadhūta</span>–to the renunciant <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī, the moon of Nabadwīp! All glory to the avadhūt Nityānanda Rāy!
জয় জয় নবদ্বীপ সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />যথায় হইল শ্রীচৈতন্য-অবতার ॥২॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />yathāya ha-ila śrī-chaitanya-avatāra [2]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–to the best of all abodes, <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-avatāra ha-ila</span>–Śrī Chaitanya appeared! [2]
All glory to the best of all abodes, Nabadwīp, where Śrī Chaitanya appeared!
সর্ব্বতীর্থে বাস করি’ যেই ফল পাই ।<br />নবদ্বীপে লভি তাহা একদিনে ভাই ॥৩॥
sarva-tīrthe vāsa kari’ yei phala pāi<br />navadvīpe labhi tāhā eka-dine bhāi [3]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, [souls] <span class="e2">labhi</span>–attain <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">eka-dine</span>–in one day <span class="e2">tāhā yei</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–the result that <span class="e2">pāi</span>–others attain <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by residing <span class="e2">sarva-tīrthe</span>–in all the holy places. [3]
Brother, souls attain in Nabadwīp in one day the result that others attain by residing in all the holy places.
সেই নবদ্বীপ পরিক্রমা বিবরণ ।<br />শাস্ত্র আলোচিয়া গাই শুন সাধুজন ॥৪॥
sei navadvīpa parikramā vivaraṇa<br />śāstra ālochiyā gāi śuna sādhu-jana [4]
<span class="e2">sādhu-jana</span>–O sādhus, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen [as] <span class="e2">ālochiyā</span>–I discuss <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scriptures [and] <span class="e2">gāi</span>–sing <span class="e2">parikramā</span> <span class="e2">vivaraṇa</span>–about circumambulating <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. [4]
O sādhus, listen as I discuss the scriptures and sing about circumambulating Nabadwīp.
শাস্ত্রের লিখন আর বৈষ্ণব-বচন ।<br />প্রভু-আজ্ঞা এই তিন মম প্রাণধন ॥৫॥
śāstrera likhana āra vaiṣṇava-vachana<br />prabhu-ājñā ei tina mama prāṇa-dhana [5]
<span class="e2">likhana</span>–The writing <span class="e2">śāstrera</span>–of the scriptures, <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-vachana</span>–the words of the devotees, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">prabhu-ājñā</span>–the order of the Lord— <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">tina</span>–three [are] <span class="e2">mama</span>–my <span class="e2">prāṇa-dhana</span>–life and wealth. [5]
The writing of the scriptures, the words of the devotees, and the order of the Lord are my life and wealth.
এ তিনে আশ্রয় করি’ করিব বর্ণন ।<br />নদীয়াভ্রমণবিধি শুন সর্ব্বজন ॥৬॥
e tine āśraya kari’ kariba varṇana<br />nadīyā-bhramaṇa-vidhi śuna sarva-jana [6]
<span class="e2">āśraya kari’</span>–Having taken shelter <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">tine</span>–of these three, <span class="e2">varṇana kariba</span>–I will describe <span class="e2">nadīyā-bhramaṇa-vidhi</span>–the procedure for circumambulating Nadia. <span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen. [6]
Having taken shelter of them, I will describe the procedure for circumambulating Nadia. Everyone listen.
শ্রীজীবগোস্বামী যবে ছাড়িলেন ঘর ।<br />“নদীয়া নদীয়া” বলি’ ব্যাকুল অন্তর ॥৭॥
śrī-jīva-gosvāmī yabe chhāḍilena ghara<br />“nadīyā nadīyā” bali’ vyākula antara [7]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">śrī-jīva-gosvāmī</span>–Śrī Jīva Goswāmī <span class="e2">chhāḍilena</span>–left <span class="e2">ghara</span>–home, [he was] <span class="e2">vyākula</span>–eager <span class="e2">antara</span>–at heart, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–calling out, <span class="e2">“nadīyā</span> <span class="e2">nadīyā”</span>–“Nadia! Nadia!” [7]
When Śrī Jīva Goswāmī left home, he was eager at heart, calling out, “Nadia! Nadia!”
চন্দ্রদ্বীপ ছাড়ি’ তেঁহ যত পথ চলে ।<br />ভাসে দুই চক্ষু তাঁর নয়নের জলে ॥৮॥
chandradvīpa chhāḍi’ te̐ha yata patha chale<br />bhāse dui chakṣu tā̐ra nayanera jale [8]
<span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Leaving <span class="e2">chandradvīpa</span>–Chandradwīp, <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–he <span class="e2">chale</span>–walked <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">patha</span>–[down] the road, [and] <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–his <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">chakṣu</span>–eyes <span class="e2">bhāse</span>–filled <span class="e2">nayanera jale</span>–with tears. [8]
As he left Chandradwīp and walked down the road, his eyes filled with tears.
“হা গৌরাঙ্গ নিত্যানন্দ জীবের জীবন ।<br />কবে মোরে কৃপা করি’ দিবে দরশন ॥৯॥
হা হা নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />কবে বা দেখিব আমি” বলে বারবার ॥১০॥
“hā gaurāṅga nityānanda jīvera jīvana<br />kabe more kṛpā kari’ dibe daraśana [9]
hā hā navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />kabe vā dekhiba āmi” bale bāra-bāra [10]
<span class="e2">bāra-bāra</span>–Again and again, <span class="e2">bale</span>–he called out, <span class="e2">“hā gaurāṅga</span>–“O Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–O Nityānanda! <span class="e2">jīvera jīvana</span>–O Life of the soul! <span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–You mercifully <span class="e2">daraśana dibe</span>–appear <span class="e2">more</span>–before me? <span class="e2">hā</span> <span class="e2">hā</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–O Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–best of all abodes! <span class="e2">kabe</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–When <span class="e2">āmi dekhiba”</span>–will I see [you]?” [9<span class="e2">–</span>10]
Again and again, he called out, “O Gaurāṅga! O Nityānanda! O Life of the soul! When will You mercifully appear before me? O Nabadwīp Dhām, best of all abodes! When will I see you?”
কৈশোর বয়স জীব সুন্দর গঠন ।<br />বৈরাগ্যের পরাকাষ্ঠা অপূর্ব্ব দর্শন ॥১১॥
kaiśora vayasa jīva sundara gaṭhana<br />vairāgyera parākāṣṭhā apūrva darśana [11]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva [was] <span class="e2">kaiśora vayasa</span>–young [and had a] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">gaṭhana</span>–figure. <span class="e2">parākāṣṭhā</span>–The depth <span class="e2">vairāgyera</span>–of [his] detachment [was an] <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–astonishing <span class="e2">darśana</span>–sight. [11]
Jīva was young and had a beautiful figure. His extreme detachment was astonishing to see.
চলিয়া চলিয়া কতদিন মহাশয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপ উত্তরিল সদা প্রেমময় ॥১২॥
chaliyā chaliyā kata-dine mahāśaya<br />navadvīpe uttarila sadā premamaya [12]
<span class="e2">chaliyā</span> <span class="e2">chaliyā</span>–After walking <span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–for many days, <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">premamaya</span>–filled with divine love, <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–the great soul <span class="e2">uttarila</span>–arrived <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. [12]
After walking for many days, always filled with divine love, Jīva arrived in Nabadwīp.
দূর হৈতে নবদ্বীপ করি’ দরশন ।<br />দণ্ডবৎ হয়ে পড়ে প্রায় অচেতন ॥১৩॥
dūra haite navadvīpa kari’ daraśana<br />daṇḍavat haye paḍe prāya achetana [13]
<span class="e2">daraśana kari’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">dūra</span>–a distance, <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–he bowed [and] <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–fell <span class="e2">prāya</span>–almost <span class="e2">achetana</span>–unconscious. [13]
Seeing Nabadwīp from a distance, he bowed and fell almost unconscious.
কতক্ষণ পরে নিজ চিত্ত করি’ স্থির ।<br />প্রবেশিল নবদ্বীপে পুলকশরীর ॥১৪॥
kata-kṣaṇa pare nija chitta kari’ sthira<br />praveśila navadvīpe pulaka śarīra [14]
<span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇa</span>–Some time <span class="e2">pare</span>–later <span class="e2">sthira kari’</span>–he steadied <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">chitta</span>–heart [and] <span class="e2">praveśila</span>–entered <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">pulaka śarīra</span>–the hair on his body standing on end. [14]
Eventually he steadied his heart and entered Nabadwīp, the hair on his body standing on end.
বারকোণা ঘাটে আসি’ জিজ্ঞাসে সবারে ।<br />“কোথা প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ দেখাও আমারে” ॥১৫॥
bārakoṇā ghāṭe āsi’ jijñāse sabāre<br />“kothā prabhu nityānanda dekhāo āmāre” [15]
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–He came <span class="e2">bārakoṇā</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭe</span>–to Bārakoṇā Ghāṭ [and] <span class="e2">jijñāse</span>–asked <span class="e2">sabāre</span>–everyone, <span class="e2">“kothā</span>–“Where [is] <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu? <span class="e2">dekhāo</span>–Please show <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–me.” [15]
He came to Bārakoṇā Ghāṭ and asked everyone, “Where is Nityānanda Prabhu? Please show me.”
শ্রীজীবের ভাব দেখি’ কোন মহাজন ।<br />প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ যথা লয় ততক্ষণ ॥১৬॥
śrī-jīvera bhāva dekhi’ kona mahājana<br />prabhu nityānanda yathā laya tata-kṣaṇa [16]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">śrī-jīvera</span>–Śrī Jīva’s <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–ecstasy, <span class="e2">kona</span>–a <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–great soul <span class="e2">tata-kṣaṇa</span>–immediately <span class="e2">laya</span>–brought [him] <span class="e2">yathā</span>–to <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu. [16]
Seeing Śrī Jīva’s ecstasy, a great soul immediately brought him to Nityānanda Prabhu.
হেথা প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ অট্ট অট্ট হাসি’ ।<br />শ্রীজীব আসিবে বলি’ অন্তরে উল্লাসী ॥১৭॥
hethā prabhu nityānanda aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsi’<br />śrī-jīva āsibe bali’ antare ullāsī [17]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Knowing <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">āsibe</span>–would come <span class="e2">hethā</span>–there, <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu [was] <span class="e2">ullāsī</span>–delighted <span class="e2">antare</span>–at heart [and] <span class="e2">aṭṭa</span> <span class="e2">aṭṭa</span> <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–roaring with laughter. [17]
Knowing that Śrī Jīva would come, Nityānanda Prabhu was delighted at heart and roaring with laughter.
আজ্ঞা দিল দাসগণে শ্রীজীবে আনিতে ।<br />অনেক বৈষ্ণব যায় জীব সম্বোধিতে ॥১৮॥
ājñā dila dāsa-gaṇe śrī-jīve ānite<br />aneka vaiṣṇava yāya jīve sambodhite [18]
<span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–He ordered <span class="e2">dāsa-gaṇe</span>–[His] servants <span class="e2">ānite</span>–to bring <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–Śrī Jīva, [and] <span class="e2">aneka</span>–many <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–devotees <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">sambodhite</span>–to call <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva. [18]
He ordered His servants to bring Śrī Jīva, and many devotees went to call him.
সাত্ত্বিক-বিকারপূর্ণ জীবের শরীর ।<br />দেখি’ জীব বলি’ সবে করিলেন স্থির ॥১৯॥
sāttvika-vikāra-pūrṇa jīvera śarīra<br />dekhi’ jīva bali’ sabe karilena sthira [19]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Upon seeing <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–the body <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of Jīva <span class="e2">sāttvika-vikāra-pūrṇa</span>–filled with divine ecstasy, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">sthira karilena</span>–identified <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva. [19]
Upon seeing the body of Jīva filled with divine ecstasy, Nityānanda Prabhu’s servants identified him.
কেহ কেহ আগে গিয়া মহাপ্রেমভরে ।<br />নিত্যানন্দ-প্রভু-আজ্ঞা বিজ্ঞাপন করে ॥২০॥
keha keha āge giyā mahāprema-bhare<br />nityānanda-prabhu-ājñā vijñāpana kare [20]
<span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">keha</span>–Some, <span class="e2">mahāprema-bhare</span>–filled with intense divine love, <span class="e2">giyā</span>–went <span class="e2">āge</span>–forward [and] <span class="e2">vijñāpana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–conveyed <span class="e2">nityānanda-prabhu-ājñā</span>–the order of Nityānanda Prabhu [to Jīva]. [20]
Some of them, filled with intense divine love, went forward and conveyed the order of Nityānanda Prabhu to Jīva.
প্রভু-নিত্যানন্দ-নাম করিয়া শ্রবণ ।<br />ধরণীতে পড়ে জীব হয়ে অচেতন ॥২১॥
prabhu-nityānanda-nāma kariyā śravaṇa<br />dharaṇīte paḍe jīva haye achetana [21]
<span class="e2">śravaṇa kariyā</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–of Nityānanda Prabhu, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–fell <span class="e2">dharaṇīte</span>–to the ground <span class="e2">achetana haye</span>–unconscious. [21]
Hearing the Name of Nityānanda Prabhu, Jīva fell to the ground unconscious.
ক্ষণেক উঠিয়া বলে, “বড় ভাগ্য মম ।<br />প্রভু-নিত্যানন্দ-কৃপা পাইল অধম” ॥২২॥
kṣaṇeka uṭhiyā bale, “baḍa bhāgya mama<br />prabhu-nityānanda-kṛpā pāila adhama” [22]
<span class="e2">kṣaṇeka</span>–Immediately, <span class="e2">uṭhiyā</span>–he arose [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, [“It is] <span class="e2">“mama</span>–my <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–great <span class="e2">bhāgya</span>–fortune [that I,] <span class="e2">adhama</span>–a fallen soul, <span class="e2">pāila</span>–have received <span class="e2">nityānanda-prabhu-kṛpā”</span>–the mercy of Nityānanda Prabhu.” [22]
Immediately, he arose and said, “It is my great fortune that I, a fallen soul, have received the mercy of Nityānanda Prabhu.”
সে সব বৈষ্ণবগণে দণ্ডবৎ হয়ে ।<br />প্রণাম করয়ে জীব প্রফুল্ল হৃদয়ে ॥২৩॥
se saba vaiṣṇava-gaṇe daṇḍavat haye<br />praṇāma karaye jīva praphulla hṛdaye [23]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">haya praṇāma karaye</span>–prostrated himself <span class="e2">se saba vaiṣṇava-gaṇe</span>–before all the devotees <span class="e2">praphulla hṛdaye</span>–with a jubilant heart. [23]
Jīva prostrated himself before all the devotees with a jubilant heart.
বলে, “তুমি সবে মোরে হইলে সদয় ।<br />নিত্যনন্দপদ পাই সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কয়” ॥২৪॥
bale, “tumi sabe more ha-ile sadaya<br />nityānanda-pada pāi sarva-śāstre kaya” [24]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">“sarva-śāstre</span>–“All the scriptures <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">tumi sabe sadaya ha-ile</span>–if you all are merciful <span class="e2">more</span>–to me, [then] <span class="e2">pāi</span>–I will attain <span class="e2">nityānanda-pada”</span>–the feet of Nityānanda.” [24]
He said, “All the scriptures say that if you all are merciful to me, then I will attain the feet of Nityānanda Prabhu.”
জীবের সৌভাগ্য হেরি’ কতেক বৈষ্ণব ।<br />চরণের ধূলি লয় করিয়া উৎসব ॥২৫॥
jīvera saubhāgya heri’ kateka vaiṣṇava<br />charaṇera dhūli laya kariyā utsava [25]
<span class="e2">heri’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–Jīva’s <span class="e2">saubhāgya</span>–fortune, <span class="e2">kateka</span>–some <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–of the devotees <span class="e2">utsava kariyā</span>–joyously <span class="e2">laya</span>–took <span class="e2">dhūli</span>–dust <span class="e2">charaṇera</span>–from [his] feet. [25]
Seeing Jīva’s fortune, some of the devotees joyously took dust from his feet.
সবে মেলি’ জীবে লয় নিত্যানন্দ যথা ।<br />বৈষ্ণববেষ্ঠিতে প্রভু কহে কৃষ্ণকথা ॥২৬॥
sabe meli’ jīve laya nityānanda yathā<br />vaiṣṇava-veṣṭita prabhu kahe kṛṣṇa-kathā [26]
<span class="e2">sabe</span>–They all <span class="e2">meli’</span>–joined together [and] <span class="e2">laya</span>–took <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–to Nityānanda Prabhu, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kathā kahe</span>–He was speaking about Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-veṣṭita</span>–surrounded by devotees. [26]
They all joined together and took Jīva to Nityānanda Prabhu, where He was speaking about Kṛṣṇa, surrounded by devotees.
প্রভু নিত্যানন্দের দেখিয়া দিব্যরূপ ।<br />জীবের শরীরে হয় ভাব অপরূপ ॥২৭॥
prabhu nityānandera dekhiyā divya-rūpa<br />jīvera śarīra haya bhāva aparūpa [27]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">divya-rūpa</span>–the divine form <span class="e2">prabhu nityānandera</span>–of Nityānanda Prabhu, <span class="e2">aparūpa bhāva</span>–extraordinary ecstasy <span class="e2">haya</span>–arose <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–in Jīva’s body. [27]
Seeing the divine form of Nityānanda Prabhu, extraordinary ecstasy arose in Jīva’s body.
“কি অপূর্ব্বরূপ আজ হেরিনু” বলিয়া ।<br />পড়িল ধরণীতলে অচেতন হৈয়া ॥২৮॥
“ki apūrva-rūpa āja herinu” baliyā<br />paḍila dharaṇī-tale achetana haiyā [28]
<span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Thinking, <span class="e2">“ki</span>–“What <span class="e2">apūrva-rūpa</span>–a wonderful form <span class="e2">herinu</span>–I have seen <span class="e2">āja”</span>–today!”, [Jīva] <span class="e2">paḍila</span>–fell <span class="e2">dharaṇī-tale</span>–to the ground <span class="e2">achetana haiyā</span>–unconscious. [28]
Thinking, “What a wonderful form I have seen today!”, Jīva fell to the ground unconscious.
মহাকৃপাবশে প্রভু নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />জীবে উঠাইয়া লয় আপনার পায় ॥২৯॥
mahākṛpā-vaśe prabhu nityānanda-rāya<br />jīve uṭhāiyā laya āpanāra pāya [29]
<span class="e2">mahākṛpā-vaśe</span>–Moved by intense compassion, <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">uṭhāiyā laya</span>–raised <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">āpanāra</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–to His feet. [29]
Moved by intense compassion, Nityānanda Prabhu raised Jīva to His feet.
ব্যস্ত হয়ে শ্রীজীবগোস্বামী দাঁড়াইল ।<br />কর যুড়ি’ নিত্যানন্দে কহিতে লাগিল ॥৩০॥
vyasta haye śrī-jīva-gosvāmī dā̐ḍāila<br />kara yuḍi’ nityānande kahite lāgila [30]
<span class="e2">śrī-jīva-gosvāmī</span>–Śrī Jīva Goswāmī <span class="e2">vyasta</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–quickly <span class="e2">dā̐ḍāila</span>–stood up, <span class="e2">yuḍi’</span>–joined [his] <span class="e2">kara</span>–hands, [and] <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–began <span class="e2">kahite</span>–to speak <span class="e2">nityānande</span>–to Nityānanda. [30]
Śrī Jīva Goswāmī quickly stood up, joined his palms, and began to speak to Nityānanda.
“বিশ্বরূপ বিশ্বধাম তুমি বলরাম ।<br />আমি জীব কিবা জানি তব গুণগ্রাম ॥৩১॥
“viśva-rūpa viśva-dhāma tumi balarāma<br />āmi jīva kibā jāni tava guṇa-grāma [31]
<span class="e2">“tumi</span>–“You [are] <span class="e2">balarāma</span>–Balarām, <span class="e2">viśva-rūpa</span>–the form of the world, <span class="e2">viśva-dhāma</span>–the shelter of the world. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–a soul. <span class="e2">kibā</span>–How <span class="e2">jāni</span>–would I understand <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">guṇa-grāma</span>–glories? [31]
“You are Balarām, the original form and shelter of the world. I am just a soul. How can I understand Your glories?
তুমি মোর প্রভু নিত্য আমি তব দাস ।<br />তোমার চরণছায়া একমাত্র আশ ॥৩২॥
tumi mora prabhu nitya āmi tava dāsa<br />tomāra charaṇa-chhāyā eka-mātra āśa [32]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Master, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant. <span class="e2">tomāra charaṇa-chhāyā</span>–The shade of Your feet [is my] <span class="e2">eka-mātra</span>–one and only <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration. [32]
“You are my Master, and I am Your eternal servant. The shade of Your feet is my one and only aspiration.
তুমি যারে কর দয়া সেই অনায়াসে ।<br />শ্রীচৈতন্যপদ পায় প্রেমজলে ভাসে ॥৩৩॥
tumi yāre kara dayā sei anāyāse<br />śrī-chaitanya-pada pāya prema-jale bhāse [33]
<span class="e2">sei yāre</span>–Those whom <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">dayā kara</span>–bless <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-pada</span>–the feet of Śrī Chaitanya [and] <span class="e2">bhāse</span>–float <span class="e2">prema-jale</span>–in the waters of divine love. [33]
“Those whom you bless easily attain the feet of Śrī Chaitanya and float in the waters of divine love.
তোমার করুণা বিনা গৌর নাহি পায় ।<br />শত জন্ম ভজে যদি গৌরাঙ্গ হিয়ায় ॥৩৪॥
tomāra karuṇā vinā gaura nāhi pāya<br />śata janma bhaje yadi gaurāṅga hiyāya [34]
<span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">karuṇā</span>–grace, [souls] <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–even if <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–they serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">hiyāya</span>–within [their] heart <span class="e2">śata</span> <span class="e2">janma</span>–for one hundred births. [34]
“Without Your grace, souls do not attain Śrī Gaura, even if they serve Him within their heart for one hundred births.
গৌর দণ্ড করে যদি তুমি রক্ষা কর ।<br />তুমি যারে দণ্ড কর গৌর তার পর ॥৩৫॥
gaura daṇḍa kare yadi tumi rakṣā kara<br />tumi yāre daṇḍa kara gaura tāra para [35]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">daṇḍa kare</span>–punishes [someone,] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">rakṣā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–protect [them, and] <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">para</span>–rejects <span class="e2">tāra yāre</span>–whomever <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">daṇḍa</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–punish. [35]
“If Gaura punishes someone, You protect them, and Gaura rejects whomever You punish.
অতএব প্রভু তব চরন-কমলে ।<br />লইনু শরণ আমি সুকৃতির বলে ॥৩৬॥
ataeva prabhu tava charaṇa-kamale<br />la-inu śaraṇa āmi sukṛtira bale [36]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–O Lord, <span class="e2">sukṛtira</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–by [my] good fortune, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">śaraṇa la-inu</span>–have taken shelter <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">charaṇa-kamale</span>–at Your lotus feet. [36]
“Therefore, O Lord, by my good fortune, I have taken shelter at Your lotus feet.
তুমি কৃপা করি মোরে দেহ অনুমতি ।<br />শ্রীগৌরদর্শনে পাই গৌরে হউ রতি ॥৩৭॥
tumi kṛpā kari’ more deha anumati<br />śrī-gaura-darśane pāi gaure ha-u rati [37]
[May] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">deha</span>–give <span class="e2">more</span>–me [Your] <span class="e2">anumati</span>–consent [that] <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-darśane</span> <span class="e2">pāi</span>–I may see Śrī Gaura [and] <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–develop <span class="e2">rati</span>–devotion <span class="e2">gaure</span>–to Gaura. [37]
“O Lord, mercifully give Your consent that I may see Śrī Gaura and develop devotion to Him.
যবে রামকেলিগ্রামে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গরায় ।<br />আমার পিতৃব্যদ্বয়ে লইলেন পায় ॥৩৮॥
yabe rāmakeli-grāme śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya<br />āmāra pitṛvya-dvaye la-ilena pāya [38]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy [was] <span class="e2">rāmakeli-grāme</span>–in the village of Rāmakeli, <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">pitṛvya-dvaye</span>–uncles <span class="e2">la-ilena</span>–took [shelter] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–at [His] feet. [38]
“When Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy was in the village of Rāmakeli, my uncles took shelter at His feet.
সেই কালে শিশু আমি সজল নয়নে ।<br />হেরিলাম গৌররূপ সদা জাগে মনে ॥৩৯॥
sei kāle śiśu āmi sajala nayane<br />herilāma gaura-rūpa sadā jāge mane [39]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [was] <span class="e2">śiśu</span>–a child. <span class="e2">sajala</span> <span class="e2">nayane</span>–With tearful eyes, <span class="e2">herilāma</span>–I saw <span class="e2">gaura-rūpa</span>–Gaura’s form, [and still now that form] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–constantly <span class="e2">jāge</span>–arises <span class="e2">mane</span>–in my heart. [39]
“At that time, I was a child. With tearful eyes, I saw Śrī Gaura’s form, and still now that form constantly arises in my heart.
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গপদে পড়ি’ করিনু প্রণতি ।<br />শ্রীঅঙ্গ স্পর্শিয়া সুখ পাইলাম অতি ॥৪০॥
śrī-gaurāṅga-pade paḍi’ karinu praṇati<br />śrī-aṅga sparśiyā sukha pāilāma ati [40]
<span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–Bowing <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-pade</span>–at Śrī Gaurāṅga’s feet, <span class="e2">praṇati karinu</span>–I offered [my] obeisance. <span class="e2">sparśiyā</span>–Touching [His] <span class="e2">śrī-aṅga</span>–divine form, <span class="e2">pāilāma</span>–I felt <span class="e2">ati</span>–great <span class="e2">sukha</span>–joy. [40]
“Bowing at Śrī Gaurāṅga’s feet, I offered my obeisance. Touching His divine form, I felt great joy.
সেই কালে গৌর মোরে কহিলা বচন ।<br />‘ওহে জীব কর তুমি শাস্ত্র অধ্যয়ন ॥৪১॥
sei kāle gaura more kahilā vachana<br />‘ohe jīva kara tumi śāstra adhyayana [41]
<span class="e2">sei kāle</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">vachana kahilā</span>–said <span class="e2">more</span>–to me, <span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">kara</span>–should <span class="e2">adhyayana</span>–study <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scriptures. [41]
“At that time, Gaura said to me, ‘O Jīva, study the scriptures.
অধ্যয়ন সমাপিয়া নবদ্বীপে চল ।<br />নিত্যানন্দ শ্রীচরণে পাইবে সকল’ ॥৪২॥
adhyayana samāpiyā navadvīpe chala<br />nityānanda śrī-charaṇe pāibe sakala’ [42]
<span class="e2">samāpiyā</span>–Complete [your] <span class="e2">adhyayana</span>–study [and then] <span class="e2">chala</span>–go <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">nityānanda</span> <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇe</span>–At the holy feet of Nityānanda, <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">sakala’</span>–everything.’ [42]
“‘Complete your study and then go to Nabadwīp. There, at the holy feet of Nityānanda, you will attain everything.’
সেই আজ্ঞা শিরে ধরি’ আমি অকিঞ্চন ।<br />যথা সাধ্য বিদ্যা করিয়াছি উপার্জ্জন ॥৪৩॥
sei ājñā śire dhari’ āmi akiñchana<br />yathā sādhya vidyā kariyāchhi upārjana [43]
<span class="e2">dhari’</span>–Holding <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–order <span class="e2">śire</span>–on [my] head, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I, <span class="e2">akiñchana</span>–a poor soul, <span class="e2">upārjana kariyāchhi</span>–have acquired <span class="e2">vidyā</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">yathā</span>–as [was] <span class="e2">sādhya</span>–possible. [43]
“Holding this order on my head, I, a poor soul, have learned as much as possible.
চন্দ্রদ্বীপে পড়িলাম সাহিত্যাদি যত ।<br />বেদান্ত আচার্য্য নাহি পাই মনোমত ॥৪৪॥
chandradvīpe paḍilāma sāhityādi yata<br />vedānta āchārya nāhi pāi manomata [44]
<span class="e2">paḍilāma</span>–I studied <span class="e2">yata sāhityādi</span>–literature and other subjects <span class="e2">chandradvīpe</span>–in Chandradwīp, [but] <span class="e2">pāi nāhi</span>–I did not find [an] <span class="e2">manomata</span>–expert <span class="e2">āchārya</span>–teacher <span class="e2">vedānta</span>–of Vedānta. [44]
“I studied literature and other subjects in Chandradwīp, but I did not find an expert teacher of Vedānta.
প্রভু আজ্ঞা দিল মোরে বেদান্ত পড়িতে ।<br />বেদান্তসম্মত কৃষ্ণভক্তি প্রকাশিতে ॥৪৫॥
prabhu ājñā dila more vedānta paḍite<br />vedānta-sammata kṛṣṇa-bhakti prakāśite [45]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–ordered <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">paḍite</span>–to study <span class="e2">vedānta</span>–Vedānta [and] <span class="e2">prakāśite</span>–prove [that] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">vedānta-sammata</span>–the purport of Vedānta. [45]
“The Lord ordered me to study Vedānta and prove that devotion to Kṛṣṇa is its purport.
আইলাম নবদ্বীপে তোমার চবণে ।<br />যেইরূপ আজ্ঞা হয় করি আচরণে ॥৪৬॥
āilāma navadvīpe tomāra charaṇe<br />yei rūpa ājñā haya kari ācharaṇe [46]
<span class="e2">āilāma</span>–I have come <span class="e2">tomāra charaṇe</span>–to Your feet <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">ācharaṇe kari</span>–I will do <span class="e2">yei rūpa</span>–whatever <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–You order [me]. [46]
“So, I have come to Your feet in Nabadwīp, and I will do whatever You order me.
আজ্ঞা হয় যাই ক্ষেত্রে প্রভুর চরণে ।<br />বেদান্ত পড়িব সার্ব্বভৌমের সদনে” ॥৪৭॥
ājñā haya yāi kṣetre prabhura charaṇe<br />vedānta paḍiba sārva-bhaumera sadane” [47]
[If] <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–You order [me,] <span class="e2">yāi</span>–I will go <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–to the feet of the Lord <span class="e2">kṣetre</span>–in Jagannāth Purī [and] <span class="e2">paḍiba</span>–study <span class="e2">vedānta</span>–Vedānta <span class="e2">sārva-bhaumera</span> <span class="e2">sadane”</span>–at the school of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya.” [47]
“If You order me, I will go to the feet of the Lord in Puruṣottam Kṣetra and study Vedānta at the school of Sārvabhauma Bhattāchārya.”
জীবের মধুর বাক্যে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />জীবে কোলে করি’ কাঁদে ধৈর্য্য নাহি পায় ॥৪৮॥
jīvera madhura vākye nityānanda-rāya<br />jīve kole kari’ kā̐de dhairya nāhi pāya [48]
[Moved] <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">madhura</span> <span class="e2">vākye</span>–by Jīva’s sweet words, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">kole</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–embraced <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva [and] <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cried, <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–without <span class="e2">dhairya</span>–restraint. [48]
Moved by Jīva’s sweet words, Nityānanda Rāy embraced Jīva and cried, unable to restrain Himself.
বলে, “শুন ওহে জীব নিগূঢ় বচন ।<br />সর্ব্বতত্ত্ব অবগত রূপ সনাতন ॥৪৯॥
bale, “śuna ohe jīva nigūḍha vachana<br />sarva-tattva avagata rūpa sanātana [49]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–Nityānanda said, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen [to My] <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">vachana</span>–words. <span class="e2">rūpa</span> <span class="e2">sanātana</span>–Rūpa and Sanātan <span class="e2">avagata</span>–know <span class="e2">sarva-tattva</span>–everything. [49]
Nityānanda said, “O Jīva, listen to My confidential words. Rūpa and Sanātan know everything.
প্রভু মোরে আজ্ঞা দিল বলিতে তোমায় ।<br />‘ক্ষেত্রে নাহি যাও তুমি না রহ হেথায়’ ॥৫০॥
prabhu more ājñā dila balite tomāya<br />‘kṣetre nāhi yāo tumi nā raha hethāya’ [50]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–ordered <span class="e2">more</span>–Me <span class="e2">balite</span>–to tell <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–you, <span class="e2">“tumi yāo nāhi</span>–Do not go <span class="e2">kṣetre</span>–to Jagannāth Purī [and] <span class="e2">raha nā</span>–do not stay <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here.’ [50]
“The Lord ordered Me to tell you, ‘Do not go to Puruṣottam Kṣetra or stay here.’
তুমি আর রূপ সনাতন দুই ভাই ।<br />প্রভুর একান্ত দাস জানেন সবাই ॥৫১॥
tumi āra rūpa sanātana dui bhāi<br />prabhura ekānta dāsa jānena sabai [51]
<span class="e2">sabai</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">jānena</span>–knows [that] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–the two brothers <span class="e2">rūpa</span> <span class="e2">sanātana</span>–Rūpa and Sanātan [are] <span class="e2">ekānta</span>–exclusive <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord. [51]
“Everyone knows that you and the brothers Rūpa and Sanātan are exclusive servants of the Lord.
তোমা প্রতি আজ্ঞা এই বারাণসী গিয়া ।<br />বাচস্পতি নিকটেতে বেদান্ত পড়িয়া ॥৫২॥
একেবারে যাহ তথা হৈতে বৃন্দাবন ।<br />তথা কৃপা করিবেন রূপ সনাতন ॥৫৩॥
tomā prati ājñā ei vārāṇasī giyā<br />vāchaspati nikaṭete vedānta paḍiyā [52]
ekebāre yāha tathā haite vṛndāvana<br />tathā kṛpā karibena rūpa sanātana [53]
[The Lord’s] <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–order <span class="e2">prati</span>–to <span class="e2">tomā</span>–you [is] <span class="e2">ei</span>–that <span class="e2">giyā</span>–you go <span class="e2">vārāṇasī</span>–to Vārāṇasī, <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–study <span class="e2">vedānta</span>–Vedānta <span class="e2">nikaṭete</span>–with <span class="e2">vāchaspati</span>–Madhusūdan Vāchaspati, [and then] <span class="e2">yāha</span>–go <span class="e2">ekebāre</span>–straight <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–to Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. <span class="e2">rūpa</span> <span class="e2">sanātana</span>–Rūpa and Sanātan <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">karibena</span>–will bless [you] <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [52<span class="e2">–</span>53]
“The Lord’s order to you is that you go to Vārāṇasī, study Vedānta with Madhusūdan Vāchaspati, and then go straight to Vṛndāvan from there. Rūpa and Sanātan will bless you in Vṛndāvan.
রূপের অনুগ হয়ে যুগল-ভজন ।<br />কর তথা বেদান্তাদি শাস্ত্র-আলাপন ॥ ৫৪॥
rūpera anuga haye yugala-bhajana<br />kara tathā vedāntādi śāstra-ālāpana [54]
<span class="e2">yugala-bhajana kara</span>–Serve the Divine Couple <span class="e2">haye</span>–as<span class="e2"> anuga</span>–a follower <span class="e2">rūpera</span>–of Rūpa. <span class="e2">vedāntādi</span> <span class="e2">śāstra-ālāpana</span>–Discuss Vedānta and other scriptures <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [54]
“Serve the Divine Couple as a follower of Śrī Rūpa, and discuss Vedānta and other scriptures there.
ভাগবত শাস্ত্র হয় সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রসার ।<br />বেদান্তসূত্রের ভাষ্য করহ প্রচার ॥৫৫॥
bhāgavata śāstra haya sarva-śāstra-sāra<br />vedānta-sūtrera bhāṣya karaha prachāra [55]
<span class="e2">prachāra karaha</span>–Preach [that] <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scripture <span class="e2">bhāgavata</span>–<span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sarva-śāstra-sāra</span>–the best of all scriptures [and] <span class="e2">bhāṣya</span>–the commentary <span class="e2">vedānta-sūtrera</span>–on the <span class="e3">Vedānta-sūtra</span>. [55]
“Preach that <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> is the best of all the scriptures and the natural commentary on the <span class="e3">Vedānta-sūtra</span>.
সার্ব্বভৌমে কৃপা করি’ গৌরাঙ্গ শ্রীহরি ।<br />ব্রহ্মসূত্র ব্যাখ্যা কৈল ভাগবত ধরি’ ॥৫৬॥
sārvabhaume kṛpā kari’ gaurāṅga śrī-hari<br />brahma-sūtra vyākhyā kaila bhāgavata dhari’ [56]
<span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span> <span class="e2">śrī-hari</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga Hari <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">vyākhyā</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–explained <span class="e2">brahma-sūtra</span>–the <span class="e3">Brahma-sūtra</span> <span class="e2">sārvabhaume</span>–to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya, <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–drawing <span class="e2">bhāgavata</span>–from <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span>. [56]
“Śrī Gaurāṅga Hari mercifully explained the <span class="e3">Brahma-sūtra</span> to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya on the basis of <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span>.
সেই বিদ্যা সার্ব্বভৌম শ্রীমধুসূদনে ।<br />শিখাইল ক্ষেত্রধামে পরম যতনে ॥৫৭॥
sei vidyā sārvabhauma śrī-madhusūdane<br />śikhāila kṣetra-dhāme parama yatane [57]
<span class="e2">sārvabhauma</span>–Sārvabhauma <span class="e2">parama</span>–very <span class="e2">yatane</span>–carefully <span class="e2">śikhāila</span>–taught <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">vidyā</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">śrī-madhusūdane</span>–to Śrī Madhusūdan <span class="e2">kṣetra-dhāme</span>–in Jagannāth Purī. [57]
“Sārvabhauma very carefully taught this knowledge to Śrī Madhusūdan in Śrī Kṣetra Dhām.
সেই মধুবাচস্পতি প্রভু-আজ্ঞা পেয়ে ।<br />আছে বারাণসী ধামে দেখ তুমি যেয়ে ॥৫৮॥
sei madhu-vāchaspati prabhu-ājñā peye<br />āchhe vārāṇasī dhāme dekha tumi yeye [58]
<span class="e2">peye</span>–Having received <span class="e2">prabhu-ājñā</span>–the order of the Lord <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">madhu-vāchaspati</span>–Madhusūdan Vāchaspati <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is <span class="e2">vārāṇasī dhāme</span>–in Vārāṇasī Dhām. <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">yeye</span>–Go [and] <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see [him]. [58]
“Go and see Madhusūdan Vāchaspati, who is in Vārāṇasī Dhām on the order of the Lord.
বাহ্যে তেঁহ সম্প্রদায়ী বৈদান্তিক হয় ।<br />শাঙ্করী সন্ন্যাসী যার নিকটে পড়য় ॥৫৯॥
bāhye te̐ha sampradāyī vaidāntika haya<br />śāṅkarī sannyāsī yāra nikaṭe paḍaya [59]
<span class="e2">bāhye</span>–Externally, <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–he <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sampradāyī</span>–a traditional <span class="e2">vaidāntika</span>–Vedāntic scholar, [and] <span class="e2">śāṅkarī</span>–Śaṅkarite <span class="e2">sannyāsī</span>–sannyāsīs <span class="e2">paḍaya</span>–study <span class="e2">yāra nikaṭe</span>–with him. [59]
“Externally, he is a traditional Vedāntic scholar, and Śaṅkarite sannyāsīs study with him.
ক্রমে ক্রমে সন্ন্যাসিগণেরে কৃপা করি’ ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গের ব্যাখ্যা শিক্ষা দেয় সূত্র ধরি’ ॥৬০॥
krame krame sannyāsi-gaṇere kṛpā kari’<br />gaurāṅgera vyākhyā śikṣā deya sūtra dhari’ [60]
<span class="e2">krame</span> <span class="e2">krame</span>–In a gradual way, <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–he mercifully <span class="e2">śikṣā</span> <span class="e2">deya</span>–teaches <span class="e2">sannyāsi-gaṇere</span>–the sannyāsīs <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–Gaurāṅga’s <span class="e2">vyākhyā</span>–explanations <span class="e2">sūtra</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–of the sūtras. [60]
“In a gradual way, he mercifully teaches the sannyāsīs Gaurāṅga’s explanations of the sūtras.
পৃথক্ ভাষ্যের এবে নাহি প্রয়োজন ।<br />ভাগবতে কয় সূত্র ভাষ্যেতে গণন ॥৬১॥
pṛthak bhāṣyera ebe nāhi prayojana<br />bhāgavate kaya sūtra bhāṣyete gaṇana [61]
<span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–need <span class="e2">pṛthak</span> <span class="e2">bhāṣyera</span>–for a separate commentary <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now. <span class="e2">bhāgavate</span>–The <span class="e3">Bhāgavatam</span> <span class="e2">kaya</span>–explains <span class="e2">sūtra</span>–the sūtras [and is] <span class="e2">gaṇana</span>–considered <span class="e2">bhāṣyete</span>–the commentary. [61]
“There is no need for a separate commentary on the <span class="e3">Brahma-sūtra</span> now. The <span class="e3">Bhāgavatam</span> explains the sūtras and is considered the sūtras’ natural commentary.
কালে যবে ভাষ্যের হইবে প্রয়োজন ।<br />শ্রীগোবিন্দভাষ্য তবে হবে প্রকটন ॥৬২॥
kāle yabe bhāṣyera ha-ibe prayojana<br />śrī-govinda-bhāṣya tabe habe prakaṭana [62]
<span class="e2">kāle</span>–In time, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–there will be <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–a need <span class="e2">bhāṣyera</span>–for a commentary, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">śrī-govinda-bhāṣya</span>–the <span class="e3">Śrī Govinda-bhāṣya</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be <span class="e2">prakaṭana</span>–revealed. [62]
“In time, when there is a need for another commentary, the <span class="e3">Śrī Govinda-bhāṣya</span> will be revealed.
সার্ব্বভৌম সম্পর্কে সেই গোপীনাথ ।<br />শুনিল প্রভুর ভাষ্য সার্ব্বভৌম সাথ ॥৬৩॥
sārvabhauma samparke sei gopīnātha<br />śunila prabhura bhāṣya sārvabhauma sātha [63]
<span class="e2">sārvabhauma</span> <span class="e2">samparke</span>–Sārvabhauma’s relative, <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">gopīnātha</span>–Gopīnāth Āchārya, <span class="e2">śunila</span>–heard <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">bhāṣya</span>–commentary <span class="e2">sātha</span>–with <span class="e2">sārvabhauma</span>–Sārvabhauma. [63]
“Sārvabhauma’s relative, Gopīnāth Āchārya, heard the Lord’s commentary with Sārvabhauma.
কালে তেঁহ প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় জন্ম লয়ে ।<br />বলদেবাবেশে যাবে জয়পুর জয়ে ॥৬৪॥
kāle te̐ha prabhura ichchhāya janma laye<br />baladevāveśe yābe jayapura jaye [64]
<span class="e2">kāle</span>–In time, <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–by the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–he <span class="e2">laye</span>–will take <span class="e2">janma</span>–birth <span class="e2">baladevāveśe</span>–as Baladev Vidyābhūṣaṇ [and] <span class="e2">jaye yābe</span>–will conquer <span class="e2">jayapura</span>–Jaipur. [64]
“In time, by the will of the Lord, he will take birth as Baladev Vidyābhūṣaṇ and conquer Jaipur.
তথা শ্রীগোবিন্দ বলে ভাষ্য প্রকাশিয়া ।<br />সেবিবে গৌরাঙ্গপদ জীবে নিস্তারিয়া ॥৬৫॥
tathā śrī-govinda bale bhāṣya prakāśiyā<br />sevibe gaurāṅga-pada jīve nistāriyā [65]
<span class="e2">tathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">prakāśiyā</span>–he will compose <span class="e2">bhāṣya</span>–a commentary <span class="e2">śrī-govinda</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–spoken by Śrī Govinda, <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-pada</span>–the feet of Gaurāṅga, [and] <span class="e2">nistāriyā</span>–deliver <span class="e2">jīve</span>–the souls. [65]
“There, he will compose a commentary spoken by Śrī Govinda, serve the feet of Gaurāṅga, and deliver the souls.
এই সব গূঢ় কথা রূপ সনাতন ।<br />সকল কহিবে তোমা প্রতি দুইজন” ॥৬৬॥
ei saba gūḍha kathā rūpa sanātana<br />sakala kahibe tomā prati dui-jana” [66]
<span class="e2">dui-jana rūpa</span> <span class="e2">sanātana</span>–Rūpa and Sanātan <span class="e2">kahibe</span>–will explain <span class="e2">sakala ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all these <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">kathā</span>–matters <span class="e2">prati</span>–to <span class="e2">tomā”</span>–you.” [66]
“Rūpa and Sanātan will explain all these confidential matters to you.”
নিত্যানন্দ-বাক্য শুনি’ শ্রীজীব গোঁসাই ।<br />কাঁদিয়া লোটায় ভূমে সংজ্ঞা আর নাই ॥৬৭॥
nityānanda-vākya śuni’ śrī-jīva go̐sāi<br />kā̐diyā loṭāya bhūme saṁjña āra nāi [67]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Upon hearing <span class="e2">nityānanda-vākya</span>–the words of Nityānanda, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span> <span class="e2">go̐sāi</span>–Śrī Jīva Goswāmī <span class="e2">loṭāya</span>–rolled <span class="e2">bhūme</span>–on the ground <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–crying [and] <span class="e2">saṁjña</span> <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–lost consciousness. [67]
Upon hearing the words of Nityānanda, Śrī Jīva Goswāmī rolled on the ground crying and lost consciousness.
কৃপা করি’ প্রভু নিজ চরণযুগল ।<br />শ্রীজীবের শিরে ধরি’ অর্পিলেন বল ॥৬৮॥
kṛpā kari’ prabhu nija charaṇa-yugala<br />śrī-jīvera śire dhari’ arpilena bala [68]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–placed <span class="e2">nija</span>–His <span class="e2">charaṇa-yugala</span>–feet <span class="e2">śrī-jīvera śire</span>–on Śrī Jīva’s head [and] <span class="e2">bala arpilena</span>–empowered [him]. [68]
Mercifully, the Lord placed His feet on Śrī Jīva’s head and empowered him.
“জয় শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ জয় নিত্যানন্দরায়” ।<br />বলিয়া নাচেন জীব বৈষ্ণব-সভায় ॥৬৯॥
“jaya śrī-gaurāṅga jaya nityānanda-rāya”<br />baliyā nāchena jīva vaiṣṇava-sabhāya [69]
<span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Chanting, <span class="e2">“jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–to Śrī Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–to Nityānanda Rāy!”, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva [then] <span class="e2">nāchena</span>–danced <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-sabhāya</span>–amidst the assembly of devotees. [69]
Chanting, “All glory to Śrī Gaurāṅga! All glory to Nityānanda Rāy!”, Jīva then danced amidst the assembly of Vaiṣṇavas.
শ্রীবাসাদি ছিল তথা যত মহাজন ।<br />জীবে নিত্যানন্দ-কৃপা করি’ দরশন ॥৭০॥
সবে নাচে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ নিত্যানন্দ বলি’ ।<br />মহাকলরবে তথা হয় হুলুস্থুলী ॥৭১॥
śrīvāsādi chhila tathā yata mahājana<br />jīve nityānanda-kṛpā kari’ daraśana [70]
sabe nāche “śrī-gaurāṅga nityānanda” bali’<br />mahākala-rave tathā haya hulu-sthulī [71]
<span class="e2">śrīvāsādi yata sabe mahājana</span>–Śrīvās and the other great souls [that] <span class="e2">tathā chhila</span>–were there, <span class="e2">daraśana kari’</span>–seeing <span class="e2">nityānanda-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of Nityānanda <span class="e2">jīve</span>–upon Jīva, <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanting, <span class="e2">“śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–“Śrī Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">nityānanda”</span>–Nityānanda!”, [and] <span class="e2">mahākala-rave</span>–the loud sound <span class="e2">hulu-sthulī</span>–of women’s cheering <span class="e2">haya</span>–arose <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [70<span class="e2">–</span>71]
Śrīvās and the other great souls there, seeing the mercy of Nityānanda upon Jīva, danced, chanting, “Śrī Gaurāṅga! Nityānanda!”, and the loud sound of women cheering arose.
কতক্ষণ পরে নৃত্য করি’ সম্বরণ ।<br />জীবে লয়ে নিত্যানন্দ বসিল তখন ॥৭২॥
kata-kṣaṇa pare nṛtya kari’ samvaraṇa<br />jīve laye nityānanda basila takhana [72]
<span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇa</span> <span class="e2">pare</span>–After some time, <span class="e2">nṛtya</span> <span class="e2">samvaraṇa kari’</span>–everyone stopped dancing, [and] <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">basila</span>–sat down <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva. [72]
Eventually everyone stopped dancing, and Nityānanda sat down with Jīva.
জীবের হইল বাসা শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে ।<br />সন্ধ্যাকালে আইল পুনঃ প্রভু দরশনে ॥৭৩॥
jīvera ha-ila vāsā śrīvāsa-aṅgane<br />sandhyā-kāle āila punaḥ prabhu daraśane [73]
<span class="e2">jīvera vāsā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–Jīva stayed <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–in the courtyard of Śrīvās, [and] <span class="e2">sandhyā-kāle</span>–in the evening <span class="e2">āila</span>–he came <span class="e2">daraśane</span>–to see <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. [73]
Jīva stayed in the courtyard of Śrīvās, and in the evening he came to see Nityānanda Prabhu again.
নির্জ্জনে বসিয়া প্রভু গৌরগুণ গায় ।<br />শ্রীজীব আসিয়া পড়ে নিত্যানন্দ পায় ॥৭৪॥
nirjane basiyā prabhu gaura-guṇa gāya<br />śrī-jīva āsiyā paḍe nityānanda-pāya [74]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">basiyā</span>–was sitting <span class="e2">nirjane</span>–alone <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chanting <span class="e2">gaura-guṇa</span>–the glories of Śrī Gaura. <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–came [and] <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–bowed <span class="e2">nityānanda-pāya</span>–at Nityānanda’s feet. [74]
Nityānanda Prabhu was sitting alone chanting the glories of Śrī Gaura. Jīva came and bowed at His feet.
যত্ন করি’ প্রভু তারে নিকটে বসায় ।<br />করযোড় করি’ জীব স্বদৈন্য জানায় ॥৭৫॥
yatna kari prabhu tāre nikaṭe basāya<br />kara-yoḍa kari’ jīva svadainya jānāya [75]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">yatna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–carefully <span class="e2">basāya</span>–sat <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–nearby.<span class="e2"> jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">kara-yoḍa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–joined [his] palms [and] <span class="e2">svadainya</span>–humbly <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–prayed. [75]
Nityānanda Prabhu carefully sat Jīva nearby. Jīva joined his palms and humbly prayed to the Lord.
জীব বলে, “প্রভু মোরে করুণা করিয়া ।<br />নবদ্বীপ-ধাম-তত্ত্ব বল বিবরিয়” ॥ ৭৬॥
jīva bale, “prabhu more karuṇā kariyā<br />navadvīpa-dhāma-tattva bala vivariya” [76]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“prabhu</span>–“O Lord, <span class="e2">karuṇā</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">vivariya bala</span>–describe <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma-tattva</span>–the glories of Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">more”</span>–for me.” [76]
Jīva said, “O Lord, mercifully describe the glories of Nabadwīp Dhām for me.”
প্রভু বলে, “ওহে জীব বলিব তোমায় ।<br />অত্যন্ত নিগূঢ় তত্ত্ব রাখিবে হিয়ায় ॥৭৭॥
prabhu bale, “ohe jīva baliba tomāya<br />atyanta nigūḍha tattva rākhibe hiyāya [77]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">baliba</span>–I will describe [the] <span class="e2">atyanta</span>–most <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">tattva</span>–truths <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–to you. <span class="e2">rākhibe</span>–Hold [them] <span class="e2">hiyāya</span>–in [your] heart. [77]
The Lord said, “O Jīva, I will describe the most confidential truths to you. Hold them in your heart.
যথা তথা এবে ইহা না কর প্রকাশ ।<br />প্রকট-লীলার অন্তে হইবে বিকাশ ॥৭৮॥
yathā tathā ebe ihā nā kara prakāśa<br />prakaṭa-līlāra ante ha-ibe vikāśa [78]
<span class="e2">prakāśa kara nā</span>–Do not reveal <span class="e2">ihā</span>–them <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–anywhere <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now. <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–They will be <span class="e2">vikāśa</span>–revealed <span class="e2">ante</span>–after <span class="e2">prakaṭa-līlāra</span>–the manifest Pastimes [of the Lord]. [78]
“Do not reveal them anywhere now. They will be revealed after the manifest Pastimes of the Lord.
এই নবদ্বীপ হয় সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />শ্রীবিরজা ব্রহ্মধাম আদি হয়ে পার ॥৭৯॥
বৈকুণ্ঠের পর শ্বেতদ্বীপ শ্রীগোলোক ।<br />তদন্তে গোকুল বৃন্দাবন কৃষ্ণলোক ॥৮০॥
ei navadvīpa haya sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />śrī-virajā brahma-dhāma ādi haye pāra [79]
vaikuṇṭhera para śvetadvīpa śrī-goloka<br />tadante gokula vṛndāvana kṛṣṇa-loka [80]
<span class="e2">ei navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–the best of all abodes. <span class="e2">pāra haye</span>–Beyond <span class="e2">śrī-virajā</span>–Virajā, <span class="e2">brahma-dhāma</span>–Brahmaloka, <span class="e2">ādi</span>–and so on, [and] <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭhera</span> <span class="e2">para</span>–past Vaikuṇṭha [is] <span class="e2">śvetadvīpa</span>–Śvetadwīp, <span class="e2">śrī-goloka</span>–Śrī Goloka, [and] <span class="e2">tadante</span>–thereafter <span class="e2">gokula vṛndāvana</span>–Gokula Vṛndāvan, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-loka</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s abode. [79<span class="e2">–</span>80]
“Nabadwīp is the best of all the Lord’s abodes. Beyond Śrī Virajā, Brahmaloka, and Vaikuṇṭha is Śvetadwīp, Śrī Goloka, and lastly Gokula Vṛndāvan, Kṛṣṇa’s abode.
সেই লোক দুই ভাবে হয় ত প্রকাশ ।<br />মাধুর্য্য ঔদার্য্য ভেদে রসের বিকাশ ॥৮১॥
sei loka dui bhāve haya ta prakāśa<br />mādhurya audārya bhede rasera vikāśa [81]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–That <span class="e2">loka</span>–abode <span class="e2">ta prakāśa haya</span>–manifests <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–in two ways: <span class="e2">bhede</span>–by differences [in] <span class="e2">vikāśa</span>–the appearance <span class="e2">rasera</span>–of [its] rasa [as] <span class="e2">mādhurya</span>–sweetness [or] <span class="e2">audārya</span>–magnanimity. [81]
“That abode manifests in two ways: its rasa appears as either mādhurya or audārya.
মাধুর্য্যে ঔদার্য্য পুর্ণরূপে অবস্থিত ।<br />ঔদার্য্যে মাধুর্য্য পুর্ণরূপেতে বিহিত ॥৮২॥
mādhurye audārya pūrṇa-rūpe avasthita<br />audārye mādhurya pūrṇa-rūpete vihita [82]
<span class="e2">audārya</span>–Magnanimity [is] <span class="e2">avasthita</span>–present <span class="e2">pūrṇa-rūpe</span>–in full form <span class="e2">mādhurye</span>–within sweetness, [and] <span class="e2">mādhurya</span>–sweetness [is] <span class="e2">vihita</span>–present <span class="e2">pūrṇa-rūpete</span>–in full form <span class="e2">audārye</span>–within magnanimity. [82]
“Audārya is fully present in mādhurya, and mādhurya is fully present in audārya.
তথাপিও যে প্রকাশে মাধুর্য্য প্রধান ।<br />বৃন্দাবন বলি তাহা জানে ভাগ্যবান্ ॥৮৩॥
tathāpio ye prakāśe mādhurya pradhāna<br />vṛndāvana bali tāhā jāne bhāgyavān [83]
<span class="e2">tathāpio</span>–Still, <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–fortunate souls <span class="e2">jāne</span>–know <span class="e2">tāhā ye</span> <span class="e2">prakāśe</span>–the manifestation in which <span class="e2">mādhurya</span>–sweetness [is] <span class="e2">pradhāna</span>–predominant <span class="e2">bali’</span>–as <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. [83]
“Still, fortunate souls know that Vṛndāvan is where mādhurya is predominant.
যে প্রকাশে ঔদার্য্য প্রধান নিত্য হয় ।<br />সেই নবদ্বীপ-ধাম সর্ব্ববেদে কয় ॥ ৮৪॥
ye prakāśe audārya pradhāna nitya haya<br />sei navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-vede kaya [84]
<span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">vede</span>–All the Vedas <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">sei ye</span> <span class="e2">prakāśe</span>–the manifestation in which <span class="e2">audārya</span>–magnanimity <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">nitya</span>–always <span class="e2">pradhāna</span>–predominant [is] <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām. [84]
“All the Vedas say that Nabadwīp Dhām is where audārya is always predominant.
বৃন্দাবন নবদ্বীপে নাহি কিছু ভেদ ।<br />রসের প্রকাশ-ভেদে করয় প্রভেদ ॥৮৫॥
vṛndāvana navadvīpe nāhi kichhu bheda<br />rasera prakāśa-bhede karaya prabheda [85]
<span class="e2">kichhu nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">bheda</span>–difference <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–between Vṛndāvan and Nabadwīp [other than] <span class="e2">prabheda</span>–the difference <span class="e2">karaya</span>–made <span class="e2">rasera</span> <span class="e2">prakāśa-bhede</span>–by [their] different manifestations of rasa. [85]
“There is no difference between Vṛndāvan and Nabadwīp other than the difference made by their respective manifestations of rasa.
এই ধাম নিত্যসিদ্ধ চিন্ময় অনন্ত ।<br />জড়-বুদ্ধি-জনে তার নাহি পায় অন্ত ॥৮৬॥
ei dhāma nitya-siddha chinmaya ananta<br />jaḍa-buddhi-jane tāra nāhi pāya anta [86]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–Dhām [is] <span class="e2">nitya-siddha</span>–eternally perfect, <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual, [and] <span class="e2">ananta</span>–infinite. <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>-<span class="e2">buddhi</span>-<span class="e2">jane</span>–Materialists <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–do not reach <span class="e2">tāra</span>–its <span class="e2">anta</span>–edge. [86]
“This abode is eternally perfect, spiritual, and infinite. Materialists cannot even reach its edge.
হ্লাদিনী-প্রভাবে জীব ছাড়ি’ জড়-ধর্ম্ম ।<br />নিত্যসিদ্ধ জ্ঞানবলে পায় তার ধর্ম্ম ॥৮৭॥
hlādinī-prabhāve jīva chhāḍi’ jaḍa-dharma<br />nitya-siddha jñāna-bale pāya tāra dharma [87]
<span class="e2">hlādinī-prabhāve</span>–By the influence of the pleasure potency, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–give up <span class="e2">jaḍa-dharma</span>–material nature [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">tāra</span>–its (the Dhām’s) <span class="e2">dharma</span>–nature <span class="e2">nitya-siddha jñāna-bale</span>–through eternal, perfect knowledge. [87]
“Only by the influence of the pleasure potency of the Lord do souls give up material nature and realise the true nature of the Dhām through eternal, perfect knowledge.
সর্ব্বনবদ্বীপ হয় চিন্ময় প্রকাশ ।<br />সেই পীঠে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ করেন বিলাস ॥৮৮॥
sarva-navadvīpa haya chinmaya prakāśa<br />sei pīṭhe śrī-gaurāṅga karena vilāsa [88]
<span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–The whole of Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–is [a] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–manifestation. <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">pīṭhe</span>–In this abode, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">karena</span>–performs [His] <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–Pastimes. [88]
“The whole of Nabadwīp is a spiritual manifestation, and Śrī Gaurāṅga performs His Pastimes there.
চর্ম্ম-চক্ষে লোকে দেখে প্রপঞ্চ গঠন ।<br />মায়া আচ্ছাদিয়া রাখে নিত্য-নিকেতন ॥৮৯॥
charma-chakṣe loke dekhe prapañcha gaṭhana<br />māyā āchchhādiyā rākhe nitya-niketana [89]
<span class="e2">charma-chakṣe</span>–With fleshy eyes, <span class="e2">loke</span>–people <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">prapañcha</span> <span class="e2">gaṭhana</span>–a material form [of the Dhām]— <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">nitya-niketana āchchhādiyā</span> <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–keeps the eternal abode hidden. [89]
“With fleshy eyes, people see a material form of the Dhām—Māyā keeps the eternal abode covered.
নবদ্বীপে মায়া নাই জড় দেশ কাল ।<br />কিছু নাহি আছে তথা জীবের জঞ্জাল ॥৯০॥
navadvīpe māyā nāi jaḍa deśa kāla<br />kichhu nāhi āchhe tathā jīvera jañjāla [90]
<span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–In Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">nāi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">māyā</span>–illusory <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–matter, <span class="e2">deśa</span>–space, [or] <span class="e2">kāla</span>–time. <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There is no <span class="e2">jañjāla</span>–suffering <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for souls <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [90]
“In Nabadwīp, there is no illusory matter, space, or time. Souls undergo no suffering there.
কিন্তু কর্ম্ম-বন্ধ-ক্রমে জীব মায়াবশে ।<br />নবদ্বীপধামে প্রাপঞ্চিক ভাবে পশে ॥৯১॥
kintu karma-bandha-krame jīva māyā-vaśe<br />navadvīpa-dhāme prāpañchika bhāve paśe [91]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Souls <span class="e2">karma-bandha-krame</span>–bound by the reactions to their previous actions [and] <span class="e2">māyā-vaśe</span>–controlled by Māyā, <span class="e2">kintu</span>–however, <span class="e2">paśe</span>–enter <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">prāpañchika</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–in a material way. [91]
“Souls bound by karma and bewildered by Māyā, however, enter Nabadwīp Dhām in a material way.
ভাগ্যক্রমে সাধুসঙ্গে প্রেমের উদয় ।<br />হয় যবে তবে দেখে বৈকুণ্ঠ চিন্ময় ॥৯২॥
bhāgya-krame sādhu-saṅge premera udaya<br />haya yabe tabe dekhe vaikuṇṭha chinmaya [92]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When [souls] <span class="e2">premera</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>– develop divine love <span class="e2">bhāgya-krame</span>–by good fortune [and] <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–the association of the sādhus, [they] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">chinmaya vaikuṇṭha</span>–the spiritual world. [92]
“When souls develop divine love by good fortune and the association of the sādhus, they then see the spiritual world.
অপ্রাকৃত দেশ কাল ধাম দ্রব্য যত ।<br />অনায়াসে দেখে স্বীয় চক্ষে অবিরত ॥৯৩॥
aprākṛta deśa kāla dhāma dravya yata<br />anāyāse dekhe svīya chakṣe avirata [93]
[Souls] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily [and] <span class="e2">avirata</span>–uninterruptedly <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">svīya</span> <span class="e2">chakṣe</span>–with their own eyes [the] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–supramundane <span class="e2">deśa</span>–space, <span class="e2">kāla</span>–time, <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–light, [and] <span class="e2">yata dravya</span>–objects [there]. [93]
“Souls easily and uninterruptedly see with their own eyes the supramundane space, time, light, and objects in the Dhām.
এই ত কহিনু আমি নবদ্বীপতত্ত্ব ।<br />বিচারিয়া দেখ জীব হয়ে শুদ্ধ সত্ত্ব” ॥৯৪॥
ei ta kahinu āmi navadvīpa-tattva<br />vichāriyā dekha jīva haye śuddha sattva” [94]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kahinu</span>–have described <span class="e2">navadvīpa-tattva</span>–the glory of Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva <span class="e2">vichāriyā</span> <span class="e2">dekha</span>–reflect on [it] <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">sattva haye”</span>–being pure at heart.” [94]
“Thus, I have described the glory of Nabadwīp. O Jīva, reflect on it with a pure heart.”
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-পদে নিত্য যার আশ ।<br />গূঢ়তত্ত্ব করে ভক্তিবিনোদ প্রকাশ ॥৯৫॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pade nitya yāra āśa<br />gūḍha-tattva kare bhakti-vinoda prakāśa [95]
<span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pade</span>–the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">prakāśa kare</span>–reveals <span class="e2">gūḍha-tattva</span>–the hidden glories [of Nadia]. [95]
Bhakti Vinod, whose eternal aspiration is the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, reveals the hidden glories of Nadia.

Chapter Five
Śrī Māyāpur and Antardwīp
জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য শচীর নন্দন ।<br />জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দ জাহ্নবীজীবন ॥১॥
jaya jaya śrī-chaitanya śachīra nandana<br />jaya jaya nityānanda jāhnavī-jīvana [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">nandana</span>–to the son of Śachī, <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">jāhnavī-jīvana</span>–to the life of Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī, Śrī Chaitanya! All glory to the life of Jāhnavā, Śrī Nityānanda!
