জয় জয় নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />যথা কলিযুগে হৈল গৌর অবতার ॥২॥
jaya jaya navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />yathā kali-yuge haila gaura avatāra [2]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–the best of all abodes, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">avatāra</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–descended <span class="e2">kali-yuge</span>–during the Age of Kali! [2]
All glory to Nabadwīp Dhām, the best of all abodes, where Gaura descended during the Age of Kali!
নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু বলে, “শুনহ বচন ।<br />ষোলক্রোশ নবদ্বীপ যথা বৃন্দাবন ॥৩॥
nityānanda prabhu bale, “śunaha vachana<br />ṣola-krośa navadvīpa yathā vṛndāvana [3]
<span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“śunaha</span>–“Listen <span class="e2">vachana</span>–to [My] words! <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–The thirty-two miles <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp [are] <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan [is]. [3]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Listen to My words! The thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp are nondifferent from Vṛndāvan.
এই ষোল-ক্রোশ মধ্যে দ্বীপ হয় নয় ।<br />অষ্টদল পদ্ম যেন জলেতে ভাসয় ॥৪॥
ei ṣola-krośa madhye dvīpa haya naya<br />aṣṭa-dala padma yena jalete bhāsaya [4]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–Within <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–thirty-two miles, <span class="e2">haya</span>–there are <span class="e2">naya</span>–nine <span class="e2">dvīpa</span>–islands, <span class="e2">yena</span>–comparable to <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dala</span> <span class="e2">padma</span>–an eight-petalled lotus [that] <span class="e2">bhāsaya</span>–floats <span class="e2">jalete</span>–on water. [4]
“Within these thirty-two miles, there are nine islands, which form an eight-petalled lotus that floats on water.
অষ্টদল অষ্টদ্বীপ মধ্যে অন্তর্দ্বীপ ।<br />তার মাঝে মায়াপুর মধ্যবিন্দু-টীপ ॥৫॥
aṣṭa-dala aṣṭa-dvīpa madhye antardvīpa<br />tāra mājhe māyāpura madhya-bindu-ṭīpa [5]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–In the middle <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dala</span>–of the eight petals— <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dvīpa</span>–the eight islands— [is] <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp. <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">mājhe madhya-bindu-ṭīpa</span>–Therein, at its centre, [is] <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur. [5]
“In the middle of the eight petals—the eight islands—is Antardwīp. At its centre is Māyāpur.
মায়াপুর যোগপীঠ সদা গোলাকার ।<br />তথা নিত্য চৈতন্যের বিবিধ বিহার ॥৬॥
māyāpura yoga-pīṭha sadā golākāra<br />tathā nitya chaitanyera vividha bihāra [6]
<span class="e2">golākāra yoga-pīṭha</span>–The circular Yoga Pīṭh <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–in Māyāpur [is] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternal. <span class="e2">tathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">chaitanyera</span>–Śrī Chaitanya’s <span class="e2">vividha</span>–various <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal <span class="e2">bihāra</span>–Pastimes [take place]. [6]
“The circular Yoga Pīṭh in Māyāpur is eternal. There, Śrī Chaitanya performs various eternal Pastimes.
ত্রিসহস্র-ধনু তার পরিধি প্রমাণ ।<br />সহস্রেক-ধনু তার ব্যাসের বিধান ॥৭॥
trisahasra-dhanu tāra paridhi pramāṇa<br />sahasreka-dhanu tāra vyāsera vidhāna [7]
<span class="e2">tāra</span>–Its <span class="e2">paridhi</span>–circumference <span class="e2">pramāṇa</span>–measures <span class="e2">trisahasra-dhanu</span>–six miles, [and] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–its <span class="e2">vyāsera</span>–diameter <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–measures <span class="e2">sahasreka-dhanu</span>–two miles. [7]
“Its circumference is six miles, and its diameter two miles.
এই যোগপীঠ-মাঝে বৈসে পঞ্চতত্ত্ব ।<br />অন্যস্থান হৈতে যোগপীঠের মহত্ত্ব ॥৮॥
ei yoga-pīṭha-mājhe vaise pañcha-tattva<br />anya-sthāna haite yoga-pīṭhera mahattva [8]
<span class="e2">pañcha-tattva</span>–The Pañcha Tattva (Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Prabhu, Gadādhar Paṇḍit, and Śrīvās Ṭhākur) <span class="e2">vaise</span>–reside <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">yoga-pīṭha-mājhe</span>–at the Yoga Pīṭh. <span class="e2">mahattva</span>–The greatness <span class="e2">yoga-pīṭhera</span>–of the Yoga Pīṭh [exceeds] <span class="e2">haite</span>–that of <span class="e2">anya-sthāna</span>–other places. [8]
“The Pañcha Tattva reside at the Yoga Pīṭh, whose greatness exceeds that of all other places.
অতি শীঘ্র গুপ্ত হবে প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ।<br />ভাগীরথী-জলে হবে সঙ্গোপিত প্রায় ॥৯॥
ati śīghra gupta habe prabhura ichchhāya<br />bhāgīrathī-jale habe saṅgopita prāya [9]
<span class="e2">ati</span>–Very <span class="e2">śīghra</span>–soon [it] <span class="e2">gupta</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be hidden <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–by the will of the Lord. <span class="e2">saṅgopita habe</span>–It will be concealed <span class="e2">prāya</span>–almost fully <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī-jale</span>–by the waters of the Gaṅgā. [9]
“Very soon it will be hidden by the will of the Lord. The waters of the Gaṅgā will almost entirely conceal it.
কভু পুনঃ প্রভু-ইচ্ছা হবে বলবান্ ।<br />প্রকাশ হইবে ধাম হবে দীপ্তিমান্ ॥১০॥
kabhu punaḥ prabhu-ichchhā habe balavān<br />prakāśa ha-ibe dhāma habe dīptimān [10]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Someday, [when] <span class="e2">prabhu-ichchhā</span>–the desire of the Lord <span class="e2">balavān habe</span>–will become strong, [it] <span class="e2">prakāśa ha-ibe</span>–will be revealed [and] <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–the Dhām <span class="e2">dīptimān habe</span>–will shine <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. [10]
“Someday, when the desire of the Lord becomes strong, the Yoga Pīṭh will be revealed and the Dhām will shine again.
নিত্যধাম কভু কালে লোপ নাহি হয় ।<br />গুপ্ত হয়ে পুনর্ব্বার হয় ত উদয় ॥১১॥
nitya-dhāma kabhu kāle lopa nāhi haya<br />gupta haye punar-bāra haya ta udaya [11]
<span class="e2">nitya-dhāma</span>–The eternal Dhām <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">kabhu nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">lopa</span>–lost <span class="e2">kāle</span>–at any time— <span class="e2">gupta</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–it [only] becomes hidden [and then] <span class="e2">udaya ta haya</span>–emerges <span class="e2">punar-bāra</span>–again. [11]
“The eternal Dhām is never lost at any time—it only becomes hidden and then emerges again.
ভাগীরথী পূর্ব্বতীরে হয় মায়াপুর ।<br />মায়াপুরে নিত্য আছেন আমার ঠাকুর ॥১২॥
bhāgīrathī pūrva-tīre haya māyāpura<br />māyāpure nitya āchhena āmāra ṭhākura [12]
<span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">pūrva-tīre</span>–on the eastern bank <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–of the Gaṅgā. <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–Lord <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">āchhena</span>–is eternally present <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur. [12]
“My Lord is eternally present in Māyāpur on the eastern bank of the Gaṅgā.
লোকদৃষ্ট্যে সন্ন্যাসী হইয়া বিশ্বম্ভর ।<br />ছাড়ি’ নবদ্বীপ ফিরে দেশদেশান্তর ॥১৩॥
loka-dṛṣṭye sannyāsī ha-iyā viśvambhara<br />chhāḍi’ navadvīpa phire deśa-deśāntara [13]
<span class="e2">loka-dṛṣṭye</span>–In the vision of common people, <span class="e2">viśvambhara</span>–Viśvambhar <span class="e2">sannyāsī</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–became a sannyāsī, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–left <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">phire</span>–toured <span class="e2">deśa-deśāntara</span>–other places. [13]
“In the vision of common people, Viśvambhar became a sannyāsī, left Nabadwīp, and toured other places.
বস্তুতঃ গৌরাঙ্গ মোর নবদ্বীপধাম ।<br />ছাড়িয়া না যায় কভু মায়াপুর-গ্রাম ॥১৪॥
vastutaḥ gaurāṅga mora navadvīpa-dhāma<br />chhāḍiyā nā yāya kabhu māyāpura-grāma [14]
<span class="e2">vastutaḥ</span>–In truth, <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span>–never <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā yāya</span>–leaves <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [or] <span class="e2">māyāpura-grāma</span>–the village of Māyāpur. [14]
“In truth, however, My Gaurāṅga never leaves Nabadwīp Dhām or the village of Māyāpur.
দৈনন্দিন লীলা তাঁর দেখে ভক্তগণ ।<br />তুমিও দেখহ জীব গৌরাঙ্গ-নর্ত্তন ॥১৫॥
dainandina līlā tā̐ra dekhe bhakta-gaṇa<br />tumio dekhaha jīva gaurāṅga-nartana [15]
<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–His <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">dainandina</span>–daily, [and] <span class="e2">tumio</span>–you too, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">dekhaha</span>–will see <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga’s <span class="e2">nartana</span>–dancing. [15]
“The devotees see His Pastimes here daily, and you too, Jīva, will see His dancing.
মায়াপুর অন্তে অন্তর্দ্বীপ শোভা পায় ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ দর্শন ব্রহ্মা পাইল যথায় ॥১৬॥
māyāpura ante antardvīpa śobhā pāya<br />gaurāṅga darśana brahmā pāila yathāya [16]
<span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–shines <span class="e2">ante</span>–within <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">pāila</span>–saw <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga. [16]
“Māyāpur shines within Antardwīp, where Brahmā saw Gaurāṅga.
ওহে জীব চাহ যদি দেখিতে সকল ।<br />পরিক্রমা কর তুমি হইবে সফল” ॥১৭॥
ohe jīva chāha yadi dekhite sakala<br />parikramā kara tumi ha-ibe saphala” [17]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">chāha</span>–you want <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to see <span class="e2">sakala</span>–everything, [then] <span class="e2">parikramā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–circumambulate [the Dhām, and] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">saphala ha-ibe”</span>–will be successful.” [17]
“O Jīva, if you want to see everything, then circumambulate the Dhām, and you will be successful.”
প্রভুবাক্য শুনি’ জীব সজলনয়নে ।<br />দণ্ডবৎ হয়ে পড়ে প্রভুর চরণে ॥১৮॥
prabhu-vākya śuni’ jīva sajala-nayane<br />daṇḍavat haye paḍe prabhura charaṇe [18]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">prabhu-vākya</span>–the Lord’s words, <span class="e2">sajala-nayane</span>–with tears in [his] eyes <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">haye</span> <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–bowed <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet of the Lord. [18]
Hearing the words of Nityānanda Prabhu, with tears in his eyes Jīva bowed at His feet.
“কৃপা যদি কর প্রভু এই অকিঞ্চনে ।<br />সঙ্গে লয়ে পরিক্রমা করাও আপনে” ॥১৯॥
“kṛpā yadi kara prabhu ei akiñchane<br />saṅge laye parikramā karāo āpane” [19]
<span class="e2">“prabhu</span>–“O Lord, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–You are merciful <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">akiñchane</span>–to this poor soul, [then] <span class="e2">laye</span> <span class="e2">parikramā</span> <span class="e2">karāo</span>–take me on a circumambulation [of the Dhām] <span class="e2">āpane saṅge”</span>–with You personally.” [19]
“O Lord, if You are merciful to this poor soul, then please personally take me with You on a circumambulation of the Dhām.”
জীবের প্রার্থনা শুনি’ নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />“তথাস্তুু” বলিয়া নিজ মানস জানায় ॥২০॥
jīvera prārthanā śuni’ nityānanda-rāya<br />“tathāstu” baliyā nija mānasa jānāya [20]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–Jīva’s <span class="e2">prārthanā</span>–prayer, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">mānasa</span> <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–answered, <span class="e2">“tathāstu” baliyā</span>–“So be it.” [20]
Hearing Jīva’s prayer, Nityānanda Rāy answered, “So be it.”
প্রভু বলে, “ওহে জীব অদ্য মায়াপুর ।<br />করহ দর্শন কল্য ভ্রমিব প্রচুর” ॥২১॥
prabhu bale, “ohe jīva adya māyāpura<br />karaha darśana kalya bhramiba prachura” [21]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">adya</span>–today <span class="e2">darśana karaha</span>–see <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur. <span class="e2">kalya</span>–Tomorrow <span class="e2">bhramiba</span>–we will tour <span class="e2">prachura”</span>–extensively.” [21]
He said, “O Jīva, today see Māyāpur. Tomorrow we will tour extensively.”
এত বলি’ নিত্যানন্দ উঠিল তখন ।<br />পাছে পাছে উঠে জীব প্রফুল্লিত মন ॥২২॥
eta bali’ nityānanda uṭhila takhana<br />pāchhe pāchhe uṭhe jīva praphullita mana [22]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Having said <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">uṭhila</span>–arose, [and] <span class="e2">praphullita</span> <span class="e2">mana</span>–with a joyous heart <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">uṭhe</span>–rose <span class="e2">pāchhe</span> <span class="e2">pāchhe</span>–after [Him]. [22]
Having said this, Nityānanda arose, and with a joyous heart Jīva rose after Him.
চলে নিত্যানন্দরায় মন্দ মন্দ গতি ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গপ্রেমেতে দেহ সুবিহ্বল অতি ॥২৩॥
chale nityānanda-rāya manda manda gati<br />gaurāṅga-premete deha suvihvala ati [23]
<span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">chale</span>–moved [with] <span class="e2">manda</span> <span class="e2">manda</span> <span class="e2">gati</span>–a slow gait, [His] <span class="e2">deha</span>–body <span class="e2">ati suvihvala</span>–completely overwhelmed <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-premete</span>–with divine love for Gaurāṅga. [23]
Nityānanda Rāy moved slowly, His body completely overwhelmed by divine love for Gaurāṅga.
মোহন মুরতি প্রভু ভাবে ঢলঢল ।<br />অলঙ্কার সর্ব্বদেহে করে ঝলমল ॥২৪॥
mohana murati prabhu bhāve ḍhala-ḍhala<br />alaṅkāra sarva-dehe kare jhalamala [24]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord’s <span class="e2">mohana</span>–enchanting <span class="e2">murati</span>–form <span class="e2">ḍhala-ḍhala</span>–swayed to and fro <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–in ecstasy, [and] <span class="e2">alaṅkāra</span>–the ornaments <span class="e2">sarva-dehe</span>–all over [His] body <span class="e2">jhalamala kare</span>–shone. [24]
Nityānanda Prabhu’s enchanting form swayed to and fro in ecstasy, and the ornaments all over His body shone.
যে চরণ ব্রহ্মা শিব ধ্যানে নাহি পায় ।<br />শ্রীজীবে করিয়া কৃপা সে পদ বাড়ায় ॥২৫॥
ye charaṇa brahmā śiva dhyāne nāhi pāya<br />śrī-jīve kariyā kṛpā se pada bāḍāya [25]
<span class="e2">se pada ye</span> <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–The feet [that] <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā [and] <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–cannot attain <span class="e2">dhyāne</span>–by meditation <span class="e2">kṛpā kariyā</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">bāḍāya</span>–walked <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–in front of Śrī Jīva. [25]
The feet that Brahmā and Śiva cannot attain by meditation mercifully walked in front of Śrī Jīva.
পাছে থাকি’ জীব লয় পদাঙ্কের ধূলি ।<br />সর্ব্ব-অঙ্গে মাখে চলে বড় কুতূহলী ॥২৬॥
pāchhe thāki’ jīva laya padāṅkera dhūli<br />sarva-aṅge mākhe chale baḍa kutūhalī [26]
<span class="e2">thāki’</span>–Remaining <span class="e2">pāchhe</span>–behind, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">laya</span>–collected <span class="e2">dhūli</span>–dust <span class="e2">padāṅkera</span>–from [their] footprints, <span class="e2">mākhe</span>–smeared [it] <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">aṅge</span>–all over [his] body, [and] <span class="e2">chale</span>–proceeded [with] <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–great <span class="e2">kutūhalī</span>–delight. [26]
Remaining behind, Jīva collected dust from their footprints, smeared it all over his body, and proceeded with great delight.
জগন্নাথমিশ্র-গৃহে করিল প্রবেশ ।<br />শচীমাতা শ্রীচরণে জানায় বিশেষ ॥২৭॥
jagannātha-miśra-gṛhe karila praveśa<br />śachī-mātā śrī-charaṇe jānāya viśeṣa [27]
<span class="e2">praveśa karila</span>–They entered <span class="e2">jagannātha-miśra-gṛhe</span>–the home of Jagannāth Miśra [and] <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–spoke <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–carefully <span class="e2">śachī-mātā</span> <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇe</span>–at the holy feet of Mother Śachī. [27]
They entered the home of Jagannāth Miśra and spoke carefully at the holy feet of Mother Śachī.
“শুনগো জননী এই জীব মহামতী ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-প্রিয়দাস ভাগ্যবান্ অতি” ॥২৮॥
“śunago jananī ei jīva mahāmatī<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-priya-dāsa bhāgyavān ati” [28]
<span class="e2">“jananī</span>–“O Mother, <span class="e2">śunago</span>–listen! <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-priya-dāsa</span>–a dear servant of Śrī Gaurāṅga. [He is] <span class="e2">mahāmatī</span>–very intelligent [and] <span class="e2">ati bhāgyavān”</span>–very fortunate.” [28]
“O Mother, listen! This is Jīva, a dear servant of Śrī Gaurāṅga. He is very intelligent and very fortunate.”
বলিতে বলিতে জীব আছাড়িয়া পড়ে ।<br />ছিন্নমূল তরু যেন বড় বড় ঝড়ে ॥২৯॥
balite balite jīva āchhāḍiyā paḍe<br />chhinna-mūla taru yena baḍa baḍa jhaḍe [29]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–As [Nityānanda] spoke, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">āchhāḍiyā</span> <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–threw [himself] down <span class="e2">yena</span>–like <span class="e2">taru</span>–a tree <span class="e2">chhinna-mūla</span>–uprooted <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">jhaḍe</span>–by an intense storm. [29]
As Nityānanda Prabhu spoke, Jīva threw himself down like a tree uprooted by an intense storm.
শচীর চরণে পড়ি’ যায় গড়াগড়ি ।<br />সাত্ত্বিক বিকার দেহে করে হুড়াহুড়ি ॥৩০॥
śachīra charaṇe paḍi’ yāya gaḍāgaḍi<br />sāttvika vikāra dehe kare huḍāhuḍi [30]
<span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–He bowed <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet of Śachī <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi yāya</span>–and rolled on the ground. <span class="e2">sāttvika</span> <span class="e2">vikāra</span>–Divine ecstasy <span class="e2">huḍāhuḍi kare</span>–surged <span class="e2">dehe</span>–through [his] body. [30]
He bowed at the feet of Śachī and rolled on the ground. Divine ecstasy surged through his body.
কৃপা করি’ শচীদেবী কৈল আশীর্ব্বাদ ।<br />সেই দিন সেই গৃহে পাইল প্রসাদ ॥৩১॥
kṛpā kari’ śachī-devī kaila āśīrvāda<br />sei dina sei gṛhe pāila prasāda [31]
<span class="e2">śachī-devī</span>–Śachī Devī <span class="e2">kṛpā kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">āśīrvāda kaila</span>–blessed [him, and] <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">dina</span>–day <span class="e2">sei</span>–he <span class="e2">pāila</span>–received <span class="e2">prasāda</span>–prasād <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–in [her] home. [31]
Śachī Devī mercifully blessed him, and that day he received prasād in her home.
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া শচীদেবী-আজ্ঞা যবে পাইল ।<br />নানা অন্ন ব্যঞ্জনাদি রন্ধন করিল ॥৩২॥
viṣṇu-priyā śachī-devī-ājñā yabe pāila<br />nānā anna vyañjanādi randhana karila [32]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">viṣṇu-priyā</span>–Viṣṇu Priyā <span class="e2">pāila</span>–received <span class="e2">śachī-devī-ājñā</span>–the order of Śachī Devī, <span class="e2">randhana</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–she cooked <span class="e2">anna</span>–rice, <span class="e2">nānā</span> <span class="e2">vyañjanādi</span>–various vegetables, and other things. [32]
Receiving the order of Śachī Devī, Viṣṇu Priyā cooked rice, various vegetables, and other things.
শ্রীবংশীবদনানন্দ প্রভু কতক্ষণে ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গে ভোগ নিবেদিল সযতনে ॥৩৩॥
śrī-vaṁśī-vadanānanda prabhu kata-kṣaṇe<br />śrī-gaurāṅge bhoga nivedila sayatane [33]
<span class="e2">śrī-vaṁśī-vadanānanda</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Śrī Vaṁśī Vadanānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇe</span>–then <span class="e2">sayatane</span>–carefully <span class="e2">nivedila</span>–offered <span class="e2">bhoga</span>–the preparations <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅge</span>–to Śrī Gaurāṅga. [33]
Śrī Vaṁśī Vadanānanda Prabhu then carefully offered the preparations to Śrī Gaurāṅga.
ঈশান ঠাকুর স্থান করি’ অতঃপর ।<br />নিত্যানন্দে ভুঞ্জাইল হরিষ অন্তর ॥৩৪॥
īśāna ṭhākura sthāna kari’ ataḥpara<br />nityānande bhuñjāila hariṣa antara [34]
<span class="e2">īśāna</span> <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–Īśān Ṭhākur <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–then <span class="e2">sthāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–prepared a place [and] <span class="e2">bhuñjāila</span>–fed <span class="e2">nityānande</span>–Nityānanda, <span class="e2">hariṣa</span> <span class="e2">antara</span>–with joy in his heart. [34]
Īśān Ṭhākur then prepared a place and fed Nityānanda, with joy in his heart.
পুত্র-স্নেহে শচীদেবী নিত্যানন্দে বলে ।<br />“খাও বাছা নিত্যানন্দ জননীর স্থলে ॥৩৫॥
putra-snehe śachī-devī nityānande bale<br />“khāo vāchhā nityānanda jananīra sthale [35]
<span class="e2">putra-snehe</span>–With affection for her son, <span class="e2">śachī-devī</span>–Śachī Devī <span class="e2">bale</span>–said <span class="e2">nityānande</span>–to Nityānanda, <span class="e2">“khāo</span>–“Eat, [my] <span class="e2">vāchhā</span>–child. <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda, [You are] <span class="e2">jananīra</span> <span class="e2">sthale</span>–in the home of [Your] mother. [35]
With motherly affection, Śachī Devī said to Nityānanda, “Eat, my child. Nityānanda, You are in the home of Your mother.
এই আমি গৌরচন্দ্রে ভুঞ্জানু গোপনে ।<br />তুমি খাইলে বড় সুখী হই আমি মনে” ॥৩৬॥
ei āmi gaurachandre bhuñjānu gopane<br />tumi khāile baḍa sukhī ha-i āmi mane” [36]
<span class="e2">gopane</span>–Privately, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bhuñjānu</span>–fed <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">gaurachandre</span>–to Gaurachandra. <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">khāile</span>–If you eat [it,] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ha-i</span>–will be <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–very <span class="e2">sukhī</span>–happy <span class="e2">mane”</span>–at heart.” [36]
“Privately, I fed this to Gaurachandra. If You eat it, I will be very happy at heart.”
জননীর বাক্যে প্রভু নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />ভুঞ্জিল আনন্দে, জীব অবশিষ্ট পায় ॥৩৭॥
jananīra vākye prabhu nityānanda-rāya<br />bhuñjila ānande, jīva avaśiṣṭa pāya [37]
<span class="e2">jananīra</span> <span class="e2">vākye</span>–At the request of Mother Śachī, <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Lord Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">ānande</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">bhuñjila</span>–ate, [and] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">pāya</span>–received [His] <span class="e2">avaśiṣṭa</span>–remnants. [37]
At the request of Mother Śachī, Nityānanda Rāy joyfully ate, and Jīva received His remnants.
জীব বলে, “ধন্য আমি মহাপ্রভুঘরে ।<br />পাইনু প্রসাদ অন্ন এই মায়াপুরে” ॥৩৮॥
jīva bale, “dhanya āmi mahāprabhu-ghare<br />pāinu prasāda anna ei māyāpure” [38]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“āmi</span>–“I [am] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate. <span class="e2">pāinu</span>–I have received <span class="e2">prasāda</span> <span class="e2">anna</span>–rice prasād <span class="e2">mahāprabhu-ghare</span>–at the home of Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">māyāpure”</span>–in Māyāpur.” [38]
Jīva said, “I am so fortunate to have received prasād at the home of Mahāprabhu in Māyāpur.”
ভোজন করিয়া তবে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />শচীদেবী শ্রীচরণে হইল বিদায় ॥৩৯॥
bhojana kariyā tabe nityānanda-rāya<br />śachī-devī śrī-charaṇe ha-ila vidāya [39]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">bhojana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–after eating, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">vidāya ha-ila</span>–took leave <span class="e2">śachī-devī</span> <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇe</span>–of Śachī Devī’s holy feet. [39]
After eating, Nityānanda Rāy took leave of Śachī Devī’s holy feet.
যাইবার কালে সঙ্গে বংশীকে লইল ।<br />শ্রীজীব বংশীর পদে প্রণতি করিল ॥৪০॥
yāibāra kāle saṅge vaṁśīke la-ila<br />śrī-jīva vaṁśīra pade praṇati karila [40]
<span class="e2">yāibāra</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–At the time of leaving, <span class="e2">la-ila</span>–He took <span class="e2">vaṁśīke</span>–Vaṁśī <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [Him]. <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">praṇati</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–bowed <span class="e2">vaṁśīra</span> <span class="e2">pade</span>–at the feet of Vaṁśī. [41]
As He was leaving, He took Vaṁśī Vadanānanda with Him. Śrī Jīva bowed at the feet of Vaṁśī.
জীব প্রতি বলে প্রভু, “এ বংশীবদন ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণের প্রিয়বংশী জানে ভক্তজন ॥৪১॥
jīva prati bale prabhu, “e vaṁśī-vadana<br />śrī-kṛṣṇera priya-vaṁśī jāne bhakta-jana [41]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said <span class="e2">prati</span>–to <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">“e</span>–“This [is] <span class="e2">vaṁśī-vadana</span>–Vaṁśī Vadanānanda. <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">jāne</span>–know [him to be] <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">priya-vaṁśī</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s dear flute. [41]
Nityānanda said to Jīva, “This is Vaṁśī Vadanānanda. The devotees know him to be Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s dear flute.
ইহার কৃপায় জীব হয় কৃষ্ণাকৃষ্ট ।<br />মহারাস লভে সবে হইয়া সতৃষ্ণ ॥৪২॥
ihāra kṛpāya jīva haya kṛṣṇākṛṣṭa<br />mahārāsa labhe sabe ha-iyā satṛṣṇa [42]
<span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">kṛpāya</span>–By his mercy, <span class="e2">jīva sabe</span>–souls <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">kṛṣṇākṛṣṭa</span>–attached to Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">satṛṣṇa ha-iyā</span>–desire <span class="e2">labhe</span>–to join <span class="e2">mahārāsa</span>–the Rāsa Dance. [42]
“By his mercy, souls become attracted to Kṛṣṇa and desire to join the Rāsa Dance.
দেখ জীব এই গৃহে চৈতন্যঠাকুর ।<br />আমা সবা লয়ে লীলা করিল প্রচুর ॥৪৩॥
dekha jīva ei gṛhe chaitanya-ṭhākura<br />āmā sabā laye līlā karila prachura [43]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–look! <span class="e2">chaitanya-ṭhākura</span>–Lord Chaitanya <span class="e2">karila</span>–performed <span class="e2">prachura</span>–many <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">sabā</span> <span class="e2">laye</span>–with us <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–in this house. [43]
“Jīva, look! Lord Chaitanya performed many Pastimes with us in this house.
এই দেখ জগন্নাথ মিশ্রের মন্দির ।<br />বিষ্ণুপূজা নিত্য যথা করিতেন ধীর ॥৪৪॥
ei dekha jagannātha miśrera mandira<br />viṣṇu-pūjā nitya yathā karitena dhīra [44]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See [here]. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">mandira</span>–the Temple <span class="e2">jagannātha</span> <span class="e2">miśrera</span>–of Jagannāth Miśra, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">dhīra</span> <span class="e2">viṣṇu-pūjā karitena</span>–Gaura would earnestly worship Viṣṇu <span class="e2">nitya</span>–daily. [44]
“See here. This is the Temple of Jagannāth Miśra, where Gaura would earnestly worship Viṣṇu each day.
এই গৃহে করিতেন অতিথি-সেবন ।<br />তুলসী-মণ্ডপ এই করহ দর্শন ॥৪৫॥
ei gṛhe karitena atithi-sevana<br />tulasī-maṇḍapa ei karaha darśana [45]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–In this house, <span class="e2">karitena</span>–the Lord would <span class="e2">atithi-sevana</span>–serve guests. <span class="e2">darśana karaha</span>–See <span class="e2">ei</span>–here [His] <span class="e2">tulasī-maṇḍapa</span>–tulasī courtyard. [45]
“In this house, the Lord would serve guests. See here His tulasī courtyard.
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গচন্দ্র গৃহে ছিল যত কাল ।<br />পিতার আচার পালিতেন ভক্তপাল ॥৪৬॥
śrī-gaurāṅga-chandra gṛhe chhila yata kāla<br />pitāra āchāra pālitena bhakta-pāla [46]
<span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">kāla</span>–When <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-chandra</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅgachandra, <span class="e2">bhakta-pāla</span>–the maintainer of the devotees, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–was present <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–at home, <span class="e2">āchāra</span> <span class="e2">pālitena</span>–He would perform the duties <span class="e2">pitāra</span>–of [His] father. [46]
“When Śrī Gaurachandra, the maintainer of the devotees, was present at home, He would perform His father’s duties.
এবে সব বংশীঠাকুরের তত্ত্বাধীনে ।<br />ঈশান নির্ব্বাহ করে প্রতি দিনে দিনে ॥৪৭॥
ebe saba vaṁśī-ṭhākurera tattvādhīne<br />īśāna nirvāha kare prati dine dine [47]
<span class="e2">īśāna</span>–Īśān <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">saba nirvāha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs these duties <span class="e2">prati</span> <span class="e2">dine</span> <span class="e2">dine</span>–each day <span class="e2">vaṁśī-ṭhākurera</span> <span class="e2">tattvādhīne</span>–under the direction of Vaṁśī Ṭhākur. [47]
“Īśān Ṭhākur now performs these duties each day under the direction of Vaṁśī Ṭhākur.
এই স্থানে ছিল এক নিম্ব বৃক্ষবর ।<br />প্রভুর পরশে বৃক্ষ হইল অগোচর” ॥৪৮॥
ei sthāne chhila eka nimba vṛkṣa-vara<br />prabhura paraśe vṛkṣa ha-ila agochara” [48]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–In this place, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–there was <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">nimba</span> <span class="e2">vṛkṣa-vara</span>–great neem tree. <span class="e2">vṛkṣa</span>–The tree <span class="e2">agochara ha-ila</span>–disappeared <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">paraśe”</span>–at the Lord’s touch.” [48]
“In this place, there was a great neem tree that disappeared upon being touched by the Lord.”
যত কাঁদে নিত্যানন্দ করিয়া বর্ণন ।<br />জীব বংশী দুঁহে তত করয়ে ক্রন্দন ॥৪৯॥
yata kā̐de nityānanda kariyā varṇana<br />jīva vaṁśī du̐he tata karaye krandana [49]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–wept <span class="e2">varṇana kariyā</span>–as He described [all of this]. <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva [and] <span class="e2">vaṁśī</span>–Vaṁśī <span class="e2">du̐he</span>–both <span class="e2">krandana karaye</span>–wept <span class="e2">yata tata</span>–as well. [49]
Nityānanda wept as He described all of this, as did Jīva and Vaṁśī.
দেখিতে দেখিতে তথা আইল শ্রীবাস ।<br />চারিজনে চলে ছাড়ি’ জগন্নাথ-বাস ॥৫০॥
dekhite dekhite tathā āila śrīvāsa<br />chāri-jane chale chhāḍi’ jagannātha-vāsa [50]
<span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–Suddenly, <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, [and] <span class="e2">chāri-jane</span>–the four of them <span class="e2">chhāḍi’ chale</span>–left <span class="e2">jagannātha-vāsa</span>–Jagannāth’s home. [50]
Just then, Śrīvās arrived, and the four of them then left Jagannāth Miśra’s home.
শত-ধনু উত্তরেতে শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গন ।<br />জীবে দেখাইল প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥৫১॥
śata-dhanu uttarete śrīvāsa-aṅgana<br />jīve dekhāila prabhu ānandita mana [51]
<span class="e2">śata</span>-<span class="e2">dhanu</span>–Three hundred and twenty metres <span class="e2">uttarete</span>–to the north, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">ānandita</span> <span class="e2">mana</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">dekhāila</span>–showed <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgana</span>–the courtyard of Śrīvās. [51]
Three hundred and twenty metres to the north, Nityānanda Prabhu joyfully showed Śrīvās Aṅgan to Jīva.
শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে জীব যায় গড়াগড়ি ।<br />স্মরিয়া প্রভুর লীলা প্রেমে হুড়াহুড়ি ॥৫২॥
śrīvāsa-aṅgane jīva yāya gaḍāgaḍi<br />smariyā prabhura līlā preme huḍāhuḍi [52]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi yāya</span>–rolled on the ground <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–in the courtyard of Śrīvās. <span class="e2">smariyā</span>–Remembering <span class="e2">līlā</span>–the Pastimes <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord [there], <span class="e2">huḍāhuḍi</span>–he was overwhelmed <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. [52]
Jīva rolled on the ground in Śrīvās Aṅgan. Remembering the Pastimes of the Lord there, he was overwhelmed with divine love.
শ্রীজীব উঠিবামাত্র দেখে এক রঙ্গ ।<br />নাচিছে গৌরাঙ্গ লয়ে ভক্ত অন্তরঙ্গ ॥৫৩॥
śrī-jīva uṭhibāmātra dekhe eka raṅga<br />nāchichhe gaurāṅga laye bhakta antaraṅga [53]
<span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">uṭhibāmātra</span>–immediately <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">raṅga dekhe</span>–had a vision: [he saw] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">nāchichhe</span>–dancing <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">antaraṅga</span>–intimate <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotees. [53]
Jīva immediately had a vision: he saw Gaurāṅga dancing with His intimate devotees.
মহাসঙ্কীর্ত্তন দেখে বল্লভনন্দন ।<br />সর্ব্বভক্ত মাঝে প্রভুর অপূর্ব্ব নর্ত্তন ॥৫৪॥
mahāsaṅkīrtana dekhe vallabha-nandana<br />sarva-bhakta mājhe prabhura apūrva nartana [54]
<span class="e2">vallabha-nandana</span>–The son of Vallabha <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">mahāsaṅkīrtana</span>–grand saṅkīrtan [and] <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">nartana</span>–dancing <span class="e2">mājhe</span>–amidst <span class="e2">sarva-bhakta</span>–all the devotees. [54]
Jīva saw the Lord’s mahāsaṅkīrtan and wonderful dancing amidst all the devotees.
নাচিছে অদ্বৈত প্রভু নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />গদাধর হরিদাস নাচে আর গায় ॥৫৫॥
nāchichhe advaita prabhu nityānanda-rāya<br />gadādhara haridāsa nāche āra gāya [55]
<span class="e2">advaita</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Advaita Prabhu [and] <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy, <span class="e2">nāchichhe</span>–were dancing. <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar [and] <span class="e2">haridāsa</span>–Haridās <span class="e2">nāche</span>–were dancing <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">gāya</span>–singing. [55]
Advaita Prabhu, Nityānanda Rāy, Gadādhar, and Haridās were dancing and singing.
শুক্লাম্বর নাচে আর শত শত জন ।<br />দেখিয়া প্রেমেতে জীব হৈল অচেতন ॥৫৬॥
śuklāmbara nāche āra śata śata jana<br />dekhiyā premete jīva haila achetana [56]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">śuklāmbara</span>–Śuklāmbar <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">śata</span> <span class="e2">śata</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–hundreds of other devotees <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dancing, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">achetana haila</span>–fainted <span class="e2">premete</span>–in divine love. [56]
Seeing Śuklāmbar and hundreds of other devotees dancing, Jīva fainted in divine love.
চেতন পাইলে আর সে রঙ্গ না ভায় ।<br />কাঁদি’ জীব গোস্বামী করেন হায় হায় ॥৫৭॥
“কেন মোর কিছু পূর্ব্বে জনম নহিল ।<br />এমন কীর্ত্তনানন্দ ভাগ্যে না ঘটিল ॥৫৮॥
chetana pāile āra se raṅga nā bhāya<br />kā̐di’ jīva gosvāmī karena hāya hāya [57]
“kena mora kichhu pūrve janama nahila<br />emana kīrtanānanda bhāgye nā ghaṭila [58]
<span class="e2">chetana</span> <span class="e2">pāile</span>–When he regained consciousness <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">se</span>–this <span class="e2">raṅga</span>–vision <span class="e2">bhāya nā</span>–disappeared, <span class="e2">jīva</span> <span class="e2">gosvāmī</span>–Jīva Goswāmī <span class="e2">kā̐di’</span>–wept [and] <span class="e2">hāya</span> <span class="e2">hāya karena</span>–lamented, <span class="e2">“kena</span>–“Why <span class="e2">mora janama nahila</span>–was I not born <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–a little <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–earlier? <span class="e2">emana</span> <span class="e2">kīrtanānanda</span>–Such ecstatic kīrtan <span class="e2">ghaṭila nā</span>–did not come about <span class="e2">bhāgye</span>–by [my] fortune. [57<span class="e2">–</span>58]
When he regained consciousness and this vision disappeared, Jīva Goswāmī wept and lamented, “Why was I not born a little earlier? I was not fortunate enough to be part of such ecstatic kīrtan.
প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ-কৃপা অসীম অনন্ত ।<br />সেই বলে ক্ষণকাল হৈনু ভাগ্যবন্ত ॥৫৯॥
prabhu nityānanda-kṛpā asīma ananta<br />sei bale kṣaṇa-kāla hainu bhāgyavanta [59]
<span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu-kṛpā</span>–The mercy of Nityānanda Prabhu [is] <span class="e2">asīma</span>–unlimited [and] <span class="e2">ananta</span>–infinite, [and] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–by its influence <span class="e2">hainu</span>–I have attained <span class="e2">kṣaṇa-kāla</span>–a moment <span class="e2">bhāgyavanta</span>–of good fortune. [59]
“The mercy of Nityānanda Prabhu is unlimited and infinite, and by its influence I have attained a moment of good fortune.
ইচ্ছা হয় মায়াপুরে থাকি’ চিরকাল ।<br />ঘুচিবে সম্পূর্ণরূপে মায়ার জঞ্জাল ॥৬০॥
ichchhā haya māyāpure thāki’ chira-kāla<br />ghuchibe sampūrṇa-rūpe māyāra jañjāla [60]
<span class="e2">ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–I want <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–to stay <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur <span class="e2">chira-kāla</span>–forever. [Here,] <span class="e2">jañjāla</span>–the miseries <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of material existence <span class="e2">sampūrṇa-rūpe ghuchibe</span>–will be completely dispelled. [60]
“I want to stay in Māyāpur forever. Here, the miseries of material existence will be completely dispelled.
দাসের বাসনা হৈতে প্রভু-আজ্ঞা বড় ।<br />মায়াপুর ছাড়িতে অন্তর ধড়ফড়” ॥৬১॥
dāsera vāsanā haite prabhu-ājñā baḍa<br />māyāpura chhāḍite antara dhaḍa-phaḍa” [61]
<span class="e2">prabhu-ājñā</span>–The order of the Lord, [however, is] <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–greater <span class="e2">haite</span>–than <span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–the desire <span class="e2">dāsera</span>–of [His] servant, [and my] <span class="e2">antara</span>–heart <span class="e2">dhaḍa-phaḍa</span>–palpitates <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–to leave <span class="e2">māyāpura”</span>–Māyāpur.” [61]
“The order of the Lord, however, is greater than the desire of His servant, and my heart is palpitating at the thought of leaving Māyāpur.”
তথা হৈতে নিত্যানন্দ জীবে লয়ে যায় ।<br />দশ-ধনু উত্তরে অদ্বৈত-গৃহ পায় ॥৬২॥
tathā haite nityānanda jīve laye yāya<br />daśa-dhanu uttare advaita-gṛha pāya [62]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">laye</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–took <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">daśa</span>-<span class="e2">dhanu</span>–thirty-two metres <span class="e2">uttare</span>–north [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–reached <span class="e2">advaita-gṛha</span>–the house of Advaita. [62]
From there, Nityānanda took Jīva thirty-two metres north to the house of Advaita.
প্রভু বলে, “দেখ জীব সীতানাথালয় ।<br />হেথা বৈষ্ণবের গোষ্ঠি সদাই মিলয় ॥৬৩॥
prabhu bale, “dekha jīva sītānāthālaya<br />hethā vaiṣṇavera goṣṭhi sadāi milaya [63]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“jīva</span>–“O Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">sītānāthālaya</span>–the house of Advaita. <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavera</span> <span class="e2">goṣṭhi</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">milaya</span>–met <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sadāi</span>–every day. [63]
The Lord said, “O Jīva, see the house of Advaita. The devotees met here every day.
হেথা সীতানাথ কৈল কৃষ্ণের পূজন ।<br />হুঙ্কারে আনিল মোর শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ ধন” ॥৬৪॥
hethā sītānātha kaila kṛṣṇera pūjana<br />huṅkāre ānila mora śrī-gaurāṅga dhana” [64]
<span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">sītānātha</span>–Advaita <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">pūjana kaila</span>–worshipped Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">ānila</span>–brought, <span class="e2">mora</span>–our <span class="e2">dhana</span>–wealth, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">huṅkāre”</span>–with [His] cries.” [62]
“Here, Advaita worshipped Kṛṣṇa and brought down our wealth, Śrī Gaurāṅga, with His cries.”
তথা গড়াগড়ি দিয়া চলে চারিজন ।<br />পঞ্চধনু পূর্ব্বে গদাধরের ভবন ॥ ৬৫॥
tathā gaḍāgaḍi diyā chale chāri-jana<br />pañcha-dhanu pūrve gadādharera bhavana [65]
<span class="e2">tathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">chāri-jana</span>–the four of them <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–rolled on the ground. [Then] <span class="e2">chale</span>–they walked <span class="e2">pañcha-dhanu</span>–sixteen metres <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–east <span class="e2">gadādharera</span> <span class="e2">bhavana</span>–to the house of Gadādhar. [65]
There, the four of them rolled on the ground. Then they walked sixteen metres east to the house of Gadādhar.
তথা হৈতে দেখাইল নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />সর্ব্বপারিষদ গৃহ যথায় তথায় ॥৬৬॥
tathā haite dekhāila nityānanda-rāya<br />sarva-pāriṣada gṛha yathāya tathāya [66]
<span class="e2">tathā</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–Thereafter, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">dekhāila</span>–showed [Jīva] <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">pāriṣada gṛha</span>–all the houses of the [Lord’s] associates <span class="e2">yathāya</span> <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–throughout [Māyāpur]. [66]
Thereafter, Nityānanda showed Jīva the houses of all the Lord’s associates throughout Māyāpur.
ব্রাহ্মণমণ্ডলী গৃহ করিয়া দর্শন ।<br />তবে চলে গঙ্গাতীরে হর্ষে চারিজন ॥৬৭॥
brāhmaṇa-maṇḍalī gṛha kariyā darśana<br />tabe chale gaṅgā-tīre harṣe chāri-jana [67]
<span class="e2">chāri-jana</span>–The four of them <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–visited <span class="e2">gṛha</span>–the homes <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa-maṇḍalī</span>–of some brāhmaṇs [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">harṣe</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">chale</span>–walked <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span>–to the bank of the Gaṅgā. [67]
The four of them visited the homes of some brāhmaṇs and then joyfully walked to the bank of the Gaṅgā.
মায়াপুর সীমাশেষে বৃদ্ধশিবালয় ।<br />জাহ্নবীর তটে দেখে জীব মহাশয় ॥৬৮॥
māyāpura sīmā-śeṣa vṛddha-śivālaya<br />jāhnavīra taṭe dekhe jīva mahāśaya [68]
<span class="e2">sīmā-śeṣa</span>–Along the outer boundary <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–of Māyāpur <span class="e2">jāhnavīra</span> <span class="e2">taṭe</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">jīva mahāśaya</span>–the great Jīva <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">vṛddha-śivālaya</span>–the Temple of Vṛddha Śiva. [68]
Along the outer boundary of Māyāpur on the bank of the Gaṅgā, Jīva saw the Temple of Vṛddha Śiva.
প্রভু বলে, “মায়াপুরে ইনি ক্ষেত্রপাল ।<br />প্রৌঢ়ামায়া শক্তি অধিষ্ঠান নিত্যকাল ॥৬৯॥
prabhu bale, “māyāpure ini kṣetra-pāla<br />prauḍhā-māyā śakti adhiṣṭhāna nitya-kāla [69]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“māyāpure</span>–“In Māyāpur, <span class="e2">ini</span>–he [is] <span class="e2">kṣetra-pāla</span>–the protector of the Dhām. [His] <span class="e2">śakti</span>–consort, <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā,<span class="e2"> adhiṣṭhāna</span>–resides [with him] <span class="e2">nitya-kāla</span>–eternally. [69]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “In Māyāpur, Vṛddha Śiva is the protector of the Dhām. His consort, Prauḍhā Māyā, resides with him eternally.
প্রভু যবে অপ্রকট হইবে তখন ।<br />তাঁহার ইচ্ছায় গঙ্গা হইবে বর্দ্ধন ॥৭০॥
prabhu yabe aprakaṭa ha-ibe takhana<br />tā̐hāra ichchhāya gaṅgā ha-ibe vardhana [70]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">aprakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–disappears, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then,<span class="e2"> tā̐hār</span>a<span class="e2"> ichchhāy</span>a–by His will, <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">vardhana ha-ibe</span>–will swell. [70]
“When the Lord disappears, then, by His will, the Gaṅgā will swell.
মায়াপুর প্রায় গঙ্গা আচ্ছাদিবে জলে ।<br />শতবর্ষ রাখি’ পুনঃ ছাড়িবেন বলে ॥৭১॥
māyāpura prāya gaṅgā āchchhādibe jale<br />śata-varṣa rākhi’ punaḥ chhāḍibena bale [71]
<span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–The Gaṅgā <span class="e2">prāya</span> <span class="e2">āchchhādibe</span>–will almost entirely cover <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">jale</span>–with water. <span class="e2">rākhi’</span>–She will keep [Māyāpur covered] <span class="e2">śata-varṣa</span>–for one hundred years, [and then] <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again <span class="e2">bale chhāḍibena</span>–she will withdraw. [71]
“She will almost entirely cover Māyāpur with water for one hundred years, and then she will withdraw.
স্থান মাত্র জাগিবেক গৃহ না রহিবে ।<br />বাসহীন হয়ে কতকাল স্থিত হবে ॥৭২॥
sthāna mātra jāgibeka gṛha nā rahibe<br />vāsa-hīna haye kata-kāla sthita habe [72]
<span class="e2">mātra</span>–Only <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–the land <span class="e2">jāgibeka</span>–will emerge; <span class="e2">gṛha nā rahibe</span>–houses will not remain. [Māyāpur] <span class="e2">sthita</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will stay <span class="e2">vāsa-hīna</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–uninhabited <span class="e2">kata-kāla</span>–for a long time. [72]
“At that time, only the land will emerge; no houses will remain. Māyāpur will stay uninhabited for a long time.
পুনঃ কভু প্রভু-ইচ্ছা হয়ে বলবান্ ।<br />হবে মায়াপুরে এই রূপ বাসস্থান ॥৭২॥
punaḥ kabhu prabhu-ichchhā haye balavān<br />habe māyāpure ei rūpa vāsa-sthāna [72]
<span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–Again, <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–when <span class="e2">prabhu-ichchhā</span>–the Lord’s desire <span class="e2">haye</span>–becomes <span class="e2">balavān</span>–strong, <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">vāsa-sthāna</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be inhabited <span class="e2">ei rūpa</span>–like this [again]. [72]
“Again, when the Lord strongly desires it, Māyāpur will be inhabited like this again.
এই সব ঘাট গঙ্গাতীরে পুনঃ হবে ।<br />প্রভুর মন্দির করিবেন ভক্ত সবে ॥৭৩॥
ei saba ghāṭa gaṅgā-tīre punaḥ habe<br />prabhura mandira karibena bhakta sabe [73]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–All these bathing places <span class="e2">habe</span>–will appear <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span>–on the banks of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again, [and] <span class="e2">bhakta</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">mandira</span> <span class="e2">karibena</span>–will make Temples <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–for the Lord. [73]
“All these ghāṭs will appear on the banks of the Gaṅgā again, and the devotees will make Temples for the Lord.
অদ্ভুত মন্দির এক হইবে প্রকাশ ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গের নিত্যসেবা হইবে বিকাশ ॥৭৪॥
adbhuta mandira eka ha-ibe prakāśa<br />gaurāṅgera nitya-sevā ha-ibe vikāśa [74]
<span class="e2">eka</span>–One <span class="e2">adbhuta</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">mandira</span>–Temple <span class="e2">prakāśa ha-ibe</span>–will manifest, [and there] <span class="e2">nitya-sevā</span>–daily worship <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">vikāśa ha-ibe</span>–will flourish. [74]
“One wonderful Temple will manifest, and there daily worship of Gaurāṅga will flourish.
প্রৌঢ়ামায়া বৃদ্ধশিব আসি’ পুনরায় ।<br />নিজ কার্য্য সাধিবেক প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ॥৭৫॥
prauḍhā-māyā vṛddha-śiva āsi’ punarāya<br />nija kārya sādhibeka prabhura ichchhāya [75]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā [and] <span class="e2">vṛddha-śiva</span>–Vṛddha Śiva <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–will come <span class="e2">punarāya</span>–again [and] <span class="e2">sādhibeka</span>–perform <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">kārya</span>–their duties. [75]
“By the will of the Lord, Prauḍhā Māyā and Vṛddha Śiva will return and perform their duties (of revealing and protecting the Dhām).”
এত শুনি’ জীব তবে করযোড় করি’ ।<br />প্রভুরে জিজ্ঞাসে বার্ত্তা পদ-যুগ ধরি’ ॥৭৬॥
eta śuni’ jīva tabe kara-yoḍa kari’<br />prabhure jijñāse vārtā pada-yūga dhari’ [76]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">kara-yoḍa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–joined [his] palms, <span class="e2">vārtā jijñāse</span>–questioned <span class="e2">prabhure</span>–the Lord, [and then] <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–grasped [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">pada-yūga</span>–feet. [76]
Hearing this, Jīva joined his palms, questioned Nityānanda Prabhu, and then grasped the Lord’s feet.
“ওহে প্রভু তুমি শেষ তত্ত্বের নিদান ।<br />ধামরূপ নামতত্ত্ব তোমারি বিধান ॥৭৭॥
“ohe prabhu tumi śeṣa tattvera nidāna<br />dhāma-rūpa nāma-tattva tomāri vidhāna [77]
<span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">nidāna</span>–the basis <span class="e2">śeṣa</span> <span class="e2">tattvera</span>–of the ultimate truth. <span class="e2">dhāma-rūpa</span>–The form of the Dhām [and] <span class="e2">nāma-tattva</span>–the Holy Name [are] <span class="e2">tomāri</span> <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–Your manifestations. [77]
“O Lord, You are the basis of the ultimate truth. You manifest Yourself as the Dhām and the Holy Name.
যদিও প্রভুর ইচ্ছামতে কর্ম্ম কর ।<br />তবু জীব-গুরু তুমি সর্ব্ব-শক্তিধর ॥৭৮॥
yadio prabhura ichchhā-mate karma kara<br />tabu jīva-guru tumi sarva-śakti-dhara [78]
<span class="e2">yadio</span>–Although <span class="e2">karma</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–You act <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhā-mate</span>–according to the will of Mahāprabhu, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–still <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">jīva-guru</span>–the Guru of all souls [and] <span class="e2">sarva-śakti-dhara</span>–the controller of all energies. [78]
“Although You act according to the will of Mahāprabhu, You are the Guru of all souls and the controller of all energies.
গৌরাঙ্গে তোমাতে ভেদ যেই জন করে ।<br />পাষণ্ডী মধ্যেতে তাঁরে বিজ্ঞজনে ধরে ॥৭৯॥
gaurāṅge tomāte bheda yei jana kare<br />pāṣaṇḍī madhyete tā̐re vijña-jane dhare [79]
<span class="e2">vijña-jane</span>–The wise <span class="e2">dhare</span>–consider <span class="e2">tā̐re yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">bheda kare</span>–distinguishes <span class="e2">gaurāṅge</span> <span class="e2">tomāte</span>–between You and Gaurāṅga [to be] <span class="e2">pāṣaṇḍī</span> <span class="e2">madhyete</span>–a sinner. [79]
“The wise consider anyone who distinguishes between You and Gaurāṅga to be a sinner.
সর্ব্বজ্ঞ পুরুষ তুমি লীলা অবতার ।<br />সংশয় জাগিল এক হৃদয়ে আমার ॥৮০॥
sarvajña puruṣa tumi līlā avatāra<br />saṁśaya jāgila eka hṛdaye āmāra [80]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">sarvajña</span> <span class="e2">puruṣa</span>–the all-knowing Lord, [who] <span class="e2">avatāra</span>–descends <span class="e2">līlā</span>–to perform Pastimes. <span class="e2">eka</span>–A <span class="e2">saṁśaya</span>–doubt <span class="e2">jāgila</span>–has arisen <span class="e2">āmāra hṛdaye</span>–in my heart. [80]
“You are the all-knowing Lord, who descends to perform Pastimes. A doubt has arisen in my heart.
যে সময় গঙ্গা লুকাইবে মায়াপুর ।<br />কোথা যাবে শিব শক্তি বলহ ঠাকুর” ॥৮১॥
ye samaya gaṅgā lukāibe māyāpura<br />kothā yābe śiva śakti balaha ṭhākura” [81]
<span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–O Lord, <span class="e2">balaha</span>–please tell [me,] <span class="e2">kothā</span>–where [will] <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Vṛddha Śiva [and] <span class="e2">śakte</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā <span class="e2">yābe</span>–go <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">samaya</span>–when <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">lukāibe</span>–hides <span class="e2">māyāpura”</span>–Māyāpur?” [81]
“O Lord, please tell me, where will Vṛddha Śiva and Prauḍhā Māyā go when the Gaṅgā hides Māyāpur?”
নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “জীব শুনহ বচন ।<br />গঙ্গার পশ্চিম ভূমি করহ দর্শন ॥৮২॥
nityānanda bale, “jīva śunaha vachana<br />gaṅgāra paśchima bhūmi karaha darśana [82]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“jīva</span>–“Jīva, <span class="e2">śunaha</span>–listen <span class="e2">vachana</span>–to [My] words [and] <span class="e2">darśana karaha</span>–look <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–at the land <span class="e2">paśchima</span>–to the west <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span>–of the Gaṅgā. [82]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Jīva, listen to My words and look at the land to the west of the Gaṅgā.
ঐ উচ্চ চড়া দেখ পারডাঙ্গা নাম ।<br />তথা আছে বিপ্রমণ্ডলীর এক গ্রাম ॥৮৩॥
ei uchcha chaḍā dekha pāraḍāṅgā nāma<br />tathā āchhe vipra-maṇḍalīra eka grāma [83]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">ei</span>–the <span class="e2">uchcha</span> <span class="e2">chaḍā</span>–sand dune <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">pāraḍāṅgā</span>–Pāraḍāṅgā, <span class="e2">tathā</span>–where <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–there is <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">grāma</span>–village <span class="e2">vipra-maṇḍalīra</span>–of brāhmaṇs. [83]
“See there the sand dune known as Pāraḍāṅgā. In that place, there is a village of brāhmaṇs.
তাহার উত্তরে আছে জাহ্নবী-পুলিন ।<br />ছিন্নডেঙ্গা বলি তারে জানেন প্রবীণ ॥৮৪॥
tāhāra uttare āchhe jāhnavī-pulina<br />chhinnaḍeṅgā bali tāre jānena pravīṇa [84]
<span class="e2">pravīṇa</span>–The wise <span class="e2">jānena</span>–know<span class="e2"> tāre jāhnavī-pulina</span>–the bank of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–that is <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">uttare</span>–to its north <span class="e2">bali</span>–as <span class="e2">chhinnaḍeṅgā</span>–Chhinnaḍeṅgā. [84]
“The wise know the bank of the Gaṅgā to its north as Chhinnaḍeṅgā.
এই ত পুলিনে এক নগর বসিবে ।<br />তথা শিব শক্তি কিছু দিবস রহিবে ॥৮৫॥
ei ta puline eka nagara vasibe<br />tathā śiva śakti kichhu divasa rahibe [85]
<span class="e2">eka</span>–A <span class="e2">nagara</span>–village <span class="e2">vasibe</span>–will be established <span class="e2">ei ta</span> <span class="e2">puline</span>–on this bank. <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Vṛddha Śiva [and] <span class="e2">śakti</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–will remain <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">divasa</span>–for some time. [85]
“A village will be established on this bank. Vṛddha Śiva and Prauḍhā Māyā will remain there for some time.
ও পুলিন মাহাত্ম্য কে কহিবারে পারে ।<br />রাসস্থলী আছে যথা জাহ্নবীর ধারে ॥৮৬॥
o pulina māhātmya ke kahibāre pāre<br />rāsa-sthalī āchhe yathā jāhnavīra dhāre [86]
<span class="e2">ke</span>–Who <span class="e2">pāre</span>–can <span class="e2">kahibāre</span>–describe <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories <span class="e2">o</span> <span class="e2">pulina</span>–of that bank? <span class="e2">rāsa-sthalī</span>–The site of the Rāsa Dance <span class="e2">yathā āchhe</span>–is there <span class="e2">jāhnavīra</span> <span class="e2">dhāre</span>–beside the Gaṅgā. [86]
“Who can describe the glories of that bank? The Rāsa Sthalī is there beside the Gaṅgā.
বালুময় ভূমি বটে চর্ম্মচক্ষে ভায় ।<br />রত্নময় নিত্যধাম দিব্য লীলা তায় ॥৮৭॥
bālumaya bhūmi vaṭe charma-chakṣe bhāya<br />ratnamaya nitya-dhāma divya līlā tāya [87]
[It] <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–appears <span class="e2">vaṭe</span>–like <span class="e2">bālumaya</span> <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–a beach <span class="e2">charma-chakṣe</span>–to fleshy eyes, [but the Lord’s] <span class="e2">divya</span>–divine <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes [take place] <span class="e2">nitya-dhāma tāya</span>–in that eternal abode <span class="e2">ratnamaya</span>–made of gemstone. [87]
“It appears like a beach to fleshy eyes, but the Lord’s divine Pastimes take place in that eternal abode of gemstone.
মায়াপুর হয় শ্রীগোকুল মহাবন ।<br />পারডাঙ্গা সট্টীকার স্বরূপ গণন ॥৮৮॥
māyāpura haya śrī-gokula mahāvana<br />pāraḍāṅgā saṭṭīkāra svarūpa gaṇana [88]
<span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">śrī-gokula</span> <span class="e2">mahāvana</span>–Śrī Gokula Mahāvan, [and] <span class="e2">pāraḍāṅgā</span>–Pāraḍāṅgā [is] <span class="e2">gaṇana</span>–considered <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–a form <span class="e2">saṭṭīkāra</span>–of Saṭṭīkāra (Chhatikāra). [88]
“Māyāpur is Śrī Gokula Mahāvan, and Pāraḍāṅgā is considered Saṭṭīkāra.
তথা আছে বৃন্দাবন শ্রীরাসমণ্ডল ।<br />কালে ঐ স্থানে হবে গান কোলাহল ॥৮৯॥
tathā āchhe vṛndāvana śrī-rāsa-maṇḍala<br />kāle ei sthāne habe gāna kolāhala [89]
<span class="e2">śrī-rāsa-maṇḍala</span>–Śrī Rāsa Maṇḍal <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–of Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is present <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, [and] <span class="e2">kāle</span>–in time <span class="e2">habe</span>–there will be <span class="e2">kolāhala gāna</span>–joyous singing <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–at that place. [89]
“Śrī Rāsa Maṇḍal of Vṛndāvan is present there, and in the future there will be joyous singing at that place.
মায়াপুর শ্রীপুলিন মধ্যে ভাগীরথী ।<br />সব লয়ে গৌরধাম জান মহামতি ॥৯০॥
māyāpura śrī-pulina madhye bhāgīrathī<br />saba laye gaura-dhāma jāna mahāmati [90]
<span class="e2">mahāmati</span>–O wise soul, <span class="e2">jāna</span>–know [that] <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur [and] <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">madhye</span>–at <span class="e2">śrī-pulina</span>–Śrī Pulina [are] <span class="e2">saba</span>–all <span class="e2">laye</span>–within <span class="e2">gaura-dhāma</span>–Śrī Gaura’s Dhām. [90]
“O wise soul, know that Māyāpur and the Gaṅgā at Śrī Pulina are both part of Śrī Gaura’s Dhām.
পঞ্চক্রোশ ধাম যেবা করিবে ভ্রমণ ।<br />মায়াপুর শ্রীপুলিন করিবে দর্শন ॥৯১॥
pañcha-krośa dhāma yebā karibe bhramaṇa<br />māyāpura śrī-pulina karibe darśana [91]
<span class="e2">yebā</span>–One who <span class="e2">bhramaṇa karibe</span>–visits <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–this abode <span class="e2">pañcha-krośa</span>–of ten miles <span class="e2">darśana karibe</span>–will see <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur [and] <span class="e2">śrī-pulina</span>–Śrī Pulina. [91]
“One who visits this abode of ten miles will see Māyāpur and Śrī Pulina.
ফল্গুন-পূর্ণিমা-দিনে যে করে ভ্রমন ।<br />পঞ্চক্রোশ ভক্তসহ পায় নিত্যধন ॥৯২॥
phālguna-pūrṇimā-dine ye kare bhramaṇa<br />pañcha-krośa bhakta-saha pāya nitya-dhana [92]
<span class="e2">ye</span>–One who <span class="e2">bhramaṇa kare</span>–visits <span class="e2">pañcha-krośa</span>–these ten miles <span class="e2">bhakta-saha</span>–with devotees <span class="e2">phālguna-pūrṇimā</span>-<span class="e2">dine</span>–on the full moon day in the month of Phālgun <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attains <span class="e2">nitya-dhana</span>–the eternal wealth. [92]
“One who visits these ten miles with devotees on the full moon day in the month of Phālgun attains the eternal wealth.
ওহে জীব গূঢ় কথা শুনহ আমার ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-মূর্ত্তি শোভে শ্রীবিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার ॥৯৩॥
ohe jīva gūḍha kathā śunaha āmāra<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-mūrti śobhe śrī-viṣṇu-priyāra [93]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">śunaha</span>–listen [to] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">kathā</span>–words. <span class="e2">śrī-viṣṇu-priyāra</span>–Śrī Viṣṇu Priyā’s <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-mūrti</span>–Deity of Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">śobhe</span>–shines [here]. [93]
“O Jīva, listen to My confidential words. Śrī Viṣṇu Priyā’s Deity of Śrī Gaurāṅga shines here.
ঐ কালে মিশ্রবংশোদ্ভব বিপ্রগণ ।<br />সট্টীকার ধামে লবে শ্রীমূর্ত্তিরতন ॥৯৪॥
ai kāle miśra-vaṁśodbhava vipra-gaṇa<br />saṭṭīkāra dhāme labe śrī-mūrti-ratana [94]
<span class="e2">ai</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">vipra-gaṇa</span>–brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">miśra-vaṁśodbhava</span>–in the lineage of Jagannāth Miśra <span class="e2">labe</span>–will bring <span class="e2">śrī-mūrti-ratana</span>–this jewel-like Deity <span class="e2">saṭṭīkāra</span> <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–to Saṭṭīkāra Dhām. [94]
“In the future, brāhmaṇs in the lineage of Jagannāth Miśra will bring this jewel-like Deity to Saṭṭīkāra Dhām.
চারিশতবর্ষ গৌরজন্মদিন ধরি’ ।<br />হইলে শ্রীমূর্ত্তি-সেবা হবে সর্ব্বোপরি ॥৯৫॥
chāri-śata-varṣa gaura-janma-dina dhari’<br />ha-ile śrī-mūrti-sevā habe sarvopari [95]
<span class="e2">chāri-śata-varṣa ha-ile</span>–When four hundred years have passed <span class="e2">gaura-janma-dina</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–after the day of Gaura’s birth, <span class="e2">śrī-mūrti-sevā</span>–the worship of the Deity <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be [established] <span class="e2">sarvopari</span>–above all. [95]
“Four hundred years after the appearance day of Śrī Gaura, the worship of the Deity will be set to the highest standard.
এই সব কথা এবে রাখ অপ্রকাশ ।<br />পরিক্রমা কর হয়ে অন্তরে উল্লাস ॥৯৬॥
ei saba kathā ebe rākha aprakāśa<br />parikramā kara haye antare ullāsa [96]
[For] <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now, <span class="e2">rākha</span>–keep <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all these <span class="e2">kathā</span>–matters <span class="e2">aprakāśa</span>–secret [and] <span class="e2">parikramā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–circumambulate [the Dhām] <span class="e2">antare</span> <span class="e2">ullāsa haye</span>–with a joyful heart. [96]
“For now, keep all these matters secret and circumambulate the Dhām with a joyful heart.
বৃদ্ধশিব ঘাট হৈতে ত্রিধনু উত্তর ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গের নিজঘাট দেখ বিজ্ঞবর ॥৯৭॥
vṛddha-śiva ghāṭa haite tridhanu uttara<br />gaurāṅgera nija-ghāṭa dekha vijña-vara [97]
<span class="e2">vijña-vara</span>–O best of the wise, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–Gaurāṅga’s <span class="e2">nija-ghāṭa</span>–own ghāṭ <span class="e2">tridhanu</span>–ten metres <span class="e2">uttara</span>–north <span class="e2">haite</span>–of <span class="e2">vṛddha-śiva</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–Vṛddha Śiva’s ghāṭ. [97]
“O best of the wise, see Śrī Gaurāṅga’s ghāṭ ten metres north of Vṛddha Śiva’s ghāṭ.
এই স্থানে বাল্যলীলা ছলে গৌরহরি ।<br />ভাগীরথীক্রীড়া করিলেন চিত্ত ভরি’ ॥৯৮॥
ei sthāne bālya-līlā chhale gaurahari<br />bhāgīrathī-krīḍā karilena chitta bhari’ [98]
<span class="e2">chhale</span>–On the pretext <span class="e2">bālya-līlā</span>–of childhood Pastimes, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī-krīḍā</span> <span class="e2">karilena</span>–played with the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">bhari’</span>–fulfilled [her] <span class="e2">chitta</span>–heart. [98]
“On the pretext of childhood Pastimes, Gaurahari played here with the Gaṅgā and filled her heart with joy.
যমুনার ভাগ্য দেখি হিমাদ্রি-নন্দিনী ।<br />বহু তপ কৈল হৈতে লীলার সঙ্গিনী ॥৯৯॥
yamunāra bhāgya dekhi’ himādri-nandinī<br />bahu tapa kaila haite līlāra saṅginī [99]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">yamunāra</span> <span class="e2">bhāgya</span>–the fortune of the Yamunā, <span class="e2">himādri-nandinī</span>–Gaṅgā Devī <span class="e2">kaila</span>–had performed <span class="e2">bahu</span>–many <span class="e2">tapa</span>–austerities <span class="e2">haite</span>–to become <span class="e2">saṅginī</span>–an associate [of the Lord] <span class="e2">līlāra</span>–in [His] Pastimes. [99]
“Seeing the fortune of the Yamunā, Gaṅgā Devī had performed many austerities to become an associate of the Lord in His Pastimes.
কৃষ্ণ কৃপা করি’ বলে দিয়া দরশন ।<br />‘গৌররূপে তব জলে করিব ক্রীড়ন’ ॥১০০॥
kṛṣṇa kṛpā kari’ bale diyā daraśana<br />‘gaura-rūpe tava jale kariba krīḍana’ [100]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">daraśana diyā</span>–appeared [before her and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘gaura-rūpe</span>–‘As Gaura, <span class="e2">krīḍana kariba</span>–I will play <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">jale’</span>–in your waters.’ [100]
“Kṛṣṇa mercifully appeared before her and said, ‘As Gaura, I will play in your waters.’
সেই লীলা কৈল হেথা ত্রিভুবন রায় ।<br />ভাগ্যবান্ জীব দেখি’ বড় সুখ পায় ॥১০১॥
sei līlā kaila hethā tribhuvana rāya<br />bhāgyavān jīva dekhi’ baḍa sukha pāya [101]
<span class="e2">tribhuvana</span> <span class="e2">rāya</span>–The Lord of the three worlds <span class="e2">kaila</span>–performed <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastime <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Upon seeing [this place,] <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span> <span class="e2">jīva</span>–fortunate souls <span class="e2">pāya</span>–feel <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–great <span class="e2">sukha</span>–joy. [101]
“The Lord of the three worlds performed this Pastime here. Upon seeing this place, fortunate souls feel great joy.
পঞ্চদশধনু যেই ঘাট তদুত্তরে ।<br />মাধাইয়ের ঘাট বলি ব্যক্ত চরাচরে ॥১০২॥
pañcha-daśa-dhanu yei ghāṭa tad uttare<br />mādhāiyera ghāṭa bale vyakta charāchare [102]
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–The ghāṭ <span class="e2">pañcha-daśa-dhanu</span>–one hundred and sixty metres <span class="e2">tad</span> <span class="e2">uttare</span>–to the north <span class="e2">vyakta bale</span>–is known as <span class="e2">mādhāiyera</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–Mādhāi’s ghāṭ <span class="e2">charāchare</span>–throughout the world. [102]
“The ghāṭ one hundred and sixty metres to the north is known by everyone as Mādhāi’s ghāṭ.
তার পাঁচধনুর উত্তরে ঘাট শোভা ।<br />নাগরীয়া জনের সর্ব্বদা মনোলোভা ॥১০৩॥
tāra pā̐cha-dhanura uttare ghāṭa śobhā<br />nāgarīyā janera sarvadā mano-lobhā [103]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">pā̐cha-dhanura</span> <span class="e2">uttare</span>–sixteen metres to its north [is a] <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–ghāṭ [that] <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always <span class="e2">mano-lobhā</span>–attracts the minds <span class="e2">nāgarīyā</span> <span class="e2">janera</span>–of the villagers. [103]
“Sixteen metres to its north is a beautiful ghāṭ that always attracts the minds of all the villagers.
বারকোণা ঘাট এই অতীব সুন্দর ।<br />বিশ্বকর্ম্মা নির্ম্মিলেন প্রভু-আজ্ঞাধর ॥১০৪॥
bārakoṇā ghāṭa ei atīva sundara<br />viśvakarmā nirmilena prabhu-ājñā-dhara [104]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">atīva</span>–extremely <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–ghāṭ [is known as] <span class="e2">bārakoṇā</span>–Bārakoṇā. <span class="e2">viśvakarmā</span>–The architect of the gods <span class="e2">nirmilena</span>–constructed [it] <span class="e2">prabhu-ājñā-dhara</span>–following the order of the Lord. [104]
“This extremely beautiful ghāṭ is known as Bārakoṇā Ghāṭ. Viśvakarmā constructed it on the order of the Lord.
এই ঘাটে দেখ জীব পঞ্চ শিবালয় ।<br />পঞ্চতীর্থ লিঙ্গ পঞ্চ সদা জ্যোতির্ম্ময় ॥১০৫॥
ei ghāṭe dekha jīva pañcha śivālaya<br />pañcha-tīrtha liṅga pañcha sadā jyotirmaya [105]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">pañcha</span> <span class="e2">śivālaya</span>–the five Śiva Temples <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭe</span>–at this ghāṭ. <span class="e2">pañcha</span>–Five <span class="e2">jyotirmaya</span>–effulgent <span class="e2">liṅga</span>–Deities of Lord Śiva <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always [reside here] <span class="e2">pañcha-tīrtha</span>–in these five holy places. [105]
“O Jīva, see the five Śiva Temples at this ghāṭ. Five effulgent liṅgams always reside here in these five holy places.
এই চারি ঘাট মায়াপুর শোভা করে ।<br />যথায় করিলে স্নান সর্ব্বদুঃখ হরে ॥১০৬॥
ei chāri ghāṭa māyāpura śobhā kare<br />yathāya karile snāna sarva-duḥkha hare [106]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–These <span class="e2">chāri ghāṭa</span>–four ghāṭs (Gaurāṅga Ghāṭ, Vṛddha Śiva Ghāṭ, Mādhāi Ghāṭ, and Bārakoṇā Ghāt) <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–beautify <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur. <span class="e2">snāna karile</span>–Bathing <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–at them <span class="e2">hare</span>–removes <span class="e2">sarva-duḥkha</span>–all sorrow. [106]
“These four ghāṭs beautify Māyāpur. Bathing at them removes all sorrow.
মায়াপুর পূর্ব্বদিকে আছে যেই স্থান ।<br />অন্তর্দ্বীপ বলি’ তায় নাম বিদ্যমান ॥১০৭॥
māyāpura pūrva-dike āchhe yei sthāna<br />antardvīpa bali’ tāya nāma vidyamāna [107]
<span class="e2">māyāpura</span> <span class="e2">pūrva-dike</span>–To the east of Māyāpur <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna tāya</span>–a place <span class="e2">bali’ nāma</span> <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–known by the name of <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp. [107]
“To the east of Māyāpur is a place known as Antardwīp.
এবে প্রভু-ইচ্ছামতে লোক-বাসহীন ।<br />এই রূপ স্থিতি রহে আরো কত দিন ॥১০৮॥
ebe prabhu-ichchhā-mate loka-vāsa-hīna<br />ei rūpa sthiti rahe āro kata dina [108]
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now, <span class="e2">prabhu-ichchhā-mate</span>–by the will of the Lord, [it is] <span class="e2">loka-vāsa-hīna</span>–uninhabited. [It] <span class="e2">rahe</span> <span class="e2">āro</span>–will remain <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">rūpa</span> <span class="e2">sthiti</span>–this way <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–for some time. [108]
“Now, by the will of the Lord, it is uninhabited. It will remain this way for some time.
কতকালে পুনঃ হেথা লোক বাস হবে ।<br />প্রকাশ হইবে স্থান নদীয়া গৌরবে ॥১০৯॥
kata-kāle punaḥ hethā loka vāsa habe<br />prakāśa ha-ibe sthāna nadīyā gaurave [109]
<span class="e2">kata-kāle</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">loka</span>–people <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will live <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again, [and] <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–the place <span class="e2">prakāśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be manifest <span class="e2">nadīyā</span> <span class="e2">gaurave</span>–as the glory of Nadia. [109]
“Eventually, people will live here again, and the place will manifest as the glory of Nadia.
ওহে জীব অদ্য তুমি রহ মায়াপুরে ।<br />কল্য লয়ে যাব আমি সীমান্তনগরে” ॥১১০॥
ohe jīva adya tumi raha māyāpure<br />kalya laye yāba āmi sīmanta-nagare” [110]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">adya</span>–today <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">raha</span>–stay <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur. <span class="e2">kalya</span>–Tomorrow <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">laye</span> <span class="e2">yāba</span>–will take [you] <span class="e2">sīmanta-nagare”</span>–to Sīmantadwīp.” [110]
“O Jīva, today stay in Māyāpur. Tomorrow I will take you to Sīmantadwīp.”
এত শুনি’ জীব তবে বলেন বচন ।<br />“সংশয় উঠিল এক করহ শ্রবণ ॥১১১॥
eta śuni’ jīva tabe balena vachana<br />“saṁśaya uṭhila eka karaha śravaṇa [111]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">vachana balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">“eka</span>–“A <span class="e2">saṁśaya</span>–doubt <span class="e2">uṭhila</span>–has arisen [within me]. <span class="e2">śravaṇa karaha</span>–Please hear [it]. [111]
Hearing this, Jīva said, “A doubt has arisen within me. Please hear it.
যবে গঙ্গাদেবী মায়াপুর আচ্ছাদন ।<br />উঠাইয়া লইবেন না রবে গোপন ॥১১২॥
সেই কালে ভক্তগণ কোন্ চিহ্ণ ধরি’ ।<br />প্রকাশিবে গুপ্তস্থান বল ব্যক্তি করি’ ॥১১৩॥
yabe gaṅgā-devī māyāpura āchchhādana<br />uṭhāiyā la-ibena nā rabe gopana [112]
sei kāle bhakta-gaṇa kon chihna dhari’<br />prakāśibe gupta-sthāna bala vyakta kari’” [113]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">gaṅgā-devī</span>–Gaṅgā Devī <span class="e2">āchchhādana</span> <span class="e2">uṭhāiyā</span> <span class="e2">la-ibena</span>–uncovers <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur [and it] <span class="e2">rabe nā</span>–no longer remains <span class="e2">gopana</span>–hidden, <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–then <span class="e2">kon</span> <span class="e2">chihna</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–by what signs [will] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">prakāśibe</span>–discover <span class="e2">gupta-sthāna</span>–the hidden places? <span class="e2">vyakta</span> <span class="e2">kari’ bala”</span>–Please explain [this].” [112<span class="e2">–</span>113]
“When Gaṅgā Devī uncovers Māyāpur and it no longer remains hidden, by what signs will the devotees discover the hidden places? Please explain this.”
জীবের বচন শুনি’ নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />বলিলা উত্তর তবে অমৃতের প্রায় ॥১১৪॥
jīvera vachana śuni’ nityānanda-rāya<br />balilā uttara tabe amṛtera prāya [114]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–Jīva’s <span class="e2">vachana</span>–words, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">balilā</span>–spoke [a] <span class="e2">amṛtera prāya</span>–nectarean <span class="e2">uttara</span>–answer. [114]
Hearing Jīva’s words, Nityānanda Rāy gave a nectarean answer.
“শুন জীব গঙ্গা যবে আচ্ছাদিবে স্থান ।<br />মায়াপুর এক কোণ রবে বিদ্যমান ॥১১৫॥
“śuna jīva gaṅgā yabe āchchhādibe sthāna<br />māyāpura eka koṇa rabe vidyamāna [115]
<span class="e2">“śuna</span>–“Listen, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–Gaṅgā Devī <span class="e2">āchchhādibe</span>–covers <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–the area, <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">koṇa</span>–edge <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–of Māyāpur <span class="e2">rabe</span>–will remain <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–manifest. [115]
“Listen, Jīva, when Gaṅgā Devī covers Māyāpur, one edge of it will remain manifest.
তথায় যবন বাস হইবে প্রচুর ।<br />তথাপি রহিবে নাম তার মায়াপুর ॥১১৬॥
tathāya yavana vāsa ha-ibe prachura<br />tathāpi rahibe nāma tāra māyāpura [116]
<span class="e2">prachura</span>–Many <span class="e2">yavana</span>–uncivilised people <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will reside <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–there. <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">tāra</span>–its <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–will remain <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur. [116]
“Many uncivilised people will reside there, but the name of the place will remain Māyāpur.
অবশিষ্ট স্থানে পশ্চিম দক্ষিণেতে ।<br />পঞ্চশতধনু পারে পাইবে দেখিতে ॥১১৭॥
কিছু উচ্চ স্থান সদা তৃণ আবরণ ।<br />সেই স্থান জগন্নাথমিশ্রের ভবন ॥১১৮॥
avaśiṣṭa sthāne paśchima dakṣiṇete<br />pañcha-śata-dhanu pāre pāibe dekhite [117]
kichhu uchcha sthāna sadā tṛṇa āvaraṇa<br />sei sthāna jagannātha-miśrera bhavana [118]
<span class="e2">pañcha-śata-dhanu</span>–One thousand six hundred metres <span class="e2">paśchima</span> <span class="e2">dakṣiṇete</span>–southwest, <span class="e2">pāre</span>–past <span class="e2">avaśiṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–this remaining place, <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">uchcha</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–a somewhat raised area <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">tṛṇa</span> <span class="e2">āvaraṇa</span>–covered with grass <span class="e2">dekhite pāibe</span>–will be visible. <span class="e2">sei</span>–That <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place [will be] <span class="e2">bhavana</span>–the home <span class="e2">jagannātha-miśrera</span>–of Jagannāth Miśra. [117<span class="e2">–</span>118]
“One thousand six hundred metres southwest, past this remaining place, a raised area always covered with grass will be visible. That place will be the home of Jagannāth Miśra.
তথা হৈতে পঞ্চধনু বৃদ্ধশিবালয়ে ।<br />এই পরিমাণ ধরি’ করিবে নির্ণয় ॥১১৯॥
tathā haite pañcha-dhanu vṛddha-śivālaya<br />ei parimāṇa dhari’ karibe nirṇaya [119]
<span class="e2">pañcha-dhanu</span>–Sixteen metres <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there [is] <span class="e2">vṛddha-śivālaya</span>–the Vṛddha Śiva Temple. <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–According <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">parimāṇa</span>–to these measurements, [devotees] <span class="e2">nirṇaya karibe</span>–will ascertain [the lost places]. [119]
“Sixteen metres from there is the Vṛddha Śiva Temple. According to these measurements, devotees will ascertain the lost places.
শিবডোবা বলি খাত দেখিতে পাইবে ।<br />সেই খাত গঙ্গাতীর বলিয়া জানিবে ॥১২০॥
śiva-ḍobā bali khāta dekhite pāibe<br />sei khāta gaṅgā-tīra baliyā jānibe [120]
<span class="e2">khāta</span>–A pond <span class="e2">bali</span>–known as <span class="e2">śiva-ḍobā</span>–Śiva Ḍobā <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–will be visible. [Devotees] <span class="e2">jānibe</span>–will recognise <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">khāta</span>–pond <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–as <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīra</span>–the bank of the Gaṅgā. [120]
“A pond known as Śiva Ḍobā will be visible. Devotees will recognise that pond as the previous bank of the Gaṅgā.
ভক্তগণ এই রূপে প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ।<br />প্রকাশিবে লুপ্তস্থান জানহ নিশ্চয় ॥১২১॥
bhakta-gaṇa ei rūpe prabhura ichchhāya<br />prakāśibe lupta-sthāna jānaha niśchaya [121]
<span class="e2">jānaha</span>–Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">prakāśibe</span>–will reveal <span class="e2">lupta-sthāna</span>–the lost places <span class="e2">ei rūpe</span>–in this way <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–by the will of the Lord. [121]
“Know for certain that the devotees will reveal the lost places in this way by the will of the Lord.
প্রভুর শতাব্দী-চতুষ্টয় অন্ত যবে ।<br />লুপ্ততীর্থ উদ্ধারের যত্ন হবে তবে” ॥১২২॥
prabhura śatābdī-chatuṣṭaya anta yabe<br />lupta-tīrtha uddhārera yatna habe tabe” [122]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">śatābdī-chatuṣṭaya</span>–the four hundredth anniversary <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord <span class="e2">anta</span>–ends, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">yatna</span>–the endeavour <span class="e2">uddhārera</span>–to reveal <span class="e2">lupta-tīrtha</span>–the lost holy places <span class="e2">habe”</span>–will be completed.” [122]
“Four hundred years after the appearance of the Lord, the endeavour to reveal the lost places will be completed.”
শ্রীজীব বলেন, “প্রভু বলহ এখন ।<br />অন্তর্দ্বীপ নামের যে যথার্থ কারণ” ॥১২৩॥
śrī-jīva balena, “prabhu balaha ekhana<br />antardvīpa nāmera ye yathārtha kāraṇa” [123]
<span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">“prabhu</span>–“O Lord <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now <span class="e2">balaha</span>–please tell [me] <span class="e2">ye</span>–the <span class="e2">yathārtha</span>–true <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–reason <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span> <span class="e2">nāmera”</span>–for Antardwīp’s name.” [123]
