Śrī Jīva said, “O Lord, now please tell me the true reason for Antardwīp’s name.”
প্রভু বলে, “এই স্থানে দ্বাপরের শেষে ।<br />তপস্যা করিল ব্রহ্মা গৌরকৃপা আশে ॥১২৪॥
prabhu bale, “ei sthāne dvāparera śeṣe<br />tapasyā karila brahmā gaura-kṛpā āśe [124]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said,<span class="e2"> “śeṣe</span>–“At the end <span class="e2">dvāparera</span>–of Dvāpar-yuga, <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">karila</span>–performed <span class="e2">tapasyā</span>–austerities <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in this place <span class="e2">āśe</span>–with an aspiration <span class="e2">gaura-kṛpā</span>–for the mercy of Gaura. [124]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “At the end of Dvāpar-yuga, Brahmā performed austerities in this place, aspiring for the mercy of Gaura.
গোবৎস গোপাল সব করিয়া হরণ ।<br />ছলিল করিয়া মায়া গোবিন্দের মন ॥১২৫॥
govatsa gopāla sabe kariyā haraṇa<br />chhalila kariyā māyā govindera mana [125]
[Previously,] <span class="e2">chhalila</span>–he [tried] to bewilder <span class="e2">govindera</span>–Govinda’s <span class="e2">mana</span>–mind <span class="e2">māyā kariyā</span>–using [his] illusion <span class="e2">haraṇa kariyā</span>–by stealing <span class="e2">sabe govatsa</span> <span class="e2">gopāla</span>–all the calves and cowherd boys. [125]
“Previously, using his illusion, he tried to trick Govinda by stealing the calves and cowherd boys.
নিজ মায়া পরাজয় দেখি’ চতুর্ম্মুখ ।<br />নিজ কার্য্যদোষে বড় পাইল অসুখ ॥১২৬॥
nija māyā parājaya dekhi’ chaturmukha<br />nija kārya-doṣe baḍa pāila asukha [126]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">māyā</span>–illusion <span class="e2">parājaya</span>–overpowered, <span class="e2">chaturmukha</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">asukha pāila</span>–became very sad <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">kārya-doṣe</span>–because of his offence. [126]
“When he saw his illusion overpowered by Govinda, Brahmā became very sad, understanding his offence.
বহু স্তব করি’ কৃষ্ণে করিল মিনতি ।<br />ক্ষমিল তাহার দোষ বৃন্দাবন-পতি ॥১২৭॥
bahu stava kari’ kṛṣṇe karila minati<br />kṣamila tāhāra doṣa vṛndāvana-pati [127]
<span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">stava</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–He profusely praised <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">minati karila</span>–prayed to Him. <span class="e2">vṛndāvana-pati</span>–The Lord of Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">kṣamila</span>–forgave <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–his <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–offence. [127]
“He profusely praised Kṛṣṇa and prayed to Him. The Lord of Vṛndāvan then forgave Brahmā’s offence.
তবু ব্রহ্মা মনে মনে করিল বিচার ।<br />‘ব্রহ্মবুদ্ধি মোর হয় অতিশয় ছার ॥ ১২৮॥
tabu brahmā mane mane karila vichāra<br />‘brahma-buddhi mora haya atiśaya chhāra [128]
<span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">tabu</span>–then <span class="e2">vichāra karila</span>–considered <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within [his] mind, <span class="e2">‘mora</span>–‘My <span class="e2">brahma-buddhi</span>–mentality of being Brahmā (the master of the universe) <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">atiśaya</span>–completely <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–worthless. [128]
“Brahmā considered within his mind, ‘My mentality of being Brahmā is completely worthless.
এই বুদ্ধি দোষে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমেতে রহিত ।<br />ব্রজলীলা রসভোগে হইনু বঞ্চিত ॥১২৯॥
ei buddhi doṣe kṛṣṇa-premete rahita<br />vraja-līlā rasa bhoge ha-inu vañchita [129]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">buddhi</span> <span class="e2">doṣe</span>–Because of this wrong mentality, <span class="e2">rahita</span>–I am devoid <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-premete</span>–of divine love for Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">vañchita ha-inu</span>–deprived <span class="e2">bhoge</span>–of relishing <span class="e2">rasa</span>–the taste <span class="e2">vraja-līlā</span>–of the Pastimes [of Kṛṣṇa] in Vṛndāvan. [129]
“‘Because of my wrong mentality, I am devoid of divine love for Kṛṣṇa and deprived of relishing the rasa of Pastimes in Vraja.
গোপাল হইয়া জন্ম পাইতাম আমি ।<br />সেবিতাম অনায়াসে গোপিকার স্বামী ॥১৩০॥
gopāla ha-iyā janma pāitāma āmi<br />sevitāma anāyāse gopikāra svāmī [130]
<span class="e2">āmi janma pāitāma</span>–If I had been born <span class="e2">gopāla</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–as a cowherd boy, <span class="e2">anāyāse sevitāma</span>–I would have easily served <span class="e2">svāmī</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">gopikāra</span>–of the gopīs. [130]
“‘If I had been born as a cowherd boy, I would have easily served the Lord of the gopīs.
সে লীলারসেতে মোর না হইল গতি ।<br />এবে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গে মোর না হয় কুমতি’ ॥১৩১॥
se līlā-rasete mora nā ha-ila gati<br />ebe śrī-gaurāṅge mora nā haya kumati’ [131]
<span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">gati ha-ila nā</span>–I did not attain entrance <span class="e2">se līlā-rasete</span>–into the rasa of those Pastimes, [but] <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅge</span>–with Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">mora kumati</span> <span class="e2">haya nā’</span>–I will not have any misconceptions.’ [131]
“‘I did not attain entrance into the rasa of those Pastimes, but now, with Śrī Gaurāṅga, I will not have any misconceptions.’
এই বলি’ বহুকাল অন্তর্দ্বীপ স্থানে ।<br />তপস্যা করিয়া ব্রহ্মা রহিল ধেয়ানে ॥ ১৩২॥
ei bali’ bahu-kāla antardvīpa sthāne<br />tapasyā kariyā brahmā rahila dheyāne [132]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Thinking <span class="e2">ei</span>–this, <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">tapasyā</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–performed austerities [and] <span class="e2">dheyāne rahila</span>–meditated <span class="e2">bahu-kāla</span>–for a long time <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in Antardwīp. [132]
“Thinking in this way, Brahmā performed austerities and meditated for a long time in Antardwīp.
কতদিনে গৌরচন্দ্র করুণা করিয়া ।<br />চতুর্ম্মুখ সন্নিধানে কহেন আসিয়া ॥১৩৩॥
kata-dine gaurachandra karuṇā kariyā<br />chaturmukha sannidhāne kahena āsiyā [133]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">karuṇā</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–came <span class="e2">sannidhāne</span>–before <span class="e2">chaturmukha</span>–Brahmā [and] <span class="e2">kahena</span>–spoke [to him]. [133]
“Eventually, Gaurachandra mercifully came before Brahmā and spoke to him.
‘ওহে ব্রহ্মা তব তপে তুষ্ট হয়ে আমি ।<br />আসিলাম দিতে যাহা আশা কর তুমি’ ॥১৩৪॥
‘ohe brahmā tava tape tuṣṭa haye āmi<br />āsilāma dite yāhā āśā kara tumi’ [134]
<span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">haye</span>–am <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span>–pleased <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">tape</span>–by your austerities, [and] <span class="e2">āsilāma</span>–I have come <span class="e2">dite</span>–to give <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–whatever <span class="e2">āśā</span> <span class="e2">kara’</span>–you desire.’ [134]
“‘O Brahmā, I am pleased by your austerities, and I have come to give you whatever you desire.’
নয়ন মেলিয়া ব্রহ্মা দেখি’ গৌররায় ।<br />অজ্ঞান হইয়া ভূমে পড়িল তথায় ॥১৩৫॥
nayana meliyā brahmā dekhi’ gaura-rāya<br />ajñāna ha-iyā bhūme paḍila tathāya [135]
<span class="e2">meliyā</span>–Opening [his] <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes [and] <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–seeing <span class="e2">gaura-rāya</span>–Gaura Rāy, <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">paḍila</span>–fell <span class="e2">bhūme</span>–to the ground <span class="e2">ajñāna</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–unconscious <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–there. [135]
“Opening his eyes and seeing Gaura Rāy, Brahmā fell to the ground unconscious.
ব্রহ্মার মস্তকে প্রভু ধরিলা চরণ ।<br />দিব্যজ্ঞান পেয়ে ব্রহ্মা করয় স্তবন ॥১৩৬॥
brahmāra mastake prabhu dharilā charaṇa<br />divya-jñāna peye brahmā karaya stavana [136]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">dharilā</span>–placed [His] <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–foot <span class="e2">brahmāra</span> <span class="e2">mastake</span>–on Brahmā’s head. <span class="e2">peye</span>–Receiving <span class="e2">divya-jñāna</span>–divine knowledge (as a result), <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">karaya</span> <span class="e2">stavana</span>–praised [Kṛṣṇa]. [136]
“The Lord placed His foot on Brahmā’s head. Receiving divine knowledge, Brahmā praised the Lord.
‘আমি দীনহীন অতি অভিমান বশে ।<br />পাসরিয়া তব পদ ফিরি জড় রসে ॥১৩৭॥
‘āmi dīna-hīna ati abhimāna vaśe<br />pāsariyā tava pada phiri jaḍa rase [137]
<span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I [am] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">dīna-hīna</span>–lowly and fallen. <span class="e2">abhimāna</span> <span class="e2">vaśe</span>–Controlled by pride, <span class="e2">pāsariyā</span>–I forgot <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">pada</span>–feet [and] <span class="e2">phiri</span>–turned <span class="e2">jaḍa</span> <span class="e2">rase</span>–to material pleasures. [137]
“‘I am very lowly and fallen. Controlled by pride, I forgot Your feet and turned to material pleasures.
আমি পঞ্চানন ইন্দ্র আদি দেবগণ ।<br />অধিকৃত দাস তব শাস্ত্রের লিখন ॥১৩৮॥
āmi pañchānana indra ādi deva-gaṇa<br />adhikṛta dāsa tava śāstrera likhana [138]
<span class="e2">śāstrera</span> <span class="e2">likhana</span>–It is written in the scriptures [that] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–myself, <span class="e2">pañchānana</span>–Śiva, <span class="e2">indra</span>–Indra, <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–and the other gods [are] <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">adhikṛta</span>–under Your control. [138]
“‘The scriptures say that myself, Śiva, Indra, and the other gods are all servants under Your control.
শুদ্ধ দাস হৈতে আমাদের ভাগ্য নয় ।<br />অতএব মায়া মোহ-জাল বিস্তারয় ॥১৩৯॥
śuddha dāsa haite āmādera bhāgya naya<br />ataeva māyā moha-jāla vistāraya [139]
<span class="e2">āmādera</span> <span class="e2">bhāgya</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–We do not have the fortune <span class="e2">haite</span>–of being [Your] <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants, [and] <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–thus <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">vistāraya</span>–spreads [her] <span class="e2">moha-jāla</span>–net of illusion [over us]. [139]
“‘But we do not have the fortune of being Your pure servants, and thus Māyā covers us with her net of illusion.
প্রথম পরার্দ্ধ মোর কাটিল জীবন ।<br />এবে ত চরম চিন্তা করয়ে পোষণ ॥১৪০॥
prathama parārdha mora kāṭila jīvana<br />ebe ta charama chintā karaye poṣaṇa [140]
<span class="e2">prathama</span>–The first <span class="e2">parārdha</span>–one hundred and fifty-five trillion years <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–of my life <span class="e2">kāṭila</span>–have passed. <span class="e2">ebe ta</span>–Now <span class="e2">chintā poṣaṇa karaye</span>–I am contemplating [my] <span class="e2">charama</span>–final days. [140]
“‘The first one hundred and fifty-five trillion years of my lifespan have passed. Now I am contemplating my final days.
দ্বিতীয় পরার্দ্ধ মোর কাটিবে কেমনে ।<br />বহির্ম্মুখ হইলে যাতনা বড় মনে ॥১৪১॥
dvitīya parārdha mora kāṭibe kemane<br />bahir-mukha ha-ile yātanā baḍa mane [141]
<span class="e2">kemane</span>–How <span class="e2">kāṭibe</span>–will I pass <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">dvitīya</span>–second <span class="e2">parārdha</span>–one hundred and fifty-five trillion years? <span class="e2">mane</span>–I know [that] <span class="e2">bahir-mukha</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–if I remain averse, <span class="e2">baḍa yātanā</span>–great suffering [will ensue]. [141]
“‘How will I pass the second one hundred and fifty-five trillion years of my lifespan? I know that if I remain averse to You, I will suffer greatly.
এই মাত্র তব পদে প্রার্থনা আমার ।<br />প্রকট লীলায় যেন হই পরিবার ॥১৪২॥
ei mātra tava pade prārthanā āmāra<br />prakaṭa līlāya yena ha-i paribāra [142]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">ei mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">prārthanā</span>–prayer <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">pade</span>–at Your feet [is that] <span class="e2">yena</span> <span class="e2">ha-i</span>–I may become <span class="e2">paribāra</span>–an associate <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">līlāya</span>–in [Your] manifest Pastimes. [142]
“‘My only prayer at Your feet is that I may become one of Your associates in Your manifest Pastimes.
ব্রহ্মবুদ্ধি দূরে যায় হেন জন্ম পাই ।<br />তোমার সঙ্গেতে থাকি’ তব গুণ গাই’ ॥১৪৩॥
brahma-buddhi dūre yāya hena janma pāi<br />tomāra saṅgete thāki’ tava guṇa gāi’ [143]
<span class="e2">pāi</span>–May I attain <span class="e2">janma</span>–a birth <span class="e2">hena</span>–in which [my] <span class="e2">brahma-buddhi</span>–mentality of being Brahmā <span class="e2">yāya</span>–goes <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away, [and] <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–I live <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">saṅgete</span>–in Your company [and] <span class="e2">gāi</span>–I chant <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">guṇa’</span>–glories.’ [143]
“‘May I attain a birth in which my mentality of being Brahmā leaves me, and I live in Your company, chanting Your glories.’
ব্রহ্মার প্রার্থনা শুনি’ গৌর ভগবান্ ।<br />‘তথাস্তু’ বলিয়া বর করিলেন দান ॥১৪৪॥
brahmāra prārthanā śuni’ gaura bhagavān<br />‘tathāstu’ baliyā vara karilena dāna [144]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">brahmāra</span>–Brahmā’s <span class="e2">prārthanā</span>–prayer, <span class="e2">gaura</span> <span class="e2">bhagavān</span>–the Supreme Lord Gaura <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘tathāstu’</span>–‘So be it’, [and] <span class="e2">dāna karilena</span>–gave [him] <span class="e2">vara</span>–the boon. [144]
“Hearing Brahmā’s prayer, the Supreme Lord Gaura said, ‘So be it’, and gave him the boon he desired.
‘যে সময় মম লীলা প্রকট হইবে ।<br />যবনের গৃহে তুমি জনম লভিবে ॥১৪৫॥
‘ye samaya mama līlā prakaṭa ha-ibe<br />yavanera gṛhe tumi janama labhibe [145]
<span class="e2">‘ye</span> <span class="e2">samaya</span>–‘When <span class="e2">mama</span>–My<span class="e2"> līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–manifest, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">janama</span> <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–will be born <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–in a home <span class="e2">yavanera</span>–of uncivilised people. [145]
“‘When My Pastimes manifest, you will be born in a home of uncivilised people.
আপনাকে হীন বলি’ হইবে গেয়ান ।<br />হরিদাস হবে তুমি শূন্য অভিমান ॥১৪৬॥
āpanāke hīna bali’ ha-ibe geyāna<br />haridāsa habe tumi śūnya abhimāna [146]
<span class="e2">bali’ geyāna ha-ibe</span>–You will consider <span class="e2">āpanāke</span>–yourself <span class="e2">hīna</span>–lowly. <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be [known as] <span class="e2">haridāsa</span>–as Haridās, [and you will be] <span class="e2">śūnya</span>–free from <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride. [146]
“‘You will consider yourself lowly. You will be known as Haridās, and you will be free from pride.
তিনলক্ষ হরিনাম জিহ্বাগ্রে নাচিবে ।<br />নির্য্যাণ-সময়ে তুমি আমাকে দেখিবে ॥১৪৭॥
tina-lakṣa hari-nāma jihvāgre nāchibe<br />niryāṇa-samaye tumi āmāke dekhibe [147]
<span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–The Name <span class="e2">nāchibe</span>–will dance <span class="e2">jihvāgre</span>–on the tip of [your] tongue <span class="e2">tina-lakṣa</span>–three hundred thousand [times a day, and] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–will see <span class="e2">āmāke</span>–Me <span class="e2">niryāṇa-samaye</span>–at the time of [your] passing. [147]
“‘The Name will dance on the tip of your tongue three hundred thousand times a day, and you will see Me at the time of your passing away.
এই ত সাধনবলে দ্বিপরার্দ্ধ-শেষে ।<br />পাবে নবদ্বীপধাম মজি’ নিত্যরসে ॥১৪৮॥
ei ta sādhana-bale dviparārdha-śeṣe<br />pābe navadvīpa-dhāma maji’ nitya-rase [148]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">sādhana-bale</span>–As a result of [your] practice, <span class="e2">dviparārdha śeṣe</span>–at the end of [Your] second one hundred trillion years, <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [and] <span class="e2">maji’</span>–relish <span class="e2">nitya-rase</span>–eternal rasa. [148]
“‘As a result of your practice, at the end of the second one hundred trillion years of your lifespan, you will attain Nabadwīp Dhām and relish eternal rasa.
ওহে ব্রহ্মা শুন মোর অন্তরের কথা ।<br />ব্যক্ত কভু না করিবে শাস্ত্রে যথা তথা ॥১৪৯॥
ohe brahmā śuna mora antarera kathā<br />vyakta kabhu nā karibe śāstre yathā tathā [149]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen [to] <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">antarera</span>–heartfelt <span class="e2">kathā</span>–words, [but] <span class="e2">vyakta</span> <span class="e2">karibe nā</span>–do not express [them] <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–in the scriptures <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–anywhere <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–at any time. [149]
“‘O Brahmā, listen to My heartfelt words, but do not express them in the scriptures anywhere at any time.
ভক্তভাব লয়ে ভক্তিরস আস্বাদিব ।<br />পরম দুর্ল্লভ সঙ্কীর্ত্তন প্রকাশিব ॥১৫০॥
bhakta-bhāva laye bhakti-rasa āsvādiba<br />parama durlabha saṅkīrtana prakāśiba [150]
<span class="e2">laye</span>–Taking <span class="e2">bhakta-bhāva</span>–the mood of a devotee, <span class="e2">āsvādiba</span>–I will relish <span class="e2">bhakti-rasa</span>–the joy of devotion [and] <span class="e2">prakāśiba</span>–reveal [the] <span class="e2">parama</span>–most <span class="e2">durlabha</span>–rare [form of] <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–saṅkīrtan. [150]
“‘Taking the mood of a devotee, I will relish the rasa of devotion and reveal the most rare form of saṅkīrtan.
অন্য অন্য অবতারকালে ভক্ত যত ।<br />ব্রজরসে সবে মাতাইব করি’ রত ॥১৫১॥
anya anya avatāra-kāle bhakta yata<br />vraja-rase sabe mātāiba kari’ rata [151]
<span class="e2">rata kari’ mātāiba</span>–I will intensely madden <span class="e2">yata bhakta sabe</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">avatāra-kāle</span>–from the times of [My] other appearances <span class="e2">vraja-rase</span>–with the taste of Vraja. [151]
“‘I will completely madden all the devotees of My previous Avatārs with the rasa of Vraja.
শ্রীরাধিকা প্রেম-বদ্ধ আমার হৃদয় ।<br />তাঁর ভাব কান্তি লয়ে হইব উদয় ॥১৫২॥
śrī-rādhikā prema-baddha āmāra hṛdaya<br />tā̐ra bhāva kānti laye ha-iba udaya [152]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart [is] <span class="e2">śrī-rādhikā</span> <span class="e2">prema-baddha</span>–bound by the love of Śrī Rādhikā. <span class="e2">laye</span>–I will take <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–Her <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–heart [and] <span class="e2">kānti</span>–halo, [and] <span class="e2">udaya ha-iba</span>–appear. [152]
“‘My heart is bound by the love of Śrī Rādhikā. I will take Her heart and halo, and appear.
কিবা সুখ রাধা পায় আমারে সেবিয়া ।<br />সেই সুখ আস্বাদিব রাধা-ভাব লৈয়া ॥১৫৩॥
kibā sukha rādhā pāya āmāre seviyā<br />sei sukha āsvādiba rādhā-bhāva laiyā [153]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–What sort <span class="e2">sukha</span>–of happiness [does] <span class="e2">rādhā</span>–Rādhā <span class="e2">pāya</span>–feel <span class="e2">seviyā</span>–by serving <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–Me? <span class="e2">laiyā</span>–Taking <span class="e2">rādhā-bhāva</span>–Rādhā’s heart, <span class="e2">āsvādiba</span>–I will relish <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sukha</span>–that happiness. [153]
“‘What sort of happiness does Rādhā feel by serving Me? Taking Her heart, I will relish that happiness.
আজি হৈতে তুমি মোর শিষ্যতা লভিবে ।<br />হরিদাস রূপে মোর সতত সেবিবে’ ॥১৫৪॥
āji haite tumi mora śiṣyatā labhibe<br />haridāsa rūpe more satata sevibe’ [154]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">āji</span>–today, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–will gain <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">śiṣyatā</span>–the status of My disciple, [and] <span class="e2">rūpe</span>–as <span class="e2">haridāsa</span>–Haridās, <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–you will serve <span class="e2">more</span>–Me <span class="e2">satata’</span>–eternally.’ [154]
“‘From today, you are My disciple, and as Haridās, you will serve Me eternally.’
এত বলি’ মহাপ্রভু হৈল অন্তর্দ্ধান ।<br />আছাড়িয়া পড়ে ব্রহ্মা হইয়া অজ্ঞান ॥১৫৫॥
eta bali’ mahāprabhu haila antardhāna<br />āchhāḍiyā paḍe brahmā ha-iyā ajñāna [155]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">antardhāna haila</span>–disappeared, [and] <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">āchhāḍiyā</span> <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–fell heavily to the ground <span class="e2">ajñāna ha-iyā</span>–unconscious. [155]
“Saying this, Mahāprabhu disappeared, and Brahmā fell heavily to the ground unconscious.
‘হা গৌরাঙ্গ দীনবন্ধু ভকতবৎসল ।<br />কবে বা পাইব তব চরণকমল’ ॥১৫৬॥
‘hā gaurāṅga dīna-bandhu bhakata-vatsala<br />kabe vā pāiba tava charaṇa-kamala’ [156]
<span class="e2">‘hā</span>–‘O <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">dīna-bandhu</span>–O Friend of the fallen! <span class="e2">bhakata-vatsala</span>–O affectionate Lord of the devotees! <span class="e2">kabe</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–When <span class="e2">pāiba</span>–will I reach <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">charaṇa-kamala’</span>–lotus feet?’ [156]
“‘O Gaurāṅga! O Friend of the fallen! O affectionate Lord of the devotees! When will I reach Your lotus feet?’
এই মত কত দিন কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে ।<br />ব্রহ্ম-লোকে গেল ব্রহ্মা কার্য্য সম্পাদিতে” ॥১৫৭॥
ei mata kata dina kā̐dite kā̐dite<br />brahma-loke gela brahmā kārya sampādite” [157]
<span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–After crying and crying <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">mata</span>–in this way <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–for some time, <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">gela</span>–went <span class="e2">brahma-loke</span>–to Brahmaloka <span class="e2">kārya</span> <span class="e2">sampādite”</span>–to perform his duties.” [157]
“After crying and crying in this way for some time, Brahmā returned to his abode to perform his duties.”
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-পদে আশা মাত্র যার ।<br />নদীয়ামাহাত্ম্য গায় দীন হীন ছার ॥১৫৮॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pade āśā mātra yāra<br />nadīyā-māhātmya gāya dīna hīna chhāra [158]
<span class="e2">dīna</span> <span class="e2">hīna</span> <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–This lowly, fallen, insignificant soul, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">āśā</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pade</span>–for Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia. [158]
This lowly, fallen, insignificant soul, who aspires only for the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, chants the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Six
Visiting Śrī Gaṅgā Nagar, Śrī Pṛthu Kuṇḍa, Śrī Sīmantadwīp, Śrī Viśrām Sthān, and Other Places
জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য শচীর নন্দন ।<br />জয় নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু জাহ্নবাজীবন ॥১॥
jaya jaya śrī-chaitanya śachīra nandana<br />jaya nityānanda prabhu jāhnavā-jīvana [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">nandana</span>–to the son of Śachī, <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">jāhnavā-jīvana</span>–to the life of Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī, Śrī Chaitanya! All glory to the life of Jāhnavā, Nityānanda Prabhu!
জয় জয় সীতানাথ জয় গদাধর ।<br />জয় জয় শ্রীবাসাদি গৌর-পরিকর ॥২॥
jaya jaya sītānātha jaya gadādhara<br />jaya jaya śrīvāsādi gaura-parikara [2]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">sītānātha</span>–to the Lord of Sītā Devī, Advaita Āchārya! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar Paṇḍit! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span> <span class="e2">gaura-parikara</span>–to Śrīvās Ṭhākur and all the Lord’s associates! [2]
All glory to the Lord of Sītā Devī, Advaita Āchārya! All glory to Gadādhar, Śrīvās, and all the Lord’s associates!
পরদিন প্রাতে প্রভু নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />শ্রীবাস শ্রীজীব লয়ে গৃহ বাহিরায় ॥৩॥
para-dina prāte prabhu nityānanda-rāya<br />śrīvāsa śrī-jīva laye gṛha bāhirāya [3]
<span class="e2">para-dina</span>–The next day <span class="e2">prāte</span>–in the morning, <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">bāhirāya</span>–left <span class="e2">gṛha</span>–the Temple <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās [and] <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva. [3]
The next day in the morning, Nityānanda Prabhu left the Temple with Śrīvās and Śrī Jīva.
সঙ্গে চলে রামদাস আদি ভক্তগণ ।<br />যাইতে যাইতে করে গৌরসঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥৪॥
saṅge chale rāma-dāsa ādi bhakta-gaṇa<br />yāite yāite kare gaura-saṅkīrtana [4]
<span class="e2">rāma-dāsa</span>–Rāmadās <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–and the other devotees <span class="e2">saṅge</span> <span class="e2">chale</span>–accompanied [them, and] <span class="e2">gaura-saṅkīrtana kare</span>–they chanted the Name of Gaura <span class="e2">yāite</span> <span class="e2">yāite</span>–as they walked. [4]
Rāmadās and other devotees accompanied them, and they chanted the Name of Gaura as they walked.
অন্তর্দ্বীপ প্রান্তে প্রভু আইলা যখন ।<br />শ্রীগঙ্গানগর জীবে দেখায় তখন ॥৫॥
antardvīpa prānte prabhu āilā yakhana<br />śrī-gaṅgā-nagara jīve dekhāya takhana [5]
<span class="e2">yakhana</span>–When <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">āilā</span>–came <span class="e2">prānte</span>–to the boundary <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–of Antardwīp, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">dekhāya</span>–He showed <span class="e2">śrī-gaṅgā-nagara</span>–Śrī Gaṅgā Nagar <span class="e2">jīve</span>–to Jīva. [5]
When the Lord came to the boundary of Antardwīp, He showed Śrī Gaṅgā Nagar to Jīva.
প্রভু বলে, “শুন জীব এ গঙ্গানগর ।<br />স্থাপিলেন ভগীরথ রঘু-বংশধর ॥৬॥
prabhu bale, “śuna jīva e gaṅgā-nagara<br />sthāpilena bhagīratha raghu-vaṁśa-dhara [6]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“śuna</span>–“Listen <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">e</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">gaṅgā-nagara</span>–Gaṅgā Nagar. <span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath, <span class="e2">raghu-vaṁśa-dhara</span>–a forefather of Lord Rāmachandra, <span class="e2">sthāpilena</span>–established [it]. [6]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Listen Jīva, this is Gaṅgā Nagar. It was established by Mahārāj Bhagīrath, a forefather of Lord Rāmachandra.
যবে গঙ্গা ভাগীরথী আইল চলিয়া ।<br />ভগীরথ যায় আগে শঙ্খ বাজাইয়া ॥৭॥
yabe gaṅgā bhāgīrathī āila chaliyā<br />bhagīratha yāya āge śaṅkha bājāiyā [7]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–the Bhāgīrathī (Gaṅgā is known as Bhāgīrathī because she was brought to the earth by Mahārāj Bhagīrath to deliver his ancestors from their offence to Kapila Muni), <span class="e2">chaliyā āila</span>–came [here,] <span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">āge</span>–ahead [of her] <span class="e2">bājāiyā</span>–blowing <span class="e2">śaṅkha</span>–a conch. [7]
“When the Gaṅgā, who is also known as Bhāgīrathī, came here, Mahārāj Bhagīrath went ahead of her blowing a conch.
নবদ্বীপধামে আসি’ গঙ্গা হয় স্থির ।<br />ভগীরথ দেখে গঙ্গা না হয় বাহির ॥৮॥
navadvīpa-dhāme āsi’ gaṅgā haya sthira<br />bhagīratha dekhe gaṅgā nā haya bāhira [8]
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–Arriving <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–in Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">sthira haya</span>–stopped, [and] <span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw [that] <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">bāhira haya nā</span>–would not leave. [8]
“Arriving in Nabadwīp Dhām, the Gaṅgā stopped, and Mahārāj Bhagīrath saw that she would not proceed.
ভয়েতে বিহ্বল হয়ে রাজা ভগীরথ ।<br />গঙ্গার নিকটে আইল ফিরি’ কত পথ ॥৯॥
bhayete vihvala haye rājā bhagīratha<br />gaṅgāra nikaṭe āila phiri’ kata patha [9]
<span class="e2">haye</span>–Becoming <span class="e2">vihvala</span>–overwhelmed <span class="e2">bhayete</span>–with fear (that his ancestors would not be delivered), <span class="e2">rājā</span> <span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">phiri’</span> <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">patha</span>–retraced [his] course [and] <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–before the Gaṅgā. [9]
“Overwhelmed with fear, Mahārāj Bhagīrath retraced his course and came before the Gaṅgā.
গঙ্গানগরেতে বসি’ তপ আরম্ভিল ।<br />তপে তুষ্ট হয়ে গঙ্গা সাক্ষাৎ হইল ॥১০॥
gaṅgā-nagarete vasi’ tapa ārambhila<br />tape tuṣṭa haye gaṅgā sākṣāt ha-ila [10]
<span class="e2">vasi’</span>–He stayed <span class="e2">gaṅgā-nagarete</span>–in Gaṅgā Nagar [and] <span class="e2">ārambhila</span>–started to perform <span class="e2">tapa</span>–austerities. <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–Pleased <span class="e2">tape</span>–by the austerities, <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–Gaṅgā <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–appeared. [10]
“He stayed in Gaṅgā Nagar and began to perform austerities. Pleased by them, Gaṅgā personally appeared before him.
ভগীরথ বলে, ‘মাতা তুমি নাহি গেলে ।<br />পিতৃলোক উদ্ধার না হবে কোন কালে’ ॥১১॥
bhagīratha bale, ’mātā tumi nāhi gele<br />pitṛloka uddhāra nā habe kona kāle’ [11]
<span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘mātā</span>–‘O Mother, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">gele</span>–if you do not go forward, [my] <span class="e2">pitṛloka</span>–ancestors <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">kāle uddhāra</span> <span class="e2">habe</span> <span class="e2">nā’</span>–will never be delivered.’ [11]
“Mahārāj Bhagīrath said, ‘O Mother, if you do not continue, my ancestors will never be delivered.’
গঙ্গা বলে, ‘শুন বাছা ভগীরথ বীর ।<br />কিছু দিন তুমি হেথা হয়ে থাক স্থির ॥১২॥
gaṅgā bale, ‘śuna vāchhā bhagīratha vīra<br />kichhu dina tumi hethā haye thāka sthira [12]
<span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–Gaṅgā <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘śuna</span>–‘Listen, [my] <span class="e2">vāchhā</span>–child, <span class="e2">vīra bhagīratha</span>–O heroic Bhagīrath! <span class="e2">sthira haye</span>–Peacefully <span class="e2">tumi thāka</span>–stay <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–for some time. [12]
“Gaṅgā said, ‘Listen, my child, O heroic Bhagīrath! Peacefully stay here for some time.
মাঘমাসে আসিয়াছি নবদ্বীপধামে ।<br />ফাল্গুনের শেষে যাব তব পিতৃকামে ॥১৩॥
māgha-māse āsiyāchhi navadvīpa-dhāme<br />phālgunera śeṣe yāba tava pitṛ-kāme [13]
<span class="e2">āsiyāchhi</span>–We have come <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–to Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">māgha-māse</span>–in the month of Māgh (January–February). <span class="e2">śeṣe</span>–At the end <span class="e2">phālgunera</span>–of Phālgun (February–March), <span class="e2">yāba</span>–I will go <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">pitṛ-kāme</span>–to attend to your ancestors. [13]
“‘We have come to Nabadwīp Dhām in the month of Māgh. At the end of Phālgun, I will deliver your ancestors.
যাঁহার চরণজল আমি ভগীরথ ।<br />তাঁর নিজধামে মোর পুরে মনোরথ ॥১৪॥
yā̐hāra charaṇa-jala āmi bhagīratha<br />tā̐ra nija-dhāme mora pure manoratha [14]
<span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–O Bhagīrath, <span class="e2">pure</span>–I will fulfil <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">manoratha</span>–desires <span class="e2">nija-dhāme</span>–in the abode <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">yā̐hāra</span>–of He whose <span class="e2">charaṇa-jala</span>–foot-water <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am]. [14]
“‘O Bhagīrath, I am the water that washes the feet of the Lord. Here in His abode, I will first fulfil my own desires.
ফাল্গুন-পূর্ণিমা-তিথি প্রভু-জন্মদিন ।<br />সেই দিন মম ব্রত আছে সমীচীন ॥১৫॥
phālguna-pūrṇimā-tithi prabhu-janma-dina<br />sei dina mama vrata āchhe samīchīna [15]
<span class="e2">pūrṇimā</span>-<span class="e2">tithi</span>–The full moon day <span class="e2">phālguna</span>–in Phālgun (February–March) [is] <span class="e2">prabhu-janma-dina</span>–the birthday of the Lord, [and] <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">vrata</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span> <span class="e2">samīchīna</span>–I should perform a rite <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–on that day. [15]
“‘The full moon day in Phālgun is the birthday of the Lord, and I should perform a rite on that day.
সেই ব্রত উদ্যাপন করিয়া নিশ্চয় ।<br />চলিব তোমার সঙ্গে না করিহ ভয়’ ॥১৬॥
sei vrata udyāpana kariyā niśchaya<br />chaliba tomāra saṅge nā kariha bhaya’ [16]
<span class="e2">udyāpana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–I will complete <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vrata</span>–this rite, [and then] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">chaliba</span>–I will go <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with you. <span class="e2">bhaya</span> <span class="e2">kariha nā’</span>–Do not be afraid.’ [16]
“‘I will complete this rite, and then certainly I will go with you. Do not be afraid.’
এ গঙ্গানগরে রাজা রঘু-কুলপতি ।<br />ফাল্গুন-পূর্ণিমা-দিনে করিল বসতি ॥১৭॥
e gaṅgā-nagare rājā raghu-kula-pati<br />phālguna-pūrṇimā-dine karila vasati [17]
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">raghu-kula-pati</span>–of the Raghu dynasty (Mahārāj Bhagīrath) <span class="e2">vasati karila</span>–resided <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">gaṅgā-nagare</span>–in Gaṅgā Nagar <span class="e2">pūrṇimā-dine</span>–until the full moon day <span class="e2">phālguna</span>–in Phālgun. [17]
“Mahārāj Bhagīrath resided in Gaṅgā Nagar until the full moon day in Phālgun.
যেই জন শ্রীফাল্গুন-পূর্ণিমা-দিবসে ।<br />গঙ্গাস্নান করি’ গঙ্গানগরেতে বসে ॥১৮॥
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ পূজা করে উপবাস করি’ ।<br />পূর্ব্বপুরুষের সহ সেই যায় তরি’ ॥১৯॥
yei jana śrī-phālguna-pūrṇimā-divase<br />gaṅgā-snāna kari’ gaṅgā-nagarete vase [18]
śrī-gaurāṅga pūjā kare upavāsa kari’<br />pūrva-puruṣera saha sei yāya tari’ [19]
<span class="e2">yei sei jana</span>–Anyone who <span class="e2">vase</span>–stays <span class="e2">gaṅgā-nagarete</span>–in Gaṅgā Nagar <span class="e2">pūrṇimā-divase</span>–on the full moon day <span class="e2">śrī-phālguna</span>–in Phālgun, <span class="e2">gaṅgā-snāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–bathes in the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">upavāsa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–fasts, [and] <span class="e2">pūjā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–worships <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">tari’ yāya</span>–crosses over [material existence] <span class="e2">saha</span>–with [their] <span class="e2">pūrva-puruṣera</span>–ancestors. [18<span class="e2">–</span>19]
“Anyone who stays in Gaṅgā Nagar on the full moon day in Phālgun, bathes in the Gaṅgā, fasts, and worships Śrī Gaurāṅga crosses over material existence, as do their ancestors.
সহস্র পুরুষ পূর্ব্বগণ সঙ্গে করি’ ।<br />শ্রীগোলোক প্রাপ্ত হয় যথা তথা মরি’ ॥ ২০॥
sahasra puruṣa pūrva-gaṇa saṅge kari’<br />śrī-goloka prāpta haya yathā tathā mari’ [20]
<span class="e2">prāpta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–They attain <span class="e2">śrī-goloka</span>–Śrī Goloka <span class="e2">saṅge</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–along with <span class="e2">sahasra</span>–one thousand <span class="e2">puruṣa</span> <span class="e2">pūrva-gaṇa</span>–of their ancestors, <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–regardless of how or where <span class="e2">mari’</span>–they died. [20]
“Along with one thousand of their ancestors, they attain Śrī Goloka, regardless of how or where they died.
ওহে জীব এ স্থানের মাহাত্ম্য অপার ।<br />শ্রীচৈতন্য নৃত্য যথা কৈল কতবার ॥২১॥
ohe jīva e sthānera māhātmya apāra<br />śrī-chaitanya nṛtya yathā kaila kata-bāra [21]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories <span class="e2">e sthānera</span>–of this place [are] <span class="e2">apāra</span>–unlimited. <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">nṛtya</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–danced <span class="e2">yathā</span>–here <span class="e2">kata-bāra</span>–many times. [21]
“O Jīva, the glories of this place are unlimited. Śrī Chaitanya danced here many times.
গঙ্গাদাসগৃহে আর সঞ্জয়-আলয় ।<br />ঐ দেখ দৃষ্ট হয় সদা সুখময় ॥২২॥
gaṅgā-dāsa-gṛhe āra sañjaya-ālaya<br />ai dekha dṛṣṭa haya sadā sukhamaya [22]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">ai</span>–there <span class="e2">gaṅgā-dāsa-gṛhe</span>–the home of Gaṅgā Dās Paṇḍit <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">sañjaya-ālaya</span>–the home of Sañjay Dās, [which] <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">dṛṣṭa</span>–seen [to be] <span class="e2">sukhamaya</span>–filled with joy. [22]
“See there the homes of Gaṅgā Dās Paṇḍit and Sañjay Dās, which are always filled with joy.
ইহার পূর্ব্বেতে যেই দীর্ঘিকা সুন্দর ।<br />তাহার মাহাত্ম্য শুন ওহে বিজ্ঞবর ॥২৩॥
ihāra pūrvete yei dīrghikā sundara<br />tāhāra māhātmya śuna ohe vijña-vara [23]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">vijña-vara</span>–best of the wise, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–hear [now] <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–about the glories <span class="e2">yei tāhāra</span>–of the <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">dīrghikā</span>–lake <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">pūrvete</span>–to their east. [23]
“O best of the wise, hear now about the glories of the beautiful lake to the east.
বল্লালদীর্ঘিকা নাম হয়েছে এখন ।<br />সত্যযুগে ছিল এর কত বিবরণ ॥২৪॥
ballāla-dīrghikā nāma hayechhe ekhana<br />satya-yuge chhila era kata vivaraṇa [24]
<span class="e2">ekhana hayechhe</span>–It has now become <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">ballāla-dīrghikā</span>–Ballāl Dīrghikā, [but] <span class="e2">era</span> <span class="e2">chhila</span> <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">vivaraṇa</span>–it was described in many other ways <span class="e2">satya-yuge</span>–during Satya-yuga. [24]
“It has now become known as Ballāl Dīrghikā, but it was described in many other ways during Satya-yuga.
পৃথু নামে মহারাজা উচ্চ নীচ স্থান ।<br />কাটিয়া পৃথিবী যবে করিল সমান ॥২৫॥
সেই কালে এই স্থান সমান করিতে ।<br />মহাজ্যোতির্ম্ময় প্রভা উঠে চতুর্ভিতে ॥২৬॥
pṛthu nāme mahārājā uchcha nīcha sthāna<br />kāṭiyā pṛthivī yabe karila samāna [25]
sei kāle ei sthāna samāna karite<br />mahājyotirmaya prabhā uṭhe chaturbhite [26]
<span class="e2">yabe sei kāle</span>–When <span class="e2">mahārājā</span>–a king <span class="e2">nāme</span>–named <span class="e2">pṛthu</span>–Pṛthu <span class="e2">kāṭiyā</span>–was cutting [and] <span class="e2">samāna karila</span>–levelling [the] <span class="e2">uchcha</span>–high [and] <span class="e2">nīcha</span>–low <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–places <span class="e2">pṛthivī</span>–on the earth, [he came] <span class="e2">samāna</span> <span class="e2">karite</span>–to level <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place, [and an] <span class="e2">mahājyotirmaya</span>–extremely bright <span class="e2">prabhā</span>–light <span class="e2">uṭhe</span>–arose <span class="e2">chaturbhite</span>–in the four directions. [25<span class="e2">–</span>26]
“When Mahārāj Pṛthu was cutting and levelling all the high and low places on the earth, he came to level this place, and an extremely bright light appeared in all directions.
কর্ম্মচারিগণ মহারাজারে জানায় ।<br />রাজা আসি’ জ্যোতিঃপুঞ্জ দেখিবারে পায় ॥২৭॥
karmachāri-gaṇa mahārājāre jānāya<br />rājā āsi’ jyotiḥ-puñja dekhibare pāya [27]
<span class="e2">karmachāri-gaṇa</span>–The workmen <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–informed <span class="e2">mahārājāre</span>–the king, [and] <span class="e2">rājā</span>–Mahārāj Pṛthu <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came [and] <span class="e2">dekhibare</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–saw <span class="e2">jyotiḥ-puñja</span>–the light. [27]
“The workmen informed the king, and Mahārāj Pṛthu came and saw the light.
শক্ত্যাবেশ-অবতার পৃথুমহাশয় ।<br />ধ্যানেতে জানিল স্থান নবদ্বীপ হয় ॥২৮॥
śaktyāveśa-avatāra pṛthu-mahāśaya<br />dhyānete jānila sthāna navadvīpa haya [28]
<span class="e2">pṛthu-mahāśaya</span>–Mahārāj Pṛthu, <span class="e2">śaktyāveśa-avatāra</span>–a soul empowered to act as the Lord Himself, <span class="e2">jānila</span>–understood <span class="e2">dhyānete</span>–through meditation [that] <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–this place <span class="e2">haya</span>–was <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. [28]
“Mahārāj Pṛthu, a Śaktyāveś-avatār, through meditation understood this place to be Nabadwīp.
স্থানের মাহাত্ম্য গুপ্ত রাখিবার তরে ।<br />আজ্ঞা দিল, ‘কর কুণ্ড স্থান মনোহরে’ ॥২৯॥
sthānera māhātmya gupta rākhibara tare<br />ājñā dila, ‘kara kuṇḍa sthāna manohare’ [29]
<span class="e2">rākhibara</span> <span class="e2">tare</span>–To keep <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories <span class="e2">sthānera</span>–of this place <span class="e2">gupta</span>–hidden, <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–he ordered, <span class="e2">‘kara</span>–Make <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–this place <span class="e2">manohare kuṇḍa’</span>–into a beautiful lake.’ [29]
“To keep the glories of this place hidden, he ordered, ‘Make a beautiful lake here.’
যে কুণ্ড করিল তাহা পৃথুকুণ্ড নামে ।<br />বিখ্যাত হইল সর্ব্বনবদ্বীপধামে ॥৩০॥
ye kuṇḍa karila tāhā pṛthu-kuṇḍa nāme<br />vikhyāta ha-ila sarva-navadvīpa-dhāme [30]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">kuṇḍa</span>–The lake <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">karila</span>–he made, <span class="e2">nāme</span>–known as <span class="e2">pṛthu-kuṇḍa</span>–Pṛthu Kuṇḍa, <span class="e2">vikhyāta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became famous <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–all over Nabadwīp Dhām. [30]
“The lake he made, known as Pṛthu Kuṇḍa, became famous all over Nabadwīp Dhām.
স্বচ্ছ জল পান করি’ গ্রামবাসিগণে ।<br />কত সুখ পাইল তাহা কহিব কেমনে ॥৩১॥
svachchha jala pāna kari’ grāma-vāsi-gaṇe<br />kata sukha pāila tāhā kahiba kemane [31]
<span class="e2">kemane</span>–How <span class="e2">kahiba</span>–will I describe <span class="e2">tāhā kata</span>–how much <span class="e2">sukha</span>–joy <span class="e2">grāma-vāsi-gaṇe</span>–the villagers <span class="e2">pāila</span>–felt <span class="e2">pāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by drinking <span class="e2">svachchha</span> <span class="e2">jala</span>–the pure water [in the lake]? [31]
“How can I describe how much joy the villagers felt when they drank the pure water of this lake?
পরে সেই স্থানে শ্রীলক্ষ্মণ সেন ধীর ।<br />দীর্ঘিকা খনন কৈল বড়ই গভীর ॥৩২॥
pare sei sthāne śrī-lakṣmaṇa sena dhīra<br />dīrghikā khanana kaila baḍa-i gabhīra [32]
<span class="e2">pare</span>–Later, <span class="e2">dhīra śrī-lakṣmaṇa</span> <span class="e2">sena</span>–wise Śrī Lakṣmaṇ Sen <span class="e2">khanana</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–excavated <span class="e2">dīrghikā</span>–the lake <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in that place, [making it] <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span>–extremely large [and] <span class="e2">gabhīra</span>–deep. [32]
“Later, King Lakṣmaṇ Sen excavated, deepened, and enlarged the lake.
নিজ পিতৃলোকের উদ্ধার করি’ আশ ।<br />বল্লালদীর্ঘিকা নাম করিল প্রকাশ ॥৩৩॥
nija pitṛlokera uddhāra kari’ āśa<br />ballāla-dīrghikā nāma karila prakāśa [33]
<span class="e2">āśa kari’</span>–Desiring <span class="e2">uddhāra</span>–to deliver <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">pitṛlokera</span>–ancestors, <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">prakāśa karila</span>–he named [the lake] <span class="e2">ballāla-dīrghikā</span>–Ballāl Dīrghikā. [33]
“Desiring to deliver his ancestors, he named the lake Ballāl Dīrghikā (after his father, Ballāl Sen).
ঐ দেখ উচ্চটিলা দেখিতে সুন্দর ।<br />লক্ষ্মণসেনের গৃহ ভগ্ন অতঃপর ॥৩৪॥
ai dekha uchcha-ṭilā dekhite sundara<br />lakṣmaṇa-senera gṛha bhagna ataḥpara [34]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">ai</span>–there <span class="e2">uchcha-ṭilā</span>–the large hill [that is] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to behold. [There stood] <span class="e2">gṛha</span>–the house <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇa-senera</span>–of Lakṣmaṇ Sen. <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–Since then, [it has fallen into] <span class="e2">bhagna</span>–ruin. [34]
“See there that large beautiful hill. There stood the house of Lakṣmaṇ Sen. It has since fallen into ruin.
এ সকল অলঙ্কার মহাতীর্থ স্থানে ।<br />রাজগণ করে সদা পুণ্য উপার্জ্জনে ॥৩৫॥
e sakala alaṅkāra mahātīrtha sthāne<br />rāja-gaṇa kare sadā puṇya upārjane [35]
<span class="e2">rāja-gaṇa</span>–Kings <span class="e2">kare</span>–made <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all these <span class="e2">alaṅkāra</span>–ornaments (lakes, buildings, etc.) <span class="e2">mahātīrtha</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–at this extremely holy place <span class="e2">sadā</span> <span class="e2">upārjane</span>–to continuously accrue <span class="e2">puṇya</span>–good fortune. [35]
“Various kings made all these ornaments at this holy place so that they would continuously accrue good fortune.
পরেতে যবনরাজ দুষিল এস্থান ।<br />অতএব ভক্তগণ না করে সম্মান ॥৩৬॥
parete yavana-rāja duṣila e-sthāna<br />ataeva bhakta-gaṇa nā kare sammāna [36]
<span class="e2">parete</span>–Later, <span class="e2">yavana-rāja</span>–an uncivilised king <span class="e2">duṣila</span>–desecrated <span class="e2">e-sthāna</span>–this place. <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–devotees <span class="e2">sammāna kare nā</span>–do not worship [it]. [36]
“Later, an uncivilised king desecrated this place, and thus devotees do not worship it.
ভূমি মাত্র সুপবিত্র এই স্থানে হয় ।<br />যবন-সংসর্গভয়ে বাস না করয় ॥৩৭॥
bhūmi mātra supavitra ei sthāne haya<br />yavana-saṁsarga-bhaye vāsa nā karaya [37]
<span class="e2">mātra</span>–Only <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–the land <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in this place <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">supavitra</span>–pure, [and] <span class="e2">yavana-saṁsarga-bhaye</span>–out of fear of interaction with uncivilised people, [devotees] <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">karaya nā</span>–do not reside here. [37]
“The land in this place is pure, but fearing interaction with the uncivilised people, devotees do not reside here.
এ স্থানে হইল শ্রীমূর্ত্তির অপমান ।<br />অতএব ভক্তবৃন্দ ছাড়ে এই স্থান” ॥৩৮॥
e sthāne ha-ila śrī-mūrtira apamāna<br />ataeva bhakta-vṛnda chhāḍe ei sthāna” [38]
<span class="e2">apamāna</span>–Offences <span class="e2">śrī-mūrtira</span>–against Deities <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–happened <span class="e2">e sthāne</span>–in this place, [and] <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–thus <span class="e2">bhakta-vṛnda</span>–devotees <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–left <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">sthāna”</span>–place.” [38]
“Offences were made against Deities in this place, and thus devotees left.”
এত বলি’ নিত্যানন্দ গর্জ্জিতে গর্জ্জিতে ।<br />আইলেন সিমুলিয়া গ্রাম সন্নিহিতে ॥৩৯॥
eta bali’ nityānanda garjite garjite<br />āilena simuliyā grāma sannihite [39]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">garjite</span> <span class="e2">garjite</span>–roared. [Then] <span class="e2">āilena</span>–He came <span class="e2">sannihite</span>–to <span class="e2">simuliyā</span> <span class="e2">grāma</span>–the village of Simuliyā. [39]
Saying this, Nityānanda roared. He then came to Simuliyā Grām.
সিমুলিয়া দেখি’ প্রভু জীব প্রতি কয় ।<br />“এই ত সীমন্তদ্বীপ জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥৪০॥
simuliyā dekhi’ prabhu jīva prati kaya<br />“ei ta sīmantadvīpa jāniha niśchaya [40]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">simuliyā</span>–Simuliyā, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">kaya</span>–said <span class="e2">prati</span>–to <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">“jāniha</span>–“Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">sīmantadvīpa</span>–Sīmantadwīp. [40]
Seeing Simuliyā, Nityānanda Prabhu said to Jīva, “Know for certain that this is Sīmantadwīp.
গঙ্গার দক্ষিণ তীরে নবদ্বীপ প্রান্তে ।<br />সীমন্ত নামেতে দ্বীপ বলে সব শান্তে ॥৪১॥
gaṅgāra dakṣiṇa tīre navadvīpa prānte<br />sīmanta nāmete dvīpa bale saba śānte [41]
<span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">śānte</span>–The sādhus <span class="e2">bale</span>–call <span class="e2">dvīpa</span>–the island <span class="e2">prānte</span>–on the border <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">dakṣiṇa</span> <span class="e2">tīre</span>–the southern bank <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span>–of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–by the name <span class="e2">sīmanta</span>–‘Sīmanta’. [41]
“The sādhus call the island on the border of Nabadwīp and the southern bank of the Gaṅgā ‘Sīmanta’.
কালে এই দ্বীপ গঙ্গা গ্রাসিবে সকল ।<br />রহিবে কেবল এক স্থান সুনির্ম্মল ॥৪২॥
kāle ei dvīpa gaṅgā grāsibe sakala<br />rahibe kevala eka sthāna sunirmala [42]
<span class="e2">kāle</span>–In time, <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">sakala grāsibe</span>–will completely cover <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">dvīpa</span>–island [and] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–only <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">sunirmala</span>–pure <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–will remain. [42]
“In time, the Gaṅgā will completely cover this island, and only one pure place will remain.
যথায় সিমুলী নামে পার্ব্বতী পূজন ।<br />করিবে বিষয়ী লোক করহ শ্রবণ ॥৪৩॥
yathāya simulī nāme pārvatī pūjana<br />karibe viṣayī loka karaha śravaṇa [43]
<span class="e2">śravaṇa karaha</span>–Hear [now about how] <span class="e2">viṣayī</span> <span class="e2">loka</span>–materialistic people <span class="e2">pūjana</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will worship <span class="e2">pārvatī</span>–Pārvatī <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–in that place <span class="e2">nāme</span>–named <span class="e2">simulī</span>–Simulī. [43]
“Hear now about how materialistic people will worship Pārvatī in that place, which is known as Simulī.
কোন কালে সত্যযুগে দেব মহেশ্বর ।<br />‘শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ’ বলি’ নৃত্য করিল বিস্তর ॥৪৪॥
kona kāle satya-yuge deva maheśvara<br />‘śrī-gaurāṅga’ bali’ nṛtya karila vistara [44]
<span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–Once, <span class="e2">satya-yuge</span>–during Satya-yuga, <span class="e2">deva</span> <span class="e2">maheśvara</span>–the god of gods (Lord Śiva) <span class="e2">bali’</span>–was chanting <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–‘Śrī Gaurāṅga’ [and] <span class="e2">nṛtya vistara</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–dancing. [44]
“Once, during Satya-yuga, the god of gods, Lord Śiva, was chanting the Name of Śrī Gaurāṅga and dancing.
পার্ব্বতী জিজ্ঞাসে তবে দেব মহেশ্বরে ।<br />‘কেবা সে গৌরাঙ্গদেব বলহ আমারে ॥৪৫॥
pārvatī jijñāse tabe deva maheśvare<br />‘kebā se gaurāṅga-deva balaha āmāre [45]
<span class="e2">pārvatī</span>–Pārvatī <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">jijñāse</span>–asked <span class="e2">deva</span> <span class="e2">maheśvare</span>–Lord Śiva, <span class="e2">‘kebā</span>–‘Who [is] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-deva</span>–this golden Lord? <span class="e2">balaha</span>–Please tell <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–me. [45]
“Pārvatī asked him, ‘Who is this golden Lord? Please tell me.
তোমার অদ্ভূত নৃত্য করি’ দরশন ।<br />শুনিয়া গৌরাঙ্গ-নাম গলে মোর মন ॥৪৬॥
tomāra adbhūta nṛtya kari’ daraśana<br />śuniyā gaurāṅga-nāma gale mora mana [46]
<span class="e2">daraśana kari’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your <span class="e2">adbhūta</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">nṛtya</span>–dancing [and] <span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–hearing <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-nāma</span>–the Name ‘Gaurāṅga’, <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart <span class="e2">gale</span>–melts. [46]
“‘Seeing your wonderful dancing and hearing the Name ‘Gaurāṅga’, my heart melts.
এত যে শুনেছি মন্ত্র-তন্ত্র এতকাল ।<br />সে সব জানিনু মাত্র জীবের জঞ্জাল ॥৪৭॥
eta ye śunechhi mantra-tantra eta-kāla<br />se saba jāninu mātra jīvera jañjāla [47]
<span class="e2">jāninu</span>–I have understood [that] <span class="e2">eta</span> <span class="e2">ye se saba</span>–all the <span class="e2">mantra-tantra</span>–chants and rites <span class="e2">śunechhi</span>–I have heard [about] <span class="e2">eta-kāla</span>–for so long [are] <span class="e2">mātra</span>–simply <span class="e2">jañjāla</span>–misery <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for the soul. [47]
“‘I have understood that all the mantras and tantra I have heard about for so long are simply misery for the soul.
অতএব বল প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গ সন্ধান ।<br />ভজিয়া তাহারে আমি পাইব পরাণ’ ॥৪৮॥
ataeva bala prabhu gaurāṅga sandhāna<br />bhajiyā tāhāre āmi pāiba parāṇa’ [48]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">bala</span>–please tell [me] <span class="e2">sandhāna</span>–about <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Lord Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">bhajiyā</span>–Serving <span class="e2">tāhāre</span>–Him, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">pāiba</span>–will attain [new] <span class="e2">parāṇa’</span>–life’. [48]
“‘So, please tell me about Lord Gaurāṅga. Serving Him, I will attain new life.’
পার্ব্বতীর কথা শুনি’ দেব পশুপতি ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ স্মরি’ কহে পার্ব্বতীর প্রতি ॥৪৯॥
pārvatīra kathā śuni’ deva paśupati<br />śrī-gaurāṅga smari’ kahe pārvatīra prati [49]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">pārvatīra</span>–Pārvatī’s <span class="e2">kathā</span>–words [and] <span class="e2">smari’</span>–remembering <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">paśupati deva</span>–Lord Śiva <span class="e2">kahe</span>–spoke <span class="e2">prati</span>–to <span class="e2">pārvatīra</span>–Pārvatī. [49]
“Hearing Pārvatī’s words and remembering Śrī Gaurāṅga, Lord Śiva spoke to Pārvatī.
‘আদ্যাশক্তি তুমি হও শ্রীরাধার অংশ ।<br />তোমারে বলিব তত্ত্বগণ অবতংস ॥৫০॥
‘ādyā-śakti tumi hao śrī-rādhāra aṁśa<br />tomāre baliba tattva-gaṇa avataṁsa [50]
<span class="e2">‘tumi</span>–‘You <span class="e2">hao</span>–are <span class="e2">ādyā-śakti</span>–the primordial energy [and] <span class="e2">aṁśa</span>–an expansion <span class="e2">śrī-rādhāra</span>–of Śrī Rādhā. <span class="e2">baliba</span>–I will tell <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–you <span class="e2">tattva-gaṇa</span> <span class="e2">avataṁsa</span>–the crown jewel of truths. [50]
“‘You are the primordial energy and an expansion of Śrī Rādhā. I will tell you the crown jewel of truths.
রাধাভাব লয়ে কৃষ্ণ কলিতে এবার ।<br />মায়াপুরে শচীগর্ভে হবে অবতার ॥৫১॥
rādhā-bhāva laye kṛṣṇa kalite e-bāra<br />māyāpure śachī-garbhe habe avatāra [51]
<span class="e2">e-bāra</span>–This time, <span class="e2">kalite</span>–during Kali-yuga, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">laye</span>–will take <span class="e2">rādhā-bhāva</span>–the heart of Rādhā [and] <span class="e2">avatāra habe</span>–appear <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur <span class="e2">śachī-garbhe</span>–in the womb of Śachī Devī. [51]
“‘This time, during Kali-yuga, Kṛṣṇa will take the heart of Rādhā and appear in Māyāpur in the womb of Śachī Devī.
কীর্ত্তন-রঙ্গেতে মাতি’ প্রভু গোরামণি ।<br />বিতরিবে প্রেমরত্ন পাত্র নাহি গণি’ ॥৫২॥
kīrtana-raṅgete māti’ prabhu gorāmaṇi<br />vitaribe prema-ratna pātra nāhi gaṇi’ [52]
<span class="e2">māti’</span>–Maddened <span class="e2">raṅgete</span>–by [His] Pastimes <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–of kīrtan, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">gorāmaṇi</span>–Gorāmaṇi (the golden jewel) <span class="e2">vitaribe</span>–will distribute <span class="e2">prema-ratna</span>–the jewel of divine love <span class="e2">gaṇi’ nāhi</span>–without judging [its] <span class="e2">pātra</span>–recipients. [52]
“‘Maddened by His Pastimes of kīrtan, Lord Gorāmaṇi will distribute the jewel of divine love without judging its recipients.
এই প্রেমবন্যা-জলে যে জীব না ভাসে ।<br />ধিক্ তার ভাগ্যে দেবি জীবন বিলাসে ॥৫৩॥
ei prema-vanyā-jale ye jīva nā bhāse<br />dhik tāra bhāgye devī jīvana vilāse [53]
<span class="e2">devī</span>–O goddess, <span class="e2">dhik</span>–shame <span class="e2">jīvana</span> <span class="e2">vilāse bhāgye</span>–on the life, enjoyment, and fortune <span class="e2">ye tāra</span> <span class="e2">jīva</span>–of the souls who <span class="e2">bhāse nā</span>–do not float <span class="e2">jale</span>–in the waters <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">prema-vanyā</span>–of this flood of divine love! [53]
“‘O goddess, shame on the life, enjoyment, and fortune of the souls who do not float in the waters of this flood of divine love!
প্রভুর প্রতিজ্ঞা স্মরি’ প্রেমে যাই ভাসি’ ।<br />ধৈরয না ধরে মন ছাড়িলাম কাশী ॥৫৪॥
prabhura pratijñā smari’ preme yāi bhāsi’<br />dhairaya nā dhare mana chhāḍilāma kāśī [54]
<span class="e2">smari’</span>–Remembering <span class="e2">pratijñā</span>–the promise <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord, <span class="e2">bhāsi’ yāi</span>–I float <span class="e2">preme</span>–in divine love. <span class="e2">mana</span>–[My] heart <span class="e2">dhare nā</span>–does not maintain [its] <span class="e2">dhairaya</span>–composure, [and thus] <span class="e2">chhāḍilāma</span>–I have left <span class="e2">kāśī</span>–Kāśī. [54]
“‘Remembering the promise of the Lord, I float in divine love. My heart has lost its composure, and thus I have left Kāśī.
মায়াপুর অন্তর্ভাগে জাহ্নবীর তীরে ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ ভজিব আমি রহিয়া কুটীরে’ ॥৫৫॥
māyāpura antarbhāge jāhnavīra tīre<br />gaurāṅga bhajiba āmi rahiyā kuṭīre’ [55]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">rahiyā</span>–will stay <span class="e2">kuṭīre</span>–in a hut <span class="e2">tīre</span>–on the bank <span class="e2">jāhnavīra</span>–of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">māyāpura</span> <span class="e2">antarbhāge</span>–in Māyāpur [and] <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaurāṅga’</span>–Gaurāṅga.’ [55]
“‘I will stay in a hut on the bank of the Gaṅgā in Māyāpur and worship Gaurāṅga.’
ধূর্জ্জটির বাক্য শুনি’ পার্ব্বতী সুন্দরী ।<br />আইলেন সীমন্তদ্বীপেতে ত্বরা করি’ ॥৫৬॥
dhūrjaṭira vākya śuni’ pārvatī sundarī<br />āilena sīmantadvīpete tvarā kari’ [56]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">dhūrjaṭira</span>–Śiva’s <span class="e2">vākya</span>–words, <span class="e2">sundarī</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">pārvatī</span>–Pārvatī <span class="e2">tvarā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–quickly <span class="e2">āilena</span>–came <span class="e2">sīmantadvīpete</span>–to Sīmantadwīp. [56]
“Hearing Śiva’s words, beautiful Pārvatī quickly came to Sīmantadwīp.
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গরূপ সদা করেন চিন্তন ।<br />‘গৌর’ বলি’ প্রেমে ভাসে স্থির নহে মন ॥৫৭॥
śrī-gaurāṅga-rūpa sadā karena chintana<br />‘gaura’ bali’ preme bhāse sthira nahe mana [57]
<span class="e2">sadā</span> <span class="e2">chintana karena</span>–She constantly meditated <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rūpa</span>–on the form of Śrī Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">bali’</span>–Chanting, <span class="e2">‘gaura’</span>–‘Gaura’ <span class="e2">bhāse</span>–she floated <span class="e2">preme</span>–in divine love, [and her] <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart <span class="e2">sthira</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–became unsteady. [57]
“She constantly meditated on the form of Śrī Gaurāṅga. Chanting Gaura’s Name she floated in divine love, and her heart became unsteady.
কতদিনে গৌরচন্দ্র কৃপা বিতরিয়া ।<br />পার্ব্বতীরে দেখা দিলা সগণে আসিয়া ॥৫৮॥
kata-dine gaurachandra kṛpā vitariyā<br />pārvatīre dekhā dilā sagaṇe āsiyā [58]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">vitariyā</span>–bestowed [His] mercy; <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–He came <span class="e2">sagaṇe</span>–with [His] associates [and] <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dilā</span>–appeared <span class="e2">pārvatīre</span>–to Pārvatī. [58]
“Eventually, Gaurachandra bestowed His mercy; He came with His associates and appeared to Pārvatī.
সুতপ্ত কাঞ্চনবর্ণ দীর্ঘ কলেবর ।<br />মাথায় চাঁচর কেশ সর্ব্বাঙ্গ সুন্দর ॥৫৯॥
sutapta kāñchana-varṇa dīrgha kalevara<br />māthāya chā̐chara keśa sarvāṅga sundara [59]
[His] <span class="e2">dīrgha</span>–long <span class="e2">kalevara</span>–form [was] <span class="e2">sutapta</span> <span class="e2">kāñchana-varṇa</span>–the colour of molten gold. <span class="e2">sarvāṅga</span>–All [His] limbs [and] <span class="e2">chā̐chara</span> <span class="e2">keśa</span>–the wavy hair <span class="e2">māthāya</span>–on [His] head [were] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful. [59]
“His long form was the colour of molten gold, and His limbs and the wavy hair on His head appeared very beautiful.
ত্রিকচ্ছ করিয়া বস্ত্র তার পরিধান ।<br />গলে দোলে ফুলমালা অপূর্ব্ব বিধান ॥৬০॥
trikachchha kariyā vastra tāra paridhāna<br />gale dole phula-mālā apūrva vidhāna [60]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">paridhāna vastra</span>–He wore cloth <span class="e2">trikachchha</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–tucked three times, [and] <span class="e2">apūrva vidhāna phula-mālā</span>–a wonderful flower garland <span class="e2">dole</span>–swung <span class="e2">gale</span>–on [His] neck. [60]
“He wore a dhotī tucked in three places, and a wonderful flower garland swung on His neck.
প্রেমে গদগদ বাক্য কহে গৌররায় ।<br />‘বলগো পার্ব্বতী! কেন আইলে হেথায়’ ॥৬১॥
preme gadagada vākya kahe gaura-rāya<br />‘balago pārvatī! kena āile hethāya’ [61]
[His]<span class="e2"> vākya</span>–voice <span class="e2">gadagada</span>–faltering <span class="e2">preme</span>–in divine love, <span class="e2">gaura-rāya</span>–Gaura Rāy <span class="e2">kahe</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘balago</span>–‘O <span class="e2">pārvatī!</span>–Pārvatī! <span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">āile</span>–have you come <span class="e2">hethāya’</span>–here?’ [61]
“Stammering in divine love, Gaura Rāy said, ‘O Pārvatī! Why have you come here?’
জগতের প্রভু-পদে পড়িয়া পার্ব্বতী ।<br />জানায় আপন দুঃখ স্থির নহে মতি ॥৬২॥
jagatera prabhu-pade paḍiyā pārvatī<br />jānāya āpana duḥkha sthira nahe mati [62]
<span class="e2">pārvatī</span>–Pārvatī <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–bowed <span class="e2">prabhu-pade</span>–at the feet of the Lord <span class="e2">jagatera</span>–of the universe, [and] <span class="e2">mati sthira</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–with an unsteady mind, <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–explained <span class="e2">āpana</span>–her <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness. [62]
“Pārvatī bowed at the feet of the Lord of the universe, and with an unsteady mind, explained her sadness.
‘ওহে প্রভু জগন্নাথ জগত-জীবন ।<br />সকলের দয়াময় মোর বিড়ম্বন ॥৬৩॥
‘ohe prabhu jagannātha jagata-jīvana<br />sakalera dayāmaya mora viḍambana [63]
<span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Master! <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–O Lord of the universe! <span class="e2">jagata-jīvana</span>–O Life of the universe! [You are] <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–merciful <span class="e2">sakalera</span>–to everyone, [but] <span class="e2">viḍambana</span>–cruel <span class="e2">mora</span>–to me. [63]
“‘O Master! O Lord and Life of the universe! You are merciful to everyone, but cruel to me.
তব বহির্ম্মুখ জীব বন্ধন কারণ ।<br />নিযুক্ত করিলা মোরে পতিতপাবন ॥৬৪॥
tava bahirmukha jīve bandhana kāraṇa<br />niyukta karila more patita-pāvana [64]
<span class="e2">patita-pāvana</span>–O Saviour of the fallen, <span class="e2">niyukta</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–You have engaged <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">bandhana</span> <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–in imprisoning <span class="e2">jīve</span>–the souls [who are] <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span>–averse to You. [64]
“‘O Saviour of the fallen, You have engaged me in imprisoning the souls who are averse to You.
আমি থাকি সেই কাজে সংসার পাতিয়া ।<br />তোমার অনন্ত প্রেমে বঞ্চিত হইয়া ॥৬৫॥
āmi thāki sei kāje saṁsāra pātiyā<br />tomāra ananta preme vañchita ha-iyā [65]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">kāje thāki</span>–perform this duty [and] <span class="e2">pātiyā</span>–manage <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the material world, [but] <span class="e2">vañchita</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–I am deprived <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">ananta</span> <span class="e2">preme</span>–of Your infinite divine love. [65]
“‘I perform this duty and manage the material world, but I am deprived of Your infinite divine love.
লোকে বলে যথা কৃষ্ণ মায়া নাহি তথা ।<br />আমি তবে বহির্ম্মুখ হইনু সর্ব্বথা ॥৬৬॥
loke bale yathā kṛṣṇa māyā nāhi tathā<br />āmi tabe bahirmukha ha-inu sarvathā [66]
<span class="e2">loke</span>–People <span class="e2">bale</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā [is] <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not present <span class="e2">yathā tathā</span>–wherever <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is present]. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ha-inu</span>–have become <span class="e2">sarvathā</span>–completely <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span>–estranged [from You]. [66]
“‘People say that Māyā is absent wherever Kṛṣṇa is present. Thus, I have become completely estranged from You.
কেমনে দেখিব প্রভু তোমার বিলাস ।<br />তুমি না করিলে পথ হইনু নিরাশ’ ॥৬৭॥
kemane dekhiba prabhu tomāra vilāsa<br />tumi nā karile patha ha-inu nirāśa’ [67]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–O Lord, <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–will I see <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–Pastimes? <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">patha nā</span> <span class="e2">karile</span>–If You do not make a way [for me], <span class="e2">ha-inu</span>–I will be <span class="e2">nirāśa’</span>–hopeless.’ [67]
“‘O Lord, how will I see Your Pastimes? If You do not make a way for me, I will be hopeless.’
এত বলি’ শ্রীপার্ব্বতী গৌরপদধূলি ।<br />সীমন্তে লইল সতী করিয়া আকুলি ॥৬৮॥
eta bali’ śrī-pārvatī gaura-pada-dhūli<br />sīmante la-ila satī kariyā ākuli [68]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">satī śrī-pārvatī</span>–chaste Pārvatī Devī <span class="e2">ākuli kariyā</span>–desperately <span class="e2">la-ila</span>–rubbed <span class="e2">gaura-pada-dhūli</span>–Gaura’s foot-dust <span class="e2">sīmante</span>–into [her] parting. [68]
“Saying this, chaste Pārvatī Devī desperately rubbed Gaura’s foot-dust into the parting in her hair.
সেই হৈতে শ্রীসীমন্তদ্বীপ নাম হৈল ।<br />সিমুলিয়া বলি’ অজ্ঞজনেতে কহিল ॥৬৯॥
sei haite śrī-sīmantadvīpa nāma haila<br />simuliyā bali’ ajña-janete kahila [69]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–Since then, [this place] <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–has been known [as] <span class="e2">śrī-sīmantadvīpa</span>–Śrī Sīmantadwīp, [though] <span class="e2">ajña-janete</span>–the ignorant <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">kahila</span>–call [it] <span class="e2">simuliyā</span>–Simuliyā. [69]
“Since then, this place has been known as Sīmantadwīp, though the ignorant call it Simuliyā.
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গচন্দ্র তবে প্রসন্ন হইয়া ।<br />বলিল, “পার্ব্বতী শুন কথা মন দিয়া ॥৭০॥
śrī-gaurāṅga-chandra tabe prasanna ha-iyā<br />balila, “pārvatī śuna kathā mana diyā [70]
<span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-chandra</span>–Moon-like Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">tabe</span> <span class="e2">prasanna</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–was then pleased [and] <span class="e2">balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘pārvatī</span>–‘O Pārvatī, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen <span class="e2">kathā</span>–to [My] words <span class="e2">mana</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–attentively. [70]
“Moon-like Śrī Gaurāṅga was pleased and said, ‘O Pārvatī, listen to My words attentively.
তুমি মোর ভিন্ন নও শক্তি সর্ব্বেশ্বরী ।<br />এক শক্তি দুই রূপ মম সহচরী ॥৭১॥
tumi mora bhinna nao śakti sarveśvarī<br />eka śakti dui rūpa mama sahacharī [71]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">nao</span>–are not <span class="e2">bhinna</span>–separate <span class="e2">mora</span>–from Me. [You are My] <span class="e2">śakti</span>–energy [and] <span class="e2">sarveśvarī</span>–the goddess of all. <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">sahacharī</span>–consort, [My] <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">śakti</span>–energy, [has] <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–forms. [71]
“‘You are not separate from Me. You are My energy and the goddess of all. My consort, My singular energy, has two forms.
স্বরূপশক্তিতে তুমি রাধিকা আমার ।<br />বহিরঙ্গা-রূপে রাধা তোমাতে বিস্তার ॥৭২॥
svarūpa-śaktite tumi rādhikā āmāra<br />bahiraṅgā-rūpe rādhā tomāte vistāra [72]
<span class="e2">āmāra svarūpa-śaktite</span>–As {My] personal energy, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">rādhikā</span>–Rādhikā. <span class="e2">bahiraṅgā-rūpe</span>–As [My] external energy, <span class="e2">rādhā</span>–Rādhā <span class="e2">vistāra</span>–expands <span class="e2">tomāte</span>–as you. [72]
“‘As My personal energy, you are Rādhikā. As My external energy, Rādhā expands as you.
তুমি নৈলে মোর লীলা সিদ্ধ নাহি হয় ।<br />তুমি যোগমায়ারূপে লীলাতে নিশ্চয় ॥৭৩॥
tumi naile mora līlā siddha nāhi haya<br />tumi yogamāyā-rūpe līlāte niśchaya [73]
<span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">naile</span>–Without you, <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–are not <span class="e2">siddha</span>–complete. <span class="e2">yogamāyā-rūpe</span>–As Yogamāyā, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly [involved] <span class="e2">līlāte</span>–in [My] Pastimes. [73]
“‘Without you, My Pastimes are not complete. As Yogamāyā, you are certainly involved in My Pastimes.
ব্রজে তুমি পৌর্ণমাসীরূপে নিত্য কাল ।<br />নবদ্বীপে পৌঢ়ামায়া সহ ক্ষেত্রপাল’ ॥৭৪॥
vraje tumi paurṇamāsī-rūpe nitya kāla<br />navadvīpe prauḍhā-māyā saha kṣetra-pāla’ [74]
<span class="e2">vraje</span>–In Vraja, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">kāla</span>–eternally [present] <span class="e2">paurṇamāsī-rūpe</span>–as Paurṇamāsī, [and] <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, [you are present] <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–as Prauḍhā Māyā <span class="e2">saha</span>–with <span class="e2">kṣetra-pāla’</span>–the guardian of [My] abode (Lord Śiva).’ [74]
“‘In Vraja, you are eternally present as Paurṇamāsī, and in Nabadwīp, you are present as Prauḍhā Māyā with Lord Śiva, the guardian of the Dhām.’
এত বলি’ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ হৈল অদর্শন ।<br />প্রেমাবিষ্ট হয়ে রহে পার্ব্বতীর মন ॥ ৭৫॥
eta bali’ śrī-gaurāṅga haila adarśana<br />premāviṣṭa haye rahe pārvatīra mana [75]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">adarśana haila</span>–disappeared, [and] <span class="e2">pārvatīra</span>–Pārvatī’s <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart <span class="e2">rahe</span>–became <span class="e2">premāviṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–overwhelmed with divine love. [75]
“Saying this, Śrī Gaurāṅga disappeared, and Pārvatī’s heart became overwhelmed with divine love.
সিমন্তিনীদেবীরূপে রহে এক ভিতে ।<br />প্রৌঢ়ামায়া মায়াপুরে রহে গৌর-প্রীতে” ॥৭৬॥
simantinī-devī-rūpe rahe eka bhite<br />prauḍhā-māyā māyāpure rahe gaura-prīte” [76]
<span class="e2">gaura-prīte</span>–Out of love for Gaura, <span class="e2">rahe</span>–Pārvatī remains [here] <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">bhite</span>–in one place <span class="e2">simantinī-devī-rūpe</span>–as Simantinī Devī [and] <span class="e2">rahe</span>–remains <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā”</span>–as Prauḍhā Māyā.” [76]
“Out of love for Śrī Gaurāṅga, Pārvatī remains here as the goddess of Sīmantadwīp and in Māyāpur as Prauḍhā Māyā.”
এত বলি’ নিত্যানন্দ কাজির নগরে ।<br />প্রবেশিল জীবে লয়ে তখন সত্বরে ॥৭৭॥
eta bali’ nityānanda kājira nagare<br />praveśila jīve laye takhana satvare [77]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">satvare</span>–quickly <span class="e2">praveśila</span>–entered <span class="e2">kājira</span> <span class="e2">nagare</span>–Kāzī Nagar <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva. [77]
Saying this, Nityānanda quickly entered Kāzī Nagar with Jīva.
প্রভু বলে, “ওহে জীব শুনহ বচন ।<br />কাজির নগর এই মথুরা ভুবন ॥৭৮॥
prabhu bale, “ohe jīva śunaha vachana<br />kājira nagara ei mathurā bhuvana [78]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">śunaha</span>–listen <span class="e2">vachana</span>–to [My] words. <span class="e2">ei kājira</span> <span class="e2">nagara</span>–Kāzī Nagar [is] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">mathurā</span> <span class="e2">bhuvana</span>–the land of Mathurā. [78]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “O Jīva, listen to My words. Kāzī Nagar is Mathurā.
হেথা শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-রায় কীর্ত্তন করিয়া ।<br />কাজি নিস্তারিল প্রভু প্রেমরত্ন দিয়া ॥৭৯॥
hethā śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya kīrtana kariyā<br />kāji nistārila prabhu prema-ratna diyā [79]
<span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya prabhu</span>–Lord Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy <span class="e2">kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–performed kīrtan, <span class="e2">kāji</span> <span class="e2">nistārila</span>–delivered the Kāzī, [and] <span class="e2">diyā</span>–gave [him] <span class="e2">prema-ratna</span>–the jewel of divine love. [79]
“Here, Śrī Gaurāṅga performed kīrtan, delivered the Kāzī, and gave him the jewel of divine love.
শ্রীকৃষ্ণলীলায় যেই কংস মথুরায় ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গলীলায় চাঁদকাজি নাম পায় ॥৮০॥
śrī-kṛṣṇa-līlāya yei kaṁsa mathurāya<br />gaurāṅga-līlāya chā̐da-kāji nāma pāya [80]
<span class="e2">yei</span>–He who [was] <span class="e2">kaṁsa</span>–Kāṁsa <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-līlāya</span>–during Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes <span class="e2">mathurāya</span>–in Mathurā <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–became known as <span class="e2">chā̐da-kāji</span>–Chā̐d Kāzī <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-līlāya</span>–during Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes. [80]
“He who was Kaṁsa during Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes in Mathurā became known as Chā̐d Kāzī during Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes.
এইজন্য প্রভু তারে মাতুল বলিল ।<br />ভয়ে কাজি গৌরপদে শরণ লইল ॥৮১॥
ei-janya prabhu tāre mātula balila<br />bhaye kāji gaura-pade śaraṇa la-ila [81]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">ei-janya</span>–thus <span class="e2">balila</span>–called <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">mātula</span>–uncle. <span class="e2">bhaye</span>–Out of fear, <span class="e2">kāji</span>–the Kāzī <span class="e2">śaraṇa</span> <span class="e2">la-ila</span>–took shelter <span class="e2">gaura-pade</span>–at Gaura’s feet. [81]
“The Lord thus called the Kāzī His uncle. Out of fear, the Kāzī took shelter at Gaurāṅga’s feet.
কীর্ত্তন আরম্ভে কাজি মৃদঙ্গ ভাঙ্গিল ।<br />হোসেন সাহার বলে উৎপাত করিল ॥৮২॥
kīrtana ārambhe kāji mṛdaṅga bhāṅgila<br />hosena sāhāra bale utpāta karila [82]
<span class="e2">kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">ārambhe</span>–When [Śrī Gaurāṅga] began performing kīrtan, <span class="e2">kāji</span>–the Kāzī <span class="e2">bhāṅgila</span>–broke <span class="e2">mṛdaṅga</span>–a mṛdaṅga (drum) [and] <span class="e2">utpāta</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–made a disturbance <span class="e2">hosena</span> <span class="e2">sāhāra</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–on the order of Nawab Hussian Shah. [82]
“When Gaurāṅga began performing kīrtan, the Kāzī broke a mṛdaṅga and made a disturbance on the order of Nawab Hussein Shah.
হোসেনসা সে জরাসন্ধ গৌড়-রাজ্যেশ্বর ।<br />তাঁহার আত্মীয় কাজি প্রতাপ বিস্তর ॥৮৩॥
hosenasā se jarāsandha gauḍa-rājyeśvara<br />tā̐hāra ātmīya kāji pratāpa vistara [83]
<span class="e2">se hosenasā</span>–Hussein Shah, <span class="e2">gauḍa-rājyeśvara</span>–the emperor of Gauḍa, [was] <span class="e2">jarāsandha</span>–Jarāsandha. <span class="e2">pratāpa</span> <span class="e2">vistara</span>–He influenced <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span>–his <span class="e2">ātmīya</span>–relative <span class="e2">kāji</span>–the Kāzī. [83]
“Hussein Shah, the emperor of Gauḍa at that time, was previously Jarāsandha. He influenced the Kāzī, who was his relative.
প্রভু তারে নৃসিংহরূপেতে দেয় ভয় ।<br />ভয়ে কংসসম কাজি জড়সড় হয় ॥৮৪॥
prabhu tāre nṛsiṁha-rūpete deya bhaya<br />bhaye kaṁsa-sama kāji jaḍasaḍa haya [84]
<span class="e2">nṛsiṁha-rūpete</span>–In the form of Nṛsiṁha, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">bhaya deya</span>–frightened <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him, [and] <span class="e2">kaṁsa-sama</span>–like Kaṁsa, <span class="e2">kāji</span>–the Kāzī <span class="e2">jaḍasaḍa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–cringed <span class="e2">bhaye</span>–in fear. [84]
“In the form of Nṛsiṁha, the Lord frightened the Kāzī, and like Kaṁsa, the Kāzī cringed in fear.
তারে প্রেম দিয়া কৈল বৈষ্ণবপ্রধান ।<br />কাজির নিস্তার কথা শুনে ভাগ্যবান্ ॥৮৫॥
tāre prema diyā kaila vaiṣṇava-pradhāna<br />kājira nistāra kathā śune bhāgyavān [85]
<span class="e2">diyā</span>–The Lord gave <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love [and] <span class="e2">kaila</span>–made [him] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-pradhāna</span>–a great devotee. <span class="e2">śune</span>–Those who hear <span class="e2">kathā</span>–discussion <span class="e2">kājira</span> <span class="e2">nistāra</span>–of the Kāzī’s deliverance [are] <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–fortunate. [85]
“The Lord then gave him divine love and made him a great devotee. Those who hear of the Kāzī’s deliverance are fortunate.
