ব্রজতত্ত্ব নবদ্বীপতত্ত্বে দেখ ভেদ ।<br />কৃষ্ণ-অপরাধী লভে নির্ব্বাণ অভেদ ॥৮৬॥
হেথা অপরাধী পায় প্রেমরত্ন-ধন ।<br />অতএব গৌরলীলা সর্ব্বোপরি হন ॥৮৭॥
vraja-tattva navadvīpa-tattve dekha bheda<br />kṛṣṇa-aparādhī labhe nirvāṇa abheda [86]
hethā aparādhī pāya prema-ratna-dhana<br />ataeva gaura-līlā sarvopari hana [87]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">bheda</span>–the difference <span class="e2">vraja-tattva</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-tattve</span>–between Vraja and Nabadwīp: <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-aparādhī</span>–offenders of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">abheda nirvāṇa</span>–static liberation, [but] <span class="e2">aparādhī</span>–offenders <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">prema-ratna-dhana</span>–the wealth of the jewel of divine love. <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–the Pastimes of Gaura <span class="e2">hana</span>–are <span class="e2">sarvopari</span>–above all. [86<span class="e2">–</span>87]
“See the difference between Vraja and Nabadwīp: in Vraja, those who offend Kṛṣṇa attain static liberation, but in Nabadwīp, offenders attain the jewel of divine love. Thus, the Pastimes of Gaura are supreme.
গৌরধাম গৌরনাম গৌররূপ-গুণ ।<br />অপরাধ নাহি মানে তারিতে নিপুণ ॥৮৮॥
gaura-dhāma gaura-nāma gaura-rūpa-guṇa<br />aparādha nāhi māne tārite nipuṇa [88]
<span class="e2">gaura-dhāma</span>–Gaura’s Abode, <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–Gaura’s Name, [and] <span class="e2">gaura-rūpa guṇa</span>–Gaura’s Form and Qualities <span class="e2">māne nāhi</span>–do not consider <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences, [and are] <span class="e2">nipuṇa</span>–adept <span class="e2">tārite</span>–at deliverance. [88]
“Gaura’s Abode, Name, Form, and Qualities do not consider offences and are adept at delivering souls.
যদি অপরাধ থাকে সাধকের মনে ।<br />কৃষ্ণনামে কৃষ্ণধামে তারে বহুদিনে ॥৮৯॥
yadi aparādha thāke sādhakera mane<br />kṛṣṇa-nāme kṛṣṇa-dhāme tāre bahu-dine [89]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">thāke</span>–exist <span class="e2">sādhakera</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–in the mind of a practitioner, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāme</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Name [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-dhāme</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s abode <span class="e2">tāre</span>–deliver [them] <span class="e2">bahu-dine</span>–after a long time. [89]
“If offences are present in the mind of a practitioner, Kṛṣṇa’s Name and abode deliver them after a long time.
গৌরনামে গৌরধামে সদ্য প্রেম হয় ।<br />অপরাধ নাহি তার বাধা উপজয় ॥৯০॥
gaura-nāme gaura-dhāme sadya prema haya<br />aparādha nāhi tāra bādhā upajaya [90]
<span class="e2">gaura-nāme</span>–Through Gaura’s Name [and] <span class="e2">gaura-dhāme</span>–Gaura’s abode, <span class="e2">prema</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–souls attain divine love <span class="e2">sadya</span>–immediately; <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">bādhā</span> <span class="e2">upajaya nāhi</span>–do not obstruct <span class="e2">tāra</span>–them. [90]
“Gaura’s Name and abode, however, immediately give souls divine love; offences do not obstruct them.
ঐ দেখ ওহে জীব কাজির সমাধি ।<br />দেখিলে জীবের নাশ হয় আধি ব্যাধি” ॥৯১॥
ai dekha ohe jīva kājira samādhi<br />dekhile jīvera nāśa haya ādhi vyādhi” [91]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">ai</span>–there <span class="e2">kājira</span> <span class="e2">samādhi</span>–the samādhi (tomb) of the Kāzī. <span class="e2">dekhile</span>–By seeing [it,] <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–a soul’s <span class="e2">ādhi</span> <span class="e2">vyādhi</span>–sickness and sorrow <span class="e2">nāśa</span> <span class="e2">haya”</span>–are dispelled.” [91]
“O Jīva, see there the samādhi of the Kāzī. Seeing it dispels sickness and sorrow.”
এত বলি’ নিত্যানন্দ প্রেমে গরগর ।<br />চলিলেন দ্রুত শঙ্খবণিকনগর ॥৯২॥
eta bali’ nityānanda preme garagara<br />chalilena druta śaṅkha-vaṇika-nagara [92]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda, <span class="e2">garagara</span>–smouldering <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love, <span class="e2">druta</span>–quickly <span class="e2">chalilena</span>–went <span class="e2">śaṅkha-vaṇika-nagara</span>–to Śaṅkha Vaṇik Nagar. [92]
Saying this, Nityānanda, smouldering with divine love, quickly went to Śaṅkha Vaṇik Nagar.
তথা গিয়া শ্রীজীবেরে বলেন বচন ।<br />“ওই দেখ শরডাঙ্গা অপূর্ব্ব দর্শন ॥৯৩॥
tathā giyā śrī-jīvere balena vachana<br />“oi dekha śaraḍāṅgā apūrva darśana [93]
<span class="e2">giyā</span>–Arriving <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, <span class="e2">vachana balena</span>–He said <span class="e2">śrī-jīvere</span>–to Jīva, <span class="e2">“dekha</span>–“See <span class="e2">oi</span>–there <span class="e2">apūrva</span> <span class="e2">darśana</span>–the wonderful sight <span class="e2">śaraḍāṅgā</span>–of Śaradāṅgā. [93]
Arriving there, He said to Śrī Jīva, “See there the wonderful sight of Śaraḍāṅgā.
শ্রীশরডাঙ্গা নাম অতি মনোহর ।<br />জগন্নাথ বৈসে যথা লইয়া শবর ॥৯৪॥
śrī-śaraḍāṅgā nāma ati manohara<br />jagannātha vaise yathā la-iyā śabara [94]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The name <span class="e2">śrī-śaraḍāṅgā</span>–Śrī Śaradāṅgā [is] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">manohara</span>–beautiful. <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–Jagannāth <span class="e2">vaise</span>–resides <span class="e2">yathā</span>–there <span class="e2">śabara la-iyā</span>–with the śabaras. [94]
“The name Śaraḍāṅgā is also very beautiful. Jagannāth resides there with the śabaras.
পূর্ব্বে যবে রক্তবাহু দৌরাত্ম্য করিল ।<br />দয়িতা সহিত প্রভু হেথায় আইল ॥৯৫॥
pūrve yabe raktabāhu daurātmya karila<br />dayitā sahita prabhu hethāya āila [95]
<span class="e2">pūrve</span>–Previously, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">raktabāhu</span>–Raktabāhu <span class="e2">daurātmya</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–was on a rampage, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">dayitā</span>–the śabaras (a tribe of outcastes). [95]
“Previously, when a demon named Raktabāhu was on a rampage, the Lord came here with the śabaras.
শ্রীপুরুষোত্তম সম এই ধাম হয় ।<br />নিত্য জগন্নাথস্থিতি তথায় নিশ্চয়” ॥৯৬॥
śrī-puruṣottama sama ei dhāma haya<br />nitya jagannātha-sthiti tathāya niśchaya” [96]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–place <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sama</span>–nondifferent <span class="e2">śrī-puruṣottama</span>–from Jagannāth Purī; <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">jagannātha-sthiti</span>–Jagannāth resides eternally <span class="e2">tathāya”</span>–here.” [96]
“This place is nondifferent from Śrī Puruṣottam Kṣetra; Jagannāth certainly resides here eternally.”
তবে তন্তুবায়গ্রাম হইলেন পার ।<br />দেখিলেন খোলাবেচা শ্রীধর-আগার ॥৯৭॥
tabe tantuvāya-grāma ha-ilena pāra<br />dekhilena kholā-vechā śrīdhara-āgāra [97]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">pāra ha-ilena</span>–they passed through <span class="e2">tantuvāya-grāma</span>–the village of Tantuvāya [and] <span class="e2">dekhilena</span>–saw <span class="e2">kholā-vechā</span> <span class="e2">śrīdhara-āgāra</span>–the cottage of the banana seller Śrīdhar. [97]
They then passed through Tantuvāya Grām and saw the cottage of Kholāvechā Śrīdhar.
প্রভু বলে, “এই স্থানে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ হরি ।<br />কীর্ত্তন বিশ্রাম কৈল ভক্তে কৃপা করি’॥৯৮॥
prabhu bale, “ei sthāne śrī-gaurāṅga hari<br />kīrtana viśrāma kaila bhakte kṛpā kari’ [98]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–“In this place, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga hari</span>–Lord Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">viśrāma</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–chanted, rested, <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–and blessed <span class="e2">bhakte</span>–devotees. [98]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Here, Śrī Gaurāṅga chanted, rested, and blessed the devotees.
এই হেতু বিশ্রামস্থান এর নাম ।<br />হেথা শ্রীধরের ঘরে করহ বিশ্রাম ॥৯৯॥
ei hetu viśrāma-sthāna era nāma<br />hethā śrīdharera ghare karaha viśrāma [99]
<span class="e2">era</span>–Its <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">hetu</span>–thus [became] <span class="e2">viśrāma-sthāna</span>–Viśrām Sthān (‘The Lord’s resting place’). <span class="e2">viśrāma karaha</span>–You may rest <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">śrīdharera</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–in Śrīdhar’s cottage. [99]
“This place thus became known as Viśrām Sthān. You may rest here in Śrīdhar’s cottage.”
শ্রীধর শুনিল যবে প্রভু-আগমন ।<br />সাষ্টাঙ্গে আসিয়া করে প্রভুর পূজন ॥১০০॥
śrīdhara śunila yabe prabhu-āgamana<br />sāṣṭāṅge āsiyā kare prabhura pūjana [100]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">śrīdhara</span>–Śrīdhar <span class="e2">śunila</span>–heard <span class="e2">prabhu-āgamana</span>–of the Lord’s arrival, <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–he came <span class="e2">sāṣṭāṅge</span>–in prostration [and] <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">pūjana kare</span>–worshipped the Lord. [100]
When Śrīdhar heard of Nityānanda Prabhu’s arrival, he came, prostrated himself, and worshipped the Lord.
বলে, “প্রভু বড় দয়া এ দাসের প্রতি ।<br />বিশ্রাম করহ হেথা আমার মিনতি” ॥১০১॥
bale, “prabhu baḍa dayā e dāsera prati<br />viśrāma karaha hethā āmāra minati” [101]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">“prabhu</span>–“O Lord, <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">dayā</span>–Be greatly merciful <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dāsera</span> <span class="e2">prati</span>–to this servant [and] <span class="e2">viśrāma</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–rest <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [This is] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">minati”</span>–request.” [101]
He said, “O Lord, be most merciful to this servant and rest here. This is my request.”
প্রভু বলে, “তুমি হও অতি ভাগ্যবান্ ।<br />তোমারে করিল কৃপা গৌর ভাগবান্ ॥১০২॥
prabhu bale, “tumi hao ati bhāgyavān<br />tomāre karila kṛpā gaura bhagavān [102]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–replied, <span class="e2">“tumi</span>–“You <span class="e2">hao</span>–are <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–fortunate: <span class="e2">gaura</span> <span class="e2">bhagavān</span>–Lord Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–has bestowed mercy <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–upon you. [102]
Nityānanda Prabhu replied, “You are very fortunate: Lord Gaurāṅga has bestowed His mercy upon you.
অদ্য মোরা এ স্থানে করিব বিশ্রাম” ।<br />শুনিয়া শ্রীধর তবে হয় আপ্তকাম ॥১০৩॥
adya morā e sthāne kariba viśrāma”<br />śuniyā śrīdhara tabe haya āpta-kāma [103]
<span class="e2">adya</span>–Today, <span class="e2">morā</span>–we <span class="e2">viśrāma kariba</span>–will rest <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">sthāne”</span>–here.” <span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–Hearing [this,] <span class="e2">śrīdhara</span>–Śrīdhar <span class="e2">haya</span>–was <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">āpta-kāma</span>–satisfied. [103]
“Today, we will rest here.” Hearing this, Śrīdhar was satisfied.
বহুযত্নে সেবাযোগ্য সামগ্রী লইয়া ।<br />রন্ধন করায় ভক্ত ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিয়া ॥১০৪॥
bahu-yatne sevā-yogya sāmagrī la-iyā<br />randhana karāya bhakta brāhmaṇere diyā [104]
<span class="e2">bahu-yatne</span>–With great care, <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–Śrīdhar collected <span class="e2">sevā-yogya</span>–offerable <span class="e2">sāmagrī</span>–ingredients [and engaged] <span class="e2">bhakta</span> <span class="e2">brāhmaṇere</span>–a Vaiṣṇava brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">diyā randhana</span> <span class="e2">karāya</span>–to cook. [104]
With great care, Śrīdhar collected suitable ingredients and engaged a Vaiṣṇava brāhmaṇ to cook.
নিতাই শ্রীবাস সেবা হৈলে সমাপন ।<br />আনন্দে প্রসাদ পায় শ্রীজীব তখন ॥১০৫॥
nitāi śrīvāsa sevā haile samāpana<br />ānande prasāda pāya śrī-jīva takhana [105]
[When] <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi [and] <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās’s <span class="e2">sevā</span>–service <span class="e2">samāpana haile</span>–was complete, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">ānande</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">pāya</span>–took [their] <span class="e2">prasāda</span>–remnants. [105]
Once Nitāi and Śrīvās had been served, Śrī Jīva joyfully took their prasād.
নিত্যানন্দে খট্টোপরি করায় শয়ন ।<br />সবংশে শ্রীধর করে পাদসম্বাহন ॥১০৬॥
nityānande khaṭṭopari karāya śayana<br />savaṁśe śrīdhara kare pāda-samvāhana [106]
<span class="e2">śayana karāya</span>–Śrīdhar laid <span class="e2">nityānande</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">khaṭṭopari</span>–on a bed. [Then] <span class="e2">śrīdhara</span>–Śrīdhar <span class="e2">savaṁśe</span>–and [his] family <span class="e2">pāda-samvāhana kare</span>–massaged [the Lord’s] feet. [106]
Śrīdhar laid Nityānanda on a bed, and then he and his family massaged the Lord’s feet.
অপরাহ্নে শ্রীজীবেরে লইয়া শ্রীবাস ।<br />ষষ্টিতীর্থ দেখাইল হইয়া উল্লাস॥১০৭॥
aparāhne śrī-jīvere la-iyā śrīvāsa<br />ṣaṣṭi-tīrtha dekhāila ha-iyā ullāsa [107]
<span class="e2">aparāhne</span>–In the afternoon, <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–took <span class="e2">śrī-jīvere</span>–Śrī Jīva [and] <span class="e2">ullāsa ha-iyā</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">dekhāila</span>–showed [him] <span class="e2">ṣaṣṭi-tīrtha</span>–Ṣaṣṭi Tīrtha. [107]
In the afternoon, Śrīvās took Śrī Jīva and joyfully showed him Ṣaṣṭi Tīrtha.
শ্রীবাস কহিল, “শুন জীব সদাশয় ।<br />পূর্ব্বে দেবগণ যবে শুনিল নিশ্চয় ॥১০৮॥
নবদ্বীপে হবে মহাপ্রভু অবতার ।<br />বিশ্বকর্ম্মা আইলেন নদীয়া নগর ॥১০৯॥
śrīvāsa kahila, “śuna jīva sad-āśaya<br />pūrve deva-gaṇa yabe śunila niśchaya [108]
navadvīpe habe mahāprabhu avatāra<br />viśvakarmā āilena nadīyā nagara [109]
<span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās <span class="e2">kahila</span>–said, <span class="e2">“śuna</span>–“Listen, <span class="e2">sad-āśaya jīva</span>–O pure-hearted Jīva! <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–Previously, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–the gods <span class="e2">śunila</span>–heard [that] <span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">niśchaya avatāra habe</span>–would certainly descend <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">viśvakarmā</span>–the architect of the gods <span class="e2">āilena</span>–came <span class="e2">nadīyā</span> <span class="e2">nagara</span>–to the city of Nadia. [108<span class="e2">–</span>109]
Śrīvās said, “Listen, O pure-hearted Jīva! Previously, when the gods heard that Mahāprabhu would descend in Nabadwīp, Viśvakarmā came to Nadia.
প্রভু যেই পথে করিবেন সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />সেই পথে জলকষ্ট করিতে বারণ ॥১১০॥
এক রাত্রে ষাট কুণ্ড কাটিল বিশাই ।<br />শেষ কুণ্ড কাজিগ্রামে করিল কাটাই ॥১১১॥
prabhu yei pathe karibena saṅkīrtana<br />sei pathe jalakaṣṭa karite vāraṇa [110]
eka rātre ṣāṭa kuṇḍa kāṭila viśāi<br />śeṣa kuṇḍa kāji-grāme karila kāṭāi [111]
<span class="e2">vāraṇa karite</span>–To prevent <span class="e2">jalakaṣṭa</span>–a scarcity of water <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">pathe sei pathe</span>–along the paths on which <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">karibena</span>–would perform <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–saṅkīrtan, <span class="e2">kāṭila</span>–Viśvakarmā dug <span class="e2">ṣāṭa</span> <span class="e2">viśāi kuṇḍa</span>–sixty large ponds <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">rātre</span>–in one night. <span class="e2">kāṭāi karila</span>–He made <span class="e2">śeṣa</span> <span class="e2">kuṇḍa</span>–the last pond <span class="e2">kāji-grāme</span>–in the village of the Kāzī. [110<span class="e2">–</span>111]
“To prevent a scarcity of water along the paths where the Lord would perform saṅkīrtan, Viśvakarmā dug sixty large ponds in one night, the last of which he made in the village of the Kāzī.
শ্রীধরের কলাবাগ দেখিতে সুন্দর ।<br />ইহার নিকট এক দেখ সরোবর ॥১১২॥
śrīdharera kalā-bāga dekhite sundara<br />ihāra nikaṭa eka dekha sarovara [112]
<span class="e2">śrīdharera</span>–Śrīdhar’s <span class="e2">kalā-bāga</span>–banana grove [is] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to see. <span class="e2">dekha</span>–See [also] <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">sarovara</span>–the lake <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭa</span>–nearby it. [112]
“Śrīdhar’s banana grove is beautiful to see. See also the lake nearby.
এই সরোবরে কভু করি’ জল-খেলা ।<br />মহাপ্রভু লইলেন শ্রীধরের খোলা ॥১১৩॥
ei sarovare kabhu kari’ jala-khelā<br />mahāprabhu la-ilena śrīdharera kholā [113]
<span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">jala-khelā kari’</span>–played in the water <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sarovare</span>–in that lake [and] <span class="e2">la-ilena</span>–took <span class="e2">śrīdharera</span>–Śrīdhar’s <span class="e2">kholā</span>–bananas. [113]
“Mahāprabhu sometimes played in the water there and took Śrīdhar’s bananas.
অদ্যাবধি মোচা থোড় লইয়া শ্রীধর ।<br />শ্রীশচীমাতাকে দেয় উল্লাস অন্তর ॥১১৪॥
adyāvadhi mochā thoḍa la-iyā śrīdhara<br />śrī-śachī-mātāke deya ullāsa antara [114]
<span class="e2">adyāvadhi</span>–Still today, <span class="e2">śrīdhara</span>–Śrīdhar <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–collects <span class="e2">mochā</span>–banana flowers [and] <span class="e2">thoḍa</span>–stems, [and] <span class="e2">deya</span>–gives [them] <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-mātāke</span>–to Mother Śachī <span class="e2">ullāsa</span> <span class="e2">antara</span>–with joy in his heart. [114]
“Still today, Śrīdhar collects banana flowers and stems, and gives them to Mother Śachī with joy in his heart.
ইহার নিকটে ময়ামারি নাম স্থান ।<br />দেখহ শ্রীজীব আজো আছে বিদ্যমান ॥১১৫॥
ihāra nikaṭe mayāmāri nāma sthāna<br />dekhaha śrī-jīva ājo āchhe vidyamāna [115]
<span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–Near here [is] <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–a place <span class="e2">nāma</span>–named <span class="e2">mayāmāri</span>–Mayāmāri. <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–O Śrī Jīva, <span class="e2">dekhaha</span>–see [that it] <span class="e2">vidyamāna āchhe</span>–exists <span class="e2">ājo</span>–even today. [115]
“Near here is a place called Mayāmāri. O Jīva, see that it still exists there today.
পৌরাণিক কথা এক করহ শ্রবণ ।<br />তীর্থযাত্রা বলদেব করিল যখন ॥১১৬॥
নবদ্বীপে আসি’ যবে করিল বিশ্রাম ।<br />বিপ্রগণ জানাইল ময়াসুর নাম ॥১১৭॥
paurāṇika kathā eka karaha śravaṇa<br />tīrthā-yātrā baladeva karila yakhana [116]
navadvīpe āsi’ yabe karila viśrāma<br />vipra-gaṇa jānāila mayāsura nāma [117]
<span class="e2">śravaṇa karaha</span>–Hear <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">kathā</span>–story <span class="e2">paurāṇika</span>–from the Purāṇas: [once] <span class="e2">yakhana</span>–when <span class="e2">baladeva</span>–Baladev <span class="e2">tīrthā-yātrā</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–was on a pilgrimage, <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–He came <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">viśrāma karila</span>–rested. <span class="e2">yabe</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">vipra-gaṇa</span>–some brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">jānāila</span>–told him about <span class="e2">mayāsura</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the demon named Maya. [116<span class="e2">–</span>117]
“Please hear a story from the Purāṇas: once when Baladev was on a pilgrimage, He came to Nabadwīp and rested. At that time, some brāhmaṇs told Him about a demon named Maya.
ময়াসুর-উপদ্রব শুনি’ হলধর ।<br />মহাবেগে ধরে তারে মাঠের ভিতর ॥১১৮॥
mayāsura-upadrava śuni haladhara<br />mahāvege dhare tāre māṭhera bhitara [118]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">upadrava</span>–of the havoc [raised by] <span class="e2">mayāsura</span>–the demon Maya, <span class="e2">haladhara</span>–Baladev <span class="e2">mahāvege</span>–furiously <span class="e2">dhare</span>–confronted <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">bhitara</span>–in <span class="e2">māṭhera</span>–a field. [118]
“Hearing of the havoc raised by Mayāsura, Baladev furiously confronted him in a field.
মহাযুদ্ধ কৈল দৈত্য বলদেব সাথ ।<br />অবশেষে রাম তারে করিল নিপাত ॥১১৯॥
mahāyuddha kaila daitya baladeva sātha<br />avaśeṣe rāma tāre karila nipāta [119]
<span class="e2">daitya</span>–The demon <span class="e2">mahāyuddha</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–fought ferociously <span class="e2">sātha</span>–with <span class="e2">baladeva</span>–Baladev, [and] <span class="e2">avaśeṣe</span>–finally <span class="e2">rāma</span>–Baladev <span class="e2">nipāta karila</span>–killed <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him. [119]
“The demon fought with Baladev ferociously, and finally Baladev killed him.
সে অবধি ময়ামারি নাম খ্যাত হৈল ।<br />বহুকাল কথা আজ তোমারে কহিল ॥১২০॥
se avadhi mayāmāri nāma khyāta haila<br />bahu-kāla kathā āja tomāre kahila [120]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">avadhi</span>–Since then, [this place] <span class="e2">khyāta</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–has become known <span class="e2">nāma</span>–by the name <span class="e2">mayāmāri</span>–Mayāmāri. <span class="e2">āja</span>–Today, <span class="e2">kahila</span>–I have told <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–you <span class="e2">bahu-kāla</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–a very old story. [120]
“Since then, this place has become known as Mayāmāri. Today, I have told you a very old story.
তালবন নাম এই তীর্থ ব্রজপুরে ।<br />সদা ভাগ্যবান্ জন নয়নেতে স্ফুরে” ॥১২১॥
tālavana nāma ei tīrtha vraja-pure<br />sadā bhāgyavān jana nayanete sphure” [121]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–place [is] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">tālavana</span>–Tālavan <span class="e2">vraja-pure</span>–in the town of Vraja [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sphure</span>–appears <span class="e2">nayanete</span>–before the eyes <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span> <span class="e2">jana”</span>–of the fortunate souls.” [121]
“This place is known as Tālavan in Vraja and always appears before the eyes of the fortunate souls.”
সেই রাত্রে সেই স্থানে থাকিলেন সবে ।<br />পরদিন যাত্রা করে “হরি হরি” রবে ॥১২২॥
sei rātre sei sthāne thākilena sabe<br />para-dina yātrā kare “hari hari” rabe [122]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">rātre</span>–That night, <span class="e2">thākilena</span>–they stayed <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–there, [and] <span class="e2">para-dina</span>–the next day <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">yātrā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–travelled on, <span class="e2">rabe</span>–chanting <span class="e2">hari</span> <span class="e2">hari</span>–“Hari! Hari!” [122]
That night, they stayed there, and the next day they continued on, chanting, “Hari! Hari!”
নিতাইজাহ্নবাপদছায়া যার আশ ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য করে এ দাস প্রকাশ ॥১২৩॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā yāra āśa<br />nadīyā-māhātmya kare e dāsa prakāśa [123]
<span class="e2">e</span>–This <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–in the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">prakāśa kare</span>–reveals <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>-<span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia. [123]
This servant, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, reveals the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Seven
Śrī Suvarṇa Bihār and Śrī Deva Pallī
জয় শ্রীচৈতন্যচন্দ্র	<span class="e22">জয় প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ</span><br />	<span class="e23">জয়াদ্বৈত জয় গদাধর ।</span><br />জয় শ্রীবাসাদি ভক্ত	<span class="e22">গৌরপদে অনুরক্ত</span><br />	<span class="e23">জয় নবদ্বীপধামবর ॥১॥</span>
jaya śrī-chaitanya-chandra	<span class="e5">jaya prabhu nityānanda</span><br />	<span class="e6">jayādvaita jaya gadādhara</span><br />jaya śrīvāsādi bhakta	<span class="e5">gaura-pade anurakta</span><br />	<span class="e6">jaya navadvīpa-dhāma-vara [1]</span>
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-chandra</span>–to the moon-like Śrī Chaitanya! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–to Nityānanda Prabhu! <span class="e2">jayādvaita</span>–All glory to Advaita Āchārya! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar Paṇḍit! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span>–to Śrīvās and <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">anurakta</span>–attached <span class="e2">gaura-pade</span>–to Gaura’s feet! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma-vara</span>–to the best of abodes, Nabadwīp! [1]
All glory to the moon-like Śrī Chaitanya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Āchārya, Gadādhar Paṇḍit, Śrīvās Paṇḍit, all the devotees attached to the feet of the Lord, and the best of abodes, Śrī Nabadwīp!
ছাড়িয়া বিশ্রামস্থান	<span class="e22">শ্রীজীবে লইয়া যান</span><br />	<span class="e23">যথা গ্রাম সুবর্ণবিহার ।</span><br />“ওহে জীব”, প্রভু কয়,	<span class="e22">“অপূর্ব্ব এস্থান হয়</span><br />	<span class="e23">নবদ্বীপ প্রকৃতির পার ॥২॥</span>
chhāḍiyā viśrāma-sthāna	<span class="e5">śrī-jīve la-iyā yāna</span><br />	<span class="e6">yathā grāma suvarṇa-bihāra</span><br />“ohe jīva”, prabhu kaya,	<span class="e5">“apūrva e-sthāna haya</span><br />	<span class="e6">navadvīpa prakṛtira pāra [2]</span>
<span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–Leaving <span class="e2">viśrāma-sthāna</span>–Viśrām Sthān, <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–with <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">yāna</span>–the party proceeded <span class="e2">grāma</span>–to the village <span class="e2">suvarṇa-bihāra</span>–of Suvarṇa Bihār.<span class="e2"> yathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">kaya</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">e-sthāna</span>–this place <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–wonderful. [It is,] <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–like [all of] Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">prakṛtira</span> <span class="e2">pāra</span>–beyond material nature. [2]
Leaving Viśrām Sthān, with Śrī Jīva the party proceeded to the village known as Suvarṇa Bihār. There, Nityānanda Prabhu said, “O Jīva, this is a wonderful place. Like all of Nabadwīp, it is beyond material nature.
সত্যযুগে এইস্থানে	<span class="e22">ছিল রাজা সবে জানে</span><br />	<span class="e23">শ্রীসুবর্ণ সেন তার নাম ।</span><br />বহুকাল রাজ্য কৈল	<span class="e22">পরেতে বার্দ্ধক্য হৈল </span><br />	<span class="e23">তবু নাহি কার্য্যেতে বিশ্রাম ॥৩॥</span>
satya-yuge ei-sthāne	<span class="e5">chhila rājā sabe jāne</span><br />	<span class="e6">śrī-suvarṇa sena tāra nāma</span><br />bahu-kāla rājya kaila	<span class="e5">parete vārdhakya haila</span><br />	<span class="e6">tabu nāhi kāryete viśrāma [3]</span>
<span class="e2">ei-sthāne</span>–Here, <span class="e2">satya-yuge</span>–in Satya-yuga, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–there was <span class="e2">rājā</span>–a king. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knew <span class="e2">tāra</span>–his <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name, <span class="e2">śrī-suvarṇa</span> <span class="e2">sena</span>–Śrī Suvarṇa Sen. <span class="e2">rājya</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–He ruled <span class="e2">bahu-kāla</span>–for a long time. <span class="e2">parete</span>–Lastly, <span class="e2">vārdhakya</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–he grew old, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">viśrāma nāhi</span>–he did not retire <span class="e2">kāryete</span>–from [his] duties. [3]
“Here, in Satya-yuga, there was a king known by all as Śrī Suvarṇa Sen. He ruled for a long time. Eventually he grew old, but he did not retire from his duties.
বিষয়ে আবিষ্টচিত্ত	<span class="e22">কিসে বৃদ্ধি হয় বিত্ত</span><br />	<span class="e23">এই চিন্তা করে নরবর ।</span><br />কি জানি কি ভাগ্যবশে	<span class="e22">শ্রীনারদ তথা আইসে</span><br />	<span class="e23">রাজা তাঁরে পূজিল বিস্তর ॥৪॥</span>
viṣaye āviṣṭa-chitta	<span class="e5">kise vṛddhi haya vitta</span><br />	<span class="e6">ei chintā kare nara-vara</span><br />ki jāni ki bhāgya-vaśe	<span class="e5">śrī-nārada tathā āise</span><br />	<span class="e6">rājā tā̐re pūjila vistara [4]</span>
[His] <span class="e2">āviṣṭa-chitta</span>–mind absorbed <span class="e2">viṣaye</span>–in material affairs, <span class="e2">nara-vara</span>–the king <span class="e2">chintā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–thought [only] <span class="e2">ei</span>–this: <span class="e2">kise</span>–how <span class="e2">haya</span>–will [my] <span class="e2">vitta</span>–wealth <span class="e2">vṛddhi</span>–increase? <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">jāni</span> <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">bhāgya-vaśe</span>–As a result of who knows what fortune, <span class="e2">śrī-nārada</span>–Śrī Nārad <span class="e2">āise</span>–came <span class="e2">tathā</span>–here, [and] <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">pūjila</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">tā̐re</span>–him <span class="e2">vistara</span>–elaborately. [4]
“His mind absorbed in mundane affairs, the king thought only of how to accumulate more wealth. As a result of some unknown fortune, Śrī Nārad came here, and the king worshipped him elaborately.
নারদের দয়া হৈল	<span class="e22">তত্ত্ব উপদেশ কৈল</span><br />	<span class="e23">রাজারে ত লইয়া নির্জ্জনে ।</span><br />নারদ কহেন, ‘রায়	<span class="e22">বৃথা তব দিন যায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">অর্থচিন্তা করি’ মনে মনে ॥৫॥</span>
nāradera dayā haila	<span class="e5">tattva upadeśa kaila</span><br />	<span class="e6">rājāre ta la-iyā nirjane</span><br />nārada kahena, ‘rāya	<span class="e5">vṛthā tava dina yāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">artha-chintā kari’ mane mane [5]</span>
<span class="e2">nāradera</span> <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–Nārad blessed [the king. Then] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–he brought <span class="e2">rājāre</span>–the king <span class="e2">nirjane</span>–into seclusion, [and] <span class="e2">upadeśa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–instructed [him] <span class="e2">tattva</span>–in the Absolute Truth. <span class="e2">nārada</span>–Nārad <span class="e2">kahena</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘rāya</span>–‘O King, <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">dina</span>–days <span class="e2">yāya</span>–pass <span class="e2">vṛthā</span>–in vain <span class="e2">artha-chintā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–thinking of wealth <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within your mind. [5]
“Nārad blessed the King. He then met with him privately and instructed him in the Absolute Truth. Nārad said, ‘O King, your days pass in vain as you think only of wealth within your mind.
অর্থকে অনর্থ জান	<span class="e22">পরমার্থ দিব্য জ্ঞান</span><br />	<span class="e23">হৃদয়ে ভাবহ একবার ।</span><br />দারা-পুত্র-বন্ধুজন	<span class="e22">কেহ নহে নিজজন</span><br />	<span class="e23">মরণেতে কেহ নহে কার ॥৬॥</span>
arthake anartha jāna	<span class="e5">paramārtha divya jñāna</span><br />	<span class="e6">hṛdaye bhāvaha eka-bāra</span><br />dārā-putra-bandhu-jana	<span class="e5">keha nahe nija-jana</span><br />	<span class="e6">maraṇete keha nahe kāra [6]</span>
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Understand [that] <span class="e2">arthake</span>–[material] wealth [is] <span class="e2">anartha</span>–meaningless [and that] <span class="e2">divya</span>–divine <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge [is] <span class="e2">paramārtha</span>–true wealth. <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–Once <span class="e2">bhāvaha</span>–consider <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–within [your] heart: <span class="e2">dārā-putra-bandhu-jana</span>–[your] wife, sons, and friends, <span class="e2">keha jana</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–none of them are <span class="e2">nija</span>–[your] own. <span class="e2">maraṇete</span>–At death, <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–no one [is] <span class="e2">kāra</span>–anyone’s. [6]
“‘Understand that material wealth is meaningless and that divine knowledge is true wealth. Once consider within your heart that your wife, sons, and friends do not belong to you. After death, no one belongs to anyone.
তোমার মরণ হলে	<span class="e22">দেহটি ভাসায়ে জলে</span><br />	<span class="e23">সবে যাবে গৃহে আপনার ।</span><br />তবে কেন মিথ্যা আশা	<span class="e22">বিষয়জলপিপাসা</span><br />	<span class="e23">যদি কেহ নাহি হৈল কার ॥৭॥</span>
tomāra maraṇa hale	<span class="e5">dehaṭi bhāsāye jale</span><br />	<span class="e6">sabe yābe gṛhe āpanāra</span><br />tabe kena mithyā āśā	<span class="e5">viṣaya-jala-pipāsā</span><br />	<span class="e6">yadi keha nāhi haila kāra [7]</span>
<span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">maraṇa</span> <span class="e2">hale</span>–When you die, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">dehaṭi</span> <span class="e2">bhāsāye</span>–will set [your] body afloat <span class="e2">jale</span>–the water [and] <span class="e2">yābe</span>–go [back] <span class="e2">āpanāra gṛhe</span>–to their houses. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–So, <span class="e2">kena</span>–why [this] <span class="e2">mithyā</span>–false <span class="e2">āśā</span>–hope? [Why this] <span class="e2">viṣaya-jala-pipāsā</span>–thirst for the water of sense objects, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–when <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–no one <span class="e2">kāra haila</span>–belongs to anyone? [7]
“‘When you die, everyone will set your body afloat down the river and then go back to their houses. So, why this false hope? Why this thirst for the water of sense objects, when no one actually belongs to anyone?
যদি বল, “লভি সুখ	<span class="e22">জীবনে না পাই দুঃখ</span><br />	<span class="e23">অতএব অর্থচেষ্টা করি” ।</span><br />সেহ মিথ্যা কথা রায়	<span class="e22">জীবন অনিত্য হয়</span><br />	<span class="e23">নাহি রহে শতবর্ষোপরি ॥৮॥</span>
yadi bala, “labhi sukha	<span class="e5">jīvane nā pāi duḥkha</span><br />	<span class="e6">ataeva artha-cheṣṭā kari”</span><br />seha mithyā kathā rāya	<span class="e5">jīvana anitya haya</span><br />	<span class="e6">nāhi rahe śata-varṣopari [8]</span>
<span class="e2">yadi</span> <span class="e2">bala</span>–You may say, <span class="e2">“jīvane</span>–“In life, <span class="e2">sukha</span> <span class="e2">labhi</span>–I find happiness; <span class="e2">duḥkha pāi nā</span>–I do not suffer. <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">artha-cheṣṭā</span> <span class="e2">kari”</span>–I endeavour for wealth.” <span class="e2">rāya</span>–O King, <span class="e2">seha</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–such words [are] <span class="e2">mithyā</span>–false. <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–Life <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">anitya</span>–temporary [and] <span class="e2">rahe nāhi</span>–does not last <span class="e2">śata-varṣopari</span>–more than one hundred years. [8]
“‘You may say, “I enjoy life; I do not suffer. Therefore, I endeavour for wealth.” O King, such words are false. Life is temporary and does not last more than a hundred years.
অতএব জান সার	<span class="e22">যেতে হবে মায়াপার</span><br />	<span class="e23">যথা সুখে দুঃখ নাহি হয় ।</span><br />কিসে বা সাধিব বল	<span class="e22">সেই ত অপূর্ব্ব ফল</span><br />	<span class="e23">যাহে নাহি শোক দুঃখ ভয় ॥৯॥</span>
ataeva jāna sāra	<span class="e5">yete habe māyāpāra</span><br />	<span class="e6">yathā sukhe duḥkha nāhi haya</span><br />kise vā sādhiba bala	<span class="e5">sei ta apūrva phala</span><br />	<span class="e6">yāhe nāhi śoka duḥkha bhaya [9]</span>
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">jāna</span>–understand <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the essence: <span class="e2">māyāpāra yete</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–we must cross over māyā <span class="e2">yathā</span>–to where <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–does not come <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–as a result of happiness. <span class="e2">bala</span>–Tell [me,] <span class="e2">kise</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–how <span class="e2">sādhiba</span>–will we attain <span class="e2">sei</span>–that<span class="e2"> ta</span> <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">phala</span>–goal, <span class="e2">yāhe</span>–wherein <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">śoka</span>–lamentation, <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness, [or] <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–fear? [9]
“‘So, understand the essence: we must cross over māyā to the land where happiness does not produce sadness. Tell me, how will we reach that wonderful land where there is no lamentation, sadness, or fear?
কেবল বৈরাগ্য করি’	<span class="e22">তাহা না পাইতে পারি</span><br />	<span class="e23">কেবল জ্ঞানেতে তাহা নাই ।</span><br />বৈরাগ্য জ্ঞানের বলে	<span class="e22">বিষয়বন্ধন গলে</span><br />	<span class="e23">জীবের কৈবল্য হয় ভাই ॥১০॥</span>
kevala vairāgya kari’	<span class="e5">tāhā nā pāite pāri</span><br />	<span class="e6">kevala jñānete tāhā nāi</span><br />vairāgya jñānera bale	<span class="e5">viṣaya-bandhana gale</span><br />	<span class="e6">jīvera kaivalya haya bhāi [10]</span>
<span class="e2">pāite</span> <span class="e2">pāri nā</span>–We cannot attain <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–it <span class="e2">kevala</span>–simply <span class="e2">vairāgya</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by being renounced, [and] <span class="e2">nāi</span>–we cannot attain <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–it <span class="e2">kevala</span>–simply <span class="e2">jñānete</span>–through knowledge. <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">vairāgya</span> <span class="e2">jñānera</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–Through renunciation and knowledge, <span class="e2">viṣaya-bandhana</span>–material bondage <span class="e2">gale</span>–falls away, [and] <span class="e2">jīvera haya</span>–souls enter <span class="e2">kaivalya</span>–oneness (souls merge into the Lord’s body or effulgence). [10]
“‘We cannot attain it by mere renunciation or knowledge. Brother! Through renunciation and knowledge, material bondage falls away, and souls enter oneness.
কৈবল্যে আনন্দ নাই	<span class="e22">সর্ব্বনাশ বলি তাই</span><br />	<span class="e23">কৈবল্যের নিতান্ত ধিক্কার ।</span><br />এদিকে বিষয় গেল	<span class="e22">শ্রেষ্ঠ কিছু না মিলিল</span><br />	<span class="e23">কৈবল্যের করহ বিচার ॥১১॥</span>
kaivalye ānanda nāi	<span class="e5">sarva-nāśa bali tāi</span><br />	<span class="e6">kaivalyera nitānta dhikkāra</span><br />e-dike viṣaya gela	<span class="e5">śreṣṭha kichhu nā milila</span><br />	<span class="e6">kaivalyera karaha vichāra [11]</span>
<span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–joy <span class="e2">kaivalye</span>–in oneness; <span class="e2">bali</span>–we consider <span class="e2">tāi</span>–it <span class="e2">sarva-nāśa</span>–total ruination. <span class="e2">kaivalyera</span>–Oneness [is] <span class="e2">nitānta</span>–utterly <span class="e2">dhikkāra</span>–condemned. <span class="e2">vichāra karaha</span>–Understand <span class="e2">kaivalyera</span>–oneness: <span class="e2">e-dike</span>–by it <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–material things <span class="e2">gela</span>–go away [but] <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–nothing <span class="e2">śreṣṭha</span>–superior <span class="e2">milila</span>–is attained. [11]
“‘There is no joy in oneness; we consider oneness total ruination. Oneness is utterly condemned. Understand oneness: by it, material things disappear, but nothing superior is attained.
অতএব জ্ঞানীজন	<span class="e22">ভুক্তি মুক্তি নাহি লন</span><br />	<span class="e23">কৃষ্ণভক্তি করেন সাধন ।</span><br />বিষয়েতে অনাসক্তি	<span class="e22">কৃষ্ণপদে অনুরক্তি</span><br />	<span class="e23">সম্বন্ধাভিধেয় প্রয়োজন ॥১২॥</span>
ataeva jñānī-jana	<span class="e5">bhukti mukti nāhi lana</span><br />	<span class="e6">kṛṣṇa-bhakti karena sādhana</span><br />viṣayete anāsakti	<span class="e5">kṛṣṇa-pade anurakti</span><br />	<span class="e6">sambandhābhidheya prayojana [12]</span>
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">jñānī-jana</span>–the wise <span class="e2">lana nāhi</span>–do not accept <span class="e2">bhukti</span>–enjoyment [or] <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation— <span class="e2">sādhana karena</span>–they practise <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">anāsakti</span>–Being detached <span class="e2">viṣayete</span>–from mundanity [and] <span class="e2">anurakti</span>–attached <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pade</span>–to Kṛṣṇa’s feet [is] <span class="e2">sambandhābhidheya</span> <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–the relationship (the proper relationship between the soul and the Lord), the process (the way to the soul’s ultimate attainment), and the goal (the perfection of the soul’s existence). [12]
“‘Thus, the wise do not accept enjoyment or liberation—they practise devotion to Kṛṣṇa. To be detached from mundanity and attached to Kṛṣṇa is the relationship, the process, and the goal.
জীব সে কৃষ্ণের দাস	<span class="e22">ভক্তি বিনা সর্ব্বনাশ</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভক্তিবৃক্ষে ফলে প্রেমফল ।</span><br />সেই ফল প্রয়োজন	<span class="e22">কৃষ্ণপ্রেম নিত্যধন</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভুক্তি মুক্তি তুচ্ছ সে সকল ॥১৩॥</span>
jīva se kṛṣṇera dāsa	<span class="e5">bhakti vinā sarva-nāśa</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhakti-vṛkṣe phale prema-phala</span><br />sei phala prayojana	<span class="e5">kṛṣṇa-prema nitya-dhana</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhukti mukti tuchchha se sakala [13]</span>
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">jīva</span>–The soul [is] <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–a servant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–of Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion, <span class="e2">sarva-nāśa</span>–everything [is] spoiled. <span class="e2">prema-phala</span>–The fruit of divine love <span class="e2">phale</span>–grows <span class="e2">bhakti-vṛkṣe</span>–on the tree of devotion; <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">phala</span>–fruit— <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–divine love for Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">nitya-dhana</span>–the eternal wealth [of the soul]— [is] <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–the goal. <span class="e2">bhukti</span>–Enjoyment [and] <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation [are] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span>–both <span class="e2">tuchchha</span>–insignificant. [13]
“‘The soul is a servant of Kṛṣṇa, and without devotion, the soul is utterly ruined. The fruit of divine love for Kṛṣṇa grows on the tree of devotion; that fruit—the eternal wealth of the soul—is the goal. Enjoyment and liberation are both insignificant.
কৃষ্ণ চিদানন্দ রবি	<span class="e22">মায়া তাঁর ছায়া ছবি</span><br />	<span class="e23">জীব তাঁর কিরণাণুগণ ।</span><br />তটস্থ ধর্ম্মের বশে	<span class="e22">জীব যদি মায়া স্পর্শে</span><br />	<span class="e23">মায়া তারে করয়ে বন্ধন ॥১৪॥</span>
kṛṣṇa chid-ānanda ravi	<span class="e5">māyā tā̐ra chhāyā chhabi</span><br />	<span class="e6">jīva tā̐ra kiraṇāṇu-gaṇa</span><br />taṭastha dharmera vaśe	<span class="e5">jīva yadi māyā sparśe</span><br />	<span class="e6">māyā tāre karaye bandhana [14]</span>
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is the] <span class="e2">chid-ānanda</span>–joyful, spiritual <span class="e2">ravi</span>–sun, <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā [is] <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–His <span class="e2">chhāyā chhabi</span>–shadow form, [and] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–the souls [are] <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–His <span class="e2">kiraṇāṇu-gaṇa</span>–atomic rays. <span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls, <span class="e2">vaśe</span>–governed by [their] <span class="e2">taṭastha</span> <span class="e2">dharmera</span>–marginal nature (of being suited to either the spiritual or material world), <span class="e2">sparśe</span>–touch <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā, [then] <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">bandhana karaye</span>–binds <span class="e2">tāre</span>–them. [14]
“‘Kṛṣṇa is the joyful, spiritual sun, Māyā is His shadow, and the souls are His atomic rays. If souls, governed by their marginal nature, touch Māyā, then Māyā binds them.
কৃষ্ণ বহির্ম্মুখ যেই	<span class="e22">মায়াস্পর্শী জীব সেই</span><br />	<span class="e23">মায়াস্পর্শে কর্ম্মসঙ্গ পায় ।</span><br />মায়াজালে ভ্রমি’ মরে	<span class="e22">কর্ম্ম জ্ঞানে নাহি তরে</span><br />	<span class="e23">কষ্টনাশ মন্ত্রণা করায় ॥১৫॥</span>
kṛṣṇa bahirmukha yei	<span class="e5">māyā-sparśī jīva sei</span><br />	<span class="e6">māyā-sparśe karma-saṅga pāya</span><br />māyā-jāle bhrami’ mare	<span class="e5">karma jñāne nāhi tare</span><br />	<span class="e6">kaṣṭa-nāśa mantraṇā karāya [15]</span>
<span class="e2">yei</span>–The souls that [become] <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span>–averse <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–to Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">sei jīva</span>–the souls [that]<span class="e2"> māyā-sparśī</span>–touch Māyā. <span class="e2">māyā-sparśe</span>–By Māyā’s touch, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–they become <span class="e2">karma-saṅga</span>–bound in the reactions to their previous actions. <span class="e2">bhrami’</span>–They wander [and] <span class="e2">mare</span>–die <span class="e2">māyā-jāle</span>–in Māyā’s prison. <span class="e2">karma</span>–Action [and] <span class="e2">jñāne</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">tare nāhi</span>–do not deliver [them, and Māyā] <span class="e2">karāya</span>–causes [them] <span class="e2">mantraṇā</span>–to invite [their own] <span class="e2">kaṣṭa-nāśa</span>–suffering and ruin. [15]
“‘The souls that turn away from Kṛṣṇa touch Māyā, and thus become bound in karma. They wander and die in Māyā’s prison. Neither action nor knowledge help them, and Māyā causes them to invite in their own suffering and ruin.
কভু কর্ম্ম আচরয়	<span class="e22">অষ্টাঙ্গাদি যোগময়</span><br />	<span class="e23">কভু ব্রহ্মজ্ঞান আলোচন ।</span><br />কভু কভু তর্ক করে	<span class="e22">অবশেষে নাহি তরে</span><br />	<span class="e23">নাহি মানে আত্মতত্ত্বধন ॥১৬॥</span>
kabhu karma ācharaya	<span class="e5">aṣṭāṅgādi yogamaya</span><br />	<span class="e6">kabhu brahma-jñāna ālochana</span><br />kabhu kabhu tarka kare	<span class="e5">avaśeṣe nāhi tare</span><br />	<span class="e6">nāhi māne ātma-tattva-dhana [16]</span>
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">ācharaya</span>–they engage in <span class="e2">karma</span>–pious works [or] <span class="e2">aṣṭāṅgādi</span> <span class="e2">yogamaya</span>–the eightfold path of yoga, <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes [they engage in] <span class="e2">ālochana</span>–discussion <span class="e2">brahma-jñāna</span>–of theory of Brahma, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">tarka</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–they argue. <span class="e2">avaśeṣe</span>–Ultimately, [these things] <span class="e2">tare nāhi</span>–do not deliver [them, however, and] <span class="e2">māne nāhi</span>–they do not appreciate <span class="e2">ātma-tattva-dhana</span>–the wealth of the self. [16]
“‘Souls sometimes perform action, sometimes practise aṣṭāṅga-yoga, sometimes discuss theory of Brahma, and sometimes argue. Ultimately, none of these things help them, however, and they fail to appreciate the wealth of the self.
ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে যবে	<span class="e22">ভক্তজনসঙ্গ হবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">তবে শ্রদ্ধা লভিবে নির্ম্মল ।</span><br />সাধুসঙ্গে কৃষ্ণ ভজি’	<span class="e22">হৃদয়-অনর্থ ত্যজি’</span><br />	<span class="e23">নিষ্ঠা লাভ করে সুবিমল ॥১৭॥</span>
bhramite bhramite yabe	<span class="e5">bhakta-jana-saṅga habe</span><br />	<span class="e6">tabe śraddhā labhibe nirmala</span><br />sādhu-saṅge kṛṣṇa bhaji’	<span class="e5">hṛdaya-anartha tyaji’</span><br />	<span class="e6">niṣṭhā lābha kare suvimala [17]</span>
<span class="e2">bhramite</span> <span class="e2">bhramite</span>–After wandering and wandering, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">bhakta-jana-saṅga habe</span>–souls attain the association of devotees, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–they develop <span class="e2">nirmala</span>–pure <span class="e2">śraddhā</span>–faith. <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–By serving <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–in the association of the sādhus, <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–souls remove <span class="e2">hṛdaya-anartha</span>–impediments from [their] hearts [and] <span class="e2">lābha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–attain <span class="e2">suvimala</span> <span class="e2">niṣṭhā</span>–pure constancy. [17]
“‘After wandering and wandering in this way, when souls attain the association of devotees, they develop pure faith. By serving Kṛṣṇa in the association of the sādhus, souls free their hearts from impediments and attain pure constancy.
ভজিতে ভজিতে তবে	<span class="e22">সেই নিষ্ঠা রুচি হবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">ক্রমে রুচি হইবে আসক্তি ।</span><br />আসক্তি হইতে ভাব	<span class="e22">তাহে হবে প্রেমলাভ</span><br />	<span class="e23">এই ক্রমে হয় শুদ্ধভক্তি ॥১৮॥</span>
bhajite bhajite tabe	<span class="e5">sei niṣṭhā ruchi habe</span><br />	<span class="e6">krame ruchi ha-ibe āsakti</span><br />āsakti ha-ite bhāva	<span class="e5">tāhe habe prema-lābha</span><br />	<span class="e6">ei krame haya śuddha bhakti [18]</span>
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">bhajite</span> <span class="e2">bhajite</span>–as [they] serve, <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">niṣṭhā</span>–their constancy <span class="e2">habe</span>–becomes <span class="e2">ruchi</span>–attraction, [and,] <span class="e2">krame</span>–gradually, <span class="e2">ruchi</span>–that attraction <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–becomes <span class="e2">āsakti</span>–attachment. <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–From <span class="e2">āsakti</span>–attachment, <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–feeling [develops, and] <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–thereafter <span class="e2">prema-lābha</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–they attain divine love. <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–Pure <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">haya</span>–awakens <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">krame</span>–in these stages. [18]
“‘Then, as they continue to serve, their constancy develops into attraction and, gradually, attachment to Kṛṣṇa. From attachment, feeling develops, and thereafter divine love. Pure devotion awakens in these stages.
শ্রবণ কীর্ত্তন মতি	<span class="e22">সেবা কৃষ্ণার্চ্চন নতি</span><br />	<span class="e23">দাস্য সখ্য আত্মনিবেদন ।</span><br />নবধা সাধন এই	<span class="e22">ভক্তসঙ্গে করে যেই</span><br />	<span class="e23">সেই লভে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমধন ॥১৯॥</span>
śravaṇa kīrtana mati	<span class="e5">sevā kṛṣṇārchchana nati</span><br />	<span class="e6">dāsya sakhya ātma-nivedana</span><br />navadhā sādhana ei	<span class="e5">bhakta-saṅge kare yei</span><br />	<span class="e6">sei labhe kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana [19]</span>
<span class="e2">śravaṇa</span>–Hearing, <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–chanting, <span class="e2">mati</span>–remembering, <span class="e2">sevā</span>–serving, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇārchchana</span>–worshipping, <span class="e2">nati</span>–bowing, <span class="e2">dāsya</span>–following, <span class="e2">sakhya</span>–befriending, [and] <span class="e2">ātma-nivedana</span>–surrendering— <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">sei</span>–souls who <span class="e2">kare</span>–engage in <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">navadhā</span>–ninefold <span class="e2">sādhana</span>–practice <span class="e2">bhakta-saṅge</span>–in the association of devotees <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana</span>–the wealth of divine love for Kṛṣṇa. [19]
“‘Hearing, chanting, remembering, serving, worshipping Kṛṣṇa, bowing, following, befriending, and surrendering—souls who engage in these nine practices in the association of devotees attain the wealth of divine love for Kṛṣṇa.
তুমি রাজা ভাগ্যবান্	<span class="e22">নবদ্বীপে তব স্থান</span><br />	<span class="e23">ধামবাসে তব ভাগ্যোদয় ।</span><br />সাধুসঙ্গে শ্রদ্ধা পেয়ে	<span class="e22">কৃষ্ণনাম-গুণ গেয়ে</span><br />	<span class="e23">প্রেমসূর্য্য করাও উদয় ॥২০॥</span>
tumi rājā bhāgyavān	<span class="e5">navadvīpe tava sthāna</span><br />	<span class="e6">dhāma-vāse tava bhāgyodaya</span><br />sādhu-saṅge śraddhā peye	<span class="e5">kṛṣṇa-nāma-guṇa geye</span><br />	<span class="e6">prema-sūrya karāo udaya [20]</span>
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–O King, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–fortunate. <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–Your residence [is] <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">bhāgyodaya</span>–your fortune has arisen <span class="e2">dhāma-vāse</span>–by residing in this abode. [So,] <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–in the association of the sādhus, <span class="e2">peye</span>–develop <span class="e2">śraddhā</span>–faith, <span class="e2">geye</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-guṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Name and glories, [and thus] <span class="e2">karāo</span>–cause <span class="e2">prema-sūrya</span>–the sun of divine love [to] <span class="e2">udaya</span>–rise. [20]
“‘O King, you are fortunate. You reside in Nabadwīp, and your fortune has arisen by residing in the Dhām. So, in the association of sādhus, develop faith, chant Kṛṣṇa’s Name and glories, and thus cause the sun of divine love to rise.
ধন্য কলি আগমনে	<span class="e22">হেথা কৃষ্ণ লয়ে গণে</span><br />	<span class="e23">শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-লীলা প্রকাশিবে ।</span><br />যেই গৌরনাম লবে	<span class="e22">তাতে কৃষ্ণকৃপা হবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">ব্রজে বাস সেই ত করিবে ॥২১॥</span>
dhanya kali āgamane	<span class="e5">hethā kṛṣṇa laye gaṇe</span><br />	<span class="e6">śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā prakāśibe</span><br />yei gaura-nāma labe	<span class="e5">tāte kṛṣṇa-kṛpā habe</span><br />	<span class="e6">vraje vāsa sei ta karibe [21]</span>
<span class="e2">kali</span> <span class="e2">āgamane</span>–The coming of Kali-yuga [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious! <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">prakāśibe</span>–will manifest [His] <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–as Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">gaṇe</span>–associates <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, [and] <span class="e2">yei sei</span>–those who <span class="e2">labe</span>–will chant <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura [will] <span class="e2">tāte</span>–thereby <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–attain the mercy of Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">vāsa karibe ta</span>–reside <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja. [21]
“‘The coming of Kali-yuga is glorious! Kṛṣṇa will manifest His Pastimes as Śrī Gaurāṅga with His associates here, and those who chant the Name of Gaura will receive the mercy of Kṛṣṇa and reside in Vraja.
গৌরনাম না লইয়া	<span class="e22">যেই কৃষ্ণ ভজে গিয়া</span><br />	<span class="e23">সেই কৃষ্ণ বহুকালে পায় ।</span><br />গৌরনাম লয় যেই	<span class="e22">সদ্য কৃষ্ণ পায় সেই</span><br />	<span class="e23">অপরাধ নাহি রহে তায়’ ॥২২॥</span>
gaura-nāma nā la-iyā	<span class="e5">yei kṛṣṇa bhaje giyā</span><br />	<span class="e6">sei kṛṣṇa bahu-kāle pāya</span><br />gaura-nāma laya yei	<span class="e5">sadya kṛṣṇa pāya sei</span><br />	<span class="e6">aparādha nāhi rahe tāya’ [22]</span>
<span class="e2">yei sei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">giyā bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [but] <span class="e2">la-iyā nā</span>–do not chant <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">bahu-kāle</span>–after a long time, [but] <span class="e2">yei sei</span>–those who <span class="e2">laya</span>–chant <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura <span class="e2">sadya</span>–immediately <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa— <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">rahe nāhi</span>–do not remain <span class="e2">tāya’</span>–in them’. [22]
“‘Those who serve Kṛṣṇa but do not chant the Name of Gaura attain Kṛṣṇa after a long time, but those who chant the Name of Gaura immediately attain Kṛṣṇa—offences do not remain in them.’
বলিতে বলিতে মুনি	<span class="e22">অধৈর্য্য হয় অমনি</span><br />	<span class="e23">নাচিতে লাগিল ‘গৌর’ বলি’ ।</span><br />‘গৌরহরি’ বোল ধরি’	<span class="e22">বীণা বলে ‘গৌরহরি’</span><br />	<span class="e23">‘কবে সে আসিবে ধন্য কলি’ ॥২৩॥</span>
balite balite muni	<span class="e5">adhairya haya amani</span><br />	<span class="e6">nāchite lāgila ‘gaura’ bali’</span><br />‘gaurahari’ bola dhari’	<span class="e5">vīṇā bale gaurahari</span><br />	<span class="e6">‘kabe se āsibe dhanya kali’ [23]</span>
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–As he spoke, <span class="e2">muni</span>–the sage <span class="e2">amani</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">haya</span>–became <span class="e2">adhairya</span>–overwhelmed. <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–He began <span class="e2">nāchite</span>–to dance, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanting <span class="e2">gaura</span>–‘Gaurahari!’ <span class="e2">dhari’ bola</span>–As he chanted <span class="e2">‘gaurahari’</span>–‘Gaurahari!’, [his] <span class="e2">vīṇā</span>–vīṇā (stringed instrument) <span class="e2">bale</span>–chanted <span class="e2">‘gaurahari’</span>–‘Gaurahari!’ <span class="e2">‘kabe</span>–‘When [will] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">dhanya</span> <span class="e2">kali</span>–the glorious Age of Kali <span class="e2">āsibe’</span>–arrive?’ [23]
“As he spoke, Nārad Muni suddenly became overwhelmed. He began to dance, chanting, ‘Gaurahari!’, and as he did so, his vīṇā also chanted ‘Gaurahari!’ He mused, ‘When will the glorious Age of Kali arrive?’
এই সব বলি’ তায়	<span class="e22">নারদ চলিয়া যায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">প্রেমোদয় হইল রাজার ।</span><br />‘গৌরাঙ্গ’ বলিয়া নাচে	<span class="e22">সাধু হৈতে প্রেম যাচে</span><br />	<span class="e23">বিষয়বাসনা ঘুচে তাঁর ॥২৪॥</span>
ei saba bali’ tāya	<span class="e5">nārada chaliyā yāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">premodaya ha-ila rājāra</span><br />‘gaurāṅga’ baliyā nāche	<span class="e5">sādhu haite prema yāche</span><br />	<span class="e6">viṣaya-vāsanā ghuche tā̐ra [24]</span>
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Having spoken <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–this, <span class="e2">tāya</span>–to him, <span class="e2">nārada</span>–Nārad <span class="e2">chaliyā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–left, [and] <span class="e2">rājāra</span>–the king’s <span class="e2">premodaya</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–divine love arose. <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Chanting <span class="e2">‘gaurāṅga’</span>–‘Gaurāṅga’, <span class="e2">nāche</span>–the king danced [and] <span class="e2">yāche</span>–begged <span class="e2">prema</span>–for divine love <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–the sādhus. <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–His <span class="e2">viṣaya-vāsanā</span>–material desires <span class="e2">ghuche</span>–disappeared. [24]
“Having spoken to the king, Nārad left, and the king’s divine love arose. Chanting ‘Gaurāṅga’, the king danced and begged for divine love from the sādhus. His material desires disappeared.
নিদ্রাকালে নরবর	<span class="e22">দেখে গৌর গদাধর</span><br />	<span class="e23">সপার্ষদে তাঁহার অঙ্গনে ।</span><br />নাচে ‘হরে কৃষ্ণ’ বলি’	<span class="e22">করে সবে কোলাকুলি </span><br />	<span class="e23">সুবর্ণপ্রতিমা গৌর সনে ॥২৫॥</span>
nidrā-kāle nara-vara	<span class="e5">dekhe gaura gadādhara</span><br />	<span class="e6">sapārṣade tā̐hāra aṅgane</span><br />nāche ‘hare kṛṣṇa’ bali’	<span class="e5">kare sabe kolākuli</span><br />	<span class="e6">suvarṇa-pratimā gaura sane [25]</span>
<span class="e2">nidrā-kāle</span>–While asleep, <span class="e2">nara-vara</span>–the king <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura [and] <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar <span class="e2">sapārṣade</span>–with [Their] associates <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">aṅgane</span>–in his courtyard. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">nāche</span>–was dancing, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanting <span class="e2">‘hare</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Hare Kṛṣṇa!’, [and] <span class="e2">kolākuli kare</span>–embracing <span class="e2">sane</span>–in the company <span class="e2">suvarṇa-pratimā</span>–of the golden Lord, <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura. [25]
“While asleep, the king had a vision of Gaura and Gadādhar with Their associates in his courtyard. Everyone was dancing, chanting ‘Hare Kṛṣṇa’, and embracing in the company of the golden Lord Gaura.
নিদ্রা ভাঙ্গি’ নরপতি	<span class="e22">কাতর হইল অতি</span><br />	<span class="e23">গৌর লাগি’ করয় ক্রন্দন ।</span><br />দৈববাণী হৈল তায়	<span class="e22">‘প্রকট সময়ে রায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">হবে তুমি পার্ষদে গণন ॥২৬॥</span>
nidrā bhāṅgi’ nara-pati	<span class="e5">kātara ha-ila ati</span><br />	<span class="e6">gaura lāgi’ karaya krandana</span><br />daiva-vāṇī haila tāya	<span class="e5">‘prakaṭa samaye rāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">habe tumi pārṣade gaṇana [26]</span>
<span class="e2">nidrā</span> <span class="e2">bhāṅgi’</span>–Awakening, <span class="e2">nara-pati</span>–the king <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became <span class="e2">ati kātara</span>–deeply dismayed [and] <span class="e2">krandana karaya</span>–cried <span class="e2">lāgi’</span>–for <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura. <span class="e2">daiva-vāṇī</span>–A divine voice <span class="e2">haila</span>–manifested <span class="e2">tāya</span>–to him,<span class="e2"> ‘rāya</span>–‘O King, <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">samaye</span>–at the time of [the Lord’s] appearance, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">gaṇana habe</span>–will be counted <span class="e2">pārṣade</span>–amongst [His] associates. [26]
“When he awoke, the king became deeply dismayed and cried for Gaura. Then he heard a divine voice: ‘O King, when the Lord appears, you will be one of His associates.
বুদ্ধিমন্তখাঁন নাম	<span class="e22">পাইবে হে গুণধাম</span><br />	<span class="e23">সেবিবে গৌরাঙ্গ-শ্রীচরণ’ ।</span><br />দৈববাণী কাণে শুনি’	<span class="e22">স্থির হৈল নরমণি</span><br />	<span class="e23">করে তবে গৌরাঙ্গ ভজন” ॥২৭॥</span>
buddhimanta-khā̐na nāma	<span class="e5">pāibe he guṇa-dhāma</span><br />	<span class="e6">sevibe gaurāṅga-śrī-charaṇa’</span><br />daiva-vāṇī kāṇe śuni’	<span class="e5">sthira haila nara-maṇi</span><br />	<span class="e6">kare tabe gaurāṅga bhajana” [27]</span>
<span class="e2">he</span>–O <span class="e2">guṇa-dhāma</span>–abode of virtue, <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–you will receive <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the name <span class="e2">buddhimanta-khā̐na</span>–Buddhimanta Khā̐n, [and] <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–you will serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-śrī-charaṇa’</span>–the holy feet of Gaurāṅga.’ <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">daiva-vāṇī</span>–the divine voice <span class="e2">kāṇe</span>–with [his] ears, <span class="e2">nara-maṇi</span>–the king <span class="e2">sthira</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–became steady [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">bhajana kare</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">gaurāṅga”</span>–Gaurāṅga.” [27]
“‘O virtuous King, you will be named Buddhimanta Khā̐n, and you will serve the holy feet of Gaurāṅga.’ Hearing this divine voice, the king became steady and then worshipped Gaurāṅga.”
নিত্যানন্দকথা শেষে	<span class="e22">নারদের শক্ত্যাবেশে</span><br />	<span class="e23">শ্রীবাস হৈল অচেতন ।</span><br />মহাপ্রেমাবেশে তবে	<span class="e22">গৌরনামামৃতাসবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভূমে লোটে শ্রীজীব তখন ॥২৮॥</span>
nityānanda-kathā śeṣe	<span class="e5">nāradera śaktyāveśe</span><br />	<span class="e6">śrīvāsa haila achetana</span><br />mahāpremāveśe tabe	<span class="e5">gaura-nāmāmṛtāsabe</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhūme loṭe śrī-jīva takhana [28]</span>
<span class="e2">śeṣe</span>–At the end <span class="e2">nityānanda-kathā</span>–of Nityānanda’s narration, <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās [became] <span class="e2">nāradera</span> <span class="e2">śaktyāveśe</span>–immersed in the mood of Nārad [and] <span class="e2">achetana haila</span>–fainted. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva, <span class="e2">mahāpremāveśe</span>–immersed in intense divine love [and] <span class="e2">gaura-nāmāmṛtāsabe</span>–the intoxicating nectar of Gaura’s Name, <span class="e2">loṭe</span>–rolled <span class="e2">bhūme</span>–on the ground <span class="e2">takhana</span>–thereafter. [28]
When Nityānanda finished speaking, Śrīvās became immersed in the mood of Nārad and fainted. Śrī Jīva rolled on the ground, immersed in intense divine love and the intoxicating nectar of Gaura’s Name.
“আহা কি গৌরাঙ্গরায়	<span class="e22">দেখিব আমি হেথায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">সুবর্ণ পুতলি গোরামণি” ।</span><br />বলিতে বলিতে তবে	<span class="e22">শ্রীগৌরকীর্ত্তন সবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">নয়নেতে দেখয়ে অমনি ॥২৯॥</span>
“āhā ki gaurāṅga-rāya	<span class="e5">dekhiba āmi hethāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">suvarṇa putali gorāmaṇi”</span><br />balite balite tabe	<span class="e5">śrī-gaura-kīrtana sabe</span><br />	<span class="e6">nayanete dekhaye amani [29]</span>
<span class="e2">“āhā</span>–“Oh! <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-rāya</span>–Gaurāṅga Rāy! <span class="e2">gorāmaṇi</span>–O golden jewel! <span class="e2">āmi ki</span> <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–Will I see [Your] <span class="e2">suvarṇa</span> <span class="e2">putali</span>–golden form <span class="e2">hethāya”</span>–here?” <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–as Jīva spoke, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">amani</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">dekhaye</span>–saw <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-kīrtana</span>–Śrī Gaura’s kīrtan <span class="e2">nayanete</span>–with [their own] eyes. [29]
“Oh! Gaurāṅga Rāy! Gorāmaṇi! Will I see Your golden form here?” As Jīva spoke, everyone suddenly saw Śrī Gaura’s kīrtan with their own eyes.
আহা সে অমিয় জিনি’	<span class="e22">গৌরাঙ্গের রূপখানি</span><br />	<span class="e23">নাচিতে লাগিল সেই খানে ।</span><br />তবে নিত্যানন্দরায়	<span class="e22">গৌরাঙ্গের গুণ গায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">অদ্বৈত সহিত সর্ব্বজনে ॥৩০॥</span>
āhā se amiya jini’	<span class="e5">gaurāṅgera rūpa-khāni</span><br />	<span class="e6">nāchite lāgila sei khāne</span><br />tabe nityānanda-rāya	<span class="e5">gaurāṅgera guṇa gāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">advaita sahita sarva-jane [30]</span>
<span class="e2">āhā</span>–Oh! <span class="e2">rūpa-khāni</span>–The form <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">se</span>–which <span class="e2">jini’</span>–surpasses <span class="e2">amiya</span>–nectar, <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–began <span class="e2">nāchite</span>–to dance <span class="e2">sei khāne</span>–there. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chanted <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–the glories <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">advaita</span>–Advaita [and] <span class="e2">sarva-jane</span>–all the devotees. [30]
Oh! The form of Gaurāṅga, which surpasses nectar, began to dance there, and Nityānanda Rāy chanted the glories of Gaurāṅga with Advaita and all the devotees.
মৃদঙ্গ মন্দিরা বাজে	<span class="e22">সঙ্কীর্ত্তন সুবিরাজে</span><br />	<span class="e23">পূর্ব্বলীলা হইল বিস্তর ।</span><br />কত যে আনন্দ হয়	<span class="e22">বর্ণিতে শকতি নয়</span><br />	<span class="e23">বেলা হইল দ্বিতীয় প্রহর ॥৩১॥</span>
mṛdaṅga mandirā bāje	<span class="e5">saṅkīrtana suvirāje</span><br />	<span class="e6">pūrva-līlā ha-ila vistara</span><br />kata ye ānanda haya	<span class="e5">varṇite śakati naya</span><br />	<span class="e6">belā ha-ila dvitīya prahara [31]</span>
<span class="e2">mṛdaṅga</span>–Mṛdaṅgas [and] <span class="e2">mandirā</span>–cymbals <span class="e2">bāje</span>–resonated, <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–the saṅkīrtan <span class="e2">suvirāje</span>–resounded, [and] <span class="e2">pūrva-līlā</span>–the previous Pastimes [of the Lord] <span class="e2">vistara ha-ila</span>–manifested. <span class="e2">śakati</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–I do not have the power <span class="e2">varṇite</span>–to describe <span class="e2">ye</span>–the <span class="e2">kata ānanda</span>–intense joy [that] <span class="e2">haya</span>–arose [and] <span class="e2">belā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–remained [there] <span class="e2">dvitīya</span> <span class="e2">prahara</span>–until midday. [31]
Mṛdaṅgas and cymbals resonated, the saṅkīrtan resounded, and the previous Pastimes of the Lord manifested. I do not have the power to describe the joy that arose and remained there until midday.
তবে ত চলিল সবে	<span class="e22">গৌরগীত কলরবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">দেবপল্লী গ্রামের ভিতর ।</span><br />তথায় বিশ্রাম কৈল	<span class="e22">দেবের অতিথি হইল</span><br />	<span class="e23">মধ্যাহ্নভোজন অতঃপর ॥৩২॥</span>
tabe ta chalila sabe	<span class="e5">gaura-gīta kala-rave</span><br />	<span class="e6">devapallī grāmera bhitara</span><br />tathāya viśrāma kaila	<span class="e5">devera atithi ha-ila</span><br />	<span class="e6">madhyāhna-bhojana ataḥpara [32]</span>
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they all <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">chalila</span>–left, <span class="e2">kala-rave</span>–loudly singing <span class="e2">gaura-gīta</span>–songs about Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">viśrāma</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–They rested <span class="e2">bhitara</span> <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–there, in <span class="e2">devapallī</span> <span class="e2">grāmera</span>–the village of Deva Pallī [and] <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–were <span class="e2">atithi</span>–guests <span class="e2">devera</span>–of the [village] Deity. <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–Thereafter, <span class="e2">madhyāhna-bhojana</span>–they ate at midday. [32]
Eventually, the party continued on, loudly singing songs about Gaurāṅga. They rested in the village of Deva Pallī as guests of the village Deity and then ate at midday.
দিবসের শেষ যামে	<span class="e22">সকলে ভ্রময় গ্রামে</span><br />	<span class="e23">প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ তবে কয় ।</span><br />“দেবপল্লী এই হয়	<span class="e22">শ্রীনৃসিংহদেবালয়</span><br />	<span class="e23">সত্যযুগ হৈতে পরিচয় ॥৩৩॥</span>
divasera śeṣa yāme	<span class="e5">sakale bhramaya grāme</span><br />	<span class="e6">prabhu nityānanda tabe kaya</span><br />“devapallī ei haya	<span class="e5">śrī-nṛsiṁha-devālaya</span><br />	<span class="e6">satya-yuga haite parichaya [33]</span>
<span class="e2">śeṣa</span> <span class="e2">yāme</span>–During the final portion <span class="e2">divasera</span>–of the day, <span class="e2">sakale</span>–they <span class="e2">bhramaya</span>–toured <span class="e2">grāme</span>–the village, [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">kaya</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ei</span>–“This <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">devapallī</span>–Deva Pallī. <span class="e2">śrī-nṛsiṁha-devālaya</span>–This Temple of Śrī Nṛsiṁhadev [has been] <span class="e2">parichaya</span>–known <span class="e2">haite</span>–since <span class="e2">satya-yuga</span>–Satya-yuga. [33]
In the evening, they toured the village, and then Nityānanda Prabhu said, “This is Deva Pallī. This Temple of Śrī Nṛsiṁhadev was established in Satya-yuga.
প্রহ্লাদেরে দয়া করি’	<span class="e22">হিরণ্য বধিয়া হরি</span><br />	<span class="e23">এই স্থানে করিল বিশ্রাম ।</span><br />ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবগণ	<span class="e22">নিজ নিজ নিকেতন</span><br />	<span class="e23">করি’ এক বসাইল গ্রাম ॥৩৪॥</span>
prahlādere dayā kari’	<span class="e5">hiraṇya badhiyā hari</span><br />	<span class="e6">ei sthāne karila viśrāma</span><br />brahmā ādi deva-gaṇa	<span class="e5">nija nija niketana</span><br />	<span class="e6">kari’ eka vasāila grāma [34]</span>
<span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–After blessing <span class="e2">prahlādere</span>–Prahlād [and] <span class="e2">badhiyā</span>–killing <span class="e2">hiraṇya</span>–Hiraṇyakaśipu, <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">viśrāma karila</span>–rested <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–and the other gods <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">niketana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–made their own homes [and] <span class="e2">vasāila</span>–established <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">grāma</span>–village. [34]
“After blessing Prahlād and killing Hiraṇyakaśipu, the Lord rested here. Brahmā and the other gods made their own homes here and established a village.
মন্দাকিনীতট ধরি’	<span class="e22">টিলায় বসতি করি’</span><br />	<span class="e23">নৃসিংহ-সেবায় হৈল রত ।</span><br />শ্রীনৃসিংহক্ষেত্র নাম	<span class="e22">নবদ্বীপে এই ধাম</span><br />	<span class="e23">পরমপাবন শাস্ত্রমত ॥৩৫॥</span>
mandākinī-taṭa dhari’	<span class="e5">ṭilāya vasati kari’</span><br />	<span class="e6">nṛsiṁha-sevāya haila rata</span><br />śrī-nṛsiṁha-kṣetra nāma	<span class="e5">navadvīpe ei dhāma</span><br />	<span class="e6">parama-pāvana śāstra-mata [35]</span>
<span class="e2">vasati</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–They resided <span class="e2">ṭilāya</span>–on [these] hills <span class="e2">mandākinī-taṭa</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–bordering the bank of the Mandākinī, [and] <span class="e2">sevāya</span> <span class="e2">rata haila</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">nṛsiṁha</span>–Nṛsiṁha. <span class="e2">śāstra-mata</span>–The scriptures state [that] <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">śrī-nṛsiṁha-kṣetra</span>–Śrī Nṛsiṁha Kṣetra, [is] <span class="e2">parama-pāvana</span>–very purifying. [35]
“They resided on these hills beside the bank of the Mandākinī and worshipped Nṛsiṁha. The scriptures state that this abode in Nabadwīp, known as Śrī Nṛsiṁha Kṣetra, is very purifying.
সূর্য্যটিলা ব্রহ্মটিলা	<span class="e22">নৃসিংহ পূরবে ছিলা</span><br />	<span class="e23">এবে স্থানে হৈল বিপর্য্যয় ।</span><br />গণেশের টিলা হের	<span class="e22">ইন্দ্রটিলা তার পর</span><br />	<span class="e23">এই রূপ বহু টিলাময় ॥৩৬॥</span>
sūrya-ṭilā brahma-ṭilā	<span class="e5">nṛsiṁha pūrave chhilā</span><br />	<span class="e6">ebe sthāne haila viparyaya</span><br />gaṇeśera ṭilā hera	<span class="e5">indra-ṭilā tāra para</span><br />	<span class="e6">ei rūpa bahu ṭilāmaya [36]</span>
<span class="e2">sūrya-ṭilā</span>–Sūrya’s hill [and] <span class="e2">brahma-ṭilā</span>–Brahmā’s hill <span class="e2">chhilā</span>–were <span class="e2">nṛsiṁha pūrave</span>–to the east of Nṛsiṁha. <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">sthāne</span> <span class="e2">viparyaya haila</span>–the place has changed. <span class="e2">hera</span>–See <span class="e2">gaṇeśera</span> <span class="e2">ṭilā</span>–Gaṇeśa’s hill [and] <span class="e2">indra-ṭilā</span>–Indra’s hill <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">para</span>–behind it. [This place was] <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">ṭilāmaya</span>–filled with many hills <span class="e2">ei rūpa</span>–like these. [36]
“Sūrya’s hill and Brahmā’s hill were to the east of Nṛsiṁha. Now this place has since changed. See Gaṇeśa’s hill and Indra’s hill behind. This place was filled with many hills like these.
বিশ্বকর্ম্মা মহাশয়	<span class="e22">নির্ম্মিলা প্রস্তরময়</span><br />	<span class="e23">কত শত দেবের বসতি ।</span><br />কালে সব লোপ হৈল	<span class="e22">মন্দাকিনী শুকাইল</span><br />	<span class="e23">টিলা মাত্র আছয়ে সম্প্রতি ॥৩৭॥</span>
viśvakarmā mahāśaya	<span class="e5">nirmilā prastaramaya</span><br />	<span class="e6">kata śata devera vasati</span><br />kāle saba lopa haila	<span class="e5">mandākinī śukāila</span><br />	<span class="e6">ṭilā mātra āchhaye samprati [37]</span>
<span class="e2">viśvakarmā</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–The renowned architect of the gods <span class="e2">nirmilā</span>–constructed <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">śata</span>–hundreds <span class="e2">prastaramaya vasati</span>–of stone homes <span class="e2">devera</span>–for the gods. <span class="e2">kāle</span>–In time, <span class="e2">saba</span>–they <span class="e2">lopa</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–decayed, [and] <span class="e2">mandākinī</span>–the Mandākinī <span class="e2">śukāila</span>–dried up. <span class="e2">mātra</span>–Only <span class="e2">ṭilā</span>–the hills <span class="e2">āchhaye</span>–exist <span class="e2">samprati</span>–now. [37]
“The renowned Viśvakarmā constructed hundreds of stone homes for the gods. In time, they decayed, and the Mandākinī dried up. Only the hills remain.
শিলাখণ্ড অগণন	<span class="e22">কর এবে দরশন</span><br />	<span class="e23">সেই সব মন্দিরের শেষ ।</span><br />পুনঃ কিছুদিন পরে	<span class="e22">এক ভক্ত নরবরে</span><br />	<span class="e23">পাবে নৃসিংহের কৃপালেশ ॥৩৮॥</span>
śilā-khaṇḍa agaṇana	<span class="e5">kara ebe daraśana</span><br />	<span class="e6">sei saba mandirera śeṣa</span><br />punaḥ kichhu-dina pare	<span class="e5">eka bhakta nara-vare</span><br />	<span class="e6">pābe nṛsiṁhera kṛpā-leśa [38]</span>
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">daraśana kara</span>–see <span class="e2">śilā-khaṇḍa</span> <span class="e2">agaṇana</span>–the countless broken stones. <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–These <span class="e2">śeṣa</span>–are the remains <span class="e2">mandirera</span>–of the homes [of the gods]. <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–Again, <span class="e2">kichhu-dina</span> <span class="e2">pare</span>–after some time, <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotee <span class="e2">nara-vare</span>–king <span class="e2">pābe</span>–will receive <span class="e2">nṛsiṁhera</span> <span class="e2">kṛpā-leśa</span>–a drop of mercy from Nṛsiṁha. [38]
“See here the countless broken stones. These are the ruins of the homes of the gods. Again in the future, a devotee-king will receive a drop of mercy from Nṛsiṁha.
বৃহৎ মন্দির করি	<span class="e22">বসাইবে নরহরি</span><br />	<span class="e23">পুনঃ সেবা করিবে প্রকাশ ।</span><br />নবদ্বীপ পরিক্রমা	<span class="e22">তাঁর এই এক সীমা</span><br />	<span class="e23">ষোলক্রোশ মধ্যে এই বাস ॥৩৯॥</span>
