bṛhat mandira kari’	<span class="e5">vasāibe narahari</span><br />	<span class="e6">punaḥ sevā karibe prakāśa</span><br />navadvīpa parikramā	<span class="e5">tā̐ra ei eka sīmā</span><br />	<span class="e6">ṣola-krośa madhye ei vāsa [39]</span>
<span class="e2">bṛhat</span> <span class="e2">mandira</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–He will make a grand Temple, <span class="e2">vasāibe</span>–establish <span class="e2">narahari</span>–Nṛsiṁha [there, and] <span class="e2">prakāśa karibe</span>–manifest [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">sevā</span>–worship <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">vāsa</span>–place [is] <span class="e2">madhye</span>–within <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–the thirty-two miles [of Nabadwīp and is] <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">sīmā</span>–of the boundaries <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span> <span class="e2">parikramā</span> <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–of the Nabadwīp parikramā. [39]
“He will build a grand Temple, establish Nṛsiṁha there, and resume His worship. This place is within the thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp and is one of the boundaries of the route to circumambulate Nabadwīp Dhām.”
নিতাইজাহ্নবাপদ	<span class="e22">যে জনার সম্পদ</span><br />	<span class="e23">সেই ভক্তিবিনোদ কাঙ্গাল ।</span><br />নবদ্বীপ সুমহিমা	<span class="e22">নাহি তার কভু সীমা</span><br />	<span class="e23">তাহা গায় ছাড়ি’ মায়াজাল ॥৪০॥</span>
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada	<span class="e5">ye janāra sampada</span><br />	<span class="e6">sei bhakti-vinoda kāṅgāla</span><br />navadvīpa sumahimā	<span class="e5">nāhi tāra kabhu sīmā</span><br />	<span class="e6">tāhā gāya chhāḍi’ māyā-jāla [40]</span>
<span class="e2">sei kāṅgāla</span>–The humble <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">janāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">sampada</span>–wealth [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada</span>–the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">tāhā sumahimā</span>–the glories <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">tāra</span>–which <span class="e2">kabhu nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">sīmā</span>–end, [and] <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leaves behind <span class="e2">māyā-jāla</span>–the net of māyā. [40]
The humble Bhakti Vinod, whose wealth is the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, chants the unending glories of Nabadwīp and thus leaves behind the net of māyā.

Chapter Eight
Śrī Harihara Kṣetra, Śrī Vārāṇasī, and Śrī Godruma
জয় জয় জয় শ্রীশচীসূত ।<br />জয় জয় জয় শ্রীঅবধূত ॥১॥
jaya jaya jaya śrī-śachī-sūta<br />jaya jaya jaya śrī-avadhūta [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span> <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-sūta</span>–to the son of Śachī, Śrī Chaitanya! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span> <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrī-avadhūta</span>–to the renunciant Nityānanda Prabhu! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī! All glory to the Avadhūt!
সীতাপতি জয় ভকতরাজ ।<br />গদাধর জয় ভক্তসমাজ ॥২॥
sītāpati jaya bhakata-rāja<br />gadādhara jaya bhakta-samāja [2]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">sītāpati</span>–to Advaita Āchārya, <span class="e2">bhakata-rāja</span>–the leader of the devotees! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar [and] <span class="e2">bhakta-samāja</span>–all the devotees! [2]
All glory to Advaita Āchārya, the leader of the devotees! All glory to Gadādhar and all the devotees!
জয় নবদ্বীপ সুন্দরধাম ।<br />জয় জয় জয় গৌর কি নাম ॥৩॥
jaya navadvīpa sundara-dhāma<br />jaya jaya jaya gaura ki nāma [3]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span> <span class="e2">sundara-dhāma</span>–to beautiful Nabadwīp Dhām! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span> <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaura</span> <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–to the Name of Gaura! [3]
All glory to beautiful Nabadwīp Dhām! All glory to the Name of Gaura!
নিতাই সহিত ভক্তগণ ।<br />“হরি হরি”বলি’ চলে তখন ॥৪॥
nitāi sahita bhakta-gaṇa<br />“hari hari” bali’ chale takhana [4]
<span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi, <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">chale</span>–departed, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanting <span class="e2">“hari</span> <span class="e2">hari</span>–“Hari! Hari!” [4]
Nitāi and the devotees then departed, chanting “Hari! Hari!”
ভাবে ঢল ঢল নিতাই চলে ।<br />প্রেমে আধ আধ বচন বলে ॥৫॥
bhāve ḍhala ḍhala nitāi chale<br />preme ādha ādha vachana bale [5]
<span class="e2">ḍhala</span> <span class="e2">ḍhala</span>–Swaying to and fro <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–in ecstasy, <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi <span class="e2">chale</span>–walked [and] <span class="e2">ādha</span> <span class="e2">ādha</span> <span class="e2">vachana</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–stammered <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. [5]
Swaying to and fro in ecstasy, Nitāi walked and stammered with divine love.
ঝর ঝর ঝরে আঁখির জল ।<br />“গোরা গোরা” বলি’ হয় বিকল ॥৬॥
jhara jhara jhare ā̐khira jala<br />“gorā gorā” bali’ haya vikala [6]
<span class="e2">jala</span>–Tears <span class="e2">jhara</span> <span class="e2">jhara</span> <span class="e2">jhare</span>–streamed <span class="e2">ā̐khira</span>–from [His] eyes. <span class="e2">bali’</span>–Chanting, <span class="e2">“gorā</span> <span class="e2">gorā”</span>–“Gorā! Gorā!”, <span class="e2">vikala haya</span>–He became overwhelmed. [6]
Tears streamed from His eyes. Chanting, “Gorā! Gorā!”, He became overwhelmed.
ঝক্মক্ করে ভূষণ মাল ।<br />রূপে দশদিক হইল আল ॥৭॥
jhakmak kare bhūṣaṇa māla<br />rūpe daśa-dika ha-ila āla [7]
[His] <span class="e2">bhūṣaṇa</span>–ornaments [and] <span class="e2">māla</span>–garlands <span class="e2">jhakmak</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–sparkled, [and] <span class="e2">daśa-dika</span>–the ten directions <span class="e2">āla ha-ila</span>–became illumined <span class="e2">rūpe</span>–by [His] form. [7]
His ornaments and garlands sparkled, and His form illumined the ten directions.
শ্রীবাস নাচিছে জীবের সনে ।<br />কভু কাঁদে কভু নাচে সঘনে ॥৮॥
śrīvāsa nāchichhe jīvera sane<br />kabhu kā̐de kabhu nāche saghane [8]
<span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās <span class="e2">nāchichhe</span>–danced <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with Jīva. <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–they cried, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">nāche</span>–they danced <span class="e2">saghane</span>–continuously. [8]
Śrīvās danced with Jīva. Sometimes they cried, and sometimes they danced continuously.
আর যত সব ভক্তগণ ।<br />নাচিতে নাচিতে চলে তখন ॥৯॥
āra yata saba bhakta-gaṇa<br />nāchite nāchite chale takhana [9]
<span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–All the other <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–devotees <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">nāchite</span> <span class="e2">nāchite</span>–danced while <span class="e2">chale</span>–they walked. [9]
All the other devotees danced as they walked.
অলকানন্দার নিকটে আসি’ ।<br />বলেন নিতাই আনন্দে ভাসি’ ॥১০॥
alakānandāra nikaṭe āsi’<br />balena nitāi ānande bhāsi’ [10]
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–Coming <span class="e2">alakānandāra</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–near the Alakānandā, <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi <span class="e2">balena</span>–spoke, <span class="e2">bhāsi’</span>–floating <span class="e2">ānande</span>–in joy. [10]
Coming to the Alakānandā River, Nitāi spoke, floating in joy.
“বিল্বপক্ষগ্রাম পশ্চিমে ধরি’ ।<br />মন্দাকিনী আসে নদীয়া ঘেরি’ ॥১১॥
“bilvapakṣa-grama paśchime dhari’<br />mandākinī āse nadīyā gheri [11]
<span class="e2">dhari’</span>–Flowing <span class="e2">bilvapakṣa-grama</span> <span class="e2">paśchime</span>–west of the village of Bilvapakṣa, <span class="e2">mandākinī</span>–the Mandākinī <span class="e2">āse</span>–comes [and] <span class="e2">gheri’</span>–surrounds <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–Nadia. [11]
“Flowing west of Bilvapakṣa Grām, the Gaṅgā comes and surrounds Nadia.
সুবর্ণবিহার দেখিলে যথা ।<br />মন্দাকিনী ছাড়ে অলকা তথা ॥১২॥
suvarṇa-bihāra dekhile yathā<br />mandākinī chhāḍe alakā tathā [12]
<span class="e2">mandākinī</span>–The Mandākinī <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–leaves <span class="e2">alakā</span>–the Alakānandā <span class="e2">yathā tathā</span>–where <span class="e2">dekhile</span>–we saw <span class="e2">suvarṇa-bihāra</span>–Suvarṇa Bihār. [12]
“Then she separates from the Alakānandā where we saw Suvarṇa Bihār.
অলকানন্দার পূরব পারে ।<br />হরিহরক্ষেত্র গণ্ডক ধারে ॥১৩॥
alakānandāra pūrava pāre<br />harihara-kṣetra gaṇḍaka dhāre [13]
<span class="e2">pūrava</span> <span class="e2">pāre</span>–On the eastern shore <span class="e2">alakānandāra</span>–of the Alakānandā, <span class="e2">gaṇḍaka</span> <span class="e2">dhāre</span>–beside the Gaṇḍaka River, [is] <span class="e2">harihara-kṣetra</span>–Harihara Kṣetra. [13]
“On the eastern shore of the Alakānandā, beside the Gaṇḍaka River, is Harihara Kṣetra.
শ্রীমূর্ত্তি প্রকাশ হইবে কালে ।<br />সুন্দর কানন শোভিবে ভালে ॥১৪॥
śrī-mūrti prakāśa ha-ibe kāle<br />sundara kānana śobhibe bhāle [14]
<span class="e2">kāle</span>–In time, <span class="e2">śrī-mūrti</span>–a Deity <span class="e2">prakāśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will manifest [there, and] <span class="e2">sundara</span> <span class="e2">kānana</span>–a beautiful forest <span class="e2">śobhibe</span>–will shine <span class="e2">bhāle</span>–gloriously. [14]
“In time, a Deity will manifest there, and a beautiful forest will shine gloriously.
অলকা পশ্চিমে দেখহ কাশী ।<br />শৈব শাক্ত সেবে মুকতিদাসী ॥১৫॥
alakā paśchime dekhaha kāśī<br />śaiva śākta seve mukati-dāsī [15]
<span class="e2">dekhaha</span>–See <span class="e2">kāśī</span>–Kāśī <span class="e2">paśchime</span>–to the west <span class="e2">alakā</span>–of the Alakānandā. [There,] <span class="e2">śaiva</span>–the followers of Śiva [and] <span class="e2">śākta</span>–the followers of Śakti, Pārvatī, <span class="e2">seve</span>–worship <span class="e2">mukati-dāsī</span>–the maidservant Liberation (the goddess of liberation, who serves the devotees as a maidservant). [15]
“See Kāśī to the west of the Alakānandā. There the followers of Śiva and Śakti worship the maidservant Liberation.
বারাণসী হতে এ ধাম পর ।<br />হেথায় ধূর্জ্জটী পিনাকধর ॥১৬॥
‘গৌর গৌর’ বলি’ সদাই নাচে ।<br />নিজজনে গৌরভকতি যাচে ॥১৭॥
vārāṇasī hate e dhāma para<br />hethāya dhūrjaṭī pināka-dhara [16]
‘gaura gaura’ bali’ sadāi nāche<br />nija-jane gaura-bhakati yāche [17]
<span class="e2">e</span>–This <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode [is] <span class="e2">hate</span> <span class="e2">para</span>–above <span class="e2">vārāṇasī</span>–Vārāṇasī [because] <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">dhūrjaṭī</span>–Lord Śiva <span class="e2">sadāi</span>–constantly <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chants <span class="e2">‘gaura</span> <span class="e2">gaura’</span>–“Gaura! Gaura!”, <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dances <span class="e2">pināka-dhara</span>–holding [his] trident, [and] <span class="e2">yāche</span>–offers <span class="e2">nija-jane</span>–his followers <span class="e2">gaura-bhakati</span>–devotion to Gaura. [16<span class="e2">–</span>17]
“This place is superior to Vārāṇasī because here Lord Śiva constantly chants, “Gaura! Gaura!”, dances holding his trident, and offers his followers devotion to Gaura.
সহস্র বরষ কাশীতে বসি’ ।<br />লভে যে মুকতি জ্ঞানেতে ন্যাসী ॥১৮॥
তাহা ত হেথায় চরণে ঠেলি’ ।<br />নাচেন ভকত ‘গৌরাঙ্গ’ বলি’ ॥১৯॥
sahasra varaṣa kāśīte vasi’<br />labhe ye mukati jñānete nyāsī [18]
tāhā ta hethāya charaṇe ṭheli’<br />nāchena bhakata ‘gaurāṅga’ bali’ [19]
<span class="e2">hethāya</span>–Here, <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–devotees <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chant <span class="e2">‘gaurāṅga’</span>–‘Gaurāṅga’, <span class="e2">nāchena</span>–dance, [and] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span> <span class="e2">ṭheli’</span>–kick away <span class="e2">ye tāhā</span> <span class="e2">mukati</span>–the liberation [that] <span class="e2">nyāsī</span>–renunciants <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–by residing <span class="e2">kāśīte</span>–in Kāśī [and] <span class="e2">jñānete</span>–acquiring knowledge <span class="e2">sahasra</span> <span class="e2">varaṣa</span>–for a thousand years. [18<span class="e2">–</span>19]
“Here, devotees chant Gaurāṅga’s Name, dance, and kick away the liberation that sannyāsīs attain by residing in Kāśī and practising jñāna-yoga for a thousand years.
নির্য্যাণ সময়ে এখানে জীব ।<br />কাণে ‘গৌর’ বলি’ তারেন শিব ॥২০॥
niryāṇa samaye ekhāne jīva<br />kāṇe ‘gaura’ bali’ tārena śiva [20]
<span class="e2">ekhāne</span>–Here, <span class="e2">samaye</span>–at the time <span class="e2">jīva</span>–of souls’ <span class="e2">niryāṇa</span>–passing away, <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chants <span class="e2">‘gaura’</span>–‘Gaura’ <span class="e2">kāṇe</span>–into [their] ears [and] <span class="e2">tārena</span>–delivers [them]. [20]
“Here, when souls pass away, Śiva chants the Name of Gaura into their ears and delivers them.
মহাবারাণসী এ ধাম হয় ।<br />জীবের মরণে নাহিক ভয়” ॥২১॥
mahāvārāṇasī e dhāma haya<br />jīvera maraṇe nāhika bhaya” [21]
<span class="e2">e</span>–This <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–place <span class="e2">haya</span>–is [thus] <span class="e2">mahāvārāṇasī</span>–‘Great Vārāṇasī’. <span class="e2">jīvera bhaya nāhika</span>–Souls have no fear <span class="e2">maraṇe”</span>–of death [here].” [21]
“This place is thus Mahāvārāṇasī. Souls have no fear of death here.”
এ৩ বলি’ তথা নিতাই নাচে ।<br />গৌরহরিপ্রেম জীবের যাচে ॥২২॥
eta bali’ tathā nitāi nāche<br />gaurahari-prema jīvere yāche [22]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there [and] <span class="e2">yāche</span>–offered <span class="e2">jīvere</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">gaurahari-prema</span>–divine love for Gaurahari. [22]
Saying this, Nitāi danced and offered Jīva divine love for Gaurahari.
অলক্ষ্যে তখন কৈলাস-পতি ।<br />নিতাই চরণে করিল নতি ॥২৩॥
alakṣye takhana kailāsa-pati<br />nitāi charaṇe karila nati [23]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then <span class="e2">kailāsa-pati</span>–the Lord of Kailās <span class="e2">alakṣye</span>–invisibly <span class="e2">nati karila</span>–bowed <span class="e2">nitāi</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet of Nitāi. [23]
Lord Śiva then invisibly bowed at the feet of Nitāi.
গৌরীসহ শিব গৌরাঙ্গনাম ।<br />গাইয়া গাইয়া পূরয় কাম ॥২৪॥
gaurī-saha śiva gaurāṅga-nāma<br />gāiyā gāiyā pūraya kāma [24]
<span class="e2">gāiyā</span> <span class="e2">gāiyā</span>–Chanting <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">gaurī-saha</span>–and Pārvatī <span class="e2">pūraya</span>–fulfilled [their] <span class="e2">kāma</span>–desires. [24]
Chanting the Name of Gaurāṅga, Śiva and Pārvatī fulfilled their desires.
স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর নিতাই তবে ।<br />ভকত-সঙ্গেতে চলিল যবে ॥২৫॥
svatantra īśvara nitāi tabe<br />bhakata-saṅgete chalila yabe [25]
<span class="e2">yabe tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">svatantra</span> <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–the independent Lord, <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi, <span class="e2">chalila</span>–left <span class="e2">bhakata-saṅgete</span>–with the devotees. [25]
Then the independent Lord, Nitāi, left with the devotees.
গাদিগাছা-গ্রামে পোঁছিল আসি’ ।<br />তথায় আসিয়া কহিল হাসি’ ॥২৬॥
gādigāchhā-grāme pau̐chhila āsi’<br />tathāya āsiyā kahila hāsi’ [26]
<span class="e2">āsi’ pau̐chhila</span>–Nitāi arrived <span class="e2">gādigāchhā-grāme</span>–in the village of Gādigāchhā. <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–There, <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–Nityānanda came over [and] <span class="e2">kahila</span>–spoke, <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–smiling. [26]
Arriving in Gādigāchhā Grām, Nityānanda came over and spoke, smiling.
“গোদ্রুম নামেতে এ দ্বীপ হয় ।<br />সুরভি সতত এখানে রয় ॥২৭॥
“godruma nāmete e dvīpa haya<br />surabhi satata ekhāne raya [27]
<span class="e2">“e</span>–“This <span class="e2">dvīpa</span>–island <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–known as <span class="e2">godruma</span>–Godruma. <span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">raya</span>–resides <span class="e2">ekhāne</span>–here <span class="e2">satata</span>–eternally. [27]
“This island is called Godruma. Surabhi resides here eternally.
কৃষ্ণমায়াবশে দেবেন্দ্র যবে ।<br />ভাসায় গোকুল নিজ গৌরবে ॥২৮॥
গোবর্দ্ধনগিরি ধরিয়া হরি ।<br />রক্ষিল গোকুল যতন করি’ ॥২৯॥
kṛṣṇa-māyā-vaśe devendra yabe<br />bhāsāya gokula nija gaurave [28]
govardhana-giri dhariyā hari<br />rakṣila gokula yatana kari’ [29]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">devendra</span>–Indra, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-māyā-vaśe</span>–bewildered by Kṛṣṇa’s illusion, <span class="e2">bhāsāya</span>–flooded <span class="e2">gokula</span>–Gokula <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">gaurave</span>–with his powerful rains, <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">dhariyā</span>–lifted <span class="e2">govardhana-giri</span>–Govardhan Hill [and] <span class="e2">yatana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–carefully <span class="e2">rakṣila</span>–protected <span class="e2">gokula</span>–Gokula. [28<span class="e2">–</span>29]
“When Indra, bewildered by Kṛṣṇa’s illusion, flooded Gokula with his powerful rains, Kṛṣṇa lifted Govardhan Hill and carefully protected Gokula.
ইন্দ্রদর্পচূর্ণ হইলে পর ।<br />শচীপতি চিনে শারঙ্গধর ॥৩০॥
indra-darpa-chūrṇa ha-ile para<br />śachī-pati chine śāraṅga-dhara [30]
<span class="e2">para</span>–After <span class="e2">indra-darpa-chūrṇa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–Indra’s pride was crushed, <span class="e2">śachī-pati</span>–Indra <span class="e2">chine</span>–recognised <span class="e2">śāraṅga-dhara</span>–Kṛṣṇa. [30]
“After Indra’s pride was crushed, Indra recognised Kṛṣṇa.
নিজ অপরাধ মার্জ্জন তরে ।<br />পড়িল কৃষ্ণের চরণ ধরে ॥৩১॥
nija aparādha mārjana tare<br />paḍila kṛṣṇera charaṇa dhare [31]
<span class="e2">mārjana</span> <span class="e2">tare</span>–To clear <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offence, <span class="e2">paḍila</span>–he bowed [and] <span class="e2">dhare</span>–grasped <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–the feet of Kṛṣṇa. [31]
“To clear his offence, he bowed and grasped the feet of Kṛṣṇa.
দয়ার সমুদ্র নন্দতনয় ।<br />ক্ষমিল ইন্দ্রেরে দিল অভয় ॥৩২॥
dayāra samudra nanda-tanaya<br />kṣamila indrere dila abhaya [32]
<span class="e2">nanda-tanaya</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">dayāra</span> <span class="e2">samudra</span>–the ocean of mercy, <span class="e2">kṣamila</span>–forgave <span class="e2">indrere</span>–Indra [and] <span class="e2">dila</span>–gave [him] <span class="e2">abhaya</span>–[the boon of] fearlessness. [32]
“Kṛṣṇa, the ocean of mercy, forgave Indra and gave him the boon of fearlessness.
তথাপি ইন্দ্রের রহিল ভয় ।<br />সুরভি নিকটে তখন কয় ॥৩৩॥
tathāpi indrera rahila bhaya<br />surabhi nikaṭe takhana kaya [33]
<span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">indrera</span> <span class="e2">bhaya</span> <span class="e2">rahila</span>–Indra remained fearful. <span class="e2">kaya</span>–He spoke <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">surabhi</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–to nearby Surabhi. [33]
“Still, Indra remained fearful. He then spoke to Surabhi.
‘কৃষ্ণলীলা মুই বুঝিতে নারি ।<br />অপরাধ মম হইল ভারি ॥৩৪॥
‘kṛṣṇa-līlā mui bujhite nāri<br />aparādha mama ha-ila bhāri [34]
<span class="e2">‘mui</span>–‘I <span class="e2">bujhite</span> <span class="e2">nāri</span>–could not understand <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā</span>–the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–I made <span class="e2">bhāri aparādha</span>–a very heavy offence. [34]
“‘I could not understand the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa, and I committed a very heavy offence.
শুনেছি কলিতে ব্রজেন্দ্রসুত ।<br />করিবে নদীয়া-লীলা অদ্ভূত ॥৩৫॥
śunechhi kalite vrajendra-suta<br />karibe nadīyā-līlā adbhūta [35]
<span class="e2">śunechhi</span>–I have heard [that] <span class="e2">kalite</span>–during Kali-yuga, <span class="e2">vrajendra-suta</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will perform <span class="e2">adbhūta</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–in Nadia. [35]
“‘I have heard that during Kali-yuga, Kṛṣṇa will perform wonderful Pastimes in Nadia.
পাছে সে সময় মোহিত হব ।<br />অপরাধী পুনঃ হয়ে রহিব ॥৩৬॥
pāchhe se samaya mohita haba<br />aparādhī punaḥ haye rahiba [36]
<span class="e2">pāchhe</span>–At <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">samaya</span>–that time, <span class="e2">mohita</span> <span class="e2">haba</span>–I will become bewildered [and] <span class="e2">rahiba</span>–be <span class="e2">aparādhī</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–an offender <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. [36]
“‘At that time, I will become bewildered and be an offender again.
তুমি ত সুরভি সকল জান ।<br />করহ এখন তাহার বিধান’ ॥৩৭॥
tumi ta surabhi sakala jāna<br />karaha ekhana tāhāra vidhāna’ [37]
<span class="e2">surabhi</span>–O Surabhi, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">jāna</span>–know <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span>–everything. <span class="e2">vidhāna karaha</span>–Please advise [me] <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–about this <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now. [37]
“‘O Surabhi, you know everything. Please advise me about this.’
সুরভি বলিল, ‘চলহ যাই ।<br />নবদ্বীপধামে ভজি’ নিমাই’ ॥৩৮॥
surabhi balila, ‘chalaha yāi<br />navadvīpa-dhāme bhaji’ nimāi’ [38]
<span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘chalaha</span> <span class="e2">yāi</span>–‘Let us go [and] <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–serve <span class="e2">nimāi</span>–Nimāi <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme’</span>–in Nabadwīp Dhām.’ [38]
“Surabhi said, ‘Let us go and serve Nimāi in Nabadwīp Dhām.’
দেবেন্দ্র সুরভি হেথায় আসি’ ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ ভজন করিল বসি’ ॥৩৯॥
devendra surabhi hethāya āsi’<br />gaurāṅga bhajana karila vasi’ [39]
<span class="e2">devendra</span>–Indra [and] <span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">āsi’ vasi’</span>–moved <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">bhajana</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga. [39]
“Indra and Surabhi moved here and worshipped Gaurāṅga.
গৌরাঙ্গ ভজন সহজ অতি ।<br />সহজ তাহার ফল বিততি ॥৪০॥
gaurāṅga bhajana sahaja ati<br />sahaja tāhāra phala vitati [40]
<span class="e2">bhajana</span>–Worshipping <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga [is] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">sahaja</span>–easy, [and] <span class="e2">phala</span>–the results <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–of doing so <span class="e2">vitati</span>–are distributed <span class="e2">sahaja</span>–easily. [40]
“Worshipping Gaurāṅga is very easy, and the results of doing so are easily distributed.
‘গৌরাঙ্গ’ বলিয়া ক্রন্দন করে ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ দর্শন হয় সত্বরে ॥৪১॥
‘gaurāṅga’ baliyā krandana kare<br />gaurāṅga darśana haya satvare [41]
<span class="e2">krandana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–They cried, <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–chanting <span class="e2">‘gaurāṅga’</span>–‘Gaurāṅga’, [and] <span class="e2">satvare</span>–immediately <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–saw <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga. [41]
“They cried, chanting the Name of Gaurāṅga, and immediately saw Him.
কিবা অপরূপ রূপ-লাবণি ।<br />দেখিল গৌরাঙ্গ প্রতিমাখানি ॥৪২॥
আধ আধ হাসি’ বরদ রূপ ।<br />প্রেমে গদগদ রসের কূপ ॥৪৩॥
kibā aparūpa rūpa-lāvaṇi<br />dekhila gaurāṅga pratimā-khāni [42]
ādha ādha hāsi’ varada rūpa<br />preme gada-gada rasera kūpa [43]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–How <span class="e2">aparūpa</span>–extraordinary [is His] <span class="e2">rūpa-lāvaṇi</span>–beauty and figure! <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–They saw <span class="e2">pratimā-khāni</span>–the figure <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–of Gaurāṅga— <span class="e2">varada</span> <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–the embodiment of benevolence, <span class="e2">rasera</span> <span class="e2">kūpa</span>–the well of rasa— <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–smiling [and] <span class="e2">ādha</span> <span class="e2">ādha</span>–stammering, <span class="e2">gada-gada</span>–choked <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. [42–43]
“How extraordinary is His beauty and form! They saw the figure of Gaurāṅga—the embodiment of benevolence, the well of rasa—smiling and stammering, choked with divine love.
হাসিয়া বলেন ঠাকুর মোর ।<br />‘জানিনু বাসনা অমি ত তোর ॥৪৪॥
hāsiyā balena ṭhākura mora<br />‘jāninu vāsanā āmi ta tora [44]
<span class="e2">hāsiyā</span>–Smiling, <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–Lord <span class="e2">balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I <span class="e2">jāninu</span>–know <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">tora</span>–your <span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–desire. [44]
“Smiling, My Lord said, ‘I know your desire.
অল্পদিন আছে প্রকটকাল ।<br />নদীয়ানগরে দেখিবে ভাল ॥৪৫॥
alpa-dina āchhe prakaṭa-kāla<br />nadīyā-nagare dekhibe bhāla [45]
<span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There is [only] <span class="e2">alpa-dina</span>–a short time [until] <span class="e2">prakaṭa-kāla</span>–the time of [My] appearance <span class="e2">nadīyā-nagare</span>–in the town of Nadia, [and] <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–you will see [Me] <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fully [then]. [45]
“‘I will appear in Nadia soon, and you will see Me fully then.
সে লীলা সময়ে সেবিবে মোরে ।<br />মায়াজাল আর না ধরে তোরে’ ॥৪৬॥
se līlā samaye sevibe more<br />māyā-jāla āra nā dhare tore’ [46]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">līlā</span> <span class="e2">samaye</span>–During the time of those Pastimes, <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–you will serve <span class="e2">more</span>–Me, [and] <span class="e2">māyā-jāla</span>–the net of māyā <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">dhare nā</span>–will no longer bind <span class="e2">tore’</span>–you.’ [46]
“‘During those Pastimes, you will serve Me, and the net of māyā will no longer bind you.’
এত বলি’ প্রভু অদৃশ্য হয় ।<br />সুরভি সুন্দরী তথায় রয় ॥৪৭॥
eta bali’ prabhu adṛśya haya<br />surabhi sundarī tathāya raya [47]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">adṛśya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">surabhi</span> <span class="e2">sundarī</span>–Beautiful Surabhi <span class="e2">raya</span>–remained <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–there. [47]
“Saying this, the Lord disappeared. Beautiful Surabhi remained there.
অশ্বত্থ নিকটে রহিলা দেবী ।<br />নিরন্তর গৌরচরণ সেবি’ ॥৪৮॥
aśvattha nikaṭe rahilā devī<br />nirantara gaura-charaṇa sevi’ [48]
<span class="e2">devī</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">rahilā</span>–stayed <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–near <span class="e2">aśvattha</span>–a banyan tree [and] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–constantly <span class="e2">sevi’</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">gaura-charaṇa</span>–the feet of Gaura. [48]
“She stayed near a banyan tree and constantly worshipped the feet of Gaura.
গোদ্রুমদ্বীপ ত হইল নাম ।<br />হেথায় পূরয় ভকত-কাম ॥৪৯॥
godrumadvīpa ta ha-ila nāma<br />hethāya pūraya bhakata-kāma [49]
[This place] <span class="e2">nāma ta ha-ila</span>–became known as <span class="e2">godrumadvīpa</span>–Godrumadwīp (‘cow-tree island’). <span class="e2">pūraya</span>–The Lord fulfils <span class="e2">bhakata-kāma</span>–the desires of the devotees <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. [49]
“This place thus became known as Godrumadwīp. The Lord fulfils the desires of the devotees here.
হেথায় কুটীর বাঁধিয়া ভজে ।<br />অনায়াসে গৌরচরণে মজে ॥৫০॥
hethāya kuṭīra bā̐dhiyā bhaje<br />anāyāse gaura-charaṇe maje [50]
<span class="e2">bā̐dhiyā</span>–Anyone who builds <span class="e2">kuṭīra</span>–a hut [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serves <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">maje</span>–becomes immersed <span class="e2">gaura-charaṇe</span>–in the feet of Gaura. [50]
“Anyone who builds a hut and serves here easily becomes immersed in the feet of Gaura.
এই দ্বীপে কভু মৃকণ্ডসুত ।<br />প্রলয়ে আছিল কথা অদ্ভুত ॥৫১॥
ei dvīpe kabhu mṛkaṇḍa-suta<br />pralaye āchhila kathā adbhuta [51]
[There is] <span class="e2">adbhuta kathā</span>–a wonderful story <span class="e2">mṛkaṇḍa-suta</span>–about Mārkaṇḍeya Muni, <span class="e2">āchhila</span>–who was present <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–once <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dvīpe</span>–on this island <span class="e2">pralaye</span>–during the destruction of the universe. [51]
“There is a wonderful story about Mārkaṇḍeya Muni, who was present on this island during the destruction of the universe.
সাতকল্প আয়ু পাইল মুনি ।<br />প্রলয়ে বড়ই বিপদ্ গণি’ ॥৫২॥
sāta-kalpa āyu pāila muni<br />pralaye baḍa-i vipad gaṇi’ [52]
<span class="e2">muni</span>–The sage <span class="e2">pāila</span>–attained <span class="e2">āyu</span>–a lifetime <span class="e2">sāta-kalpa</span>–of seven kalpas (cycles of creation and destruction of the universe), [and] <span class="e2">pralaye</span>–during the destruction of the universe, <span class="e2">gaṇi’</span>–he underwent <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span> <span class="e2">vipad</span>–great difficulty. [52]
“Mārkaṇḍeya Muni attained a lifetime of seven kalpas, and during the destruction of the universe, he underwent great difficulty.
জলময় হৈল সমস্ত স্থান ।<br />কোথা বা রহিবে করে সন্ধান ॥৫৩॥
jalamaya haila samasta sthāna<br />kothā vā rahibe kare sandhāna [53]
<span class="e2">samasta</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–Everything <span class="e2">jalamaya</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–became submerged in water, [and] <span class="e2">sandhāna kare</span>–he searched [for] <span class="e2">kothā</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–somewhere <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–he could stay. [53]
“Everything became submerged in water, and he searched for a place to stay.
ভাসিয়া ভাসিয়া চলিয়া যায় ।<br />‘কেন হেন বর লইনু হায়’ ॥৫৪॥
bhāsiyā bhāsiyā chaliyā yāya<br />‘kena hena vara la-inu hāya’ [54]
<span class="e2">chaliyā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–Moving about, <span class="e2">bhāsiyā</span> <span class="e2">bhāsiyā</span>–floating and floating, [he thought,] <span class="e2">‘hāya</span>–‘Alas! <span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">la-inu</span>–have I taken <span class="e2">hena</span>–this <span class="e2">vara’</span>–boon?’ [54]
“Floating and floating about, he thought, ‘Alas! Why have I taken this boon?’
ষোলক্রোশ মাত্র নদীয়াধাম ।<br />জাগিয়া ভকতে দেয় বিশ্রাম ॥৫৫॥
ṣola-krośa mātra nadīyā-dhāma<br />jāgiyā bhakate deya viśrāma [55]
<span class="e2">mātra</span>–Only <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–the thirty-two miles <span class="e2">nadīyā-dhāma</span>–of Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">jāgiyā</span>–arise [and] <span class="e2">deya</span>–give <span class="e2">viśrāma</span>–shelter <span class="e2">bhakate</span>–to the devotees. [55]
“During the destruction, only the thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp Dhām arise and give shelter to the devotees.
জলের তরঙ্গে ভাসিয়া মুনি ।<br />অজ্ঞান হইয়া পড়ে অমনি ॥৫৬॥
jalera taraṅge bhāsiyā muni<br />ajñāna ha-iyā paḍe amani [56]
<span class="e2">bhāsiyā</span>–Floating <span class="e2">jalera</span> <span class="e2">taraṅge</span>–in the waves of the water, <span class="e2">muni</span>–the sage <span class="e2">amani</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">ajñāna</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span> <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–lost consciousness. [56]
“Floating in the waves of the water, the sage suddenly lost consciousness.
মহাকৃপা করি’ সুরভি তায় ।<br />যতনে মুনিরে হেথা উঠায় ॥৫৭॥
mahākṛpā kari’ surabhi tāya<br />yatane munire hethā uṭhāya [57]
<span class="e2">mahākṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Being very merciful <span class="e2">tāya</span>–to him, <span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">yatane</span>–carefully <span class="e2">uṭhāya</span>–brought <span class="e2">munire</span>–the sage <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [57]
“Being very merciful to him, Surabhi carefully rescued the sage.
সম্বিৎ লভিয়া মৃকণ্ডসুত ।<br />দেখিল গোদ্রুমদ্বীপ অদ্ভুত ॥৫৮॥
samvit labhiyā mṛkaṇḍa-suta<br />dekhila godrumadvīpa adbhuta [58]
<span class="e2">labhiyā</span>–Regaining <span class="e2">samvit</span>–consciousness, <span class="e2">mṛkaṇḍa-suta</span>–Mārkaṇḍeya Muni <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–saw <span class="e2">adbhuta</span>–the wonders <span class="e2">godrumadvīpa</span>–of Godrumadwīp. [58]
“Regaining consciousness, Mārkaṇḍeya Muni saw the wonders of Godrumadwīp.
শতকোটিক্রোশ বিস্তার স্থান ।<br />নদনদী শোভা প্রকাশমান ॥৫৯॥
śata-koṭī-krośa vistāra sthāna<br />nada-nadī śobhā prakāśamāna [59]
[He saw] <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–an abode <span class="e2">vistāra</span>–spanning <span class="e2">śata-koṭī-krośa</span>–two billion miles around, <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">prakāśamāna</span>–resplendent <span class="e2">nada-nadī</span>–with rivers and streams. [59]
“He saw an abode spanning two billion miles around, resplendent with rivers and streams.
তরুলতা কত শোভয় তথা ।<br />পক্ষিগণ গায় শ্রীগৌর-গাথা ॥৬০॥
taru-latā kata śobhaya tathā<br />pakṣi-gaṇa gāya śrī-gaura-gāthā [60]
<span class="e2">kata</span>–Numerous <span class="e2">taru-latā</span>–trees and vines <span class="e2">śobhaya</span>–were shining <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, [and] <span class="e2">pakṣi-gaṇa</span>–birds <span class="e2">gāya</span>–were chanting <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-gāthā</span>–the glories of Śrī Gaura. [60]
“Numerous trees and vines were shining, and birds were chanting the glories of Śrī Gaura.
যোজনবিস্তার অশ্বত্থ হের ।<br />সুরভিকে তথা দর্শন কর ॥৬১॥
yojana-vistāra aśvattha hera<br />surabhike tathā darśana kara [61]
<span class="e2">hera</span>–He saw <span class="e2">aśvattha</span>–a banyan tree [that was] <span class="e2">yojana-vistāra</span>–eight miles wide, [and] <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–he saw <span class="e2">surabhike</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">tathā</span>–beneath [it]. [61]
“He saw a banyan tree that was eight miles wide, and he saw Surabhi beneath it.
ক্ষুধায় আকুল মুনি তখন ।<br />সুরভির প্রতি বলে বচন ॥৬২॥
kṣudhāya ākula muni takhana<br />surabhira prati bale vachana [62]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">ākula</span>–stricken <span class="e2">kṣudhāya</span>–with hunger, <span class="e2">muni</span>–the sage <span class="e2">vachana bale</span>–spoke <span class="e2">surabhira</span> <span class="e2">prati</span>–to Surabhi. [62]
“Stricken with hunger, the sage spoke to Surabhi.
‘তুমি ভগবতি রাখহ প্রাণ ।<br />দুগ্ধ দিয়া মোর করহ ত্রাণ’ ॥৬৩॥
‘tumi bhagavati rākhaha prāṇa<br />dugdha diyā mora karaha trāṇa’ [63]
<span class="e2">‘bhagavati</span>–‘O goddess! <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">rākhaha</span>–Please save [my] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–life. <span class="e2">mora trāṇa karaha</span>–Rescue me <span class="e2">diyā</span>–by giving [me] <span class="e2">dugdha’</span>–some milk.’ [63]
“‘O goddess! Please save my life. Rescue me by giving me some milk.’
সুরভি তখন সদয় হয়ে ।<br />পিয়াইল দুগ্ধ মুনিরে লয়ে ॥৬৪॥
surabhi takhana sadaya haye<br />piyāila dugdha munire laye [64]
<span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">sadaya</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">piyāila</span>–fed <span class="e2">munire</span>–the sage <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [her] <span class="e2">dugdha</span>–milk. [64]
“Surabhi mercifully fed the sage with her milk.
সবল হইয়া মৃকণ্ডসূনু ।<br />সুরভির প্রতি কহয় পুনঃ ॥৬৫॥
sabala ha-iyā mṛkaṇḍa-sūnu<br />surabhira prati kahaya punaḥ [65]
<span class="e2">sabala</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Revitalised, <span class="e2">mṛkaṇḍa-sūnu</span>–Mārkaṇḍeya Muni <span class="e2">kahaya</span>–spoke <span class="e2">surabhira</span> <span class="e2">prati</span>–to Surabhi <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. [65]
“Revitalised, Mārkaṇḍeya Muni spoke to Surabhi again.
‘তুমি ভগবতি জননী মোর ।<br />তোমার মায়ায় জগৎ ভোর ॥৬৬॥
‘tumi bhagavati jananī mora<br />tomāra māyāya jagat bhora [66]
<span class="e2">‘bhagavati</span>–‘O goddess, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">jananī</span>–mother, [and] <span class="e2">jagat</span>–the world [is] <span class="e2">bhora</span>–absorbed <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">māyāya</span>–in your illusion. [66]
“‘O goddess, you are my mother, and the world is absorbed in your illusion.
না বুঝিয়া আমি লয়েছি বর ।<br />সপ্তকল্প জীব হয়ে অমর ॥৬৭॥
nā bujhiyā āmi layechhi vara<br />sapta-kalpa jīva haye amara [67]
<span class="e2">bujhiyā nā</span>–Not understanding [the consequences,] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">layechhi</span>–accepted <span class="e2">vara</span>–a boon <span class="e2">jīva</span>–of living <span class="e2">sapta-kalpa</span>–for seven kalpas <span class="e2">amara haye</span>–without dying. [67]
“‘Not understanding the consequences, I accepted a boon of living for seven kalpas without dying.
প্রলয় সময়ে বড়ই দুঃখ ।<br />নানাবিধ ক্লেশ নাহিক সুখ ॥৬৮॥
pralaya samaye baḍa-i duḥkha<br />nānā-vidha kleśa nāhika sukha [68]
<span class="e2">pralaya</span> <span class="e2">samaye</span>–At the time of the destruction of the universe, [there are] <span class="e2">nānā-vidha</span>–various types <span class="e2">kleśa</span>–of miseries [and] <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span>–extreme <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–distress. <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–There is no <span class="e2">sukha</span>–happiness. [68]
“‘During the destruction of the universe, there are numerous miseries and extreme distress. There is no happiness.
কি করি জননি বলগো মোরে ।<br />কিসে বা যাইব এ দুঃখ তরে’ ॥৬৯॥
ki kari janani balago more<br />kise vā yāiba e duḥkha tare’ [69]
<span class="e2">janani</span>–O Mother, <span class="e2">balago</span>–tell <span class="e2">more</span>–me, <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">kari</span>–what should I do? <span class="e2">kise</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–How <span class="e2">tare yāiba</span>–can I overcome <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">duḥkha’</span>–this distress?’ [69]
“‘O Mother, tell me, what should I do? How can I overcome this distress?’
সুরভি তখন বলিল বাণী ।<br />‘ভজহ শ্রীগৌরপদ দুখানি ॥৭০॥
surabhi takhana balila vāṇī<br />‘bhajaha śrī-gaura-pada dukhāni [70]
<span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">vāṇī balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘bhajaha</span>–‘Serve <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-pada</span> <span class="e2">dukhāni</span>–the feet of Śrī Gaura. [70]
“Surabhi said, ‘Serve the feet of Śrī Gaura.
এই নবদ্বীপ প্রকৃতিপার ।<br />কভু নাশ নাহি হয় ইহার ॥৭১॥
ei navadvīpa prakṛti-pāra<br />kabhu nāśa nāhi haya ihāra [71]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This abode <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">prakṛti-pāra</span>–beyond material nature— <span class="e2">ihāra haya</span>–it is <span class="e2">kabhu nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">nāśa</span>–destroyed. [71]
“‘This abode of Nabadwīp is beyond material nature—it is never destroyed.
চর্ম্মচক্ষে ইহা ষোড়শক্রোশ ।<br />পরম বৈকুণ্ঠ সদা নির্দ্দোষ ॥৭২॥
charma-chakṣe ihā ṣoḍaśa-krośa<br />parama vaikuṇṭha sadā nirdoṣa [72]
<span class="e2">charma-chakṣe</span>–To fleshy eyes <span class="e2">ihā</span>–it [is] <span class="e2">ṣoḍaśa-krośa</span>–thirty-two miles, [but it is] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭha</span>–the supreme realm in the spiritual world [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternally <span class="e2">nirdoṣa</span>–faultless. [72]
“‘To fleshy eyes, it is only thirty-two miles, but it is the supreme abode Vaikuṇṭha and eternally faultless.
অপ্রাকৃত দেশ কাল এখানে ।<br />জড় মায়া কেবা কেহ না জানে ॥৭৩॥
aprākṛta deśa kāla ekhāne<br />jaḍa māyā kebā keha nā jāne [73]
<span class="e2">ekhāne</span>–Here, <span class="e2">kāla</span>–time [and] <span class="e2">deśa</span>–space [are] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–supramundane, [and] <span class="e2">kebā</span> <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–no one <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows [of] <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–material <span class="e2">māyā</span>–illusion. [73]
“‘Here, time and space are supramundane, and no one knows of material illusion.
নবদ্বীপে দেখ অপূর্ব্ব অতি ।<br />চারিদিকে বেড়ে বিরজা সতী ॥৭৪॥
navadvīpe dekha apūrva ati<br />chāri-dike beḍe virajā satī [74]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">ati apūrva</span>–the great wonder <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–of Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">virajā</span> <span class="e2">satī</span>–The chaste Virajā <span class="e2">beḍe</span>–flows <span class="e2">chāri-dike</span>–in the four directions. [74]
“‘See the great wonder of Nabadwīp! The chaste Virajā flows all around it.
শতকোটিক্রোশ প্রত্যেক খণ্ড ।<br />মধ্যে মায়াপুর নগর গণ্ড ॥৭৫॥
śata-koṭi-krośa pratyeka khaṇḍa<br />madhye māyāpura nagara gaṇḍa [75]
<span class="e2">pratyeka</span>–Every <span class="e2">khaṇḍa</span>–part [is] <span class="e2">śata-koṭi-krośa</span>–two billion miles, [and] <span class="e2">madhye</span>–at [its] centre [is] <span class="e2">nagara</span> <span class="e2">gaṇḍa</span>–the grand city <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–of Māyāpur. [75]
“‘Every part of Nabadwīp measures two billion miles, and at its centre is the grand city of Māyāpur.
অষ্টদল অষ্টদ্বীপের মান ।<br />অন্তর্দ্বীপ তার কেশর স্থান ॥৭৬॥
aṣṭa-dala aṣṭa-dvīpera māna<br />antardvīpa tāra keśara sthāna [76]
<span class="e2">aṣṭa-dvīpera</span>–The eight islands <span class="e2">māna</span>–resemble <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dala</span>–eight petals, [and] <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp [is] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">keśara sthāna</span>–whorl. [76]
“‘The eight islands of Nabadwīp are petals, and Antardwīp is their whorl.
সর্ব্বতীর্থ সর্ব্বদেবতা ঋষি ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ ভজিছে হেথায় বসি’ ॥৭৭॥
sarva-tīrtha sarva-devatā ṛṣi<br />gaurāṅga bhajichhe hethāya vasi’ [77]
<span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha</span>–All the holy places, [and] <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all <span class="e2">devatā</span>–the gods [and] <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span>–sages <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–reside <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">bhajichhe</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga. [77]
“‘All the holy places, gods, and sages reside here and worship Gaurāṅga.
তুমি মার্কণ্ডেয় গৌরাঙ্গপদ ।<br />আশ্রয় করহ জানি’ সম্পদ ॥৭৮॥
tumi mārkaṇḍeya gaurāṅga-pada<br />āśraya karaha jāni’ sampada [78]
<span class="e2">tumi mārkaṇḍeya</span>–O Mārkaṇḍeya, <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–understand [your] <span class="e2">sampada</span>–fortune [and] <span class="e2">āśraya</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–take shelter <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-pada</span>–at the feet of Gaurāṅga. [78]
“‘O Mārkaṇḍeya, understand your fortune and take shelter at the feet of Gaurāṅga.
অকৈতব ধর্ম্ম আশ্রয় কর ।<br />ভুক্তি-মুক্তি-বাঞ্ছা সুদূরে ধর ॥৭৯॥
akaitava dharma āśraya kara<br />bhukti-mukti-vāñchhā sudūre dhara [79]
<span class="e2">āśraya</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Take shelter [of] <span class="e2">akaitava</span> <span class="e2">dharma</span>–the true religion, [and] <span class="e2">dhara</span>–keep <span class="e2">bhukti-mukti-vāñchhā</span>–desires for enjoyment and liberation <span class="e2">sudūre</span>–far away. [79]
“‘Take shelter of the true dharma, and keep desires for enjoyment and liberation far away.
গৌরাঙ্গ-ভজন-আশ্রয়-বলে ।<br />মধুর প্রেম ত লভিবে ফলে ॥৮০॥
gaurāṅga-bhajana-āśraya-bale<br />madhura prema ta labhibe phale [80]
<span class="e2">gaurāṅga-bhajana-āśraya-bale</span>–By taking shelter and serving Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love <span class="e2">madhura</span>–in madhura-rasa <span class="e2">phale</span>–as a result. [80]
“‘By taking shelter of Gaurāṅga and serving Him, you will attain divine love in madhura-rasa.
সেই প্রেম যবে হৃদয়ে বসে ।<br />ভাসায় বিলাস-কলার রসে ॥৮১॥
sei prema yabe hṛdaye vase<br />bhāsāya vilāsa-kalāra rase [81]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love <span class="e2">vase</span>–appears <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–in [your] heart, <span class="e2">bhāsāya</span>–it will set [you] afloat <span class="e2">rase</span>–in the rasa <span class="e2">vilāsa-kalāra</span>–of the arts within the Pastimes [of the Lord]. [81]
“When that divine love appears in your heart, it will set you afloat in the rasa of the arts within the Pastimes of the Lord.
ব্রজে রাধাপদ আশ্রয় হয় ।<br />যুগল-সেবায় মানস রয় ॥৮২॥
vraje rādhā-pade āśraya haya<br />yugala-sevāya mānasa raya [82]
<span class="e2">āśraya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–You will take shelter <span class="e2">rādhā-pade</span>–at the feet of Rādhā <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja, [and your] <span class="e2">mānasa</span>–heart <span class="e2">raya</span>–will be engaged <span class="e2">yugala-sevāya</span>–in the service of the Divine Couple. [82]
“‘You will take shelter at the feet of Rādhā in Vraja, and your heart will be engaged in the service of the Divine Couple.
সেবার সুখ ত অতুল জান ।<br />অভেদ নির্ব্বাণে অপার্থ জ্ঞান’ ॥৮৩॥
sevāra sukha ta atula jāna<br />abheda nirvāṇe apārtha jñāna’ [83]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [that] <span class="e2">sukha</span>–the joy <span class="e2">sevāra</span>–of service [is] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">atula</span>–unparalleled [and] <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">abheda</span> <span class="e2">nirvāṇe</span>–of static liberation [is] <span class="e2">apārtha’</span>–useless.’ [83]
“‘Know that the joy of service is unparalleled, and knowledge of static liberation is useless.’
সুরভি-বচন শুনিয়া মুনি ।<br />করযোড় করি’ বলে অমনি ॥৮৪॥
surabhi-vachana śuniyā muni<br />kara-yoḍa kari’ bale amani [84]
<span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">surabhi-vachana</span>–the words of Surabhi, <span class="e2">muni</span>–the sage <span class="e2">amani</span>–immediately <span class="e2">kara-yoḍa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–joined [his] palms [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–spoke. [84]
“Hearing the words of Surabhi, the sage immediately joined his palms and spoke.
‘শ্রীগৌরচরণ ভজিব যবে ।<br />আমার অদৃষ্ট কোথায় রবে’ ॥৮৫॥
‘śrī-gaura-charaṇa bhajiba yabe<br />āmāra adṛṣṭa kothāya rabe’ [85]
<span class="e2">‘yabe</span>–‘When <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–I serve <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-charaṇa</span>–the feet of Śrī Gaura, <span class="e2">kothāya</span>–where [will] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">adṛṣṭa</span>–destiny <span class="e2">rabe’</span>–remain?’ [85]
“‘When I serve the feet of Śrī Gaura, what will become of my destiny?’
সুরভি কহিল সিদ্ধান্তসার ।<br />‘শ্রীগৌরভজনে নাহি বিচার ॥৮৬॥
surabhi kahila siddhānta-sāra<br />‘śrī-gaura-bhajane nāhi vichāra [86]
<span class="e2">surabhi</span>–Surabhi <span class="e2">kahila</span>–spoke <span class="e2">siddhānta-sāra</span>–the ultimate conclusion: <span class="e2">‘nāhi</span>–‘There is no <span class="e2">vichāra</span>–judgement <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-bhajane</span>–in the service of Śrī Gaura. [86]
“Surabhi then spoke the ultimate conclusion: ‘There is no judgement in the service of Śrī Gaura.
‘শ্রীগৌর’ বলিয়া ডাকিবে যবে ।<br />সমস্ত করম বিনাশ হবে ॥৮৭॥
‘śrī-gaura’ baliyā ḍākibe yabe<br />samasta karama vināśa habe [87]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">baliyā</span> <span class="e2">ḍākibe</span>–you call out, <span class="e2">‘śrī-gaura’</span>–‘Śrī Gaura’, <span class="e2">samasta</span> <span class="e2">karama</span>–all the reactions to your previous actions <span class="e2">vināśa</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be destroyed. [87]
“‘When you call the Name of Śrī Gaura, all your karma will be destroyed.
কিছু নাহি রবে বিপাক আর ।<br />ঘুচিবে তোমার ভবসংসার ॥৮৮॥
kichhu nāhi rabe vipāka āra<br />ghuchibe tomāra bhava-saṁsāra [88]
<span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–No <span class="e2">vipāka</span>–reactions <span class="e2">rabe</span>–will remain <span class="e2">āra</span>–any longer, [and] <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your<span class="e2"> bhava-saṁsāra</span>–attachment to material existence <span class="e2">ghuchibe</span>–will disappear. [88]
“‘No reactions will remain any longer, and your attachment to material existence will disappear.
কর্ম্ম কেনে একা জ্ঞানের ফল ।<br />ঘুচিবে সমূলে হয়ে বিকল ॥৮৯॥
karma kene ekā jñānera phala<br />ghuchibe samūle haye vikala [89]
<span class="e2">kene</span>–Why <span class="e2">karma</span>–karma <span class="e2">ekā</span>–alone? <span class="e2">phala</span>–The consequences <span class="e2">jñānera</span>–of [your] knowledge <span class="e2">ghuchibe</span>–will disappear, <span class="e2">vikala haye</span>–being destroyed <span class="e2">samūle</span>–at the root. [89]
“‘And not only your karma, but the consequences of your pursuing liberation will also be eradicated.
তুমি ত মজিবে গৌরাঙ্গরসে ।<br />ভজিবে তাঁহারে এ দ্বীপে বসে’ ॥৯০॥
tumi ta majibe gaurāṅga-rase<br />bhajibe tā̐hāre e dvīpe vase’ [90]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">majibe</span>–will become immersed <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-rase</span>–in the ecstasy of Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">bhajibe</span>–You will serve <span class="e2">tā̐hāre</span>–Him, <span class="e2">vase</span>–residing <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dvīpe’</span>–on this island.’ [90]
“‘You will become immersed in the ecstasy of Gaurāṅga, living on this island and serving Him.’
মার্কণ্ডেয় শুনি’ আনন্দে ভাসে ।<br />‘গৌর’ বলি’ কাঁদে কখন হাসে ॥৯১॥
mārkaṇḍeya śuni’ ānande bhāse<br />‘gaura’ bali’ kā̐de kakhana hāse [91]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing [this,] <span class="e2">mārkaṇḍeya</span>–Mārkaṇḍeya <span class="e2">bhāse</span>–floated <span class="e2">ānande</span>–in joy. <span class="e2">bali’</span>–He chanted, <span class="e2">‘gaura’</span>–‘Gaura’, <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cried, [and] <span class="e2">kakhana</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">hāse</span>–laughed. [91]
“Hearing this, Mārkaṇḍeya floated in joy. He chanted the Name of Gaura, cried, and sometimes laughed.
এই দেখ জীব অপূর্ব্ব স্থান ।<br />মার্কণ্ডেয় যথা পাইল প্রাণ” ॥৯২॥
ei dekha jīva apūrva sthāna<br />mārkaṇḍeya yathā pāila prāṇa” [92]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see [here] <span class="e2">ei</span>–the <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">mārkaṇḍeya</span>–Mārkaṇḍeya <span class="e2">pāila</span>–received <span class="e2">prāṇa”</span>–life.” [92]
“Jīva, see here the wonderful place where Mārkaṇḍeya received life.”
গৌরাঙ্গ-মহিমা নিতাই-মুখে ।<br />শুনি’ জীব ভাসে পরম সুখে ॥৯৩॥
gaurāṅga-mahimā nitāi-mukhe<br />śuni’ jīva bhāse parama sukhe [93]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-mahimā</span>–the glories of Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">nitāi-mukhe</span>–from the mouth of Nitāi, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">bhāse</span>–floated <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–in the greatest joy. [93]
Hearing the glories of Gaurāṅga from the mouth of Nitāi, Jīva floated in the greatest joy.
সে স্থানে সে দিন যাপন করি’ ।<br />মধ্যদ্বীপে চলে বলিয়া “হরি” ॥৯৪॥
se sthāne se dina yāpana kari’<br />madhyadvīpe chale baliyā “hari” [94]
<span class="e2">yāpana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–They spent <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–the day <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in that place [and then] <span class="e2">chale</span>–went <span class="e2">madhyadvīpe</span>–to Madhyadwīp, <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–chanting <span class="e2">“hari”</span>–“Hari!” [94]
They spent the day in that place and then went to Madhyadwīp, chanting “Hari!”
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-চরণ সার ।<br />জানিয়া ভক্তিবিনোদ ছার ॥৯৫॥
নিতাই-আদেশ মস্তকে ধরে ।<br />নদীয়া-মহিমা বর্ণন করে ॥৯৬॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-charaṇa sāra<br />jāniyā bhakti-vinoda chhāra [95]
nitāi-ādeśa mastake dhare<br />nadīyā-mahimā varṇana kare [96]
<span class="e2">jāniyā</span>–Knowing <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-charaṇa</span>–Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet [to be] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–all-in-all, <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–the fallen <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod <span class="e2">dhare</span>–holds <span class="e2">nitāi-ādeśa</span>–the order of Nitāi <span class="e2">mastake</span>–on [his] head [and] <span class="e2">varṇana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–describes <span class="e2">nadīyā-mahimā</span>–the glories of Nadia. [95<span class="e2">–</span>96]
Knowing Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet to be all-in-all, the fallen Bhakti Vinod holds the order of Nitāi on his head and describes the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Nine
Śrī Madhyadwīp and Śrī Naimiṣa
জয় গৌরাচন্দ্র	<span class="e25">জয় নিত্যানন্দ</span><br />	<span class="e26">জয় জয় গদাধর ।</span><br />শ্রীবাসাদি জয়	<span class="e25">জয় ভক্তালয়</span><br />	<span class="e26">নববদ্বীপ ধামবর ॥১॥</span>
jaya gaurachandra	<span class="e10">jaya nityānanda</span><br />	<span class="e11">jaya jaya gadādhara</span><br />śrīvāsādi jaya	<span class="e10">jaya bhaktālaya</span><br />	<span class="e11">navadvīpa-dhāma-vara [1]</span>
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–to Gaurachandra! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–to Nityānanda! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span>–to Śrīvās and all the devotees of the Lord! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">bhaktālaya</span>–to the home of the devotees, <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma-vara</span>–the best of abodes, Nabadwīp! [1]
All glory to Gaurachandra, Nityānanda, Gadādhar, Śrīvās, all the devotees of the Lord! All glory to their home, the best of abodes, Śrī Nabadwīp!
নিশি অবসানে	<span class="e25">মত্ত গৌরগানে</span><br />	<span class="e26">চলিলেন নিত্যানন্দ ।</span><br />সঙ্গে ভক্তগণ	<span class="e25">প্রেমেতে মগন</span><br />	<span class="e26">বিস্তারিয়া পরানন্দ ॥২॥</span>
niśi avasāne	<span class="e10">matta gaura-gāne</span><br />	<span class="e11">chalilena nityānanda</span><br />saṅge bhakta-gaṇa	<span class="e10">premete magana</span><br />	<span class="e11">vistāriyā parānanda [2]</span>
<span class="e2">magana</span>–Immersed <span class="e2">premete</span>–in divine love [and] <span class="e2">matta</span>–madly <span class="e2">gaura-gāne</span>–chanting about Gaura, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">chalilena</span>–departed <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">avasāne</span>–at the end <span class="e2">niśi</span>–of the night, <span class="e2">vistāriyā</span>–distributing <span class="e2">parānanda</span>–divine joy. [2]
Immersed in divine love and madly chanting about Gaurāṅga, Nityānanda departed with the devotees at the end of the night, distributing divine joy.
মধ্যদ্বীপে আসি’	<span class="e25">বলে হাসি’ হাসি’</span><br />	<span class="e26">“এই ত মাজিদা গ্রাম ।</span><br />হেথা সপ্তঋষি	<span class="e25">ভজি’ গৌরশশী</span><br />	<span class="e26">করিলেন সুবিশ্রাম ॥৩॥</span>
madhyadvīpe āsi’	<span class="e10">bale hāsi’ hāsi’</span><br />	<span class="e11">“ei ta mājidā grāma</span><br />hethā sapta-ṛṣi	<span class="e10">bhaji’ gaura-śaśī</span><br />	<span class="e11">karilena suviśrāma [3]</span>
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–Coming <span class="e2">madhyadvīpe</span>–into Madhyadwīp [and] <span class="e2">hāsi’</span> <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–laughing, <span class="e2">bale</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu said, <span class="e2">“ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">mājidā</span> <span class="e2">grāma</span>–the village of Mājidā. <span class="e2">sapta-ṛṣi</span>–The seven sages <span class="e2">suviśrāma karilena</span>–resided <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">gaura-śaśī</span>–the moon-like Śrī Gaura. [3]
Coming into Madhyadwīp and laughing, Nityānanda Prabhu said, “This is Mājidā Grām. The seven sages resided here and worshipped the moon-like Śrī Gaura.
পিতৃ-সন্নিধানে	<span class="e25">গৌর-গুণগানে</span><br />	<span class="e26">সত্যযুগে ঋষিগণ ।</span><br />হইয়া মগন	<span class="e25">যাচিল তখন</span><br />	<span class="e26">গৌরপ্রেম নিত্যধন ॥৪॥</span>
pitṛ-sannidhāne	<span class="e10">gaura-guṇa-gāne</span><br />	<span class="e11">satya-yuge ṛṣi-gaṇa</span><br />ha-iyā magana	<span class="e10">yāchila takhana</span><br />	<span class="e11">gaura-prema nitya-dhana [4]</span>
<span class="e2">satya-yuge</span>–During Satya-yuga, <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–the sages <span class="e2">magana ha-iyā</span>–became immersed <span class="e2">gaura-guṇa-gāne</span>–in chanting Gaura’s glories [and] <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">yāchila</span>–prayed <span class="e2">pitṛ-sannidhāne</span>–to [their] father <span class="e2">nitya-dhana</span>–for the eternal wealth <span class="e2">gaura-prema</span>–of divine love for Gaura. [4]
“During Satya-yuga, the sages became immersed in chanting Gaura’s glories and prayed to their father, Brahmā, for the eternal wealth of divine love for Gaurāṅga.
ব্রহ্মা চতুর্ম্মুখ	<span class="e25">পেয়ে বড় সুখ</span><br />	<span class="e26">সপ্তপুত্রে বলে তবে ।</span><br />‘নবদ্বীপে যাও	<span class="e25">গৌরণ্ডণ গাও</span><br />	<span class="e26">অনায়াসে প্রেম হবে ॥৫॥</span>
brahmā chaturmukha	<span class="e10">peye baḍa sukha</span><br />	<span class="e11">sapta-putre bale tabe</span><br />‘navadvīpe yāo	<span class="e10">gaura-guṇa gāo</span><br />	<span class="e11">anāyāse prema habe [5]</span>
<span class="e2">chaturmukha brahmā</span>–Four-headed Brahmā <span class="e2">peye</span>–felt <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–great <span class="e2">sukha</span>–joy [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">bale</span>–said <span class="e2">sapta-putre</span>–to [his] seven sons, <span class="e2">‘yāo</span>–‘Go <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">gāo</span>–chant <span class="e2">gaura-guṇa</span>–the glories of Gaura. <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–Easily, <span class="e2">prema</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–you will attain divine love. [5]
“Four-headed Brahmā felt great joy and said to his seven sons*, ‘Go to Nabadwīp and chant the glories of Gaura. You will easily attain divine love.
* According to the <span class="e3">Viṣṇu-purāṇa</span> (3.1.32), the seven ṛṣis of the current manvantara are Atri, Bharadvāja, Gautama, Jamadagni, Kaśyapa, Vasiṣṭha, and Viśvāmitra. In previous eras, these and numerous other ṛṣis served in this capacity. Because the seven ṛṣis are described here as sons of Lord Brahmā, the seven ṛṣis who received Śrīman Mahāprabhu’s mercy may have been Aṅgirā, Atri, Kratu, Marīchi, Pulaha, Pulastya, and Vasiṣṭha, as this group is the only group of ṛṣis listed as the seven ṛṣis in the scriptures (in this case the <span class="e3">Bṛhat-saṁhitā</span>) in which all seven of the ṛṣis are sons of Brahmā.
ধাম-কৃপা সার	<span class="e25">লাভ হয় যার</span><br />	<span class="e26">তার হয় সাধুসঙ্গ ।</span><br />সাধুসঙ্গে ভজে	<span class="e25">কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে মজে</span><br />	<span class="e26">এই ত পরম রঙ্গ ॥৬॥</span>
dhāma-kṛpā sāra	<span class="e10">lābha haya yāra</span><br />	<span class="e11">tāra haya sādhu-saṅga</span><br />sādhu-saṅge bhaje	<span class="e10">kṛṣṇa-preme maje</span><br />	<span class="e11">ei ta parama raṅga [6]</span>
<span class="e2">dhāma-kṛpā</span>–The mercy of the abode [of the Lord] [is] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–supreme. <span class="e2">yāra tāra</span>–Those who <span class="e2">lābha</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–attain [it,] <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅga haya</span>–attain the association of the sādhus. <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–Serving <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–in the association of the sādhus, <span class="e2">maje</span>–becoming immersed <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-preme</span>–in divine love for Kṛṣṇa— <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">raṅga</span>–the ultimate joy. [6]
“‘The mercy of the Dhām is supreme. Those who attain it, attain the association of the sādhus. Serving in the association of the sādhus and becoming immersed in divine love for Kṛṣṇa is the ultimate joy.
নবদ্বীপে রতি	<span class="e25">লভে যার মতি</span><br />	<span class="e26">সেই পায় ব্রজবাস ।</span><br />অপ্রাকৃত ধাম	<span class="e25">গৌরহরি নাম</span><br />	<span class="e26">কেবল সাধুর আশ’ ॥৭॥</span>
navadvīpe rati	<span class="e10">labhe yāra mati</span><br />	<span class="e11">sei pāya vraja-vāsa</span><br />aprākṛta dhāma	<span class="e10">gaurahari nāma</span><br />	<span class="e11">kevala sādhura āśa’ [7]</span>
<span class="e2">yāra sei mati</span>–Those whose hearts <span class="e2">labhe</span>–develop <span class="e2">rati</span>–attachment <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">vraja-vāsa</span>–residency in Vraja. <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–The supramundane Dhām [and] <span class="e2">gaurahari</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name of Gaurahari [are the] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–only <span class="e2">āśa</span>–desires <span class="e2">sādhura’</span>–of the sādhus.’ [7]
“‘Those whose hearts develop attachment to Nabadwīp attain residency in Vraja. The supramundane Dhām and the Name of Gaurahari are the only desires of the sādhus.’
পিতৃ-উপদেশ	<span class="e25">বুঝিয়া বিশেষ</span><br />	<span class="e26">সপ্তঋষি আসি’ তবে ।</span><br />‘হরি’ বলি’ নাচে	<span class="e25">গৌরপ্রেম যাচে</span><br />	<span class="e26">গায় গুণ উচ্চরবে ॥৮॥</span>
pitṛ-upadeśa	<span class="e10">bujhiyā viśeṣa</span><br />	<span class="e11">sapta-ṛṣi āsi’ tabe</span><br />‘hari’ bali’ nāche	<span class="e10">gaura-prema yāche</span><br />	<span class="e11">gāya guṇa uchcha-rave [8]</span>
<span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–Properly <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–understanding <span class="e2">pitṛ-upadeśa</span>–the instructions of [their] father, <span class="e2">sapta-ṛṣi</span>–the seven sages <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came [here,] <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanted <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Hari’, [and] <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced. <span class="e2">yāche</span>–They prayed <span class="e2">gaura-prema</span>–for divine love for Gaura [and] <span class="e2">uchcha-rave</span>–loudly <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chanted [His] <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–glories. [8]
“Properly understanding the instructions of their father, the seven sages came here, chanted the Name of the Lord, and danced. They prayed for divine love for Gaurāṅga and loudly chanted His glories.
বলে, ‘গৌরহরি	<span class="e25">অনুগ্রহ করি’</span><br />	<span class="e26">দেখা দাও একবার ।</span><br />নানা ধর্ম্ম সাধি’	<span class="e25">হৈনু অপরাধী</span><br />	<span class="e26">ভক্তি এবে কৈনু সার’ ॥৯॥</span>
bale, ‘gaurahari	<span class="e10">anugraha kari’</span><br />	<span class="e11">dekhā dāo eka-bāra</span><br />nānā dharma sādhi‘	<span class="e10">hainu aparādhī</span><br />	<span class="e11">bhakti ebe kainu sāra’ [9]</span>
<span class="e2">bale</span>–They chanted, <span class="e2">‘gaurahari</span>–‘O Gaurahari! <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–Once<span class="e2"> anugraha kari’</span>–mercifully<span class="e2"> dekhā dāo</span>–reveal [Yourself]. <span class="e2">sādhi’</span>–Practising <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various <span class="e2">dharma</span>–dharmas, <span class="e2">hainu</span>–we became <span class="e2">aparādhī</span>–offenders, [but] <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">kainu</span>–we have accepted <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion [to be] <span class="e2">sāra’</span>–all-in-all.’ [9]
“They prayed, ‘O Gaurahari! Just once mercifully reveal Yourself to us. Practising various dharmas, we became offenders, but we have now accepted devotion to be all-in-all.’
ভক্তিনিষ্ঠা করি’	<span class="e25">ভজি’ গৌরহরি</span><br />	<span class="e26">ঋষিগণ করে তপ ।</span><br />কিছু নাহি খায়	<span class="e25">নিদ্রা নাহি যায়</span><br />	<span class="e26">গৌরনাম করে জপ ॥১০॥</span>
bhakti-niṣṭhā kari’	<span class="e10">bhaji’ gaurahari</span><br />	<span class="e11">ṛṣi-gaṇa kare tapa</span><br />kichhu nāhi khāya	<span class="e10">nidrā nāhi yāya</span><br />	<span class="e11">gaura-nāma kare japa [10]</span>
<span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–The sages <span class="e2">kare</span>–performed <span class="e2">tapa</span>–austerities [and] <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–served <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">bhakti-niṣṭhā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–with firm devotion. <span class="e2">khāya</span>–They ate <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–nothing, <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–never went <span class="e2">nidrā</span>–to sleep, [and] <span class="e2">japa kare</span>–constantly chanted <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura. [10]
“The sages performed austerities and served Gaurahari with firm devotion. They ate nothing, never went to sleep, and constantly chanted the Name of Gaura.
মধ্যাহ্ন সময়	<span class="e25">গৌর দয়াময়</span><br />	<span class="e26">দেখা দিল ঋষিগণে ।</span><br />শতসূর্য্য-প্রভা	<span class="e25">যোগি-মনোলোভা</span><br />	<span class="e26">শুদ্ধ পঞ্চতত্ত্ব সনে ॥১১॥</span>
madhyāhna samaya	<span class="e10">gaura dayāmaya</span><br />	<span class="e11">dekhā dila ṛṣi-gaṇe</span><br />śata-sūrya-prabhā	<span class="e10">yogi-mano-lobhā</span><br />	<span class="e11">śuddha pañcha-tattva sane [11]</span>
<span class="e2">madhyāhna</span> <span class="e2">samaya</span>–At midday, <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–merciful <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura, <span class="e2">sane</span>–in the company <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">pañcha-tattva</span>–of the divine Pañcha Tattva (Nityānanda, Advaita, Gadādhar, and Śrīvās),<span class="e2"> dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [Himself] <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇe</span>–to the sages <span class="e2">śata-sūrya-prabhā</span>–with an effulgence like that of a hundred suns, [which was] <span class="e2">yogi-mano-lobhā</span>–alluring to the minds of yogīs. [11]
“Once, at midday, merciful Gaurāṅga, in the company of the Pañcha Tattva, revealed Himself to the sages. As bright as a hundred suns, His effulgence was alluring to the minds of yogīs.
কিবা সেই রূপ	<span class="e25">অতি অপরূপ</span><br />	<span class="e26">সুবর্ণ সুন্দর মূর্ত্তি ।</span><br />গলে বনমালা	<span class="e25">দিক্ করে আলা</span><br />	<span class="e26">তাহে আভরণ স্ফূর্ত্তি ॥১২॥</span>
kibā sei rūpa	<span class="e10">ati aparūpa</span><br />	<span class="e11">suvarṇa sundara mūrti</span><br />gale vana-mālā	<span class="e10">dik kare ālā</span><br />	<span class="e11">tāhe ābharaṇa sphūrti [12]</span>
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–How <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">aparūpa</span>–extraordinary [was] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–His form! [How] <span class="e2">suvarṇa</span>–golden [and] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful [was His] <span class="e2">mūrti</span>–figure! [There was] <span class="e2">vana-mālā</span>–a forest garland <span class="e2">gale</span>–on [His] neck, [and] <span class="e2">tāhe</span> <span class="e2">sphūrti</span>–the glittering <span class="e2">ābharaṇa</span>–of [His] ornaments <span class="e2">ālā kare</span>–illumined <span class="e2">dik</span>–the directions. [12]
“How extraordinary was His form! How beautiful and golden was His figure! He had a forest garland around His neck, and the glittering of His ornaments illumined the directions.
চাহনি সুন্দর	<span class="e25">চিকুর চাঁচর</span><br />	<span class="e26">চন্দনের বিন্দু ভালে ।</span><br />ত্রিকচ্ছ বসন	<span class="e25">সূত্র সুশোভন</span><br />	<span class="e26">শোভিত মল্লিকা-মালে ॥১৩॥</span>
chāhani sundara	<span class="e10">chikura chā̐chara</span><br />	<span class="e11">chandanera bindu bhāle</span><br />trikachchha vasana	<span class="e10">sūtra suśobhana</span><br />	<span class="e11">śobhita mallikā-māle [13]</span>
[His] <span class="e2">sundara chāhani</span>–charming glance, [His] <span class="e2">chikura</span> <span class="e2">chā̐chara</span>–wavy hair, <span class="e2">chandanera</span> <span class="e2">bindu</span>–the spot of sandalwood paste <span class="e2">bhāle</span>–on [His] forehead, [His] <span class="e2">trikachchha</span> <span class="e2">vasana</span>–cloth tucked three times, [His] <span class="e2">sūtra</span>–sacred thread— [all were] <span class="e2">suśobhana</span>–extremely beautiful [and] <span class="e2">śobhita</span>–beautified <span class="e2">mallikā-māle</span>–by [His] garland of jasmine flowers. [13]
“His charming glance, His wavy hair, the spot of sandalwood paste on His forehead, His dhotī tucked in three places, His sacred thread—all were extremely beautiful and further beautified by His garland of jasmine flowers.
সে রূপ দেখিয়া	<span class="e25">মোহিত হইয়া</span><br />	<span class="e26">সবে করে নিবেদন ।</span><br />‘তোমার চরণ	<span class="e25">লইনু শরণ</span><br />	<span class="e26">দেহ পদে ভক্তিধন’ ॥১৪॥</span>
se rūpa dekhiyā	<span class="e10">mohita ha-iyā</span><br />	<span class="e11">sabe kare nivedana</span><br />‘tomāra charaṇa	<span class="e10">la-inu śaraṇa</span><br />	<span class="e11">deha pade bhakti-dhana’ [14]</span>
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">se rūpa</span>–His form [and] <span class="e2">mohita</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–becoming enchanted, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">nivedana kare</span>–prayed, <span class="e2">‘la-inu</span>–‘May we take <span class="e2">śaraṇa</span>–shelter <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–at Your feet. <span class="e2">deha</span>–Please give [us] <span class="e2">bhakti-dhana</span>–the wealth of devotion <span class="e2">pade’</span>–to [Your] feet.’ [14]
“Seeing His form and becoming enchanted, the sages prayed, ‘May we take shelter at Your feet. Please give us the wealth of devotion to Your feet.’
শুনি’ গৌরহরি	<span class="e25">বলে দয়া করি’</span><br />	<span class="e26">‘শুন ওহে ঋষিগণ ।</span><br />ছাড়ি’ অভিলাষ	<span class="e25">জ্ঞান-কর্ম্ম-পাশ</span><br />	<span class="e26">কর কৃষ্ণ আলোচন ॥১৫॥</span>
śuni’ gaurahari	<span class="e10">bale dayā kari’</span><br />	<span class="e11">‘śuna ohe ṛṣi-gaṇa</span><br />chhāḍi’ abhilāṣa	<span class="e10">jñāna-karma-pāśa</span><br />	<span class="e11">kara kṛṣṇa ālochana [15]</span>
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing [their prayer,] <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–sages, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Leave behind <span class="e2">abhilāṣa</span>–[other] desires [and] <span class="e2">jñāna-karma-pāśa</span>–the chains of exploitation and renunciation, [and] <span class="e2">ālochana kara</span>–discuss [only] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa. [15]
“Hearing their prayer, Gaurahari mercifully said, ‘O sages, listen! Leave behind all other desires and the chains of exploitation and renunciation, and discuss only Kṛṣṇa.
স্বল্প দিনান্তরে	<span class="e25">নদীয়া নগরে</span><br />	<span class="e26">হইবে প্রকট লীলা ।</span><br />তুমি সবে তবে	<span class="e25">দর্শন করিবে</span><br />	<span class="e26">নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনখেলা ॥১৬॥</span>
svalpa dināntare	<span class="e10">nadīyā nagare</span><br />	<span class="e11">ha-ibe prakaṭa līlā</span><br />tumi sabe tabe	<span class="e10">darśana karibe</span><br />	<span class="e11">nāma-saṅkīrtana-khelā [16]</span>
[My] <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">prakaṭa ha-ibe</span>–will manifest <span class="e2">svalpa</span> <span class="e2">dināntare</span>–after a short time <span class="e2">nadīyā</span> <span class="e2">nagare</span>–in the city of Nadia, [and] <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–you all <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will see [My] <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana-khelā</span>–Pastime of chanting [My] Name <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then. [16]
“‘My Pastimes will manifest in Nadia soon, and you all will then see My Pastime of chanting My Name.
এ কথা এখন	<span class="e25">রাখহ গোপন</span><br />	<span class="e26">আমার বচন ধর ।</span><br />শ্রীকুমারহট্টে	<span class="e25">নিজকৃত ঘট্টে</span><br />	<span class="e26">কৃষ্ণের ভজন কর’ ॥১৭॥</span>
e kathā ekhana	<span class="e10">rākhaha gopana</span><br />	<span class="e11">āmāra vachana dhara</span><br />śrī-kumāra-haṭṭe	<span class="e10">nija-kṛta ghaṭṭe</span><br />	<span class="e11">kṛṣṇera bhajana kara’ [17]</span>
<span class="e2">ekhana</span>–For now, <span class="e2">rākhaha</span>–keep <span class="e2">e kathā</span>–this matter <span class="e2">gopana</span>–secret. <span class="e2">dhara</span>–Remember <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">vachana</span>–words [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">bhajana</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–worship Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ghaṭṭe</span>–at the ghāṭ <span class="e2">nija-kṛta</span>–you made <span class="e2">śrī-kumāra-haṭṭe’</span>–in Śrī Kumār Haṭṭa.’ [17]
“‘For now, keep this secret. Remember My words and worship Kṛṣṇa at the ghāṭ you made in Śrī Kumār Haṭṭa.’
গৌর-অদর্শনে	<span class="e25">সপ্তর্ষি তখনে</span><br />	<span class="e26">কুমারহট্টেতে যায় ।</span><br />এস্থানে এখন	<span class="e25">কর দরশন</span><br />	<span class="e26">সপ্তটীলা শোভা পায় ॥১৮॥</span>
gaura-adarśane	<span class="e10">saptarṣi takhane</span><br />	<span class="e11">kumāra-haṭṭete yāya</span><br />e-sthāne ekhana	<span class="e10">kara daraśana</span><br />	<span class="e11">sapta-ṭīlā śobhā pāya [18]</span>
<span class="e2">takhane</span>–Then, [when] <span class="e2">gaura-adarśane</span>–Gaura disappeared, <span class="e2">saptarṣi</span>–the seven sages <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">kumāra-haṭṭete</span>–to Kumār Haṭṭa. <span class="e2">daraśana kara</span>–See <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now <span class="e2">sapta-ṭīlā</span>–the seven hills <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–shining <span class="e2">e-sthāne</span>–here. “When Gaura disappeared, the seven sages went to Kumār Haṭṭa. See now the seven hills shining here.

saptarṣi ākāśe	<span class="e10">yemate prakāśe</span><br />	<span class="e11">sapta-ṭīlā tā̐ra sama</span><br />hethā vāsa kari’	<span class="e10">pāya gaurahari</span><br />	<span class="e11">nā sādhi’ niyama yama [19]</span>
<span class="e2">sapta-ṭīlā</span>–The seven hills <span class="e2">prakāśe</span>–are arranged <span class="e2">yemate tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">sama</span>–just as <span class="e2">saptarṣi</span>–the seven sages [are] <span class="e2">ākāśe</span>–in the sky (as the constellation known as the ‘Big Dipper’). <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Residing <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–the sages attained <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">sādhi’ nā</span>–without following <span class="e2">niyama</span> <span class="e2">yama</span>–the rules and regulations (for aṣṭāṅga-yoga practice). [19]
“They are arranged just as the seven sages are in the sky. Residing here, the sages attained Gaurahari without following the rules and regulations of yoga practice.

<span class="e2">dekhaha</span>–See <span class="e2">nayane</span>–with [your] eyes <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">dakṣiṇe</span>–to the south <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–there is <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">jaladhāra</span>–river; <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">gomatī</span>–the Gomatī. [She is] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">supavitra</span>–extremely pure. [See] <span class="e2">āra</span>–also <span class="e2">naimiṣa-kānana</span>–the Naimiṣa forest. [20]
“See the river to the south of here; this is the Gomatī. She is extremely pure. See also the Naimiṣa forest.

<span class="e2">purā</span> <span class="e2">kalpe</span>–In the previous manifestation of the universe, <span class="e2">kali</span> <span class="e2">mahābalī haile</span>–as Kali became very strong, <span class="e2">śaunakādi ṛṣi-gaṇa sabe</span>–Śaunaka and other sages <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">śune</span>–heard <span class="e2">gaura-bhāgavata-dhana</span>–about the wealth of Lord Gaura <span class="e2">sūtera</span> <span class="e2">śrī-mukhe</span>–from the holy mouth of Sūta Goswāmī. [21]
“In the previous manifestation of the universe, as Kali became very strong, Śaunaka and other sages joyfully heard about Lord Gaura from the holy mouth of Sūta Goswāmī.

hethā yei jana	<span class="e10">purāṇa paṭhana</span><br />	<span class="e11">karaya kārtika māse</span><br />sarva-kleśa tyaje	<span class="e10">gaura-raṅge maje</span><br />	<span class="e11">vraja labhe anāyāse [22]</span>
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Anyone who <span class="e2">paṭhana karaya</span>–recites <span class="e2">purāṇa</span>–the Purāṇas <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">kārtika</span> <span class="e2">māse</span>–during the month of Kārtik (October–November) <span class="e2">tyaje</span>–leaves behind <span class="e2">sarva-kleśa</span>–all miseries, <span class="e2">maje</span>–becomes immersed <span class="e2">gaura-raṅge</span>–in the Pastimes of Gaura, [and] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attains <span class="e2">vraja</span>–Vraja. [22]
“Anyone who recites the Purāṇas here during the month of Kārtik leaves behind all miseries, becomes immersed in the Pastimes of Gaura, and easily attains Vraja.
কভু পঞ্চানন	<span class="e25">ছাড়ি’ বৃষাসন</span><br />	<span class="e26">শ্রীহংসবাহন হয়ে ।</span><br />শুনিল পুরাণ	<span class="e25">গৌরগুণগান</span><br />	<span class="e26">আপন ভকত লয়ে ॥২৩॥</span>

“Once, Śiva left Nandī, rode Brahmā’s swan here with his devotees, and heard the Purāṇas and songs about the glories of Gaura.
গাইয়া গাইয়া	<span class="e25">নাচিয়া নাচিয়া</span><br />	<span class="e26">শৈব যত কাশীবাসী ।</span><br />পঞ্চাননে ঘেরি’	<span class="e25">বলি’ ‘গৌরহরি’</span><br />	<span class="e26">পুষ্প ফেলে রাশি রাশি” ॥২৪॥</span>
