<span class="e2">gāiyā</span> <span class="e2">gāiyā</span>–Chanting [and] <span class="e2">nāchiyā</span> <span class="e2">nāchiyā</span>–dancing, <span class="e2">yata śaiva</span>–Śiva’s followers, [who] <span class="e2">kāśī-vāsī</span>–resided in Kāśī, <span class="e2">gheri’</span>–surrounded <span class="e2">pañchānane</span>–Śiva, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanted <span class="e2">‘gaurahari’</span>–‘Gaurahari’, [and] <span class="e2">phele</span>–threw <span class="e2">rāśi</span> <span class="e2">rāśi</span>–heaps <span class="e2">puṣpa”</span>–of flowers.” [24]
“Chanting and dancing, Śiva’s followers from Kāśī surrounded him, chanted the Name of Gaurahari, and showered flowers.”
নিতাই-বচন	<span class="e25">শুনিয়া তখন</span><br />	<span class="e26">জীবের উথলে ভাব ।</span><br />গড়াগড়ি যায়	<span class="e25">ধৈরয না পায়</span><br />	<span class="e26">আস্বাদে ধামপ্রভাব ॥২৫॥</span>

<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–hearing <span class="e2">nitāi-vachana</span>–the words of Nitāi, <span class="e2">jīvera bhāva uthale</span>–Jīva became ecstatic. <span class="e2">dhairaya</span> <span class="e2">pāya nā</span>–He lost [his] composure [and] <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled on the ground, <span class="e2">āsvāde</span>–relishing <span class="e2">dhāma-prabhāva</span>–the glory of [the Lord’s] abode. [25]
Hearing the words of Nitāi, Jīva became ecstatic. He lost his composure and rolled on the ground, relishing the glory of the Dhām.
সে দিন যাপন	<span class="e25">করে ভক্তগণ</span><br />	<span class="e26">নিতাইচাঁদের সনে ।</span><br />পরদিন সবে	<span class="e25">চলিলেন তবে</span><br />	<span class="e26">শ্রীপুষ্কর দরশনে ॥২৬॥</span>
se dina yāpana	<span class="e10">kare bhakta-gaṇa</span><br />	<span class="e11">nitāichā̐dera sane</span><br />para-dina sabe	<span class="e10">chalilena tabe</span><br />	<span class="e11">śrī-puṣkara daraśane [26]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">yāpana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–spent <span class="e2">se dina</span>–the day <span class="e2">nitāichā̐dera</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with Nitāichā̐d. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">para-dina</span>–the next day, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">chalilena</span>–went <span class="e2">daraśane</span>–to see <span class="e2">śrī-puṣkara</span>–Śrī Puṣkara. [26]
The devotees spent the day there with Nitāichā̐d. The next day, they went to see Śrī Puṣkara.
জাহ্নবা-নিতাই	<span class="e25">ভজন সদাই</span><br />	<span class="e26">যাহার অন্তরে জাগে ।</span><br />নদীয়া-মহিমা	<span class="e25">ভক্ত-মধুরিমা</span><br />	<span class="e26">গাইছে সে জন রাগে ॥২৭॥</span>
jāhnavā-nitāi	<span class="e10">bhajana sadāi</span><br />	<span class="e11">yāhāra antare jāge</span><br />nadīyā-mahimā	<span class="e10">bhakta-madhurimā</span><br />	<span class="e11">gāichhe se jana rāge [27]</span>
<span class="e2">se jana yāhāra antare</span>–He within whose heart <span class="e2">sadāi</span>–constant <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–service <span class="e2">jāhnavā</span>-<span class="e2">nitāi</span>–to Jāhnavā and Nitāi <span class="e2">jāge</span>–arises <span class="e2">rāge</span>–lovingly <span class="e2">gāichhe</span>–sings <span class="e2">bhakta-madhurimā</span>–of the sweetness of the devotees [and] <span class="e2">nadīyā-mahimā</span>–the glories of Nadia. [27]
As constant service to Jāhnavā and Nitāi arises in his heart, this soul lovingly sings of the sweetness of the devotees and the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Ten
Visiting Śrī Brāhmaṇa Puṣkara, Śrī Uchcha Haṭṭa, and Other Places
জয় গৌর নিত্যানন্দ অদ্বৈত সহিত ।<br />জয় গদাধর জয় শ্রীবাস পণ্ডিত ॥১॥
jaya gaura nityānanda advaita sahita<br />jaya gadādhara jaya śrīvāsa paṇḍita [1]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaura</span>–to Gaura <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda [and] <span class="e2">advaita</span>–Advaita! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span> <span class="e2">paṇḍita</span>–to Śrīvās Paṇḍit! [1]
All glory to Gaurāṅga, Nityānanda, and Advaita! All glory to Gadādhar and Śrīvās Paṇḍit!
জয় নবদ্বীপ শুদ্ধ প্রেমভক্তিধাম ।<br />জয় জয় জয় গৌর-নিত্যানন্দ-নাম ॥২॥
jaya navadvīpa śuddha prema-bhakti-dhāma<br />jaya jaya jaya gaura-nityānanda-nāma [2]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–to Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">prema-bhakti-dhāma</span>–the abode of pure love and devotion! <span class="e2">jaya jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaura-nityānanda-nāma</span>–to the Names of Gaura and Nityānanda! [2]
All glory to Nabadwīp, the abode of pure love and devotion! All glory to the Names of Gaura and Nityānanda!
শুনহে কলির জীব ছাড়ি’ জ্ঞান কর্ম্ম ।<br />নিতাই চৈতন্য ভজ ত্যজি’ ধর্ম্মাধর্ম্ম ॥৩॥
śunahe kalira jīva chhāḍi’ jñāna karma<br />nitāi chaitanya bhaja tyaji’ dharmādharma [3]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–O souls <span class="e2">kalira</span>–of Kali-yuga, <span class="e2">śunahe</span>–listen! <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Abandon <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–renunciation [and] <span class="e2">karma</span>–exploitation, <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–reject <span class="e2">dharmādharma</span>–religion and irreligion, [and] <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi [and] <span class="e2">chaitanya</span>–Chaitanya! [3]
O souls of Kali-yuga, listen! Abandon renunciation and exploitation, reject religion and irreligion, and serve Nitāi and Chaitanya!
দয়ার সমুদ্র সেই গৌর-নিত্যানন্দ ।<br />অকাতরে দিবে ভাই সার ব্রজানন্দ ॥৪॥
dayāra samudra sei gaura-nityānanda<br />akātare dibe bhāi sāra vrajānanda [4]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">gaura</span>-<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Gaura and Nityānanda [are] <span class="e2">samudra</span>–oceans <span class="e2">dayāra</span>–of mercy. <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">akātare</span>–Freely, <span class="e2">dibe</span>–They will give [you] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the essence <span class="e2">vrajānanda</span>–of Vraja’s joy. [4]
They are oceans of mercy. Brother! They will freely give you the essence of Vraja’s joy.
যামিনী প্রভাত হৈলে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />জীবেরে লইয়া ধামভ্রমণেতে যায় ॥৫॥
yāminī prabhāta haile nityānanda-rāya<br />jīvere la-iyā dhāma-bhramaṇete yāya [5]
<span class="e2">yāminī</span> <span class="e2">prabhāta</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–When dawn came, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–took <span class="e2">jīvere</span>–Jīva [and] <span class="e2">dhāma-bhramaṇete</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went out to tour the Dhām. [5]
At dawn, Nityānanda Rāy took Jīva and went out to tour the Dhām.
বলে, “দেখ জীব এই গ্রাম মনোহর ।<br />এখন ব্রাহ্মণপুরা ডাকে সর্ব্বনর ॥৬॥
bale, “dekha jīva ei grāma manohara<br />ekhana brāhmaṇa-purā ḍāke sarva-nara [6]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">“jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–look <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">manohara grāma</span>–at this beautiful village. <span class="e2">sarva-nara</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–calls [it] <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa-purā</span>–Brāhmaṇpur. [6]
He said, “Jīva, look at this beautiful village. Everyone now calls it Brāhmaṇpur.
ব্রাহ্মণপুষ্কর নাম সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কয় ।<br />হেথা যে রহস্য তাহা অতি গুহ্য হয় ॥৭॥
brāhmaṇa-puṣkara nāma sarva-śāstre kaya<br />hethā ye rahasya tāhā ati guhya haya [7]
<span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [its] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name [is] <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa-puṣkara</span>–Brāhmaṇ Puṣkar. <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">tāhā rahasya</span>–The Pastime that [happened] <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">guhya</span>–confidential. [7]
“All the scriptures call it Brāhmaṇ Puṣkara. A very confidential Pastime took place here.
সত্যযুগে দিবদাস নামেতে ব্রাহ্মণ ।<br />গৃহ ত্যজি’ করে সর্ব্বতীর্থ দরশন ॥৮॥
satya-yuge diva-dāsa nāmete brāhmaṇa<br />gṛha tyaji’ kare sarva-tīrtha daraśana [8]
<span class="e2">satya-yuge</span>–During Satya-yuga, <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa</span>–a brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–named <span class="e2">diva-dāsa</span>–Diva Dās <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–left <span class="e2">gṛha</span>–home [and] <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–visited <span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha</span>–all the holy places. [8]
“During Satya-yuga, a brāhmaṇ named Diva Dās left home and visited all the holy places.
পুষ্করতীর্থেতে তার হৈল বড় প্রীত ।<br />তথাপি ভ্রমিতে নবদ্বীপে উপস্থিত ॥৯॥
puṣkara-tīrthete tāra haila baḍa prīta<br />tathāpi bhramite navadvīpe upasthita [9]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">prīta haila</span>–He felt the greatest joy <span class="e2">puṣkara-tīrthete</span>–at Puṣkara Tīrtha. <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">bhramite</span>–he travelled [and] <span class="e2">upasthita</span>–came <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp. [9]
“He felt the greatest joy at Puṣkara Tīrtha. Still, he travelled, and eventually he came to Nabadwīp.
এই স্থানে রাত্রিযোগে দেখিল স্বপন ।<br />‘হেথা বাস কর বিপ্র পাবে নিত্যধন’ ॥১০॥
ei sthāne rātri-yoge dekhila svapana<br />‘hethā vāsa kara vipra pābe nitya-dhana’ [10]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–Here, <span class="e2">rātri-yoge</span>–during the night, <span class="e2">svapana dekhila</span>–he had a dream [in which he was told,] <span class="e2">‘vipra</span>–‘O brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–reside <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">nitya-dhana’</span>–eternal wealth.’ [10]
“Here, during the night, he had a dream in which he was told, ‘O brāhmaṇ, reside here and you will attain eternal wealth.’
এই স্থানে কুটীর বাঁধিয়া দিবদাস ।<br />বৃদ্ধকালাবধি তেঁহ করিলেন বাস ॥১১॥
ei sthāne kuṭīra bā̐dhiyā diva-dāsa<br />vṛddha-kālāvadhi te̐ha karilena vāsa [11]
<span class="e2">diva-dāsa</span>–Diva Dās <span class="e2">bā̐dhiyā</span>–built <span class="e2">kuṭīra</span>–a cottage <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–He <span class="e2">vāsa karilena</span>–resided [here] <span class="e2">vṛddha-kālāvadhi</span>–into his old age. [11]
“Diva Dās built a cottage and resided here into his old age.
বৃদ্ধকালে চলিতে অশক্ত দ্বিজবর ।<br />ইচ্ছা হৈল ‘এবে আমি দেখিব পুষ্কর’ ॥১২॥
vṛddha-kāle chalite aśakta dvija-vara<br />ichchhā haila ‘ebe āmi dekhiba puṣkara’ [12]
<span class="e2">vṛddha-kāle</span>–In [his] old age, <span class="e2">dvija-vara</span>–the great brāhmaṇ [was] <span class="e2">aśakta</span>–unable <span class="e2">chalite</span>–to travel [but] <span class="e2">ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–he desired, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span> <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–‘May I see <span class="e2">puṣkara</span>–Puṣkara <span class="e2">ebe’</span>–now.’ [12]
“In his old age, the great brāhmaṇ was unable to travel, but he desired to see Puṣkara.
চলিতে না পারে দ্বিজ করয় ক্রন্দন ।<br />‘আর না পাইব আমি পুষ্কর দর্শন’ ॥১৩॥
chalite nā pāre dvija karaya krandana<br />‘āra nā pāiba āmi puṣkara darśana’ [13]
<span class="e2">pāre nā</span>–Unable <span class="e2">chalite</span>–to travel, <span class="e2">dvija</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">krandana karaya</span>–cried, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I <span class="e2">darśana pāiba nā</span>–will never see <span class="e2">puṣkara</span>–Puṣkara <span class="e2">āra’</span>–again.’ [13]
“Unable to travel, the brāhmaṇ cried, ‘I will never see Puṣkara again.’
তখন পুষ্কররাজ সদয় হইল ।<br />দ্বিজরূপে দিবদাসে দরশন দিল ॥১৪॥
takhana puṣkara-rāja sadaya ha-ila<br />dvija-rūpe diva-dāse daraśana dila [14]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">puṣkara-rāja</span>–the Lord of Puṣkara <span class="e2">sadaya</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–felt compassion [and] <span class="e2">daraśan</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [himself] <span class="e2">diva-dāse</span>–to Diva Dās <span class="e2">dvija-rūpe</span>–in the form of a brāhmaṇ. [14]
“The Lord of Puṣkara felt compassion and revealed himself to Diva Dās in the form of a brāhmaṇ.
দিবদাসে বলে, ‘বিপ্র না কর ক্রন্দন ।<br />তোমার সম্মুখে এই কুণ্ড সুশোভন ॥১৫॥
diva-dāse bale, ‘vipra nā kara krandana<br />tomāra sammukhe ei kuṇḍa suśobhana [15]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said <span class="e2">diva-dāse</span>–to Diva Dās, <span class="e2">‘vipra</span>–‘O brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">krandana kara nā</span>–do not cry. [There is] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">suśobhana kuṇḍa</span>–a beautiful pond <span class="e2">sammukhe</span>–in front <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–of you. [15]
“He said to Diva Dās, ‘O brāhmaṇ, do not cry. There is a beautiful pond in front of you.
এই কুণ্ডে স্নান তুমি কর একবার ।<br />প্রত্যক্ষ হইবে তীর্থ পুষ্কর তোমার’ ॥১৬॥
ei kuṇḍe snāna tumi kara eka-bāra<br />pratyakṣa ha-ibe tīrtha puṣkara tomāra’ [16]
<span class="e2">tumi snāna</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Bathe <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">kuṇḍe</span>–in this pond <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once, [and] <span class="e2">tomāra pratyakṣa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–you will see <span class="e2">puṣkara tīrtha’</span>–Puṣkara Tīrtha.’ [16]
“‘Bathe in this pond once, and you will see Puṣkara Tīrtha.’
তাহা শুনি’ কুণ্ডে স্নান করে দ্বিজবর ।<br />দিব্যচক্ষু লভি’ দেখে সম্মুখে পুষ্কর ॥১৭॥
tāhā śuni’ kuṇḍe snāna kare dvija-vara<br />divya-chakṣu labhi’ dekhe sammukhe puṣkara [17]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–this, <span class="e2">dvija-vara</span>–the great brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">snāna</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–bathed <span class="e2">kuṇḍe</span>–in the pond. <span class="e2">labhi’</span>–Attaining <span class="e2">divya-chakṣu</span>–divine eyes, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–he saw <span class="e2">puṣkara</span>–Puṣkara <span class="e2">sammukhe</span>–before him. [17]
“Hearing this, the great brāhmaṇ bathed in the pond. Attaining divine eyes, he saw Puṣkara before him.
ক্রন্দন করিয়া দ্বিজ পুষ্করে বলিল ।<br />‘আমা লাগি’ বড় ক্লেশ তোমার হইল’ ॥১৮॥
krandana kariyā dvija puṣkare balila<br />‘āmā lāgi’ baḍa kleśa tomāra ha-ila’ [18]
<span class="e2">krandana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">dvija</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">balila</span>–said <span class="e2">puṣkare</span>–to Puṣkara, <span class="e2">‘tomāra baḍa</span> <span class="e2">kleśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–‘You have taken great trouble <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">lāgi’</span>–for me.’ [18]
“Crying, the brāhmaṇ said to Puṣkara, ‘You have taken great trouble for me.’
পুষ্কর বলেন, ‘শুন দ্বিজ ভাগ্যবান্ ।<br />দূর হৈতে না আসিনু হেথা বিদ্যমান ॥১৯॥
puṣkara balena, ‘śuna dvija bhāgyavān<br />dūra haite nā āsinu hethā vidyamāna [19]
<span class="e2">puṣkara</span>–Puṣkara <span class="e2">balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘bhāgyavān dvija</span>–‘O fortunate brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">āsinu nā</span>–I have not come <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">dūra</span>–far away. <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–I live <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [19]
“Puṣkara said, ‘Listen, O fortunate brāhmaṇ! I have not come from far away. I live here.
এই নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বতীর্থময় ।<br />নবদ্বীপে সেবি’ হেথা থাকে তীর্থচয় ॥২০॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-tīrthamaya<br />navadvīpe sevi’ hethā thāke tīrtha-chaya [20]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">sarva-tīrthamaya</span>–contains all holy places; <span class="e2">tīrtha-chaya</span>–all holy places <span class="e2">thāke</span>–reside <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">sevi’</span>–serve <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–Nabadwīp. [20]
“‘Nabadwīp Dhām contains all holy places; all holy places reside here and serve Nabadwīp.
আমার স্বরূপ এক পাশ্চাত্যে প্রকাশ ।<br />নিজে আমি এই স্থানে নিত্য করি বাস ॥২১॥
āmāra svarūpa eka pāśchātye prakāśa<br />nije āmi ei sthāne nitya kari vāsa [21]
<span class="e2">eka</span>–One <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–form of mine <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–exists <span class="e2">pāśchātye</span>–in the west (of India), [but] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">nije</span>–myself <span class="e2">vāsa kari</span>–live <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally. [21]
“‘Although a form of mine exists in the west, I myself live here eternally.
শতবার কেহ সেই তীর্থে করি’ স্নান ।<br />যেই ফল পায় হেথা সে ফল বিধান ॥২২॥
śata-bāra keha sei tīrthe kari’ snāna<br />yei phala pāya hethā se phala vidhāna [22]
<span class="e2">keha</span>–Souls <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">phala se phala</span>–the result <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–attained <span class="e2">snāna kari’</span>–by bathing <span class="e2">śata-bāra</span>–a hundred times <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">tīrthe</span>–there. [22]
“‘Souls attain here the result attained by bathing a hundred times there.
অতএব নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি’ যেই জন ।<br />অন্য তীর্থ আশা করে সে মূঢ় দুর্জ্জন ॥২৩॥
ataeva navadvīpa chhāḍi’ yei jana<br />anya tīrtha āśā kare se mūḍha durjana [23]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">yei se</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leaves <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">āśā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–desires [to visit] <span class="e2">anya</span>–other <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–holy places [is] <span class="e2">mūḍha</span> <span class="e2">durjana</span>–a foolish, unfortunate soul. [23]
“‘Thus, anyone who leaves Nabadwīp desiring to visit other holy places is a foolish, unfortunate soul.
সর্ব্বতীর্থ ভ্রমি’ যদি হয় ফলোদয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপ তবে তার বাসস্থান হয় ॥২৪॥
sarva-tīrtha bhrami’ yadi haya phalodaya<br />navadvīpa tabe tāra vāsa-sthāna haya [24]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–When <span class="e2">phalodaya haya</span>–souls attain the result <span class="e2">bhrami’</span>–of visiting <span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha</span>–all other holy places, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–becomes <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">vāsa-sthāna</span>–place of residence. [24]
“‘When souls attain the result of visiting all other holy places, then they can reside in Nabadwīp.
ঐ দেখ উচ্চস্থান হট্টের সমান ।<br />কুরুক্ষেত্র ব্রহ্মাবর্ত্ত তথা বিদ্যমান ॥২৫॥
ai dekha uchcha-sthāna haṭṭera samāna<br />kurukṣetra brahmāvarta tathā vidyamāna [25]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">ai</span>–there <span class="e2">uchcha-sthāna</span>–the raised area [that] <span class="e2">haṭṭera</span> <span class="e2">samāna</span>–resembles a market. <span class="e2">kurukṣetra</span>–Kurukṣetra [and] <span class="e2">brahmāvarta</span>–Brahmāvarta <span class="e2">vidyamāna</span>–exist <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [25]
“‘See there the raised area that resembles a market. Kurukṣetra and Brahmāvarta exist there.
সরস্বতী দৃষদ্বতী দুই পার্শে তার ।<br />অতি শোভা পায় পুণ্য করয়ে বিস্তার ॥২৬॥
sarasvatī dṛṣadvatī dui pārśe tāra<br />ati śobhā pāya puṇya karaye vistāra [26]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">pārśe</span>–On its two sides [are] <span class="e2">sarasvatī</span>–the Saraswatī [and] <span class="e2">dṛṣadvatī</span>–Dṛṣadvatī. [It] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–shines brightly [and] <span class="e2">puṇya</span> <span class="e2">vistāra karaye</span>–bestows good fortune. [26]
“‘With the Saraswatī and Dṛṣadvatī Rivers on its two sides, it shines brightly and bestows good fortune.
ওহে বিপ্র গূঢ় কথা বলিব তোমায় ।<br />অতি অল্প কালে হবে আনন্দ হেথায় ॥২৭॥
ohe vipra gūḍha kathā baliba tomāya<br />ati alpa kāle habe ānanda hethāya [27]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">vipra</span>–brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">baliba</span>–I will tell <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–you <span class="e2">gūḍha</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–a secret. <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">alpa</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–Within a very short time, <span class="e2">habe</span>–there will be <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–joy <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. [27]
“‘O brāhmaṇ, I will tell you a secret. Very soon there will be great joy here.
মায়াপুরে শচীগৃহে গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।<br />প্রকট হইয়া প্রেম বিলাবে বিস্তর ॥২৮॥
māyāpure śachī-gṛhe gaurāṅga-sundara<br />prakaṭa ha-iyā prema vilābe vistara [28]
<span class="e2">gaurāṅga-sundara</span>–Gaurāṅgasundar <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–will appear <span class="e2">śachī-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Śachī <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur [and] <span class="e2">vistara vilābe</span>–broadly distribute <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love. [28]
“‘Gaurāṅgasundar will appear in the home of Śachī in Māyāpur and broadly distribute divine love.
এই সব স্থানে প্রভু ভক্তবৃন্দ লয়ে ।<br />সঙ্কীর্ত্তনরসে নাচিবেন মত্ত হয়ে ॥২৯॥
ei saba sthāne prabhu bhakta-vṛnda laye<br />saṅkīrtana-rase nāchibena matta haye [29]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–In all these places, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">nāchibena</span>–will dance <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana-rase</span>–in the ecstasy of saṅkīrtan <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-vṛnda</span>–the devotees [and] <span class="e2">matta</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–become mad. [29]
“‘In all these places, the Lord will dance in the ecstasy of saṅkīrtan with the devotees and become mad.
সর্ব্ব-অবতারে ছিলা যে যে ভক্তগণ ।<br />সকলে লইয়া প্রভু করিবে কীর্ত্তন ॥৩০॥
sarva-avatāre chhilā ye ye bhakta-gaṇa<br />sakale la-iyā prabhu karibe kīrtana [30]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will perform <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–kīrtan <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–with <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span> <span class="e2">sakale</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">avatāre</span> <span class="e2">chhilā</span>–of all the previous Avatārs. [30]
“‘The Lord will perform kīrtan with all the devotees of all His previous Avatārs.
প্রেম-বন্যা জলে সর্ব্বজগৎ ভাসাবে ।<br />কুতার্কিক বিনা সবে মহাপ্রেম পাবে ॥৩১॥
prema-vanyā jale sarva-jagat bhāsābe<br />kutārkika vinā sabe mahāprema pābe [31]
<span class="e2">bhāsābe</span>–He will inundate <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">jagat</span>–the entire world <span class="e2">prema-vanyā</span> <span class="e2">jale</span>–with a flood of divine love. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">vinā</span>–except <span class="e2">kutārkika</span>–the speculators <span class="e2">pābe</span>–will attain <span class="e2">mahāprema</span>–intense divine love. [31]
“‘He will inundate the entire world with a flood of divine love. Everyone except the speculators will attain intense divine love.
এই ধামনিষ্ঠা করি’ যেবা করে বাস ।<br />তারে মিলে গৌরপদ ওহে দিবদাস ॥৩২॥
ei dhāma-niṣṭhā kari’ yebā kare vāsa<br />tāre mile gaura-pada ohe diva-dāsa [32]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">diva-dāsa</span>–Diva Dās, <span class="e2">yebā tāre</span>–souls who <span class="e2">dhāma-niṣṭhā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–are faithful to the abode [and] <span class="e2">vāsa kare</span>–reside <span class="e2">ei</span>–here <span class="e2">mile</span>–will reach <span class="e2">gaura-pada</span>–the feet of Gaura. [32]
“‘O Diva Dās, souls who are faithful to the Dhām and reside here will reach the feet of Gaura.
কোটি কোটি বর্ষ করি’ শ্রীকৃষ্ণভজন ।<br />তথাপি নামেতে রতি না পায় দুর্জ্জন ॥৩৩॥
koṭī koṭī varṣa kari’ śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana<br />tathāpi nāmete rati nā pāya durjana [33]
<span class="e2">durjana</span>–Unfortunate souls <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana kari’</span>–worship Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">koṭī</span> <span class="e2">koṭī</span> <span class="e2">varṣa</span>–for billions of years <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–but <span class="e2">pāya nā</span>–do not attain <span class="e2">rati</span>–attraction <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–to [His] Name. [33]
“Unfortunate souls worship Kṛṣṇa for billions of years but do not attain attraction to His Name.
গৌরাঙ্গ ভজিলে দুষ্টভাব দূরে যায় ।<br />অল্প দিনে ব্রজধামে রাধা-কৃষ্ণ পায় ॥৩৪॥
gaurāṅga bhajile duṣṭa-bhāva dūre yāya<br />alpa dine vraja-dhāme rādhā-kṛṣṇa pāya [34]
<span class="e2">bhajile</span>–If souls worship <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga, [their] <span class="e2">duṣṭa-bhāva</span>–wickedness <span class="e2">yāya</span>–goes <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away, [and they] <span class="e2">alpa</span> <span class="e2">dine</span>–quickly <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">vraja-dhāme</span>–in Vraja Dhām. [34]
“‘If souls worship Gaurāṅga, their wickedness goes away, and they quickly attain Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja Dhām.
নিজ সিদ্ধদেহ পায় সখীর আশ্রয় ।<br />নিজ কুঞ্জ শ্রীযুগলসেবা তার হয় ॥৩৫॥
nija siddha-deha pāya sakhīra āśraya<br />nija kuñja śrī-yugala-sevā tāra haya [35]
<span class="e2">pāya</span>–They attain <span class="e2">nija</span>–their <span class="e2">siddha-deha</span>–spiritual body [and] <span class="e2">sakhīra</span> <span class="e2">āśraya</span>–the shelter of the sakhīs, [and] <span class="e2">tāra śrī-yugala-sevā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–serve the Divine Couple <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">kuñja</span>–in their own grove. [35]
“‘They attain their spiritual body and the shelter of the sakhīs, and serve the Divine Couple in their own grove.
ওহে বিপ্র হেথা থাকি’ করহ ভজন ।<br />সপার্ষদে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ পাবে দরশন’ ॥৩৬॥
ohe vipra hethā thāki’ karaha bhajana<br />sapārṣade śrī-gaurāṅga pābe daraśana’ [36]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">vipra</span>–brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–stay [and] <span class="e2">bhajana karaha</span>–serve <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">daraśana pābe</span>–You will see <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">sapārṣade’</span>–with [His] associates.’ [36]
“‘O brāhmaṇ, stay and serve here. You will see Śrī Gaurāṅga with His associates.’
এই কথা বলি’ তীর্থরাজ গেল চলি’ ।<br />শুনিল আকাশবাণী আইসে, ‘ধন্য কলি ॥৩৭॥
ei kathā bali’ tīrtha-rāja gela chali’<br />śunila ākāśa-vāṇī āise, ‘dhanya kali [37]
<span class="e2">kathā bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">ei</span>–this, <span class="e2">tīrtha-rāja</span>–the Lord of Puṣkara <span class="e2">chali’ gela</span>–left. <span class="e2">śunila</span>–The brāhmaṇ [then] heard <span class="e2">ākāśa-vāṇī</span> <span class="e2">āise</span>–a voice come from the sky, <span class="e2">‘dhanya</span>–Glory <span class="e2">kali</span>–to the Age of Kali! [37]
“Saying this, the Lord of Puṣkara left. The brāhmaṇ then heard a voice come from the sky, ‘Glory to the Age of Kali!
তুমি বিপ্র সেই কালে জন্মিবে আবার ।<br />শ্রীগৌরকীর্ত্তন প্রেমে দিবে ত সাঁতার’ ॥৩৮॥
tumi vipra sei kāle janmibe ābāra<br />śrī-gaura-kīrtana preme dibe ta sā̐tāra’ [38]
<span class="e2">vipra</span>–O brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">janmibe</span>–will be born <span class="e2">ābāra</span>–again <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–at that time [and] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">sā̐tāra dibe</span>–swim <span class="e2">preme</span>–in the divine love <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-kīrtana’</span>–of Śrī Gaura’s kīrtan.’ [38]
“‘O brāhmaṇ, you will be born again at that time and swim in the divine love of Śrī Gaura’s kīrtan.’
এত শুনি’ দিবদাস নিশ্চিন্ত হইল ।<br />এই কুণ্ডতীরে বসি’ ভজন করিল” ॥৩৯॥
eta śuni diva-dāsa niśchinta ha-ila<br />ei kuṇḍa-tīre vasi’ bhajana karila” [39]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">diva-dāsa</span>–Diva Dās <span class="e2">niśchinta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became fearless. <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–He resided <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">kuṇḍa-tīre</span>–on the bank of the pond [and] <span class="e2">bhajana</span> <span class="e2">karila”</span>–performed worship.” [39]
“Hearing this, Diva Dās became fearless. He resided on the bank of the pond and performed worship.”
এ সব পুরাণ কথা শ্রীজীবে কহিয়া ।<br />উচ্চহট্ট কুরুক্ষত্রে প্রবেশিল গিয়া ॥৪০॥
e saba purāṇa kathā śrī-jīve kahiyā<br />uchcha-haṭṭa kurukṣetre praveśila giyā [40]
<span class="e2">kahiyā</span>–After telling <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">e saba</span> <span class="e2">purāṇa</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–these ancient stories, <span class="e2">giyā praveśila</span>–Nityānanda entered <span class="e2">uchcha-haṭṭa</span> <span class="e2">kurukṣetre</span>–Uchcha Haṭṭa, Kurukṣetra. [40]
After telling Śrī Jīva these ancient stories, Nityānanda entered Uchcha Haṭṭa, Kurukṣetra.
নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “হেথা সর্ব্বদেবগণ ।<br />কুরুক্ষেত্র তীর্থ সহ কৈল আগমন ॥৪১॥
nityānanda bale, “hethā sarva-deva-gaṇa<br />kurukṣetra tīrtha saha kaila āgamana [41]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“sarva-deva-gaṇa</span>–“All the gods <span class="e2">āgamana kaila</span>–came <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">saha</span>–with <span class="e2">kurukṣetra</span> <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–Kurukṣetra Tīrtha. [41]
Nityānanda said, “All the gods came here with Kurukṣetra Tīrtha.
ব্রহ্মাবর্ত্তে কুরুক্ষেত্রে যত তীর্থ ছিল ।<br />সর্ব্বতীর্থ আসি’ হেথা বিরাজ করিল ॥৪২॥
brahmāvarte kurukṣetre yata tīrtha chhila<br />sarva-tīrtha āsi’ hethā virāja karila [42]
<span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha</span>–All the holy places, <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–all the holy places [that] <span class="e2">chhila</span>–were <span class="e2">brahmāvarte</span> <span class="e2">kurukṣetre</span>–in Brahmāvarta and Kurukṣetra, <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came [and] <span class="e2">virāja</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–resided <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [42]
“All the holy places in Brahmāvarta and Kurukṣetra came and resided here.
পৃথূদক আদি করি’ সব হেথা বৈসে ।<br />সবে নবদ্বীপ সেবা করে অনায়াসে” ॥৪৩॥
pṛthūdaka ādi kari’ saba hethā vaise<br />sabe navadvīpa sevā kare anāyāse” [43]
<span class="e2">pṛthūdaka</span>–Pṛthūdaka <span class="e2">ādi saba</span>–and all the other holy places <span class="e2">kari’ vaise</span>–resided <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–They all <span class="e2">sevā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–served <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">anāyāse”</span>–without difficulty.” [43]
“Pṛthūdaka and the other holy places resided here and served Nabadwīp without difficulty.”
শতবর্ষ কুরুক্ষেত্রে বাসে যেই ফল ।<br />হেথা একরাত্র বাসে লভে সে সকল ॥৪৪॥
śata-varṣa kurukṣetre vāse yei phala<br />hethā eka-rātra vāse labhe se sakala [44]
<span class="e2">vāse</span>–By staying <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">eka-rātra</span>–for one night, <span class="e2">labhe</span>–souls attain <span class="e2">yei se sakala</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–the full result <span class="e2">vāse</span>–of residing <span class="e2">kurukṣetre</span>–in Kurukṣetra <span class="e2">śata-varṣa</span>–for a hundred years. [44]
By staying here for one night, souls attain the full result of residing in Kurukṣetra for a hundred years.
প্রভু বলে, “হেথা বাস করি’ দেবগণ ।<br />হট্ট করি’ গৌরকথা করে আলোচন ॥৪৫॥
prabhu bale, “hethā vāsa kari’ deva-gaṇa<br />haṭṭa kari’ gaura-kathā kare ālochana [45]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“deva-gaṇa</span>–“The gods <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–resided <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, <span class="e2">haṭṭa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–established a market, [and] <span class="e2">gaura-kathā</span> <span class="e2">ālochana kare</span>–discussed Gaura. [45]
Nityānanda Prabhu continued, “The gods resided here, established a market, and discussed Gaurāṅga.
হট্টডাঙ্গা বলি’ নাম হইল ইহার ।<br />ইহার দর্শনে পায় প্রেমপারাবার ॥৪৬॥
haṭṭa-ḍāṅgā bali’ nāma ha-ila ihāra<br />ihāra darśane pāya prema-pārābāra [46]
<span class="e2">ihāra</span>–Its <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name <span class="e2">bali’ ha-ila</span>–became <span class="e2">haṭṭa-ḍāṅgā</span>–Haṭṭaḍāṅgā (‘upland market’). <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">darśane</span>–By seeing it, <span class="e2">prema-pārābāra pāya</span>–souls enter an ocean of divine love. [46]
“The name of this place thus became Haṭṭaḍāṅgā. By seeing this place, souls enter an ocean of divine love.
এই এক সীমা জীব দেখ নদীয়ার ।<br />এবে চল যাই মোরা ভাগীরথী পার” ॥৪৭॥
ei eka sīmā jīva dekha nadīyāra<br />ebe chala yāi morā bhāgīrathī pāra” [47]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see [here.] <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">sīmā</span>–of the boundaries <span class="e2">nadīyāra</span>–of Nadia. <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">morā chala pāra yāi</span>–let us go and cross <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī”</span>–the Gaṅgā.” [47]
“O Jīva, see here one of the boundaries of Nadia. Let us now cross the Gaṅgā.”
ভাগীরথী পার হয়ে মধ্যাহ্ন সময় ।<br />কোলদ্বীপে নিত্যানন্দ হইল উদয় ॥৪৮॥
bhāgīrathī pāra haye madhyāhna samaya<br />koladvīpe nityānanda ha-ila udaya [48]
<span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–Crossing <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–arrived <span class="e2">koladvīpe</span>–in Koladwīp <span class="e2">madhyāhna</span> <span class="e2">samaya</span>–at midday. [48]
Crossing the Gaṅgā, Nityānanda Prabhu arrived in Koladwīp at midday.
কুলিয়াপাহাড়পুরে যাইতে যাইতে ।<br />শ্রীজীবে নিতাইচাঁদ লাগিল কহিতে ॥৪৯॥
kuliyāpāhāḍapure yāite yāite<br />śrī-jīve nitāichā̐da lāgila kahite [49]
<span class="e2">yāite</span> <span class="e2">yāite</span>–While going <span class="e2">kuliyāpāhāḍapure</span>–to Kuliyāpāhāḍapur, <span class="e2">nitāichā̐da</span>–Nitāichā̐d <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–began <span class="e2">kahite</span>–to speak <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–to Śrī Jīva. [49]
On the way to Kuliyāpāhāḍapur, Nitāichā̐d spoke to Śrī Jīva.
“যে ক্রমে আইনু মোরা হয়ে গঙ্গা পার ।<br />সেই ক্রম সিদ্ধ-ক্রম পরিক্রমা-সার ॥৫০॥
“ye krame āinu morā haye gaṅgā pāra<br />sei krama siddha-krama parikramā-sāra [50]
<span class="e2">“ye</span> <span class="e2">krame sei</span> <span class="e2">krama</span>–“The way <span class="e2">morā</span>–we <span class="e2">āinu</span>–have come, <span class="e2">pāra haye</span>–crossing <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā, [is] <span class="e2">siddha-krama</span>–the proper way <span class="e2">parikramā-sāra</span>–to best circumambulate [the Dhām]. [50]
“The way we have come, crossing the Gaṅgā, is the proper way to circumambulate the Dhām.
যবে প্রভু শ্রীচৈতন্য লয়ে নিজগণ ।<br />করিলেন শ্রীচৌদ্দমাদল সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥৫১॥
কাজিরে শোধিতে প্রভু সন্ধ্যা আগমনে ।<br />মায়াপুর ছাড়ি’ চলে লয়ে ভক্তজনে ॥৫২॥
yabe prabhu śrī-chaitanya laye nija-gaṇa<br />karilena śrī-chaudda-mādala saṅkīrtana [51]
kājire śodhite prabhu sandhyā āgamane<br />māyāpura chhāḍi’ chale laye bhakta-jane [52]
[One] <span class="e2">sandhyā</span>–evening, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya prabhu</span>–Lord Śrī Chaitanya, [along] <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">nija-gaṇa</span>–His associates, <span class="e2">karilena</span>–performed <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–saṅkīrtan [with] <span class="e2">śrī-chaudda-mādala</span>–fourteen mṛdaṅgas, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">chale</span>–left <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-jane</span>–the devotees [and] <span class="e2">āgamane</span>–came <span class="e2">śodhite</span>–to purify <span class="e2">kājire</span>–the Kāzī. [51<span class="e2">–</span>52]
“One evening, while performing saṅkīrtan with fourteen mṛdaṅgas, Śrī Chaitanya left Māyāpur with His associates and came to purify the Kāzī.
সেই রাত্র ব্রহ্মরাত্র শীঘ্র নহে শেষ ।<br />এই ক্রমে মহাপ্রভু ভ্রমে নিজদেশ ॥৫৩॥
sei rātra brahma-rātra śīghra nahe śeṣa<br />ei krame mahāprabhu bhrame nija-deśa [53]
<span class="e2">sei rātra</span>–That night, <span class="e2">brahma-rātra</span>–[like] a night of Brahmā, <span class="e2">śeṣa nahe</span>–did not end <span class="e2">śīghra</span>–quickly. <span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">bhrame</span>–toured <span class="e2">nija-deśa</span>–His abode <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">krame</span>–in this way. [53]
“That night, like a night of Brahmā, did not end quickly. Mahāprabhu toured His abode in this way.
তারপর প্রতি একাদশী-তিথি ধরি’ ।<br />ভ্রমিলা আমার প্রভু সঙ্কীর্ত্তন করি’ ॥৫৪॥
tārapara prati ekādaśī-tithi dhari’<br />bhramilā āmāra prabhu saṅkīrtana kari’ [54]
<span class="e2">tārapara</span>–Thereafter, <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">bhramilā</span>–toured <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–performing saṅkīrtan <span class="e2">prati ekādaśī-tithi</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–on every Ekādaśī. [54]
“Thereafter, My Lord toured performing saṅkīrtan on every Ekādaśī.
কভু পঞ্চক্রোশ ভ্রমে অন্তর্দ্বীপময় ।<br />কভু অষ্টক্রোশ ভ্রমে যেন মনে লয় ॥৫৫॥
kabhu pañcha-krośa bhrame antardvīpamaya<br />kabhu aṣṭa-krośa bhrame yena mane laya [55]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">bhrame</span>–He toured <span class="e2">pañcha-krośa</span>–the ten miles <span class="e2">antardvīpamaya</span>–of Antardwīp, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes, <span class="e2">yena</span>–as <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">laya</span>–He desired, <span class="e2">bhrame</span>–He toured <span class="e2">aṣṭa-krośa</span>–for sixteen miles. [55]
“Sometimes He toured the ten miles of Antardwīp, and sometimes, as He desired, He toured for sixteen miles.
নিজ গৃহ হৈতে বারকোণা ঘাট ছাড়ি’ ।<br />দীর্ঘিকা বেষ্টনে যায় শ্রীধরের বাড়ী ॥৫৬॥
nija gṛha haite bārakoṇā ghāṭa chhāḍi’<br />dīrghikā veṣṭane yāya śrīdharera bāḍī [56]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">nija gṛha</span>–His home, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–He would leave <span class="e2">bārakoṇā</span> <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–Bārakoṇā Ghāṭ [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">veṣṭane</span>–around <span class="e2">dīrghikā</span>–Ballāl Dīrghikā <span class="e2">śrīdharera</span> <span class="e2">bāḍī</span>–to Śrīdhar’s house. [56]
“From His home, He would leave Bārakoṇā Ghāt and go around Ballāl Dīrghikā to Śrīdhar’s house.
তথা হৈতে অন্তর্দ্বীপ সীমা ভ্রমি’ আসে ।<br />পঞ্চক্রোশ পরিক্রমা হয় অনায়াসে ॥৫৭॥
tathā haite antardvīpa sīmā bhrami’ āse<br />pañcha-krośa parikramā haya anāyāse [57]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, <span class="e2">bhrami’</span>–He would tour <span class="e2">sīmā</span>–around the boundary <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–of Antardwīp [and] <span class="e2">āse</span>–return. [In this way,] <span class="e2">parikramā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–He would circumambulate <span class="e2">pañcha-krośa</span>–the ten miles <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily. [57]
“From there, He would tour around the boundary of Antardwīp and then return. In this way, He would easily circumambulate for ten miles.
সিমুলিয়া হয়ে কাজিগৃহে বেড়ি’ চলে ।<br />শ্রীধরে সম্ভাষি’ আইসে গাদিগাছা স্থলে ॥৫৮॥
simuliyā haye kāji-gṛhe beḍi’ chale<br />śrīdhare sambhāṣi’ āise gādigāchhā sthale [58]
[Other times,] <span class="e2">haye</span>–passing <span class="e2">simuliyā</span>–Simuliyā, <span class="e2">beḍi’</span> <span class="e2">chale</span>–He would go <span class="e2">kāji-gṛhe</span>–to the house of the Kāzī, <span class="e2">sambhāṣi’</span>–speak <span class="e2">śrīdhare</span>–with Śrīdhar, [and then] <span class="e2">āise</span>–come <span class="e2">gādigāchhā</span> <span class="e2">sthale</span>–to the place of Gādigāchhā. [58]
“Other times, passing Simuliyā, He would go to the house of the Kāzī, speak with Śrīdhar, and then come to Gādigāchhā.
মাজিদা হইতে হয় ভাগীরথী পার ।<br />পারডাঙ্গা ছিনাডাঙ্গা পুলিন বিস্তর ॥৫৯॥
mājidā haite haya bhāgīrathī pāra<br />pāraḍāṅgā chhināḍāṅgā pulina vistara [59]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">mājidā</span>–Mājidā, <span class="e2">pāra haya</span>–He would cross <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–the Gaṅgā [and tour] <span class="e2">pāraḍāṅgā</span>–Pāraḍāṅgā [and] <span class="e2">chhināḍāṅgā</span>–Chhināḍāṅgā <span class="e2">vistara pulina</span>–along the broad riverbank. [59]
“From Mājidā, He would cross the Gaṅgā and tour Pāraḍāṅgā and Chhināḍāṅgā along the broad riverbank.
ছাড়িয়া জাহ্নবী পার হইয়া তখন ।<br />অষ্টক্রোশ ভ্রমি’ চলে আপন ভবন ॥৬০॥
chhāḍiyā jāhnavī pāra ha-iyā takhana<br />aṣṭa-krośa bhrami’ chale āpana bhavana [60]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–He would leave, <span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–cross <span class="e2">jāhnavī</span>–the Gaṅgā, [and] <span class="e2">chale</span>–return <span class="e2">āpana</span> <span class="e2">bhavana</span>–to His home, [thus] <span class="e2">bhrami’</span>–touring <span class="e2">aṣṭa-krośa</span>–for sixteen miles. [60]
“Then He would cross the Gaṅgā again and return to His home, thus touring for sixteen miles.
সিদ্ধ পরিক্রমা হয় পূর্ণ ষোলক্রোশ ।<br />সেই পরিক্রমা কৈলে প্রভুর সন্তোষ ॥৬১॥
siddha parikramā haya pūrṇa ṣola-krośa<br />sei parikramā kaile prabhura santoṣa [61]
<span class="e2">siddha</span> <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–A complete circumambulation <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">pūrṇa ṣola-krośa</span>–the full thirty-two miles. <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">santoṣa</span>–The Lord is pleased <span class="e2">kaile</span>–if someone performs <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation. [61]
“A complete circumambulation is the full thirty-two miles. The Lord is pleased if someone completes this.
সেই পরিক্রমা আমি তোমারে করাই ।<br />ইহার সমান পরিক্রমা আর নাই ॥৬২॥
sei parikramā āmi tomāre karāi<br />ihāra samāna parikramā āra nāi [62]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">karāi</span>–am taking <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–you <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–on that circumambulation. <span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">āra</span>–other <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">samāna</span>–equal to it. [62]
“I am taking you on this complete circumambulation. There is no circumambulation equal to it.
বৃন্দাবন ষোলক্রোশ দ্বাদশ কানন ।<br />এই পরিক্রমা মধ্যে পাবে দরশন ॥৬৩॥
vṛndāvana ṣola-krośa dvādaśa kānana<br />ei parikramā madhye pābe daraśana [63]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–During <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation, <span class="e2">daraśana pābe</span>–you will see <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–the thirty-two miles [and] <span class="e2">dvādaśa</span> <span class="e2">kānana</span>–the twelve forests <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–of Vṛndāvan. [63]
“During this circumambulation, you will see all thirty-two miles of the Dhām and the twelve forests of Vṛndāvan.
নবরাত্রে এই পরিক্রমা শেষ হয় ।<br />নবরাত্র বলি’ এর নাম শাস্ত্রে কয় ॥৬৪॥
nava-rātre ei parikramā śeṣa haya<br />nava-rātra bali’ nāma śāstre kaya [64]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation <span class="e2">śeṣa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–is completed <span class="e2">nava-rātre</span>–over the course of nine nights; <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">nāma bali’ kaya</span>–call [it] <span class="e2">nava-rātra</span>–‘nine nights’. [64]
“This circumambulation is completed over the course of nine nights; the scriptures call it the ‘nava-rātra parikramā’.
পঞ্চক্রোশ পরিক্রমা একদিনে করে ।<br />রাত্রত্রয় অষ্টক্রোশ পরিক্রমা ধরে ॥৬৫॥
pañcha-krośa parikramā eka-dine kare<br />rātra-traya aṣṭa-krośa parikramā dhare [65]
<span class="e2">kare</span>–Devotees perform <span class="e2">pañcha-krośa</span> <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–the ten-mile circumambulation <span class="e2">eka-dine</span>–in one day [and] <span class="e2">dhare</span>–complete <span class="e2">aṣṭa-krośa parikramā</span>–the sixteen-mile circumambulation <span class="e2">rātra-traya</span>–over the course of three nights. [65]
“Devotees perform the ten-mile circumambulation in one day and complete the sixteen-mile circumambulation over the course of three nights.
একরাত্র মায়াপুরে দ্বিতীয় গোদ্রুমে ।<br />পুলিনে তৃতীয় রাত্র এই ক্রমে ভ্রমে” ॥৬৬॥
eka-rātra māyāpure dvitīya godrume<br />puline tṛtīya rātra ei krame bhrame” [66]
<span class="e2">eka-rātra</span>–One night [is] <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur. <span class="e2">dvitīya</span>–The second [is] <span class="e2">godrume</span>–in Godrumadwīp. <span class="e2">tṛtīya</span> <span class="e2">rātra</span>–The third night [is] <span class="e2">puline</span>–in Śrī Pulina. <span class="e2">bhrame</span>–Devotees tour <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">krame”</span>–in this way.” [66]
“One night is in Māyāpur, the second is in Godrumadwīp, and the third night is in Śrī Pulina. Devotees tour in this way.”
শুনি’ পরিক্রমা-তত্ত্ব জীবমহাশয় ।<br />প্রেমেতে অধৈর্য্য হয়ে কতক্ষণ রয় ॥৬৭॥
śuni’ parikramā-tattva jīva-mahāśaya<br />premete adhairya haye kata-kṣaṇa raya [67]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">parikramā-tattva</span>–about the process of circumambulation, <span class="e2">jīva-mahāśaya</span>–Jīva Goswāmī <span class="e2">adhairya</span> <span class="e2">haye raya</span>–became overwhelmed <span class="e2">premete</span>–with divine love <span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇa</span>–for some time. [67]
Hearing about the process of circumambulation, Śrī Jīva Goswāmī became overwhelmed with divine love for some time.
নিতাইজাহ্নবাপদছায়া আশ যার ।<br />নদীয়া-মহিমা বর্ণে অকিঞ্চন ছার ॥৬৮॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā āśa yāra<br />nadīyā-mahimā varṇe akiñchana chhāra [68]
<span class="e2">akiñchana</span> <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–This poor, fallen soul, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">varṇe</span>–describes <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–the glories <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–of Nadia. [68]
This poor, fallen soul, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, describes the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Eleven
Śrī Śrī Koladwīp, Śrī Samudragaḍ, Śrī Champā Haṭṭa, and Śrī Jayadev
জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।<br />জয়াদ্বৈত-শ্রীবাসাদি গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥১॥
jaya jaya śrī-chaitanya jaya nityānanda<br />jayādvaita-śrīvāsādi gaura-bhakta-vṛnda [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–to Śrī Chaitanya! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–to Nityānanda! <span class="e2">jayādvaita-śrīvāsādi</span> <span class="e2">gaura-bhakta-vṛnda</span>–All glory to Advaita, Śrīvās, and all the devotees of the Lord! [1]
All glory to Śrī Chaitanya, Nityānanda, Advaita, Śrīvās, and all the devotees of the Lord!
জয় জয় গৌড়ভূমি সর্ব্বভূমিসার ।<br />যথা নামসহ শ্রীচৈতন্য অবতার ॥২॥
jaya jaya gauḍa-bhūmi sarva-bhūmi-sāra<br />yathā nāma-saha śrī-chaitanya avatāra [2]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gauḍa-bhūmi</span>–to the land of Gauḍa, <span class="e2">sarva-bhūmi-sāra</span>–the best of all lands, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">avatāra</span>–descended <span class="e2">nāma-saha</span>–with [His] Name! [2]
All glory to the land of Gauḍa, the best of all lands, where Śrī Chaitanya descended with His Name!
নিত্যানন্দপ্রভু বলে, “শুন সর্ব্বজন ।<br />পঞ্চবেণীরূপে গঙ্গা হেথায় মিলন ॥৩॥
nityānanda prabhu bale, “śuna sarva-jana<br />pañchaveṇī-rūpe gaṅgā hethāya milana [3]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“sarva-jana</span>–“Everyone, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–Here, <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">milana</span>–convenes <span class="e2">pañchaveṇī-rūpe</span>–with five other rivers. [3]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Everyone, listen! Here, the Gaṅgā convenes with five other rivers.
মন্দাকিনী অলকা সহিত ভাগীরথী ।<br />গুপ্তভাবে হেথায় আছেন সরস্বতী ॥৪॥
mandākinī alakā sahita bhāgīrathī<br />gupta-bhāve hethāya āchhena sarasvatī [4]
<span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–The Gaṅgā [flows] <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">mandākinī alakā </span>–the Mandākinī and Alakānandā. <span class="e2">sarasvatī</span>–The Saraswatī <span class="e2">gupta-bhāve āchhena</span>–is hidden <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. [4]
“The Gaṅgā flows here with the Mandākinī and the Alakānandā. The Saraswatī is also hidden here.
পশ্চিমে যমুনা সহ আইসে ভোগবতী ।<br />তাহাতে মানসগঙ্গা মহাবেগবতী ॥৫॥
paśchime yamunā saha āise bhogavatī<br />tāhāte mānasa-gaṅgā mahāvegavatī [5]
<span class="e2">yamunā</span>–The Yamunā <span class="e2">āise</span>–comes <span class="e2">paśchime</span>–from the west <span class="e2">saha</span>–with <span class="e2">bhogavatī</span>–the Bhogavatī. <span class="e2">mahāvegavatī mānasa-gaṅgā</span>–The swift Mānasa Gaṅgā [also flows] <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–within them. [5]
“The Yamunā comes from the west with the Bhogavatī, and the swift Mānasa Gaṅgā also flows within them.
মহা মহা প্রয়াগ বলিয়া ঋষিগণে ।<br />কোটি কোটি যজ্ঞ হেথা কৈল ব্রহ্মা সনে ॥৬॥
mahā mahā prayāga baliyā ṛṣi-gaṇe<br />koṭi koṭi yajña hethā kaila brahmā sane [6]
<span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Considering [this place] <span class="e2">mahā</span> <span class="e2">mahā</span> <span class="e2">prayāga</span>–Mahāprayāg, <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇe</span>–sages <span class="e2">kaila</span>–have performed <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">koṭi</span>–billions <span class="e2">yajña</span>–of sacrifices <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sane</span>–with <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Lord Brahmā. [6]
“Considering this place Mahāprayāg, sages have performed billions of sacrifices here with Lord Brahmā.
ব্রহ্মসত্র স্থান এই মহিমা অপার ।<br />হেথা স্নান করিলে জনম নহে আর ॥৭॥
brahma-satra sthāna ei mahimā apāra<br />hethā snāna karile janama nahe āra [7]
<span class="e2">mahimā</span>–The glories <span class="e2">ei sthāna</span>–of this place <span class="e2">brahma-satra</span>–of Brahmā’s sacrifices [are] <span class="e2">apāra</span>–unlimited. <span class="e2">snāna</span> <span class="e2">karile</span>–If a soul bathes <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, <span class="e2">janama</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–they do not take birth <span class="e2">āra</span>–again. [7]
“The glories of this place of Brahmā’s sacrifices are unlimited. If a soul bathes here, they do not take birth again.
ইহার মহিমা কেবা বর্ণিবারে পারে ।<br />শুষ্ক ধারাসম কোন তীর্থ হইতে নারে ॥৮॥
ihāra mahimā kebā varṇibāre pāre<br />śuṣka dhārā-sama kona tīrtha ha-ite nāre [8]
<span class="e2">kebā</span>–Who <span class="e2">pāre</span>–can <span class="e2">varṇibāre</span>–describe <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–the glories <span class="e2">ihāra</span>–of this place? <span class="e2">ha-ite</span> <span class="e2">nāre</span>–It cannot be <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–a holy place [that is] <span class="e2">śuṣka</span> <span class="e2">dhārā-sama</span>–like a dry river. [8]
“Who can describe the glories of this place? It is not a holy place that is now simply a dry river.
জলে-স্থলে-অন্তরীক্ষে ত্যজিয়া জীবন ।<br />সর্ব্বজীব পায় শ্রীগোলোক-বৃন্দাবন ॥৯॥
jale-sthale-antarīkṣe tyajiyā jīvana<br />sarva-jīva pāya śrī-goloka-vṛndāvana [9]
<span class="e2">sarva-jīva</span>–All souls [who] <span class="e2">tyajiyā</span>–give up [their] <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–life <span class="e2">jale-sthale-antarīkṣe</span>–in the water, on the earth, or in the air [here] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">śrī-goloka-vṛndāvana</span>–Śrī Goloka Vṛndāvan. [9]
“All souls who give up their life in the water, on the earth, or in the air here attain Śrī Goloka Vṛndāvan.
কুলিয়াপাহাড় বলি’ খ্যাত এই স্থান ।<br />গঙ্গাতীরে উচ্চভূমি পর্ব্বত-সমান ॥১০॥
kuliyāpāhāḍa bali’ khyāta ei sthāna<br />gaṅgā-tīre uchcha-bhūmi parvata-samāna [10]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–This place <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">khyāta</span>–is known as <span class="e2">kuliyāpāhāḍa</span>–Kuliyāpāhāḍa. [It is] <span class="e2">uchcha-bhūmi</span>–a raised land <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">parvata-samāna</span>–resembling a mountain. [10]
“This place is known as Kuliyāpāhāḍa. It is a raised land on the bank of the Gaṅgā, resembling a mountain.
কোলদ্বীপ নাম শাস্ত্রে আছয় বর্ণন ।<br />সত্যযুগ-কথা এক শুন সর্ব্বজন ॥১১॥
koladvīpa nāma śāstre āchhaya varṇana<br />satya-yuga-kathā eka śuna sarva-jana [11]
<span class="e2">nāma varṇana āchhaya</span>–It is named <span class="e2">koladvīpa</span>–Koladwīp <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–in the scriptures. <span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen <span class="e2">eka satya-yuga-kathā</span>–to a story from Satya-yuga. [11]
“It is called Koladwīp in the scriptures. Everyone, listen to a story from Satya-yuga.
বাসুদেব নামে এক ব্রাহ্মণকুমার ।<br />বরাহদেবের সেবা করে বারবার ॥১২॥
vāsudeva nāme eka brāhmaṇa-kumāra<br />varāhadevera sevā kare bāra-bāra [12]
[There was] <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa-kumāra</span>–brāhmaṇ boy <span class="e2">nāme</span>–named <span class="e2">vāsudeva</span>–Vāsudev. <span class="e2">bāra-bāra</span>–Regularly, <span class="e2">varāhadevera sevā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–he worshipped Varāhadev. [12]
“There was a brāhmaṇ boy named Vāsudev. He regularly worshipped Varāhadev.
শ্রীবরাহমূর্ত্তি পূজি’ করে উপাসনা ।<br />সর্ব্বদা বরাহদেবের করয় প্রার্থনা ॥১৩॥
śrī-varāha-mūrti pūji’ kare upāsanā<br />sarvadā varāhadevera karaya prārthanā [13]
<span class="e2">pūji’</span> <span class="e2">upāsanā kare</span>–He worshipped and adored <span class="e2">śrī-varāha-mūrti</span>–a Deity of Śrī Varāha.<span class="e2">varāhadevera</span> <span class="e2">prārthanā karaya</span>–He prayed to Varāhadev <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–constantly. [13]
“He worshipped a Deity of Śrī Varāha and constantly prayed to Him.
‘প্রভু মোরে কৃপা করি’ দেহ দরশন ।<br />সফল হউক মোর নয়ন জীবন’ ॥১৪॥
‘prabhu more kṛpā kari’ deha daraśana<br />saphala ha-uka mora nayana jīvana’ [14]
<span class="e2">‘prabhu</span>–‘O Lord! <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully <span class="e2">daraśana deha</span>–reveal [Yourself] <span class="e2">more</span>–to me. [May] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes [and] <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–life <span class="e2">saphala</span> <span class="e2">ha-uka’</span>–be fulfilled. ’ [14]
“‘O Lord! Mercifully reveal Yourself to me so that my eyes and life may be fulfilled.’
এই বলি’ কাঁদে বিপ্র গড়াগড়ি যায় ।<br />‘প্রভু নাহি দেখা দিলে জীবন বৃথায়’ ॥১৫॥
ei bali’ kā̐de vipra gaḍāgaḍi yāya<br />‘prabhu nāhi dekhā dile jīvana vṛthāya’ [15]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Praying <span class="e2">ei</span>–in this way, <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–would roll on the ground [and] <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cry, <span class="e2">‘prabhu</span>–‘O Lord! <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">dile</span>–If You do not reveal [Yourself, my] <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–life [is] <span class="e2">vṛthāya’</span>–worthless.’ [15]
“Praying in this way, the brāhmaṇ would roll on the ground and cry, ‘O Lord! If You do not reveal Yourself, my life is worthless.’
কতদিনে শ্রীবরাহ অনুকম্পা করি’ ।<br />দেখা দিলা বাসুদেবে কোলরূপ ধরি’ ॥১৬॥
kata-dine śrī-varāha anukampā kari’<br />dekhā dilā vāsudeve kola-rūpa dhari’ [16]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">śrī-varāha</span>–Śrī Varāha <span class="e2">anukampā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dilā</span>–revealed [Himself] <span class="e2">vāsudeve</span>–to Vāsudev, <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–bearing <span class="e2">kola-rūpa</span>–the form of a boar. [16]
“Eventually, Śrī Varāha mercifully revealed Himself to Vāsudev in the form of a boar.
নানারত্ন ভূষণে ভূষিত কলেবর ।<br />পদ গ্রীবা নাসা মুখ চক্ষু মনোহর ॥১৭॥
nānā-ratna bhūṣaṇe bhūṣita kalevara<br />pada grīvā nāsā mukha chakṣu manohara [17]
[His] <span class="e2">kalevara</span>–body [was] <span class="e2">bhūṣita</span>–ornamented <span class="e2">nānā-ratna</span> <span class="e2">bhūṣaṇe</span>–with various jewels and ornaments, [and His] <span class="e2">pada</span>–feet, <span class="e2">grīvā</span>–neck, <span class="e2">nāsā</span>–nose, <span class="e2">mukha</span>–mouth, [and] <span class="e2">chakṣu</span>–eyes [were] <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting. [17]
“His body was ornamented with various jewels and ornaments, and His feet, neck, nose, mouth, and eyes were enchanting.
পর্ব্বতসমান উচ্চ শরীর তাঁহার ।<br />দেখি’ বিপ্র নিজে ধন্য মানে বার বার ॥১৮॥
parvata-samāna uchcha śarīra tā̐hāra<br />dekhi’ vipra nije dhanya māne bāra bāra [18]
<span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span>–His <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–body [was] <span class="e2">parvata-samāna</span> <span class="e2">uchcha</span>–as tall as a mountain. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing [Him,] <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">bāra</span> <span class="e2">bāra</span>–again and again <span class="e2">nije māne</span>–felt himself [to be] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate. [18]
His body was as tall as a mountain. Seeing Him, the brāhmaṇ again and again felt himself to be fortunate.
ভূমে পড়ি’ বিপ্র প্রণমিয়া প্রভু-পায় ।<br />কাঁদিয়া আকুল হৈল গড়াগড়ি যায় ॥১৯॥
bhūme paḍi’ vipra praṇamiyā prabhu-pāya<br />kā̐diyā ākula haila gaḍāgaḍi yāya [19]
<span class="e2">vipra</span>–The brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–fell <span class="e2">bhūme</span>–to the ground, <span class="e2">praṇamiyā</span>–bowed <span class="e2">prabhu-pāya</span>–at the feet of the Lord, <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–cried <span class="e2">ākula</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–fervently, [and] <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled on the ground. [19]
He fell to the ground, bowed at the feet of the Lord, cried fervently, and rolled on the ground.
বিপ্রের ভকতি দেখি’ বরাহ তখন ।<br />কহিলেন বাসুদেবে মধুর বচন ॥২০॥
viprera bhakati dekhi’ varāha takhana<br />kahilena vāsudeve madhura vachana [20]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–seeing <span class="e2">bhakati</span>–the devotion <span class="e2">viprera</span>–of the brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">varāha</span>–Varāha <span class="e2">kahilena</span>–spoke <span class="e2">madhura</span> <span class="e2">vachana</span>–sweet words <span class="e2">vāsudeve</span>–to Vāsudev. [20]
Seeing the devotion of the brāhmaṇ, Varāha spoke sweet words to Vāsudev.
‘ওহে বাসুদেব তুমি ভকত আমার ।<br />বড় তুষ্ট হৈনু পূজা পাইয়া তোমার ॥২১॥
‘ohe vāsudeva tumi bhakata āmāra<br />baḍa tuṣṭa hainu pūjā pāiyā tomāra [21]
<span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">vāsudeva</span>–Vāsudev! <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–devotee, [and] <span class="e2">hainu</span>–I have become <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span>–very pleased <span class="e2">pāiyā</span>–by receiving<span class="e2"> tomāra</span>–your <span class="e2">pūjā</span>–worship. [21]
“‘O Vāsudev! You are My devotee, and I am very pleased with your worship.
এই নবদ্বীপে মোর প্রকট বিহার ।<br />কলি আগমনে হবে শুন বাক্যসার ॥২২॥
ei navadvīpe mora prakaṭa bihāra<br />kali āgamane habe śuna vākya-sāra [22]
<span class="e2">kali</span> <span class="e2">āgamane</span>–When Kali-yuga arrives, <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">bihāra prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–I will perform Pastimes <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">śuna</span>–Listen <span class="e2">vākya-sāra</span>–to [My] conclusive words. [22]
“‘When Kali-yuga arrives, I will perform Pastimes in Nabadwīp. Listen to My conclusive words.
নবদ্বীপসম ধাম নাহি ত্রিভুবনে ।<br />অতি প্রিয়ধাম মোর আছে সঙ্গোপনে ॥২৩॥
navadvīpa-sama dhāma nāhi tribhuvane<br />ati priya-dhāma mora āchhe saṅgopane [23]
<span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode <span class="e2">navadvīpa-sama</span>–like Nabadwīp <span class="e2">tribhuvane</span>–in the three worlds; [all of] <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">priya-dhāma</span>–most beloved abodes <span class="e2">saṅgopane āchhe</span>–are hidden [within it]. [23]
“‘There is no abode like Nabadwīp in the three worlds; all of My most beloved abodes are hidden within it.
ব্রহ্মাবর্ত্ত সহ আছে পুণ্যতীর্থ যত ।<br />সে সব আছয়ে হেথা শাস্ত্রের সম্মত ॥২৪॥
brahmāvarta saha āchhe puṇya-tīrtha yata<br />se saba āchhaye hethā śāstrera sammata [24]
<span class="e2">brahmāvarta</span>–Brahmāvarta, <span class="e2">saha</span>–along with <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">puṇya-tīrtha se</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all the other holy places <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–there are, <span class="e2">āchhaye</span>–is present <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [This is] <span class="e2">sammata</span>–the conclusion <span class="e2">śāstrera</span>–of the scriptures. [24]
“‘Brahmāvarta and all other holy places that exist are present here. This is the conclusion of the scriptures.
যে স্থানে ব্রহ্মার যজ্ঞে প্রকাশ হইয়া ।<br />নাশিলাম হিরণ্যাক্ষ দন্তে বিদারিয়া ॥২৫॥
সেই স্থান পুণ্যভূমি এই স্থানে রয় ।<br />যথায় আমার এবে হইল উদয় ॥২৬॥
ye sthāne brahmāra yajñe prakāśa ha-iyā<br />nāśilāma hiraṇyākṣa dante vidāriyā [25]
sei sthāna puṇya-bhūmi ei sthāne raya<br />yathāya āmāra ebe ha-ila udaya [26]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">sthāne sei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna puṇya-bhūmi</span>–The holy land of the place in which <span class="e2">prakāśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–I appeared <span class="e2">brahmāra</span> <span class="e2">yajñe</span>–during Brahmā’s sacrifice [and] <span class="e2">nāśilāma</span>–killed <span class="e2">hiraṇyākṣa</span>–Hiraṇyākṣa, <span class="e2">vidāriyā</span>–ripping [him] <span class="e2">dante</span>–with [My] tusks, <span class="e2">raya</span>–exists <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–I have appeared <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now. [25<span class="e2">–</span>26]
“‘The holy place in which I appeared during Brahmā’s sacrifice and killed Hiraṇyākṣa, ripping him with My tusks, exists here where I have now appeared.
নবদ্বীপ সেবি’ সর্ব্বতীর্থ বিরাজয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপবাসে সর্ব্বতীর্থবাস হয় ॥২৭॥
navadvīpa sevi’ sarva-tīrtha virājaya<br />navadvīpa-vāse sarva-tīrtha-vāsa haya [27]
<span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha</span>–All holy places <span class="e2">virājaya</span>–exist [here and] <span class="e2">sevi’</span>–serve <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāse</span>–By residing in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha-vāsa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–you reside in all the holy places. [27]
“‘All holy places exist here and serve Nabadwīp. By residing in Nabadwīp, you reside in all the holy places.
ধন্য তুমি নবদ্বীপে সেবিলে আমায় ।<br />শ্রীগৌরপ্রকটকালে জন্মিবে হেথায় ॥২৮॥
dhanya tumi navadvīpe sevile āmāya<br />śrī-gaura-prakaṭa-kāle janmibe hethāya [28]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate: <span class="e2">sevile</span>–you have served <span class="e2">āmāya</span>–Me <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp.<span class="e2">janmibe</span>–You will take birth <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-prakaṭa-kāle</span>–at the time of Śrī Gaura’s appearance. [28]
“‘You are fortunate: you have served Me in Nabadwīp. You will take birth here when I appear as Śrī Gaurāṅga.
অনায়াসে দেখিবে সে মহাসঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />অপূর্ব্ব গৌরাঙ্গরূপ পাবে দরশন’ ॥২৯॥
anāyāse dekhibe se mahāsaṅkīrtana<br />apūrva gaurāṅga-rūpa pābe daraśana’ [29]
<span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–Easily, <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–you will see <span class="e2">se</span>–His <span class="e2">mahāsaṅkīrtana</span>–grand saṅkīrtan. <span class="e2">daraśana pābe</span>–You will see <span class="e2">apūrva</span> <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-rūpa’</span>–Gaurāṅga’s extraordinary form.’ [29]
“‘Easily, you will see His grand saṅkīrtan and extraordinary form.’
এত বলি’ শ্রীবরাহ হৈল অন্তর্দ্ধান ।<br />দৈববাণী হইল বিপ্রে বুঝিতে সন্ধান ॥৩০॥
eta bali’ śrī-varāha haila antardhāna<br />daiva-vāṇī ha-ila vipre bujhite sandhāna [30]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">śrī-varāha</span>–Śrī Varāha <span class="e2">antardhāna haila</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">daiva-vāṇī</span>–A divine voice [then] <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–arose <span class="e2">sandhāna bujhite</span>–to guide <span class="e2">vipre</span>–the brāhmaṇ. [30]
“Saying this, Śrī Varāha disappeared. A divine voice then arose to guide the brāhmaṇ.
পরম পণ্ডিত বাসুদেব মহাশয় ।<br />সর্ব্বশাস্ত্র বিচারিয়া জানিল নিশ্চয় ॥৩১॥
parama paṇḍita vāsudeva mahāśaya<br />sarva-śāstra vichāriyā jānila niśchaya [31]
<span class="e2">vāsudeva</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Worshippable Vāsudev [was] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">paṇḍita</span>–a great scholar. <span class="e2">vichāriyā</span>–He studied <span class="e2">sarva-śāstra</span>–all the scriptures [and] <span class="e2">jānila</span>–understood [everything] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–clearly. [31]
“Worshippable Vāsudev was a great scholar. He studied all the scriptures and understood everything clearly.
‘বৈবস্বত-মন্বন্তরে কলির সন্ধ্যায় ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গপ্রভু-লীলা হবে নদীয়ায় ॥৩২॥
‘vaivasvata-manvantare kalire sandhyāya<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-prabhu-līlā habe nadīyāya [32]
<span class="e2">‘kalire</span> <span class="e2">sandhyāya</span>–‘At the beginning of Kali-yuga <span class="e2">vaivasvata-manvantare</span>–during the reign of Vaivasvata Manu, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-prabhu-līlā</span>–Lord Śrī Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes <span class="e2">habe</span>–will manifest <span class="e2">nadīyāya</span>–in Nadia. [32]
“‘At the beginning of Kali-yuga during the reign of Vaivasvata Manu, the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga will manifest in Nadia.
ঋষিগণ সেই তত্ত্ব রাখিল গোপনে ।<br />ইঙ্গিতে কহিল সব বুঝে বিজ্ঞজনে ॥৩৩॥
ṛṣi-gaṇa sei tattva rākhila gopane<br />iṅgite kahila saba bujhe vijña-jane [33]
<span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–The sages <span class="e2">rākhila</span>–kept <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">tattva</span>–truth <span class="e2">gopane</span>–hidden [but also] <span class="e2">iṅgite</span> <span class="e2">kahila</span>–hinted [at it in the scriptures]. <span class="e2">vijña-jane</span>–The wise <span class="e2">bujhe</span>–understand <span class="e2">saba</span>–all of this. [33]
“‘The sages kept this truth hidden but also hinted at it in the scriptures. The wise understand all of this.
‘প্রকট হইলে লীলা হইবে প্রকাশ ।<br />এবে গোপ্য’ এই তত্ত্ব পাইল আভাস ॥৩৪॥
‘prakaṭa ha-ile līlā ha-ibe prakāśa<br />ebe gopya’ ei tattva pāila ābhāsa [34]
<span class="e2">‘prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–‘When the Lord appears, [His] <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">prakāśa ha-ibe</span>–will be revealed, [but] <span class="e2">ebe</span>–for now, [they] <span class="e2">gopya’</span>–should be kept hidden.’ [In this way,] <span class="e2">ābhāsa pāila</span>–Vāsudev understood the purport <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–of this truth [in the scriptures]. [34]
“‘When the Lord appears, His Pastimes will be revealed, but for now they should be kept hidden.’ In this way, Vāsudev understood the purport of the scriptures.
পরম আনন্দে বিপ্র করে সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />গৌরনাম গায় মনে মনে সর্ব্বক্ষণ ॥৩৫॥
parama ānande vipra kare saṅkīrtana<br />gaura-nāma gāya mane mane sarva-kṣaṇa [35]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ānande</span>–With great joy, <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana kare</span>–performed saṅkīrtan: <span class="e2">gāya</span>–he chanted <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–constantly <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within his heart. [35]
“With great joy, the brāhmaṇ performed saṅkīrtan, chanting the Name of Gaura constantly within his heart.
পর্ব্বত-প্রমাণ কোলদেবের শরীর ।<br />দেখি’ বাসুদেব মনে বিচারিল ধীর ॥৩৬॥
কোলদ্বীপ পর্ব্বতাখ্য এই স্থান হয় ।<br />সেই হৈতে পর্ব্বতাখ্য হৈল পরিচয় ॥৩৭॥
parvata-pramāṇa koladevera śarīra<br />dekhi’ vāsudeva mane vichārila dhīra [36]
koladvīpa parvatākhya ei sthāna haya<br />sei haite parvatākhya haila parichaya [37]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Having seen <span class="e2">parvata</span>-<span class="e2">pramāṇa</span>–the mountain-like <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–form <span class="e2">koladevera</span>–of Varāhadev, <span class="e2">dhīra vāsudeva</span>–the wise Vāsudev <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">vichārila</span>–decided <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–this place <span class="e2">haya</span>–would be <span class="e2">koladvīpa</span> <span class="e2">parvatākhya</span>–named Koladwīp Parvat. <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–Since then, <span class="e2">parvatākhya</span> <span class="e2">parichaya haila</span>–it has been known as Parvat. [36<span class="e2">–</span>37]
“Having seen the mountain-like form of Varāhadev, the wise Vāsudev decided that this place would be named Koladwīp Parvat. Since then, it has been known as Parvat.
ওহে জীব! নিত্যলীলাময় বৃন্দাবনে ।<br />গিরিগোবর্দ্ধন এই জানে ভক্তজনে ॥৩৮॥
ohe jīva! nitya-līlāmaya vṛndāvane<br />giri-govardhana ei jāne bhakta-jane [38]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva!</span>–Jīva! <span class="e2">bhakta-jane</span>–Devotees <span class="e2">jāne</span>–know <span class="e2">ei</span>–this place [to be] <span class="e2">giri-govardhana</span>–Govardhan Hill <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–of Vṛndāvan, [which is] <span class="e2">nitya-līlāmaya</span>–filled with eternal Pastimes. [38]
“O Jīva! Devotees know this place to be Govardhan Hill of Vṛndāvan, which is filled with the Lord’s eternal Pastimes.
শ্রীবহুলাবন দেখ ইহার উত্তরে ।<br />রূপের ছটায় সর্ব্বদিক্ শোভা করে ॥৩৯॥
śrī-bahulāvana dekha ihāra uttare<br />rūpera chhaṭāya sarva-dik śobhā kare [39]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">śrī-bahulavāna</span>–Śrī Bahulāvan <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">uttare</span>–to its north. <span class="e2">rūpera</span> <span class="e2">chhaṭāya</span>–The effulgence of its form <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–shines <span class="e2">sarva-dik</span>–in all directions. [39]
“See Śrī Bahulāvan to the north. Its effulgence shines in all directions.
বৃন্দাবনে যে যে ক্রমে দ্বাদশ কানন ।<br />সে ক্রম নাহিক হেথা বল্লভনন্দন ॥৪০॥
vṛndāvane ye ye krame dvādaśa kānana<br />se krama nāhika hethā vallabha-nandana [40]
<span class="e2">vallabha-nandana</span>–O son of Vallabha, <span class="e2">dvādaśa</span> <span class="e2">kānana</span>–the twelve forests (of Vraja) <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–do not exist <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">krame</span> <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">krama</span>–in the order that they do <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–in Vṛndāvan. [40]
“O Jīva, the twelve forests are not arranged here the way they are in Vṛndāvan.
প্রভু-ইচ্ছামতে হেথা ক্রমবিপর্য্যয় ।<br />ইহার তাৎপর্য্য জানে প্রভু ইচ্ছাময় ॥৪১॥
prabhu-ichchhā-mate hethā krama-viparyaya<br />ihāra tātparya jāne prabhu ichchhāmaya [41]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>-<span class="e2">ichchhā-mate</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">krama-viparyaya</span>–their order is reversed <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāmaya</span>–The whimsical Lord <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows <span class="e2">tātparya</span>–the reason <span class="e2">ihāra</span>–for this. [41]
“By the will of the Lord, their order is reversed here. The whimsical Lord knows the reason for this.
যেইরূপ আছে হেথা দেখ সেই রূপ ।<br />বিপর্য্যয়ে প্রেমবৃদ্ধি এই অপরূপ” ॥৪২॥
yei rūpa āchhe hethā dekha sei rūpa<br />viparyaye prema-vṛddhi ei aparūpa” [42]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">yei rūpa sei rūpa āchhe</span>–the way they are <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">aparūpa viparyaye</span>–This extraordinary reversal <span class="e2">prema-vṛddhi”</span>–increases [everyone’s] divine love.” [42]
“See the way they are arranged here. This extraordinary reversal increases everyone’s divine love.”
কিছুদূর গিয়া প্রভু বলেন বচন ।<br />“এই যে সমুদ্রগড়ি কর দরশন ॥৪৩॥
kichhu-dūra giyā prabhu balena vachana<br />“ei ye samudragaḍi kara daraśana [43]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">giyā</span>–went <span class="e2">kichhu-dūra</span>–ahead [and] <span class="e2">vachana balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">“daraśana kara</span>–“See <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ye</span>–here <span class="e2">samudragaḍi</span>–Samudragaḍ. [43]
Nityānanda Prabhu went ahead and then said, “See here Samudragaḍ.
সাক্ষাৎ দ্বারকাপুরী শ্রীগঙ্গাসাগর ।<br />দুই তীর্থ আছে হেথা দেখ বিজ্ঞবর ॥৪৪॥
sākṣāt dvārakāpurī śrī-gaṅgā-sāgara<br />dui tīrtha āchhe hethā dekha vijña-vara [44]
<span class="e2">vijña-vara</span>–O best of the wise, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span>–directly <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–present <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–the two holy places <span class="e2">dvārakāpurī</span>–Dvārakā Purī [and] <span class="e2">śrī-gaṅgā-sāgara</span>–Śrī Gaṅgā Sāgar. [44]
“O best of the wise, see here both Dvārakā Purī and Śrī Gaṅgā Sāgar.
শ্রীসমুদ্রসেন রাজা ছিল এইস্থানে ।<br />বড় কৃষ্ণভক্ত কৃষ্ণ বিনা নাহি জানে ॥৪৫॥
śrī-samudra-sena rājā chhila ei-sthāne<br />baḍa kṛṣṇa-bhakta kṛṣṇa vinā nāhi jāne [45]
<span class="e2">śrī-samudra-sena</span>–Śrī Samudra Sen <span class="e2">chhila</span>–was <span class="e2">rājā</span>–a king <span class="e2">ei-sthāne</span>–here. [He was] <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–a great devotee of Kṛṣṇa— <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–he knew nothing <span class="e2">vinā</span>–but <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa. [45]
“Śrī Samudra Sen was a king here. He was a great devotee of Kṛṣṇa—he knew nothing but Kṛṣṇa.
যবে ভীমসেন আইল নিজ সৈন্য লয়ে ।<br />ঘেরিল সমুদ্রগড়ি বঙ্গদিগ্বিজয়ে ॥৪৬॥
yabe bhīmasena āila nija sainya laye<br />gherila samudragaḍi baṅga-digvijaye [46]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">bhīmasena</span>–Bhīmasen <span class="e2">āila</span>–came [here] <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">sainya</span>–army <span class="e2">baṅga-digvijaye</span>–to conquer Bengal, <span class="e2">gherila</span>–he surrounded <span class="e2">samudragaḍi</span>–Samudragaḍ. [46]
“When Bhīmasen came here with his army to conquer Bengal, he surrounded Samudragaḍ.
রাজা জানে কৃষ্ণ এক পাণ্ডবের গতি ।<br />পাণ্ডব বিপদে পৈলে আইসে যদুপতি ॥৪৭॥
rājā jāne kṛṣṇa eka pāṇḍavera gati<br />pāṇḍava vipade paile āise yadupati [47]
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knew <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [was] <span class="e2">pāṇḍavera</span>–the Pāṇḍavas’ <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">gati</span>–only shelter, [and that] <span class="e2">pāṇḍava</span> <span class="e2">vipade</span> <span class="e2">paile</span>–if the Pāṇḍavas faced danger, <span class="e2">yadupati</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">āise</span>–would come. [47]
“The king knew Kṛṣṇa was the Pāṇḍavas’ only shelter, and that if the Pāṇḍavas faced danger, Kṛṣṇa would come.
‘যদি আমি পারি ভীমে দেখাইতে ভয় ।<br />ভীম-আর্ত্তনাদে হরি হবে দয়াময় ॥৪৮॥
‘yadi āmi pāri bhīme dekhāite bhaya<br />bhīma-ārta-nāde hari habe dayāmaya [48]
<span class="e2">‘yadi</span>–‘If <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">pāri</span>–can <span class="e2">bhīme bhaya</span> <span class="e2">dekhāite</span>–cause Bhīma to show that he is afraid, <span class="e2">hari</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">dayāmaya habe</span>–will feel compassion <span class="e2">bhīma-ārta-nāde</span>–in response to Bhīma’s cries of distress. [48]
“‘If I can cause Bhīma to show that he is afraid, Kṛṣṇa will feel compassion in response to his cries of distress.
দয়া করি’ আসিবেন এ দাসের দেশে ।<br />দেখিবে সে শ্যামমূর্ত্তি চক্ষে অনায়াসে’ ॥৪৯॥
dayā kari’ āsibena e dāsera deśe<br />dekhiba se śyāma-mūrti chakṣe anāyāse’ [49]
<span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span> <span class="e2">āsibena</span>–Kṛṣṇa will compassionately come <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dāsera</span> <span class="e2">deśe</span>–to this servant’s land, [and] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">śyāma-mūrti</span>–His dark form <span class="e2">chakṣe’</span>–with [my] eyes.’ [49]
“‘Then Kṛṣṇa will compassionately come to this servant’s land, and I will easily see His dark form with my eyes.’
এত ভাবি’ নিজ সৈন্য সাজাইল রায় ।<br />গজ বাজি পদাতিক লয়ে যুদ্ধে যায় ॥৫০॥
eta bhāvi’ nija sainya sājāila rāya<br />gaja bāji padātika laye yuddhe yāya [50]
