<span class="e2">bhāvi’</span>–Thinking <span class="e2">eta</span>–thus, <span class="e2">rāya</span>–the king <span class="e2">sājāila</span>–prepared <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">sainya</span>–army. <span class="e2">laye</span>–Taking [his] <span class="e2">gaja</span>–elephants, <span class="e2">bāji</span>–horses, [and] <span class="e2">padātika</span>–foot soldiers, <span class="e2">yāya</span>–he went <span class="e2">yuddhe</span>–to battle. [50]
“Thinking thus, the king prepared his army. Taking his elephants, horses, and foot soldiers, he went to battle.
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ স্মরিয়া রাজা বাণ নিক্ষেপয় ।<br />বাণে জর জর ভীম পাইল বড় ভয় ॥৫১॥
śrī-kṛṣṇa smariyā rājā bāṇa nikṣepaya<br />bāṇe jara jara bhīma pāila baḍa bhaya [51]
<span class="e2">smariyā</span>–Remembering <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">nikṣepaya</span>–fired <span class="e2">bāṇa</span>–arrows. <span class="e2">jara</span> <span class="e2">jara</span>–Overwhelmed <span class="e2">bāṇe</span>–by the arrows, <span class="e2">bhīma</span>–Bhīma <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">bhaya pāila</span>–became extremely afraid. [51]
“Remembering Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the king fired arrows. Overwhelmed by the arrows, Bhīma became extremely afraid.
মনে মনে কৃষ্ণে ডাকে বিপদ দেখিয়া ।<br />‘রক্ষা কর ভীমে নাথ শ্রীচরণ দিয়া ॥৫২॥
mane mane kṛṣṇe ḍāke vipada dekhiyā<br />‘rakṣā kara bhīme nātha śrī-charaṇa diyā [52]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing [that he was in] <span class="e2">vipada</span>–danger, <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–Bhīma called out <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–to Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within his mind, <span class="e2">‘nātha</span>–‘O Lord! <span class="e2">rakṣā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Protect <span class="e2">bhīme</span>–Bhīma <span class="e2">diyā</span>–with [Your] <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇa</span>–holy feet. [52]
“Seeing that he was in danger, Bhīma called out to Kṛṣṇa within his mind, ‘O Lord! Protect Bhīma with Your holy feet.
সমুদ্রসেনের সহ যুঝিতে না পারি ।<br />ভঙ্গ দিলে বড় লজ্জা তাহা সৈতে নারি ॥৫৩॥
samudra-senera saha yujhite nā pāri<br />bhaṅga dile baḍa lajjā tāhā saite nāri [53]
<span class="e2">yujhite</span> <span class="e2">pāri nā</span>–I cannot fight <span class="e2">samudra-senera</span> <span class="e2">saha</span>–with Samudra Sen, [but] <span class="e2">bhaṅga</span> <span class="e2">dile</span>–if I retreat, [it will be] <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">lajjā</span>–a great shame, [and] <span class="e2">saite</span> <span class="e2">nāri</span>–I cannot tolerate <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that. [53]
“‘I cannot fight with Samudra Sen, but I also cannot tolerate the great shame of retreating.
পাণ্ডবের নাথ কৃষ্ণ পাই পরাজয় ।<br />বড়ই লজ্জার কথা ওহে দয়াময়’ ॥৫৪॥
pāṇḍavera nātha kṛṣṇa pāi parājaya<br />baḍa-i lajjāra kathā ohe dayāmaya’ [54]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–O Kṛṣṇa! [You are] <span class="e2">pāṇḍavera</span> <span class="e2">nātha</span>–the Lord of the Pāṇḍavas. <span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–merciful Lord! <span class="e2">parājaya pāi</span>–If we are defeated, [it will be] <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span> <span class="e2">lajjāra</span> <span class="e2">kathā’</span>–a matter of great shame.’ [54]
“‘O Kṛṣṇa! You are the Lord of the Pāṇḍavas. O merciful Lord! If we are defeated, it will be a great shame.’
ভীমের করুণানাদ শুনি’ দয়াময় ।<br />সেই যুদ্ধস্থলে কৃষ্ণ হইল উদয় ॥৫৫॥
bhīmera karuṇā-nāda śuni’ dayāmaya<br />sei yuddha-sthale kṛṣṇa ha-ila udaya [55]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">bhīmera</span>–Bhīma’s <span class="e2">karuṇā-nāda</span>–sorrowful cry, <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–the merciful Lord, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–appeared <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">yuddha-sthale</span>–on the battlefield. [55]
“Hearing Bhīma’s sorrowful cry, Kṛṣṇa mercifully appeared on the battlefield.
না দেখে সে রূপ কেহ অপূর্ব্ব ঘটনা ।<br />শ্রীসমুদ্রসেন মাত্র দেখে একজনা ॥৫৬॥
nā dekhe se rūpa keha apūrva ghaṭanā<br />śrī-samudra-sena mātra dekhe eka-janā [56]
<span class="e2">apūrva</span> <span class="e2">ghaṭanā</span>–An extraordinary event [took place]: <span class="e2">keha nā</span>–no one <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">se rūpa</span>–the Lord’s form. <span class="e2">eka-janā</span>–One man, <span class="e2">śrī-samudra-sena</span>–Śrī Samudra Sen <span class="e2">mātra</span>–alone, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw [it]. [56]
“An extraordinary event then took place: Śrī Samudra Sen saw the Lord’s form, but no one else did.
নবজলধররূপ কৈশোর মুরতি ।<br />গলে দোলে বনমালা মুকুতার ভাতি ॥৫৭॥
nava-jala-dhara-rūpa kaiśora murati<br />gale dole vana-mālā mukutāra bhāti [57]
[His] <span class="e2">kaiśora</span> <span class="e2">murati</span>–adolescent form [was] <span class="e2">nava-jala-dhara-rūpa</span>–the colour of a fresh rain cloud, <span class="e2">vana-mālā</span>–a forest garland <span class="e2">dole</span>–swung <span class="e2">gale</span>–on [His] neck, [and His] <span class="e2">mukutāra</span>–crown <span class="e2">bhāti</span>–shone. [57]
“The Lord’s adolescent form was the colour of a fresh rain cloud, a forest garland swung on His neck, and His crown shone.
সর্ব্ব-অঙ্গে অলঙ্কার অতি সুশোভন ।<br />পীতবস্ত্র পরিধান অপূর্ব্ব গঠন ॥৫৮॥
sarva-aṅge alaṅkāra ati suśobhana<br />pīta-vastra paridhāna apūrva gaṭhana [58]
[He had] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">suśobhana</span>–extremely beautiful <span class="e2">alaṅkāra</span>–ornaments <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">aṅge</span>–on all [His] limbs, [and His] <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–extraordinary <span class="e2">gaṭhana</span>–body [was] <span class="e2">paridhāna</span>–clothed <span class="e2">pīta-vastra</span>–in yellow garments. [58]
“He had extremely beautiful ornaments on all His limbs, and His extraordinary body was clothed in yellow garments.
সে রূপ দেখিয়া রাজা প্রেমে মূর্চ্ছা যায় ।<br />মূর্চ্ছা সম্বরিয়া কৃষ্ণে প্রার্থনা জানায় ॥৫৯॥
se rūpa dekhiyā rājā preme mūrchchhā yāya<br />mūrchchhā samvariyā kṛṣṇe prārthanā jānāya [59]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">se rūpa</span>–His form, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">mūrchchhā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–fainted <span class="e2">preme</span>–out of divine love. [Then] <span class="e2">mūrchchhā</span> <span class="e2">samvariyā</span>–he steadied himself [and] <span class="e2">prārthanā</span> <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–prayed <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–to Kṛṣṇa. [59]
“Seeing Kṛṣṇa’s form, the king fainted out of divine love. He then steadied himself and prayed to the Lord.
‘তুমি কৃষ্ণ জগন্নাথ পতিতপাবন ।<br />পতিত দেখিয়া মোরে তব আগমন ॥৬০॥
‘tumi kṛṣṇa jagannātha patita-pāvana<br />patita dekhiyā more tava āgamana [60]
<span class="e2">‘kṛṣṇa</span>–‘O Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–the Lord of the universe [and] <span class="e2">patita-pāvana</span>–the saviour of the fallen. <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Having seen <span class="e2">more</span>–me, <span class="e2">patita</span>–a fallen soul, <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">āgamana</span>–You have come [here]. [60]
“‘O Kṛṣṇa, You are the Lord of the universe and the saviour of the fallen. Having seen this fallen soul, You have come here.
তব লীলা জগজ্জন করয় কীর্ত্তন ।<br />শুনি দেখিবার ইচ্ছা হইল তখন ॥৬১॥
tava līlā jagaj-jana karaya kīrtana<br />śuni’ dekhibāra ichchhā ha-ila takhana [61]
<span class="e2">jagaj-jana</span>–The souls of this world <span class="e2">kīrtana karaya</span>–glorify <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–hearing [that,] <span class="e2">takhana ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–I then desired <span class="e2">dekhibāra</span>–to see [You]. [61]
“‘The souls of this world glorify Your Pastimes, and hearing that, I desired to see You.
কিন্তু মোর ব্রত ছিল ওহে দয়াময় ।<br />এই নবদ্বীপে তব হইবে উদয় ॥৬২॥
“হেথায় দেখিব তব রূপ মনোহর ।<br />নবদ্বীপ ছাড়িবারে না হয় অন্তর” ॥৬৩॥
kintu mora vrata chhila ohe dayāmaya<br />ei navadvīpe tava ha-ibe udaya [62]
“hethāya dekhiba tava rūpa manohara<br />navadvīpa chhāḍibāre nā haya antara” [63]
<span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">vrata</span>–vow, <span class="e2">kintu</span>–however, <span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–merciful Lord, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–was [that] <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">udaya ha-ibe</span>–You would appear <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp: <span class="e2">“dekhiba</span>–“I will see <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here [so that] <span class="e2">antara haya nā</span>–I do not have <span class="e2">chhāḍibāre</span>–to leave <span class="e2">navadvīpa”</span>–Nabadwīp.” [62–63]
“‘My vow, however, O merciful Lord, was that You would appear in Nabadwīp: “I will see Your enchanting form here so that I do not have to leave Nabadwīp.”
সেই ব্রত রক্ষা মোর করি’ দয়াময় ।<br />নবদ্বীপে কৃষ্ণরূপে হইলে উদয় ॥৬৪॥
sei vrata rakṣā mora kari’ dayāmaya <br />navadvīpe kṛṣṇa-rūpe haile udaya [64]
<span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–O merciful Lord, <span class="e2">mora sei</span> <span class="e2">vrata</span> <span class="e2">rakṣā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–You have upheld my vow [and] <span class="e2">udaya haile</span>–appeared <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-rūpe</span>–as Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. [64]
“‘O merciful Lord, You have upheld my vow and appeared as Kṛṣṇa in Nabadwīp.
তথাপি আমার ইচ্ছা অতি গূঢ়তর ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ হউন মোর অক্ষির গোচর’ ॥৬৫॥
tathāpi āmāra ichchhā ati gūḍha-tara<br />gaurāṅga ha-una mora akṣira gochara’ [65]
<span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">gūḍha-tara</span>–very confidential <span class="e2">ichchhā</span>–desire [is that] <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">akṣira</span> <span class="e2">gochara ha-una</span>–You will appear before my eyes <span class="e2">gaurāṅga’</span>–as Gaurāṅga.’ [65]
“‘Still, my very confidential desire is that You will appear before my eyes as Gaurāṅga.’
দেখিতে দেখিতে রাজা সম্মুখে দেখিল ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ-লীলারূপ মাধুর্য্য অতুল ॥৬৬॥
dekhite dekhite rājā sammukhe dekhila<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā-rūpa mādhurya atula [66]
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–saw <span class="e2">sammukhe</span>–before him <span class="e2">atula mādhurya</span>–the incomparably sweet <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā-rūpa</span>–forms and Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. [66]
“The king suddenly saw before him the incomparably sweet forms and Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
শ্রীকুমুদবনে কৃষ্ণ সখীগণ সনে ।<br />অপরাহ্নে করে লীলা গিয়া গোচারণে ॥৬৭॥
śrī-kumudavane kṛṣṇa sakhī-gaṇa sane<br />aparāhne kare līlā giyā go-chāraṇe [67]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">go-chāraṇe giyā</span>–was tending cows [and] <span class="e2">līlā kare</span>–playing <span class="e2">sane</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">sakhī-gaṇa</span>–friends <span class="e2">śrī-kumudavane</span>–in Śrī Kumudavan <span class="e2">aparāhne</span>–in the afternoon. [67]
“Kṛṣṇa was tending cows and playing with His friends in Śrī Kumudavan in the afternoon.
ক্ষণেকে হইল সেই লীলা অদর্শন ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-রূপ হেরে ভরিয়া নয়ন ॥৬৮॥
kṣaṇeke ha-ila sei līlā adarśana<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-rūpa here bhariyā nayana [68]
<span class="e2">kṣaṇeke</span>–Within a moment, <span class="e2">sei</span>–these <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">adarśana ha-ila</span>–disappeared, [and] <span class="e2">here</span>–the king saw <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rūpa</span>–the form of Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">bhariyā</span>–filling [his] <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes. [68]
“Within a moment, these Pastimes disappeared, and the king saw the form of Śrī Gaurāṅga, filling his eyes.
মহাসঙ্কীর্ত্তনাবেশ সঙ্গে ভক্তগণ ।<br />নাচিয়া নাচিয়া প্রভু করেন কীর্ত্তন ॥৬৯॥
mahāsaṅkīrtanāveśa saṅge bhakta-gaṇa<br />nāchiyā nāchiyā prabhu karena kīrtana [69]
<span class="e2">mahāsaṅkīrtanāveśa</span>–Immersed in grand saṅkīrtan, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">nāchiyā</span> <span class="e2">nāchiyā</span>–was dancing [and] <span class="e2">kīrtana karena</span>–chanting <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–devotees. [69]
“Immersed in grand saṅkīrtan, the Lord was dancing and chanting with His devotees.
পুরটসুন্দরকান্তি অতি মনোহর ।<br />নয়ন মাতায় অতি কাঁপায় অন্তর ॥৭০॥
puraṭa-sundara-kānti ati manohara<br />nayana mātāya ati kā̐pāya antara [70]
[The Lord’s] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">manohara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">puraṭa-sundara-kānti</span>–golden lustre <span class="e2">nayana</span> <span class="e2">mātāya</span>–made the eyes [of the king] quiver [and his] <span class="e2">antara</span>–heart <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">kā̐pāya</span>–palpitate intensely. [70]
“The Lord’s extremely beautiful golden lustre made the eyes of the king quiver and his heart palpitate intensely.
সেই রূপ হেরি’ রাজা নিজে ধন্য মানে ।<br />বহু স্তব করে তবে গৌরাঙ্গ-চরণে ॥৭১॥
sei rūpa heri’ rājā nije dhanya māne<br />bahu stava kare tabe gaurāṅga-charaṇe [71]
<span class="e2">heri’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">sei rūpa</span>–the form of the Lord, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">māne</span>–considered <span class="e2">nije</span>–himself <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">stava</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–he offered prayers <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-charaṇe</span>–at Gaurāṅga’s feet. [71]
“Seeing the form of the Lord, the king considered himself fortunate. He then offered prayers at the Lord’s feet.
কতক্ষণে সে সকল হৈল অদর্শন ।<br />কাঁদিতে লাগিল রাজা হয়ে অন্য মন ॥৭২॥
kata-kṣaṇe se sakala haila adarśana<br />kā̐dite lāgila rājā haye anya mana [72]
<span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇe</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span>–everything <span class="e2">adarśana haila</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">mana haye</span>–became thoughtful [and] <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–began <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–to cry. [72]
“Eventually, everything disappeared. The king became thoughtful and began to cry.
ভীমসেন এই পর্ব্ব না দেখে নয়নে ।<br />ভাবে রাজা যুদ্ধে ভীত হৈল এতক্ষণে ॥৭৩॥
bhīmasena ei parva nā dekhe nayane<br />bhāve rājā yuddhe bhīta haila eta-kṣaṇe [73]
<span class="e2">bhīmasena</span>–Bhīmasen <span class="e2">dekhe nā</span>–did not see <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">parva</span>–miracle <span class="e2">nayane</span>–with [his] eyes [and] <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–thought <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">eta-kṣaṇe</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">bhīta</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–had become afraid <span class="e2">yuddhe</span>–to fight. [73]
“Bhīmasen did not see this miracle and thought that the king had suddenly become afraid to fight.
অত্যন্ত বিক্রম করে পাণ্ডুর নন্দন ।<br />রাজা তুষ্ট হয়ে কর যাচে ততক্ষণ ॥৭৪॥
atyanta vikrama kare pāṇḍura nandana<br />rājā tuṣṭa haye kara yāche tata-kṣaṇa [74]
<span class="e2">pāṇḍura</span> <span class="e2">nandana</span>–Bhīmasen <span class="e2">kare</span>–showed [his] <span class="e2">atyanta</span> <span class="e2">vikrama</span>–immense strength, [and] <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">tata-kṣaṇa</span>–then <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–happily <span class="e2">kara</span> <span class="e2">yāche</span>–submitted [his] tax payment. [74]
“Bhīmasen showed his immense strength, and the king happily submitted his tribute.
কর পেয়ে ভীমসেন অন্য স্থানে যায় ।<br />ভীম দিগ্বিজয় সর্ব্বজগতেতে গায় ॥৭৫॥
kara peye bhīmasena anya sthāne yāya<br />bhīma digvijaya sarva-jagatete gāya [75]
<span class="e2">bhīmasena</span>–Bhīmasen <span class="e2">peye</span>–accepted <span class="e2">kara</span>–the tribute, [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–elsewhere. [Still now,] <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">jagatete</span>–the whole world <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sings <span class="e2">bhīma</span>–of Bhīma [as] <span class="e2">digvijaya</span>–the conqueror of all directions. [75]
“Bhīmasen accepted the tribute and went elsewhere. Still now, the whole world sings of Bhīma as the conqueror of all directions.
এই সে সমুদ্রগড়ি নবদ্বীপসীমা ।<br />ব্রহ্মা নাহি জানে এই স্থানের মহিমা ॥৭৬॥
ei se samudragaḍi navadvīpa-sīmā<br />brahmā nāhi jāne ei sthānera mahimā [76]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">se</span>–This place, <span class="e2">samudragaḍi</span>–Samudragaḍ, [is] <span class="e2">navadvīpa-sīmā</span>–on the boundary of Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–does not know <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–the glories <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthānera</span>–of this place. [76]
“This place, Samudragaḍ, is on the boundary of Nabadwīp. Even Brahmā does not know the glories of this place.
সমুদ্র আসিয়া হেথা জাহ্নবী-আশ্রয়ে ।<br />প্রভুপদ সেবা করে ভক্তভাব লয়ে ॥৭৭॥
samudra āsiyā hethā jāhnavī āśraye<br />prabhu-pada sevā kare bhakta-bhāva laye [77]
<span class="e2">samudra</span>–The ocean <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–came <span class="e2">jāhnavī-āśraye</span>–to the shelter of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and,] <span class="e2">bhakta-bhāva</span> <span class="e2">laye</span>–with the mood of a devotee, <span class="e2">sevā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–served <span class="e2">prabhu-pada</span>–the feet of the Lord. [77]
“The ocean came to the shelter of the Gaṅgā here and, with the mood of a devotee, served the feet of the Lord.
জাহ্নবী বলেন, ‘সিন্ধু অতি অল্পদিনে ।<br />তব তীরে প্রভু মোর রহিবে বিপিনে’ ॥৭৮॥
jāhnavī balena, ‘sindhu ati alpa-dine<br />tava tīre prabhu mora rahibe vipine’ [78]
<span class="e2">jāhnavī</span>–The Gaṅgā <span class="e2">balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘sindhu</span>–‘O Ocean, <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">alpa-dine</span>–very soon <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–will stay <span class="e2">vipine</span>–in a forest <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">tīre’</span>–on your bank.’ [78]
“The Gaṅgā said, ‘O Ocean, very soon my Lord will stay in a forest on your bank.’
সিন্ধু বলে, ‘শুন দেবী আমার বচন ।<br />নবদ্বীপ নাহি ছাড়ে শচীর নন্দন ॥৭৯॥
sindhu bale, ‘śuna devī āmāra vachana<br />navadvīpa nāhi chhāḍe śachīra nandana [79]
<span class="e2">sindhu</span>–The ocean <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘devī</span>–‘O goddess, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">vachana</span>–to my words! <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">nandana</span>–The son of Śachī <span class="e2">chhāḍe nāhi</span>–never leaves <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. [79]
“The ocean said, ‘O goddess, listen to my words! The son of Śachī never leaves Nabadwīp.
যদ্যপিও কিছুদিন রহে মম তীরে ।<br />অপ্রত্যক্ষ রহে তবু নদীয়া ভিতরে ॥৮০॥
yadyapio kichhu-dina rahe mama tīre<br />apratyakṣa rahe tabu nadīyā bhitare [80]
<span class="e2">yadyapio</span>–Although <span class="e2">rahe</span>–He will stay <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">tīre</span>–on my bank <span class="e2">kichhu-dina</span>–for some time, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–still, <span class="e2">rahe</span>–He will remain <span class="e2">apratyakṣa</span>–invisibly <span class="e2">nadīyā</span> <span class="e2">bhitare</span>–in Nadia. [80]
“‘Although He will stay on my bank for some time, He will remain invisibly in Nadia.
নিত্যধাম নবদ্বীপ প্রভুর হেথায় ।<br />প্রকট ও অপ্রকট লীলা বেদে গায় ॥৮১॥
nitya-dhāma navadvīpa prabhura hethāya<br />prakaṭa o aprakaṭa līlā vede gāya [81]
<span class="e2">vede</span>–The Vedas <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span>–of the manifest <span class="e2">o</span>–and <span class="e2">aprakaṭa</span>–unmanifest <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">nitya-dhāma</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–in [His] eternal abode of Nabadwīp. [81]
“‘The Vedas sing of the manifest and unmanifest Pastimes of the Lord here in His eternal abode of Nabadwīp.
হেথা তবাশ্রয়ে আমি রহিব সুন্দরি ।<br />সেবিব নবদ্বীপে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ হরি’ ॥৮২॥
hethā tavāśraye āmi rahiba sundari<br />seviba navadvīpe śrī-gaurāṅga hari’ [82]
<span class="e2">sundari</span>–O beautiful goddess! <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">rahiba</span>–will stay <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">tavāśraye</span>–under your shelter [and] <span class="e2">seviba</span>–serve <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span> <span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">navadvīpe’</span>–in Nabadwīp.’ [82]
“‘O beautiful goddess! I will stay here under your shelter and serve Śrī Gaurāṅga in Nabadwīp.’
এই বলি’ পয়োনিধি নবদ্বীপে রয় ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গের নিত্যলীলা সতত চিন্তয়” ॥৮৩॥
ei bali’ payo-nidhi navadvīpe raya<br />gaurāṅgera nitya-līlā satata chintaya” [83]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">ei</span>–this, <span class="e2">payo-nidhi</span>–the ocean <span class="e2">raya</span>–stayed <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">satata</span> <span class="e2">chintaya</span>–meditating <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span> <span class="e2">nitya-līlā”</span>–on the eternal Pastimes of Gaurāṅga.” [83]
“Saying this, the ocean stayed in Nabadwīp, meditating on the eternal Pastimes of Gaurāṅga.”
তবে নিত্যানন্দ আইল চম্পাহট্ট গ্রাম ।<br />বাণীনাথ-গৃহে তথা করিল বিশ্রাম ॥৮৪॥
tabe nityānanda āila champāhaṭṭa grāma<br />vāṇīnātha-gṛhe tathā karila viśrāma [84]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span> <span class="e2">grāma</span>–to the village of Champā Haṭṭa [and] <span class="e2">viśrāma karila</span>–rested <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">vāṇīnātha-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Vāṇīnāth. [84]
Nityānanda Prabhu then came to Champā Haṭṭa Grām and rested there in the home of Vāṇīnāth.
অপরাহ্নে চম্পাহট্ট করয় ভ্রমণ ।<br />নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “শুন বল্লভ-নন্দন ॥৮৫॥
aparāhne champāhaṭṭa karaya bhramaṇa<br />nityānanda bale, “śuna vallabha-nandana [85]
<span class="e2">aparāhne</span>–In the afternoon, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">bhramaṇa karaya</span>–toured <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span>–through Champā Haṭṭa [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“vallabha-nandana</span>–“O son of Vallabha, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! [85]
In the afternoon, Nityānanda toured through Champā Haṭṭa and said, “O Jīva, listen!
এই স্থানে ছিল পূর্ব্বে চম্পককানন ।<br />খদিরবনের অংশ সুন্দর দর্শন ॥৮৬॥
ei sthāne chhila pūrve champaka-kānana<br />khadiravanera aṁśa sundara darśana [86]
<span class="e2">pūrve</span>–Previously, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–there was <span class="e2">sundara darśana champaka-kānana</span>–a beautiful champak forest <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here [that was] <span class="e2">aṁśa</span>–part <span class="e2">khadiravanera</span>–of Khadiravan. [86]
“Previously, there was a beautiful champak forest here that was part of Khadiravan.
চম্পকলতা সখী নিত্য চম্পক লইয়া ।<br />মালা গাঁথি’ রাধাকৃষ্ণে সেবিতেন গিয়া ॥৮৭॥
champakalatā sakhī nitya champaka la-iyā<br />mālā gā̐thi’ rādhā-kṛṣṇe sevitena giyā [87]
<span class="e2">nitya</span>–Daily, <span class="e2">champakalatā</span> <span class="e2">sakhī</span>–Champakalatā Sakhī <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–would pick <span class="e2">champaka</span>–champak flowers [here,] <span class="e2">gā̐thi’</span>–string <span class="e2">mālā</span>–garlands, [and] <span class="e2">giyā sevitena</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇe</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. [87]
“Daily, Champakalatā Sakhī would pick champak flowers here, string garlands, and serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
কলি বৃদ্ধি হৈলে সেই চম্পক কাননে ।<br />মালিগণ ফুল লয় অতি হৃষ্টমনে ॥৮৮॥
kali vṛddhi haile sei champaka kānane<br />māli-gaṇa phula laya ati hṛṣṭa-mane [88]
<span class="e2">kali</span> <span class="e2">vṛddhi</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–When Kali-yuga started, <span class="e2">māli-gaṇa</span>–garland-makers <span class="e2">ati hṛṣṭa-mane</span>–eagerly <span class="e2">laya</span>–began to take <span class="e2">phula</span>–the flowers <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">champaka</span> <span class="e2">kānane</span>–from that champak forest. [88]
“When Kali-yuga started, garland-makers eagerly began to take the champak flowers from the forest.
হট্ট করি’ চম্পক-কুসুম লয়ে বসি’ ।<br />বিক্রয় করয় লয় যত গ্রামবাসী ॥৮৯॥
haṭṭa kari’ champaka-kusuma laye vasi’<br />vikraya karaya laya yata grāma-vāsī [89]
<span class="e2">haṭṭa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–They established a market [and] <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–resided [here]. <span class="e2">laye</span>–They would take <span class="e2">champaka-kusuma</span>–the champak flowers [and] <span class="e2">vikraya</span> <span class="e2">karaya</span>–sell [them, and] <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">grāma-vāsī</span>–all the villagers <span class="e2">laya</span>–would buy them. [89]
“They established a market and resided here. They would take the flowers and sell them, and the villagers would buy them.
সেই হৈতে শ্রীচম্পকহট্ট হৈল নাম ।<br />চাঁপাহাটি সবে বলে মনোহর ধাম ॥৯০॥
sei haite śrī-champakahaṭṭa haila nāma<br />chā̐pāhāṭi sabe bale manohara dhāma [90]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–As a result, <span class="e2">manohara</span> <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–this beautiful place <span class="e2">nāma haila</span>–was named <span class="e2">śrī-champakahaṭṭa</span>–Śrī Champaka Haṭṭa (‘Champaka flower market’), [and] <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">bale</span>–called [it] <span class="e2">chā̐pāhāṭi</span>–Chā̐pāhāṭi. [90]
“As a result, this beautiful place was named Śrī Champaka Haṭṭa, and people began to call it Chā̐pāhāṭi.
যে কাল লক্ষ্মণসেন নদীয়ার রাজা ।<br />জয়দেব নবদ্বীপে হন তাঁর প্রজা ॥৯১॥
ye kāle lakṣmaṇa-sena nadīyāra rājā<br />jayadeva navadvīpe hana tā̐ra prajā [91]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–When <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇa-sena</span>–Lakṣmaṇ Sen [was] <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">nadīyāra</span>–of Nadia, <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev Goswāmī <span class="e2">hana</span>–was <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">prajā</span>–his subject <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. [91]
“When Lakṣmaṇ Sen was the king of Nadia, Jayadev Goswāmī was one of His subjects in Nabadwīp.
বল্লালদীর্ঘিকাকূলে বাঁধিয়া কুটীর ।<br />পদ্মাসহ বৈসে তথা জয়দেব ধীর ॥৯২॥
ballāla-dīrghikā-kūle bā̐dhiyā kuṭīra<br />padmā-saha vaise tathā jayadeva dhīra [92]
<span class="e2">dhīra jayadeva</span>–The wise Jayadev <span class="e2">bā̐dhiyā</span>–built <span class="e2">kuṭīra</span>–a cottage <span class="e2">ballāla-dīrghikā-kūle</span>–on the bank of Ballāl Dīrghikā [and] <span class="e2">vaise</span>–resided <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">padmā-saha</span>–with [his wife] Padmāvatī. [92]
“The wise Jayadev built a cottage on the bank of Ballāl Dīrghikā and resided there with his wife Padmāvatī.
দশ-অবতার স্তব রচিল তথায় ।<br />সেই স্তব লক্ষ্মণের হস্তে কভু যায় ॥৯৩॥
daśa-avatāra stava rachila tathāya<br />sei stava lakṣmaṇera haste kabhu yāya [93]
[While] <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–there, <span class="e2">rachila</span>–he wrote <span class="e2">daśa-avatāra</span> <span class="e2">stava</span>–the <span class="e3">Daśa-avatāra-stotram</span>, [and] <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">stava</span>–poem <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–once <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">haste</span>–to the hand <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇera</span>–of Lakṣmaṇ Sen. [93]
“While there, he wrote the <span class="e3">Daśa-avatāra-stotram</span>, and this poem once came to the hand of Lakṣmaṇ Sen.
পরম আনন্দে স্তব করিল পঠন ।<br />জিজ্ঞাসিল রাজা, ‘স্তব কৈল কোন্ জন’ ॥৯৪॥
parama ānande stava karila paṭhana<br />jijñāsila rājā, ‘stava kaila kon jana’ [94]
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">paṭhana karila</span>–read <span class="e2">stava</span>–the poem <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ānande</span>–with great joy [and] <span class="e2">jijñāsila</span>–asked, <span class="e2">‘kon</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–‘Who <span class="e2">kaila</span>–wrote <span class="e2">stava’</span>–this poem?’ [94]
“The king read the poem with great joy and then asked, ‘Who wrote this?’
গোবর্দ্ধন আচার্য্য রাজারে তবে কয় ।<br />‘মহাকবি জয়দেব রচয়িতা হয়’ ॥৯৫॥
govardhana āchārya rājāre tabe kaya<br />‘mahākavi jayadeva rachayitā haya’ [95]
<span class="e2">govardhana</span> <span class="e2">āchārya</span>–Govardhan Āchārya (the king’s chief scholar) <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">kaya</span>–said <span class="e2">rājāre</span>–to the king, <span class="e2">‘rachayitā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–‘It is written <span class="e2">mahākavi</span>–by the great poet <span class="e2">jayadeva’</span>–Jayadev.’ [95]
“Govardhan Āchārya said to the king, ‘The great poet Jayadev wrote it.’
‘কোথা জয়দেব কবি’ জিজ্ঞাসে ভূপতি ।<br />গোবর্দ্ধন বলে, ‘এই নবদ্বীপে স্থিতি’ ॥৯৬॥
‘kothā jayadeva kavi’ jijñāse bhūpati<br />govardhana bale, ‘ei navadvīpe sthiti’ [96]
<span class="e2">bhūpati</span>–The king <span class="e2">jijñāse</span>–asked, <span class="e2">‘kothā</span>–‘Where [is] <span class="e2">kavi</span>–this poet <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev?’ <span class="e2">govardhana</span>–Govardhan <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘sthiti</span>–‘He lives <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpe’</span>–in Nabadwīp.’ [96]
“The king asked, ‘Where is this poet Jayadev?’ Govardhan replied, ‘He lives in Nabadwīp.’
শুনিয়া গোপনে রাজা করিয়া সন্ধান ।<br />রাত্রযোগে আইল তবে জয়দেব-স্থান ॥৯৭॥
śuniyā gopane rājā kariyā sandhana<br />rātra-yoge āila tabe jayadeva-sthāna [97]
<span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–Hearing [this,] <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">gopane</span>–secretly <span class="e2">sandhana kariyā</span>–searched [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">jayadeva-sthāna</span>–to the home of Jayadev <span class="e2">rātra-yoge</span>–in the evening. [97]
“Hearing this, the king secretly searched for Jayadev’s home and then came there in the evening.
বৈষ্ণববেশেতে রাজা কুটিরে প্রবেশ ।<br />জয়দেবে নতি করি’ বৈসে একদেশে ॥৯৮॥
vaiṣṇava-veśete rājā kuṭire praveśa<br />jayadeve nati kari’ baise eka-deśe [98]
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">praveśa</span>–entered <span class="e2">kuṭire</span>–the cottage <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-veśete</span>–in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava. <span class="e2">nati</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–He bowed <span class="e2">jayadeve</span>–to Jayadev [and] <span class="e2">baise</span>–sat <span class="e2">eka-deśe</span>–on one side. [98]
“The king entered the cottage in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava. He bowed to Jayadev and sat on one side.
জয়দেব জানিলেন ভূপতি এ জন ।<br />বৈষ্ণববেশেতে আইল হয়ে অকিঞ্চন ॥৯৯॥
jayadeva jānilena bhūpati e jana<br />vaiṣṇava-veśete āila haye akiñchana [99]
<span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev <span class="e2">jānilena</span>–understood [that] <span class="e2">e jana</span>–this man [was] <span class="e2">bhūpati</span>–the king [and that] <span class="e2">āila</span>–he had come <span class="e2">akiñchana haye</span>–as a beggar <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-veśete</span>–in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava. [99]
“Jayadev understood that this man was the king and that he had come to him as a beggar in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava.
অল্পক্ষণে রাজা তবে দেয় পরিচয় ।<br />জয়দেবে যাচে যাইতে আপন আলয় ॥১০০॥
alpa-kṣaṇe rājā tabe deya parichaya<br />jayadeve yāche yāite āpana ālaya [100]
<span class="e2">alpa-kṣaṇe</span>–Within a short time, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">parichaya deya</span>–introduced [himself and] <span class="e2">yāche</span>–requested <span class="e2">jayadeve</span>–Jayadev <span class="e2">yāite</span>–to go <span class="e2">āpana</span> <span class="e2">ālaya</span>–to his palace. [100]
“Within a short time, the king introduced himself and requested Jayadev to go to his palace.
অত্যন্ত বিরক্ত জয়দেব মহামতি ।<br />বিষয়িগৃহেতে যেতে না করে সম্মতি ॥১০১॥
atyanta virakta jayadeva mahāmati<br />viṣayi-gṛhete yete nā kare sammati [101]
<span class="e2">mahāmati</span>–The wise <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev [was] <span class="e2">atyanta</span>–extremely <span class="e2">virakta</span>–detached, [and] <span class="e2">sammati kare nā</span>–he did not agree <span class="e2">yete</span>–to go <span class="e2">viṣayi-gṛhete</span>–to the home of any materialist. [101]
“The wise Jayadev was extremely detached, and he did not agree to go to the home of any materialist.
কৃষ্ণভক্ত জয়দেব বলিল তখন ।<br />‘তব দেশ ছাড়ি’ আমি করিব গমন ॥১০২॥
kṛṣṇa-bhakta jayadeva balila takhana<br />‘tava deśa chhāḍi’ āmi kariba gamana [102]
<span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–the [great] devotee of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–will leave <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">deśa</span>–province [and] <span class="e2">gamana kariba</span>–go [elsewhere]. [102]
“Jayadev, the great devotee of Kṛṣṇa, then said, ‘I will leave your province and go elsewhere.
বিষয়ি-সংসর্গ কভু না দেয় মঙ্গল ।<br />গঙ্গা পার হয়ে যাব যথা নীলাচল’ ॥১০৩॥
viṣayi-saṁsarga kabhu nā deya maṅgala<br />gaṅgā pāra haye yāba yathā nīlāchala’ [103]
<span class="e2">viṣayi-saṁsarga</span>–Association with materialists <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">deya</span>–grants <span class="e2">maṅgala</span>–fortune, [so] <span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–I will cross <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā [and] <span class="e2">yāba</span>–go <span class="e2">yathā</span>–to <span class="e2">nīlāchala’</span>–Jagannāth Purī.’ [103]
“‘Association with materialists never results in good fortune, so I will cross the Gaṅgā and go to Nīlāchal.’
রাজা বলে, ‘শুন প্রভু আমার বচন ।<br />নবদ্বীপ ত্যাগ নাহি কর কদাচন ॥১০৪॥
rājā bale, ‘śuna prabhu āmāra vachana<br />navadvīpa tyāga nāhi kara kadāchana [104]
<span class="e2">rājā</span>–The king <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘prabhu</span>–‘O master, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">vachana</span>–to my words. <span class="e2">kadāchana tyāga</span> <span class="e2">kara nāhi</span>–Please do not ever leave <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. [104]
“The king said, ‘O master, listen to my words. Please do not ever leave Nabadwīp.
তব বাক্য সত্য হবে মোর ইচ্ছা রবে ।<br />হেন কার্য্য কর দেব মোরে কৃপা যবে ॥১০৫॥
tava vākya satya habe mora ichchhā rabe<br />hena kārya kara deva more kṛpā yabe [105]
<span class="e2">yabe deva more kṛpā</span>–Please be merciful to me [and] <span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">kārya</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–act so that <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">vākya</span>–words <span class="e2">satya</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will come true [and] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">ichchhā</span>–desire <span class="e2">rabe</span>–will [also] be fulfilled.<span class="e2"> </span>[105]
“‘Please be merciful to me and act in such a way that your words will come true and my desire will also be fulfilled.
গঙ্গাপারে চম্পহট্ট স্থান মনোহর ।<br />সেই স্থানে থাক তুমি দু’ এক বৎসর ॥১০৬॥
gaṅgā-pāre champāhaṭṭa sthāna manohara<br />sei sthāne thāka tumi du’ eka vatsara [106]
<span class="e2">gaṅgā-pāre</span>–On the other side of the Gaṅgā, [there is] <span class="e2">manohara sthāna</span>–a beautiful place [known as] <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span>–Champā Haṭṭa. <span class="e2">tumi thāka</span>–Please stay <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–there <span class="e2">du’</span> <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">vatsara</span>–for a couple of years. [106]
“‘On the other side of the Gaṅgā, there is a beautiful place known as Champā Haṭṭa. Please stay there for a couple of years.
মম ইচ্ছামতে আমি তথা না যাইব ।<br />তব ইচ্ছা হলে তব চরণ হেরিব’ ॥১০৭॥
mama ichchhā-mate āmi tathā nā yāiba<br />tava ichchhā hale tava charaṇa heriba’ [107]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">yāiba nā</span>–will not go <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">ichchhā-mate</span>–according to my own desire; <span class="e2">heriba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet [only] <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">hale’</span>–when you desire it.’ [107]
“‘I will not go there according to my own desire; I will come to see your feet only when you desire it.’
রাজার বচন শুনি’ মহাকবিবর ।<br />সম্মত হইয়া বলে বচন সত্ত্বর ॥১০৮॥
rāyāra vachana śuni’ mahākavi-vara<br />sammata ha-iyā bale vachana satvara [108]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">vachana</span>–the words <span class="e2">rāyāra</span>–of the king, <span class="e2">mahākavi-vara</span>–the best of great poets <span class="e2">satvara</span>–immediately<span class="e2"> vachana bale</span>–replied <span class="e2">sammata</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–in agreement. [108]
“Hearing the words of the king, the great poet immediately replied in agreement.
‘যদ্যপি বিষয়ী তুমি এ রাজ্য তোমার ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্ত তুমি তব নাহিক সংসার ॥১০৯॥
‘yadyapi viṣayī tumi e rājya tomāra<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakta tumi tava nāhika saṁsāra [109]
<span class="e2">‘yadyapi</span>–‘Although <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">viṣayī</span>–a materialist [and] <span class="e2">e rājya</span>–this kingdom [is] <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–yours, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–a devotee of Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">tava</span>–<span class="e2">saṁsāra nāhika</span>–you have no material attachment. [109]
“‘Although you are a materialist and this kingdom is yours, you are a devotee of Kṛṣṇa and you have no material attachment.
পরীক্ষা করিতে আমি বিষয়ী বলিয়া ।<br />সম্ভাষিণু তবু তুমি সহিলে শুনিয়া ॥১১০॥
parīkṣā karite āmi viṣayī baliyā<br />sambhāṣiṇu tabu tumi sahile śuniyā [110]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">baliyā sambhāṣiṇu</span>–called [you] <span class="e2">viṣayī</span>–a materialist <span class="e2">parīkṣā</span> <span class="e2">karite</span>–to test [you,] <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–heard [this and] <span class="e2">sahile</span>–tolerated [it]. [110]
“‘I called you a materialist to test you, but you heard this and tolerated it.
অতএব জানিলাম তুমি কৃষ্ণভক্ত ।<br />বিষয় লইয়া ফির হয়ে অনাসক্ত ॥১১১॥
ataeva jānilāma tumi kṛṣṇa-bhakta<br />viṣaya la-iyā phira haye anāsakta [111]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">jānilāma</span>–I have [now] understood [that] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–a devotee of Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">la-iyā</span> <span class="e2">phira</span>–You engage <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–in material affairs [but] <span class="e2">anāsakta haye</span>–are detached. [111]
“‘I have now understood that you are a devotee of Kṛṣṇa. You engage in material affairs but remain detached.
চম্পকহট্টেতে আমি কিছুদিন রব ।<br />গোপনে আসিবে তুমি ছাড়িয়া বৈভব’ ॥১১২॥
champaka-haṭṭete āmi kichhu-dina raba<br />gopane āsibe tumi chhāḍiyā vaibhava’ [112]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">raba</span>–will stay <span class="e2">champaka-haṭṭete</span>–in Champaka Haṭṭa <span class="e2">kichhu-dina</span>–for some time. <span class="e2">gopane</span>–In secret, <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leaving behind [your] <span class="e2">vaibhava</span>–opulence,<span class="e2"> tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">āsibe’</span>–may come [to see me].’ [112]
“‘I will stay in Champaka Haṭṭa for some time. In secret, leaving your opulence behind, you may come to see me.’
হৃষ্টচিত্ত হয়ে রাজা অমাত্য দ্বারায় ।<br />চম্পকহট্টেতে গৃহ নির্ম্মাণ করায় ॥১১৩॥
hṛṣṭa-chitta haye rājā amātya dvārāya<br />champaka-haṭṭete gṛha nirmāṇa karāya [113]
<span class="e2">dvārāya</span>–Through <span class="e2">amātya</span>–a minister, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–the king <span class="e2">hṛṣṭa-chitta</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–happily <span class="e2">gṛha</span> <span class="e2">nirmāṇa</span> <span class="e2">karāya</span>–had a house constructed <span class="e2">champaka-haṭṭete</span>–in Champaka Haṭṭa. [113]
“Through one of his ministers, the king happily had a house constructed in Champaka Haṭṭa.
তথা জয়দেব কবি রহে দিন কত ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণভজন করে রাগমার্গ মত ॥১১৪॥
tathā jayadeva kavi rahe dina kata<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana kare rāga-mārga mata [114]
<span class="e2">kavi</span>–The poet <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev <span class="e2">rahe</span>–stayed <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">dina</span> <span class="e2">kata</span>–for some time [and] <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–served Śrī Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">rāga-mārga</span> <span class="e2">mata</span>–according to the principles of rāga-mārg (the path of divine love). [114]
“The poet Jayadev stayed there for some time and served Śrī Kṛṣṇa according to the path of divine love.
পদ্মাবতী দেবী আনে চম্পকের ভার ।<br />জয়দেব পূজে কৃষ্ণ নন্দের কুমার ॥১১৫॥
padmāvatī devī āne champakera bhāra<br />jayadeva pūje kṛṣṇa nandera kumāra [115]
<span class="e2">padmāvatī</span> <span class="e2">devī</span>–Padmāvatī Devī <span class="e2">āne</span>–would bring <span class="e2">bhāra</span>–loads <span class="e2">champakera</span>–of champak flowers, [and] <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev <span class="e2">pūje</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">nandera</span> <span class="e2">kumāra kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda [with them]. [115]
“Padmāvatī Devī would bring loads of champak flowers, and Jayadev worshipped Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda, with them.
মহাপ্রেমে জয়দেব করয়ে পূজন ।<br />দেখিল শ্রীকৃষ্ণ হৈল চম্পকবরণ ॥১১৬॥
mahāpreme jayadeva karaye pūjana<br />dekhila śrī-kṛṣṇa haila champaka-varaṇa [116]
<span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev <span class="e2">pūjana karaye</span>–offered worship <span class="e2">mahāpreme</span>–with intense love, [and] <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–he saw <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">haila</span>–appear <span class="e2">champaka-varaṇa</span>–the colour of a champak flower. [116]
“Jayadev offered worship with intense love, and eventually he saw Śrī Kṛṣṇa appear before him in a form the colour of a champak flower.
পুরটসুন্দরকান্তি অতি মনোহর ।<br />কোটিচন্দ্রনিন্দি মুখ পরম সুন্দর ॥১১৭॥
puraṭa-sundara-kānti ati manohara<br />koṭi-chandra-nindi mukha parama sundara [117]
[The Lord’s] <span class="e2">puraṭa-sundara-kānti</span>–beautiful golden lustre [was] <span class="e2">ati</span>–completely <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting, [and His] <span class="e2">parama</span>–extremely <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">mukha</span>–face <span class="e2">nindi</span>–belittled <span class="e2">koṭi-chandra</span>–millions of moons. [117]
“The Lord’s beautiful, golden lustre was completely enchanting, and His extremely beautiful face belittled millions of moons.
চাঁচর চিকুর শোভা গলে ফুলমালা ।<br />দীর্ঘবাহু রূপে আলো করে পর্ণশালা ॥১১৮॥
chā̐chara chikura śobhā gale phula-mālā<br />dīrgha-bāhu rūpe ālo kare parṇa-śālā [118]
[He had] <span class="e2">chā̐chara</span>–wavy <span class="e2">chikura</span>–hair, <span class="e2">dīrgha-bāhu</span>–long arms, [and] <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">phula-mālā</span>–a beautiful flower garland <span class="e2">gale</span>–around [His] neck. [His] <span class="e2">rūpe</span>–body <span class="e2">ālo</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–illumined <span class="e2">parṇa-śālā</span>–the thatched hut [of Jayadev]. [118]
“He had wavy hair, long arms, and a beautiful flower garland around His neck. His body illumined the thatched hut of Jayadev.
দেখিয়া গৌরাঙ্গ-রূপ মহাকবিবর ।<br />প্রেমে মুর্চ্ছা যায় চক্ষে অশ্রু ঝর ঝর ॥১১৯॥
dekhiyā gaurāṅga-rūpa mahākavi-vara<br />preme mūrchchhā yāya chakṣe aśru jhara jhara [119]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-rūpa</span>–the form of Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">mahākavi-vara</span>–the best of poets <span class="e2">mūrchchhā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–fainted <span class="e2">preme</span>–in divine love, [and] <span class="e2">aśru</span>–tears <span class="e2">jhara</span> <span class="e2">jhara</span>–streamed <span class="e2">chakṣe</span>–from [his] eyes. [119]
“Seeing the form of Gaurāṅga, Jayadev, the best of poets, fainted in divine love as tears streamed from his eyes.
পদ্মাবতী দেবী সেই রূপ নিরখিয়া ।<br />হইল চৈতন্যহীন ভূমেতে পড়িয়া ॥১২০॥
padmāvatī devī sei rūpa nirakhiyā<br />ha-ila chaitanya-hīna bhūmete paḍiyā [120]
<span class="e2">nirakhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–His form, <span class="e2">padmāvatī</span> <span class="e2">devī</span>–Padmāvatī Devī <span class="e2">chaitanya-hīna ha-ila</span>–fainted [and] <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–fell <span class="e2">bhūmete</span>–to the ground. [120]
“Seeing the Lord’s form, Padmāvatī Devī fainted and fell to the ground.
পদ্মহস্ত দিয়া প্রভু তোলে দুই জনে ।<br />কৃপা করি বলে তবে অমিয়-বচনে ॥১২১॥
padma-hasta diyā prabhu tole dui jane<br />kṛpā kari’ bale tabe amiya-vachane [121]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">tole</span>–raised <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–the two of them <span class="e2">diyā</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">padma-hasta</span>–lotus hands [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">kṛpā kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">bale</span>–spoke <span class="e2">amiya-vachane</span>–nectarean words. [121]
“The Lord raised them both with His lotus hands and then mercifully spoke nectarean words.
‘তুমি দোঁহে মম ভক্ত পরম উদার ।<br />দরশন দিতে ইচ্ছা হইল আমার ॥১২২॥
‘tumi do̐he mama bhakta parama udāra<br />daraśana dite ichchhā ha-ila āmāra [122]
<span class="e2">‘tumi</span>–‘You [are] <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–both <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">udāra</span>–highly exalted <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotees, [and] <span class="e2">āmāra ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–I desired <span class="e2">daraśana</span> <span class="e2">dite</span>–to reveal [Myself to you]. [122]
“‘You are both My highly exalted devotees, and I desired to reveal Myself to you.
অতি অল্পদিনে এই নদীয়া নগরে ।<br />জনম লইব আমি শচীর উদরে ॥১২৩॥
ati alpa-dine ei nadīyā nagare<br />janama la-iba āmi śachīra udare [123]
<span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">alpa-dine</span>–Within a very short time, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">janama</span> <span class="e2">la-iba</span>–will take birth <span class="e2">udare</span>–from the womb <span class="e2">śachīra</span>–of Śachī <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nadīyā</span> <span class="e2">nagare</span>–in the town of Nadia. [123]
“‘Very soon I will take birth from the womb of Śachī Devī in Nadia.
সর্ব্ব-অবতারে সকলভক্ত সনে ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণকীর্ত্তনে বিতরিব প্রেমধনে ॥১২৪॥
sarva-avatāre sakala-bhakta sane<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtane vitariba prema-dhane [124]
<span class="e2">sane</span>–With <span class="e2">sakala-bhakta</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">avatāre</span>–of all [My] Avatārs, <span class="e2">vitariba</span>–I will distribute <span class="e2">prema-dhane</span>–the wealth of divine love <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtane</span>–by chanting the Name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [124]
“‘With all the devotees of all My previous Avatārs, I will distribute the wealth of divine love through Śrī Kṛṣṇa-kīrtan.
চব্বিশ বৎসরে আমি করিয়া সন্ন্যাস ।<br />করিব অবশ্য নীলাচলেতে নিবাস ॥১২৫॥
chabbiśa vatsare āmi kariyā sannyāsa<br />kariba avaśya nīlāchalete nivāsa [125]
<span class="e2">chabbiśa</span> <span class="e2">vatsare</span>–During [My] twenty-fourth year, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">sannyāsa kariyā</span>–will take sannyās, [and] <span class="e2">avaśya</span>–undoubtedly <span class="e2">nivāsa kariba</span>–I will reside <span class="e2">nīlāchalete</span>–in Jagannāth Purī. [125]
“‘At the age of twenty-four, I will take sannyās and then reside in Nīlāchal.
তথা ভক্তগণ সঙ্গে মহাপ্রেমাবেশে ।<br />শ্রীগীতগোবিন্দ আস্বাদিব অবশেষে ॥১২৬॥
tathā bhakta-gaṇa saṅge mahāpremāveśe<br />śrī-gīta-govinda āsvādiba avaśeṣe [126]
<span class="e2">tathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">mahāpremāveśe</span>–immersed in intense divine love, <span class="e2">avaśeṣe āsvādiba</span>–I will deeply relish [your] <span class="e2">śrī-gīta-govinda</span>–<span class="e3">Śrī Gīta-govinda</span> <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [My] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–devotees. [126]
“‘There, immersed in intense divine love, I will deeply relish your <span class="e3">Śrī Gīta-govinda</span> with My devotees.
তব বিরচিত গীতগোবিন্দ আমার ।<br />অতিশয় প্রিয়বস্তু কহিলাম সার ॥১২৭॥
tava virachita gīta-govinda āmāra<br />atiśaya priya-vastu kahilāma sāra [127]
<span class="e2">sāra kahilāma</span>–I am telling you the truth: <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">virachita</span>–your composition <span class="e2">gīta-govinda</span>–<span class="e3">Gīta-govinda</span> [is] <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">atiśaya</span> <span class="e2">priya-vastu</span>–extremely dear to Me. [127]
“‘I am telling you the truth: your <span class="e3">Gīta-govinda</span> is extremely dear to Me.
এই নবদ্বীপধাম পরম চিন্ময় ।<br />দেহান্তে আসিবে হেথা কহিনু নিশ্চয় ॥১২৮॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma parama chinmaya<br />dehānte āsibe hethā kahinu niśchaya [128]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [is] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual [and] <span class="e2">parama</span>–supreme; <span class="e2">kahinu</span>–I promise [you that] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">āsibe</span>–you will come <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">dehānte</span>–after [leaving your] body. [128]
“‘Nabadwīp Dhām is spiritual and supreme; I promise you that you will come here after leaving your body.
এবে তুমি দোঁহে যাও যথা নীলাচল ।<br />জগন্নাথে সেব গিয়া পাবে প্রেমফল’ ॥১২৯॥
ebe tumi do̐he yāo yathā nīlāchala<br />jagannāthe seva giyā pābe prema-phala’ [129]
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–For now, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–two <span class="e2">yāo</span>–will go <span class="e2">yathā</span>–to <span class="e2">nīlāchala</span>–Jagannāth Purī. <span class="e2">seva</span> <span class="e2">giyā</span>–Serve <span class="e2">jagannāthe</span>–Jagannāth [there, and] <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">prema-phala’</span>–the fruit of divine love.’ [129]
“‘For now, you two will go to Nīlāchal. Serve Jagannāth there, and you will attain the fruit of divine love.’
এত বলি’ গৌরচন্দ্র হৈল অদর্শন ।<br />প্রভুর বিচ্ছেদে মুর্চ্ছা হয় দুইজন ॥১৩০॥
eta bali’ gaurachandra haila adarśana<br />prabhura vichchhede murchchhā haya dui-jana [130]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">adarśana haila</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">vichchhede</span>–In separation from the Lord, <span class="e2">dui-jana</span>–the two of them <span class="e2">murchchhā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–fainted. [130]
“Saying this, Gaurachandra disappeared. In separation from the Lord, Jayadev and Padmāvatī fainted.
মূর্চ্ছাশেষে অনর্গল কাঁদিতে লাগিল ।<br />কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে সব নিবেদন কৈল ॥১৩১॥
mūrchchhā-śeṣe anargala kā̐dite lāgila<br />kā̐dite kā̐dite saba nivedana kaila [131]
<span class="e2">mūrchchhā-śeṣe</span>–After fainting, <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–they began <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–to cry <span class="e2">anargala</span>–profusely. <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–Crying and crying, <span class="e2">saba</span>–they <span class="e2">nivedana</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–offered prayers. [131]
“Regaining consciousness, they began to cry profusely. Crying and crying, they offered prayers.
‘হায় কিবা রূপ মোরা দেখিনু নয়নে ।<br />কেমনে বাঁচিব এবে তাঁর অদর্শনে ॥১৩২॥
‘hāya kibā rūpa morā dekhinu nayane<br />kemane vā̐chiba ebe tā̐ra adarśane [132]
<span class="e2">‘hāya!</span>–‘Alas! <span class="e2">kibā</span>–What <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–a form <span class="e2">morā</span>–we <span class="e2">dekhinu</span>–have seen <span class="e2">nayane</span>–with [our] eyes! <span class="e2">kemane</span>–How <span class="e2">vā̐chiba</span>–will we live <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">adarśane</span>–in separation from Him? [132]
“‘Alas! What a form we have seen! How will we now live in separation from Him?
নদীয়া ছাড়িতে প্রভু কেন আজ্ঞা কৈল ।<br />বুঝি এই ধামে কিছু অপরাধ হৈল ॥১৩৩॥
nadīyā chhāḍite prabhu kena ājñā kaila<br />bujhi ei dhāme kichhu aparādha haila [133]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">prabhu ājñā</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–did the Lord order [us] <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–to leave <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–Nadia? <span class="e2">bujhi</span>–We understand [that] <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–we [must] have made some offences <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–here. [133]
“‘Why did the Lord order us to leave Nadia? We understand that we must have made some offence here.
এই নবদ্বীপধাম পরম চিন্ময় ।<br />ছাড়িতে মানস এবে বিকলিত হয় ॥১৩৪॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma parama chinmaya<br />chhāḍite mānasa ebe vikalita haya [134]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [is] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual [and] <span class="e2">parama</span>–supreme, [and our] <span class="e2">mānasa</span>–hearts <span class="e2">ebe</span> <span class="e2">vikalita</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are now dismayed [at having] <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–to leave. [134]
“‘Nabadwīp Dhām is spiritual and supreme, and our hearts are dismayed at the thought of leaving.
ভাল হৈত নবদ্বীপে পশু পক্ষী হয়ে ।<br />থাকিতাম চিরদিন ধামচিন্তা লয়ে ॥১৩৫॥
bhāla haita navadvīpe paśu pakṣī haye<br />thākitāma chira-dina dhāma-chintā laye [135]
<span class="e2">bhāla</span> <span class="e2">haita</span>–It would be better [to] <span class="e2">paśu</span> <span class="e2">pakṣī</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–become an animal or bird <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. [Then] <span class="e2">thākitāma</span>–we would remain [here]<span class="e2"> chira-dina</span>–forever, <span class="e2">dhāma-chintā</span> <span class="e2">laye</span>–meditating on the Dhām. [135]
“‘It would be better to become an animal or bird and remain here forever, meditating on the Dhām.
পরাণ ছাড়িতে পারি তবু এই ধাম ।<br />ছাড়িতে না পারি এই গূঢ় মনস্কাম ॥১৩৬॥
parāṇa chhāḍite pāri tabu ei dhāma<br />chhāḍite nā pāri ei gūḍha manaskāma [136]
<span class="e2">chhāḍite</span> <span class="e2">pāri</span>–We can give up [our] <span class="e2">parāṇa</span>–lives, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span> <span class="e2">pāri nā</span>–we cannot give up <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–the Dhām— [our] <span class="e2">manaskāma</span>–attachment [is] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–so intense. [136]
“‘We can give up our lives, but we cannot give up the Dhām—our attachment is so intense.
ওহে প্রভু শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ কৃপা বিতরিয়া ।<br />রাখ আমা দোঁহে হেথা শ্রীচরণ দিয়া’ ॥১৩৭॥
ohe prabhu śrī-gaurāṅga kṛpā vitariyā<br />rākha āmā do̐he hethā śrī-charaṇa diyā’ [137]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord! <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">vitariyā</span>–Be merciful [and] <span class="e2">rākha</span>–keep <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–us both <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇa</span> <span class="e2">diyā’</span>–at Your holy feet.’ [137]
“‘O Lord! Śrī Gaurāṅga! Be merciful and keep us here at Your holy feet.’
বলিতে বলিতে দোঁহে কাঁদে উচ্চরায় ।<br />দৈববাণী সেইক্ষণে শুনিবারে পায় ॥১৩৮॥
balite balite do̐he kā̐de uchcharāya<br />daiva-vāṇī sei-kṣaṇe śunibāre pāya [138]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–While speaking, <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–they both <span class="e2">kā̐de</span> <span class="e2">uchcharāya</span>–cried aloud, [and] <span class="e2">sei-kṣaṇe</span>–then <span class="e2">śunibāre</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–they heard <span class="e2">daiva-vāṇī</span>–a divine voice. [138]
“While speaking in this way, they cried aloud, and then they heard a divine voice.
‘দুঃখ নাহি কর দোঁহে যাও নীলাচল ।<br />দুই কথা হবে চিত্ত না কর চঞ্চল ॥১৩৯॥
‘duḥkha nāhi kara do̐he yāo nīlāchala<br />dui kathā habe chitta nā kara chañchala [139]
<span class="e2">‘duḥkha</span> <span class="e2">kara nāhi</span>–‘Do not be sad. <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–Both of you <span class="e2">yāo</span>–go <span class="e2">nīlāchala</span>–to Jagannāth Purī. <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–I will tell [you] two things. <span class="e2">chitta</span> <span class="e2">chañchala kara nā</span>–Do not be unsteady at heart. [139]
“‘Go to Nīlāchal, and do not be sad or unsteady at heart. I will tell you two things.
কিছুদিন পূর্ব্বে দোঁহে করিলে মানস ।<br />নীলাচলে বাস করি কতক দিবস ॥১৪০॥
kichhu-dina pūrve do̐he karile mānasa<br />nīlāchale vāsa kari kataka divasa [140]
<span class="e2">kichhu-dina</span>–Some time <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–ago, <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–you both <span class="e2">mānasa karile</span>–desired <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kari</span>–to stay <span class="e2">nīlāchale</span>–in Nīlāchal <span class="e2">kataka</span> <span class="e2">divasa</span>–for a few days. [140]
“‘Some time ago, you both desired to stay in Nīlāchal for a few days.
সেই বাঞ্ছা জগবন্ধু পূরাইল তব ।<br />জগন্নাথ চাহে তব দর্শন সম্ভব ॥১৪১॥
sei vāñchhā jagabandhu pūrāila tava<br />jagannātha chāhe tava darśana sambhava [141]
<span class="e2">jagabandhu</span>–Jagannāth (the friend of the world) <span class="e2">pūrāila</span>–has fulfilled <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">vāñchhā</span>–desire <span class="e2">tava</span>–of yours, [and] <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–Jagannāth <span class="e2">chāhe</span>–wants <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">sambhava</span>–the chance to see you. [141]
“‘Jagannāth has fulfilled this desire of yours, and He wants to see you.
জগন্নাথে তুষি’ পুনঃ ছাড়িয়া শরীর ।<br />নবদ্বীপে দুইজনে নিত্য হবে স্থির’ ॥১৪২॥
jagannāthe tuṣi’ punaḥ chhāḍiyā śarīra<br />navadvīpe dui-jane nitya habe sthira’ [142]
<span class="e2">dui-jane</span>–You two <span class="e2">tuṣi’</span>–will please <span class="e2">jagannāthe</span>–Jagannāth, <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leave [your] <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–bodies, [and then] <span class="e2">sthira habe</span>–remain <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">nitya’</span>–eternally.’ [142]
“‘You two will please Jagannāth, again leave your bodies, and then reside in Nabadwīp eternally.’
দৈববাণী শুনি’ দোঁহে চলে ততক্ষণ ।<br />পাছে ফিরি নবদ্বীপ করেন দর্শন ॥১৪৩॥
daiva-vāṇī śuni’ do̐he chale tata-kṣaṇa<br />pāchhe phiri navadvīpa karena darśana [143]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Upon hearing <span class="e2">daiva-vāṇī</span>–the divine voice, <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–they both <span class="e2">tata-kṣaṇa</span>–immediately <span class="e2">chale</span>–left, [and] <span class="e2">pāchhe</span>–later on, <span class="e2">phiri</span>–they turned [and] <span class="e2">darśana karena</span>–looked <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–at Nabadwīp. [143]
“Upon hearing the divine voice, Jayadev and Padmāvatī immediately left, and after some time, they turned and looked back at Nabadwīp.
ছল ছল করে নেত্র জলধারা বহে ।<br />নবদ্বীপবাসিগণে দৈন্যবাক্য কহে ॥১৪৪॥
chhala chhala kare netra jaladhārā vahe<br />navadvīpa-vāsi-gaṇe dainya-vākya kahe [144]
<span class="e2">chhala</span> <span class="e2">chhala</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–They wept, [and] <span class="e2">jaladhārā</span>–tears <span class="e2">vahe</span>–streamed <span class="e2">netra</span>–from [their] eyes. <span class="e2">dainya-vākya</span> <span class="e2">kahe</span>–They spoke humbly <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsi-gaṇe</span>–to the residents of Nabadwīp. [144]
“They wept, and tears streamed from their eyes. Humbly, they spoke to the residents of Nabadwīp.
‘তোমরা করিয়া কৃপা এই দুই জনে ।<br />অপরাধ করিয়াছি করহ মার্জ্জনে’ ॥১৪৫॥
‘tomarā kariyā kṛpā ei dui jane<br />aparādha kariyāchhi karaha mārjane’ [145]
<span class="e2">‘tomarā</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span> <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–‘Please be merciful <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–to these two souls. <span class="e2">aparādha</span> <span class="e2">kariyāchhi</span>–We have committed offences; <span class="e2">mārjane karaha’</span>–please forgive us.’ [145]
“‘Please be merciful to these two souls. Please forgive us for the offences we have committed.’
অষ্টদল পদ্মসম নবদ্বীপ ভায় ।<br />দেখিতে দেখিতে দোঁহে কতদূরে যায় ॥১৪৬॥
aṣṭa-dala padma-sama navadvīpa bhāya<br />dekhite dekhite do̐he kata-dūre yāya [146]
<span class="e2">do̐he</span>–They <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">kata-dūre</span>–away, <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–looking [back] <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–at Nabadwīp, [which] <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dala</span> <span class="e2">padma-sama</span> <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–resembles an eight-petalled lotus. [146]
“They walked away, looking back again and again at the eight-petalled lotus of Nabadwīp.
দূরে গিয়া নবদ্বীপ নাহি দেখে আর ।<br />কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে গৌড়ভূমি হয় পার ॥১৪৭॥
dūre giyā navadvīpa nāhi dekhe āra<br />kā̐dite kā̐dite gauḍa-bhūmi haya pāra [147]
<span class="e2">giyā</span>–They went <span class="e2">dūre</span>–ahead [and] <span class="e2">dekhe nāhi</span>–did not see <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">āra</span>–any more. <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">pāra haya</span>–they crossed outside <span class="e2">gauḍa-bhūmi</span>–the land of Gauḍa. [147]
“They went ahead and eventually did not see Nabadwīp anymore. Crying, they crossed outside the land of Gauḍa.
কতদিনে নীলাচলে পৌঁছিয়া দুই জনে ।<br />জগন্নাথ দরশন কৈল হৃষ্টমনে ॥১৪৮॥
kata-dine nīlāchale pau̐chhiyā dui jane<br />jagannātha daraśana kaila hṛṣṭa-mane [148]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Some time later, <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–the two of them <span class="e2">pau̐chhiyā</span>–arrived <span class="e2">nīlāchale</span>–in Nīlāchal [and] <span class="e2">daraśana</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–saw <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–Jagannāth <span class="e2">hṛṣṭa-mane</span>–with cheerful hearts. [148]
“Some time later, they arrived in Nīlāchal and saw Jagannāth with cheerful hearts.
ওহে জীব এই জয়দেবস্থান হয় ।<br />উচ্চভূমি মাত্র আছে বৃদ্ধলোকে কয়” ॥১৪৯॥
ohe jīva ei jayadeva-sthāna haya<br />uchcha-bhūmi mātra āchhe vṛddha-loke kaya” [149]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">jayadeva-sthāna</span>–the place of Jayadev. <span class="e2">vṛddha-loke</span>–The elders <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">uchcha-bhūmi</span>–this raised land <span class="e2">āchhe”</span>–remains.” [149]
“O Jīva, this is the place of Jayadev. The elders say that only this raised land is what remains of it.”
জয়দেবস্থান দেখি শ্রীজীব তখন ।<br />প্রেমে গড়াগড়ি যায় করয় রোদন ॥১৫০॥
jayadeva-sthāna dekhi’ śrī-jīva takhana<br />preme gaḍāgaḍi yāya karaya rodana [150]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">jayadeva-sthāna</span>–the place of Jayadev, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled on the ground [and] <span class="e2">rodana karaya</span>–wept <span class="e2">preme</span>–in divine love. [150]
Seeing the place of Jayadev, Śrī Jīva rolled on the ground and wept in divine love.
“ধন্য জয়দেব কবি ধন্য পদ্মাবতী ।<br />শ্রীগীতগোবিন্দ ধন্য ধন্য কৃষ্ণরতি ॥১৫১॥
“dhanya jayadeva kavi dhanya padmāvatī<br />śrī-gīta-govinda dhanya dhanya kṛṣṇa-rati [151]
<span class="e2">“dhanya</span>–“Glory <span class="e2">jayadeva</span> <span class="e2">kavi</span>–to the poet Jayadev! <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–Glory <span class="e2">padmāvatī</span>–to Padmāvatī! <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–Glory <span class="e2">śrī-gīta-govinda</span>–to <span class="e3">Śrī Gīta-govinda</span>! <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–Glory <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-rati</span>–to love for Kṛṣṇa! [151]
“Glory to the poet Jayadev! Glory to Padmāvatī! Glory to <span class="e3">Śrī Gīta-govinda</span>! Glory to love for Kṛṣṇa!
জয়দেব ভোগ কৈল যেই প্রেমসিন্ধু ।<br />কৃপা করি’ দেহ মোরে তার একবিন্দু” ॥১৫২॥
jayadeva bhoga kaila yei prema-sindhu<br />kṛpā kari’ deha more tāra eka-bindu” [152]
[O Lord,] <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">deha</span>–give <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">eka-bindu</span>–a drop <span class="e2">tāra yei</span> <span class="e2">prema-sindhu</span>–of the ocean of divine love [that] <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev <span class="e2">bhoga</span> <span class="e2">kaila”</span>–relished.” [152]
“O Lord, mercifully give me a drop of the ocean of divine love that Jayadev relished.”
এই কথা বলি’ জীব ধরণী লোটায় ।<br />নিত্যানন্দশ্রীচরণে গড়াগড়ি যায় ॥১৫৩॥
ei kathā bali’ jīva dharaṇī loṭāya<br />nityānanda-śrī-charaṇe gaḍāgaḍi yāya [153]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–this, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">loṭāya</span>–tumbled <span class="e2">dharaṇī</span>–to the ground [and] <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled <span class="e2">nityānanda-śrī-charaṇe</span>–at the holy feet of Nityānanda. [153]
Saying this, Jīva tumbled to the ground and rolled at the holy feet of Nityānanda Prabhu.
সেই রাত্র সবে রয় বাণীনাথঘরে ।<br />বংশসহ বাণী নিত্যানন্দ-সেবা করে ॥১৫৪॥
sei rātra sabe raya vāṇīnātha-ghare<br />vaṁśa-saha vaṇī nityānanda-sevā kare [154]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–That <span class="e2">rātra</span>–night <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">raya</span>–stayed <span class="e2">vāṇīnātha-ghare</span>–at the house of Vāṇīnāth, [and] <span class="e2">vaṇī</span>–Vāṇīnāth <span class="e2">vaṁśa-saha</span>–and [his] family <span class="e2">nityānanda-sevā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–served Nityānanda. [154]
That night they stayed at the house of Vāṇīnāth, and he and his family served Nityānanda Prabhu.
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-পদছায়া আশ যার ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য গায় অকিঞ্চন ছার ॥১৫৫॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā āśa yāra<br />nadīyā-māhātmya gāya akiñchana chhāra [155]
<span class="e2">akiñchana</span> <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–This poor, fallen soul, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–of Nadia. [155]
This poor, fallen soul, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, chants the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Twelve
Śrī Śrī Ṛtudwīp and Śrī Rādhā Kuṇḍa
জয় শ্রীচৈতন্যচন্দ্র	<span class="e22">জয় প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ</span><br />	<span class="e23">জয়াদ্বৈত জয় গদাধর ।</span><br />শ্রীবাসাদি ভক্ত জয়	<span class="e22">জয় জগন্নাথালয়</span><br />	<span class="e23">জয় নবদ্বীপধামবর ॥১॥</span>
jaya śrī-chaitanya-chandra	<span class="e5">jaya prabhu nityānanda</span><br />	<span class="e6">jayādvaita jaya gadādhara</span><br />śrīvāsādi bhakta jaya	<span class="e5">jaya jagannāthālaya</span><br />	<span class="e6">jaya navadvīpa-dhāma-vara [1]</span>
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-chandra</span>–to the moon-like Śrī Chaitanya! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–to Nityānanda Prabhu! <span class="e2">jayādvaita</span>–All glory to Advaita! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span> <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–to Śrīvās and all the devotees! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">jagannāthālaya</span>–to Jagannāth’s home! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma-vara</span>–to the best of abodes, Nabadwīp! [1]
All glory to the moon-like Śrī Chaitanya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita, Gadādhar, Śrīvās, and all the devotees! All glory to the home of Jagannāth Miśra and the best of abodes, Śrī Nabadwīp!
প্রভাত হইল রাত্র	<span class="e22">ভক্তগণ তুলে গাত্র</span><br />	<span class="e23">শ্রীগৌর নিতাইচাঁদে ডাকে ।</span><br />ভক্তসহ নিত্যানন্দ	<span class="e22">চলে ভজি’ পরানন্দ</span><br />	<span class="e23">চম্পাহট্ট পশ্চাতেতে রাখে ॥২॥</span>
prabhāta ha-ila rātra	<span class="e5">bhakta-gaṇa tule gātra</span><br />	<span class="e6">śrī-gaura nitāichā̐de ḍāke</span><br />bhakta-saha nityānanda	<span class="e5">chale bhaji’ parānanda</span><br />	<span class="e6">champāhaṭṭa paśchātete rākhe [2]</span>
<span class="e2">rātra prabhāta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–Dawn arrived. <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">tule</span>–lifted [their] <span class="e2">gātra</span>–bodies [and] <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–called out <span class="e2">śrī-gaura</span> <span class="e2">nitāichā̐de</span>–to Śrī Gaura and Nitāichā̐d. <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–Feeling <span class="e2">parānanda</span>–great joy, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">bhakta-saha</span>–and the devotees <span class="e2">chale</span>–departed [and] <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–left <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span>–Champā Haṭṭa <span class="e2">paśchātete</span>–behind. [2]
At dawn, the devotees arose and called out to Śrī Gaura and Nitāichā̐d. Feeling great joy, Nityānanda and the devotees then departed, leaving Champā Haṭṭa behind.
তথা হৈতে বাণীনাথ	<span class="e22">চলে নিত্যানন্দ-সাথ</span><br />	<span class="e23">বলে, “হেন দিন কবে পাব ।</span><br />নিতাইচাঁদের সঙ্গে	<span class="e22">পরিক্রমা করি’ রঙ্গে</span><br />	<span class="e23">মায়াপুর প্রভু-গৃহে যাব” ॥৩॥</span>
tathā haite vāṇīnātha	<span class="e5">chale nityānanda-sātha</span><br />	<span class="e6">bale, “hena dina kabe pāba</span><br />nitāichā̐dera saṅge	<span class="e5">parikramā kari’ raṅge</span><br />	<span class="e6">māyāpura prabhu-gṛhe yāba” [3]</span>
<span class="e2">tathā</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–From then on, <span class="e2">vāṇīnātha</span>–Vāṇīnāth <span class="e2">chale</span>–came <span class="e2">sātha</span>–with <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda. <span class="e2">bale</span>–He considered, <span class="e2">“kabe</span>–“When [will] <span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">dina</span> <span class="e2">pāba</span>–that day be mine [when] <span class="e2">raṅge parikramā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–I will joyfully circumambulate <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">nitāichā̐dera saṅge</span>–with Nitāichā̐d [and] <span class="e2">yāba</span>–go <span class="e2">prabhu</span>-<span class="e2">gṛhe”</span>–to the home of the Lord?” [3]
From then on, Vāṇīnāth came with Nityānanda. He considered, “When else will I get the chance to joyfully circumambulate Māyāpur with Nitāichā̐d and go to the home of the Lord?”
দেখিতে দেখিতে তবে	<span class="e22">রাতুপুর চলে সবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">দেখি’ সেই নগরের শোভা ।</span><br />প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “	<span class="e22">ঋতুদ্বীপে আইল চলে</span><br />	<span class="e23">এই স্থান অতি মনোলোভা ॥৪॥</span>
dekhite dekhite tabe	<span class="e5">rātupura chale sabe</span><br />	<span class="e6">dekhi’ sei nagarera śobhā</span><br />prabhu nityānanda bale,	<span class="e5">“ṛtudvīpe āila chale</span><br />	<span class="e6">ei sthāna ati mano-lobhā [4]</span>
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–eventually, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">chale</span>–came <span class="e2">rātupura</span>–to Rātupur. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Upon seeing <span class="e2">sei</span>–the <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–beauty <span class="e2">nagarera</span>–of the town, <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“chale āila</span>–“We have come <span class="e2">ṛtudvīpe</span>–to Ṛtudwīp. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place [is] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">mano-lobhā</span>–enchanting. [4]
Eventually, they came to Rātupur. Upon seeing the beauty of the town, Nityānanda Prabhu said, “We have come to Ṛtudwīp, which is extremely enchanting.
বৃক্ষ সব নতশির	<span class="e22">পবন বহয়ে ধীর</span><br />	<span class="e23">কুসুম ফুটেছে চারিভিত ।</span><br />ভৃঙ্গের ঝঙ্কার রব	<span class="e22">কুসুমের গন্ধাসব</span><br />	<span class="e23">মাতায় পথিকগণচিত” ॥৫॥</span>
vṛkṣa saba nata-śira	<span class="e5">pavana vahaye dhīra</span><br />	<span class="e6">kusuma phuṭechhe chāri-bhita</span><br />bhṛṅgera jhaṅkāra rava	<span class="e5">kusumera gandhāsaba</span><br />	<span class="e6">mātāya pathika-gaṇa-chitta” [5]</span>
<span class="e2">saba vṛkṣa</span>–All the trees <span class="e2">nata-śira</span>–bow [their] heads, <span class="e2">pavana</span>–the breeze <span class="e2">vahaye</span>–blows <span class="e2">dhīra</span>–gently, [and] <span class="e2">kusuma</span>–the flowers <span class="e2">phuṭechhe</span>–are blooming <span class="e2">chāri-bhita</span>–in all directions. <span class="e2">jhaṅkāra</span> <span class="e2">rava</span>–The humming <span class="e2">bhṛṅgera</span>–of the bees [and] <span class="e2">gandhāsaba</span>–fragrant nectar <span class="e2">kusumera</span>–of the flowers <span class="e2">mātāya</span>–intoxicate <span class="e2">pathika-gaṇa-chitta”</span>–the hearts of travellers.” [5]
“The trees bow their heads, the breeze blows gently, and the flowers bloom in all directions. The humming of the bees and the fragrant nectar of the flowers intoxicate the hearts of travellers.”
বলিতে বলিতে রায়	<span class="e22">হৈল পাগলের প্রায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">বলে, “শিঙ্গা আনে শীঘ্রগতি ।</span><br />বৎসগণ যায় দূরে	<span class="e22">কানাই নিদ্রিত পুরে</span><br />	<span class="e23">এখন না আইসে শিশুমতি ॥৬॥</span>
balite balite rāya	<span class="e5">haila pāgalera prāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">bale, “śiṅgā āne śīghra-gati</span><br />vatsa-gaṇa yāya dūre	<span class="e5">kānāi nidrita pure</span><br />	<span class="e6">ekhana nā āise śiśu-mati [6]</span>
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–As He spoke, <span class="e2">rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">pāgalera</span> <span class="e2">prāya haila</span>–became almost mad [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“śīghra-gati</span>–“Quickly <span class="e2">āne</span>–bring [My] <span class="e2">śiṅgā</span>–horn! <span class="e2">vatsa-gaṇa</span>–The calves <span class="e2">dūre yāya</span>–have gone off, [and] <span class="e2">kānāi</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nidrita</span> <span class="e2">pure</span>–is asleep. <span class="e2">śiśu-mati</span>–Like a child, <span class="e2">āise nā</span>–He does not come <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now. [6]
As He spoke, Nityānanda Rāy became almost mad and said, “Quickly bring My horn! The calves have run off, and Kānāi is asleep. Like a child, He does not come now.
কোথায় সুবল দাম	<span class="e22">আমি একা বলরাম</span><br />	<span class="e23">গোচারণে যাইতে না পারি” ।</span><br />“কানাই কানাই” বলি’	<span class="e22"> ডাক ছাড়ে মহাবলী</span><br />	<span class="e23">লাফ মারে হাত দুই চারি ॥৭॥</span>
kothāya subala dāma	<span class="e5">āmi ekā balarāma</span><br />	<span class="e6">gochāraṇe yāite nā pāri”</span><br />“kānāi kānāi” bali’	<span class="e5">ḍāka chhāḍe mahābalī</span><br />	<span class="e6">lāpha māre hāta dui chāri [7]</span>
<span class="e2">kothāya</span>–Where [are] <span class="e2">subala</span>–Subal [and] <span class="e2">dāma</span>–Śrīdām? <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I, <span class="e2">balarāma</span>–Balarām, <span class="e2">pāri nā</span>–cannot <span class="e2">gochāraṇe</span> <span class="e2">yāite</span>–go out to tend the cows <span class="e2">ekā”</span>–alone.” <span class="e2">mahābalī</span>–With great power,<span class="e2"> bali’ ḍāka</span> <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–Nityānanda called out, <span class="e2">“kānāi</span> <span class="e2">kānāi</span>–“Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!”, [and] <span class="e2">lāpha</span> <span class="e2">māre</span>–jumped <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">chāri hāta</span>–two to four cubits. [7]
“Where are Subal and Śrīdām? I, Balarām, cannot go out to tend the cows alone.” With great power, Nityānanda called out, “Kānāi! Kānāi!” and jumped a couple of metres.
সে ভাব দর্শন করি’	<span class="e22">ভক্তগণ ত্বরা করি’</span><br />	<span class="e23">নিবেদয় নিতাইয়ের পায় ।</span><br />“ওহে প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ	<span class="e22">ভাই তব গৌরচন্দ্র</span><br />	<span class="e23">নাহি এবে আছেন হেথায় ॥৮॥</span>
