se bhāva darśana kari’	<span class="e5">bhakta-gaṇa tvarā kari’</span><br />	<span class="e6">nivedaya nitāiyera pāya</span><br />“ohe prabhu nityānanda	<span class="e5">bhāi tava gaurachandra</span><br />	<span class="e6">nāhi ebe āchhena hethāya [8]</span>
<span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–His ecstasy, <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">tvarā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–quickly <span class="e2">nivedaya</span>–submitted <span class="e2">nitāiyera</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–at Nitāi’s feet, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–“O <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu! <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">āchhena nāhi</span>–is not <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now. [8]
Seeing His ecstasy, the devotees quickly submitted at His feet, “O Nityānanda Prabhu! Your brother Gaurachandra is not here now.
সন্ন্যাস করিয়া হরি	<span class="e22">গেল নীলাচলোপরি</span><br />	<span class="e23">আমাদের কাঙ্গাল করিয়া” ।</span><br />তাহা শুনি’ নিত্যানন্দ	<span class="e22">হইলেন নিরানন্দ</span><br />	<span class="e23">কাঁদি লোটে ভূমেতে পড়িয়া ॥৯॥</span>
sannyāsa kariyā hari	<span class="e5">gela nīlāchalopari</span><br />	<span class="e6">āmādera kāṅgāla kariyā”</span><br />tāhā śuni’ nityānanda	<span class="e5">ha-ilena nirānanda</span><br />	<span class="e6">kā̐di loṭe bhūmete paḍiyā [9]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">sannyāsa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–has taken sannyās [and] <span class="e2">gela</span>–gone <span class="e2">nīlāchalopari</span>–to Nīlāchal, <span class="e2">āmādera</span> <span class="e2">kāṅgāla</span> <span class="e2">kariyā”</span>–leaving us destitute.” <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–this, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">ha-ilena</span>–became <span class="e2">nirānanda</span>–dismayed. <span class="e2">paḍiyā loṭe</span>–He fell <span class="e2">bhūmete</span>–to the ground [and] <span class="e2">kā̐di</span>–wept. [9]
“The Lord has taken sannyās and gone to Nīlāchal, leaving us destitute.” Hearing this, Nityānanda became dismayed. He fell to the ground and wept.
“কি দুঃখে কানাই ভাই	<span class="e22">আমা সবে ছাড়ি’ যাই’</span><br />	<span class="e23">সন্ন্যাসী হইল নীলাচলে ।</span><br />এ জীবন না রাখিব	<span class="e22">যমুনায় ঝাঁপ দিব”</span><br />	<span class="e23">বলি’ অচেতন সেই স্থলে ॥১০॥</span>
“ki duḥkhe kānāi bhāi	<span class="e5">āmā sabe chhāḍi’ yāi’</span><br />	<span class="e6">sannyāsī ha-ila nīlāchale</span><br />e jīvana nā rākhiba	<span class="e5">yamunāya jhā̐pa diba”</span><br />	<span class="e6">bali’ achetana sei sthale [10]</span>
<span class="e2">“ki</span>–“What <span class="e2">duḥkhe</span>–sorrow! <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother <span class="e2">kānāi</span>–Kānāi! <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">yāi’</span>–You left <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–us all [and] <span class="e2">sannyāsī</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became a sannyāsī <span class="e2">nīlāchale</span>–in Nīlāchal! <span class="e2">rākhiba nā</span>–I cannot continue <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–life; <span class="e2">jhā̐pa</span> <span class="e2">diba</span>–I will dive <span class="e2">yamunāya”</span>–into the Yamunā.” <span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying [this, Nityānanda] <span class="e2">achetana</span>–lost consciousness <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sthale</span>–in that place. [10]
“What sorrow! Brother Kānāi! You left us and became a sannyāsī in Nīlāchal! I cannot continue this life; I will dive into the Yamunā.” Saying this, Nityānanda lost consciousness.
নিত্যানন্দে মহাভাব	<span class="e22">করি’ সবে অনুভব</span><br />	<span class="e23">হরিনাম সঙ্কীর্ত্তন করে ।</span><br />চারিদণ্ড দিন হৈল	<span class="e22">নিত্যানন্দ না উঠিল</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভক্ত সব গৌরগীত ধরে ॥১১॥</span>
nityānande mahābhāva	<span class="e5">kari’ sabe anubhava</span><br />	<span class="e6">hari-nāma saṅkīrtana kare</span><br />chāri-daṇḍa dina haila	<span class="e5">nityānanda nā uṭhila</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhakta saba gaura-gīta dhare [11]</span>
<span class="e2">sabe</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">anubhava kari’</span>–saw <span class="e2">mahābhāva</span>–the intense ecstasy <span class="e2">nityānande</span>–in Nityānanda [and] <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–chanted <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Lord’s Name. <span class="e2">chāri-daṇḍa</span>–An hour and a half <span class="e2">dina</span>–of the day <span class="e2">haila</span>–passed, [but] <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">uṭhila nā</span>–did not get up. <span class="e2">saba bhakta</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">dhare</span>–sang <span class="e2">gaura-gīta</span>–songs about Gaura. [11]
Everyone saw the intense ecstasy of Nityānanda and chanted the Lord’s Name. An hour and a half passed, but Nityānanda did not get up. Finally, the devotees sang songs about Gaurāṅga.
গৌরাঙ্গের নাম শুনি’	<span class="e22">নিতাই উঠে অমনি</span><br />	<span class="e23">বলে, “এই রাধাকুণ্ড-স্থান ।</span><br />হেথা ভক্ত সঙ্গে করি’	<span class="e22">অপরাহ্নে গৌরহরি</span><br />	<span class="e23">করিতেন কীর্ত্তন বিধান ॥১২॥</span>
gaurāṅgera nāma śuni’	<span class="e5">nitāi uṭhe amani</span><br />	<span class="e6">bale, “ei rādhā-kuṇḍa-sthāna</span><br />hethā bhakta saṅge kari’	<span class="e5">aparāhne gaurahari</span><br />	<span class="e6">karitena kīrtana vidhāna [12]</span>
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Nitāi <span class="e2">amani</span>–immediately <span class="e2">uṭhe</span>–arose [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said,<span class="e2"> “ei</span>–“This <span class="e2">rādhā-kuṇḍa</span>-<span class="e2">sthāna</span>–is the place of Rādhā Kuṇḍa. <span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">vidhāna karitena</span>–would perform kīrtan <span class="e2">bhakta</span> <span class="e2">saṅge</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–with the devotees <span class="e2">aparāhne</span>–in the afternoon. [12]
Hearing the Name of Gaurāṅga, Nitāi immediately arose and said, “This is the place of Rādhā Kuṇḍa. Here, Gaurahari would perform kīrtan with the devotees in the afternoon.
হেথা ছয় ঋতু মেলি’	<span class="e22">গৌরাঙ্গ-কীর্ত্তন-কেলি</span><br />	<span class="e23">পুষ্ট কৈল শোভা বিস্তারিয়া।</span><br />রাধাকুণ্ড ব্রজে যেই	<span class="e22">ঋতুদ্বীপ হেথা সেই</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভক্ত হেথা মজে প্রেম পিয়া ॥১৩॥</span>
hethā chhaya ṛtu meli’	<span class="e5">gaurāṅga-kīrtana-keli</span><br />	<span class="e6">puṣṭa kaila śobhā vistāriyā</span><br />rādhā-kuṇḍa vraje yei	<span class="e5">ṛtudvīpa hethā sei</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhakta hethā maje prema piyā [13]</span>
<span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">chhaya</span> <span class="e2">ṛtu</span>–the six seasons <span class="e2">meli’</span>–meet [and] <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">vistāriyā puṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–enhance the beauty <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-kīrtana-keli</span>–of Gaurāṅga’s kīrtan Pastimes. <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">rādhā-kuṇḍa</span>–Rādhā Kuṇḍa <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja [is present] <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">ṛtudvīpa</span>–in Ṛtudwīp. <span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotees <span class="e2">piyā</span>–drink [and]<span class="e2"> maje</span>–relish <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love. [13]
“Here, the six seasons meet and enhance the beauty of Gaurāṅga’s kīrtan Pastimes. Rādhā Kuṇḍa in Vraja is present here in Ṛtudwīp, where devotees drink and relish divine love.
দেখ শ্যামকুণ্ডশোভা	<span class="e22">জগজ্জন-মনোলোভা</span><br />	<span class="e23">সখীগণ কুঞ্জ নানাস্থানে ।</span><br />হেথা অপরাহ্নে গোরা	<span class="e22">সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে হয়ে ভোরা</span><br />	<span class="e23">তুষিলেন সবে প্রেমদানে ॥১৪॥</span>
dekha śyāma-kuṇḍa-śobhā	<span class="e5">jagaj-jana-mano-lobhā</span><br />	<span class="e6">sakhī-gaṇa-kuñja nānā-sthāne</span><br />hethā aparāhne gorā	<span class="e5">saṅkīrtane haye bhorā</span><br />	<span class="e6">tuṣilena sabe prema-dāne [14]</span>
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">śyāma-kuṇḍa-śobhā</span>–the beauty of Śyāma Kuṇḍa, [which] <span class="e2">jagaj-jana-mano-lobhā</span>–enchants the mind of the souls of this world, [and] <span class="e2">sakhī-gaṇa-kuñja</span>–the groves of the sakhīs <span class="e2">nānā-sthāne</span>–in various places. <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">bhorā haye</span>–would become immersed <span class="e2">saṅkīrtane</span>–in the saṅkīrtan <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">aparāhne</span>–in the afternoon [and] <span class="e2">tuṣilena</span>–satisfy <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">prema-dāne</span>–with the gift of divine love. [14]
“See also the beauty of Śyāma Kuṇḍa, which enchants the mind of every soul in this world, and the groves of the sakhīs nearby. Gorā would become immersed in saṅkīrtan here in the afternoon and satisfy everyone with the gift of divine love.
এ স্থান সমান ভাই	<span class="e22">ত্রিজগতে নাহি পাই</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভক্তের ভজন-স্থান জান ।</span><br />হেথায় বসতি যাঁর	<span class="e22">প্রেমধন লাভ তাঁর</span><br />	<span class="e23">সুশীতল হয় তাঁর প্রাণ” ॥১৫॥</span>
e sthāna samāna bhāi	<span class="e5">trijagate nāhi pāi</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhaktera bhajana-sthāna jāna</span><br />hethāya vasati yā̐ra	<span class="e5">prema-dhana lābha tā̐ra</span><br />	<span class="e6">suśītala haya tā̐ra prāṇa” [15]</span>
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">pāi</span>–We find <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–no <span class="e2">e sthāna</span> <span class="e2">samāna</span>–place like this <span class="e2">trijagate</span>–in the three worlds. <span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [it to be] <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–a place <span class="e2">bhaktera</span>–for the devotees <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–to serve. <span class="e2">yā̐ra tā̐ra vasati</span>–Souls whose residences [are] <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">lābha</span>–attain <span class="e2">prema-dhana</span>–the wealth of divine love, [and] <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–their <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–hearts <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">suśītala”</span>–serene.” [15]
“Brother! We find no place like this in the three worlds. Know it to be a place for the devotees to serve. Souls who reside here attain the wealth of divine love, and their hearts become serene.”
সে দিন সে স্থানে থাকি’	<span class="e22">শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-নাম ডাকি’</span><br />	<span class="e23">প্রেমে মগ্ন সর্ব্বভক্তগণ ।</span><br />ঋতুদ্বীপে সবে বসি’	<span class="e22">ভজে শ্রীচৈতন্য-শশী</span><br />	<span class="e23">রাত্রদিন করিল যাপন ॥১৬॥</span>
se dina se sthāne thāki’	<span class="e5">śrī-gaurāṅga-nāma ḍāki’</span><br />	<span class="e6">preme magna sarva-bhakta-gaṇa</span><br />ṛtudvīpe sabe vasi’	<span class="e5">bhaje śrī-chaitanya-śaśī</span><br />	<span class="e6">rātra-dina karila yāpana [16]</span>
<span class="e2">thāki’</span>–Remaining <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–there <span class="e2">se dina</span>–for the day, <span class="e2">ḍāki’</span>–calling <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-nāma</span>–the Name of Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">magna</span>–became immersed <span class="e2">preme</span>–in divine love. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–They <span class="e2">vasi’</span> <span class="e2">yāpana karila</span>–spent <span class="e2">rātra-dina</span>–the day and night <span class="e2">ṛtudvīpe</span>–in Ṛtudwīp [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-śaśī</span>–the moon-like Śrī Chaitanya. [16]
Remaining there for the day, calling the Name of Śrī Gaurāṅga, all the devotees became immersed in divine love. They spent the day and night in Ṛtudwīp and worshipped the moon-like Śrī Chaitanya.
নাচিতে নাচিতে তবে	<span class="e22">নিত্যানন্দ চলে যবে</span><br />	<span class="e23">শ্রীবিদ্যানগরে উপনীত ।</span><br />বিদ্যানগরের শোভা	<span class="e22">মুনিজন-মনোলোভা</span><br />	<span class="e23">ভক্তগণ দেখি’ প্রফুল্লিত ॥১৭॥</span>
nāchite nāchite tabe	<span class="e5">nityānanda chale yabe</span><br />	<span class="e6">śrī-vidyā-nagare upanīta</span><br />vidyā-nagarera śobhā	<span class="e5">muni-jana-mano-lobhā</span><br />	<span class="e6">bhakta-gaṇa dekhi’ praphullita [17]</span>
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">chale</span>–left, <span class="e2">nāchite</span> <span class="e2">nāchite</span>–dancing as He went, <span class="e2">upanīta</span>–He arrived <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-nagare</span>–in Śrī Vidyā Nagar. <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–The beauty <span class="e2">vidyā-nagarera</span>–of Vidyā Nagar <span class="e2">muni-jana-mano-lobhā</span>–enchants the minds of sages, [and] <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–upon seeing [it,] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees [were] <span class="e2">praphullita</span>–jubilant. [17]
Then, dancing as He went, Nityānanda Prabhu arrived in Śrī Vidyā Nagar. The beauty of the town attracts the minds of sages, and upon seeing it, the devotees were jubilant.
নিতাইজাহ্নবাপদ	<span class="e22">যে জনার সুসম্পদ</span><br />	<span class="e23">সে ভক্তিবিনোদ অকিঞ্চন ।</span><br />নদীয়ামাহাত্ম্য গায়	<span class="e22">ধরি’ ভক্তজন-পায়</span><br />	<span class="e23">যাচে মাত্র কৃষ্ণভক্তিধন ॥১৮॥</span>
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada	<span class="e5">ye janāra susampada</span><br />	<span class="e6">se bhakti-vinoda akiñchana</span><br />nadīyā-māhātmya gāya	<span class="e5">dhari’ bhakta-jana-pāya</span><br />	<span class="e6">yāche mātra kṛṣṇa-bhakti-dhana [18]</span>
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">akiñchana bhakti-vinoda</span>–The poor Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">janāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">susampada</span>–true wealth [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada</span>–the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia. <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–Grasping <span class="e2">bhakta-jana-pāya</span>–the feet of the devotees, <span class="e2">yāche</span>–he prays <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti-dhana</span>–for the wealth of devotion to Kṛṣṇa. [18]
The poor Bhakti Vinod, whose true wealth is the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, chants the glories of Nadia. Grasping the feet of the devotees, he prays only for the wealth of devotion to Kṛṣṇa.

Chapter Thirteen
Śrī Vidyā Nagar and Śrī Jahnudwīp
জয় গৌর নিত্যানন্দাদ্বৈত গদাধর ।<br />শ্রীবাস শ্রীনবদ্বীপ কীর্ত্তনসাগর ॥১॥
jaya gaura nityānandādvaita gadādhara<br />śrīvāsa śrī-navadvīpa kīrtana-sāgara [1]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaura</span>–to Gaura, <span class="e2">nityānandādvaita</span>–Nityānanda, Advaita, <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar, <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās, [and] <span class="e2">kīrtana-sāgara</span>–the ocean of kīrtan, <span class="e2">śrī-navadvīpa</span>–Śrī Nabadwīp! [1]
All glory to Gaura, Nityānanda, Advaita, Gadādhar, Śrīvās, and the ocean of kīrtan, Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām!
শ্রীবিদ্যানগরে আসি’ নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />বিদ্যানগরের তত্ত্ব শ্রীজীবে শিখায় ॥২॥
śrī-vidyā-nagare āsi’ nityānanda-rāya<br />vidyā-nagarera tattva śrī-jīve śikhāya [2]
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–Coming <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-nagare</span>–to Śrī Vidyā Nagar, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">śikhāya</span>–taught <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">tattva</span>–the importance <span class="e2">vidyā-nagarera</span>–of Vidyā Nagar. [2]
Coming to Vidyā Nagar, Nityānanda Rāy taught Śrī Jīva the importance of the town.
“নিত্যধাম নবদ্বীপ প্রলয়-সময়ে ।<br />অষ্টদল পদ্মরূপে থাকে শুদ্ধ হয়ে ॥৩॥
“nitya-dhāma navadvīpa pralaya-samaye<br />aṣṭa-dala padma-rūpe thāke śuddha haye [3]
<span class="e2">“pralaya-samaye</span>–“At the time of the destruction of the universe, <span class="e2">nitya-dhāma</span>–the eternal abode <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp <span class="e2">thāke</span>–remains <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–undisturbed <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dala</span> <span class="e2">padma-rūpe</span>–as an eight-petalled lotus. [3]
“During the destruction of the universe, the eternal abode of Nabadwīp remains undisturbed as an eight-petalled lotus.
সর্ব্ব-অবতার আর ধন্যজীব যত ।<br />কমলের একদেশে থাকে কত শত ॥৪॥
sarva-avatāra āra dhanya-jīva yata<br />kamalera ekadeśe thāke kata śata [4]
<span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">avatāra</span>–All the Avatārs <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">yata kata</span> <span class="e2">śata dhanya-jīva</span>–thousands of fortunate souls <span class="e2">thāke</span>–stay <span class="e2">ekadeśe</span>–in one part <span class="e2">kamalera</span>–of that lotus. [4]
“All the Avatārs and thousands of fortunate souls stay in one part of that lotus.
ঋতুদ্বীপ অন্তর্গত এ বিদ্যানগরে ।<br />মৎস্যরূপী ভগবান্ সর্ব্ববেদ ধরে ॥৫॥
ṛtudvīpa antargata e vidyā-nagare<br />matsya-rūpī bhagavān sarva-veda dhare [5]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">vidyā-nagare</span>–In Vidyā Nagar <span class="e2">antargata</span>–within <span class="e2">ṛtudvīpa</span>–Ṛtudwīp, <span class="e2">bhagavān</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">matsya-rūpī</span>–as Matsya, <span class="e2">dhare</span>–holds <span class="e2">sarva-veda</span>–all the Vedas. [5]
“In Vidyā Nagar within Ṛtudwīp, the Lord, as Matsya, holds all the Vedas.
সর্ব্ববিদ্যা থাকে বেদ আশ্রয় করিয়া ।<br />শ্রীবিদ্যানগর নাম এই স্থানে দিয়া ॥৬॥
sarva-vidyā thāke veda āśraya kariyā<br />śrī-vidyā-nagara nāma ei sthāne diyā [6]
<span class="e2">veda</span>–The Vedas, [which contain] <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">vidyā</span>–all knowledge, <span class="e2">āśraya</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–took shelter [and] <span class="e2">thāke</span>–stayed [here.] <span class="e2">nāma diyā</span>–They named <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–this place <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-nagara</span>–Śrī Vidyā Nagar. [6]
“The Vedas, which contain all knowledge, took shelter and stayed here. They named this place Śrī Vidyā Nagar.
পুনঃ যবে সৃষ্টিমুখে ব্রহ্মা মহাশয় ।<br />অতি ভীত হন দেখি’ সকল প্রলয় ॥৭॥
punaḥ yabe sṛṣṭi-mukhe brahmā mahāśaya<br />ati bhīta hana dekhi’ sakala pralaya [7]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">brahmā mahāśaya</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">sṛṣṭi-mukhe</span>–desired to create <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again, <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–he saw <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">pralaya</span>–the full devastation [and] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">bhīta</span> <span class="e2">hana</span>–became extremely afraid. [7]
“When Brahmā desired to create the world again, he saw the full devastation and became extremely afraid.
সেই কালে প্রভুকৃপা হয় তাঁর প্রতি ।<br />এই স্থানে পেয়ে ভগবানে করে স্তুতি ॥৮॥
sei kāle prabhu-kṛpā haya tā̐ra prati<br />ei sthāne peye bhagavāne kare stuti [8]
<span class="e2">sei kāle</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">prabhu-kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–the Lord bestowed mercy <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">prati</span>–upon him. <span class="e2">peye</span>–He received [that mercy] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">stuti kare</span>–prayed <span class="e2">bhagavāne</span>–to the Lord. [8]
“At that time, the Lord bestowed mercy upon him. He received that mercy here and then prayed to the Lord.
মুখ খুলিবার কালে দেবী সরস্বতী ।<br />ব্রহ্মজিহ্বা হৈতে জন্মে অতি রূপবতী ॥৯॥
mukha khulibāra kāle devī sarasvatī<br />brahma-jihvā haite janme ati rūpavatī [9]
<span class="e2">kāle</span>–When <span class="e2">khulibāra</span>–he opened [his] <span class="e2">mukha</span>–mouths, <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">rūpavatī</span> <span class="e2">sarasvatī devī</span>–the extremely beautiful goddess Saraswatī <span class="e2">janme</span>–manifested <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">brahma-jihvā</span>–Brahmā’s tongues. [9]
“As he opened his mouths, the extremely beautiful goddess Saraswatī manifested from his tongues.
সরস্বতীশক্তি পেয়ে দেবচতুর্ম্মুখ ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণে করেন স্তব পেয়ে বড় সুখ ॥১০॥
sarasvatī-śakti peye deva-chaturmukha<br />śrī-kṛṣṇe karena stava peye baḍa sukha [10]
<span class="e2">peye</span>–Receiving <span class="e2">sarasvatī-śakti</span>–power from Saraswatī, <span class="e2">deva-chaturmukha</span>–the four-headed god <span class="e2">stava karena</span>–prayed <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇe</span>–to Śrī Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">peye</span>–felt <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–great <span class="e2">sukha</span>–satisfaction. [10]
“Becoming empowered by Saraswatī, four-headed Brahmā prayed to Kṛṣṇa and felt great satisfaction.
সৃষ্টি যবে হয় মায়া সর্ব্বদিক ঘেরি’ ।<br />বিরজার পারে থাকে গুণত্রয় ধরি’ ॥১১॥
sṛṣṭi yabe haya māyā sarva-dika gheri’<br />virajāra pāre thāke guṇa-traya dhari’ [11]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">sṛṣṭi</span>–creation <span class="e2">haya</span>–takes place, <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">thāke</span>–remains <span class="e2">pāre</span>–on the bank <span class="e2">virajāra</span>–of the Virajā River [and] <span class="e2">gheri’</span>–envelops <span class="e2">sarva-dika</span>–all directions <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–with <span class="e2">guṇa-traya</span>–the three modes of material nature. [11]
“When creation takes place, Māyā remains on the bank of the Virajā River and envelops all directions with the three modes of material nature.
মায়া প্রকাশিত বিশ্বে বিদ্যার প্রকাশ ।<br />করে ঋষিগণ তবে করিয়া প্রয়াস ॥১২॥
māyā prakāśita viśve vidyāra prakāśa<br />kare ṛṣi-gaṇa tabe kariyā prayāsa [12]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">viśve</span>–within that world <span class="e2">māyā</span> <span class="e2">prakāśita</span>–manifested by Māyā, <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–the sages <span class="e2">prayāsa kariyā</span>–endeavour [and] <span class="e2">vidyāra</span> <span class="e2">prakāśa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–reveal knowledge. [12]
“Then, within that world manifested by Māyā, the sages reveal knowledge.
এই ত সারদাপীঠ করিয়া আশ্রয় ।<br />ঋষিগণ করে অবিদ্যার পরাজয় ॥১৩॥
ei ta sāradā-pīṭha kariyā āśraya<br />ṛṣi-gaṇa kare avidyāra parājaya [13]
<span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–The sages <span class="e2">āśraya kariyā</span>–take shelter <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">sāradā-pīṭha</span>–in this abode of Saraswatī [and] <span class="e2">avidyāra</span> <span class="e2">parājaya kare</span>–conquer ignorance. [13]
“They take shelter in this abode of Saraswatī and conquer ignorance.
চৌষট্টি বিদ্যার পাঠ লয়ে ঋষিগণ ।<br />ধরাতলে স্থানে স্থানে করে বিজ্ঞাপন ॥১৪॥
chauṣaṭṭi vidyāra pāṭha laye ṛṣi-gaṇa<br />dharā-tale sthāne sthāne kare vijñāpana [14]
<span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–The sages <span class="e2">pāṭha</span> <span class="e2">laye</span>–study <span class="e2">chauṣaṭṭi</span> <span class="e2">vidyāra</span>–the sixty-four branches of knowledge [and then] <span class="e2">vijñāpana kare</span>–teach [them] <span class="e2">sthāne</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–at various places <span class="e2">dharā-tale</span>–on the earth. [14]
“They study the sixty-four branches of knowledge and then teach them at various places on the earth.
যে যে ঋষি যে যে বিদ্যা করে অধ্যয়ন ।<br />এই পীঠে সে সবার স্থান অনুক্ষণ ॥১৫॥
ye ye ṛṣi ye ye vidyā kare adhyayana<br />ei pīṭhe se sabāra sthāna anukṣaṇa [15]
<span class="e2">sthāna</span>–The residences <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sabāra</span>–of all <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span>–the sages who <span class="e2">adhyayana kare</span>–study <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">vidyā</span>–each and every type of knowledge [are present] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">pīṭhe</span>–here <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–eternally. [15]
“The residences of all the sages who study each and every type of knowledge are present here eternally.
শ্রীবাল্মীকি কাব্যরস এই স্থানে পায় ।<br />নারদ-কৃপায় তেঁহ আইলা হেথায় ॥১৬॥
śrī-vālmīki kāvya-rasa ei sthāne pāya<br />nārada-kṛpāya te̐ha āilā hethāya [16]
<span class="e2">śrī-vālmīki</span>–Śrī Vālmīki <span class="e2">pāya</span>–learned <span class="e2">kāvya-rasa</span>–the art of poetry <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–He <span class="e2">āilā</span>–came <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here <span class="e2">nārada-kṛpāya</span>–by the grace of Nārad. [16]
“Śrī Vālmīki came here by the grace of Nārad and learned the art of poetry.
ধন্বন্তরি আসি’ হেথা আয়ুর্ব্বেদ পায় ।<br />বিশ্বামিত্র আদি ধনুর্ব্বিদ্যা শিখি’ যায় ॥১৭॥
dhanvantari āsi’ hethā āyurveda pāya<br />viśvāmitra ādi dhanur-vidyā śikhi’ yāya [17]
<span class="e2">dhanvantari</span>–Dhanvantari <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–learned <span class="e2">āyurveda</span>–the science of life. <span class="e2">viśvāmitra</span>–Viśvāmitra <span class="e2">ādi</span>–and others <span class="e2">śikhi’</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–learned <span class="e2">dhanur-vidyā</span>–archery. [17]
“Dhanvantari came here and learned āyurveda. Viśvāmitra and others learned archery.
শৌনকাদি ঋষিগণ পড়ে বেদমন্ত্র ।<br />দেব-দেব মহাদেব আলোচয় তন্ত্র ॥১৮॥
śaunakādi ṛṣi-gaṇa paḍe veda-mantra<br />deva-deva mahādeva ālochaya tantra [18]
<span class="e2">śaunakādi</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–Śaunaka and other sages <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–studied <span class="e2">veda-mantra</span>–Vedic mantras. <span class="e2">deva-deva</span>–The god of gods, <span class="e2">mahādeva</span>–Lord Śiva, <span class="e2">ālochaya</span>–studied <span class="e2">tantra</span>–tantra. [18]
“Śaunaka and other sages studied Vedic mantras. The god of gods, Lord Śiva, studied tantra.
ব্রহ্মা-চারিমুখ হৈতে বেদ চতুষ্টয় ।<br />ঋষিগণ প্রার্থনায় করিল উদয় ॥১৯॥
brahmā-chāri-mukha haite veda chatuṣṭaya<br />ṛṣi-gaṇa prārthanāya karila udaya [19]
<span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span> <span class="e2">prārthanāya</span>–At the request of the sages, <span class="e2">veda</span> <span class="e2">chatuṣṭaya</span>–the four Vedas <span class="e2">udaya karila</span>–manifested <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">chāri-mukha</span>–the four mouths <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–of Lord Brahmā. [19]
“At the request of the sages, the four Vedas manifested from the four mouths of Lord Brahmā.
কপিল রচিল সাঙ্খ্য এই স্থানে বসি’ ।<br />ন্যায় তর্ক প্রকাশিল শ্রীগৌতম ঋষি ॥২০॥
kapila rachila sāṅkhya ei sthāne vasi’<br />nyāya tarka prakāśila śrī-gautama ṛṣi [20]
<span class="e2">kapila</span>–Kapila <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–resided <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">rachila</span>–wrote [about] <span class="e2">sāṅkhya</span>–analysis of matter and spirit, [and] <span class="e2">śrī-gautama</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span>–Śrī Gautam Ṛṣi <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–wrote [texts] <span class="e2">nyāya</span> <span class="e2">tarka</span>–about logic and argument. [20]
“Kapila resided here and wrote about sāṅkhya, and Śrī Gautam Ṛṣi wrote texts about logic and argument.
বৈশেষিক প্রকাশিল কণভুক্ মুনি ।<br />পাতঞ্জলি যোগশাস্ত্র প্রকাশে আপনি ॥২১॥
vaiśeṣika prakāśila kaṇabhuk muni<br />pātañjali yoga-śāstra prakāśe āpani [21]
<span class="e2">kaṇabhuk</span> <span class="e2">muni</span>–Kaṇāda <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–wrote [about] <span class="e2">vaiśeṣika</span>–atomistic pluralism, [and] <span class="e2">pātañjali</span>–Pātañjali <span class="e2">āpani prakāśe</span>–personally wrote <span class="e2">yoga-śāstra</span>–texts on yoga. [21]
“Kaṇāda wrote about vaiśeṣika, and Pātañjali wrote texts on yoga.
জৈমিনী মীমাংসা শাস্ত্র করিল প্রকাশ ।<br />পুরাণাদি প্রকাশিল ঋষি বেদব্যাস ॥২২॥
jaiminī mīmāṁsā śāstra karila prakāśa<br />purāṇādi prakāśila ṛṣi vedavyāsa [22]
<span class="e2">jaiminī</span>–Jaiminī <span class="e2">prakāśa karila</span>–wrote <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–texts [about] <span class="e2">mīmāṁsā</span>–examination of scripture, [and] <span class="e2">vedavyāsa ṛṣi</span>–the sage Vedavyās <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–wrote <span class="e2">purāṇādi</span>–the Purāṇas and other texts. [22]
“Jaiminī wrote texts about mīmāṁsā, and Vedavyās wrote the Purāṇas and other texts.
পঞ্চরাত্র নারদাদি ঋষি পঞ্চজন ।<br />প্রকাশিয়া জীবগণে শিখায় সাধন ॥২৩॥
pañcharātra nāradādi ṛṣi pañcha-jana<br />prakāśiyā jīva-gaṇe śikhāya sādhana [23]
<span class="e2">nāradādi</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span> <span class="e2">pañcha-jana</span>–Five sages, Nārad and others, <span class="e2">prakāśiyā</span>–wrote <span class="e2">pañcharātra</span>–the Pañcharātras [and] <span class="e2">śikhāya</span>–taught <span class="e2">jīva-gaṇe</span>–souls <span class="e2">sādhana</span>–spiritual practices. [23]
“Nārad and four other sages wrote the Pañcharātras and taught souls spiritual practices.
এই উপবনে সর্ব্ব-উপনিষদ্গণ ।<br />বহুকাল শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ করে আরাধন ॥২৪॥
ei upavane sarva-upaniṣad-gaṇa<br />bahu-kāla śrī-gaurāṅga kare ārādhana [24]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">upavane</span>–In this garden, <span class="e2">sarva</span>-<span class="e2">upaniṣad-gaṇa</span>–all the Upaniṣads <span class="e2">ārādhana kare</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">bahu-kāla</span>–for a long time. [24]
“In this garden, all the Upaniṣads worshipped Śrī Gaurāṅga for a long time.
অলক্ষ্যে শ্রীগৌর সে সবে কহিল ।<br />‘নিরাকার-বুদ্ধি তব হৃদয় দূষিল ॥২৫॥
alakṣye śrī-gaura se sabe kahila<br />‘nirākāra-buddhi tava hṛdaya dūṣila [25]
<span class="e2">alakṣye</span>–Invisibly, <span class="e2">śrī-gaura</span>–Śrī Gaura <span class="e2">kahila</span>–said <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–to them, <span class="e2">‘buddhi</span>–‘The conception <span class="e2">nirākāra</span>–of formlessness <span class="e2">dūṣila</span>–has polluted <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–hearts. [25]
“Invisibly, Śrī Gaura said to them, ‘The conception of formlessness has polluted your hearts.
তুমি সবে শ্রুতিরূপে মোরে না পাইবে ।<br />আমার পার্ষদরূপে যবে জন্ম লবে ॥২৬॥
প্রকটলীলায় তবে দেখিবে আমায় ।<br />মম গুণ কীর্ত্তন করিবে উভরায়’ ॥২৭॥
tumi sabe śruti-rūpe more nā pāibe<br />āmāra pārṣada-rūpe yabe janma labe [26]
prakaṭa-līlāya tabe dekhibe āmāya<br />mama guṇa kīrtana karibe ubharāya’ [27]
<span class="e2">śruti-rūpe</span>–As scriptures, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–you all <span class="e2">pāibe nā</span>–will not attain <span class="e2">more</span>–Me, [but] <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">janma</span> <span class="e2">labe</span>–you all take birth <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">pārṣada-rūpe</span>–as My associates <span class="e2">prakaṭa-līlāya</span>–in [My] manifest Pastimes, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–you all will see <span class="e2">āmāya</span>–Me [and] <span class="e2">ubharāya kīrtana karibe</span>–loudly chant <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">guṇa’</span>–glories.’ [26<span class="e2">–</span>27]
“‘As scriptures, you will not attain Me, but when you take birth as My associates in My manifest Pastimes, you will see Me and loudly chant My glories.’
তাহা শুনি’ শ্রুতিগণ নিস্তব্ধ হইয়া ।<br />গোপনে আছিল হেথা কাল অপেক্ষিয়া ॥২৮॥
tāhā śuni’ śruti-gaṇa nistabdha ha-iyā<br />gopane āchhila hethā kāla apekṣiyā [28]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–this, <span class="e2">śruti-gaṇa</span>–the Upaniṣads <span class="e2">nistabdha</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–became silent [and] <span class="e2">kāla</span> <span class="e2">apekṣiyā</span>–waited <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">gopane</span> <span class="e2">āchhila</span>–in secret. [28]
“Hearing this, the Upaniṣads became silent and secretly waited here.
এই ধন্য কলিযুগ সর্ব্বযুগসার ।<br />যাহাতে হইল শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ অবতার ॥২৯॥
ei dhanya kali-yuga sarva-yuga-sāra<br />yāhāte ha-ila śrī-gaurāṅga avatāra [29]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious <span class="e2">kali-yuga</span>–Age of Kali, <span class="e2">yāhāte</span>–in which <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">avatāra ha-ila</span>–has descended, [is] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the best <span class="e2">sarva-yuga</span>–of all ages. [29]
“This glorious Age of Kali, in which Śrī Gaurāṅga has descended, is the best of all ages.
বিদ্যালীলা করিবেন গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।<br />গণসহ বৃহস্পতি জন্মে অতঃপর ॥৩০॥
vidyā-līlā karibena gaurāṅga-sundara<br />gaṇa-saha bṛhaspati janme ataḥpara [30]
[Hearing that] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-sundara</span>–Gaurāṅgasundar <span class="e2">karibena</span>–would perform <span class="e2">vidyā-līlā</span>–Pastimes of scholarship, <span class="e2">bṛhaspati</span>–Bṛhaspati <span class="e2">gaṇa-saha</span>–and [his] associates <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–then <span class="e2">janme</span>–took birth. [30]
“Hearing that Gaurāṅgasundar would perform Pastimes of scholarship, Bṛhaspati and his associates took birth before the Lord.
বাসুদেব সার্ব্বভৌম সেই বৃহস্পতি ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গে তুষিতে যত্ন করিলেন অতি ॥৩১॥
vāsudeva sārvabhauma sei bṛhaspati<br />gaurāṅge tuṣite yatna karilena ati [31]
<span class="e2">vāsudeva</span> <span class="e2">sārvabhauma</span>–As Vāsudev Sārvabhauma, <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">bṛhaspati</span>–Bṛhaspati <span class="e2">ati yatna</span> <span class="e2">karilena</span>–endeavoured greatly <span class="e2">tuṣite</span>–to please <span class="e2">gaurāṅge</span>–Gaurāṅga. [31]
“As Vāsudev Sārvabhauma, Bṛhaspati endeavoured greatly to please Gaurāṅga.
‘প্রভু মোর নবদ্বীপে শ্রীবিদ্যাবিলাস ।<br />করিবেন’ জানি’ মনে হইয়া উদাস ॥৩২॥
ইন্দ্রসভা পরিহরি’ নিজগণ লয়ে ।<br />জন্মিলেন স্থানে স্থানে আনন্দিত হয়ে ॥৩৩॥
‘prabhu mora navadvīpe śrī-vidyā-vilāsa<br />karibena’ jāni’ mane ha-iyā udāsa [32]
indra-sabhā parihari’ nija-gaṇa laye<br />janmilena sthāne sthāne ānandita haye [33]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Knowing <span class="e2">mane</span>–within [his] heart, <span class="e2">‘mora</span>–‘My <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">karibena</span>–will perform <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-vilāsa</span>–Pastimes of scholarship <span class="e2">navadvīpe’</span>–in Nabadwīp’, [and] <span class="e2">udāsa ha-iyā</span>–becoming detached, <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–Bṛhaspati left <span class="e2">indra-sabhā</span>–the assembly of Indra <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">nija-gaṇa</span>–his associates, [and] <span class="e2">ānandita</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">janmilena</span>–they took birth <span class="e2">sthāne</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in various places. [32<span class="e2">–</span>33]
“Knowing within his heart, ‘My Lord will perform Pastimes of scholarship in Nabadwīp’, and becoming detached, Bṛhaspati left the assembly of Indra with his associates. Joyfully, he and his associates took birth in various places.
এই বিদ্যানগরীতে করি’ বিদ্যালয় ।<br />বিদ্যা প্রচারিল সার্ব্বভৌম মহাশয় ॥৩৪॥
ei vidyā-nagarīte kari’ vidyālaya<br />vidyā prachārila sārvabhauma mahāśaya [34]
<span class="e2">vidyālaya kari’</span>–Bṛhaspati made a school <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">vidyā-nagarīte</span>–in Vidyā Nagar [and] <span class="e2">vidyā</span> <span class="e2">prachārila</span>–taught <span class="e2">sārvabhauma</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–as Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya. [34]
“Bṛhaspati made a school in Vidyā Nagar and taught here as Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya.
‘পাছে বিদ্যাজালে ডুবে হারাই গৌরাঙ্গ’ ।<br />এই মনে করি’ এক করিলেন রঙ্গ ॥৩৫॥
‘pāchhe vidyā-jāle ḍube hārāi gaurāṅga’<br />ei mane kari’ eka karilena raṅga [35]
<span class="e2">‘pāchhe</span>–‘Later, <span class="e2">ḍube</span>–I may sink <span class="e2">vidyā-jāle</span>–in the net of knowledge [and] <span class="e2">hārāi</span>–forget <span class="e2">gaurāṅga’</span>–Gaurāṅga.’ <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Thinking this, <span class="e2">karilena</span>–he performed <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">raṅga</span>–trick. [35]
“Thinking, ‘Later, I may sink into the net of knowledge and forget Gaurāṅga’, he performed a trick.
নিজ শিষ্যগণে রাখি’ নদীয়া-নগরে ।<br />গৌরজন্ম পূর্ব্বে তেঁহ গেলা দেশান্তরে ॥৩৬॥
nija śiṣya-gaṇe rākhi’ nadīyā-nagare<br />gaura-janma pūrve te̐ha gelā deśāntare [36]
<span class="e2">rākhi’</span>–Keeping <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇe</span>–disciples <span class="e2">nadīyā-nagare</span>–in the town of Nadia, <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–he <span class="e2">gelā</span>–went <span class="e2">deśāntare</span>–elsewhere <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–before <span class="e2">gaura-janma</span>–the birth of Gaura. [36]
“Keeping his disciples in Nadia, he went elsewhere before the birth of Gaura.
মনে ভাবে, ‘যদি আমি হই গৌরদাস ।<br />কৃপা করি’ মোরে প্রভু লইবেন পাশ’ ॥৩৭॥
mane bhāve, ‘yadi āmi ha-i gaura-dāsa<br />kṛpā kari’ more prabhu la-ibena pāśa’ [37]
<span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–He thought, <span class="e2">‘yadi</span>–‘If <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ha-i</span>–am <span class="e2">gaura-dāsa</span>–Gaura’s servant, [then my] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’ la-ibena</span>–will mercifully bring <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">pāśa’</span>–to [His] side.’ [37]
“He thought, ‘If I am Gaura’s servant, then my Lord will mercifully bring me to His side.’
এই বলি’ সার্ব্বভৌম যায় নীলাচল ।<br />মায়াবাদ শাস্ত্র তথা করিল প্রবল ॥৩৮॥
ei bali’ sārvabhauma yāya nīlāchala<br />māyāvāda śāstra tathā karila prabala [38]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Thinking <span class="e2">ei</span>–this, <span class="e2">sārvabhauma</span>–Sārvabhauma <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">nīlāchala</span>–to Jagannāth Purī [and] <span class="e2">prabala karila</span>–propagated <span class="e2">māyāvāda</span> <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–texts on illusionism <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [38]
“Thinking this, Sārvabhauma went to Nīlāchal and propagated texts on māyāvād there.
হেথা প্রভু গৌরচন্দ্র শ্রীবিদ্যাবিলাসে ।<br />সার্ব্বভৌমশিষ্যগণে জিনে পরিহাসে ॥৩৯॥
hethā prabhu gaurachandra śrī-vidyā-vilāse<br />sārvabhauma-śiṣya-gaṇe jine parihāse [39]
<span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-vilāse</span>–during [His] Pastimes of scholarship,<span class="e2"> gaurachandra prabhu</span>–Lord Gaurachandra <span class="e2">jine</span>–defeated [and] <span class="e2">parihāse</span>–joked with <span class="e2">sārvabhauma-śiṣya-gaṇe</span>–the disciples of Sārvabhauma. [39]
“Here, during His Pastimes of scholarship, Gaurachandra Prabhu defeated and joked with the disciples of Sārvabhauma.
ন্যায় ফাঁকি করি’ প্রভু সকলে হারায় ।<br />কভু বিদ্যানগরেতে আইসে গৌররায় ॥৪০॥
nyāya phā̐ki kari’ prabhu sakale hārāya<br />kabhu vidyā-nagarete āise gaura-rāya [40]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">gaura-rāya</span>–Gaura Rāy, <span class="e2">āise</span>–came <span class="e2">vidyā-nagarete</span>–to Vidyā Nagar, <span class="e2">nyāya</span> <span class="e2">phā̐ki</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–posed trick questions, [and] <span class="e2">hārāya</span>–defeated <span class="e2">sakale</span>–everyone. [40]
“Sometimes the Lord came to Vidyā Nagar, posed trick questions, and defeated everyone.
অধ্যাপকগণ আর পড়ুয়ার গণ ।<br />পরাজিত হয়ে সবে করে পলায়ন ॥৪১॥
adhyāpaka-gaṇa āra paḍuyāra gaṇa<br />parājita haye sabe kare palāyana [41]
<span class="e2">parājita haye</span>–Defeated, <span class="e2">sabe adhyāpaka-gaṇa</span> <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">paḍuyāra</span> <span class="e2">gaṇa</span>–all the teachers and students <span class="e2">palāyana kare</span>–would flee. [41]
“Defeated, all the teachers and students would flee.
গৌরাঙ্গের বিদ্যালীলা অপূর্ব্ব কথন ।<br />অবিদ্যা ছাড়য়ে তার যে করে শ্রবণ” ॥৪২॥
gaurāṅgera vidyā-līlā apūrva kathana<br />avidyā chhāḍaye tāra ye kare śravaṇa” [42]
<span class="e2">avidyā</span>–Ignorance <span class="e2">chhāḍaye</span>–leaves <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">ye</span>–those who <span class="e2">śravaṇa kare</span>–hear <span class="e2">apūrva</span> <span class="e2">kathana</span>–the wonderful accounts <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span> <span class="e2">vidyā-līlā”</span>–of Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes of scholarship.” [42]
“Ignorance leaves those who hear about Gaurāṅga’s extraordinary Pastimes of scholarship.”
শুনি’ জীব প্রেমানন্দে সে বেদনগরে ।<br />ব্যাসপীঠে গড়াগড়ি যায় প্রেমভরে ॥৪৩॥
śuni’ jīva premānande se veda-nagare<br />vyāsa-pīṭhe gaḍāgaḍi yāya prema-bhare [43]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing [this] <span class="e2">premānande</span>–with the joy of divine love, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled on the ground <span class="e2">vyāsa-pīṭhe</span>–at the school <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">veda-nagare</span>–in Vidyā Nagar, <span class="e2">prema-bhare</span>–filled with divine love. [43]
Hearing this with the joy of divine love, Jīva rolled on the ground at the school in Vidyā Nagar, filled with divine love.
নিত্যানন্দশ্রীচরণে করে নিবেদন ।<br />“আমার সংশয় ছেদন করহ এখন ॥৪৪॥
nityānanda-śrī-charaṇe kare nivedana<br />“āmāra saṁśaya chhedana karaha ekhana [44]
<span class="e2">nityānanda-śrī-charaṇe</span>–At the holy feet of Nityānanda, <span class="e2">nivedana kare</span>–he submitted, <span class="e2">“āmāra</span> <span class="e2">saṁśaya</span>–“I have a doubt. <span class="e2">chhedana</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–Please cut [it away] <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now. [44]
At the holy feet of Nityānanda, he submitted, “I have a doubt. Please cut it away.
সাঙ্খ্যবিদ্যা তর্কবিদ্যা অমঙ্গলময় ।<br />কেমনে নিত্যধামে সে সকল রয়” ॥৪৫॥
sāṅkhya-vidyā tarka-vidyā amaṅgalamaya<br />kemane nitya-dhāme se sakala raya” [45]
<span class="e2">sāṅkhya-vidyā</span>–Knowledge of analysis [and] <span class="e2">tarka-vidyā</span>–knowledge of argument [are] <span class="e2">amaṅgalamaya</span>–inauspicious, [so] <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">raya</span>–do they reside <span class="e2">nitya-dhāme”</span>–in the eternal Dhām?” [45]
“Knowledge of analysis and argument are inauspicious, so how do they reside in the eternal Dhām?”
শুনি’ প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ জীবে দেয় কোল ।<br />আদর করিয়া বলে, “হরি হরি বোল” ॥৪৬॥
śuni’ prabhu nityānanda jīve deya kola<br />ādara kariyā bale, “hari hari bola [46]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing [this,] <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">kola deya</span>–embraced <span class="e2">jīve</span>–Jīva [and] <span class="e2">ādara</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–affectionately <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“hari</span> <span class="e2">hari</span> <span class="e2">bola</span>–“Hari! Haribol! [46]
Hearing this, Nityānanda Prabhu embraced Jīva and affectionately said, “Hari! Haribol!
প্রভুর পবিত্র ধামে নাহি অমঙ্গল ।<br />তর্ক সাঙ্খ্য স্বতঃ নহে হেথায় প্রবল ॥৪৭॥
prabhura pavitra dhāme nāhi amaṅgala<br />tarka sāṅkhya svataḥ nahe hethāya prabala [47]
<span class="e2">nāhi</span>–Nothing [is] <span class="e2">amaṅgala</span>–inauspicious <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">pavitra</span> <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–in the holy abode of the Lord. <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–Here, <span class="e2">tarka</span>–argument [and] <span class="e2">sāṅkhya</span>–analysis <span class="e2">nahe</span>–have no <span class="e2">prabala</span>–power <span class="e2">svataḥ</span>–of their own. [47]
“Nothing is inauspicious in the holy abode of the Lord. Here, argument and analysis have no power of their own.
ভক্তির অধীন সব ভক্তিদাস্য করে ।<br />কর্ম্মদোষে দুষ্ট জনে বিপর্য্যয় ধরে ॥৪৮॥
bhaktira adhīna saba bhakti-dāsya kare<br />karma-doṣe duṣṭa jane viparyaya dhare [48]
<span class="e2">saba</span>–Everything [is] <span class="e2">bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">adhīna</span>–dependent on devotion [and] <span class="e2">bhakti-dāsya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–serves devotion. <span class="e2">karma-doṣe</span>–As a result of [their] sins, <span class="e2">duṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–the wicked <span class="e2">dhare</span>–think <span class="e2">viparyaya</span>–the opposite. [48]
“Here, everything is dependent on devotion and serves devotion. As a result of their sins, the wicked think the opposite.
ভক্তি মহাদেবী হেথা আর সব দাস ।<br />সকলে করয় ভক্তি-দেবীর প্রকাশ ॥৪৯॥
bhakti mahādevī hethā āra saba dāsa<br />sakale karaya bhakti-devīra prakāśa [49]
<span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here,<span class="e2"> bhakti</span>–devotion [is] <span class="e2">mahādevī</span>–the supreme goddess: <span class="e2">saba</span>–everyone [is her] <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">sakale</span>–everything <span class="e2">bhakti-devīra</span> <span class="e2">prakāśa karaya</span>–reveals the goddess of devotion. [49]
“Here, the goddess of devotion is supreme: everyone is her servant, and everything reveals her.
নবদ্বীপে নববিধা ভক্তি অধিষ্ঠান ।<br />ভক্তিরে সেবয় সদা কর্ম্ম আর জ্ঞান ॥৫০॥
navadvīpe nava-vidhā bhakti adhiṣṭhāna<br />bhaktire sevaya sadā karma āra jñāna [50]
<span class="e2">adhiṣṭhāna</span>–The abode <span class="e2">nava-vidhā</span> <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–of the ninefold practice of devotion [is] <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">karma</span>–Action <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sevaya</span>–serve <span class="e2">bhaktire</span>–devotion. [50]
“Nabadwīp is the abode of the ninefold practice of devotion. Here, action and knowledge always serve devotion.
বহির্ম্মুখ-জনে শাস্ত্র দেয় দুষ্টমতি ।<br />শিষ্টজনে সেই শাস্ত্র দেয় কৃষ্ণরতি ॥৫১॥
bahirmukha-jane śāstra deya duṣṭa-mati<br />śiṣṭa-jane sei śāstra deya kṛṣṇa-rati [51]
<span class="e2">śāstra</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">deya</span>–give <span class="e2">duṣṭa-mati</span>–misconceptions <span class="e2">bahirmukha-jane</span>–to averse souls, [and] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">deya</span>–give <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-rati</span>–love for Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">śiṣṭa-jane</span>–to gentle souls. [51]
“The scriptures give misconceptions to those who are averse, and love for Kṛṣṇa to those who are gentle.
প্রৌঢ়ামায়া গৌরদাসী অধিষ্ঠাত্রী দেবী ।<br />সর্ব্বযুগে এই স্থানে থাকে গৌরসেবী ॥৫২॥
prauḍhā-māyā gaura-dāsī adhiṣṭhātrī devī<br />sarva-yuge ei sthāne thāke gaura-sevī [52]
<span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā, <span class="e2">gaura-dāsī</span>–a servant of Gaurāṅga, [is] <span class="e2">adhiṣṭhātrī devī</span>–the presiding goddess [here]. <span class="e2">sarva-yuge</span>–In every age, <span class="e2">thāke</span>–she stays <span class="e2">ei sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">gaura-sevī</span>–as a servant of Gaura. [52]
“Prauḍhā Māyā, a servant of Gaurāṅga, is the presiding goddess here. In every age, she stays here and serves Gaurāṅga.
অতি কর্ম্মদোষ যার বৈষ্ণবেতে দ্বেষ ।<br />তারে মায়া অন্ধ করি’ দেয় নানা ক্লেশ ॥৫৩॥
ati karma-doṣa yāra vaiṣṇavete dveṣa<br />tāre māyā andha kari’ deya nānā kleśa [53]
<span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">andha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–blinds <span class="e2">tāre yāra</span>–those who [are] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">karma-doṣa</span>–very sinful [and] <span class="e2">dveṣa</span>–inimical <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavete</span>–to devotees, [and] <span class="e2">nānā</span> <span class="e2">kleśa deya</span>–subjects [them] to various miseries. [53]
“Māyā blinds those who are very sinful and inimical to Vaiṣṇavas, and subjects them to various miseries.
সর্ব্বপাপ সর্ব্বকর্ম্ম হেথা হয় ক্ষয় ।<br />প্রৌঢ়ামায়া বিদ্যারূপে করে কর্ম্ম লয় ॥৫৪॥
sarva-pāpa sarva-karma hethā haya kṣaya<br />prauḍhā-māyā vidyā-rūpe kare karma laya [54]
<span class="e2">sarva-pāpa</span>–All sin [and] <span class="e2">sarva-karma</span>–all the reactions for one’s previous actions <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">kṣaya</span>–annihilated <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">vidyā-rūpe</span>–In the form of knowledge, <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā <span class="e2">laya kare</span>–destroys <span class="e2">karma</span>–karma. [54]
“All sin and karma are annihilated here. In the form of knowledge, Prauḍhā Māyā destroys karma.
কিন্তু যদি শ্রীবৈষ্ণবে অপরাধ থাকে ।<br />তবে দূর করে তারে কর্ম্মের বিপাকে ॥৫৫॥
kintu yadi śrī-vaiṣṇave aparādha thāke<br />tabe dūra kare tāre karmera vipāke [55]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If, <span class="e2">kintu</span>–however, <span class="e2">śrī-vaiṣṇave</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span> <span class="e2">thāke</span>–someone offends a Vaiṣṇava, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">tāre dūra</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā drives them further <span class="e2">karmera</span> <span class="e2">vipāke</span>–into the miseries of karma. [55]
“If, however, someone offends a Vaiṣṇava, Prauḍhā Māyā drives them further into the miseries of karma.
বিদ্যা পড়ি’ নদীয়ায় সে সব দুর্জ্জন ।<br />কভু নাহি পায় কৃষ্ণপদে প্রেমধন ॥৫৬॥
vidyā paḍi’ nadīyāya se saba durjana<br />kabhu nāhi pāya kṛṣṇa-pade prema-dhana [56]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">durjana</span>–Such sinners <span class="e2">vidyā</span> <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–may study <span class="e2">nadīyāya</span>–in Nadia, [but] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–they never attain <span class="e2">prema-dhana</span>–the wealth of love <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pade</span>–for the feet of Kṛṣṇa. [56]
“Such sinners may study in Nadia, but they never attain the wealth of divine love for the feet of Kṛṣṇa.
বিদ্যার অবিদ্যা লাভ করে সেই সব ।<br />নাহি দেখে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ নদীয়া-বৈভব ॥৫৭॥
vidyāra avidyā lābha kare sei saba<br />nāhi dekhe śrī-gaurāṅga nadīyā-vaibhava [57]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–They <span class="e2">lābha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–attain <span class="e2">avidyā</span>–ignorance <span class="e2">vidyāra</span>–of knowledge, [and] <span class="e2">dekhe nāhi</span>–do not see <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga’s <span class="e2">nadīyā-vaibhava</span>–glory in Nadia. [57]
“They attain only ignorance of true knowledge and do not see the glory of Śrī Gaurāṅga in Nadia.
অতএব বিদ্যা নহে অমঙ্গলময় ।<br />বিদ্যার অবিদ্যা ছায়া অমঙ্গল হয় ॥৫৮॥
ataeva vidyā nahe amaṅgalamaya<br />vidyāra avidyā chhāyā amaṅgala haya [58]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">vidyā</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is not <span class="e2">amaṅgalamaya</span>–inauspicious; [its] <span class="e2">chhāyā</span>–shadow, <span class="e2">avidyā</span>–ignorance <span class="e2">vidyāra</span>–of knowledge, <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">amaṅgala</span>–inauspicious. [58]
“Thus, knowledge is not inauspicious; its shadow, ignorance, is inauspicious.
এ সব স্ফুরিবে জীব গৌরাঙ্গকৃপায় ।<br />লিখিবে আপন শাস্ত্রে প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ॥৫৯॥
e saba sphuribe jīva gaurāṅga-kṛpāya<br />likhibe āpana śāstre prabhura ichchhāya [59]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva, [you] <span class="e2">sphuribe</span>–will reveal <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all this <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-kṛpāya</span>–by the mercy of Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By the desire of the Lord, <span class="e2">likhibe</span>–you will write <span class="e2">āpana</span>–your own <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–scriptures [about it]. [59]
“O Jīva, you will reveal all this by the mercy of Gaurāṅga. By His desire, you will write scriptures about it.
তোমার দ্বারা করিবেন শাস্ত্রপরকাশ ।<br />এবে চল যাই মোরা জহ্নুর আবাস” ॥৬০॥
tomāra dvārā karibena śāstra-parakāśa<br />ebe chala yāi morā jahnura āvāsa” [60]
<span class="e2">śāstra-parakāśa karibena</span>–The Lord will write scriptures <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">dvārā</span>–through you. <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now, <span class="e2">morā chala</span> <span class="e2">yāi</span>–let us go <span class="e2">jahnura</span> <span class="e2">āvāsa”</span>–to the residence of Jahnu.” [60]
“Actually, He will write scriptures through you. Now, let us go to the residence of Jahnu Muni.”
বলিতে বলিতে সবে জান্নগর যায় ।<br />জহ্নু তপোবনশোভা দেখিবারে পায় ॥৬১॥
balite balite sabe jānnagara yāya<br />jahnu-tapovana-śobhā dekhibāre pāya [61]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–While speaking, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">yāya</span>–went <span class="e2">jānnagara</span>–to Jān Nagar [and] <span class="e2">dekhibāre</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–saw <span class="e2">jahnu-tapovana-śobhā</span>–the beauty of the hermitage of Jahnu Muni. [61]
While speaking, they went to Jān Nagar and saw the beauty of the hermitage of Jahnu Muni.
নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “এই জহ্নুদ্বীপ নাম ।<br />ভদ্রবন নামে খ্যাত মনোহর ধাম ॥৬২॥
nityānanda bale, “ei jahnudvīpa nāma<br />bhadravana nāme khyāta manohara dhāma [62]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ei</span>–“This <span class="e2">manohara</span>–charming <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode <span class="e2">nāma nāme</span> <span class="e2">khyāta</span>–is known as <span class="e2">jahnudvīpa</span>–Jahnudwīp [and] <span class="e2">bhadravana</span>–Bhadravan. [62]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “This charming abode is known as Jahnudwīp and Bhadravan.
এই স্থানে জহ্নুমুনি তপ আচরিল ।<br />সুবর্ণ প্রতিমা গৌর দর্শন করিল ॥৬৩॥
ei sthāne jahnu-muni tapa ācharila<br />suvarṇa pratimā gaura darśana karila [63]
<span class="e2">jahnu-muni</span>–The sage Jahnu <span class="e2">tapa</span> <span class="e2">ācharila</span>–performed austerities <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–saw <span class="e2">suvarṇa</span> <span class="e2">pratimā</span>–the golden form <span class="e2">gaura</span>–of Gaura. [63]
“Jahnu Muni performed austerities here and saw the golden form of Gaura.
হেথা জহ্নুমুনি বৈসে সন্ধ্যা করিবারে ।<br />ভাগীরথী বেগে কোশাকুশী পড়ে ধারে ॥৬৪॥
hethā jahnu-muni baise sandhyā karibāre<br />bhāgīrathī vege kośā-kuśī paḍe dhāre [64]
<span class="e2">jahnu-muni</span>–Jahnu Muni <span class="e2">baise</span>–sat <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sandhyā</span> <span class="e2">karibāre</span>–to perform [his] evening meditation, [and His] <span class="e2">kośā-kuśī</span>–copper vessel <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–fell <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span> <span class="e2">vege</span> <span class="e2">dhāre</span>–in the swiftly flowing Gaṅgā. [64]
“Once, when Jahnu Muni sat here to perform his evening meditation, His copper vessel fell into the swiftly flowing River Gaṅgā.
ধারে পড়ি’ কোশাকুশী ভাসিয়া চলিল ।<br />গণ্ডুষে গঙ্গার জল সব পান কৈল ॥৬৫॥
dhāre paḍi’ kośā-kuśī bhāsiyā chalila<br />gaṇḍuṣe gaṅgāra jala saba pāna kaila [65]
<span class="e2">kośā-kuśī</span>–The copper vessel <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–fell <span class="e2">dhāre</span>–into the river [and] <span class="e2">bhāsiyā chalila</span>–floated away. <span class="e2">kaila pāna</span>–Jahnu Muni drank <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span> <span class="e2">saba jala</span>–all the water of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">gaṇḍuṣe</span>–with [his] palm. [65]
“The copper vessel fell into the river and floated away. Jahnu Muni then drank all the water of the Gaṅgā with his palm.
ভগীরথ মনে ভাবে, ‘কোথা গঙ্গা গেল’ ।<br />বিহ্বল হইয়া তবে ভাবিতে লাগিল ॥৬৬॥
bhagīratha mane bhāve, ‘kothā gaṅgā gela’<br />vihvala ha-iyā tabe bhāvite lāgila [66]
<span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–thought, <span class="e2">‘kothā</span>–‘Where <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span> <span class="e2">gela’</span>–did the Gaṅgā go?’ <span class="e2">vihvala</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Bewildered, <span class="e2">tabe lāgila</span>–he then began <span class="e2">bhāvite</span>–to think. [66]
“Mahārāj Bhagīrath thought, ‘Where did the Gaṅgā go?’ Bewildered, he began to think over the situation.
জহ্নুমুনি পান কৈল সব গঙ্গাজল ।<br />জানি’ ভগীরথ মনে হইল বিকল ॥৬৭॥
jahnu-muni pāna kaila saba gaṅgā-jala<br />jāni’ bhagīratha mane ha-ila vikala [67]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Understanding [that] <span class="e2">jahnu-muni</span>–Jahnu Muni <span class="e2">pāna</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–had drunk <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">gaṅgā-jala</span>–all the water of the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">bhagīratha</span>–Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">vikala ha-ila</span>–became concerned. [67]
“Understanding that Jahnu Muni had drunk all the water of the Gaṅgā, Mahārāj Bhagīrath became concerned.
কতদিনে মুনিরে পূজিল মহাধীর ।<br />অঙ্গ বিদারিয়া গঙ্গা করিল বাহির ॥৬৮॥
kata-dine munire pūjila mahādhīra<br />aṅga vidāriyā gaṅgā karila bāhira [68]
<span class="e2">mahādhīra</span>–Sober Mahārāj Bhagīrath <span class="e2">pūjila</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">munire</span>–the sage <span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–for some time. <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–The Gaṅgā <span class="e2">vidāriyā</span>–broke through <span class="e2">aṅga</span>–the body [of the sage and] <span class="e2">bāhira karila</span>–came out. [68]
Sober Mahārāj Bhagīrath worshipped the sage for some time, and eventually the Gaṅgā broke out of the sage’s body.
সেই হৈতে জাহ্নবী হইল নাম তাঁর ।<br />‘জাহ্নবী’ বলিয়া ডাকে সকল সংসার ॥৬৯॥
sei haite jāhnavī ha-ila nāma tā̐ra<br />‘jāhnavī’ baliyā ḍāke sakala saṁsāra [69]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–Thereafter, <span class="e2">tā̐ra nāma ha-ila</span>–she became known as <span class="e2">jāhnavī</span>–Jāhnavī (‘she who comes from Jahnu’). <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–The whole world <span class="e2">baliyā</span> <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–calls [her] <span class="e2">‘jāhnavī’</span>–‘Jāhnavī’. [69]
“Thereafter, she became known as Jāhnavī. The whole world now calls her ‘Jāhnavī’.
কতদিন পরে হেথা গঙ্গার নন্দন ।<br />ভীষ্মদেব কৈল মাতামহ দরশন ॥৭০॥
kata-dina pare hethā gaṅgāra nandana<br />bhīṣmadeva kaila mātāmaha daraśana [70]
<span class="e2">kata</span>-<span class="e2">dina</span>–Some time <span class="e2">pare</span>–later, <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span>–Gaṅgā’s <span class="e2">nandana</span>–son, <span class="e2">bhīṣmadeva</span>–Bhīṣmadev, <span class="e2">mātāmaha</span> <span class="e2">daraśana kaila</span>–met [his] grandfather <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [70]
“Some time later, Gaṅgā’s son, Bhīṣmadev, met his grandfather Jahnu Muni here.
ভীষ্মেরে আদর করে জহ্নু মহাশয় ।<br />বহুদিন রাখে তারে আপন আলয় ॥৭১॥
bhīṣmere ādara kare jahnu-mahāśaya<br />bahu-dina rākhe tāre āpana ālaya [71]
<span class="e2">jahnu-mahāśaya</span>–Jahnu Muni <span class="e2">ādara</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–honoured <span class="e2">bhīṣmere</span>–Bhīṣma [and] <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–kept <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">āpana</span> <span class="e2">ālaya</span>–at [his] home <span class="e2">bahu-dina</span>–for a long time. [71]
“Jahnu Muni honoured Bhīṣma and kept Bhīṣma at his home for a long time.
জহ্নু-স্থানে ভীষ্ম ধর্ম্ম শিখিল অপার ।<br />যুধিষ্ঠিরে শিক্ষা দিল সেই ধর্ম্মসার ॥৭২॥
jahnu-sthāne bhīṣma dharma śikhila apāra<br />yudhiṣṭhire śikṣā dila sei dharma-sāra [72]
<span class="e2">bhīṣma</span>–Bhīṣma <span class="e2">śikhila</span>–learned <span class="e2">apāra</span> <span class="e2">dharma</span>–profound religious principles <span class="e2">jahnu-sthāne</span>–from Jahnu Muni [and] <span class="e2">śikṣā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–taught <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">dharma-sāra</span>–the essence of those religious principles <span class="e2">yudhiṣṭhire</span>–to Yudhiṣṭhir Mahārāj. [72]
“Bhīṣma learned profound religious principles from Jahnu Muni and later taught the essence of them to Yudhiṣṭhir Mahārāj.
নবদ্বীপে থাকি’ ভীষ্ম পাইল ভক্তিধন ।<br />বৈষ্ণবমধ্যেতে ভীষ্ম হইল গণন ॥৭৩॥
navadvīpe thāki’ bhīṣma pāila bhakti-dhana<br />vaiṣṇava-madhyete bhīṣma ha-ila gaṇana [73]
<span class="e2">thāki’</span>–Residing <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">bhīṣma</span>–Bhīṣma <span class="e2">pāila</span>–attained <span class="e2">bhakti-dhana</span>–the wealth of devotion. <span class="e2">bhīṣma</span>–Bhīṣma [then] <span class="e2">gaṇana ha-ila</span>–became recognised <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-madhyete</span>–as a Vaiṣṇava. [73]
“Residing in Nabadwīp, Bhīṣma attained the wealth of devotion and became recognised as a Vaiṣṇava.
অতএব জহ্নুদ্বীপ পরম পাবন ।<br />হেথা বাস করে সদা ভাগ্যবান জন” ॥৭৪॥
ataeva jahnudvīpa parama pāvana<br />hethā vāsa kare sadā bhāgyavāna jana” [74]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">jahnudvīpa</span>–Jahnudwīp [is] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">pāvana</span>–supremely purifying. <span class="e2">bhāgyavāna</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Fortunate souls <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–reside <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sadā”</span>–eternally.” [74]
“Thus, Jahnudwīp is supremely purifying. Fortunate souls reside here eternally.”
সেই দিন জহ্নুদ্বীপে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />ভক্তগণ-সহ রহে ভক্তের আলয় ॥৭৫॥
sei dina jahnudvīpe nityānanda-rāya<br />bhakta-gaṇa saha rahe bhaktera ālaya [75]
<span class="e2">sei dina</span>–That day <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa-saha</span>–and the devotees <span class="e2">rahe</span>–stayed <span class="e2">bhaktera</span> <span class="e2">ālaya</span>–at the home of a devotee <span class="e2">jahnudvīpe</span>–in Jahnudwīp. [75]
That day Nityānanda and the devotees stayed at the home of a devotee in Jahnudwīp.
পরদিন প্রাতে প্রভু লয়ে ভক্তগণ ।<br />মোদদ্রুমদ্বীপে তবে করিল গমন ॥৭৬॥
para-dina prāte prabhu laye bhakta-gaṇa<br />modadrumadvīpe tabe karila gamana [76]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">para-dina</span>–the next day <span class="e2">prāte</span>–in the morning, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">laye</span>–took <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees [and] <span class="e2">gamana karila</span>–went <span class="e2">modadrumadvīpe</span>–to Modadrumadwīp. [76]
The next morning, Nityānanda Prabhu took the devotees and went to Modadrumadwīp.
জাহ্নবানিতাইপদ যাহার গরিমা ।<br />এ ভক্তিবিনোদ গায় নদীয়া মহিমা ॥৭৭॥
jāhnavā-nitāi-pada yāhāra garimā<br />e bhakti-vinoda gāya nadīyā-mahimā [77]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāhāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">garimā</span>–pride [is] <span class="e2">jāhnavā-nitāi-pada</span>–the feet of Jāhnavā and Nitāi, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-mahimā</span>–the glories of Nadia. [77]
Bhakti Vinod, whose pride is the feet of Jāhnavā and Nitāi, chants the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Fourteen
Śrī Modadrumadwīp and Śrī Rāma-Līlā
জয় জয় পঞ্চতত্ত্বাত্মক গৌরহরি ।<br />জয় জয় নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বোপরি ॥১॥
jaya jaya pañcha-tattvātmaka gaurahari<br />jaya jaya navadvīpa-dhāma sarvopari [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">pañcha-tattvātmaka</span>–to the life of the Pañcha Tattva, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span> <span class="e2">sarvopari</span>–to the Dhām above all, Nabadwīp! [1]
All glory to the life of the Pañcha Tattva, Śrī Gaurahari, and the best of all abodes, Śrī Nabadwīp!
মামগাছি-গ্রামে গিয়া নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />বলে, “এই মোদদ্রুম, অযোধ্যা হেথায় ॥২॥
māmagāchhi-grāme giyā nityānanda-rāya<br />bale, “ei modadruma, ayodhyā hethāya [2]
<span class="e2">giyā</span>–Proceeding <span class="e2">māmagāchhi-grāme</span>–to the village of Māmgāchhi, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ei</span>–“This [is] <span class="e2">modadruma</span>–Modadrumadwīp. <span class="e2">ayodhyā</span>–Ayodhyā [is present] <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. [2]
Proceeding to Māmgāchhi Grām, Nityānanda Rāy said, “This is Modadrumadwīp. Ayodhyā is present here.
পূর্ব্বকল্পে যবে রাম হৈল বনবাসী ।<br />লক্ষণ জানকী লয়ে এই স্থানে আসি’ ॥৩॥
মহাবট বৃক্ষ তলে কুটীর বাঁধিয়া ।<br />কতদিন বাস কৈল আনন্দিত হৈয়া ॥৪॥
pūrva-kalpe yabe rāma haila vana-vāsī<br />lakṣaṇa jānakī laye ei sthāne āsi’ [3]
mahāvaṭa vṛkṣa tale kuṭīra bā̐dhiyā<br />kata-dina vāsa kaila ānandita haiyā [4]
<span class="e2">pūrva-kalpe</span>–In a previous manifestation of the universe, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">vana-vāsī haila</span>–He was a resident of the forest, <span class="e2">rāma</span>–Rāma <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">lakṣaṇa</span>–Lakṣmaṇ [and] <span class="e2">jānakī</span>–Sītā, <span class="e2">bā̐dhiyā</span>–built <span class="e2">kuṭīra</span>–a cottage <span class="e2">mahāvaṭa</span> <span class="e2">vṛkṣa</span> <span class="e2">tale</span>–under a massive banyan tree, [and] <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–lived [here] <span class="e2">ānandita</span> <span class="e2">haiyā</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time. [3<span class="e2">–</span>4]
“In a previous manifestation of the universe, while He was residing in the forest, Rāma came here with Lakṣmaṇ and Sītā, built a cottage under a massive banyan tree, and lived here joyfully for some time.
নবদ্বীপ-প্রভা রাম করি’ দরশন ।<br />অল্প অল্প হাস্য করে শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ॥৫॥
navadvīpa-prabhā rāma kari’ daraśana<br />alpa alpa hāsya kare śrī-raghu-nandana [5]
<span class="e2">daraśana kari’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">navadvīpa-prabhā</span>–the lustre of Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">rāma śrī-raghu-nandana</span>–Rāma, the son of the Raghus, <span class="e2">hāsya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–smiled <span class="e2">alpa</span> <span class="e2">alpa</span>–slightly. [5]
“Seeing the lustre of Nabadwīp, Rāma smiled slightly.
কিবা দুর্ব্বাদলশ্যামরূপ মনোহর ।<br />রাজীবলোচন হস্তে ধনুক সুন্দর ॥৬॥
kibā durvā-dala-śyāma-rūpa manohara<br />rājīva-lochana haste dhanuka sundara [6]
[His] <span class="e2">rājīva-lochana</span>–lotus eyes, [His] <span class="e2">sundara dhanuka</span>–beautiful bow <span class="e2">haste</span>–in hand— <span class="e2">kibā</span>–how <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting [was His] <span class="e2">durvā-dala-śyāma-rūpa</span>–dark grass-green form! [6]
“His lotus eyes, His beautiful bow in hand—how enchanting was His dark grass-green form!
ব্রহ্মচারীবেশ শিরে জটা শোভা করে ।<br />দর্শনে সকল প্রাণীগণ মনোহরে ॥৭॥
brahmachārī-veśa śire jaṭā śobhā kare<br />darśane sakala prāṇī-gaṇa manohare [7]
[His] <span class="e2">brahmachārī-veśa</span>–dress was that of a brahmachārī, [and] <span class="e2">jaṭā</span>–dreadlocks <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–shone <span class="e2">śire</span>–atop [His] head. <span class="e2">darśane</span>–The sight [of Him] <span class="e2">manohare</span>–captivated <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">prāṇī-gaṇa</span>–all living beings.<span class="e2"> </span>[7]
“He wore the dress of a brahmachārī, and dreadlocks shone atop His head. Seeing Him captivated all living beings.
হাসি’ হাসি’ মুখ দেখি’ জানকী তখন ।<br />জিজ্ঞাসে শ্রীরামে দেবী হাস্যের কারণ ॥৮॥
hāsi’ hāsi’ mukha dekhi’ jānakī takhana<br />jijñāse śrī-rāme devī hāsyera kāraṇa [8]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing [His] <span class="e2">hāsi’</span> <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–smiling <span class="e2">mukha</span>–face, <span class="e2">jānakī devī</span>–Sītā Devī <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">jijñāse</span>–asked <span class="e2">śrī-rāme</span>–Śrī Rāma <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–about the reason <span class="e2">hāsyera</span>–for [His] smile. [8]
“Seeing His smiling face, Sītā Devī asked Śrī Rāma about the reason for His smile.
রাম বলে, ‘শুন সীতা জনকনন্দিনি<br />অতি গোপনীয় এক আছে ত কাহিনী ॥৯॥
rāma bale, ‘śuna sītā janaka-nandini<br />ati gopanīya eka āchhe ta kāhinī [9]
<span class="e2">rāma</span>–Rāma <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘sītā</span>–‘O Sītā, <span class="e2">janaka-nandini</span>–daughter of Janaka, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There is <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">gopanīya</span>–confidential <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">kāhinī</span>–answer. [9]
“Rāma replied, ‘O Sītā, listen! There is a very confidential answer.
ধন্য কলি যবে হয় এই নদীয়ায় ।<br />পীতবর্ণরূপ মোর দেখিবারে পায় ॥১০॥
dhanya kali yabe haya ei nadīyāya<br />pīta-varṇa-rūpa mora dekhibāre pāya [10]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">dhanya</span> <span class="e2">kali</span>–the glorious Kali-yuga <span class="e2">haya</span>–takes place, <span class="e2">dekhibāre</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–souls will see <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">pīta-varṇa-rūpa</span>–golden form <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nadīyāya</span>–in Nadia. [10]
“‘When the glorious Kali-yuga takes place, souls will see My golden form here in Nadia.
জগন্নাথমিশ্র-গৃহে শ্রীশচী-উদরে ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ-রূপেতে জন্ম লভিব সত্বরে ॥১১॥
jagannātha-miśra-gṛhe śrī-śachī-udare<br />gaurāṅga-rūpete janma labhiba satvare [11]
<span class="e2">satvare janma</span> <span class="e2">labhiba</span>–I will soon take birth <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-rūpete</span>–as Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-udare</span>–from the womb of Śrī Śachī <span class="e2">jagannātha-miśra-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Jagannāth Miśra. [11]
“‘I will soon take birth as Gaurāṅga from the womb of Śachī Devī in the home of Jagannāth Miśra.
বাল্যলীলা দেখিবে যে সব ভাগ্যবান ।<br />করিব সে সব আমি পরা প্রেম দান ॥১২॥
bālya-līlā dekhibe ye saba bhāgyavāna<br />kariba se sabe āmi parā prema dāna [12]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">bhāgyavāna</span>–The fortunate souls <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–will see [My] <span class="e2">bālya-līlā</span>–childhood Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">dāna kariba</span>–will give <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–them all <span class="e2">parā</span> <span class="e2">prema</span>–the highest divine love. [12]
“‘The fortunate souls will see My childhood Pastimes, and I will give them all the highest form of divine love.
করিব সে কালে প্রিয়ে বিদ্যার বিলাস ।<br />শ্রীনাম-মাহাত্ম্য আমি করিব প্রকাশ ॥১৩॥
kariba se kāle priye vidyāra vilāsa<br />śrī-nāma-māhātmya āmi kariba prakāśa [13]
<span class="e2">priye</span>–Dear Sītā, <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–at that time, <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will perform <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">vidyāra</span>–of scholarship. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">prakāśa kariba</span>–will reveal <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-māhātmya</span>–the glories of [My] Name. [13]
“‘Dear Sītā, at that time, I will perform Pastimes of scholarship and reveal the glories of My Name.
সন্ন্যাস করিয়া আমি যাব নীলাচলে ।<br />কাঁদিবে জননী স্বীয় বধু লয়ে কোলে’ ॥১৪॥
sannyāsa kariyā āmi yāba nīlāchale<br />kā̐dibe jananī svīya vadhū laye kole’ [14]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">sannyāsa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–will take sannyās [and] <span class="e2">yāba</span>–go <span class="e2">nīlāchale</span>–to Jagannāth Purī. [My] <span class="e2">jananī</span>–mother <span class="e2">kole laye</span>–will embrace <span class="e2">svīya</span>–My <span class="e2">vadhū</span>–wife <span class="e2">kā̐dibe’</span>–and cry.’ [14]
“‘Later, I will take sannyās and go to Nīlāchal. My mother will embrace My wife and cry.’
এই কথা শুনি’ সীতা বলেন বচন ।<br />‘জননী কাঁদাবে কেন রাজীবলোচন ॥১৫॥
ei kathā śuni’ sītā balena vachana<br />‘jananī kā̐dābe kena rājīva-lochana [15]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">kathā</span>–explanation, <span class="e2">sītā</span>–Sītā <span class="e2">vachana balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘rājīva-lochana</span>–‘O lotus-eyed Lord, <span class="e2">kena</span>–why <span class="e2">jananī</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dābe</span>–will You make [Your] mother cry? [15]
“Hearing this, Sītā said, ‘O lotus-eyed Lord, why will You make Your mother cry?
সন্ন্যাস করিবে কেন ছাড়িয়া গৃহিণী ।<br />পত্নী দুঃখ দিয়া সুখ কিবা নাহি জানি’ ॥১৬॥
sannyāsa karibe kena chhāḍiyā gṛhiṇī<br />patnī duḥkha diyā sukha kibā nāhi jāni’ [16]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">sannyāsa</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will You take sannyās [and] <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leave [Your] <span class="e2">gṛhiṇī</span>–wife? <span class="e2">kibā</span>–What <span class="e2">sukha</span>–happiness [do You feel] <span class="e2">patnī</span> <span class="e2">duḥkha</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–by making [Your] wife unhappy? <span class="e2">jāni nāhi’</span>–I do not understand.’ [16]
“‘Why will You take sannyās and leave Your wife? What happiness is there in making Your wife unhappy? I do not understand.’
শ্রীরাম বলেন, ‘প্রিয়ে তুমি সব জান ।<br />জীবেরে শিখাতে এবে হইল অজ্ঞান ॥১৭॥
śrī-rāma balena, ‘priye tumi saba jāna<br />jīvere śikhāte ebe ha-ila ajñāna [17]
<span class="e2">śrī-rāma</span>–Śrī Rāma <span class="e2">balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘priye</span>–‘[My] dear, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">jāna</span>–understand <span class="e2">saba</span>–everything, [but] <span class="e2">śikhāte</span>–to teach <span class="e2">jīvere</span>–the souls, <span class="e2">ebe</span> <span class="e2">ajñāna ha-ila</span>–You now [act as if You] were unaware. [17]
“Śrī Rāma answered, ‘My dear, You actually understand everything, but to teach the souls, You now act as if You were unaware.
আমাতে যে প্রেমভক্তি তার আস্বাদন ।<br />দুই মতে হয় সীতা শুনহ বচন ॥১৮॥
āmāte ye prema-bhakti tāra āsvādana<br />dui mate haya sītā śunaha vachana [18]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">tāra prema-bhakti</span>–Loving devotion <span class="e2">āmāte</span>–to Me <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">āsvādana</span>–relished <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">mate</span>–in two ways. <span class="e2">sītā</span>–O Sītā, <span class="e2">śunaha</span>–hear [My] <span class="e2">vachana</span>–words. [18]
“‘Loving devotion to Me is relished in two ways. O Sītā, please hear My words.
আমার সংযোগে সুখ সম্ভোগ বোলয় ।<br />আমার বিয়োগে সুখ বিপ্রলম্ভ হয় ॥১৯॥
āmāra saṁyoge sukha sambhoga bolaya<br />āmāra viyoge sukha vipralambha haya [19]
<span class="e2">sukha</span>–The joy <span class="e2">āmāra saṁyoge</span>–during union with Me <span class="e2">bolaya</span>–is called <span class="e2">sambhoga</span>–<span class="e3">sambhoga</span>. <span class="e2">sukha</span>–The joy <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">viyoge</span>–during separation from Me <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">vipralambha</span>–<span class="e3">vipralambha</span>. [19]
“‘The joy felt during union with Me is called <span class="e3">sambhoga</span>. The joy felt during separation from Me is called <span class="e3">vipralambha</span>.
ভক্ত মোর নিত্যসঙ্গী সম্ভোগ বাঞ্ছয় ।<br />মম কৃপাবশে তার বিপ্রলম্ভ হয় ॥২০॥
bhakta mora nitya-saṅgī sambhoga vāñchhaya<br />mama kṛpā-vaśe tāra vipralambha haya [20]
<span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotees, [My] <span class="e2">nitya-saṅgī</span>–eternal associates, <span class="e2">vāñchhaya</span>–desire <span class="e2">sambhoga</span>–union, [and] <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">kṛpā-vaśe</span>–under the control of My grace, <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–they experience <span class="e2">vipralambha</span>–separation. [20]
“‘My devotees, My eternal associates, desire sambhoga, and by My grace, they experience vipralambha.
বিপ্রলম্ভে দুঃখ যেই আমার কারন ।<br />পরম আনন্দ তাহা জানে ভক্তজন ॥২১॥
vipralambhe duḥkha yei āmāra kāraṇa<br />parama ānanda tāhā jāne bhakta-jana [21]
<span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–Devotees <span class="e2">jāne</span>–know [that] <span class="e2">yei tāhā duḥkha</span>–the sadness, <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–for My sake, <span class="e2">vipralambhe</span>–of separation [is] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–the greatest joy. [21]
“‘Devotees know that the sadness felt for My sake during vipralambha is actually the greatest joy.
বিপ্রলম্ভ শেষে যবে সম্ভোগ উদয় ।<br />পূর্ব্বাপেক্ষা কোটিগুণ সুখ তাহে হয় ॥২২॥
vipralambha śeṣe yabe sambhoga udaya<br />pūrvāpekṣā koṭi-guṇa sukha tāhe haya [22]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">sambhoga</span>–union <span class="e2">udaya</span>–occurs <span class="e2">śeṣe</span>–after <span class="e2">vipralambha</span>–separation, <span class="e2">sukha</span>–the happiness <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–within it <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">koṭi-guṇa</span>–ten million times greater <span class="e2">pūrvāpekṣā</span>–than before. [22]
“‘When sambhoga occurs after vipralambha, the happiness felt is ten million times greater than before.
সেই ত সুখের হেতু আমার বিচ্ছেদ ।<br />স্বীকার করহ তুমি বলে চারি বেদ ॥২৩॥
sei ta sukhera hetu āmāra vichchheda<br />svīkāra karaha tumi bale chāri veda [23]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">vichchheda</span>–Separation from Me [is] <span class="e2">hetu</span>–the cause <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">sukhera</span>–of that happiness. <span class="e2">tumi svīkāra</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–Accept [this;] <span class="e2">chāri</span> <span class="e2">veda</span>–the four Vedas <span class="e2">bale</span>–say [it]. [23]
