“‘Separation from Me is the cause of that happiness. Accept this as truth; the four Vedas affirm it.
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-অবতারে কৌশল্যা জননী ।<br />শচীদেবী অদিতি বেদেতে যার ধ্বনি ॥২৪॥
śrī-gaurāṅga-avatāre kauśalyā jananī<br />śachī-devī aditi vedete yāra dhvani [24]
<span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-avatāre</span>–During My appearance as Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">jananī kauśalyā</span>–Mother Kauśalyā, <span class="e2">yāra</span> <span class="e2">dhvani</span>–who is said [to be] <span class="e2">aditi</span>–Aditi <span class="e2">vedete</span>–in the Vedas, [will appear as] <span class="e2">śachī-devī</span>–Śachī Devī. [24]
“‘During My Pastimes as Śrī Gaurāṅga, Mother Kauśalyā, who is known in the Vedas as Aditi, will appear as Śachī Devī.
তুমি বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ারূপে সেবিবে আমারে ।<br />বিচ্ছেদে শ্রীগৌরমূর্ত্তি করিবে প্রচারে ॥২৫॥
tumi viṣṇu-priyā-rūpe sevibe āmāre<br />vichchhede śrī-gaura-mūrti karibe prachāre [25]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–will serve <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–Me <span class="e2">viṣṇu-priyā-rūpe</span>–as Viṣṇu Priyā. <span class="e2">vichchhede</span>–In separation, <span class="e2">prachāre karibe</span>–You will make <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-mūrti</span>–a Deity of Śrī Gaura. [25]
“‘You will serve Me as Viṣṇu Priyā. In separation from Me, You will make a Deity of My golden form.
তোমার বিচ্ছেদে কভু স্বর্ণসীতা করি’ ।<br />ভজিব তোমারে আমি অযোধ্যা নগরী ॥২৬॥
tomāra vichchhede kabhu svarṇa-sītā kari’<br />bhajiba tomāre āmi ayodhyā nagarī [26]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–At some time, <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">vichchhede</span>–in separation from You, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kari’</span>–will make <span class="e2">svarṇa-sītā</span>–a golden Sītā [and] <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–worship <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–You <span class="e2">ayodhyā</span> <span class="e2">nagarī</span>–in the city of Ayodhyā. [26]
“‘In separation from You, I will make a golden Sītā and worship You in Ayodhyā.
তার বিনিময়ে তুমি নদীয়ানগরে ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গপ্রতিমা করি’ পূজিবে আমারে ॥২৭॥
tāra vinimaye tumi nadīyā-nagare<br />gaurāṅga-pratimā kari’ pūjibe āmāre [27]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">vinimaye</span>–In exchange for this, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">kari’</span>–will make <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-pratimā</span>–a Deity of Gaurāṅga [and] <span class="e2">pūjibe</span>–worship <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–Me <span class="e2">nadīyā-nagare</span>–in the town of Nadia. [27]
“‘In exchange, You will make a Deity of My golden form and worship Me in Nadia.
এই গূঢ় কথা সীতা গোপনীয় অতি ।<br />লোকেতে প্রকাশ নাহি হইবে সম্প্রতি ॥২৮॥
ei gūḍha kathā sītā gopanīya ati<br />lokete prakāśa nāhi ha-ibe samprati [28]
<span class="e2">sītā</span>–O Sītā, <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–profound <span class="e2">kathā</span>–topics [are] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">gopanīya</span>–confidential. <span class="e2">prakāśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe nāhi</span>–They will not be revealed <span class="e2">lokete</span>–to the public <span class="e2">samprati</span>–now. [28]
“‘O Sītā, these profound topics are very confidential. They will not be revealed to the public now.
এই নবদ্বীপ মোর বড় প্রিয় স্থান ।<br />অযোধ্যাদি নাহি হয় ইহার সমান ॥২৯॥
ei navadvīpa mora baḍa priya sthāna<br />ayodhyādi nāhi haya ihāra samāna [29]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">priya sthāna</span>–a place [that is] very dear to Me: <span class="e2">ayodhyādi</span>–Ayodhyā and other places <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–are not <span class="e2">samāna</span>–equal <span class="e2">ihāra</span>–to it. [29]
“‘Nabadwīp is very dear to Me: neither Ayodhyā nor any other place is equal to it.
এই রামবট বৃক্ষ কলি আগমনে ।<br />অদর্শন হয়ে সীতা রবে সঙ্গোপনে’ ॥৩০॥
ei rāma-vaṭa vṛkṣa kali āgamane<br />adarśana haye sītā rabe saṅgopane’ [30]
<span class="e2">sītā</span>–O Sītā, <span class="e2">kali</span> <span class="e2">āgamane</span>–when Kali-yuga arrives, <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">rāma-vaṭa</span> <span class="e2">vṛkṣa</span>–this banyan tree, Rāma Vaṭa, <span class="e2">adarśana</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–will disappear [but] <span class="e2">saṅgopane</span>–invisibly <span class="e2">rabe’</span>–remain.’ [30]
“‘O Sītā, when Kali-yuga arrives, this banyan tree, Rāma Vaṭa, will disappear but invisibly remain.’
এই রূপে রাম সীতা লক্ষণ সহিত ।<br />এই স্থানে কতদিন হয়ে অবস্থিত ॥ ৩১॥
ei rūpe rāma sītā lakṣaṇa sahita<br />ei sthāne kata-dina haye avasthita [31]
<span class="e2">ei rūpe</span>–In this way, <span class="e2">rāma</span>–Rāma, <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">sītā</span>–Sītā [and] <span class="e2">lakṣaṇa</span>–Lakṣmaṇ, <span class="e2">avasthita haye</span>–resided <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time. [31]
“In this way Rāma, Sītā, and Lakṣmaṇ resided here for some time.
দণ্ডক অরণ্যে গেলা কার্য্য সাধিবারে ।<br />রামের কুটীর স্থান পাও দেখিবারে ॥৩২॥
daṇḍaka araṇye gelā kārya sādhibāre<br />rāmera kuṭīra sthāna pāo dekhibāre [32]
<span class="e2">gelā</span>–They went <span class="e2">daṇḍaka</span> <span class="e2">araṇye</span>–to the Daṇḍaka forest <span class="e2">kārya</span> <span class="e2">sādhibāre</span>–to perform [Their] Pastimes. <span class="e2">dekhibāre pāo</span>–See <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–the place <span class="e2">rāmera</span> <span class="e2">kuṭīra</span>–of Rāma’s cottage. [32]
“Eventually, They went to the Daṇḍaka forest to perform Their Pastimes. See here the place of Rāma’s cottage.
রামমিত্র গুহক প্রভুর ইচ্ছা-বশে ।<br />এই স্থানে জন্মিলেন বিপ্রের ঔরসে ॥৩৩॥
rāma-mitra guhaka prabhura ichchhā-vaśe<br />ei sthāne janmilena viprera aurase [33]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhā-vaśe</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">rāma-mitra</span>–Rāma’s friend <span class="e2">guhaka</span>–Guhaka <span class="e2">janmilena</span>–took birth <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">viprera</span> <span class="e2">aurase</span>–as the son of a brāhmaṇ. [33]
“By the will of the Lord, Rāma’s friend Guhaka took birth here as the son of a brāhmaṇ.
সদানন্দ বিপ্র ভট্টাচার্য্য নাম তাঁর ।<br />রাম বিনা ত্রিজগতে নাহি জানে আর ॥৩৪॥
sadānanda vipra bhaṭṭāchārya nāma tā̐ra<br />rāma vinā trijagate nāhi jāne āra [34]
<span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–His <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name [became] <span class="e2">sadānanda</span> <span class="e2">vipra</span> <span class="e2">bhaṭṭāchārya</span>–Sadānanda Vipra Bhaṭṭāchārya. <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–He did not know [anything] <span class="e2">vinā</span> <span class="e2">āra</span>–other than <span class="e2">rāma</span>–Rāma <span class="e2">trijagate</span>–in the three worlds. [34]
“His name became Sadānanda Vipra Bhaṭṭāchārya. He knew nothing other than Rāma within the three worlds.
যেই দিন প্রভু মোর জন্মে মায়াপুরে ।<br />সেই দিন সদানন্দ ছিল মিশ্র ঘরে ॥৩৫॥
yei dina prabhu mora janme māyāpure<br />sei dina sadānanda chhila miśra ghare [35]
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">dina sei</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–On the day <span class="e2">mora</span>–our <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">janme</span>–took birth <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur, <span class="e2">sadānanda</span>–Sadānanda <span class="e2">chhila</span>–was present <span class="e2">miśra</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–in the home of Jagannāth Miśra. [35]
“On the day that our Lord took birth in Māyāpur, Sadānanda was present in the home of Jagannāth Miśra.
প্রভুর জনমকালে যত দেবগণ ।<br />মিশ্রের ভবনে শিশু করে দরশন ॥৩৬॥
prabhura janama-kāle yata deva-gaṇa<br />miśrera bhavane śiśu kare daraśana [36]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">janama-kāle</span>–At the time of the Lord’s birth, <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–all the gods <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–observed <span class="e2">śiśu</span>–the child <span class="e2">miśrera</span> <span class="e2">bhavane</span>–in the home of Jagannāth Miśra. [36]
“At the time of the Lord’s birth, all the gods observed the child in the home of Jagannāth Miśra.
পরম সাধক বিপ্র চিনে দেবগণে ।<br />জানিল আমার প্রভু জন্মিল এখানে ॥৩৭॥
parama sādhaka vipra chine deva-gaṇe<br />jānila āmāra prabhu janmila ekhāne [37]
<span class="e2">vipra</span>–The brāhmaṇ Sadānanada, <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">sādhaka</span>–a great devotee, <span class="e2">chine</span>–recognised <span class="e2">deva-gaṇe</span>–the gods [and] <span class="e2">jānila</span>–understood [that] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–our <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">janmila</span>–had taken birth <span class="e2">ekhāne</span>–there. [37]
“The brāhmaṇ, a great devotee, recognised the gods and understood that our Lord had taken birth there.
পরম কৌতুকে বিপ্র আইল নিজ ঘরে ।<br />ইষ্টধ্যানে দেখে বিপ্র গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দরে ॥৩৮॥
parama kautuke vipra āila nija ghare<br />iṣṭa-dhyāne dekhe vipra gaurāṅgasundare [38]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">kautuke</span>–With great delight, <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">āila</span>–returned <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–to his home. <span class="e2">iṣṭa-dhyāne</span>–In meditation on the Lord, <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">gaurāṅgasundare</span>–Gaurāṅgasundar. [38]
“With great delight, the brāhmaṇ returned to his home. In meditation on his worshippable Lord, he saw Gaurāṅgasundar.
সিংহাসনে বসিয়াছে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গরায় ।<br />ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবগণ চামর ঢুলায় ॥৩৯॥
siṁhāsane basiyāchhe śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya<br />brahmā ādi deva-gaṇe chāmara ḍhulāya [39]
<span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy <span class="e2">basiyāchhe</span>–was sitting <span class="e2">siṁhāsane</span>–on a throne, [and] <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā [and] <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">deva-gaṇe</span>–the other gods <span class="e2">ḍhulāya</span>–were waving <span class="e2">chāmara</span>–yak-tail fans. [39]
“Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy was sitting on a throne, and Brahmā and the other gods were waving chāmaras beside Him.
পুনঃ দেখে রামচন্দ্র দুর্ব্বাদলশ্যাম ।<br />নিকটে লক্ষ্মণবীর শ্রীঅনন্তধাম ॥৪০॥
punaḥ dekhe rāmachandra durvādala-śyāma<br />nikaṭe lakṣmaṇa-vīra śrī-ananta-dhāma [40]
<span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–Then <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–the brāhmaṇ saw <span class="e2">durvādala-śyāma</span>–the dark, grass-green <span class="e2">rāmachandra</span>–Rāmachandra [and] <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇa-vīra</span>–heroic Lakṣmaṇ, <span class="e2">śrī-ananta-dhāma</span>–the abode of Ananta, <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–nearby. [40]
“Then, the brāhmaṇ saw the dark, grass-green Rāmachandra and heroic Lakṣmaṇ, the abode of Ananta, nearby.
বামে সীতা সম্মুখে ভকত হনুমান ।<br />দেখিয়া বিপ্রের হৈল প্রভুতত্ত্বজ্ঞান ॥৪১॥
bāme sītā sammukhe bhakata hanumāna<br />dekhiyā viprera haila prabhu-tattva-jñāna [41]
<span class="e2">bāme</span>–On [His] left [was] <span class="e2">sītā</span>–Sītā, [and] <span class="e2">sammukhe</span>–in front [of Him,] <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–the devotee <span class="e2">hanumāna</span>–Hanumān. <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing [this,] <span class="e2">viprera</span> <span class="e2">prabhu-tattva-jñāna haila</span>–the brāhmaṇ understood the identity of the Lord. [41]
“On His left was Sītā, and His devotee Hanumān sat in front of Him. Seeing this, the brāhmaṇ understood the identity of the Lord.
পরম আনন্দে বিপ্র মায়াপুরে গিয়া ।<br />আনন্দে গৌরাঙ্গ দেখে নয়ন ভরিয়া ॥৪২॥
parama ānande vipra māyāpure giyā<br />ānande gaurāṅga dekhe nayana bhariyā [42]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ānande</span>–With great joy, <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">giyā</span>–went <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–to Māyāpur [and] <span class="e2">ānande</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">bhariyā</span>–filling [his] <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes. [42]
“With great joy, the brāhmaṇ went to Māyāpur and joyfully saw Gaurāṅga to the satisfaction of his eyes.
‘ধন্য আমি ধন্য আমি’ বলে বারবার ।<br />‘গৌররূপে রামচন্দ্র সম্মুখে আমার’ ॥৪৩॥
‘dhanya āmi dhanya āmi’ bale bāra-bāra<br />‘gaura-rūpe rāmachandra sammukhe āmāra’ [43]
<span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I [am] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–blessed! <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">dhanya’</span>–blessed!’ <span class="e2">bale</span>–said the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">bāra-bāra</span>–again and again. <span class="e2">‘rāmachandra</span>–‘Rāmachandra [has appeared] <span class="e2">āmāra sammukhe</span>–before me <span class="e2">gaura-rūpe’</span>–as Gaura!’ [43]
“‘I am blessed! I am blessed!’ said the brāhmaṇ again and again. ‘Rāmachandra has appeared before me as Gaurāṅga!’
কতদিনে সঙ্কীর্ত্তন আরম্ভ হইল ।<br />সদানন্দ ‘গৌর’ বলি’ তাহাতে নাচিল ॥৪৪॥
kata-dine saṅkīrtana ārambha ha-ila<br />sadānanda ‘gaura’ bali’ tāhāte nāchila [44]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Some time later, [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–saṅkīrtan <span class="e2">ārambha</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–started. <span class="e2">sadānanda</span>–Sadānanda <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanted <span class="e2">‘gaura’</span>–‘Gaura!’ [and] <span class="e2">nāchila</span>–danced <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–within it. [44]
“Later, when the saṅkīrtan Pastimes of the Lord started, Sadānanda would dance and chant the Name of Gaura.
ওহে জীব এই স্থানে শ্রীভাণ্ডীরবন ।<br />নির্ম্মল ভকতগণ করে দরশন” ॥৪৫॥
ohe jīva ei sthāne śrī-bhāṇḍīravana<br />nirmala bhakata-gaṇa kare daraśana” [45]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">nirmala</span>–pure <span class="e2">bhakata-gaṇa</span>–devotees <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–see <span class="e2">śrī-bhāṇḍīravana”</span>–Śrī Bhāṇḍīravan.” [45]
“O Jīva, here pure devotees see Śrī Bhāṇḍīravan.”
সেই সব কথা শুনি’ নিত্যধামে হেরি ।<br />নাচেন ভকতগণ নিত্যানন্দে ঘেরি’ ॥৪৬॥
sei saba kathā śuni’ nitya-dhāme heri’<br />nāchena bhakata-gaṇa nityānande gheri’ [46]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–all these descriptions [and] <span class="e2">heri’</span>–seeing <span class="e2">nitya-dhāme</span>–the eternal abode, <span class="e2">bhakata-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">gheri’</span>–surrounded <span class="e2">nityānande</span>–Nityānanda [and] <span class="e2">nāchena</span>–danced. [46]
Hearing this and seeing the eternal abode, the devotees surrounded Nityānanda and danced.
শ্রীজীবের অঙ্গে হয় সাত্ত্বিক বিকার ।<br />“হা গৌরাঙ্গ” বলি’ জীব করেন চিৎকার ॥৪৭॥
śrī-jīvera aṅge haya sāttvika vikāra<br />“hā gaurāṅga” bali’ jīva karena chitkāra [47]
<span class="e2">sāttvika</span> <span class="e2">vikāra</span>–Divine ecstasy <span class="e2">haya</span>–manifested <span class="e2">śrī-jīvera</span> <span class="e2">aṅge</span>–in the body of Śrī Jīva [and] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">bali’chitkāra karena</span>–exclaimed, <span class="e2">“hā</span>–“O <span class="e2">gaurāṅga”</span>–Gaurāṅga!” [47]
Divine ecstasy manifested in the body of Śrī Jīva, and he exclaimed, “O Gaurāṅga!”
সেই গ্রামে সেই দিন নারায়ণী-ঘরে ।<br />রহিলেন নিত্যানন্দ প্রফুল্ল অন্তরে ॥৪৮॥
sei grāme sei dina nārāyaṇī-ghare<br />rahilena nityānanda praphulla antare [48]
<span class="e2">praphulla</span> <span class="e2">antare</span>–With a jubilant heart, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">rahilena</span>–stayed <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">grāme</span>–in that village <span class="e2">nārāyaṇī</span>-<span class="e2">ghare</span>–in the home of Nārāyaṇī <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–that day. [48]
With a jubilant heart, Nityānanda stayed in that village in the home of Nārāyaṇī that day.
পরম পবিত্র সতী ব্যাসের জননী ।<br />শ্রীবৈষ্ণবগণে সেবা করিল আপনি ॥৪৯॥
parama pavitra satī vyāsera jananī<br />śrī-vaiṣṇava-gaṇe sevā karila āpani [49]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">pavitra</span>–The perfectly pure [and] <span class="e2">satī</span>–chaste [Nārāyaṇī,] <span class="e2">jananī</span>–the mother <span class="e2">vyāsera</span>–of Vyāsa (Śrīla Vṛndāvan Dās Ṭhākur, the Vyāsa of Śrīman Mahāprabhu’s Pastimes), <span class="e2">āpani</span>–personally <span class="e2">sevā</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–served <span class="e2">śrī-vaiṣṇava-gaṇe</span>–the devotees. [49]
The perfectly pure and chaste Nārāyaṇī, the mother of Vyāsa, personally served the devotees.
পরদিন প্রাতে সবে চলি’ কত দূর ।<br />প্রবেশিল অনায়াসে শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠপুর ॥৫০॥
para-dina prāte sabe chali’ kata dūra<br />praveśila anāyāse śrī-vaikuṇṭha-pura [50]
<span class="e2">para-dina</span>–The next day <span class="e2">prāte</span>–in the morning, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">chali’</span>–walked <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dūra</span>–some distance [and] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–peacefully <span class="e2">praveśila</span>–entered <span class="e2">śrī-vaikuṇṭha-pura</span>–Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur. [50]
The next day in the morning, the devotees walked some distance and peacefully entered Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur.
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-আজ্ঞা করিতে পালন ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য গায় দীন অকিঞ্চন ॥৫১॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-ājñā karite pālana<br />nadīyā-māhātmya gāya dīna akiñchana [51]
<span class="e2">pālana karite</span>–To fulfil <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-ājñā</span>–the order of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">dīna</span> <span class="e2">akiñchana</span>–this poor, lowly soul <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia. [51]
To fulfil the order of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, this poor, lowly soul chants the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Fifteen
Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur, Śrī Rudradwīp, and Śrī Pulina
পঞ্চতত্ত্ব সহিত গৌরাঙ্গ জয় জয় ।<br />জয় জয় নবদ্বীপ গৌরাঙ্গ-আলয় ॥১॥
pañcha-tattva sahita gaurāṅga jaya jaya<br />jaya jaya navadvīpa gaurāṅga-ālaya [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–to Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with <span class="e2">pañcha-tattva</span>–the Pañcha Tattva! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-ālaya</span>–to the abode of Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp! [1]
All glory to Śrī Gaurāṅga, the Pañcha Tattva, and the abode of Śrī Gaurāṅga, Śrī Nabadwīp!
শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠপুরে আসি’ প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ ।<br />শ্রীজীবে কহেন তবে হাসি’ মন্দ মন্দ ॥২॥
śrī-vaikuṇṭha-pure āsi’ prabhu nityānanda<br />śrī-jīve kahena tabe hāsi’ manda manda [2]
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–Arriving <span class="e2">śrī-vaikuṇṭha-pure</span>–in Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur, <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–smiled <span class="e2">manda</span> <span class="e2">manda</span>–gently [and] <span class="e2">kahena</span>–spoke <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–to Śrī Jīva. [2]
Arriving in Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur, Nityānanda Prabhu smiled gently and spoke to Śrī Jīva.
“নবদ্বীপ অষ্টদল একপার্শ্বে হয় ।<br />এই ত বৈকুণ্ঠপুরী শুনহ নিশ্চয় ॥৩॥
“navadvīpa aṣṭa-dala eka-pārśve haya<br />ei ta vaikuṇṭha-purī śunaha niśchaya [3]
<span class="e2">“śunaha</span>–“Please listen <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–with certainty. [Here,] <span class="e2">eka-pārśve</span>–on one side <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span> <span class="e2">aṣṭa-dala</span>–of the eight-petalled lotus of Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭha-purī</span>–Vaikuṇṭhapur. [3]
“Please listen carefully. Here, on one side of the eight-petalled lotus of Nabadwīp, is Vaikuṇṭhapur.
পরব্যোম শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠ নারায়ণস্থান ।<br />বিরজার পারে স্থিতি এই ত সন্ধান ॥৪॥
paravyoma śrī-vaikuṇṭha nārāyaṇa-sthāna<br />virajāra pāre sthiti ei ta sandhāna [4]
<span class="e2">śrī-vaikuṇṭha</span>–Śrī Vaikuṇṭha, <span class="e2">paravyoma</span>–the spiritual world, <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa-sthāna</span>–the abode of Nārāyaṇ, [is] <span class="e2">sthiti</span>–situated <span class="e2">virajāra</span> <span class="e2">pāre</span>–beyond the Virajā River. <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–This [is its] <span class="e2">sandhāna</span>–position. [4]
“Śrī Vaikuṇṭha, the spiritual world, the abode of Nārāyaṇ, is situated beyond the Virajā River. This is its position.
মায়ার নাহিক তথা গতি কদাচন ।<br />শ্রীভূলীলা-শক্তি-সেব্য তথা নারায়ণ ॥৫॥
māyāra nāhika tathā gati kadāchana<br />śrī-bhū-līlā-śakti-sevya tathā nārāyaṇa [5]
<span class="e2">māyāra</span> <span class="e2">kadāchana nāhika</span>–Māyā never has [any] <span class="e2">gati</span>–role <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa</span>–Nārāyaṇ <span class="e2">sevya</span>–is to be served <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">śrī-bhū-līlā</span>-<span class="e2">śakti</span>–by the śrī, bhū, and līlā energies. [5]
“Māyā never enters there, where Nārāyaṇ is served by the śrī, bhū, and līlā energies.
চিন্ময় ভূমির ব্রহ্ম হয় ত কিরণ ।<br />চর্ম্মচক্ষে জড়দৃষ্টি করে সর্ব্বজন ॥৬॥
chinmaya bhūmira brahma haya ta kiraṇa<br />charma-chakṣe jaḍa-dṛṣṭi kare sarva-jana [6]
<span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">kiraṇa</span>–The effulgence <span class="e2">chinmaya</span> <span class="e2">bhūmira</span>–of this spiritual land <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">brahma</span>–Brahma. <span class="e2">charma-chakṣe</span>–With fleshy eyes, <span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–everyone <span class="e2">jaḍa-dṛṣṭi</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–sees it to be material. [6]
“The effulgence of this spiritual land is Brahma. With fleshy eyes, everyone sees it to be material.
এই নারায়ণধামে নিত্য নিরঞ্জনে ।<br />নারদ দেখিল কভু চিন্ময় লোচনে ॥৭॥
ei nārāyaṇa-dhāme nitya nirañjane<br />nārada dekhila kabhu chinmaya lochane [7]
<span class="e2">nārada</span>–Nārad <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–once <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–saw <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">nirañjane</span>–pure, <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa-dhāme</span>–abode of Nārāyaṇ <span class="e2">chinmaya</span> <span class="e2">lochane</span>–with [his] spiritual eyes. [7]
“Nārad once saw this pure, eternal abode of Nārāyaṇ with his spiritual eyes.
নারায়ণে দেখে পুনঃ গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।<br />দেখি’ হেথা কতদিনে রহে মুনিবর ॥৮॥
nārāyaṇe dekhe punaḥ gaurāṅgasundara<br />dekhi’ hethā kata-dine rahe muni-vara [8]
<span class="e2">dekhe</span>–He saw <span class="e2">nārāyaṇe</span>–Nārāyaṇ, [and] <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–then <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–he saw [Him as] <span class="e2">gaurāṅgasundara</span>–Gaurāṅgasundar. <span class="e2">muni-vara</span>–The best of the sages [then] <span class="e2">rahe</span>–stayed <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–for some time. [8]
“He saw Nārāyaṇ, and then saw Him as Gaurāṅgasundar. Thereafter, Nārad, the best of the sages, stayed here for some time.
আর এক কথা গূঢ় আছে পুরাতন ।<br />জগন্নাথ-ক্ষেত্রে আইলা আচার্য্য লক্ষ্মণ ॥৯॥
āra eka kathā gūḍha āchhe purātana<br />jagannātha-kṣetre āilā āchārya lakṣmaṇa [9]
<span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There is <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">eka</span>–another <span class="e2">purātana</span>–ancient, <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">kathā</span>–subject. [Once,] <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇa āchārya</span>–Rāmānuja Āchārya <span class="e2">āilā</span>–came <span class="e2">jagannātha-kṣetre</span>–to Jagannāth Purī. [9]
“There is another ancient, confidential subject. Once, Rāmānuja Āchārya came to Jagannāth Kṣetra.
বহু স্তবে তুষ্ট কৈল দেব জগন্নাথে ।<br />কৃপা করি’ জগন্নাথ আইল সাক্ষাতে ॥১০॥
bahu stave tuṣṭa kaila deva jagannāthe<br />kṛpā kari’ jagannātha āila sākṣāte [10]
<span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–He pleased <span class="e2">deva</span> <span class="e2">jagannāthe</span>–Lord Jagannāth <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">stave</span>–with many prayers, [and] <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–Jagannāth <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">sākṣāte</span>–before him. [10]
“He pleased Lord Jagannāth with numerous prayers, and Jagannāth mercifully came before him.
সাক্ষাতে আসিয়া প্রভু বলিল বচন ।<br />‘নবদ্বীপধাম তুমি করহ দর্শন ॥১১॥
sākṣāte āsiyā prabhu balila vachana<br />‘navadvīpa-dhāma tumi karaha darśana [11]
<span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–Coming <span class="e2">sākṣāte</span>–before him, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">vachana balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘tumi</span> <span class="e2">darśana karaha</span>–‘Visit <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām. [11]
“Coming before him, the Lord said, ‘Visit Nabadwīp Dhām.
অতি অল্পদিনে আমি নদীয়ানগরে ।<br />প্রকট হইব জগন্নাথমিশ্র-ঘরে ॥১২॥
ati alpa-dine āmi nadīyā-nagare<br />prakaṭa ha-iba jagannātha-miśra-ghare [12]
<span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">alpa</span>-<span class="e2">dine</span>–Within a very short time, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iba</span>–will appear <span class="e2">nadīyā-nagare</span>–in the town of Nadia <span class="e2">jagannātha-miśra-ghare</span>–in the home of Jagannāth Miśra. [12]
“‘Very soon, I will appear in Nadia in the home of Jagannāth Miśra.
নবদ্বীপ হয় মোর অতি প্রিয়স্থান ।<br />পরব্যোম তার একদেশে অধিষ্ঠান ॥১৩॥
navadvīpa haya mora ati priya-sthāna<br />paravyoma tāra eka-deśe adhiṣṭhāna [13]
<span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">priya-sthāna</span>–dear place. <span class="e2">paravyoma</span>–The spiritual world <span class="e2">adhiṣṭhāna</span>–is situated <span class="e2">eka-deśe</span>–within one portion <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of it. [13]
“‘Nabadwīp is My dearmost abode. The spiritual world of Vaikuṇṭha is situated within one portion of it.
তুমি মোর নিত্যদাস ভকত-প্রধান ।<br />অবশ্য দেখিবে তুমি নবদ্বীপস্থান ॥১৪॥
tumi mora nitya-dāsa bhakata pradhāna<br />avaśya dekhibe tumi navadvīpa-sthāna [14]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">nitya-dāsa</span>–eternal servant, [and] <span class="e2">pradhāna</span>–foremost <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–amongst [My] devotees. <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">avaśya</span> <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–must see <span class="e2">navadvīpa-sthāna</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām. [14]
“‘You are My eternal servant, and foremost amongst My devotees. You must see Nabadwīp Dhām.
তব শিষ্যগণ দাস্য-রসেতে মগন ।<br />হেথায় থাকুক তুমি করহ গমন ॥১৫॥
tava śiṣya-gaṇa dāsya-rasete magana<br />hethāya thākuka tumi karaha gamana [15]
<span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇa</span>–disciples <span class="e2">thākuka magana</span>–may remain immersed <span class="e2">dāsya-rasete</span>–in servitorship <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">gamana karaha</span>–must go. [15]
“‘Let your disciples remain here immersed in dāsya-rasa. You must go.
নবদ্বীপ না দেখে যে পাইয়া শরীর ।<br />মিথ্যা তার জন্ম ওহে রামানুজ ধীর ॥১৬॥
navadvīpa nā dekhe ye pāiyā śarīra<br />mithyā tāra janma ohe rāmānuja dhīra [16]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">dhīra rāmānuja</span>–wise Rāmānuja! <span class="e2">ye tāra</span> <span class="e2">janma</span>–The birth of those who <span class="e2">pāiyā</span>–obtain <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–a body [but] <span class="e2">dekhe nā</span>–do not see <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">mithyā</span>–meaningless. [16]
“‘O wise Rāmānuja! The birth of those who obtain a body but do not see Nabadwīp is meaningless.
রঙ্গস্থান শ্রীবেঙ্কট যাদব অচল ।<br />নবদ্বীপ-কলা মাত্র হয় সে সকল ॥১৭॥
raṅga-sthāna śrī-veṅkaṭa yādava achala<br />navadvīpa-kalā mātra haya se sakala [17]
<span class="e2">raṅga-sthāna</span>–Śrī Raṅgam, <span class="e2">śrī-veṅkaṭa</span>–Śrī Veṅkaṭa, [and] <span class="e2">yādava</span> <span class="e2">achala</span>–Yādavāchal <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">mātra</span>–simply <span class="e2">navadvīpa-kalā</span>–minor parts of Nabadwīp. [17]
“‘Śrī Raṅgam, Śrī Veṅkaṭa, and Yādavāchal are simply minor parts of Nabadwīp.
অতএব নবদ্বীপ করিয়া গমন ।<br />দেখ গৌরাঙ্গের রূপ কেশবনন্দন ॥১৮॥
ataeva navadvīpa kariyā gamana<br />dekhe gaurāṅgera rūpa keśava-nandana [18]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">keśava-nandana</span>–O Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">gamana kariyā</span>–go <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–to Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–the form <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga. [18]
“‘Therefore, O Rāmānuja, go to Nabadwīp and see the form of Gaurāṅga.
ভক্তি প্রচারিতে তুমি আইলে ধরাতলে ।<br />সার্থক হউক জন্ম গৌরকৃপাবলে ॥১৯॥
bhakti prachārite tumi āile dharā-tale<br />sārthaka ha-uka janma gaura-kṛpā-bale [19]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">āile</span>–came <span class="e2">dharā-tale</span>–to the earth <span class="e2">prachārite</span>–to preach <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion. [May your] <span class="e2">janma</span>–birth <span class="e2">sārthaka</span> <span class="e2">ha-uka</span>–be successful <span class="e2">gaura-kṛpā-bale</span>–by the mercy of Gaura. [19]
“‘You came to the earth to preach devotion. May your birth be successful by the mercy of Gaura.
নবদ্বীপ দেখি’ তুমি যাও কূর্ম্মস্থান ।<br />শিষ্যগণ সনে তথা হইবে মিলন’ ॥২০॥
navadvīpa dekhi’ tumi yāo kūrma-sthāna<br />śiṣya-gaṇa sane tathā ha-ibe milana’ [20]
<span class="e2">tumi dekhi’</span>–See <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">yāo</span>–go <span class="e2">kūrma-sthāna</span>–to Kūrma Sthān. <span class="e2">milana ha-ibe</span>–You will meet <span class="e2">sane</span>–with [your] <span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇa</span>–disciples <span class="e2">tathā’</span>–there.’ [20]
“‘See Nabadwīp and then go to Kūrma Sthān. You will meet your disciples there.’
এত শুনি’ লক্ষ্মণাচার্য্য যুড়ি’ দুই কর ।<br />জগন্নাথ নিবেদন করে অতঃপর ॥২১॥
eta śuni’ lakṣmaṇāchārya yuḍi’ dui kara<br />jagannāthe nivedana kare ataḥpara [21]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇāchārya</span>–Rāmānuja Āchārya <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">kara yuḍi’</span>–joined [his] palms [and] <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–then <span class="e2">nivedana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–prayed <span class="e2">jagannāthe</span>–to Jagannāth. [21]
“Hearing this, Rāmānuja Āchārya joined his palms and prayed to Jagannāth.
‘তোমার কৃপায় প্রভু গৌরকথা শুনি’ ।<br />কোন তত্ত্ব গৌরচন্দ্র তাহা নাহি জানি’ ॥২২॥
‘tomāra kṛpāya prabhu gaura-kathā śuni’<br />kona tattva gaurachandra tāhā nāhi jāni’ [22]
<span class="e2">‘prabhu</span>–‘O Lord, <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">kṛpāya</span>–by Your mercy, <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–I have heard <span class="e2">gaura-kathā</span>–a description of Gaura, [but] <span class="e2">jāni nāhi</span>–I do not know <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">tattva tāhā</span>–who <span class="e2">gaurachandra’</span>–Gaurachandra [is].’ [22]
“‘O Lord, by Your mercy I have now heard about Gaurāṅga, but I do not know who He is.’
রামানুজে কৃপা করি’ জগবন্ধু বলে ।<br />‘গোলোকের নাথ কৃষ্ণ জানেন সকলে ॥২৩॥
rāmānuje kṛpā kari’ jagabandhu bale<br />‘golokera nātha kṛṣṇa jānena sakale [23]
<span class="e2">jagabandhu</span>–Jagannāth <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">bale</span>–said <span class="e2">rāmānuje</span>–to Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">‘sakale</span>–‘Everyone <span class="e2">jānena</span>–knows [that] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">nātha</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">golokera</span>–of Goloka. [23]
“Jagannāth mercifully replied to Rāmānuja, ‘Everyone knows that Kṛṣṇa is the Lord of Goloka.
যাঁহার বিলাসমূর্ত্তি প্রভু নারায়ণ ।<br />সেই কৃষ্ণ পরতত্ত্ব ধাম বৃন্দাবন ॥২৪॥
yā̐hāra vilāsa-mūrti prabhu nārāyaṇa<br />sei kṛṣṇa para-tattva dhāma vṛndāvana [24]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">yā̐hāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">vilāsa-mūrti</span>–‘Pastime-form’ [is] <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa prabhu</span>–Lord Nārāyaṇ, [is] <span class="e2">para-tattva</span>–the supreme being, [and His] <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode [is] <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. [24]
“‘Lord Nārāyaṇ is a form Kṛṣṇa assumes to perform Pastimes. Kṛṣṇa is the supreme being, and His abode is Vṛndāvan.
সেই কৃষ্ণ পূর্ণ রূপে নিত্য গৌরহরি ।<br />সেই বৃন্দাবনধাম নবদ্বীপপুরী ॥২৫॥
sei kṛṣṇa pūrṇa rūpe nitya gaurahari<br />sei vṛndāvana-dhāma navadvīpa-purī [25]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [exists] <span class="e2">pūrṇa</span> <span class="e2">rūpe</span>–fully [and] <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally [as] <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari, [and] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vṛndāvana-dhāma</span>–Vṛndāvan Dhām [exists] <span class="e2">navadvīpa-purī</span>–as the abode of Nabadwīp. [25]
“‘Kṛṣṇa also exists fully and eternally as Gaurahari, and Vṛndāvan also exists fully and eternally as Nabadwīp.
নবদ্বীপে আমি নিত্য গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।<br />নবদ্বীপ শ্রেষ্টধাম জগত ভিতর ॥২৬॥
navadvīpe āmi nitya gaurāṅgasundara<br />navadvīpa śreṣṭha-dhāma jagata bhitara [26]
<span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–In Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [exist] <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally <span class="e2">gaurāṅgasundara</span>–as Gaurāṅgasundar. <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">śreṣṭha-dhāma</span>–the best abode <span class="e2">jagata</span> <span class="e2">bhitara</span>–in the world. [26]
“‘In Nabadwīp, I am eternally present as Gaurāṅgasundar. Nabadwīp is the best abode in the world.
আমার কৃপায় ধাম আছে ভুমণ্ডলে ।<br />মায়াগন্ধ নাহি তথা সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে বলে ॥২৭॥
āmāra kṛpāya dhāma āchhe bhū-maṇḍale<br />māyā-gandha nāhi tathā sarva-śāstre bale [27]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">kṛpāya</span>–By My grace, <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is present <span class="e2">bhū-maṇḍale</span>–on the earth, [and] <span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–all the scriptures <span class="e2">bale</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">māyā-gandha</span>–trace of māyā <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [27]
“‘By My grace, Nabadwīp Dhām is present on the earth, and all the scriptures say that there is no trace of māyā there.
ভূমণ্ডলে আছে বলি’ যদি ভাব হীন ।<br />তবে তব ভক্তি ক্ষয় হবে দিন দিন ॥২৮॥
bhū-maṇḍale āchhe bali’ yadi bhāva hīna<br />tabe tava bhakti kṣaya habe dina dina [28]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Considering [that] <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–Nabadwīp is present <span class="e2">bhū-maṇḍale</span>–on the earth, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–you think [it is] <span class="e2">hīna</span>–degraded, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">kṣaya</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will diminish <span class="e2">dina</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–day by day. [28]
“‘If you think that Nabadwīp is degraded because it is present on the earth, then your devotion will diminish day by day.
আমার অচিন্ত্যশক্তি সে চিন্ময়ধামে ।<br />আমার ইচ্ছায় রাখিয়াছে মায়াশ্রমে ॥২৯॥
āmāra achintya-śakti se chinmaya-dhāme<br />āmāra ichchhāya rākhiyāchhe māyāśrame [29]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By My will, <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">achintya-śakti</span>–inconceivable energy <span class="e2">rākhiyāchhe</span>–has manifested <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">chinmaya-dhāme</span>–this spiritual abode <span class="e2">māyāśrame</span>–within the realm of Māyā. [29]
“‘By My will, My inconceivable energy has manifested this spiritual abode within the realm of Māyā.
যুক্তির অতীত তত্ত্ব শাস্ত্র নাহি পায় ।<br />কেবল জানেন ভক্ত আমার কৃপায়’ ॥৩০॥
yuktira atīta tattva śāstra nāhi pāya<br />kevala jānena bhakta āmāra kṛpāya’ [30]
<span class="e2">śāstra</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not <span class="e2">pāya</span>–reach<span class="e2"> tattva</span>–truth [that is] <span class="e2">yuktira</span> <span class="e2">atīta</span>–beyond reason. <span class="e2">kevala</span>–Only <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotees <span class="e2">jānena</span>–understand [it,] <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">kṛpāya’</span>–by My grace.’ [30]
“The scriptures do not ascertain truth that is beyond reason. Only devotees understand it, by My grace.’
জগন্নাথবাক্য শুনি’ রামানুজ ধীর ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গপ্রেমে তবে হইল অস্থির ॥৩১॥
jagannātha-vākya śuni’ rāmānuja dhīra<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-preme tabe ha-ila asthira [31]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">jagannātha-vākya</span>–the words of Jagannāth, <span class="e2">dhīra rāmānuja</span>–the sober Rāmānuja <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">asthira ha-ila</span>–became overwhelmed <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-preme</span>–with divine love for Śrī Gaurāṅga. [31]
“Hearing the words of Jagannāth, the sober Rāmānuja became overwhelmed with divine love for Śrī Gaurāṅga.
বলে, ‘প্রভু বড়ই আশ্চর্য্য লীলা তব ।<br />বেদশাস্ত্র নাহি জানে তোমার বৈভব ॥৩২॥
bale, ‘prabhu baḍa-i āścharya līlā tava<br />veda-śāstra nāhi jāne tomāra vaibhava [32]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">‘prabhu</span>–‘O Lord, <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes [are] <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span>–extremely <span class="e2">āścharya</span>–astonishing. <span class="e2">veda-śāstra</span>–The Vedic scriptures <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–do not know <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">vaibhava</span>–glories. [32]
“He said, ‘O Lord, Your Pastimes are extremely astonishing. The Vedic scriptures do not know Your glories.
শাস্ত্রেতে বিশেষরূপে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গলীলা ।<br />কেন প্রভু জগন্নাথ ব্যক্ত না করিলা ॥৩৩॥
śāstrete viśeṣa-rūpe śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā<br />kena prabhu jagannātha vyakta nā karilā [33]
<span class="e2">jagannātha prabhu</span>–O Lord Jagannāth, <span class="e2">kena</span>–why <span class="e2">śāstrete</span> <span class="e2">vyakta</span> <span class="e2">karilā nā</span>–did the scriptures not describe <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā</span>–the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">viśeṣa-rūpe</span>–specifically? [33]
“‘O Lord Jagannāth, why did the scriptures not specifically describe the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga?
গাঢ়রূপে শ্রুতিপুরাণাদি দেখি যবে ।<br />কভু গৌরতত্ত্ব স্ফুর্ত্তি চিত্তে পাই তবে ॥৩৪॥
gāḍha-rūpe śruti-purāṇādi dekhi yabe<br />kabhu gaura-tattva sphurti chitte pāi tabe [34]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Only <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–I look <span class="e2">śruti-purāṇādi</span>–at the Vedas, Purāṇas, and so on <span class="e2">gāḍha</span>-<span class="e2">rūpe</span>–in a deeper way, <span class="e2">tabe pāi</span>–do I then find <span class="e2">chitte</span>–within [my] heart <span class="e2">sphurti</span>–revelation <span class="e2">gaura-tattva</span>–of Gaura’s existence. [34]
“‘Only when I look at the Vedas, Purāṇas, and other scriptures in a deeper way do I find revelation of Gaurāṅga.
তব আজ্ঞা প্রাপ্ত হয়ে ছাড়িল সংশয় ।<br />গৌরলীলা-রস হৃদে হইল উদয় ॥৩৫॥
tava ājñā prāpta haye chhāḍila saṁśaya<br />gaura-līlā-rasa hṛde ha-ila udaya [35]
<span class="e2">prāpta</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–Receiving <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–order, <span class="e2">chhāḍila</span>–I have left behind [my] <span class="e2">saṁśaya</span>–doubts. <span class="e2">gaura-līlā-rasa</span>–The ecstasy of the Pastimes of Gaura <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–has arisen <span class="e2">hṛde</span>–in [my] heart. [35]
“‘Receiving Your order, I have left behind my doubts. The ecstasy of the Pastimes of Gaura has arisen in my heart.
আজ্ঞা হয় নবদ্বীপ করিয়া গমন ।<br />প্রচারিব গৌরলীলা এ তিন ভুবন ॥৩৬॥
ājñā haya navadvīpa kariyā gamana<br />prachāriba gaura-līlā e tina bhuvana [36]
<span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–If You order [me,] <span class="e2">gamana kariyā</span>–I will go <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–to Nabadwīp [and then] <span class="e2">prachāriba</span>–preach <span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–about the Pastimes of Gaura <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">tina</span> <span class="e2">bhuvana</span>–throughout the three worlds. [36]
“‘If You order me, I will go to Nabadwīp and then preach about the Pastimes of Gaura throughout the three worlds.
গূঢ়শাস্ত্র ব্যক্ত করি’ জানাব সবারে ।<br />গৌরভক্ত করি’ বল এ তিন সংসারে’ ॥৩৭॥
gūḍha-śāstra vyakta kari’ jānāba sabāre<br />gaura-bhakta kari’ bala e tina saṁsāre’ [37]
<span class="e2">vyakta</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–I will reveal <span class="e2">gūḍha-śāstra</span>–the hidden scriptures, <span class="e2">jānāba</span>–enlighten <span class="e2">sabāre</span>–everyone, [and] <span class="e2">kari’</span>–make <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">tina</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–the three worlds <span class="e2">gaura-bhakta</span>–devotees of Gaura! <span class="e2">bala’</span>–Please speak.’ [37]
“‘I will reveal hidden scriptures, enlighten everyone, and make every soul within the three worlds a devotee of Gaura! Please speak.’
রামানুজ-আগ্রহ দেখিয়া জগন্নাথ ।<br />বলে, ‘রামানুজ নাহি বল ঐছে বাত ॥৩৮॥
rāmānuja-āgraha dekhiyā jagannātha<br />bale, ‘rāmānuja nāhi bala aichhe bāta [38]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">rāmānuja-āgraha</span>–the eagerness of Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">jagannātha</span>–Jagannāth <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘rāmānuja</span>–‘O Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">bala nāhi</span>–do not speak <span class="e2">aichhe</span>–such <span class="e2">bāta</span>–words. [38]
“Seeing the eagerness of Rāmānuja, Jagannāth said, ‘O Rāmānuja, do not speak this way.
গৌরলীলা অতি গূঢ় রাখিবে গোপনে ।<br />সে লীলার অপ্রকটে পাবে সর্ব্বজনে ॥৩৯॥
gaura-līlā ati gūḍha rākhibe gopane<br />se līlāra aprakaṭe pābe sarva-jane [39]
<span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–The Pastimes of Gaura [are] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">gūḍha</span>–confidential; <span class="e2">rākhibe</span>–keep [them] <span class="e2">gopane</span>–secret. <span class="e2">sarva-jane</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">pābe</span>–will receive [those Pastimes] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">līlāra</span> <span class="e2">aprakaṭe</span>–when those Pastimes are unmanifest. [39]
“‘My Pastimes as Gaura are very confidential; keep them secret. Only after they are unmanifest will everyone receive them.
তুমি দাস্যরস মোর করহ প্রচার ।<br />নিজে নিজে চিত্তে গৌর ভজ অনিবার’ ॥৪০॥
tumi dāsya-rasa mora karaha prachāra<br />nije nije chitte gaura bhaja anibāra’ [40]
<span class="e2">tumi prachāra karaha</span>–Preach <span class="e2">dāsya-rasa</span>–about servitorship <span class="e2">mora</span>–to Me, [and] <span class="e2">anibāra</span>–always <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">nije</span> <span class="e2">nije</span> <span class="e2">chitte’</span>–within your heart.’ [40]
“‘Preach dāsya-rasa, and always worship Gaura within your heart.’
সঙ্কেত পাইয়া রামানুজ মহাশয় ।<br />গোপনে শ্রীনবদ্বীপে হইল উদয় ॥৪১॥
saṅketa pāiyā rāmānuja mahāśaya<br />gopane śrī-navadvīpe ha-ila udaya [41]
<span class="e2">pāiyā</span>–Receiving <span class="e2">saṅketa</span>–this instruction, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Rāmānuja Āchārya <span class="e2">gopane</span>–secretly <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–arrived <span class="e2">śrī-navadvīpe</span>–in Śrī Nabadwīp. [41]
“Receiving this instruction, Rāmānuja Āchārya secretly came to Nabadwīp.
পাছে ব্যক্ত হয় গৌরলীলা অসময়ে ।<br />সে কারণে রামানুজে বিশ্বক্সেন লয়ে ॥৪২॥
পরব্যোম শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠপুরীতে রাখয় ।<br />এই স্থান দেখি’ রামানুজ মুগ্ধ হয় ॥৪৩॥
pāchhe vyakta haya gaura-līlā asamaye<br />se kāraṇe rāmānuje viśvaksena laye [42]
paravyoma śrī-vaikuṇṭha-purīte rākhaya<br />ei sthāna dekhi’ rāmānuja mugdha haya [43]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">kāraṇe pāchhe</span>–So that <span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–the Pastimes of Gaura [did not] <span class="e2">vyakta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–manifest <span class="e2">asamaye</span>–untimely, <span class="e2">viśvaksena</span>–Nārāyaṇ <span class="e2">laye</span>–took <span class="e2">rāmānuje</span>–Rāmānuja [and] <span class="e2">rākhaya</span>–kept [him] <span class="e2">paravyoma</span> <span class="e2">śrī-vaikuṇṭha-purīte</span>–in Paravyoma Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja <span class="e2">haya</span>–was <span class="e2">mugdha</span>–charmed. [42<span class="e2">–</span>43]
“So that the Pastimes of Gaura were not manifest prematurely, Nārāyaṇ took Rāmānuja and kept him in Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur. Seeing this place, Rāmānuja was charmed.
শ্রীভূলীলা-নিষেবিত পরব্যোমপতি ।<br />দেখা দিল রামানুজে কৃপা করি’ অতি ॥৪৪॥
śrī-bhū-līlā-niṣevita paravyoma-pati<br />dekhā dila rāmānuje kṛpā kari’ ati [44]
<span class="e2">paravyoma-pati</span>–The Lord of the spiritual world, [who is] <span class="e2">śrī-bhū-līlā-niṣevita</span>–served by the śrī, bhū, and līlā energies, <span class="e2">ati kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari</span>–very mercifully <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [Himself] <span class="e2">rāmānuje</span>–to Rāmānuja. [44]
“Nārāyaṇ, who is served by His śrī, bhū, and līlā energies, then very mercifully revealed Himself to Rāmānuja.
রামানুজ নিজ ইষ্টদেবের দর্শনে ।<br />আপনারে ধন্য মানি’ গণে মনে মনে ॥৪৫॥
rāmānuja nija iṣṭa-devera darśane<br />āpanāre dhanya māni’ gaṇe mane mane [45]
<span class="e2">darśane</span>–By seeing <span class="e2">nija</span>–His <span class="e2">iṣṭa-devera</span>–worshippable Lord, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja <span class="e2">māni’</span> <span class="e2">gaṇe</span>–felt <span class="e2">āpanāre</span>–himself <span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within [his] heart [to be] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate. [45]
“Seeing His worshippable Lord, Rāmānuja felt himself to be most fortunate.
ক্ষণেকে লক্ষ্মণ দেখে পুরটসুন্দর ।<br />জগন্নাথমিশ্রসুত-রূপ মনোহর ॥৪৬॥
kṣaṇeke lakṣmaṇa dekhe puraṭa-sundara<br />jagannātha-miśra-suta-rūpa manohara [46]
<span class="e2">lakṣmaṇa</span>–Rāmānuja [then] <span class="e2">kṣaṇeke</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">manohara puraṭa-sundara</span>–the beautiful, enchanting, golden <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">jagannātha-miśra-suta</span>–of the son of Jagannāth Miśra. [46]
“Rāmānuja then suddenly saw the beautiful, enchanting, golden form of the son of Jagannāth Miśra.
রূপের ছটায় রামানুজ মূর্চ্ছা যায় ।<br />শ্রীগৌর ধরিল পদ তাঁহার মাথায় ॥৪৭॥
rūpera chhaṭāya rāmānuja mūrchchhā yāya<br />śrī-gaura dharila pada tā̐hāra māthāya [47]
<span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja <span class="e2">mūrchchhā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–fainted <span class="e2">rūpera</span> <span class="e2">chhaṭāya</span>–in the lustre of [this] form, [and] <span class="e2">śrī-gaura</span>–Śrī Gaura <span class="e2">dharila</span>–put [His] <span class="e2">pada</span>–feet <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">māthāya</span>–on his head. [47]
“Rāmānuja fainted in the lustre of the Lord’s form, and Śrī Gaura put His feet on Rāmānuja’s head.
দিব্যজ্ঞানে রামানুজ করিল স্তবন ।<br />‘নদীয়া প্রকট-লীলা পাব দরশন’ ॥৪৮॥
divya-jñāne rāmānuja karila stavana<br />‘nadīyā prakaṭa-līlā pāba daraśana’ [48]
<span class="e2">divya-jñāne</span>–With divine knowledge, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja <span class="e2">stavana karila</span>–prayed, <span class="e2">‘daraśana pāba</span>–‘May I behold [Your] <span class="e2">prakaṭa-līlā</span>–manifest Pastimes <span class="e2">nadīyā’</span>–in Nadia.’ [48]
“With divine knowledge, Rāmānuja then prayed, ‘May I behold Your manifest Pastimes in Nadia.’
এই বলি’ প্রেমে কাঁদে রামানুজস্বামী ।<br />বলে, ‘নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি’ নাই যাব আমি’ ॥৪৯॥
ei bali’ preme kā̐de rāmānuja-svāmī<br />bale, ‘navadvīpa chhāḍi’ nāhi yāba āmi’ [49]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">ei</span>–this, <span class="e2">rāmānuja-svāmī</span>–the master Rāmānuja <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cried <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. <span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">yāba nāhi</span>–will not leave <span class="e2">navadvīpa’</span>–Nabadwīp.’ [49]
“Saying this, Rāmānuja cried with divine love. Then he said, ‘I will not leave Nabadwīp.’
কৃপা করি’ গৌরহরি বলিল বচন ।<br />‘পূর্ণ হবে ইচ্ছা তব কেশবনন্দন ॥৫০॥
kṛpā kari’ gaurahari balila vachana<br />‘pūrṇa habe ichchhā tava keśava-nandana [50]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">vachana balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘keśava-nandana</span>–‘O Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">ichchhā</span>–desires <span class="e2">pūrṇa</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be fulfilled. [50]
“Mercifully, Gaurahari said, ‘O Rāmānuja, your desires will be fulfilled.
যে কালে নদীয়ালীলা প্রকট হইবে ।<br />তখন দ্বিতীয় জন্ম নবদ্বীপে পাবে’ ॥৫১॥
ye kāle nadīyā-līlā prakaṭa ha-ibe<br />takhana dvitīya janma navadvīpe pābe’ [51]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–When [My] <span class="e2">nadīyā-līlā</span>–Pastimes in Nadia <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–manifest, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain [your] <span class="e2">dvitīya</span>–second <span class="e2">janma</span>–birth <span class="e2">navadvīpe’</span>–in Nabadwīp.’ [51]
“‘When My Pastimes in Nadia manifest, you will be born again in Nabadwīp.’
এই বলি’ গৌরহরি হৈল অন্তর্দ্ধান ।<br />স্বস্থ হয়ে রামানুজ করিল প্রয়াণ ॥৫২॥
ei bali’ gaurahari haila antardhāna<br />svastha haye rāmānuja karila prayāṇa [52]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">ei</span>–this, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">antardhāna haila</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">svastha</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–Satisfied, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja <span class="e2">prayāṇa karila</span>–departed. [52]
“Saying this, Gaurahari disappeared. Satisfied, Rāmānuja departed.
কতদিনে কূর্ম্মস্থানে হৈল উপস্থিত ।<br />তথা দেখা হৈল শিষ্যগণের সহিত ॥৫৩॥
kata-dine kūrma-sthāne haila upasthita<br />tathā dekhā haila śiṣya-gaṇera sahita [53]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">upasthita haila</span>–Rāmānuja arrived <span class="e2">kūrma-sthāne</span>–in Kūrma Sthān [and] <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–met <span class="e2">sahita</span>–with [his] <span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇera</span>–disciples <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there. [53]
“Eventually, Rāmānuja arrived in Kūrma Sthān and met his disciples there.
দাক্ষিণাত্যে গিয়া দাস্যরস ব্যক্ত করে ।<br />নবদ্বীপ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ ভাবিয়া অন্তরে ॥৫৪॥
dākṣiṇātye giyā dāsya-rasa vyakta kare<br />navadvīpa śrī-gaurāṅga bhāviyā antare [54]
<span class="e2">giyā</span>–He proceeded <span class="e2">dākṣiṇātye</span>–south [and] <span class="e2">vyakta</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–preached <span class="e2">dāsya-rasa</span>–about servitorship, <span class="e2">bhāviyā</span>–thinking <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">antare</span>–within [his] heart. [54]
“He proceeded south and preached about dāsya-rasa while thinking of Nabadwīp and Śrī Gaurāṅga within His heart.
গৌরাঙ্গের কৃপাবশে এই নিত্যধামে ।<br />জনমিল রামানুজ শ্রীঅনন্ত নামে” ॥৫৫॥
gaurāṅgera kṛpā-vaśe ei nitya-dhāme<br />janamila rāmānuja śrī-ananta nāme” [55]
<span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span> <span class="e2">kṛpā-vaśe</span>–By the mercy of Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja <span class="e2">janamila</span>–took birth <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nitya-dhāme</span>–in this eternal abode <span class="e2">nāme</span>–under the name <span class="e2">śrī-ananta”</span>–Śrī Ananta.” [55]
“By the mercy of Gaurāṅga, Rāmānuja took birth in this eternal abode as Śrī Ananta Āchārya.”
বল্লভ-আচার্য্য-গৃহে করিয়া গমন ।<br />লক্ষ্মী-গৌরাঙ্গের বিভা করে দরশন ॥৫৬॥
vallabha-āchārya-gṛhe kariyā gamana<br />lakṣmī-gaurāṅgera vibhā kare daraśana [56]
<span class="e2">gamana kariyā</span>–The party [then] went <span class="e2">vallabha-āchārya-gṛhe</span>–to the home of Vallabha Āchārya [and] <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–saw [the site of] <span class="e2">lakṣmī-gaurāṅgera</span>–Lakṣmī and Gaurāṅga’s <span class="e2">vibhā</span>–marriage. [56]
The party then went to the home of Vallabha Āchārya and saw the site of Lakṣmī and Gaurāṅga’s marriage.
“অনন্তের গৃহস্থান দেখ ভক্তগণ ।<br />হেথা নারায়ণভক্ত ছিল বহুজন ॥৫৭॥
“anantera gṛha-sthāna dekha bhakta-gaṇa<br />hethā nārāyaṇa-bhakta chhila bahu-jana [57]
<span class="e2">“bhakta-gaṇa</span>–“O devotees, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">anantera</span> <span class="e2">gṛha-sthāna</span>–the site of Ananta’s home. <span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–there were <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa-bhakta bahu-jana</span>–many devotees of Nārāyaṇ. [57]
“O devotees, see the site of Ananta Āchārya’s home. Here, there were many devotees of Nārāyaṇ.
তাৎকালিক রাজগণ এই পীঠস্থানে ।<br />নারায়ণ-সেবা প্রকাশিল সবে জানে” ॥৫৮॥
tāt-kālika rāja-gaṇa ei pīṭha-sthāne<br />nārāyaṇa-sevā prakāśila sabe jāne” [58]
<span class="e2">sabe</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows [that] <span class="e2">rāja-gaṇa</span>–the king <span class="e2">tāt-kālika</span>–of that time <span class="e2">sevā</span> <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–established worship <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa</span>–of Nārāyān <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">pīṭha-sthāne”</span>–in this place.” [58]
“Everyone knows that the king of that time established worship of Nārāyaṇ in this place.”
নিঃশ্রেয়স বন এই বিরজার পার ।<br />ভক্তগণ দেখি পায় আনন্দ অপার ॥৫৯॥
niḥśreyasa vana ei virajāra pāra<br />bhakta-gaṇa dekhi’ pāya ānanda apāra [59]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">niḥśreyasa</span> <span class="e2">vana</span>–the Niḥśreyasa forest <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">virajāra</span> <span class="e2">pāra</span>–on the bank of the Virajā River, <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">pāya</span>–felt <span class="e2">apāra</span>–unlimited <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–joy. [59]
Seeing the Niḥśreyasa forest on the bank of the Virajā River, the devotees felt unlimited joy.
এই রূপ পূর্ব্বকথা বলিতে বলিতে ।<br />সবে উপনীত মহৎপুর সন্নিহিতে ॥৬০॥
ei rūpa pūrva-kathā balite balite<br />sabe upanīta mahatpura sannihite [60]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–While speaking <span class="e2">pūrva-kathā</span>–about the past <span class="e2">ei rūpa</span>–in this way, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">upanīta</span>–arrived <span class="e2">sannihite</span>–in <span class="e2">mahatpura</span>–Mahatpur. [60]
While discussing this history, the devotees arrived in Mahatpur.
প্রভু বলে, “এই স্থানে আছে কাম্যবন ।<br />পরম ভকতি সহ কর দরশন ॥৬১॥
prabhu bale, “ei sthāne āchhe kāmyavana<br />parama bhakati saha kara daraśana [61]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“kāmyavana</span>–“Kāmyavan <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is present <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. <span class="e2">daraśana kara</span>–Visit [it] <span class="e2">saha</span>–with <span class="e2">parama</span>–great <span class="e2">bhakati</span>–devotion. [61]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Kāmyavan is present here. Visit it with great devotion.
পঞ্চবট এই স্থানে ছিল পূর্ব্ব কালে ।<br />প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় এবে গেল অন্তরালে ॥৬২॥
pañcha-vaṭa ei sthāne chhila pūrva kāle<br />prabhura ichchhāya ebe gela antarāle [62]
<span class="e2">pūrva</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–Previously, <span class="e2">chhila</span>–there were <span class="e2">pañcha-vaṭa</span>–five banyan trees <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here, [but] <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–by the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">antarāle gela</span>–they have disappeared <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now. [62]
“Previously, there were five banyan trees here, but by the will of the Lord, they have since disappeared.
এবে এই স্থানে মাতাপুর নাম কয় ।<br />পূর্ব্ব নাম শাস্ত্রসিদ্ধ মহৎপুর হয় ॥৬৩॥
ebe ei sthāna mātāpura nāma kaya<br />pūrva nāma śāstra-siddha mahatpura haya [63]
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now, <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–this place <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">kaya</span>–is called <span class="e2">mātāpura</span>–Mātāpur. <span class="e2">śāstra-siddha</span>–The scriptures state [its] <span class="e2">pūrva</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–previous name <span class="e2">haya</span>–was <span class="e2">mahatpura</span>–Mahatpur. [63]
“This place is now called Mātāpur. The scriptures state that its previous name was Mahatpur.
দ্রৌপদীর সহ পাণ্ডুপুত্র পঞ্চজন ।<br />অজ্ঞাতবাসেতে গৌড়ে কৈল আগমন ॥৬৪॥
draupadīra saha pāṇḍu-putra pañcha-jana<br />ajñāta-vāsete gauḍe kaila āgamana [64]
<span class="e2">pāṇḍu-putra pañcha-jana</span>–The five Pāṇḍavas <span class="e2">āgamana kaila</span>–came <span class="e2">gauḍe</span>–to Gauḍa <span class="e2">draupadīra</span> <span class="e2">saha</span>–with Draupadī <span class="e2">ajñāta-vāsete</span>–to live incognito. [64]
“Once, the five Pāṇḍavas came to Gauḍa with Draupadī to live incognito.
একচক্রা-গ্রামে স্বপ্নে রাজা যুধিষ্ঠির ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য জানি’ হইল অস্থির ॥৬৫॥
ekachakrā-grāme svapne rājā yudhiṣṭhira<br />nadīyā-māhātmya jāni’ ha-ila asthira [65]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Understanding <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia <span class="e2">svapne</span>–through a dream <span class="e2">ekachakrā-grāme</span>–in the village of Ekachakrā, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–King <span class="e2">yudhiṣṭhira</span>–Yudhiṣṭhir <span class="e2">asthira ha-ila</span>–became amazed. [65]
“Understanding the glories of Nadia through a dream in Ekachakrā, Mahārāj Yudhiṣṭhir became amazed.
পরদিন নবদ্বীপ দর্শনের আশে ।<br />এই স্থানে আইল সবে পরম উল্লাসে ॥৬৬॥
para-dina navadvīpa darśanera āśe<br />ei sthāne āila sabe parama ullāse [66]
<span class="e2">darśanera</span> <span class="e2">āśe</span>–With the desire to see <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–the Pāṇḍavas <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">para-dina</span>–the next day <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ullāse</span>–with great joy. [66]
“Desiring to see Nabadwīp, the Pāṇḍavas came here the next day with great joy.
নবদ্বীপ-শোভা হেরি’ পাণ্ডুপুত্রগণ ।<br />গৌড়বাসিগণ-ভাগ্য করে প্রশংসন ॥৬৭॥
navadvīpa-śobhā heri’ pāṇḍu-putra-gaṇa<br />gauḍa-vāsi-gaṇa-bhāgya kare praśaṁsana [67]
<span class="e2">heri’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">navadvīpa-śobhā</span>–the beauty of Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">pāṇḍu-putra-gaṇa</span>–the Pāṇḍavas <span class="e2">praśaṁsana kare</span>–praised <span class="e2">gauḍa-vāsi-gaṇa-bhāgya</span>–the fortune of the residents of Gauḍa. [67]
“Seeing the beauty of Nabadwīp, the Pāṇḍavas praised the fortune of the residents of Gauḍa.
কতদিন করিলেন এই স্থানে বাস ।<br />অসুর-রাক্ষসগণে করিল বিনাশ ॥৬৮॥
kata-dina karilena ei sthāne vāsa<br />asura-rākṣasa-gaṇe karila vināśa [68]
<span class="e2">vāsa karilena</span>–They stayed <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time [and] <span class="e2">vināśa karila</span>–killed <span class="e2">asura-rākṣasa-gaṇe</span>–various demons. [68]
“They stayed here for some time and killed various demons.
যুধিষ্ঠির-টিলা এই দেখ সর্ব্বজন ।<br />দ্রৌপদীর কুণ্ড হেথা কর দরশন ॥৬৯॥
yudhiṣṭhira-ṭilā ei dekha sarva-jana<br />draupadīra kuṇḍa hethā kare daraśana [69]
<span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–Everyone,<span class="e2"> dekha</span>–see<span class="e2"> ei</span>–there<span class="e2"> yudhiṣṭhira-ṭilā</span>–Yudhiṣṭhir Ṭilā. <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–See <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">draupadīra</span> <span class="e2">kuṇḍa</span>–the pond of Draupadī. [69]
“Everyone, see there Yudhiṣṭhir Ṭilā. See here the pond of Draupadī.
স্থানের মাহাত্ম্য জানি’ রাজা যুধিষ্ঠির ।<br />এই স্থানে কতদিন হইলেন স্থির ॥৭০॥
sthānera māhātmya jāni’ rājā yudhiṣṭhira<br />ei sthāne kata-dina ha-ilena sthira [70]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Understanding <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories <span class="e2">sthānera</span>–of this place, <span class="e2">rājā</span>–King <span class="e2">yudhiṣṭhira</span>–Yudhiṣṭhir <span class="e2">sthira ha-ilena</span>–stayed <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time. [70]
“Understanding the glories of this place, Mahārāj Yudhiṣṭhir stayed here for some time.
একদিন স্বপ্নে দেখে গৌরাঙ্গের রূপ ।<br />সর্ব্বদিক আলো করে অতি অপরূপ ॥৭১॥
eka-dina svapne dekhe gaurāṅgera rūpa<br />sarva-dika ālo kare ati aparūpa [71]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">svapne</span>–in a dream, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–he saw [the] <span class="e2">ati aparūpa</span>–extraordinary <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">ālo</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–illuminate <span class="e2">sarva-dika</span>–all directions. [71]
“One day, in a dream, he saw the extraordinary form of Gaurāṅga illuminate all directions.
হাসিতে হাসিতে গৌর বলিল বচন ।<br />‘অতি গোপ্য রূপ এই কর দরশন ॥৭২॥
hāsite hāsite gaura balila vachana<br />‘ati gopya rūpa ei kara daraśana [72]
<span class="e2">hāsite</span> <span class="e2">hāsite</span>–Smiling, <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">vachana balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘daraśana kara</span>–‘Behold <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">gopya</span>–secret <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form. [72]
“Smiling, Gaurāṅga said, ‘Behold this very secret form.
আমি কৃষ্ণ নন্দসুত তোমার আলয়ে ।<br />মিত্রভাবে থাকি সদা নিজজন হয়ে ॥৭৩॥
āmi kṛṣṇa nanda-suta tomāra ālaye<br />mitra-bhāve thāki sadā nija-jana haye [73]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">nanda-suta</span>–the son of Nanda, [and] <span class="e2">thāki</span>–I stay <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">ālaye</span>–in your house <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">mitra-bhāve</span> <span class="e2">nija-jana</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–as your friendly companion. [73]
“‘I am Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda, and I always stay in your house as your friendly companion.
এই নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বধাম-সার ।<br />কলিতে প্রকট হয়ে নাশে অন্ধকার ॥৭৪॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />kalite prakaṭa haye nāśe andhakāra [74]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [is] <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–the best of all abodes. <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–It will manifest <span class="e2">kalite</span>–during Kali-yuga [and] <span class="e2">nāśe</span>–dispel [all] <span class="e2">andhakāra</span>–darkness. [74]
“‘Nabadwīp Dhām is the best of all abodes. It will manifest during Kali-yuga and dispel all darkness.
তুমি সবে আছ চিরকাল দাস মম ।<br />আমার প্রকটকালে পাইবে জনম ॥৭৫॥
tumi sabe āchha chira-kāla dāsa mama<br />āmāra prakaṭa-kāle pāibe janama [75]
<span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–You all <span class="e2">āchha</span>–are <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">chira-kāla</span>–eternal <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants, [and] <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">prakaṭa-kāle</span>–at the time of My appearance, <span class="e2">janama pāibe</span>–you will take birth. [75]
“‘You are all My eternal servants, and when I appear, you will also take birth.
উৎকল দেশেতে সিন্ধুতীরে তোমা সহ ।<br />একত্রে পুরুষোত্তমে রব অহঃরহঃ ॥৭৬॥
utkala deśete sindhu-tīre tomā saha<br />ekatre puruṣottame raba ahaḥ-rahaḥ [76]
<span class="e2">raba</span>–I will live <span class="e2">ekatre</span>–together <span class="e2">tomā</span> <span class="e2">saha</span>–with you <span class="e2">ahaḥ-rahaḥ</span>–permanently <span class="e2">puruṣottame</span>–in Jagannāth Purī <span class="e2">sindhu-tīre</span>–on the bank of the ocean <span class="e2">utkala</span> <span class="e2">deśete</span>–in Odisha. [76]
“‘I will live with you permanently in Puruṣottam Kṣetra on the bank of the ocean in Odisha.
এই স্থান হৈতে এবে যাহ ওড্র-দেশ ।<br />সে দেশ পবিত্র করি’ নাশ জীব-ক্লেশ’ ॥৭৭॥
ei sthāna haite ebe yāha oḍra-deśa<br />se deśa pavitra kari’ nāśa jīva-kleśa’ [77]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–here, <span class="e2">yāha</span>–go <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">oḍra-deśa</span>–to Odisha, <span class="e2">pavitra</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–purify <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">deśa</span>–the country, [and] <span class="e2">nāśa</span>–remove <span class="e2">jīva-kleśa’</span>–the sorrow of the souls’. [77]
“‘From here, go to Odisha, purify the country, and remove the sorrow of the people.’
স্বপ্ন দেখি’ যুধিষ্ঠির ভ্রাতৃগণে বলে ।<br />যুক্তি করি’ ছয়-জনে ওড্র-দেশে চলে ॥৭৮॥
svapna dekhi’ yudhiṣṭhira bhrātṛ-gaṇe bale<br />yukti kari’ chhaya-jane oḍra-deśe chale [78]
<span class="e2">svapna</span> <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–After having this dream, <span class="e2">yudhiṣṭhira</span>–Yudhiṣṭhir <span class="e2">bale</span>–spoke <span class="e2">bhrātṛ-gaṇe</span>–to [his] brothers. <span class="e2">chhaya-jane</span>–The six of them <span class="e2">yukti</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–consulted [and then] <span class="e2">chale</span>–went <span class="e2">oḍra-deśe</span>–to Odisha. [78]
“After having this dream, Yudhiṣṭhir spoke to his brothers. They consulted with Draupadī and then went to Odisha.
নবদ্বীপ ছাড়িতে হৈল বড় ক্লেশ ।<br />তথাপি পালন করে প্রভুর আদেশ ॥৭৯॥
navadvīpa chhāḍite haila baḍa kleśa<br />tathāpi pālana kare prabhura ādeśa [79]
<span class="e2">baḍa kleśa haila</span>–They felt great sorrow <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–to leave <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">pālana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–they followed <span class="e2">ādeśa</span>–the order <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord. [79]
“They felt great sorrow to leave Nabadwīp. Still, they followed the order of the Lord.
এই স্থানে মধ্বমুনি শিষ্যগণ লয়ে ।<br />রহিলেন কতদিন ধামবাসী হয়ে ॥৮০॥
ei sthāne madhva-muni śiṣya-gaṇa laye<br />rahilena kata-dina dhāma-vāsī haye [80]
<span class="e2">madhva-muni</span>–Madhva Āchārya <span class="e2">rahilena</span>–stayed <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [his] <span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇa</span>–disciples <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time <span class="e2">dhāma-vāsī</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–as a resident of the Dhām. [80]
“Madhva Āchārya also stayed here with his disciples for some time as a resident of the Dhām.
মধ্বের করিয়া কৃপা গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।<br />স্বপ্নে দেখাইল রূপ অতি মনোহর ॥৮১॥
madhvere kariyā kṛpā gaurāṅgasundara<br />svapne dekhāila rūpa ati manohara [81]
<span class="e2">gaurāṅgasundara</span>–Gaurāṅgasundar <span class="e2">kariyā</span> <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">dekhāila</span>–revealed [His] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">manohara</span>–most enchanting <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">madhvere</span>–to Madhva <span class="e2">svapne</span>–in a dream. [81]
“Gaurāṅgasundar mercifully revealed His most enchanting form to Madhva Āchārya in a dream.
হাসি’ হাসি’ গৌরচন্দ্র মধ্বাচার্য্যে বলে ।<br />‘তুমি নিত্যদাস মম জানে ত সকলে ॥৮২॥
hāsi’ hāsi’ gaurachandra madhvāchārye bale<br />‘tumi nitya-dāsa mama jāne ta sakale [82]
<span class="e2">hāsi’</span> <span class="e2">hāsi’</span>–Smiling, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">bale</span>–said <span class="e2">madhvāchārye</span>–to Madhva Āchārya, <span class="e2">‘sakale</span>–‘Everyone <span class="e2">ta jāne</span>–knows [that] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">nitya-dāsa</span>–eternal servant. [82]
“Smiling, Gaurachandra said to Madhva Āchārya, ‘Everyone knows that you are My eternal servant.
নবদ্বীপে যবে আমি প্রকট হইব ।<br />তব সম্প্রদায় আমি স্বীকার করিব ॥৮৩॥
navadvīpe yabe āmi prakaṭa ha-iba<br />tava sampradāya āmi svīkāra kariba [83]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iba</span>–appear <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">svīkāra</span> <span class="e2">kariba</span>–will follow <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">sampradāya</span>–lineage. [83]
“‘When I appear in Nabadwīp, I will follow your lineage.
এবে সর্ব্বদেশে তুমি করিয়া যতন ।<br />মায়াবাদ অসচ্ছাস্ত্র কর উৎপাটন ॥৮৪॥
শ্রীমূর্ত্তিমাহাত্ম্য তুমি কর পরকাশ ।<br />তব শুদ্ধ মত আমি করিব বিকাশ’ ॥৮৫॥
ebe sarva-deśe tumi kariyā yatana<br />māyāvāda asach-chhāstra kara utpāṭana [84]
śrī-mūrti-māhātmya tumi kara parakāśa<br />tava śuddha mata āmi kariba vikāśa’ [85]
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">yatana kariyā</span>–carefully <span class="e2">utpāṭana kara</span>–eradicate <span class="e2">māyāvāda</span>–illusionism [and] <span class="e2">asach-chhāstra</span>–false scriptures <span class="e2">sarva-deśe</span>–from all regions, [and] <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">parakāśa kara</span>–establish <span class="e2">śrī-mūrti-māhātmya</span>–the glory of [the Lord’s] Deity form. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">vikāśa kariba</span>–will develop <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure <span class="e2">mata’</span>–conception.’ [84–85]
“‘Now, carefully eradicate illusionism and false scriptures from all regions, and establish the glory of the Lord’s Deity form. Later, I will develop your pure conception.’
এত বলি’ গৌরচন্দ্র হৈল অন্তর্দ্ধান ।<br />নিদ্রা ভাঙ্গি’ মধ্বমুনি হইল অজ্ঞান ॥৮৬॥
eta bali’ gaurachandra haila antardhāna<br />nidrā bhāṅgi’ madhva-muni ha-ila ajñāna [86]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">antardhāna haila</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">madhva-muni</span>–Madhva Āchārya <span class="e2">nidrā</span> <span class="e2">bhāṅgi’</span>–awoke [and then] <span class="e2">ajñāna ha-ila</span>–fainted. [86]
“Saying this, Gaurachandra disappeared. Madhva Āchārya awoke and then fainted.
‘আর কি দেখিব রূপ পুরটসুন্দর’ ।<br />বলিয়া ক্রন্দন করে মধ্ব অতঃপর ॥৮৭॥
‘āra ki dekhiba rūpa puraṭa-sundara’<br />baliyā krandana kare madhva ataḥpara [87]
<span class="e2">madhva</span>–Madhva <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–then <span class="e2">krandana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–cried, <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–wondering, <span class="e2">‘ki</span> <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–‘Will I ever see [that] <span class="e2">puraṭa-sundara</span>–beautiful golden <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">āra’</span>–again?’ [87]
“Madhva Āchārya then cried, wondering, ‘Will I ever see that beautiful golden form again?’
দৈববাণী হৈল তবে নির্ম্মল আকাশে ।<br />‘আমারে গোপনে ভজি’ আইস মম পাশে’ ॥৮৮॥
daiva-vāṇī haila tabe nirmala ākāśe<br />‘āmāre gopane bhaji’ āisa mama pāśe’ [88]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">daiva-vāṇī</span>–a divine voice <span class="e2">haila</span>–came <span class="e2">nirmala</span> <span class="e2">ākāśe</span>–from the clear sky, <span class="e2">‘bhaji’</span>–‘Serve <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–Me <span class="e2">gopane</span>–secretly, [and] <span class="e2">āisa</span>–you will come <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">pāśe’</span>–to My side.’ [88]
“Then a divine voice came from the clear sky, ‘Serve Me secretly, and you will come to Me.’
সুস্থির হইয়া মধ্বাচার্য্য মহাশয় ।<br />মায়াবাদী দিগ্বিজয়ে করিল বিজয়” ॥৮৯॥
susthira ha-iyā madhvāchārya mahāśaya<br />māyāvādī digvijaye karila vijaya” [89]
<span class="e2">madhvāchārya</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Madhva Āchārya <span class="e2">susthira</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–became resolute [and] <span class="e2">vijaya karila</span>–defeated <span class="e2">māyāvādī</span>–the illusionists <span class="e2">digvijaye”</span>–during His tour in all directions.” [89]
“Madhva Āchārya became resolute and defeated the māyāvādīs in all directions.”
এই সব পূর্ব্বকথা বলিতে বলিতে ।<br />রুদ্রদ্বীপে উপনীত দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥৯০॥
ei saba pūrva-kathā balite balite<br />rudradvīpe upanīta dekhite dekhite [90]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–As Nityānanda spoke <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">pūrva-kathā</span>–about all this history, <span class="e2">upanīta</span>–the devotees arrived <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">rudradvīpe</span>–in Rudradwīp. [90]
As Nityānanda Prabhu spoke about all this history, the devotees suddenly arrived in Rudradwīp.
প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “এই রুদ্রখণ্ড ।<br />ভাগীরথী প্রভাবে হইল দুই খণ্ড ॥৯১॥
prabhu nityānanda bale, “ei rudra-khaṇḍa<br />bhāgīrathī prabhāve ha-ila dui khaṇḍa [91]
<span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ei</span>–“This [is] <span class="e2">rudra-khaṇḍa</span>–Rudradwīp. <span class="e2">khaṇḍa ha-ila</span>–It has been divided <span class="e2">dui</span>–in two <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span> <span class="e2">prabhāve</span>–by the Gaṅgā’s influence. [91]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “This is Rudradwīp. It has been divided into two parts by the Gaṅgā.
লোকবাস নাহি হেথা প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ।<br />পশ্চিমের দ্বীপ দেখ পূর্ব্বপারে যায় ॥৯২॥
loka-vāsa nāhi hethā prabhura ichchhāya<br />paśchimera dvīpa dekha pūrva-pāre yāya [92]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">loka-vāsa</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–people do not reside <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">dekha</span>–See [how] <span class="e2">paśchimera</span> <span class="e2">dvīpa</span>–this western island <span class="e2">yāya</span>–has gone <span class="e2">pūrva-pāre</span>–to the eastern bank. [92]
“By the will of the Lord, people do not live here. See that this western island has moved to the east bank of the river.
হেথা হৈতে দেখ ঐ শ্রীশঙ্করপুর ।<br />শোভা পায় গঙ্গাতীরে দেখ কত দূর ॥৯৩॥
hethā haite dekha ai śrī-śaṅkarapura<br />śobhā pāya gaṅgā-tīre dekha kata dūra [93]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">ai</span>–there <span class="e2">śrī-śaṅkarapura</span>–Śrī Śaṅkarpur. <span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dūra</span>–how far <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–it shines <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span>–along the bank of the Gaṅgā. [93]
“From here, see Śrī Śaṅkarpur. See how far it shines along the bank of the Gaṅgā.
শঙ্কর আচার্য্য যবে করে দিগ্বিজয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপ জয়ে তথা উপস্থিত হয় ॥৯৪॥
śaṅkara āchārya yabe kare digvijaya<br />navadvīpa jaye tathā upasthita haya [94]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">śaṅkara</span> <span class="e2">āchārya</span>–Śaṅkar Āchārya <span class="e2">digvijaya kare</span>–was conquering all directions, <span class="e2">upasthita</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–he came <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">jaye</span>–to conquer <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp. [94]
“When Śaṅkar Āchārya was conquering all directions, he came there to conquer Nabadwīp.
মনেতে বৈষ্ণবরাজ আচার্য্য শঙ্কর ।<br />বাহিরে অদ্বৈতবাদী মায়ার কিঙ্কর ॥৯৫॥
manete vaiṣṇava-rāja āchārya śaṅkara<br />bāhire advaitavādī māyāra kiṅkara [95]
<span class="e2">manete</span>–At heart, <span class="e2">śaṅkara āchārya</span>–Śaṅkar Āchārya [was] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-rāja</span>–a great Vaiṣṇava; [only] <span class="e2">bāhire</span>–externally, [he was] <span class="e2">advaitavādī</span>–a nondualist [and] <span class="e2">māyāra</span> <span class="e2">kiṅkara</span>–servant of Māyā. [95]
“At heart, Śaṅkar Āchārya was a great Vaiṣṇava; only externally was he acting as a nondualist and servant of Māyā.
নিজে রুদ্র-অংশ সদা প্রতাপে প্রচুর ।<br />প্রচ্ছন্ন বৌদ্ধের মত প্রচারেতে শূর ॥৯৬॥
nije rudra-aṁśa sadā pratāpe prachura<br />prachchhanna bauddhera mata prachārete śūra [96]
<span class="e2">nije</span>–Personally, [he was a] <span class="e2">sadā prachura pratāpe</span>–highly and constantly empowered <span class="e2">rudra-aṁśa</span>–manifestation of Śiva [and] <span class="e2">śūra</span>–an expert <span class="e2">prachārete</span>–at preaching <span class="e2">mata</span>–a conception <span class="e2">prachchhanna</span> <span class="e2">bauddhera</span>–of veiled Buddhism. [96]
“He was a highly empowered manifestation of Śiva who was expert at preaching a conception of veiled Buddhism.
প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় রুদ্র এই কার্য্য করে ।<br />আইলেন যবে তেঁহ নদীয়া-নগরে ॥৯৭॥
স্বপ্নে প্রভু গৌরচন্দ্র দিলা দরশন ।<br />কৃপা করি’ বলে তারে মধুর বচন ॥৯৮॥
prabhura ājñāya rudra ei kārya kare<br />āilena yabe te̐ha nadīyā-nagare [97]
svapne prabhu gaurachandra dilā daraśana<br />kṛpā kari’ bale tāre madhura vachana [98]
