<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ājñāya</span>–According to the order of the Lord, <span class="e2">rudra</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">kārya</span>–duty. <span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–he <span class="e2">āilena</span>–came <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>-<span class="e2">nagare</span>–to the town of Nadia, <span class="e2">gaurachandra prabhu</span>–Lord Gaurachandra <span class="e2">daraśana dilā</span>–revealed [Himself] <span class="e2">svapne</span>–in a dream [and] <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">bale</span>–spoke <span class="e2">madhura</span>–sweet <span class="e2">vachana</span>–words <span class="e2">tāre</span>–to him. [97<span class="e2">–</span>98]
“According to the order of the Lord, Śiva performs this duty. When Śaṅkar Āchārya came to Nadia, Gaurachandra revealed Himself to Śaṅkar Āchārya in a dream and mercifully spoke sweet words to him.
‘তুমি ত আমার দাস মম আজ্ঞা ধরি’ ।<br />প্রচারিছ মায়াবাদ বহু যত্ন করি’ ॥৯৯॥
‘tumi ta āmāra dāsa mama ājñā dhari’<br />prachārichha māyāvāda bahu yatna kari’ [99]
<span class="e2">‘tumi</span>–‘You [are] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant, [and] <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–following <span class="e2">mama</span>–my <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–order, <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">yatna</span> <span class="e2">kari’ prachārichha</span>–you are very cleverly preaching <span class="e2">māyāvāda</span>–illusionism. [99]
“‘You are My servant, and following My order, you are very cleverly preaching illusionism.
এই নবদ্বীপধাম মম প্রিয় অতি ।<br />হেথা মায়াবাদ কভু না পাইবে গতি ॥১০০॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma mama priya ati<br />hethā māyāvāda kabhu nā pāibe gati [100]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [is] <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">ati priya</span>–very dear to Me, [and] <span class="e2">māyāvāda</span>–illusionism <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">pāibe nā</span>–will never have <span class="e2">gati</span>–a place <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [100]
“‘Nabadwīp Dhām is very dear to Me, and illusionism will never have a place here.
বৃদ্ধশিব হেথা প্রৌঢ়ামায়ারে লইয়া ।<br />কল্পিত আগমগণে দেন প্রচারিয়া ॥১০১॥
vṛddha-śiva hethā prauḍhā-māyāre la-iyā<br />kalpita āgama-gaṇe dena prachāriyā [101]
<span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">vṛddha-śiva</span>–Vṛddha Śiva, <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–with <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyāre</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā <span class="e2">prachāriyā dena</span>–propagate <span class="e2">kalpita</span>–imaginary interpretations <span class="e2">āgama-gaṇe</span>–of the scriptures. [101]
“‘Here, Vṛddha Śiva and Prauḍhā Māyā propagate imaginary interpretations of the scriptures.
মম ভক্তগণে দ্বেষ করে যেই জন ।<br />তাহারে কেবল তেঁহ করেন বঞ্চন ॥১০২॥
mama bhakta-gaṇe dveṣa kare yei jana<br />tāhāre kevala te̐ha karena vañchana [102]
<span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–They <span class="e2">vañchana karena</span>–deceive <span class="e2">kevala</span>–only <span class="e2">tāhāre yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–those who <span class="e2">dveṣa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–oppose <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇe</span>–devotees. [102]
“‘They deceive, however, only those who oppose My devotees.
এই স্থানে সাধারণে মম ভক্ত হয় ।<br />দুষ্টমত প্রচারের স্থান ইহা নয় ॥১০৩॥
ei sthāne sādhāraṇe mama bhakta haya<br />duṣṭa-mata prachārera sthāna ihā naya [103]
<span class="e2">sādhāraṇe</span>–In general, <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotees <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. <span class="e2">ihā</span>–This place <span class="e2">naya</span>–is not <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–a place <span class="e2">duṣṭa-mata</span> <span class="e2">prachārera</span>–for preaching misconception. [103]
“‘In general, My devotees reside here. This place is not for preaching misconception.
অতএব তুমি কর অন্যত্র গমন ।<br />নবদ্বীপবাসিগণে না কর পীড়ন’ ॥১০৪॥
ataeva tumi kara anyatra gamana<br />navadvīpa-vāsi-gaṇe nā kara pīḍana’ [104]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">tumi gamana kara</span>–you should go <span class="e2">anyatra</span>–elsewhere. <span class="e2">pīḍana kara nā</span>–Do not trouble <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsi-gaṇe’</span>–the residents of Nabadwīp.’ [104]
“‘Therefore, you should go elsewhere. Do not trouble the residents of Nabadwīp.’
স্বপ্নে নবদ্বীপতত্ত্ব জানিয়া তখন ।<br />ভক্ত্যাবেশে অন্য দেশে করিল গমন ॥১০৫॥
svapne navadvīpa-tattva jāniyā takhana<br />bhaktyāveśe anya deśe karila gamana [105]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">jāniyā</span>–understanding <span class="e2">navadvīpa-tattva</span>–the position of Nabadwīp <span class="e2">svapne</span>–through [his] dream, <span class="e2">gamana karila</span>–he went <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">deśe</span>–elsewhere, <span class="e2">bhaktyāveśe</span>–inspired with devotion. [105]
“Understanding the position of Nabadwīp through this dream, Śaṅkar Āchārya went elsewhere, inspired with devotion.
এই রুদ্রদ্বীপে হয় রুদ্রগণস্থান ।<br />হেথা রুদ্রগণ গৌর-গুণ করে গান ॥১০৬॥
ei rudradvīpe haya rudra-gaṇa-sthāna<br />hethā rudra-gaṇa gaura-guṇa kare gāna [106]
<span class="e2">rudra-gaṇa-sthāna</span>–The place of the eleven Rudras <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">rudradvīpe</span>–in Rudradwīp. <span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">rudra-gaṇa</span>–the Rudras <span class="e2">gāna kare</span>–chant <span class="e2">gaura-guṇa</span>–the glories of Gaura. [106]
“The eleven Rudras reside here in Rudradwīp and chant the glories of Gaura.
শ্রীনীললোহিতরুদ্রগণ-অধিপতি ।<br />মহানন্দে নৃত্যে হেথা করে নিতি নিতি ॥১০৭॥
śrī-nīla-lohita-rudra-gaṇa-adhipati<br />mahānande nṛtya hethā kare niti niti [107]
<span class="e2">adhipati</span>–The leader <span class="e2">śrī-nīla-lohita-rudra-gaṇa</span>–of the Nīlalohita Rudras <span class="e2">niti</span> <span class="e2">niti</span>–always <span class="e2">nṛtya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–dances <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">mahānande</span>–with great joy. [107]
“Śrī Nīlalohita Śiva, the leader of the Nīlalohita Rudras, always dances here with great joy.
রুদ্র-নৃত্য দেখি’ আকাশেতে দেবগণ ।<br />আনন্দেতে করে সবে পুষ্পবরিষণ ॥১০৮॥
rudra-nṛtya dekhi’ ākāśete deva-gaṇa<br />ānandete kare sabe puṣpa-variṣaṇa [108]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">rudra-nṛtya</span>–the dancing of the Rudras, <span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–the gods <span class="e2">ākāśete</span>–in the sky <span class="e2">ānandete</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">puṣpa-variṣaṇa kare</span>–shower flowers <span class="e2">sabe</span>–upon them. [108]
“Seeing the dancing of the Rudras, the gods in the sky joyfully shower flowers upon them.
কদাচিৎ বিষ্ণুস্বামী আসি’ দিগ্বিজয়ে ।<br />রুদ্রদ্বীপে রহে রাত্রে শিষ্যগণ লয়ে ॥১০৯॥
kadāchit viṣṇu-svāmī āsi’ digvijaye<br />rudradvīpe rahe rātre śiṣya-gaṇa laye [109]
<span class="e2">kadāchit</span>–Once, <span class="e2">viṣṇu-svāmī</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī, <span class="e2">digvijaye</span>–while conquering all directions, <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">rudradvīpe</span>–to Rudradwīp <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [his] <span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇa</span>–disciples [and] <span class="e2">rahe</span>–stayed <span class="e2">rātre</span>–the night. [109]
“Once, Viṣṇu Swāmī, while conquering all directions, came to Rudradwīp with his disciples and stayed the night.
‘হরি হরি’ বলি’ নৃত্য করে শিষ্যগণ ।<br />বিষ্ণুস্বামী শ্রুতিস্তুতি করেন পঠন ॥১১০॥
‘hari hari’ bali’ nṛtya kare śiṣya-gaṇa<br />viṣṇu-svāmī śruti-stuti karena paṭhana [110]
<span class="e2">śiṣya-gaṇa</span>–The disciples <span class="e2">nṛtya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–danced, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanting <span class="e2">‘hari</span> <span class="e2">hari’</span>–‘Hari! Hari!’, [and] <span class="e2">viṣṇu-svāmī</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">śruti-stuti</span> <span class="e2">paṭhana karena</span>–recited prayers from the scriptures. [110]
“The disciples danced, chanting, ‘Hari! Hari!’, and Viṣṇu Swāmī recited prayers from the scriptures.
ভক্তি আলোচনা দেখি’ হয়ে হরষিত ।<br />কৃপা করি’ দেখা দিল শ্রীনীললোহিত ॥১১১॥
bhakti ālochanā dekhi’ haye haraṣita<br />kṛpā kari’ dekhā dila śrī-nīla-lohita [111]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotional <span class="e2">ālochanā</span>–discussion, <span class="e2">śrī-nīla-lohita</span>–Śrī Nīlalohita Śiva <span class="e2">haraṣita haye</span>–was pleased [and] <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [himself]. [111]
“Seeing this devotional discussion, Śrī Nīlalohita Śiva was pleased and mercifully revealed himself.
বৈষ্ণবসভায় রুদ্র হৈল উপনীত ।<br />দেখি’ বিষ্ণুস্বামী অতি হৈল চমকিত ॥১১২॥
vaiṣṇava-sabhāya rudra haila upanīta<br />dekhi’ viṣṇu-svāmī ati haila chamakita [112]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Upon seeing [that] <span class="e2">rudra</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">upanīta haila</span>–had arrived <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-sabhāya</span>–at a Vaiṣṇava assembly, <span class="e2">viṣṇu-svāmī</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">haila</span>–became <span class="e2">ati</span>–completely <span class="e2">chamakita</span>–amazed. [112]
“Upon seeing that Śiva had arrived at a Vaiṣṇava assembly, Viṣṇu Swāmī became completely amazed.
কর যুড়ি’ স্তব করে বিষ্ণু ততক্ষণ ।<br />দয়ার্দ্র হইয়া রুদ্র বলেন বচন ॥১১৩॥
kara yuḍi’ stava kare viṣṇu tata-kṣaṇa<br />dayārdra ha-iyā rudra balena vachana [113]
<span class="e2">tata-kṣaṇa</span>–Immediately, <span class="e2">viṣṇu</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">kara</span> <span class="e2">yuḍi’</span>–joined [his] palms [and] <span class="e2">stava</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–prayed [to Śiva.] <span class="e2">dayārdra</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Melting with compassion, <span class="e2">rudra</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">vachana balena</span>–spoke. [113]
“He immediately joined his palms and prayed to Śiva. Melting with compassion, Śiva spoke to him.
‘তোমরা বৈষ্ণব-জন মম প্রিয় অতি ।<br />ভক্তি আলোচনা দেখি’ তুষ্ট মম মতি ॥১১৪॥
‘tomarā vaiṣṇava-jana mama priya ati<br />bhakti ālochanā dekhi’ tuṣṭa mama mati [114]
<span class="e2">tomarā</span>–All you <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-jana</span>–Vaiṣṇavas [are] <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">ati priya</span>–very dear to me, [and] <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–seeing [your] <span class="e2">ālochanā</span>–discussion <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–of devotion, <span class="e2">mama</span>–my <span class="e2">mati</span>–heart [is] <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span>–delighted. [114]
“‘All you Vaiṣṇavas are very dear to me, and my heart is delighted to see your discussion of devotion.
বর মাগ দিব আমি হইয়া সদয় ।<br />বৈষ্ণবে অদেয় মোর কিছু নাহি হয়’ ॥১১৫॥
vara māga diba āmi ha-iyā sadaya<br />vaiṣṇave adeya mora kichhu nāhi haya’ [115]
<span class="e2">māga</span>–Request <span class="e2">vara</span>–a boon, [and] <span class="e2">sadaya ha-iyā</span>–kindly, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">diba</span>–will give [it to you]. <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–I have nothing [that] <span class="e2">adeya</span>–is not given <span class="e2">vaiṣṇave’</span>–to Vaiṣṇavas.’ [115]
“‘Request a boon, and I will kindly give it to you. There is nothing that I do not give to Vaiṣṇavas.’
দণ্ডবৎ প্রণমিয়া বিষ্ণু মহাশয় ।<br />কর যুড়ি’ বর মাগে প্রেমানন্দময় ॥১১৬॥
daṇḍavat praṇamiyā viṣṇu mahāśaya<br />kara yuḍi’ vara māge premānandamaya [116]
<span class="e2">premānandamaya</span>–Filled with divine love, <span class="e2">viṣṇu</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">praṇamiyā</span>–bowed down, <span class="e2">kara yuḍi’</span>–joined [his] palms, [and] <span class="e2">māge</span>–requested <span class="e2">vara</span>–a boon. [116]
“Filled with divine love, Viṣṇu Swāmī bowed down, joined his palms, and requested a boon.
‘এই বর দেহ প্রভু আমা সবাকারে ।<br />ভক্তি-সম্প্রদায় সিদ্ধি লভি অতঃপরে’ ॥১১৭॥
‘ei vara deha prabhu āmā sabākāre<br />bhakti-sampradāya siddhi labhi ataḥpare’ [117]
<span class="e2">‘prabhu</span>–‘O Lord, <span class="e2">deha</span>–give <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">sabākāre</span>–us <span class="e2">ei</span>–the <span class="e2">vara</span>–boon [that] <span class="e2">ataḥpare</span>–hereafter <span class="e2">siddhi</span> <span class="e2">labhi</span>–we will establish <span class="e2">bhakti-sampradāya’</span>–a school of devotion.’ [117]
“‘O Lord, give us the boon that hereafter we will establish a school of devotion.’
পরম আনন্দে রুদ্র বর করি’ দান ।<br />নিজ সম্প্রদায় বলি’ করিল আখ্যান ॥১১৮॥
parama ānande rudra vara kari’ dāna<br />nija sampradāya bali’ karila ākhyāna [118]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ānande</span>–With great joy, <span class="e2">rudra</span>–Rudra <span class="e2">dāna kari’</span>–granted <span class="e2">vara</span>–this boon [and] <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">ākhyāna karila</span>–named <span class="e2">sampradāya</span>–the school <span class="e2">nija</span>–after himself. [118]
“With great joy, Rudra granted this boon and named the school after himself.
সেই হৈতে বিষ্ণুস্বামী স্বীয় সম্প্রদায় ।<br />শ্রীরুদ্র নামেতে খ্যাতি দিয়া নাচে গায় ॥১১৯॥
sei haite viṣṇu-svāmī svīya sampradāya<br />śrī-rudra nāmete khyāti diyā nāche gāya [119]
<span class="e2">viṣṇu-svāmī</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–thus <span class="e2">nāmete</span> <span class="e2">khyāti</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–named <span class="e2">svīya</span>–his <span class="e2">sampradāya</span>–school <span class="e2">śrī-rudra</span>–‘Śrī Rudra’, [and] <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced [and] <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sang. [119]
“Viṣṇu Swāmī thus named his school the Śrī Rudra sampradāya, and danced and sang.
রুদ্রকৃপাবলে বিষ্ণু এ স্থানে রহিয়া ।<br />ভজিল শ্রীগৌরচন্দ্র প্রেমের লাগিয়া ॥১২০॥
rudra-kṛpā-bale viṣṇu e sthāne rahiyā<br />bhajile śrī-gaurachandra premera lāgiyā [120]
<span class="e2">rudra-kṛpā-bale</span>–By Śiva’s mercy, <span class="e2">viṣṇu</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">rahiyā</span>–stayed <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">bhajile</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">śrī-gaurachandra</span>–Śrī Gaurachandra, <span class="e2">lāgiyā</span>–aspiring <span class="e2">premera</span>–for divine love. [120]
“By Śiva’s mercy, Viṣṇu Swāmī stayed here and worshipped Śrī Gaurachandra, aspiring for divine love.
স্বপ্নে আসি’ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ বিষ্ণুরে বলিল ।<br />‘মম ভক্ত রুদ্র কৃপা তোমারে হইল ॥১২১॥
svapne āsi’ śrī-gaurāṅga viṣṇure balila<br />‘mama bhakta rudra kṛpā tomāre ha-ila [121]
<span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">viṣṇure</span>–to Viṣṇu Swāmī <span class="e2">svapne</span>–in a dream [and] <span class="e2">balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘mama</span>–‘My <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotee <span class="e2">rudra</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">kṛpā ha-ila</span>–blessed <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–you. [121]
“Śrī Gaurāṅga came to Viṣṇu Swāmī in a dream and said, ‘My devotee Śiva blessed you.
ধন্য তুমি নবদ্বীপে পাইলে ভক্তিধন ।<br />শুদ্ধাদ্বৈত-মত প্রচারহ এইক্ষণ ॥১২২॥
dhanya tumi navadvīpe pāile bhakti-dhana<br />śuddhādvaita-mata prachāraha ei-kṣaṇa [122]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate [to] <span class="e2">pāile</span>–have attained <span class="e2">bhakti-dhana</span>–the wealth of devotion <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">ei-kṣaṇa</span>–For now, <span class="e2">prachāraha</span>–preach <span class="e2">śuddhādvaita-mata</span>–pure nondualism. [122]
“‘You are fortunate to have attained the wealth of devotion in Nabadwīp. For now, preach pure nondualism.
কতদিনে হবে মোর প্রকট সময় ।<br />শ্রীবল্লভভট্ট রূপে হইবে উদয় ॥১২৩॥
kata-dine habe mora prakaṭa samaya<br />śrī-vallabha-bhaṭṭa rūpe hai-be udaya [123]
<span class="e2">kata-dine</span>–Later, <span class="e2">samaya</span>–the time <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span>–of My appearance <span class="e2">habe</span>–will come. <span class="e2">udaya hai-be</span>–You will appear <span class="e2">rūpe</span>–as <span class="e2">śrī-vallabha-bhaṭṭa</span>–Śrī Vallabha Bhaṭṭa. [123]
“‘Later, at the time of My appearance, you will appear as Śrī Vallabha Bhaṭṭa.
শ্রীক্ষেত্রে আমারে তুমি করি’ দরশনে ।<br />সম্প্রদায়ে সিদ্ধি পাবে গিয়া মহাবনে’ ॥১২৪॥
śrī-kṣetre āmāre tumi kari’ daraśane<br />sampradāye siddhi pābe giyā mahāvane’ [124]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">daraśane kari’</span>–will meet <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–Me <span class="e2">śrī-kṣetre</span>–in Jagannāth Purī, <span class="e2">giyā</span>–go <span class="e2">mahāvane</span>–to Gokula Mahāvan, [and] <span class="e2">siddhi</span> <span class="e2">pābe</span>–establish [your] <span class="e2">sampradāye’</span>–school’. [124]
“‘You will meet Me in Śrī Kṣetra, later go to Mahāvan, and establish your school.’
ওহে জীব শ্রীবল্লভ গোকুলে এখন ।<br />তুমি তথা গেলে পাবে তাঁর দরশন” ॥১২৫॥
ohe jīva śrī-vallabha gokule ekhana<br />tumi tathā gele pābe tā̐ra daraśana” [125]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva, <span class="e2">śrī-vallabha</span>–Śrī Vallabha [is] <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now <span class="e2">gokule</span>–in Goloka. <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">gele</span>–When you go <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">daraśana pābe”</span>–you will meet him.” [125]
“O Jīva, Śrī Vallabha is now in Gokula. When you go there, you will meet him.”
এত বলি’ নিত্যানন্দ দক্ষিণাভিমুখে ।<br />পারডাঙ্গা শ্রীপুলিনে চলিলেন সুখে ॥১২৬॥
eta bali’ nityānanda dakṣiṇābhimukhe<br />pāraḍāṅgā śrī-puline chalilena sukhe [126]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–happily <span class="e2">chalilena</span>–walked <span class="e2">dakṣiṇābhimukhe</span>–southbound <span class="e2">pāraḍāṅgā</span>–towards Pāraḍāṅgā <span class="e2">śrī-puline</span>–through Śrī Pulina. [126]
Saying this, Nityānanda happily walked southbound towards Pāraḍāṅgā through Śrī Pulina.
পুলিনে যাইয়া প্রভু নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />শ্রীরাসমণ্ডল ধীর-সমীর দেখায় ॥১২৭॥
puline yāiyā prabhu nityānanda-rāya<br />śrī-rāsa-maṇḍala dhīra-samīra dekhāya [127]
<span class="e2">yāiyā</span>–Passing <span class="e2">puline</span>–through Śrī Pulina, <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Lord Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">dekhāya</span>–showed [the devotees] <span class="e2">śrī-rāsa-maṇḍala</span>–Śrī Rāsa Maṇḍal [and] <span class="e2">dhīra-samīra</span>–Dhīra Samīra. [127]
Passing through Śrī Pulina, Nityānanda Prabhu showed the devotees Śrī Rāsa Maṇḍal and Dhīra Samīra.
বলে, “জীব এই দেখ নিত্য-বৃন্দাবন ।<br />বৃন্দাবন-লীলা হেথা পায় দরশন ॥১২৮॥
bale, “jīva ei dekha nitya-vṛndāvana<br />vṛndāvana-līlā hethā pāya daraśana” [128]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">“jīva</span>–O Jīva, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–see <span class="e2">ei nitya-vṛndāvana</span>–eternal Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">daraśana pāya</span>–you will see <span class="e2">vṛndāvana-līlā”</span>–the Pastimes of Vṛndāvan.” [128]
He said, “O Jīva, see here eternal Vṛndāvan and its Pastimes.”
বৃন্দাবন শুনি’ জীব প্রেমেতে বিহ্বল ।<br />নয়নেতে বহে দরদর প্রেমজল ॥১২৯॥
vṛndāvana śuni’ jīva premete vihvala<br />nayanete vahe dara-dara prema-jala [129]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–of Vṛndāvan, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva [became] <span class="e2">vihvala</span>–overwhelmed <span class="e2">premete</span>–with divine love, [and] <span class="e2">prema-jala</span>–tears of love <span class="e2">dara-dara vahe</span>–streamed <span class="e2">nayanete</span>–from [his] eyes. [129]
Hearing of Vṛndāvan, Jīva became overwhelmed with divine love, and tears of love streamed from his eyes.
প্রভু বলে, “শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ লয়ে ভক্তজন ।<br />এই স্থানে রাসপদ্য করিল কীর্ত্তন ॥১৩০॥
prabhu bale, “śrī-gaurāṅga laye bhakta-jana<br />ei sthāne rāsa-padya karila kīrtana [130]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–“Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">rāsa-padya</span> <span class="e2">kīrtana karila</span>–chanted verses about the Rāsa-līlā <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–the devotees. [130]
Nityānanda Prabhu said, “Śrī Gaurāṅga chanted verses about the Rāsa-līlā here with the devotees.
মহারাস-লীলাস্থান যথা বৃন্দাবনে ।<br />তথা এই স্থান জীব জাহ্নবী-পুলিনে ॥১৩১॥
mahārāsa-līlā-sthāna yathā vṛndāvane<br />tathā ei sthāna jīva jāhnavī-puline [131]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva, <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place <span class="e2">jāhnavī-puline</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā [is] <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–equal to <span class="e2">mahārāsa-līlā-sthāna</span>–the place of the great Rāsa-līlā <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–in Vṛndāvan. [131]
“O Jīva, this place on the bank of the Gaṅgā is the place of the great Rāsa-līlā in Vṛndāvan.
নিত্যরাস হয় হেথা গোপীগণ সনে ।<br />দরশন করে কভু ভাগ্যবান জনে ॥১৩২॥
nitya-rāsa haya hethā gopī-gaṇa sane<br />daraśana kare kabhu bhāgyavāna jane [132]
<span class="e2">nitya-rāsa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–Daily, the Rāsa-līlā happens <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sane</span>–with <span class="e2">gopī-gaṇa</span>–the gopīs. <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">bhāgyavāna</span>–fortunate <span class="e2">jane</span>–souls <span class="e2">daraśana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–see [this]. [132]
“Daily, the Rāsa-līlā happens here with the gopīs. Sometimes fortunate souls see this.
ইহার পশ্চিমে দেখ শ্রীধীর-সমীর ।<br />ভজনের স্থান এই শুন ওহে ধীর ॥১৩৩॥
ihāra paśchime dekha śrī-dhīra-samīra<br />bhajanera sthāna ei śuna ohe dhīra [133]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–See <span class="e2">śrī-dhīra-samīra</span>–Śrī Dhīra Samīra <span class="e2">ihāra</span> <span class="e2">paśchime</span>–to its west. <span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">dhīra</span>–wise one, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–hear <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">bhajanera</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–about this place of worship. [133]
“See Śrī Dhīra Samīra to the west. O wise one, hear about this place of worship.
ব্রজে ধীরসমীর যে যমুনার তীরে ।<br />সেই স্থান হেথা গঙ্গাপুলিন ভিতরে ॥১৩৪॥
vraje dhīra-samīra ye yamunāra tīre<br />sei sthāna hethā gaṅgā-pulina bhitare [134]
<span class="e2">ye sei sthāna</span>–The place [known as] <span class="e2">dhīra-samīra</span>–Dhīra Samīra <span class="e2">yamunāra</span> <span class="e2">tīre</span>–on the bank of the Yamunā <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja, [is present] <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">gaṅgā-pulina</span> <span class="e2">bhitare</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā. [134]
“The place known as Dhīra Samīra on the bank of the Yamunā in Vraja is present here on the bank of the Gaṅgā.
দেখিতে গঙ্গার তীর বস্তুতঃ তা নয় ।<br />গঙ্গার পশ্চিমধারে শ্রীযমুনা বয় ॥১৩৫॥
dekhite gaṅgāra tīra vastutaḥ tā naya<br />gaṅgāra paśchima-dhāre śrī-yamunā vaya [135]
<span class="e2">vastutaḥ</span>–Actually, <span class="e2">tā</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–it is not that <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span> <span class="e2">tīra</span>–the bank of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–is seen. <span class="e2">śrī-yamunā</span>–The Yamunā <span class="e2">vaya</span>–flows <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span> <span class="e2">paśchima-dhāre</span>–on the west side of the Gaṅgā. [135]
“Actually, you do not see the bank of the Gaṅgā here. The Yamunā flows on the west side of the Gaṅgā.
যমুনার তীরে এই পুলিন সুন্দর ।<br />অতএব বৃন্দাবন বলে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥১৩৬॥
yamunāra tīre ei pulina sundara<br />ataeva vṛndāvana bale viśvambhara [136]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">pulina</span>–bank [is] <span class="e2">tīre</span>–on the shore <span class="e2">yamunāra</span>–of the Yamunā. <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">viśvambhara</span>–Viśvambhar <span class="e2">bale</span>–calls [this place] <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. [136]
“This beautiful bank is on the shore of the Yamunā. Thus, Viśvambhar called this place Vṛndāvan.
বৃন্দাবন যত স্থান লীলার আছয় ।<br />সে সব জানহ জীব এই স্থানে হয় ॥১৩৭॥
vṛndāvane yata sthāna līlāra āchhaya<br />se saba jānaha jīva ei sthāne haya [137]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva, <span class="e2">jānaha</span>–know [that] <span class="e2">yata sthāna se</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all the places <span class="e2">līlāra</span>–of the Pastimes <span class="e2">āchhaya</span>–present <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–in Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">haya</span>–are present <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. [137]
“O Jīva, know that all the places of the Pastimes in Vṛndāvan are present here.
বৃন্দাবনে নবদ্বীপে কিছু নাহি ভেদ ।<br />গৌর-কৃষ্ণে কভু নাহি করিবে প্রভেদ” ॥১৩৮॥
vṛndāvane navadvīpe kichhu nāhi bheda<br />gaura-kṛṣṇe kabhu nāhi karibe prabheda” [138]
<span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">bheda</span>–difference <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–between Vṛndāvan and Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–Never <span class="e2">prabheda karibe</span>–differentiate <span class="e2">gaura-kṛṣṇe”</span>–between Gaura and Kṛṣṇa.” [138]
“There is no difference between Vṛndāvan and Nabadwīp, and one should never differentiate between Gaura and Kṛṣṇa.”
মহাভাবে গরগর নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />বৃন্দাবন দেখাইয়া জীবে লয়ে যায় ॥১৩৯॥
mahābhāve gara-gara nityānanda-rāya<br />vṛndāvana dekhāiyā jīve laye yāya [139]
<span class="e2">gara-gara</span>–Exuberant <span class="e2">mahābhāve</span>–with intense ecstasy, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">dekhāiyā</span>–revealed <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">jīve</span>–to Jīva [and then] <span class="e2">laye yāya</span>–took [him ahead]. [139]
Exuberant with intense ecstasy, Nityānanda Rāy revealed Vṛndāvan to Jīva and then took him ahead.
কতদূরে উত্তরেতে করিয়া গমন ।<br />রুদ্রদ্বীপে সেই রাত্রি করিল যাপন ॥১৪০॥
kata-dūre uttarete kariyā gamana<br />rudradvīpe sei rātri karila yāpana [140]
<span class="e2">gamana kariyā</span>–They went <span class="e2">kata-dūre</span>–a little ways <span class="e2">uttarete</span>–to the north [and] <span class="e2">yāpana karila</span>–spent <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">rātri</span>–night <span class="e2">rudradvīpe</span>–in Rudradwīp. [140]
They went a little ways north and spent that night in Rudradwīp.
নিতাইজাহ্নবাপদ যাহার সম্পদ ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য গায় সে ভক্তিবিনোদ ॥১৪১॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada yāhāra sampada<br />nadīyā-māhātmya gāya se bhakti-vinoda [141]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāhāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">sampada</span>–wealth [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada</span>–the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia. [141]
Bhakti Vinod, whose wealth is the feet of Nitāi and Jāhnavā, chants the glories of Nadia.

Chapter Sixteen
Śrī Bilvapakṣa and Śrī Bharadvāja Ṭilā
জয় জয় নদীয়াবিহারী গৌরচন্দ্র ।<br />জয় একচক্রাপতি প্রভুনিত্যানন্দ ॥১॥
jaya jaya nadīyā-bihārī gaurachandra<br />jaya ekachakrā-pati prabhu-nityānanda [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nadīyā-bihārī</span>–to the reveller of Nadia, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">ekachakrā-pati</span>–to the Lord of Ekachakrā, <span class="e2">prabhu-nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu! [1]
All glory to the reveller of Nadia, Gaurachandra! All glory to the Lord of Ekachakrā, Nityānanda Prabhu!
জয় শান্তিপুরনাথ অদ্বৈত ঈশ্বর ।<br />রামচন্দ্রপুরবাসী জয় গদাধর ॥২॥
jaya śāntipura-nātha advaita īśvara<br />rāmachandrapura-vāsī jaya gadādhara [2]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śāntipura-nātha</span>–to the Lord Śāntipur, <span class="e2">advaita</span> <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–Lord Advaita! <span class="e2">jay</span>–All glory <span class="e2">rāmachandrapura-vāsī</span>–to the resident of Rāmachandrapur <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar! [2]
All glory to the Lord of Śāntipur, Advaita Āchārya, and the resident of Rāmachandrapur Gadādhar Paṇḍit!
জয় জয় গৌড়ভূমি চিন্তামণিসার ।<br />কলিযুগে কৃষ্ণ যথা করিলা বিহার ॥৩॥
jaya jaya gauḍa-bhūmi chintāmaṇi-sāra<br />kali-yuge kṛṣṇa yathā karilā bihāra [3]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gauḍa-bhūmi</span>–to the land of Gauḍa, <span class="e2">chintāmaṇi-sāra</span>–made of pure spiritual gemstone, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">karilā</span>–performed <span class="e2">bihāra</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">kali-yuge</span>–during Kali-yuga! [3]
All glory to the land of Gauḍa, made of pure spiritual gemstone, where Kṛṣṇa performed Pastimes during Kali-yuga!
শ্রীজাহ্নবী পার হয়ে পদ্মার নন্দন ।<br />কিছুদূরে গিয়া বলে, “দেখ ভক্তগণ ॥৪॥
śrī-jāhnavī pāra haye padmāra nandana<br />kichhu-dūre giyā bale, “dekha bhakta-gaṇa [4]
<span class="e2">padmāra</span> <span class="e2">nandana</span>–Nityānanda, the son of Padmāvatī Devī, <span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–crossed <span class="e2">śrī-jāhnavī</span>–the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">giyā</span>–went <span class="e2">kichhu-dūre</span>–a little ways ahead, [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bhakta-gaṇa</span>–“O devotees, <span class="e2">dekha</span>–look! [4]
Nityānanda Prabhu crossed the Gaṅgā, went a little ways ahead, and said, “O devotees, look!
বিল্বপক্ষ নাম এই স্থান মনোহর ।<br />বেলপুখরিয়া বলি’ বলে সর্ব্ব-নর ॥৫॥
bilvapakṣa nāma ei sthāna manohara<br />bela-pukhariyā bali’ bale sarva-nara [5]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place [is] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–named <span class="e2">bilvapakṣa</span>–Bilvapakṣa. <span class="e2">sarva-nara</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–calls [it] <span class="e2">bela-pukhariyā</span>–Bel Pukhariyā. [5]
“This enchanting place is named Bilvapakṣa. Everyone calls it Bel Pukhariyā.
ব্রজধামে যারে শাস্ত্রে বলে বিল্ববন ।<br />নবদ্বীপে সেই স্থান কর দরশন ॥৬॥
vraja-dhāme yāre śāstre bale bilvavana<br />navadvīpe sei sthāna kara daraśana [6]
<span class="e2">daraśana kara</span>–See <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–the place <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">yāre</span>–which <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">bale</span>–call <span class="e2">bilvavana</span>–Bilvavan <span class="e2">vraja-dhāme</span>–in Vraja Dhām. [6]
“See here in Nabadwīp the place which the scriptures call Bilvavan in Vraja Dhām.
পঞ্চবক্ত্র বিল্বকেশ আছিল হেথায় ।<br />একপক্ষ বিল্বদলে আরাধিয়া তাঁয় ॥৭॥
ব্রাহ্মণ সজ্জনগণে তুষিল তাঁহারে ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তি বর দিল তাহা সবাকারে ॥৮॥
pañcha-vaktra bilvakeśa āchhila hethāya<br />eka-pakṣa bilva-dale ārādhiyā tā̐ya [7]
brāhmaṇa sajjana-gaṇe tuṣila tā̐hāre<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti vara dila tāhā sabākāre [8]
<span class="e2">pañcha-vaktra</span>–Śiva, who has five faces, <span class="e2">bilvakeśa</span>–the lord of bael, <span class="e2">āchhila</span>–is present <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. [After] <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa</span> <span class="e2">sajjana-gaṇe</span>–a group of noble brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">tuṣila</span>–satisfied <span class="e2">tā̐hāre</span>–him, <span class="e2">ārādhiyā</span>–having worshipped <span class="e2">tā̐ya</span>–him <span class="e2">bilva-dale</span>–with bael leaves <span class="e2">eka-pakṣa</span>–for a fortnight, <span class="e2">dila</span>–he gave <span class="e2">sabākāre</span>–them <span class="e2">tāhā</span> <span class="e2">vara</span>–the boon <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–of devotion to Kṛṣṇa. [7<span class="e2">–</span>8]
“Śiva, the lord of bael, resides here. After a group of noble brāhmaṇs satisfied him, having worshipped him with bael leaves for a fortnight, Śiva gave them the boon of devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
সেই বিপ্রগণ মধ্যে নিম্বাদিত্য ছিল ।<br />বিশেষ করিয়া পঞ্চবক্ত্রে আরাধিল ॥৯॥
sei vipra-gaṇa madhye nimbāditya chhila<br />viśeṣa kariyā pañcha-vaktre ārādhila [9]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–Amongst <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vipra-gaṇa</span>–the brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">chhila</span>–was <span class="e2">nimbāditya</span>–Nimbāditya (Nimbārka Āchārya), [who] <span class="e2">ārādhila kariyā</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">pañcha-vaktre</span>–Śiva (‘he who has five heads’) <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–exceptionally [well]. [9]
“Amongst the brāhmaṇs was Nimbāditya, who worshipped Śiva exceptionally well.
কৃপা করি’ পঞ্চবক্ত্র কহিল তখন ।<br />‘এই গ্রাম-প্রান্তে আছে দিব্য বিল্ববন ॥১০॥
kṛpā kari’ pañcha-vaktra kahila takhana<br />‘ei grāma-prānte āchhe divya bilvavana [10]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully, <span class="e2">pañcha-vaktra</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">kahila</span>–said [to him,] <span class="e2">‘ei</span> <span class="e2">grāma-prānte</span>–‘On the edge of this village <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is [a] <span class="e2">divya</span>–divine <span class="e2">bilvavana</span>–bael forest. [10]
“Mercifully, Śiva said to him, ‘On the edge of this village is a divine bael forest.
সেই বন মধ্যে চতুঃসন আছে ধ্যানে ।<br />তাঁদের কৃপায় তব হবে দিব্যজ্ঞানে ॥১১॥
sei vana madhye chatuḥsana āchhe dhyāne<br />tā̐dera kṛpāya tava habe divya-jñāne [11]
<span class="e2">chatuḥsana</span>–The four Kumāras (Sanaka, Sanandana, Sanātan, and Sanat) <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–are <span class="e2">dhyāne</span>–in meditation <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vana</span> <span class="e2">madhye</span>–in that forest, [and] <span class="e2">tā̐dera</span> <span class="e2">kṛpāya</span>–by their grace, <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">divya-jñāne habe</span>–you will attain divine knowledge. [11]
“‘The four Kumāras are meditating in that forest, and by their grace, you will attain divine knowledge.
চতুঃসন গুরু তব তাঁদের সেবায় ।<br />সর্ব্ব-অর্থ লাভ তব হইবে হেথায়’ ॥১২॥
chatuḥsana guru tava tā̐dera sevāya<br />sarva-artha lābha tava ha-ibe hethāya’ [12]
<span class="e2">chatuḥsana</span>–The four Kumāras [are] <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">guru</span>–Gurus, [and] <span class="e2">tā̐dera</span> <span class="e2">sevāya</span>–through their service, <span class="e2">tava lābha</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all <span class="e2">artha</span>–ends <span class="e2">hethāya’</span>–here.’ [12]
“‘The four Kumāras are your Gurus, and through their service, you will attain everything here.’
এ৩ বলি’ মহেশ্বর হৈল অন্তর্দ্ধান ।<br />নিম্বাদিত্য অন্বেষণ করি’ পায় স্থান ॥১৩॥
eta bali’ maheśvara haila antardhāna<br />nimbāditya anveṣaṇa kari’ pāya sthāna [13]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">maheśvara</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">antardhāna haila</span>–disappeared. <span class="e2">nimbāditya</span>–Nimbāditya <span class="e2">anveṣaṇa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–searched [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–found <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–the place. [13]
“Saying this, Śiva disappeared. Nimbāditya then searched and found the place.
বিল্ববন মধ্যে দেখে বেদী মনোহর ।<br />চতুঃসন বসিয়াছে তাহার উপর ॥১৪॥
সনক সনন্দ আর ঋষি সনাতন ।<br />শ্রীসনৎকুমার এই ঋষি চার জন ॥১৫॥
বৃদ্ধকেশ সন্নিধানে অন্য অলক্ষিত ।<br />বস্ত্রহীন সুকুমার উদার চরিত ॥১৬॥
bilvavana madhye dekhe vedī manohara<br />chatuḥsana basiyāchhe tāhāra upara [14]
sanaka sananda āra ṛṣi sanātana<br />śrī-sanat-kumāra ei ṛṣi chāra jana [15]
vṛddha-keśa sannidhāne anya alakṣita<br />vastra-hīna sukumāra udāra charita [16]
<span class="e2">bilvavana</span> <span class="e2">madhye</span>–In the bael forest, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–he saw <span class="e2">chatuḥsana</span>–the four Kumāras— <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span> <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi chāra</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–the four sages <span class="e2">sanaka</span>–Sanak, <span class="e2">sananda</span>–Sananda, <span class="e2">sanātana</span>–Sanātan, [and] <span class="e2">śrī-sanat-kumāra</span>–Śrī Sanat Kumar— <span class="e2">basiyāchhe</span>–seated <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">upara</span>–on a<span class="e2"> manohara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">vedī</span>–platform <span class="e2">sannidhāne</span>–beside <span class="e2">vṛddha-keśa</span>–Śiva, <span class="e2">alakṣita</span>–unseen <span class="e2">anya</span>–by others. [They were] <span class="e2">vastra-hīna</span>–unclothed, <span class="e2">sukumāra</span>–very young, [and] <span class="e2">udāra</span> <span class="e2">charita</span>–of noble character. [14<span class="e2">–</span>16]
“In the bael forest, he saw the four Kumāras—the sages Sanak, Sananda, Sanātan, and Sanat Kumār—seated on a beautiful platform beside Śiva, unseen by others. They were unclothed, very young, and of noble character.
দেখি’ নিম্বাদিত্যাচার্য্য পরম কৌতুকে ।<br />‘হরে কৃষ্ণ হরে কৃষ্ণ’ ডাকি’ বলে সুখে ॥১৭॥
dekhi’ nimbādityāchārya parama kautuke<br />‘hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa’ ḍāki’ bale sukhe [17]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">kautuke</span>–With great excitement <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–upon seeing [them,] <span class="e2">nimbādityāchārya</span>–Nimbāditya Āchārya <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–happily <span class="e2">ḍāki’</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–called out, <span class="e2">‘hare kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">hare kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Hare Kṛṣṇa! Hare Kṛṣṇa!’ [17]
“Greatly excited upon seeing them, Nimbāditya Āchārya happily called out, ‘Hare Kṛṣṇa! Hare Kṛṣṇa!’
হরিনাম শুনি’ কানে ধ্যান ভঙ্গ হৈল ।<br />সম্মুখে বৈষ্ণবমূর্ত্তি দেখিতে পাইল ॥১৮॥
hari-nāma śuni’ kāne dhyāna bhaṅga haila<br />sammukhe vaiṣṇava-mūrti dekhite pāila [18]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">kāne</span>–with [their] ears, [their] <span class="e2">dhyāna</span>–meditation <span class="e2">bhaṅga</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–broke, [and] <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">pāila</span>–they saw <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-mūrti</span>–the form of a Vaiṣṇava <span class="e2">sammukhe</span>–in front of them. [18]
“Hearing the Name of the Lord, their meditation broke, and they saw the form of a Vaiṣṇava in front of them.
বৈষ্ণব দেখিয়া সবে হয়ে হৃষ্টমন ।<br />নিম্বাদিত্যে ক্রমে ক্রমে দেয় আলিঙ্গন ॥১৯॥
vaiṣṇava dekhiyā sabe haye hṛṣṭa-mana<br />nimbāditye krame krame deya āliṅgana [19]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–the Vaiṣṇava, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">hṛṣṭa-mana haye</span>–were pleased, [and] <span class="e2">krame</span> <span class="e2">krame</span>–one by one <span class="e2">āliṅgana deya</span>–they embraced <span class="e2">nimbāditye</span>–Nimbāditya. [19]
“Seeing the Vaiṣṇava, they were pleased, and one by one they embraced Nimbāditya.
‘কে তুমি কেন বা হেথা বল পরিচয় ।<br />তোমার প্রার্থনা মোরা পুরাব নিশ্চয়’ ॥২০॥
‘ke tūmi kena vā hethā bala parichaya<br />tomāra prārthanā morā purāba niśchaya’ [20]
<span class="e2">‘ke</span>–‘Who [are] <span class="e2">tūmi</span>–you? <span class="e2">kena</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–Why [are you] <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here? <span class="e2">parichaya bala</span>–Introduce [yourself]. <span class="e2">morā</span>–We <span class="e2">niśchaya</span> <span class="e2">purāba</span>–will certainly fulfil <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your <span class="e2">prārthanā’</span>–prayers.’ [20]
“‘Who are you? Why have you come here? Please introduce yourself. We will certainly fulfil your prayers.’
শুনি’ নিম্বাদিত্য দণ্ডবৎ প্রণমিয়া ।<br />নিজ পরিচয় দেয় বিনীত হইয়া ॥২১॥
śuni’ nimbāditya daṇḍavat praṇamiyā<br />nija parichaya deya vinīta ha-iyā [21]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing [this] <span class="e2">nimbāditya</span>–Nimbāditya <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">praṇamiyā</span>–prostrated [and] <span class="e2">vinīta</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–humbly <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">parichaya</span> <span class="e2">deya</span>–introduced himself. [21]
“Hearing their words, Nimbāditya prostrated and humbly introduced himself.
নিম্বার্কের পরিচয় করিয়া শ্রবণ ।<br />শ্রীসনৎকুমার কয় সহাস্য বদন ॥২২॥
nimbārkera parichaya kariyā śravaṇa<br />śrī-sanat-kumāra kaya sahāsya vadana [22]
<span class="e2">śravaṇa kariyā</span>–Upon hearing <span class="e2">nimbārkera</span>–Nimbārka’s <span class="e2">parichaya</span>–introduction, <span class="e2">śrī-sanat-kumāra</span>–Śrī Sanat Kumār <span class="e2">kaya</span>–spoke <span class="e2">sahāsya</span> <span class="e2">vadana</span>–with a smiling face. [22]
“Upon hearing Nimbārka’s introduction, Śrī Sanat Kumār spoke with a smiling face.
‘কলি ঘোর হইবে জানিয়া কৃপাময় ।<br />ভক্তি প্রচারিতে চিত্তে করিল নিশ্চয় ॥২৩॥
‘kali ghora ha-ibe jāniyā kṛpāmaya<br />bhakti prachārite chitte karila niśchaya [23]
<span class="e2">‘jāniyā</span>–‘Knowing [that] <span class="e2">kali</span>–Kali-yuga <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–would be <span class="e2">ghora</span>–dark, <span class="e2">kṛpāmaya</span>–the merciful Lord <span class="e2">chitte</span> <span class="e2">niśchaya</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–decided <span class="e2">prachārite</span>–to preach <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion. [23]
“‘Knowing that Kali-yuga would be dark, the merciful Lord decided to preach devotion.
চারিজন ভক্তে শক্তি করিয়া অর্পণ ।<br />ভক্তি প্রচারিতে বিশ্বে করিল প্রেরণ ॥২৪॥
chāri-jana bhakte śakti kariyā arpaṇa<br />bhakti prachārite viśve karila preraṇa [24]
<span class="e2">śakti</span> <span class="e2">arpaṇa kariyā</span>–He empowered <span class="e2">chāri-jana</span> <span class="e2">bhakte</span>–four devotees [and] <span class="e2">preraṇa karila</span>–sent [them] <span class="e2">prachārite</span>–to preach <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">viśve</span>–throughout the world. [24]
“‘He empowered four devotees and sent them to preach devotion throughout the world.
রামানুজ, মধ্ব, বিষ্ণু—এই তিন জন ।<br />তুমি ত চতুর্থ হও ভক্ত মহাজন ॥২৫॥
rāmānuja, madhva, viṣṇu—ei tina jana<br />tumi ta chaturtha hao bhakta mahājana [25]
<span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">madhva</span>–Madhva Āchārya, [and] <span class="e2">viṣṇu</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī [are] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">tina</span>–three of these <span class="e2">jana</span>–souls. <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">hao</span>–are <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">chaturtha</span>–the fourth <span class="e2">bhakta</span> <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–of these great devotees. [25]
“‘Rāmānuja, Madhva Āchārya, and Viṣṇu Swāmī are three of them. You are the fourth of these great devotees.
শ্রীদেবী করিল রামানুজে অঙ্গীকার ।<br />ব্রহ্মা মধ্বাচার্য্যে রুদ্র বিষ্ণুকে স্বীকার ॥২৬॥
śrī-devī karila rāmānuje aṅgīkāra<br />brahmā madhvāchārye rudra viṣṇuke svīkāra [26]
<span class="e2">śrī-devī</span>–Lakṣmī Devī <span class="e2">aṅgīkāra karila</span>–accepted <span class="e2">rāmānuje</span>–Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā <span class="e2">svīkāra</span>–accepted <span class="e2">madhvāchārye</span>–Madhva Āchārya, [and] <span class="e2">rudra</span>–Śiva [accepted] <span class="e2">viṣṇuke</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī. [26]
“‘Lakṣmī Devī accepted Rāmānuja, Brahmā accepted Madhva Āchārya, and Śiva accepted Viṣṇu Swāmī.
আমরা তোমাকে আজ জানিনু আপন ।<br />শিষ্য করি’ ধন্য হই এই প্রয়োজন ॥২৭॥
āmarā tomāke āja jāninu āpana<br />śiṣya kari’ dhanya ha-i ei prayojana [27]
<span class="e2">āja</span>–Today, <span class="e2">āmarā</span>–we <span class="e2">jāninu</span>–have met <span class="e2">tomāke</span>–you <span class="e2">āpana</span>–personally. <span class="e2">kari’</span>–We will make [you our] <span class="e2">śiṣya</span>–disciple [and thus] <span class="e2">ha-i</span>–become <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is our] <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–purpose. [27]
“‘Today, we have met you personally. We will make you our disciple and thus become fortunate. This is our purpose.
পূর্ব্বে মোরা অভেদ-চিন্তায় ছিনু রত ।<br />কৃপাযোগে সেই পাপ হৈল দূরগত ॥২৮॥
pūrve morā abheda-chintāya chhinu rata<br />kṛpā-yoge sei pāpa haila dūra-gata [28]
<span class="e2">pūrve</span>–Previously, <span class="e2">morā</span>–we <span class="e2">abheda-chintāya</span> <span class="e2">rata chhinu</span>–meditated on nonduality, [but] <span class="e2">kṛpā-yoge</span>–by the grace [of the Lord] <span class="e2">sei</span>–such <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sin <span class="e2">dūra-gata haila</span>–has left us. [28]
“‘Previously, we meditated on nonduality, but by the grace of the Lord such sin has left us.
এবে শুদ্ধভক্তি অতি উপাদেয় জানি ।<br />সংহিতা রচনা করিয়াছি একখানি ॥২৯॥
ebe śuddha-bhakti ati upādeya jāni<br />saṁhitā rachanā kariyāchhi eka-khāni [29]
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now, <span class="e2">jāni</span>–we understand [that] <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti</span>–pure devotion [is] <span class="e2">ati</span>–supremely <span class="e2">upādeya</span>–relishable, [and] <span class="e2">rachanā</span> <span class="e2">kariyāchhi</span>–we have written <span class="e2">eka-khāni</span>–a <span class="e2">saṁhitā</span>–scripture [about it]. [29]
“‘We now understand that pure devotion is supremely relishable, and we have written a scripture about it.
সনৎকুমার-সংহিতা ইহার নাম হয় ।<br />এইমতে দীক্ষা তব হইবে নিশ্চয়’ ॥৩০॥
sanat-kumāra-saṁhitā ihāra nāma haya<br />ei-mate dīkṣā tava ha-ibe niśchaya’ [30]
<span class="e2">ihāra</span>–Its <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sanat-kumāra-saṁhitā</span>–<span class="e3">Sanat-kumāra-saṁhitā</span>. <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">dīkṣā niśchaya ha-ibe</span>–You will certainly be initiated <span class="e2">ei-mate’</span>–into its teachings.’ [30]
“‘Its name is <span class="e3">Sanat-kumāra-saṁhitā</span>. You will certainly be initiated into its teachings.’
গুরু-অনুগ্রহ দেখি’ নিম্বার্ক ধীমান ।<br />অবিলম্বে আইলা করি’ ভাগীরথী স্নান ॥৩১॥
guru-anugraha dekhi’ nimbārka dhīmāna<br />avilambe āilā kari’ bhāgīrathī snāna [31]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">guru-anugraha</span>–the grace of [his] Guru, <span class="e2">dhīmāna nimbārka</span>–the wise Nimbārka <span class="e2">avilambe</span>–immediately <span class="e2">snāna kari’</span>–bathed <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–in the Gaṅgā [and] <span class="e2">āilā</span>–returned. [31]
“Seeing the grace of his Guru, the wise Nimbārka immediately bathed in the Gaṅgā and returned.
সাষ্টাঙ্গে পড়িয়া বলে সদৈন্য বচন ।<br />‘এ অধমে তার নাথ পতিতপাবন’ ॥৩২॥
sāṣṭāṅge paḍiyā bale sadainya vachana<br />‘e adhame tāra nātha patita-pāvana’ [32]
<span class="e2">sāṣṭāṅge</span> <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–He prostrated [himself and] <span class="e2">sadainya</span>–humbly <span class="e2">vachana bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘nātha</span>–‘O Lord! <span class="e2">patita-pāvana</span>–Saviour of the fallen! <span class="e2">tāra</span>–Deliver <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">adhame’</span>–lowly soul.’ [32]
“He prostrated himself and humbly said, ‘O lord! Saviour of the fallen! Deliver this lowly soul.’
চতুঃসন কৈল শ্রীযুগল-মন্ত্র দান ।<br />ভাবমার্গে উপাসনা করিল বিধান ॥৩৩॥
chatuḥsana kaila śrī-yugala-mantra dāna<br />bhāva-mārge upāsanā karila vidhāna [33]
<span class="e2">chatuḥsana</span>–The four Kumāras <span class="e2">dāna kaila</span>–gave [him] <span class="e2">śrī-yugala-mantra</span>–a mantra for the Divine Couple [and] <span class="e2">vidhāna karila</span>–taught [him] <span class="e2">upāsanā</span>–worship <span class="e2">bhāva-mārge</span>–on the path of love (rāga-mārg). [33]
“The four Kumāras gave him a mantra to worship the Divine Couple and taught him how to worship on the path of love.
মন্ত্র লভি’ নিম্বাদিত্য সিদ্ধ পীঠস্থানে ।<br />উপাসনা করিলেন সংহিতা-বিধানে ॥৩৪॥
mantra labhi’ nimbāditya siddha pīṭha-sthāne<br />upāsanā karilena saṁhitā-vidhāne [34]
<span class="e2">labhi’</span>–Receiving <span class="e2">mantra</span>–the mantra, <span class="e2">nimbāditya</span>–Nimbāditya <span class="e2">upāsanā</span> <span class="e2">karilena</span>–performed worship <span class="e2">siddha</span> <span class="e2">pīṭha-sthāne</span>–in this holy place <span class="e2">saṁhitā-vidhāne</span>–according to the teachings of the <span class="e3">Sanat-kumāra-saṁhitā.</span> [34]
“Receiving the mantra, Nimbāditya performed worship in this holy place according to the teachings of the <span class="e3">Sanat-kumāra-saṁhitā</span>.
কৃপা করি’ রাধাকৃষ্ণ তারে দেখা দিল ।<br />রূপের ছটায় চতুর্দ্দিক আলো হৈল ॥৩৫॥
kṛpā kari’ rādhā-kṛṣṇa tāre dekhā dila<br />rūpera chhaṭāya chatur-dika ālo haila [35]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully, <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [Themselves] <span class="e2">tāre</span>–to him, [and] <span class="e2">rūpera</span> <span class="e2">chhaṭāya</span>–the lustre of [Their] forms <span class="e2">ālo</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–illuminated <span class="e2">chatur-dika</span>–the four directions. [35]
“Mercifully, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa revealed Themselves to him, and the lustre of Their forms illuminated the four directions.
মৃদু মৃদু হাসি’ মুখে বলেন বচন ।<br />‘ধন্য তুমি নিম্বাদিত্য করিলে সাধন ॥৩৬॥
mṛdu mṛdu hāsi’ mukhe balena vachana<br />‘dhanya tumi nimbāditya karile sādhana [36]
<span class="e2">mṛdu</span> <span class="e2">mṛdu</span>–Gently <span class="e2">mukhe hāsi’</span>–smiling, <span class="e2">vachana balena</span>–They said, <span class="e2">‘nimbāditya</span>–‘O Nimbāditya, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate: <span class="e2">sādhana karile</span>–you have performed worship [here]. [36]
“Gently smiling, They said, ‘O Nimbāditya, you are fortunate: you have performed worship here.
অতি প্রিয় নবদ্বীপ আমা দোঁহাকার ।<br />হেথা দোঁহে একরূপ শচীর কুমার’ ॥৩৭॥
ati priya navadvīpa āmā do̐hākāra<br />hethā do̐he eka-rūpa śachīra kumāra’ [37]
<span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">do̐hākāra ati</span> <span class="e2">priya</span>–very dear to Us. <span class="e2">hethā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">do̐he</span>–We [are present] <span class="e2">eka-rūpa</span>–in one form <span class="e2">śachīra kumāra’</span>–as the son of Śachī.’ [37]
“‘Nabadwīp is very dear to Us. Here, We are present in one form as the son of Śachī Devī.’
বলিতে বলিতে গৌর-রূপ প্রকাশিল ।<br />রূপ দেখি’ নিম্বাদিত্য বিহ্বল হইল ॥৩৮॥
balite balite gaura-rūpa prakāśila<br />rūpa dekhi’ nimbāditya vihvala ha-ila [38]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–As They spoke, <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–They revealed [Their] <span class="e2">gaura-rūpa</span>–form as Gaura. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–this form, <span class="e2">nimbāditya</span>–Nimbāditya <span class="e2">vihvala</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–was overwhelmed. [38]
“As They spoke, They revealed Their form as Gaurāṅga. Seeing this form, Nimbāditya was overwhelmed.
বলে, ‘কভু নাহি দেখি নাহি শুনি কানে ।<br />এ হেন অপূর্ব্ব রূপ আছে কোনখানে’ ॥৩৯॥
bale, ‘kabhu nāhi dekhi nāhi śuni kāne<br />e hena apūrva rūpa āchhe kona-khāne’ [39]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">‘kabhu</span> <span class="e2">dekhi nāhi</span>–‘I have never seen <span class="e2">śuni nāhi</span>–or heard <span class="e2">kāne</span>–with [my] ears <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">hena</span>–of this <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–extraordinary <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–existing <span class="e2">kona-khāne’</span>–anywhere.’ [39]
“He said, ‘I have never seen or heard of this extraordinary form anywhere.’
কৃপা করি’ মহাপ্রভু বলিল তখন ।<br />এরূপ গোপন এবে কর মহাজন ॥৪০॥
kṛpā kari’ mahāprabhu balila takhana<br />e-rūpa gopana ebe kara mahājana [40]
<span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘mahājana</span>–‘O great soul, <span class="e2">ebe</span>–for now,<span class="e2"> e-rūpa</span> <span class="e2">gopana</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–keep this form a secret. [40]
“Mahāprabhu then mercifully said, ‘O great soul, for now, keep this form a secret.
প্রচারহ কৃষ্ণভক্তি যুগল-বিলাস ।<br />যুগল-বিলাসে মোর অত্যন্ত উল্লাস ॥৪১॥
prachāraha kṛṣṇa-bhakti yugala-vilāsa<br />yugala-vilāse mora atyanta ullāsa [41]
<span class="e2">prachāraha</span>–Preach <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">yugala-vilāsa</span>–the Pastimes of the Divine Couple. <span class="e2">yugala</span>-<span class="e2">vilāse</span>–The Divine Couples’ Pastimes [are] <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">atyanta</span>–greatest <span class="e2">ullāsa</span>–joy. [41]
“‘Preach devotion to Kṛṣṇa and the Pastimes of the Divine Couple. Their Pastimes are My greatest joy.
যে সময়ে গৌররূপ প্রকট হইবে ।<br />শ্রীবিদ্যাবিলাসে তবে বড় রঙ্গ হবে ॥৪২॥
ye samaye gaura-rūpa prakaṭa ha-ibe<br />śrī-vidyā-vilāse tabe baḍa raṅga habe [42]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">samaye</span>–When [My] <span class="e2">gaura-rūpa</span>–form of Gaura <span class="e2">prakaṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–appears, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">raṅga</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–I will take great pleasure <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-vilāse</span>–in Pastimes of scholarship. [42]
“‘When I appear in the form of Gaura, I will find great pleasure in Pastimes of scholarship.
সে সময়ে কাশ্মীর প্রদেশে জন্ম লয়ে ।<br />ভ্রমিবে ভারতবর্ষ দিগ্বিজয়ী হয়ে ॥৪৩॥
se samaye kāśmīra pradeśe janma laye<br />bhramibe bhārata-varṣa digvijayī haye [43]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">samaye</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">janma</span> <span class="e2">laye</span>–you will take birth <span class="e2">kāśmīra</span> <span class="e2">pradeśe</span>–in the region of Kāśmīr [and] <span class="e2">bhramibe</span>–travel <span class="e2">bhārata-varṣa</span>–throughout the land of Bhārat (India), <span class="e2">digvijayī</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–conquering all directions. [43]
“‘At that time, you will take birth in Kāśmīr and travel throughout the land of Bhārat, conquering all directions.
কেশব কাশ্মীরী নামে সকলে তোমায় ।<br />মহাবিদ্যাবান বলি’ সর্ব্বত্রেতে গায় ॥৪৪॥
keśava kāśmīrī nāme sakale tomāya<br />mahāvidyāvāna bali’ sarvatrete gāya [44]
<span class="e2">sakale</span>–Everyone,<span class="e2"> sarvatrete</span>–everywhere, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–will call <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–you <span class="e2">nāme</span>–by the name <span class="e2">keśava</span> <span class="e2">kāśmīrī</span>–Keśava Kāśmīrī [and] <span class="e2">gāya</span>–praise [you for being] <span class="e2">mahāvidyāvāna</span>–highly learned. [44]
“‘Everyone, everywhere, will call you Keśava Kāśmīrī and praise you for being highly learned.
ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে এই নবদ্বীপধামে ।<br />আসিয়া থাকিবে তুমি মায়াপুর-গ্রামে ॥৪৫॥
bhramite bhramite ei navadvīpa-dhāme<br />āsiyā thākibe tumi māyāpura-grāme [45]
<span class="e2">bhramite</span> <span class="e2">bhramite</span>–While travelling, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–will come <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāme</span>–to Nabadwīp Dhām [and] <span class="e2">thākibe</span>–stay <span class="e2">māyāpura-grāme</span>–in the village of Māyāpur. [45]
“‘While travelling, you will come to Nabadwīp Dhām and stay in the village of Māyāpur.
নবদ্বীপে বড় বড় অধ্যাপকগণ ।<br />তব নাম শুনি’ করিবেক পলায়ন ॥৪৬॥
navadvīpe baḍa baḍa adhyāpaka-gaṇa<br />tava nāma śuni’ karibeka palāyana [46]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name, <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">adhyāpaka-gaṇa</span>–the greatest scholars <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">palāyana karibeka</span>–will flee. [46]
“‘Hearing your name, the greatest scholars in Nabadwīp will flee.
আমি ত তখন বিদ্যাবিলাসে মাতিব ।<br />পরাজিয়া তোমা সবে আনন্দ লভিব ॥৪৭॥
āmi ta takhana vidyā-vilāse mātiba<br />parājiyā tomā sabe ānanda labhiba [47]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ta mātiba</span>–will be immersed <span class="e2">vidyā-vilāse</span>–in Pastimes of scholarship, [and] <span class="e2">parājiyā</span>–I will defeat <span class="e2">tomā sabe</span>–you, [and] <span class="e2">ānanda</span> <span class="e2">labhiba</span>–feel pleasure. [47]
“‘At that time, immersed in Pastimes of scholarship, I will defeat you and feel great pleasure.
সরস্বতী-কৃপাবলে জানি’ মম তত্ত্ব ।<br />আশ্রয় করিবে মোরে ছাড়িয়া মহত্ত্ব ॥৪৮॥
sarasvatī-kṛpā-bale jāni’ mama tattva<br />āśraya karibe more chhāḍiyā mahattva [48]
<span class="e2">sarasvatī-kṛpā-bale</span>–By the grace of Saraswatī, <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–you will understand <span class="e2">mama</span>–My <span class="e2">tattva</span>–identity, <span class="e2">āśraya</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–take shelter <span class="e2">more</span>–of Me, [and] <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–give up [your] <span class="e2">mahattva</span>–pride. [48]
“‘By the grace of Saraswatī, you will understand My identity, take shelter of Me, and give up your pride.
ভক্তি দান করি’ আমি তোমারে তখন ।<br />ভক্তি প্রচারিতে পুনঃ করিব প্রেরণ ॥৪৯॥
bhakti dāna kari’ āmi tomāre takhana<br />bhakti prachārite punaḥ kariba preraṇa [49]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then,<span class="e2"> āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">dāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–will give <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–you <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion [and] <span class="e2">preraṇa kariba</span>–send [you] <span class="e2">prachārite</span>–to preach <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. [49]
“‘Then, I will give you devotion and send you to preach devotion again.
অতএব দ্বৈতাদ্বৈত-মত প্রচারিয়া ।<br />তুষ্ট কর এবে মোরে গোপন করিয়া ॥৫০॥
ataeva dvaitādvaita-mata prachāriyā<br />tuṣṭa kara ebe more gopana kariyā [50]
<span class="e2">ataeva ebe</span>–So for now, <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–satisfy [Me] <span class="e2">prachāriyā</span>–by preaching <span class="e2">dvaitādvaita-mata</span>–the conception of dualistic non-dualism [and] <span class="e2">more</span> <span class="e2">gopana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–keep Me secret. [50]
“‘So for now, satisfy Me by preaching the conception of dualistic nondualism and keep My identity secret.
যবে আমি সঙ্কীর্ত্তন আরম্ভ করিব ।<br />তোমাদের মতসার নিজে প্রচারিব ॥৫১॥
yabe āmi saṅkīrtana ārambha kariba<br />tomādera mata-sāra nije prachāriba [51]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ārambha</span> <span class="e2">kariba</span>–start <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–saṅkīrtan, <span class="e2">nije</span> <span class="e2">prachāriba</span>–I will personally preach <span class="e2">tomādera</span> <span class="e2">mata-sāra</span>–the essence of Your conception. [51]
“‘When I start My saṅkīrtan Pastimes, I will preach the essence of your conception.
মধ্ব হইতে সারদ্বয় করিব গ্রহণ ।<br />এক হয় কেবল-অদ্বৈত নিরসন ॥৫২॥
madhva ha-ite sāra-dvaya kariba grahaṇa<br />eka haya kevala-advaita nirasana [52]
<span class="e2">grahaṇa kariba</span>–I will accept <span class="e2">sāra-dvaya</span>–two essential principles <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">madhva</span>–Madhva Āchārya. <span class="e2">eka</span>–One <span class="e2">haya</span>–is [his] <span class="e2">nirasana</span>–refutation <span class="e2">kevala-advaita</span>–of exclusive nondualism. [52]
“‘I will accept two essential principles from Madhva Āchārya. One is his refutation of exclusive nondualism.
কৃষ্ণমূর্ত্তি নিত্য জানি তাঁহার সেবন ।<br />সেই ত দ্বিতীয় সার জান মহাজন ॥৫৩॥
kṛṣṇa-mūrti nitya jāni’ tā̐hāra sevana<br />sei ta dvitīya sāra jāna mahājana [53]
<span class="e2">mahājana</span>–O great soul, <span class="e2">jāna</span>–know <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–the <span class="e2">dvitīya</span>–second <span class="e2">sāra</span>–essential principle [to be] <span class="e2">sevana</span>–serving <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-mūrti</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Deity form, <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–knowing <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span>–Him [to be] <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal. [53]
“‘O great soul, know the second essential principle to be serving Kṛṣṇa’s Deity form, knowing the Deity to be eternal.
রামানুজ হৈতে আমি লই দুই সার ।<br />অনন্য ভকতি ভক্তজন সেবা আর ॥৫৪॥
rāmānuja haite āmi la-i dui sāra<br />ananya bhakati bhakta-jana sevā āra [54]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Rāmānuja, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">la-i</span>–will take <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">sāra</span>–essential principles: <span class="e2">ananya</span> <span class="e2">bhakati</span>–exclusive devotion (devotion free from karma, yoga, and jñān) <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span> <span class="e2">sevā</span>–service to the devotees. [54]
“‘From Rāmānuja, I will take two essential principles: exclusive devotion and service to the devotees.
বিষ্ণু হৈতে দুই সার করিব স্বীকার ।<br />তদীয় সর্ব্বস্ব ভাব রাগমার্গ আর ॥৫৫॥
viṣṇu haite dui sāra kariba svīkāra<br />tadīya sarvasva bhāva rāga-mārga āra [55]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">viṣṇu</span>–Viṣṇu Swāmī, <span class="e2">svīkāra kariba</span>–I will accept <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">sāra</span>–essential principles: <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–the mood [that] <span class="e2">sarvasva</span>–one’s all [is] <span class="e2">tadīya</span>–His <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">rāga-mārga</span>–the path of love. [55]
“‘From Viṣṇu Swāmī, I will accept two essential principles: surrender to the Lord and the path of love.
তোমা হৈতে লব আমি দুই মহাসার ।<br />একান্ত রাধিকাশ্রয় গোপীভাব আর’ ॥৫৬॥
tomā haite laba āmi dui mahāsāra<br />ekānta rādhikāśraya gopī-bhāva āra’ [56]
<span class="e2">haite</span>–From <span class="e2">tomā</span>–you, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">laba</span>–will accept <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">mahāsāra</span>–most essential principles: <span class="e2">ekānta</span> <span class="e2">rādhikāśraya</span>–taking shelter of Rādhārāṇī exclusively <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">gopī-bhāva’</span>–the mood of the gopīs.’ [56]
“‘From you, I will accept two most essential principles: taking shelter of Rādhārāṇī exclusively and serving in the mood of the gopīs.’
এত বলি’ গৌরচন্দ্র হৈল অদর্শন ।<br />প্রেমে নিম্বাদিত্য কত করিল রোদন ॥৫৭॥
eta bali’ gaurachandra haila adarśana<br />preme nimbāditya kata karila rodana [57]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">adarśana haila</span>–disappeared, [and] <span class="e2">nimbāditya</span>–Nimbāditya <span class="e2">rodana karila</span>–cried <span class="e2">kata</span>–profusely <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. [57]
“Saying this, Gaurachandra disappeared, and Nimbāditya cried profusely with divine love.
গুরুপাদপদ্ম নমি’ চলে দেশান্তর ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তি প্রচারিতে হইলা তৎপর” ॥৫৮॥
guru-pāda-padma nami’ chale deśāntara<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti prachārite ha-ilā tatpara” [58]
<span class="e2">nami’</span>–Nimbāditya [then] bowed <span class="e2">guru-pāda-padma</span>–at the lotus feet of his Guru [and] <span class="e2">chale</span>–travelled <span class="e2">deśāntara</span>–elsewhere, <span class="e2">tatpara ha-ilā</span>–intent <span class="e2">prachārite</span>–upon preaching <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti”</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa.” [58]
“Nimbāditya then bowed at the lotus feet of his Guru and travelled elsewhere, intent upon preaching devotion to Kṛṣṇa.”
দূর হৈতে রামতীর্থ জীবেরে দেখায় ।<br />কোলাসুরে হলধর বধিল যথায় ॥৫৯॥
করিলেন গঙ্গাস্নান লয়ে যদুগণ ।<br />রুক্মপুর বলি’ নাম প্রকাশ এখন ॥৬০॥
dūra haite rāma-tīrtha jīvere dekhāya<br />kolāsure haladhara badhila yathāya [59]
karilena gaṅgā-snāna laye yadu-gaṇa<br />rukmapura bali’ nāma prakāśa ekhana [60]
<span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–From afar, <span class="e2">dekhāya</span>–Nityānanda showed <span class="e2">rāma-tīrtha</span>–Rāma Tīrtha <span class="e2">jīvere</span>–to Jīva, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">haladhara</span>–Balarām <span class="e2">badhila</span>–killed <span class="e2">kolāsure</span>–Kolāsura [and] <span class="e2">gaṅgā-snāna karilena</span>–bathed in the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">yadu-gaṇa</span>–the Yadus. [This place’s] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–has manifested <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now <span class="e2">bali’</span>–as <span class="e2">rukmapura</span>–Rukmapur. [59<span class="e2">–</span>60]
From afar, Nityānanda Prabhu showed Rāma Tīrtha to Jīva, where Balarām killed Kolāsura and bathed in the Gaṅgā with the Yadus. This place is now known as Rukmapur.
নবদ্বীপ-পরিক্রমা ঐ একশেষ ।<br />কার্ত্তিক মাসেতে তথা মাহাত্ম্য বিশেষ ॥৬১॥
navadvīpa-parikramā ei eka-śeṣa<br />kārtika māsete tathā māhātmya viśeṣa [61]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">eka-śeṣa</span>–one end [of the route for] <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–circumambulation <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–of Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–Special <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–glories [manifest] <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">kārtika</span> <span class="e2">māsete</span>–during Kārtik (October–November). [61]
It is at one end of the route to circumambulate Nabadwīp. It is especially glorious during the month of Kārtik.
বিল্বপক্ষ ছাড়ি’ প্রভু লয়ে ভক্তগণ ।<br />ভরদ্বাজটিলা গ্রামে করে আরোহণ ॥৬২॥
bilvapakṣa chhāḍi’ prabhu laye bhakta-gaṇa<br />bharadvāja-ṭilā grāme kare ārohaṇa [62]
<span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Leaving <span class="e2">bilvapakṣa</span>–Bilvapakṣa, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees, <span class="e2">ārohaṇa kare</span>–went <span class="e2">grāme</span>–to the village <span class="e2">bharadvāja-ṭilā</span>–of Bharadvāja Ṭilā. [62]
Leaving Bilvapakṣa, Nityānanda Prabhu and the devotees went to Bharadvāja Ṭilā.
নিত্যানন্দ বলে, “এই স্থানে মুনিবর ।<br />আইলেন দেখি’ তীর্থ শ্রীগঙ্গাসাগর ॥৬৩॥
nityānanda bale, “ei sthāne muni-vara<br />āilena dekhi’ tīrtha śrī-gaṅgā-sāgara [63]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“muni-vara</span>–“The best of sages, Bharadvāja Muni, <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–visited <span class="e2">śrī-gaṅgā-sāgara tīrtha</span>–Śrī Gaṅgā Sāgar Tīrtha [and then] <span class="e2">āilena</span>–came <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here. [63]
Nityānanda said, “The best of the sages, Bharadvāja Muni, visited Śrī Gaṅgā Sāgar and then came here.
হেথা শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গচন্দ্র করি’আরাধন ।<br />রহিলেন কতদিন মুনি মহাজন ॥৬৪॥
hethā śrī-gaurāṅga-chandra kari’ ārādhana<br />rahilena kata-dina muni mahājana [64]
<span class="e2">muni</span> <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–The great sage <span class="e2">rahilena</span>–stayed <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time <span class="e2">ārādhana kari’</span>–worshipping <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-chandra</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅgachandra. [64]
“The great sage stayed here for some time worshipping Śrī Gaurāṅgachandra.
তাঁর আরাধনে তুষ্ট হয়ে বিশ্বম্ভর ।<br />নিজরূপে দেখা দিলা সদয় অন্তর ॥৬৫॥
tā̐ra ārādhane tuṣṭa haye viśvambhara<br />nija-rūpe dekhā dilā sadaya antara [65]
<span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–Satisfied <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">ārādhane</span>–by his worship, <span class="e2">viśvambhara</span>–Viśvambhar <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dilā</span>–revealed <span class="e2">nija-rūpe</span>–His form <span class="e2">sadaya</span> <span class="e2">antara</span>–with a compassionate heart. [65]
“Satisfied by the worship of the sage, Viśvambhar revealed His form to the sage with a compassionate heart.
মুনিরে বলিল, ‘তব ইষ্ট সিদ্ধ হবে ।<br />আমার প্রকটকালে আমারে দেখিবে’ ॥৬৬॥
munire balila, ‘tava iṣṭa siddha habe<br />āmāra prakaṭa-kāle āmāre dekhibe’ [66]
<span class="e2">balila</span>–He said <span class="e2">munire</span>–to the sage, <span class="e2">‘tava</span>–‘Your <span class="e2">iṣṭa</span>–desire <span class="e2">siddha</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be fulfilled: <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–you will see <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–Me <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">prakaṭa-kāle’</span>–at the time of My appearance.’ [66]
“He said to the sage, ‘Your desire will be fulfilled: you will see Me at the time of My appearance.’
এই কথা বলি’ প্রভু হৈল অন্তর্দ্ধান ।<br />ভরদ্বাজ মহাপ্রেমে হইল অজ্ঞান ॥৬৭॥
ei kathā bali’ prabhu haila antardhāna<br />bharadvāja mahāpreme ha-ila ajñāna [67]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Speaking <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">kathā</span>–statement, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">antardhāna haila</span>–disappeared, [and] <span class="e2">bharadvāja</span>–Bharadvāja Muni <span class="e2">ajñāna ha-ila</span>–fainted <span class="e2">mahāpreme</span>–with intense divine love. [67]
“Saying this, the Lord disappeared, and Bharadvāja Muni fainted with intense divine love.
কতদিন থাকি’ এই টিলার উপর ।<br />অন্যতীর্থ দরশনে গেলা মুনিবর ॥৬৮॥
kata-dina thāki’ ei ṭilāra upara<br />anya-tīrtha daraśane gelā muni-vara [68]
<span class="e2">muni-vara</span>–The great sage <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–stayed <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ṭilāra</span> <span class="e2">upara</span>–on top of this hill <span class="e2">kata-dina</span>–for some time [and then] <span class="e2">gelā</span>–went <span class="e2">daraśane</span>–to visit <span class="e2">anya-tīrtha</span>–other holy places. [68]
“The great sage stayed here for some time on this hill and then went to visit other holy places.
লোকেতে ভারুইডাঙ্গা বলে এই স্থানে ।<br />মহাতীর্থ হয় এই শাস্ত্রের বিধানে” ॥৬৯॥
lokete bhāruiḍāṅgā bale ei sthāne<br />mahātīrtha haya ei śāstrera vidhāne” [69]
<span class="e2">lokete</span>–People <span class="e2">bale</span>–call <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–place <span class="e2">bhāruiḍāṅgā</span>–Bhāruiḍāṅgā. <span class="e2">ei</span>–It <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">mahātīrtha</span>–a great holy place <span class="e2">śāstrera</span> <span class="e2">vidhāne”</span>–according to the verdict of the scriptures.” [69]
“People call this place Bhāruiḍāṅgā. The scriptures say that it is a great holy place.”
বলিতে বলিতে সবে যায় মায়াপুর ।<br />আগুবাড়ি লয় সবে ঈশান ঠাকুর ॥৭০॥
balite balite sabe yāya māyāpura<br />āgubāḍi laya sabe īśāna ṭhākura [70]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–While speaking, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">yāya</span>–arrived <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–in Māyāpur. <span class="e2">īśāna</span> <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–Īśān Ṭhākur <span class="e2">āgubāḍi</span>–came forward [and] <span class="e2">laya</span>–received <span class="e2">sabe</span>–them. [70]
While speaking, the party arrived in Māyāpur. Īśān Ṭhākur came forward and received them.
মহাপ্রেমে নিত্যানন্দ করেন নর্ত্তন ।<br />সকল বৈষ্ণব মেলি’ করেন কীর্ত্তন ॥৭১॥
mahāpreme nityānanda karena nartana<br />sakala vaiṣṇava meli’ karena kīrtana [71]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">nartana karena</span>–danced <span class="e2">mahāpreme</span>–with intense divine love, [and] <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–all the Vaiṣṇavas <span class="e2">meli’</span>–joined together [and] <span class="e2">kīrtana karena</span>–chanted. [71]
Nityānanda Prabhu danced with intense divine love, and all the Vaiṣṇavas joined together and chanted.
জগন্নাথ-মিশ্রালয় সর্ব্বপীঠসার ।<br />নাম সহ যথা শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-অবতার ॥৭২॥
jagannātha-miśrālaya sarva-pīṭha-sāra<br />nāma saha yathā śrī-gaurāṅga-avatāra [72]
<span class="e2">jagannātha-miśrālaya</span>–The home of Jagannāth Miśra, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">avatāra</span>–descended <span class="e2">saha</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name, <span class="e2">sarva-pīṭha-sāra</span>–is the best of all holy places. [72]
The home of Jagannāth Miśra, where Śrī Gaurāṅga descended with His Name, is the best of all holy places.
সেই দিন প্রভুগৃহে প্রভুর জননী ।<br />বৈষ্ণবগণেরে অন্ন খাওয়ান আপনি ॥৭৩॥
sei dina prabhu-gṛhe prabhura jananī<br />vaiṣṇava-gaṇere anna khāoyāna āpani [73]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–That <span class="e2">dina</span>–day, <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">jananī</span>–mother <span class="e2">āpani</span>–personally <span class="e2">anna</span> <span class="e2">khāoyāna</span>–fed <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-gaṇere</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">prabhu-gṛhe</span>–in the Lord’s home. [73]
That day, the Lord’s mother personally fed the devotees in the Lord’s home.
কি আনন্দ হৈল তথা না হয় বর্ণন ।<br />মহাসমারোহে হয় নাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥৭৪॥
ki ānanda haila tathā nā haya varṇana<br />mahāsamārohe haya nāma-saṅkīrtana [74]
<span class="e2">ki</span>–What sort <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–of joy <span class="e2">haila</span>–arose <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there? [It] <span class="e2">varṇana haya nā</span>–cannot be described, [and] <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana</span>–the chanting of the Name <span class="e2">mahāsamārohe haya</span>–erupted tumultuously. [74]
What sort of joy arose there? It was indescribable, and the Nām-saṅkīrtan erupted tumultuously.
নিতাইজাহ্নবাপদছায়া যার আশ ।<br />এ ভক্তিবিনোদ গায় নদীয়া-বিলাস ॥৭৫॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā yāra āśa<br />e bhakti-vinoda gāya nadīyā-vilāsa [75]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration [is] <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-vilāsa</span>–the Pastimes [of the Lord] in Nadia. [75]
Bhakti Vinod, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, chants the Pastimes of the Lord in Nadia.

Chapter Seventeen
Śrī Jīva Goswāmī’s Questions and Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu’s Answers
জয় জয় গোরাচাঁদ জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।<br />জয়াদ্বৈত গদাধর প্রেম-রসানন্দ ॥১॥
jaya jaya gorāchā̐da jaya nityānanda<br />jayādvaita gadādhara prema-rasānanda [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gorāchā̐da</span>–to Gorāchā̐d! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–to Nityānanda! <span class="e2">jayādvaita</span>–All glory to Advaita, <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar, [and] <span class="e2">prema-rasānanda</span>–the ecstatic joy of divine love! [1]
All glory to Gorāchā̐d, Nityānanda, Advaita, Gadādhar, and the ecstatic joy of divine love!
জয় শ্রীবাসাদি ভক্ত নবদ্বীপ জয় ।<br />জয় নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তন প্রেমের নিলয় ॥২॥
jaya śrīvāsādi bhakta navadvīpa jaya<br />jaya nāma-saṅkīrtana premera nilaya [2]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span> <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–to Śrīvās and the devotees! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–to Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana</span>–to the chanting of the Name, <span class="e2">premera</span> <span class="e2">nilaya</span>–the abode of divine love! [2]
All glory to Śrīvās, the devotees, and Nabadwīp! All glory to Nām-saṅkīrtan, the abode of divine love!
বসিয়াছে নিত্যানন্দ শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে ।<br />গৌরপ্রেমে বারিধারা বহে দু’নয়নে ॥৩॥
basiyāchhe nityānanda śrīvāsa-aṅgane<br />gaura-preme vāridhārā vahe du’nayane [3]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda <span class="e2">basiyāchhe</span>–sat <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–in the courtyard of Śrīvās, [and] <span class="e2">gaura-preme</span>–in divine love for Gaura, <span class="e2">vāridhārā</span>–streams of tears <span class="e2">vahe</span>–flowed <span class="e2">du’nayane</span>–from [His] two eyes. [3]
Nityānanda sat in the courtyard of Śrīvās, and in divine love for Gaura, streams of tears flowed from His eyes.
চারিদিকে বৈষ্ণব সজ্জন অগণন ।<br />গৌরপ্রেমপারাবারে মগ্ন সর্ব্বজন ॥৪॥
chāri-dike vaiṣṇava sajjana agaṇana<br />gaura-prema-pārābāre magna sarva-jana [4]
[There were] <span class="e2">agaṇana</span>–countless <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–Vaiṣṇava <span class="e2">sajjana</span>–sādhus <span class="e2">chāri-dike</span>–in all directions, [and] <span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–everyone [was] <span class="e2">magna</span>–immersed <span class="e2">gaura-prema-pārābāre</span>–in the ocean of divine love for Gaura. [4]
There were countless Vaiṣṇava sādhus in all directions, and everyone was immersed in the ocean of divine love for Gaura.
কতক্ষণে শ্রীজীব গোস্বামী মহাশয় ।<br />শ্রীযুগল-প্রেমে মত্ত, হইল উদয় ॥৫॥
kata-kṣaṇe śrī-jīva gosvāmī mahāśaya<br />śrī-yugala-preme matta, ha-ila udaya [5]
<span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇe</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span> <span class="e2">gosvāmī</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Śrī Jīva Goswāmī Mahāśay <span class="e2">matta</span> <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–became mad <span class="e2">śrī-yugala-preme</span>–with divine love for the Divine Couple. [5]
At that time, Śrī Jīva Goswāmī became mad with love for the Divine Couple.
দণ্ডবৎ প্রণমিয়া নিত্যানন্দপায় ।<br />শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে তবে গড়াগড়ি যায় ॥৬॥
