daṇḍavat praṇamiyā nityānanda-pāya<br />śrīvāsa-aṅgane tabe gaḍāgaḍi yāya [6]
<span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">praṇamiyā</span>–He prostrated [himself] <span class="e2">nityānanda-pāya</span>–at the feet of Nityānanda, [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled on the ground <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–in the courtyard of Śrīvās. [6]
He prostrated himself at the feet of Nityānanda and rolled on the ground in the courtyard of Śrīvās.
যতনে শ্রীনিত্যানন্দ জিজ্ঞাসেন বচন ।<br />“কতদিন পরে যাবে তুমি বৃন্দাবন” ॥৭॥
yatane śrī-nityānanda jijñāsena vachana<br />“kata-dina pare yābe tumi vṛndāvana” [7]
<span class="e2">yatane</span>–With affection, <span class="e2">śrī-nityānanda</span>–Śrī Nityānanda <span class="e2">vachana jijñāsena</span>–asked <span class="e2">“kata-dina</span> <span class="e2">pare</span>–“After how many days <span class="e2">tumi yābe</span>–will you go [to] <span class="e2">vṛndāvana”</span>–Vṛndāvan?” [7]
Affectionately, Nityānanda Prabhu asked, “When will you go to Vṛndāvan?”
জীব বলে, “প্রভু-আজ্ঞা সর্ব্বোপরি হয় ।<br />আজ্ঞা পাইলে করি আমি বৃন্দাবনাশ্রয় ॥৮॥
jīva bale, “prabhu-ājñā sarvopari haya<br />ājñā pāile kari āmi vṛndāvanāśraya [8]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“prabhu-ājñā</span>–“The order of the Lord <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sarvopari</span>–above all. <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">pāile</span>–When I receive Your order, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">vṛndāvanāśraya kari</span>–will take shelter in Vṛndāvan. [8]
Jīva answered, “The order of the Lord is above all. When I receive Your order, I will take shelter in Vṛndāvan.
দুই এক কথা মোর আছে জিজ্ঞাসিতে ।<br />উত্তর দাও হে প্রভু এ দাসের হিতে ॥৯॥
dui eka kathā mora āchhe jijñāsite<br />uttara dāo he prabhu e dāsera hite [9]
<span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–I have <span class="e2">eka</span>–one [or] <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">kathā</span>–questions <span class="e2">jijñāsite</span>–to ask [You]. <span class="e2">he</span>–O <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord, <span class="e2">uttara</span> <span class="e2">dāo</span>–please answer [them] <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dāsera</span> <span class="e2">hite</span>–for the benefit of this servant. [9]
“I have one or two questions to ask You. O Lord, please answer them for the benefit of this servant.
এই নবদ্বীপধাম হয় বৃন্দাবন ।<br />তবে কেন বৃন্দাবন গমনে যতন” ॥১০॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma haya vṛndāvana<br />tabe kena vṛndāvana gamane yatana” [10]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–So, <span class="e2">kena</span>–why <span class="e2">yatana</span>–should I endeavour <span class="e2">gamane</span>–to go <span class="e2">vṛndāvana”</span>–to Vṛndāvan?” [10]
“Nabadwīp Dhām is Vṛndāvan. So, why should I endeavour to go to Vṛndāvan?”
জীব-প্রশ্ন শুনি’ প্রভু করেন উত্তর ।<br />“বড় গুহ্যকথা এই শুন অতঃপর ॥১১॥
jīva-praśna śuni’ prabhu karena uttara<br />“baḍa guhya-kathā ei śuna ataḥpara [11]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">jīva-praśna</span>–Jīva’s question, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">uttara karena</span>–answered, <span class="e2">“ei</span>–“This [is] <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">guhya-kathā</span>–a very confidential subject. <span class="e2">śuna</span>–Listen <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–from now on. [11]
Hearing Jīva’s question, Nityānanda Prabhu answered, “This is a very confidential subject. Now listen.
প্রভুর প্রকট-লীলা যতদিন রয় ।<br />দেখ যেন বহির্ম্মুখ জনে না জানয় ॥১২॥
prabhura prakaṭa-līlā yata-dina raya<br />dekha yena bahirmukha jane nā jānaya [12]
<span class="e2">yata-dina</span>–As long as <span class="e2">prakaṭa-līlā</span>–the manifest Pastimes <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord <span class="e2">raya</span>–continue, <span class="e2">dekha</span> <span class="e2">yena</span>–see to it that <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–averse souls <span class="e2">jānaya nā</span>–do not know [about this]. [12]
“As long as the Pastimes of the Lord remain manifest, see to it that averse souls do not know about this.
নবদ্বীপ বৃন্দাবন হয় এক তত্ত্ব ।<br />পরস্পর কিছু নাহি হীনত্ব মহত্ত্ব ॥১৩॥
navadvīpa vṛndāvana haya eka tattva<br />paraspara kichhu nāhi hīnatva mahattva [13]
<span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">tattva</span>–truth; <span class="e2">paraspara</span> <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–neither one [is] <span class="e2">hīnatva</span>–lesser [or] <span class="e2">mahattva</span>–greater [than the other]. [13]
“Nabadwīp and Vṛndāvan are one; neither one is lesser or greater than the other.
সেই বৃন্দাবনধাম রসের আধার ।<br />সে রস না পায় যার নাহি অধিকার ॥১৪॥
sei vṛndāvana-dhāma rasera ādhāra<br />se rasa nā pāya yāra nāhi adhikāra [14]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vṛndāvana-dhāma</span>–Vṛndāvan Dhām [is] <span class="e2">ādhāra</span>–an abode <span class="e2">rasera</span>–of divine love, [but] <span class="e2">se yāra nāhi</span>–souls who have no <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–qualification <span class="e2">pāya nā</span>–do not attain <span class="e2">se</span>–that <span class="e2">rasa</span>–rasa. [14]
“Vṛndāvan Dhām is an abode of rasa, but unqualified souls do not attain that rasa.
কৃপা করি’ সেই ধাম নবদ্বীপ হয় ।<br />হেথা রস-অধিকার জীবে উপজয় ॥১৫॥
kṛpā kari’ sei dhāma navadvīpa haya<br />hethā rasa-adhikāra jīve upajaya [15]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–That <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">haya</span>–manifests <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–as Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, <span class="e2">jīve</span> <span class="e2">upajaya</span>–souls develop <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–the qualification <span class="e2">rasa</span>–for divine love. [15]
“Vṛndāvan Dhām mercifully manifests as Nabadwīp, and here, souls develop the qualification to attain rasa.
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-লীলা হয় সর্ব্বরসসার ।<br />সহসা তাহাতে নাহি হয় অধিকার ॥১৬॥
rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā haya sarva-rasa-sāra<br />sahasā tāhāte nāhi haya adhikāra [16]
<span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā</span>–The Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">sarva-rasa-sāra</span>–the highest of all rasas, [and] <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–qualification <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–for them <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–does not come <span class="e2">sahasā</span>–immediately. [16]
“The Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are the highest of all rasas, and qualification for them does not come immediately.
কত জন্ম তপস্যা করিয়া হয় জ্ঞান ।<br />জ্ঞান পরিপক্কে পায় রসের সন্ধান ॥১৭॥
kata janma tapasyā kariyā haya jñāna<br />jñāna paripakke pāya rasera sandhāna [17]
<span class="e2">tapasyā</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–Performing austerities <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">janma</span>–for many births <span class="e2">haya</span>–results in <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge, [and] <span class="e2">jñāna</span> <span class="e2">paripakke</span>–when knowledge matures, <span class="e2">rasera</span> <span class="e2">sandhāna pāya</span>–souls discover rasa. [17]
“Performing austerities for many births results in knowledge, and when knowledge matures, souls discover rasa.
তাহাতে ব্যাঘাত বহু আছে সর্ব্বক্ষণ ।<br />অতএব সুদুর্ল্লভ রস মহাধন ॥১৮॥
tāhāte vyāghāta bahu āchhe sarva-kṣaṇa<br />ataeva sudurlabha rasa mahādhana [18]
<span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There are <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–always <span class="e2">bahu</span>–many <span class="e2">vyāghāta</span>–obstacles <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–in this regard, [and] <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–thus, <span class="e2">mahādhana</span>–the supreme wealth <span class="e2">rasa</span>–of rasa [is] <span class="e2">sudurlabha</span>–very difficult to attain. [18]
“There are always many obstacles involved, and thus, the supreme wealth of rasa is very difficult to attain.
যেই সেই ব্রজে গিয়া নাহি পায় রস ।<br />অপরাধ-বশে রস হয় ত বিরস ॥১৯॥
yei sei vraje giyā nāhi pāya rasa<br />aparādha-vaśe rasa haya ta virasa [19]
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">sei</span>–Everyone who <span class="e2">giyā</span>–goes <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–does not attain <span class="e2">rasa</span>–rasa, [and] <span class="e2">aparādha</span> <span class="e2">vaśe</span>–as a result of offences, <span class="e2">rasa</span>–rasa <span class="e2">haya</span>–becomes <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">virasa</span>–tasteless. [19]
“Not everyone who goes to Vraja attains rasa, and as a result of offences, rasa becomes tasteless.
ঘোর কলিকালে অপরাধ সর্ব্বকাল ।<br />জীবের জীবন স্বল্প বড়ই জঞ্জাল ॥২০॥
ghora kali-kāle aparādha sarva-kāla<br />jīvera jīvana svalpa baḍa-i jañjāla [20]
<span class="e2">ghora</span> <span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–During the darkness of the Age of Kali, <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences [are] <span class="e2">sarva-kāla</span>–constant, [and] <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–the life <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of a soul [is] <span class="e2">svalpa</span>–short [and] <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span>–extremely <span class="e2">jañjāla</span>–troublesome. [20]
“During the darkness of Kali-yuga, offences are constant, and the life of a soul is short and extremely troublesome.
ইচ্ছা করিলেও ব্রজরস লভ্য নয় ।<br />অতএব কৃষ্ণকৃপা রসহেতু হয় ॥২১॥
ichchhā karileo vraja-rasa labhya naya<br />ataeva kṛṣṇa-kṛpā rasa-hetu haya [21]
<span class="e2">ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">karileo</span>–Even if souls desire [it,] <span class="e2">vraja-rasa</span>–the rasa of Vraja <span class="e2">labhya</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–is not attainable. <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kṛpā</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s mercy <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">rasa-hetu</span>–the [only] cause of rasa. [21]
“Even if souls desire it, the rasa of Vraja is not attainable. The mercy of Kṛṣṇa is therefore the only cause of attaining rasa.
রাধাকৃষ্ণ কৃপা করি’ জীবের উপর ।<br />বৃন্দাবন সহ সমুদিতে অতঃপর ॥২২॥
rādhā-kṛṣṇa kṛpā kari’ jīvera upara<br />vṛndāvana saha samudita ataḥpara [22]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Being merciful <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">upara</span>–to the souls, <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ataḥpara samudita</span>–have since appeared <span class="e2">saha</span>–with <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. [22]
“Being merciful to the souls, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa have again appeared with Vṛndāvan.
একমূর্ত্তি রাধাকৃষ্ণ প্রভু গৌরহরি ।<br />শচীগর্ভে নবদ্বীপে এবে অবতরি’ ॥২৩॥
রস-অধিকার জীবে করেন প্রদান ।<br />অপরাধ বাধা কভু নাহি পায় স্থান ॥২৪॥
eka-mūrti rādhā-kṛṣṇa prabhu gaurahari<br />śachī-garbhe navadvīpe ebe avatari’ [23]
rasa-adhikāra jīve karena pradāna<br />aparādha bādhā kabhu nāhi pāya sthāna [24]
<span class="e2">avatari’</span>–Descending <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">śachī-garbhe</span>–through Śachī’s womb <span class="e2">eka-mūrti</span>–in one form, <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">gaurahari prabhu</span>–as Lord Gaurahari, <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">pradāna karena</span>–give <span class="e2">jīve</span>–souls <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–qualification <span class="e2">rasa</span>–for rasa. <span class="e2">bādhā</span>–The obstacle <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–of offences <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–never has <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–a place [in Nabadwīp]. [23<span class="e2">–</span>24]
“Descending in Nabadwīp through the womb of Śachī Devī in one form, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, as Lord Gaurahari, now give souls qualification for rasa. Offences are never an obstacle in Nabadwīp.
হেথা বাস করি’ নাম করিলে আশ্রয় ।<br />রসে অধিকার জন্মে অপরাধ ক্ষয় ॥২৫॥
hethā vāsa kari’ nāma karile āśraya<br />rase adhikāra janme aparādha kṣaya [25]
<span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–If souls reside <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">āśraya karile</span>–take shelter <span class="e2">nāma</span>–of the Name, [their] <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–qualification <span class="e2">rase</span>–for rasa <span class="e2">janme</span>–develops [and their] <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences [are] <span class="e2">kṣaya</span>–eradicated. [25]
“If souls reside here and take shelter of the Name, their qualification for rasa develops and their offences are eradicated.
স্বল্পদিনে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম হয় ত উজ্জ্বল ।<br />যুগল-রসের বার্ত্তা হয় ত প্রবল ॥২৬॥
svalpa-dine kṛṣṇa-prema haya ta ujjvala<br />yugala-rasera vārtā haya ta prabala [26]
<span class="e2">svalpa-dine</span>–Within a short time, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–divine love for Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">ta ujjvala</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–shines [within them, and] <span class="e2">vārtā</span>–discussion <span class="e2">yugala-rasera</span>–of the Divine Couple’s rasa <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">prabala haya</span>–captivates [him]. [26]
“Within a short time, divine love for Kṛṣṇa shines within them, and they become captivated by discussion of the Divine Couple’s rasa.
তবে জীব গৌরকৃপা করিয়া অর্জ্জন ।<br />যুগল-রসের পীঠ পায় বৃন্দাবন ॥২৭॥
tabe jīva gaura-kṛpā kariyā arjana<br />yugala-rasera pīṭha pāya vṛndāvana [27]
<span class="e2">arjana kariyā</span>–Attaining <span class="e2">gaura-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of Gaura, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">vṛndāvana pāya</span>–reach Vṛndāvan, <span class="e2">yugala-rasera</span> <span class="e2">pīṭha</span>–the abode of the Divine Couple’s rasa. [27]
“Attaining the mercy of Gaura, souls then reach Vṛndāvan, the abode of the Divine Couple’s rasa.
গূঢ়তত্ত্ব এই নাহি কহ যারে তারে ।<br />নবদ্বীপ-বৃন্দাবনে ভেদ হইতে নারে ॥২৮॥
gūḍha-tattva ei nāhi kaha yāre tāre<br />navadvīpa-vṛndāvane bheda ha-ite nāre [28]
<span class="e2">kaha nāhi</span>–Do not tell <span class="e2">yāre</span> <span class="e2">tāre</span>–anyone <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">gūḍha-tattva</span>–confidential truth. <span class="e2">ha-ite</span> <span class="e2">nāre</span>–There can be no <span class="e2">bheda</span>–difference <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vṛndāvane</span>–between Nabadwīp and Vṛndāvan. [28]
“Do not tell anyone this confidential truth. There is no difference between Nabadwīp and Vṛndāvan.
তোমার আশ্রয় এবে রসপীঠ হয় ।<br />অতএব বৃন্দাবন করহ আশ্রয় ॥২৯॥
tomāra āśraya ebe rasa-pīṭha haya<br />ataeva vṛndāvana karaha āśraya [29]
<span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">āśraya</span>–shelter <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">rasa-pīṭha</span>–that abode of rasa. <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">āśraya karaha</span>–take shelter <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–in Vṛndāvan. [29]
“Your shelter is now that abode of rasa. Therefore, take shelter in Vṛndāvan.
এই ধামে বৃন্দাবন হয় ত উদয় ।<br />তবু ব্রজধাম তব হউক আশ্রয় ॥৩০॥
ei dhāme vṛndāvana haya ta udaya<br />tabu vraja-dhāma tava ha-uka āśraya [30]
<span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">udaya haya</span>–manifests <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–in this abode. <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">vraja-dhāma ha-uka</span>–let Vraja Dhām be <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">āśraya</span>–shelter. [30]
“Vṛndāvan is present here. Still, let Vraja Dhām be your shelter.
ব্রজরস অধিকারে নবদ্বীপাশ্রয় ।<br />জীবের কর্ত্তব্য সদা বল্লভতনয় ॥৩১॥
vraja-rasa adhikāre navadvīpāśraya<br />jīvera kartavya sadā vallabha-tanaya [31]
<span class="e2">vallabha-tanaya</span>–O son of Śrī Vallabha, <span class="e2">kartavya</span>–the duty <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of the soul [is] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">navadvīpāśraya</span>–to take shelter in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">adhikāre</span>–to attain qualification <span class="e2">vraja-rasa</span>–for the rasa of Vraja. [31]
“O Jīva, the duty of the soul is always to take shelter in Nabadwīp to become qualified for the rasa of Vraja.
ব্রজরস প্রাপ্তিস্থলে বৃন্দাবন বাস ।<br />জীবের যথায় হয় রসের উল্লাস ॥৩২॥
vraja-rasa prāpti-sthale vṛndāvana vāsa<br />jīvera yathāya haya rasera ullāsa [32]
<span class="e2">vraja-rasa</span> <span class="e2">prāpti-sthale</span>–In the place to attain the rasa of Vraja, <span class="e2">jīvera vāsa haya</span>–souls reside <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–in Vṛndāvan [and] <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–there [experience] <span class="e2">ullāsa</span>–the joy <span class="e2">rasera</span>–of [its] rasa. [32]
“In the place to attain the rasa of Vraja (Nabadwīp), souls reside in Vraja and experience the joy of its rasa.
নবদ্বীপ-কৃপা যবে লভে সাধুজন ।<br />তবে অনায়াসে লভে ধাম বৃন্দাবন” ॥৩৩॥
navadvīpa-kṛpā yabe labhe sādhu-jana<br />tabe anāyāse labhe dhāma vṛndāvana” [33]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">sādhu-jana</span>–sādhus <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">navadvīpa-kṛpā</span>–the grace of Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">anāyāse</span> <span class="e2">labhe</span>–they easily attain <span class="e2">vṛndāvana dhāma”</span>–Vṛndāvan Dhām.” [33]
“When sādhus attain the grace of Nabadwīp, they easily attain Vṛndāvan Dhām.”
প্রভুর সিদ্ধান্ত শুনি’ জীব মহাশয় ।<br />পরম আনন্দে প্রভুচরণ ধরয় ॥৩৪॥
prabhura siddhānta śuni’ jīva mahāśaya<br />parama ānande prabhu-charaṇa dharaya [34]
<span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">siddhānta</span>–the conclusions <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord, <span class="e2">jīva</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Jīva Mahāśay <span class="e2">dharaya</span>–grasped <span class="e2">prabhu-charaṇa</span>–the Lord’s feet <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">ānande</span>–with great joy. [34]
Hearing the conclusions of Nityānanda Prabhu, Jīva grasped His feet with great joy.
চরণ ধরিয়া বলে, “কথা এক আর ।<br />আছে মোর শুন প্রভু সর্ব্বসারাৎসার ॥৩৫॥
charaṇa dhariyā bale, “kathā eka āra<br />āchhe mora śuna prabhu sarva-sārātsāra [35]
<span class="e2">dhariyā</span>–Grasping [His] <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet, <span class="e2">bale</span>–Jīva said, <span class="e2">“mora</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–“I have <span class="e2">āra eka</span>–another <span class="e2">kathā</span>–question. <span class="e2">śuna</span>–Please hear [it,] <span class="e2">sarva-sārātsāra prabhu</span>–O Supreme Lord! [35]
Grasping His feet, Jīva said, “I have another question. Please hear it, O Supreme Lord!
এই নবদ্বীপে বাস করে বহুজন ।<br />সবে কেন কৃষ্ণভক্তি না করে অর্জ্জন ॥৩৬॥
ei navadvīpe vāsa kare bahu-jana<br />sabe kena kṛṣṇa-bhakti nā kare arjana [36]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">bahu-jana sabe vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–do many souls who reside <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">arjana kare nā</span>–not attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa? [36]
“Why do many souls who reside in Nabadwīp not attain devotion to Kṛṣṇa?
ধামে বৈসে তবু কেন অপরাধ রয় ।<br />আমার হইল এবে বিষম সংশয় ॥৩৭॥
dhāme vaise tabu kena aparādha raya<br />āmāra ha-ila ebe viṣama saṁśaya [37]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">vaise</span>–do they reside <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–in the Dhām <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">aparādha</span> <span class="e2">raya</span>–commit offences? <span class="e2">ebe ha-ila</span>–This has now become <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">viṣama</span>–troubling <span class="e2">saṁśaya</span>–doubt. [37]
“Why do souls reside in the Dhām but commit offences? This is now my troubling doubt.
কিসে তবে নিশ্চিন্ত হইবে বিষ্ণুজন ।<br />বল প্রভু বিশ্বধাম নিত্য নিরঞ্জন” ॥৩৮॥
kise tabe niśchinta ha-ibe viṣṇu-jana<br />bala prabhu viśva-dhāma nitya nirañjana” [38]
<span class="e2">kise</span>–How <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">viṣṇu-jana niśchinta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will devotees of the Lord become free from anxiety [about this]? <span class="e2">bala</span>–Please tell [me,] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–O Lord, <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">nirañjana viśva-dhāma”</span>–O pure, eternal abode of the universe!” [38]
“How will devotees of the Lord become free from anxiety about this? Please answer me, O Lord, O pure, eternal abode of the universe!”
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-পদছায়া আশ যার ।<br />সে ভক্তিবিনোদ কহে অকিঞ্চন ছার ॥৩৯॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā āśa yāra<br />se bhakti-vinoda kahe akiñchana chhāra [39]
[So] <span class="e2">kahe</span>–speaks <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">akiñchana</span> <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–the poor and fallen <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet. [39]
So speaks the poor and fallen Bhakti Vinod, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet.

Chapter Eighteen
The Removal of Śrī Jīva Goswāmī’s Doubts and His Travelling to Vṛndāvan
জয় জয় শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ শচীর নন্দন ।<br />জয় পদ্মাবতীসুত জাহ্নবাজীবন ॥১॥
jaya jaya śrī-gaurāṅga śachīra nandana<br />jaya padmāvatī-suta jāhnavā-jīvana [1]
<span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">nandana</span>–to the son of Śachī, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">padmāvatī-suta</span>–to the son of Padmāvatī, Śrī Nityānanda, <span class="e2">jāhnavā-jīvana</span>–the life of Jāhnavā! [1]
All glory to the son of Śachī, Śrī Gaurāṅga, and the son of Padmāvatī, the life of Jāhnavā!
জয় সীতাপতি জয় জয় গদাধর ।<br />জয় শ্রীবাসাদি যত গৌর-পরিকর ॥২॥
jaya sītāpati jaya jaya gadādhara<br />jaya śrīvāsādi yata gaura-parikara [2]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">sītāpati</span>–to the husband of Sītā! <span class="e2">jaya jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–to Gadādhar! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–All glory <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span> <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">gaura-parikara</span>–to Śrīvās and all the associates of the Lord! [2]
All glory to Advaita, Gadādhar, Śrīvās, and all the associates of the Lord!
শুনিয়া জীবের প্রশ্ন নিত্যানন্দরায় ।<br />বলেন নিগূঢ় তত্ত্ব বৈষ্ণব-সভায় ॥৩॥
śuniyā jīvera praśna nityānanda-rāya<br />balena nigūḍha tattva vaiṣṇava-sabhāya [3]
<span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–Jīva’s <span class="e2">praśna</span>–question, <span class="e2">nityānanda-rāya</span>–Nityānanda Rāy <span class="e2">balena</span>–explained <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–a highly confidential truth <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-sabhāya</span>–in the assembly of Vaiṣṇavas. [3]
Hearing Jīva’s question, Nityānanda Rāy explained a highly confidential truth in the assembly of Vaiṣṇavas.
“শুন জীব বৃন্দাবন নবদ্বীপধাম ।<br />অজস্র আনন্দময় জীবের বিশ্রাম ॥৪॥
“śuna jīva vṛndāvana navadvīpa-dhāma<br />ajasra ānandamaya jīvera viśrāma [4]
<span class="e2">“jīva</span>–“O Jīva, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan [and] <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām [are] <span class="e2">viśrāma</span>–shelters <span class="e2">ajasra</span> <span class="e2">ānandamaya</span> <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for countless joyful souls. [4]
“O Jīva, listen! Vṛndāvan Dhām and Nabadwīp Dhām are shelters for countless joyful souls.
শুদ্ধজীবগণ জড়াপ্রকৃতির পার ।<br />সদা বাস করে হেথা কৃষ্ণপরিবার ॥৫॥
śuddha-jīva-gaṇa jaḍā-prakṛtira pāra<br />sadā vāsa kare hethā kṛṣṇa-paribāra [5]
<span class="e2">śuddha-jīva-gaṇa</span>–Pure souls [are] <span class="e2">jaḍā-prakṛtira</span> <span class="e2">pāra</span>–beyond material nature; <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–they reside <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternally <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-paribāra</span>–as associates of Kṛṣṇa. [5]
“Pure souls are beyond material nature; they reside here in the Dhām eternally as associates of Kṛṣṇa.
এই ধাম নিত্যধাম বিশুদ্ধ চিন্ময় ।<br />জড়দেশকাল হেথা পায় পরাজয় ॥৬॥
ei dhāma nitya-dhāma viśuddha chinmaya<br />jaḍa-deśa-kāla hethā pāya parājaya [6]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–This Dhām [is] <span class="e2">viśuddha chinmaya nitya-dhāma</span>–an eternal, pure, spiritual abode. <span class="e2">jaḍa-deśa-kāla</span>–Material time and space <span class="e2">parājaya pāya</span>–are suppressed <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [6]
“The Dhām is eternal, pure, and spiritual. Material time and space are suppressed here.
এ ধামের দেশকাল চিদানন্দময় ।<br />জড়ধর্ম্ম বিপর্য্যয় সদা লক্ষ্য হয় ॥৭॥
e dhāmera deśa-kāla chid-ānandamaya<br />jaḍa-dharma viparyaya sadā lakṣya haya [7]
<span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dhāmera</span>–The Dhām’s <span class="e2">deśa-kāla</span>–time and space [are] <span class="e2">chid-ānandamaya</span>–spiritual and joyful. <span class="e2">sadā</span> <span class="e2">lakṣya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–Everything always appears <span class="e2">viparyaya</span>–the opposite <span class="e2">jaḍa-dharma</span>–of material nature. [7]
“Time and space in the Dhām are spiritual and joyful. Everything here always appears the opposite of material nature.
গৃহদ্বারা নদ-নদী কানন চত্বর ।<br />চিন্ময় সকল জান অতি মনোহর ॥৮॥
gṛha-dvārā nada-nadī kānana chatvara<br />chinmaya sakala jāna ati manohara [8]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [that] <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">gṛha-dvārā</span>–the homes, gates, <span class="e2">nada-nadī</span>–rivers, streams, <span class="e2">kānana</span>–forests, [and] <span class="e2">chatvara</span>–courtyards [are] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual [and] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">manohara</span>–beautiful. [8]
“Know that all the homes, gates, rivers, streams, forests, and courtyards here are spiritual and extremely beautiful.
সেই ত আনন্দধাম প্রকৃতির পার ।<br />অচিন্ত্য কৃষ্ণের শক্তি পরম উদার ॥৯॥
sei ta ānanda-dhāma prakṛtira pāra<br />achintya kṛṣṇera śakti parama udāra [9]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">ānanda-dhāma</span>–the abode of joy <span class="e2">prakṛtira</span> <span class="e2">pāra</span>–beyond material nature, <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">udāra</span>–the grand manifestation <span class="e2">achintya</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span>–of Kṛṣṇa’s inconceivable energy. [9]
“This is the abode of joy beyond material nature, the grand manifestation of Kṛṣṇa’s inconceivable energy.
সেই শক্তিক্রমে ধাম হেথা অবতার ।<br />জীবের নিস্তার জন্য কৃষ্ণ-ইচ্ছা-সার ॥১০॥
sei śakti-krame dhāma hethā avatāra<br />jīvera nistāra janya kṛṣṇa-ichchhā-sāra [10]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-ichchhā-sāra</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s greatest desire [is] <span class="e2">janya</span>–for <span class="e2">nistāra</span>–the deliverance <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of the souls, [and thus] <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–the Dhām <span class="e2">avatāra</span>–has descended <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">śakti-krame</span>–by that energy. [10]
“Kṛṣṇa’s greatest desire is for the souls’ deliverance, and thus the Dhām has descended here by Kṛṣṇa’s inconceivable energy.
ধাম মধ্যে কভু নহে জড় অবস্থিতি ।<br />জড়বদ্ধ জীব নাহি পায় হেথা গতি ॥১১॥
dhāma madhye kabhu nahe jaḍa avasthiti<br />jaḍa-baddha jīva nāhi pāya hethā gati [11]
<span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–Matter <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is never <span class="e2">avasthiti</span>–present <span class="e2">madhye</span>–within <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–the Dhām, [and] <span class="e2">jaḍa-baddha</span> <span class="e2">jīva</span>–conditioned souls <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–do not receive <span class="e2">gati</span>–entrance <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. [11]
“Matter is never present within the Dhām, and conditioned souls do not receive entrance here.
ধামের উপরে জড়মায়া পাতি’ জাল ।<br />আচ্ছাদিয়া রাখে এই ধাম চিরকাল ॥১২॥
dhāmera upare jaḍa-māyā pāti’ jāla<br />āchchhādiyā rākhe ei dhāma chira-kāla [12]
<span class="e2">jaḍa-māyā</span>–The material energy <span class="e2">pāti’</span>–spreads <span class="e2">jāla</span>–a covering <span class="e2">dhāmera</span> <span class="e2">upare</span>–over the Dhām [and] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāma āchchhādiyā</span> <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–keeps the Dhām covered <span class="e2">chira-kāla</span>–forever. [12]
“The material energy spreads a covering over the Dhām and keeps it covered forever.
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য যার নাহিক সম্বন্ধ ।<br />জালের উপরে বাস করে সেই অন্ধ ॥১৩॥
śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya yāra nāhika sambandha<br />jālera upare vāsa kare sei andha [13]
<span class="e2">sei yāra</span> <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–Souls who have no <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–relationship <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya</span>–with Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya <span class="e2">andha</span>–blindly <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–reside <span class="e2">upare</span>–on the surface <span class="e2">jālera</span>–of this covering. [13]
“Souls who have no relationship with Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya blindly reside on the surface of this covering.
মনে ভাবে, ‘আমি আছি নবদ্বীপপুরে’ ।<br />প্রৌঢ়ামায়া মুগ্ধ করি রাখে তারে দূরে ॥১৪॥
mane bhāve, ‘āmi āchhi navadvīpa-pure’<br />prauḍhā-māyā mugdha kari’ rākhe tāre dūre [14]
<span class="e2">mane</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–They think, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I <span class="e2">āchhi</span>–am <span class="e2">navadvīpa-pure’</span>–in Nabadwīp Dhām’, [but] <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā <span class="e2">mugdha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–bewilders [them and] <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–keeps <span class="e2">tāre</span>–them <span class="e2">dūre</span>–far away. [14]
“They think, ‘I am in Nabadwīp Dhām’, but Prauḍhā Māyā bewilders them and keeps them far away.
যদি কোন ভাগ্যোদয়ে সাধু-সঙ্গ পায় ।<br />তবে কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য-সম্বন্ধ আসে তায় ॥১৫॥
yadi kona bhāgyodaye sādhu-saṅga pāya<br />tabe kṛṣṇa-chaitanya-sambandha āse tāya [15]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If, <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">bhāgyodaye</span>–by some good fortune, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–souls attain<span class="e2"> sādhu-saṅga</span>–the association of the sādhus, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-chaitanya-sambandha</span>–a relationship with Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya <span class="e2">āse</span>–comes <span class="e2">tāya</span>–to them. [15]
“If, by some fortune, souls attain the association of the sādhus, then their relationship with Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya develops.
সম্বন্ধ নিগূঢ় তত্ত্ব বল্লভ-নন্দন ।<br />সহজে না বুঝে বদ্ধজীব সেই ধন ॥১৬॥
sambandha nigūḍha tattva vallabha-nandana<br />sahaje nā bujhe baddha-jīva sei dhana [16]
<span class="e2">vallabha-nandana</span>–O son of Vallabha, [such] <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–relationships [are] <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–a highly confidential subject. <span class="e2">sei</span>–They [are] <span class="e2">dhana</span>–a fortune [that] <span class="e2">baddha-jīva</span>–conditioned souls <span class="e2">bujhe nā</span>–do not understand <span class="e2">sahaje</span>–easily. [16]
“O Jīva, such relationships are a highly confidential subject, a fortune that conditioned souls do not easily understand.
মুখে বলে, ‘শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য প্রভু মোর ।<br />হৃদয় সম্বন্ধ হীন সদা মায়াভোর ॥১৭॥
mukhe bale, ‘śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya prabhu mora<br />hṛdaya sambandha hīna sadā māyā-bhora [17]
<span class="e2">mukhe</span>–By mouth, <span class="e2">bale</span>–someone [may] say, <span class="e2">‘śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya</span>–‘Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya [is] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord’, [but] <span class="e2">sambandha</span> <span class="e2">hīna</span>–have no relationship [with Him] <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–at heart [and be] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–constantly <span class="e2">māyā-bhora</span>–engrossed in illusion. [17]
“Someone may say, ‘Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya is my Lord’, but have no relationship with Him at heart and be constantly engrossed in māyā.
সেই সব লোক বৈসে মায়াজালোপরি ।<br />কভু শুদ্ধভক্তি নাহি পায় হরি হরি ॥১৮॥
sei saba loka vaise māyā-jālopari<br />kabhu śuddha-bhakti nāhi pāya hari hari [18]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–All such <span class="e2">loka</span>–persons <span class="e2">vaise</span>–reside <span class="e2">māyā-jālopari</span>–on the surface of Māyā’s covering [and] <span class="e2">kabhu nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti</span>–pure devotion. <span class="e2">hari</span>–O Lord! <span class="e2">hari</span>–O Lord! [18]
“Such persons reside on the surface of Māyā’s covering and never attain pure devotion. O Lord! O Lord!
ধর্ম্মধ্বজি সুকপটী সদা দৈন্যহীন ।<br />দম্ভগুণে আপনাকে ভাবে সমীচীন ॥১৯॥
dharma-dhvaji sukapaṭī sadā dainya-hīna<br />dambha-guṇe āpanāke bhāve samīchīna [19]
[They are] <span class="e2">dharma-dhvaji</span>–religious pretenders. [They are] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sukapaṭī</span>–deceitful [and] <span class="e2">dainya-hīna</span>–devoid of humility. <span class="e2">dambha-guṇe</span>–Because of [their] pride, <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–they consider <span class="e2">āpanāke</span>–themselves <span class="e2">samīchīna</span>–wise. [19]
“They are religious pretenders. They are always deceitful and devoid of humility. Because of their pride, they consider themselves wise.
সেই দম্ভ ছাড়ে সাধুচরণ-প্রসাদে ।<br />তৃণ হৈতে আপনাকে দীন করি’ সাধে ॥২০॥
sei dambha chhāḍe sādhu-charaṇa-prasāde<br />tṛṇa haite āpanāke dīna kari’ sādhe [20]
<span class="e2">sādhu-charaṇa-prasāde</span>–By the grace of the feet of the sādhus, [however,] <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–they abandon <span class="e2">sei</span>–such <span class="e2">dambha</span>–pride [and] <span class="e2">sādhe</span>–willingly <span class="e2">āpanāke kari’</span>–consider themselves <span class="e2">dīna</span>–lower <span class="e2">haite</span>–than <span class="e2">tṛṇa</span>–grass. [20]
“By the grace of the sādhus, however, they abandon their pride and willingly consider themselves lower than grass.
বৃক্ষাপেক্ষা হয় তারে সহিষ্ণুতা-গুণ ।<br />অমানী আপনি অন্যে সম্মানে নিপুণ ॥২১॥
vṛkṣāpekṣā haya tāra sahiṣṇutā-guṇa<br />amānī āpani anye sammāne nipuṇa [21]
<span class="e2">tāra</span>–Their <span class="e2">sahiṣṇutā-guṇa</span>–quality of tolerance <span class="e2">haya</span>–becomes <span class="e2">vṛkṣāpekṣā</span>–greater than that of a tree, [and] <span class="e2">āpani</span>–personally, [they become] <span class="e2">amānī</span>–prideless, [and] <span class="e2">nipuṇa</span>–expert <span class="e2">sammāne</span>–at honouring <span class="e2">anye</span>–others. [21]
“Their tolerance becomes greater than that of a tree, and they become prideless and expert at honouring others.
এই চারি গুণে গুণী কৃষ্ণগুণ গায় ।<br />চৈতন্য-সম্বন্ধ তার বসেন হিয়ায় ॥২২॥
ei chāri guṇe guṇī kṛṣṇa-guṇa gāya<br />chaitanya-sambandha tāra vasena hiyāya [22]
<span class="e2">guṇī</span>–Qualified <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">chāri</span> <span class="e2">guṇe</span>–with these four qualities, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–they chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-guṇa</span>–the glories of Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">chaitanya-sambandha</span>–relationship with Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">vasena</span>–develops <span class="e2">hiyāya</span>–within the heart. [22]
“Enriched with these four qualities, they chant the glories of Kṛṣṇa, and their relationship with Śrī Chaitanya develops within the heart.
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-সম্বন্ধ শান্ত দাস্য সখ্য আর ।<br />বাৎসল্য মধুর ইতি পঞ্চ-পরকার ॥২৩॥
śrī-kṛṣṇa-sambandha śānta dāsya sakhya āra<br />vātsalya madhura iti pañcha-parakāra [23]
<span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa</span>-<span class="e2">sambandha</span>–Relationships with Śrī Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">pañcha-parakāra iti</span>–of five types: <span class="e2">śānta</span>–adoration, <span class="e2">dāsya</span>–servitorship, <span class="e2">sakhya</span>–friendship, <span class="e2">vātsalya</span>–affectionate guardianship, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">madhura</span>–paramour love. [23]
“There are five relationships with Śrī Kṛṣṇa: those of adoration, servitorship, friendship, affectionate guardianship, and paramour love.
শান্ত দাস্য ভাবে করি’ গৌরাঙ্গ ভজন ।<br />লভে বাৎসল্যাদি-রস কৃষ্ণে সাধুজন ॥২৪॥
śānta dāsya bhāve kari’ gaurāṅga bhajana<br />labhe vātsalyādi-rasa kṛṣṇe sādhu-jana [24]
<span class="e2">sādhu-jana</span>–Sādhus <span class="e2">bhajana kari’</span>–serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–in the relationships <span class="e2">śānta</span> <span class="e2">dāsya</span>–of adoration and servitorship [and] <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">vātsalyādi-rasa</span>–relationships of affectionate guardianship and paramour love <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–with Kṛṣṇa. [24]
“Sādhus serve Gaurāṅga in the relationships of adoration and servitorship and thereby attain relationships of affectionate guardianship and paramour love with Kṛṣṇa.
যার যেই সম্বন্ধজনিত সিদ্ধভাব ।<br />তাহার ভজনে সেই ভাবের প্রভাব ॥২৫॥
yāra yei sambandha-janita siddha-bhāva<br />tāhāra bhajane sei bhāvera prabhāva [25]
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">siddha-bhāva sei</span> <span class="e2">bhāvera</span>–The eternal mood <span class="e2">yāra</span>–of a soul, <span class="e2">sambandha-janita</span>–produced by [their] relationship [with the Lord, is] <span class="e2">prabhāva</span>–the power <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">bhajane</span>–in their service. [25]
“The soul’s perfected mood that arises from their particular relationship with the Lord predominates in their service.
গৌর-কৃষ্ণে ভেদ যার সেই জীব ছার ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-সম্বন্ধ কভু না হয় তাহার ॥২৬॥
gaura-kṛṣṇe bheda yāra sei jīva chhāra<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-sambandha kabhu nā haya tāhāra [26]
<span class="e2">sei jīva yāra bheda</span>–Souls who differentiate <span class="e2">gaura-kṛṣṇe</span>–between Gaura and Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–wicked, [and] <span class="e2">tāhāra kabhu haya nā</span>–they never develop <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-sambandha</span>–a relationship with Kṛṣṇa. [26]
“Souls who differentiate between Gaura and Kṛṣṇa are wicked, and they never develop a relationship with Kṛṣṇa.
সাধুসঙ্গে দৈন্য আদি গুণ যার হয় ।<br />সেই জীব দাস্যরসে গৌরাঙ্গ ভজয় ॥২৭॥
sādhu-saṅge dainya ādi guṇa yāra haya<br />sei jīva dāsya-rase gaurāṅga bhajaya [27]
<span class="e2">sei jīva yāra haya</span>–Souls who develop, <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–through the association of the sādhus, <span class="e2">dainya</span>–humility <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–and other qualities <span class="e2">bhajaya</span>–serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">dāsya-rase</span>–in a relationship of servitorship. [27]
“Souls who develop, through the association of the sādhus, the qualities of humility, tolerance, pridelessness, and respectfulness, serve Gaurāṅga in a relationship of servitorship.
দাস্যরস পরাকাষ্ঠা গৌরাঙ্গ-ভজনে ।<br />‘মহাপ্রভু’ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ বলে সাধুজনে ॥২৮॥
dāsya-rasa parākāṣṭhā gaurāṅga-bhajane<br />‘mahāprabhu’ śrī-gaurāṅga bale sādhu-jane [28]
<span class="e2">dāsya-rasa</span>–The relationship of servitorship [is] <span class="e2">parākāṣṭhā</span>–full-fledged [in] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-bhajane</span>–the service of Gaurāṅga; <span class="e2">sādhu-jane</span>–the sādhus <span class="e2">bale</span>–call <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">‘mahāprabhu’</span>–‘Mahāprabhu’ (‘Supreme Master’). [28]
“The relationship of servitorship is full-fledged in the service of Gaurāṅga; the sādhus call Śrī Gaurāṅga ‘Mahāprabhu’.
মধুর-প্রেমেতে যার হয় অধিকার ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রূপে গৌর-ভজন তাহার ॥২৯॥
madhura-premete yāra haya adhikāra<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpe gaura-bhajana tāhāra [29]
<span class="e2">tāhāra yāra haya</span>–Souls who have <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–qualification <span class="e2">madhura-premete</span>–for a relationship of paramour love <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–serve <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpe</span>–as Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. [29]
“Souls who are qualified for a relationship of paramour love serve Gaura as Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
রাধাকৃষ্ণ ঐক্য মোর শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-রায় ।<br />যুগলবিলাস ঐক্যে স্বতঃ নাহি ভায় ॥৩০॥
rādhā-kṛṣṇa aikya mora śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya<br />yugala-vilāsa aikye svataḥ nāhi bhāya [30]
<span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">aikya</span>–united <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rāya</span>–as our Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy. <span class="e2">yugala-vilāsa</span>–The Pastimes of the Divine Couple <span class="e2">svataḥ</span>–themselves <span class="e2">bhāya nāhi</span>–do not manifest <span class="e2">aikye</span>–in that unity. [30]
“Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are united as our Śrī Gaurāṅga Rāy. The Pastimes of the Divine Couple, however, do not manifest in Him.
দাস্য পরিপক্কে যবে জীবের হৃদয়ে ।<br />শ্রীমধুর-রস উদে মূর্ত্তিমান হয়ে ॥৩১॥
dāsya paripakke yabe jīvera hṛdaye<br />śrī-madhura-rasa ude mūrtimāna haye [31]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">dāsya</span>–servitorship <span class="e2">paripakke</span>–matures <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–in the heart of the soul, <span class="e2">śrī-madhura-rasa</span>–the relationship of paramour love <span class="e2">mūrtimāna</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–manifests [and] <span class="e2">ude</span>–arises. [31]
“When the relationship of servitorship matures in the heart of the soul, then the relationship of paramour love emerges.
সে সময়ে ভজনীয় তত্ত্ব গৌরহরি ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণরূপ হয়ে ব্রজে অবতরি’ ॥৩২॥
নিত্যলীলারসে সেই ভক্তকে ডুবায় ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ-নিত্যলীলা ব্রজধাম পায় ॥৩৩॥
se samaye bhajanīya tattva gaurahari<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpa haye vraje avatari’ [32]
nitya-līlā-rase sei bhaktake ḍubāya<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-nitya-līlā vraja-dhāma pāya [33]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">samaye</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">bhajanīya</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–the worshippable Lord, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari, <span class="e2">avatari’</span>–appears <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rūpa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–as Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">ḍubāya</span>–immerses <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">bhaktake</span>–the devotee <span class="e2">nitya-līlā-rase</span>–in the ecstasy of the eternal Pastimes. [In this way,] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–the devotee reaches <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-nitya-līlā</span>–the eternal Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">vraja-dhāma</span>–in Vraja Dhām. [32<span class="e2">–</span>33]
“At that time, the worshippable Lord, Gaurahari, appears in Vraja as Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa and immerses the devotee in the ecstasy of the eternal Pastimes. In this way, the devotee attains the eternal Pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja Dhām.
নবদ্বীপে ব্রজে সেই নিগূঢ় সম্বন্ধ ।<br />এক হয়ে দুই হয় নাহি দেখে অন্ধ ॥৩৪॥
navadvīpe vraje sei nigūḍha sambandha<br />eka haye dui haya nāhi dekhe andha [34]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span> <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–the highly confidential relationship <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span> <span class="e2">vraje</span>–between Nabadwīp and Vraja: <span class="e2">haye</span>–they are <span class="e2">eka</span>–one, [and] <span class="e2">haya</span>–they are <span class="e2">dui</span>–two, [but] <span class="e2">andha</span>–the blind <span class="e2">dekhe nāhi</span>–do not see [this]. [34]
“This is the highly confidential relationship between Nabadwīp and Vraja: they are one, and yet they are also two, but the blind do not see this.
সেই ত সম্বন্ধ গৌরে কৃষ্ণে জান সার ।<br />মধুররসেতে গৌর যুগল আকার ॥৩৫॥
sei ta sambandha gaure kṛṣṇe jāna sāra<br />madhura-rasete gaura yugala ākāra [35]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [this to be] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the essence <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–of the relationship <span class="e2">gaure</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–between Gaura and Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">madhura-rasete</span>–In the relationship of paramour love, <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura’s <span class="e2">ākāra</span>–form [is] <span class="e2">yugala</span>–the Divine Couple. [35]
“Know this to be the essence of the relationship between Gaura and Kṛṣṇa. In the relationship of paramour love, Gaura’s form is the Divine Couple.
সেই সব তত্ত্ব তোরে রূপ-সনাতন ।<br />জানাইবে অল্পদিনে বল্লভনন্দন ॥৩৬॥
sei saba tattva tore rūpa-sanātana<br />jānāibe alpa-dine vallabha-nandana [36]
<span class="e2">vallabha-nandana</span>–O son of Vallabha, <span class="e2">alpa-dine</span>–soon <span class="e2">rūpa-sanātana</span>–Rūpa and Sanātan <span class="e2">jānāibe</span>–will teach <span class="e2">tore</span>–you <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–all these truths. [36]
“O Jīva, soon Rūpa and Sanātan will teach you all these truths.
তোরে বৃন্দাবনে প্রভু দিল অধিকার ।<br />বিলম্ব না কর জীব ব্রজে যেতে আর” ॥৩৭॥
tore vṛndāvane prabhu dila adhikāra<br />vilamba nā kara jīva vraje yete āra” [37]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">dila</span>–has given <span class="e2">tore</span>–you <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–the qualification [to stay] <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–in Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">jīva</span>–O Jīva, <span class="e2">vilamba</span> <span class="e2">kara nā</span>–do not delay <span class="e2">yete</span>–going <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja <span class="e2">āra”</span>–any longer!” [37]
“The Lord has given you the qualification to stay in Vṛndāvan. O Jīva, do not delay going to Vraja any longer!”
এত বলি’ প্রভু তাঁর মস্তকে চরণ ।<br />অর্পণ করিয়া শক্তি করে সঞ্চারণ ॥৩৮॥
eta bali’ prabhu tā̐ra mastake charaṇa<br />arpaṇa kariyā śakti kare sañchāraṇa [38]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">arpaṇa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–placed [His] <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">mastake</span>–on his head [and] <span class="e2">śakti</span> <span class="e2">sañchāraṇa kare</span>–empowered [him]. [38]
Saying this, Nityānanda Prabhu placed His feet on Jīva’s head and empowered him.
মহাপ্রেমে শ্রীজীব গোস্বামী কতক্ষণ ।<br />নিত্যানন্দ-পদতলে রহে অচেতন ॥৩৯॥
mahāpreme śrī-jīva gosvāmī kata-kṣaṇa<br />nityānanda-pada-tale rahe achetana [39]
<span class="e2">mahāpreme</span>–In intense divine love, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span> <span class="e2">gosvāmī</span>–Śrī Jīva Goswāmī <span class="e2">rahe</span>–remained <span class="e2">achetana</span>–unconscious <span class="e2">nityānanda-pada-tale</span>–at the feet of Nityānanda <span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇa</span>–for some time. [39]
In intense divine love, Śrī Jīva Goswāmī remained unconscious at the feet of Nityānanda for some time.
শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে জীব গড়াগড়ি যায় ।<br />সাত্ত্বিক বিকার সব দেহে শোভা পায় ॥৪০॥
śrīvāsa-aṅgane jīva gaḍāgaḍi yāya<br />sāttvika vikāra saba dehe śobhā pāya [40]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–rolled on the ground <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–in the courtyard of Śrīvās, [and] <span class="e2">saba</span>–all [of the symptoms] <span class="e2">sāttvika</span> <span class="e2">vikāra</span>–of divine ecstasy <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–shone <span class="e2">dehe</span>–in [his] body. [40]
He rolled on the ground in the courtyard of Śrīvās, and all the symptoms of divine ecstasy shone in his body.
কাঁদিয়া কাঁদিয়া বলে, “দুর্ভাগ্য আমার ।<br />না দেখিনু এ নয়নে নদীয়াবিহার ॥৪১॥
kā̐diyā kā̐diyā bale, “durbhāgya āmāra<br />nā dekhinu e nayane nadīyā-bihāra [41]
<span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span> <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">bale</span>–he said, <span class="e2">“āmāra</span>–“My <span class="e2">durbhāgya</span>–misfortune [is that] <span class="e2">dekhinu nā</span>–I did not see <span class="e2">nadīyā-bihāra</span>–the Pastimes [of the Lord] in Nadia <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">nayane</span>–with these eyes. [41]
Crying, he said, “My misfortune is that I did not see the Pastimes of the Lord in Nadia with these eyes.
জীব নিস্তারিতে লীলা কৈল গৌররায় ।<br />সে লীলা না দেখি’ মোর দিন বৃথা যায়” ॥৪২॥
jīva nistārite līlā kaila gaura-rāya<br />se līlā nā dekhi’ mora dina vṛthā yāya” [42]
<span class="e2">gaura-rāya</span>–Gaura Rāy <span class="e2">kaila</span>–performed <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">nistārite</span>–to deliver [all] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls. <span class="e2">dekhi’ nā</span>–Having not seen <span class="e2">se</span>–those <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes, <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">dina</span>–days <span class="e2">yāya</span>–have passed <span class="e2">vṛthā”</span>–in vain.” [42]
“Gaura Rāy performed Pastimes to deliver all souls. Having not seen those Pastimes, my days have passed in vain.”
শ্রীজীব যাইবে ব্রজে করিয়া শ্রবণ ।<br />শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে আইল যত সাধুজন ॥৪৩॥
śrī-jīva yāibe vraje kariyā śravaṇa<br />śrīvāsa-aṅgane āila yata sādhu-jana [43]
<span class="e2">śravaṇa kariyā</span>–Hearing [that] <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">yāibe</span>–would go <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja, <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">sādhu-jana</span>–all the sādhus <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–to the courtyard of Śrīvās. [43]
Hearing that Śrī Jīva would go to Vraja, all the sādhus came to the courtyard of Śrīvās.
বৃদ্ধ-সব শ্রীজীবে করেন আশীর্ব্বাদ ।<br />কনিষ্ঠ বৈষ্ণব মাগে শ্রীজীব-প্রসাদ ॥৪৪॥
vṛddha-saba śrī-jīve karena āśīrvāda<br />kaniṣṭha vaiṣṇava māge śrī-jīva-prasāda [44]
<span class="e2">vṛddha-saba</span>–The elders <span class="e2">āśīrvāda karena</span>–blessed <span class="e2">śrī-jīve</span>–Śrī Jīva, [and] <span class="e2">kaniṣṭha</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–the junior devotees <span class="e2">māge</span>–prayed <span class="e2">śrī-jīva-prasāda</span>–for Śrī Jīva’s grace. [44]
The elder devotees blessed Jīva, and the junior devotees prayed for his grace.
কর যুড়ি’ বলে জীব সকল বৈষ্ণবে ।<br />“মম অপরাধ কিছুমাত্র নাহি লবে ॥৪৫॥
kara yuḍi’ bale jīva sakala vaiṣṇave<br />“mama aparādha kichhu-mātra nāhi labe [45]
<span class="e2">kara</span> <span class="e2">yuḍi’</span>–Joining [his] palms, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">bale</span>–said <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇave</span>–to all the devotees, <span class="e2">“labe nāhi</span>–“Please do not take <span class="e2">kichhu-mātra</span>–any <span class="e2">mama</span>–of my <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences. [45]
Joining his palms, Jīva said to all the devotees, “Please do not take any of my offences.
তোমরা চৈতন্যদাস জগতের গুরু ।<br />এ ক্ষুদ্র জীবেরে দয়া কর কল্পতরু ॥৪৬॥
tomarā chaitanya-dāsa jagatera guru<br />e kṣudra jīvere dayā kara kalpa-taru [46]
<span class="e2">tomarā</span>–You [are] all <span class="e2">chaitanya-dāsa</span>–servants of Śrī Chaitanya [and] <span class="e2">guru</span>–the Gurus <span class="e2">jagatera</span>–of this world. <span class="e2">kalpa-taru</span>–O wish-fulfilling trees, <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–please bless <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">kṣudra</span> <span class="e2">jīvere</span>–this insignificant soul. [46]
“You are all servants of Śrī Chaitanya and Gurus of this world. O wish-fulfilling trees, please bless this insignificant soul.
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যে মোর থাকুক্ রতি মতি ।<br />নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু হউক্ জন্মে জন্মে গতি ॥৪৭॥
śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanye mora thākuk rati mati<br />nityānanda prabhu ha-uk janme janme gati [47]
<span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">thākuk</span>–May I have <span class="e2">rati</span> <span class="e2">mati</span>–love and devotion <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanye</span>–to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya, [and] <span class="e2">nityānanda</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span> <span class="e2">gati ha-uk</span>–may Nityānanda Prabhu be my shelter, <span class="e2">janme</span> <span class="e2">janme</span>–birth after birth. [47]
“May I have love and devotion to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya, and may Nityānanda Prabhu be my shelter, birth after birth.
নাহি বুঝি’ বাল্যকালে ছাড়িলাম ঘর ।<br />তুমি সব জীবনের বন্ধু অতঃপর ॥৪৮॥
nāhi bujhi’ bālya-kāle chhāḍilāma ghara<br />tumi saba jīvanera bandhu ataḥpara [48]
<span class="e2">bujhi’ nāhi</span>–Not understanding, <span class="e2">chhāḍilāma</span>–I left <span class="e2">ghara</span>–home <span class="e2">bālya-kāle</span>–in [my] youth, [and] <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–since then, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–you all [have been] <span class="e2">bandhu</span>–the well-wishers <span class="e2">jīvanera</span>–in [my] life. [48]
“I left home in my youth without understanding anything, and since then, you all have been the well-wishers in my life.
বৈষ্ণবানুকম্পা বিনা কৃষ্ণ নাহি পাই ।<br />বৈষ্ণবচরণধূলি দেহ সবে ভাই” ॥৪৯॥
vaiṣṇavānukampā vinā kṛṣṇa nāhi pāi<br />vaiṣṇava-charaṇa-dhūli deha sabe bhāi” [49]
<span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavānukampā</span>–the grace of the Vaiṣṇavas, <span class="e2">pāi nāhi</span>–I cannot attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">sabe bhāi</span>–O brothers, <span class="e2">deha</span>–please give [me] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-charaṇa-dhūli”</span>–the dust of the Vaiṣṇavas’ feet.” [49]
“Without the grace of the Vaiṣṇavas, I cannot attain Kṛṣṇa. O brothers, please give me the dust of the Vaiṣṇavas’ feet.”
এত বলি’ সকলে করিয়া স্তুতি নতি ।<br />নিত্যানন্দ প্রভুর লইয়া অনুমতি ॥ ৫০॥
জগন্নাথগৃহে গিয়া শচীর চরণে ।<br />ব্রজে যাইতে আজ্ঞা লয় বিকলিত মনে ॥৫১॥
eta bali’ sakale kariyā stuti nati<br />nityānanda prabhura la-iyā anumati [50]
jagannātha-gṛhe giyā śachīra charaṇe<br />vraje yāite ājñā laya vikalita mane [51]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">stuti</span> <span class="e2">nati kariyā</span>–Jīva bowed and prayed <span class="e2">sakale</span>–to everyone, [and] <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–took <span class="e2">anumati</span>–permission, <span class="e2">nityānanda</span> <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–from Nityānanda Prabhu. [Then] <span class="e2">giyā</span>–he went <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–to the feet of Śachī <span class="e2">jagannātha-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Jagannāth [and] <span class="e2">vikalita</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–with an eager heart <span class="e2">laya</span>–took <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–permission <span class="e2">yāite</span>–to go <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja. [50<span class="e2">–</span>51]
Saying this, Jīva bowed and prayed to everyone, and took permission from Nityānanda Prabhu. Then he went to the feet of Śachī in the home of Jagannāth Miśra and with an eager heart took permission to go to Vraja.
শ্রীচরণরেণু দিয়া শচীদেবী তায় ।<br />আশীর্ব্বাদ করি’ জীবে করিল বিদায় ॥৫২॥
śrī-charaṇa-reṇu diyā śachī-devī tāya<br />āśīrvada kari’ jīve karila vidāya [52]
<span class="e2">śachī-devī</span>–Śachī Devī <span class="e2">diyā</span>–gave <span class="e2">tāya</span>–him <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇa-reṇu</span>–dust from [her] holy feet, <span class="e2">āśīrvada</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–blessed [him, and] <span class="e2">jīve</span> <span class="e2">vidāya karila</span>–bade Jīva farewell. [52]
Śachī Devī gave Jīva dust from her holy feet, blessed him, and bade him farewell.
কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে জীব ভাগীরথী পার ।<br />“হা গৌরাঙ্গ” বলি’ যায় আজ্ঞা জানি’ সার ॥৫৩॥
kā̐dite kā̐dite jīva bhāgīrathī pāra<br />“hā gaurāṅga” bali’ yāya ājñā jāni’ sāra [53]
<span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">pāra</span>–crossed <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">bali’</span>–chanting, <span class="e2">“hā</span>–“O <span class="e2">gaurāṅga”</span>–Gaurāṅga!”, [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–departed <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–knowing <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–the order [of the Lord to be] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–all-in-all. [53]
Crying, Jīva crossed the Gaṅgā chanting, “O Gaurāṅga!”, and departed, knowing the order of the Lord to be all-in-all.
কতক্ষণ চলি’ চলি’ নবদ্বীপ-সীমা ।<br />পার হয়ে যায় জীব অনন্ত মহিমা ॥৫৪॥
kata-kṣaṇa chali’ chali’ navadvīpa-sīmā<br />pāra haye yāya jīva ananta mahimā [54]
<span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇa</span>–Soon, <span class="e2">chali’</span> <span class="e2">chali’</span>–walking ahead, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Jīva <span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–crossed <span class="e2">navadvīpa-sīmā</span>–the border of Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–left <span class="e2">ananta</span> <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–that infinitely glorious abode. [54]
Walking ahead, Jīva soon crossed the border of Nabadwīp and left that infinitely glorious abode.
নবদ্বীপধাম ছাড়ি’ শ্রীজীব তখন ।<br />সাষ্টাঙ্গ প্রণমি’ চলে যথা বৃন্দাবন ॥৫৫॥
navadvīpa-dhāma chhāḍi’ śrī-jīva takhana<br />sāṣṭāṅga praṇami’ chale yathā vṛndāvana [55]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–as he left <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span>–Śrī Jīva <span class="e2">sāṣṭāṅga</span> <span class="e2">praṇami’</span>–prostrated [himself] fully [and then] <span class="e2">chale</span>–departed <span class="e2">yathā</span>–for <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. [55]
As he left Nabadwīp Dhām, Jīva prostrated himself fully and then departed for Vṛndāvan.
ব্রজধাম শ্রীযমুনা রূপসনাতন ।<br />জাগিতে লাগিল হৃদে জীবের তখন ॥৫৬॥
vraja-dhāma śrī-yamunā rūpa-sanātana<br />jāgite lāgila hṛde jīvera takhana [56]
<span class="e2">vraja-dhāma</span>–Vraja Dhām, <span class="e2">śrī-yamunā</span>–the Yamunā, [and] <span class="e2">rūpa-sanātana</span>–Rūpa and Sanātan <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">jāgite</span> <span class="e2">lāgila</span>–arose <span class="e2">jīvera hṛde</span>–in the heart of Jīva. [56]
Vraja Dhām, the Yamunā, and Rūpa and Sanātan then arose in his heart.
পথিমধ্যে রাত্রে স্বপ্নে দেখে গৌররায় ।<br />জীবেরে বলেন, “তুমি যাও মথুরায় ॥৫৭॥
pathi-madhye rātre svapne dekhe gaura-rāya<br />jīvere balena, “tumi yāo mathurāya [57]
<span class="e2">rātre</span>–At night <span class="e2">pathi-madhye</span>–along the path, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–Jīva saw <span class="e2">gaura-rāya</span>–Gaura Rāy <span class="e2">svapne</span>–in a dream. <span class="e2">balena</span>–The Lord said <span class="e2">jīvere</span>–to Jīva, <span class="e2">“tumi</span> <span class="e2">yāo</span>–“Go <span class="e2">mathurāya</span>–to Mathurā. [57]
At night along the path, Jīva saw Gaura Rāy in a dream. The Lord said to Jīva, “Go to Mathurā.
অতি প্রিয় তুমি আর রূপসনাতন ।<br />একত্রে করহ ভক্তিশাস্ত্র প্রকটন ॥৫৮॥
ati priya tumi āra rūpa-sanātana<br />ekatre karaha bhakti-śāstra prakaṭana [58]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You, <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–Rūpa, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and<span class="e2"> sanātana</span>–Sanātan [are] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">priya</span>–dear [to Me, and] <span class="e2">ekatre</span>–together <span class="e2">prakaṭana karaha</span>–you will write <span class="e2">bhakti-śāstra</span>–scriptures on devotion. [58]
“You, Rūpa, and Sanātan are very dear to Me, and together you will write scriptures on devotion.
আমার যুগল-সেবা তোমার জীবন ।<br />শ্রীব্রজবিলাস সদা করহ দর্শন” ॥৫৯॥
āmāra yugala-sevā tomāra jīvana<br />śrī-vraja-vilāsa sadā karaha darśana” [59]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">yugala-sevā</span>–Service to Me as the Divine Couple [will be] <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–life, [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span> <span class="e2">darśana karaha</span>–you will always see [Their] <span class="e2">śrī-vraja-vilāsa”</span>–Pastimes in Śrī Vraja.” [59]
“Service to Me as the Divine Couple will be your life, and you will always see Their Pastimes in Vraja.”
স্বপ্ন দেখি’ জীবের আনন্দ হৈল অতি ।<br />ব্রজধাম প্রতি ধায় সুসত্বর গতি ॥৬০॥
svapna dekhi’ jīvera ānanda haila ati<br />vraja-dhāma prati dhāya susatvara gati [60]
<span class="e2">svapna</span> <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–After having this dream, <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">ati ānanda</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–Jīva felt intense joy [and] <span class="e2">susatvara</span> <span class="e2">gati</span>–swiftly <span class="e2">dhāya</span>–ran <span class="e2">prati</span>–towards <span class="e2">vraja-dhāma</span>–Vraja Dhām. [60]
After this dream, Jīva felt intense joy and swiftly ran towards Vraja Dhām.
ব্রজে গিয়া শ্রীজীব গোস্বামী মহাশয় ।<br />যে যে কার্য্য সাধিল তা বর্ণন না হয় ॥৬১॥
vraje giyā śrī-jīva gosvāmī mahāśaya<br />ye ye kārya sādhila tā varṇana nā haya [61]
<span class="e2">tā ye</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">kārya</span>–The services <span class="e2">śrī-jīva</span> <span class="e2">gosvāmī</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–Śrī Jīva Goswāmī Mahāśay <span class="e2">sādhila</span>–performed <span class="e2">giyā</span>–after going <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja <span class="e2">varṇana</span> <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–cannot be described. [61]
The services Śrī Jīva Goswāmī performed after arriving in Vraja cannot be described.
ভাগ্যবান জন পরে করিবে বর্ণন ।<br />শুনিবে আনন্দচিত্তে যত সাধুজন ॥৬২॥
bhāgyavāna jana pare karibe varṇana<br />śunibe ānanda-chitte yata sādhu-jana [62]
<span class="e2">pare</span>–Later, <span class="e2">bhāgyavāna</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–a fortunate soul <span class="e2">varṇana karibe</span>–will describe [them, and] <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">sādhu-jana</span>–all the sādhus <span class="e2">śunibe</span>–will hear [about them] <span class="e2">ānanda-chitte</span>–with joy in [their] hearts. [62]
Later, a fortunate soul will describe them, and the sādhus will hear about them with joy in their hearts.
ছারবুদ্ধি এ ভক্তিবিনোদ অভাজন ।<br />শ্রীধাম-ভ্রমণবার্ত্তা করিল বর্ণন ॥৬৩॥
chhāra-buddhi e bhakti-vinoda abhājana<br />śrī-dhāma-bhramaṇa-vārtā karila varṇana [63]
<span class="e2">e abhājana chhāra-buddhi</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–The unfit and wicked-minded Bhakti Vinod <span class="e2">varṇana karila</span>–has described <span class="e2">śrī-dhāma-bhramaṇa-vārtā</span>–the subject of visiting the Holy Dhām. [63]
The unfit and wicked-minded Bhakti Vinod has described the subject of visiting the Holy Dhām.
বৈষ্ণবচরণে মোর এই সে প্রার্থনা ।<br />শ্রীগৌর-সম্বন্ধ মোর হউক যোজনা ॥৬৪॥
vaiṣṇava-charaṇe mora ei se prāthanā<br />śrī-gaura-sambandha mora ha-uka yojanā [64]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">se</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">prāthanā</span>–prayer <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-charaṇe</span>–at the feet of the Vaiṣṇavas: [May] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-sambandha</span>–relationship with Śrī Gaura <span class="e2">yojanā ha-uka</span>–come about. [64]
This is my prayer at the feet of the Vaiṣṇavas: may I have a relationship with Śrī Gaura.
শ্রীগৌর-সম্বন্ধ-সহ নবদ্বীপ বাস ।<br />হউক অচিরে মোর” এই অভিলাষ ॥৬৫॥
śrī-gaura-sambandha-saha navadvīpa vāsa<br />ha-uka achire mora ei abhilāṣa [65]
<span class="e2">achire mora vāsa</span> <span class="e2">ha-uka</span>–May I soon reside <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">saha</span>–with <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-sambandha</span>–a relationship with Śrī Gaura. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is my] <span class="e2">abhilāṣa</span>–desire. [65]
May I soon reside in Nabadwīp and have a relationship with Śrī Gaura. This is my desire.
বিষয়গর্ত্তের কীট অতি দুরাচার ।<br />ভক্তিহীন কামরত ক্রোধে মত্ত আর ॥৬৬॥
viṣaya-gartera kīṭa ati durāchāra<br />bhakti-hīna kāma-rata krodhe matta āra [66]
[I am] <span class="e2">kīṭa</span>–a worm <span class="e2">viṣaya-gartera</span>–in the ditch of mundanity [and] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">durāchāra</span>–misbehaved. [I am] <span class="e2">bhakti-hīna</span>–devoid of devotion, <span class="e2">kāma-rata</span>–lustful, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">matta</span>–mad <span class="e2">krodhe</span>–with anger. [66]
I am a worm in the ditch of mundanity and very misbehaved. I have no devotion. I am lustful and mad with anger.
এ হেন দুর্জ্জন আমি মায়ার কিঙ্কর ।<br />শ্রীগৌর-সম্বন্ধ কিসে পাই অতঃপর ॥৬৭॥
e hena durjana āmi māyāra kiṅkara<br />śrī-gaura-sambandha kise pāi ataḥpara [67]
<span class="e2">kise</span>–How <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–then [will] <span class="e2">durjana</span>–a fallen soul [and] <span class="e2">kiṅkara</span>–servant <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of illusion <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">hena</span>–such as <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">pāi</span>–attain <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-sambandha</span>–a relationship with Gaura? [67]
How will a fallen soul and servant of māyā like me develop a relationship with Śrī Gaura?
নবদ্বীপধাম মোরে অনুগ্রহ করি’ ।<br />উদয় হউন হৃদে তবে আমি তরি ॥৬৮॥
navadvīpa-dhāma more anugraha kari’<br />udaya ha-una hṛde tabe āmi tari [68]
[May] <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām <span class="e2">anugraha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–bless <span class="e2">more</span>–me [and] <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">ha-una</span>–appear <span class="e2">hṛde</span>–within [my] heart. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">tari</span>–will be delivered. [68]
May Nabadwīp Dhām bless me and appear in my heart. Then I will be delivered.
প্রৌঢ়ামায়া কুলদেবী কৃপা অকপট ।<br />ভরসা তরিতে মাত্র অবিদ্যা-সঙ্কট ॥৬৯॥
prauḍhā-māyā kuladevī kṛpā akapaṭa<br />bharasā tarite mātra avidyā-saṅkaṭa [69]
<span class="e2">akapaṭa</span> <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–The genuine grace <span class="e2">prauḍhā-māyā</span>–of Prauḍhā Māyā, <span class="e2">kuladevī</span>–the protectress of the Dhām, [is my] <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">bharasā</span>–hope <span class="e2">tarite</span>–to overcome <span class="e2">avidyā-saṅkaṭa</span>–the dangers of ignorance. [69]
The genuine grace of Prauḍhā Māyā, the protectress of the Dhām, is my only hope to overcome the dangers of ignorance.
বৃদ্ধশিব ক্ষেত্রপাল হউন সদয় ।<br />চিদ্ধাম আমার চক্ষে হউন উদয় ॥৭০॥
vṛddha-śiva kṣetra-pāla ha-una sadaya<br />chid-dhāma āmāra chakṣe ha-una udaya [70]
[May] <span class="e2">vṛddha-śiva</span>–Vṛddha Śiva, <span class="e2">kṣetra-pāla</span>–the protector of the Dhām, <span class="e2">sadaya ha-una</span>–be merciful [to me]. [May] <span class="e2">chid-dhāma</span>–the divine Dhām <span class="e2">udaya ha-una</span>–appear <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">chakṣe</span>–before my eyes. [70]
May Vṛddha Śiva, the protector of the Dhām, be merciful to me. May the divine Dhām appear before my eyes.
নবদ্বীপবাসী যত গৌরভক্তগণ ।<br />এ পামর শিরে সবে দাও শ্রীচরণ ॥৭১॥
navadvīpa-vāsī yata gaura-bhakta-gaṇa<br />e pāmara śire sabe dāo śrī-charaṇa [71]
<span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsī</span>–O residents of Nabadwīp [and] <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">sabe gaura-bhakta-gaṇa</span>–all the devotees of Gaura! <span class="e2">dāo</span>–Place [your] <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇa</span>–holy feet <span class="e2">śire</span>–on the head <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">pāmara</span>–of this sinner. [71]
O residents of Nabadwīp and devotees of Gaurāṅga! Place your holy feet on the head of this sinner.
এই ত প্রার্থনা মোর শুন সর্ব্বজন ।<br />অচিরেতে যেন পাই চৈতন্যচরণ ॥৭২॥
ei ta prārthanā mora śuna sarva-jana<br />achirete yena pāi chaitanya-charaṇa [72]
<span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–Everyone,<span class="e2"> śun</span>a–please hear<span class="e2"> ei ta</span>–this<span class="e2"> prārthanā</span>–prayer <span class="e2">mora</span>–of mine <span class="e2">yena</span>–so that <span class="e2">achirete</span>–quickly <span class="e2">pāi</span>–I may attain <span class="e2">chaitanya-charaṇa</span>–the feet of Śrī Chaitanya. [72]
Everyone, please hear this prayer of mine so that I may quickly attain the feet of Śrī Chaitanya.
নিত্যানন্দ-শ্রীজাহ্নবা-আদেশ পাইয়া ।<br />বর্ণিলাম নবদ্বীপ অতি দীন হৈয়া ॥৭৩॥
nityānanda-śrī-jāhnavā-ādeśa pāiyā<br />varṇilāma navadvīpa ati dīna haiyā [73]
<span class="e2">pāiyā</span>–Receiving <span class="e2">nityānanda-śrī-jāhnavā-ādeśa</span>–the order of Nityānanda and Śrī Jāhnavā, <span class="e2">varṇilāma</span>–I have described <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [although] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">dīna</span> <span class="e2">haiyā</span>–I am very fallen. [73]
Receiving the order of Nityānanda and Śrī Jāhnavā, I have described Nabadwīp although I am very fallen.
নবদ্বীপ গৌর নিত্যানন্দ নামময় ।<br />এই গ্রন্থ বিরচিত হইল নিশ্চয় ॥৭৪॥
navadvīpa gaura nityānanda nāmamaya<br />ei grantha virachita ha-ila niśchaya [74]
<span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–Certainly <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">grantha</span>–book <span class="e2">virachita</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–has been written [to be] <span class="e2">nāmamaya</span>–full of the names <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–‘Nabadwīp’, <span class="e2">gaura</span>–‘Gaura’, [and] <span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–‘Nityānanda’. [74]
Certainly this book has been written so as to be filled with the names ‘Nabadwīp’, ‘Gaura’, and ‘Nityānanda’.
অতএব এই গ্রন্থ পরম পাবন ।<br />রচনা-দোষেতে দোষী নহে কদাচন ॥৭৫॥
ataeva ei grantha parama pāvana<br />rachanā-doṣete doṣī nahe kadāchana [75]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">grantha</span>–book [is] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">pāvana</span>–greatly purifying, [and] <span class="e2">kadāchana doṣī</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–I will not be at fault <span class="e2">rachanā-doṣete</span>–for [any] faults in [its] composition. [75]
Thus, this book is greatly purifying, and I will not be to blame for any faults in its composition.
এই গ্রন্থ পাঠ করি’ গৌরভক্তজন ।<br />পরিক্রমা ফল সদা করুন অর্জ্জন ॥৭৬॥
ei grantha pāṭha kari’ gaura-bhakta-jana<br />parikramā phala sadā karuna arjana [76]
[May] <span class="e2">gaura-bhakta-jana</span>–the devotees of Gaura <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">pāṭha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–study <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">grantha</span>–book [and] <span class="e2">arjana karuna</span>–attain <span class="e2">phala</span>–the result <span class="e2">parikramā</span>–of circumambulation [of the Dhām]. [76]
May the devotees of Gaurāṅga always study this book and attain the result of circumambulating the Dhām.
পরিক্রমাকালে গ্রন্থ কৈলে আলোচনা ।<br />শতগুণ ফল হয় শাস্ত্রের বচন ॥৭৭॥
parikramā-kāle grantha kaile ālochanā<br />śata-guṇa phala haya śāstrera vachana [77]
<span class="e2">ālochanā kaile</span>–When devotees discuss <span class="e2">grantha</span>–this book <span class="e2">parikramā-kāle</span>–during circumambulation [of the Dhām,] <span class="e2">phala</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–they attain a result <span class="e2">śata-guṇa</span>–a hundred times greater. [This is] <span class="e2">vachana</span>–the word <span class="e2">śāstrera</span>–of the scriptures. [77]
When devotees discuss this book while circumambulating the Dhām, they attain a result a hundred times greater. This is stated by the scriptures.
নিতাই-জাহ্নবা-পদছায়া আশ যার ।<br />নদীয়া-মাহাত্ম্য গায় দীনহীন ছার ॥৭৮॥
nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā āśa yāra<br />nadīyā-māhātmya gāya dīna-hīna chhāra [78]
<span class="e2">dīna-hīna</span> <span class="e2">chhāra</span>–This insignificant, lowly, and humble soul, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–whose <span class="e2">āśa</span>–aspiration <span class="e2">nitāi-jāhnavā-pada-chhāyā</span>–of the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chants <span class="e2">nadīyā-māhātmya</span>–the glories of Nadia. [78]
This insignificant, lowly, and humble soul, whose aspiration is the shade of Nitāi and Jāhnavā’s feet, chants the glories of Nadia.
শ্রীল ভক্তিবিনোদ ঠাকুর-কৃত
শ্রীনবদ্বীপদাম-মাহাত্ম্যের পরিক্রমা-খণ্ড সমাপ্ত ।
Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur-kṛta
Śrī-Navadvīpa-Dhāma-Māhātmyera <br />Parikramā-khaṇḍa samāpta
Thus ends the Parikramā Khaṇḍa of <span class="e3">Śrī Navadvīpa-dhāma-māhātmya</span> by Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur.

শ্রীশ্রীগুরুগৌরাঙ্গৌ-জয়তঃ
All glory to Śrī Guru and Śrī Gaurāṅga
Śrī Śrī Navadvīpa-bhāva-taraṅga
Waves of the Ecstasy of Nabadwīp
সর্ব্বধামশিরোমণি সন্ধিনীবিলাস ।<br />ষোলক্রোশ নবদ্বীপ চিদানন্দবাস ॥<br />সর্ব্বতীর্থ-দেব-ঋষি-শ্রুতির বিশ্রাম ।<br />স্ফুরুক্ নয়নে মম নবদ্বীপধাম ॥১॥
sarva-dhāma-śiromaṇi sandhinī-vilāsa<br />ṣola-krośa navadvīpa chid-ānanda-vāsa<br />sarva-tīrtha-deva-ṛṣi-śrutira viśrāma<br />sphūruk nayane mama navadvīpa-dhāma [1]
[May] <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-śiromaṇi</span>–the crown jewel of all the Lord’s abodes, <span class="e2">sandhinī-vilāsa</span>–the play of the concrete spiritual energy, <span class="e2">chid-ānanda-vāsa</span>–the joyful, spiritual abode <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa navadvīpa</span>–of nine islands measuring thirty-two miles, <span class="e2">sarva-tīrtha-deva-ṛṣi-śrutira viśrāma</span>–the sanctuary of all holy places, gods, sages, and scriptures, <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">sphūruk</span>–appear <span class="e2">nayane mama</span>–before my eyes. [1]
May the crown jewel of all the Lord’s abodes, the play of the sandhinī energy, the joyful, spiritual abode of nine islands measuring thirty-two miles, the sanctuary of all holy places, gods, sages, and scriptures, Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām, appear before my eyes.
মাথুর-মণ্ডলে ষোলক্রোশ বৃন্দাবন ।<br />গৌড়ে নবদ্বীপ তথা দেখুক্ নয়ন ॥<br />একের প্রকাশ দুই অনাদি চিন্ময় ।<br />প্রভুর বিলাস-ভেদে শুদ্ধধামদ্বয় ॥২॥
māthura-maṇḍale ṣola-krośa vṛndāvana<br />gauḍe navadvīpa tathā dekhuk nayana<br />ekera prakāśa dui anādi chinmaya<br />prabhura vilāsa-bhede śuddha-dhāma-dvaya [2]
[May my] <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes <span class="e2">dekhuk</span>–behold <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–the thirty-two miles <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–of Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">māthura</span>-<span class="e2">maṇḍale</span>–in the district of Mathurā <span class="e2">tathā</span>–as <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Śrī Nabadwīp <span class="e2">gauḍe</span>–of the district of Gauḍa. [They are] <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">anādi</span>–eternal <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–manifestations <span class="e2">ekera</span>–of one [truth]. [These] <span class="e2">śuddha-dhāma-dvaya</span>–two divine abodes [exist] <span class="e2">vilāsa-bhede</span>–in accordance with different Pastimes <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord. [2]
May my eyes behold the thirty-two miles of Vṛndāvan in Mathurā Maṇḍal as Śrī Nabadwīp of Gauḍa Maṇḍal. These divine abodes are eternal, spiritual manifestations of one truth and exist in accordance with different Pastimes of the Lord.
প্রভুর অচিন্ত্য শক্তি অনাদি চিন্ময়ে ।<br />জীব নিস্তারিতে আনে প্রপঞ্চ-নিলয়ে ॥<br />সেই কৃষ্ণকৃপাবলে জড়-বদ্ধ জন ।<br />বৃন্দাবন নবদ্বীপে করুক দর্শন ॥৩॥
prabhura achintya śakti anādi chinmaye<br />jīva nistārite āne prapañcha-nilaye<br />sei kṛṣṇa-kṛpā-bale jaḍa-baddha jana<br />vṛndāvana navadvīpa karuka darśana [3]
<span class="e2">achintya</span>–The inconceivable, <span class="e2">anādi</span>–eternal, <span class="e2">chinmaye</span>–spiritual<span class="e2"> śakti</span>–energy <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord <span class="e2">āne</span>–brings [these divine abodes] <span class="e2">prapañcha-nilaye</span>–to the material world <span class="e2">nistārite</span>–to deliver <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls. [May] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jaḍa-baddha jana</span>–the materially conditioned souls <span class="e2">darśana karuka</span>–behold <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan [and] <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kṛpā-bale</span>–by Kṛṣṇa’s grace. [3]
The inconceivable, eternal, spiritual energy of the Lord brings these divine abodes to the material world to deliver souls. May the materially conditioned souls behold Vṛndāvan and Nabadwīp by Kṛṣṇa’s grace.
যোগ্যতা লভিয়া সব জীবেন্দ্রিয়গণ ।<br />চিন্ময় বিশেষ সুধা করে আস্বাদন ॥<br />অযোগ্য ইন্দ্রিয় তাহা আস্বাদিতে নারে ।<br />ক্ষুদ্র জড় বলি’ তারে নিন্দে বারে বারে ॥৪॥
yogyatā labhiyā saba jīvendriya-gaṇa<br />chinmaya viśeṣa sudhā kare āsvādana<br />ayogya indriya tāhā āsvādite nāre<br />kṣudra jaḍa bali’ tāre ninde bāre bāre [4]
<span class="e2">labhiyā</span>–Upon attaining <span class="e2">yogyatā</span>–fitness, <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">jīvendriya-gaṇa</span>–all the senses <span class="e2">āsvādana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–taste <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–extraordinary <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">sudhā</span>–nectar. <span class="e2">ayogya</span>–Unfit <span class="e2">indriya</span>–senses <span class="e2">nāre</span>–cannot <span class="e2">āsvādite</span>–taste <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–it [and] <span class="e2">ninde</span>–deride <span class="e2">tāre</span>–it <span class="e2">bāre</span>–again [and] <span class="e2">bāre</span>–again <span class="e2">bali’</span>–as <span class="e2">kṣudra</span>–insignificant <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–matter. [4]
Upon attaining fitness, all the senses taste extraordinary spiritual nectar. Unfit senses cannot taste it and deride it again and again as insignificant matter.
কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণভক্ত-কৃপা যোগ্যতা কারণ ।<br />জীবে দয়া সাধুসঙ্গে লভে ভক্তজন ॥<br />জ্ঞানকর্ম্মযোগে সেই যোগ্যতা না হয় ।<br />শ্রদ্ধাবলে সাধুসঙ্গে করে জড় জয় ॥৫॥
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa-bhakta-kṛpā yogyatā kāraṇa<br />jīve dayā sādhu-saṅge labhe bhakta-jana<br />jñāna-karma-yoge sei yogyatā nā haya<br />śraddhā-bale sādhu-saṅge kare jaḍa jaya [5]
