<span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–The mercy <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–the devotees of Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–the cause <span class="e2">yogyatā</span>–of fitness. <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–Devotees <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain [it] <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–by associating with the sādhus [and] <span class="e2">dayā</span>–being kind <span class="e2">jīve</span>–to other souls. <span class="e2">sei</span>–Such <span class="e2">yogyatā</span>–fitness <span class="e2">nā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–does not arise <span class="e2">jñāna-karma-yoge</span>–through exploitation, renunciation, or meditation. [Souls] <span class="e2">jaya kare</span>–conquer <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–matter <span class="e2">śraddhā-bale</span>–through faith [and] <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–the association of the sādhus. [5]
The mercy of Kṛṣṇa and the devotees of Kṛṣṇa are the cause of the senses becoming fit. Devotees attain such fitness by associating with the sādhus and being kind to other souls. Souls do not become fit through exploitation, renunciation, or yoga. Souls conquer matter through faith and the association of the sādhus.
জড় জাল জীবেন্দ্রিয়ে ছাড়ে যেই ক্ষণ ।<br />জীবচক্ষু করে ধাম-শোভা দরশন ॥<br />আহা কবে সে অবস্থা হইবে আমারে ।<br />দেখিব শ্রীনবদ্বীপ জড়মায়া পারে ॥৬॥
jaḍa jāla jīvendriye chhāḍe yei kṣaṇa<br />jīva-chakṣu kare dhāma-śobhā daraśana<br />āhā kabe se avasthā ha-ibe āmāre<br />dekhiba śrī-navadvīpa jaḍa-māyā pāre [6]
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">kṣaṇa</span>–When <span class="e2">jāla</span>–the net <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–of matter <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–releases <span class="e2">jīvendriye</span>–the senses of the soul, <span class="e2">jīva-chakṣu</span>–the eyes of the soul <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–see <span class="e2">dhāma-śobhā</span>–the splendour of the Dhām. <span class="e2">āhā</span>–Ah! <span class="e2">kabe</span>–When <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span> <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–will I attain <span class="e2">se</span>–that <span class="e2">avasthā</span>–state? [When] <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–will I see <span class="e2">śrī-navadvīpa</span>–Śrī Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">pāre</span>–beyond <span class="e2">jaḍa-māyā</span>–the illusion of matter? [6]
When the net of matter releases the senses of the soul, the eyes of the soul see the splendour of the Dhām. Ah! When will I attain that state? When will I see Śrī Nabadwīp, beyond the illusion of matter?
অষ্টদলপদ্মনিভ ধাম নিরমল ।<br />কোটিচন্দ্র জ্যোৎস্না জিনি’ অতীব শীতল ॥<br />কোটি-সূর্য্য-প্রভা জিনি’ অতি তেজময় ।<br />আমার নয়ন পথে হইবে উদয় ॥৭॥
aṣṭadala-padma-nibha dhāma niramala<br />koṭi-chandra jyotsnā jini’ atīva śītala<br />koṭi-sūrya-prabhā jini’ ati tejamaya<br />āmāra nayana pathe ha-ibe udaya [7]
<span class="e2">dhāma</span> <span class="e2">niramala</span>–The Holy Dhām <span class="e2">nibha</span>–resembles <span class="e2">aṣṭadala-padma</span>–an eight-petalled lotus. [It is] <span class="e2">atīva</span>–extremely <span class="e2">śītala</span>–cool, <span class="e2">jini’</span>–more so than <span class="e2">jyotsnā</span>–the light <span class="e2">koṭi-chandra</span>–of ten million moons, [and] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">tejamaya</span>–bright, <span class="e2">jini’</span>–more so than <span class="e2">prabhā</span>–the brilliance <span class="e2">koṭi-sūrya</span>–of ten million suns. [When] <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span>–will [the Dhām] appear <span class="e2">pathe</span>–in the path <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">nayana</span>–of my eyes? [7]
The Holy Dhām resembles an eight-petalled lotus. It is extremely cool, more so than the light of ten million moons, and extremely bright, more so than the brilliance of ten million suns. When will the Dhām appear before my eyes?
অষ্টদ্বীপ অষ্টদল মধ্যে দ্বীপবর ।<br />অন্তদ্বীপ নাম তার অতীব সুন্দর ॥<br />তার মধ্য-ভাগে যোগপীঠ মায়াপুর ।<br />দেখিয়া আনন্দ লাভ করিব প্রচুর ॥৮॥
aṣṭadvīpa aṣṭadala madhye dvīpa-vara<br />antardvīpa nāma tāra atīva sundara<br />tāra madhya-bhāge yoga-pīṭha māyāpura<br />dekhiyā ānanda lābha kariba prachura [8]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–In the centre <span class="e2">aṣṭadvīpa</span>–of the [Dhām’s] eight islands, [which resemble] <span class="e2">aṣṭadala</span>–eight petals, [is] <span class="e2">dvīpa-vara</span>–the best island. <span class="e2">tāra</span>–Its <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name [is] <span class="e2">antardvīpa</span>–Antardwīp, [and it is] <span class="e2">atīva</span>–extremely <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful. <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">madhya-bhāge</span>–At its centre [is] <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur [and] <span class="e2">yoga-pīṭha</span>–the Yoga Pīṭh (the Lord’s birth place). <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing [it,] <span class="e2">lābha</span> <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will feel <span class="e2">prachura</span>–intense <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–joy. [8]
In the centre of the Dhām’s eight islands, which resemble eight petals, is the best island: the extremely beautiful Antardwīp. At its centre is Māyāpur and the Yoga Pīṭh. Seeing it, I will feel intense joy.
ব্রহ্মপুর বলি’ শ্রুতিগণ যাকে গায় ।<br />মায়ামুক্ত চক্ষে আহা মায়াপুর ভায় ॥<br />সর্ব্বোপরি শ্রীগোকুল নাম মহাবন ।<br />যথা নিত্যলীলা করে শ্রীশচীনন্দন ॥৯॥
brahmapura bali’ śruti-gaṇa yāke gāya<br />māyā-mukta chakṣe āhā māyāpura bhāya<br />sarvopari śrī-gokula nāma mahāvana<br />yathā nitya-līlā kare śrī-śachī-nandana [9]
<span class="e2">śruti-gaṇa</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing <span class="e2">yāke</span>–of it, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–calling [it] <span class="e2">brahmapura</span>–Brahmapur. <span class="e2">āhā</span>–Ah! <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–shines <span class="e2">chakṣe</span>–before eyes <span class="e2">māyā-mukta</span>–free from illusion. [It is] <span class="e2">śrī-gokula</span>–Śrī Gokula, [which is] <span class="e2">sarvopari</span>–above all, [and] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">mahāvana</span>–Mahāvan, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-nandana</span>–Śachī’s son <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs [His] <span class="e2">nitya-līlā</span>–eternal Pastimes. [9]
The scriptures sing of it, calling it Brahmapur. Ah! Māyāpur shines before eyes free from illusion. It is nondifferent from the supreme abode, Śrī Gokula Mahāvan, where the son of Śachī performs His eternal Pastimes.
ব্রজে সেই ধাম গোপ-গোপীগণালয় ।<br />নবদ্বীপে শ্রীগোকুল দ্বিজবাস রয় ॥<br />জগন্নাথমিশ্রগৃহ পরম পাবন ।<br />মায়াপুর-মধ্যে শোভে নিত্য নিকেতন ॥১০॥
vraje sei dhāma gopa-gopī-gaṇālaya<br />navadvīpe śrī-gokula dvija-vāsa raya<br />jagannātha-miśra-gṛha parama pāvana<br />māyāpura-madhye śobhe nitya niketana [10]
<span class="e2">vraje</span>–As Vraja, <span class="e2">sei</span>–the <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–Dhām [is] <span class="e2">gopa-gopī-gaṇālaya</span>–the home of cowherd men and women. <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–As Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">śrī-gokula</span>–Śrī Gokula <span class="e2">raya</span>–is <span class="e2">dvija-vāsa</span>–the home of brāhmaṇs. <span class="e2">jagannātha-miśra-gṛha</span>–The house of Jagannāth Miśra, [the] <span class="e2">parama</span>–supremely <span class="e2">pāvana</span>–pure, <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal <span class="e2">niketana</span>–home [of the Lord,] <span class="e2">śobhe</span>–shines <span class="e2">māyāpura-madhye</span>–in Māyāpur. [10]
As Vraja, the Dhām is the home of cowherd men and women. As Nabadwīp, Śrī Gokula is the home of brāhmaṇs. The house of Jagannāth Miśra, the supremely pure, eternal home of the Lord, shines in Māyāpur.
মায়াজালাবৃত চক্ষু দেখে ক্ষুদ্রাগার ।<br />জড়ময় ভূমি জল দ্রব্য যত আর ॥<br />মায়া কৃপা করি’ জাল উঠায় যখন ।<br />আঁখি দেখে সুবিশাল চিন্ময় ভবন ॥১১॥
māyā-jālāvṛta chakṣu dekhe kṣudrāgāra<br />jaḍamaya bhūmi jala dravya yata āra<br />māyā kṛpā kari’ jāla uṭhāya yakhana<br />ā̐khi dekhe suviśāla chinmaya bhavana [11]
<span class="e2">chakṣu</span>–Eyes <span class="e2">āvṛta</span>–covered [by] <span class="e2">jāla</span>–the veil <span class="e2">māyā</span>–of Māyā <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">kṣudrāgāra</span>–a small house, <span class="e2">jaḍamaya</span>–material <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–land, <span class="e2">jala</span>–water, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">yata</span>–other <span class="e2">dravya</span>–objects. <span class="e2">yakhana</span>–When <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">uṭhāya</span>–lifts [her] <span class="e2">jāla</span>–veil, <span class="e2">ā̐khi</span>–the eyes <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see [a] <span class="e2">suviśāla</span>–magnificent <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">bhavana</span>–abode. [11]
Eyes covered by the veil of Māyā see a small house, some land, some water, and other materials. When Māyā mercifully lifts her veil, the eyes see a magnificent spiritual abode.
যথা নিত্য-মাতাপিতা দাসদাসীগণ ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গে সেবে প্রেমে মত্ত অনুক্ষণ ॥<br />লক্ষ্মীবিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া সেবে প্রভুর চরণ ।<br />পঞ্চতত্ত্বাত্মক প্রভু অপূর্ব্ব দর্শন ॥১২॥
yathā nitya-mātā-pitā dāsa-dāsī-gaṇa<br />śrī-gaurāṅge seve preme matta anukṣaṇa<br />lakṣmī-viṣṇu-priyā seve prabhura charaṇa<br />pañcha-tattvātmaka prabhu apūrva darśana [12]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–There, [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal <span class="e2">mātā</span>–mother, <span class="e2">pitā</span>–father, [and] <span class="e2">dāsa-dāsī-gaṇa</span>–servants <span class="e2">seve</span>–serve <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅge</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–ever <span class="e2">matta</span>–enchanted <span class="e2">preme</span>–by divine love. <span class="e2">lakṣmī-viṣṇu-priyā</span>–Lakṣmī Priyā and Viṣṇu Priyā <span class="e2">seve</span>–serve <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–the feet of the Lord, [and] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">darśana</span>–appears <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–wonderfully <span class="e2">pañcha-tattvātmaka</span>–as the Pañcha Tattva (Śrī Gaurāṅga, Śrī Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita, Śrī Gadādhar, and Śrī Śrīvās). [12]
There, Śrī Gaurāṅga’s eternal mother, father, and servants serve Him, ever enchanted by divine love. Lakṣmī Priyā and Viṣṇu Priyā serve His feet, and the Lord manifests Himself wonderfully as the Pañcha Tattva.
নিত্যানন্দ শ্রীঅদ্বৈত সেই মায়াপুরে ।<br />গদাধর শ্রীবাসাদি স্থানে স্থানে স্ফুরে ॥<br />অসংখ্য বৈষ্ণবালয় চতুর্দ্দিকে ভায় ।<br />হেন মায়াপুর কৃপা করুন আমায় ॥১৩॥
nityānanda śrī-advaita sei māyāpure<br />gadādhara śrīvāsādi sthāne sthāne sphure<br />asaṅkhya vaiṣṇavālaya chaturdike bhāya<br />hena māyāpura kṛpā karuna āmāya [13]
<span class="e2">nityānanda</span>–Nityānanda, <span class="e2">śrī-advaita</span>–Śrī Advaita, <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar, <span class="e2">śrīvāsādi</span>–Śrīvās, and others <span class="e2">sphure</span>–reside <span class="e2">sthāne</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in various places <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–throughout Māyāpur. <span class="e2">asaṅkhya</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavālaya</span>–The homes of innumerable devotees <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–fill <span class="e2">chaturdike</span>–the four directions. [May] <span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–that Māyāpur <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">karuna</span>–be merciful <span class="e2">āmāya</span>–to me. [13]
Nityānanda, Advaita, Gadādhar, Śrīvās, and other devotees reside throughout Māyāpur, where the homes of innumerable devotees fill the four directions. May Māyāpur be merciful to me.
নৈঋতে যমুনা গঙ্গা স্বসৌভাগ্য গণি’ ।<br />নাগরূপে সেবা করে গোরা দ্বিজমণি ॥<br />ভাগীরথী-তটে বহু ঘাট দেবালয় ।<br />পৌঢ়ামায়া বৃদ্ধ শিব উপবনচয় ॥১৪॥
naiṛte yamunā gaṅgā svasaubhāgya gaṇi’<br />nāga-rūpe sevā kare gorā dvija-maṇi<br />bhāgīrathī-taṭe bahu ghāṭa devālaya<br />prauḍhāmāyā vṛddha śiva upavana-chaya [14]
<span class="e2">naiṛte</span>–To the southwest, <span class="e2">yamunā</span>–the Yamunā [and] <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">gaṇi’</span>–reflect on <span class="e2">svasaubhāgya</span>–their good fortune [and] <span class="e2">nāga-rūpe</span>–like serpents <span class="e2">sevā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā, <span class="e2">dvija-maṇi</span>–the jewel of the brāhmaṇs. <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī-taṭe</span>–On the banks of the Gaṅgā, [there are] <span class="e2">bahu</span>–many <span class="e2">ghāṭa</span>–bathing places, <span class="e2">devālaya</span>–Temples, [and] <span class="e2">upavana-chaya</span>–parks, [as well as] <span class="e2">prauḍhāmāyā</span>–Prauḍhā Māyā [and] <span class="e2">vṛddha</span> <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Vṛddha Śiva. [14]
To the southwest, the Yamunā and the Gaṅgā reflect on their good fortune and, flowing like serpents, serve Gorā, the jewel of the brāhmaṇs. On the banks of the Gaṅgā, there are many ghāṭs, Temples, and parks, as well as Prauḍhā Māyā and Vṛddha Śiva.
অসংখ্য ব্রাহ্মণ-গৃহ মায়াপুরে হয় ।<br />রাজপথ চত্বর বিপিন শিবালয় ॥<br />পূর্ব্ব দক্ষিণেতে এক সরস্বতী ধার ।<br />নিরবধি বহে ঈশোদ্যান তটে যার ॥১৫॥
asaṅkhya brāhmaṇa-gṛha māyāpure haya<br />rāja-patha chatvara vipina śivālaya<br />pūrva dakṣiṇete eka sarasvatī dhāra<br />niravadhi vahe īśodyāna taṭe yāra [15]
<span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–In Māyāpur, <span class="e2">haya</span>–there are <span class="e2">asaṅkhya</span>–countless <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa-gṛha</span>–homes of brāhmaṇs, <span class="e2">rāja-patha</span>–roads, <span class="e2">chatvara</span>–courtyards, <span class="e2">vipina</span>–groves, [and] <span class="e2">śivālaya</span>–Śiva Temples. <span class="e2">pūrva</span> <span class="e2">dakṣiṇete</span>–To the southeast, <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">dhāra</span>–stream <span class="e2">sarasvatī</span>–of the Saraswatī <span class="e2">niravadhi</span>–constantly <span class="e2">vahe</span>–flows. <span class="e2">īśodyāna</span>–The Lord’s garden [is] <span class="e2">taṭe</span> <span class="e2">yāra</span>–on her bank. [15]
In Māyāpur, there are countless homes of brāhmaṇs, roads, courtyards, groves, and Temples of Lord Śiva. To the southeast, a stream of the Saraswatī constantly flows. Īśodyān is on her bank.
এ সব বৈভব নিত্য চিন্ময় অপার ।<br />কেন পাবে কলিজীব মায়াবদ্ধ ছার ॥<br />ত্রিনদী-ভাঙ্গন-ছলে লুকাইল মায়া ।<br />জড় চক্ষু দেখে মাত্র মায়াপুর-ছায়া ॥১৬॥
e saba vaibhava nitya chinmaya apāra<br />kena pābe kali-jīva māyā-baddha chhāra<br />trinadī-bhāṅgana-chhale lukāila māyā<br />jaḍa chakṣu dekhe mātra māyāpura-chhāyā [16]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why [should] <span class="e2">chhāra</span> <span class="e2">kali-jīva</span>–the fallen souls in the Age of Kali, <span class="e2">māyā-baddha</span>–who are conditioned by Māyā, <span class="e2">pābe</span>–attain <span class="e2">e saba</span>–all this <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal, <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual, <span class="e2">apāra</span>–inexhaustible <span class="e2">vaibhava</span>–opulence? <span class="e2">trinadī-bhāṅgana-chhale</span>–With the pretext of diverting the three rivers, <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">lukāila</span>–hid [the opulence of the Dhām]. <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–Material <span class="e2">chakṣu</span>–eyes <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">māyāpura-chhāyā</span>–a shadow of Māyāpur. [16]
Why should the fallen souls of Kali-yuga, conditioned by Māyā, attain all this eternal, spiritual, inexhaustible opulence? Māyā hid it by diverting the three rivers, and material eyes only see a shadow form of Māyāpur.
সশক্তিক-নিত্যানন্দ-কৃপাবল-ক্রমে ।<br />স্ফুরুক্ নয়নে মায়াপুরী সসম্ভ্রমে ॥<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-গৃহলীলা করি’ দরশন ।<br />অতি ধন্য হউ এই মূঢ় অকিঞ্চন ॥১৭॥
saśaktika-nityānanda-kṛpā-bala-krame<br />sphuruk nayane māyāpurī sasambhrame<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-gṛha-līlā kari’ daraśana<br />ati dhanya ha-u ei mūḍha akiñchana [17]
[May] <span class="e2">māyāpurī</span>–Māyāpur <span class="e2">sasambhrame</span>–gloriously <span class="e2">sphuruk</span>–appear <span class="e2">nayane</span>–before [my] eyes <span class="e2">bala-krame</span>–by the force <span class="e2">saśaktika-nityānanda</span>–of powerful Nityānanda’s <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercy. [May] <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">akiñchana</span>–poor, <span class="e2">mūḍha</span>–foolish soul <span class="e2">daraśana kari’</span>–behold <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-gṛha-līlā</span>–the household Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga [and] <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–become <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate. [17]
May Māyāpur gloriously appear before my eyes by the force of powerful Nityānanda’s mercy. May this poor, foolish soul behold the household Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga and thus become most fortunate.
অন্তর্দ্বীপ-মধ্যে যেই মায়াপুর-গ্রাম ।<br />অষ্টদল কমলের কর্ণিকা সে ধাম ॥<br />গৌরকান্তি পীত জ্যোতির্ম্ময় সুনির্ম্মল ।<br />করুন নয়নে মোর সদা ঝলমল ॥১৮॥
antardvīpa-madhye yei māyāpura-grāma<br />aṣṭadala kamalera karṇikā se dhāma<br />gaura-kānti pīta jyotirmaya sunirmala<br />karuna nayane mora sadā jhalamala [18]
[May the] <span class="e2">jyotirmaya</span>–bright, <span class="e2">sunirmala</span>–spotless, <span class="e2">pīta gaura-kānti</span>–golden-yellow lustre <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">māyāpura-grāma se dhāma</span>–of the village of Māyāpur <span class="e2">antardvīpa-madhye</span>–in Antardwīp, <span class="e2">karṇikā</span>–the whorl <span class="e2">aṣṭadala</span> <span class="e2">kamalera</span>–of the eight-petalled lotus, <span class="e2">jhalamala</span> <span class="e2">karuna</span>–shine <span class="e2">nayane</span> <span class="e2">mora</span>–before my eyes <span class="e2">sadā</span>–forever. [18]
May the bright, spotless, golden lustre of the village of Māyāpur in Antardwīp, the whorl of the eight-petalled lotus of the Dhām, shine before my eyes forever.
কোন স্থানে উপবন পৃথু সরোবর ।<br />গোচারণভূমি কত দেখিতে সুন্দর ॥<br />প্রবাহপ্রণালী কত শস্যভূমি-খণ্ড ।<br />রাজপথ বকুল কদম্ব বৃক্ষষণ্ড ॥১৯॥
kona sthāne upavana pṛthu sarovara<br />gochāraṇa-bhūmi kata dekhite sundara<br />pravāha-praṇālī kata śasya-bhūmi-khaṇḍa<br />rāja-patha bakula kadamba vṛkṣa-ṣaṇḍa [19]
<span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–Throughout [the Dhām], <span class="e2">pṛthu</span> <span class="e2">sarovara</span>–the lake known as Pṛthu, [the] <span class="e2">kata</span>–numerous <span class="e2">upavana</span>–groves, <span class="e2">gochāraṇa-bhūmi</span>–cow pastures, <span class="e2">pravāha-praṇālī</span>–waterways, <span class="e2">kata</span>–numerous <span class="e2">śasya-bhūmi-khaṇḍa</span>–grain fields, <span class="e2">rāja-patha</span>–roads, [and] <span class="e2">bakula</span> <span class="e2">kadamba</span> <span class="e2">vṛkṣa-ṣaṇḍa</span>–strong bakul (<span class="e3">Mimusops elengi</span>) and kadamba (<span class="e3">Neolamarckia cadamba</span> or <span class="e3">Anthocephalus cadamba</span>) trees [are] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to see. [19]
Throughout the Dhām, Pṛthu Kuṇḍa, and the numerous groves, cow pastures, waterways, grain fields, roads, and strong bakul and kadamba trees are beautiful to see.
তাহার পশ্চিমে জহ্নু-তনয়ার তট ।<br />শ্রীগঙ্গানগর-নামে প্রসিদ্ধ খর্ব্বট ॥<br />যথা গঙ্গাদাস-গৃহে বিদ্যানুশীলন ।<br />করিলেন প্রভু মোর লয়ে দ্বিজজন ॥২০॥
tāhāra paśchime jahnu-tanayāra taṭa<br />śrī-gaṅgā-nagara-nāme prasiddha kharvaṭa<br />yathā gaṅgā-dāsa-gṛhe vidyānuśīlana<br />karilena prabhu mora laye dvija-jana [20]
<span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">paśchime</span>–To their west, <span class="e2">jahnū-tanayāra</span> <span class="e2">taṭa</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā, [is] <span class="e2">prasiddha</span>–the famous <span class="e2">kharvaṭa</span>–village <span class="e2">śrī-gaṅgā-nagara-nāme</span>–known as Śrī Gaṅgā Nagar, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">mora</span>–our <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">vidyānuśīlana</span> <span class="e2">karilena</span>–studied <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">dvija-jana</span>–brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">gaṅgā-dāsa-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Gaṅgā Dās. [20]
To their west, on the bank of the Gaṅgā, is the famous village of Śrī Gaṅgā Nagar, where our Lord studied with brāhmaṇs in the home of Gaṅgā Dās Paṇḍit.
ভরদ্বাজটীলা তথা দেখিতে সুন্দর ।<br />গৌর ভজি’ যথা ভরদ্বাজ মুনিবর ॥<br />লভিয়া চৈতন্যপ্রেম সূত্র প্রকাশিল ।<br />কতশত বহির্ম্মুখ জনে ভক্তি দিল ॥২১॥
bharadvāja-ṭīlā tathā dekhite sundara<br />gaura bhaji’ yathā bharadvāja muni-vara<br />labhiyā chaitanya-prema sūtra prakāśila<br />kata-śata bahirmukha jane bhakti dila [21]
<span class="e2">tathā</span>–There [is] <span class="e2">bharadvāja-ṭīlā</span>–Bharadvāja Ṭīlā, <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to see, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">bharadvāja</span> <span class="e2">muni-vara</span>–the great Bharadvāja Muni <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura, <span class="e2">labhiyā</span>–attained <span class="e2">chaitanya-prema</span>–divine love for Śrī Chaitanya, <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–wrote <span class="e2">sūtra</span>–aphorisms, [and] <span class="e2">dila</span>–distributed <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion [to] <span class="e2">kata-śata</span>–hundreds <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span> <span class="e2">jane</span>–of averse souls. [21]
There also is Bharadvāja Ṭīlā, beautiful to see, where the great Bharadvāja Muni worshipped Gaura, attained divine love for the Lord, wrote sūtras, and distributed devotion to thousands of averse souls.
পৃথুকুণ্ড উত্তরেতে মথুরা নগর ।<br />ষষ্ঠীতীর্থ মধুবন পরম সুন্দর ॥<br />বহুজনাকীর্ণ জনপদ সুবিস্তার ।<br />দর্শনে পবিত্র হউ নয়ন আমার ॥২২॥
pṛthu-kuṇḍa uttarete mathurā nagara<br />ṣaṣṭhī-tīrtha madhuvana parama sundara<br />bahu-janākīrṇa jana-pada suvistāra<br />darśane pavitra ha-u nayana āmāra [22]
<span class="e2">uttarete</span>–North <span class="e2">pṛthu-kuṇḍa</span>–of Pṛthu Kuṇḍa [is] <span class="e2">mathurā</span> <span class="e2">nagara</span>–Mathurā Nagar [and] <span class="e2">ṣaṣṭhī-tīrtha</span>–Ṣaṣṭī Tīrtha, [which are] <span class="e2">parama</span>–extremely <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful [and nondifferent from] <span class="e2">madhuvana</span>–Madhuvan. [May] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–become <span class="e2">pavitra</span>–purified <span class="e2">darśane</span>–by seeing <span class="e2">bahu-janākīrṇa</span>–the numerous people [and] <span class="e2">suvistāra</span>–grand <span class="e2">jana-pada</span>–residences [there].[22]
North of Pṛthu Kuṇḍa is Mathurā Nagar and Ṣaṣṭhī Tīrtha, which are extremely beautiful and nondifferent from Madhuvan. May my eyes become purified by seeing the numerous people and grand residences there.
তদুত্তরে শরডাঙ্গা স্থান মনোহর ।<br />রক্তবাহুভয়ে যথা শবরপ্রবর ॥<br />নীলাদ্রিপতিকে লয়ে রহে সংগোপনে ।<br />সেই স্থান দেখি যেন সর্ব্বদা নয়নে ॥২৩॥
tad uttare śaraḍāṅgā sthāna manohara<br />raktabāhu-bhaye yathā śabara-pravara<br />nīlādripatike laye rahe saṁgopane<br />sei sthāna dekhi yena sarvadā nayane [23]
<span class="e2">uttare</span>–North <span class="e2">tad</span>–of there [is the] <span class="e2">manohara</span>–charming <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place <span class="e2">śaraḍāṅgā</span>–Śaraḍāṅgā, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">śabara-pravara</span>–the great śabaras <span class="e2">laye</span>–brought <span class="e2">nīlādripatike</span>–Jagannāth [and] <span class="e2">rahe</span>–resided <span class="e2">saṁgopane</span>–in secret <span class="e2">raktabāhu-bhaye</span>–out of fear of (the demon) Raktabāhu. <span class="e2">yena</span>–May [my] <span class="e2">nayane</span>–eyes <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–see <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place. [23]
North of there is the charming Śaraḍāṅgā, where the great śabaras brought Jagannāth and resided in secret out of fear of Raktabāhu. May my eyes always see this place.
মথুরায় বায়ুকোণে হেরিব নয়নে ।<br />সীমন্তদ্বীপের শোভা জাহ্নবী-সদনে ॥<br />যথায় পার্ব্বতীদেবী গৌরপদ-ধূলি ।<br />সীমন্তে ধারণ কৈল করিয়া আকুলি ॥২৪॥
mathurāya vāyu-koṇe heriba nayane<br />sīmantadvīpera śobhā jāhnavī-sadane<br />yathāya pārvatī-devī gaura-pada-dhūli<br />sīmante dhāraṇa kaila kariyā ākuli [24]
<span class="e2">jāhnavī-sadane</span>–Beside the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">vāyu-koṇe</span>–in the northwest corner <span class="e2">mathurāya</span>–of Mathurā, [my] <span class="e2">nayane</span>–eyes <span class="e2">heriba</span>–will see <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–the splendour <span class="e2">sīmantadvīpera</span>–of Sīmantadwīp, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">pārvatī-devī</span>–Pārvatī Devī <span class="e2">ākuli kariyā</span>–eagerly <span class="e2">dhāraṇa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–placed <span class="e2">gaura-pada-dhūli</span>–Gaura’s foot-dust <span class="e2">sīmante</span>–on the parting in her hair. [24]
Beside the Gaṅgā, in the northwest corner of Mathurā, my eyes will see the splendour of Sīmantadwīp, where Pārvatī Devī eagerly placed Gaura’s foot-dust on the parting in her hair.
দূর হইতে বিলোকিব বিল্বপক্ষবন ।<br />যথা গৌরধ্যানে আছে ঋষি চতুঃসন ॥<br />নিতাইবিলাসভূমি দেখিব সুদূরে ।<br />যথা সঙ্কর্ষণ-ক্ষেত্র বিজ্ঞজনে স্ফুরে ॥২৫॥
dūra ha-ite vilokiba bilvapakṣavana<br />yathā gaura-dhyāne āchhe ṛṣi chatuḥsana<br />nitāi-vilāsa-bhūmi dekhiba sudūre<br />yathā saṅkarṣaṇa-kṣetra vijña-jane sphure [25]
<span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–From <span class="e2">dūra</span>–afar, <span class="e2">vilokiba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">bilvapakṣavana</span>–the forest of Bilvapakṣa, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">chatuḥsana</span>–(Brahmā’s) four sons, [who are] <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span>–sages, <span class="e2">gaura-dhyāne</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–meditate on Gaura. <span class="e2">sudūre</span>–In the distance, <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">nitāi-vilāsa-bhūmi</span>–the land of the Pastimes of Nitāi, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">saṅkarṣaṇa-kṣetra</span>–Saṅkarṣaṇ Kṣetra <span class="e2">sphure</span>–appears <span class="e2">vijña-jane</span>–before the wise. [25]
From afar, I will see the forest of Bilvapakṣa, where the four Kumāras meditate on Gaura. In the distance, I will see the land of the Pastimes of Nitāi, where Saṅkarṣaṇ Kṣetra appears before the wise.
মায়াপুর-দক্ষিণাংশে জাহ্নবীর তটে ।<br />সরস্বতী-সঙ্গমের অতীব নিকটে ॥<br />ঈশোদ্যান নাম উপবন সুবিস্তার ।<br />সর্ব্বদা ভজনস্থান হউক আমার ॥২৬॥
māyāpura-dakṣiṇāṁśe jāhnavīra taṭe<br />sarasvatī-saṅgamera atīva nikaṭe<br />īśodyāna nāma upavana suvistāra<br />sarvadā bhajana-sthāna ha-uka āmāra [26]
<span class="e2">māyāpura-dakṣiṇāṁśe</span>–In the southern part of Māyāpur, <span class="e2">taṭe</span>–on the bank <span class="e2">jāhnavīra</span>–of the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">atīva</span>–very <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–near <span class="e2">sarasvatī-saṅgamera</span>–the confluence with the Saraswatī, [is the] <span class="e2">suvistāra</span>–large <span class="e2">upavana</span>–garden <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">īśodyāna</span>–‘the Lord’s garden’. <span class="e2">ha-uka</span>–May [it] be <span class="e2">bhajana-sthāna</span> <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–the place of my worship <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–forever. [26]
In the southern part of Māyāpur, on the bank of the Gaṅgā, very near the confluence with the Saraswatī, is the large garden known as Īśodyān. May it be my place of worship forever.
যে বনে আমার প্রভু শ্রীশচীনন্দন ।<br />মধ্যাহ্নে করেন লীলা লয়ে ভক্তজন ॥<br />বনশোভা হেরি’ রাধাকৃষ্ণ পড়ে মনে ।<br />সে সব স্ফুরুক্ সদা আমার নয়নে ॥২৭॥
ye vane āmāra prabhu śrī-śachī-nandana<br />madhyāhne karena līlā laye bhakta-jana<br />vana-śobhā heri’ rādhā-kṛṣṇa paḍe mane<br />se saba sphuruk sadā āmāra nayane [27]
<span class="e2">heri’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">vane vana-śobhā</span>–the splendour of that grove in which <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord, <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-nandana</span>–the son of Śachī, <span class="e2">karena</span>–performs <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">madhyāhne</span>–at midday <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–the devotees, <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–come <span class="e2">mane</span>–to mind. [May] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all these [places] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sphuruk</span>–appear <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">nayane</span>–before my eyes. [27]
Seeing the splendour of that grove where my Lord, Śrī Śachī Nandan, performs Pastimes at midday with the devotees, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa come to mind. May all these places always appear before my eyes.
বনস্পতি কৃষ্ণলতা নিবিড় দর্শন ।<br />নানা পক্ষী গায় তথা গৌরগুণগান ॥<br />সরোবর শ্রীমন্দির অতি শোভা তায় ।<br />হিরণ্য-হীরক-নীল-পীতমণি ভায় ॥২৮॥
vanaspati kṛṣṇa-latā niviḍa darśana<br />nānā pakṣī gāya tathā gaura-guṇa-gāna<br />sarovara śrī-mandira ati śobhā tāya<br />hiraṇya-hīraka-nīla-pīta-maṇi bhāya [28]
<span class="e2">tathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">vanaspati</span>–the trees [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-latā</span>–dark vines <span class="e2">darśana</span>–appear <span class="e2">niviḍa</span>–thick, [and] <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various <span class="e2">pakṣī</span>–birds <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing <span class="e2">gaura-guṇa-gāna</span>–songs about the glories of Gaura. <span class="e2">tāya</span>–There, <span class="e2">sarovara</span>–the lake [and] <span class="e2">śrī-mandira</span>–Temple <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–appear <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–beautiful, [with] <span class="e2">hiraṇya</span>–gold, <span class="e2">hīraka</span>–diamonds, [and]<span class="e2"> nīla-pīta-maṇi</span>–blue and yellow sapphires. [28]
There, the trees and dark vines are thick, and various birds sing songs about the glories of Gaura. The lake and Temple are very beautiful, inlaid with gold, diamonds, and blue and yellow sapphires.
বহির্ম্মুখ জন মায়ামুগ্ধ আঁখিদ্বয়ে ।<br />কভু নাহি দেখে সেই উপবনচয়ে ॥<br />দেখে মাত্র কণ্টক আবৃত ভূমিখণ্ড ।<br />তটিনীবন্যার বেগে সদা লণ্ডভণ্ড ॥২৯॥
bahirmukha jana māyā-mugdha ā̐khi-dvaye<br />kabhu nāhi dekhe sei upavana-chaye<br />dekhe mātra kaṇṭaka āvṛta bhūmi-khaṇḍa<br />taṭinī-vanyāra vege sadā laṇḍa-bhaṇḍa [29]
<span class="e2">ā̐khi-dvaye</span>–The eyes <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–of averse souls, [who are] <span class="e2">māyā-mugdha</span>–bewildered by illusion, <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">upavana-chaye</span>–these groves; [they] <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">bhūmi-khaṇḍa</span>–a piece of land <span class="e2">āvṛta</span>–covered <span class="e2">kaṇṭaka</span>–with thorns [that is] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–constantly <span class="e2">laṇḍa-bhaṇḍa</span>–disturbed <span class="e2">taṭinī-vanyāra</span> <span class="e2">vege</span>–by the force of flooding rivers. [29]
The eyes of averse souls, who are bewildered by Māyā, never see these groves; they see only a piece of land covered with thorns that is constantly disturbed by the force of flooding rivers.
মধুবন মধ্যভাগে শ্রীবিশ্রামস্থল ।<br />শ্রীধরকুটীর আর কুণ্ড নিরমল ॥<br />কাজীরে শোধিয়া প্রভু লয়ে পরিকর ।<br />যথায় বিশ্রাম কৈল ত্রিদশ-ঈশ্বর ॥৩০॥
madhuvana madhya-bhāge śrī-viśrāma-sthala<br />śrīdhara-kuṭīra āra kuṇḍa niramala<br />kājīre śodhiyā prabhu laye parikara<br />yathāya viśrāma kaila tridaśa-īśvara [30]
<span class="e2">madhya-bhāge</span>–In the centre <span class="e2">madhuvana</span>–of Madhuvan [is a] <span class="e2">niramala</span>–clear <span class="e2">kuṇḍa</span>–pond, <span class="e2">śrīdhara-kuṭīra</span>–the cottage of Śrīdhar, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">śrī-viśrāma-sthala</span>–Viśrām Sthal, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">tridaśa-īśvara</span> <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord of the three worlds (Śrīman Mahāprabhu) <span class="e2">viśrāma</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–rested <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">parikara</span>–associates [after] <span class="e2">śodhiyā</span>–redeeming <span class="e2">kājīre</span>–the Kāzī. [30]
In the centre of Madhuvan is a clear pond, the cottage of Śrīdhar, and Viśrām Sthal, where the Lord of the three worlds rested with His associates after redeeming the Kāzī.
“হা গৌরাঙ্গ” বলি’ কবে সে বিশ্রামস্থলে ।<br />গড়াগড়ি দিয়া আমি কাঁদিব বিরলে ॥<br />প্রেমাবেশে দেখিব শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গসুন্দরে ।<br />লৌহপাত্রে জল পিয়ে শ্রীধরের ঘরে ॥৩১॥
“hā gaurāṅga” bali’ kabe se viśrāma-sthale<br />gaḍāgaḍi diyā āmi kā̐diba virale<br />premāveśe dekhiba śrī-gaurāṅga-sundare<br />lauha-pātre jala piye śrīdharera ghare [31]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When <span class="e2">āmi</span> <span class="e2">bali’</span>–will I call out, <span class="e2">“hā</span> <span class="e2">gaurāṅga”</span>–“O Gaurāṅga!”, <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–roll about, [and] <span class="e2">kā̐diba</span>–cry <span class="e2">virale</span>–in seclusion <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">viśrāma-sthale</span>–at Viśrām Sthal? [When will I,] <span class="e2">premāveśe</span>–rapt with divine love, <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–see <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-sundare</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅgasundar <span class="e2">piye</span>–drinking <span class="e2">jala</span>–water <span class="e2">lauha-pātre</span>–from the iron pot <span class="e2">śrīdharera</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–in the home of Śrīdhar? [31]
When will I call out, “O Gaurāṅga!”, roll about, and cry in seclusion at Viśrām Sthal? When will I, rapt with divine love, see Śrī Gaurāṅgasundar drinking water from the iron pot in the home of Śrīdhar?
কবে বা সৌভাগ্যবলে নয়ন আমার ।<br />হেরিবে কীর্ত্তনমাঝে শচীর কুমার ॥<br />নিত্যানন্দাদ্বৈত গদাধর শ্রীনিবাসে ।<br />লয়ে নাচে প্রেম যাচে শ্রীধর-আবাসে ॥৩২॥
kabe vā saubhāgya-bale nayana āmāra<br />heribe kīrtana-mājhe śachīra kumāra<br />nityānandādvaita gadādhara śrīnivāse<br />laye nāche prema yāche śrīdhara-āvāse [32]
<span class="e2">kabe</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–When, <span class="e2">saubhāgya-bale</span>–by great fortune, [will] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes <span class="e2">heribe</span>–see <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">kumāra</span>–the son of Śachī <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dance [and] <span class="e2">yāche</span>–distribute <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love <span class="e2">kīrtana-mājhe</span>–in the midst of kīrtan <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">nityānandādvaita</span>–Nityānanda, Advaita, <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar, [and] <span class="e2">śrīnivāse</span>–Śrīvās <span class="e2">śrīdhara-āvāse</span>–at the home of Śrīdhar? [32]
When, by great fortune, will my eyes see the son of Śachī dance and distribute divine love in the midst of kīrtan with Nityānanda, Advaita, Gadādhar, and Śrīvās at the home of Śrīdhar?
তার পূর্ব্বে বিলোকিব সুবর্ণবিহার ।<br />সুবর্ণসেনের দুর্গ তুল্য নাহি যার ॥<br />যথায় শ্রীগৌরচন্দ্র সহ পরিকর ।<br />নাচেন সুবর্ণমূর্ত্তি অতি মনোহর ॥৩৩॥
tāra pūrve vilokiba suvarṇa-bihāra<br />suvarṇa-senera durga tulya nāhi yāra<br />yathāya śrī-gaurachandra saha parikara<br />nāchena suvarṇa-mūrti ati manohara [33]
[To] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–its <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–east, <span class="e2">vilokiba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">suvarṇa-bihāra</span>–Suvarṇa Bihār [and] <span class="e2">suvarṇa-senera</span>–Suvarṇa Sen’s <span class="e2">durga</span>–palace, <span class="e2">yāra</span>–which has <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–no <span class="e2">tulya</span>–comparison, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">śrī-gaurachandra</span>–Śrī Gaurachandra <span class="e2">nāchena</span>–dances <span class="e2">saha</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">parikara</span>–associates [in His] <span class="e2">ati</span>–most <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting <span class="e2">suvarṇa-mūrti</span>–golden form. [33]
To the east, I will see Suvarṇa Bihār and the incomparable palace of Suvarṇa Sen, where Śrī Gaurachandra dances with His associates in His most enchanting golden form.
একাকী বা ভক্তসঙ্গে কবে কাকুস্বরে ।<br />কাঁদিয়া বেড়াব আমি সুবর্ণনগরে ॥<br />গৌরপদে শ্রীযুগল-সেবা মাগি’ লব ।<br />শ্রীরাধাচরণাশ্রয়ে প্রাণ সমর্পিব ॥৩৪॥
ekākī vā bhakta-saṅge kabe kāku-svare<br />kā̐diyā beḍāba āmi suvarṇa-nagare<br />gaura-pade śrī-yugala-sevā māgi’ lava<br />śrī-rādhā-charaṇāśraye prāṇa samarpiba [34]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When <span class="e2">beḍāba</span> <span class="e2">āmi</span>–will I wander, <span class="e2">ekākī</span>–alone <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">bhakta-saṅge</span>–with devotees, <span class="e2">suvarṇa-nagare</span>–throughout Suvarṇa Bihār, <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–crying <span class="e2">kāku-svare</span>–with a wavering voice? [When] <span class="e2">māgi’</span>–will I beg <span class="e2">gaura-pade</span>–at the feet of Gaura <span class="e2">lava</span>–for a little <span class="e2">śrī-yugala-sevā</span>–service to the Divine Couple [and] <span class="e2">samarpiba</span>–surrender [my] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–heart <span class="e2">śrī-rādhā-charaṇāśraye</span>–in the shelter of the feet of Śrī Rādhā? [34]
When will I wander, alone or with devotees, throughout Suvarṇa Bihār, crying with a wavering voice? When will I beg at the feet of Gaura for a little service to the Divine Couple and surrender my heart in the shelter of the feet of Śrī Rādhā?
তার পূর্ব্বদক্ষিণেতে শ্রীনৃসিংহ-পুরী ।<br />কবে বা হেরিব দেবপল্লীর মাধুরী ॥<br />নরহরি-ক্ষেত্রে প্রেমে গড়াগড়ি দিয়া ।<br />নিষ্কপট কৃষ্ণপ্রেম লইব মাগিয়া ॥৩৫॥
tāra pūrva-dakṣiṇete śrī-nṛsiṁha-purī<br />kabe vā heriba deva-pallīra mādhurī<br />narahari-kṣetre preme gaḍāgaḍi diyā<br />niṣkapaṭa kṛṣṇa-prema la-iba māgiyā [35]
<span class="e2">pūrva-dakṣiṇete</span>–Southeast <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of there [is] <span class="e2">śrī-nṛsiṁha-purī</span>–Nṛsiṁha Pallī. <span class="e2">kabe</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–When <span class="e2">heriba</span>–will I see <span class="e2">mādhurī</span>–the beauty <span class="e2">deva-pallīra</span>–of Nṛsiṁha Pallī? [When] <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–will I roll about <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love <span class="e2">narahari-kṣetre</span>–in Nṛsiṁha Pallī, <span class="e2">māgiyā</span>–pray <span class="e2">niṣkapaṭa</span>–sincerely, [and] <span class="e2">la-iba</span>–accept <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–divine love for Kṛṣṇa? [35]
Southeast of there is Nṛsiṁha Pallī. When will I see its beauty? When will I roll about with divine love, pray sincerely, and attain divine love for Kṛṣṇa?
এ দুষ্ট হৃদয়ে কাম আদি রিপু ছয় ।<br />কুটিনাটি প্রতিষ্ঠাশা শাঠ্য সদা রয় ॥<br />হৃদয়শোধন আর কৃষ্ণের বাসনা ।<br />নৃসিংহ-চরণে মোর এই ত’ কামনা ॥৩৬॥
e duṣṭa hṛdaye kāma ādi ripu chhaya<br />kuṭināṭi pratiṣṭhāśā śāṭhya sadā raya<br />hṛdaya-śodhana āra kṛṣṇera vāsanā<br />nṛsiṁha-charaṇe mora ei ta’ kāmanā [36]
[In] <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">duṣṭa</span>–wicked <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–heart, [the] <span class="e2">chhaya</span>–six <span class="e2">ripu</span>–enemies— <span class="e2">kāma</span>–lust, <span class="e2">ādi</span>–anger, greed, madness, pride, and envy— [as well as] <span class="e2">kuṭināṭi</span>–fault-finding, <span class="e2">pratiṣṭhāśā</span>–desire for prestige, [and] <span class="e2">śāṭhya</span>–deceit, <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">raya</span>–remain. <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">kāmanā</span>–prayer <span class="e2">nṛsiṁha-charaṇe</span>–at the feet of Nṛsiṁha <span class="e2">ei ta’</span>–is that [my] <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart [will be] <span class="e2">śodhana</span>–purified <span class="e2">āra</span>–and [my] <span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–desires [will be only] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–for Kṛṣṇa. [36]
In this wicked heart, the six enemies—lust, anger, and so forth—as well as fault-finding, desire for prestige, and deceit, always remain. My prayer at the feet of Nṛsiṁha is that my heart will be purified and my desires will be only for Kṛṣṇa.
কাঁদিয়া নৃসিংহ-পদে মাগিব কখন ।<br />নিরাপদে নবদ্বীপে যুগলভজন ॥<br />ভয় ভয় পায় যাঁর দর্শনে সে হরি ।<br />প্রসন্ন হইবে কবে মোরে দয়া করি’ ॥৩৭॥
kā̐diyā nṛsiṁha-pade māgiba kakhana<br />nirāpade navadvīpe yugala-bhajana<br />bhaya bhaya pāya yā̐ra darśane se hari<br />prasanna ha-ibe kabe more dayā kari’ [37]
<span class="e2">kakhana</span>–When <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–will I cry <span class="e2">nṛsiṁha-pade</span>–at the feet of Nṛsiṁha [and] <span class="e2">māgiba</span>–pray [that I may] <span class="e2">yugala-bhajana</span>–serve the Divine Couple <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">nirāpade</span>–without disturbance? <span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">yā̐ra</span>–by whose <span class="e2">darśane</span>–sight <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–fear <span class="e2">bhaya</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–becomes fearful, <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–be <span class="e2">prasanna</span>–pleased [and] <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–bless <span class="e2">more</span>–me? [37]
When will I cry at the feet of Nṛsiṁha and pray that I may serve the Divine Couple in Nabadwīp without disturbance? When will the Lord, seeing whom fear becomes fearful, be pleased and bless me?
যদ্যপি ভীষণ মূর্ত্তি দুষ্ট জীব প্রতি ।<br />প্রহ্লাদাদি কৃষ্ণভক্তজনে ভদ্র অতি ॥<br />কবে বা প্রসন্ন হয়ে সকৃপবচনে ।<br />নির্ভয় করিবে এই মূঢ় অকিঞ্চনে ॥৩৮॥
yadyapi bhīṣaṇa mūrti duṣṭa jīva prati<br />prahlādādi kṛṣṇa-bhakta-jane bhadra ati<br />kabe vā prasanna haye sakṛpa-vachane<br />nirbhaya karibe ei mūḍha akiñchane [38]
<span class="e2">yadyapi</span>–Although [He is] <span class="e2">bhīṣaṇa</span> <span class="e2">mūrti</span>–the embodiment of terror <span class="e2">prati</span>–to <span class="e2">duṣṭa</span>–sinful <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls, [He is] <span class="e2">ati</span>–very <span class="e2">bhadra</span>–gentle <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta-jane</span>–with devotees of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">prahlādādi</span>–like Prahlād. <span class="e2">kabe</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–When [will He] <span class="e2">prasanna</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–be pleased [and] <span class="e2">karibe</span>–make <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">mūḍha</span>–foolish, <span class="e2">akiñchane</span>–poor soul <span class="e2">nirbhaya</span>–fearless <span class="e2">sakṛpa-vachane</span>–with His compassionate words? [38]
Although He is terrifying to sinful souls, He is very gentle with devotees like Prahlād. When will He be pleased and make this poor, foolish soul fearless with His compassionate words?
“স্বচ্ছন্দে বৈস হে বৎস শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গধামে ।<br />যুগলভজন হউ, রতি হউ নামে ॥<br />মম ভক্তকৃপাবলে বিঘ্ন যাবে দূর ।<br />শুদ্ধ চিত্তে ভজ রাধাকৃষ্ণ রসপূর” ॥৩৯॥
“svachchhande vaisa he vatsa śrī-gaurāṅga-dhāme<br />yugala-bhajana ha-u, rati ha-u nāme<br />mama bhakta-kṛpā-bale vighna yābe dūra<br />śuddha chitte bhaja rādhā-kṛṣṇa rasa-pūra” [39]
<span class="e2">“he</span>–“O <span class="e2">vatsa</span>–child, <span class="e2">vaisa</span>–live <span class="e2">svachchhande</span>–freely <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-dhāme</span>–in the abode of Śrī Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–May you <span class="e2">yugala-bhajana</span>–serve the Divine Couple. <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–May you have <span class="e2">rati</span>–attachment <span class="e2">nāme</span>–to [Their] Names. <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">bhakta-kṛpā-bale</span>–By the grace of My devotees, <span class="e2">vighna</span>–obstacles <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will go <span class="e2">dūra</span>–away. <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">chitte</span>–With a pure heart, <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, [who are] <span class="e2">rasa-pūra”</span>–a reservoir of nectar.” [39]
“O child, live freely in the abode of Śrī Gaurāṅga. May you serve the Divine Couple and have attachment to Their Names. By the grace of My devotees, obstacles will leave you. With a pure heart, serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, who are a reservoir of nectar.”
এই বলি’ কবে মোর মস্তক-উপর ।<br />স্বীয় শ্রীচরণ হর্ষে ধরিবে ঈশ্বর ॥<br />অমনি যুগল-প্রেমে সাত্ত্বিক বিকারে ।<br />ধরায় লুটিব আমি শ্রীনৃসিংহদ্বারে ॥৪০॥
ei bali’ kabe mora mastaka-upara<br />svīya śrī-charaṇa harṣe dharibe īśvara<br />amani yugala-preme sāttvika vikāre<br />dharāya luṭiba āmi śrī-nṛsiṁha-dvāre [40]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">bali’</span>–say <span class="e2">ei</span>–this [and] <span class="e2">harṣe</span>–happily <span class="e2">dharibe</span>–place <span class="e2">svīya</span>–His <span class="e2">śrī-charaṇa</span>–holy feet <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">mastaka-upara</span>–on my head? <span class="e2">amani</span>–Immediately, <span class="e2">yugala-preme</span>–out of love for the Divine Couple, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">luṭiba</span>–will roll <span class="e2">dharāya</span>–on the earth <span class="e2">śrī-nṛsiṁha-dvāre</span>–at the door of Śrī Nṛsiṁha <span class="e2">sāttvika</span> <span class="e2">vikāre</span>–in divine ecstasy. [40]
When will the Lord say this and happily place His feet on my head? Immediately, out of love for the Divine Couple, I will roll on the earth at the door of Śrī Nṛsiṁha in divine ecstasy.
সে ক্ষেত্রের পশ্চিমেতে গণ্ডকের ধার ।<br />শ্রীঅলকানন্দা কাশীক্ষেত্র হয়ে পার ॥<br />দেখিব গোদ্রুমক্ষেত্র অতি নিরমল ।<br />ইন্দ্রসুরভির যথা ভজনের স্থল ॥৪১॥
se kṣetrera paśchimete gaṇḍakera dhāra<br />śrī-alakānandā kāśī-kṣetra haye pāra<br />dekhiba godruma-kṣetra ati niramala<br />indra-surabhira yathā bhajanera sthala [41]
<span class="e2">paśchimete</span>–West <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">kṣetrera</span>–of this place [is] <span class="e2">dhāra</span>–a stream <span class="e2">gaṇḍakera</span>–of the Gaṇḍaka. <span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–Past <span class="e2">śrī-alakānandā</span>–the Alakānandā [and] <span class="e2">kāśī-kṣetra</span>–Kāśī Kṣetra, <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–I will see [the] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">niramala</span>–pure <span class="e2">godruma-kṣetra</span>–Godrumadwīp, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where [there is] <span class="e2">sthala</span>–the place <span class="e2">indra-surabhira</span> <span class="e2">bhajanera</span>–of Indra and Surabhi’s worship. [41]
West of this place is the Gaṇḍaka. Past the Alakānandā and Kāśī Kṣetra, I will see the extremely pure Godrumadwīp, the place of Indra and Surabhi’s worship.
গোদ্রুম-সমান ক্ষেত্র নাহি ত্রিভুবনে ।<br />মার্কণ্ডেয় গৌরকৃপা পায় যেই বনে ॥<br />যেমন সংলগ্ন সরস্বতীনদীতটে ।<br />ঈশোদ্যান রাধাকুণ্ড জাহ্নবী-নিকটে ॥৪২॥
godruma-samāna kṣetra nāhi tribhuvane<br />mārkaṇḍeya gaura-kṛpā pāya yei vane<br />yemana saṁlagna sarasvatī-nadī-taṭe<br />īśodyāna rādhā-kuṇḍa jāhnavī-nikaṭe [42]
<span class="e2">tribhuvane</span>–Throughout the three worlds, <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">kṣetra</span>–place <span class="e2">godruma-samāna</span>–like Godruma, <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in the forest of which <span class="e2">mārkaṇḍeya</span>–Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attained <span class="e2">gaura-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of Gaura. [Godruma] <span class="e2">saṁlagna</span>–lies beside <span class="e2">sarasvatī-nadī-taṭe</span>–the bank of the Saraswatī River <span class="e2">yemana</span>–as <span class="e2">īśodyāna</span>–the Lord’s garden [and] <span class="e2">rādhā-kuṇḍa</span>–Rādhā Kuṇḍa [lie beside] <span class="e2">jāhnavī-nikaṭe</span>–the Gaṅgā. [42]
Throughout the three worlds, there is no place like Godruma, where Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi attained the mercy of Gaura. Godruma lies beside the Saraswatī as Īśodyān and Rādhā Kuṇḍa lie beside the Gaṅgā.
ভজ রে ভজ রে মন গোদ্রুম-কানন ।<br />অচিরে হেরিবে চক্ষে গৌরলীলাধন ॥<br />সে লীলা-দর্শনে তুমি যুগলবিলাস ।<br />অনায়াসে লভিবে পূরিবে তব আশ ॥৪৩॥
bhaja re bhaja re mana godruma-kānana<br />achire heribe chakṣe gaura-līlā-dhana<br />se līlā-darśane tumi yugala-vilāsa<br />anāyāse labhibe pūribe tava āśa [43]
<span class="e2">mana</span>–O mind! <span class="e2">bhaja re</span>–Worship! <span class="e2">bhaja re</span>–Worship <span class="e2">godruma-kānana</span>–the forest of Godruma! <span class="e2">achire</span>–Soon [your] <span class="e2">chakṣe</span>–eyes <span class="e2">heribe</span>–will behold <span class="e2">gaura-līlā-dhana</span>–the wealth of Gaura’s Pastimes. <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">līlā-darśane</span>–By seeing those Pastimes, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">anāyāse</span> <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–will easily attain <span class="e2">yugala-vilāsa</span>–the Pastimes of the Divine Couple, [and] <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">āśa</span>–desires <span class="e2">pūribe</span>–will be fulfilled. [43]
O mind! Worship, just worship, the forest of Godruma! Soon your eyes will behold the wealth of Gaura’s Pastimes. By seeing those Pastimes, you will easily attain the Pastimes of the Divine Couple, and your desires will be fulfilled.
গোদ্রুম শ্রীনন্দীশ্বর-ধাম গোপাবাস ।<br />যথা শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ করে বিবিধ বিলাস ॥<br />পূর্ব্বাহ্নে গোপের ঘরে গব্যদ্রব্য খাই’ ।<br />গোপসনে গোচারণ করেন নিমাই ॥৪৪॥
godruma śrī-nandīśvara-dhāma gopāvāsa<br />yathā śrī-gaurāṅga kare vividha vilāsa<br />pūrvāhne gopera ghare gavya-dravya khāi’<br />gopa-sane go-chāraṇa karena nimāi [44]
<span class="e2">godruma</span>–Godruma [is] <span class="e2">śrī-nandīśvara-dhāma</span>–Śrī Nandīśvar Dhām, <span class="e2">gopāvāsa</span>–the residence of the cowherd boys, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs <span class="e2">vividha</span>–various <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–Pastimes. <span class="e2">pūrvāhne</span>–In the morning, <span class="e2">nimāi</span>–Nimāi <span class="e2">khāi’</span>–eats <span class="e2">gavya-dravya</span>–milk products <span class="e2">gopera</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–in the cowherd boys’ houses [and] <span class="e2">go-chāraṇa</span> <span class="e2">karena</span>–herds cows <span class="e2">gopa-sane</span>–with the cowherd boys. [44]
Godruma is Śrī Nandīśvar Dhām, the residence of the cowherd boys where Śrī Gaurāṅga performs various Pastimes. In the morning, the Lord eats milk products in the cowherd boys’ houses and herds cows with the cowherd boys.
গোপগণ বলে, “ভাই তুমি ত গোপাল ।<br />দ্বিজরূপ কভু তব নাহি সাজে ভাল ॥<br />এস কাঁধে করি’ তোরে গোচারণ করি’ ।<br />মায়ের নিকটে লই যথা মায়াপুরী ॥৪৫॥
gopa-gaṇa bale, “bhāi tumi ta gopāla<br />dvija-rūpa kabhu tava nāhi sāje bhāla<br />esa kā̐dhe kari’ tore gochāraṇa kari’<br />māyera nikaṭe la-i yathā māyāpurī” [45]
<span class="e2">gopa-gaṇa</span>–The cowherd boys <span class="e2">bale</span>–say, “<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–“O Brother! <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">ta</span>–certainly [are] <span class="e2">gopāla</span>–Gopāl. <span class="e2">dvija-rūpa</span>–The form of a brāhmaṇ [is] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–never [a] <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–good <span class="e2">sāje</span>–outfit <span class="e2">tava</span>–for You. <span class="e2">esa</span>–Come! [We will]<span class="e2"> kari’</span>–carry <span class="e2">tore</span>–You <span class="e2">kā̐dhe</span>–on our shoulders, <span class="e2">gochāraṇa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–herd the cows, [and] <span class="e2">la-i</span>–bring [You] <span class="e2">māyera</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–to [Your] mother <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">māyāpurī”</span>–in Māyāpur.” [45]
The cowherd boys say, “O Brother! You are Gopāl. Your brāhmaṇ form does not suit You well. Come! We will carry You on our shoulders, herd the cows, and bring You to Your mother in Māyāpur.”
কোন গোপ স্নেহ করি’ দেয় ছানাক্ষীর ।<br />কোন গোপ রূপ দেখি’ হয় ত অস্থির ।<br />কোন গোপ নানা ফল-ফুল দিয়া করে ॥<br />বলে, “ভাই নিতি নিতি আইস মোর ঘরে ॥৪৬॥
kona gopa sneha kari’ deya chhānā-kṣīra<br />kona gopa rūpa dekhi’ haya ta asthira<br />kona gopa nānā phala-phula diyā kare<br />bale, “bhāi niti niti āisa mora ghare [46]
<span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">gopa</span>–A cowherd boy [would] <span class="e2">sneha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–affectionately <span class="e2">deya</span>–give [the Lord] <span class="e2">chhānā-kṣīra</span>–curd and condensed milk. <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">gopa</span>–A cowherd boy [would] <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">ta</span>–completely <span class="e2">asthira</span>–overwhelmed <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–seeing [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form. <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">gopa</span>–A cowherd boy [would] <span class="e2">diyā</span>–place <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various <span class="e2">phala-phula</span>–fruits and flowers <span class="e2">kare</span>–in the hand [of the Lord and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–say, <span class="e2">“bhāi</span>–“O Brother! <span class="e2">āisa</span>–Come <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–to my house <span class="e2">niti</span> <span class="e2">niti</span>–every day. [46]
One cowherd boy would affectionately give the Lord curd and condensed milk. Another would become overwhelmed upon seeing His form, and another would place various fruits and flowers in the hands of the Lord and say, “O Brother! Come to my house every day.
“বিপ্রের ঠাকুর তুমি গোপের কারণ ।<br />তোমা ছাড়ি’ যেতে নারি তুমি ধ্যান-জ্ঞান ॥<br />ঐ দেখ গাভি সব তোমারে দেখিয়া ।<br />হাম্বারবে ডাকে ঘাস বৎস তেয়াগিয়া ॥৪৭॥
“viprera ṭhākura tumi gopera kāraṇa<br />tomā chhāḍi’ yete nāri tumi dhyāna-jñāna<br />ai dekha gābhi saba tomāre dekhiyā<br />hāmbā-rave ḍāke ghāsa vatsa teyāgiyā [47]
<span class="e2">“tumi</span>–“You [are] <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">viprera</span>–of the brāhmaṇs, [but You are] <span class="e2">kāraṇa</span>–the life <span class="e2">gopera</span>–of the cowherd boys. <span class="e2">nāri</span>–We cannot <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">yete</span>–leave <span class="e2">tomā</span>–You. <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are our] <span class="e2">dhyāna-jñāna</span>–meditation and knowledge. <span class="e2">ai</span> <span class="e2">dekha</span>–Look there! <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–You, <span class="e2">saba</span>–all <span class="e2">gābhi</span>–the cows <span class="e2">hāmbā-rave</span> <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–moo [and] <span class="e2">teyāgiyā</span>–leave [their] <span class="e2">ghāsa</span>–grass [and] <span class="e2">vatsa</span>–children. [47]
“You are the Lord of the brāhmaṇs, but You are the life of the cowherd boys. We cannot leave you. You are our meditation and knowledge. Look there! Seeing You, all the cows moo and leave aside their grass and calves.
“আজ বেলা হইল চল জগন্নাথালয় ।<br />কাল যেন এই স্থানে পুনঃ দেখা হয় ॥<br />রাখিব তোমার লাগি’ দধিছানাক্ষীর ।<br />বেলা হইলে জেন আমি হইব অস্থির” ॥৪৮॥
“āja belā ha-ila chala jagannāthālaya<br />kāla yena ei sthāne punaḥ dekhā haya<br />rākhiba tomāra lāgi’ dadhi-chhānā-kṣīra<br />belā ha-ile jena āmi ha-iba asthira” [48]
<span class="e2">“belā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–“It is now late <span class="e2">āja</span>–today. <span class="e2">chala</span>–Go <span class="e2">jagannāthālaya</span>–to the house of Jagannāth. <span class="e2">yena</span> <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–We will meet <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again <span class="e2">kāla</span>–tomorrow. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">rākhiba</span>–will keep <span class="e2">dadhi-chhānā-kṣīra</span>–some yoghurt, curd, and condensed milk <span class="e2">lāgi’</span>–for <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–You, [but] <span class="e2">jena</span>–know [that] <span class="e2">ha-iba</span>–I will be <span class="e2">asthira</span>–upset <span class="e2">belā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–if You are late. [48]
“It is now late today. Go back to the house of Jagannāth Miśra. We will meet here again tomorrow. I will keep some yoghurt, curd, and condensed milk for You, but know that I will be upset if You are late.”
এই রূপে নিতি নিতি শ্রীগোদ্রুম-বনে ।<br />শ্রীগৌর-নিতাই খেলা করে গোপসনে ॥<br />বেলা না হইতে পুনঃ করি’ গঙ্গাস্নান ।<br />শ্রীশচীসদনে যান গৌর ভগবান্ ॥৪৯॥
ei rūpe niti niti śrī-godruma-vane<br />śrī-gaura-nitāi khelā kare gopa-sane<br />belā nā ha-ite punaḥ kari’ gaṅgā-snāna<br />śrī-śachī-sadane yāna gaura bhagavān [49]
<span class="e2">śrī-gaura-nitāi</span>–Gaura and Nitāi <span class="e2">khelā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–play <span class="e2">gopa-sane</span>–with the cowherd boys <span class="e2">śrī-godruma-vane</span>–in the forest of Godruma <span class="e2">niti</span> <span class="e2">niti</span>–every day <span class="e2">ei rūpe</span>–in this way. <span class="e2">belā</span> <span class="e2">nā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–When there is time, <span class="e2">gaura</span> <span class="e2">bhagavān</span>–Lord Gaura <span class="e2">gaṅgā-snāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–bathes in the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again [and then] <span class="e2">yāna</span>–goes <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-sadane</span>–to the home of Śachī. [49]
Gaura and Nitāi play with the cowherd boys in the forest of Godruma every day in this way. When there is time, Lord Gaura bathes in the Gaṅgā again and then goes to the home of Śachī.
হেন দিন আমার কি হইবে উদয় ।<br />হেরিব গোদ্রুম-লীলা শুদ্ধ-প্রেমময় ॥<br />গোপসঙ্গে গোপভাবে প্রভু-সেবা-আশে ।<br />একমনে বসিব সে গোদ্রুম-আবাসে ॥৫০॥
hena dina āmāra ki ha-ibe udaya<br />heriba godruma-līlā śuddha-premamaya<br />gopa-saṅge gopa-bhāve prabhu-sevā-āśe<br />ekamane vasiba se godruma-āvāse [50]
<span class="e2">ki</span>–Will <span class="e2">hena</span>–that <span class="e2">dina</span>–day <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–be mine [when] <span class="e2">heriba</span>–I will see <span class="e2">līlā</span>–the Pastimes <span class="e2">śuddha-premamaya</span>–of pure divine love [in] <span class="e2">godruma</span>–in Godruma? [When] <span class="e2">vasiba</span>–will I reside <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">godruma-āvāse</span>–in the abode of Godruma <span class="e2">gopa-saṅge</span>–with the cowherd boys <span class="e2">prabhu-sevā-āśe</span> <span class="e2">ekamane</span>–with single-minded desire to serve the Lord <span class="e2">gopa-bhāve</span>–in the mood of a cowherd boy? [50]
Will that day be mine when I will see the Pastimes of pure divine love in Godruma? When will I reside in that abode of Godruma with the cowherd boys with single-minded desire to serve the Lord in the mood of a cowherd boy?
গোদ্রুম-দক্ষিণে মধ্যদ্বীপ মনোহর ।<br />বনরাজি শোভে যথা দেখিতে সুন্দর ॥<br />যথায় মধ্যাহ্নে প্রভু লয়ে ভক্তগণ ।<br />সপ্তঋষি কাছে আসি’ দিল দরশন ॥৫১॥
godruma-dakṣiṇe madhyadvīpa manohara<br />vana-rāji śobhe yathā dekhite sundara<br />yathāya madhyāhne prabhu laye bhakta-gaṇa<br />sapta-ṛṣi kāchhe āsi’ dila daraśana [51]
<span class="e2">godruma-dakṣiṇe</span>–South of Godruma [is] <span class="e2">manohara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">madhyadvīpa</span>–Madhyadwīp, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">vana-rāji</span>–rows of forests <span class="e2">śobhe</span>–shine [and are] <span class="e2">sundara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to see. <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–There, <span class="e2">madhyāhne</span>–at midday, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord [once] <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">kāchhe</span>–before <span class="e2">sapta-ṛṣi</span>–the seven sages <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–devotees [and] <span class="e2">daraśana</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [Himself]. [51]
South of Godruma is beautiful Madhyadwīp, where rows of forests shine and are beautiful to see. There, at midday, the Lord once came before the seven sages with His devotees and revealed Himself.
যথায় গোমতী-তীরে নৈমিষ-কাননে ।<br />গৌরভাগবতকথা শুনে ঋষিগণে ॥<br />শুনিতে সে গৌরকথা দেব-পঞ্চানন ।<br />সহসা আইলা হয়ে শ্রীহংস-বাহন ॥৫২॥
yathāya gomatī-tīre naimiṣa-kānane<br />gaura-bhāgavata-kathā śune ṛṣi-gaṇe<br />śunite se gaura-kathā deva-pañchānana<br />sahasā āilā haye śrī-haṁsa-vāhana [52]
<span class="e2">yathāya</span>–There, <span class="e2">gomatī-tīre</span>–on the bank of the Gomatī River <span class="e2">naimiṣa-kānane</span>–in the Naimiṣa forest, <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇe</span>–the sages <span class="e2">śune</span>–listen <span class="e2">gaura-bhāgavata-kathā</span>–to descriptions of Lord Gaura. <span class="e2">deva-pañchānana</span>–Lord Śiva [once] <span class="e2">sahasā</span>–swiftly <span class="e2">āilā</span>–came <span class="e2">śunite</span>–to hear <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">gaura-kathā</span>–these descriptions of Gaura <span class="e2">śrī-haṁsa-vāhana haye</span>–riding Brahmā’s swan. [52]
There, on the bank of the Gomatī in the Naimiṣa forest, the sages listen to descriptions of Lord Gaura. Lord Śiva once swiftly came to hear these descriptions riding Brahmā’s swan.
কবে আমি ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে সেই বন ।<br />হেরিব পুরাণ-সভা অপূর্ব্বদর্শন ॥<br />শুনিব চৈতন্য-কথা শ্রীহরিবাসরে ।<br />সুপুণ্য কার্ত্তিকমাসে গোমতীর ধারে ॥৫৩॥
kabe āmi bhramite bhramite sei vana<br />heriba purāṇa-sabhā apūrva-darśana<br />śuniba chaitanya-kathā śrī-hari-vāsare<br />supuṇya kārtika-māse gomatīra dhāre [53]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bhramite bhramite</span>–roam [throughout] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vana</span>–this forest [and] <span class="e2">heriba</span>–see <span class="e2">apūrva-darśana</span>–the wonderful site <span class="e2">purāṇa-sabhā</span>–of that recital of the Purāṇas? [When] <span class="e2">śuniba</span>–will I hear <span class="e2">chaitanya-kathā</span>–discussion of Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">śrī-hari-vāsare</span>–on the Lord’s day (Ekādaśī) <span class="e2">supuṇya</span> <span class="e2">kārtika-māse</span>–during the holy month of Kārtik <span class="e2">dhāre</span>–on the bank <span class="e2">gomatīra</span>–of the Gomatī? [53]
When will I roam throughout this forest and see the wonderful site of that recital of the <span class="e3">Gaura-purāṇa</span>? When will I hear discussion of Śrī Chaitanya on Ekādaśī during the holy month of Kārtik beside the Gomatī?
শৌনকাদি শ্রোতা ঋষিগণ কৃপা করি’ ।<br />পদধূলি দিয়া মাথে হস্তদ্বয় ধরি’ ॥<br />বলিবে, “হে নবদ্বীপবাসি! একমনে ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-কথামৃত পিয় এই বনে” ॥৫৪॥
śaunakādi śrotā ṛṣi-gaṇa kṛpā kari’<br />pada-dhūli diyā māthe hasta-dvaya dhari’<br />balibe, “he navadvīpa-vāsi! ekamane<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-kathāmṛta piya ei vane” [54]
[When will] <span class="e2">śaunakādi</span>–Śaunaka and <span class="e2">śrotā</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–the audience of sages <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">diyā</span>–place <span class="e2">pada-dhūli</span>–the dust of their feet <span class="e2">māthe</span>–on my head, <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–hold <span class="e2">hasta-dvaya</span>–my hands, [and] <span class="e2">balibe</span>–say, <span class="e2">“he</span>–“O <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsi!</span>–resident of Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">ekamane</span>–Single-mindedly <span class="e2">piya</span>–drink <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-kathāmṛta</span>–the nectar of discussion of Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">vane”</span>–in this forest!” [54]
When will Śaunaka and the audience of sages mercifully place the dust of their feet on my head, hold my hands, and say, “O resident of Nabadwīp! Single-mindedly drink the nectar of discussion of Śrī Gaurāṅga in this forest!”
তাহার দক্ষিণে শোভে ব্রাহ্মণ-পুষ্কর ।<br />শ্রীপুষ্করতীর্থ যথা দেখি’ দ্বিজবর ॥<br />ভজিয়ে গৌরাঙ্গপদ বিপ্র দিবদাস ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গরূপ হেরি’ পাইল আশ্বাস ॥৫৫॥
tāhāra dakṣiṇe śobhe brāhmaṇa-puṣkara<br />śrī-puṣkara-tīrtha yathā dekhi’ dvija-vara<br />bhajiye gaurāṅga-pada vipra diva-dāsa<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-rūpa heri’ pāila āśvāsa [55]
<span class="e2">dakṣiṇe</span>–South <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–of there <span class="e2">śobhe</span>–shines <span class="e2">brāhmaṇa-puṣkara</span>–Brāhmaṇ Puṣkara, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">dvija-vara</span>–the best of brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–saw <span class="e2">śrī-puṣkara-tīrtha</span>–Śrī Puṣkara Tīrtha. <span class="e2">bhajiye</span>–Worshipping <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-pada</span>–the feet of Gaurāṅga here, <span class="e2">vipra</span>–the brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">diva-dāsa</span>–Diva Dās <span class="e2">heri’</span>–beheld <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-rūpa</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga’s form [and] <span class="e2">pāila</span>–found <span class="e2">āśvāsa</span>–solace. [55]
South of there shines Brāhmaṇ Puṣkara, where the best of brāhmaṇs saw Śrī Puṣkara Tīrtha. Worshipping the feet of Gaurāṅga here, the brāhmaṇ Diva Dās beheld the Lord’s form and found solace.
তাহার দক্ষিণে ক্ষেত্র উচ্চহট্ট নাম ।<br />ব্রহ্মাবর্ত্ত কুরুক্ষেত্র ত্রিপিষ্টপ-ধাম ॥<br />যথা দেবগণ করে গৌর-সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />কভু ধামবাসী তাহা করেন শ্রবণ ॥৫৬॥
tāhāra dakṣiṇe kṣetra uchcha-haṭṭa nāma<br />brahmāvarta kurukṣetra tripiṣṭapa-dhāma<br />yathā deva-gaṇa kare gaura-saṅkīrtana<br />kabhu dhāma-vāsī tāhā karena śravaṇa [56]
<span class="e2">dakṣiṇe</span>–South <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–of there [is] <span class="e2">kṣetra</span>–a place <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">uchcha-haṭṭa</span>–Uchcha Haṭṭa, [which is] <span class="e2">tripiṣṭapa-dhāma</span>–an abode of the gods [and nondifferent from]<span class="e2"> kurukṣetra</span>–Kurukṣetra <span class="e2">brahmāvarta</span>–of Brahmāvarta. <span class="e2">yathā</span>–There, <span class="e2">deva-gaṇa</span>–the gods <span class="e2">gaura-saṅkīrtana kare</span>–chant about Gaura, [and] <span class="e2">dhāma-vāsī</span>–the residents of the Dhām <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">śravaṇa karena</span>–hear <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that. [56]
South of there is an abode of the gods known as Uchcha Haṭṭa, which is nondifferent from Kurukṣetra of Brahmāvarta. There, the gods chant the glories of Gaura and are sometimes heard by the residents of the Dhām.
শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ গণ-সহ মধ্যাহ্ন-সময়ে ।<br />ভ্রমণে এ সব বনে প্রেমমত্ত হয়ে ॥<br />ভক্তগণে কৃষ্ণলীলা সঙ্কেত বলিয়া ।<br />নাচেন কীর্ত্তনে রাধা-ভাব আস্বাদিয়া ॥৫৭॥
śrī-gaurāṅga gaṇa-saha madhyāhna-samaye<br />bhrameṇa e saba vane prema-matta haye<br />bhakta-gaṇe kṛṣṇa-līlā saṅketa baliyā<br />nāchena kīrtane rādhā-bhāva āsvādiyā [57]
<span class="e2">madhyāhna-samaye</span>–At midday, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">bhrameṇa</span>–roams <span class="e2">e saba</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in all the forests <span class="e2">gaṇa-saha</span>–with [His] associates, <span class="e2">prema-matta haye</span>–mad with divine love. <span class="e2">saṅketa</span> <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Hinting <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā</span>–at the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">nāchena</span>–He dances <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇe</span>–with the devotees <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–during kīrtan [and] <span class="e2">āsvādiyā</span>–relishes <span class="e2">rādhā-bhāva</span>–the ecstasy of Rādhā. [57]
At midday, Śrī Gaurāṅga roams in all these forests with His associates, mad with divine love. Hinting at the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa, He dances with the devotees during kīrtan and relishes the ecstasy of Rādhā.
আমি কবে একাকী বা ভক্তজন-সঙ্গে ।<br />ভাসিব চৈতন্য-প্রেম-সমুদ্র-তরঙ্গে ॥<br />মধ্যাহ্নে ভ্রমিব মধ্যদ্বীপ-বনচয়ে ।<br />প্রভুভাব বিভাবিয়া অকিঞ্চন হয়ে ॥৫৮॥
āmi kabe ekākī vā bhakta-jana-saṅge<br />bhāsiba chaitanya-prema-samudra-taraṅge<br />madhyāhne bhramiba madhyadvīpa-vana-chaye<br />prabhu-bhāva vibhāviyā akiñchana haye [58]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I, <span class="e2">ekākī</span>–alone <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">bhakta-jana-saṅge</span>–in the company of devotees, <span class="e2">bhāsiba</span>–float <span class="e2">taraṅge</span>–in the waves <span class="e2">samudra</span>–of the ocean <span class="e2">chaitanya-prema</span>–of divine love for Śrī Chaitanya? [When will I,] <span class="e2">akiñchana</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–as a surrendered soul, <span class="e2">bhramiba</span>–roam <span class="e2">madhyāhne</span>–at midday <span class="e2">madhyadvīpa-vana-chaye</span>–throughout the forests of Madhyadwīp <span class="e2">vibhāviyā</span>–feeling <span class="e2">prabhu-bhāva</span>–the Lord’s ecstasy? [58]
When will I, alone or in the company of devotees, float in the waves of the ocean of divine love for Śrī Chaitanya? When will I, as a surrendered soul, roam at midday throughout the forests of Madhyadwīp feeling the Lord’s ecstasy?
মধ্যদ্বীপবাসী ভক্তগণ কৃপা করি’ ।<br />দেখাইবে, “ঐ দেখ গৌরাঙ্গশ্রীহরি ॥<br />ব্রহ্মকুণ্ডতীরে ব্রহ্মনগর-ভিতরে ।<br />কীর্ত্তন ঘটায় নাচে লয়ে পরিকরে” ॥৫৯॥
madhyadvīpa-vāsī bhakta-gaṇa kṛpā kari’<br />dekhāibe, “ai dekha gaurāṅga-śrī-hari<br />brahma-kuṇḍa-tīre brahma-nagara-bhitare<br />kīrtana ghaṭāya nāche laye parikare” [59]
[When will] <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">madhyadvīpa-vāsī</span>–residing in Madhyadwīp <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">dekhāibe</span>–show [me], “<span class="e2">ai</span> <span class="e2">dekha</span>–“Look there! <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-śrī-hari</span>–Lord Śrī Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">nāche</span>–is dancing <span class="e2">laye</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">parikare</span>–associates <span class="e2">kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">ghaṭāya</span>–in a grand kīrtan <span class="e2">brahma-kuṇḍa-tīre</span>–on the bank of Brahma Kuṇḍa <span class="e2">brahma-nagara-bhitare”</span>–in Brahma Nagar.” [59]
When will the devotees residing in Madhyadwīp mercifully show me, “Look there! Lord Śrī Gaurāṅga is dancing with His associates in a grand kīrtan on the bank of Brahma Kuṇḍa in Brahma Nagar.”
কবে বা দেখিব সেই পুরটসুন্দর ।<br />অপূর্ব্বমুরতি গোরা বনমালাধর ॥<br />দীর্ঘবাহু হয়ে উচ্চৈঃস্বরে ডাকি’ বলে ।<br />“হরিনাম বল ভাই একত্রে সকলে” ॥৬০॥
kabe vā dekhiba sei puraṭa-sundara<br />apūrva-murati gorā vana-mālā-dhara<br />dīrgha-bāhu haye uchchaiḥ-svare ḍāki’ bale<br />“hari-nāma bala bhāi ekatre sakale” [60]
<span class="e2">kabe</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–When <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–will I see <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">puraṭa-sundara</span> <span class="e2">apūrva-murati</span>–astonishingly beautiful, golden form <span class="e2">gorā</span>–of Gorā <span class="e2">vana-mālā-dhara</span>–wearing a forest garland [between His] <span class="e2">dīrgha-bāhu</span>–long arms [and] <span class="e2">uchchaiḥ-svare haye</span>–loudly <span class="e2">ḍāki’</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–calling, <span class="e2">“bhāi</span>–“O brothers! <span class="e2">bala</span>–Chant <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">ekatre</span> <span class="e2">sakale”</span>–in unison!” [60]
When will I see that astonishingly beautiful, golden form of Gorā wearing a forest garland between His long arms and loudly calling out, “O brothers! Chant the Name of the Lord in unison!”
অমনি শ্রীবাস-আদি যত ভক্তজন ।<br />“হরি হরি” বলিয়া করিবে সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥<br />কেহ বা বলিবে, “‘গৌরহরি’ বল ভাই ।<br />গৌর বিনা রাধাকৃষ্ণ-সেবা নাহি পাই” ॥৬১॥
amani śrīvāsa-ādi yata bhakta-jana<br />“hari hari” baliyā karibe saṅkīrtana<br />keha vā balibe, “‘gaurahari’ bala bhāi<br />gaura vinā rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā nāhi pāi” [61]
<span class="e2">amani</span>–At that moment, <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–and all the other devotees <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will perform <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–saṅkīrtan, <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–chanting, “<span class="e2">hari</span>–“O Lord! <span class="e2">hari”</span>–O Lord!” <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–Someone <span class="e2">balibe</span>–will say, <span class="e2">“bhāi</span>–“Brothers! <span class="e2">bala</span>–Chant <span class="e2">‘gaurahari’</span>–‘Gaurahari!’ <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura, <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">pāi</span>–we cannot attain <span class="e2">sevā</span>–the service <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa”</span>–of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa!”[61]
At that moment, Śrīvās and all the other devotees will perform kīrtan, chanting, “Hari! Hari!” Someone will say, “Brothers! Chant ‘Gaurahari!’ Without Gaura, we cannot attain the service of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa!”
উচ্চহট্ট সন্নিকটে পঞ্চবেণী নাম ।<br />দেবতীর্থ যথা দেবগণের বিশ্রাম ॥<br />জাহ্নবী ত্রিধারা সরস্বতী শ্রীযমুনা ।<br />মিলিয়াছে গৌরসেবা করিয়া কামনা ॥৬২॥
uchcha-haṭṭa sannikaṭe pañchaveṇī nāma<br />deva-tīrtha yathā deva-gaṇera viśrāma<br />jāhnavī tridhārā sarasvatī śrī-yamunā<br />miliyāchhe gaura-sevā kariyā kāmanā [62]
<span class="e2">sannikaṭe</span>–Near <span class="e2">uchcha-haṭṭa</span>–Uchcha Haṭta [is] <span class="e2">deva-tīrtha</span>–an abode of the gods <span class="e2">nāma</span>–known as <span class="e2">pañchaveṇī</span>–Pañchaveṇī, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">deva-gaṇera</span> <span class="e2">viśrāma</span>–the gods rest [and] <span class="e2">tridhārā</span>–the three rivers— <span class="e2">jāhnavī</span>–the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">sarasvatī</span>–Saraswatī, <span class="e2">śrī-yamunā</span>–and Yamunā—(as the Bhāgīrathī, Bhogavatī, and Alakānandā), <span class="e2">miliyāchhe</span>–have met, <span class="e2">kāmanā kariyā</span>–desiring <span class="e2">gaura-sevā</span>–Gaura’s service. [62]
Near Uchcha Haṭṭa is an abode of the gods named Pañchaveṇī, where the gods rest and the three rivers—the Gaṅgā, Saraswatī, and Yamunā—meet, desiring to serve Gaura.
গণ-সহ গৌরহরি যথা করি’ স্নান ।<br />কলিপাপ হইতে তীর্থে কৈল পরিত্রান ॥<br />পঞ্চবেণী হেন তীর্থ এ চৌদ্দভুবনে ।<br />নাহি দেখে বেদব্যাস আর ঋষিগণে ॥৬৩॥
gaṇa-saha gaurahari yathā kari’ snāna<br />kali-pāpa ha-ite tīrthe kaila paritrāna<br />pañchaveṇī hena tīrtha e chaudda-bhuvane<br />nāhi dekhe vedavyāsa āra ṛṣi-gaṇe [63]
<span class="e2">snāna kari’</span>–Bathing <span class="e2">yathā</span>–here, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">gaṇa-saha</span>–and [His] associates <span class="e2">paritrāna kaila</span>–purified <span class="e2">tīrthe</span>–this place <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–of <span class="e2">kali-pāpa</span>–the sins of Kali-yuga. <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–Neither <span class="e2">vedavyāsa</span>–Vedavyās <span class="e2">āra</span>–nor <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇe</span>–the [other] sages <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–have ever seen <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–a holy place <span class="e2">hena</span>–like <span class="e2">pañchaveṇī</span>–Pañchaveṇī <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">chaudda-bhuvane</span>–within the fourteen worlds. [63]
Bathing here, Gaurahari and His associates purified this place of the sins of Kali-yuga. Neither Vedavyās nor the other sages have ever seen any holy place like Pañchaveṇī within the fourteen worlds.
কবে পঞ্চবেণী-জলে করিয়া স্নপন ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গপাদপদ্ম করিব স্মরণ ॥<br />গৌরপদপূত বারি অঞ্জলি ভরিয়া ।<br />পিয়া ধন্য হব গৌরপ্রসঙ্গে মাতিয়া ॥৬৪॥
kabe pañchaveṇī-jale kariyā snapana<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-pāda-padma kariba smaraṇa<br />gaura-pada-pūta vāri añjali bhariyā<br />piyā dhanya haba gaura-prasaṅge mātiyā [64]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When <span class="e2">snapana kariyā</span>–will I bathe <span class="e2">pañchaveṇī-jale</span>–in the water at Pañchaveṇī [and] <span class="e2">smaraṇa kariba</span>–remember <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-pāda-padma</span>–the lotus feet of Śrī Gaurāṅga? [When] <span class="e2">bhariyā</span>–will I fill [my] <span class="e2">añjali</span>–cupped palms <span class="e2">pūta</span> <span class="e2">vāri</span>–with holy water <span class="e2">gaura-pada</span>–from Gaura’s feet, <span class="e2">piyā</span>–drink [it,] <span class="e2">mātiyā</span>–become mad <span class="e2">gaura-prasaṅge</span>–for Gaura, [and thus] <span class="e2">haba</span>–become <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate? [64]
When will I bathe in the water at Pañchaveṇī and remember the lotus feet of Śrī Gaurāṅga? When will I fill my cupped palms with holy water from His feet, drink it, become mad for Him, and thus become fortunate?
পঞ্চবেণী-পারে কোলদ্বীপ মহোহর ।<br />কোলরূপে প্রভু যথা ভক্তের গোচর ॥<br />শ্রীবরাহক্ষেত্র বলি’ সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কয় ।<br />দেবের দুর্ল্লভ স্নান চিদানন্দময় ॥৬৫॥
pañchaveṇī-pāre koladvīpa manohara<br />kola-rūpe prabhu yathā bhaktera gochara<br />śrī-varāha-kṣetra bali’ sarva-śāstre kaya<br />devera durlabha sthāna chid-ānandamaya [65]
<span class="e2">pañchaveṇī-pāre</span>–Past Pañchaveṇī [is] <span class="e2">manohara</span>–beautiful <span class="e2">koladvīpa</span>–Koladwīp, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">gochara</span>–appeared <span class="e2">bhaktera</span>–to [His] devotee <span class="e2">kola-rūpe</span>–as a boar. <span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [this] <span class="e2">chid-ānandamaya</span>–joyful, spiritual <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–abode, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–known as <span class="e2">śrī-varāha-kṣetra</span>–Śrī Varāha Kṣetra, <span class="e2">devera</span> <span class="e2">durlabha</span>–is difficult for even the gods to reach. [65]
Past Pañchaveṇī is beautiful Koladwīp, where the Lord appeared to His devotee as a boar. All the scriptures say this joyful, spiritual abode, known as Śrī Varāha Kṣetra, is difficult for even the gods to reach.
