কুলিয়াপাহাড় নামে প্রসিদ্ধ জগতে ।<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গলীলাস্থান শ্রেষ্ঠ সর্ব্বমতে ॥<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য যথা সন্ন্যাসের পর ।<br />ব্রজযাত্রা-ছলে দেখে নদীয়া-নগর ॥৬৬॥
kuliyāpāhāḍa nāme prasiddha jagate<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā-sthāna śreṣṭha sarva-mate<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya yathā sannyāsera para<br />vraja-yātrā-chhale dekhe nadīyā-nagara [66]
[It] <span class="e2">prasiddha</span>–is known <span class="e2">jagate</span>–throughout the world <span class="e2">nāme</span>–by the name <span class="e2">kuliyāpāhāḍa</span>–Kuliyāpāhāḍ. <span class="e2">sarva-mate</span>–In all respects, [it is] <span class="e2">śreṣṭha śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā-sthāna</span>–the supreme place in the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">para</span>–After [His] <span class="e2">sannyāsera</span>–sannyās, <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–visited <span class="e2">nadīyā-nagara</span>–the town of Nadia <span class="e2">yathā</span>–here <span class="e2">vraja-yātrā-chhale</span>–on the pretext of travelling to Vraja. [66]
It is known throughout the world as Kuliyāpāhāḍ. In all respects, it is the supreme place in the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga. After taking sannyās, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya visited the town of Nadia here on the pretext of travelling to Vraja.
বিদ্যাবাচস্পতি-বিদ্যালয় যেই স্থানে ।<br />বিশারদপুত্র তেঁহ কেবা নাহি জানে ॥<br />প্রভুর একান্ত ভৃত্য শুদ্ধভক্তিবলে ।<br />আকর্ষিল নিজ প্রভু গঙ্গাস্নানছলে ॥৬৭॥
vidyā-vāchaspati-vidyālaya yei sthāne<br />viśārada-putra te̐ha kebā nāhi jāne<br />prabhura ekānta bhṛtya śuddha-bhakti-bale<br />ākarṣila nija prabhu gaṅgā-snāna-chhale [67]
<span class="e2">vidyā-vāchaspati-vidyālaya</span>–The school of Vidyā Vāchaspati [is located] <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–at this place. <span class="e2">kebā</span>–Who <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–does not <span class="e2">jāne</span>–know <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–him, <span class="e2">viśārada-putra</span>–the son of Viśārada? [He is] <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">ekānta</span>–earnest <span class="e2">bhṛtya</span>–servant, [and] <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti-bale</span>–with [his] pure devotion, [he] <span class="e2">ākarṣila</span>–attracted <span class="e2">nija</span>–his <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord [here,] [who came] <span class="e2">gaṅgā-snāna-chhale</span>–on the pretext of bathing in the Gaṅgā. [67]
The school of Vidyā Vāchaspati is located at this place. Who does not know Vidyā Vāchaspati, the son of Viśārada? He is the Lord’s earnest servant, and with his pure devotion, he attracted the Lord here, who came on the pretext of bathing in the Gaṅgā.
কবে আমি গঙ্গাতীরে দাঁড়াইয়া রব ।<br />বিদ্যাবাচস্পতি-দ্বারে দেখিয়া বৈভব ॥<br />কতক্ষণে কৃপা করি’ প্রভু যতীশ্বর ।<br />হইবে প্রাসাদোপরি নয়নগোচর ॥৬৮॥
kabe āmi gaṅgā-tīre dā̐ḍāiyā raba<br />vidyā-vāchaspati-dvāre dekhiyā vaibhava<br />kata-kṣaṇe kṛpā kari’ prabhu yatīśvara<br />ha-ibe prāsādopari nayana-gochara [68]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When <span class="e2">āmi</span> <span class="e2">dā̐ḍāiyā raba</span>–will I stand <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā [and] <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–behold [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">vaibhava</span>–glory <span class="e2">vidyā-vāchaspati-dvāre</span>–at the door of Vidyā Vāchaspati? <span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">yatīśvara</span>–the leader of the sannyāsīs, <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">nayana-gochara ha-ibe</span>–appear before [my] eyes <span class="e2">prāsādopari</span>–atop the roof [of Vidyā Vāchaspati]? [68]
When will I stand on the bank of the Gaṅgā and behold the glory of the Lord at the door of Vidyā Vāchaspati? When will the Lord, the leader of the sannyāsīs, mercifully appear before my eyes atop the roof of Vidyā Vāchaspati’s home?
দেখিয়া কনককান্তি সন্ন্যাস-মুরতি ।<br />ভূমে পড়ি’ বিলোকিব করিয়া আকুতি ॥<br />দ্বারকায় রাজবেশে শ্রীকৃষ্ণে দেখিয়া ।<br />কাঁদিল যেমন গোপী যমুনা স্মরিয়া ॥৬৯॥
dekhiyā kanaka-kānti sannyāsa-murati<br />bhūmi paḍi’ vilokiba kariyā ākuti<br />dvārakāya rāja-veśe śrī-kṛṣṇe dekhiyā<br />kā̐dila yemana gopī yamunā smariyā [69]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">kanaka-kānti</span>–the golden lustre [of the Lord’s] <span class="e2">sannyāsa-murati</span>–sannyāsī form, <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–I will fall <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–to the ground [and] <span class="e2">ākuti kariyā</span>–longingly <span class="e2">vilokiba</span>–gaze [at Him] <span class="e2">yemana</span>–like <span class="e2">gopī</span>–the gopīs, [who] <span class="e2">kā̐dila</span>–cried <span class="e2">smariyā</span>–remembering <span class="e2">yamunā</span>–the Yamunā <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–upon seeing <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇe</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">dvārakāya</span>–of Dvārakā <span class="e2">rāja-veśe</span>–in the garb of a king. [69]
Seeing the golden lustre of the Lord’s sannyāsī form, I will fall to the ground and longingly gaze at Him like the gopīs, who cried remembering the Yamunā upon seeing Śrī Kṛṣṇa of Dvārakā in the garb of a king.
আমি চাই গৌরচন্দ্রে লইতে মায়াপুরে ।<br />যথায় কৈশোরবেশ শ্রীঅঙ্গেতে স্ফুরে ॥<br />যথায় চাঁচর কেশ ত্রিকচ্ছবসনে ।<br />ঈশোদ্যানে লীলা করে ভক্তজন সনে ॥৭০॥
āmi chāi gaurachandre la-ite māyāpure<br />yathāya kaiśora-veśa śrī-aṅgete sphure<br />yathāya chā̐chara keśa trikachchha-vasane<br />īśodyāne līlā kare bhakta-jana sane [70]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">chāi</span>–want <span class="e2">la-ite</span>–to bring <span class="e2">gaurachandre</span>–Gaurachandra [back] <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–to Māyāpur, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where [His] <span class="e2">kaiśora-veśa</span>–youthful dress <span class="e2">sphure</span>–shines <span class="e2">śrī-aṅgete</span>–on [His] divine form; <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where, [with His] <span class="e2">trikachchha-vasane</span>–triple-tucked cloth, [and] <span class="e2">chā̐chara</span>–wavy <span class="e2">keśa</span>–hair, [He] <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">īśodyāne</span>–at His garden <span class="e2">sane</span>–with [His] <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–devotees. [70]
I want to bring Gaurachandra back to Māyāpur, where His youthful dress shines on His divine form; where, with His wavy hair and dhotī tucked in three places, He performs Pastimes at Īśodyān with His devotees.
সেই বটে এই যতি আমি সেই দাস ।<br />প্রভুর দর্শন সেই অনন্ত বিলাস ॥<br />তথাপি আমার চিত্ত পৃথুকুণ্ড-তীরে ।<br />প্রভুরে লইতে চায় শ্রীবাস-মন্দিরে ॥৭১॥
sei vaṭe ei yati āmi sei dāsa<br />prabhura darśana sei ananta vilāsa<br />tathāpi āmāra chitta pṛthu-kuṇḍa-tīre<br />prabhure la-ite chāya śrīvāsa-mandire [71]
<span class="e2">vaṭe</span>–In truth, <span class="e2">sei</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">yati</span>–sannyāsī, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">sei</span>–His <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant. [This] <span class="e2">darśana</span>–appearance <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord [is one of] <span class="e2">sei</span>–His <span class="e2">ananta</span>–infinite <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–Pastimes. <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">chitta</span>–heart <span class="e2">chāya</span>–longs <span class="e2">la-ite</span>–to take <span class="e2">prabhure</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-mandire</span>–to the Temple of Śrīvās <span class="e2">pṛthu-kuṇḍa-tīre</span>–on the bank of Pṛthu Kuṇḍa. [71]
In truth, He is this sannyāsī, and I am His servant. This appearance of the Lord is one of His infinite Pastimes. Still, my heart longs to take the Lord back to the Temple of Śrīvās on the bank of Pṛthu Kuṇḍa.
তথা হৈতে কিছু আগে করি দরশন ।<br />শ্রীসমুদ্রগড়তীর্থ জগতপাবন ॥<br />যথা পূর্ব্বে ভীম যুদ্ধে শ্রীসমুদ্রসেনে ।<br />দেখা দিল দীনবন্ধু শুদ্ধভক্ত জেনে ॥৭২॥
tathā haite kichhu āge kari daraśana<br />śrī-samudra-gaḍa-tīrtha jagata-pāvana<br />yathā pūrve bhīma yuddhe śrī-samudra-sene<br />dekhā dila dīna-bandhu śuddha-bhakta jene [72]
<span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">āge</span>–Further on <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, <span class="e2">daraśana kari</span>–I will see <span class="e2">śrī-samudra-gaḍa-tīrtha</span>–Samudragaḍ Tīrtha, <span class="e2">jagata-pāvana</span>–the purifier of the world, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">bhīma</span>–Bhīma <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–previously <span class="e2">yuddhe</span>–fought <span class="e2">śrī-samudra-sene</span>–with Śrī Samudra Sen [and] <span class="e2">dīna-bandhu</span>–the friend of the fallen <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed [Himself], <span class="e2">jene</span>–knowing [His] <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta</span>–pure devotee. [72]
Further on from there, I will see Śrī Samudragaḍ Tīrtha, the purifier of the world, where Bhīma previously fought with Śrī Samudra Sen, and the Lord, the friend of the fallen, revealed Himself, knowing Samudra Sen to be His pure devotee.
যথায় সাগর আসি’ গঙ্গার আশ্রয়ে ।<br />নবদ্বীপলীলা দেখে প্রেমে মুগ্ধ হয়ে ॥<br />শ্রীগঙ্গাসাগর-তীর্থ নবদ্বীপপুরে ।<br />নিত্য শোভা পায় যথা দেখে সুরাসুরে ॥৭৩॥
yathāya sāgara āsi’ gaṅgāra āśraye<br />navadvīpa-līlā dekhe preme mugdha haye<br />śrī-gaṅgā-sāgara-tīrtha navadvīpa-pure<br />nitya śobhā pāya yathā dekhe surāsure [73]
<span class="e2">yathāya</span>–Here, <span class="e2">sāgara</span>–the ocean <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">āśraye</span>–to the shelter <span class="e2">gaṅgāra</span>–of the Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">navadvīpa-līlā</span>–the Pastimes [of the Lord] in Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">haye</span>–became <span class="e2">mugdha</span>–overwhelmed <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. <span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">surāsure</span>–the gods and demons <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">śrī-gaṅgā-sāgara-tīrtha</span>–Śrī Gaṅgā Sāgar Tīrtha <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–shine <span class="e2">nitya</span>–constantly <span class="e2">navadvīpa-pure</span>–in the town of Nabadwīp. [73]
Here, the ocean came to the bank of the Gaṅgā, saw the Pastimes of the Lord in Nabadwīp, and became overwhelmed with divine love. Here, both the gods and demons see Śrī Gaṅgā Sāgar Tīrtha shine constantly in Nabadwīp.
ধন্য জীব কোলদ্বীপ করে দরশন ।<br />পরম-আনন্দ-ধাম শ্রীবহুলাবন ॥<br />কীর্ত্তন-আবেশে যথা শ্রীশচীকুমার ।<br />ভক্তগণ সঙ্গে লয়ে নাচে কতবার ॥৭৪॥
dhanya jīva koladvīpa kare daraśana<br />parama-ānanda-dhāma śrī-bahulāvana<br />kīrtana-āveśe yathā śrī-śachī-kumāra<br />bhakta-gaṇa saṅge laye nāche kata-bāra [74]
<span class="e2">dhanya</span>–Fortunate <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">daraśana kare</span>–see <span class="e2">parama-ānanda-dhāma</span>–this abode of the ultimate joy, <span class="e2">koladvīpa</span>–Koladwīp, [which is nondifferent from] <span class="e2">śrī-bahulāvana</span>–Śrī Bahulāvan. <span class="e2">kīrtana-āveśe</span>–Absorbed in kīrtan <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-kumāra</span>–the son of Śachī <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dances <span class="e2">yathā</span>–here <span class="e2">saṅge</span> <span class="e2">laye</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">kata-bāra</span>–again and again. [74]
Fortunate souls see this abode of the ultimate joy, Koladwīp, which is nondifferent from Śrī Bahulāvan. Absorbed in kīrtan, the son of Śachī dances here with the devotees again and again.
কোলদ্বীপ কৃপা করি’ এই অকিঞ্চনে ।<br />দেহ নবদ্বীপবাস ভক্তজন-সনে ॥<br />শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-লীলাধনে দেহ অধিকার ।<br />জীবন মরণে প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গ আমার ॥৭৫॥
koladvīpa kṛpā kari’ ei akiñchane<br />deha navadvīpa-vāsa bhakta-jana-sane<br />śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā-dhane deha adhikāra<br />jīvane maraṇe prabhu gaurāṅga āmāra [75]
<span class="e2">koladvīpa</span>–O Koladwīp, <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">deha</span>–give <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">akiñchane</span>–poor soul <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsa</span>–a dwelling in Nabadwīp <span class="e2">bhakta-jana-sane</span>–amongst the devotees, <span class="e2">deha</span>–give [him] <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–a share <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-līlā-dhane</span>–of the wealth in the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga [is] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord, <span class="e2">jīvane</span>–in life [and] <span class="e2">maraṇe</span>–in death. [75]
O Koladwīp, mercifully give this poor soul a dwelling in Nabadwīp amongst the devotees and a share of the wealth in the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurāṅga. Gaurāṅga is my Lord, in life and death.
কোলদ্বীপ উত্তরাংশে চম্পাহট্ট গ্রাম ।<br />সদা শোভা করে যাঁহা নবদ্বীপ-ধাম ॥<br />মহাতীর্থ চম্পাহট্ট গ্রাম মনোহর ।<br />জয়দেব যথা ভজে গৌরশশধর ॥৭৬॥
koladvīpa uttarāṁśe champāhaṭṭa grāma<br />sadā śobhā kare yā̐hā navadvīpa-dhāma<br />mahātīrtha champāhaṭṭa grāma manohara<br />jayadeva yathā bhaje gaura-śaśadhara [76]
<span class="e2">uttarāṁśe</span>–In the northern part <span class="e2">koladvīpa</span>–of Koladwīp [is] <span class="e2">grāma</span>–the village <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span>–of Champā Haṭṭa, <span class="e2">yā̐hā</span>–which <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">śobhā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–beautifies <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām. <span class="e2">grāma</span>–The village <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span>–of Champā Haṭṭa [is the] <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting <span class="e2">mahātīrtha</span>–holy place <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">jayadeva</span>–Jayadev Goswāmī <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">gaura-śaśadhara</span>–the moon Śrī Gaura. [76]
In the northern part of Koladwīp is Champā Haṭṭa Grām, which always beautifies Nabadwīp Dhām. In this enchanting, extremely holy place, Jayadev Goswāmī worshipped the moon Śrī Gaura.
যথা বাণীনাথ-গৃহে শচীর নন্দন ।<br />সপার্ষদে করিলেন নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥<br />বাণীনাথ-গৃহে হৈল মহামহোৎসব ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ দেখায় নিজ প্রেমের বৈভব ॥৭৭॥
yathā vāṇīnātha-gṛhe śachīra nandana<br />sapārṣade karilena nāma-saṅkīrtana<br />vāṇīnātha-gṛhe haila mahāmahotsava<br />gaurāṅga dekhāya nija premera vaibhava [77]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">vāṇīnātha-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Vāṇīnāth, <span class="e2">śachīra</span>–Śachī’s <span class="e2">nandana</span>–son <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana</span> <span class="e2">karilena</span>–chanted the Holy Name <span class="e2">sapārṣade</span>–with [His] associates. <span class="e2">mahāmahotsava</span>–A grand festival <span class="e2">haila</span>–took place <span class="e2">vāṇīnātha-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Vāṇīnāth, [and] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">dekhāya</span>–revealed <span class="e2">vaibhava</span>–the glory <span class="e2">nija premera</span>–of His divine love. [77]
Here, in that home of Dvija Vāṇīnāth, the son of Śachī performed Nām-saṅkīrtan with His associates. A grand festival took place, and Gaurāṅga revealed the glory of His divine love.
চম্পহট্ট গ্রামে আছে চম্পকের বন ।<br />চম্পলতা করে যথা কুসুম-চয়ন ॥<br />নবদ্বীপে শ্রীখদিরবন সেই গ্রাম ।<br />ব্রজে যথা রামকৃষ্ণ করেন বিশ্রাম ॥৭৮॥
champāhaṭṭa grāme āchhe champakera vana<br />champalatā kare yathā kusuma-chayana<br />navadvīpe śrī-khadiravana sei grāma<br />vraje yathā rāma-kṛṣṇa karena viśrāma [78]
<span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There is <span class="e2">vana</span>–a forest <span class="e2">champakera</span>–of champak flowers (<span class="e3">Michelia champaca</span>) <span class="e2">grāme</span>–in the village <span class="e2">champāhaṭṭa</span>–of Champā Haṭṭa <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where<span class="e2"> champalatā</span>–Champakalatā (Rādhārāṇī’s sakhī) <span class="e2">kusuma-chayana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–picks flowers. <span class="e2">sei</span>–This <span class="e2">grāma</span>–village <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">śrī-khadiravana</span>–Śrī Khadiravan, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">rāma-kṛṣṇa</span>–Balarām and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">viśrāma</span> <span class="e2">karena</span>–rest <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja. [78]
There is a champak forest in Champā Haṭṭa Grām where Champakalatā Devī picks flowers. This village in Nabadwīp is Śrī Khadiravan, where Balarām and Kṛṣṇa rest in Vraja.
ঋতুদ্বীপ বনময় অতি মনোহর ।<br />বসন্তাদি ঋতু যথা গৌরসেবাপর ॥<br />সর্ব্বর্তুসেবিতভূমি আনন্দ-নিলয় ।<br />রাধাকুণ্ড-প্রদেশের একদেশ হয় ॥৭৯॥
ṛtudvīpa vanamaya ati manohara<br />vasantādi ṛtu yathā gaura-sevāpara<br />sarvartu-sevita-bhūmi ānanda-nilaya<br />rādhā-kuṇḍa-pradeśera ekadeśa haya [79]
<span class="e2">ṛtudvīpa</span>–Ṛtudwīp [is] <span class="e2">vanamaya</span>–forested [and] <span class="e2">ati</span>–extremely <span class="e2">manohara</span>–enchanting. <span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">vasantādi ṛtu</span>–spring and the other seasons [are] <span class="e2">gaura-sevāpara</span>–devoted to the service of Gaura. <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–The land [is] <span class="e2">sarvartu-sevita</span>–worshipped by all the seasons [and is] <span class="e2">ānanda-nilaya</span>–an abode of joy. <span class="e2">ekadeśa</span>–A manifestation <span class="e2">rādhā-kuṇḍa-pradeśera</span>–of Rādhā Kuṇḍa <span class="e2">haya</span>–exists [here]. [79]
Ṛtudwīp is forested and extremely enchanting. Here, spring and the other seasons are devoted to the service of Gaura. The land is worshipped by all the seasons and is an abode of joy. A manifestation of Rādhā Kuṇḍa exists here.
কভু প্রভু সঙ্কীর্ত্তন-রঙ্গে এই স্থানে ।<br />স্মরি’ গোচারণ-লীলা কৃষ্ণগুণগানে ॥<br />“শ্যামলি ধবলি” বলি’ ডাকে ঘন ঘন ।<br />“শ্রীদাম সুবল” বলি’ করেন ক্রন্দন ॥৮০॥
kabhu prabhu saṅkīrtana-raṅge ei sthāne<br />smari’ gochāraṇa-līlā kṛṣṇa-guṇa-gāne<br />“śyāmali dhavali” bali’ ḍāke ghana ghana<br />“śrīdāma subala” bali’ karena krandana [80]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes, <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana-raṅge</span>–during [His] kīrtan Pastimes <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">smari’</span>–would remember <span class="e2">gochāraṇa-līlā</span>–[His] cowherding Pastimes [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-guṇa-gāne</span>–chant the glories of Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">bali’ ḍāke</span>–Calling out, <span class="e2">“śyāmali</span>–“Śyāmali! <span class="e2">dhavali”</span>–Dhavali!”, [and] <span class="e2">bali’</span>–calling out <span class="e2">“śrīdāma</span>–“Śrīdām! <span class="e2">subala”</span>–Subal!” <span class="e2">ghana</span> <span class="e2">ghana</span>–again and again, [the Lord] <span class="e2">krandana karena</span>–would cry. [80]
Sometimes, during His kīrtan Pastimes here, the Lord would remember His cowherding Pastimes and chant the glories of Kṛṣṇa. Calling out, “Śyāmali! Dhavali! Śrīdām! Subal!” again and again, the Lord would cry.
আমি কবে ঋতুদ্বীপে করিয়া ভ্রমণ ।<br />বন-শোভা হেরি’ লীলা করিব স্মরণ ॥<br />রাধাকুণ্ডলীলাস্ফূর্ত্তি হইবে তখন ।<br />স্তম্ভিত হইয়া তাহা করিব দর্শন ॥৮১॥
āmi kabe ṛtudvīpe kariyā bhramaṇa<br />vana-śobhā heri’ līlā kariba smaraṇa<br />rādhā-kuṇḍa-līlā-sphūrti ha-ibe takhana<br />stambhita ha-iyā tāhā kariba darśana [81]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bhramaṇa kariyā</span>–roam <span class="e2">ṛtudvīpe</span>–in Ṛtudwīp, <span class="e2">heri’</span>–seeing <span class="e2">vana-śobhā</span>–the beauty of the forest, [and] <span class="e2">smaraṇa kariba</span>–remember <span class="e2">līlā</span>–the Pastimes [of the Lord]? <span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, [when the Lord’s] <span class="e2">rādhā-kuṇḍa-līlā</span>–Pastimes at Rādhā Kuṇḍa<span class="e2"> sphūrti ha-ibe</span>–appear, [I] <span class="e2">stambhita</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–will become stunned [as] <span class="e2">darśana kariba</span>–I behold <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–them. [81]
When will I roam in Ṛtudwīp, seeing the beauty of the forest, and remember the Pastimes of the Lord? When the Lord’s Pastimes at Rādhā Kuṇḍa appear before me, I will become stunned to behold them.
মানসগঙ্গার তীরে গোচারণ-স্থল ।<br />রামকৃষ্ণ-সহ দাম-বল-মহাবল ॥<br />অসংখ্য গোবৎস লয়ে নিভৃতে চরায় ।<br />নানালীলাচ্ছলে সবে কৃষ্ণগুণ গায় ॥৮২॥
mānasa-gaṅgāra tīre gochāraṇa-sthala<br />rāma-kṛṣṇa-saha dāma-bala-mahābala<br />asaṅkhya go-vatsa laye nibhṛte charāya<br />nānā-līlā-chchhale sabe kṛṣṇa-guṇa gāya [82]
<span class="e2">tīre</span>–On the bank <span class="e2">mānasa-gaṅgāra</span>–of Mānasa Gaṅgā, <span class="e2">dāma-bala-mahābala</span>–Śrīdām, Subal, and Mahābal, <span class="e2">rāma-kṛṣṇa-saha</span>–along with Balarām and Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">laye</span> <span class="e2">charāya</span>–herd <span class="e2">asaṅkhya</span>–countless <span class="e2">go-vatsa</span>–calves <span class="e2">gochāraṇa-sthala</span>–from the pastures <span class="e2">nibhṛte</span>–to the secluded forests, [and] <span class="e2">nānā-līlā-chchhale</span>–on the pretext of various Pastimes, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-guṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s glories. [82]
On the bank of Mānasa Gaṅgā, Śrīdām, Subal, and Mahābal, along with Balarām and Kṛṣṇa, herd countless calves from the pastures to the secluded forests, and on the pretext of various Pastimes, they sing Kṛṣṇa’s glories.
গোপশিশুগণ রহে নানা আলাপনে ।<br />চরিতে চরিতে সবে যায় দূর বনে ॥<br />না দেখিয়া বৎসগণে চিন্তে সর্ব্বজন ।<br />কৃষ্ণবংশীরবে বৎস আইসে ততক্ষণ ॥৮৩॥
gopa-śiśu-gaṇa rahe nānā ālāpane<br />charite charite sabe yāya dūra vane<br />nā dekhiyā vatsa-gaṇe chinte sarva-jana<br />kṛṣṇa-vaṁśī-rave vatsa āise tata-kṣaṇa [83]
<span class="e2">gopa-śiśu-gaṇa</span>–The cowherd boys <span class="e2">rahe</span>–engage [in] <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various <span class="e2">ālāpane</span>–discussions, [and,] <span class="e2">charite</span> <span class="e2">charite</span>–while grazing, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–all the calves <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">dūra</span>–far <span class="e2">vane</span>–into the forest. <span class="e2">nā</span>–Not <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–seeing <span class="e2">vatsa-gaṇe</span>–the calves, <span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–all the boys <span class="e2">chinte</span>–worry, [but] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-vaṁśī-rave</span>–at the sound of Kṛṣṇa’s flute, <span class="e2">vatsa</span>–the calves <span class="e2">āise</span>–return <span class="e2">tata-kṣaṇa</span>–immediately. [83]
The cowherd boys discuss various things, and meanwhile the calves move into distant woods to graze. Not seeing them, all the boys become worried, but at the sound of Kṛṣṇa’s flute, the calves immediately return.
দেখিতে দেখিতে লীলা হৈলে অদর্শন ।<br />ভূমিতে পড়িব আমি হয়ে অচেতন ॥<br />কতক্ষণে সংজ্ঞা লভি’ আপনি উঠিব ।<br />ধীরে ধীরে বনমাঝে ভ্রমণ করিব ॥৮৪॥
dekhite dekhite līlā haile adarśana<br />bhūmite paḍiba āmi haye achetana<br />kata-kṣaṇe saṁjñā labhi’ āpani uṭhiba<br />dhīre dhīre vana-mājhe bhramaṇa kariba [84]
<span class="e2">haile</span>–When <span class="e2">līlā</span>–these Pastimes <span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">adarśana</span>–disappear, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">paḍiba</span>–will fall <span class="e2">bhūmite</span>–to the ground <span class="e2">achetana haye</span>–unconscious. <span class="e2">kata-kṣaṇe</span>–Eventually, <span class="e2">labhi’</span>–regaining <span class="e2">āpani</span>–my <span class="e2">saṁjñā</span>–awareness, <span class="e2">uṭhiba</span>–I will arise [and] <span class="e2">dhīre</span> <span class="e2">dhīre</span>–slowly <span class="e2">bhramaṇa</span> <span class="e2">kariba</span>–roam <span class="e2">vana-mājhe</span>–throughout the forest. [84]
When these Pastimes suddenly disappear, I will fall to the ground unconscious. Eventually regaining my awareness, I will arise and slowly roam throughout the forest.
“হা গৌরাঙ্গ! কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র! দয়ার সাগর ।<br />কাঙ্গালের ধন তুমি আমি ত পামর” ॥<br />এই বলি’ কাঁদি’ কাঁদি’ হয়ে অগ্রসর ।<br />দেখিব সহসা আমি শ্রীবিদ্যানগর ॥৮৫॥
“hā gaurāṅga! kṛṣṇachandra! dayāra sāgara<br />kāṅgālera dhana tumi āmi ta pāmara”<br />ei bali’ kā̐di’ kā̐di’ haye agrasara<br />dekhiba sahasā āmi śrī-vidyā-nagara [85]
<span class="e2">“hā</span>–“O <span class="e2">gaurāṅga!</span>–Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">kṛṣṇachandra!</span>–O Kṛṣṇachandra! <span class="e2">dayāra</span> <span class="e2">sāgara</span>–O Ocean of mercy! <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">dhana</span>–the wealth <span class="e2">kāṅgālera</span>–of the poor, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">ta</span>–certainly <span class="e2">pāmara”</span>–needy.” <span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">ei</span>–this [and] <span class="e2">kā̐di’</span> <span class="e2">kā̐di’</span>–crying <span class="e2">agrasara haye</span>–as I proceed, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [will] <span class="e2">sahasā</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–see <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-nagara</span>–Śrī Vidyā Nagar. [85]
“O Gaurāṅga! O Kṛṣṇachandra! O Ocean of mercy! You are the wealth of the poor, and I am certainly in need.” Saying this and crying as I proceed, I will suddenly see Śrī Vidyā Nagar.
চারিবেদ চতুঃষষ্টি বিদ্যার আলয় ।<br />সরস্বতী-পীঠ বিদ্যানগর নিশ্চয় ॥<br />ব্রহ্মাশিবঋষিগণ এ পীঠ-আশ্রয়ে ।<br />সর্ব্ববিদ্যা প্রকাশিল প্রপঞ্চ নিলয়ে ॥৮৬॥
chāri-veda chatuḥṣaṣṭi vidyāra ālaya<br />sarasvatī-pīṭha vidyā-nagara niśchaya<br />brahmā-śiva-ṛṣi-gaṇa e pīṭha-āśraye<br />sarva-vidyā prakāśila prapañcha nilaye [86]
<span class="e2">vidyā-nagara</span>–Vidyā Nagar [is] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">ālaya</span>–the abode <span class="e2">chāri-veda</span>–of the four Vedas, <span class="e2">chatuḥṣaṣṭi</span>–the sixty-four branches <span class="e2">vidyāra</span>–of knowledge, [and] <span class="e2">sarasvatī-pīṭha</span>–Saraswatī Devī. <span class="e2">e pīṭha-āśraye</span>–In the shelter of this place, <span class="e2">brahmā-śiva-ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–Brahmā, Śiva, and the sages <span class="e2">prakāśila</span>–revealed <span class="e2">sarva-vidyā</span>–all forms of knowledge <span class="e2">prapañcha</span> <span class="e2">nilaye</span>–within the material world. [86]
Vidyā Nagar is the abode of the four Vedas, the sixty-four branches of knowledge, and Saraswatī. Brahmā, Śiva, and the sages resided here and revealed all forms of knowledge within the material world.
প্রভু মোর করিবেন বিদ্যার বিলাস ।<br />ইহা জানি’ বৃহস্পতি ছাড়ি’ নিজবাস ॥<br />বাসুদেব সার্ব্বভৌমরূপে এই স্থানে ।<br />প্রচারিল সর্ব্ববিদ্যা বিবিধ বিধানে ॥৮৭॥
prabhu mora karibena vidyāra vilāsa<br />ihā jāni’ bṛhaspati chhāḍi’ nija-vāsa<br />vāsudeva sārvabhauma-rūpe ei sthāne<br />pracharila sarva-vidyā vividha vidhāne [87]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Knowing <span class="e2">mora</span>–our <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–Lord <span class="e2">karibena</span>–would perform <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">vidyāra</span>–of education <span class="e2">ihā</span>–here, <span class="e2">bṛhaspati</span>–Bṛhaspati (the guru of the gods) <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–left <span class="e2">nija-vāsa</span>–his abode [and] <span class="e2">vāsudeva</span> <span class="e2">sārvabhauma-rūpe</span>–as Vāsudev Sārvabhauma (Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya) <span class="e2">pracharila</span>–established <span class="e2">sarva-vidyā</span>–all forms of knowledge <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–here <span class="e2">vividha</span> <span class="e2">vidhāne</span>–by various methods. [87]
Knowing that our Lord would perform Pastimes of being educated here, Bṛhaspati left his abode and as Vāsudev Sārvabhauma established all forms of knowledge here using various methods.
যে বিদ্যানগরে বসি’ গৌরগুণ গায় ।<br />সেই অধ্যাপক ধন্য শোক নাহি পায় ॥<br />অবিদ্যা ছাড়য়ে তারে যে বিদ্যানগরে ।<br />দর্শন করিয়া ভজে গৌরসুধাকরে ॥৮৮॥
ye vidyā-nagare vasi’ gaura-guṇa gāya<br />sei adhyāpaka dhanya śoka nāhi pāya<br />avidyā chhāḍaye tāre ye vidyā-nagare<br />darśana kariyā bhaje gaura-sudhākare [88]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">adhyāpaka</span>–Any teacher who <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–lives <span class="e2">vidyā-nagare</span>–in Vidyā Nagar [and] <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sings <span class="e2">gaura-guṇa</span>–the glories of Gaura [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate [and] <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">pāya</span>–undergoes <span class="e2">śoka</span>–distress. <span class="e2">avidyā</span>–Ignorance <span class="e2">chhāḍaye</span>–releases <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">tāre</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">darśana</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–visits <span class="e2">vidyā-nagare</span>–Vidyā Nagar [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–worships <span class="e2">gaura-sudhākare</span>–the moon Śrī Gaura. [88]
Any teacher who lives in Vidyā Nagar and sings the glories of Gaura is fortunate and never undergoes distress. Ignorance releases anyone who visits Vidyā Nagar and worships the moon Śrī Gaura.
আমি কি দেখিব কভু শ্রীগৌরসুন্দরে ।<br />বিদ্যানুরাগে গিয়া শ্রীবিদ্যানগরে?॥<br />শ্রীবাসাপরাধে দেবানন্দ-মহাশয়ে ।<br />দণ্ডিবেন বাক্য-দণ্ডে ভক্তপক্ষ হয়ে ॥৮৯॥
āmi ki dekhiba kabhu śrī-gaurasundare<br />vidyānurāge giyā śrī-vidyā-nagare?<br />śrīvāsāparādhe devānanda-mahāśaye<br />daṇḍibena vākya-daṇḍe bhakta-pakṣa haye [89]
<span class="e2">ki</span>–Will <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–ever <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–see <span class="e2">śrī-gaurasundare</span>–Śrī Gaurasundar <span class="e2">vidyānurāge</span> <span class="e2">giyā</span>–going to study <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-nagare?</span>–in Śrī Vidyā Nagar? [Will I ever see Him,] <span class="e2">bhakta-pakṣa</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–on behalf of the devotees, <span class="e2">daṇḍibena</span> <span class="e2">vākya-daṇḍe</span>–chastise <span class="e2">devānanda-mahāśaye</span>–Devānanda Paṇḍit <span class="e2">śrīvāsāparādhe</span>–for [his] offence to Śrīvās Ṭhākur? [89]
Will I ever see Śrī Gaurasundar going to study in Śrī Vidyā Nagar? Will I ever see Him, on behalf of the devotees, chastise Devānanda Paṇḍit for his offence to Śrīvās Ṭhākur?
আমার প্রভুর লীলা অনন্ত না জানে ।<br />কখন কি কার্য্যে মাতে, থাকে কিবা ধ্যানে ॥<br />কেন যে কীর্ত্তন ছাড়ি’ পড়ুয়া তাড়ায় ।<br />পরাজিয়া অধ্যাপকে কিবা সুখ পায় ॥৯০॥
āmāra prabhura līlā ananta nā jāne<br />kakhana ki kārye māte, thāke kibā dhyāne<br />kena ye kīrtana chhāḍi’ paḍuyā tāḍāya<br />parājiyā adhyāpake kibā sukha pāya [90]
<span class="e2">ananta</span>–Ananta Śeṣa <span class="e2">nā</span>–does not <span class="e2">jāne</span>–understand <span class="e2">līlā</span>–the Pastimes <span class="e2">āmāra prabhura</span>–of our Lord. <span class="e2">kakhana ki</span>–When [does He] <span class="e2">māte</span>–enjoy <span class="e2">kārye</span>–an activity? <span class="e2">kibā</span>–What sort of <span class="e2">dhyāne</span>–meditation <span class="e2">thāke</span>–does He perform? <span class="e2">kena</span>–Why [does] <span class="e2">ye</span>–He <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leave <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–the kīrtan [and] <span class="e2">tāḍāya</span>–chastise <span class="e2">paḍuyā</span>–students? <span class="e2">kibā</span>–What sort of <span class="e2">sukha</span>–joy <span class="e2">pāya</span>–does He feel <span class="e2">parājiyā</span>–by defeating <span class="e2">adhyāpake</span>–scholars? [90]
Even Ananta Śeṣa does not understand the Pastimes of our Lord. When does He enjoy a particular activity? What sort of meditation does He perform? Why does He leave the kīrtan to chastise students? What sort of joy does He feel by defeating scholars?
যাই করে প্রভু তাই আনন্দজনক ।<br />স্বেচ্ছাময় প্রভু তেঁহ আমি ত সেবক ॥<br />ক্ষুদ্র পরিমিত বুদ্ধি সহজে আমার ।<br />বিচারিতে শক্তি নাই বিধান তাঁহার ॥৯১॥
yāi kare prabhu tāi ānanda-janaka<br />svechchhāmaya prabhu te̐ha āmi ta sevaka<br />kṣudra parimita buddhi sahaje āmāra<br />vichārite śakti nāi vidhāna tā̐hāra [91]
<span class="e2">yāi tāi</span>–Whatever <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">kare</span>–does [is] <span class="e2">ānanda-janaka</span>–a cause of joy. <span class="e2">te̐ha prabhu</span>–The Lord [is] <span class="e2">svechchhāmaya</span>–whimsical, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">ta</span>–certainly [His] <span class="e2">sevaka</span>–servant. <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–intelligence [is] <span class="e2">sahaje</span>–by nature <span class="e2">kṣudra</span> <span class="e2">parimita</span>–small, [and] <span class="e2">nāi</span>–I have no <span class="e2">śakti</span>–capacity <span class="e2">vichārite</span>–to understand <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span>–His <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–ways. [91]
Whatever the Lord does creates joy. He is whimsical, and I am His servant. My intelligence is by nature small, and I have no capacity to understand His ways.
নবদ্বীপবাসী অধ্যাপকগণ তাঁর ।<br />নিত্যলীলা-পুষ্টিকারী প্রণম্য আমার ॥<br />সকলে করুণা কর দীন অকিঞ্চনে ।<br />মোরে অধিকার দেহ নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনে ॥৯২॥
navadvīpa-vāsī adhyāpaka-gaṇa tā̐ra<br />nitya-līlā-puṣṭikārī praṇamya āmāra<br />sakale karuṇā kare dīna akiñchane<br />more adhikāra deha nāma-saṅkīrtane [92]
<span class="e2">adhyāpaka-gaṇa</span>–The teachers <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsī</span>–residing in Nabadwīp, [who] <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">nitya-līlā-puṣṭikārī</span>–augment His eternal Pastimes, [are] <span class="e2">praṇamya</span>–worshippable <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–to me. [May] <span class="e2">sakale</span>–you all <span class="e2">karuṇā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–bless [this] <span class="e2">dīna</span>–lowly <span class="e2">akiñchane</span>–poor soul [and] <span class="e2">deha</span>–give <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–the qualification <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–to chant the Name. [92]
The teachers residing in Nabadwīp, who augment the Lord’s eternal Pastimes, are worshippable to me. May you all bless this poor, lowly soul and give me the qualification to chant the Name.
শ্রীবিদ্যানগর-প্রতি এই নিবেদন ।<br />“যে অবিদ্যা গৌরতত্ত্ব করে আবরণ ॥<br />সে অবিদ্যা-জালে যেন মানস আমার ।<br />আবৃত না হয় কভু থাকে মায়াপার” ॥৯৩॥
śrī-vidyā-nagara-prati ei nivedana<br />“ye avidyā gaura-tattva kare āvaraṇa<br />se avidyā-jāle yena mānasa āmāra<br />āvṛta nā haya kabhu thāke māyāpāra” [93]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is my] <span class="e2">nivedana</span>–prayer <span class="e2">śrī-vidyā-nagara-prati</span>–to Śrī Vidyā Nagar, <span class="e2">“yena</span>–“May <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">mānasa</span>–mind <span class="e2">thāke</span>–exist <span class="e2">māyāpāra</span>–beyond illusion [and] <span class="e2">kabhu haya nā</span>–never [be] <span class="e2">āvṛta</span>–covered <span class="e2">se vidyā-jāle</span>–by the net of ignorance, <span class="e2">ye avidyā</span>–the ignorance [that] <span class="e2">āvaraṇa kare</span>–conceals <span class="e2">gaura-tattva”</span>–the glory of Gaura.” [93]
I pray to Vidyā Nagar, “May my mind transcend illusion and never be covered by the net of ignorance that conceals the glory of Gaura.”
শোভে জহ্নুদ্বীপ বিদ্যানগর উত্তরে ।<br />যথা জহ্নু-তপোবন ব্যক্ত চরাচরে ॥<br />গঙ্গারে করিল পান যথা মুনিবর ।<br />জাহ্নবী-স্বরূপে গঙ্গা হইল গোচর ॥৯৪॥
śobhe jahnudvīpa vidyā-nagara uttare<br />yathā jahnu-tapovana vyakta charāchare<br />gaṅgāre karila pāna yathā muni-vara<br />jāhnavī-svarūpe gaṅgā ha-ila gochara [94]
<span class="e2">uttare</span>–North <span class="e2">vidyā-nagara</span>–of Vidyā Nagar <span class="e2">śobhe</span>–shines <span class="e2">jahnudvīpa</span>–Jahnudwīp, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">jahnu-tapovana</span>–the hermitage of Jahnu Muni <span class="e2">vyakta</span>–is visible <span class="e2">charāchare</span>–to all beings. <span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">muni-vara</span>–the great sage <span class="e2">pāna karila</span>–drank <span class="e2">gaṅgāre</span>–the Gaṅgā, [and] <span class="e2">gaṅgā</span>–the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">gochara ha-ila</span>–appeared <span class="e2">jāhnavī-svarūpe</span>–as his daughter. [94]
North of Vidyā Nagar shines Jahnudwīp, where the hermitage of Jahnu Muni is visible to all. Here, the great sage drank the Gaṅgā, and she reappeared as his daughter.
যথা কৃষ্ণভক্ত ভীষ্ম মুনির আশ্রমে ।<br />ভাগবতধর্ম্ম-শিক্ষা কৈল বিধিক্রমে ॥<br />যথা জহ্নু নিষ্কপটে করিয়া ভজন ।<br />অনায়াসে পায় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যচরণ ॥৯৫॥
yathā kṛṣṇa-bhakta bhīṣma munira āśrame<br />bhāgavata-dharma-śikṣā kaila vidhi-krame<br />yathā jahnu niṣkapaṭe kariyā bhajana<br />anāyāse pāya śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya-charaṇa [95]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here <span class="e2">munira</span> <span class="e2">āśrame</span>–at the sage’s ashram, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s devotee <span class="e2">bhīṣma</span>–Bhīṣma <span class="e2">vidhi-krame</span>–systematically <span class="e2">śikṣā</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–learned <span class="e2">bhāgavata-dharma</span>–devotion to the Lord. <span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">jahnu</span>–Jahnu Muni <span class="e2">niṣkapaṭe</span>–sincerely <span class="e2">bhajana kariyā</span>–engaged in service [and] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attained <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya-charaṇa</span>–the feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya. [95]
Here at Jahnu Muni’s ashram, Kṛṣṇa’s devotee Bhīṣma systematically learned devotion to the Lord. Jahnu Muni sincerely engaged in service and easily attained the feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya.
জহ্নুদ্বীপ ভদ্রবন কৃষ্ণলীলাস্থল ।<br />নয়নগোচর কবে হবে নিরমল ॥<br />সেই বলে ভীষ্মটীলা পরমপাবন ।<br />তদুপরি রহি’ আমি করিব ভজন ॥৯৬॥
jahnudvīpa bhadravana kṛṣṇa-līlā-sthala<br />nayana-gochara kabe habe niramala<br />sei vane bhīṣma-ṭīlā parama-pāvana<br />tad upari rahi’ āmi kariba bhajana [96]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">jahnudvīpa</span>–Jahnudwīp, [which is nondifferent from] <span class="e2">bhadravana</span>–Bhadravan <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā-sthala</span>–in Vṛndāvan, <span class="e2">niramala</span>–clearly <span class="e2">nayana-gochara habe</span>–appear before [my] eyes? [When will] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">rahi’</span>–sit <span class="e2">tad</span> <span class="e2">upari</span>–atop <span class="e2">parama-pāvana</span>–the supremely purifying <span class="e2">bhīṣma-ṭīlā</span>–Bhīṣma Ṭīlā <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in that forest [and] <span class="e2">bhajana kariba</span>–perform worship? [96]
When will Jahnudwīp, which is nondifferent from Bhadravan in Vṛndāvan, clearly appear before my eyes? When will I sit atop the supremely purifying Bhīṣma Ṭīlā in that forest and perform worship?
রাত্র্যাগমে ভীষ্মদেব প্রশান্ত অন্তরে ।<br />দরশন দিবে মোরে শুদ্ধ কলেবরে ॥<br />কৃষ্ণবর্ণ বৃক্ষ তুলসীর মালা করে ।<br />দ্বাদশ-তিলকান্বিত নামানন্দভরে ॥৯৭॥
rātryāgame bhīṣma-deva praśānta antare<br />daraśana dibe more śuddha kalevare<br />kṛṣṇa-varṇa vṛkṣa tulasīra mālā kare<br />dvādaśa-tilakānvita nāmānanda-bhare [97]
<span class="e2">rātryāgame</span>–In the evening, <span class="e2">bhīṣma-deva</span>–Bhīṣmadev <span class="e2">daraśana</span> <span class="e2">dibe</span>–will reveal himself <span class="e2">more</span>–before me <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-varṇa vṛkṣa kalevare</span>–in [his] pure, blackish coloured form <span class="e2">dvādaśa-tilakānvita</span>–decorated with the twelve tilaks. [He will have] <span class="e2">tulasīra</span> <span class="e2">mālā</span>–a tulasī-mālā <span class="e2">kare</span>–in hand, <span class="e2">praśānta antare</span>–a peaceful heart, [and be] <span class="e2">nāmānanda-bhare</span>–filled with the joy of the Name. [97]
In the evening, Bhīṣmadev will reveal himself before me in his pure, blackish coloured form decorated with the twelve tilaks. He will have a tulasī-mālā in hand, a peaceful heart, and be filled with the joy of the Name.
বলিবে, “নবীন নবদ্বীপবাসী শুন ।<br />আমার মুখেতে আজ গৌরাঙ্গের গুণ ॥<br />কুরুক্ষেত্র-রণে পড়ি’ মরণসময়ে ।<br />দেখিলাম কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র একচিত্ত হয়ে ॥৯৮॥
balibe, “navīna navadvīpa-vāsī śuna<br />āmāra mukhete āja gaurāṅgera guṇa<br />kurukṣetra-raṇe paḍi’ maraṇa-samaye<br />dekhilāma kṛṣṇachandra eka-chitta haye [98]
<span class="e2">balibe</span>–He will say, <span class="e2">“navīna</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-vāsī</span>–O new resident of Nabadwīp! <span class="e2">āja</span>–Today, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–hear <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–the glories <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">mukhete</span>–from my mouth. <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–I fell <span class="e2">kurukṣetra-raṇe</span>–during the battle of Kurukṣetra, [and] <span class="e2">maraṇa-samaye</span>–at the time of [my] death, <span class="e2">dekhilāma</span>–I saw <span class="e2">kṛṣṇachandra</span>–Kṛṣṇachandra <span class="e2">eka-chitta</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–vividly. [98]
He will say, “O new resident of Nabadwīp! Today, hear the glories of Gaurāṅga from my mouth. I fell during the battle of Kurukṣetra, and at the time of my death, I saw Kṛṣṇachandra vividly.
নির্যাণসময়ে প্রভু বলিল বচন ।<br />নবদ্বীপ তুমি পূর্ব্বে করিলা দর্শন ॥<br />সেই পুণ্যে গৌরকৃপা তোমার ঘটিল ।<br />নবদ্বীপে নিত্যবাস এখন হইল ॥৯৯॥
niryāṇa-samaye prabhu balila vachana<br />‘navadvīpa tumi pūrve karilā darśana<br />sei puṇye gaura-kṛpā tomāra ghaṭila<br />navadvīpe nitya-vāsa ekhana ha-ila’ [99]
<span class="e2">niryāṇa-samaye</span>–At the time of [my] passing, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">vachana balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘pūrve</span>–‘Previously <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">darśana karilā</span>–visited <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">puṇye</span>–by that good fortune, <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">ghaṭila</span>–you have received <span class="e2">gaura-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of Gaura. [Your] <span class="e2">nitya-vāsa</span>–eternal home <span class="e2">ekhana</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–has now become <span class="e2">navadvīpe’</span>–Nabadwīp.’ [99]
“During my passing, the Lord said, ‘Previously you visited Nabadwīp, and as a result of that good fortune, you have received the mercy of Gaura. Your eternal home has now become Nabadwīp.’
অতএব সর্ব্ব-আশা পরিত্যাগ করি’ ।<br />নবদ্বীপে বসি’ তুমি ভজ গৌরহরি ॥<br />আর না করহ ভয় বিষয়-বন্ধনে ।<br />অবশ্য লভিবে সেবা গৌরাঙ্গচরণে ॥১০০॥
ataeva sarva-āśā parityāga kari’<br />navadvīpe vasi’ tumi bhaja gaurahari<br />āra nā karaha bhaya viṣaya-bandhane<br />avaśya labhibe sevā gaurāṅga-charaṇe [100]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Therefore, <span class="e2">tumi parityāga</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–abandon <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all [other] <span class="e2">āśā</span>–desires, <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–reside <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari. <span class="e2">karaha nā</span>–Do not <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–fear <span class="e2">viṣaya-bandhane</span>–material bondage <span class="e2">āra</span>–any longer. [You will] <span class="e2">avaśya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–attain <span class="e2">sevā</span>–the service <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-charaṇe</span>–of Gaurāṅga’s feet. [100]
“Therefore, abandon all other desires, reside in Nabadwīp, and worship Gaurahari. Do not fear material bondage any longer. You will certainly attain the service of Gaurāṅga’s feet.
প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় এই ধামে সর্ব্বক্ষণ ।<br />কৃষ্ণলীলা গৌরলীলা দেখে মুক্তজন ॥<br />শোক, ভয়, মৃত্যু আর উদ্বেগ-কারণ ।<br />বহির্ম্মুখ ইচ্ছা নাহি জীবের পীড়ন ॥১০১॥
prabhura ichchhāya ei dhāme sarva-kṣaṇa<br />kṛṣṇa-līlā gaura-līlā dekhe mukta-jana<br />śoka, bhaya, mṛtyu āra udvega-kāraṇa<br />bahirmukha ichchhā nāhi jīvera pīḍana [101]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">mukta-jana</span>–liberated souls <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–always <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā</span>–the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–the Pastimes of Gaura <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–in this abode. <span class="e2">śoka</span>–Lamentation, <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–fear, <span class="e2">mṛtyu</span>–death, <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span>–material <span class="e2">ichchhā</span>–desire, [and] <span class="e2">āra</span>–other <span class="e2">udvega-kāraṇa</span>–causes of disturbance [and] <span class="e2">pīḍana</span>–affliction <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for the soul <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not exist [here]. [101]
“By the will of the Lord, liberated souls always see the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa and the Pastimes of Gaura in this abode. Neither lamentation, nor fear, nor death, nor material desire, nor any other cause of disturbance or affliction to the soul exist here.
শুদ্ধভক্তজন কৃষ্ণকৈঙ্কর্য্য-আসবে ।<br />নিজ নিজ ভজনেতে মগ্ন সুখার্ণবে ॥<br />না জানে অভাব-পীড়া সংসার-যাতনা ।<br />সিদ্ধকাম শুদ্ধদেহ বৈসে সর্ব্বজনা ॥১০২॥
śuddha-bhakta-jana kṛṣṇa-kaiṅkarya-āsabe<br />nija nija bhajanete magna sukhārṇave<br />nā jāne abhāva-pīḍā saṁsāra-yātanā<br />siddha-kāma śuddha-deha vaise sarva-janā [102]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kaiṅkarya-āsabe</span>–With the nectar of servitorship to Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">nija</span>–their respective <span class="e2">bhajanete</span>–services, <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta-jana</span>–pure devotees <span class="e2">magna</span>–are immersed <span class="e2">sukhārṇave</span>–in an ocean of joy. [They] <span class="e2">nā</span>–do not <span class="e2">jāne</span>–know of <span class="e2">abhāva-pīḍā</span>–deprivation, disease, [or] <span class="e2">saṁsāra-yātanā</span>–worldly sorrow. <span class="e2">sarva-janā</span>–Everyone [here] <span class="e2">vaise</span>–lives [in their] <span class="e2">śuddha-deha</span>–spiritual body [and has only] <span class="e2">siddha-kāma</span>–spiritual desires. [102]
“With the nectar of servitorship to Kṛṣṇa and their respective services, pure devotees here are immersed in an ocean of joy. They do not know of deprivation, disease, or worldly sorrow. Everyone here lives in their spiritual body and has only spiritual desires.
নিত্যমুক্ত বদ্ধমুক্ত ভক্তি পরিকর ।<br />অনন্ত সংখ্যক দাসগণের ঈশ্বর ॥<br />যার যেই ভাব সেই ভাবে তার সনে ।<br />নিত্যলীলা করে প্রভু এই সব বনে ॥১০৩॥
nitya-mukta baddha-mukta bhakti parikara<br />ananta saṅkhyaka dāsa-gaṇera īśvara<br />yāra yei bhāva sei bhāve tāra sane<br />nitya-līlā kare prabhu ei saba vane [103]
<span class="e2">bhakti</span> <span class="e2">parikara</span>–Devotees [are either] <span class="e2">nitya-mukta</span>–eternally liberated <span class="e2">baddha-mukta</span>–or liberated from [their prior] bondage. <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–The Supreme Lord [has] <span class="e2">ananta</span> <span class="e2">saṅkhyaka</span>–innumerable <span class="e2">dāsa-gaṇera</span>–servants. <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">kare</span>–performs [His] <span class="e2">nitya-līlā</span>–eternal Pastimes <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in all these forests <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with them <span class="e2">yāra</span> <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">bhāva</span> <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–according to their respective moods.[103]
“The Supreme Lord has innumerable devoted servants, who are either eternally liberated or liberated from their prior bondage. He performs His eternal Pastimes in all these forests with each of them according to their respective moods.
এ ধাম অনন্ত, জড়া মায়া হেথা নাই ।<br />চিচ্ছক্তি হেথায় অধিষ্ঠাত্রী শুন ভাই ॥<br />তদনুগ দেশকাল করণ শরীর ।<br />সব নির্ম্মায়িক সত্ত্ব এই তত্ত্ব স্থির ॥১০৪॥
e dhāma ananta, jaḍā māyā hethā nāi<br />chich-chhakti hethāya adhiṣṭhātrī śuna bhāi<br />tadanuga deśa-kāla karaṇa śarīra<br />saba nirmāyika sattva ei tattva sthira [104]
<span class="e2">e dhāma</span>–The abode [is] <span class="e2">ananta</span>–infinite, [and] <span class="e2">nāi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">jaḍā</span>–material <span class="e2">māyā</span>–illusion <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here. <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">chich-chhakti</span>–The spiritual energy [is] <span class="e2">adhiṣṭhātrī</span>–the presiding goddess <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here, [and] <span class="e2">tadanuga</span>–thus, <span class="e2">deśa</span>–space, <span class="e2">kāla</span>–time, <span class="e2">karaṇa</span>–action, [and] <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–bodies [here are] <span class="e2">saba</span>–all <span class="e2">nirmāyika</span>–non-illusory <span class="e2">sattva</span>–in nature. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">tattva</span>–truth [is] <span class="e2">sthira</span>–firm. [104]
“The Dhām is infinite, and there is no material illusion here. Brother, listen! The spiritual energy of the Lord is the presiding Deity here, and thus space, time, action, and bodies here are all non-illusory by nature. This is a firm truth.
যতদিন না ছাড়িবে প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ।<br />মায়িক শরীর ততদিন ত তোমায় ॥<br />না স্ফুরিবে পূর্ণরূপে এ ধামের ভাব ।<br />তব বুদ্ধি না ছাড়িবে জাতীয় স্বভাব ॥১০৫॥
yata-dina nā chhāḍibe prabhura ichchhāya<br />māyika śarīra tata-dina ta tomāya<br />nā sphuribe pūrṇa-rūpe e dhāmera bhāva<br />tava buddhi nā chhāḍibe jātīya svabhāva [105]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–According to the desire of the Lord, <span class="e2">yata-dina tata-dina ta</span>–as long as [your] <span class="e2">māyika</span>–illusory <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–body <span class="e2">chhāḍibe nā</span>–does not leave <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–you, <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–the nature <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dhāmera</span>–of this abode <span class="e2">sphuribe nā</span>–will not be revealed <span class="e2">pūrṇa-rūpe</span>–fully, [and] <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–intelligence <span class="e2">chhāḍibe nā</span>–will not leave behind [its]<span class="e2"> jātīya</span>–conditioned <span class="e2">svabhāva</span>–nature. [105]
“According to the desire of the Lord, as long as your illusory body does not leave you, the nature of the Dhām will not be fully revealed to you, and your intelligence will not leave behind its conditioned nature.
ভাগবতী তনু পাবে প্রভুর ইচ্ছায় ।<br />অব্যাহতগতি তব হইবে হেথায় ॥<br />জড়মায়াজালে আবরণ যাবে দূরে ।<br />অসীম আনন্দ পাবে এই নিত্যপুরে ॥১০৬॥
bhāgavatī tanu pābe prabhura ichchhāya<br />avyāhatagati tava ha-ibe hethāya<br />jaḍa-māyā-jāle āvaraṇa yābe dūre<br />asīma ānanda pābe ei nitya-pure [106]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–By the will of the Lord, <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will receive [a] <span class="e2">bhāgavatī</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">tanu</span>–body, [and] <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–you will have <span class="e2">avyāhatagati</span>–freedom <span class="e2">hethāya</span>–here. <span class="e2">āvaraṇa</span>–The covering <span class="e2">jaḍa-māyā-jāle</span>–of the net of material illusion <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will go <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away, [and] <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will feel <span class="e2">asīma</span>–unlimited <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–joy <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nitya-pure</span>–in this eternal abode. [106]
“By the will of the Lord, you will receive a spiritual body and be free here. The covering of the net of material illusion will disappear, and you will feel unlimited joy in this eternal abode.
যে পর্য্যন্ত আছে ভাই মায়িক শরীর ।<br />সাবধানে ভক্তিতত্ত্বে থাক সদা স্থির ॥<br />ভক্তসেবা কৃষ্ণনাম যুগলভজন ।<br />বিষয়ে শৈথিল্যভাব কর সর্ব্বক্ষণ ॥১০৭॥
ye paryanta āchhe bhāi māyika śarīra<br />sāvadhāne bhakti-tattve thāka sadā sthira<br />bhakta-sevā kṛṣṇa-nāma yugala-bhajana<br />viṣaye śaithilya-bhāva kare sarva-kṣaṇa [107]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother! <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">paryanta</span>–As long as [your] <span class="e2">māyika</span>–illusory <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–body <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–exists, <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sāvadhāne</span>–carefully <span class="e2">sthira thāka</span>–practise <span class="e2">bhakti-tattve</span>–devotion. <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–Constantly <span class="e2">bhakta-sevā</span>–serve the devotees, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">yugala-bhajana</span>–worship the Divine Couple, [and] <span class="e2">śaithilya-bhāva</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–be detached <span class="e2">viṣaye</span>–from the mundane. [107]
“Brother! As long as your illusory body remains, always carefully practise devotion. Constantly serve the devotees, chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, worship the Divine Couple, and be detached from the mundane.
ধামকৃপা নামকৃপা ভক্তকৃপাবলে ।<br />অসাধু-সম্বন্ধ দূরে রাখহ কৌশলে ॥<br />অচিরে পাইবে তুমি নিত্যধামে বাস ।<br />শুদ্ধ শ্রীযুগলসেবা হইবে প্রকাশ” ॥১০৮॥
dhāma-kṛpā nāma-kṛpā bhakta-kṛpā-bale<br />asādhu-sambandha dūre rākhaha kauśale<br />achire pāibe tumi nitya-dhāme vāsa<br />śuddha śrī-yugala-sevā ha-ibe prakāśa” [108]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–By the <span class="e2">dhāma-kṛpā</span>–mercy of the Dhām, <span class="e2">nāma-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of the Name, [and] <span class="e2">bhakta-kṛpā</span>–the mercy of the devotees, <span class="e2">kauśale</span>–artfully <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">rākhaha</span>–avoid <span class="e2">asādhu-sambandha</span>–bad association. <span class="e2">achire</span>–Soon <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–will attain <span class="e2">vāsa</span>–residence <span class="e2">nitya-dhāme</span>–in the eternal Dhām, [and your] <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure<span class="e2"> śrī-yugala-sevā</span>–service to the Divine Couple <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be <span class="e2">prakāśa”</span>–revealed.” [108]
“By the mercy of the Dhām, the mercy of the Name, and the mercy of the devotees, artfully avoid bad association. Soon you will attain residence in the eternal Dhām, and your pure service to the Divine Couple will be revealed.”
ভীষ্মদেব-উপদেশ ধরিয়া শ্রবণে ।<br />সাষ্টাঙ্গে পড়িব আমি তাঁহার চরণে ॥<br />আশীর্ব্বাদ করি’ তেঁহ হবে অদর্শন ।<br />কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে যাব মোদদ্রুম বন ॥১০৯॥
bhīṣmadeva-upadeśa dhariyā śravaṇe<br />sāṣṭāṅge paḍiba āmi tā̐hāra charaṇe<br />āśīrvāda kari’ te̐ha habe adarśana<br />kā̐dite kā̐dite yāba modadruma vana [109]
<span class="e2">śravaṇe dhariyā</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">bhīṣmadeva-upadeśa</span>–the instructions of Bhīṣmadev, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">sāṣṭāṅge</span> <span class="e2">paḍiba</span>–will prostrate myself <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at his feet. <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–He <span class="e2">āśīrvāda</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–will bless me [and] <span class="e2">adarśana</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–disappear. <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">yāba</span>–I will go <span class="e2">vana</span>–to the forest <span class="e2">modadruma</span>–in Modadrumadwīp. [109]
Hearing the instructions of Bhīṣmadev, I will prostrate myself at his feet. He will bless me and then disappear. Crying, I will go to the forest in Modadrumadwīp.
মোদদ্রুম শ্রীভাণ্ডীর হয় এক তত্ত্ব ।<br />যথা পশুপক্ষীগনে সব শুদ্ধ সত্ত্ব ॥<br />মনোহর বৃক্ষডালে বসি’ পিকগণ ।<br />গৌরহরি সীতারাম গায় অনুক্ষণ ॥১১০॥
modadruma śrī-bhāṇḍīra haya eka tattva<br />yathā paśu-pakṣī-gaṇe saba śuddha sattva<br />manohara vṛkṣa-ḍāle vasi’ pika-gaṇa<br />gaurahari sītā-rāma gāya anukṣaṇa [110]
<span class="e2">modadruma</span>–Modadrumadwīp <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–one <span class="e2">śrī-bhāṇḍīra</span>–with Śrī Bhāṇḍīravan, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">saba</span>–all <span class="e2">paśu-pakṣī-gaṇe</span>–the animals and birds [are] <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">sattva</span>–spiritual. <span class="e2">pika-gaṇa</span>–Cuckoos <span class="e2">vasi’</span>–live <span class="e2">manohara</span> <span class="e2">vṛkṣa-ḍāle</span>–in the branches of the enchanting trees [and] <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–constantly <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing [about] <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari, <span class="e2">sītā-rāma</span>–Sītā, and Rāma. [110]
Modadrumadwīp is nondifferent from Śrī Bhāṇḍīravan, where all the animals and birds are spiritual. Cuckoos live in the branches of the enchanting trees and constantly sing about Gaurahari, Sītā, and Rāma.
কত কত বটবৃক্ষ ছায়া বিস্তারিয়া ।<br />শোভিছে ভাণ্ডীরবন সূর্য্য আচ্ছাদিয়া ॥<br />রামকৃষ্ণ-লীলাস্থান প্রত্যক্ষ ভুবনে ।<br />কবে বা স্ফুরিবে মোর এ দুই নয়নে ॥১১১॥
kata kata vaṭa-vṛkṣa chhāyā vistāriyā<br />śobhichhe bhāṇḍīravana sūrya āchchhādiyā<br />rāma-kṛṣṇa-līlā-sthāna pratyakṣa bhuvane<br />kabe vā sphūribe mora e dui nayane [111]
<span class="e2">āchchhādiyā</span>–Covering <span class="e2">sūrya</span>–the sun, <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">kata</span>–countless <span class="e2">vaṭa-vṛkṣa</span>–banyan trees <span class="e2">vistāriyā</span>–spread [their] <span class="e2">chhāyā</span>–shade [and] <span class="e2">śobhichhe</span>–beautify <span class="e2">bhāṇḍīravana</span>–Bhāṇḍīravan. <span class="e2">kabe vā</span>–When will <span class="e2">rāma-kṛṣṇa-līlā-sthāna</span>–this place of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes <span class="e2">bhuvane</span>–in this world <span class="e2">pratyakṣa</span> <span class="e2">sphūribe</span>–become visible <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">nayane</span>–before my eyes? [111]
Covering the sun, countless banyan trees spread their shade and beautify Bhāṇḍīravan. When will this place of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes in the world become visible before my eyes?
দেখিয়া বনের শোভা ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে ।<br />শ্রীরামকুটীর চক্ষে পড়ে আচম্বিতে ॥<br />দুর্ব্বাদলবর্ণ রাম ব্রহ্মচারী বেশে ।<br />লক্ষ্মণ জানকীসহ তার এক দেশে ॥১১২॥
dekhiyā vanera śobhā bhramite bhramite<br />śrī-rāma-kuṭīra chakṣe paḍe āchambite<br />durvā-dala-varṇa rāma brahmachārī veśe<br />lakṣmaṇa jānakī-saha tāra eka deśe [112]
<span class="e2">bhramite</span> <span class="e2">bhramite</span>–Wandering about <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–observing <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–the beauty <span class="e2">vanera</span>–of the forest, <span class="e2">śrī-rāma-kuṭīra</span>–the cottage of Lord Rāma <span class="e2">āchambite</span>–suddenly <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–appears <span class="e2">chakṣe</span>–before my eyes. <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">deśe</span>–Within it [are] <span class="e2">lakṣmaṇa</span>–Lakṣmaṇ, <span class="e2">jānakī-saha</span>–Sītā, and <span class="e2">rāma</span>–Rāma, [who is] <span class="e2">durvā-dala-varṇa</span>–grass-green coloured [and] <span class="e2">veśe</span>–in the garb <span class="e2">brahmachārī</span>–of a brahmachārī. [112]
Wandering about observing the beauty of the forest, the cottage of Lord Rāma suddenly appears before my eyes. Within it are Lakṣmaṇ, Sītā, and Rāma, who is grass-green and dressed in the garb of a brahmachārī.
দেখিয়া শ্রীরামচন্দ্ররূপ মনোহর ।<br />অচেতনে পড়িব সে কানন-ভিতর ॥<br />প্রেমে গর গর দেহ না স্ফুরিবে বাণী ।<br />দুই আঁখি ভরি’ পিব সেই রূপখানি ॥১১৩॥
dekhiyā śrī-rāmachandra-rūpa manohara<br />achetane paḍiba se kānana-bhitara<br />preme gara gara deha nā sphuribe vāṇī<br />dui ā̐khi bhari’ piba sei rūpa-khāni [113]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">manohara śrī-rāmachandra-rūpa</span>–the enchanting form of Rāmachandra, <span class="e2">paḍiba</span>–I will fall <span class="e2">achetane</span>–unconscious <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">kānana-bhitara</span>–in the forest. [My] <span class="e2">deha</span>–body <span class="e2">gara</span> <span class="e2">gara</span>–overwhelmed <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love, <span class="e2">nā</span>–no <span class="e2">vāṇī</span>–words <span class="e2">sphuribe</span>–will be spoken. <span class="e2">bhari’</span>–Filling [my] <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">ā̐khi</span>–eyes, <span class="e2">piba</span>–I will drink <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">rūpa-khāni</span>–from the reservoir of His form. [113]
Seeing the enchanting form of Rāmachandra, I will fall unconscious in the forest. My body overwhelmed with divine love, I will become speechless. Filling my eyes, I will drink from the reservoir of His form.
কৃপা করি’ রামানুজ আসি’ ধীরে ধীরে ।<br />বন ফল রাখি’ পদ দিবে মম শিরে ॥<br />বলিবেন, “বৎস তুমি খাও এই ফল ।<br />বনবাসে ফলফুলে আতিথ্য কেবল” ॥১১৪॥
kṛpā kari’ rāmānuja āsi’ dhīre dhīre<br />vana phala rākhi’ pada dibe mama śire<br />balibena, “vatsa tumi khāo ei phala<br />vana-vāse phala-phule ātithya kevala” [114]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully, <span class="e2">rāmānuja</span>–Lakṣmaṇ <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–will come [to me] <span class="e2">dhīre</span> <span class="e2">dhīre</span>–slowly, <span class="e2">rākhi’</span>–set down [His] <span class="e2">vana</span>–forest <span class="e2">phala</span>–fruits, <span class="e2">dibe</span>–place [His] <span class="e2">pada</span>–feet <span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">śire</span>–on my head, [and] <span class="e2">balibena</span>–say, <span class="e2">“vatsa</span>–“[My] child, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">khāo</span>–eat <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">phala</span>–fruits. <span class="e2">vana-vāse</span>–In [Our] forest cottage [We have] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–only <span class="e2">phala-phule</span>–fruits and flowers <span class="e2">ātithya”</span>–to offer guests.” [114]
Mercifully, Lakṣmaṇ will come to me slowly, set down His fruits, place His feet on my head, and say, “My child, eat these fruits. In Our forest cottage We have only fruits and flowers to offer Our guests.”
বলিতে বলিতে লীলা হবে অদর্শন ।<br />কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে ফল করিব ভক্ষণ ॥<br />আর কি দেখিব আমি দুর্ব্বাদল রূপ ।<br />হৃদয়ে ভাবিব সেই অচিন্ত্য-স্বরূপ ॥১১৫॥
balite balite līlā habe adarśana<br />kā̐dite kā̐dite phala kariba bhakṣaṇa<br />āra ki dekhiba āmi durvā-dala rūpa<br />hṛdaye bhāviba sei achintya-svarūpa [115]
<span class="e2">balite</span> <span class="e2">balite</span>–As He speaks, <span class="e2">līlā</span>–this Pastime <span class="e2">adarśana habe</span>–will disappear. <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">bhakṣaṇa kariba</span>–I will eat <span class="e2">phala</span>–the fruits. <span class="e2">āmi ki</span> <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–Will I see [that] <span class="e2">durvā-dala</span>–grass-green <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form <span class="e2">āra</span>–again? <span class="e2">bhāviba</span>–I will meditate <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">achintya-svarūpa</span>–on His inconceivable form <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–within [my] heart. [115]
As He speaks, this Pastime will disappear. Crying, I will eat the fruits. Will I see that grass-green form of Rāmachandra again? I will meditate on His inconceivable form within my heart.
আহা! সে ভাণ্ডীরবন চিন্তামণিধাম ।<br />ছাড়িতে হৃদয় কাঁদে না হয় বিরাম ॥<br />রামকৃষ্ণ করে লীলা গোচারণ-ছলে ।<br />যথায় কীর্ত্তনে মাতে গোরা নিজ দলে ॥১১৬॥
āhā! se bhāṇḍīravana chintāmaṇi-dhāma<br />chhāḍite hṛdaya kā̐de nā haya virāma<br />rāma-kṛṣṇa kare līlā gochāraṇa-chhale<br />yathāya kīrtane māte gorā nija dale [116]
<span class="e2">āhā!</span>–Aha! [My] <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cries <span class="e2">virāma haya nā</span>–incessantly <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–to leave <span class="e2">se</span>–the <span class="e2">chintāmaṇi-dhāma</span>–spiritual abode <span class="e2">bhāṇḍīravana</span>–of Bhāṇḍīravan, <span class="e2">yathāya</span>–where <span class="e2">rāma-kṛṣṇa</span>–Balarām and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">kare</span>–perform <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">gochāraṇa-chhale</span>–on the pretext of herding cows, [and] <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">māte</span>–revels <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–in kīrtan <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">dale</span>–with His associates. [116]
Aha! My heart cries incessantly to leave the spiritual abode of Bhāṇḍīravan, where Balarām and Kṛṣṇa perform Pastimes on the pretext of herding cows, and Gorā revels in kīrtan with His associates.
ধীরে ধীরে যাব তথা শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠপুর ।<br />নিঃশ্রেয়স বন যথা ঐশ্বর্য্য প্রচুর ॥<br />সর্ব্বদেবপ্রপূজিত পরব্যোমনাথ ।<br />নিত্য বিরাজেন যথা শক্তিত্রয়-সাথ ॥১১৭॥
dhīre dhīre yāba tathā śrī-vaikuṇṭha-pura<br />niḥśreyasa vana yathā aiśvarya prachura<br />sarva-deva-prapūjita paravyomanātha<br />nitya virājena yathā śakti-traya-sātha [117]
<span class="e2">dhīre</span> <span class="e2">dhīre</span>–Slowly <span class="e2">yāba</span>–I will go <span class="e2">śrī-vaikuṇṭha-pura tathā</span>–to Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur, <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where [the] <span class="e2">prachura</span>–extremely <span class="e2">aiśvarya</span>–opulent <span class="e2">vana</span>–forest <span class="e2">niḥśreyasa</span>–of Niḥśreyas [is located and] <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where <span class="e2">paravyomanātha</span>–the Lord of the spiritual sky, [who is] <span class="e2">sarva-deva-prapūjita</span>–worshipped by all the gods, <span class="e2">virājena</span>–resides <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally <span class="e2">śakti-traya-sātha</span>–with His three energies (līlā, bhū, and śrī). [117]
Slowly I will go to Śrī Vaikuṇṭhapur, where the extremely opulent Niḥśreyas forest is located and the Lord of the spiritual sky, who is worshipped by all the gods, resides eternally with His three energies.
যদিও মাধুর্য্যময় শ্রীকৃষ্ণ আমার ।<br />তবুও ঈশ্বর তেঁহ সর্ব্বৈশ্বর্য্যধর ॥<br />ঐশ্বর্য্য না ছাড়ে কৃষ্ণ ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ।<br />ঐশ্বর্য্য না দেখে তবু কৃষ্ণভক্তজন ॥১১৮॥
yadio mādhuryamaya śrī-kṛṣṇa āmāra<br />tabuo īśvara te̐ha sarvaiśvarya-dhara<br />aiśvarya nā chhāḍe kṛṣṇa vrajendra-nandana<br />aiśvarya nā dekhe tabu kṛṣṇa-bhakta-jana [118]
<span class="e2">yadio tabuo</span>–Although <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">mādhuryamaya</span>–full of sweetness, <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–the Supreme Lord [and] <span class="e2">sarvaiśvarya-dhara</span>–the possessor of all opulence. [As] <span class="e2">vrajendra-nandana</span>–the prince of Vraja, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nā</span>–does not <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–abandon [His] <span class="e2">aiśvarya</span>–opulence. <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta-jana</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s devotees <span class="e2">nā</span>–do not <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see [His] <span class="e2">aiśvarya</span>–opulence. [118]
Although my Śrī Kṛṣṇa is full of sweetness, He is the Supreme Lord and possessor of all opulence. As the prince of Vraja, Kṛṣṇa does not abandon His opulence. Still, His devotees do not see it.
কৃপা করি’ সর্ব্বেশ্বর ঐশ্য লুকাইয়া ।<br />তুষিতে নারদচিত্ত গৌরাঙ্গ হইয়া ॥<br />দেখিয়া সে রূপ আমি আনন্দসাগরে ।<br /> ডুবু ডুবু নাচিব কাঁদিব উচ্চৈঃস্বরে ॥১১৯॥
kṛpa kari’ sarveśvara aiśya lukāiyā<br />tuṣite nārada-chitta gaurāṅga ha-iyā<br />dekhiyā se rūpa āmi ānanda-sāgare<br />ḍubu ḍubu nāchiba kā̐diba uchchaiḥ-svare [119]
<span class="e2">kṛpa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully, <span class="e2">sarveśvara</span>–the Supreme Lord <span class="e2">lukāiyā</span>–hid [His] <span class="e2">aiśya</span>–opulence [and] <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–became <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">tuṣite</span>–to please <span class="e2">nārada-chitta</span>–the heart of Nārad. <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">se</span>–that <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">ḍubu</span> <span class="e2">ḍubu</span>–will dive <span class="e2">ānanda-sāgare</span>–in an ocean of joy, <span class="e2">nāchiba</span>–dance, [and] <span class="e2">kā̐diba</span>–cry <span class="e2">uchchaiḥ-svare</span>–aloud. [119]
Mercifully, the Supreme Lord hid His opulence and became Gaurāṅga to please the heart of Nārad. Seeing that form, I will dive into an ocean of joy, dance, and cry aloud.
হইয়া বিরজা পার ব্রহ্মাণীনগর ।<br />ছাড়িয়া উঠিব অর্কটীলার উপর ॥<br />তথা বসি’ একান্তে ভজিব গৌরহরি ।<br />নামসুধারসে মাতি নাম গান করি’ ॥১২০॥
ha-iyā virajā pāra brahmāṇī-nagara<br />chhāḍiyā uṭhiba arka-ṭīlāra upara<br />tathā basi’ ekānte bhajiba gaurahari<br />nāma-sudhā-rase māti nāma gāna kari’ [120]
<span class="e2">pāra</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Crossing <span class="e2">virajā</span>–the Virajā [and] <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leaving <span class="e2">brahmāṇī-nagara</span>–Brahmāṇī Nagar, <span class="e2">uṭhiba</span>–I will climb <span class="e2">upara</span>–on top <span class="e2">arka-ṭīlāra</span>–of Arka Ṭīlā. <span class="e2">basi’</span>–Sitting <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there, [I will] <span class="e2">ekānte</span>–earnestly <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari, <span class="e2">gāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name, [and] <span class="e2">māti</span>–become mad <span class="e2">nāma-sudhā-rase</span>–with the Name’s nectar. [120]
Crossing the Virajā and leaving Brahmāṇī Nagar, I will climb to the top of Arka Ṭīlā. Sitting there, I will earnestly worship Gaurahari, chant the Name, and become mad with the Name’s nectar.
অর্কদেব কৃপা করি’ দিবে দরশন ।<br />রক্তবর্ণ দীর্ঘবাহু অরুণ বসন ॥<br />সর্ব্বাঙ্গ তুলসীমালা চর্চিত চন্দনে ।<br />মুখে সদা গৌরহরি অশ্রু দু’নয়নে ॥১২১॥
arkadeva kṛpā kari’ dibe daraśana<br />rakta-varṇa dīrgha-bāhu aruṇa vasana<br />sarvāṅga tulasī-mālā charchita chandane<br />mukhe sadā gaurahari aśru du’nayane [121]
[With] <span class="e2">dīrgha-bāhu</span>–long arms, <span class="e2">aruṇa</span> <span class="e2">vasana</span>–saffron garments, <span class="e2">rakta-varṇa</span>–a red complexion, <span class="e2">chandane</span>–sandalwood paste <span class="e2">charchita</span>–smeared <span class="e2">sarvāṅga</span>–all over [his] body, <span class="e2">tulasī-mālā</span>–tulasī-mālā [in his hand], <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–‘Gaurahari’ <span class="e2">sadā</span>–constantly <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–in [his] mouth, [and] <span class="e2">aśru</span>–tears <span class="e2">du’nayane</span>–in [his] eyes, <span class="e2">arkadeva</span>–the sun-god [will] <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">daraśana dibe</span>–appear [before me]. [121]
With long arms, saffron garments, a red complexion, sandalwood paste smeared all over his body, tulasī-mālā in his hand, the Name of Gaurahari resonating in his mouth, and tears in his eyes, Arkadev will mercifully appear before me.
বলিবেন, “বৎস তুমি গৌরভক্তদাস ।<br />তোমার নিকটে আমি হইনু প্রকাশ ॥<br />অধিকৃতদাস মোরা গৌরাঙ্গচরণে ।<br />গৌরদাস অনুদাসে ভালবাসি মনে ॥১২২॥
balibena, “vatsa tumi gaura-bhakta-dāsa<br />tomāra nikaṭe āmi ha-inu prakāśa<br />adhikṛta-dāsa morā gaurāṅga-charaṇe<br />gaura-dāsa anudāse bhālabāsi mane [122]
<span class="e2">balibena</span>–He will say, <span class="e2">“vatsa</span>–“My boy, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are a] <span class="e2">gaura-bhakta-dāsa</span>–servant of the devotees of Gaura. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">prakāśa ha-inu</span>–have appeared <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–before you. <span class="e2">morā</span>–We [are] <span class="e2">adhikṛta-dāsa</span>–servants <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-charaṇe</span>–of the feet of Gaurāṅga, [and] <span class="e2">mane</span>–at heart <span class="e2">bhālabāsi</span>–we love <span class="e2">gaura-dāsa</span> <span class="e2">anudāse</span>–the servants of the servants of Gaura. [122]
He will say, “My boy, you are a servant of the devotees of Gaura. Thus I have appeared before you. We are slaves of the feet of Gaurāṅga, and at heart we love the servants of the servants of Gaura.
মম আশীর্ব্বাদে তব হবে কৃষ্ণভক্তি ।<br />ধামবাসে নামগানে হবে তব শক্তি ॥<br />সুধামাখা কৃষ্ণনাম গাইতে গাইতে ।<br />সর্ব্বদা আসিও হেথা আমারে তুষিতে” ॥১২৩॥
mama āśīrvāde tava habe kṛṣṇa-bhakti<br />dhāma-vāse nāma-gāne habe tava śakti<br />sudhā-mākhā kṛṣṇa-nāma gāite gāite<br />sarvadā āsio hethā āmāre tuṣite” [123]
<span class="e2">mama</span> <span class="e2">āśīrvāde</span>–With my blessing, <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">tava habe</span>–you will attain<span class="e2"> śakti</span>–the strength <span class="e2">dhāma-vāse</span>–to reside in the Dhām [and] <span class="e2">nāma-gāne</span>–chant the Name. <span class="e2">āmāre</span> <span class="e2">tuṣite</span>–To please me, <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always <span class="e2">āsio</span>–come <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">gāite</span> <span class="e2">gāite</span>–chanting <span class="e2">sudhā-mākhā</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma”</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s nectar-packed Name.” [123]
“With my blessing, you will attain devotion to Kṛṣṇa and the strength to reside in the Dhām and chant the Name. To please me, always come here chanting Kṛṣṇa’s nectarean Name.”
সূর্য্যদেবপদে করি’ দণ্ডপরণাম ।<br />অগ্রসর হয়ে পাব মহৎপুর ধাম ॥<br />মহৎপুর কাম্যবন কৃষ্ণলীলাস্থল ।<br />যথা গৌরগণ করে কৃষ্ণকোলাহল ॥১২৪॥
sūryadeva-pade kari’ daṇḍa-paraṇāma<br />agrasara haye pāba mahatpura dhāma<br />mahatpura kāmyavana kṛṣṇa-līlā-sthala<br />yathā gaura-gaṇa kare kṛṣṇa-kolāhala [124]
<span class="e2">daṇḍa-paraṇāma kari’</span>–I will bow <span class="e2">sūryadeva-pade</span>–at the feet of the sun-god, <span class="e2">agrasara</span> <span class="e2">haye</span>–proceed on, [and] <span class="e2">pāba</span>–reach <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–the abode of<span class="e2"> mahatpura</span>–Mahatpur. <span class="e2">mahatpura</span>–Mahatpur [is] <span class="e2">kāmyavana</span>–Kāmyavan <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā-sthala</span>–in the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">yathā</span>–Here, <span class="e2">gaura-gaṇa</span>–the followers of Gaura <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kolāhala kare</span>–loudly chant about Kṛṣṇa. [124]
I will bow at the feet of Sūryadev, proceed on, and reach the abode of Mahatpur, which is Kāmyavan in the Pastimes of Kṛṣṇa. Here, the followers of Gaura loudly chant about Kṛṣṇa.
যুধিষ্ঠির আদি পঞ্চ ভাই যেই বনে ।<br />কত দিন বাস কৈল দ্রৌপদীর সনে ॥<br />ব্যাসদেব আনি’ গৌরপুরাণ শুনিল ।<br />একান্তে শ্রীগৌরহরি ভজন করিল ॥১২৫॥
yudhiṣṭhira ādi pañcha bhāi yei vane<br />kata dina vāsa kaila draupadīra sane<br />vyāsadeva āni’ gaura-purāṇa śunila<br />ekānte śrī-gaurahari bhajana karila [125]
<span class="e2">pañcha</span> <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–The five brothers, <span class="e2">yudhiṣṭhira</span>–Yudhiṣṭhir <span class="e2">ādi</span>–and so on, <span class="e2">vāsa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–resided <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in this forest <span class="e2">draupadīra sane</span>–with Draupadī <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–for some time. <span class="e2">āni’</span>–They brought <span class="e2">vyāsadeva</span>–Vyāsadev [here,] <span class="e2">śunila</span>–heard <span class="e2">gaura-purāṇa</span>–the <span class="e3">Gaura-purāṇa</span>, [and] <span class="e2">ekānte</span>–earnestly <span class="e2">bhajana</span> <span class="e2">karila</span>–worshipped <span class="e2">śrī-gaurahari</span>–Śrī Gaurahari. [125]
The five brothers led by Mahārāj Yudhiṣṭhir resided in this forest with Draupadī for some time. They brought Vyāsadev here, heard the <span class="e3">Gaura-purāṇa</span>, and earnestly worshipped Śrī Gaurahari.
অদ্যাপিও কাম্যবনে দেখে ভক্তজন ।<br />যুধিষ্ঠিরসভা যথা বৈসে ঋষিগণ ॥<br />ভৌম শুক দেবল চ্যবন গর্গমুনি ।<br />বৃক্ষতলে বসি’ কাঁদে গৌরকথা শুনি’ ॥১২৬॥
adyāpio kāmyavane dekhe bhakta-jana<br />yudhiṣṭhira-sabhā yathā baise ṛṣi-gaṇa<br />bhauma śuka devala chyavana garga-muni<br />vṛkṣa-tale vasi’ kā̐de gaura-kathā śuni’ [126]
<span class="e2">adyāpio</span>–Still today <span class="e2">kāmyavane</span>–in Kāmyavan, <span class="e2">bhakta-jana</span>–devotees <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">ṛṣi-gaṇa</span>–the sages <span class="e2">baise</span>–sitting <span class="e2">yathā</span>–here [in] <span class="e2">yudhiṣṭhira-sabhā</span>–Yudhiṣṭhir’s assembly. <span class="e2">bhauma</span>–Bhauma, <span class="e2">śuka</span>–Śuka, <span class="e2">devala</span>–Devala, <span class="e2">chyavana</span>–Chyavan, [and] <span class="e2">garga-muni</span>–Garga Muni <span class="e2">basi’</span>–sit <span class="e2">vṛkṣa-tale</span>–at the base of a tree [and] <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cry, <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–listening <span class="e2">gaura-kathā</span>–to the glories of Gaura. [126]
Still today in Kāmyavan, devotees see the sages sitting in Mahārāj Yudhiṣṭhir’s assembly. Bhauma, Śuka, Devala, Chyavan, and Garga Muni sit at the base of a tree and cry, listening to the glories of Gaura.
আমি কবে সে সভায় করিব গমন ।<br />দূরে দণ্ডবৎ করি’ আসিব তখন ॥<br />পাষণ্ড-উদ্ধার-লীলা গৌর-ইতিহাস ।<br />ব্যাসমুখে শুনি’ প্রেমে ছাড়িব নিঃশ্বাস ॥১২৭॥
āmi kabe se sabhāya kariba gamana<br />dūre daṇḍavat kari’ āsiba takhana<br />pāṣaṇḍa-uddhāra-līlā gaura-itihāsa<br />vyāsa-mukhe śuni’ preme chhāḍiba niḥśvāsa [127]
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–When <span class="e2">āmi</span> <span class="e2">gamana kariba</span>–will I go <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sabhāya</span>–to that assembly <span class="e2">daṇḍavat kari’</span>–bow <span class="e2">dūre</span>–from a distance, [and] <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">āsiba</span>–join them? <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">gaura-itihāsa</span>–accounts of Gaura’s <span class="e2">pāṣaṇḍa-uddhāra-līlā</span>–Pastimes of delivering the fallen souls <span class="e2">vyāsa-mukhe</span>–from the mouth of Vyāsadev, <span class="e2">niḥśvāsa chhāḍiba</span>–I will sigh <span class="e2">preme</span>–with divine love. [127]
