<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-chaitanya-viśeṣa</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya Himself [is] <span class="e2">pratiṣṭhā</span>–the origin <span class="e2">brahmera</span>–of Brahma; <span class="e2">brahma</span>–Brahma [is] <span class="e2">nirviśeṣa jyoti</span>–the nondifferentiated lustre <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">śrī-aṅgera</span>–of His divine form.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya Himself is the origin of Brahma; Brahma is the nondifferentiated lustre of His divine form.
অতএব ‘একাত্মা’ শব্দেতে শ্রীচৈতন্য ।<br />বুঝেন পণ্ডিতগণ স্বরূপাদি ধন্য ॥৪৭॥
ataeva ‘ekātmā’ śabdete śrī-chaitanya<br />bujhena paṇḍita-gaṇa svarūpādi dhanya [47]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">svarūpādi dhanya paṇḍita-gaṇa</span>–Svarūp Dāmodar and other renowned scholars <span class="e2">bujhena</span>–understand <span class="e2">śabdete</span>–the word <span class="e2">‘ekātmā’</span>–<span class="e33">ekātmā</span> [to mean] <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya.
Thus, Svarūp Dāmodar and other renowned scholars understand <span class="e3">ekātmā</span> to mean Śrī Chaitanya.
সেই ত’ ‘একাত্মা’-তত্ত্বে কর পরণাম ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণসেবা পাবে, সিদ্ধ হবে কাম ॥৪৮॥
sei ta’ ‘ekātmā’-tattve kara paraṇāma<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā pābe, siddha habe kāma [48]
<span class="e2">paraṇāma kara</span>–Bow <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">‘ekātmā’-tattve</span>–to that <span class="e33">ekātmā</span> (‘one being’). <span class="e2">pābe</span>–You will attain <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa’s service, [and your] <span class="e2">kāma</span>–desires <span class="e2">siddha</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be fulfilled.
Bow down to that <span class="e3">ekātmā</span> (‘one being’). You will attain Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa’s service, and all your desires will be fulfilled.
পরমাত্মা শ্রীচৈতন্যের অংশ
paramātmā śrī-chaitanyera aṁśa
The Supersoul is Śrī Chaitanya’s expansion
যদি বল ‘একাত্মা’ শব্দে হয় পরমাত্মা ।<br />যাহা হইতে রাধাকৃষ্ণ হয় দুই আত্মা ॥৪৯॥
yadi bala ‘ekātmā’ śabde haya paramātmā<br />yāhā ha-ite rādhā-kṛṣṇa haya dui ātmā [49]
<span class="e2">yadi</span> <span class="e2">bala</span>–You may say [that] <span class="e2">śabde</span>–the word <span class="e2">‘ekātmā’</span>–<span class="e33">ekātmā</span> (‘one being’) <span class="e2">haya</span>–means <span class="e2">paramātmā</span>–the Supersoul (the all-pervading Soul of all beings), <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">haya</span>–have become <span class="e2">dui</span>–two <span class="e2">ātmā</span>–beings.
You may say that <span class="e3">ekātmā</span> (‘one being’) means the Supersoul, from which Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa have become two beings.
শ্লোকের আভাসে তাহা কভু নহে সিদ্ধ ।<br />“চৈতন্যাখ্য”-শব্দে হয় বড়ই বিরুদ্ধ ॥৫০॥
ślokera ābhāse tāhā kabhu nahe siddha<br />“chaitanyākhya”-śabde haya baḍa-i viruddha [50]
<span class="e2">tāhā</span>–That <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">siddha nahe</span>–is never <span class="e2">ābhāse</span>–the intention <span class="e2">ślokera</span>–of the verse. <span class="e2">“chaitanyākhya”-śabde</span>–The word <span class="e33">Chaitanyākhya</span> (‘known as “Chaitanya”’) <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span>–completely <span class="e2">viruddha</span>–contradictory [to this].
That can never be the intended meaning of the verse, however, because the word <span class="e3">Chaitanyākhya</span> (‘known as ‘Chaitanya’’) is completely contradictory to this.
মূলতত্ত্ব শ্রীচৈতন্যস্বরূপ জানিবা ।<br />তাঁহার অংশ পরমাত্মা সর্ব্বদা বুঝিবা ॥৫১॥
mūla-tattva śrī-chaitanya-svarūpa jānibā<br />tā̐hāra aṁśa paramātmā sarvadā bujhibā [51]
<span class="e2">jānibā</span>–Understand [that] <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya-svarūpa</span>–Śrī Chaitanya Himself [is] <span class="e2">mūla-tattva</span>–the original truth, [and] <span class="e2">bujhibā</span>–understand [that] <span class="e2">paramātmā</span>–the Supersoul [is] <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span>–His <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–eternal <span class="e2">aṁśa</span>–expansion.
Understand that Śrī Chaitanya is the original truth, and that the Supersoul is His eternal expansion.
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-ঐক্য সেই ‘একাত্ম’-স্বরূপ ।<br />শ্রীচৈতন্য মোর প্রাণ-নাথ অপরূপ ॥৫২॥
rādhā-kṛṣṇa-aikya sei ‘ekātma’-svarūpa<br />śrī-chaitanya mora prāṇa-nātha aparūpa [52]
<span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-aikya</span>–The combination of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">‘ekātma’-svarūpa</span>–the form of that <span class="e33">ekātmā</span> (‘one being’), [is] <span class="e2">śrī-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Chaitanya, [the] <span class="e2">aparūpa</span>–sublime <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">prāṇa-nātha</span>–Lord of my heart.
The combination of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, the form of that <span class="e3">ekātmā</span> (‘one being’), is Śrī Chaitanya, the sublime Lord of my heart.
রাধাপদ-দাসী আমি রাধাপদ-দাসী ।<br />রাধা দ্যুতি সুবলিত রূপ ভালবাসি ॥৫৩॥
rādhā-pada-dāsī āmi rādhā-pada-dāsī<br />rādhā-dyuti-suvalita rūpa bhālavāsi [53]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">rādhā-pada-dāsī</span>–a maidservant of Rādhā’s feet. [I am] <span class="e2">rādhā-pada-dāsī</span>–a maidservant of Rādhā’s feet, [and] <span class="e2">bhālavāsi</span>–I love <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–the form [that is] <span class="e2">rādhā-dyuti-suvalita</span>–adorned with Her halo.
I am a maidservant of Rādhā’s feet. I am a maidservant of Rādhā’s feet, and I love the form of the Lord that is adorned with Her halo.
পরাৎপর শচীসুত তাঁহার চরণে ।<br />দণ্ড-পরণাম মোর অনন্যশরণে ॥৫৪॥
parātpara śachī-suta tā̐hara charaṇe<br />daṇḍa-paraṇāma mora ananya-śaraṇe [54]
<span class="e2">śachī-suta</span>–The son of Śachī (Śrī Chaitanya) [is] <span class="e2">parātpara</span>–the Supreme Being, [and] <span class="e2">daṇḍa-paraṇāma</span>–I bow <span class="e2">tā̐hara</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at His feet. [He is] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">ananya-śaraṇe</span>–sole shelter.
The son of Śachī is the Supreme Being, and I bow at His feet. He is my sole shelter.

Chapter Two
গ্রন্থরচনা
Grantha-rachanā
The Composition of this Book
চৈতন্যের রূপ গুণ সদা পড়ে মনে ।<br />পরাণ কাঁদায় দেহ ফাঁপায় সঘনে ॥১॥
chaitanyera rūpa guṇa sadā paḍe mane<br />parāṇa kā̐dāya, deha phā̐pāya saghane [1]
<span class="e2">chaitanyera</span>–Śrī Chaitanya’s <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–form [and] <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–qualities <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–come <span class="e2">mane</span>–to [my] mind, [and thus my] <span class="e2">parāṇa</span>–heart <span class="e2">kā̐dāya</span>–cries, [and my] <span class="e2">deha</span>–body <span class="e2">saghane</span>–constantly <span class="e2">phā̐pāya</span>–swells.
Śrī Chaitanya’s form and qualities always come to my mind, and thus my heart cries, and my body constantly swells.
কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে মনে হইল উদয় ।<br />লেখনী ধরিয়া লিখি ছাড়ি’ লাজ ভয় ॥২॥
kā̐dite kā̐dite mane ha-ila udaya<br />lekhanī dhariyā likhi chhāḍi’ lāja bhaya [2]
<span class="e2">kā̐dite</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dite</span>–As I cry, <span class="e2">dhariyā</span>–I hold <span class="e2">lekhanī</span>–a pen [and] <span class="e2">likhi</span>–write [what] <span class="e2">udaya ha-ila</span>–arises <span class="e2">mane</span>–in [my] mind, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leaving aside [my] <span class="e2">lāja</span>–shame [and] <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–fear.
As I cry, I hold a pen and write what comes to mind, leaving aside my shame and fear.
নামেতে ‘পণ্ডিত’ মাত্র, ঘটে কিছু নাই ।<br />চৈতন্যের লীলা তবু লিখিবারে চাই ॥৩॥
nāmete ‘paṇḍita’ mātra, ghaṭe kichhu nāi<br />chaitanyera līlā tabu likhibāre chāi [3]
[I am] <span class="e2">‘paṇḍita’</span>–a ‘paṇḍit’ (scholar) <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–in name <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only. <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is nothing <span class="e2">ghaṭe</span>–in [my] pot (head). <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">chāi</span>–I want <span class="e2">likhibāre</span>–to write <span class="e2">chaitanyera</span> <span class="e2">līlā</span>–about Śrī Chaitanya’s Pastimes.
I am a paṇḍit in name only. There is nothing in my pot. Still, I want to write about Śrī Chaitanya’s Pastimes.
স্বরূপ গোসাঞি ও পণ্ডিত জগদানন্দ
svarūpa gosāñi o paṇḍita jagadānanda
Svarūp Gosāñi and Paṇḍit Jagadānanda
গোসাঞি স্বরূপ বলে, “কি লিখ পণ্ডিত” ।<br />আমি বলি, “লিখি তাই যাহাতে পীরিত ॥৪॥
gosāñi svarūpa bale, “ki likha paṇḍita”<br />āmi bali, “likhi tāi yāhāte pīrita [4]
<span class="e2">svarūpa gosāñi</span>–Svarūp Dāmodar <span class="e2">bale</span>–said [to me,] <span class="e2">“paṇḍita</span>–“O Paṇḍit, <span class="e2">ki</span>–what <span class="e2">likha”</span>–are you writing?” <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bali</span>–said, <span class="e2">“likhi</span>–“I write <span class="e2">tāi</span> <span class="e2">yāhāte</span>–about whom <span class="e2">pīrita</span>–I love.
Svarūp Dāmodar asked me, “O Paṇḍit, what are you writing?” I replied, “I am writing about whom I love.
চৈতন্যের লীলাকথা যাহা পড়ে মনে ।<br />লিখিয়া রাখিব আমি অতি সঙ্গোপনে” ॥৫॥
chaitanyera līlā-kathā yāhā paḍe mane<br />likhiyā rākhiba āmi ati saṅgopane” [5]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">likhiyā</span> <span class="e2">rākhiba</span>–will write down <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–what <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–comes <span class="e2">mane</span>–to mind <span class="e2">chaitanyera</span> <span class="e2">līlā-kathā</span>–about Śrī Chaitanya’s Pastimes <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">saṅgopane”</span>–very confiden­tially.”
“I am very confidentially writing down whatever comes to my mind about Śrī Chaitanya’s Pastimes.”
স্বরূপ বলেন, “তবে লিখ প্রভুর চরিত ।<br />যাহা পড়ি’ জগতের হবে বড় হিত” ॥৬॥
svarūpa balena, “tabe likha prabhura charita<br />yāhā paḍi’ jagatera habe baḍa hita” [6]
<span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–Svarūp Dāmodar <span class="e2">balena</span>–said, <span class="e2">“tabe</span>–“Then <span class="e2">likha</span>–write <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">charita</span>–about the Pastimes of the Lord <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">jagatera baḍa</span> <span class="e2">hita</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–the world will be greatly benefitted <span class="e2">paḍi’”</span>–by reading [about].”
Svarūp Dāmodar said, “Then write about the Pastimes of the Lord that the world will be greatly benefitted by reading about.”
আমি বলি, “জগতের হিত নাহি জানি ।<br />যাহা যাহা ভাল লাগে তাই লিখে আনি” ॥৭॥
āmi bali, “jagatera hita nāhi jāni<br />yāhā yāhā bhāla lāge tāi likhe āni” [7]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bali</span>–replied, <span class="e2">“jāni nāhi</span>–“I do not know [what is] <span class="e2">hita</span>–beneficial <span class="e2">jagatera</span>–for the world. <span class="e2">likhe</span> <span class="e2">āni</span>–I write <span class="e2">tāi</span> <span class="e2">yāhā</span> <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–whatever <span class="e2">bhāla</span> <span class="e2">lāge”</span>–appeals [to me.]”
I replied, “I don’t know what is beneficial for the world. I just write whatever I like.”
স্বরূপ ছাড়িল মোরে বাতুল বলিয়া ।<br />একা বসি’ লিখি আমি প্রভু ধেয়াইয়া ॥৮॥
svarūpa chhāḍila more bātula baliyā<br />ekā basi’ likhi āmi prabhu dheyāiya [8]
<span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–Svarūp <span class="e2">chhāḍila</span>–left, <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–considering <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">bātula</span>–mad. <span class="e2">basi’</span>–Sitting <span class="e2">ekā</span>–alone, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">likhi</span>–write, <span class="e2">dheyāiya</span>–meditating <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–on the Lord.
Svarūp left, considering me mad. Sitting alone, I write, meditating on the Lord.
দেখিছি অনেক লীলা থাকি’ প্রভু সঙ্গে ।<br />কিছু কিছু লিখি তাই নিজ মনোরঙ্গে ॥৯॥
dekhichhi aneka līlā thāki’ prabhu-saṅge<br />kichhu kichhu likhi tāi nija mano-raṅge [9]
<span class="e2">dekhichhi</span>–I saw <span class="e2">aneka</span>–many <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes [while] <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–living <span class="e2">prabhu-saṅge</span>–with the Lord, [and] <span class="e2">likhi</span>–I write <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">kichhu tāi</span>–some of them, <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">mano-raṅge</span>–as is pleasing to my mind.
I saw many Pastimes while living with the Lord, and I write about some of them, as is pleasing to my mind.
মন কাঁদে, প্রাণ কাঁদে, কাঁদে দুটী আঁখি ।<br />যখন যাহা মনে পড়ে তখন তাহা লিখি ॥১০॥
mana kā̐de, prāṇa kā̐de, kā̐de duṭī ā̐khi<br />yakhana yāhā mane paḍe takhana tāhā likhi [10]
[My] <span class="e2">mana</span>–mind <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cries, [my] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–heart <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cries, [my] <span class="e2">duṭī</span> <span class="e2">ā̐khi</span>–two eyes <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cry, [and] <span class="e2">yakhana</span>–when <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–something <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–comes <span class="e2">mane</span>–to mind, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">tāhā</span> <span class="e2">likhi</span>–I write it down.
My mind cries, my heart cries, my eyes cry, and whenever something comes to mind, I write it down.
মহাপ্রভু ও গ্রন্থকার
mahāprabhu o granthakāra
Śrīman Mahāprabhu and the author
প্রভু মোরে হাস্য করি’ কৈল এক দিন ।<br />“দ্বারকার পাটেশ্বরী তুমি ত’ প্রবীন ॥১১॥
prabhu more hāsya kari’ kaila eka-dina<br />“dvārakāra pāṭeśvarī tumi ta’ pravīṇa [11]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">hāsya</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–smiled <span class="e2">more</span>–at me [and] <span class="e2">kaila</span>–said, <span class="e2">“tumi</span>–You [are the] <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">pravīṇa</span>–renowned <span class="e2">pāṭeśvarī</span>–queen <span class="e2">dvārakāra</span>–of Dvārakā.
One day, the Lord smiled at me and said, “You are the renowned queen of Dvārakā.
আমি ত’ ভিখারী অতি, মোরে সেব কেন ।<br />কত শত সন্ন্যাসী পাইবে আমা হেন” ॥১২॥
āmi ta’ bhikhārī ati, more seva kena<br />kata śata sannyāsī pāibe āmā hena” [12]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">ta’ ati</span> <span class="e2">bhikhārī</span>–a poor beggar. <span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">more</span> <span class="e2">seva</span>–do you serve Me? <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–You will find <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">śata</span>–hundreds <span class="e2">sannyāsī</span>–of sannyāsīs <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">hena”</span>–like Me.”
“I am a poor beggar. Why do you serve Me? You will find hundreds of sannyāsīs like Me.”
মুঞি বলি, “রেখে দাও তোমার ছলনা ।<br />রাধাপদ-দাসী আমি, ও কথা বলো না ।১৩॥।
muñi bali, “rekhe dāo tomāra chhalanā<br />rādhā-pada-dāsī āmi, o kathā balo nā [13]
<span class="e2">muñi</span>–I <span class="e2">bali</span>–said, <span class="e2">“rekhe</span> <span class="e2">dāo</span>–“Stop <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">chhalanā</span>–tricks. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">rādhā-pada-dāsī</span>–a maidservant of Rādhā’s feet. <span class="e2">o kathā</span> <span class="e2">balo</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–Do not say that.
I said, “Stop Your tricks. I am a maidservant of Rādhā’s feet. Do not speak that way.
আমার রাধার বর্ণ করিয়াছ চুরি ।<br />ব্রজে লয়ে যাব আমি তোমায় চোর ধরি’ ॥১৪॥
āmāra rādhāra varṇa kariyāchha churi<br />vraje laye yāba āmi tomāya chora dhari’ [14]
<span class="e2">churi kariyāchha</span>–You stole <span class="e2">varṇa</span>–the complexion <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">rādhāra</span>–of my Rādhā, [You] <span class="e2">chora</span>–thief! <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–am going to catch <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–You [and] <span class="e2">laye</span> <span class="e2">yāba</span>–bring [You back] <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja.
“You stole the complexion of my Rādhā, You thief! I am going to catch You and bring You back to Vraja.
আমি চাই রাধাপদ, তুমি ফেল ঠেলি’ ।<br />দ্বারকা পাঠাও মোরে, এই তোমার কেলি ॥১৫॥
āmi chāi rādhā-pada, tumi phela ṭheli’<br />dvārakā pāṭhāo more, ei tomāra keli [15]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">chāi</span>–want <span class="e2">rādhā-pada</span>–Rādhā’s feet, [but] <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">ṭheli’ phela</span>–push [me] aside [and] <span class="e2">pāṭhāo</span>–send <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">dvārakā</span>–to Dvārakā. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">keli</span>–play.
“I want Rādhā’s feet, but You want to push me aside and send me to Dvārakā. This is Your play.
তোমার সন্ন্যাসি-গিরি আমি ভাল জানি ।<br />মোদের বঞ্চিয়া রাধা সেবিবে আপনি” ॥১৬॥
tomāra sannyāsi-giri āmi bhāla jāni<br />modera vañchiyā rādhā sevibe āpani” [16]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bhāla</span> <span class="e2">jāni</span>–understand well <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">sannyāsi-giri</span>–act as a sannyāsī. <span class="e2">modera</span> <span class="e2">vañchiyā</span>–You will trick us [and] <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhā</span>–Rādhā <span class="e2">āpani”</span>–Yourself.”
“I understand perfectly Your act as a sannyāsī. You want to trick us and serve Rādhā Yourself.”
বাল্য-ঘটনা-স্মরণে গ্রন্থকারের আক্ষেপোক্তি
bālya-ghaṭanā-smaraṇe granthakārera ākṣepokti
The author’s lament in remembrance of the Lord’s childhood Pastimes
আহা সে চৈতন্য পদ	ভজনের সম্পদ<br />	কোথা এবে গেল আমা ছাড়ি’<br />আমাকে ফেলিয়া গেল	মৃত্যু মোর না হৈল<br />	শোকে আমি যাই গড়াগড়ি ॥১৭॥
āhā se chaitanya-pada	bhajanera sampada<br />	kothā ebe gela āmā chhāḍi’<br />āmāke pheliyā gela	mṛtyu mora nā ha-ila<br />	śoke āmi yāi gaḍāgaḍi [17]
<span class="e2">āhā</span>–Oh! <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">chaitanya-pada</span>–Śrī Chaitanya’s feet [are] <span class="e2">sampada</span>–the wealth <span class="e2">bhajanera</span>–of devotion. <span class="e2">kothā</span>–Where <span class="e2">gela</span>–have they gone <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leaving <span class="e2">āmā</span>–me? <span class="e2">āmāke</span> <span class="e2">pheliyā</span>–They have thrown me away [and] <span class="e2">gela</span>–left, [but] <span class="e2">mora mṛtyu</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila nā</span>–I have not died. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi yāi</span>–wallow <span class="e2">śoke</span>–in lamentation.
Oh! Śrī Chaitanya’s feet are the wealth of devotion. Where have they gone, leaving me alone? They have thrown me away and left, but I have not died. I simply wallow in lamentation.
একদিন শিশুকালে	দুজনেতে পাঠশালে<br />	কোন্দলে করিনু হাতাহাতি ।<br />মায়াপুরে গঙ্গাতীরে	পড়িয়া দুঃখের ভারে<br />	কাঁঁদিলাম এক দিন রাতি ॥১৮॥
eka-dina śiśu-kāle	du-janete pāṭhaśāle<br />	kondale karinu hātāhāti<br />māyāpure gaṅgā-tīre	paḍiyā duḥkhera bhāre<br />	kā̐dilāma eka-dina rāti [18]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">śiśu-kāle</span>–in [our] childhood, <span class="e2">du-janete</span>–we <span class="e2">hātāhāti karinu</span>–fought hand to hand <span class="e2">kondale</span>–in a quarrel <span class="e2">pāṭhaśāle</span>–at school. <span class="e2">duḥkhera</span> <span class="e2">bhāre paḍiyā</span>–I became filled with sadness [and] <span class="e2">kā̐dilāma</span>–cried <span class="e2">eka-dina</span> <span class="e2">rāti</span>–that day and night <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span>–on the bank of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur.
One day, in our childhood, we fought hand to hand in a quarrel at school. I became filled with sadness and cried all day and night on the bank of the Gaṅgā in Māyāpur.
সদয় হইয়া নাথ	না হইতে পরভাত <br />	গদাধরের সঙ্গেতে আসিয়া ।<br />ডাকেন, “জগদানন্দ!	অভিমান বড় মন্দ<br />	কথা বলো বক্রতা ছাড়িয়া” ॥১৯॥
sadaya ha-iyā nātha	nā ha-ite parabhāta<br />	gadādharera saṅgete āsiyā<br />ḍākena, “jagadānanda!	abhimāna baḍa manda<br />	kathā balo vakratā chhāḍiyā” [19]
<span class="e2">sadaya</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Compassionately, <span class="e2">nātha</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–came [to me] <span class="e2">parabhāta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ite nā</span>–before dawn <span class="e2">gadādharera</span> <span class="e2">saṅgete</span>–with Gadādhar [and] <span class="e2">ḍākena</span>–called out, <span class="e2">“jagadānanda!</span>–Jagadānanda! <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–Pride [is] <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–very <span class="e2">manda</span>–bad. <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–Give up [your] <span class="e2">vakratā</span>–crookedness [and] <span class="e2">kathā</span> <span class="e2">balo”</span>–speak [to Me].”
Compassionately, the Lord came to me before dawn with Gadādhar and called out, “Jagadānanda! Pride is very bad. Be straightforward and speak to Me.”
প্রভুর বদন হেরি’	অভিমান দূর করি’<br />	জিজ্ঞাসিলাম, “এত রাত্রে কেন<br />নদীয়ার কড়া ভূমি	চলি’ কষ্ট পাইলে তুমি<br />	মো লাগি’ তোমার কষ্ট হেন” ॥২০॥
prabhura vadana heri’	abhimāna dūra kari’<br />	jijñāsilāma, “eta rātre kena<br />nadīyāra kaḍā bhūmi	chali’ kaṣṭa pāile tumi<br />	mo lāgi’ tomāra kaṣṭa hena” [20]
<span class="e2">heri’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">vadana</span>–face, <span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–I did away with [my] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride [and] <span class="e2">jijñāsilāma</span>–asked, <span class="e2">“kena</span>–“Why <span class="e2">kaṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">tumi pāile</span>–have You taken [such] trouble [and] <span class="e2">chali’</span>–walked [here,] <span class="e2">kaḍā</span> <span class="e2">bhūmi</span>–across the hard ground <span class="e2">nadīyāra</span>–of Nadia, <span class="e2">eta</span> <span class="e2">rātre</span>–so late at night? <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">hena kaṣṭa</span>–Have You taken such trouble <span class="e2">mo</span> <span class="e2">lāgi’”</span>–for me?”
Seeing the Lord’s face, I gave up my pride and asked, “Why have You taken such trouble and walked here, across the hard ground of Nadia, so late at night? Have You taken such trouble for me?”
প্রভু বলে, “চল চল	নিশি অবসান ভেল<br />	গৃহে গিয়া করহ ভোজন ।<br />তব দুঃখ জানি’ মনে	ছিলাম আমি অনশনে<br />	শয্যা ছাড়ি’ ভূমিতে শয়ান ॥২১॥
prabhu bale, “chala chala	niśi avasāna bhela<br />	gṛhe giyā karaha bhojana<br />tava duḥkha jāni’ mane	chhilāma āmi anaśane<br />	śayyā chhāḍi’ bhūmite śayāna [21]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“chala</span>–“Let’s go! <span class="e2">chala</span>–Let’s go! <span class="e2">niśi</span>–The night <span class="e2">avasāna</span> <span class="e2">bhela</span>–has ended. <span class="e2">giyā</span>–Come <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–to [My] house [and] <span class="e2">bhojana karaha</span>–eat. <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Knowing [of] <span class="e2">tava</span>–your <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness <span class="e2">mane</span>–at heart, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">anaśane chhilāma</span>–fasted. <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–I left [My] <span class="e2">śayyā</span>–bed [and] <span class="e2">śayāna</span>–laid <span class="e2">bhūmite</span>–on the ground.
The Lord replied, “Let’s go! Let’s go! The night has ended. Come to My house and eat. Knowing you were sad, I also fasted. I left My bed and laid on the ground.
হেনকালে গদাধর	আইল আমার ঘর<br />	দুঁহে আইনু তোমার তল্লাসে ।<br />ভাল হৈল মান গেল	এবে নিজ গৃহে চল <br />	কালি খেলা করিব উল্লাসে” ॥২২॥
hena-kāle gadādhara	āila āmāra ghara<br />	du̐he āinu tomāra tallāse<br />bhāla haila māna gela	ebe nija gṛhe chala<br />	kāli khelā kariba ullāse” [22]
<span class="e2">hena-kāle</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">ghara</span>–to my room, [and then] <span class="e2">du̐he</span>–we <span class="e2">āinu</span>–came <span class="e2">tallāse</span>–to search <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–for you. <span class="e2">haila</span>–It is <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–good [that your] <span class="e2">māna</span>–pride <span class="e2">gela</span>–has gone. <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">chala</span>–let’s go <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–to My house, [and] <span class="e2">kāli</span>–tomorrow <span class="e2">khelā</span> <span class="e2">kariba</span>–we will play [together] <span class="e2">ullāse”</span>–happily.”
“Gadādhar came to My room, and then we came here to search for you. It is good that your pride is gone. Now let’s go to My house, and tomorrow we will play together happily.”
গদাই-চরণ ধরি’	উঠিলাম ধীরি ধীরি<br />	প্রভু-আজ্ঞা ঠেলিতে না পারি ।<br />প্রভুর গৃহেতে গিয়া	কিছু খাই জল পিয়া<br />	শুইলাম দণ্ড দুই চারি ॥২৩॥
gadāi-charaṇa dhari’	uṭhilāma dhīri dhīri<br />	prabhu-ājñā ṭhelite nā pāri<br />prabhura gṛhete giyā	kichhu khāi jala piyā<br />	śuilāma daṇḍa dui chāri [23]
<span class="e2">dhari’</span>–I grasped <span class="e2">gadāi-charaṇa</span>–Gadāi’s (Gadādhar’s) feet [and] <span class="e2">dhīri</span> <span class="e2">dhīri</span>–slowly <span class="e2">uṭhilāma</span>–got up. <span class="e2">ṭhelite</span> <span class="e2">pāri nā</span>–I could not disobey <span class="e2">prabhu-ājñā</span>–the Lord’s order. <span class="e2">giyā</span>–I went <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">gṛhete</span>–to the Lord’s home, <span class="e2">khāi</span>–ate<span class="e2"> kichhu</span>–something, <span class="e2">piyā</span>–drank [some] <span class="e2">jala</span>–water, [and then] <span class="e2">śuilāma</span>–rested <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">chāri daṇḍa</span>–for forty-eight to ninety-six minutes.
I grasped Gadāi’s feet and slowly got up. I could not disobey the Lord’s order. I went to His home, ate something, drank some water, and then rested for an hour or so.
প্রাতে শচী-জগন্নাথ	মোরে দিলা দুধ-ভাত<br />	প্রভু সঙ্গে পড়িতে পাঠায় ।<br />পড়িয়া শুনিয়া তবে	আইলাম গৃহে যবে<br />	প্রভু মোরে গৃহে আসি’ খায় ॥২৪॥
prāte śachī-jagannātha	more dilā dudha-bhāta<br />	prabhu saṅge paḍite pāṭhāya<br />paḍiyā śuniyā tabe	āilāma gṛhe yabe<br />	prabhu mora gṛhe āsi’ khāya [24]
<span class="e2">prāte</span>–In the morning, <span class="e2">śachī-jagannātha</span>–Śachī and Jagannāth <span class="e2">dilā</span>–gave <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">dudha-bhāta</span>–some milk and rice [and] <span class="e2">pāṭhāya</span>–sent [me] <span class="e2">paḍite</span>–to study <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">āilāma</span>–I came <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–home <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span> <span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–after reading and listening, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–to my house [and] <span class="e2">khāya</span>–ate [with me].
In the morning, Śachī and Jagannāth gave me some milk and rice and sent me to school with the Lord. When I came home after studying, the Lord came over and ate with me.
কোন্দলের পরে প্রেম	হয় যেন শুদ্ধ হেম<br />	কত সুখ মনেতে হইল ।<br />প্রভু বলে, “এই লাগি’	তুমি রাগো, আমি রাগি<br />	পরস্পর প্রেম বৃদ্ধি ভেল” ॥২৫॥
kondalera pare prema	haya yena śuddha hema<br />	kata sukha manete ha-ila<br />prabhu bale, “ei lāgi’	tumi rāgo, āmi rāgi<br />	paraspara prema-vṛddhi bhela” [25]
<span class="e2">prema</span>–Love <span class="e2">kondalera pare</span>–after a quarrel <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">yena</span>–like <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure <span class="e2">hema</span>–gold. <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">sukha ha-ila</span>–I was so happy <span class="e2">manete</span>–within [my] heart, [and] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“tumi</span>–“You <span class="e2">rāgo</span>–got angry [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">rāgi</span>–got angry <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">lāgi’</span>–for this reason, [and now our] <span class="e2">prema</span>–love <span class="e2">paraspara</span>–for one another <span class="e2">vṛddhi</span> <span class="e2">bhela”</span>–has increased.”
Love after a quarrel is like pure gold. I was so happy within my heart, and the Lord said, “Both you and I became angry out of love, and now our love for one another has increased.”
গ্রন্থকারের শ্রীচৈতন্য প্রীতি
granthakārera śrī-chaitanya prīti
The author’s love for Śrī Chaitanya
এ হেন গৌরাঙ্গচাঁদ	না ভজিলে পরমাদ<br />	ভজিলে পরম সুখ হয় ।<br />দয়ার ঠাকুর তেঁহো	তাঁকে কি ভুলিবে কেহ <br />	এত দয়া দাসে বিতরয় ॥২৬॥
e hena gaurāṅgachā̐da	nā bhajile paramāda<br />	bhajile parama sukha haya<br />dayāra ṭhākura te̐ha	tā̐ke ki bhulibe keha<br />	eta dayā dāse vitaraya [26]
<span class="e2">bhajile nā</span>–If you do not serve <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">gaurāṅgachā̐da</span>–Gaurāṅgachā̐d, [then you are] <span class="e2">paramāda</span>–crazy. <span class="e2">bhajile</span>–If you serve [Him,] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">sukha</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–you feel the greatest joy. <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–the Deity <span class="e2">dayāra</span>–of mercy. <span class="e2">ki</span>–How could <span class="e2">keha</span>–anyone <span class="e2">bhulibe</span>–forget <span class="e2">tā̐ke</span>–Him? <span class="e2">vitaraya</span>–He bestows <span class="e2">eta</span>–such <span class="e2">dayā</span>–mercy <span class="e2">dāse</span>–upon [His] servants.
If you do not serve Gaurāṅgachā̐d, then you are crazy. If you serve Him, you will feel the greatest joy. He is the Deity of mercy. How could anyone forget Him? He bestows such mercy upon His servants.
চৈতন্য আমার প্রভু	চৈতন্যে না ছাড়ি কভু<br />	সেই মোর প্রাণের ঈশ্বর ।<br />যে “চৈতন্য” বলি’ ডাকে	উঠে কোল দিই তাকে <br />	সেই মোর প্রাণের সোদর ॥২৭॥
chaitanya āmāra prabhu	chaitanye nā chhāḍi kabhu<br />	sei mora prāṇera īśvara<br />ye “chaitanya” bali’ ḍāke	uṭhe kola dii tāke<br />	sei mora prāṇera sodara [27]
<span class="e2">chaitanya</span>–Chaitanya [is] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–master. <span class="e2">kabhu nā chhāḍi</span>–I shall never leave <span class="e2">chaitanye</span>–Śrī Chaitanya. <span class="e2">sei</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">prāṇera</span>–of my heart. <span class="e2">uṭhe</span>–I arise [and] <span class="e2">kola</span> <span class="e2">dii</span>–embrace <span class="e2">tāke</span> <span class="e2">ye</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–calls out, <span class="e2">“chaitanya”</span>–“Chaitanya!” <span class="e2">sei</span>–They [are] <span class="e2">sodara</span>–a dear brother <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">prāṇera</span>–of my heart.
Chaitanya is my master. I shall never leave Him—He is the Lord of my heart. I arise and embrace anyone who calls out, “Chaitanya!” They are a brother dear to my heart.
“হা চৈতন্য প্রাণধন”	না বলিল যেই জন<br />	মুখ তার না দেখি নয়নে ।<br />চৈতন্যে ভুলিল যেবা 	যদিও সে দেবী দেবা<br />	কুপ্রভাত তার দরশনে ॥২৮॥
“hā chaitanya prāṇa-dhana”	nā balila yei jana<br />	mukha tāra nā dekhi nayane<br />chaitanye bhulila yebā	yadio se devī devā<br />	kuprabhāta tāra daraśane [28]
<span class="e2">dekhi nā</span>–I do not look <span class="e2">nayane</span>–with [my] eyes [at] <span class="e2">mukha</span>–the face <span class="e2">tāra yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–of anyone who <span class="e2">balila nā</span>–does not call out, <span class="e2">“hā</span>–O <span class="e2">chaitanya</span>–Chaitanya, [my] <span class="e2">prāṇa-dhana”</span>–life and wealth!” <span class="e2">daraśane</span>–By seeing <span class="e2">tāra yebā</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">bhulila</span>–has forgotten <span class="e2">chaitanye</span>–Chaitanya, <span class="e2">yadio</span>–even if <span class="e2">se</span>–they [are] <span class="e2">devī</span>–a goddess [or] <span class="e2">devā</span>–god, [I have] <span class="e2">kuprabhāta</span>–an inauspicious morning.
I do not look at the face of anyone who does not call out, “O Chaitanya, my wealth and life!” Seeing anyone who has forgotten Chaitanya, even if they are a god or goddess, spoils my morning.
চৈতন্যে ছাড়িয়া অন্য	সন্ন্যাসীরে করে মান্য<br />	তারে যষ্টি করিব প্রহার ।<br />ছাড়িয়া চৈতন্যকথা	অন্য ইতিহাস বৃথা<br />	বলে যেই মুখে আগুন তার ॥২৯॥
chaitanye chhāḍiyā anya	sannyāsīre kare mānya<br />	tāre yaṣṭi kariba prahāra<br />chhāḍiyā chaitanya-kathā	anya itihāsa vṛthā<br />	bale yei mukhe āguna tāra [29]
<span class="e2">prahāra kariba</span>–I will beat <span class="e2">yaṣṭi</span>–with a stick <span class="e2">tāre</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leaves <span class="e2">chaitanye</span>–Chaitanya [and] <span class="e2">mānya kare</span>–honours <span class="e2">anya</span>–another <span class="e2">sannyāsīre</span>–sannyāsī. [I will throw] <span class="e2">āguna</span>–fire <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–in the mouth <span class="e2">tāra yei</span>–of anyone who <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leaves aside <span class="e2">chaitanya-kathā</span>–discussion of Chaitanya [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–speaks [about] <span class="e2">anya</span>–irrelevant, <span class="e2">vṛthā</span>–meaningless <span class="e2">itihāsa</span>–subjects.
I will beat with a stick anyone who leaves Chaitanya and honours another sannyāsī. I will throw fire into the mouth of anyone who leaves aside discussion of Chaitanya and speaks about irrelevant, meaningless subjects.
চৈতন্যের যাহে সুখ	তাহে যদি ঘটে দুঃখ<br />	চির দুঃখ ভোগ হউ মোর ।<br />সে যদি স্বসুখ ত্যজে	যতি-ধর্ম্ম কভু ভজে<br />	আমি তাহে দুঃখেতে বিভোর ॥৩০॥
chaitanyera yāhe sukha	tāhe yadi ghaṭe duḥkha<br />	chira duḥkha bhoga ha-u mora<br />se yadi svasukha tyaje	yati-dharma kabhu bhaje<br />	āmi tāhe duḥkhete vibhora [30]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">tāhe</span> <span class="e2">yāhe</span>–that by which <span class="e2">chaitanyera</span> <span class="e2">sukha</span>–Chaitanya is pleased <span class="e2">ghaṭe</span>–results [in my] <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness, [then] <span class="e2">mora bhoga</span> <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–let me endure <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–such sadness <span class="e2">chira</span>–forever. <span class="e2">kabhu yadi</span>–Whenever <span class="e2">se</span>–He <span class="e2">tyaje</span>–gives up <span class="e2">svasukha</span>–His own happiness [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–follows <span class="e2">yati-dharma</span>–the duties of a renunciant, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">vibhora</span>–overwhelmed <span class="e2">duḥkhete</span>–with sadness <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–by that.
If what pleases Chaitanya makes me sad, then let me endure such sadness forever. But, when He gives up His own happiness and follows the duties of a renunciant, I am overwhelmed with sadness.
শ্রীগৌর-গদাধর তত্ত্ব
śrī-gaura-gadādhara tattva
The nature of Śrī Gaura and Śrī Gadādhar
একদিন প্রভু মোর খেলিতে খেলিতে ।<br />চলিল অলকাতীরে নিবিড় বনেতে ॥৩১॥
eka-dina prabhu mora khelite khelite<br />chalila alakā-tīre nibiḍa vanete [31]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">khelite</span> <span class="e2">khelite</span>–while playing <span class="e2">mora</span>–with me, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">chalila</span>–went <span class="e2">nibiḍa</span> <span class="e2">vanete</span>–into the dense forest <span class="e2">alakā-tīre</span>–on the bank of the Alakā River.
One day, while playing with Me, the Lord went into the dense forest on the bank of the Alakā.
আমি আর গদাধর আছিলাম সঙ্গে ।<br />বকুলের গাছে শুক পক্ষী ধরে রঙ্গে ॥৩২॥
āmi āra gadādhara āchhilāma saṅge<br />bakulera gāchhe śuka pakṣī dhare raṅge [32]
<span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">āchhilāma</span>–were <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [Him]. <span class="e2">raṅge dhare</span>–The Lord playfully caught <span class="e2">śuka</span> <span class="e2">pakṣī</span>–a parrot<span class="e2"> bakulera</span> <span class="e2">gāchhe</span>–in a bakul tree.
Gadādhar and I were with Him. The Lord playfully caught a parrot in a bakul tree.
শুকে ধরি’ বলে, “তুই ব্যাসের নন্দন ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ বলি’ কর আনন্দ বর্ধন” ॥৩৩॥
śuke dhari’ bale, “tui vyāsera nandana<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa bali’ kara ānanda vardhana” [33]
<span class="e2">dhari’</span>–Holding <span class="e2">śuke</span>–the parrot, <span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, <span class="e2">“tui</span>–“You [are] <span class="e2">nandana</span>–the son <span class="e2">vyāsera</span>–of Vyāsa. <span class="e2">bali’</span>–Tell [us about] <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">vardhana kara</span>–increase [our] <span class="e2">ānanda”</span>–joy.”
Holding the parrot, He said, “You are the son of Vyāsa. Please delight us by speaking about Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.”
শুক তাহা নাহি বলে, বলে, “গৌরহরি” ।<br />প্রভু তারে দূরে ফেলে কোপ ছল করি’ ॥৩৪॥
śuka tāhā nāhi bale, bale, “gaurahari”<br />prabhu tāre dūre phele kopa chhala kari’ [34]
<span class="e2">śuka</span>–The parrot <span class="e2">bale nāhi</span>–did not speak <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–about Them. [Instead,] <span class="e2">bale</span>–he called out, <span class="e2">“gaurahari”</span>–“Gaurahari!” <span class="e2">kopa</span> <span class="e2">chhala</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Feigning anger, <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">phele</span>–threw <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away.
The parrot did not do this, and instead called out, “Gaurahari!” Feigning anger, the Lord threw the parrot away.
তবু শুক “গৌর গৌর” বলিয়া নাচয় ।<br />শুকের কীর্ত্তনে হয় প্রেমের উদয় ॥৩৫॥
tabu śuka “gaura gaura” baliyā nāchaya<br />śukera kīrtane haya premera udaya [35]
<span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">śuka</span>–the parrot <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–chanted, <span class="e2">“gaura</span> <span class="e2">gaura”</span>–“Gaura! Gaura!” [and] <span class="e2">nāchaya</span>–danced, [and] <span class="e2">premera</span> <span class="e2">udaya haya</span>–divine love arose <span class="e2">śukera</span> <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–through the parrot’s kīrtan.
Still, the parrot continued chanting, “Gaura! Gaura!” and danced, and his kīrtan gave rise to feelings of divine love.
প্রভু বলে, “ওরে শুক এ যে বৃন্দাবন ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ বল হেথা শুনুক সর্ব্বজন” ॥৩৬॥
prabhu bale, “ore śuka e ye vṛndāvana<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa bala hethā śunuka sarva-jana” [36]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ore</span>–O <span class="e2">śuka</span>–parrot! <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">ye</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">bala</span>–Speak <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–about Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here <span class="e2">sarva-jana śunuka”</span>–so that everyone may hear.”
The Lord said, “O parrot! This is Vṛndāvan. Speak about Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa so that everyone may hear.”
শুক বলে, “বৃন্দাবন নবদ্বীপ হইল ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ গৌরহরি-রূপে দেখা দিল ॥৩৭॥
śuka bale, “vṛndāvana navadvīpa ha-ila<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa gaurahari-rūpe dekhā dila [37]
<span class="e2">śuka</span>–The parrot <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–has become <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–have revealed [Themselves] <span class="e2">gaurahari-rūpe</span>–as Gaurahari.
The parrot said, “Vṛndāvan has become Nabadwīp, and Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa have revealed Themselves as Gaurahari.
আমি শুক এই বনে গৌর-নাম গাই ।<br />তুমি মোর কৃষ্ণ, রাধা এই যে গদাই ॥৩৮॥
āmi śuka ei vane gaura-nāma gāi<br />tumi mora kṛṣṇa, rādhā ei ye gadāi [38]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">śuka</span>–a parrot, [and] <span class="e2">gāi</span>–I chant <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–the Name of Gaura <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in this forest. <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">gadāi</span>–Gadāi [is] my <span class="e2">rādhā</span>–Rādhā.
“I am a parrot, and I chant the Name of Gaura in this forest. You are my Kṛṣṇa, and Gadāi is my Rādhā.
গদাই-গৌরাঙ্গ মোর প্রাণের ঈশ্বর ।<br />আন কিছু মুখে না আইসে অতঃপর” ॥৩৯॥
gadāi-gaurāṅga mora prāṇera īśvara<br />āna kichhu mukhe nā āise ataḥpara” [39]
<span class="e2">gadāi-gaurāṅga</span>–Gadāi and Gaurāṅga [are] <span class="e2">īśvara</span>–the Lords<span class="e2"> mora</span> <span class="e2">prāṇera</span>–of my heart. <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–Thus, <span class="e2">āna</span> <span class="e2">kichhu nā</span>–nothing else <span class="e2">āise</span>–comes <span class="e2">mukhe”</span>–from [my] mouth.”
“Gadāi and Gaurāṅga are the Lords of my heart. Thus, nothing else comes from my mouth.”
প্রভু বলে, “আমি রাধাকৃষ্ণ-উপাসক ।<br />অন্য নাম শুনিলে আমার হয় শোক” ॥৪০॥
prabhu bale, “āmi rādhā-kṛṣṇa-upāsaka<br />anya nāma śunile āmāra haya śoka” [40]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“āmi</span>–“I [am] <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-upāsaka</span>–a worshipper of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">śunile</span>–if I hear <span class="e2">anya</span>–other <span class="e2">nāma</span>–names, <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">śoka haya”</span>–I become upset.”
The Lord said, “I am a worshipper of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and if I hear anyone else’s name, I become upset.”
এত বলি’ গদাইয়ের হাতটী ধরিয়া ।<br />মায়াপুরে ফিরে আইল শুকেরে ছাড়িয়া ॥৪১॥
eta bali’ gadāiyera hātaṭī dhariyā<br />māyāpure phire āila śukere chhāḍiyā [41]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Saying <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">dhariyā</span>–the Lord grasped <span class="e2">gadāiyera</span>–Gadāi’s <span class="e2">hātaṭī</span>–hand [and] <span class="e2">phire</span> <span class="e2">āila</span>–went back <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–to Māyāpur, <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leaving <span class="e2">śukere</span>–the parrot.
Saying this, the Lord took Gadāi’s hand and went back to Māyāpur, leaving the parrot behind.
শুকে বলে, “গাও তুমি যাহা লাগে ভাল ।<br />আমার ভজন আমি করি চিরকাল” ॥৪২॥
śuke bale, “gāo tumi yāhā lāge bhāla<br />āmāra bhajana āmi kari chira-kāla” [42]
<span class="e2">śuke</span>–The parrot <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, [“You may] <span class="e2">“gāo</span>–sing <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–whatever <span class="e2">bhāla lāge</span>–appeals <span class="e2">tumi</span>–to You, [but] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kari</span>–will do <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–worship <span class="e2">chira-kāla”</span>–forever.”
The parrot said, “You may sing whatever You like, but I will continue my worship forever.”
মধুর চৈতন্যলীলা জাগে যার মনে ।<br />মোর দণ্ডবৎ ভাই তাঁহার চরণে ॥৪৩॥
madhura chaitanya-līlā jāge yāra mane<br />mora daṇḍavat bhāi tā̐hāra charaṇe [43]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span>–I bow <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet <span class="e2">tā̐hāra yāra</span>–of anyone in whose <span class="e2">mane</span>–heart <span class="e2">madhura</span> <span class="e2">chaitanya-līlā</span>–the sweet Pastimes of Śrī Chaitanya <span class="e2">jāge</span>–arise.
Brother, I bow at the feet of anyone in whose heart the sweet Pastimes of Śrī Chaitanya arise.
শ্রীনবদ্বীপ ও বৃন্দাবন
śrī-navadvīpa o vṛndāvana
Śrī Nabadwīp and Vṛndāvan
গদাই গৌরাঙ্গ মুঞি “রাধাশ্যাম” জানি ।<br />ষোলক্রোশ “নবদ্বীপে” “বৃন্দাবন” মানি ॥৪৪॥
gadāi gaurāṅge muñi “rādhā-śyāma” jāni<br />ṣola-krośa “navadvīpe” “vṛndāvana” māni [44]
<span class="e2">muñi</span>–I <span class="e2">jāni</span>–know [that] <span class="e2">gadāi</span>–Gadāi [and] <span class="e2">gaurāṅge</span>–Gaurāṅga [are] <span class="e2">“rādhā-śyāma”</span>–Rādhā and Śyām. <span class="e2">māni</span>–I know [that] <span class="e2">ṣola-krośa</span>–the thirty-two miles <span class="e2">“navadvīpe”</span>–of Nabadwīp [are] <span class="e2">“vṛndāvana”</span>–Vṛndāvan.
I know that Gadāi and Gaurāṅga are Rādhā and Śyām, and that the thirty-two miles of Nabadwīp are Vṛndāvan.
যশোদানন্দনে আর শচীর নন্দনে ।<br />যে জন পৃথক্ দেখে সে না মরে কেনে ॥৪৫॥
yaśodā-nandane āra śachīra nandane<br />ye jana pṛthak dekhe se nā mare kene [45]
<span class="e2">kene</span>–Why [do] <span class="e2">se ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–those who <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">pṛthak</span>–a distinction <span class="e2">yaśodā-nandane</span> <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">nandane</span>–between the son of Yaśodā and the son of Śachī <span class="e2">mare nā</span>–not die?
Why do those who see a distinction between the son of Yaśodā and the son of Śachī not die?
নবদ্বীপে না পাইল যেই বৃন্দাবন ।<br />বৃথা সে তার্কিক কেন ধরয় জীবন ॥৪৬॥
navadvīpe nā pāile yei vṛndāvana<br />vṛthā se tārkika kena dharaya jīvana [46]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why [do] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">yei tārkika</span>–speculators who <span class="e2">pāile nā</span>–do not find <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–within Nabadwīp <span class="e2">dharaya</span>–continue [their] <span class="e2">vṛthā</span>–meaningless <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–lives?
Why do speculators who do not find Vṛndāvan within Nabadwīp continue their meaningless lives?
গৌর-ভজন বিনা ‘রাধাকৃষ্ণ’-ভজন বৃথা
gaura-bhajana vinā ‘rādhā-kṛṣṇa’-bhajana vṛthā
Without service to Gaura, service to Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa is useless
গৌর-নাম গৌর-ধাম গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত ।<br />যে ভজে তাতে মোর অকৈতব প্রীত ॥৪৭॥
gaura-nāma gaura-dhāma gaurāṅga-charita<br />ye bhaje tāte mora akaitava prīta [47]
<span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">akaitava</span> <span class="e2">prīta</span>–I sincerely love <span class="e2">tāte ye</span>–those who <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–Gaura’s Name, <span class="e2">gaura-dhāma</span>–Gaura’s abode, [and] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-charita</span>–Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes.
I sincerely love those who worship Gaura’s Name, Gaura’s abode, and Gaura’s Pastimes.
গৌর-রূপ গৌর-নাম	গৌর-লীলা গৌর-ধাম<br />	যে না ভজে গৌড়েতে জন্মিয়া ।<br />রাধাকৃষ্ণ-নাম-রূপ-	ধাম-লীলা অপরূপ<br />	কভু নাহি স্পর্শে তার হিয়া ॥৪৮॥
gaura-rūpa gaura-nāma	gaura-līlā gaura-dhāma<br />	ye nā bhaje gauḍete janmiyā<br />rādhā-kṛṣṇa-nāma-rūpa-	dhāma-līlā aparūpa<br />	kabhu nāhi sparśe tāra hiyā [48]
<span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa’s <span class="e2">aparūpa</span>–extraordinary <span class="e2">nāma-rūpa-dhāma-līlā</span>–Names, Forms, Abode, and Pastimes <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">sparśe</span>–touch <span class="e2">hiyā</span>–the hearts <span class="e2">tāra ye</span>–of those who <span class="e2">janmiyā</span>–take birth <span class="e2">gauḍete</span>–in Gauḍa [but] <span class="e2">bhaje nā</span>–do not worship <span class="e2">gaura-rūpa</span>–Gaura’s Form, <span class="e2">gaura-nāma</span>–Gaura’s Name, <span class="e2">gaura-līlā</span>–Gaura’s Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">gaura-dhāma</span>–Gaura’s Abode.
Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa’s extraordinary Names, Forms, Abode, and Pastimes never touch the hearts of those who take birth in Gauḍa but do not worship Gaura’s Form, Gaura’s Name, Gaura’s Pastimes, and Gaura’s Abode.

Chapter Three
প্রথম প্রণাম
Prathama Praṇāma
First Obeisances
যাঁর অংশে সত্যভামা দ্বারকায় ধাম ।<br />সে রাধা-চরণে মোর অসংখ্য প্রণাম ॥১॥
yā̐ra aṁśe satyabhāmā dvārakāya dhāma<br />se rādhā-charaṇe mora asaṅkhya praṇāma [1]
<span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">asaṅkhya</span> <span class="e2">praṇāma</span>–I bow innumerable times <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">rādhā-charaṇe</span>–at the feet of Rādhā, <span class="e2">yā̐ra</span>–whose <span class="e2">aṁśe</span>–expansion <span class="e2">dvārakāya dhāma</span>–in the abode of Dvārakā [is] <span class="e2">satyabhāmā</span>–Satyabhāmā.
I bow innumerable times at the feet of Rādhā, whose expansion in Dvārakā is Satyabhāmā.
শ্রীনন্দনন্দন এবে শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ।<br />গদাধরে সঙ্গে আনি’ নদীয়া কৈল ধন্য ॥২॥
śrī-nanda-nandana ebe śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya<br />gadādhare saṅge āni’ nadīyā kaila dhanya [2]
<span class="e2">śrī-nanda-nandana</span>–The son of Śrī Nanda [is] <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya. <span class="e2">āni’</span>–Bringing <span class="e2">gadādhare</span>–Gadādhar <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [Him,] <span class="e2">dhanya kaila</span>–He has blessed <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–Nadia.
The son of Nanda is now Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya. Bringing Gadādhar with Him, He has blessed Nadia.
গদাধর লঞা শ্রীপুরুষোত্তম আইল ।<br />গদাই-গৌরাঙ্গ-রূপে গূঢ়-লীলা কৈল ।<br />টোটা-গোপীনাথ-সেবা গদাধরে দিল ॥৩॥
gadādhare lañā śrī-puruṣottama āila<br />gadāi-gaurāṅga-rūpe gūḍha-līlā kaila<br />ṭoṭā-gopīnātha-sevā gadādhare dila [3]
<span class="e2">lañā</span>–He took <span class="e2">gadādhare</span>–Gadādhar [and] <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">śrī-puruṣottama</span>–to Jagannāth Purī. <span class="e2">gadāi-gaurāṅga-rūpe</span>–As Gaurāṅga with Gadāi, <span class="e2">kaila</span>–He performed <span class="e2">gūḍha-līlā</span>–confidential Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">dila</span>–He gave <span class="e2">gadādhare</span>–Gadādhar <span class="e2">ṭoṭā-gopīnātha-sevā</span>–the service of Ṭoṭā Gopīnāth.
He took Gadādhar and came to Śrī Puruṣottam Kṣetra. As Gaurāṅga with Gadāi, He performed confidential Pastimes, and He gave Gadādhar the service of Ṭoṭā Gopīnāth.
মোরে দিল গিরিধারী-সেবা সিন্ধুতটে ।<br />গৌড়ীয়-ভকত সব আমার নিকটে ॥৪॥
more dila giridhārī-sevā sindhu-taṭe<br />gauḍīya-bhakata saba āmāra nikaṭe [4]
<span class="e2">dila</span>–The Lord gave <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">giridhārī-sevā</span>–the service of Giridhārī <span class="e2">sindhu-taṭe</span>–on the shore of the ocean, [and kept] <span class="e2">saba</span>–all the <span class="e2">gauḍīya-bhakata</span>–devotees from Gauḍa <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–with me.
The Lord gave me the service of Giridhārī on the shore of the ocean, and kept all the devotees from Gauḍa with me.
দামোদর স্বরূপ আমার প্রাণের সমান ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য যার দেহ-মন-প্রাণ ॥৫॥
dāmodara svarūpa āmāra prāṇera samāna<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya yāra deha-mana-prāṇa [5]
<span class="e2">svarūpa dāmodara</span>–Svarūp Dāmodar [is] <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">prāṇera</span> <span class="e2">samāna</span>–like my heart, [and] <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya [is] <span class="e2">yāra</span>–his <span class="e2">deha-mana-prāṇa</span>–body, heart, and mind.
Svarūp Dāmodar is my heart, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya is his body, heart, and mind.
নমি প্রাণ-গৌর-পদে সাষ্টাঙ্গ পড়িয়া ।<br />এ ‘প্রেমবিবর্ত্ত’ লিখি ভক্ত-আজ্ঞা পায়া ॥৬॥
nami prāṇa-gaura-pade sāṣṭāṅge paḍiyā<br />e ‘prema-vivarta’ likhi bhakta-ājñā pāyā [6]
<span class="e2">nami</span>–I bow, <span class="e2">sāṣṭāṅge</span> <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–prostrating myself, <span class="e2">prāṇa-gaura-pade</span>–at the feet of [my] beloved Gaura, [and] <span class="e2">likhi</span>–write <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">‘prema-vivarta’</span>–<span class="e33">Prema-vivarta</span> <span class="e2">pāyā</span>–having received <span class="e2">bhakta-ājñā</span>–the order of the devotees.
I prostrate myself at the feet of my beloved Gaura and write this <span class="e3">Prema-vivarta</span>, having received the order of the devotees.

Chapter Four
গৌরস্য গুরুতা
Gaurasya Gurutā
Gaura’s Greatness
গৌরের নৃত্য, নিত্য
gaurera nṛtya, nitya
Gaura’s dancing is eternal
ভাইরে ভজ মোর প্রাণের গৌরাঙ্গ ।<br />গৌর বিনা বৃথা সব জীবনের রঙ্গ ॥১॥
bhāi-re bhaja mora prāṇera gaurāṅga<br />gaura vinā vṛthā saba jīvanera raṅga [1]
<span class="e2">bhāi-re</span>–O brother! <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–the Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">prāṇera</span>–of my heart. <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura, <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">jīvanera</span>–all of life’s <span class="e2">raṅga</span>–pleasures [are] <span class="e2">vṛthā</span>–meaningless.
O brother! Serve the Gaurāṅga of my heart. Without Gaura, all of life’s pleasures are meaningless.
নবদ্বীপ-মায়াপুরে শচীর অঙ্গনে ।<br />গৌর নাচে নিত্য নিতাই-অদ্বৈতের সনে ॥২॥
navadvīpa-māyāpure śachīra aṅgane<br />gaura nāche nitya nitāi-advaitera sane [2]
<span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dances <span class="e2">nitāi-advaitera</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with Nitāi and Advaita <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally <span class="e2">śachīra</span> <span class="e2">aṅgane</span>–in Śachī’s courtyard <span class="e2">navadvīpa-māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur within Nabadwīp.
Gaura dances with Nitāi and Advaita eternally in Śachī’s courtyard in Māyāpur within Nabadwīp.
শ্রীবাস-অঙ্গনে নাচে গায় রসভরে ।<br />যে দেখিল একবার আর না পাশরে ॥৩॥
śrīvāsa-aṅgane nāche gāya rasa-bhare<br />ye dekhila eka-bāra āra nā pāśare [3]
<span class="e2">rasa-bhare</span>–Filled with ecstasy, <span class="e2">nāche</span>–He dances [and] <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sings <span class="e2">śrīvāsa-aṅgane</span>–in Śrīvās’s courtyard. <span class="e2">ye</span>–Anyone who <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–sees [this] <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">pāśare nā</span>–never forgets [it].
Filled with ecstasy, He dances and sings in Śrīvās’s courtyard. Anyone who sees this once never forgets it.
আমার হৃদয়ে নাট অঙ্কিত হইয়া ।<br />নিরন্তর আছে মোর প্রাণ কাঁদাইয়া ॥৪॥
āmāra hṛdaye nāṭa aṅkita ha-iyā<br />nirantara āchhe mora prāṇa kā̐dāiyā [4]
[His] <span class="e2">nāṭa</span>–dancing <span class="e2">aṅkita</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–is imprinted <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–in my heart, <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–remains [there] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–forever, [and] <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">prāṇa</span> <span class="e2">kā̐dāiyā</span>–makes my heart cry.
His dancing is imprinted in my heart. It remains there forever and makes my heart cry.
জগন্নাথ-মন্দিরেতে নৃত্য দেখি যবে ।<br />অনন্ত ভাবের ঢেউ মনে উঠে তবে ॥৫॥
jagannātha-mandirete nṛtya dekhi yabe<br />ananta bhāvera ḍheu mane uṭhe tabe [5]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–I see [His] <span class="e2">nṛtya</span>–dancing <span class="e2">jagannātha-mandirete</span>–in the Temple of Jagannāth, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">ḍheu</span>–waves <span class="e2">ananta</span> <span class="e2">bhāvera</span>–of innumerable emotions <span class="e2">uṭhe</span>–swell <span class="e2">mane</span>–within [my] heart.
When I see His dancing in the Temple of Jagannāth, waves of innumerable emotions swell within my heart.
আর কি দেখিব প্রভুর জাহ্নবীপুলিনে ।<br />সুনৃত্য-কীর্ত্তনলীলা এ ছার জীবনে ॥৬॥
āra ki dekhiba prabhura jāhnavī-puline<br />sunṛtya-kīrtana-līlā e chhāra jīvane [6]
<span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–Will I see <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">sunṛtya-kīrtana-līlā</span>–Pastimes of kīrtan and wondrous dancing <span class="e2">jāhnavī-puline</span>–on the banks of the Gaṅgā <span class="e2">āra</span>–again <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">chhāra</span> <span class="e2">jīvane</span>–in this wretched life?
Will I ever see the Lord’s Pastimes of kīrtan and wondrous dancing on the banks of the Gaṅgā again in this wretched life?
সর্ব্বদেবদেবী শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গের দাস
sarva-deva-devī śrī-gaurāṅgera dāsa
All gods and goddesses are servants of Śrī Gaurāṅga
নিষ্ঠা করি’ ভজ ভাই গৌরাঙ্গচরণ ।<br />অন্য দেব-দেবী কভু না কর ভজন ॥৭॥
niṣṭhā kari’ bhaja bhāi gaurāṅga-charaṇa<br />anya deva-devī kabhu nā kara bhajana [7]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–worship <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-charaṇa</span>–Gaurāṅga’s feet <span class="e2">niṣṭhā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–sincerely: <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">bhajana kara</span>–serve <span class="e2">anya</span>–other <span class="e2">deva-devī</span>–gods and goddesses.
Brother, worship Gaura’s feet sincerely: never worship other gods or goddesses.
গৌরাঙ্গের দাস বলি’ সর্ব্বদেবে জান ।<br />কৃষ্ণ হৈতে গৌরকে কভু না জানিবে আন ॥৮॥
gaurāṅgera dāsa bali’ sarva-deve jāna<br />kṛṣṇa haite gaurake kabhu nā jānibe āna [8]
<span class="e2">bali’ jāna</span>–Consider [that] <span class="e2">sarva-deve</span>–all gods [are] <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–of Gaurāṅga, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span> <span class="e2">jānibe</span>–never consider <span class="e2">gaurake</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">āna</span>–different <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa.
Know that all gods are servants of Gaurāṅga, and never consider Gaura different from Kṛṣṇa.
নিজ গুরুদেবে জান গৌরকৃষ্ণপাত্র ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ-পার্ষদে জান গৌরদেহগাত্র ॥৯॥
nija gurudeve jāna gaura-kṛpā-pātra<br />gaurāṅga-pārṣade jāna gaura-deha-gātra [9]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know <span class="e2">nija</span>–your <span class="e2">gurudeve</span>–Gurudev [to be] <span class="e2">gaura-kṛpā-pātra</span>–a recipient of Gaura’s mercy, [and] <span class="e2">jāna</span>–know <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-pārṣade</span>–Gaurāṅga’s associates [to be] <span class="e2">gaura-deha-gātra</span>–limbs of Gaura’s body.
Know your Gurudev to be a recipient of Gaura’s mercy, and know Gaura’s associates to be limbs of Gaura’s body.
গৌর-বৈরী রসপোষ্টা এই মাত্র জান ।<br />সকলে গৌরাঙ্গ-দাস এ কথাটী মান ॥১০॥
gaura-vairī rasa-poṣṭā ei mātra jāna<br />sakale gaurāṅga-dāsa e kathāṭī māna [10]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [that] <span class="e2">gaura-vairī</span>–the enemies of Gaura [are] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">mātra</span>–simply <span class="e2">rasa-poṣṭā</span>–nourishers of rasa— <span class="e2">sakale</span>–everyone [is] <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-dāsa</span>–a servant of Gaurāṅga. <span class="e2">māna</span>–Accept <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">kathāṭī</span>–truth.
Know that the enemies of Gaura are simply nourishers of rasa—everyone is a servant of Gaurāṅga. Accept this truth.
গৌরভজননিষ্ঠা
gaura-bhajana-niṣṭhā
Attachment to Gaura’s service
পরনিন্দা পরচর্চ্চা না কর কখন ।<br />দৃঢ়ভাবে একান্তে ভজ শ্রীগৌরচরণ ॥১১॥
para-nindā para-charchchā nā kara kakhana<br />dṛḍha-bhāve ekānte bhaja śrī-gaura-charaṇa [11]
<span class="e2">kakhana kara nā</span>–Never <span class="e2">para-nindā</span>–criticise others [or] <span class="e2">para-charchchā</span>–gossip about others; <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-charaṇa</span>–Śrī Gaura’s feet <span class="e2">dṛḍha-bhāve</span>–resolutely [and] <span class="e2">ekānte</span>–exclusively.
Never criticise or gossip about others; serve Śrī Gaura’s feet resolutely and exclusively.
গৌর যে শিখাল নাম সেই নাম গাও ।<br />অন্য সব নামমাহাত্ম্য সেই নামে পাও ॥১২॥
gaura ye śikhāla nāma sei nāma gāo<br />anya saba nāma-māhātmya sei nāme pāo [12]
<span class="e2">gāo</span>–Chant <span class="e2">sei ye</span> <span class="e2">nāma nāma</span>–the Name [that] <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">śikhāla</span>–taught [and] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">nāme</span>–through that Name, <span class="e2">pāo</span>–get <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">nāma-māhātmya</span>–the benefits of all other Names.
Chant the Name that Gaura taught and by doing so get the benefit of chanting all other Names.
গৌর বিনা গুরু নাই এ ভব-সংসারে ।<br />সরল গৌরাঙ্গভক্তি শিখাও সবারে ॥১৩॥
gaura vinā guru nāi e bhava-saṁsāre<br />sarala gaurāṅga-bhakti śikhāo sabāre [13]
<span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">guru</span>–Guru <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">bhava-saṁsāre</span>–in this world <span class="e2">vinā</span>–other than <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura. <span class="e2">śikhāo</span>–Teach <span class="e2">sabāre</span>–everyone <span class="e2">sarala</span>–sincere <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-bhakti</span>–devotion to Gaurāṅga.
There is no Guru in this world other than Gaura. Teach everyone sincere devotion to Gaurāṅga.
কুটীনাটী ছাড়, মন করহ সরল ।<br />গৌর-ভজা লোকরক্ষা একত্রে নিষ্ফল ॥১৪॥
kuṭīnāṭī chhāḍa, mana karaha sarala<br />gaura-bhajā loka-rakṣā ekatre niṣphala [14]
<span class="e2">chhāḍa</span>–Give up <span class="e2">kuṭīnāṭī</span>–deceit [and] <span class="e2">karaha</span>–make [your] <span class="e2">mana</span>–mind <span class="e2">sarala</span>–sincere. <span class="e2">gaura-bhajā</span>–Serving Gaura [and] <span class="e2">loka-rakṣā</span>–serving society <span class="e2">ekatre</span>–at the same time [is] <span class="e2">niṣphala</span>–useless.
Give up deceit and make your mind sincere. Serving Gaura and serving society at the same time is useless.
হয় গোরা ভজ, নয় লোক ভজ ভাই ।<br />একপাত্রে দুই কভু না রহে এক ঠাঞি ॥১৫॥
haya gorā bhaja, naya loka bhaja bhāi<br />eka-pātre dui kabhu nā rahe eka ṭhāñi [15]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">haya</span>–either <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">naya</span>–or<span class="e2"> bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">loka</span>–society. <span class="e2">dui</span>–The two <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">rahe</span>–remain <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">ṭhāñi</span>–in one place <span class="e2">eka-pātre</span>–together.
Brother, either serve Gorā or serve society. The two never remain in one place together.
জগাই বলে, “যদি একনিষ্ঠ না হইবে ।<br />দুই নায়ে নদী-পারের দুর্দ্দশা লভিবে” ॥১৬॥
jagāi bale, “yadi eka-niṣṭha nā ha-ibe<br />dui nāye nadī-pārera durdaśā labhibe” [16]
<span class="e2">jagāi</span>–Jagāi <span class="e2">bale</span>–says, <span class="e2">“yadi</span>–“If <span class="e2">ha-ibe nā</span>–you do not become <span class="e2">eka-niṣṭha</span>–single-minded, <span class="e2">durdaśā</span>–the plight <span class="e2">nadī-pārera</span>–of crossing a river <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">nāye</span>–in two boats <span class="e2">labhibe”</span>–will befall you.”
Jagāi says, “If you do not become single-minded, the plight of crossing a river in two boats will befall you.”

Chapter Five
বিবর্ত্তবিলাসসেবা
Vivarta-vilāsa-sevā
Transformations of Ecstasy in Service
প্রেমের বৈচিত্ত্যগত	প্রেমের বিবর্ত্ত যত<br />	মোর মনে নাচে নিরন্তর ।<br />কলহ গৌরের সনে	করি আমি দিনে দিনে<br />	“কুন্দলে জগাই” নাম মোর ॥১॥
premera vaichitya-gata	premera vivarta yata<br />	mora mane nāche nirantara<br />kalaha gaurera sane	kari āmi dine dine<br />	“kundale jagāi” nāma mora [1]
<span class="e2">yata</span>–The <span class="e2">vaichitya-gata</span>–pangs <span class="e2">premera</span>–of love [and the] <span class="e2">yata vivarta</span>–transformations <span class="e2">premera</span>–of love <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–constantly <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dance <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–within my heart. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kalaha kari</span>–quarrel <span class="e2">gaurera</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with Gaura <span class="e2">dine</span> <span class="e2">dine</span>–every day. <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">nāma</span>–name [is] <span class="e2">“kundale</span> <span class="e2">jagāi”</span>–“Angry Jagāi”.
The pangs and transformations of love constantly dance within my heart. I quarrel with Gaura every day, and thus I am known as “Angry Jagāi”.
গেলাম ব্রজে দেখিবারে	রহি সনাতনের ঘরে<br />	কলহ করিনু তার সনে ।<br />রক্তবস্ত্র সন্ন্যাসীর	শিরে বাঁধি’ আইলা ধীর<br />	ভাতের হাঁড়ি মারিতে কৈনু মনে ॥২॥
gelāma vraja dekhibāre	rahi sanātanera ghare<br />	kalaha karinu tāra sane<br />rakta-vastra sannyāsīra	śire bā̐dhi’ āilā dhīra<br />	bhātera hā̐ḍi mārite kainu mane [2]
<span class="e2">gelāma</span>–I went <span class="e2">dekhibāre</span>–to see <span class="e2">vraja</span>–Vraja. <span class="e2">rahi</span>–I stayed <span class="e2">sanātanera</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–at Sanātan’s place. <span class="e2">kalaha</span> <span class="e2">karinu</span>–I quarrelled <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with him. [When] <span class="e2">bā̐dhi’</span>–he tied <span class="e2">sannyāsīra</span>–a sannyāsī’s <span class="e2">rakta-vastra</span>–red cloth <span class="e2">śire</span>–on [his] head [and] <span class="e2">dhīra</span>–calmly <span class="e2">āilā</span>–came [before me,] <span class="e2">mane kainu</span>–I decided <span class="e2">mārite</span>–to beat [him] <span class="e2">bhātera</span> <span class="e2">hā̐ḍi</span>–with a rice pot.
I went to see Vraja, and while staying at Sanātan’s place, I quarrelled with him. When he tied a sannyāsī’s red cloth on his head and calmly came before me, I decided to beat him with a rice pot.
সনাতনের বিনয় দেখে	ছাড়ি’ তারে এক পাকে<br />	লজ্জায় বসিনু এক ধারে ।<br />গৌর মোর যত জানে	আমায় পাঠায় বৃন্দাবনে<br />	মজা দেখে থাকি’ নিজে দূরে ॥৩॥
sanātanera vinaya dekhe	chhāḍi’ tāre eka pāke<br />	lajjāya basinu eka dhāre<br />gaura mora yata jāne	āmāya pāṭhāya vṛndāvane<br />	majā dekhe thāki’ nije dūre [3]
<span class="e2">dekhe</span>–I saw <span class="e2">sanātanera</span>–Sanātan’s <span class="e2">vinaya</span>–humility, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–left <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">pāke</span>–alone, [and] <span class="e2">lajjāya</span>–shamefully <span class="e2">basinu</span>–sat <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">dhāre</span>–to one side. <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows <span class="e2">yata</span>–everything. <span class="e2">pāṭhāya</span>–He sent <span class="e2">āmāya</span>–me <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–to Vṛndāvan [and] <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–observed <span class="e2">majā</span>–the result <span class="e2">nije thāki’</span>–while Himself remaining <span class="e2">dūre</span>–at a distance.
When I saw Sanātan’s humility, I left him alone and shamefully sat to one side. My Gaura knows everything: He sent me to Vṛndāvan and observed the result from afar.
ভাল তার হউক সুখ	মোর হউক চির দুঃখ<br />	তার সুখে হবে মোর সুখ ।<br />আমি কাঁদি রাত্রদিনে	গৌর বিচ্ছেদ ভাবি’ মনে<br />	গৌর হাসে দেখি কাঁদা মুখ ॥৪॥
bhāla tāra ha-uka sukha	mora ha-uka chira duḥkha<br />	tāra sukhe habe mora sukha<br />āmi kā̐di rātra-dine	gaura-vichchheda bhāvi’ mane<br />	gaura hāse dekhi’ kā̐dā mukha [4]
<span class="e2">bhāla</span>–Good! <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sukha ha-uka</span>–Let Him be happy, [and] <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">chira</span> <span class="e2">duḥkha ha-uka</span>–let me be sad forever. <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">sukha habe</span>–I will be happy <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–with His happiness. <span class="e2">rātra-dine</span>–Night and day <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kā̐di</span>–cry, <span class="e2">bhāvi’</span>–feeling <span class="e2">gaura-vichchheda</span>–separation from Gaura <span class="e2">mane</span>–at heart, [but] <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">hāse</span>–laughs <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–seeing [my] <span class="e2">kā̐dā</span>–crying <span class="e2">mukha</span>–face.
Good! He can be happy, and I can be sad forever. His happiness will be my happiness. Night and day I cry, feeling separation from Gaura, but Gaura laughs seeing my crying face.
সেই ত’ কপটন্যাসী	তার লীলা ভালবাসি<br />	মধুমাখা কথাগুলি তার ।<br />যে ভাব ব্রজেতে ভেবে	পুনঃ সেই ভাব এবে<br />	বুঝেও না বুঝি আর বার ॥৫॥
sei ta’ kapaṭa-nyāsī	tāra līlā bhālavāsi<br />	madhu-mākhā kathāguli tāra<br />ye bhāva vrajete bheve	punaḥ sei bhāva ebe<br />	bujheo nā bujhi āra bāra [5]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">kapaṭa-nyāsī</span>–a deceitful sannyāsī, [but] <span class="e2">bhālavāsi</span>–I love <span class="e2">tāra</span>–His <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes. <span class="e2">tāra</span>–His <span class="e2">kathāguli</span>–words [are] <span class="e2">madhu-mākhā</span>–full of nectar. <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">bheve</span>–The Lord is feeling <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">bhāva sei bhāva</span>–the same mood [He felt] <span class="e2">vrajete</span>–in Vraja. <span class="e2">bujheo</span>–Although I understand [this,] <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">bāra</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">bujhi nā</span>–I do not understand [it].
He is a deceitful sannyāsī, but I love His Pastimes. His words are full of nectar. The Lord is now feeling the same mood that He felt in Vraja. Although I understand this, sometimes I do not.
চন্দনাদি তৈল আনি’	বাঁকা বাঁকা কথা শুনি’<br />	তৈল-ভাণ্ড ভাঙ্গিলাম বলে ।<br />মান করি’ নিজাসনে	শুঞা রৈনু অনশনে<br />	সে মান ভাঙ্গিল নানা ছলে ॥৬॥
chandanādi taila āni’	bā̐kā bā̐kā kathā śuni’<br />	taila-bhāṇḍa bhāṅgilāma bale<br />māna kari’ nijāsane	śuñā rainu anaśane<br />	se māna bhāṅgila nānā chhale [6]
<span class="e2">āni’</span>–I brought <span class="e2">chandanādi</span>–sandalwood <span class="e2">taila</span>–oil [for Him, but] <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–after hearing [His] <span class="e2">bā̐kā</span> <span class="e2">bā̐kā</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–stubborn remarks, <span class="e2">bhāṅgilāma</span>–I broke <span class="e2">taila-bhāṇḍa</span>–the pot of oil <span class="e2">bale</span>–forcibly. <span class="e2">māna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Angrily, <span class="e2">śuñā</span> <span class="e2">rainu</span>–I layed <span class="e2">nijāsane</span>–on my bed <span class="e2">anaśane</span>–fasting. <span class="e2">bhāṅgila</span>–He pacified [my] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">māna</span>–anger <span class="e2">nānā</span> <span class="e2">chhale</span>–with various pleas.
I brought some sandalwood oil for Him, but after hearing His stubborn remarks, I smashed the pot of oil. Angrily, I layed on my bed fasting, but He pacified my anger with various pleas.
আমারে করায় পাক	অন্নব্যঞ্জন আবোনা শাক<br />	বলে, “ক্রোধের পাক বড় মিষ্ট” ।<br />বাড়ায় আমার রোষ	তাতে তার সন্তোষ<br />	তার প্রসন্নতা মোর ইষ্ট ॥৭॥
āmāre karāya pāka	anna-vyañjana ābonā śāka<br />	bale, “krodhera pāka baḍa miṣṭa”<br />bāḍāya āmāra roṣa	tāte tāra santoṣa<br />	tāra prasannatā mora iṣṭa [7]
<span class="e2">karāya</span>–He had <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–me <span class="e2">pāka</span>–cook <span class="e2">anna-vyañjana</span>–rice, vegetables, [and] <span class="e2">ābonā</span>–wild <span class="e2">śāka</span>–spinach. <span class="e2">bale</span>–He said, “[Your] <span class="e2">“krodhera</span> <span class="e2">pāka</span>–angry cooking [is] <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–very <span class="e2">miṣṭa”</span>–sweet.” <span class="e2">bāḍāya</span>–He increased <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">roṣa</span>–anger [and] <span class="e2">tāte</span>–so <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">santoṣa</span>–He [was] pleased. <span class="e2">tāra</span>–His <span class="e2">prasannatā</span>–satisfaction [is] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">iṣṭa</span>–desire.
He had me cook rice, vegetables, and wild spinach. He said, “Your angry cooking is very sweet.” He increased my anger and so was pleased. His satisfaction is my desire.
জিজ্ঞাসিল সনাতন	যাইতে কৈনু বৃন্দাবন<br />	তাতে মোরে রাখে বোকা করি’ ।<br />বাল্য বুদ্ধি দেখি’ তার	চিত্তে হয় চমৎকার<br />	আমি তার পাদপদ্ম ধরি’ ॥৮॥
jijñāsila sanātana	yāite kainu vṛndāvana<br />	tāte more rākhe bokā kari’<br />bālya buddhi dekhi’ tāra	chitte haya chamatkāra<br />	āmi tāra pāda-padma dhari’ [8]
<span class="e2">sanātana</span>–Sanātan <span class="e2">jijñāsila</span>–asked [me for advice, and] <span class="e2">kainu</span>–I told [him] <span class="e2">yāite</span>–to go <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–to Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">more</span> <span class="e2">bokā</span> <span class="e2">kari’ rākhe</span>–The Lord deemed me a fool <span class="e2">tāte</span>–for this. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">tāra</span>–His <span class="e2">bālya</span>–childish <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–mentality, <span class="e2">chitte</span> <span class="e2">chamatkāra haya</span>–I was amazed at heart, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–grasped <span class="e2">tāra</span>–His <span class="e2">pāda-padma</span>–lotus feet.
Once, Sanātan asked me for advice, and I told him to go to Vṛndāvan. The Lord deemed me a fool for this. Seeing His childish mentality, I was amazed at heart, and I grasped His lotus feet.
বৃন্দাবন যাইতে চাই	তাতে আজ্ঞা নাহি পাই<br />	নানা ছল করে মোর সনে ।<br />যখন কোন্দল হয়	নবদ্বীপে যেতে কয়<br />	সেই তার কৃপা জানি মনে ॥৯॥
vṛndāvana yāite chāi	tāte ājñā nāhi pāi<br />	nānā chhala kare mora sane<br />yakhana kondala haya	navadvīpe yete kaya<br />	sei tāra kṛpā jāni mane [9]
<span class="e2">chāi</span>–I wanted <span class="e2">yāite</span>–to go <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–to Vṛndāvan, [but] <span class="e2">pāi nāhi</span>–I did not receive <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–permission <span class="e2">tāte</span>–to do so. <span class="e2">kare</span>–He gave <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–me <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various <span class="e2">chhala</span>–excuses. <span class="e2">yakhana</span>–When <span class="e2">kondala</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–we quarrelled, [however] <span class="e2">kaya</span>–He told [me] <span class="e2">yete</span>–to go <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–to Nabadwīp, [and] <span class="e2">mane jāni</span>–I accepted <span class="e2">sei</span>–that [as] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–His <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercy.
I wanted to go to Vṛndāvan, but I did not receive His permission: He gave me various excuses. When we quarrelled, however, He told me to go to Nabadwīp, and I accepted that as His mercy.
মাতৃ-আজ্ঞা ছল করি’	আছেন বৈকুণ্ঠপুরী<br />	নিজ ধাম ছাড়িয়া এখন ।<br />তাতে পাঠায় নিজপুরে	যাহাকে সে কৃপা করে<br />	যেন গোপের গোলোক-দর্শন ॥১০॥
mātṛ-ājñā chhala kari’	āchhena vaikuṇṭhapurī<br />	nija-dhāma chhāḍiyā ekhana<br />tāte pāṭhāya nija-pure	yāhāke se kṛpā kare<br />	yena gopera goloka-darśana [10]
<span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–He left <span class="e2">nija-dhāma</span>–His home, [and] <span class="e2">mātṛ-ājñā</span> <span class="e2">chhala</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–using the pretext of His mother’s order, <span class="e2">āchhena</span>–He is <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭhapurī</span>–in Jagannāth Purī. <span class="e2">pāṭhāya</span>–He sends <span class="e2">tāte yāhāke</span>–those whom <span class="e2">se</span>–He <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–blesses <span class="e2">nija-pure</span>–to His abode, [where they] <span class="e2">yena</span> <span class="e2">gopera</span> <span class="e2">goloka-darśana</span>–can see Goloka as the cowherd men did.
He left His home, and on the pretext of His mother’s order, He is now in Jagannāth Purī. He sends those whom He blesses to His abode, where they can behold Goloka as the cowherd men did.*
এই ভাবে গৌর-সেবা	করি আমি রাত্রদিবা<br />	গৌরগণের এই ত’ স্বভাব ।<br />গৌর-গদাধর-পদ	আমার ত’ সম্পদ<br />	দামোদর জ্ঞানে এই ভাব ॥১১॥
ei bhāve gaura-sevā	kari āmi rātra-divā<br />	gaura-gaṇera ei ta’ svabhāva<br />gaura-gadādhara-pada	āmāra ta’ sampada<br />	dāmodara jñāne ei bhāva [11]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–In this way, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">gaura-sevā kari</span>–serve Gaura <span class="e2">rātra-divā</span>–night and day. <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">svabhāva</span>–the nature <span class="e2">gaura-gaṇera</span>–of Gaura’s associates. <span class="e2">gaura-gadādhara-pada</span>–The feet of Gaura and Gadādhar [are] <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–my <span class="e2">sampada</span>–wealth. <span class="e2">dāmodara</span>–Svarūp Dāmodar <span class="e2">jñāne</span>–understands <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–mood.
In this way, I serve Gaura night and day. This is the nature of Gaura’s associates. The feet of Gaura and Gadādhar are my wealth. Svarūp Dāmodar understands this mood.
*<span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> (10.28) describes that Nanda Mahārāj was once captured by the attendants of Varuṇa while bathing in the River Yamunā. After Kṛṣṇa rescued Nanda Mahārāj from Varuṇa’s abode, Nanda Mahārāj described both Varuṇa’s majesty and Varuṇa’s reverence for Kṛṣṇa to the cowherd men, who under the cover of yogamāyā were amazed that Kṛṣṇa was the Supreme Lord. They then wondered whether Kṛṣṇa would ever show them His abode in the spiritual world. Knowing that the cowherd men were unaware of their own supreme fortune of already being in the expansion of His personal abode on earth, Gokula, Kṛṣṇa fulfilled their desire. He briefly removed them from Gokula, showed them that Goloka, His abode in the spiritual world, is above both Brahmaloka and Vaikuṇṭha, and then revealed Himself in Goloka being worshipped by the personified Vedas. As the cowherd men rejoiced in astonishment, Kṛṣṇa effortlessly returned them to Gokula.

Chapter Six
জীব-গতি
Jīva-gati
The Journey of the Soul
জীব ও কৃষ্ণ
jīva o kṛṣṇa
The soul and Kṛṣṇa
চিৎকণ জীব, কৃষ্ণ চিন্ময় ভাস্কর ।<br />নিত্যকৃষ্ণ দেখি’ কৃষ্ণে করেন আদর ॥১॥
chit-kaṇa jīva, kṛṣṇa chinmaya bhāskara<br />nitya-kṛṣṇa dekhi’ kṛṣṇe karena ādara [1]
<span class="e2">jīva</span>–The soul [is] <span class="e2">chit-kaṇa</span>–a spiritual spark, [and]<span class="e2"> kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span> <span class="e2">bhāskara</span>–the spiritual sun. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing<span class="e2"> nitya-kṛṣṇa</span>–eternal Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">ādara karena</span>–the soul adores <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–Kṛṣṇa.
The soul is a spiritual spark, and Kṛṣṇa is the spiritual sun. Seeing eternal Kṛṣṇa, the soul adores Him.
মায়াগ্রস্ত জীব
māyā-grasta jīva
The soul bound by Māyā
কৃষ্ণ-বহির্ম্মুখ হঞা ভোগ বাঞ্ছা করে ।<br />নিকটস্থ মায়া তারে জাপটিয়া ধরে ॥২॥
