kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha hañā bhoga vāñchhā kare<br />nikaṭastha māyā tāre jāpaṭiyā dhare [2]
[When] <span class="e2">hañā</span>–souls become<span class="e2"> kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha</span>–averse to Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">vāñchhā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–desire <span class="e2">bhoga</span>–enjoyment, <span class="e2">nikaṭastha</span>–nearby <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">jāpaṭiyā</span> <span class="e2">dhare</span>–seizes <span class="e2">tāre</span>–them.
When souls become averse to Kṛṣṇa and desire enjoyment, nearby Māyā seizes them.
পিশাচী পাইলে যেন মতিচ্ছন্ন হয় ।<br />মায়াগ্রস্ত জীবের হয় সে ভাব উদয় ॥৩॥
piśachī pāile yena mati-chchhanna haya<br />māyā-grasta jīvera haya se bhāva udaya [3]
<span class="e2">piśachī</span> <span class="e2">pāile</span>–When someone is possessed by a ghost, <span class="e2">haya</span>–they become <span class="e2">mati-chchhanna</span>–bewildered. <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–This condition <span class="e2">yena</span>–similarly <span class="e2">jīvera udaya haya</span>–overtakes souls <span class="e2">māyā-grasta</span>–bound by Māyā.
When someone is possessed by a ghost, they become bewildered. This condition overtakes souls bound by Māyā.
“আমি নিত্য কৃষ্ণদাস” এই কথা ভুলে<br />মায়ার নফর হঞা চিরদিন বুলে ॥৪॥
“āmi nitya kṛṣṇa-dāsa” ei kathā bhule<br />māyāra naphara hañā chira-dina bule [4]
<span class="e2">“āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-dāsa”</span>–an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa.” <span class="e2">bhule</span>–Forgetting <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">kathā</span>–principle, <span class="e2">hañā</span>–souls become <span class="e2">naphara</span>–slaves <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of Māyā [and] <span class="e2">bule</span>–wander<span class="e2"> chira-dina</span>–indefinitely.
Forgetting, “I am an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa”, souls become slaves of Māyā and wander indefinitely.
কভু রাজা কভু প্রজা কভু বিপ্র শূদ্র ।<br />কভু দুঃখী কভু সুখী কভু কীট ক্ষুদ্র ॥৫॥
kabhu rājā kabhu prajā kabhu vipra śūdra<br />kabhu duḥkhī kabhu sukhī kabhu kīṭa kṣudra [5]
[They are] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">rājā</span>–kings, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">prajā</span>–subjects; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">vipra</span>–brāhmaṇs, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">śūdra</span>–śūdras; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">duḥkhī</span>–sad, <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">sukhī</span>–happy, [and sometimes] <span class="e2">kīṭa</span> <span class="e2">kṣudra</span>–insignificant ants.
They are sometimes kings, and sometimes subjects; sometimes brāhmaṇs, and sometimes śūdras; sometimes sad, sometimes happy, and sometimes insignificant ants.
কভু স্বর্গে, কভু মর্ত্ত্যে, নরকে বা কভু ।<br />কভু দেব, কভু দৈত্য, কভু দাস প্রভু ॥৬॥
kabhu svarge, kabhu martye, narake vā kabhu<br />kabhu deva, kabhu daitya, kabhu dāsa prabhu [6]
[They are] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">svarge</span>–in heaven, <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">martye</span>–on earth, <span class="e2">kabhu vā</span>–and sometimes <span class="e2">narake</span>–in hell; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">deva</span>–gods, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">daitya</span>–demons; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servants, [and sometimes] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–masters.
They are sometimes in heaven, sometimes on earth, and sometimes in hell; sometimes gods, and sometimes demons; sometimes servants, and sometimes masters.
সাধুসঙ্গে নিস্তার
sādhu-saṅge nistāra
Liberation through the association of the sādhus
এইরূপে সংসার ভ্রমিতে কোন জন ।<br />সাধুসঙ্গে নিজতত্ত্ব অবগত হন ॥৭॥
ei-rūpe saṁsāra bhramite kona jana<br />sādhu-saṅge nija-tattva avagata hana [7]
<span class="e2">bhramite</span>–While wandering <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–throughout the world <span class="e2">ei-rūpe</span>–in this way, <span class="e2">kona</span>–some <span class="e2">jana</span>–souls <span class="e2">hana</span>–become <span class="e2">avagata</span>–aware <span class="e2">nija-tattva</span>–of their true nature <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–through association with the sādhus.
While wandering throughout saṁsāra in this way, some souls become aware of their true nature by associating with the sādhus.
নিজতত্ত্ব জানি’ আর সংসার না চায় ।<br />“কেন বা ভজিনু মায়া” করে হায় হায় ॥৮॥
nija-tattva jāni’ āra saṁsāra nā chāya<br />“kena vā bhajinu māyā” kare hāya hāya [8]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Understanding <span class="e2">nija-tattva</span>–their true nature, <span class="e2">āra chāya nā</span>–they no longer desire <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the world, [and] <span class="e2">hāya</span> <span class="e2">hāya kare</span>–lament,<span class="e2">“kena</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–“Why <span class="e2">bhajinu</span>–have I been serving <span class="e2">māyā”</span>–Māyā?”
Understanding their true nature, they no longer desire saṁsāra, and lament, “Why have I been serving Māyā?”
কেঁদে বলে, “ওহে কৃষ্ণ আমি তব দাস ।<br />তোমার চরণ ছাড়ি’ হৈল সর্ব্ব নাশ” ॥৯॥
ke̐de bale, “ohe kṛṣṇa āmi tava dāsa<br />tomāra charaṇa chhāḍi’ haila sarva-nāśa” [9]
<span class="e2">ke̐de</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">bale</span>–they say, <span class="e2">“ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa! <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant, [but] <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–I have left <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet [and] <span class="e2">sarva-nāśa haila”</span>–became utterly ruined.
Crying, they say, “O Kṛṣṇa! I am Your servant, but I have left Your feet and become utterly ruined.”
কৃপা করি’ কৃষ্ণ তারে ছাড়ান সংসার ।<br />কাকুতি করিয়া কৃষ্ণে যদি ডাকে একবার ॥১০॥
kṛpā kari’ kṛṣṇa tāre chhāḍāna saṁsāra<br />kākuti kariyā kṛṣṇe yadi ḍāke eka-bāra [10]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">tāre</span> <span class="e2">chhāḍāna</span>–causes them to leave <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the world <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">kākuti</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–they earnestly [even] <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–call out <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–to Kṛṣṇa.
Kṛṣṇa mercifully frees souls from saṁsāra if they even once earnestly call out to Him.
মায়াকে পিছনে রাখি’ কৃষ্ণপানে চায় ।<br />ভজিতে ভজিতে কৃষ্ণপাদপদ্ম পায় ॥১১॥
māyāke pichhane rākhi’ kṛṣṇa-pāne chāya<br />bhajite bhajite kṛṣṇa-pāda-padma pāya [11]
<span class="e2">māyāke</span> <span class="e2">pichhane</span> <span class="e2">rākhi’</span>–Leaving Māyā behind, <span class="e2">chāya</span>–souls hanker <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pāne</span>–for Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">bhajite</span> <span class="e2">bhajite</span>–by continuously serving [Kṛṣṇa,] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–they reach <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pāda-padma</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet.
Leaving Māyā behind, souls hanker for Kṛṣṇa, and by continuously serving Kṛṣṇa, they reach His lotus feet.
কৃষ্ণ তারে দেন নিজ চিচ্ছক্তির বল ।<br />মায়া আকর্ষণ ছাড়ে হইয়া দুর্ব্বল ॥১২॥
kṛṣṇa tāre dena nija chich-chhaktira bala<br />māyā ākarṣaṇa chhāḍe ha-iyā durbala [12]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">dena</span>–gives <span class="e2">tāre</span>–them <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">chich-chhaktira</span> <span class="e2">bala</span>–the power of His spiritual energy, [and] <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā, <span class="e2">durbala ha-iyā</span>–becoming powerless, <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–stops <span class="e2">ākarṣaṇa</span>–attracting [them].
Kṛṣṇa gives them His spiritual power, and Māyā, becoming powerless, stops attracting them.
সাধুসঙ্গে কৃষ্ণনামে—এই মাত্র চাই ।<br />সংসার জিনিতে আর কোন বস্তু নাই ॥১৩॥
sādhu-saṅge kṛṣṇa-nāma—ei mātra chāi<br />saṁsāra jinite āra kona vastu nāi [13]
<span class="e2">chāi</span>–I want <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">ei</span>–this: [to chant] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–in the association of the sādhus. <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">vastu</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is no other way <span class="e2">jinite</span>–to conquer <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the world.
I want only to chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa in the association of the sādhus—there is no other way to conquer saṁsāra.
সকল ভরসা ছাড়ি’ গোরাপদে আশ ।<br />করিয়া বসিয়া আছে জগাই গোরার দাস ॥১৪॥
sakala bharasā chhāḍi’ gorā-pade āśa<br />kariyā basiyā āchhe jagāi gorāra dāsa [14]
<span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Giving up<span class="e2"> sakala</span>–all [other] <span class="e2">bharasā</span>–prospects, <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–servant <span class="e2">jagāi</span>–Jagāi <span class="e2">basiyā</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–sits <span class="e2">āśa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–hopefully <span class="e2">gorā-pade</span>–at Gorā’s feet.
Giving up all other prospects, Gorā’s servant Jagāi sits hopefully at Gorā’s feet.

Chapter Seven
সকলের পক্ষে নাম
Sakalera Pakṣe Nāma
The Name is for Everyone
অসাধুসঙ্গে নাম হয় না
asādhu-saṅge nāma haya nā
The Name does not appear in bad association
অসাধুসঙ্গে ভাই কৃষ্ণনাম নাহি হয় ।<br />নামাক্ষর বাহিরায় বটে তবু নাম কভু নয় ॥১॥
asādhu-saṅge bhāi kṛṣṇa-nāma nāhi haya<br />nāmākṣara bāhirāya baṭe tabu nāma kabhu naya [1]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–does not appear <span class="e2">asādhu-saṅge</span>–in bad association: <span class="e2">nāmākṣara</span>–the letters of the Name <span class="e2">bāhirāya</span>–appear, <span class="e2">baṭe</span>–true, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–never <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name.
Brother, the Name of Kṛṣṇa never appears in bad association: the letters of the Name may appear, but the Name never does.
কভু নামাভাস হয়, সদা নাম-অপরাধ ।<br />এ সব জানিবে ভাই কৃষ্ণভক্তির বাধ ॥২॥
kabhu nāmābhāsa haya, sadā nāma-aparādha<br />e saba jānibe bhāi kṛṣṇa-bhaktira bādha [2]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">nāmābhāsa</span>–a semblance of the Name <span class="e2">haya</span>–appears, [but] <span class="e2">nāma-aparādha</span>–offences to the Name <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always [do]. <span class="e2">jānibe</span>–Know <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all of these, <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother, [to be] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">bādha</span>–obstacles to devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
Sometimes a semblance of the Name appears, but offences to the Name always do. Know both of these, brother, to be obstacles to devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
নামভজন-প্রণালী
nāma-bhajana-praṇālī
The process to serve the Name
যদি করিবে কৃষ্ণনাম সাধুসঙ্গ কর ।<br />ভুক্তি-মুক্তি-সিদ্ধি-বাঞ্ছা দূরে পরিহর ॥৩॥
yadi karibe kṛṣṇa-nāma sādhu-saṅga kara<br />bhukti-mukti-siddhi-vāñchhā dūre parihara [3]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma karibe</span>–you want to chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, [then] <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅga</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–associate with sādhus [and] <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">parihara</span>–leave behind <span class="e2">bhukti-mukti-siddhi-vāñchhā</span>–the desires for enjoyment, liberation, and supernatural power.
If you want to chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, then associate with sādhus and leave behind the desires for enjoyment, liberation, and supernatural power.
“দশ-অপরাধ” ত্যজ মান অপমান ।<br />অনাসক্ত্যে বিষয় ভুঞ্জ আর লহ কৃষ্ণনাম ॥৪॥
“daśa-aparādha” tyaja māna apamāna<br />anāsaktye viṣaya bhuñja āra laha kṛṣṇa-nāma [4]
<span class="e2">tyaja</span>–Give up <span class="e2">“daśa</span> <span class="e2">aparādha”</span>–the ten offences, <span class="e2">māna</span>–honour, [and] <span class="e2">apamāna</span>–dishonour, <span class="e2">bhuñja</span>–interact <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–with the world <span class="e2">anāsaktye</span>–with detachment, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">laha</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
Give up the ten offences, honour, and dishonour, interact with the world with detachment, and chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
কৃষ্ণভক্তির অনুকূল সব করহ স্বীকার ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তির প্রতিকূল সব কর পরিহার ॥৫॥
kṛṣṇa-bhaktira anukūla saba karaha svīkāra<br />kṛṣṇa-bhaktira pratikūla saba kara parihāra [5]
<span class="e2">svīkāra karaha</span>–Accept <span class="e2">saba</span>–everything <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhaktira</span>–to devotion to Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">parihāra kara</span>–reject <span class="e2">saba</span>–everything <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhaktira</span>–to devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
Accept everything favourable to devotion to Kṛṣṇa, and reject everything unfavourable to devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
জ্ঞানযোগচেষ্টা ছাড় আর কর্ম্মসঙ্গ ।<br />মর্কটবৈরাগ্য ত্যজ যাতে দেহরঙ্গ ॥৬॥
jñāna-yoga-cheṣṭā chhāḍa āra karma-saṅga<br />markaṭa-vairāgya tyaja yāte deha-raṅga [6]
<span class="e2">chhāḍa</span>–Give up <span class="e2">karma-saṅga</span>–attachment to material activity <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">jñāna-yoga-cheṣṭā</span>–endeavours based on knowledge and yoga. <span class="e2">tyaja</span>–Avoid <span class="e2">markaṭa-vairāgya</span>–‘monkey renunciation’, <span class="e2">yāte</span>–in which [there is only] <span class="e2">deha-raṅga</span>–bodily enjoyment.
Give up attachment to material activity and endeavours based on knowledge and yoga. Avoid ‘monkey renunciation’, in which there is only bodily enjoyment.
কৃষ্ণ আমায় পালে রাখে জান সর্ব্বকাল ।<br />আত্মনিবেদনদৈন্যে ঘুচাও জঞ্জাল ॥৭॥
kṛṣṇa āmāya pāle rākhe jāna sarva-kāla<br />ātma-nivedana-dainye ghuchāo jañjāla [7]
<span class="e2">sarva-kāla</span>–At all times, <span class="e2">jāna</span>–know, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–“Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–protects [and] <span class="e2">pāle</span>–maintains <span class="e2">āmāya</span>–me.” <span class="e2">ghuchāo</span>–Put an end <span class="e2">jañjāla</span>–to [your] troubles <span class="e2">ātma-nivedana-dainye</span>–through self-surrender and humility.
Always know, “Kṛṣṇa protects and maintains me.” Put an end to your troubles through self-surrender and humility.
সাধু পাওয়া কষ্ট বড় জীবের জানিয়া ।<br />সাধুগুরুরূপে কৃষ্ণ আইল নদীয়া ॥৮॥
sādhu pāoyā kaṣṭa baḍa jīvera jāniyā<br />sādhu-bhakta-rūpe kṛṣṇa āilā nadīyā [8]
<span class="e2">jāniyā</span>–Understanding [that] <span class="e2">pāoyā</span>–finding <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–a pure devotee [is] <span class="e2">baḍa kaṣṭa</span>–very difficult <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for a soul, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">āilā</span>–came <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–to Nadia <span class="e2">sādhu-bhakta-rūpe</span>–in the form of a pure devotee.
Understanding that it is very difficult for a soul to find a sādhu, Kṛṣṇa came to Nadia in the form of a pure devotee.
গোরাপদ আশ্রয় করহ বুদ্ধিমান্ ।<br />গোরা বৈ সাধু গুরু আছে কে বা আন ॥৯॥
gorā-pada āśraya karaha buddhimān<br />gorā vai sādhu guru āchhe ke vā āna [9]
<span class="e2">buddhimān</span>–O intelligent soul,<span class="e2"> āśraya</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–take shelter <span class="e2">gorā-pada</span>–at Gorā’s feet. <span class="e2">ke</span> <span class="e2">vā</span> <span class="e2">āna</span>–What other <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–sādhu [or] <span class="e2">guru</span>–Guru <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is there <span class="e2">vai</span>–besides <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā?
O intelligent soul, take shelter at Gorā’s feet. What other sādhu or Guru is there besides Gorā?
বৈরাগীর কর্ত্তব্য
vairāgīra kartavya
The duty of a renunciant
বৈরাগী ভাই গ্রাম্যকথা না শুনিবে কানে ।<br />গ্রাম্যবার্তা না কহিবে যবে মিলিবে আনে ॥১০॥
vairāgī bhāi grāmya-kathā nā śunibe kāne<br />grāmya-vārtā nā kahibe yabe milibe āne [10]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–renunciants <span class="e2">śunibe nā</span>–should not listen <span class="e2">grāmya-kathā</span>–to village talk <span class="e2">kāne</span>–with [their] ears [and] <span class="e2">kahibe nā</span>–should not speak <span class="e2">grāmya-vārtā</span>–about village news <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">milibe</span>–they meet <span class="e2">āne</span>–with others.
Brother, renunciants should neither listen to village talk nor discuss village news when they meet with others.
স্বপনেও না কর ভাই স্ত্রী-সম্ভাষণ ।<br />গৃহে স্ত্রী ছাড়িয়া ভাই আসিয়াছ বন ॥১১॥
svapaneo nā kara bhāi strī-sambhāṣaṇa<br />gṛhe strī chhāḍiyā bhāi āsiyāchha vana [11]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">strī-sambhāṣaṇa kara nā</span>–do not converse with women, <span class="e2">svapaneo</span>–even in dreams. <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–you have left <span class="e2">strī</span>–women <span class="e2">gṛhe</span>–at home [and] <span class="e2">āsiyāchha</span>–come <span class="e2">vana</span>–to the forest.
Brother, do not converse with women, even in dreams. Brother, you have left women at home and come to the forest.
যদি চাহ প্রণয় রাখিতে গৌরাঙ্গের সনে ।<br />ছোট হরিদাসের কথা থাকে যেন মনে ॥১২॥
yadi chāha praṇaya rākhite gaurāṅgera sane<br />chhoṭa haridāsera kathā thāke yena mane [12]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">chāha</span>–you want <span class="e2">rākhite</span>–to maintain [your] <span class="e2">praṇaya</span>–love <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–for Gaurāṅga, <span class="e2">yena</span>–then <span class="e2">mane thāke</span>–remember <span class="e2">kathā</span>–the story <span class="e2">chhoṭa</span> <span class="e2">haridāsera</span>–of Chhoṭa Haridās.
If you want to maintain your love for Gaurāṅga, then remember the story of Chhoṭa Haridās.
ভাল না খাইবে আর ভাল না পরিবে ।<br />হৃদয়েতে রাধাকৃষ্ণ সর্ব্বদা সেবিবে ॥১৩॥
bhāla nā khāibe āra bhāla nā paribe<br />hṛdayete rādhā-kṛṣṇa sarvadā sevibe [13]
<span class="e2">khāibe nā</span>–Do not eat <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">paribe nā</span>–do not dress <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy. <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–Always <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">hṛdayete</span>–within [your] heart.
Do not eat fancy food, and do not wear fancy clothes. Always serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa within your heart.
বড় হরিদাসের ন্যায় কৃষ্ণনাম বলিবে বদনে ।<br />অষ্টকাল রাধাকৃষ্ণ সেবিবে কুঞ্জবনে ॥১৪॥
baḍa haridāsera nyāya kṛṣṇa-nāma balibe vadane<br />aṣṭa-kāla rādhā-kṛṣṇa sevibe kuñja-vane [14]
<span class="e2">vadane balibe</span>–Loudly chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nyāya</span>–like <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">haridāsera</span>–Haridās Ṭhākur, [and] <span class="e2">sevibe</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">kuñja-vane</span>–in the groves <span class="e2">aṣṭa-kāla</span>–twenty-four hours [a day].
Loudly chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa like Haridās Ṭhākur, and serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in the groves of Vraja twenty-four hours a day.
গৃহস্থ ও বৈরাগীর প্রতি আদেশ
gṛhastha o vairāgīra prati ādeśa
Instructions for householders and renunciants
গৃহস্থ বৈরাগী দুঁহে বলে গোরারায় ।<br />“দেখ ভাই নাম বিনা যেন দিন নাহি যায়” ॥১৫॥
gṛhastha vairāgī du̐he bale gorā-rāya<br />“dekha bhāi nāma vinā yena dina nāhi yāya” [15]
<span class="e2">gorā-rāya</span>–Gorā Rāy <span class="e2">bale</span>–says <span class="e2">du̐he</span>–to both <span class="e2">gṛhastha</span>–householders [and] <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–renunciants, <span class="e2">“bhāi</span>–Brothers, <span class="e2">dekha yena</span>–see to it that <span class="e2">dina</span>–a day <span class="e2">yāya nāhi</span>–does not pass <span class="e2">vinā</span>–without [chanting] <span class="e2">nāma”</span>–the Name.”
Gorā Rāy says to both householders and renunciants, “Brothers, see to it that a day does not pass without chanting the Name.”
বহু-অঙ্গ সাধনে ভাই নাহি প্রয়োজন ।<br />কৃষ্ণনামাশ্রয়ে শুদ্ধ করহ জীবন ॥১৬॥
bahu-aṅga sādhane bhāi nāhi prayojana<br />kṛṣṇa-nāmāśraye śuddha karaha jīvana [16]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">prayojana nāhi</span>–there is no need <span class="e2">sādhane</span>–to perform <span class="e2">bahu-aṅga</span>–many practices: <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–purify [your] <span class="e2">jīvana</span>–life <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāmāśraye</span>–in the shelter of Kṛṣṇa’s Name.
Brother, there is no need to perform many practices: purify your life in the shelter of Kṛṣṇa’s Name.
বদ্ধ জীবে কৃপা করি’ কৃষ্ণ হইল নাম ।<br />কলিজীবে দয়া করি’ কৃষ্ণ হইল গৌরধাম ॥১৭॥
baddha jīve kṛpā kari’ kṛṣṇa ha-ila nāma<br />kali-jīve dayā kari’ kṛṣṇa ha-ila gaura-dhāma [17]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Being merciful <span class="e2">baddha</span> <span class="e2">jīve</span>–to the conditioned souls, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–appeared <span class="e2">nāma</span>–as [His] Name, [and] <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–being compassionate <span class="e2">kali-jīve</span>–to the souls of Kali-yuga, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–appeared <span class="e2">gaura-dhāma</span>–as Gaura.
Being merciful to the conditioned souls, Kṛṣṇa appeared as His Name, and being compassionate to the souls of Kali-yuga, He appeared as Gaura.
একান্ত-সরল-ভাবে ভজ গৌরজন ।<br />তবে ত’ পাইবে ভাই শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ ॥১৮॥
ekānta-sarala-bhāve bhaja gaura-jana<br />tabe ta’ pāibe bhāi śrī-kṛṣṇa-charaṇa [18]
<span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">gaura-jana</span>–Gaura’s devotees <span class="e2">ekānta-sarala-bhāve</span>–with perfect sincerity, [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–then, <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother, <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-charaṇa</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s feet.
Serve Gaura’s devotees with perfect sincerity, and then, brother, you will reach Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s feet.
গৌরজন সঙ্গ কর গৌরাঙ্গ বলিয়া ।<br />‘হরে কৃষ্ণ’ নাম বল নাচিয়া নাচিয়া ॥১৯॥
gaura-jana saṅga kara gaurāṅga baliyā<br />‘hare kṛṣṇa’ nāma bala nāchiyā nāchiyā [19]
<span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Chant <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–‘Gaurāṅga’ [and] <span class="e2">saṅga</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–associate [with] <span class="e2">gaura-jana</span>–Gaura’s devotees. <span class="e2">bala</span>–Chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Names <span class="e2">‘hare</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Hare Kṛṣṇa’ [and] <span class="e2">nāchiyā</span> <span class="e2">nāchiyā</span>–dance and dance.
Chant ‘Gaurāṅga’ and associate with Gaura’s devotees. Chant ‘Hare Kṛṣṇa’ and dance.
অচিরে পাইবে ভাই নামপ্রেমধন ।<br />যাহা বিলাইতে প্রভুর নদে আগমন ॥২০॥
achire pāibe bhāi nāma-prema-dhana<br />yāhā bilāite prabhura nade āgamana [20]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother,<span class="e2"> achire</span>–soon <span class="e2">pāibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">nāma-prema-dhana</span>–the Name and the wealth of divine love, <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">nade</span> <span class="e2">āgamana</span>–the Lord came to Nadia <span class="e2">bilāite</span>–to distribute.
Brother, soon you will attain the Name and the wealth of divine love, which the Lord came to Nadia to distribute.
প্রভুর কুন্দলে জগা কেঁদে কেঁদে বলে ।<br />নাম ভজ নাম গাও ভকত সকল ॥২১॥
prabhura kundale jagā ke̐de ke̐de bale<br />nāma bhaja nāma gāo bhakata sakale [21]
<span class="e2">ke̐de</span> <span class="e2">ke̐de</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">kundale</span>–angry <span class="e2">jagā</span>–Jagā <span class="e2">bale</span>–says, <span class="e2">bhakata</span> <span class="e2">sakale</span>–“O devotees! <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name! <span class="e2">gāo</span>–Chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name!”
Crying, the Lord’s angry Jagā says, “O devotees! Serve the Name and chant the Name!”

Chapter Eight
কুটীনাটী ছাড়
Kuṭīnāṭī Chhāḍa
Give up Deceit
সরল মনে গোরাভজন
sarala mane gorā-bhajana
Serving Gorā with a sincere heart
গোরা ভজ, গোরা ভজ, গোরা ভজ ভাই ।<br />গোরা বিনা এ জগতে গুরু আর নাই ॥১॥
gorā bhaja, gorā bhaja, gorā bhaja bhāi<br />gorā vinā e jagate guru āra nāi [1]
<span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā! <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā! <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā! <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">nāi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">guru</span>–Guru <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">jagate</span>–in this world <span class="e2">vinā</span> <span class="e2">āra</span>–other than <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā.
Serve Gorā! Serve Gorā! Serve Gorā! Brother, there is no Guru in this world other than Gorā.
যদি ভজিবে গোরা সরল কর নিজ মন ।<br />কুটীনাটিই ছাড়ি’ ভজ গোরার চরণ ॥২॥
yadi bhajibe gorā sarala kara nija mana<br />kuṭīnāṭi chhāḍi’ bhaja gorāra charaṇa [2]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">bhajibe</span>–you want to serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā, <span class="e2">kara</span>–make <span class="e2">nija</span>–your <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart <span class="e2">sarala</span>–sincere. <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Give up <span class="e2">kuṭīnāṭi</span>–deceit [and] <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet.
If you want to serve Gorā, make your heart sincere. Give up deceit and serve Gorā’s feet.
মনের কথা গোরা জানে ফাঁকি কেমনে দিবে ।<br />সরল হলে গোরার শিক্ষা বুঝিয়া লইবে ॥৩॥
manera kathā gorā jāne phā̐ki kemane dibe<br />sarala hale gorāra śikṣā bujhiyā la-ibe [3]
<span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows [your] <span class="e2">manera</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–thoughts. <span class="e2">kemane</span>–How <span class="e2">phā̐ki dibe</span>–will you cheat [Him]? <span class="e2">sarala</span> <span class="e2">hale</span>–When you are sincere, <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span> <span class="e2">la-ibe</span>–you will understand <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s <span class="e2">śikṣā</span>–teachings.
Gorā knows your thoughts, so how will you cheat Him? When you are sincere, you will understand Gorā’s teachings.
আনের মন রাখিতে গিয়া আপনাকে দিবে ফাঁকি ।<br />মনের কথা জানে গোরা কেমনে হৃদয় ঢাকি ॥৪॥
ānera mana rākhite giyā āpanāke dibe phā̐ki<br />manera kathā jāne gorā kemane hṛdaya ḍhāki [4]
<span class="e2">giyā</span>–Going <span class="e2">rākhite</span>–to satisfy <span class="e2">mana</span>–the minds <span class="e2">ānera</span>–of others, <span class="e2">phā̐ki dibe</span>–you will cheat <span class="e2">āpanāke</span>–yourself. <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows [your] <span class="e2">manera</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–thoughts, [so] <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how <span class="e2">ḍhāki</span>–will you hide [your] <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart [from Him]?
If you go to satisfy the minds of others, you will only cheat yourself. Gorā knows your thoughts, so how will you hide your heart from Him?
গোরা বলে, “আমার মত করহ চরিত ।<br />আমার আজ্ঞা পালন কর চাহ যদি হিত” ॥৫॥
gorā bale, “āmāra mata karaha charita<br />āmāra ājñā pālana kara chāha yadi hita” [5]
<span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">bale</span>–says, <span class="e2">“charita karaha</span>–“Behave <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">mata</span>–like Me [and] <span class="e2">pālana</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–follow <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–instructions <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">chāha</span>–you want <span class="e2">hita”</span>–good fortune.”
Gorā says, “Behave like Me and follow My instructions if you want good fortune.”
কপট ভজন
kapaṭa bhajana
Deceitful service
“গোরার আমি, গোরার আমি” মুখে বলিলে না চলে ।<br />গোরার আচার, গোরার বিচার লইলে ফল ফলে ॥৬॥
“gorāra āmi, gorāra āmi” mukhe balile nāhi chale<br />gorāra āchāra, gorāra vichāra la-ile phala phale [6]
<span class="e2">mukhe</span> <span class="e2">balile</span>–You may say aloud, <span class="e2">“āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I [am] <span class="e2">gorāra”</span>–Gorā’s”, [but this] <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">chale</span>–does not do. <span class="e2">la-ile</span>–When you follow <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s <span class="e2">āchāra</span>–practices [and] <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s <span class="e2">vichāra</span>–conception, [then] <span class="e2">phala</span>–the result <span class="e2">phale</span>–manifests.
Just saying, “I am Gorā’s! I am Gorā’s!” does not do. Only when you follow Gorā’s practices and Gorā’s conception will you get the proper result.
লোক দেখান গোরা ভজা তিলক মাত্র ধরি ।<br />গোপনেতে অত্যাচার গোরা ধরে চুরি ॥৭॥
loka dekhāna gorā bhajā tilaka mātra dhari’<br />gopanete atyāchāra gorā dhare churi [7]
<span class="e2">loka-dekhāna</span>–You show the world [you] <span class="e2">bhajā</span>–serve <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">mātra</span>–simply <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–by wearing <span class="e2">tilaka</span>–tilak [but] <span class="e2">gopanete</span>–secretly you <span class="e2">atyāchāra</span>–misbehave. <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">dhare</span>–will catch [you, you] <span class="e2">churi</span>–thief!
You show the world you serve Gorā simply by wearing tilak but secretly you misbehave. Gorā will catch you, you thief!
অধঃপতন হবে ভাই কৈলে কুটীনাটি ।<br />নাম-অপরাধে তোমার ভজন হবে মাটি ॥৮॥
adhaḥ-patana habe bhāi kaile kuṭīnāṭi<br />nāma-aparādhe tomāra bhajana habe māṭi [8]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">kuṭīnāṭi</span> <span class="e2">kaile</span>–if you act deceitfully <span class="e2">adhaḥ-patana</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–you will fall down. <span class="e2">nāma-aparādhe</span>–Because of offences to the Name <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–service <span class="e2">māṭi habe</span>–will be ruined.
Brother, if you act deceitfully, you will fall down. Because of offences to the Name, your service will be ruined.
নাম লঞা যে করে পাপ হয় অপরাধ ।<br />এর মত ভক্তি আর আছে কিবা বাধ ?॥৯॥
nāma lañā ye kare pāpa haya aparādha<br />era mata bhakti āra āchhe kibā bādha? [9]
<span class="e2">ye</span>–Those who <span class="e2">lañā</span>–chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [and] <span class="e2">pāpa kare</span>–sin <span class="e2">aparādha haya</span>–commit offence. <span class="e2">kibā āra</span>–What greater <span class="e2">bādha</span>–obstacle <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is there <span class="e2">era</span> <span class="e2">mata</span>–than such <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–‘devotion’?
Those who chant the Name and sin commit offence. What greater obstacle is there than such ‘devotion’?
নাম করিতে কষ্ট নাই নাম সহজ ধন ।<br />ওষ্ঠ-স্পন্দ-মাত্রে হয় নামের কীর্ত্তন ।<br />তাহাও না হয় যদি হয় নামের স্মরণ ॥১০॥
nāma karite kaṣṭa nāi nāma sahaja dhana<br />oṣṭha-spanda-mātre haya nāmera kīrtana<br />tāhāo nā haya yadi haya nāmera smaraṇa [10]
<span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">kaṣṭa</span>–difficulty <span class="e2">karite</span>–in chanting <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name. <span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is everyone’s] <span class="e2">sahaja</span>–natural <span class="e2">dhana</span>–wealth. <span class="e2">oṣṭha-spanda-mātre</span>–Simply by moving your lips, <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">kīrtana haya</span>–you chant the Name. <span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–you cannot do <span class="e2">tāhāo</span>–even that, [then] <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">smaraṇa haya</span>–you can remember the Name.
The Name is everyone’s natural wealth, and chanting the Name is not difficult: simply by moving your lips you can chant the Name. If you cannot do even that, then you can remember the Name.
তুণ্ডবন্ধে চিত্তভ্রংশে শ্রবণ তবু হয় ।<br />সর্ব্বপাপ ক্ষয়ে জীবের মুখ্য ফলোদয় ॥১১॥
tuṇḍa-bandhe chita-bhraṁśe śravaṇa tabu haya<br />sarva-pāpa kṣaye jīvera mukhya phalodaya [11]
<span class="e2">tuṇḍa-bandhe</span>–The mute [and]<span class="e2"> chita-bhraṁśe</span>–the deranged <span class="e2">tabu</span>–still <span class="e2">śravaṇa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–hear [the Name, and this alone] <span class="e2">kṣaye</span>–destroys <span class="e2">sarva-pāpa</span>–all sins [and] <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">mukhya</span> <span class="e2">phalodaya</span>–gives rise to the true fortune of the soul.
Even the mute and the deranged can still hear the Name, and this alone destroys all sins and gives rise to the true fortune of the soul.
বহুজন্ম অর্চ্চনেতে এই ফল ধরে ।<br />কৃষ্ণনাম নিরন্তর তুণ্ডে নৃত্য করে ॥১২॥
bahu-janma archchanete ei phala dhare<br />krṣṇa-nāma nirantara tuṇḍe nṛtya kare [12]
<span class="e2">bahu-janma</span>–Many lifetimes <span class="e2">archanete</span>–of Deity worship <span class="e2">dhare</span>–bear <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">phala</span> <span class="e2">dhare</span>–this result: <span class="e2">krṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–constantly <span class="e2">nṛtya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–dances <span class="e2">tuṇḍe</span>–in [your] mouth.
Many lifetimes of Deity worship bear this result: the Name of Kṛṣṇa constantly dances in your mouth.
কর্ম্মজ্ঞানযোগাদির সেই শক্তি নহে ।<br />বিধিভঙ্গদোষে ফলহীন শাস্ত্রে কহে ॥১৩॥
karma-jñāna-yogādira sei śakti nahe<br />vidhi-bhaṅga-doṣe phala-hīna śāstre kahe [13]
<span class="e2">śāstre</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">kahe</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">karma-jñāna-yogādira nahe</span>–worldly action, knowledge, yoga, and so on, do not have <span class="e2">sei</span>–such <span class="e2">śakti</span>–power, [and that] <span class="e2">vidhi-bhaṅga-doṣe</span>–by the fault of breaking [their] rules, [they become] <span class="e2">phala-hīna</span>–fruitless.
The scriptures say that worldly action, knowledge, yoga, and so on, do not have such power, and that when the rules for practising them are broken, they bear no fruit at all.
সে সব ছাড় ভাই নাম কর সার ।<br />অতি অল্পদিনে তবে জিনিবে সংসার ॥১৪॥
se saba chhāḍa bhāi nāma kara sāra<br />ati alpa-dine tabe jinibe saṁsāra [14]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">chhāḍa</span>–leave behind <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all of them [and] <span class="e2">nāma sāra kara</span>–accept the Name as all-in-all. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">jinibe</span>–you will conquer <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the world <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">alpa-dine</span>–very soon.
Brother, leave them all behind and accept the Name as all-in-all. Then you will conquer saṁsāra very soon.
কবি কর্ণপূর
kavi karṇapūra
Kavi Karṇapūr
ধন্য কবি কর্ণপূর স্বগ্রামনিবাসী ।<br />নামের মহিমা কিছু রাখিল প্রকাশি’ ॥১৫॥
dhanya kavi karṇapūra sva-grāma-nivāsī<br />nāmera mahimā kichhu rākhila prakāśi’ [15]
<span class="e2">dhanya</span>–The glorious <span class="e2">kavi</span> <span class="e2">karṇapūra</span>–Kavi Karṇapūr [is] <span class="e2">sva-grāma-nivāsī</span>–a resident of my village. <span class="e2">prakāśi’ rākhila</span>–He revealed and recorded <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–some <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name’s <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–glories.
The glorious Kavi Karṇapūr is a resident of my village. He revealed and recorded some of the Name’s glories.
গৌর যারে কৃপা করে, বিশ্বে সেই ধন্য ।<br />সপ্তবর্ষে বয়সে হৈল মহাকবি মান্য ॥১৬॥
gaura yāre kṛpā kare, viśve sei dhanya<br />sapta-varṣe vayase haila mahākavi mānya [16]
<span class="e2">sei yāre</span>–Those whom <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–blesses [become] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious <span class="e2">viśve</span>–throughout the world, [and] <span class="e2">mānya haila</span>–Kavi Karṇapūr was honoured <span class="e2">mahākavi</span>–as a great poet <span class="e2">sapta-varṣe</span> <span class="e2">vayase</span>–at the age of seven.
Those whom Gaura blesses become glorious throughout the world, and Kavi Karṇapūr was honoured as a great poet when he was only seven years old.
ধন্য শিবানন্দ কবি-কর্ণপূর-পিতা ।<br />মোরে বাল্যে শিখাইল ভাগবত-গীতা ॥১৭॥
dhanya śivānanda kavi-karṇapūra-pitā<br />more bālye śikhāila bhāgavata-gītā [17]
<span class="e2">dhanya</span>–The glorious <span class="e2">śivānanda</span>–Śivānanda Sen, <span class="e2">kavi-karṇapūra-pitā</span>–Kavi Karṇapūr’s father, <span class="e2">śikhāila</span>–taught <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">bhāgavata-gītā</span>–<span class="e33">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> and <span class="e33">Bhagavad-gītā</span> <span class="e2">bālye</span>–in my youth.
The glorious Śivānanda Sen, Kavi Karṇapūr’s father, taught me <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> and <span class="e3">Bhagavad-gītā</span> in my youth.
নদীয়া লইয়া মোরে রাখে প্রভুপদে ।<br />শিবানন্দ ত্রাতা মোর সম্পদে বিপদে ॥১৮॥
nadīyā la-iyā more rākhe prabhu-pade<br />śivānanda trātā mora sampade vipade [18]
<span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–Śivānanda brought <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">nadīyā</span>–to Nadia [and] <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–kept [me] <span class="e2">prabhu-pade</span>–at the feet of the Lord. <span class="e2">śivānanda</span>–Śivānanda [is] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">trātā</span>–saviour, <span class="e2">sampade</span> <span class="e2">vipade</span>–in good fortune and in bad.
Śivānanda brought me to Nadia and kept me at the feet of the Lord. He is my saviour, in good fortune and in bad.
তার ঘরে ভোগ রান্ধি’ পাক-শিক্ষা হইল ।<br />ভাল পাক করি’ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-সেবা কৈল ॥১৯॥
tāra ghare bhoga rāndhi’ pāka-śikṣā haila<br />bhāla pāka kari’ śrī-gaurāṅga-sevā kaila [19]
<span class="e2">pāka</span> <span class="e2">śikṣā</span> <span class="e2">haila</span>–I learned to cook [and] <span class="e2">bhoga</span> <span class="e2">rāndhi’</span>–prepared offerings <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–in his home, [and] <span class="e2">pāka</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by cooking <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–well, <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga-sevā</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–I served Śrī Gaurāṅga.
I learned to cook and prepare offerings in his home, and by cooking well, I served Śrī Gaurāṅga.
জগাই বলে, “সাধুসঙ্গে দিন যায় যার ।<br />সেই মাত্র নামাশ্রয় করে নিরন্তর” ॥২০॥
jagāi bale, “sādhu-saṅge dina yāya yāra<br />sei mātra nāmāśraya kare nirantara” [20]
<span class="e2">jagāi</span>–Jagāi <span class="e2">bale</span>–says, <span class="e2">“mātra</span>–“Only <span class="e2">sei yāra</span>–those whose <span class="e2">dina</span>–days <span class="e2">yāya</span>–pass <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–in the association of sādhus <span class="e2">nāmāśraya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–take shelter of the Name <span class="e2">nirantara”</span>–constantly.”
Jagāi says, “Only those whose days pass in the association of sādhus take shelter of the Name constantly.”

Chapter Nine
যুক্তবৈরাগ্য
Yukta-vairāgya
Proper Renunciation
বৈরাগ্য দুই প্রকার—ফল্গু ও যুক্ত
vairāgya dui prakāra—phalgu o yukta
There are two types of renunciation: false and proper
একদিন জিজ্ঞাসিলেন গোসাঞি সনাতন ।<br />“‘যুক্ত বৈরাগ্য’ কারে বলে প্রভু করুন বর্ণন ॥১॥
eka-dina jijñāsilena gosāñi sanātana<br />“‘yukta vairāgya’ kāre bale prabhu karuna varṇana [1]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">sanātana gosāñi</span>–Sanātan Goswāmī <span class="e2">jijñāsilena</span>–asked, <span class="e2">“kare</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–“What is <span class="e2">‘yukta</span> <span class="e2">vairāgya’</span>–proper renunciation? <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–O Lord, <span class="e2">varṇana karuna</span>–please explain [it].
One day, Sanātan Goswāmī asked, “What is proper renunciation? O Lord, please explain it.
মায়াবাদী বলে, ‘সব কাকবিষ্ঠাসম ।<br />বিষয় জানিলে ন্যাসী হয় সর্ব্বোত্তম’ ॥২॥
māyāvādī bale, ‘saba kāka-viṣṭhā-sama<br />viṣaya jānile nyāsī haya sarvottama’ [2]
<span class="e2">māyāvādī</span>–Illusionists <span class="e2">bale</span>–say, <span class="e2">‘nyāsī jānile</span>–‘If a sannyāsī considers <span class="e2">saba viṣaya</span>–everything material <span class="e2">kāka-viṣṭhā-sama</span>–to be equal to crow’s stool, [then] <span class="e2">haya</span>–they are <span class="e2">sarvottama’</span>–the best of all.’
“Māyāvādīs say, ‘If a sannyāsī considers everything material to be crow’s stool, then they are the best of men.’
বৈষ্ণবের কি কর্ত্তব্য জানিতে ইচ্ছা করি ।<br />কৃপা করি’ আজ্ঞা কর আজ্ঞা শিরে ধরি” ॥৩॥
vaiṣṇavera ki kartavya jānite ichchhā kari<br />kṛpā kari’ ājñā kara ājñā śire dhari” [3]
<span class="e2">ichchhā</span> <span class="e2">kari</span>–I want <span class="e2">jānite</span>–to know <span class="e2">ki</span>–what [are] <span class="e2">kartavya</span>–the duties <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavera</span>–of a Vaiṣṇava. <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–instruct [me]. <span class="e2">dhari</span>–I hold [your] <span class="e2">ājñā”</span>–instructions <span class="e2">śire</span>–on [my] head.”
“I want to know the duties of a Vaiṣṇava. Please instruct me, so I can hold Your instructions on my head.”
প্রভু বলে, “বৈরাগ্য হয় দুই ত প্রকার ।<br />‘ফল্গু’-‘যুক্ত’ ভেদ আমি শিখাইনু বার বার ॥৪॥
prabhu bale, “vairāgya haya dui ta prakāra<br />‘phalgu’-‘yukta’ bhede āmi śikhāinu bāra bāra [4]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“haya</span>–“There are <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">ta</span>–two <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–types <span class="e2">vairāgya</span>–of renunciation: <span class="e2">‘phalgu’-‘yukta’</span>–false and proper. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">śikhāinu</span>–have taught <span class="e2">bhede</span>–the difference <span class="e2">bāra</span> <span class="e2">bāra</span>–many times.
The Lord said, “There are two types of renunciation: false and proper. I have taught the difference between them many times.
ফল্গুবৈরাগ্য
phalgu-vairāgya
False renunciation
কর্ম্মী জ্ঞানী যবে করে নির্ব্বেদ আশ্রয় ।<br />তার চিত্তে ফল্গুবৈরাগ্য পায় দুষ্টাশয় ॥৫॥
karmī jñānī yabe kare nirveda āśraya<br />tāra chitte phalgu-vairāgya pāya duṣṭāśaya [5]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">karmī</span>–materialists [and] <span class="e2">jñānī</span>–speculators <span class="e2">nirveda</span> <span class="e2">āśraya kare</span>–resort to apathy, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–they develop <span class="e2">duṣṭāśaya</span>–the wickedness <span class="e2">phalgu-vairāgya</span>–of false renunciation <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">chitte</span>–within their minds.
“When materialists and speculators resort to apathy (towards the world), the wickedness of false renunciation arises in their minds.
সংসারেতে তুচ্ছবুদ্ধি আসিয়া তখন ।<br />জড়-বিপরীত ধর্ম্মে করে প্রবর্ত্তন ॥৬॥
saṁsārete tuchchha-buddhi āsiyā takhana<br />jaḍa-viparīta dharme kare pravartana [6]
<span class="e2">takhana</span>–Then, <span class="e2">saṁsārete</span> <span class="e2">tuchchha-buddhi</span>–the mentality that the world is trifling <span class="e2">āsiyā</span>–comes [to them, and] <span class="e2">pravartana kare</span>–they start <span class="e2">jaḍa-viparīta</span> <span class="e2">dharme</span>–to oppose material nature.
“They develop the mentality that saṁsāra is trifling and begin to oppose material nature.
কৃষ্ণসেবা সাধুসেবা আত্মরসাস্বাদ ।<br />জড়-বিপরীত ধর্ম্মে পায় নিতান্ত অবসাদ ॥৭॥
kṛṣṇa-sevā sādhu-sevā ātma-rasāsvāda<br />jaḍa-viparīta dharme pāya nitānta avasāda [7]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-sevā</span>–Service to Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">sādhu-sevā</span>–service to the sādhus [are] <span class="e2">ātma-rasāsvāda</span>–relishable to the soul. <span class="e2">jaḍa-viparīta</span> <span class="e2">dharme</span>–By opposing material nature, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–you become <span class="e2">nitānta</span>–completely <span class="e2">avasāda</span>–disheartened.
“Service to Kṛṣṇa and the sādhus is relishable to the soul. By simply opposing material nature, you end up completely disheartened.
ফল্গুবৈরাগীর মন সদা শুষ্ক রসহীন ।<br />নামরূপগুণলীলা না হয় সমীচীন ॥৮॥
phalgu-vairāgīra mana sadā śuṣka rasa-hīna<br />nāma-rūpa-guṇa-līlā nā haya samīchīna [8]
<span class="e2">mana</span>–The mind <span class="e2">phalgu-vairāgīra</span>–of a false renunciant [is] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">śuṣka</span>–dry [and] <span class="e2">rasa-hīna</span>–dissatisfied. <span class="e2">haya</span>–It is <span class="e2">nā</span>–not <span class="e2">samīchīna</span>–fit <span class="e2">nāma-rūpa-guṇa-līlā</span>–for [the Lord’s] Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes.
“The mind of a false renunciant is always dry and dissatisfied. It is unfit for the Lord’s Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes.
যুক্তবৈরাগ্য
yukta-vairāgya
Proper renunciation
যুক্তবৈরাগীর ভক্তি হয় ত’ সুলভ ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তি-পূত বিষয় তার ঘটে সব ॥৯॥
yukta-vairāgīra bhakti haya ta’ sulabha<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti-pūta viṣaya tāra ghaṭe saba [9]
<span class="e2">yukta-vairāgīra</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">sulabha haya</span>–A proper renunciant easily attains <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion: <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">saba viṣaya ghaṭe</span>–everything they do [is] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti-pūta</span>–purified by devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
“A proper renunciant easily attains devotion: everything they do is purified by devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
প্রকৃতির জড়ধর্ম্ম তার চিত্ত ছাড়ে অনায়াসে ।<br />চিৎ-আশ্রয়ে মজে শীঘ্র অপ্রাকৃত ভক্তিরসে ॥১০॥
prakṛtira jaḍa-dharma tāra chitta chhāḍe anāyāse<br />chit-āśraye maje śīghra āprākṛta bhakti-rase [10]
<span class="e2">tāra</span>–Their <span class="e2">chitta</span>–heart <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–gives up <span class="e2">jaḍa-dharma</span>–the dull nature <span class="e2">prakṛtira</span>–of matter, [and] <span class="e2">chit-āśraye</span>–in shelter of spirit, <span class="e2">śīghra</span>–quickly <span class="e2">maje</span>–revels <span class="e2">āprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">bhakti-rase</span>–in the joy of supramundane devotion.
“Their heart easily gives up the dull nature of matter and, sheltered in spirit, quickly begins to relish the joy of supramundane devotion.
ভক্তিযোগে শ্রীকৃষ্ণের প্রসন্নতা পায় ।<br />‘ন মে ভক্তঃ প্রণশ্যতি’, প্রতিজ্ঞা জানায় ॥১১॥
bhakti-yoge śrī-kṛṣṇera prasannatā pāya<br />‘na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati’, pratijñā jānāya [11]
<span class="e2">pāya</span>–They attain <span class="e2">prasannatā</span>–the favour <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇera</span>–of Śrī Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">bhakti-yoge</span>–through the practice of devotion, [and then] <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–proclaim [Kṛṣṇa’s] <span class="e2">pratijñā</span>–promise (Bg: 9.31): <span class="e2">‘me</span>–‘My <span class="e2">bhaktaḥ</span>–devotee <span class="e2">praṇaśyati na’</span>–is never vanquished.’
“They attain the favour of Śrī Kṛṣṇa through the practice of devotion and then proclaim Kṛṣṇa’s promise: ‘<span class="e3">Na Me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati</span>: My devotee is never vanquished.’*
প্রসন্ন হইয়া কৃষ্ণ যারে কৃপা করে ।<br />সেই জন ধন্য এই সংসার-ভিতরে ॥১২॥
prasanna ha-iyā kṛṣṇa yāre kṛpā kare<br />sei jana dhanya ei saṁsāra-bhitare [12]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jana yāre</span>–Those whom <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">prasanna</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–is pleased [with and] <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–blesses [are] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāra-bhitare</span>–within this world.
“Those whom Kṛṣṇa is pleased with and blesses are truly fortunate within this world.
গোলোকের পরম ভাব তার চিত্তে স্ফুরে ।<br />গোকুলে গোলোক পায় মায়া পড়ে দূরে ॥১৩॥
golokera parama bhāva tāra chitte sphure<br />gokule goloka pāya māyā paḍe dūre [13]
<span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–The supreme mood <span class="e2">golokera</span>–of Goloka <span class="e2">sphure</span>–appears <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">chitte</span>–in their hearts, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–they attain <span class="e2">goloka</span>–Goloka <span class="e2">gokule</span>–in Gokula (on earth), [and] <span class="e2">māyā</span>–Māyā <span class="e2">dūre paḍe</span>–falls away [from them].
“The supreme mood of Goloka appears in their hearts, they attain Goloka in Gokula, and Māyā falls away from them.
শুষ্কবৈরাগ্য দূর করা কর্ত্তব্য
śuṣka-vairāgya dūra karā kartavya
Avoiding dry renunciation is our duty
ওরে ভাই শুষ্কবৈরাগ্য এবে দূর কর ।<br />যুক্তবৈরাগ্য আনি’ সদা হৃদয়েতে ধর ॥১৪॥
ore bhāi śuṣka-vairāgya ebe dūra kara<br />yukta-vairāgya āni’ sadā hṛdayete dhara [14]
<span class="e2">ore</span>–O <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother, <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–avoid <span class="e2">śuṣka</span>–dry <span class="e2">vairāgya</span>–renunciation. <span class="e2">āni’</span>–Bring <span class="e2">yukta</span>–proper <span class="e2">vairāgya</span>–renunciation <span class="e2">hṛdayete</span>–into [your] heart [and] <span class="e2">dhara</span>–hold [it there] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–forever.
“O brother, from now on, avoid dry renunciation. Bring proper renunciation into your heart and keep it there forever.
বিষয় ছাড়িয়া ভাই কোথা যাবে বল ।<br />বনে যাবে, সেখানে বিষয়-জঞ্জাল ॥১৫॥
viṣaya chhāḍiyā bhāi kothā yābe bala<br />vane yābe, sekhāne viṣaya-jañjāla [15]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">bala</span>–tell Me, <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–after abandoning <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–worldly affairs, <span class="e2">kothā</span>–where <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will you go? <span class="e2">yābe</span>–You will go <span class="e2">vane</span>–to the forest, [and] <span class="e2">sekhāne</span>–there [you will find] <span class="e2">viṣaya-jañjāla</span>–worldly troubles.
“Brother, tell Me, after abandoning worldly affairs, where will you go? You will go to the forest, and there also you will find worldly troubles.
* See 19.42.
পেট তোমার সঙ্গে যাবে, দেহের রক্ষণে ।<br />কত লেঠা হবে তাহা ভেবে দেখ মনে ॥১৬॥
peṭa tomāra saṅge yābe, dehera rakṣaṇe<br />kata leṭhā habe tāhā bhebe dekha mane [16]
<span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">peṭa</span>–belly <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will go <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [you;] <span class="e2">bhebe</span> <span class="e2">mane dekha</span>–think [about] <span class="e2">kata</span>–how much <span class="e2">leṭhā</span>–difficulty <span class="e2">habe</span>–there will be <span class="e2">dehera</span> <span class="e2">rakṣaṇe</span>–to maintain [your] body <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–there.
“Your belly will go with you; think about how difficult it will be to maintain your body there.
অকারণে জীবনের শীঘ্র হবে ক্ষয় ।<br />মরিলে কেমনে আর মায়া কর্বে জয় ॥১৭॥
akāraṇe jīvanera śighra habe kṣaya<br />marile kemane āra māyā karbe jaya [17]
<span class="e2">akāraṇe</span>–Unnecessarily, [your] <span class="e2">jīvanera</span> <span class="e2">kṣaya</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–life will end <span class="e2">śighra</span>–quickly, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">marile</span>–if you die, <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how <span class="e2">jaya karbe</span>–will you conquer <span class="e2">māyā</span>–māyā?
“Unnecessarily, your life will end quickly, and if you die, how will you conquer māyā?
যদিও না মর তবু হইবে দুর্ব্বল ।<br />জ্ঞাননাশ হৈলে কোথা জ্ঞানের সম্বল ॥১৮॥
yadio nā mara tabu ha-ibe durbala<br />jñāna-nāśa ha-ile kothā jñānera sambala [18]
<span class="e2">yadio</span>–Even if <span class="e2">mara nā</span>–you do not die, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–still <span class="e2">durbala ha-ibe</span>–you will become weak, [and] <span class="e2">jñāna-nāśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–if your knowledge is lost [as a result, then] <span class="e2">kothā</span>–where [is] <span class="e2">sambala</span>–the benefit <span class="e2">jñānera</span>–of that knowledge?
“Even if you do not die, you will still become weak, and if you lose your knowledge as a result, what benefit will you get from it?
সুতরাং যুক্তবৈরাগ্য কর্ত্তব্য
sutarāṁ yukta-vairāgya kartavya
So, proper renunciation is our duty
ঘরে বসি’ সদা কাল কৃষ্ণনাম লঞা ।<br />যথাযোগ্য-বিষয় ভুঞ্জ, অনাসক্ত হঞা ॥১৯॥
ghare basi’ sadā kāla kṛṣṇa-nāma lañā<br />yathā-yogya-viṣaya bhuñja, anāsakta hañā [19]
<span class="e2">basi’</span>–Stay <span class="e2">ghare</span>–at home, [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span> <span class="e2">kāla</span>–at all times <span class="e2">lañā</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">yathā-yogya</span>–As appropriate, <span class="e2">viṣaya</span> <span class="e2">bhuñja</span>–interact with the world, <span class="e2">hañā</span>–remaining <span class="e2">anāsakta</span>–detached.
“Stay at home and always chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa. As appropriate, interact with the world, remaining detached.
“যথাযোগ্য” এই শব্দ দুটীর মর্ম্মার্থ বুঝে লহ ।<br />কপটার্থ লঞা যেন দেহারামী না হ ॥২০॥
“yathā-yogya” ei śabda duṭīra marmārtha bujhe laha<br />kapaṭārtha lañā yena dehārāmī nā ha [20]
<span class="e2">bujhe</span> <span class="e2">laha</span>–Understand <span class="e2">duṭīra</span>–the two <span class="e2">marmārtha</span>–purports <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">śabda</span>–of the phrase <span class="e2">“yathā-yogya”</span>–‘as appropriate’. <span class="e2">yena nā</span>–Do not <span class="e2">lañā</span>–accept <span class="e2">kapaṭārtha</span>–the false meaning [and] <span class="e2">ha</span>–become <span class="e2">dehārāmī</span>–a sensualist.
“Understand the two purports of the phrase ‘as appropriate’ so that you do not accept the false meaning and become a sensualist.
শুদ্ধভক্তির অনুকূল কর অঙ্গীকার ।<br />শুদ্ধভক্তির প্রতিকূল কর অস্বীকার ॥২১॥
śuddha-bhaktira anukūla kara aṅgīkāra<br />śuddha-bhaktira pratikūla kara asvīkāra [21]
<span class="e2">aṅgīkāra kara</span>–Accept [everything] <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable <span class="e2">śuddha-bhaktira</span>–to pure devotion, [and] <span class="e2">asvīkāra kara</span>–reject [everything] <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable <span class="e2">śuddha-bhaktira</span>–to pure devotion.
“Accept everything favourable to pure devotion, and reject everything unfavourable to pure devotion.
মর্ম্মার্থ ছাড়িয়া যেবা শব্দ অর্থ করে ।<br />রসের বশে দেহারামী কপট মার্গ ধরে ॥২২॥
marmārtha chhāḍiyā yebā śabda artha kare<br />rasera vaśe dehārāmī kapaṭa mārga dhare [22]
<span class="e2">yebā</span>–Those who <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–reject <span class="e2">marmārtha</span>–this purport [and] <span class="e2">artha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–interpret <span class="e2">śabda</span>–the phrase [otherwise are] <span class="e2">dehārāmī</span>–sensualists <span class="e2">rasera</span> <span class="e2">vaśe</span>–controlled by pleas­ures; [they] <span class="e2">dhare</span>–follow <span class="e2">mārga</span>–the path <span class="e2">kapaṭa</span>–of deceit.
“Those who reject this purport and misinterpret the phrase are sensualists controlled by pleasures; they follow the path of deceit.
ভাল খায়, ভাল পরে, করে বহু ধনার্জ্জন ।<br />যোষিৎসঙ্গে রত হঞা ফিরে রাত্রদিন ।<br />ভাল শয্যা অট্টালিকা খোঁজে অর্ব্বাচীন ॥২৩॥
bhāla khāya, bhāla pare, kare bahu dhanārjana<br />yoṣit-saṅge rata hañā phire rātra-dina<br />bhāla śayyā aṭṭālikā kho̐je arvāchīna [23]
<span class="e2">khāya</span>–They eat <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy [food], <span class="e2">pare</span>–wear <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy [clothes, and] <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">dhanārjana kare</span>–accumulate immense wealth. <span class="e2">hañā</span>–Being <span class="e2">rata</span>–attached <span class="e2">yoṣit-saṅge</span>–to the company of women, <span class="e2">arvāchīna</span>–such fools <span class="e2">phire</span>–roam about <span class="e2">rātra-dina</span>–night and day [and] <span class="e2">kho̐je</span>–search <span class="e2">aṭṭālikā</span>–for a mansion [with] <span class="e2">bhāla</span> <span class="e2">śayyā</span>–a fancy bed.
“They eat fancy food, wear fancy clothes, and accumulate immense wealth. Attached to the company of women, such fools roam about night and day searching for a mansion with a fancy bed.
দেহযাত্রার উপযোগী নিতান্ত প্রয়োজন ।<br />বিষয় স্বীকার করি’ কর দেহের রক্ষণ ॥২৪॥
deha-yātrāra upayogī nitānta prayojana<br />viṣaya svīkāra kari’ kara dehera rakṣaṇa [24]
[Instead of all this,] <span class="e2">dehera</span> <span class="e2">rakṣaṇa kara</span>–maintain the body <span class="e2">svīkāra</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by accepting <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–things [that are] <span class="e2">upayogī</span>–suitable [and] <span class="e2">nitānta</span>–actually <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–necessary <span class="e2">deha-yātrāra</span>–for the body’s preservation.
“Instead of all this, maintain the body by accepting things that are suitable and actually necessary for its preservation.
সাত্ত্বিক সেবন কর আসব বর্জ্জন ।<br />সর্ব্বভূতে দয়া করি’ কর উচ্চ সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥২৫॥
sāttvika sevana kara āsaba varjana<br />sarva-bhūte dayā kari’ kara uchcha saṅkīrtana [25]
<span class="e2">sevana</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Eat <span class="e2">sāttvika</span>–things in the mode of goodness [and] <span class="e2">varjana</span>–reject <span class="e2">āsaba</span>–intoxicants. <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Be kind <span class="e2">sarva-bhūta</span>–to all beings [and] <span class="e2">uchcha</span> <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana kara</span>–chant loudly.
“Eat food in the mode of goodness and reject intoxicants. Be kind to all beings and loudly chant the Name.
দেবসেবা ছল করি’ বিষয় নাহি কর ।<br />বিষয়েতে রাগ-দ্বেষ সদা পরিহর ॥২৬॥
deva-sevā chhala kari’ viṣaya nāhi kara<br />viṣayete rāga-dveṣa sadā parihara [26]
<span class="e2">viṣaya</span> <span class="e2">kara nāhi</span>–Do not engage in worldly affairs <span class="e2">chhala</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by making a pretence <span class="e2">deva-sevā</span>–of Deity worship, [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">parihara</span>–avoid <span class="e2">rāga-dveṣa</span>–attachment and aversion <span class="e2">viṣayete</span>–to worldly matters.
“Do not engage in worldly affairs on the pretence of Deity worship, and always avoid attachment and aversion to worldly matters.
পরহিংসা কপটতা অন্য সনে বৈর ।<br />কভু নাহি কর ভাই যদি মোর বাক্য ধর ॥২৭॥
para-hiṁsā kapaṭatā anya sane vaira<br />kabhu nāhi kara bhāi yadi mora vākya dhara [27]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–Never <span class="e2">kara</span>–engage in <span class="e2">para-hiṁsā</span>–envy, <span class="e2">kapaṭatā</span>–deceit, [or] <span class="e2">vaira</span>–enmity <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with others, <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if [you want to] <span class="e2">dhara</span>–follow <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">vākya</span>–advice.
“Never behave enviously, deceitfully, or inimically with others, brother, if you want to follow My advice.
নির্জ্জন সুদৃঢ় ভক্তি কর আলোচন ।<br />কৃষ্ণসেবার সম্বন্ধে দিন করহ যাপন ॥২৮॥
nirjana sudṛḍha bhakti kara ālochana<br />kṛṣṇa-sevāra sambandhe dina karaha yāpana [28]
<span class="e2">ālochana kara</span>–Discuss <span class="e2">sudṛḍha</span>–resolute <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">nirjana</span>–in seclusion, [and] <span class="e2">yāpana karaha</span>–spend [your] <span class="e2">dina</span>–days <span class="e2">sambandhe</span>–engaged in <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-sevāra</span>–the service of Kṛṣṇa.
“Discuss resolute devotion in seclusion, and spend your days engaged in the service of Kṛṣṇa.
মঠ মন্দির দালান বাড়ীর না কর প্রয়াস ।<br />অর্থ থাকে কর ভাই যেমন অভিলাষ ॥২৯॥
maṭha mandira dālāna bāḍīra nā kara prayāsa<br />artha thāke kara bhāi yemana abhilāṣa [29]
<span class="e2">prayāsa kara nā</span>–Do not endeavour <span class="e2">maṭha mandira</span> <span class="e2">dālāna</span> <span class="e2">bāḍīra</span>–for monasteries, temples, or big houses, [but] <span class="e2">artha</span> <span class="e2">thāke</span>–if you have wealth, <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother, [then you can] <span class="e2">kara</span>–make [them,] <span class="e2">yemana</span>–as [you] <span class="e2">abhilāṣa</span>–desire.
“Do not endeavour to make monasteries, temples, or big houses, but if you have wealth, brother, then you can make them, as you desire.
অর্থ নাই তবে মাত্র সাত্ত্বিক সেবা কর ।<br />জল-তুলসী দিয়া গিরিধারীকে বক্ষে ধর ॥৩০॥
artha nāi tabe mātra sāttvika sevā kara<br />jala-tulasī diyā giridhārīke vakṣe dhara [30]
<span class="e2">artha</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–If you do not have wealth, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">mātra</span>–simply <span class="e2">sāttvika</span> <span class="e2">sevā</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–perform pure worship. <span class="e2">diyā</span>–Offer <span class="e2">jala-tulasī</span>–water and Tulasī <span class="e2">giridhārīke</span>–to Giridhārī [and] <span class="e2">dhara</span>–hold [Him] <span class="e2">vakṣe</span>–to [your] chest.
“If you do not have wealth, then simply perform pure worship. Offer water and Tulasī to Giridhārī and hold Him to your chest.
ভাবেতে কাঁদিয়া বল, “আমি ত’ তোমার ।<br />তব পাদপদ্ম চিত্তে রহুক আমার” ॥৩১॥
bhāvete kā̐diyā bala, “āmi ta’ tomāra<br />tava pāda-padma chitte rahuka āmāra” [31]
<span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–Crying <span class="e2">bhāvete</span>–with love, <span class="e2">bala</span>–say, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–‘I [am] <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Yours. [Let] <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">pāda-padma</span>–lotus feet <span class="e2">rahuka</span>–remain <span class="e2">āmāra chitte’</span>–in my heart.’
“Crying with love, pray, ‘I am Yours. Let Your lotus feet remain in my heart.’
বৈষ্ণবে আদর কর প্রসাদাদি দিয়া ।<br />অর্থ নাই দৈন্যবাক্যে তোষ মিনতি করিয়া ॥৩২॥
vaiṣṇave ādara kara prasādādi diyā<br />artha nāi dainya-vākye toṣa minati kariyā [32]
<span class="e2">ādara</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Honour <span class="e2">vaiṣṇave</span>–the Vaiṣṇavas <span class="e2">diyā</span>–with <span class="e2">prasādādi</span>–prasād and other remnants. <span class="e2">artha</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–If you have no wealth, [then] <span class="e2">minati</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–submissively <span class="e2">toṣa</span>–satisfy [them] <span class="e2">dainya-vākye</span>–with humble words.
“Honour the Vaiṣṇavas with prasād and other remnants. If you have no wealth, then submissively satisfy them with humble words.
পরিজন পরিকর কৃষ্ণদাস-দাসী ।<br />আত্মসম পালনে হইবে মিষ্টভাষী ॥৩৩॥
parijana parikara kṛṣṇa-dāsa-dāsī<br />ātma-sama pālane ha-ibe miṣṭa-bhāṣī [33]
[Consider your] <span class="e2">parijana</span>–friends [and] <span class="e2">parikara</span>–relatives <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-dāsa-dāsī</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s servants and maidservants, <span class="e2">pālane</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–care [for them] <span class="e2">ātma-sama</span>–as you do for yourself, [and] <span class="e2">miṣṭa-bhāṣī</span>–speak [to them] sweetly.
“Consider your friends and relatives servants of Kṛṣṇa, care for them as well as you care for yourself, and speak to them sweetly.
স্মরণ-কীর্ত্তন-সেবা সর্ব্বভূতে দয়া ।<br />এই ত’ করিবে যুক্ত বৈরাগী হইয়া ॥৩৪॥
smaraṇa-kīrtana-sevā sarva-bhūte dayā<br />ei ta’ karibe yukta vairāgī ha-iyā [34]
<span class="e2">smaraṇa-kīrtana-sevā</span>–Remember, glorify, and serve [the Lord, and] <span class="e2">dayā</span>–be kind <span class="e2">sarva-bhūte</span>–to all beings. <span class="e2">karibe</span>–Do <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–this, <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–being <span class="e2">yukta</span> <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–a proper renunciant.
“Remember, glorify, and serve the Lord, and be kind to all beings. Do all this as a proper renunciant.
কৃষ্ণ যদি নাহি দেয় পরিজন-পরিকর ।<br />অথবা দিয়া ত লয় সর্ব্ব সুখের আকর ॥৩৫॥
kṛṣṇa yadi nāhi deya parijana-parikara<br />athavā diyā ta laya sarva sukhera ākara [35]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">deya nāhi</span>–does not give [you] <span class="e2">parijana-parikara</span>–friends and relatives, <span class="e2">athavā</span>–or if <span class="e2">diyā</span>–He gives [them and then] <span class="e2">ta</span> <span class="e2">laya</span>–takes [them] away, [accept] <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all [such conditions as] <span class="e2">ākara</span>–a source <span class="e2">sukhera</span>–of joy.
“Kṛṣṇa may not give you friends and relatives, or He may give them and then take them away. Accept all such conditions as a source of joy.
শোক-মোহ ছাড় ভাই নাম কর নিরন্তর” ।<br />জগাই বলে, “এভাব গৌরের সনে মোর কোঁদল বিস্তর” ॥৩৬॥
śoka-moha chhāḍa bhāi nāma kara nirantara”<br />jagāi bale, “e-bhāva gaurera sane mora ko̐dala vistara” [36]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">chhāḍa</span>–leave behind <span class="e2">śoka-moha</span>–lamentation and bewilderment, [and] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–always <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">kara”</span>–chant the Name.” <span class="e2">jagāi</span>–Jagāi <span class="e2">bale</span>–says, <span class="e2">“mora</span>–“I have <span class="e2">vistara</span>–many <span class="e2">ko̐dala</span>–quarrels <span class="e2">e-bhāva”</span>–about this subject <span class="e2">gaurera</span> <span class="e2">sane</span>–with Gaura.”
“Brother, leave behind all lamentation and bewilderment, and always chant the Name.” Jagāi says, “I have many quarrels with Gaura about this.”

Chapter Ten
জাতিকুল
Jāti-kula
Caste and Class
কুল ও ভজন যোগ্যতা
kula o bhajana yogyatā
Class and qualification for devotion
শ্রদ্ধা হইলে নরমাত্র নামের অধিকারী ।<br />জাতিকুলের তর্ক তর্কীর না চলে ভারিভুরি ॥১॥
śraddhā ha-ile nara-mātra nāmera adhikārī<br />jāti-kulera tarka tarkīra nā chale bhāri-bhuri [1]
<span class="e2">nara-mātra</span>–Every human being— <span class="e2">śraddhā</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–if they have faith— [is] <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">adhikārī</span>–qualified [to chant] the Name. <span class="e2">tarka</span>–The arguments [and] <span class="e2">bhāri-bhuri</span>–brashness <span class="e2">tarkīra</span>–of speculators <span class="e2">jāti-kulera</span>–about caste and class <span class="e2">chale nā</span>–do not go [anywhere].
Every human being—if they have faith—is qualified to chant the Name. The arguments and brashness of speculators about caste and class do not count for anything.
ব্রাহ্মণের সৎকুল না হয় ভজনের যোগ্য ।<br />শ্রদ্ধাবান্ নীচজাতি নহে ভজনে অযোগ্য ॥২॥
brāhmaṇera sat-kula nā haya bhajanera yogya<br />śraddhāvan nīcha-jāti nahe bhajane ayogya [2]
<span class="e2">brāhmaṇera</span> <span class="e2">sat-kula</span>–Birth in a family of brāhmaṇs <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–does not make one <span class="e2">yogya</span>–fit <span class="e2">bhajanera</span>–for devotion, [and] <span class="e2">nīcha-jāti</span>–a lowborn person [who] <span class="e2">śraddhāvan</span>–has faith <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is not <span class="e2">ayogya</span>–unfit <span class="e2">bhajane</span>–for devotion.
Birth in a family of brāhmaṇs does not make one fit for devotion, and a lowborn person who has faith is not unfit for devotion.
কুলাভিমানী অভক্ত
kulābhimānī abhakta
Non-devotees are proud of their class
সংসারের দশকর্ম্মে জাতিকুলের আধিপত্য ।<br />কৃষ্ণজনে জাতিকুলের না আছে মাহাত্ম্য ॥৩॥
saṁsārera daśa-karme jāti-kulera ādhipatya<br />kṛṣṇa-jane jāti-kulera nā āchhe māhātmya [3]
<span class="e2">jāti-kulera</span> <span class="e2">ādhipatya</span>–The importance of caste and class [lies in] <span class="e2">saṁsārera</span> <span class="e2">daśa-karme</span>–the ten worldly rites, [but] <span class="e2">jāti-kulera</span> <span class="e2">āchhe nā</span>–caste and creed have no <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–importance <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-jane</span>–for devotees of Kṛṣṇa.
Caste and class are important in worldly religious ceremonies, but are of no importance to devotees of Kṛṣṇa.
জাতিকুলের অভিমানে অহঙ্কারী জন ।<br />ভক্তিকে বিদ্বেষ করি’ যায় নরক-ভবন ॥৪॥
jāti-kulera abhimāne ahaṅkārī jana<br />bhaktike vidveṣa kari’ yāya naraka-bhavana [4]
<span class="e2">ahaṅkārī jana</span>–Egotists [who are] <span class="e2">abhimāne</span>–proud <span class="e2">jāti-kulera</span>–of [their] caste and class <span class="e2">vidveṣa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–oppose <span class="e2">bhaktike</span>–devotion [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">naraka-bhavana</span>–to hell.
Egotists who are proud of their caste and class oppose devotion and go to hell.
না মানে বৈষ্ণবভক্ত, না মানে ধর্ম্মাধর্ম্ম ।<br />অহঙ্কারে করে সদা অকর্ম্ম-বিকর্ম্ম ॥৫॥
nā māne vaiṣṇava-bhakta, nā māne dharmādharma<br />ahaṅkāre kare sadā akarma-vikarma [5]
<span class="e2">māne nā</span>–They do not respect <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-bhakta</span>–Vaiṣṇava devotees, [and] <span class="e2">māne nā</span>–do not honour <span class="e2">dharmādharma</span>–religion [as opposed to] irreligion. <span class="e2">ahaṅkāre</span>–Out of pride, <span class="e2">sadā kare</span>–they always engage in <span class="e2">akarma-vikarma</span>–idleness and sin.
They neither respect Vaiṣṇava devotees nor do they have any regard for religion or irreligion. Out of pride, they always remain idle or commit sins.
অভক্ত বিপ্র হইতে ভক্তি মুচি শ্রেষ্ঠ
abhakta vipra ha-ite bhakti muchi śreṣṭha
A devotee cobbler is superior to a non-devotee brāhmaṇ
মুচি হঞা কৃষ্ণ ভজে কৃষ্ণকৃপা পায় ।<br />শুচি হঞা ভক্তিহীন কৃষ্ণকৃপা নাহি তায় ॥৬॥
muchi hañā kṛṣṇa bhaje kṛṣṇa-kṛpā pāya<br />śuchi hañā bhakti-hīna kṛṣṇa-kṛpā nāhi tāya [6]
<span class="e2">muchi</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–Remaining a cobbler, <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–a soul who serves <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">pāya</span>–gets <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kṛpā</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s mercy, [and] <span class="e2">śuchi</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–a soul who is virtuous [but] <span class="e2">bhakti-hīna</span>–devoid of devotion <span class="e2">tāya nāhi</span>–does not get <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kṛpā</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s mercy.
Remaining a cobbler, a soul who serves Kṛṣṇa gets Kṛṣṇa’s mercy, and a soul who is virtuous but devoid of devotion does not get Kṛṣṇa’s mercy.
দ্বাদশ গুণেতে বিপ্র অলঙ্কৃত হঞা ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তি বিনা যায় নরকে চলিয়া ॥৭॥
dvādaśa guṇete vipra alaṅkṛta hañā<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti vinā yāya narake chaliyā [7]
<span class="e2">vipra</span>–A brāhmaṇ <span class="e2">alaṅkṛta</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–ornamented <span class="e2">dvādaśa</span> <span class="e2">guṇete</span>–with the twelve qualities (given in <span class="e33">Mahābhārata</span> as piety, truthfulness, self-control, austerity, non-enviousness, humility, tolerance, non-maliciousness, expertise in sacrifice, charitableness, steadiness, and learning) [but] <span class="e2">vinā</span>–devoid <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–of devotion to Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">chaliyā yāya</span>–goes <span class="e2">narake</span>–to hell.
A brāhmaṇ ornamented with the twelve qualities but devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa goes to hell.
কৃষ্ণভক্তি যথা, তথা সর্ব্বগুণগণ ।<br />আপন ইচ্ছায় দেহে বৈসে অনুক্ষণ ॥৮॥
kṛṣṇa-bhakti yathā, tathā sarva-guṇa-gaṇa<br />āpana ichchhāya dehe vaise anukṣaṇa [8]
<span class="e2">sarva-guṇa-gaṇa</span>–All qualities [are present] <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–wherever <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa [is present]; <span class="e2">āpana</span> <span class="e2">ichchhāya</span>–by their own desire, <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa vaise</span>–they always reside <span class="e2">dehe</span>–in the body [of a devotee].
All qualities are present wherever devotion to Kṛṣṇa is present; by their own desire, they always reside in the body of a devotee.
মৃতদেহে অলঙ্কার হয় ঘৃণাস্পদ ।<br />অভক্তের জপ তপ বাহ্য সে সম্পদ ॥৯॥
mṛta-dehe alaṅkāra haya ghṛṇāspada<br />abhaktera japa tapa bāhya se sampada [9]
<span class="e2">alaṅkāra</span>–Ornaments <span class="e2">mṛta-dehe</span>–on a dead body <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">ghṛṇāspada</span>–revolting; <span class="e2">abhaktera</span>–a non-devotee’s <span class="e2">japa</span>–chanting [and] <span class="e2">tapa</span>–austerity [are comparable to] <span class="e2">se</span>–such <span class="e2">bāhya</span> <span class="e2">sampada</span>–external ‘wealth’.
Ornaments on a dead body are revolting; a non-devotee’s chanting and austerity are comparable to such external ‘wealth’.
বিষয়ে রাগেদ্বেষ বর্জ্জনীয়
viṣaye rāga-dveṣa varjanīya
Attachment and aversion to the mundane must be given up
ভজ ভাই একমনে শচীর নন্দন ।<br />জাতিকুলের অভিমান হবে বিসর্জ্জন ॥১০॥
bhaja bhāi eka-mane śachīra nandana<br />jāti-kulera abhimāna habe visarjana [10]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">eka-mane</span>–single-mindedly <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–serve <span class="e2">nandana</span>–the son <span class="e2">śachīra</span>–<br />of Śachī. [Then] <span class="e2">visarjana habe</span>–you will give up [your] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride <span class="e2">jāti-kulera</span>–in [your] caste and class.
Brother, single-mindedly serve the son of Śachī. Then you will give up your pride in your caste and class.
অভিমান ছাড়িলে ভাই ছাড়িবে বিষয় ।<br />বিষয় ছাড়িলে শুদ্ধ হবে তোমার আশয় ॥১১॥
abhimāna chhāḍile bhāi chhāḍibe viṣaya<br />viṣaya chhāḍile śuddha habe tomāra āśaya [11]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">chhāḍile</span>–when you give up [your] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride, <span class="e2">chhāḍibe</span>–you will give up <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–the world, [and] <span class="e2">chhāḍile</span>–when you give up <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–the world, <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your <span class="e2">āśaya</span>–heart <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will become pure.
Brother, when you give up your pride, you will give up the world, and when you give up the world, your heart will become pure.
বিষয় হইতে অনুরাগ লও উঠাইয়া ।<br />কৃষ্ণপদাম্বুজে রাগে দেহ লাগাইয়া ॥১২॥
viṣaya ha-ite anurāga lao uṭhāiyā<br />kṛṣṇa-padāmbuje rāge deha lāgāiyā [12]
<span class="e2">uṭhāiyā lao</span>–Withdraw [your] <span class="e2">anurāga</span>–affection <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–the world [and] <span class="e2">lāgāiyā deha</span>–dedicate [your] <span class="e2">rāge</span>–affection <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-padāmbuje</span>–to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
Withdraw your affection from the world and dedicate it to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
হও তুমি সৎকুলীন তাহে কিবা ক্ষতি ।<br />কুলের অভিমান ছাড়ি’ হও দীনমতি ॥১৩॥
hao tumi sat-kulīna tāhe kibā kṣati<br />kulera abhimāna chhāḍi’ hao dīna-mati [13]
<span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">hao</span>–may be <span class="e2">sat-kulīna</span>–high-class; <span class="e2">kibā</span>–what [is] <span class="e2">kṣati</span>–the harm <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–in that? <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–Give up [your] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride <span class="e2">kulera</span>–in [your] class [and] <span class="e2">hao</span>–be <span class="e2">dīna-mati</span>–humble.
You may be high-class; what is the harm in that? Just give up your pride in your class and be humble.
অভিমানহীন দীনের প্রতি ভগবানের দয়া
abhimāna-hīna dīnera prati bhagavāner dayā
The Lord’s mercy upon the prideless, humble souls
দীনেরে অধিক দয়া করে ভগবান্ ।<br />অভিমান দৈন্য নাহি রহে একস্থান ॥১৪॥
dīnere adhika dayā kare bhagavān<br />abhimāna dainya nāhi rahe eka-sthāna [14]
<span class="e2">bhagavān</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">adhika</span> <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–bestows greater mercy <span class="e2">dīnere</span>–upon the humble, [and] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride [and] <span class="e2">dainya</span>–humility <span class="e2">rahe nāhi</span>–do not exist <span class="e2">eka-sthāna</span>–in one place.
The Lord bestows greater mercy upon the humble, and pride and humility do not co-exist.
অভিমান নরকের পথ, তাহা যত্নে ত্যজ ।<br />দৈন্যে রাধাগোবিন্দের পাদপদ্মে মজ ॥১৫॥
abhimāna narakera patha, tāhā yatne tyaja<br />dainye rādhā-govindera pāda-padme maja [15]
<span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–Pride [is] <span class="e2">patha</span>–the path <span class="e2">narakera</span>–to hell. <span class="e2">yatne</span>–Carefully <span class="e2">tyaja</span>–avoid <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–it. <span class="e2">dainye</span>–Humbly <span class="e2">maja</span>–immerse yourself <span class="e2">rādhā-govindera</span> <span class="e2">pāda-padme</span>–in the lotus feet of Rādhā and Govinda.
Pride is the path to hell. Carefully avoid it, and humbly immerse yourself in the lotus feet of Rādhā and Govinda.
অভিমান-ত্যাগ নিত্যানন্দের দয়া সাপেক্ষ
abhimāna-tyāga nityānandera dayā sāpekṣa
Giving up pride is dependent on Nityānanda’s mercy
আহা! প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ কবে করিবে দয়া ।<br />অভিমান ছাড়াঞা মোরে দিবে পদ-ছায়া ॥১৬॥
āhā! prabhu nityānanda kabe karibe dayā<br />abhimāna chhāḍāñā more dibe pada-chhāyā [16]
<span class="e2">āhā!</span>–Ah! <span class="e2">kabe</span>–When [will] <span class="e2">nityānanda prabhu</span>–Nityānanda Prabhu <span class="e2">dayā karibe</span>–be merciful [to me]? [When] <span class="e2">more chhāḍāñā</span>–will He force me to leave [my] <span class="e2">abhimāna</span>–pride [and] <span class="e2">dibe</span>–give [me] <span class="e2">pada-chhāyā</span>–the shade of His feet?
Ah! When will Nityānanda Prabhu be merciful to me? When will He force me to leave my pride and give me the shade of His feet?

Chapter Eleven
নবদ্বীপ-দীপক
Navadvīpa-dīpaka
The Light of Nabadwīp
শ্রীনবদ্বীপ বৃন্দাবন অভিন্ন
śrī-navadvīpa vṛndāvana abhinna
Śrī Nabadwīp and Vṛndāvan are nondifferent
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে ধরণী ধন্য, ধরায় গৌড়-ক্ষৌণী ধন্য ।<br />গৌড়ে নবদ্বীপ ধন্য দ্ব্যষ্টক্রোশ জগৎ মান্য ॥১॥
brahmāṇḍe dharaṇī dhanya, dharāya gauḍa-kṣauṇī dhanya<br />gauḍe navadvīpa dhanya dvyaṣṭa-krośa jagat mānya [1]
