<span class="e2">brahmāṇḍe</span>–Within the universe, <span class="e2">dharaṇī</span>–the earth [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious; <span class="e2">dharāya</span>–on the earth, <span class="e2">gauḍa-kṣauṇī</span>–the land of Gauḍa [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious; [and] <span class="e2">gauḍe</span>–within Gauḍa, <span class="e2">navadvīpa</span>–Nabadwīp [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious. [Its] <span class="e2">dvyaṣṭa-krośa</span>–thirty-two miles [are] <span class="e2">mānya</span>–revered <span class="e2">jagat</span>–by the [entire] world.
Within the universe, the earth is glorious; on the earth, the land of Gauḍa is glorious; and within Gauḍa, Śrī Nabadwīp is glorious. Its thirty-two miles are revered by the entire world.
মধ্যে স্রোতস্বতী ধন্য ভাগীরথী বেগবতী ।<br />তাহাতে মিলেছে আসি’ শ্রীযমুনা সরস্বতী ॥২॥
madhye srotasvatī dhanya bhāgīrathī vegavatī<br />tāhāte milechhe āsi’ śrī-yamunā sarasvatī [2]
<span class="e2">madhye</span>–Within it, <span class="e2">bhāgīrathī vegavatī srotasvatī</span>–the swift River Ganges [is] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–glorious; [there] <span class="e2">śrī-yamunā</span>–the Yamunā [and] <span class="e2">sarasvatī</span>–Saraswatī <span class="e2">āsi’ milechhe</span>–have come and united <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–with her.
Within Nabadwīp, the swift River Ganges is glorious; there the Yamunā and Saraswatī have come and united with her.
তার পূর্ব্বতীরে সাক্ষাৎ গোলোক মায়াপুর ।<br />তথায় শ্রীশচীগৃহে শোভে গৌরাঙ্গঠাকুর ॥৩॥
tāra pūrva-tīre sākṣāt goloka māyāpura<br />tathāya śrī-śachī-gṛhe śobhe gaurāṅga-ṭhākura [3]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">pūrva-tīre</span>–On the east bank of the Ganges [is] <span class="e2">goloka</span> <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–Goloka Māyāpur <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span>–itself, [and] <span class="e2">tathāya</span>–there, <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-ṭhākura</span>–Lord Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">śobhe</span>–shines <span class="e2">śrī-śachī-gṛhe</span>–in the home of Śrī Śachī.
On the east bank of the Ganges is Goloka Māyāpur itself, and there, Lord Gaurāṅga shines in the home of Śrī Śachī.
যে ঠাকুর দ্বাপরের শেষ বৃন্দাবনে বনে ।<br />মহারাসক্রীড়া কৈল রাধিকাদি গোপী সনে ॥৪॥<br />পরকীয় মহারাস গোলোকের নিত্যধন ।<br />আনিল ব্রজের সহ নন্দযশোদানন্দন ॥৫॥<br />সেই ঠাকুর আবার নিজের যোগ-মায়াপুর ।<br />প্রপঞ্চে আনিল গৌড়ে রসাস্বাদ সুচতুর ॥৬॥
ye ṭhākura dvāparera śeṣa vṛndāvane vane<br />mahārāsa-krīḍā kaila rādhikādi gopī sane [4]<br />parakīya mahārāsa golokera nitya-dhana<br />ānila vrajera saha nanda-yaśodā-nandana [5]<br />sei ṭhākura ābāra nijera yoga-māyāpura<br />prapañche ānila gauḍe rasāsvāda suchatura [6]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–The Lord who <span class="e2">kaila</span>–performed <span class="e2">mahārāsa-krīḍā</span>–the Mahārāsa-līlā <span class="e2">sane</span>–with <span class="e2">rādhikādi</span> <span class="e2">gopī</span>–Rādhikā and the gopīs <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span> <span class="e2">vane</span>–in the forest of Vṛndāvan <span class="e2">dvāparera</span> <span class="e2">śeṣa</span>–at the end of the Dvāpar-yuga, <span class="e2">nanda-yaśodā-nandana</span>–the son of Nanda and Yaśodā [who] <span class="e2">ānila</span>–brought <span class="e2">golokera</span>–Goloka’s <span class="e2">nitya-dhana</span>–eternal wealth— <span class="e2">mahārāsa</span>–the Mahārāsa-līlā <span class="e2">parakīya</span>–in paramour love— <span class="e2">vrajera</span> <span class="e2">saha</span>–with Vraja [to this earth—] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–this Lord, <span class="e2">rasāsvāda</span> <span class="e2">suchatura</span>–the connoisseur of rasa, <span class="e2">ābāra</span>–again <span class="e2">ānila</span>–has brought <span class="e2">nijera</span> <span class="e2">yoga-māyāpura</span>–His abode of Yogamāyāpur <span class="e2">prapañche</span>–to the earth <span class="e2">gauḍe</span>–in Gauḍa.
As the son of Nanda and Yaśodā, the Lord performed the Rāsa-līlā with Rādhikā and the gopīs in the forest of Vṛndāvan at the end of the Dvāpar-yuga. He brought Goloka’s eternal wealth—the Rāsa-līlā in paramour love—with Vraja to this earth, and now this Lord, the connoisseur of rasa, has again brought His abode of Yogamāyāpur to the earth in Gauḍa.
গৌরাবতারের হেতু
gaurāvatārera hetu
The reason for Gaura’s appearance
শ্রীকৃষ্ণলীলায় বাঞ্ছাত্রয় না হৈল পূরণ ।<br />শ্রীগৌরলীলায় পূর্ণ কৈল সে সুখ সাধন ॥৭॥
śrī-kṛṣṇa-līlāya vāñchhā-traya nā haila pūraṇa<br />śrī-gaura-līlāya pūrṇa kaila se sukha sādhana [7]
<span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-līlāya</span>–During [His] Pastimes as Śrī Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">vāñchhā-traya</span> <span class="e2">pūraṇa haila nā</span>–the Lord had three unfulfilled desires. <span class="e2">śrī-gaura-līlāya</span>–During [His] Pastimes as Śrī Gaura, <span class="e2">pūrṇa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–the Lord completed [His] <span class="e2">sādhana</span>–endeavour <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sukha</span>–for that satisfaction.
During His Pastimes as Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Lord had three unfulfilled desires, and during His Pastimes as Śrī Gaura, He fulfilled them.
“মোরে প্রণয় করি’ রাধা পায় কিবা সুখ ।<br />মোর মাধুর্য-আস্বাদনে রাধার কত যে কৌতুক ॥৮॥
“more praṇaya kari’ rādhā pāya kibā sukha<br />mora mādhurya-āsvādane rādhāra kata ye kautuka [8]
<span class="e2">“kibā</span>–“What sort <span class="e2">sukha</span>–of happiness <span class="e2">rādhā</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–does Rādhā feel <span class="e2">praṇaya</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–by loving <span class="e2">more</span>–Me? <span class="e2">kata</span>–How great [is] <span class="e2">rādhāra</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">kautuka</span>–Rādhā’s delight <span class="e2">mora mādhurya-āsvādane</span>–in tasting My sweetness?
“What sort of happiness does Rādhā feel by loving Me? How great is Rādhā’s delight in tasting My sweetness?
আমার অনুভবে রাধায় সৌখ্য কি প্রকার ।<br />নায়ক হঞা নাহি বুঝি এ সুখের সার ॥৯॥
āmāra anubhave rādhāya saukhya ki prakāra<br />nāyaka hañā nāhi bujhi e sukhera sāra [9]
<span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–What sort <span class="e2">saukhya</span>–of joy [arises] <span class="e2">rādhāya</span>–in Rādhā [in Her] <span class="e2">anubhave</span>–experience <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–of Me? <span class="e2">hañā</span>–Being <span class="e2">nāyaka</span>–the beloved, <span class="e2">bujhi nāhi</span>–I do not understand <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the essence <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">sukhera</span>–of this happiness.
“What sort of joy does Rādhā feel in Her experience of Me? Being Her beloved, I do not understand the essence of this happiness.
অতএব রাধার ভাবকান্তি লঞা গৌর হব ।<br />কৃষ্ণমাধুর্য্যাদি ভক্তভাবে আস্বাদ পাইব” ॥১০॥
ataeva rādhāra bhāva-kānti lañā gaura haba<br />kṛṣṇa-mādhuryādi bhakta-bhāve āsvāda pāiba” [10]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">lañā</span>–I will take <span class="e2">rādhāra</span>–Rādhā’s <span class="e2">bhāva-kānti</span>–heart and halo [and] <span class="e2">haba</span>–become <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura. <span class="e2">āsvāda pāiba</span>–I will relish <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-mādhuryādi</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness and other qualities <span class="e2">bhakta-bhāve”</span>–in the mood of a devotee.”
“So, I will take Rādhā’s heart and halo and become Gaura. I will relish Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness in the mood of a devotee.”
এত ভাবি’ কৃষ্ণ নিজধাম লঞা গৌড়-দেশে ।<br />নবদ্বীপে প্রকটিল স্বয়ং আনন্দ-আবেশে ॥১১॥
eta bhāvi’ kṛṣṇa nija-dhāma lañā gauḍa-deśe<br />navadvīpe prakaṭila svayaṁ ānanda-āveśe [11]
<span class="e2">bhāvi’</span>–Thinking <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">lañā</span>–took <span class="e2">nija-dhāma</span>–His abode <span class="e2">gauḍa-deśe</span>–to the land of Gauḍa [and,] <span class="e2">ānanda-āveśe</span>–overwhelmed with joy, <span class="e2">prakaṭila</span>–manifested <span class="e2">svayaṁ</span>–Himself <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp.
Thinking in this way, Kṛṣṇa took His abode to the land of Gauḍa and, overwhelmed with joy, manifested Himself in Nabadwīp.
গৌরের ভজন-প্রণালীতে কৃষ্ণভজন
gaurera bhajana-praṇālīte kṛṣṇa-bhajana
Serving Gaura is the way to serve Kṛṣṇa
ওরে ভাই সব ছাড়ি’ বৈস নবদ্বীপপুরে ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গের অষ্টকাল ভজ, দুঃখ যাবে দূরে ॥১২॥
ore bhāi saba chhāḍi’ vaisa navadvīpapure<br />gaurāṅgera aṣṭa-kāla bhaja, duḥkha yābe dūre [12]
<span class="e2">ore</span>–O <span class="e2">bhāi</span>–brother, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–give up <span class="e2">saba</span>–everything [and] <span class="e2">vaisa</span>–stay <span class="e2">navadvīpapure</span>–in the town of Nabadwīp. <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">aṣṭa-kāla</span>–throughout the eight periods of the day, [and your] <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will go <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away.
O brother, give up everything and stay in Nabadwīp. Serve Gaurāṅga throughout the eight periods of the day and your sadness will go away.
অষ্টকালে অষ্টপরকার কৃষ্ণলীলা-সার ।<br />গৌরোদিত ভাবে ভজ, পাবে প্রেম চমৎকার ॥১৩॥
aṣṭa-kāle aṣṭa-parakāra kṛṣṇa-līlā-sāra<br />gaurodita bhāve bhaja, pābe prema chamatkāra [13]
<span class="e2">bhāve</span>–In the mood <span class="e2">gaurodita</span>–revealed by Gaura, <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–worship <span class="e2">aṣṭa-parakāra</span>–the eight modes <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā-sāra</span>–of Kṛṣṇa’s super-excellent Pastimes <span class="e2">aṣṭa-kāle</span>–during the eight periods of the day, [and] <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">chamatkāra</span>–astonishing <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love.
In the mood revealed by Gaura, worship the eight modes of Kṛṣṇa’s super-excellent Pastimes during the eight periods of the day and you will attain astonishing divine love.
কৃষ্ণ ভজিবারে যার একান্ত আছে মন ।<br />গৌড়ের অষ্টকালে ভজ কৃষ্ণরসধন ॥১৪॥
kṛṣṇa bhajibāre yāra ekānta āchhe mana<br />gauḍera aṣṭa-kāle bhaja kṛṣṇa-rasa-dhana [14]
<span class="e2">yāra mana āchhe</span>–Those who want <span class="e2">ekānta</span>–sincerely <span class="e2">bhajibāre</span>–to serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–should serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-rasa-dhana</span>–Gaura, whose wealth is devotion to Krṣṇa, <span class="e2">aṣṭa-kāle</span>–during the eight periods of the day <span class="e2">gauḍera</span>–in Gauḍa.
Those who sincerely want to serve Kṛṣṇa should serve Gaura, whose wealth is devotion to Kṛṣṇa, during the eight periods of the day in Gauḍa.
গৌরভাব নাহি জানে যে কৃষ্ণ ভজিতে চায় ।<br />অপ্রাকৃত কৃষ্ণতত্ত্ব তার কভু নাহি ভায় ॥১৫॥
gaura-bhāva nāhi jāne ye kṛṣṇa bhajite chāya<br />aprākṛta kṛṣṇa-tattva tāra kabhu nāhi bhāya [15]
<span class="e2">tāra ye</span>–Those who <span class="e2">chāya</span>–want <span class="e2">bhajite</span>–to serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [but] <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–do not understand <span class="e2">gaura-bhāva</span>–Gaura’s mood [will] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–perceive <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-tattva</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s divine nature.
Those who want to serve Kṛṣṇa but do not understand Gaura’s mood will never perceive Kṛṣṇa’s divine nature.
আচার্য বর্ণাশ্রমে আবদ্ধ নহেন
āchārya varṇāśrame ābaddha nahena
An Āchārya is not restricted by socio-religious principles
কিবা বর্ণী, কিবাশ্রমী, কিবা বর্ণাশ্রমহীন ।<br />কৃষ্ণতত্ত্ব বেত্তা যেই, সেই আচার্য প্রবীণ ॥১৬॥
kibā varṇī, kibāśramī, kibā varṇāśrama-hīna<br />kṛṣṇa-tattva vettā yei, sei āchārya pravīṇa [16]
<span class="e2">sei yei</span>–Anyone [who] <span class="e2">vettā</span>–knows <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-tattva</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s nature [is] <span class="e2">pravīṇa āchārya</span>–an expert Āchārya, <span class="e2">kibā</span>–whether [they] <span class="e2">varṇī</span>–belong to a social order, <span class="e2">kibāśramī</span>–whether they belong to a religious order, [or] <span class="e2">kibā</span>–whether <span class="e2">varṇāśrama-hīna</span>–they have no religious or social order.
Anyone who knows Kṛṣṇa’s nature is an expert Āchārya, whether they belong to a religious and social order or not.
অসদ্গুরুগ্রহণে সর্ব্বনাশ
asad-guru-grahaṇe sarva-nāśa
By accepting a false guru, everything is lost
আসল কথা ছেড়ে ভাই বর্ণে যে করে আদর ।<br />অসদ্গুরু করি’ তার বিনষ্ট পূর্ব্বাপর ॥১৭॥
āsala kathā chheḍe bhāi varṇe ye kare ādara<br />asad-guru kari’ tāra vinaṣṭa pūrvāpara [17]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">pūrvāpara</span>–the past and future <span class="e2">tāra ye</span>–of those who <span class="e2">chheḍe</span>–reject <span class="e2">āsala</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–truth, <span class="e2">ādara kare</span>–revere <span class="e2">varṇe</span>–social status, [and] <span class="e2">kari’</span>–accept <span class="e2">asad-guru</span>–a false guru [are] <span class="e2">vinaṣṭa</span>–ruined.
Brother, the past and future of those who reject truth, revere social status, and accept a false guru are ruined.

Chapter Twelve
বৈষ্ণব-মহিমা
Vaiṣṇava-mahimā
Glories of the Vaiṣṇavas
কৃষ্ণভক্তি ও তীর্থ
kṛṣṇa-bhakti o tīrtha
Devotion to Kṛṣṇa and holy places
জলময় তীর্থ মৃৎশিলাময় মূর্ত্তি ।<br />বহুকালে দেয় জীবহৃদে ধর্ম্ম স্ফূর্ত্তি ॥১॥
jalamaya tīrtha mṛtśilāmaya mūrti<br />bahu-kāle deya jīva-hṛde dharma sphūrti [1]
<span class="e2">jalamaya</span> <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–Holy waters [and] <span class="e2">mṛtśilāmaya mūrti</span>–earthen Deities <span class="e2">sphūrti deya</span>–reveal <span class="e2">dharma</span>–religion <span class="e2">jīva-hṛde</span>–in the hearts of souls <span class="e2">bahu-kāle</span>–over the course of a long time.
Holy waters and earthen Deities gradually reveal dharma in the hearts of souls.
কৃষ্ণভক্ত দেখি’ দূরে যায় সর্ব্বানর্থ ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তি সমুদিত হয় পরমার্থ ॥২॥
kṛṣṇa-bhakta dekhi’ dūre yāya sarvānartha<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti samudita haya paramārtha [2]
[But simply] <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–by seeing <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakta</span>–a devotee of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">sarvānartha</span>–all obstacles <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">dūre</span>–away [and] <span class="e2">paramārtha</span>–the supreme wealth— <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa— <span class="e2">samudita</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–arises in full.
But simply by seeing a devotee of Kṛṣṇa, all obstacles go away and the supreme wealth—devotion to Kṛṣṇa—arises in full.
সাধুসঙ্গের ফল
sādhu-saṅgera phala
The result of association with sādhus
সংসার ভ্রমিতে ভব-ক্ষয়োন্মুখ যবে ।<br />সাধুসঙ্গ-সংঘটন ভাগ্যক্রমে হবে ॥৩॥
saṁsāra bhramite bhava-kṣayonmukha yabe<br />sādhu-saṅga-saṁghaṭana bhāgya-krame habe [3]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">bhramite</span>–the souls’ wandering <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–throughout the world <span class="e2">bhava-kṣayonmukha</span>–comes to an end, [then] <span class="e2">bhāgya-krame</span>–according to their fortune, <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅga-saṁghaṭana habe</span>–they attain the association of the sādhus.
When the souls’ wandering throughout saṁsāra comes to an end, then, according to their fortune, they attain the association of the sādhus.
সাধুসঙ্গফলে কৃষ্ণে সর্ব্বেশ্বরেশ্বরে ।<br />ভাবোদয় হয় ভাই জীবের অন্তরে ॥৪॥
sādhu-saṅga-phale kṛṣṇe sarveśvareśvare<br />bhāvodaya haya bhāi jīvera antare [4]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅga-phale</span>–as a result of this association with the sādhus, <span class="e2">sarveśvareśvare kṛṣṇe bhāvodaya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of all Lords, appears <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">antare</span>–within the hearts of the souls.
Brother, as a result of this association with the sādhus, devotion to Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of all Lords, appears within their hearts.
প্রাকৃত বা কনিষ্ঠ ভক্ত
prākṛta vā kaniṣṭha bhakta
The beginner or neophyte devotee
সেই ত’ প্রাকৃত ভক্ত দীক্ষিত হইয়া ।<br />কৃষ্ণার্চ্চন করে বিধিমার্গেতে বসিয়া ॥৫॥
sei ta’ prākṛta bhakta dīkṣita ha-iyā<br />kṛṣṇārchana kare vidhi-mārgete vasiyā [5]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–These <span class="e2">prākṛta</span> <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–beginner devotees <span class="e2">dīkṣita</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–become initiated [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇārchana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–worship Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">vasiyā</span>–following <span class="e2">vidhi-mārgete</span>–the regulated path.
These beginner devotees become initiated and worship Kṛṣṇa according to the regulated path.
উত্তম মধ্যম ভক্ত না করে বিচার ।<br />শুদ্ধভক্তে সমাদর না হয় তাহার ॥৬॥
uttama madhyama bhakta nā kare vichāra<br />śuddha-bhakte samādara nā haya tāhāra [6]
<span class="e2">vichāra kare nā</span>–They cannot judge [who is] <span class="e2">uttama</span> <span class="e2">madhyama</span> <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–an advanced or intermediate devotee, [and] <span class="e2">tāhāra samādara</span> <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–they do not appreciate <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta</span>–pure devotees.
They cannot judge who is an advanced or intermediate devotee and do not appreciate pure devotees.
মধ্যম ভক্ত
madhyama bhakta
The intermediate devotee
কৃষ্ণে প্রেম, ভক্তে মৈত্রী, মূঢ়ে কৃপা আর ।<br />শুদ্ধভক্তদ্বেষী উপেক্ষা যাঁহার ॥৭॥<br />তিহোঁ ত’ প্রকৃত ভক্তিসাধক মধ্যম ।<br />অতি শীঘ্র কৃষ্ণ-বলে হইবে উত্তম ॥৮॥
kṛṣṇe prema, bhakte maitrī, mūḍhe kṛpā āra<br />śuddha-bhakta-dveṣī upekṣā yā̐hāra [7]<br />tiho̐ ta’ prakṛta bhakti-sādhaka madhyama<br />ati śīghra kṛṣṇa-bale ha-ibe uttama [8]
<span class="e2">tiho̐</span> <span class="e2">ta’ yā̐hāra</span>–Those who have <span class="e2">prema</span>–love <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–for Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">maitrī</span>–friendship <span class="e2">bhakte</span>–with devotees, <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–compassion <span class="e2">mūḍhe</span>–for the ignorant, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">upekṣā</span>–disregard <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta-dveṣī</span>–for those who are inimical to pure devotees [are] <span class="e2">prakṛta</span> <span class="e2">madhyama bhakti-sādhaka</span>–genuine intermediate practitioners of devotion. <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bale</span>–By Kṛṣṇa’s grace, <span class="e2">uttama ha-ibe</span>–they become advanced <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">śīghra</span>–very quickly.
Those who have love for Kṛṣṇa, friendship with devotees, compassion for the ignorant, and disregard for those who are inimical to pure devotees are intermediate practitioners of devotion. By Kṛṣṇa’s grace, they very quickly become advanced devotees.
উত্তম ভক্ত
uttama bhakta
The advanced devotee
সর্ব্বভূতে শ্রীকৃষ্ণের ভাব সন্দর্শন ।<br />ভগবানে সর্ব্বভূতে করেন দর্শন ॥৯॥<br />শত্রু-মিত্র-বিষয়েতে নাহি রাগদ্বেষ ।<br />তিহোঁ ভাগবতোত্তম এই গৌর-উপদেশ ॥১০॥
sarva-bhūte śrī-kṛṣṇera bhāva sandarśana<br />bhagavāne sarva-bhūte karena darśana [9]<br />śatru-mitra-viṣayete nāhi rāga-dveṣa<br />tiho̐ bhāgavatottama ei gaura-upadeśa [10]
<span class="e2">tiho̐</span>–Those [who] <span class="e2">sandarśana</span>–see <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–the presence of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sarva-bhūte</span>–in all beings [and] <span class="e2">darśana karena</span>–see <span class="e2">sarva-bhūte</span>–all beings <span class="e2">bhagavāne</span>–within the Lord, [and who] <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–have no <span class="e2">rāga-dveṣa</span>–attachment or aversion <span class="e2">śatru-mitra-viṣayete</span>–to enemies, friends, or the world [are] <span class="e2">bhāgavatottama</span>–advanced devotees. <span class="e2">ei</span>–These [are] <span class="e2">gaura-upadeśa</span>–Gaura’s teachings.
Those who see the presence of Kṛṣṇa in all beings, see all beings within Kṛṣṇa, and have no attachment or aversion to enemies, friends, or the world are advanced devotees. These are Gaura’s teachings.
উত্তম ভক্তের বিষয়-স্বীকার
uttama bhaktera viṣaya-svīkāra
How the advanced devotee accepts material things
বিষয় ইন্দ্রিয়দ্বারে করিয়া স্বীকার ।<br />রাগদ্বেষহীন ভক্তি জীবনে যাঁহার ॥১১॥<br />সমস্ত জগৎ দেখি’ বিষ্ণুমায়াময় ।<br />ভাগবতগণোত্তম সেই মহাশয় ॥১২॥
viṣaya indriya-dvāre kariyā svīkāra<br />rāga-dveṣa-hīna bhakti jīvane yā̐hāra [11]<br />samasta jagat dekhi’ viṣṇu-māyā-maya<br />bhāgavata-gaṇottama sei mahāśaya [12]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya yā̐hāra</span>–Those great souls who <span class="e2">svīkāra kariyā</span>–accept <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–material things <span class="e2">indriya-dvāre</span>–through [their] senses <span class="e2">bhakti</span> <span class="e2">jīvane</span>–in [their] life of devotion [but] <span class="e2">rāga-dveṣa-hīna</span>–have no attachment or aversion, [and who] <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–see <span class="e2">samasta</span> <span class="e2">jagat</span>–the entire world [to be] <span class="e2">viṣṇu-māyā-maya</span>–made of Viṣṇu’s energy, [are] <span class="e2">bhāgavata-gaṇottama</span>–advanced amongst the devotees of the Lord.
Those great souls who accept material things through their senses but live a life of devotion free from attachment and aversion, and who see the entire world as a manifestation of Viṣṇu’s energy, are advanced amongst the devotees of the Lord.
তাঁহার ইন্দ্রিয় বৃত্তি পরিচালন
tā̐hāra indriya-vṛtti parichālana
How they control the work of their senses
দেহেন্দ্রিয়-প্রাণ-মন-বুদ্ধি-যুক্ত-সবে ।<br />জন্ম নাশ ক্ষুধা তৃষ্ণা ভয় উপদ্রবে ॥১৩॥<br />অনিত্য সংসার-ধর্ম্মে হঞা মোহহীন ।<br />কৃষ্ণ স্মরি’ কাল কাটে ভক্ত সমীচীন ॥১৪॥
dehendriya-prāṇa-mana-buddhi-yukta-sabe<br />janma nāśa kṣudhā tṛṣṇā bhaya upadrave [13]<span class="e2"><br /></span>anitya saṁsāra-dharme hañā moha-hīna<br />kṛṣṇa smari’ kāla kāṭe bhakta samīchīna [14]
[Although] <span class="e2">dehendriya-prāṇa-mana-buddhi-yukta-sabe</span>–they have a body, senses, a life-force, a mind, and intelligence, <span class="e2">samīchīna bhakta</span>–wise devotees <span class="e2">moha-hīna hañā</span>–remaining unaffected <span class="e2">janma</span> <span class="e2">nāśa</span> <span class="e2">kṣudhā</span> <span class="e2">tṛṣṇā</span> <span class="e2">bhaya</span> <span class="e2">upadrave</span>–by birth, death, hunger, thirst, fear, and disturbances, [as well as] <span class="e2">anitya</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāra-dharme</span>–the temporary nature of this world. <span class="e2">kāla</span> <span class="e2">kāṭe</span>–They spend [their] time <span class="e2">smari’</span>–remembering <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa.
Although they have a body, senses, a life-force, a mind, and intelligence, wise devotees remain unaffected by birth, death, hunger, thirst, fear, and disturbances, as well as the temporary nature of this world. They spend their time remembering Kṛṣṇa.
তাঁহার কর্ম্ম দেহযাত্রার্থে মাত্র—কামের জন্য নহে
tā̐hāra karma deha-yātrārthe mātra—kāmera janya nahe
Their worldly activities are only for the maintenance of their body—not for selfish enjoyment
যাঁর চিত্তে নিরন্তর যশোদানন্দন ।<br />দেহযাত্রামাত্র কামকর্ম্মের গ্রহণ ॥১৫॥
yā̐ra chitte nirantara yaśodā-nandana<br />deha-yātrā-mātra kāma-karmera grahaṇa [15]
<span class="e2">yā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">chitte</span>–Devotees in whose heart <span class="e2">yaśodā-nandana</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is present] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–always <span class="e2">grahaṇa</span>–accept [engagement in] <span class="e2">kāma-karmera</span>–worldly actions <span class="e2">deha-yātrā-mātra</span>–only to maintain their bodies.
Devotees in whose heart Kṛṣṇa is always present accept engagement in worldly actions only to maintain their bodies.
কামকর্ম্মবীজরূপ বাসনা তাঁহার ।<br />চিত্তে নাহি জন্মে এই ভক্তিতত্ত্বসার ॥১৬॥
kāma-karma-bīja-rūpa vāsanā tā̐hāra<br />chitte nāhi janme ei bhakti-tattva-sāra [16]
<span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–Material desire,<span class="e2"> kāma-karma-bīja-rūpa</span>–the seed of worldly actions, <span class="e2">janme nāhi</span>–does not arise <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">chitte</span>–in their heart. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">bhakti-tattva-sāra</span>–the essence of the nature of devotion.
Material desire—the seed of worldly actions—does not arise in their heart. This is the essence of devotion.
হরিজন দেহাত্মবুদ্ধিহীন
hari-jana dehātma-buddhi-hīna
The surrendered soul has no conception of the body being the self
জ্ঞান-কর্ম্ম-বর্ণাশ্রম দেহের স্বভাব ।<br />তাহে সঙ্গদ্বারা হয় ‘অহং-মম’-ভাব ॥১৭॥
jñāna-karma-varṇāśrama dehera svabhāva<br />tāhe saṅga-dvārā haya ‘ahaṁ-mama’-bhāva [17]
<span class="e2">jñāna-karma-varṇāśrama</span>–Knowledge, action, and social duties [are] <span class="e2">svabhāva</span>–attributes <span class="e2">dehera</span>–of the body, [and] <span class="e2">‘ahaṁ-mama’-bhāva</span>–the conception of ‘I’ and ‘mine’ <span class="e2">haya</span>–arise <span class="e2">saṅga-dvārā</span>–through attachment <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–to them.
Knowledge, action, and social duties are attributes of the body, and the conceptions of ‘I’ and ‘mine’ arise through attachment to them.
দেহসত্ত্বে ‘অহং-মম’-ভাব নাহি যাঁর ।<br />হরিপ্রিয়জন তিহোঁ, করহ বিচার ॥১৮॥
deha-sattve ‘ahaṁ-mama’-bhāva nāhi yā̐ra<br />hari-priya-jana tiho̐, karaha vichāra [18]
<span class="e2">vichāra karaha</span>–Consider <span class="e2">tiho̐ yā̐ra nāhi</span>–those who have no <span class="e2">‘ahaṁ-mama’-bhāva</span>–conception of ‘I’ or ‘mine’ <span class="e2">deha-sattve</span>–in relation to [their] body [to be] <span class="e2">hari-priya-jana</span>–dear to the Lord.
Consider those who have no conception of ‘I’ or ‘mine’ in relation to their body to be dear to the Lord.
সর্ব্বভূতে সমবুদ্ধিসম্পন্ন
sarva-bhūte sama-buddhi-sampanna
Equality towards all beings
বিত্তসত্ত্বে তাহে ছাড়ি’ স্ব-পরভাবনা ।<br />‘তুমি’ ‘আমি’-সত্ত্বভেদে মিত্রারি-কল্পনা ॥১৯॥<br />সর্ব্বভূতে সমবুদ্ধি শান্ত যেই জন ।<br />ভাগবতোত্তম বলি’ তাঁহার গণন ॥২০॥
vitta-sattve tāhe chhāḍi’ sva-para-bhāvanā<br />‘tumi’ ‘āmi’-sattva-bhede mitrāri-kalpanā [19]<br />sarva-bhūte sama-buddhi śānta yei jana<br />bhāgavatottama bali’ tā̐hāra gaṇana [20]
<span class="e2">tā̐hāra yei</span> <span class="e2">śānta jana</span>–Peaceful souls who <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–reject <span class="e2">sva-para-bhāvanā</span>–the conceptions of ‘mine’ and ‘other’s’ <span class="e2">vitta-sattve tāhe</span>–with regard to property, <span class="e2">sattva-bhede</span>–the distinction between <span class="e2">‘tumi’</span>–‘You’ [and] <span class="e2">‘āmi’</span>–‘I’, [and] <span class="e2">mitrāri-kalpanā</span>–the conceptions of friends and enemies, [and who are] <span class="e2">sama-buddhi</span>–equal <span class="e2">sarva-bhūte</span>–towards all beings, [are] <span class="e2">gaṇana</span>–considered <span class="e2">bali’</span>–to be <span class="e2">bhāgavatottama</span>–advanced devotees.
Peaceful souls who reject the conceptions of ‘mine’ and ‘other’s’ regarding property, reject distinctions between themself and others, reject the conceptions of friends and enemies, and are equal towards all beings, are advanced devotees.
কৃষ্ণপাদপদ্মে সেই সুরমৃগ্য ধন ।<br />ভুবনবৈভব লাগি’ না ছাড়ে যে জন ॥২১॥<br />কৃষ্ণপদস্মৃতি নিমেষার্ধ নাহি ত্যজে ।<br />বৈষ্ণব-অগ্রণী তিহোঁ পরানন্দে মজে ॥২২॥
kṛṣṇa-pāda-padme sei sura-mṛgya dhana<br />bhuvana-vaibhava lāgi’ nā chhāḍe ye jana [21]<br />kṛṣṇa-pada-smṛti nimeṣārdha nāhi tyaje<br />vaiṣṇava-agraṇī tiho̐ parānande maje [22]
<span class="e2">tiho̐ ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">chhāḍe nā</span>–do not leave <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pāda-padme</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet— <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sura-mṛgya</span> <span class="e2">dhana</span>–the wealth sought by the wise— <span class="e2">lāgi’</span>–for the sake of <span class="e2">bhuvana-vaibhava</span>–worldly opulence, [and] <span class="e2">tyaje nāhi</span>–do not neglect <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pada-smṛti</span>–remem­bering Kṛṣṇa’s feet <span class="e2">nimeṣārdha</span>–for half a second, [are] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-agraṇī</span>–advanced devotees [and are] <span class="e2">maje</span>–immersed <span class="e2">parānande</span>–in divine ecstasy.
Those who do not leave Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet—the wealth sought by the wise—for the sake of worldly opulence, and do not forget Kṛṣṇa’s feet for even half a second, are advanced devotees and are immersed in divine ecstasy.
ভক্ত ত্রিতাপমুক্ত
bhakta tritāpa-mukta
The devotee is free from the three miseries
কৃষ্ণপদশাখানখমণিচন্দ্রিকায় ।<br />নিরস্ত সকল তাপ যাঁহার হিয়ায় ॥২৩॥<br />সে কেন বিষয়সূর্য্যতাপ অন্বেষিবে ।<br />হৃদয় শীতল তার সর্ব্বদা রহিবে ॥২৪॥
kṛṣṇa-pada-śākhā-nakha-maṇi-chandrikāya<br />nirasta sakala tāpa yā̐hāra hiyāya [23]<br />se kena viṣaya-sūrya-tāpa anveṣibe<br />hṛdaya śītala tāra sarvadā rahibe [24]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why [would] <span class="e2">se</span>–the soul <span class="e2">yā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">hiyāya</span>–from whose heart <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">tāpa</span>–miseries [have been] <span class="e2">nirasta</span>–driven away <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pada-śākhā-nakha-maṇi-chandrikāya</span>–by the moonlight from the jewel-like toenails of Kṛṣṇa’s feet <span class="e2">anveṣibe</span>–seek <span class="e2">viṣaya-sūrya-tāpa</span>–the misery produced by the sun of mundanity? <span class="e2">tāra</span>–Their <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–will remain <span class="e2">śītala</span>–cool <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always.
Why would the soul from whose heart all miseries have been driven away by the moonlight from the jewel-like toenails of Kṛṣṇa’s feet seek the misery produced by the sun of mundanity? Such a soul’s heart always remains tranquil.
উত্তম ভক্তের অন্যান্য লক্ষণ
uttama bhaktera anyānya lakṣaṇa
Other qualities of the advanced devotee
যে বেঁধেছে প্রেমছাঁদে কৃষ্ণাঙ্ঘ্রিকমল ।<br />নাহি ছাড়ে হরি তার হৃদয় সরল ॥২৫॥
ye be̐dhechhe prema-chhā̐de kṛṣṇāṅghri-kamala<br />nāhi chhāḍe hari tāra hṛdaya sarala [25]
<span class="e2">hari</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">chhāḍe nāhi</span>–never leaves <span class="e2">sarala hṛdaya</span>–the sincere hearts <span class="e2">tāra ye</span>–of those who <span class="e2">be̐dhechhe</span>–have bound <span class="e2">kṛṣṇāṅghri-kamala</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet <span class="e2">prema-chhā̐de</span>–with the rope of divine love.
The Lord never leaves the sincere hearts of those who have bound His lotus feet with the rope of divine love.
অবশেও যদি মুখে স্ফুরে কৃষ্ণনাম ।<br />ভাগবতোত্তম সেই, পূর্ণ সর্ব্ব কাম ॥২৬॥
avaśeo yadi mukhe sphure kṛṣṇa-nāma<br />bhāgavatottama sei, pūrṇa sarva kāma [26]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">avaśeo</span>–even involuntarily <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sphure</span>–appears <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–in [their] mouth, [then] <span class="e2">sei</span>–they [are] <span class="e2">bhāgavatottama</span>–an advanced devotee, [and] <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">kāma</span>–all [their] desires [are] <span class="e2">pūrṇa</span>–fulfilled.
If even involuntarily the Name of Kṛṣṇa appears in their mouth, then they are an advanced devotee, and all their desires are fulfilled.
স্বধর্ম্মের গুণদোষ বুঝিয়া যে জন ।<br />সর্ব্ব ধর্ম্ম ছাড়ি’ ভজে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥২৭॥<br />সেই ত’ উত্তম ভক্ত, কেহ তার সম ।<br />না আছে জগতে আর ভাগবতোত্তম ॥২৮॥
svadharmera guṇa-doṣa bujhiyā ye jana<br />sarva dharma chhāḍi’ bhaje kṛṣṇera charaṇa [27]<br />sei ta’ uttama bhakta, keha tāra sama<br />nā āchhe jagate āra bhāgavatottama [28]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta’ ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–understand <span class="e2">guṇa-doṣa</span>–the qualities and faults <span class="e2">svadharmera</span>–of social duties (the duties of their varṇa and āśram), [subsequently] <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leave aside <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">dharma</span>–all [such] duties, [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–the feet <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–of Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">uttama</span> <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–advanced devotees. <span class="e2">jagate</span>–Throughout the world, <span class="e2">keha āchhe nā</span>–there are no <span class="e2">āra</span>–other <span class="e2">bhāgavatottama</span>–advanced devotees <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sama</span>–equal to them.
Those who understand the qualities and faults of social duties, subsequently leave aside all such duties, and serve the feet of Kṛṣṇa are advanced devotees. Throughout the world, there are no advanced devotees equal to them.
কৃষ্ণের স্বরূপ আর নামের স্বরূপ ।<br />ভক্তের স্বরূপ আর ভক্তির স্বরূপ ॥২৯॥<br />জানিয়া ভজন করে যেই মহাজন ।<br />তার তুল্য নাহি কেহ বৈষ্ণব সুজন ॥৩০॥
kṛṣṇera svarūpa āra nāmera svarūpa<br />bhaktera svarūpa āra bhaktira svarūpa [29]<br />jāniyā bhajana kare yei mahājana<br />tāra tulya nāhi keha vaiṣṇava sujana [30]
<span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span> <span class="e2">sujana</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There are no sincere devotees <span class="e2">tulya</span>–comparable <span class="e2">tāra yei</span> <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–to the great souls who <span class="e2">bhajana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–engage in service <span class="e2">jāniyā</span>–understanding <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the true nature of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the true nature of the Name, <span class="e2">bhaktera</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the true nature of devotees, <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the true nature of devotion.
There are no sincere devotees comparable to the great souls who engage in service understanding the true nature of Kṛṣṇa, the true nature of the Name, the true nature of devotees, and the true nature of devotion.
স্বরূপ না জানে তবু অনন্যভাবেতে ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণে সাক্ষাৎ ভজে নামস্বরূপেতে ॥৩১॥<br />তিহোঁ ভক্তোত্তম বলি’ জানিবেরে ভাই ।<br />এই আজ্ঞা দিয়াছেন চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ॥৩২॥
svarūpa nā jāne tabu ananya-bhāvete<br />śrī-kṛṣṇe sākṣāt bhaje nāma-svarūpete [31]<br />tiho̐ bhaktottama bali’ jānibere bhāi<br />ei ājñā diyāchhena chaitanya gosāñi [32]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">jānibere</span>–know <span class="e2">tiho̐</span>–those who <span class="e2">jāne nā</span>–do not understand <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–these truths, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">ananya-bhāvete</span>–exclusively [and] <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span>–directly <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇe</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nāma-svarūpete</span>–in the form of [His] Name <span class="e2">bali’</span>–to be <span class="e2">bhaktottama</span>–advanced devotees. <span class="e2">chaitanya</span> <span class="e2">gosāñi</span>–Lord Chaitanya <span class="e2">diyāchhena</span>–has given <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–instruction.
Brother, know even those who do not understand these truths but exclusively and directly serve Kṛṣṇa in the form of His Name to be advanced devotees. Lord Chaitanya has given this instruction.

Chapter Thirteen
শ্রীগৌরদর্শনের ব্যাকুলতা
Śrī-Gaura-darśanera Vyākulatā
Eagerness to see Śrī Gaura
গৌরাঙ্গ তোমার	চরণ ছাড়িয়া<br />	চলিনু শ্রীবৃন্দাবনে ।<br />পূর্ব্ব-লীলা তব	দেখিব বলিয়া<br />	হইল আমার মনে ॥১॥
gaurāṅga tomāra	charaṇa chhāḍiyā<br />	chalinu śrī-vṛndāvane<br />pūrva-līlā tava	dekhiba baliyā<br />	ha-ila āmāra mane [1]
<span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–O Gaurāṅga! <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–I left <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet [and] <span class="e2">chalinu</span>–went <span class="e2">śrī-vṛndāvane</span>–to Śrī Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–Thinking <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–I would see<span class="e2"> tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">pūrva-līlā</span>–previous Pastimes, <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">mane ha-ila</span>–I decided [to go there].
O Gaurāṅga! I left Your feet and went to Vṛndāvan. Thinking I would see Your previous Pastimes, I decided to go there.
কেন সেই ভাব	হইল আমার<br />	এখন কাঁদিয়া মরি ।<br />তোমারে না দেখি’	প্রাণ ছাড়ি’ যায় <br />	না জানি এবে কি করি ॥২॥
kena sei bhāva	ha-ila āmāra<br />	ekhana kā̐diyā mari<br />tomāre nā dekhi’	prāṇa chhāḍi’ yāya<br />	nā jāni ebe ki kari [2]
<span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">āmāra sei</span> <span class="e2">bhāva</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–did I think that? <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–Now <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–I am crying [and] <span class="e2">mari</span>–dying. <span class="e2">dekhi’ nā</span>–Not seeing <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–You, [my] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–heart <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–is leaving [me]. <span class="e2">jāni nā</span>–I do not know <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">kari</span>–what to do <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now.
Why did I think that? Now I am crying and dying. Not seeing You, my heart is leaving me. I do not know what to do now.
ও রাঙ্গা চরণ	মম প্রাণ ধন<br />	সমুদ্রবালিতে রাখি’ ।<br />কি দেখিতে আইনু	নিজ মাথা খাইনু <br />	উড়ু উড়ু প্রাণপাখী ॥৩॥
o rāṅgā charaṇa	mama prāṇa dhana<br />	samudra-bālite rākhi’<br />ki dekhite āinu	nija māthā khāinu<br />	uḍu uḍu prāṇa-pākhī [3]
<span class="e2">o</span> <span class="e2">rāṅgā</span> <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–Your reddish feet [are] <span class="e2">mama</span>–my <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–life [and] <span class="e2">dhana</span>–wealth, [but] <span class="e2">rākhi’</span>–I left [them] <span class="e2">samudra-bālite</span>–on the sand beside the ocean; <span class="e2">ki</span>–what <span class="e2">āinu</span>–have I come [here] <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–to see? <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">māthā</span> <span class="e2">khāinu</span>–I indulged my mind, [and now] <span class="e2">prāṇa-pākhī</span>–the bird of my heart [is] <span class="e2">uḍu</span> <span class="e2">uḍu</span>–anxious to fly [away].
Your reddish feet are my life and wealth, but I left them on the sand beside the ocean; what have I come here to see? I indulged my mind, and now the bird of my heart is anxious to fly away.
যত চলি’ যাই	মন নাহি চলে<br />	তবু যাই জেদ করি’ ।<br />প্রেমের বিবর্ত্ত	আমারে নাচায়<br />	না বুঝিয়া আমি মরি ॥৪॥
yata chali’ yāi	mana nāhi chale<br />	tabu yāi jeda kari’<br />premera vivarta	āmāre nāchāya<br />	nā bujhiyā āmi mari [4]
<span class="e2">yata</span>–As far as <span class="e2">chali’</span> <span class="e2">yāi</span>–I go on, [my] <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart <span class="e2">chale nāhi</span>–does not proceed. <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">yāi</span>–I go on <span class="e2">jeda</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–stubbornly. <span class="e2">vivarta</span>–Transformations <span class="e2">premera</span>–of love <span class="e2">āmāre</span> <span class="e2">nāchāya</span>–make me dance, [but] <span class="e2">bujhiyā nā</span>–not understanding [them,] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">mari</span>–am dying.
Although I go on, my heart does not. Still, I go on stubbornly …Transformations of love make me dance, but, not understanding them, I am dying.
গৌরাঙ্গের রঙ্গ	বুঝিতে নারিনু<br />	পড়িনু দুঃখ-সাগরে ।<br />আমি চাই যাহা	নাহি পাই তাহা<br />	মন যে কেমন করে ॥৫॥
gaurāṅgera raṅga	bujhite nārinu<br />	paḍinu duḥkha-sāgare<br />āmi chāi yāhā	nāhi pāi tāhā<br />	mana ye kemana kare [5]
<span class="e2">nārinu</span>–I could not <span class="e2">bujhite</span>–understand <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span>–Gaurāṅga’s <span class="e2">raṅga</span>–Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">paḍinu</span>–I have fallen <span class="e2">duḥkha-sāgare</span>–into an ocean of sorrow. <span class="e2">pāi nāhi</span>–I do not get <span class="e2">tāhā yāhā</span>–that which <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">chāi</span>–want. <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">kemana</span>–How might <span class="e2">mana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–[my] heart act?
Failing to understand Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes, I have fallen into an ocean of sorrow. I do not get what I want; what is my heart going to do now?
গৌরাঙ্গের তরে	প্রাণ দিতে যাই<br />	না হয় মরণ তবু ।<br />মরিব বলিয়া	পড়িয়া সমুদ্রে<br />	খাই মাত্র হাবুডুবু ॥৬॥
gaurāṅgera tare	prāṇa dite yāi<br />	nā haya maraṇa tabu<br />mariba baliyā	paḍiyā samudre<br />	khāi mātra hābuḍubu [6]
<span class="e2">yāi</span>–I go <span class="e2">dite</span>–to give [my] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–life <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera</span> <span class="e2">tare</span>–to Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but <span class="e2">maraṇa haya nā</span>–I do not die. <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–I decide <span class="e2">mariba</span>–I will die [and] <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–I jump <span class="e2">samudre</span>–into the ocean [but] <span class="e2">mātra</span> <span class="e2">hābuḍubu khāi</span>–I only flounder in the water.
I go to give my life to Gaurāṅga, but I do not die. I decide to die and jump into the ocean, but I only flounder in the water.
সে চন্দ্রবদন	দেখিবার লোভে<br />	শীঘ্র উঠি সিন্ধুতটে ।<br />পুনঃ নাহি দেখি’	প্রাণ উড়ি’ যায়<br />	চলি পুনঃ টোটাবাটে ॥৭॥
se chandra-vadana	dekhibāra lobhe<br />	śīghra uṭhi sindhu-taṭe<br />punaḥ nāhi dekhi’	prāṇa uḍi’ yāya <br />	chali punaḥ ṭoṭā-vāṭe [7]
<span class="e2">lobhe</span>–Anxious <span class="e2">dekhibāra</span>–to see <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">chandra-vadana</span>–His moon-like face, <span class="e2">śīghra</span> <span class="e2">uṭhi</span>–I quickly get up <span class="e2">sindhu-taṭe</span>–on the shore of the ocean. <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–Again, <span class="e2">dekhi’ nāhi</span>–not seeing [Him, my] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–heart <span class="e2">uḍi’</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–flies [up, and] <span class="e2">chali</span>–I run <span class="e2">punaḥ ṭoṭā-vāṭe</span>–back down the path to the garden.
Anxious to see His moon-like face, I quickly return to the shore. Again, not seeing Him, my heart flies up, and I run back down the path to the garden.
গোপীনাথাঙ্গনে	দেখি’ গোরামুখ<br />	পড়ি অচেতন হঞা ।<br />পণ্ডিত গোঁসাঞি	মোরে লঞা রাখে<br />	দেখি পুনঃ সংজ্ঞা পাঞা ॥৮॥
gopīnāthāṅgane	dekhi’ gorā-mukha<br />	paḍi achetana hañā<br />paṇḍita go̐sāñi	more lañā rākhe<br />	dekhi punaḥ saṁjñā pāñā [8]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing <span class="e2">gorā-mukha</span>–Gorā’s face <span class="e2">gopīnāthāṅgane</span>–in the courtyard of Gopīnāth, <span class="e2">achetana</span> <span class="e2">hañā paḍi</span>–I fell unconscious. <span class="e2">paṇḍita</span> <span class="e2">go̐sāñi</span>–Gadādhar Paṇḍit <span class="e2">lañā</span> <span class="e2">rākhe</span>–took care <span class="e2">more</span>–of me, [and then] <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–I saw [that] <span class="e2">saṁjñā</span> <span class="e2">pāñā</span>–I was conscious <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again.
Seeing Gorā’s face in the courtyard of Gopīnāth, I fell unconscious. Gadādhar Paṇḍit took care of me, and then I saw that I was conscious again.
গৌর গদাধর	বসিয়া দুজনে<br />	বলেন আমার কথা ।<br />অমনি কাঁদিয়া	যাই গড়াগড়ি<br />	না বিচারি যথা তথা ॥৯॥
gaura gadādhara	basiyā dujane<br />	balena āmāra kathā<br />amani kā̐diyā	yāi gaḍāgaḍi<br />	nā vichāri yathā tathā [9]
<span class="e2">gaura</span> <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gaura and Gadādhar <span class="e2">basiyā</span>–were sitting [and] <span class="e2">dujane</span>–the two of Them <span class="e2">balena</span>–where speaking <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–about me, [and] <span class="e2">amani</span>–all of a sudden <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–I [began to] cry [and] <span class="e2">gaḍāgaḍi yāi</span>–rolled on the ground, <span class="e2">vichāri nā</span>–not considering <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–here from there.
Gaura and Gadādhar were sitting and speaking about me, and all of a sudden, I began to cry and roll on the ground, unaware of where I was.
ক্ষণেক বিরহ	সহিতে না পারি<br />	গৌর মোর হৃদে নাচে ।<br />মরিতে না দেয়	বাঁচিলে কোন্দল<br />	কিসে মোর প্রাণ বাঁচে ॥১০॥
kṣaṇeka viraha	sahite nā pāri<br />	gaura mora hṛde nāche<br />marite nā deya	vā̐chile kondala<br />	kise mora prāṇa vā̐che [10]
<span class="e2">pāri nā</span>–I cannot <span class="e2">sahite</span>–tolerate <span class="e2">kṣaṇeka</span>–a moment <span class="e2">viraha</span>–of separation [as] <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dances <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">hṛde</span>–in my heart. <span class="e2">deya nā</span>–He does not allow [me] <span class="e2">marite</span>–to die, [but] <span class="e2">vā̐chile</span>–when I live, <span class="e2">kondala</span>–we quarrel. <span class="e2">kise</span>–How [can] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–heart <span class="e2">vā̐che</span>–live?
I cannot tolerate a moment of separation as Gaura dances in my heart. He does not let me die, but when I live, we quarrel. How does my life go on?
হেন অবস্থায়	গৌরপদ ছাড়ি’<br />	মোর বৃন্দাবনে আসা ।<br />এ বুদ্ধি হইল	কেন নাহি জানি<br />	ইহ-পরলোক-নাশা ॥১১॥
hena avasthāya	gaura-pada chhāḍi’<br />	mora vṛndāvane āsā<br />e buddhi ha-ila	kena nāhi jāni<br />	iha-para-loka-nāśā [11]
<span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">avasthāya</span>–In this condition, <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–I left <span class="e2">gaura-pada</span>–Gaura’s feet [and] <span class="e2">mora āsā</span>–came <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–to Vṛndāvan. <span class="e2">jāni nāhi</span>–I do not know <span class="e2">kena</span>–why <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">buddhi</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–this decision was made, [but now my] <span class="e2">iha-para-loka-nāśā</span>–present and future [are] ruined.
In this condition, I left Gaura’s feet and came to Vṛndāvan. I do not know what made me do this, but now my present and future are ruined.
আজ্ঞা লইনু যাইতে	আজ্ঞা না পালিলে<br />	তাতে হয় অপরাধ ।<br />গোরাচাঁদমুখ	না দেখিয়া মরি <br />	সব দিকে মোর বাধ ॥১২॥
ājñā la-inu yāite	ājñā nā pālile<br />	tāte haya aparādha<br />gorāchā̐da-mukha	nā dekhiyā mari<br />	saba dike mora bādha [12]
<span class="e2">la-inu</span>–I took <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–permission <span class="e2">yāite</span>–to go, [and] <span class="e2">pālile nā</span>–if I don’t act according [to this] <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–permission, <span class="e2">tāte</span>–then <span class="e2">aparādha haya</span>–I will commit an offence. [But] <span class="e2">dekhiyā nā</span>–not seeing<span class="e2"> gorāchā̐da-mukha</span>–Gorāchā̐d’s face, <span class="e2">mari</span>–I am dying. <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">bādha</span>–I have obstacles <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">dike</span>–in all directions!
I took permission to go, and if I don’t do so accordingly, I will commit an offence. But not seeing Gorāchā̐d’s face, I am dying; there are obstacles all around me!
গোরাপ্রেম যার	সঙ্কট তাহার<br />	প্রাণ লঞা টানাটানি ।<br />গদাধরগণে	এই ত’ দুর্দ্দশা<br />	সবে করে কাণাকাণি ॥১৩॥
gorā-prema yāra	saṅkaṭa tāhāra<br />	prāṇa lañā ṭānāṭāni<br />gadādhara-gaṇe	ei ta’ durdaśā<br />	sabe kare kāṇākāṇi [13]
<span class="e2">tāhāra yāra</span>–Those who have <span class="e2">gorā-prema</span>–love for Gorā [undergo] <span class="e2">saṅkaṭa</span>–distress. [That love] <span class="e2">prāṇa</span> <span class="e2">lañā</span> <span class="e2">ṭānāṭāni</span>–pulls [their] hearts in opposite directions [simultaneously]. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">kāṇākāṇi kare</span>–whispers [that] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">durdaśā</span>–the miserable state <span class="e2">gadādhara-gaṇe</span>–of Gadādhar’s associates.
Those who have love for Gorā undergo distress: that love pulls their hearts in opposite directions simultaneously. Everyone whispers that this is the miserable state of Gadādhar’s associates.

Chapter Fourteen
বিপরীত বিবর্ত্ত
Viparīta Vivarta
Contradictory Transformations
নবদ্বীপ-দর্শনে বৃন্দাবন-দর্শন
navadvīpa-darśane vṛndāvana-darśana
Seeing Vṛndāvan by seeing Nabadwīp
ভাইরে<br />বৃন্দাবনে যাওয়া আর হলো না ॥১॥
bhāi-re<br />vṛndāvane yāoyā āra halo nā [1]
<span class="e2">bhāi-re</span>–O brother, <span class="e2">āra yāoyā</span> <span class="e2">halo</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–I could not continue <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–to Vṛndāvan.
O brother, I could not continue to Vṛndāvan.
গোরামুখ না দেখিয়া	গোরারূপ ধেয়াইয়া<br />	পথ ভুলি’ যাই অন্য দেশ ।<br />সেখান হইতে ফিরি’	পুনঃ যাই ধীরি ধীরি<br />	পুনঃ আসি’ দেখি সে প্রদেশ ॥২॥
gorā-mukha nā dekhiyā	gorā-rūpa dheyāiyā<br />	patha bhuli’ yāi anya deśa<br />sekhāna ha-ite phiri’	punaḥ yāi dhīri dhīri<br />	punaḥ āsi’ dekhi se pradeśa [2]
<span class="e2">dekhiyā nā</span>–I had not seen <span class="e2">gorā-mukha</span>–Gorā’s face, [and so] <span class="e2">dheyāiyā</span>–was meditating <span class="e2">gorā-rūpa</span>–on Gorā’s form; <span class="e2">bhuli’</span>–I lost <span class="e2">patha</span>–the way [and] <span class="e2">yāi</span>–went <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">deśa</span>–elsewhere. <span class="e2">phiri’</span>–Turning around <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">sekhāna</span>–there, <span class="e2">yāi punaḥ</span>–I went on <span class="e2">dhīri</span> <span class="e2">dhīri</span>–slowly. [When] <span class="e2">punaḥ āsi’</span>–I came back, <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–I saw <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">pradeśa</span>–the same place.
I had not seen Gorā’s face and so was meditating on His form; I lost the way and went in the wrong direction. I turned back and slowly went on. When I came back, I saw I was in the same place!
এইরূপে কত দিনে	যাব আমি বৃন্দাবনে<br />	না জানি কি হবে দশা মোর ।<br />বৃক্ষতলে বসি’ বসি’	কাটি আমি অহর্নিশি<br />	কভু মোর নিদ্রা আসে ঘোর ॥৩॥
ei-rūpe kata dine	yāba āmi vṛndāvane<br />	nā jāni ki habe daśā mora<br />vṛkṣa-tale basi’ basi‘	kāṭi āmi ahar-niśi<br />	kabhu mora nidrā āse ghora [3]
<span class="e2">ei-rūpe</span>–In this way, <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dine</span>–for many days, [I thought,] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">yāba</span>–would go <span class="e2">vṛndāvane</span>–to Vṛndāvan, [but] <span class="e2">jāni nā</span>–I did not know <span class="e2">ki</span>–what <span class="e2">mora daśā habe</span>–condition would befall me. <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kāṭi</span>–passed <span class="e2">ahar-niśi</span>–days and nights <span class="e2">basi’</span> <span class="e2">basi‘</span>–sitting <span class="e2">vṛkṣa-tale</span>–under trees, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">ghora</span> <span class="e2">nidrā</span> <span class="e2">āse</span>–I slept heavily.
In this way, for many days I thought I would go to Vṛndāvan, but I did not know what would become of me. I passed days and nights sitting under trees, and sometimes I slept heavily.
স্বপ্নে বহু দূরে গিয়া	সিন্ধুতটে প্রবেশিয়া<br />	দেখি গোরার অপূর্ব্ব নর্ত্তন ।<br />গদাধর নাচে সঙ্গে	ভক্তগণ নাচে রঙ্গে<br />	গায় গীত অমৃত বর্ষণ ॥৪॥
svapne bahu dūre giyā	sindhu-taṭe praveśiyā<br />	dekhi gorāra apūrva nartana<br />gadādhara nāche saṅge	bhakta-gaṇa nāche raṅge<br />	gāya gīta amṛta varṣaṇa [4]
<span class="e2">svapne</span>–In a dream, <span class="e2">giyā</span>–I went <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">dūre</span>–a long way, <span class="e2">praveśiyā</span>–arrived <span class="e2">sindhu-taṭe</span>–at the shore of the ocean, [where] <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–I saw <span class="e2">gorāra</span>–Gorā’s <span class="e2">apūrva</span>–wonderful <span class="e2">nartana</span>–dancing. <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [Him]. <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–The devotees <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced <span class="e2">raṅge</span>–joyfully, [and] <span class="e2">gāya</span>–they sang <span class="e2">gīta</span>–songs [that were like] <span class="e2">amṛta</span> <span class="e2">varṣaṇa</span>–showers of nectar.
In a dream, I walked a long way and arrived at the shore of the ocean, where I saw Gorā’s wonderful dancing. Gadādhar and the devotees joyfully danced with Him, and they sang songs that were like showers of nectar.
নৃত্যগীত-অবসানে	গোরা মোর হাত টানে<br />	বলে, “তুমি ক্রোধে ছাড়ি’ গেলে ।<br />আমার কি দোষ বল	তব চিত্ত সুচঞ্চল<br />	ব্রজে গেলে আমা হেথা ফেলে ॥৫॥
nṛtya-gīta-avasāne	gorā mora hāta ṭāne<br />	bale, “tumi krodhe chhāḍi’ gele<br />āmāra ki doṣa bala	tava chitta suchañchala<br />	vraje gele āmā hethā phele [5]
<span class="e2">nṛtya-gīta-avasāne</span>–When they finished dancing and singing, <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">ṭāne</span>–pulled <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">hāta</span>–hand [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“tumi</span>–“You <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">gele</span>–left <span class="e2">krodhe</span>–in anger. <span class="e2">bala</span>–Tell [Me,] <span class="e2">ki</span>–what [was] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–fault? <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">chitta</span>–heart [is] <span class="e2">suchañchala</span>–so fickle: <span class="e2">phele</span>–you left <span class="e2">āmā</span>–Me <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here [and] <span class="e2">gele</span>–went <span class="e2">vraje</span>–to Vraja!
When they finished dancing and singing, Gorā took my hand and said, “You left in anger. Tell Me, what was My fault? Your heart is so fickle: you left Me here and went to Vraja!
আইস আলিঙ্গন করি	তব বক্ষে বক্ষ ধরি’<br />	ছাঁড়ো মুঞি চিত্তের বিকার ।<br />মধ্যাহ্নে করিয়া পাক	দেহ মোরে অন্ন শাক<br />	ক্ষুন্নিবৃত্তি হউক্ আমার ॥৬॥
āisa āliṅgana kari	tava vakṣe vakṣa dhari’<br />	chhā̐ḍo muñi chittera vikāra<br />madhyāhne kariyā pāka	deha more anna śāka<br />	kṣun-nivṛtti ha-uk āmāra [6]
<span class="e2">āisa</span>–Come! <span class="e2">āliṅgana</span> <span class="e2">kari</span>–I will embrace [you]. <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–Holding [My] <span class="e2">vakṣa</span>–chest <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">vakṣe</span>–to your chest, <span class="e2">muñi</span>–I <span class="e2">chhā̐ḍo</span>–will give up [My] <span class="e2">chittera</span> <span class="e2">vikāra</span>–anxiety. <span class="e2">pāka kariyā</span>–Cook <span class="e2">madhyāhne</span>–at midday [and] <span class="e2">deha</span>–give <span class="e2">more</span>–Me <span class="e2">anna</span>–some rice [and] <span class="e2">śāka</span>–spinach [so that] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">kṣun-nivṛtti</span> <span class="e2">ha-uk</span>–hunger will [also] be relieved.
“Come! Let Me embrace you, let Me hold your chest to Mine, then My anxiety will go away. Cook at midday and give Me some rice and spinach so that My hunger will also be relieved.
ছাড়িয়া জগদানন্দে	মোর মন নিরানন্দে<br />	ভোজনাদি লইল কত দিন ।<br />কি বুঝিয়া গেলে তুমি	দুঃখেতে পড়িনু আমি<br />	জগা মোরে সদা দয়াহীন ॥৭॥
chhāḍiyā jagadānande	mora mana nirānande<br />	bhojanādi la-ila kata dina<br />ki bujhiyā gele tumi	duḥkhete paḍinu āmi<br />	jagā more sadā dayā-hīna [7]
<span class="e2">jagadānande</span>–O Jagadānanda! <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–after [your] leaving, <span class="e2">bhojanādi</span> <span class="e2">la-ila</span>–I ate, slept, and so on, <span class="e2">kata</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–for many days [while] <span class="e2">mora</span>–My <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart [was] <span class="e2">nirānande</span>–unhappy. <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–With what understanding <span class="e2">tumi gele</span>–did you leave [Me]? <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">paḍinu</span>–slumped <span class="e2">duḥkhete</span>–in sadness: <span class="e2">jagā</span>–Jagā [is] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">dayā-hīna</span>–merciless <span class="e2">more</span>–to Me.
“O Jagadānanda, after you left, I ate and slept for many days with an unhappy heart. Why did you leave Me? I slumped into sadness: Jagā is always merciless to Me.
শীঘ্র ব্রজ নিরখিয়া	আইস তুমি সুখী হঞা<br />	মোরে দেহ শাকান্ন ব্যঞ্জন ।<br />তবে ত’ বাঁচিব আমি	তাতে সুখী হবে তুমি<br />	ক্রোধে মোরে না ছাড কখন” ॥৮॥
śīghra vraja nirakhiyā	āisa tumi sukhī hañā<br />	more deha śākānna vyañjana<br />tabe ta’ vā̐chiba āmi	tāte sukhī habe tumi<br />	krodhe more nā chhāḍa kakhana” [8]
<span class="e2">śīghra</span>–Quickly <span class="e2">nirakhiyā</span>–see <span class="e2">vraja</span>–Vraja, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">āisa</span>–come back <span class="e2">sukhī</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–feeling happy, [and] <span class="e2">deha</span>–offer <span class="e2">more</span>–Me <span class="e2">śākānna</span>–some rice, spinach, [and] <span class="e2">vyañjana</span>–vegetables. <span class="e2">tabe</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–Then <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">vā̐chiba</span>–will live, [and] <span class="e2">tāte</span>–thereby <span class="e2">sukhī</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–you will [also] be happy. <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">kakhana chhāḍa nā</span>–Never leave <span class="e2">more</span>–Me <span class="e2">krodhe”</span>–out of anger.”
“Quickly see Vraja, come back happy, and offer Me some rice, spinach, and vegetables. Then I will be able to live, and you will also be happy. Never leave Me out of anger again.”
নিদ্রা ভাঙ্গি’ দেখি আমি	বহুদূর ব্রজভূমি<br />	নিকটেতে জাহ্নবীপুলিনে ।<br />আহা! নবদ্বীপধাম	নিত্যগৌরলীলাগ্রাম<br />	ব্রজসার অতি সমীচীন ॥৯॥
nidrā bhāṅgi’ dekhi āmi	bahu-dūra vraja-bhūmi<br />	nikaṭete jāhnavī-puline<br />āhā! navadvīpa-dhāma	nitya-gaura-līlā-grāma<br />	vraja-sāra ati samīchīna [9]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">nidrā</span> <span class="e2">bhāṅgi’</span>–suddenly awoke [and] <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–saw [that I was] <span class="e2">nikaṭete</span>–near <span class="e2">jāhnavī-puline</span>–the bank of the Ganges, <span class="e2">bahu-dūra</span>–far away <span class="e2">vraja-bhūmi</span>–from the land of Vraja. <span class="e2">āhā!</span>–Oh! <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–Nabadwīp Dhām! <span class="e2">nitya-gaura-līlā-grāma</span>–The eternal abode of Gaura’s Pastimes! <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">samīchīna</span>–The perfect <span class="e2">vraja-sāra</span>–essence of Vraja!
I suddenly awoke and saw that I was on the bank of the Ganges, far away from the land of Vraja. Oh! Nabadwīp Dhām! The eternal abode of Gaura’s Pastimes! The perfect essence of Vraja!
আনন্দেতে মায়াপুরে	প্রবেশিনু অন্তঃপুরে<br />	নমি আমি আইমাতা-পদ ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গের কথা বলি’	শীঘ্র আইলাম চলি’<br />	দেখি নবদ্বীপ-সুসম্পদ ॥১০॥
ānandete māyāpure	praveśinu antaḥpure<br />	nami āmi āi-mātā-pada<br />gaurāṅgera kathā bali’	śīghra āilāma chali’<br />	dekhi navadvīpa-susampada [10]
<span class="e2">ānandete</span>–Overjoyed [to be] <span class="e2">māyāpure</span>–in Māyāpur, <span class="e2">praveśinu</span>–I entered <span class="e2">antaḥpure</span>–the inner apartment [of the Lord’s house and] <span class="e2">nami</span>–bowed <span class="e2">āi-mātā-pada</span>–at the feet of Mother Śachī. <span class="e2">bali’</span>–I spoke <span class="e2">gaurāṅgera kathā</span>–Gaurāṅga’s message, <span class="e2">śīghra</span>–quickly <span class="e2">chali’ āilāma</span>–came out, [and] <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–saw <span class="e2">navadvīpa-susampada</span>–the divine opulence of Nabadwīp.
Overjoyed to be in Māyāpur, I entered the inner apartment of the Lord’s house and bowed at the feet of Mother Āi. I explained what Gaurāṅga had told me, quickly came out, and saw the divine opulence of Nabadwīp.
ভাবিলাম বৃন্দাবন	করিলাম দরশন<br />	আর কেন যাউ দূর দেশ ।<br />গৌর দরশন করি’	সব দুঃখ পরিহরি’<br />	ছাড়ি’ দিব বিরহজ-ক্লেশ ॥১১॥
bhāvilāma vṛndāvana	karilāma daraśana<br />	āra kena yāu dūra deśa<br />gaura daraśana kari’	saba duḥkha parihari’<br />	chhāḍi’ diba virahaja-kleśa [11]
<span class="e2">bhāvilāma</span>–I felt [that] <span class="e2">daraśana karilāma</span>–I had seen <span class="e2">vṛndāvana</span>–Vṛndāvan, [so] <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">kena</span>–why again <span class="e2">yāu</span>–should I go <span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">deśa</span>–to that faraway land? <span class="e2">daraśana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–I will meet <span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaura, <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–give up <span class="e2">saba</span>–all [my] <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–sadness, [and] <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span> <span class="e2">diba</span>–leave behind <span class="e2">virahaja-kleśa</span>–the sorrow produced by separation.
I felt that I had already seen Vṛndāvan, so why should I now go to that faraway land? Instead, I will go to meet Gaura, give up all my sadness, and leave behind the sorrow of separation.

Chapter Fifteen
শ্রীনবদ্বীপে পূর্বাহ্ন-লীলা
Śrī-Navadvīpe Pūrvāhna-līlā
Morning Pastimes in Nabadwīp
যখন যাহা মনে পড়ে গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত ।<br />তাহা লিখি, হইলেও ক্রম-বিপরীত ॥১॥
yakhana yāhā mane paḍe gaurāṅga-charita<br />tāhā likhi, ha-ileo krama-viparīta [1]
<span class="e2">yakhana</span>–Whenever <span class="e2">yāhā tāhā</span>–anything <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-charita</span>–about Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–comes <span class="e2">mane</span>–to mind, <span class="e2">likhi</span>–I write [it] down, <span class="e2">ha-ileo</span>–even if it is <span class="e2">krama-viparīta</span>–out of sequence.
I write whatever comes to my mind about Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes, whenever it does, even if it is out of sequence.
গৌরাঙ্গ-প্রসাদ
gaurāṅga-prasāda
Gaurāṅga’s prasād
শচী আই একদিন বড় যত্ন করি’ ।<br />গোরা-অবশিষ্ট-পাত্র মোরে দিল ধরি’ ॥২॥
śachī āi eka-dina baḍa yatna kari’<br />gorā-avaśiṣṭa-pātra more dila dhari’ [2]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">śachī</span> <span class="e2">āi</span>–Mother Śachī <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">yatna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–very affectionately <span class="e2">dhari’ dila</span>–gave <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">gorā-avaśiṣṭa-pātra</span>–the plate with the remnants of Gorā’s meal.
One day, Mother Śachī very affectionately gave me the plate of Gorā’s remnants.
আমি খাইলাম যেন অমৃতাস্বাদন ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গ-প্রসাদ পাঞা আহ্লাদিত মন ॥৩॥
āmi khāilāma yena amṛtāsvādana<br />gaurāṅga-prasāda pāñā āhlādita mana [3]
[My] <span class="e2">āhlādita</span> <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart was delighted <span class="e2">pāñā</span>–by receiving <span class="e2">gaurāṅga-prasāda</span>–Gaurāṅga’s remnants, [and when] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">khāilāma</span>–ate [it, it was] <span class="e2">yena</span>–like <span class="e2">amṛtāsvādana</span>–the taste of nectar.
I was delighted to receive Gaurāṅga’s prasād, and as I ate it, I felt as though I was tasting nectar.
কভু কি করিব আমি সে ভূরি ভোজন ।<br />আবোনা অচ্যুত শাক, আইয়ের রন্ধন ॥৪॥
মোচাঘণ্ট, কচুশাক তাহে ফুলবড়ি ।<br />মানচাকি, নিম্বপটোল, আর দধিবড়ি ॥৫॥
kabhu ki kariba āmi se bhūri bhojana<br />ābonā achyuta śāka, āiyera randhana [4]
mochā ghaṇṭa, kachu-śāka tāhe phula-baḍi<br />mānachāki, nimba-paṭola, āra dadhi-baḍi [5]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">āmi kariba</span>–Will I ever eat <span class="e2">se</span>–such <span class="e2">bhūri</span>–delicious <span class="e2">bhojana</span>–food [again]? <span class="e2">āiyera</span>–Śachī’s <span class="e2">randhana</span>–cooking [consisted of] <span class="e2">ābonā</span> <span class="e2">achyuta</span> <span class="e2">śāka</span>–wild spinach, <span class="e2">mochā</span> <span class="e2">ghaṇṭa</span>–banana flower, <span class="e2">kachu-śāka</span> <span class="e2">tāhe</span> <span class="e2">phula-baḍi</span>–taro with balls of fried dal, <span class="e2">mānachāki</span>–ground taro, <span class="e2">nimba-paṭola</span>–paṭol with neem, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">dadhi-baḍi</span>–balls of fried dal in yoghurt.
Will I ever eat such delicious food again? Mother Śachī made wild spinach, banana flower, taro with balls of fried dal, ground taro, paṭol with neem leaves, and patties of fried dal in yoghurt.
গাদিগাছা গ্রামে গমন
gādigāchhā grāme gamana
Visiting the village of Gādigāchhā
ভোজনে আনন্দমতি	চলিলাম হংসগতি<br />	নিতাই-গৌরাঙ্গগণ-সঙ্গে ।<br />গঙ্গাতীরে তীরে যাই 	গাদিগাছা গ্রাম পাই<br />	হরিনাম-গানের প্রসঙ্গে ॥৬॥
bhojane ānanda-mati	chalilāma haṁsa-gati<br />	nitāi-gaurāṅga-gaṇa-saṅge<br />gaṅgā-tīre tīre yāi	gādigāchhā grāma pāi<br />	hari-nāma-gānera prasaṅge [6]
<span class="e2">ānanda-mati</span>–Joyful <span class="e2">bhojane</span>–after eating, <span class="e2">chalilāma</span>–I walked, <span class="e2">haṁsa-gati</span>–moving like a swan, <span class="e2">nitāi-gaurāṅga-gaṇa-saṅge</span>–in the company of Nitāi, Gaurāṅga, and Their associates. <span class="e2">yāi</span>–We walked <span class="e2">gaṅgā-tīre</span> <span class="e2">tīre</span>–along the banks of the Ganges <span class="e2">hari-nāma-gānera</span> <span class="e2">prasaṅge</span>–engaged in chanting the Lord’s Name [and] <span class="e2">pāi</span>–arrived <span class="e2">gādigāchhā</span> <span class="e2">grāma</span>–in the village of Gādigāchhā.
Joyful after eating, I walked like a swan in the company of Nitāi, Gaurāṅga, and Their associates. Walking along the banks of the Ganges and chanting the Lord’s Name, we arrived in the village of Gādigāchhā.
গোবিন্দ মৃদঙ্গ বায়	বাসুঘোষ নাম গায়<br />	নাচে গদাধর বক্রেশ্বর ।<br />হরিবোল রব শুনি’	চারিদিকে হুলুধ্বনি<br />	গোরাপ্রেমে সবে মাতোয়ার ॥৭॥
govinda mṛdaṅga vāya	vāsu-ghoṣa nāma gāya<br />	nāche gadādhara vakreśvara<br />haribola rava śuni’	chāri-dike hulu-dhvani<br />	gorā-preme sabe mātoyāra [7]
<span class="e2">govinda</span>–Govinda <span class="e2">vāya</span>–played <span class="e2">mṛdaṅga</span>–the drum, <span class="e2">vāsu-ghoṣa</span>–Vāsudev Ghoṣ <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chanted <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name, [and] <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar [and] <span class="e2">vakreśvara</span>–Vakreśvar <span class="e2">nāche</span>–danced. <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">rava</span>–the sound <span class="e2">haribola</span>–of ‘Haribol!’ [and] <span class="e2">hulu-dhvani</span>–cheering <span class="e2">chāri-dike</span>–in the four directions, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">mātoyāra</span>–become mad <span class="e2">gorā-preme</span>–with love for Gorā.
Govinda Ghoṣ played mṛdaṅga, Vāsudev Ghoṣ chanted the Name, and Gadādhar and Vakreśvar danced. Hearing the sound of ‘Haribol!’ and cheering in all directions, everyone became mad with love for Gorā.
নাচ গান নাহি জানি	তবু নাচি ঊর্ধ্বপাণি<br />	গৌরাঙ্গ নাচায় অঙ্গে পশি’ ।<br />সুরতালবোধ নাই	তবু নাচি, তবু গাই<br />	কি জানি কি জানে গৌরশশী ॥৮॥
nācha gāna nāhi jāni	tabu nāchi ūrdhva-pāṇi<br />	gaurāṅga nāchāya aṅge paśi’<br />sura-tāla-bodha nāi	tabu nāchi, tabu gāi<br />	ki jāni ki jāne gaura-śaśī [8]
<span class="e2">jāni nāhi</span>–I do not know [how to] <span class="e2">nācha</span>–dance [or] <span class="e2">gāna</span>–sing. <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">nāchi</span>–I dance— <span class="e2">ūrdhva-pāṇi</span>–with upraised arms! <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">paśi’</span>–enters [my] <span class="e2">aṅge</span>–body [and] <span class="e2">nāchāya</span>–makes me dance. <span class="e2">sura-tāla-bodha</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–I do not have a sense of rhythm or tune. <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">nāchi</span>–I dance! <span class="e2">tabu</span>–Still, <span class="e2">gāi</span>–I sing! <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">jāni</span>–I do not know <span class="e2">ki</span>–what [my] <span class="e2">gaura-śaśī</span>–moon-like Gaura <span class="e2">jāne</span>–thinks.
I do not know how to dance or sing. Still, I dance—with my arms upraised! Gaurāṅga enters my body and makes me do so. I do not have any sense of rhythm or tune. Still, I dance! Still, I sing! I do not know what my moon-like Gaura thinks.
তথায় গোপগণের সেবা
tathāya gopa-gaṇera sevā
The cowherd boys’ service there
গাদিগাছা গ্রামে আসি’	গোপপল্লী মাঝে পশি’<br />	গোরা বলে “শুন ভক্তগণ <br />দহকূলে বিচরণ	আজি মোদের বিচরণ<br />	বৃক্ষমূলে করিব শয়ন ॥৯॥
gādigāchhā grāme āsi’	gopa-pallī mājhe paśi’<br />	gorā bale, “śuna bhakta-gaṇa<br />daha-kūle vicharaṇa	āji modera vicharaṇa<br />	vṛkṣa-mūle kariba śayana [9]
<span class="e2">āsi’</span>–We came <span class="e2">gādigāchhā</span> <span class="e2">grāme</span>–to the village of Gādigāchhā [and] <span class="e2">paśi’</span>–entered <span class="e2">gopa-pallī</span> <span class="e2">mājhe</span>–a neighbourhood of cowherds. <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bhakta-gaṇa</span>–“Devotees, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">āji</span>–Today <span class="e2">modera</span> <span class="e2">vicharaṇa</span>–our walk [will be] <span class="e2">vicharaṇa</span>–a walk <span class="e2">daha-kūle</span>–around the bank of this lake. <span class="e2">śayana kariba</span>–We will rest <span class="e2">vṛkṣa-mūle</span>–at the base of this tree.
We came to the village of Gādigāchhā and entered a neighbourhood of cowherds. Gorā said, “Devotees, listen! Today we will walk around the bank of this lake, and then we will rest under this tree.
এই বটবৃক্ষতলে	গাভী আছে কুতূহলে<br />	গোপ-সহ করিব বিহার” ।<br />বহু গোপগণ আইল	দধি, ছানা, ননী দিল<br />	পথশ্রম না রহিল আর ॥১০॥
ei vaṭa-vṛkṣa-tale	gābhī āchhe kutūhale<br />	gopa-saha kariba vihāra”<br />bahu gopa-gaṇa āila	dadhi, chhānā, nanī dila<br />	patha-śrama nā rahila āra [10]
<span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There are <span class="e2">kutūhale</span>–happy <span class="e2">gābhī</span>–cows <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">vaṭa-vṛkṣa-tale</span>–under this banyan tree. <span class="e2">vihāra kariba</span>–Let us play <span class="e2">gopa-saha”</span>–with the cowherd boys!” <span class="e2">bahu</span>–Many <span class="e2">gopa-gaṇa</span>–cowherds <span class="e2">āila</span>–came [over and] <span class="e2">dila</span>–offered <span class="e2">dadhi</span>–yoghurt, <span class="e2">chhānā</span>–curd, [and] <span class="e2">nanī</span>–butter. [Our] <span class="e2">patha-śrama</span>–tiredness from the path <span class="e2">āra rahila nā</span>–remained no longer.
“There are happy cows under this banyan tree. Let us go and play with the cowherd boys!” Many cowherd boys then came over and offered us yoghurt, curd, and butter, and our tiredness from walking was gone.
নৃসিংহানন্দের সঙ্গে	প্রদ্যুম্ন আইল রঙ্গে<br />	পুরুষোত্তমাচার্য মিলিল ।<br />মৃদঙ্গের বাদ্যরবে	গৃহ ছাড়ি’ আইল সবে<br />	হরিধ্বনি গগনে উঠিল ॥১১॥
nṛsiṁhānandera saṅge	pradyumna āila raṅge<br />	puruṣottamāchārya milila<br />mṛdaṅgera vādya-rave	gṛha chhāḍi’ āila sabe<br />	hari-dhvani gagane uṭhila [11]
<span class="e2">pradyumna</span>–Pradyumna <span class="e2">raṅge</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">āila</span>–came over <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with <span class="e2">nṛsiṁhānandera</span>–Nṛsiṁhānanda, [and] <span class="e2">puruṣottamāchārya</span>–Puruṣottam Āchārya (Svarūp Dāmodar) <span class="e2">milila</span>–joined [us]. <span class="e2">vādya-rave</span>–At the sound <span class="e2">mṛdaṅgera</span>–of the mṛdaṅga, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–left [their] <span class="e2">gṛha</span>–homes [and] <span class="e2">āila</span>–came over. <span class="e2">hari-dhvani</span>–The sound of ‘Hari’ <span class="e2">uṭhila</span>–arose <span class="e2">gagane</span>–in the sky.
Pradyumna joyfully came over with Nṛsiṁhānanda, and Puruṣottam Āchārya joined us there. Hearing the sound of the mṛdaṅga, everyone left their homes and came over, and the sound of ‘Hari’ resounded in the sky.
ভীম গোপ
bhīma gopa
The cowherd boy Bhīma
ভীম-নামে গোপ এক পরম উদার ।<br />অগ্রসর হঞা বলে, “শুনহ গোহার ॥১২॥
bhīma-nāme gopa eka parama udāra<br />agrasara hañā bale, “śunaha gohāra [12]
<span class="e2">eka</span>–A <span class="e2">parama</span>–very <span class="e2">udāra</span>–cordial <span class="e2">gopa</span>–cowherd <span class="e2">bhīma-nāme</span>–with the name Bhīma <span class="e2">agrasara</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–came forward [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“gohāra</span>–“Dear sir, <span class="e2">śunaha</span>–please listen.
A very cordial cowherd boy named Bhīma came forward and said, “Dear sir, please listen.
আমার জননী শ্যামা গোয়ালিনী ধন্যা ।<br />গঙ্গানগরের সাধু গোয়ালার কন্যা ॥১৩॥
āmāra jananī śyāmā goyālinī dhanyā<br />gaṅgā-nagarera sādhu goyālāra kanyā [13]
<span class="e2">āmāra</span>–My <span class="e2">jananī</span>–mother <span class="e2">śyāmā</span>–Śyāmā [is] <span class="e2">dhanyā goyālinī</span>–a pious milkmaid [and] <span class="e2">kanyā</span>–a daughter <span class="e2">sādhu</span> <span class="e2">goyālāra</span>–of a virtuous milkman <span class="e2">gaṅgā-nagarera</span>–from Gaṅgā Nagar. 
“My mother Śyāmā is a pious milkmaid and a daughter of a virtuous milkman from Gaṅgā Nagar.
শচী আইকে মা বলিয়া সদা করে সেবা ।<br />সে সম্পর্কে তুমি আমার মাতুল হইবা ॥১৪॥
śachī āike mā baliyā sadā kare sevā<br />se samparke tumi āmāra mātula ha-ibā [14]
<span class="e2">baliyā</span>–She calls <span class="e2">śachī</span> <span class="e2">āike</span>–Śachī Āi <span class="e2">mā</span>–‘Mother’ [and] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sevā kare</span>–serves [her.] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">samparke</span>–According to this relationship, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">ha-ibā</span>–would be <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">mātula</span>–maternal uncle.
“She calls Śachī Āi ‘Mother’ and always serves her. So, You are my uncle.
চল মামা মোর ঘরে চল দল লঞা ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণকীর্ত্তন কর আনন্দিত হঞা ॥১৫॥
chala māmā mora ghare chala dala lañā<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtana kara ānandita hañā [15]
<span class="e2">māmā</span>–Dear Uncle, <span class="e2">chala</span>–let’s go <span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">ghare</span>–to my house! <span class="e2">chala</span>–Let’s go <span class="e2">lañā</span>–with [Your] <span class="e2">dala</span>–party [and] <span class="e2">ānandita</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–happily <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–chant the Name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
“Dear Uncle, let’s go to my house! Come with Your party and happily chant the Name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
দধি-দুগ্ধ যাহা কিছু রাখিয়াছে মা ।<br />সব খাওয়াইব আর টীপে দিব পা” ॥১৬॥
dadhi-dugdha yāhā kichhu rākhiyāchhe mā<br />saba khāoyāiba āra ṭīpe diba pā” [16]
<span class="e2">khāoyāiba</span>–I will feed [You] <span class="e2">yāhā kichhu saba</span>–all <span class="e2">dadhi-dugdha</span>–the yoghurt and milk [my] <span class="e2">mā</span>–mother <span class="e2">rākhiyāchhe</span>–has stored <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">ṭīpe</span> <span class="e2">diba</span>–massage [Your] <span class="e2">pā”</span>–feet.”
“I will feed You all the yoghurt and milk my mother has in store and massage Your feet.”
গৌরাঙ্গের ভীমের গৃহে গমন ও ক্ষীর-ভোজন
gaurāṅgera bhīmera gṛhe gamana o kṣīra bhojana
Gaurāṅga’s visiting Bhīma’s house and eating condensed milk
নাছোড় হইয়া যবে সকলে ধরিল ।<br />গোপপ্রেমে গোরা গোপগৃহেতে চলিল ॥১৭॥
nāchhoḍa ha-iyā yabe sakale dharila<br />gopa-preme gorā gopa-gṛhete chalila [17]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">nāchhoḍa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Bhīma became insistent [and] <span class="e2">dharila</span>–requested [this] <span class="e2">sakale</span>–of everyone, <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">chalila</span>–went <span class="e2">gopa-gṛhete</span>–to the cowherd’s house <span class="e2">gopa-preme</span>–out of love for the cowherd boys.
When Bhīma became insistent and requested this of everyone, Gorā went to his home out of love for the cowherd boys.
শ্যামা গোয়ালিনী তবে উলুধ্বনি দিয়া ।<br />সকলকে গোয়াল-ঘরে দিলে বসাইয়া ॥১৮॥
śyāmā goyālinī tabe ulu-dhvani diyā<br />sakalake goyāla-ghare dile basāiyā [18]
<span class="e2">śyāmā</span> <span class="e2">goyālinī</span>–The milkmaid Śyāmā <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">ulu-dhvani</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–cheered [and] <span class="e2">sakalake basāiyā dile</span>–seated everyone down <span class="e2">goyāla-ghare</span>–in [her] cowshed.
The milkmaid Śyāmā cheered and seated everyone in her cowshed.
শ্যামা বলে, “পণ্ডিত দাদা, কেমন আছেন মা?”<br />“ভাল ভাল” বলি’ গোরা নাচাইল গা ॥১৯॥

<span class="e2">śyāmā</span>–Śyāmā <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“paṇḍita</span> <span class="e2">dādā</span>–“Learned elder brother, <span class="e2">kemana</span>–how <span class="e2">āchhena</span>–is <span class="e2">mā?”</span>–Mother?” <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">bali’</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bhāla</span>–[She is] well,<span class="e2"> bhāla</span>–[She is] well,” [and] <span class="e2">gā</span> <span class="e2">nāchāila</span>–caused [His] body to dance.
Śyāmā said, “Learned elder brother, how is Mother?” Gorā replied, “She is well, she is well”, and began to dance.
কলাপাতা পাতি’ শ্যামা দেয় দধি-ক্ষীর ।<br />ভক্তগণ লঞা নিমাই ভোজনে বসে ধীর ॥২০॥
kalā-pātā pāti’ śyāmā deya dadhi-kṣīra<br />bhakta-gaṇa lañā nimāi bhojane base dhīra [20]
<span class="e2">śyāmā</span>–Śyāmā <span class="e2">pāti’</span>–laid out <span class="e2">kalā-pātā</span>–banana leaves [and] <span class="e2">dadhi-kṣīra deya</span>–served yoghurt and condensed milk. <span class="e2">nimāi</span>–Nimāi, <span class="e2">lañā</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–the devotees, <span class="e2">dhīra</span>–respectfully <span class="e2">base</span>–sat down <span class="e2">bhojane</span>–to eat.
Śyāmā laid out banana leaves and served yoghurt and condensed milk. Nimāi and the devotees respectfully sat down to eat.
গোরাদহ
gorā-daha
Gorā’s lake
ভোজন সমাপি’ চলে সেই দহের তীরে ।<br />হরিগুণগান সবে করে ধীরে ধীরে ॥২১॥
bhojana samāpi’ chale sei dahera tīre<br />hari-guṇa-gāna sabe kare dhīre dhīre [21]
[After] <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone<span class="e2"> samāpi’</span>–finished <span class="e2">bhojana</span>–eating, [they] <span class="e2">dhīre</span> <span class="e2">dhīre</span>–slowly <span class="e2">chale</span>–went <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">dahera</span> <span class="e2">tīre</span>–to the edge of the lake, <span class="e2">hari-guṇa-gāna</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–chanting the glories of the Lord.
After everyone finished eating, they strolled over to the edge of the lake, chanting the glories of the Lord.
রামদাস গোপ আসি’ করে নিবেদন ।<br />“দহের জল পান নাহি করে গাভীগণ ॥২২॥
rāmadāsa gopa āsi’ kare nivedana<br />“dahera jala pāna nāhi kare gābhī-gaṇa [22]
