<span class="e2">gopa</span>–The cowherd boy <span class="e2">rāmadāsa</span>–Rāmadās <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–came over [and] <span class="e2">nivedana kare</span>–said, <span class="e2">“gābhī-gaṇa</span>–“[Our] cows <span class="e2">pāna</span> <span class="e2">kare nāhi</span>–do not drink <span class="e2">jala</span>–water <span class="e2">dahera</span>–from this lake.
A cowherd boy named Rāmadās came over and said, “Our cows do not drink water from this lake.
দহে নক্র
dahe nakra
The crocodile in the lake
নক্র এক ভয়ঙ্কর বেড়ায় দহের জলে ।<br />জল না খাইয়া গাভী ডাকে হাম্বা বোল” ॥২৩॥
nakra eka bhayaṅkara beḍāya dahera jale<br />jala nā khāiyā gābhī ḍāke hāmbā bola” [23]
<span class="e2">eka</span>–A <span class="e2">bhayaṅkara</span>–fearsome <span class="e2">nakra</span>–crocodile <span class="e2">beḍāya</span>–comes out <span class="e2">dahera</span> <span class="e2">jale</span>–of this lake’s waters, [and our] <span class="e2">gābhī</span>–cows, <span class="e2">khāiyā nā</span>–not drinking <span class="e2">jala</span>–the water, <span class="e2">hāmbā</span> <span class="e2">bola ḍāke”</span>–moo.”
“A fearsome crocodile comes out of this lake, and our cows moo because they cannot drink the water.”
তাহা শুনি’ গোরা করে শ্রীনামকীর্ত্তন ।<br />কীর্ত্তনে আকৃষ্ট হইল নক্র তত ক্ষণ ॥২৪॥
tāhā śuni’ gorā kare śrī-nāma-kīrtana<br />kīrtane ākṛṣṭa ha-ila nakra tata kṣaṇa [24]
[When] <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–He heard <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–this, <span class="e2">gorā</span>–Gorā <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-kīrtana kare</span>–chanted the Name, [and] <span class="e2">nakra</span>–the crocodile <span class="e2">tata</span> <span class="e2">kṣaṇa</span>–immediately <span class="e2">ākṛṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became attracted <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–to the chanting.
When Gorā heard this, He chanted the Name, and the crocodile immediately became attracted to the chanting.
নক্র নহে, দেব শিশু
nakra nahe, deva śiśu
Not a crocodile but a child god
শীঘ্র করি’ উঠিয়া আইল গোরা-পায় ।<br />পদস্পর্শে দেবশিশু পরিদৃশ্য হয় ॥২৫॥
śīghra kari’ uṭhiyā āila gorā-pāya<br />pada-sparśe deva-śiśu paridṛśya haya [25]
<span class="e2">śīghra</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–The crocodile quickly <span class="e2">uṭhiyā</span>–got out [of the water and] <span class="e2">āila</span>–came [over] <span class="e2">gorā-pāya</span>–to Gorā’s feet. <span class="e2">pada-sparśe</span>–Upon touching [His] feet, <span class="e2">paridṛśya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–the crocodile turned [into] <span class="e2">deva-śiśu</span>–a child god.
The crocodile quickly got out of the water and came over to Gorā’s feet. Upon touching them, the crocodile turned into a child god.
কাঁদি’ সেই দেবশিশু করেন স্তবন ।<br />নিজ দুঃখকথা বলে আর করয় রোদন ॥২৬॥
kā̐di’ sei deva-śiśu karena stavana<br />nija duḥkha-kathā bale āra karaya rodana [26]
<span class="e2">kā̐di’</span>–Crying, <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">deva-śiśu</span>–the child god <span class="e2">stavana karena</span>–prayed [to the Lord]. <span class="e2">bale</span>–He told [the Lord] <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">duḥkha-kathā</span>–the tale of his sorrow <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">rodana karaya</span>–wept.
Crying, the child god prayed to the Lord. He recounted the tale of his sorrow and wept.
নক্ররূপী দেব শিশুর পূর্ব্ব-বিবরণ
nakra-rūpī deva-śiśura pūrva-vivaraṇa
The child god describes his past in the body of a crocodile
দেবশিশু বলে, “প্রভু দুর্ব্বাসার শাপে ।<br />নক্ররূপে ভ্রমি আমি, সর্ব্বলোক কাঁপে ॥২৭॥
deva-śiśu bale, “prabhu durvāsāra śāpe<br />nakra-rūpe bhrami āmi, sarva-loka kā̐pe [27]
<span class="e2">deva-śiśu</span>–The child god <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“prabhu</span>–“O Lord! <span class="e2">durvāsāra</span> <span class="e2">śāpe</span>–As a result of a curse by Durvāsā Muni, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">bhrami</span>–have been wandering <span class="e2">nakra-rūpe</span>–in the form of a crocodile, [and] <span class="e2">sarva-loka</span>–everyone <span class="e2">kā̐pe</span>–trembles.
The child god said, “O Lord! Cursed by Durvāsā Muni, I have been wandering in the form of a crocodile, making everyone tremble.
কাম্যবনে মুনিবর শুতিয়া আছিল ।<br />চঞ্চলতা করি’ তার জটা কাটি নিল ॥২৮॥
kāmyavane muni-vara śutiyā āchhila<br />chañchalatā kari’ tāra jaṭā kāṭi nila [28]
[Once, when] <span class="e2">muni-vara</span>–the great sage <span class="e2">śutiyā</span> <span class="e2">āchhila</span>–was resting <span class="e2">kāmyavane</span>–in Kāmyavan, <span class="e2">chañchalatā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–I mischievously <span class="e2">kāṭi</span> <span class="e2">nila</span>–cut off <span class="e2">tāra</span>–his <span class="e2">jaṭā</span>–dreadlocks.
“Once, when the great sage was resting in Kāmyavan, I mischievously cut off his dreadlocks.
ক্রোধে মুনি কহে, ‘তুমি পাঞা নক্ররূপ ।<br />চারি যুগ থাক কর্ম্মফল-অনুরূপ’ ॥২৯॥
krodhe muni kahe, ‘tumi pāñā nakra-rūpa<br />chāri yuga thāka karma-phala-anurūpa’ [29]
<span class="e2">muni</span>–The sage <span class="e2">kahe</span>–said <span class="e2">krodhe</span>–angrily, <span class="e2">‘tumi</span> <span class="e2">pāñā</span>–‘Take <span class="e2">nakra-rūpa</span>–the form of a crocodile [and] <span class="e2">karma-phala-anurūpa thāka</span>–undergo the befitting results of [your] actions <span class="e2">chāri</span> <span class="e2">yuga’</span>–for four ages.’
“The sage angrily said, ‘Take the form of a crocodile and suffer the results of your actions for four ages.’
তবে কাঁদিলাম আমি মিনতি করিয়া ।<br />দয়া করি’ মুনি মোরে কহিল ডাকিয়া ॥৩০॥
tabe kā̐dilāma āmi minati kariyā<br />dayā kari’ muni more kahila ḍākiyā [30]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">kā̐dilāma</span>–cried [and] <span class="e2">minati</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–prayed [to the sage, and] <span class="e2">muni</span>–the sage <span class="e2">dayā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–graciously <span class="e2">ḍākiyā</span>–called <span class="e2">more</span>–for me [and] <span class="e2">kahila</span>–spoke [to me].
“I cried and prayed to the sage, and he graciously called me over and spoke to me.
‘ওরে দেবশিশু যবে শ্রীনন্দনন্দন ।<br />নবদ্বীপে হইবেন শচীপ্রাণধন ॥৩১॥
তাঁহার কীর্ত্তনে তোমার শাপ-ক্ষয় হবে ।<br />দিব্য দেহ পেয়ে তবে ত্রিপিষ্টপ যাবে’ ॥৩২॥
‘ore deva-śiśu yabe śrī-nanda-nandana<br />navadvīpe ha-ibena śachī-prāṇa-dhana [31]
tā̐hāra kīrtane tomāra śāpa-kṣaya habe<br />divya deha peye tabe tripiṣṭapa yābe’ [32]
<span class="e2">‘ore</span>–‘O <span class="e2">deva-śiśu</span>–child god! <span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">śrī-nanda-nandana</span>–the son of Śrī Nanda <span class="e2">ha-ibena</span>–becomes <span class="e2">śachī-prāṇa-dhana</span>–the life and wealth of Śachī <span class="e2">navadvīpe</span>–in Nabadwīp, <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">śāpa-kṣaya</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–you will be freed from [my] curse <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–by His chanting; <span class="e2">peye</span>–you will get <span class="e2">divya</span> <span class="e2">deha</span>–a heavenly body [again and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">yābe</span>–return <span class="e2">tripiṣṭapa’</span>–to the abode of the gods.’
“‘O child god! When the son of Śrī Nanda becomes the life and wealth of Śachī in Nabadwīp, you will be freed from my curse by His chanting; you will get a heavenly body again and return to the abode of the gods.’
দেবশিশুর স্তব
deva-śiśura stava
The child god’s prayers
জয় জয় শচীসুত পতিতপাবন ।<br />দীনহীন অগতির গতি মহাজন ॥৩৩॥
jaya jaya śachī-suta patita-pāvana<br />dīna-hīna agatira gati mahājana [33]
<span class="e2">jaya</span>–Glory! <span class="e2">jaya</span>–Glory <span class="e2">śachī-suta</span>–to the son of Śachī, <span class="e2">patita-pāvana</span>–the saviour of the fallen, <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–the Supreme Soul, <span class="e2">gati</span>–the shelter <span class="e2">dīna-hīna</span> <span class="e2">agatira</span>–of the humble, lowly, and shelterless!
“Glory to the son of Śachī, the saviour of the fallen, the Supreme Soul, the shelter of the humble, lowly, and shelterless!
চৌদ্দ ভুবনে ঘোষে সুকীর্ত্তি তোমার ।<br />আমা হেন অধমেরে করিলে উদ্ধার ॥৩৪॥
chaudda bhuvane ghoṣe sukīrti tomāra<br />āmā hena adhamere karile uddhāra [34]
<span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">sukīrti</span>–glories <span class="e2">ghoṣe</span>–resound <span class="e2">chaudda</span> <span class="e2">bhuvane</span>–throughout the fourteen worlds! <span class="e2">uddhāra karile</span>–You have saved <span class="e2">āmā</span> <span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">adhamere</span>–a soul as fallen as myself!
“Your glories resound throughout the fourteen worlds! You have saved a soul as fallen as myself!
এই নবদ্বীপধাম সর্ব্বধামসার ।<br />এখানে হইলে কলি-পাবনাবতার ॥৩৫॥
ei navadvīpa-dhāma sarva-dhāma-sāra<br />ekhāne ha-ile kali-pāvanāvatāra [35]
<span class="e2">āvatāra ha-ile</span>–You have descended <span class="e2">ekhāne</span>–here, <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">navadvīpa-dhāma</span>–in Nabadwīp Dhām, <span class="e2">sarva-dhāma-sāra</span>–the best of all abodes, <span class="e2">kali-pāvana</span>–as the saviour for the Age of Kali.
“You have descended here, in Nabadwīp Dhām, the best of all abodes, as the saviour for the Age of Kali.
কলিজীব উদ্ধারিবে দিয়া হরিনাম ।<br />আসিয়াছ, মহাপ্রভু তোমাকে প্রণাম ॥৩৬॥
kali-jīva uddhāribe diyā hari-nāma<br />āsiyāchha, mahāprabhu tomāke praṇāma [36]
<span class="e2">uddhāribe</span>–You will deliver <span class="e2">kali-jīva</span>–the souls of Kali-yuga <span class="e2">diyā</span>–by giving <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord. <span class="e2">āsiyāchha</span>–You have come, <span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–O Mahāprabhu! <span class="e2">praṇāma</span>–I bow <span class="e2">tomāke</span>–to You.
“You will deliver the souls of Kali-yuga by giving the Name of the Lord. You have come, O Mahāprabhu! I bow to You.
চারি যুগ আছি আমি নক্ররূপ ধরি’ ।<br />এবে উদ্ধারিলে তুমি পতিতপাবন হরি ॥৩৭॥
chāri yuga āchhi āmi nakra-rūpa dhari’<br />ebe uddhārile tumi patita-pāvana hari [37]
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">āchhi</span>–have been [here] <span class="e2">chāri</span> <span class="e2">yuga</span>–for four ages, <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–bearing <span class="e2">nakra-rūpa</span>–the form of a crocodile. <span class="e2">hari</span>–O Lord! <span class="e2">patita-pāvana</span>–O saviour of the fallen! <span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You <span class="e2">uddhārile</span>–have delivered [me].
“I have spent four ages in the form of a crocodile. O Lord! O saviour of the fallen! Now You have delivered me.
তব মুখে হরিনাম পরম মধুর ।<br />স্থাবরাস্থাবর জীব তারিলে প্রচুর ॥৩৮॥
tava mukhe hari-nāma parama madhura<br />sthāvarāsthāvara jīva tārile prachura [38]
<span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–From Your mouth, <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord [is] <span class="e2">parama</span>–extremely <span class="e2">madhura</span>–sweet. <span class="e2">tārile</span>–You have delivered <span class="e2">prachura</span>–innumerable <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls, [both] <span class="e2">sthāvarāsthāvara</span>–moving and inert.
“From Your mouth, the Name of the Lord is extremely sweet, and You have delivered innumerable souls, both moving and inert.
আজ্ঞা দেও যাই আমি ত্রিপিষ্টপ যথা ।<br />মাতা পিতা দেখি’ সুখ পাইব সর্ব্বথা” ॥৩৯॥
ājñā deo yāi āmi tripiṣṭapa yathā<br />mātā pitā dekhi’ sukha pāiba sarvathā” [39]
<span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">deo</span>–Give [me] permission, [and] <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">yāi</span>–will return <span class="e2">tripiṣṭapa</span>–to the abode of the gods. <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing [my] <span class="e2">mātā</span> <span class="e2">pitā</span>–mother and father <span class="e2">yathā</span>–there, <span class="e2">pāiba</span>–I will feel <span class="e2">sarvathā</span>–completely <span class="e2">sukha”</span>–happy.”
“Give me permission, and I will return to the abode of the gods. Seeing my mother and father there, I will be completely happy.”
দেবশিশুর স্বরূপপ্রাপ্তি ও স্বস্থানে গমন
deva-śiśura svarūpa-prāpti o svasthāne gamana
The child god obtains his original form and returns home
এত বলি’ প্রণমিয়া দেবশিশু যায় ।<br />কীর্ত্তনের রোল তবে উঠে পুনরায় ॥৪০॥
eta bali’ praṇamiyā deva-śiśu yāya<br />kīrtanera rola tabe uṭhe punarāya [40]
<span class="e2">bali’</span>–Having said <span class="e2">eta</span>–this, <span class="e2">deva-śiśu</span>–the child god <span class="e2">praṇamiyā</span>–bowed [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–left, [and] <span class="e2">rola</span>–the sound <span class="e2">kīrtanera</span>–of the chanting <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">uṭhe</span>–arose <span class="e2">punarāya</span>–again.
Having said this, the child god bowed and left, and the sound of the kīrtan arose again.
মধ্যাহ্ন হইল দেখি’ সর্ব্ব ভক্তগণ ।<br />প্রভুসঙ্গে মায়াপুর করিল গমন ॥৪১॥
madhyāhna ha-ila dekhi’ sarva bhakta-gaṇa<br />prabhu-saṅge māyāpura karila gamana [41]
<span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–Seeing [that] <span class="e2">madhyāhna</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–it was midday, <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">gamana karila</span>–went <span class="e2">māyāpura</span>–to Māyāpur <span class="e2">prabhu-saṅge</span>–with the Lord.
Seeing that it was midday, all the devotees went back to Māyāpur with the Lord.
মহাপ্রভুর এই লীলা যে করে শ্রবণ ।<br />ব্রহ্মশাপমুক্ত হয় সেই মহাজন ॥৪২॥
mahāprabhura ei līlā ye kare śravaṇa<br />brahma-śāpa-mukta haya sei mahājana [42]
<span class="e2">sei ye</span> <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–The great souls who <span class="e2">śravaṇa kare</span>–hear <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastime <span class="e2">mahāprabhura</span>–of Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">brahma-śāpa-mukta</span>–free from brāhmaṇs’ curses.
The great souls who hear this Pastime of Mahāprabhu become free from brāhmaṇs’ curses.
গোরাদহ দর্শনের ফল
gorā-daha darśanera phala
The result of seeing Gorā’s lake
সেই হইতে ‘গোরাদহ’ নাম পরচার ।<br />কালীয়দহের ন্যায় হইল তাহার ॥৪৩॥
sei ha-ite ‘gorā-daha’ nāma parachāra<br />kālīya-dahera nyāya ha-ila tāhāra [43]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–Since then, <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–its name <span class="e2">‘gorā-daha’</span>–‘Gorā’s lake’ <span class="e2">parachāra ha-ila</span>–has spread <span class="e2">nyāya</span>–like [the name] <span class="e2">kālīya-dahera</span>–of Kālīya’s lake.
Since then, the lake has become widely known as ‘Gorā Daha’, like Kālīya Daha in Vraja.
সেই ‘দহ’ দর্শনে স্পর্শনে পাপক্ষয় ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তি লাভ হয় সর্ব্ববেদে কয় ॥৪৪॥
sei ‘daha’ darśane sparśane pāpa-kṣaya<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti lābha haya sarva-vede kaya [44]
<span class="e2">sarva-vede</span>–All the Vedas <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">pāpa-kṣaya haya</span>–sins are removed [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">lābha</span>–attained <span class="e2">darśane</span>–by seeing [or] <span class="e2">sparśane</span>–by touching <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">‘daha’</span>–lake.
All the Vedas say that sins are removed and devotion to Kṛṣṇa is attained by seeing or touching this lake.
সেই গোপগণ দেখ মহাপ্রেমানন্দে ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গে করিল হেথা মামা বলি’ স্কন্ধে ॥৪৫॥
sei gopa-gaṇa dekha mahāpremānande<br />gaurāṅge karila hethā māmā bali’ skandhe [45]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">gopa-gaṇa</span>–The cowherd boys <span class="e2">dekha</span>–saw [this Pastime] <span class="e2">hethā</span>–here, [and] <span class="e2">mahā­premānande</span>–with the joy of intense divine love, <span class="e2">bali’</span>–they called <span class="e2">gaurāṅge</span>–Gaurāṅga <span class="e2">māmā</span>–uncle [and] <span class="e2">skandhe karila</span>–held [Him] on [their] shoulders.
The cowherd boys saw this Pastime here, and with the joy of intense divine love, they called Gaurāṅga ‘uncle’ and held Him on their shoulders.
সকলে দেখিল প্রভুর পূর্ব্বাহ্ন-বিহার ।<br />তঁহি মধ্যে দেখে রামকৃষ্ণ-লীলাসার ॥৪৬॥
sakale dekhila prabhura pūrvāhna-vihāra<br />ta̐hi madhye dekhe rāma-kṛṣṇa-līlā-sāra [46]
<span class="e2">sakale</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">dekhila</span>–saw <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–the Lord’s <span class="e2">pūrvāhna-vihāra</span>–morning Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">ta̐hi</span> <span class="e2">madhye</span>–within them, <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–they saw <span class="e2">rāma-kṛṣṇa-līlā-sāra</span>–the essence of Balarām and Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes.
Everyone saw the Lord’s morning Pastimes, and within them, they saw the essence of Balarām and Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes.
দেখে গোবর্ধন তথা মানস-জাহ্নবীপুলিনে ।<br />কৃষ্ণগোচারণলীলা অতি সমীচীন ॥৪৭॥
dekhe govardhana tathā mānasa-jāhnavī-puline<br />kṛṣṇa-go-chāraṇa-līlā ati samīchīna [47]
[Everyone] <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">samīchīna</span>–actually <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–saw <span class="e2">govardhana</span>–Govardhan [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-go-chāraṇa-līlā</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s cowherding Pastimes <span class="e2">tathā</span>–there <span class="e2">mānasa-jāhnavī-puline</span>–on the bank of the Mānasa Gaṅgā.
They actually saw Govardhan and Kṛṣṇa’s cowherding Pastimes there on the bank of the Mānasa Gaṅgā.
গোপগণ জানিল যে নিমাঞি-চরিত ।<br />শ্রীনন্দনন্দনলীলা নিজ সমীহিত ॥৪৮॥
gopa-gaṇa jānila ye nimāñi-charita<br />śrī-nanda-nandana-līlā nija samīhita [48]
<span class="e2">gopa-gaṇa</span>–The cowherd boys <span class="e2">jānila</span>–understood <span class="e2">ye</span>–that <span class="e2">nimāñi-charita</span>–the Pastimes of Nimāi [are] <span class="e2">līlā</span>–the Pastimes [of] <span class="e2">nija</span>–their <span class="e2">samīhita</span>–dear <span class="e2">śrī-nanda-nandana</span>–son of Śrī Nanda.
The cowherd boys understood that the Pastimes of Nimāi are the Pastimes of their dear Kṛṣṇa, the son of Śrī Nanda.

Chapter Sixteen
পীরিতি কিরূপ?
Pīriti Ki-rūpa?
What is Love?
শ্রীরঘুনাথ গোস্বামীর প্রশ্ন
śrī-raghunātha gosvāmīra praśna
Śrī Raghunāth Goswāmī’s question
একদিন রঘুনাথ স্বরূপে জিজ্ঞাসে ।<br />“কি বস্তু পীরিতি, মোরে শিখাও আভাসে ॥১॥
eka-dina raghunātha svarūpe jijñāse<br />“ki vastu pīriti, more śikhāo ābhāse [1]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">jijñāse</span>–asked <span class="e2">svarūpe</span>–Svarūp, <span class="e2">“ki</span> <span class="e2">vastu</span>–“What [is] <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love? <span class="e2">śikhāo</span>–Teach <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">ābhāse</span>–in essence.
One day, Raghunāth Dās asked Svarūp Dāmodar, “What is love? Please teach me in essence.
বিদ্যাপতি চণ্ডীদাস যে প্রীতি বর্ণিল ।<br />সে প্রীতি বুঝিতে মোর শক্তি না হইল ॥২॥
vidyāpati chaṇḍī-dāsa ye prīti varṇila<br />se prīti bujhite mora śakti nā ha-ila [2]
<span class="e2">mora</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila nā</span>–I do not have the ability <span class="e2">bujhite</span>–to understand <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">prīti ye</span> <span class="e2">prīti</span>–the love that <span class="e2">vidyāpati</span>–Vidyāpati [and] <span class="e2">chaṇḍī-dāsa</span>–Chaṇḍī Dās <span class="e2">varṇila</span>–described.
“I cannot understand the love that Vidyāpati and Chaṇḍī Dās described.
তাঁহাদের বাক্যে বাহ্যে বুঝে যে পীরিতি ।<br />সে কেবল স্ত্রীপুরুষের প্রণয়ের রীতি ॥৩॥
tā̐hādera vākye bāhye bujhe ye pīriti<br />se kevala strī-puruṣera praṇayera rīti [3]
<span class="e2">se ye</span> <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–The love that <span class="e2">bujhe</span>–I understand <span class="e2">tā̐hādera</span> <span class="e2">vākye</span>–from their words <span class="e2">bāhye</span>–externally [is] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–nothing [more than] <span class="e2">praṇayera</span> <span class="e2">rīti</span>–the type of love <span class="e2">strī-puruṣera</span>–between a man and a woman.
“The love that I understand from their words externally is nothing more than the love between a man and a woman.
সে কেমনে পরমার্থ-মধ্যে গণ্য হয় ।<br />প্রাকৃত কামকে কেন অপ্রাকৃত কয় ॥৪॥
se kemane paramārtha-madhye gaṇya haya<br />prākṛta kāmake kena aprākṛta kaya [4]
<span class="e2">kemane</span>–How <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">gaṇya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–has that been accepted <span class="e2">paramārtha-madhye</span>–as spiritual? <span class="e2">kena</span>–Why <span class="e2">kaya</span>–do they call <span class="e2">prākṛta</span> <span class="e2">kāmake</span>–mundane lust <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–divine?
“How has that love been accepted as spiritual? And why do they call mundane lust divine?
মহাপ্রভু তোমার সঙ্গে সেই সব গান ।<br />করেন সর্ব্বদা, তার না পাই সন্ধান ॥৫॥
mahāprabhu tomāra saṅge sei saba gāna<br />karena sarvadā, tāra nā pāi sandhāna [5]
<span class="e2">mahāprabhu</span>–Mahāprabhu <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">gāna</span> <span class="e2">karena</span>–sings all their songs <span class="e2">tomāra</span> <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with you, [but] <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sandhāna</span> <span class="e2">pāi nā</span>–I do not understand them.
“Mahāprabhu always sings their songs with you, but I do not understand them.
প্রভু তব হস্তে মোরে করিল সমর্পণ ।<br />আজ্ঞা কৈল, ‘শিখাও এবে নিগূঢ তত্ত্বধন’ ॥৬॥
prabhu tava haste more karila samarpaṇa<br />ājñā kaila, ‘śikhāo ebe nigūḍha tattva-dhana’ [6]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">samarpaṇa karila</span>–put <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">haste</span>–in your hands [and] <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–instructed [you,] <span class="e2">‘ebe</span>–‘Now <span class="e2">śikhāo</span>–teach [him] <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span> <span class="e2">tattva-dhana’</span>–these precious hidden truths.’
“The Lord put me in your hands and instructed you, ‘Now teach him these precious hidden truths.’
প্রীতি-তত্ত্ব কি ?
prīti-tattva ki ?
What is the nature of love?
কৃপা করি’ প্রীতিতত্ত্ব মোরে দেহ বুঝাইয়া ।<br />কৃতার্থ হইব মুঞি সংশয় ত্যজিয়া” ॥৭॥
kṛpā kari’ prīti-tattva more deha bujhāiyā<br />kṛtārtha ha-iba muñi saṁśaya tyajiyā” [7]
<span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully <span class="e2">more bujhāiyā deha</span>–help me understand <span class="e2">prīti-tattva</span>–the nature of love. [Then] <span class="e2">muñi</span>–I <span class="e2">kṛtārtha</span> <span class="e2">ha-iba</span>–will be fulfilled [and] <span class="e2">tyajiyā</span>–leave behind [my] <span class="e2">saṁśaya”</span>–doubts.”
“Please help me understand the nature of love. Then I will be fulfilled and leave behind my doubts.”
উত্তর
uttara
The answer
স্বরূপ বলিল, “ভাই রঘুনাথদাস ।<br />নিভৃতে তোমারে তত্ত্ব করিব প্রকাশ ॥৮॥
svarūpa balila, “bhāi raghunātha-dāsa<br />nibhṛte tomāre tattva kariba prakāśa [8]
<span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–Svarūp <span class="e2">balila</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bhāi</span>–“Dear brother, <span class="e2">raghunātha-dāsa</span>–Raghunāth Dās! <span class="e2">nibhṛte</span>–Confidentially, <span class="e2">prakāśa kariba</span>–I will reveal <span class="e2">tattva</span>–this truth <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–to you.
Svarūp said, “Dear brother, Raghunāth Dās! Confidentially, I will reveal this truth to you.
আমি কিবা রামানন্দ অথবা পণ্ডিত ।<br />কেহ না বুঝিবে তত্ত্ব প্রভুর উদিত ॥৯॥
āmi kibā rāmānanda athavā paṇḍita<br />keha nā bujhibe tattva prabhura udita [9]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–Neither <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I, <span class="e2">athavā</span>–nor <span class="e2">rāmānanda</span>–Rāmānanda, <span class="e2">paṇḍita</span>–Gadādhar Paṇḍit, <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–or anyone [else], <span class="e2">bujhibe</span>–will [ever] understand <span class="e2">tattva</span>–the truth <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">udita</span>–revealed by the Lord.
“Neither I, nor Rāmānanda, Gadādhar Paṇḍit, or anyone else, will ever understand the love that the Lord revealed.
তবে যদি গৌরচন্দ্র জিহ্বায় বসিয়া ।<br />বলাইবে নিজতত্ত্ব সকৃপ হইয়া ॥১০॥<br />তখনি জানিবে হৈল সুসত্য প্রকাশ ।<br />শুনিয়া আনন্দ পাবে রঘুনাথদাস ॥১১॥
tabe yadi gaurachandra jihvāya basiyā<br />balāibe nija-tattva sakṛpa ha-iyā [10]<br />takhani jānibe haila susatya prakāśa<br />śuniyā ānanda pābe raghunātha-dāsa [11]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Still, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">gaurachandra</span>–Gaurachandra <span class="e2">sakṛpa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">basiyā</span>–sits <span class="e2">jihvāya</span>–on [my] tongue [and] <span class="e2">balāibe</span>–causes me to speak <span class="e2">nija-tattva</span>–about His love, <span class="e2">takhani</span>–then <span class="e2">jānibe</span>–you will know [that] <span class="e2">susatya</span>–the highest truth <span class="e2">prakāśa haila</span>–has been revealed, [and] <span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–hearing [it,] <span class="e2">raghunātha-dāsa</span>–Raghunāth Dās, <span class="e2">ānanda</span> <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will be overjoyed!
“Still, if Gaurachandra mercifully takes control of my tongue and causes me to speak about His love, then you will know that the highest truth has been revealed to you, and when you hear it, Raghunāth Dās, you will be overjoyed!
চণ্ডীদাস বিদ্যাপতি	কর্ণামৃত রায়ের গীতি<br />	এসব অমূল্য শাস্ত্র জান ।<br />এসবে নাহিক কাম	এসব প্রেমের ধাম<br />	অপ্রাকৃত তাহাতে বিধান ॥১২॥
chaṇḍī-dāsa vidyāpati	karṇāmṛta rāyera gīti<br />	e-saba amūlya śāstra jāna<br />e-sabe nāhika kāma	e-saba premera dhāma<br />	aprākṛta tāhāte vidhāna [12]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [that] <span class="e2">karṇāmṛta</span>–<span class="e33">Śrī Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta</span> [and] <span class="e2">gīti</span>–the songs <span class="e2">chaṇḍī-dāsa</span> <span class="e2">vidyāpati</span> <span class="e2">rāyera</span>–of Chaṇḍī Dās, Vidyāpati, and Rāmānanda Rāy [are] <span class="e2">e-saba</span>–all <span class="e2">amūlya</span>–invaluable <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–scriptures. <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–There is no <span class="e2">kāma</span>–lust <span class="e2">e-sabe</span>–within them. <span class="e2">e-saba</span>–They [are] <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–repositories <span class="e2">premera</span>–of divine love. <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–Within them, <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–the divine [is] <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–the law.
“Know that <span class="e3">Śrī Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta</span> and the songs of Chaṇḍī Dās, Vidyāpati, and Rāmānanda Rāy are invaluable scriptures that contain no lust. They are repositories of love, and by nature divine.
স্ত্রী-পুরুষ-বিবরণ	যে কিছু তঁহি বর্ণন<br />	সে সব উপমা মাত্র সার ।<br />প্রাকৃত-কাম-বর্ণন	তাহে কৃষ্ণ-অদর্শন<br />	অপ্রাকৃত করহ বিচার ॥১৩॥
strī-puruṣa-vivaraṇa	ye kichhu ta̐hi varṇana<br />	se saba upamā mātra sāra<br />prākṛta-kāma-varṇana	tāhe kṛṣṇa-adarśana<br />	aprākṛta karaha vichāra [13]
<span class="e2">strī-puruṣa-vivaraṇa</span>–The descriptions of men and women— <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saba ye</span> <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–all the <span class="e2">varṇana</span>–descriptions— <span class="e2">ta̐hi</span>–within them [are] <span class="e2">upamā</span>–analogies, [and] <span class="e2">mātra</span> <span class="e2">sāra</span>–nothing more. <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-adarśana</span>–Kṛṣṇa is absent <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–within <span class="e2">prākṛta-kāma-varṇana</span>–descriptions of mundane lust; [so,] <span class="e2">vichāra karaha</span>–consider [these descriptions] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–divine.
“All the descriptions of men and women within them are analogies, and nothing more. Kṛṣṇa is never present within descriptions of mundane lust; so, consider the descriptions within them to be divine.
কি পুরুষ, কিবা নারী,	এ-তত্ত্ব বুঝিতে নারি<br />	জড়দেহে করে রসরঙ্গ ।<br />সে গুরু কৃষ্ণের ভাণে	শুদ্ধ-রতি নাহি জানে<br />	তাহার ভজন মায়ারঙ্গ ॥১৪॥
ki puruṣa, kibā nārī,	e-tattva bujhite nāri<br />	jaḍa-dehe kare rasa-raṅga<br />se guru kṛṣṇera bhāṇe	śuddha-rati nāhi jāne<br />	tāhāra bhajana māyā-raṅga [14]
<span class="e2">ki</span>–Whether <span class="e2">puruṣa</span>–a man <span class="e2">kibā</span>–or <span class="e2">nārī</span>–a women, [one who] <span class="e2">rasa-raṅga kare</span>–takes pleasure <span class="e2">jaḍa-dehe</span>–in [their] material body <span class="e2">bujhite nāri</span>–cannot understand <span class="e2">e-tattva</span>–this love. <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">guru</span>–A ‘guru’ who <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">bhāṇe</span>–pretends to be Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–does not understand <span class="e2">śuddha-rati</span>–pure love, [and] <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–his <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–‘worship’ [is] <span class="e2">māyā-raṅga</span>–a trick of Māyā.
“If anyone—be they a man or a woman—takes pleasure in their material body, they can never understand this love. A ‘guru’ who pretends to be Kṛṣṇa does not understand pure love, and his ‘worship’ is a trick of Māyā.
কৃষ্ণপ্রেম
kṛṣṇa-prema
Love for Kṛṣṇa
কৃষ্ণপ্রেম সুনির্ম্মল	যেন শুদ্ধ গঙ্গাজল<br />	সেই প্রেমা অমৃতের সিন্ধু ।<br />নির্ম্মল সে অনুরাগ	নাহি তাহে জড়দাগ<br />	শুক্লবস্ত্র শূন্যমসীবিন্দু ॥১৫॥
kṛṣṇa-prema sunirmala	yena śuddha gaṅgā-jala<br />	sei premā amṛtera sindhu<br />nirmala se anurāga	nāhi tāhe jaḍa-dāga<br />	śukla-vastra śūnya-masī-bindu [15]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–Love for Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">sunirmala</span>–perfectly pure, <span class="e2">yena</span>–like [the] <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure <span class="e2">gaṅgā-jala</span>–water of the Ganges. <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">premā</span>–Such love [is] <span class="e2">amṛtera</span> <span class="e2">sindhu</span>–an ocean of nectar. <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is not <span class="e2">jaḍa-dāga</span>–a trace of mundanity <span class="e2">se nirmala</span> <span class="e2">anurāga tāhe</span>–within such pure love. [It is like] <span class="e2">śukla-vastra</span>–a white cloth [that is] <span class="e2">śūnya-masī-bindu</span>–free from a drop of ink.
[Svarūp Dāmodar continued:] “Love for Kṛṣṇa is perfectly pure, like the pure water of the Ganges; it is an ocean of nectar. Within such pure love, there is not even a trace of mundanity. It is like a white cloth that is free from even a single drop of ink.
শুদ্ধপ্রেম সুখসিন্ধু	পাই তার এক বিন্দু<br />	সেই বিন্দু জগৎ ডুবায় ।<br />জড়দেহে করি’ প্রীতি	কেবল কামের রীতি<br />	শুদ্ধ দেহ না হয় উদয় ॥১৬॥
śuddha-prema sukha-sindhu	pāi tāra eka bindu<br />	sei bindu jagat ḍubāya<br />jaḍa-dehe kari’ prīti	kevala kāmera rīti<br />	śuddha deha nā haya udaya [16]
<span class="e2">śuddha-prema</span>–Pure love [is] <span class="e2">sukha-sindhu</span>–an ocean of joy. <span class="e2">pāi</span>–I have received <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">bindu</span>–drop <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of it, [and] <span class="e2">sei</span>–this <span class="e2">bindu</span>–drop <span class="e2">ḍubāya</span>–floods <span class="e2">jagat</span>–the world. <span class="e2">prīti kari’</span>–Loving <span class="e2">jaḍa-dehe</span>–the material body [is] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–merely <span class="e2">kāmera</span> <span class="e2">rīti</span>–a form of lust, [and one’s] <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure <span class="e2">deha</span>–body <span class="e2">udaya haya nā</span>–is not revealed [by doing so].
“Pure love is an ocean of joy. I have received one drop of it, and this drop floods the world. Loving the material body is merely a form of lust, and one’s divine body will never be revealed by doing so.
দূরে শুদ্ধ প্রেমবন্ধ	কপট প্রেমেতে অন্ধ<br />	সেই প্রেমে কৃষ্ণ নাহি পায় ।<br />তবে যে করে ক্রন্দন	স্বসৌভাগ্য প্রখ্যাপন<br />	করে ইহা, জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥১৭॥
dūre śuddha prema-bandha	kapaṭa premete andha<br />	sei preme kṛṣṇa nāhi pāya<br />tabe ye kare krandana	svasaubhāgya prakhyāpana<br />	kare ihā, jāniha niśchaya [17]
<span class="e2">andha</span>–Those who are blinded <span class="e2">kapaṭa</span> <span class="e2">premete</span>–by insincere love [are] <span class="e2">dūre</span>–far <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">prema-bandha</span>–from a connection with pure love: <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–one does not attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">preme</span>–with such ‘love’. <span class="e2">jāniha</span>–Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain <span class="e2">ihā</span>–that <span class="e2">ye</span>–those who <span class="e2">tabe</span>–still <span class="e2">krandana kare</span>–shed tears [only] <span class="e2">prakhyāpana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–make a show <span class="e2">svasaubhāgya</span>–of their ‘fortune’.
“Those who are blinded by insincere love are far from having pure love: no one can get Kṛṣṇa with such ‘love’. Know for certain that those who still shed tears are only making a show of their ‘fortune’.
কৃষ্ণপ্রেম যার হয়	তার বিভাব চিন্ময়<br />	অনুভাব দেহেতে প্রকাশ ।<br />সাত্ত্বিকাদি ব্যভিচারী	চিন্ময় স্বরূপ ধরি’<br />	চিৎস্বরূপে করয়ে বিলাস ॥১৮॥
kṛṣṇa-prema yāra haya	tāra vibhāva chinmaya<br />	anubhāva dehete prakāśa<br />sāttvikādi vyabhichārī	chinmaya svarūpa dhari’<br />	chit-svarūpe karaye vilāsa [18]
<span class="e2">vibhāva</span>–The stimuli (causes of rati) <span class="e2">tāra yāra</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–of those who have <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-prema</span>–love for Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual. [Their] <span class="e2">anubhāva</span>–gestures, <span class="e2">sāttvikādi</span>–ecstasies, [and] <span class="e2">vyabhichārī</span>–emotions, <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–having <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–forms, <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–manifest [and] <span class="e2">vilāsa karaye</span>–play <span class="e2">chit-svarūpe dehete</span>–within [their] spiritual bodies.
“The stimuli of those who have love for Kṛṣṇa are spiritual. Their gestures, ecstasies, and emotions, having spiritual forms, manifest and play within their spiritual bodies.
ধন্য সেই লীলাশুক	কৃষ্ণ তারে হয়ে সম্মুখ<br />	দিল ব্রজের অপ্রাকৃত রস ।<br />ছাড়িল এদেহ-রঙ্গ	প্রাকৃতালম্বন-ভঙ্গ<br />	তাহে কৃষ্ণ পরম সন্তোষ ॥১৯॥
dhanya sei līlāśuka	kṛṣṇa tāre haye sammukha<br />	dila vrajera aprākṛta rasa<br />chhāḍila e-deha-raṅga	prākṛtālambana-bhaṅga<br />	tāhe kṛṣṇa parama santoṣa [19]
<span class="e2">sei līlāśuka</span>–Līlāśuka (Śrīla Bilvamaṅgal Ṭhākur) [is most] <span class="e2">dhanya</span>–fortunate: <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">tāre sammukha haye</span>–came before him [and] <span class="e2">dila</span>–revealed <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–the divine <span class="e2">rasa</span>–rasas <span class="e2">vrajera</span>–of Vraja [to him when] <span class="e2">chhāḍila</span>–he gave up <span class="e2">e-deha-raṅga</span>–the pleasures of the body, [and] <span class="e2">prākṛtālambana-bhaṅga</span>–broke away from material para­phernalia. <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–Thereby, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [was] <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">santoṣa</span>–greatly pleased.
“Līlāśuka is most fortunate: Kṛṣṇa came before him and revealed the divine rasas of Vraja to him when he gave up bodily pleasures and broke away from material paraphernalia. Kṛṣṇa was greatly pleased by this.
বিদ্যাপতি, চণ্ডীদাস	ছাড়ি’ পূর্ব্ব রসাভাস<br />	অপ্রাকৃত-রসলাভ কৈল ।<br />পূর্ব্বে ছিল তুচ্ছ রস	তাহা ছাড়ি’ প্রেমবশ<br />	হঞা, কৃষ্ণভজন লভিল ॥২০॥
vidyāpati chaṇḍī-dāsa	chhāḍi’ pūrva rasābhāsa<br />	aprākṛta-rasa-lābha kaila<br />pūrve chhila tuchchha rasa	tāhā chhāḍi’ prema-vaśa<br />	hañā, kṛṣṇa-bhajana labhila [20]
<span class="e2">vidyāpati</span>–Vidyāpati [and] <span class="e2">chaṇḍī-dāsa</span>–Chaṇḍī Dās <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–rejected <span class="e2">rasābhāsa</span>–the tainted rasas <span class="e2">pūrva</span>–of the past [and] <span class="e2">aprākṛta-rasa-lābha</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–attained divine rasa. <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–They left behind <span class="e2">tuchchha</span> <span class="e2">rasa</span>–the crude pleasures <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">chhila</span>–existed <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–previously, <span class="e2">hañā</span>–became <span class="e2">prema-vaśa</span>–captivated by divine love, [and] <span class="e2">labhila</span>–attained <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhajana</span>–service to Kṛṣṇa.
“Vidyāpati and Chaṇḍī Dās rejected the tainted rasas of the past and attained divine rasa. They left behind the crude pleasures that existed previously, became captivated by divine love, and attained service to Kṛṣṇa.
তুচ্ছ রসে মাতোয়ার	না পায় কৃষ্ণরস-সার<br />	নহে বংশীবদনালম্বন ।<br />জড় দেহে সাজ সাজ	মাথায় তার পড়ে বাজ<br />	প্রাণকীটের করয়ে ধারণ ॥২১॥
tuchchha rase mātoyāra	nā pāya kṛṣṇa-rasa-sāra<br />	nahe vaṁśī-vadanālambana<br />jaḍa dehe sāja sāja	māthāya tāra paḍe vāja<br />	prāṇa-kīṭera karaye dhāraṇa [21]
<span class="e2">mātoyāra</span>–Those who are intoxicated <span class="e2">tuchchha</span> <span class="e2">rase</span>–by crude pleasures <span class="e2">pāya nā</span>–do not attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-rasa-sāra</span>–the essence of devotion to Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">vaṁśī-vadanālambana nahe</span>–the Flute Player does not become the object [of their love]. [Let] <span class="e2">vāja</span>–lightning <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–strike <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">māthāya</span>–the head of those [who] <span class="e2">sāja</span> <span class="e2">sāja</span>–pamper [their] <span class="e2">jaḍa</span> <span class="e2">dehe</span>–material bodies! <span class="e2">prāṇa-kītera</span> <span class="e2">dhāraṇa karaye</span>–They live the life of an insect!
“Those who are intoxicated by crude pleasures do not attain the essence of devotion to Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa the flute player does not become the object of their love. Let lightning strike the heads of those who pamper their bodies! They live the life of an insect!
সেই তুচ্ছ রস ত্যজি’	শ্রীনন্দনন্দন ভজি’<br />	দেখে কৃষ্ণ শ্রীবংশীবদন ।<br />নিজে গোপীদেহ পায়	ব্রজবনে বেগে যায়<br />	পূর্ব্ব সঙ্গ করয় ত্যজন ॥২২॥
sei tuchchha rasa tyaji’	śrī-nanda-nandana bhaji’<br />	dekhe kṛṣṇa śrī-vaṁśī-vadana<br />nije gopī-deha pāya	vraja-vane vege yāya<br />	pūrva saṅga karaya tyajana [22]
[When] <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–souls leave behind <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">tuchchha</span> <span class="e2">rasa</span>–crude pleasures, <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–serve <span class="e2">śrī-nanda-nandana</span>–the son of Nanda, [and] <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">śrī-vaṁśī-vadana</span>–the flute player, [they then] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">nije</span>–personally <span class="e2">gopī-deha</span>–the bodies of gopīs, <span class="e2">vege</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–run <span class="e2">vraja-vane</span>–to the forest of Vraja, [and] <span class="e2">tyajana karaya</span>–leave behind <span class="e2">pūrva</span> <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–all [their] previous attachments.
“When souls leave behind crude pleasures, serve Kṛṣṇa, and see Him playing the flute, they then attain the bodies of gopīs and run to Vṛndāvan, leaving behind all their previous attachments.
তথাহি মহাপ্রভুর শ্লোক
tathāhi mahāprabhura śloka
Mahāprabhu’s verse in confirmation
‘ন প্রেমগন্ধোঽস্তি দরাপি মে হরৌ<br />ক্রন্দামি সৌভাগ্যভরং প্রকাশিতুম্ ।<br />বংশীবিলাস্যাননলোকনং বিনা<br />বিভর্ম্মি যৎ প্রাণপতঙ্গকান্ বৃথা’ ॥২৩॥
‘na prema-gandho ’sti darāpi me harau<br />krandāmi saubhāgya-bharaṁ prakāśitum<br />vaṁśī-vilāsy-ānana-lokanaṁ vinā<br />bibharmi yat prāṇa-pataṅgakān vṛthā’ [23]
<span class="e2">me asti na</span>–I do not have <span class="e2">darā api</span>–even a trace <span class="e2">prema-gandhaḥ</span>–of the fragrance of divine love <span class="e2">harau</span>–for Kṛṣṇa. [Still,] <span class="e2">krandāmi</span>–I cry <span class="e2">prakāśitum</span>–to show [others that I have]<span class="e2"> saubhāgya-bharaṁ</span>–a great fortune. <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">vaṁśī-vilāsy-ānana-lokanaṁ</span>–a glimpse of the face of that Flute Player, <span class="e2">bibharmi</span>–I carry on [my] <span class="e2">vṛthā</span>–meaningless, <span class="e2">yat prāṇa-pataṅgakān</span>–insect-like life.
“‘I do not have even a trace of love for Kṛṣṇa. Still, I cry to show that I have a great fortune. Without a glimpse of the face of that Flute Player, I carry on My meaningless, insect-like life.’
ব্রজগোপী ব্যতীত পীরিতি বুঝে না
vraja-gopī vyatīta pīriti bujhe nā
No one understands love except the gopīs of Vraja
পীরিতি পীরিতি	পীরিতি বলে<br />	পীরিতি বুঝিল কে ?<br />যে জন পীরিতি	বুঝিতে পারে<br />	ব্রজগোপী হয় সে ॥২৪॥
pīriti pīriti	pīriti bale<br />	pīriti bujhila ke?<br />ye jana pīriti	bujhite pāre<br />	vraja-gopī haya se [24]
<span class="e2">bale</span>–People say, <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–“Love, <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love, <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love”, [but] <span class="e2">ke</span>–who <span class="e2">bujhila</span>–has understood <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love? <span class="e2">se ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Souls who <span class="e2">pāre</span>–can [actually] <span class="e2">bujhite</span>–understand <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">vraja-gopī</span>–gopīs in Vraja.
[Svarūp Dāmodar continued:] “People say, ‘Love, love, love’, but who has understood love? Souls who can actually understand love become gopīs in Vraja.
পীরিতি বলিয়া	তিনটি আঁখর<br />	বিদিত ভুবন-মাঝে ।<br />যাহাতে পশিল	সেই সে মজিল<br />	কি তার কলঙ্কলাজে ॥২৫॥
pīriti baliyā	tinaṭi ā̐khara<br />	vidita bhuvana-mājhe<br />yāhāte paśila	sei se majila<br />	ki tāra kalaṅka-lāje [25]
<span class="e2">tinaṭi</span>–The three <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–spoken <span class="e2">ā̐khara</span>–syllables <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–<span class="e33">pī</span>, <span class="e33">ri</span>, and <span class="e33">ti</span> [are] <span class="e2">vidita</span>–known <span class="e2">bhuvana-mājhe</span>–throughout the world. <span class="e2">se yāhāte</span>–Souls in whom <span class="e2">sei</span>–they <span class="e2">paśila</span>–have entered <span class="e2">majila</span>–become overwhelmed. <span class="e2">ki</span>–What <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">kalaṅka-lāje</span>–is shame or disgrace to them?
“These three syllables <span class="e3">pī</span>, <span class="e3">ri</span>, and <span class="e3">ti</span> (in the word <span class="e3">pīriti</span>) are known throughout the world. Souls in whom they have entered become overwhelmed. What is shame or disgrace to them?
ব্রজগোপী হঞা	চিদ্দেহ স্মরিয়া<br />	জড়ের সম্বন্ধ ছাড়ে ।<br />বিষয়ে আশ্রয়ে	শুদ্ধ-আলম্বন<br />	পরকীয়-রস বাড়ে ॥২৬॥
vraja-gopī hañā	chid-deha smariyā<br />	jaḍera sambandha chhāḍe<br />viṣaye āśraye	śuddha-ālambana<br />	parakīya-rasa bāḍe [26]
<span class="e2">hañā</span>–Becoming <span class="e2">vraja-gopī</span>–gopīs in Vraja [and] <span class="e2">smariyā</span>–meditating <span class="e2">chid-deha</span>–with [their] spiritual bodies, <span class="e2">chhāḍe</span>–they give up<span class="e2"> jaḍera</span> <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–all connection with matter. <span class="e2">parakīya-rasa</span>–Paramour love <span class="e2">bāḍe</span>–develops [when its] <span class="e2">ālambana</span>–basis, <span class="e2">viṣaye</span> <span class="e2">āśraye</span>–the lover and the beloved, [are] <span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure.
“Becoming gopīs in Vraja and meditating with their spiritual bodies, they give up all connection with matter. Paramour love develops when its basis, the lover and the beloved, are pure.
ব্রজ বিনা কোথাও নাহি পরকীয়-ভাব ।<br />বৈকুণ্ঠ-লক্ষ্মীতে তার সদা অসদ্ভাব ॥২৭॥
vraja vinā kothāo nāhi parakīya-bhāva<br />vaikuṇṭha-lakṣmīte tāra sadā asadbhāva [27]
<span class="e2">parakīya-bhāva</span>–Paramour love <span class="e2">kothāo</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–does not exist anywhere <span class="e2">vinā</span>–except <span class="e2">vraja</span>–Vraja. <span class="e2">sadā</span>–Forever, <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">asadbhāva</span>–it is incompatible <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭha-lakṣmīte</span>–with Lakṣmī in Vaikuṇṭha.
“Paramour love does not exist anywhere except Vraja. It is forever incompatible with Lakṣmī Devī in Vaikuṇṭha.
সহজিয়ার প্রীতি
sahajiyāra prīti
The love of the imitationists
সংসারে যতেক	পুরুষ, রমণী<br />	আলম্বন-দোষে সদা ।<br />রক্তমাংসদেহে	আরোপ করিতে<br />	নারকী হয় সর্ব্বদা ॥২৮॥
saṁsāre yateka	puruṣa, ramaṇī<br />	ālambana-doṣe sadā<br />rakta-māṁsa-dehe	āropa karite<br />	nārakī haya sarvadā [28]
<span class="e2">yateka</span> <span class="e2">puruṣa</span> <span class="e2">ramaṇī</span>–The men and woman <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–in this world [are] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">ālambana-doṣe</span>–the wrong basis [for that love]. <span class="e2">āropa</span> <span class="e2">karite</span>–By attributing [that love] <span class="e2">rakta-māṁsa-dehe</span>–to bodies of flesh and blood, <span class="e2">haya</span>–souls become <span class="e2">nārakī</span>–sinners <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–perpetually.
“The men and women of this world are always the wrong basis for that love. By attributing that love to bodies of flesh and blood, souls become perpetual sinners.
অতএব তারা	সহজ-সাধনে<br />	কৃষ্ণকৃপা যবে পায় ।<br />জড়দেহগন্ধ	ছাড়িয়া সে সব<br />	চিদানন্দরসে ধায় ॥২৯॥
ataeva tārā	sahaja sādhane<br />	kṛṣṇa-kṛpā yabe pāya<br />jaḍa-deha-gandha	chhāḍiyā se saba<br />	chid-ānanda-rase dhāya [29]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when <span class="e2">tārā</span>–they <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kṛpā</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s mercy [through] <span class="e2">sahaja</span> <span class="e2">sādhane</span>–natural practice, <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–they avoid <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">jaḍa-deha-gandha</span>–even the scent of the material body [and] <span class="e2">dhāya</span>–run <span class="e2">chid-ānanda-rase</span>–towards joyful, spiritual rasa.
“So, when souls attain Kṛṣṇa’s mercy through natural practice, they avoid even subtle connection with the material body and run towards joyful, spiritual rasa.
রায় রামানন্দের প্রীতি
rāya rāmānandera prīti
Rāy Rāmānanda’s love
প্রকৃত সহজ	শ্রীকৃষ্ণভজন<br />	করে রামানন্দ রায় ।<br />সুবৈধ সাধনে	এ জড দেহেতে<br />	সুযুক্ত বৈরাগ্য ভায় ॥৩০॥
prakṛta sahaja	śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana<br />	kare rāmānanda rāya<br />suvaidha sādhane	e jaḍa dehete<br />	suyukta vairāgya bhāya [30]
<span class="e2">rāmānanda</span> <span class="e2">rāya</span>–Rāmānanda Rāy <span class="e2">kare</span>–renders <span class="e2">prakṛta</span>–genuine, <span class="e2">sahaja</span>–natural <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana</span>–service to Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [He is] <span class="e2">suvaidha</span>–perfectly regulated <span class="e2">sādhane</span>–in [his] practice, [and] <span class="e2">suyukta</span>–perfect <span class="e2">vairāgya</span>–renunciation <span class="e2">bhāya</span>–shines <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">jaḍa</span> <span class="e2">dehete</span>–in his physical body.
[Svarūp Dāmodar continued:] “Rāmānanda Rāy’s service to Kṛṣṇa is genuine and natural. He is perfectly regulated in his practice, and perfect renunciation shines in his physical body.
বিশুদ্ধ দেহেতে	ব্রজে কৃষ্ণ ভজে<br />	মহাপ্রভু-কৃপা পাঞা ।<br />নাটকাভিনয়ে	দেবদাসীশিক্ষা<br />	সঙ্গদোষশূন্য হঞা ॥৩১॥
viśuddha dehete	vraje kṛṣṇa bhaje<br />	mahāprabhu-kṛpā pāñā<br />nāṭakābhinaye	deva-dāsī-śikṣā<br />	saṅga-doṣa-śūnya hañā [31]
<span class="e2">pāñā</span>–Having received <span class="e2">mahāprabhu-kṛpā</span>–Mahāprabhu’s mercy, <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–he serves <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja <span class="e2">viśuddha</span> <span class="e2">dehete</span>–in [his] pure body. <span class="e2">deva-dāsī-śikṣā</span>–He teaches maidservants of the Lord <span class="e2">nāṭakābhinaye</span>–to perform plays, [but he] <span class="e2">saṅga-doṣa-śūnya</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–is free from any inappropriate association [with them].
“Having received Mahāprabhu’s mercy, he serves Kṛṣṇa in Vraja in his pure body. He teaches maidservants of Jagannāth to perform plays, but he is free from any inappropriate association with them.
প্রীতি-শিক্ষায় অধিকার কাহার ?
prīti-śikṣāya adhikāra kāhāra?
Who is qualified to learn about love?
রামানন্দ বিনা	তাহে অধিকার<br />	কেহ নাহি পায় আর ।<br />পরস্ত্রী-দর্শন	স্পর্শন, সেবন<br />	বুদ্ধি হৃদে আছে যার ।<br />পীরিতি শিক্ষায়	জানিবে নিশ্চয়<br />	নাহি তার অধিকার ॥৩২॥
rāmānanda vinā	tāhe adhikāra<br />	keha nāhi pāya āra<br />para-strī-darśana	sparśana, sevana<br />	buddhi hṛde āchhe yāra<br />pīriti śikṣāya	jānibe niśchaya<br />	nāhi tāra adhikāra [32]
<span class="e2">vinā</span>–Except for <span class="e2">rāmānanda</span>–Rāmānanda, <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nāhi āra</span>–no one else <span class="e2">pāya</span>–has <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–the qualification <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–for this. <span class="e2">jānibe</span>–Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">tāra yāra āchhe</span>–anyone who has <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–the inclination <span class="e2">hṛde</span>–in their heart <span class="e2">darśana</span>–to see, <span class="e2">sparśana</span>–touch, [or] <span class="e2">sevana</span>–serve <span class="e2">para-strī</span>–another’s wife <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–does not have <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–the qualification <span class="e2">pīriti</span> <span class="e2">śikṣāya</span>–to learn about love.
“No one has this qualification except Rāmānanda. Know for certain that anyone who desires at heart to see, touch, or serve another’s wife is never qualified to learn about love.
স্ত্রীপুরুষবুদ্ধি থাকিতে প্রীতিসাধন অসম্ভব
strī-puruṣa-buddhi thākite prīti-sādhana asambhava
Developing love is impossible in the presence of man-woman consciousness
কভু এ সংসারে	স্ত্রী-পুং-ব্যবহারে<br />	না হয় পীরিতি-ধন ।<br />চর্ম্মসুখ যত	অনিত্য নিয়ত<br />	নহে নিত্য সংঘটন ॥৩৩॥
kabhu e saṁsāre	strī-puṁ-vyavahāre<br />	nā haya pīriti-dhana<br />charma-sukha yata	anitya niyata<br />	nahe nitya saṁghaṭana [33]
<span class="e2">pīriti-dhana</span>–The wealth of that love <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span>–never <span class="e2">haya</span>–exists <span class="e2">strī-puṁ-vyavahāre</span>–in the affairs of men and women <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–in this world. <span class="e2">yata</span>–All <span class="e2">charma-sukha</span>–carnal pleasures [are] <span class="e2">niyata</span>–always <span class="e2">anitya</span>–temporary. <span class="e2">nahe</span>–They have no <span class="e2">saṁghaṭana</span>–connection <span class="e2">nitya</span>–with eternity.
“The wealth of love never exists in the affairs of men and women in this world. Carnal pleasures are always temporary. They have no connection with eternity.
গোপীভাব ধরি’	চিদ্ধর্ম্ম আচরি’<br />	পীরিতি সাধিবে যেই ।<br />স্ত্রী-পুং-ব্যবহার	নাহিক তাহার<br />	ভিতরে গোপিনী সেই ॥৩৪॥
gopī-bhāva dhari’	chid-dharma āchari’<br />	pīriti sādhibe yei<br />strī-puṁ-vyavahāra	nāhika tāhāra<br />	bhitare gopinī sei [34]
<span class="e2">sei yei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–embrace <span class="e2">gopī-bhāva</span>–the mood of the gopīs, [and] <span class="e2">sādhibe</span>–cultivate <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love <span class="e2">āchari’</span>–by acting <span class="e2">chid-dharma</span>–according [to their] spiritual nature <span class="e2">tāhāra nāhika</span>–have no [involvement in] <span class="e2">strī-puṁ-vyavahāra</span>–man-woman affairs; [they are] <span class="e2">gopinī</span>–gopīs <span class="e2">bhitare</span>–internally.
“Those who embrace the mood of the gopīs and cultivate love by acting according to their spiritual nature are never involved in the affairs of men and women; they are gopīs internally.
বাহিরে সজ্জন	ধর্ম্ম-আচরণ<br />	আমরণ বৈধাচার ।<br />অন্তরেতে গোপী	চিত্তে কৃষ্ণ সেবে<br />	কেবল পীরিতি তার ॥৩৫॥
bāhire sajjana	dharma-ācharaṇa<br />	āmaraṇa vaidhāchāra<br />antarete gopī	chitte kṛṣṇa seve<br />	kevala pīriti tāra [35]
<span class="e2">bāhire</span>–Externally, <span class="e2">sajjana</span>–as sādhus, <span class="e2">dharma-ācharaṇa</span>–they behave virtuously [and] <span class="e2">vaidhāchāra</span>–adhere to regulations <span class="e2">āmaraṇa</span>–until death. <span class="e2">antarete</span>–Internally, <span class="e2">gopī</span>–as gopīs, <span class="e2">seve</span>–they serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">chitte</span>–within the heart: [their] <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love [is] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–only <span class="e2">tāra</span>–for Him.
“Externally, as sādhus, they behave virtuously and adhere to regulations until death. Internally, as gopīs, they serve Kṛṣṇa within the heart: their love is only for Him.
‘যঃ কৌমারহরঃ’	ইত্যাদি কবিতা<br />	কেবল উপমাস্থল ।<br />নায়ক-নায়িকা	চিৎস্বরূপ হঞা<br />	কৃষ্ণ ভজে সুনির্ম্মল ॥৩৬॥
‘yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ’	ityādi kavitā<br />	kevala upamā-sthala<br />nāyaka-nāyikā	chit-svarūpa hañā<br />	kṛṣṇa bhaje sunirmala [36]
<span class="e2">kavitā</span>–Verses <span class="e2">ityādi</span>–such as <span class="e2">‘yaḥ</span> <span class="e2">kaumāra-haraḥ’</span>–‘He who has stolen my youth’ [are] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–simply <span class="e2">upamā-sthala</span>–analogies. [Understanding that] <span class="e2">nāyaka-nāyikā</span>–the lover and the beloved <span class="e2">hañā</span>–are <span class="e2">chit-svarūpa</span>–spiritual, <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–souls serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sunirmala</span>–purely.
“Verses such as <span class="e3">Yaḥ Kaumāra-haraḥ</span>* are simply analogies. Under­standing that the lover and the beloved in these verses are spiritual, souls should serve Kṛṣṇa purely.
জডেতে এই ভাব আরোপ, নরক—কলির ছলনা
jaḍete ei bhāva āropa, naraka—kalira chhalanā
Attributing this love to the mundane is hellish; it is a deception produced by Kali
কেহ যদি বলে ইহা আরোপ চিন্তায় ।<br />পরপুরুষেতে কৃষ্ণভজন উপায় ॥৩৭॥<br />চৈতন্য আজ্ঞায় আমি একথা না মানি ।<br />জড়েতে এরূপ বুদ্ধি নরক বলি’ মানি ॥৩৮॥
keha yadi bale ihā āropa chintāya<br />para-puruṣete kṛṣṇa-bhajana upāya [37]<br />chaitanya ājñāya āmi e-kathā nā māni<br />jaḍete e-rūpa buddhi naraka bali’ māni [38]
*yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva chaitra-kṣapās<br />te chonmīlita-mālatī-surabhayaḥ prauḍhāḥ kadambānilāḥ<br />sā chaivāsmi tathāpi tatra surata-vyāpāra-līlā-vidhau<br />revā-rodhasi vetasī-taru-tale chetaḥ samutkaṇṭhat
(Śrī Chaitanya-charitāmṛta: Madhya-līlā, 1.58)
“He is the paramour who has stolen my youth, these are the same moonlit spring nights filled with the fragrance of blooming jasmine and sweet breezes blowing from the kadamba forest, and I am the same lover. Still, my heart is yearning for our trysts on the bank of the Revā beneath that vetasī tree.”
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">keha</span>–someone <span class="e2">bale</span>–says [that] <span class="e2">āropa</span> <span class="e2">chintāya</span>–attributing <span class="e2">ihā</span>–that love <span class="e2">para-puruṣete</span>–to another person [is] <span class="e2">upāya</span>–a way <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhajana</span>–to serve Kṛṣṇa, [then,] <span class="e2">chaitanya</span> <span class="e2">ājñāya</span>–on Śrī Chaitanya’s order, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">māni nā</span>–do not accept <span class="e2">e-kathā</span>–their statement. <span class="e2">māni</span>–I consider <span class="e2">e-rūpa</span> <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–such a conception <span class="e2">jaḍete</span>–of the mundane <span class="e2">bali’</span>–to be <span class="e2">naraka</span>–hellish.
[Svarūp Dāmodar continued:] “If someone says that ascribing love to another man is a way to serve Kṛṣṇa, then, on Śrī Chaitanya’s order, I do not accept their statement. I consider such a mundane conception to be hellish.
জড়দেহে চিদারোপ, সঙ্গ তুচ্ছ অতি ।<br />তাহে কৃষ্ণভাব আনা, সমূহ দুর্ম্মতি ॥৩৯॥
jaḍa-dehe chid-āropa, saṅga tuchchha ati<br />tāhe kṛṣṇa-bhāva ānā, samūha durmati [39]
<span class="e2">chid-āropa</span>–Attributing spirit <span class="e2">jaḍa-dehe</span>–to the material body [is] <span class="e2">ati tuchchha</span>–a very crude <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–attachment, [and] <span class="e2">ānā</span>–bringing <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhāva</span>–love for Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–into it [is] <span class="e2">samūha</span> <span class="e2">durmati</span>–completely wicked.
“Attributing spirit to the material body is a very crude attachment, and associating love for Kṛṣṇa with the material body is completely wicked.
কলির ছলনা এই জানিহ নিশ্চয় ।<br />ইহাতে বৈষ্ণব-ধর্ম্ম অধঃপথে যায় ॥৪০॥
kalira chhalanā ei jāniha niśchaya<br />ihāte vaiṣṇava-dharma adhaḥ-pathe yāya [40]
<span class="e2">jāniha</span>–Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">ei</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">chhalanā</span>–a deception <span class="e2">kalira</span>–produced by Kali, [and] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-dharma</span>–the Vaiṣṇava religion <span class="e2">adhaḥ-pathe</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–becomes degraded <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–because of it.
“Know for certain that such thinking is a deception produced by Kali, and the Vaiṣṇava dharma becomes degraded because of it.
সুকৃতি পুরুষ মাত্র উপমা বুঝিয়া ।<br />স্বীয় অপ্রাকৃতদেহে কৃষ্ণ ভজে গিয়া ॥৪১॥
sukṛti puruṣa mātra upamā bujhiyā<br />svīya aprākṛta-dehe kṛṣṇa bhaje giyā [41]
<span class="e2">mātra</span>–Only <span class="e2">sukṛti</span>–fortunate <span class="e2">puruṣa</span>–souls <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–understand <span class="e2">upamā</span>–the analogies [and] <span class="e2">giyā bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">svīya</span> <span class="e2">aprākṛta-dehe</span>–in their divine bodies.
“Only fortunate souls understand the analogies in the scriptures and serve Kṛṣṇa in their divine bodies.
চণ্ডীদাস বিদ্যাপতি আদি মহাজন ।<br />পূর্ব্ববুদ্ধি দূরে রাখি’ করিল ভজন ॥৪২॥
chaṇḍī-dāsa vidyāpati ādi mahājana<br />pūrva-buddhi dūre rākhi’ karila bhajana [42]
<span class="e2">chaṇḍī-dāsa</span>–Chaṇḍī Dās, <span class="e2">vidyāpati</span>–Vidyāpati, <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–and other great souls <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">rākhi’</span>–left behind [their] <span class="e2">pūrva-buddhi</span>–previous conceptions [and] <span class="e2">bhajana karila</span>–practised devotion.
“Chaṇḍī Dās, Vidyāpati, and the other great souls left their previous conceptions behind and practised devotion.
সে সবার শেষ বাক্য চিন্ময়ী পীরিতি ।<br />আছে তবু নাহি বুঝে দুষ্কৃতির রীতি ॥৪৩॥
se sabāra śeṣa vākya chinmayī pīriti<br />āchhe tabu nāhi bujhe duṣkṛtira rīti [43]
<span class="e2">śeṣa</span> <span class="e2">vākya</span>–The final statement <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sabāra</span>–of them all [is that] <span class="e2">chinmayī</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–love <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–exists, <span class="e2">tabu</span>–but [those whose] <span class="e2">duṣkṛtira</span> <span class="e2">rīti</span>–habits are sinful <span class="e2">bujhe nāhi</span>–do not understand [it].
“The final statement of all these great souls is that spiritual love does exist, but sinners never understand it.
রঘুনাথ এ বিষয়ে করহ বিচার ।<br />তোমা হেন ভক্ত প্রচারিবে সদাচার ॥৪৪॥
raghunātha e viṣaye karaha vichāra<br />tomā hena bhakta prachāribe sad-āchāra [44]
<span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–O Raghunāth, <span class="e2">vichāra karaha</span>–consider <span class="e2">e</span>–this <span class="e2">viṣaye</span>–matter. <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–Devotees <span class="e2">tomā</span> <span class="e2">hena</span>–such as yourself <span class="e2">prachāribe</span>–should preach [about] <span class="e2">sad-āchāra</span>–proper practice.
“O Raghunāth, consider this matter. Devotees such as yourself should preach the proper way to practise.
এ বিষয় একবার প্রভুকে জানাঞা ।<br />চিত্ত দৃঢ করি’ লও, দৃঢ় কর হিয়া” ॥৪৫॥
e viṣaya eka-bāra prabhuke jānāñā<br />chitta dṛḍha kari’ lao, dṛḍha kara hiyā” [45]
<span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–Once <span class="e2">jānāñā</span>–ask <span class="e2">prabhuke</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–about this matter. <span class="e2">kari’</span> <span class="e2">lao</span>–Make [your] <span class="e2">chitta</span>–mind <span class="e2">dṛḍha</span>–resolute, [and] <span class="e2">kara</span>–make [your] <span class="e2">hiyā</span>–heart <span class="e2">dṛḍha”</span>–resolute.”
[Svarūp Dāmodar concluded:] “You should once ask the Lord about this matter, and make your mind and heart resolute.”
তবে রঘুনাথ শ্রীমৎ প্রভুপদে গিয়া ।<br />ঠারে ঠোরে জিজ্ঞাসিল বিনীত হইয়া ॥৪৬॥
tabe raghunātha śrīmat prabhu-pade giyā<br />ṭhāre ṭhore jijñāsila vinīta ha-iyā [46]
<span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">giyā</span>–went <span class="e2">śrīmat</span> <span class="e2">prabhu-pade</span>–to the holy feet of the Lord [and] <span class="e2">vinīta</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–humbly <span class="e2">jijñāsila</span>–asked [Him about the matter] <span class="e2">ṭhāre</span> <span class="e2">ṭhore</span>–indirectly.
Raghunāth then went to the holy feet of the Lord and humbly asked Him about the matter indirectly.
প্রভু তারে আজ্ঞা দিল আমার সম্মুখে ।<br />রঘুনাথ আজ্ঞা পেয়ে ভজে মনসুখে ॥৪৭॥
prabhu tāre ājñā dila āmāra sammukhe<br />raghunātha ājñā peye bhaje mana-sukhe [47]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–instructed <span class="e2">tāre</span>–him <span class="e2">āmāra</span> <span class="e2">sammukhe</span>–in front of me. <span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">peye</span>–received [the Lord’s] <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–instructions [and then] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–served <span class="e2">mana-sukhe</span>–with joy in [his] heart.
The Lord instructed Raghunāth in front of me. He received the Lord’s instructions and then engaged in service with joy in his heart.
শ্রীরঘুনাথ-প্রতি শ্রীমন্মহাপ্রভুর আজ্ঞা
śrī-raghunātha-prati śrīman mahāprabhura ājñā
Śrīman Mahāprabhu’s instructions to Śrī Raghunāth
“গ্রাম্য কথা না শুনিবে, গ্রাম্য বার্তা না কহিবে ।<br />ভাল না খাইবে, আর ভাল না পরিবে ॥৪৮॥
“grāmya kathā nā śunibe, grāmya vārtā nā kahibe<br />bhāla nā khāibe, āra bhāla nā paribe [48]
<span class="e2">“śunibe nā</span>–“Do not listen <span class="e2">grāmya</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–to village talk, [and] <span class="e2">kahibe nā</span>–do not discuss <span class="e2">grāmya</span> <span class="e2">vārtā</span>–village matters. <span class="e2">khāibe nā</span>–Do not eat <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy [food] <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">paribe nā</span>–do not wear <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy [clothes].
“Do not listen to village talk or discuss village matters. Do not eat fancy food or wear fancy clothes.
অমানী, মানদ হঞা কৃষ্ণনাম সদা লবে ।<br />ব্রজে রাধাকৃষ্ণ-সেবা মানসে করিবে” ॥৪৯॥
amānī, mānada hañā kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā labe<br />vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā mānase karibe” [49]
<span class="e2">hañā</span>–Be <span class="e2">amānī</span>–prideless [and] <span class="e2">mānada</span>–respectful, <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">labe</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Name, [and,] <span class="e2">mānase</span>–within [your] heart, <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā karibe</span>–serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">vraje”</span>–in Vraja.”
“Be prideless and respectful, always chant Kṛṣṇa’s Name, and, within your heart, serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja.”
এই আজ্ঞা পাঞা রঘু বুঝিল তখন ।<br />পীরিতি না হয় কভু জড়েতে সাধন ॥৫০॥
ei ājñā pāñā raghu bujhila takhana<br />pīriti nā haya kabhu jaḍete sādhana [50]
<span class="e2">pāñā</span>–Upon receiving <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–instructions, <span class="e2">raghu</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">bujhila</span>–understood [that] <span class="e2">pīriti</span>–divine love <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span>–never <span class="e2">haya</span>–develops <span class="e2">sādhana</span> <span class="e2">jaḍete</span>–through material practices.
When Raghunāth received these instructions, he then understood that divine love never develops through material practices.
মানসেতে সিদ্ধদেহ করিয়া ভাবন ।<br />সেই দেহে রাধানাথের করিবে সেবন ॥৫১॥
mānasete siddha-deha kariyā bhāvana<br />sei dehe rādhānāthera karibe sevana [51]
<span class="e2">mānasete</span>–Within your heart, <span class="e2">bhāvana kariyā</span>–meditate <span class="e2">siddha-deha</span>–with [your] spiritual body [and] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">dehe</span>–in that body, <span class="e2">sevana karibe</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhānāthera</span>–the Lord of Rādhā.
Within your heart, meditate with your spiritual body, and in that body, serve the Lord of Rādhā.
অমানী মানদ ভাবে অকিঞ্চন হঞা ।<br />বৃক্ষ হেন সহিষ্ণুতা আপনে করিয়া ॥৫২॥
amānī mānada bhāve akiñchana hañā<br />vṛkṣa hena sahiṣṇutā āpane kariyā [52]
<span class="e2">amānī</span> <span class="e2">mānada</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–In a prideless and respectful manner, <span class="e2">akiñchana hañā</span>–be humble [and] <span class="e2">āpane</span>–personally <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–be <span class="e2">sahiṣṇutā</span>–tolerant <span class="e2">hena</span>–like <span class="e2">vṛkṣa</span>–a tree.
Be prideless, respectful, humble, and tolerant like a tree.
বাহ্যদেহে কৃষ্ণনাম সর্ব্বকাল গায় ।<br />অন্তর্দেহে থাকে রাধাকৃষ্ণের সেবায় ॥৫৩॥
bāhya-dehe kṛṣṇa-nāma sarva-kāla gāya<br />antar-dehe thāke rādhā-kṛṣṇera sevāya [53]
<span class="e2">bāhya-dehe</span>–In [your] external body, <span class="e2">sarva-kāla</span>–always <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">antar-dehe</span>–in your internal body, <span class="e2">sevāya thāke</span>–engage in service <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇera</span>–to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
In your external body, always chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, and in your internal body, serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
ভাল খাওয়া, ভাল পরা পরিত্যাগ করি’ ।<br />প্রাণবৃত্তি দ্বারা জড়দেহযাত্রা ধরি’ ॥৫৪॥
bhāla khāoyā, bhāla parā parityāga kari’<br />prāṇa-vṛtti dvārā jaḍa-deha-yātrā dhari’ [54]
<span class="e2">parityāga</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Give up <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy <span class="e2">khāoyā</span>–eating [and] <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–fancy <span class="e2">parā</span>–dressing, [and] <span class="e2">jaḍa-deha-yātrā</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–maintain [your] material body <span class="e2">dvārā</span>–with <span class="e2">prāṇa-vṛtti</span>–the necessities for life.
Give up fancy food and fancy clothes, and maintain your material body with the necessities for life.
মর্কট-বৈরাগ্য
markaṭa-vairāgī
The monkey renunciant
এই জড়দেহে রাধাকৃষ্ণ বুদ্ধ্যারোপ ।<br />মর্কট বৈরাগী করে সর্ব্বধর্ম্ম লোপ ॥৫৫॥
ei jaḍa-dehe rādhā-kṛṣṇa buddhyāropa<br />markaṭa vairāgī kare sarva-dharma lopa [55]
<span class="e2">markaṭa</span> <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–The monkey renunciant <span class="e2">buddhyāropa</span>–attributes a conception <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">jaḍa-dehe</span>–to the material body [and] <span class="e2">lopa kare</span>–disregards <span class="e2">sarva-dharma</span>–all principles.
The monkey renunciant attributes a conception of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa to the material body and disregards all principles.
প্রভু বলিয়াছেন, “মর্কট বৈরাগী সে জন ।<br />বৈরাগীর প্রায় থাকি’ করে প্রকৃতি-সম্ভাষণ” ॥৫৬॥
prabhu baliyāchhena, “markaṭa vairāgī se jana<br />vairāgīra prāya thāki’ kare prakṛti-sambhāṣaṇa” [56]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">baliyāchhena</span>–has said, <span class="e2">“se</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">thāki’</span>–act <span class="e2">vairāgīra</span> <span class="e2">prāya</span>–like renunciants [but] <span class="e2">prakṛti-sambhāṣaṇa kare</span>–converse with women [are] <span class="e2">markaṭa</span> <span class="e2">vairāgī”</span>–monkey renunciants.”
The Lord has said, “Those who act like renunciants but converse with women are monkey renunciants.”
বিশুদ্ধ বৈরাগী
viśuddha vairāgī
The pure renunciant
বিশুদ্ধ বৈরাগী করে নাম সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />মাগিয়া খাইয়া করে জীবন-যাপন ॥৫৭॥
viśuddha vairāgī kare nāma saṅkīrtana<br />māgiyā khāiyā kare jīvana-yāpana [57]
<span class="e2">viśuddha</span> <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–Pure renunciants <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana kare</span>–chant the Name [and] <span class="e2">jīvana-yāpana kare</span>–maintain [their] life <span class="e2">māgiyā</span>–by begging [and] <span class="e2">khāiyā</span>–eating.
Pure renunciants chant the Name and live by begging and eating.
বৈরাগী হইয়া যেবা করে পরাপেক্ষা ।<br />কার্যসিদ্ধি নহে, কৃষ্ণ করে উপেক্ষা ॥৫৮॥
vairāgī ha-iyā yebā kare parāpekṣā<br />kārya-siddhi nahe, kṛṣṇa kare upekṣā [58]
<span class="e2">yebā</span>–Those who <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–become <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–renunciants [but] <span class="e2">parāpekṣā kare</span>–depend on others <span class="e2">nahe</span>–do not become <span class="e2">kārya-siddhi</span>–successful, [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">upekṣā kare</span>–ignores [them].
Those who become renunciants but depend on others do not become successful, and Kṛṣṇa ignores them.
বৈরাগী হইয়া করে জিহ্বার লালস ।<br />পরমার্থ যায়, আর হয় রসের বশ ॥৫৯॥
vairāgī ha-iyā kare jihvāra lālasa<br />paramārtha yāya, āra haya rasera vaśa [59]
<span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Those who become <span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–renunciants [but] <span class="e2">jihvāra</span> <span class="e2">lālasa kare</span>–follow the cravings of the tongue <span class="e2">paramārtha</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away from spiritual life <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">rasera</span> <span class="e2">vaśa haya</span>–become controlled by tastes.
Those who become renunciants but indulge the cravings of the tongue stray from spiritual life and become controlled by material tastes.
বৈরাগী করিবে সদা নাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />শাক-পত্র-ফল-মূলে উদর ভরণ ॥৬০॥
vairāgī karibe sadā nāma-saṅkīrtana<br />śāka-patra-phala-mūle udara bharaṇa [60]
<span class="e2">vairāgī</span>–A renunciant <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana karibe</span>–should chant the Name <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always [and] <span class="e2">bharaṇa</span>–fill [their] <span class="e2">udara</span>–belly <span class="e2">śāka-patra-phala-mūle</span>–with leaves, vegetables, fruits, and roots.
A renunciant should always chant the Name and fill their belly with leaves, vegetables, fruits, and roots.
জিহ্বার লালসে যেই সমাজে বেড়ায় ।<br />শিশ্নোদরপরায়ণ কৃষ্ণ নাহি পায় ॥৬১॥
jihvāra lālase yei samāje beḍāya<br />śiśnodara-parāyaṇa kṛṣṇa nāhi pāya [61]
<span class="e2">yei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">beḍāya</span>–go out <span class="e2">samāje</span>–amidst society [under the control of] <span class="e2">jihvāra</span> <span class="e2">lālase</span>–the cravings of their tongue [become] <span class="e2">śiśnodara-parāyaṇa</span>–engrossed in the genitals and stomach, [and] <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–do not attain <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa.
Those who go out amidst society to indulge the cravings of their tongue become engrossed in their genitals and stomach, and do not attain Kṛṣṇa.

Chapter Seventeen
ভক্তভেদে আচারভেদ
Bhakta-bhede Āchāra-bheda
Different Practices <br />for Different Devotees
আর দিনে শ্রীস্বরূপ রঘুনাথে কয় ।<br />“তোমারে নিগূঢ় কিছু কহিব নিশ্চয়” ॥১॥
āra dine śrī-svarūpa raghunāthe kaya<br />“tomāre nigūḍha kichhu kahiba niśchaya” [1]
<span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">dine</span>–Another day, <span class="e2">śrī-svarūpa</span>–Śrī Svarūp <span class="e2">kaya</span>–said, <span class="e2">raghunāthe</span>–to Raghunāth, <span class="e2">“kahiba niśchaya</span>–“I will explain <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–something <span class="e2">nigūḍha</span>–confidential <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–to you.
Another day, Svarūp said to Raghunāth, “I will explain something confidential to you.
ভজনবিহীন-ধর্ম্ম কেবল কৈতব
bhajana-vihīna-dharma kevala kaitava
Dharma without devotion is simply deception
যে বর্ণেতে জন্ম যার যে আশ্রমে স্থিতি ।<br />তত্তদ্ধর্ম্মে দেহযাত্রা এই শুদ্ধ নীতি ॥২॥
ye varṇete janma yāra ye āśrame sthiti<br />tat-tad-dharme deha-yātrā ei śuddha nīti [2]
<span class="e2">deha-yātrā</span>–Maintaining the body <span class="e2">tat-tad-dharme</span>–according to the duties <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">varṇete</span>–of the class <span class="e2">yāra janma</span>–of one’s birth [and] <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">āśrame</span>–the order [in which one is] <span class="e2">sthiti</span>–situated [is] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">nīti</span>–the proper conduct.
“Maintaining the body according to the duties of the class in which one is born and the order in which one is situated is the proper conduct.
এইমতে দেহযাত্রা নির্বাহ করিয়া ।<br />নিরন্তর কৃষ্ণ ভজে একান্ত হইয়া ॥৩॥<br />সেই সে সুবোধ, সুধার্ম্মিক, সুবৈষ্ণব ।<br />ভজনবিহীন-ধর্ম্ম কেবল কৈতব ॥৪॥
ei-mate deha-yātrā nirvāha kariyā<br />nirantara kṛṣṇa bhaje ekānta ha-iyā [3]<br />sei se subodha, sudhārmika, suvaiṣṇava<br />bhajana-vihīna-dharma kevala kaitava [4]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">se</span>–Those who <span class="e2">deha-yātrā nirvāha</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–maintain the body <span class="e2">ei-mate</span>–in this way [and] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–always <span class="e2">ekānta</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–sincerely <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">subodha</span>–truly wise [and] <span class="e2">sudhārmika</span>–truly religious; [they are] <span class="e2">suvaiṣṇava</span>–true devotees. <span class="e2">bhajana-vihīna-dharma</span>–Religion (varṇāśram-dharma) without devotion, [however, is] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–simply <span class="e2">kaitava</span>–deception.
“Those who maintain the body in this way and always sincerely serve Kṛṣṇa, are truly wise, religious, and devoted. Dharma without devotion, however, is simply deception.
কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজে, করে ধর্ম্ম-আচরণ ।<br />অধঃপথে যায় তার মানব-জীবন ॥৫॥
kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaje, kare dharma-ācharaṇa<br />adhaḥ-pathe yāya tāra mānava-jīvana [5]
<span class="e2">mānava-jīvana</span>–The human life <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of those who <span class="e2">dharma-ācharaṇa kare</span>–practise dharma [but] <span class="e2">bhaje nāhi</span>–do not serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">adhaḥ-pathe</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–is ruined.
“The human life of those who practise dharma but do not serve Kṛṣṇa is ruined.
গৃহী, ব্রহ্মচারী, বানপ্রস্থ বা সন্ন্যাসী ।<br />কৃষ্ণভক্তিশূন্য অসম্ভাষ্য দিবানিশি ॥৬॥
gṛhī, brahmachārī, vānaprastha vā sannyāsī<br />kṛṣṇa-bhakti-śūnya asambhāṣya divā-niśi [6]
<span class="e2">gṛhī</span>–Householders, <span class="e2">brahmachārī</span>–students, <span class="e2">vānaprastha</span>–retired householders, <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">sannyāsī</span>–renunciants [who are] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti-śūnya</span>–devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">asambhāṣya</span>–should not be mixed with, <span class="e2">divā-niśi</span>–day [or] night.
“Do not mix, day or night, with householders, students, retired householders, or renunciants who are devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
সম্বন্ধজ্ঞানলাভ ও যুক্ত-বৈরাগ্য-আশ্রয়
sambandha-jñāna-lābha o yukta-vairāgya-āśraya
Acquiring knowledge of the soul’s relationship with the Lord and practising proper renunciation
সকলেই করিবেন যুক্ত-বৈরাগ্য-আশ্রয় ।<br />কৃষ্ণ ভজিবেন বুঝি’ সম্বন্ধ নিশ্চয় ॥৭॥
sakalei karibena yukta-vairāgya-āśraya<br />kṛṣṇa bhajibena bujhi’ sambandha niśchaya [7]
<span class="e2">sakalei</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">yukta-vairāgya-āśraya karibena</span>–should practise proper renunciation [and] <span class="e2">bhajibena</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">bujhi’</span>–understanding <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–clearly [their] <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–relationship with [Him].
“Everyone should practise proper renunciation and serve Kṛṣṇa with a clear understanding of their relationship with Him.
সম্বন্ধনির্ণয়ে হয় আলম্বন বোধ ।<br />শুদ্ধ-আলম্বন হৈলে হয় প্রেমের প্রবোধ ॥৮॥
sambandha-nirṇaye haya ālambana bodha<br />śuddha-ālambana haile haya premera prabodha [8]
<span class="e2">sambandha-nirṇaye</span>–By understanding that relationship, [its] <span class="e2">ālambana</span>–object (the Lord) <span class="e2">bodha haya</span>–is realised, [and] <span class="e2">śuddha-ālambana</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–when this proper object is realised, <span class="e2">haya</span>–there is <span class="e2">prabodha</span>–an awakening <span class="e2">premera</span>–of divine love.
“By understanding that relationship, its object (the Lord) is realised, and when this proper object is realised, divine love awakens.
প্রেমে কৃষ্ণ ভজে সেই বাপের ঠাকুর ।<br />প্রেমশূন্য জীব কেবল ছাঁচের কুকুর ॥৯॥
preme kṛṣṇa bhaje sei bāpera ṭhākura<br />prema-śūnya jīva kevala chhā̐chera kukura [9]
<span class="e2">sei bhaje</span>–Souls who serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">preme</span>–with love [are] <span class="e2">bāpera</span> <span class="e2">ṭhākura</span>–worshippable to their own fathers, [but] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">prema-śūnya</span>–devoid of divine love [are] <span class="e2">kevala</span>–merely <span class="e2">chhā̐chera</span> <span class="e2">kukura</span>–toy dogs.
“Souls who serve Kṛṣṇa with love are worshippable, even to their own fathers, but souls devoid of divine love are no better than toy dogs.
কৃষ্ণভক্তি আছে যার বৈষ্ণব সে জন ।<br />গৃহ ছাড়ি’ ভিক্ষা করে, না করে ভজন ।<br />বৈষ্ণব বলিয়া তারে না কর গণন ॥১০॥
kṛṣṇa-bhakti āchhe yāra vaiṣṇava se jana<br />gṛha chhāḍi’ bhikṣā kare, nā kare bhajana<br />vaiṣṇava baliyā tāre nā kara gaṇana [10]
