<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">jana yāra āchhe</span>–Those who have <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–devotees. <span class="e2">gaṇana kara nā</span>–Do not consider <span class="e2">tāre</span>–someone who <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–gives up [their] <span class="e2">gṛha</span>–home [and] <span class="e2">bhikṣā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–begs [but] <span class="e2">bhajana kare nā</span>–does not serve, <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–to be <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–a devotee.
“Those who have devotion to Kṛṣṇa are Vaiṣṇavas. Do not consider someone who gives up their home and begs but does not serve Kṛṣṇa to be a Vaiṣṇava.
অন্য দেব-নির্ম্মাল্যাদি না কর গ্রহণ ।<br />কর্ম্মকাণ্ডে কভু না মানিবে নিমন্ত্রণ ॥১১॥
anya deva-nirmālyādi nā kara grahaṇa<br />karma-kāṇḍe kabhu nā mānibe nimantraṇa [11]
<span class="e2">grahaṇa kara nā</span>–Do not accept <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">deva-nirmālyādi</span>–the remnants of other gods, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">mānibe</span>–accept <span class="e2">nimantraṇa</span>–invitations <span class="e2">karma-kāṇḍe</span>–to sacrifices performed for worldly gain.
“Do not accept the remnants of other gods, and never accept invitations to sacrifices performed for worldly gain.
গৃহী ও গৃহত্যাগী-বৈষ্ণবের আচার
gṛhī o gṛha-tyāgī-vaiṣṇavera āchāra
The practices of householder Vaiṣṇavas and Vaiṣṇavas who have renounced household life
গৃহী গৃহত্যাগী ভেদে বৈষ্ণব-বিচার ।<br />দুঁহে ভক্তি-অধিকারী পৃথক্ আচার ॥১২॥
gṛhī gṛha-tyāgī bhede vaiṣṇava-vichāra<br />du̐he bhakti-adhikārī pṛthak āchāra [12]
[There are] <span class="e2">bhede vaiṣṇava-vichāra</span>–different types of devotees: <span class="e2">gṛhī</span>–householders [and] <span class="e2">gṛha-tyāgī</span>–those who have renounced household life. <span class="e2">du̐he</span>–Both [are] <span class="e2">bhakti-adhikārī</span>–qualified for devotion, [but their] <span class="e2">āchāra</span>–practices [are] <span class="e2">pṛthak</span>–different.
“There are two types of Vaiṣṇavas: householders and renunciants. Both are qualified for devotion, but their practices are different.
দুঁহার চাহিয়ে যুক্ত-বৈরাগ্য বিধান ।<br />সুজ্ঞান, সুভক্তি দুঁহার সমপরিমাণ ॥১৩॥
du̐hāra chāhiye yukta-vairāgya vidhāna<br />sujñāna, subhakti du̐hāra sama-parimāṇa [13]
<span class="e2">chāhiye</span>–The requirement <span class="e2">du̐hāra</span>–of both [is] <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–the practice <span class="e2">yukta-vairāgya</span>–of proper renunciation. <span class="e2">du̐hāra</span>–Their <span class="e2">sujñāna</span>–pure knowledge [and] <span class="e2">subhakti</span>–pure devotion [are] <span class="e2">sama-parimāṇa</span>–of equal measure.
“Both are required to practise proper renunciation, and in terms of pure knowledge and pure devotion, they are equal.
গৃহস্থ-বৈষ্ণব কৃত্য
gṛhastha-vaiṣṇava kṛtya
The duties of householder devotees
গৃহস্থ-বৈষ্ণব সদা স্বধর্ম্মে অর্জ্জিবে ।<br />আতিথ্যাদি সেবা যথাসাধ্য আচরিবে ॥১৪॥
gṛhastha-vaiṣṇava sadā sva-dharme arjibe<br />ātithyādi sevā yathā-sādhya ācharibe [14]
<span class="e2">gṛhastha-vaiṣṇava</span>–Householder devotees [should] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">arjibe</span>–earn [their living] <span class="e2">sva-dharme</span>–according to their social duty (their varṇa and āśram), [and] <span class="e2">ācharibe</span>–practise <span class="e2">sevā</span>–serving <span class="e2">ātithyādi</span>–guests and others <span class="e2">yathā-sādhya</span>–to the best of [their] ability.
“Householder devotees should always earn their living according to their social duty, and they should serve guests and others to the best of their ability.
বৈধপত্নী সহবাসে নহে ভক্তি হানি ।<br />সার্ষপ সুতৈল ব্যবহারে নাহি দোষ মানি ॥১৫॥
vaidha-patnī sahavāse nahe bhakti hāni<br />sārṣapa sutaila vyavahāre nāhi doṣa māni [15]
<span class="e2">sahavāse</span>–Living with <span class="e2">vaidha-patnī</span>–a lawful wife <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is not <span class="e2">hāni</span>–a harm <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion, [and] <span class="e2">māni nāhi</span>–I do not consider <span class="e2">vyavahāre</span>–using <span class="e2">sārṣapa</span> <span class="e2">sutaila</span>–refined mustard oil <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–a fault.
“Living with a lawful wife is not harmful to devotion, and I do not consider using mustard oil to be a fault.
দধি দুগ্ধ স্মার্ত্ত-উপচরিত আমিষ ।<br />যুক্ত-বৈরাগীর হয় গ্রহণে নিরামিষ ॥১৬॥
dadhi dugdha smārta-upacharita āmiṣa<br />yukta-vairāgīra haya grahaṇe nirāmiṣa [16]
<span class="e2">dadhi</span>–Yoghurt [and] <span class="e2">dugdha</span>–milk <span class="e2">smārta-upacharita</span>–prepared according to the smṛti scriptures [are] <span class="e2">āmiṣa</span>–non-vegetarian, [but] <span class="e2">haya</span>–they become <span class="e2">nirāmiṣa</span>–vegetarian <span class="e2">yukta-vairāgīra</span> <span class="e2">grahaṇe</span>–through acceptance by a proper renunciant.
“Milk and yoghurt prepared according to smārta regulations are non-vegetarian, but they become vegetarian when they are accepted by proper renunciants.
গৃহস্থ-বৈষ্ণব সদা নামাপরাধ রাখি’ দূরে ।<br />আনুকূল্য লয়, প্রাতিকূল্য ত্যাগ করে ॥১৭॥
gṛhastha-vaiṣṇava sadā nāmāparādha rākhi’ dūre<br />ānukūlya laya, prātikūlya tyāga kare [17]
<span class="e2">gṛhastha-vaiṣṇava</span>–Householder devotees <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">dūre rākhi’</span>–avoid <span class="e2">nāmāparādha</span>–offences to the Name, <span class="e2">laya</span>–accept <span class="e2">ānukūlya</span>–the favourable, [and] <span class="e2">tyāga</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–reject <span class="e2">prātikūlya</span>–the unfavourable.
“Householder devotees always avoid offences to the Name, accept the favourable, and reject the unfavourable.
ঐকান্তিক নামাশ্রয় তাহার মহিমা ।<br />গৃহস্থ বৈষ্ণবের নাহি মাহাত্ম্যের সীমা ॥১৮॥
aikāntika nāmāśraya tāhāra mahimā<br />gṛhastha vaiṣṇavera nāhi māhātmyera sīmā [18]
<span class="e2">aikāntika</span>–Sincerely <span class="e2">nāmāśraya</span>–taking shelter of the Name [is] <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–their <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–glory. <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">sīmā</span>–limit <span class="e2">māhātmyera</span>–to the glories <span class="e2">gṛhastha</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavera</span>–of householder devotees.
“Sincerely taking shelter of the Name is a householder’s glory. The glories of householder devotees have no end.
পরহিংসা ত্যাগ, পর-উপকারে রত ।<br />সর্ব্বভূতে দয়া গৃহীর এইমাত্র ব্রত ॥১৯॥
para-hiṁsā tyāga, para-upakāre rata<br />sarva-bhūte dayā gṛhīra ei-mātra vrata [19]
<span class="e2">gṛhīra</span>–The householder’s <span class="e2">ei-mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">vrata</span>–duty [is] <span class="e2">tyāga</span>–to avoid <span class="e2">para-hiṁsā</span>–envy, <span class="e2">para-upakāre</span> <span class="e2">rata</span>–engage in helping others, [and] <span class="e2">sarva-bhūte</span> <span class="e2">dayā</span>–be compassionate to all beings.
“The householder’s only duty is to avoid envy, help others, and be compassionate to all beings.
গৃহত্যাগী বা বৈরাগী বৈষ্ণবের কৃত্য
gṛha-tyāgī vā vairāgī vaiṣṇavera kṛtya
The duties of renounced devotees who have given up household life
বৈরাগী বৈষ্ণব প্রাণবৃত্তি অঙ্গীকরি’ ।<br />অসঞ্চয় স্ত্রীসম্ভাষণশূন্য, ভজে হরি ॥২০॥
vairāgī vaiṣṇava prāṇa-vṛtti aṅgīkari’<br />asañchaya strī-sambhāṣaṇa-śūnya, bhaje hari [20]
<span class="e2">vairāgī</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–Renounced devotees <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">aṅgīkari’</span>–accept <span class="e2">prāṇa-vṛtti</span>–the necessities for life, <span class="e2">asañchaya</span>–do not accumulate [wealth, and] <span class="e2">strī-sambhāṣaṇa-śūnya</span>–do not converse with women.
“Renounced devotees serve the Lord, accept the necessities for life, do not accumulate wealth, and do not converse with women.
এইরূপ আচারভেদে সকল বৈষ্ণব ।<br />কৃষ্ণ ভজি’ পায় কৃষ্ণের অপ্রাকৃত বৈভব ॥২১॥
ei-rūpa āchāra-bhede sakala vaiṣṇava<br />kṛṣṇa bhaji’ pāya kṛṣṇera aprākṛta vaibhava [21]
<span class="e2">ei-rūpa</span>–In this way, <span class="e2">āchāra-bhede</span>–according to different practices, <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–devotees <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–realise <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">vaibhava</span>–the divine glory <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–of Kṛṣṇa.
“In this way, according to different practices, all devotees serve Kṛṣṇa and realise His divine glory.
বৈষ্ণবের কুটীনাটী নাই
vaiṣṇavera kuṭīnāṭī nāi
Vaiṣṇavas are not deceitful
গৃহী হউক ত্যাগী হউক ভক্তে ভেদ নাই ।<br />ভেদ কৈলে কুম্ভীপাক নরকেতে যাই ॥২২॥
gṛhī ha-uka tyāgī ha-uka bhakte bheda nāi<br />bheda kaile kumbhīpāka narakete yāi [22]
<span class="e2">nāi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">bheda</span>–difference <span class="e2">bhakte</span>–between devotees— <span class="e2">ha-uka</span>–be they <span class="e2">gṛhī</span>–householders [or] <span class="e2">ha-uka</span>–be they <span class="e2">tyāgī</span>–renunciants. <span class="e2">bheda</span> <span class="e2">kaile</span>–If someone makes distinctions [between them,] <span class="e2">yāi</span>–they go <span class="e2">kumbhīpāka</span> <span class="e2">narakete</span>–to the hell of boiling oil.
“There is no difference between devotees—be they householders or renunciants. If someone makes distinctions between them, they go to the hell of boiling oil.
মূল কথা, কুটীনাটী ব্যবহার যার ।<br />বৈষ্ণবকুলেতে সেই মহাকুলাঙ্গার ॥২৩॥
mūla kathā, kuṭīnāṭī vyavahāra yāra<br />vaiṣṇava-kulete sei mahākulāṅgāra [23]
<span class="e2">mūla</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–The main point [is that] <span class="e2">sei yāra</span>–those who <span class="e2">vyavahāra</span>–behave <span class="e2">kuṭīnāṭī</span>–deceitfully [are] <span class="e2">mahākulāṅgāra</span>–a great disgrace <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-kulete</span>–to the society of devotees.
“The main point is that those who behave deceitfully are a great disgrace to the society of Vaiṣṇavas.
সরল ভাবেতে গঠি’ নিজ ব্যবহার ।<br />জীবনে মরণে কৃষ্ণভক্তি জানি সার ॥২৪॥
sarala bhāvete gaṭhi’ nija vyavahāra<br />jīvane maraṇe kṛṣṇa-bhakti jāni sāra [24]
<span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">vyavahāra gaṭhi’</span>–Everyone should behave <span class="e2">sarala</span> <span class="e2">bhāvete</span>–in a sincere manner [and] <span class="e2">jāni</span>–know <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhakti</span>–devotion to Kṛṣṇa [to be] <span class="e2">sāra</span>–all-in-all, <span class="e2">jīvane</span>–in life [and] <span class="e2">maraṇe</span>–death.
“Everyone should behave in a sincere manner and know devotion to Kṛṣṇa to be all-in-all, in life and death.
কুটীনাটী কপটতা শাঠ্য কুটীলতা ।<br />না ছাড়িয়া হরি ভজে, তার দিন গেল বৃথা ॥২৫॥
kuṭīnāṭī kapaṭatā śāṭhya kuṭīlatā<br />nā chhāḍiyā hari bhaje, tāra dina gela vṛthā [25]
<span class="e2">dina</span>–The days <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of those who <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord [but] <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā nā</span>–do not give up <span class="e2">kuṭīnāṭī</span>–deceit, <span class="e2">kapaṭatā</span>–duplicity, <span class="e2">śāṭhya</span>–dishonesty, [and] <span class="e2">kuṭīlatā</span>–insincerity <span class="e2">gela</span>–pass <span class="e2">vṛthā</span>–in vain.
“Those who serve the Lord but do not give up deceit, duplicity, dishonesty, and insincerity pass their days in vain.
সেই সব ভাগবত কদর্থ করিয়া ।<br />ইন্দ্রিয় চরাঞা বুলে প্রকৃতি ভুলাইয়া ॥২৬॥
sei saba bhāgavata kadartha kariyā<br />indriya charāñā bule prakṛti bhulāiyā [26]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–They <span class="e2">kadartha</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–distort the meaning <span class="e2">bhāgavata</span>–of <span class="e33">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span>, [and] <span class="e2">bule</span>–roam about <span class="e2">charāñā</span>–enjoying <span class="e2">indriya</span>–the senses [and] <span class="e2">bhulāiyā</span>–seducing <span class="e2">prakṛti</span>–women.
“They distort the meaning of <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> and roam about enjoying the senses and seducing women.
ভাগবত-শ্লোক যথা
bhāgavata-śloka yathā
A verse from Śrīmad Bhāgavatam (10.33.36)
অনুগ্রহায় ভক্তানাং মানুষং দেহমাশ্রিতঃ ।<br />ভজতে তাদৃশীঃ ক্রীড়া যাঃ শ্রুত্বা তৎপরো ভবেৎ ॥২৭॥
anugrahāya bhaktānāṁ mānuṣaṁ deham āśritaḥ<br />bhajate tādṛśīḥ krīḍā yāḥ śrutvā tat-paro bhavet [27]
<span class="e2">anugrahāya</span>–To bestow mercy <span class="e2">bhaktānāṁ</span>–upon [His] devotees, <span class="e2">āśritaḥ</span>–Kṛṣṇa assumes <span class="e2">mānuṣaṁ</span> <span class="e2">deham</span>–a human-like form [and] <span class="e2">bhajate</span>–manifests <span class="e2">krīḍā</span>–Pastimes. <span class="e2">śrutvā</span>–Hearing <span class="e2">tādṛśīḥ</span> <span class="e2">yāḥ</span>–about them, <span class="e2">bhavet</span>–souls become <span class="e2">tat-paro</span>–devoted to Him.
“‘To bestow mercy upon His devotees, Kṛṣṇa assumes a human-like form and manifests His Pastimes. Those who hear about these Pastimes become devoted to Kṛṣṇa.’
লম্পট পাপিষ্ঠ আপনাকে কৃষ্ণ মানি’ ।<br />কৃষ্ণলীলা অনুকৃতি করে ধর্ম্মহানি ॥২৮॥
lampaṭa pāpiṣṭha āpanāke kṛṣṇa māni’<br />kṛṣṇa-līlā anukṛti kare dharma-hāni [28]
<span class="e2">lampaṭa</span> <span class="e2">pāpiṣṭha</span>–Lewd sinners <span class="e2">māni’</span>–consider <span class="e2">āpanāke</span>–themselves <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">anukṛti</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–imitate <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-līlā</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes, [and] <span class="e2">dharma-hāni</span>–desecrate religious principles.
“Lewd sinners consider themselves Kṛṣṇa, imitate Kṛṣṇa’s Pastimes, and desecrate dharma.
শুদ্ধভক্তের রাধাকৃষ্ণের সেবা
śuddha-bhaktera rādhā-kṛṣṇera sevā
A pure devotee’s service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa
শুদ্ধভক্ত ভক্তভাবে চিৎস্বরূপ হঞা ।<br />ব্রজে রাধাকৃষ্ণ সেবে সখীভাব লঞা ॥২৯॥
śuddha-bhakta bhakta-bhāve chit-svarūpa hañā<br />vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa seve sakhī-bhāva lañā [29]
<span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta</span>–Pure devotees <span class="e2">hañā</span>–attain [their] <span class="e2">chit-svarūpa</span>–spiritual form <span class="e2">bhakta-bhāve</span>–as a devotee [and] <span class="e2">seve</span>–serve <span class="e2">rādhā-kṛṣṇa</span>–Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja <span class="e2">lañā</span>–with <span class="e2">sakhī-bhāva</span>–the mood of a sakhī.
“Pure devotees attain their spiritual devotee form and serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja in the mood of a sakhī.
কৃষ্ণভাবে তৎপর হয় যে পামর ।<br />কুম্ভীপাক প্রাপ্ত হয় মরণের পর ॥৩০॥
kṛṣṇa-bhāve tat-para haya ye pāmara<br />kumbhīpāka prāpta haya maraṇera para [30]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">pāmara</span>–Fools who <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-bhāve</span> <span class="e2">tat-para</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–impersonate Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">prāpta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–go <span class="e2">kumbhīpāka</span>–to the hell of boiling oil <span class="e2">maraṇera</span> <span class="e2">para</span>–after death.
“Fools who impersonate Kṛṣṇa go to the hell of boiling oil after death.
অন্তরঙ্গ ভক্তি দেহে নহে, আত্মায়
antaraṅga bhakti dehe nahe, ātmāya
Confidential devotion exists within the heart—not the body
অন্তরঙ্গ ভক্তি মনে, দেহে কিছু নয় ।<br />কুটীনাটী বলে মূঢ় আচরণ হয় ॥৩১॥
antaraṅga bhakti mane, dehe kichhu naya<br />kuṭīnāṭī bale mūḍha ācharaṇa haya [31]
<span class="e2">antaraṅga</span>–Confidential <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion [is] <span class="e2">mane</span>–in the heart. <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–There is nothing <span class="e2">dehe</span>–within the body, [but] <span class="e2">mūḍha</span>–fools <span class="e2">kuṭīnāṭī</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–deceitfully <span class="e2">ācharaṇa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–imitate [it].
“Confidential devotion is in the heart, not the body, but fools deceitfully imitate it.
সেই সব অসৎসঙ্গ দূরে পরিহরি’ ।<br />কৃষ্ণ ভজে শুদ্ধভক্ত সিদ্ধদেহ ধরি ॥৩২॥
sei saba asat-saṅga dūre parihari’<br />kṛṣṇa bhaje śuddha-bhakta siddha-deha dhari’ [32]
<span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–Avoiding <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all such <span class="e2">asat-saṅga</span>–bad association, <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta</span>–pure devotees <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">siddha-deha</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–with [their] spiritual bodies.
“Avoiding all such forms of bad association, pure devotees serve Kṛṣṇa with their spiritual bodies.
কৃষ্ণই পুরুষ, আর সব প্রকৃতি
kṛṣṇa-i puruṣa, āra saba prakṛti
Kṛṣṇa is the only male; everyone else is female
ভক্তসব প্রকৃতি হইয়া মজে কৃষ্ণপায় ।<br />পুরুষ একলে কৃষ্ণ, দাস মহাশয়” ॥৩৩॥
bhakta-saba prakṛti ha-iyā maje kṛṣṇa-pāya<br />puruṣa ekale kṛṣṇa, dāsa mahāśaya” [33]
<span class="e2">bhakta-saba</span>–All devotees <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–are <span class="e2">prakṛti</span>–female [and] <span class="e2">maje</span>–revel <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-pāya</span>–in Kṛṣṇa’s feet. <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ekale</span>–alone [is] <span class="e2">puruṣa</span>–male, <span class="e2">dāsa</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya”</span>–O honour­able servant, Dās.”
“All devotees are female and revel in Kṛṣṇa’s feet. Kṛṣṇa is the only male, O Dās Mahāśay.”
রঘুনাথ দাস তবে বিনীত হইয়া ।<br />স্বরূপেরে নিবেদন করে দু’হাত জুড়িয়া ॥৩৪॥
raghunātha dāsa tabe vinīta ha-iyā<br />svarūpere nivedana kare du’hāta juḍiyā [34]
<span class="e2">raghunātha</span> <span class="e2">dāsa</span>–Raghunāth Dās <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">juḍiyā</span>–joined [his] <span class="e2">du’hāta</span>–two hands [and] <span class="e2">vinīta</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–humbly <span class="e2">nivedana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–spoke <span class="e2">svarūpere</span>–to Svarūp.
Raghunāth Dās joined his palms and humbly spoke to Svarūp.
“বল প্রভু, আছে এক জিজ্ঞাস্য আমার ।<br />স্বধর্ম্মবিহীনভক্তি সর্ব্বভক্তিসার ॥৩৫॥
“bala prabhu, āchhe eka jijñāsya āmāra<br />sva-dharma-vihīna-bhakti sarva-bhakti-sāra [35]
<span class="e2">“prabhu</span>–“Master, <span class="e2">bala</span>–please speak [to me]. <span class="e2">āmāra āchhe</span>–I have <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">jijñāsya</span>–question. <span class="e2">sva-dharma-vihīna-bhakti</span>–Devotion that is free from social duty (the duties of varṇa and āśram) [is] <span class="e2">sarva-bhakti-sāra</span>–the best of all forms of devotion.
“Master, I have a question. Please answer me. Devotion that is free from social duty is the best of all forms of devotion.
গৃহস্থ ও স্বধর্ম্ম
gṛhastha o svadharma
Householders and social duty
তবে কেন গৃহস্থ থাকিবে স্বধর্ম্মেতে ।<br />স্বধর্ম্ম ছাড়িয়া ভক্তি পারে ত’ করিতে” ॥৩৬॥
tabe kena gṛhastha thākibe svadharmete<br />svadharma chhāḍiyā bhakti pāre ta’ karite” [36]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–So <span class="e2">kena</span>–why [should] <span class="e2">gṛhastha</span>–householders <span class="e2">thākibe</span>–remain [engaged] <span class="e2">svadharmete</span>–in their social duty? <span class="e2">pāre</span>–They can <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–leave [their] <span class="e2">svadharma</span>–social duty [and] <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">karite</span>–practise <span class="e2">bhakti”</span>–devotion.”
“So why should householders remain engaged in their social duty when they can give it up and practise devotion?”
স্বরূপ বলে, “শুন, ভাই, ইহাতে যে মর্ম্ম ।<br />বলিব তোমাকে আমি শুদ্ধভক্তি ধর্ম্ম ॥৩৭॥
svarūpa bale, “śuna, bhāi, ihāte ye marma<br />baliba tomāke āmi śuddha-bhakti dharma [37]
<span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–Svarūp <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bhāi</span>–“Brother, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen! <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">baliba</span>–will explain <span class="e2">tomāke</span>–to you<span class="e2"> dharma</span>–the nature <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti</span>–of pure devotion, <span class="e2">ye</span>–which [is] <span class="e2">marma</span>–the essence <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–of this.
Svarūp replied, “Brother, listen! I will explain to you the nature of pure devotion, which is the essence of this matter.
স্বধর্ম্মে জীবনযাত্রা সহজে ঘটয় ।<br />পরধর্ম্মে কষ্ট আছে, স্বাভাবিক নয় ॥৩৮॥
svadharme jīvana-yātrā sahaje ghaṭaya<br />para-dharme kaṣṭa āchhe, svābhāvika naya [38]
[Your] <span class="e2">jīvana-yātrā</span>–livelihood <span class="e2">ghaṭaya</span>–is maintained <span class="e2">sahaje</span>–easily <span class="e2">svadharme</span>–by fol­lowing [your] own social duty; <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–there is <span class="e2">kaṣṭa</span>–difficulty <span class="e2">para-dharme</span>–in following someone else’s duty, [because] <span class="e2">naya</span>–it is not <span class="e2">svābhāvika</span>–natural.
“Your livelihood is easily maintained by following your own social duty; it is difficult to follow someone else’s duty because it is unnatural.
স্বধর্ম্মে ভক্তির অনুকূল যাহা হয় ।<br />তাই ভক্তিমান্ জন গ্রহণ করয় ॥৩৯॥<br />যাহা যখন ভক্তি-প্রতিকূল হঞা যায় ।<br />তাহা ত্যাগ করিলে ত’ শুদ্ধভক্তি পায় ॥৪০॥
svadharme bhaktira anukūla yāhā haya<br />tāi bhaktimān jana grahaṇa karaya [39]
yāhā yakhana bhakti-pratikūla hañā yāya<br />tāhā tyāga karile ta’ śuddha-bhakti pāya [40]
[When] <span class="e2">bhaktimān</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–devotees, <span class="e2">svadharme</span>–in the midst of [their] social duty, <span class="e2">grahaṇa</span> <span class="e2">karaya</span>–accept <span class="e2">tāi yāhā</span>–that which <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–to devotion [and] <span class="e2">tyāga</span> <span class="e2">karile</span>–avoid <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–things <span class="e2">yakhana</span>–when <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–they <span class="e2">hañā yāya</span>–become <span class="e2">bhakti-pratikūla</span>–unfavourable to devotion, [then] <span class="e2">pāya ta’</span>–they attain <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti</span>–pure devotion.
“When devotees, in the midst their social duty, accept everything that is favourable to devotion and avoid everything that is unfavourable to devotion, then they attain pure devotion.
অতএব স্বধর্ম্মনিষ্ঠা চিত্ত হইতে ত্যজি’ ।<br />ভক্তিনিষ্ঠা করিলেই সাধুধর্ম্ম ভজি’ ॥৪১॥
ataeva svadharma-niṣṭhā chitta ha-ite tyaji’<br />bhakti-niṣṭhā karilei sādhu-dharma bhaji’ [41]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, [only if] <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–they remove <span class="e2">svadharma-niṣṭhā</span>–attachment to [their] social duty <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from [their] <span class="e2">chitta</span>–heart [and] <span class="e2">bhakti-niṣṭhā</span> <span class="e2">karilei</span>–develop attachment to devotion [do they] <span class="e2">bhaji’</span>–follow <span class="e2">sādhu-dharma</span>–the duty of a sādhu.
“So, only if they remove attachment to their social duty from their heart and develop attachment to devotion do they follow the duty of a sādhu.
স্বধর্ম্মত্যাগের নাম নিষ্ঠাপরিহার ।<br />নিয়মাগ্রহ দূর হইলে হয় বৈষ্ণব আচার ॥৪২॥
svadharma-tyāgera nāma niṣṭhā-parihāra<br />niyamāgraha dūra ha-ile haya vaiṣṇava āchāra [42]
<span class="e2">svadharma-tyāgera</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–The phrase, ‘renouncing social duty’ [means] <span class="e2">niṣṭhā-parihāra</span>–giving up attachment [to it. When] <span class="e2">niyamāgraha</span>–excessive attachment to rules <span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">ha-ile</span>–withdraws, <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span> <span class="e2">āchāra</span>–Vaiṣṇava practice <span class="e2">haya</span>–takes place.
“‘Renouncing social duty’ means giving up attachment to it. When excessive attachment to the rules for social duty withdraws, Vaiṣṇava practice begins.
কৃষ্ণস্মৃতি বিধি; কৃষ্ণবিস্মৃতি নিষেধ
kṛṣṇa-smṛti vidhi; kṛṣṇa-vismṛti niṣedha
The rule is: remember Kṛṣṇa, <br />and the prohibition is: do not forget Kṛṣṇa
নিরন্তর কৃষ্ণস্মৃতি মূলবিধি ভাই ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণবিস্মৃতি যাহে নিষেধ মূল তাই” ॥৪৩॥
nirantara kṛṣṇa-smṛti mūla-vidhi bhāi<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-vismṛti yāhe niṣedha mūla tāi” [43]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–constant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-smṛti</span>–remembrance of Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">mūla-vidhi</span>–the fundamental rule, [and] <span class="e2">tāi yāhe</span>–that by which <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-vismṛti</span>–forgetfulness of Śrī Kṛṣṇa [occurs is] <span class="e2">mūla niṣedha”</span>–the fundamental prohibition.”
“Brother, constant remembrance of Kṛṣṇa is the fundamental rule, and forgetfulness of Kṛṣṇa is the fundamental prohibition.”
তবে রঘুনাথ বলে, “কথা এক আর ।<br />আজ্ঞা হয় শুনি যাহে বৈষ্ণব-বিচার ॥৪৪॥
tabe raghunātha bale, “kathā eka āra<br />ājñā haya śuni yāhe vaiṣṇava-vichāra [44]
<span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, [“There is] <span class="e2">“āra eka kathā</span>–another subject. <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–If you allow [me,] <span class="e2">śuni</span>–I would like to hear [further] <span class="e2">yāhe</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-vichāra</span>–explanation about Vaiṣṇavas.
Raghunāth said, “I have another subject to discuss. If you allow me, I would like to hear further explanation about Vaiṣṇavas.
শ্রীঅচ্যুতগোত্র ও স্বধর্ম্ম
śrī-achyuta-gotra o svadharma
The family of the Lord and social duty
শ্রীঅচ্যুতগোত্র বলি’ বৈষ্ণব-নির্দ্দেশ ।<br />ইহার তাৎপর্য কিবা, ইথে কি বিশেষ” ॥৪৫॥
śrī-achyuta-gotra bali’ vaiṣṇava-nirdeśa<br />ihāra tātparya kibā, ithe ki viśeṣa” [45]
<span class="e2">vaiṣṇava-nirdeśa bali’</span>–Devotees are identified as <span class="e2">śrī-achyuta-gotra</span>–the family of the Lord. <span class="e2">kibā</span>–What [is] <span class="e2">tātparya</span>–the meaning <span class="e2">ihāra</span>–of this? <span class="e2">ki</span>–What [is] <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–significant <span class="e2">ithe”</span>–in this regard?”
“Vaiṣṇavas are described as the family of the Lord. What is the meaning and significance of this?”
স্বরূপ বলে, “গৃহী, ত্যাগী উভয়ে সর্ব্বথা ।<br />এই গোত্রে অধিকারী নাহিক অন্যথা ॥৪৬॥
svarūpa bale, “gṛhī, tyāgī ubhaye sarvathā<br />ei gotre adhikārī nāhika anyathā [46]
<span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–Svarūp <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ubhaye</span>–Both <span class="e2">gṛhī</span>–householders [and] <span class="e2">tyāgī</span>–renunciants [are,] <span class="e2">sarvathā</span>–in all respects, <span class="e2">adhikārī</span>–members <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">gotre</span>–of this family [and] <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–no <span class="e2">anyathā</span>–other.
Svarūp said, “Both householders and renunciants are, in all respects, members of this family and no other.
শ্রীঅচ্যুতগোত্রে থাকে শুদ্ধভক্ত যত ।<br />স্বধর্ম্মনিষ্ঠায় কভু নাহি হয় রত ॥৪৭॥
śrī-achyuta-gotre thāke śuddha-bhakta yata<br />svadharma-niṣṭhāya kabhu nāhi haya rata [47]
<span class="e2">yata</span>–All <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakta</span>–pure devotees <span class="e2">thāke</span>–live <span class="e2">śrī-achyuta-gotre</span>–in the family of the Lord [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">svadharma-niṣṭhāya</span> <span class="e2">rata haya</span>–become attached to social duty.
“All pure devotees belong to the family of the Lord and never become attached to social duty.
সংসারের গোত্র ত্যজি’ কৃষ্ণগোত্র ভজে ।<br />সেই নিত্যগোত্র তার যেই বৈসে ব্রজে ॥৪৮॥
saṁsārera gotra tyaji’ kṛṣṇa-gotra bhaje<br />sei nitya-gotra tāra yei vaise vraje [48]
<span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–They leave behind [their]<span class="e2"> saṁsārera</span> <span class="e2">gotra</span>–worldly family [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-gotra</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s family. <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">yei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">vaise</span>–reside <span class="e2">vraje</span>–in Vraja [are part of] <span class="e2">sei</span>–that <span class="e2">nitya-gotra</span>–eternal family.
“They give up their worldly families and serve Kṛṣṇa’s family. Those who reside in Vraja are part of that eternal family.
কেহ বা স্বদেহে বৈসে ব্রজগোপী হঞা ।<br />কেহ বা আরোপসিদ্ধ-মানসে লইয়া ॥৪৯॥
keha vā svadehe vaise vraja-gopī hañā<br />keha vā āropa-siddha-mānase la-iyā [49]
<span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–Some <span class="e2">vaise</span>–reside <span class="e2">svadehe</span>–in [their] own body <span class="e2">hañā</span>–as <span class="e2">vraja-gopī</span>–a gopī of Vraja, [and] <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">vā</span>–some <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–practise <span class="e2">āropa-siddha-mānase</span>–ascription within their minds.
“Some reside in their spiritual body as Vraja-gopīs, and others practise ārop-siddhā* within their minds.
প্রবর্ত্ত, সাধক, সিদ্ধ
pravarta, sādhaka, siddha
Beginners, practitioners, and experts
প্রবর্ত্ত, সাধক, সিদ্ধ—তিন যে প্রকার ।<br />বুঝিতে পারিলে বুঝি ভক্তিধর্ম্মসার ॥৫০॥
pravarta, sādhaka, siddha—tina ye prakāra<br />bujhite pārile bujhi bhakti-dharma-sāra [50]
<span class="e2">pārile</span>–If you can <span class="e2">bujhite</span>–understand <span class="e2">ye</span>–the <span class="e2">tina</span>–three <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–classes [of devotees]— <span class="e2">pravarta</span>–beginners, <span class="e2">sādhaka</span>–practitioners, [and] <span class="e2">siddha</span>–experts— [then] <span class="e2">bujhi</span>–you can understand <span class="e2">bhakti-dharma-sāra</span>–the essence of devotional practice.
“If you can understand the three classes of devotees—beginners, practitioners, and experts—then you can understand the essence of devotional practice.
‘কনিষ্ঠাধিকারী’ হয় ‘প্রবর্ত্তে’ গণন ।<br />মধ্যমাধিকারী সাধক ভক্ত মহাজন ॥৫১॥
‘kaniṣṭhādhikārī’ haya ‘pravarte’ gaṇana<br />‘madhyamādhikārī’ ‘sādhaka’ bhakta mahājana [51]
<span class="e2">‘kaniṣṭhādhikārī’</span>–A kaniṣṭha adhikārī <span class="e2">gaṇana haya</span>–is counted <span class="e2">‘pravarte’</span>–as a beginner. <span class="e2">‘madhyamādhikārī’</span>–A madhyam adhikārī [is] <span class="e2">‘sādhaka’</span>–a practitioner, <span class="e2">bhakta</span> <span class="e2">mahājana</span>–a devotee, and a great soul.
“A kaniṣṭha adhikārī is considered a beginner. A madhyam adhikārī is a practitioner, a devotee, and a great soul.
‘উত্তমাধিকারী’ হয় ‘সিদ্ধ’ মহাশয় ।<br />হৃদয়ে স্বধর্ম্মনিষ্ঠা কভু না করয় ॥৫২॥
‘uttamādhikārī’ haya ‘siddha’ mahāśaya<br />hṛdaye svadharma-niṣṭhā kabhu nā karaya [52]
<span class="e2">‘uttamādhikārī’</span>–An uttam adhikārī <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span> <span class="e2">‘siddha’</span>–a worshippable expert, [and] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">svadharma-niṣṭhā</span> <span class="e2">karaya</span>–becomes attached to social duty <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–at heart.
“An uttam adhikārī is a worshippable expert and never becomes attached to social duty at heart.
* See 17.57.
মধ্যমাধিকারী আর উত্তমাধিকারী ।<br />সকলে অচ্যুতগোত্র দেখহ বিচারি’” ॥৫৩॥
madhyamādhikārī āra uttamādhikārī<br />sakale achyuta-gotra dekhaha vichāri’” [53]
<span class="e2">vichāri’ dekhaha</span>–Consider <span class="e2">sakale</span>–both <span class="e2">madhyamādhikārī</span>–practitioners <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">uttamādhikārī</span>–experts [to be part] <span class="e2">achyuta-gotra”</span>–of the family of the Lord.”
“Consider both practitioners and experts to be part of the family of the Lord.”
আরোপ
āropa
Ascription
রঘুনাথ বলে, “এবে আরোপ বুঝিব ।<br />তাৎপর্য বুঝিয়া সব সন্দেহ ত্যজিব” ॥৫৪॥
raghunātha bale, “ebe āropa bujhiba<br />tātparya bujhiyā saba sandeha tyajiba” [54]
<span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bujhiba</span>–“I wish to understand <span class="e2">āropa</span>–ascription <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now. <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–By understanding [its] <span class="e2">tātparya</span>–significance, <span class="e2">tyajiba</span>–I will give up <span class="e2">saba</span>–all [my] <span class="e2">sandeha</span>–doubts.
Raghunāth said, “I now wish to understand ascription. By understanding its significance, I will give up all my doubts.
দামোদর বলে, “শুন আরোপ-সন্ধান ।<br />ইহাতে চাহিয়ে ভক্তিস্বরূপের জ্ঞান ॥৫৫॥
dāmodara bale, “śuna āropa-sandhāna<br />ihāte chāhiye bhakti-svarūpera jñāna [55]
<span class="e2">dāmodara</span>–Dāmodar <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“śuna</span>–“Hear <span class="e2">āropa-sandhāna</span>–a description of ascription. <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–In this regard, <span class="e2">chāhiye</span>–you need <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">bhakti-svarūpera</span>–of the nature of devotion [itself].
Dāmodar said, “Hear now about ascription. To understand it, you need to understand the nature of devotion itself.
ত্রিবিধা বৈষ্ণবী ভক্তি
trividhā vaiṣṇavī bhakti
The three types of Vaiṣṇava devotion
ত্রিবিধা বৈষ্ণবী ভক্তি করহ বিচার ।<br />(১) ‘আরোপ-সিদ্ধা’, (২) ‘সঙ্গসিদ্ধা’, (৩) ‘স্বরূপ-সিদ্ধা’ আর ॥৫৬॥
trividhā vaiṣṇavī bhakti karaha vichāra<br />(1) ‘āropa-siddhā’, (2) ‘saṅga-siddhā’, (3) ‘svarūpa-siddhā’ āra [56]
<span class="e2">vichāra karaha</span>–Consider <span class="e2">trividhā</span>–the three types <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavī</span> <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–of Vaiṣṇava devotion: <span class="e2">‘āropa-siddhā’</span>–‘ārop-siddhā’, <span class="e2">‘saṅga-siddhā’</span>–‘saṅga-siddhā’, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">‘svarūpa-siddhā’</span>–‘svarūp-siddhā’.
“You should know that there are three types of Vaiṣṇava devotion: ārop-siddhā, saṅga-siddhā, and svarūp-siddhā.
(১) আরোপ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তি—কনিষ্ঠাধিকারীর
(1) āropa-siddhā bhakti—kaniṣṭhādhikārīra
(1) Devotion expressed through ascription is for the beginner
আরোপ-সিদ্ধার কথা বলিব প্রথমে ।<br />সুস্থির হইয়া বুঝ চিত্তের সংযমে ॥৫৭॥
āropa-siddhāra kathā baliba prathame<br />susthira ha-iyā bujha chittera saṁyame [57]
<span class="e2">prathame</span>–First, <span class="e2">āropa-siddhāra</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span> <span class="e2">baliba</span>–I will explain ārop-siddhā. <span class="e2">susthira ha-iyā</span>–Focus [and] <span class="e2">bujha</span>–understand [it] <span class="e2">chittera</span> <span class="e2">saṁyame</span>–with a controlled mind.
“First, I will explain ārop-siddhā. Focus and understand it with a controlled mind.
বদ্ধ বহির্ম্মুখ জীব বিষয়ী প্রধান ।<br />জড়সঙ্গমাত্র করি’ করে অবস্থান ॥৫৮॥
baddha bahirmukha jīva viṣayī pradhāna<br />jaḍa-saṅga-mātra kari’ kare avasthāna [58]
<span class="e2">baddha</span> <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Conditioned souls [who are] <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span>–averse [to the Lord are] <span class="e2">viṣayī</span> <span class="e2">pradhāna</span>–mostly materialists. <span class="e2">avasthāna kare</span>–They live [and] <span class="e2">saṅga-mātra</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–associate only <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–with matter.
“Conditioned souls who are averse to the Lord are mostly materialists and associate only with material things.
জড়সুখ জড়দুঃখ নিয়ত তাহার ।<br />প্রাকৃত সংসর্গ বিনা কিছু নাহি আর ॥৫৯॥
jaḍa-sukha jaḍa-duḥkha niyata tāhāra<br />prākṛta saṁsarga vinā kichhu nāhi āra [59]
<span class="e2">niyata</span>–Constantly, <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–their [experience] <span class="e2">jaḍa-sukha</span>–of material happiness [and] <span class="e2">jaḍa-duḥkha</span>–material sadness [takes places]. <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–They have no <span class="e2">saṁsarga</span>–connection <span class="e2">āra</span>–with anything <span class="e2">vinā</span>–other than <span class="e2">prākṛta</span>–matter.
“They are constantly engrossed in material happiness and sadness, and have no experience of anything other than matter.
অপ্রাকৃত বলি’ কিছু নাহি পায় জ্ঞান ।<br />অপ্রাকৃত-তত্ত্ব মনে নাহি পায় স্থান ॥৬০॥
aprākṛta bali’ kichhu nāhi pāya jñāna<br />aprākṛta-tattva mane nāhi pāya sthāna [60]
<span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–They have no <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge <span class="e2">bali’</span>–regarding <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–spirit, [and] <span class="e2">aprākṛta-tattva</span>–spiritual truth <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–finds no <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place <span class="e2">mane</span>–in [their] hearts.
“They know nothing about spirit, and there is no place for spiritual truth in their hearts.
নিজে অপ্রাকৃত বস্তু তাহাও না জানে ।<br />অরক্ষিত শিশু যেন সদাই অজ্ঞানে ॥৬১॥
nije aprākṛta vastu tāhāo nā jāne<br />arakṣita śiśu yena sadāi ajñāne [61]
<span class="e2">jāne nā</span>–They do not know <span class="e2">tāhāo</span>–even that <span class="e2">nije</span>–they [are] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">vastu</span>–spiritual beings. <span class="e2">yena</span>–Like <span class="e2">arakṣita</span>–uneducated <span class="e2">śiśu</span>–children, [they] <span class="e2">sadāi</span>–always [remain] <span class="e2">ajñāne</span>–ignorance.
“They do not even know that they are spiritual beings. Like uneducated children, they always remain in ignorance.
কোন ভাগ্যে কোন জন্মে সুকৃতির ফলে ।<br />শ্রদ্ধার উদয় হয় হৃদয়কমলে ॥৬২॥
kona bhāgye kona janme sukṛtira phale<br />śraddhāra udaya haya hṛdaya-kamale [62]
<span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">bhāgye</span>–By some good fortune, <span class="e2">kona</span> <span class="e2">janme</span>–in some birth, <span class="e2">sukṛtira</span> <span class="e2">phale</span>–as a result of sukṛti (rendering of service knowingly or unknowingly to the Lord or His paraphernalia), <span class="e2">śraddhāra</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–faith arises <span class="e2">hṛdaya-kamale</span>–in the lotus of their hearts.
“By some good fortune, in some birth, as a result of sukṛti, faith arises in the lotus of their hearts.
প্রথম সন্ধানে শুনে, ‘আমি কৃষ্ণদাস’ ।<br />এ সংসার হইতে উদ্ধারে করে আশ ॥৬৩॥
prathama sandhāne śune, ‘āmi kṛṣṇa-dāsa’<br />e saṁsāra haite uddhāre kare āśa [63]
<span class="e2">prathama</span>–At first, <span class="e2">sandhāne</span>–in the course of their search, <span class="e2">śune</span>–they hear, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–‘I [am] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-dāsa’</span>–a servant of Kṛṣṇa’, [and] <span class="e2">āśa kare</span>–aspire <span class="e2">uddhāre</span>–to be delivered <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–this world.
“At first, in the course of their search, they hear, ‘I am a servant of Kṛṣṇa’, and then they aspire to be delivered from saṁsāra.
কৃষ্ণার্চ্চন
kṛṣṇārchana
Worshipping Kṛṣṇa
গুরু বলে, ‘শুন, বাছা, কর কৃষ্ণার্চ্চন’ ।<br />কৃষ্ণার্চ্চনে তবে তার ইচ্ছা-সঙ্গঠন ॥৬৪॥
guru bale, ‘śuna, vāchhā, kara kṛṣṇārchana’<br />kṛṣṇārchane tabe tāra ichchhā-saṅgaṭhana [64]
[Their] <span class="e2">guru</span>–Guru <span class="e2">bale</span>–says [to them,] <span class="e2">‘śuna</span>–‘Listen! [My] <span class="e2">vāchhā</span>–child, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇārchana kara’</span>–you should worship Kṛṣṇa.’ <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">ichchhā-saṅgaṭhana</span>–they become eager <span class="e2">kṛṣṇārchane</span>–to worship Kṛṣṇa.
“Their Guru says to them, ‘Listen! My child, you should worship Kṛṣṇa’, and they then become eager to worship Kṛṣṇa.
কৃষ্ণ যে অপ্রাকৃত প্রভু, এই মাত্র শুনে ।<br />কৃষ্ণস্বরূপ অপ্রাকৃত তাহা নাহি জানে ॥৬৫॥
kṛṣṇa ye aprākṛta prabhu, ei mātra śune<br />kṛṣṇa-svarūpa aprākṛta tāhā nāhi jāne [65]
<span class="e2">śune</span>–They hear <span class="e2">mātra</span>–simply <span class="e2">ei ye</span>–that <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–spiritual [and that He is] <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–the Lord, [but] <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–they do not understand <span class="e2">tāhā aprākṛta kṛṣṇa-svarūpa</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s spiritual nature.
“They simply hear that Kṛṣṇa is spiritual and that He is the Lord, but they do not understand Kṛṣṇa’s spiritual nature.
নিজ চতুর্দিকে যাহা করে দরশনে ।<br />তঁহি মধ্যে ইষ্ট যাহা বুঝি দেখ মনে ॥৬৬॥
nija chatur-dike yāhā kare daraśane<br />ta̐hi madhye iṣṭa yāhā bujhi dekha mane [66]
<span class="e2">bujhi</span> <span class="e2">dekha</span> <span class="e2">mane</span>–They understand and regard <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–everything <span class="e2">ta̐hi</span> <span class="e2">madhye</span>–within <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–what <span class="e2">daraśane kare</span>–they see <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">chatur-dike</span>–in the four directions around them [is] <span class="e2">iṣṭa</span>–the Lord’s.
“They understand that everything they see around them belongs to the Lord.
ইষ্টদ্রব্যে ইষ্টমূর্ত্তির করয় পূজন ।<br />এই স্থলে হয় তার আরোপ-চিন্তন ॥৬৭॥
iṣṭa-dravye iṣṭa-mūrtira karaya pūjana<br />ei sthale haya tāra āropa-chintana [67]
<span class="e2">iṣṭa-mūrtira</span> <span class="e2">pūjana karaya</span>–They [then] worship the Lord’s form <span class="e2">iṣṭa-dravye</span>–with the Lord’s paraphernalia. <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">sthale</span>–At this stage, <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">āropa-chintana haya</span>–they practise ascription.
“They then worship the Lord’s form with the Lord’s paraphernalia. At this stage, they practise ascription.
মনুষ্যমূরতি এক করিয়া গঠন ।<br />গন্ধ-পুষ্প-ধূপ-দীপে করয়ে অর্চ্চন ॥৬৮॥
manuṣya-mūrati eka kariyā gaṭhana<br />gandha-puṣpa-dhūpa-dīpe karaye archana [68]
<span class="e2">gaṭhana kariyā</span>–They make <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">manuṣya-mūrati</span>–human form [and] <span class="e2">archana karaye</span>–worship [Him] <span class="e2">gandha-puṣpa-dhūpa-dīpe</span>–with fragrances, flowers, incense, and lamps.
“They make a human-like form of the Lord and worship Him with fragrances, flowers, incense, and lamps.
আরোপ-বুদ্ধ্যে ভাবে সব অপ্রাকৃত ধন ।<br />আরোপ চিন্তিয়া কভু অপ্রাকৃতাপন ॥৬৯॥
āropa-buddhye bhāve saba aprākṛta dhana<br />āropa chintiyā kabhu aprākṛtāpana [69]
<span class="e2">āropa-buddhye</span>–By understanding ascription, <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–they consider [that] <span class="e2">saba</span>–everything [is] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">dhana</span>–property, [and] <span class="e2">āropa</span> <span class="e2">chintiyā</span>–by practising ascription, [they] <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–sometimes <span class="e2">aprākṛtāpana</span>–perceive spiritual reality.
“By understanding ascription, they consider that everything is spiritual property, and by practising ascription, they sometimes perceive spiritual reality.
ইহাতে যে কর্ম্মার্পণ আরোপের স্থল ।<br />আরোপে ক্রমশঃ ভক্তিতত্ত্বে পায় বল ॥৭০॥
ihāte ye karmārpaṇa āropera sthala<br />ārope kramaśaḥ bhakti-tattve pāya bala [70]
<span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">karmārpaṇa</span>–The offering of actions [to the Lord] <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–in this way [is] <span class="e2">āropera</span> <span class="e2">sthala</span>–the stage of ascription, [and] <span class="e2">ārope</span>–through ascription, [souls] <span class="e2">kramaśaḥ</span>–gradually <span class="e2">pāya</span>–develop <span class="e2">bala</span>–strength <span class="e2">bhakti-tattve</span>–in devotion.
“Offering actions to the Lord in this way is the practice of ascription, and through it, souls gradually develop devotional strength.
এই ত’ আরোপ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তির লক্ষণ ।<br />কনিষ্ঠাধিকারীর হয় এই সমর্চ্চন ॥৭১॥
ei ta’ āropa-siddhā bhaktira lakṣaṇa<br />kaniṣṭhādhikārīra haya ei samarchana [71]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–These [are] <span class="e2">lakṣaṇa</span>–the characteristics <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion <span class="e2">āropa-siddhā</span>–expressed through ascription. <span class="e2">kaniṣṭhādhikārīra</span> <span class="e2">ei samarchana</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–Beginners perform such worship.
“These are the characteristics of ārop-siddhā devotion. Beginners perform worship in this way.
তত্ত্ববোধে শ্রীমূর্ত্তি পূজা
tattva-bodhe śrī-mūrti-pūjā
Worshipping the Deity with realisation
তত্ত্বটী বুঝিয়া যবে শ্রীমূর্ত্তি পূজয় ।<br />তবে মধ্যম অধিকার হয় ত’ উদয় ॥৭২॥
tattvaṭī bujhiyā yabe śrī-mūrti pūjaya<br />tabe madhyama adhikāra haya ta’ udaya [72]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">pūjaya</span>–they worship <span class="e2">śrī-mūrti</span>–the Deity <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–understanding <span class="e2">tattvaṭī</span>–the Lord’s nature, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">madhyama</span> <span class="e2">adhikāra</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">ta’ haya</span>–they rise to the inter­mediate stage.
“When beginners worship the Deity and come to understand the Lord’s nature, they rise to the intermediate stage.
উত্তমাধিকারীর আরোপের নাহি স্থান ।<br />মানসে অপ্রাকৃত তত্ত্বের পায় ত’ সন্ধান ॥৭৩॥
uttamādhikārīra āropera nāhi sthāna<br />mānase aprākṛta tattvera pāya ta’ sandhāna [73]
<span class="e2">āropera</span> <span class="e2">sthāna nāhi</span>–Ascription has no position <span class="e2">uttamādhikārīra</span>–for experts: <span class="e2">sandhāna ta’ pāya</span>–they perceive <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">tattvera</span>–spiritual reality [directly] <span class="e2">mānase</span>–within [their] hearts.
“Experts do not practise ascription: they directly perceive spiritual reality within their hearts.
প্রেমের উদয় হয় প্রেমচক্ষে হেরি’ ।<br />প্রাণেশ্বর ভজে পূর্ব্ব-আরোপ দূর করি’ ॥৭৪॥
premera udaya haya prema-chakṣe heri’<br />prāṇeśvara bhaje pūrva-āropa dūra kari’ [74]
<span class="e2">premera</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–Divine love arises [within them, and] <span class="e2">heri’</span>–they [begin to] see <span class="e2">prema-chakṣe</span>–with the eyes of that love. <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–They serve <span class="e2">prāṇeśvara</span>–the Lord of their heart, [and] <span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–give up [their] <span class="e2">pūrva-āropa</span>–previous [practice of] ascription.
“Divine love arises in them, and they begin to see with the eyes of that love. They serve the Lord of their heart and give up their previous practice of ascription.
ভক্তি স্বভাবতঃ নহে হেন কর্ম্মার্পণে ।<br />আরোপ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তিমধ্যে হয় ত’ গণনে ॥৭৫॥
bhakti svabhāvataḥ nahe hena karmārpaṇe<br />āropa-siddhā bhakti-madhye haya ta’ gaṇane [75]
<span class="e2">svabhāvataḥ</span>–By nature, <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is not <span class="e2">hena</span>–like <span class="e2">karmārpaṇe</span>–offering actions. [Still,] <span class="e2">āropa-siddhā</span>–ascription <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">gaṇane</span>–counted <span class="e2">bhakti-madhye</span>–within devotion.
“By nature, devotion is not the same as offering actions. Still, ascription is considered a type of devotion.
(১) আরোপ-সিদ্ধার মূল তত্ত্ব
(1) āropa-siddhāra mūla tattva
(1) The key principle of ascription
আরোপ-সিদ্ধার এক মূলতত্ত্ব এই ।<br />জড়বস্তু, জড়কর্ম্ম ভক্তিভাবে লই ॥৭৬॥
āropa-siddhāra eka mūla-tattva ei<br />jaḍa-vastu jaḍa-karma bhakti-bhāve la-i [76]
<span class="e2">ei eka</span>–The <span class="e2">mūla-tattva</span>–key principle <span class="e2">āropa-siddhāra</span>–within ascription [is] <span class="e2">la-i</span>–using <span class="e2">jaḍa-vastu</span>–material objects [and] <span class="e2">jaḍa-karma</span>–material actions <span class="e2">bhakti-bhāve</span>–in a devo­tional way.
“The key principle within ascription is to use material objects and actions in a devotional way.
জড়বস্তু, জড়কর্ম্মমধ্যে ঘৃণ্য যাহা ।<br />অর্পণেও ভক্তি নাহি হয় কভু তাহা ॥৭৭॥
jaḍa-vastu, jaḍa-karma-madhye ghṛṇya yāhā<br />arpaṇeo bhakti nāhi haya kabhu tāhā [77]
<span class="e2">arpaṇeo</span>–By offering [the Lord], however, <span class="e2">tāhā yāhā</span>–that which [is] <span class="e2">ghṛṇya</span>–objectionable <span class="e2">jaḍa-karma-madhye</span>–amongst material actions [and] <span class="e2">jaḍa-vastu</span>–material objects, <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion <span class="e2">kabhu nāhi</span>–never <span class="e2">haya</span>–comes about.
“Offering the Lord objectionable material objects and actions, however, is never devotion.
উপাদেয় ইষ্ট বলি’ কর্ম্মার্পণ করে ।<br />‘আরোপ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তি’ বলি’ বলিব তাহারে ॥৭৮॥
upādeya iṣṭa bali’ karmārpaṇa kare<br />‘āropa-siddhā bhakti’ bali’ baliba tāhāre [78]
<span class="e2">karmārpaṇa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–Offering actions [to the Lord] <span class="e2">upādeya</span> <span class="e2">iṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">bali’</span>–considering [them] pleasing to the Lord— <span class="e2">tāhāre</span>–that <span class="e2">bali’ baliba</span>–I will consider to be <span class="e2">‘āropa-siddhā bhakti’</span>–devotion expressed through ascription.
“I consider offering the Lord actions that are pleasing to Him to be ārop-siddhā devotion.
মায়াবাদে অর্চ্চনাঙ্গ আরোপ-লক্ষণ ।<br />ভক্তিবাদে স্বরূপসিদ্ধা ভক্তির দর্শন ॥৭৯॥
māyāvāde archanāṅga āropa-lakṣaṇa<br />bhaktivāde svarūpa-siddhā bhaktira darśana [79]
<span class="e2">māyāvāde</span>–According to illusionist principles, <span class="e2">archanāṅga</span>–the practice of worship [has] <span class="e2">āropa-lakṣaṇa</span>–the characteristics of ascription, [but] <span class="e2">bhaktivāde</span>–according to devotional principles, [worship is also] <span class="e2">darśana</span>–seen <span class="e2">svarūpa-siddhā</span> <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–[as a type] of self-manifest devotion.
“According to illusionist principles, worshipping the Lord is a form of ascription, but according to devotional principles, it is also seen as a type of self-manifest* devotion.
* See 17.83.
(২) সঙ্গ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তি
(2) saṅga-siddhā bhakti
(2) Devotion expressed as associated qualities
এবে শুন, ‘সঙ্গ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তি’ যেই রূপ ।<br />শুদ্ধজ্ঞান সুবৈরাগ্য সঙ্গসিদ্ধার স্বরূপ ॥৮০॥
ebe śuna, ‘saṅga-siddhā bhakti’ yei rūpa<br />śuddha-jñāna suvairāgya saṅga-siddhāra svarūpa [80]
<span class="e2">ebe</span>–Now <span class="e2">śuna</span>–hear <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–about <span class="e2">‘saṅga-siddhā</span> <span class="e2">bhakti’</span>–devotion expressed as associated qualities. <span class="e2">śuddha-jñāna</span>–Pure knowledge [and] <span class="e2">suvairāgya</span>–proper renunciation [are] <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the forms <span class="e2">saṅga-siddhāra</span>–of saṅga-siddhā [devotion].
“Now hear about saṅga-siddhā devotion. Pure knowledge and proper renunciation are themselves saṅga-siddhā devotion.
যথা ভক্তি তথা যুক্তবৈরাগ্য শুদ্ধজ্ঞান ।<br />সাহচর্য্যে সঙ্গসিদ্ধ বুঝহ সন্ধান ॥৮১॥
yathā bhakti tathā yukta-vairāgya śuddha-jñāna<br />sāhacharye saṅga-siddha bujhaha sandhāna [81]
<span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–Wherever [there is] <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion, [there is] <span class="e2">śuddha-jñāna</span>–pure knowledge [and] <span class="e2">yukta-vairāgya</span>–proper renunciation. <span class="e2">sāhacharye</span>–With the help [of this principle], <span class="e2">bujhaha</span>–understand <span class="e2">sandhāna</span>–the nature <span class="e2">saṅga-siddha</span>–of saṅga-siddhā [devotion].
“Wherever there is devotion, there is pure knowledge and proper renunciation. With this principle, understand the nature of saṅga-siddhā devotion.
দৈন্য দয়া সহিষ্ণুতা ভক্তি-সহচর ।<br />সঙ্গসিদ্ধ-ভক্তি-অঙ্গ জান অতঃপর ॥৮২॥
dainya dayā sahiṣṇutā bhakti-sahachara<br />saṅga-siddha-bhakti-aṅga jāna ataḥpara [82]
<span class="e2">dainya</span>–Humility, <span class="e2">dayā</span>–compassion, [and] <span class="e2">sahiṣṇutā</span>–tolerance, <span class="e2">bhakti-sahachara</span>–accompany devotion. <span class="e2">ataḥpara</span>–From now on, <span class="e2">jāna</span>–you know <span class="e2">saṅga-siddha-bhakti-aṅga</span>–the limbs of saṅga-siddhā devotion.
“Humility, compassion, and tolerance also accompany devotion. You now know the limbs of saṅga-siddhā devotion.
(৩) স্বরূপ-সিদ্ধা ভক্তি
(3) svarūpa-siddhā bhakti
(3) Self-manifest devotion
সাক্ষাৎ ভক্তির কার্য্য যাহাতে নিশ্চয় ।<br />‘স্বরূপসিদ্ধা ভক্তি’র ক্রিয়া তাহাই হয় ॥৮৩॥
sākṣāt bhaktira kārya yāhāte niśchaya<br />‘svarūpa-siddhā bhakti’ra kriyā tāhāi haya [83]
<span class="e2">tāhāi yāhāte</span>–That by which <span class="e2">kārya</span>–an act <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span> <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion itself <span class="e2">haya</span>–takes place [is] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">kriyā</span>–an act <span class="e2">‘svarūpa-siddhā</span> <span class="e2">bhakti’ra</span>–of self-manifest devotion.
“An act of svarūp-siddhā devotion is an act of devotion itself.
শ্রবণ-কীর্ত্তন-আদি নববিধ ভজন ।<br />স্বরূপসিদ্ধা ভক্তি বলি’ তন্নামকীর্ত্তন ॥৮৪॥
śravaṇa-kīrtana-ādi nava-vidha bhajana<br />svarūpa-siddhā bhakti bali’ tan-nāma-kīrtana [84]
<span class="e2">nava-vidha</span> <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–The nine types of service— <span class="e2">śravaṇa-kīrtana-ādi</span>–hearing, chanting, remembering, attending, worshipping, praying, serving, befriending, and surrendering— [are] <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">tan-nāma-kīrtana</span>–renowned by the name <span class="e2">svarūpa-siddhā</span> <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–‘svarūp-siddhā devotion’.
“The nine types of service—hearing, chanting, and so on—are known as svarūp-siddhā devotion.
কৃষ্ণেতে সাক্ষাৎ তাহাদের মুখ্যগতি ।<br />আরোপসিদ্ধা, সঙ্গসিদ্ধার গৌণভাবে স্থিতি ॥৮৫॥
kṛṣṇete sākṣāt tāhādera mukhya-gati<br />āropa-siddhā, saṅga-siddhāra gauṇa-bhāve sthiti [85]
<span class="e2">tāhādera</span>–Their <span class="e2">mukhya-gati</span>–main focus [is] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇete</span> <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span>–Kṛṣṇa Himself, [and] <span class="e2">āropa-siddhā</span>–ārop-siddhā [devotion and] <span class="e2">saṅga-siddhāra</span>–saṅga-siddhā [devotion are] <span class="e2">sthiti</span>–situated [within them] <span class="e2">gauṇa-bhāve</span>–secondarily.
“The main focus of these practices is Kṛṣṇa Himself, and ārop-siddhā and saṅga-siddhā devotion are present within them secondarily.
স্বতঃসিদ্ধ আত্মবৃত্তি শুদ্ধভক্তিসার ।<br />বদ্ধজীবে মনোবৃত্তে উদয় তাহার ॥৮৬॥<br />কৃষ্ণোন্মুখ জড়দেহে তাহার বিস্তৃতি ।<br />এ জগতে ভক্তিদেবীর এইরূপ স্থিতি ॥৮৭॥
svataḥ-siddha ātma-vṛtti śuddha-bhakti sāra<br />baddha-jīve mano-vṛtte udaya tāhāra [86]
kṛṣṇonmukha jaḍa-dehe tāhāra vistṛti<br />e jagate bhakti-devīra ei-rūpa sthiti [87]
<span class="e2">sāra</span>–The essence <span class="e2">svataḥ-siddha</span> <span class="e2">ātma-vṛtti</span>–of the natural propensity of the soul [is] <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti</span>–pure devotion. <span class="e2">tāhāra udaya</span>–It arises <span class="e2">mano-vṛtte</span>–in the mental functioning <span class="e2">baddha-jīve</span>–of a conditioned soul [and] <span class="e2">tāhāra vistṛti</span>–expands [as] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇonmukha</span>–inclination towards Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">jaḍa-dehe</span>–in [their] material body. <span class="e2">bhakti-devīra sthiti</span>–The goddess of devotion exists <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">jagate</span>–in this world <span class="e2">ei-rūpa</span>–in this way.
“The essence of the natural propensity of the soul is pure devotion. It arises in the mind of a conditioned soul and expands as inclination towards Kṛṣṇa within their material body. This is how the goddess of devotion exists in this world.
ত্রিবিধা ভক্তির ত্রিবিধা ক্রিয়া
trividhā bhaktir trividhā kriyā
The three functions of the three types of devotion
সেই ভক্তি ‘স্বরূপসিদ্ধা’ সাক্ষাৎ ক্রিয়া যথা ।<br />‘সঙ্গসিদ্ধা’ সহচর সাহায্যে সর্ব্বথা ॥৮৮॥
sei bhakti ‘svarūpa-siddhā’ sākṣāt kriyā yathā<br />‘saṅga-siddhā’ sahachara sāhāye sarvathā [88]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–Where [there is] <span class="e2">kriyā</span>–an act [of devotion] <span class="e2">sākṣāt</span>–itself, <span class="e2">sei</span>–such <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion [is] <span class="e2">‘svarūpa-siddhā’</span>–svarūp-siddhā [devotion]. <span class="e2">‘saṅga-siddhā’</span>–Saṅga-siddhā [devotion] <span class="e2">sāhāye</span>–assists [and] <span class="e2">sahachara</span>–accompanies [svarūp-siddhā devotion] <span class="e2">sarvathā</span>–everywhere.
“An act of devotion itself is svarūp-siddhā devotion. Saṅga-siddhā devotion assists and accompanies svarūp-siddhā devotion everywhere.
‘আরোপসিদ্ধা’ হয় যথা প্রাকৃত বস্তু ক্রিয়া ।<br />অপ্রাকৃত ভাবে সাধে প্রাকৃত নাশিয়া” ॥৮৯॥
‘āropa-siddhā’ haya yathā prākṛta vastu kriyā<br />aprākṛta bhāve sādhe prākṛta nāśiyā” [89]
<span class="e2">‘āropa-siddhā’</span>–Ārop-siddhā devotion <span class="e2">haya</span>–takes place <span class="e2">yathā</span>–where [there are] <span class="e2">prākṛta</span>–material <span class="e2">vastu</span>–objects [and] <span class="e2">kriyā</span>–actions. [When] <span class="e2">sādhe</span>–practised <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">bhāve</span>–in a spiritual manner, [it] <span class="e2">nāśiyā</span>–conquers <span class="e2">prākṛta”</span>–material nature.”
“Ārop-siddhā devotion is practised in connection with material objects and actions. When practised with realisation of spirit, it conquers material nature.”
স্বরূপের উপদেশে, বুঝে রঘুনাথ ।<br />পীরিতি-স্বরূপতত্ত্ব জগাইয়ের সাথ ॥৯০॥
svarūpera upadeśe, bujhe raghunātha<br />pīriti-svarūpa-tattva jagāiyera sātha [90]
<span class="e2">upadeśe</span>–Through the advice <span class="e2">svarūpera</span>–of Svarūp, <span class="e2">raghunātha</span>–Raghunāth <span class="e2">bujhe</span>–understood <span class="e2">pīriti-svarūpa-tattva</span>–the nature of love <span class="e2">jagāiyera</span> <span class="e2">sātha</span>–in the company of Jagāi.
Through Svarūp’s advice, Raghunāth understood the nature of love in the company of Jagāi.

Chapter Eighteen
শ্রীএকাদশী
Śrī-Ekādaśī
Śrī Ekādaśī
একদিন গৌরহরি	শ্রীগুণ্ডিচা পরিহরি’<br />	‘জগন্নাথ বল্লভে’ বসিলা ।<br />শুদ্ধা একাদশী দিনে	কৃষ্ণনাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে<br />	দিবস রজনী কাটাইলা ॥১॥
eka-dina gaurahari	śrī-guṇḍichā parihari’<br />	‘jagannātha-vallabhe’ vasilā<br />śuddhā ekādaśī dine	kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane<br />	divasa rajanī kāṭāilā [1]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">gaurahari</span>–Gaurahari <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–left <span class="e2">śrī-guṇḍichā</span>–Śrī Guṇḍichā [and] <span class="e2">vasilā</span>–sat <span class="e2">‘jagannātha-vallabhe’</span>–in the Jagannāth Vallabha garden. <span class="e2">dine</span>–On the day <span class="e2">śuddhā</span> <span class="e2">ekādaśī</span>–of pure Ekādaśī (the day on which Ekādaśī begins before dawn), <span class="e2">kāṭāilā</span>–the Lord spent <span class="e2">divasa</span>–the day [and] <span class="e2">rajanī</span>–night <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
One day, Gaurahari left the Guṇḍichā Temple and sat in the Jagannāth Vallabha garden. It was pure Ekādaśī, and the Lord spent the whole day and night chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
সঙ্গে স্বরূপদামোদর	রামানন্দ, বক্রেশ্বর<br />	আর যত ক্ষেত্রবাসিগণ ।<br />প্রভু বলে, “একমনে	কৃষ্ণনাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে<br />	নিদ্রাহার করিয়ে বর্জ্জন ॥২॥
saṅge svarūpa-dāmodara	rāmānanda vakreśvara<br />	āra yata kṣetra-vāsi-gaṇa<br />prabhu bale, “ekamane	kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane<br />	nidrāhāra kariye varjana [2]
<span class="e2">svarūpa-dāmodara</span>–Svarūp Dāmodar, <span class="e2">rāmānanda</span>–Rāmānanda, <span class="e2">vakreśvara</span>–Vakreśvar, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">kṣetra-vāsi-gaṇa</span>–other residents of Śrī Kṣetra (Jagannāth Purī) [were there] <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with [the Lord]. <span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“ekamane</span>–“Single-mindedly <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa [and] <span class="e2">varjana kariye</span>–avoid <span class="e2">nidrāhāra</span>–sleeping and eating.
Svarūp Dāmodar, Rāmānanda Rāy, Vakreśvar Paṇḍit, and the other devotees residing in Śrī Kṣetra were there with Him. The Lord said, “Single-mindedly chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa and avoid sleeping and eating.
কেহ কর সঙ্খ্যানাম	কেহ দণ্ড-পরণাম<br />	কেল বল রামকৃষ্ণকথা” ।<br />যথা তথা পড়ি’ সবে	‘গোবিন্দ’ ‘গোবিন্দ’ রবে<br />	মহাপ্রেমে প্রমত্ত সর্ব্বথা ॥৩॥
keha kara saṅkhyā-nāma	keha daṇḍa-paraṇāma<br />	keha bala rāma-kṛṣṇa-kathā”<br />yathā tathā paḍi’ sabe	‘govinda’ ‘govinda’ rave<br />	mahāpreme pramatta sarvathā [3]
<span class="e2">keha</span>–Some of you <span class="e2">kara</span>–should <span class="e2">saṅkhyā-nāma</span>–chant japa, <span class="e2">keha</span>–some of you [should] <span class="e2">daṇḍa-paraṇāma</span>–offer obeisances, [and] <span class="e2">keha</span>–some of you <span class="e2">kathā bala</span>–should speak <span class="e2">rāma-kṛṣṇa”</span>–about Balarām and Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–Bowing <span class="e2">yathā</span> <span class="e2">tathā</span>–wherever [they were,] <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">rave</span>–chanted <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span> <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span>–“Govinda! Govinda!” [and became] <span class="e2">sarvathā</span>–completely <span class="e2">pramatta</span>–intoxicated <span class="e2">mahāpreme</span>–with intense divine love.
“Some of you should chant japa, some of you should offer obeisances, and some of you should speak about Balarām and Kṛṣṇa.” Bowing wherever they were, everyone chanted, “Govinda! Govinda!” and became completely intoxicated with intense divine love.
হেন কালে গোপীনাথ	পড়িছা সার্ব্বভৌম সাথ<br />	গুণ্ডিচা-প্রসাদ লঞা আইল ।<br />অন্নব্যঞ্জন, পিঠা, পানা,	পরমান্ন, দধি, ছানা<br />	মহাপ্রভু-অগ্রেতে ধরিল ॥৪॥
hena kāle gopīnātha	paḍichhā sārvabhauma sātha<br />	guṇḍichā-prasāda lañā āila<br />anna-vyañjana, pīṭhā, pānā,	paramānna, dadhi, chhānā,<br />	mahāprabhu-agrete dharila [4]
<span class="e2">hena</span> <span class="e2">kāle</span>–At that time, <span class="e2">gopīnātha</span>–Gopīnāth, <span class="e2">paḍichhā</span>–Tulasī Paḍichhā, <span class="e2">sārvabhauma sātha</span>–and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya <span class="e2">lañā</span> <span class="e2">āila</span>–brought <span class="e2">guṇḍichā-prasāda</span>–prasād from the Guṇḍichā Temple. <span class="e2">dharila</span>–They placed <span class="e2">anna-vyañjana</span>–rice, vegetables, <span class="e2">pīṭhā</span>–pancakes, <span class="e2">pānā</span>–sherbert, <span class="e2">paramānna</span>–sweet rice, <span class="e2">dadhi</span>–yoghurt, [and] <span class="e2">chhānā</span>–curd <span class="e2">mahāprabhu-agrete</span>–before Mahāprabhu.
At that time, Gopīnāth Āchārya, Tulasī Paḍichhā, and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya brought prasād from the Guṇḍichā Temple. They placed rice, vegetables, pancakes, sherbert, sweet rice, yoghurt, and curd before Mahāprabhu.
প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় সবে	দণ্ডবৎ পড়ি’ তবে<br />	মহাপ্রসাদ বন্দিয়া বন্দিয়া ।<br />ত্রিযামা রজনী সবে	মহাপ্রেমে মগ্নভাবে<br />	অকৈতবে নামে কাটাইয়া ॥৫॥
prabhura ājñāya sabe	daṇḍavat paḍi’ tabe<br />	mahāprasāda vandiyā vandiyā<br />triyāmā rajanī sabe	mahāpreme magna-bhāve<br />	akaitave nāme kāṭāiyā [5]
<span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">ājñāya</span>–On the Lord’s order, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–bowed down [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">vandiyā</span> <span class="e2">vandiyā</span>–offered prayers <span class="e2">mahāprasāda</span>–to the mahāprasād. <span class="e2">sabe</span>–They <span class="e2">kāṭāiyā</span>–spent <span class="e2">triyāmā</span> <span class="e2">rajanī</span>–the entire night <span class="e2">akaitave</span>–earnestly <span class="e2">nāme</span>–chanting the Name, <span class="e2">magna-bhāve</span>–immersed <span class="e2">mahāpreme</span>–in intense divine love.
On the Lord’s order, everyone bowed down and offered prayers to the mahāprasād. Then they spent the entire night earnestly chanting the Name, immersed in intense divine love.
প্রভু-আজ্ঞা শিরে ধরি’	প্রাতঃস্নান সবে করি’<br />	মহাপ্রসাদ সেবায় পারণ ।<br />করি’ হৃষ্ট চিত্ত সবে	প্রভুর চরণে তবে<br />	করযোড়ে করে নিবেদন ॥৬॥
prabhu-ājñā śire dhari’	prātaḥ-snāna sabe kari’<br />	mahāprasāda sevāya pāraṇa<br />kari’ hṛṣṭa chitta sabe	prabhura charaṇe tabe<br />	kara-yoḍe kare nivedana [6]
<span class="e2">dhari’</span>–Holding <span class="e2">prabhu-ājñā</span>–the Lord’s order <span class="e2">śire</span>–on [their] heads, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–everyone <span class="e2">prātaḥ-snāna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–bathed in the morning, [and then] <span class="e2">pāraṇa</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–broke the fast <span class="e2">sevāya</span>–by honouring <span class="e2">mahāprasāda</span>–the mahāprasād. <span class="e2">hṛṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">chitta</span>–With joyful hearts [and] <span class="e2">kara-yoḍe</span>–joined palms, <span class="e2">sabe</span>–they <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">nivedana kare</span>–made an appeal <span class="e2">prabhura</span> <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet of the Lord.
Holding the Lord’s order on their heads, everyone bathed in the morning, and then broke their fast by honouring the mahāprasād. With joyful hearts and joined palms, the devotees then made an appeal at the feet of the Lord.
শ্রীক্ষেত্রে শ্রীএকাদশী
śrī-kṣetre śrī-ekādaśī
Śrī Ekādaśī in Śrī Kṣetra
“সর্ব্বব্রত-শিরোমণি	শ্রীহরিবাসরে জানি<br />	নিরাহারে করি জাগরণ ।<br />জগন্নাথ-প্রসাদান্ন	ক্ষেত্রে সর্ব্বকালে মান্য<br />	পাইলেই করিয়ে ভক্ষণ ॥৭॥
“sarva-vrata-śiromaṇi	śrī-hari-vāsare jāni<br />	nirāhāre kari jāgaraṇa<br />jagannātha-prasādānna	kṣetre sarva-kāle mānya<br />	pāilei kariye bhakṣaṇa [7]
<span class="e2">“jāni</span>–We know [that] <span class="e2">sarva-vrata-śiromaṇi</span>–the crown jewel of all rites [is] <span class="e2">jāgaraṇa kari</span>–staying awake [all night] <span class="e2">nirāhāre</span>–without food or water <span class="e2">śrī-hari-vāsare</span>–on the day of the Lord (pure Ekādaśī or Mahādvādaśī) [and that] <span class="e2">kṣetre</span>–in Śrī Kṣetra, <span class="e2">jagannātha-prasādānna</span>–Jagannāth’s prasād <span class="e2">mānya</span>–should be honoured <span class="e2">sarva-kāle</span>–at all times. <span class="e2">pāilei</span>–Whenever one receives [it,] <span class="e2">bhakṣaṇa kariye</span>–one should eat [it].
“We know that the crown jewel of all rites is to stay awake all night without food or water on the day of the Lord. We also know that in Śrī Kṣetra, Jagannāth’s prasād should be honoured at all times and should be eaten whenever it is received.
এ সঙ্কটে ক্ষেত্রবাসে	মনে হয় বড় ত্রাসে<br />	স্পষ্ট আজ্ঞা করিয়ে প্রার্থনা ।<br />সর্ব্ববেদ আজ্ঞা তব	যাহা মানে ব্রহ্মা শিব<br />	তাহা দিয়া ঘুচাও যাতনা” ॥৮॥
e saṅkaṭe kṣetra-vāse	mane haya baḍa trāse<br />	spaṣṭa ājñā kariye prārthanā<br />sarva-veda ājñā tava	yāhā māne brahmā śiva<br />	tāhā diyā ghuchāo yātanā” [8]
<span class="e2">kṣetra-vāse</span>–Living in Śrī Kṣetra <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">saṅkaṭe</span>–with this dilemma, <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">trāse haya</span>–we feel great fear <span class="e2">mane</span>–in [our] minds. [Our] <span class="e2">prārthanā</span>–prayer [is that] <span class="e2">spaṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">ājñā</span> <span class="e2">kariye</span>–You give [us] a clear instruction. <span class="e2">sarva-veda</span>–All the Vedas [are] <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your <span class="e2">ājñā</span>–instructions, <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā [and] <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">māne</span>–follow. <span class="e2">ghuchāo</span>–Please put an end [to our] <span class="e2">yātanā</span>–confusion <span class="e2">diyā</span>–by giving [us] <span class="e2">tāhā”</span>–that [such an instruction].”
“We live in Śrī Kṣetra and are very afraid because of this dilemma, so we pray that You give us a clear instruction. All the Vedas are Your instructions, and Brahmā and Śiva follow them. Please put an end to our confusion by giving us an instruction.”
শ্রীমহাপ্রভুর বিচার
śrī-mahāprabhur vichāra
Śrīman Mahāprabhu’s conclusion
প্রভু বলে, “ভক্তি-অঙ্গে	একাদশী-মান-ভঙ্গে<br />	সর্ব্বনাশ উপস্থিত হয় ।<br />প্রসাদ-পূজন করি’	পরদিনে পাইলে তরি<br />	তিথি পরদিনে নাহি রয় ॥৯॥
prabhu bale, “bhakti-aṅge	ekādaśī-māna-bhaṅge<br />	sarva-nāśa upasthita haya<br />prasāda-pūjana kari’	para-dine pāile tari<br />	tithi para-dine nāhi raya [9]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“bhakti-aṅge</span> <span class="e2">ekādaśī-māna-bhaṅge</span>–By failing to observe the devotional practice of Ekādaśī, <span class="e2">sarva-nāśa</span> <span class="e2">upasthita</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–total ruination occurs. <span class="e2">prasāda-pūjana</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–If you worship the prasād [and] <span class="e2">pāile</span>–take it <span class="e2">para-dine</span>–the following day, <span class="e2">tari</span>–you will cross over [this dilemma because] <span class="e2">tithi</span>–the lunar day <span class="e2">raya nāhi</span>–does not continue <span class="e2">para-dine</span>–the next day.
The Lord said, “Failing to observe the practice of Ekādaśī leads to total ruination. If you worship the prasād (on Ekādaśī) and take it the following day, you will cross over this dilemma because the period of Ekādaśī always ends the next day.
শ্রীহরিবাসর-দিনে	কৃষ্ণনামরসপানে<br />	তৃপ্ত হয় বৈষ্ণব সুজন ।<br />অন্য রস নাহি লয়	অন্য কথা নাহি কয়<br />	সর্ব্বভোগ করয়ে বর্জ্জন ॥১০॥
śrī-hari-vāsara-dine	kṛṣṇa-nāma-rasa-pāne<br />	tṛpta haya vaiṣṇava sujana<br />anya rasa nāhi laya	anya kathā nāhi kaya<br />	sarva-bhoga karaye varjana [10]
<span class="e2">śrī-hari-vāsara-dine</span>–On the day of the Lord, <span class="e2">sujana vaiṣṇava</span>–pure devotees <span class="e2">tṛpta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are satisfied <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-rasa-pāne</span>–by drinking the rasa of Kṛṣṇa’s Name. <span class="e2">laya nāhi</span>–They do not partake <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">rasa</span>–of any other rasa, [and] <span class="e2">kaya nāhi</span>–do not speak <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–about any other subject. <span class="e2">varjana karaye</span>–They avoid <span class="e2">sarva-bhoga</span>–all [forms of] enjoyment.
“On the day of the Lord, pure devotees are satisfied by drinking the rasa of Kṛṣṇa’s Name. They do not partake of any other rasa or speak about anything else. They avoid all forms of enjoyment.
প্রসাদ ভোজন নিত্য	শুদ্ধ বৈষ্ণবের কৃত্য<br />	অপ্রসাদ না করে ভক্ষণ ।<br />শুদ্ধা একাদশী যবে	নিরাহার থাকে তবে<br />	পারণেতে প্রসাদ ভোজন ॥১১॥
prasāda bhojana nitya	śuddha vaiṣṇavera kṛtya<br />	aprasāda nā kare bhakṣaṇa<br />śuddhā ekādaśī yabe 	nirāhāra thāke tabe<br />	pāraṇete prasāda bhojana [11]
<span class="e2">bhojana</span>–Taking <span class="e2">prasāda</span>–prasād [is] <span class="e2">nitya kṛtya</span>–the daily activity <span class="e2">śuddha vaiṣṇavera</span>–of pure devotees; <span class="e2">bhakṣaṇa kare nā</span>–they do not eat <span class="e2">aprasāda</span>–non-prasād. <span class="e2">yabe</span>–When [it is] <span class="e2">śuddhā</span> <span class="e2">ekādaśī</span>–pure Ekādaśī, <span class="e2">nirāhāra</span> <span class="e2">thāke</span>–they fast, [however, and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">prasāda</span> <span class="e2">bhojana</span>–they take prasād <span class="e2">pāraṇete</span>–to break the fast.
“Taking prasād is a daily activity of pure devotees; they do not eat anything that is not prasād. On pure Ekādaśī, however, they fast and then take prasād to break their fast (the following day).
অনুকল্পস্থানমাত্র	নিরন্ন প্রসাদপাত্র<br />	বৈষ্ণবকে জানিহ নিশ্চিত ।<br />অবৈষ্ণব জন যারা	প্রসাদ-ছলেতে তারা<br />	ভোগে হয় দিবানিশি রত ।<br />পাপপুরুষের সঙ্গে	অন্নাহার করে রঙ্গে<br />	নাহি মানে হরিবাসর-ব্রত ॥১২॥
anukalpa-sthāna-mātra	niranna prasāda-pātra<br />	vaiṣṇavake jāniha niśchita<br />avaiṣṇava jana yārā	prasāda-chhalete tārā<br />	bhoge haya divā-niśi rata<br />pāpa-puruṣera saṅge	annāhāra kare raṅge<br />	nāhi māne hari-vāsara-vrata [12]
<span class="e2">vaiṣṇavake jāniha</span>–Devotees should know <span class="e2">niśchita</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only <span class="e2">niranna</span>–non-grain <span class="e2">prasāda-pātra</span>–prasād [is] <span class="e2">anukalpa-sthāna</span>–a supplement [acceptable on Ekādaśī]. <span class="e2">tārā yārā</span>–Those who [are] <span class="e2">avaiṣṇava</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–non-devotees <span class="e2">bhoge rata</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–enjoy <span class="e2">divā-niśi</span>–day and night <span class="e2">prasāda-chhalete</span>–on the pretence of [honouring] prasād. <span class="e2">raṅge</span>–Lightheartedly, <span class="e2">annāhāra</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–they eat grains <span class="e2">pāpa-puruṣera</span> <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–with the association of the personification of sin [and] <span class="e2">māne nāhi</span>–disregard <span class="e2">hari-vāsara-vrata</span>–the rite for the day of the Lord.
“Devotees should know for certain that non-grain prasād is the only supplement acceptable on Ekādaśī. Non-devotees enjoy day and night using prasād as an excuse. Lightheartedly, they eat grains in which the personification of sin is present and disregard the rite for the day of the Lord.
ভক্তি-অঙ্গ সদাচার	ভক্তির সম্মান কর<br />	ভক্তি-দেবী-কৃপা-লাভ হবে ।<br />অবৈষ্ণবসঙ্গ ছাড়	একাদশীব্রত ধর<br />	নামব্রতে একাদশী তবে ॥১৩॥
bhakti-aṅga sadāchāra	bhaktira sammāna kara<br />	bhakti-devī-kṛpā-lābha habe<br />avaiṣṇava-saṅga chhāḍa	ekādaśī-vrata dhara<br />	nāma-vrate ekādaśī tabe [13]
<span class="e2">bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">sammāna</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Everyone should devoutly honour [and] <span class="e2">bhakti-aṅga</span> <span class="e2">sadāchāra</span>–properly perform the practices of devotion. [Then] <span class="e2">bhakti-devī-kṛpā-lābha</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–they will attain the grace of the goddess of devotion. [So,] <span class="e2">chhāḍa</span>–reject <span class="e2">avaiṣṇava-saṅga</span>–the association of non-devotees [and] <span class="e2">dhara</span>–follow <span class="e2">ekādaśī-vrata</span>–the Ekādaśī rite <span class="e2">nāma-vrate</span>–by following the rite of chanting the Name. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then [your observance] <span class="e2">ekādaśī</span>–of Ekādaśī [will be successful].
“Everyone should devoutly honour and properly perform the practices of devotion. Then they will attain the grace of Bhakti Devī. So, reject the association of non-devotees and follow the Ekādaśī rite by following the rite of chanting the Name. Then your observance of Ekādaśī will be successful.
প্রসাদসেবন আর শ্রীহরিবাসরে ।<br />বিরোধ না করে কভু বুঝহ অন্তরে ॥১৪॥
prasāda-sevana āra śrī-hari-vāsare<br />virodha nā kare kabhu bujhaha antare [14]
<span class="e2">bujhaha</span>–Understand <span class="e2">antare</span>–within [your] heart [that] <span class="e2">prasāda-sevana</span>–honouring prasād <span class="e2">āra</span>–and [honouring] <span class="e2">śrī-hari-vāsare</span>–the day of the Lord <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span>–never <span class="e2">virodha</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–conflict.
“Understand within your heart that honouring prasād and honouring the day of the Lord never conflict.
এক অঙ্গ মানে, আর অন্য অঙ্গে দ্বেষ ।<br />যে করে নির্ব্বোধ সেই, জানহ বিশেষ ॥১৫॥
eka aṅga māne, āra anya aṅge dveṣa<br />ye kare nirbodha sei, jānaha viśeṣa [15]
<span class="e2">sei ye</span>–Those who <span class="e2">māne</span>–follow <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">aṅga</span>–one practice <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">dveṣa kare</span>–disregard <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">aṅge</span>–the other practices [are] <span class="e2">nirbodha</span>–foolish. <span class="e2">jānaha</span>–Know [this] <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span>–for certain.
“Those who follow one practice of devotion but disregard the others are foolish. Know this for certain.
যে অঙ্গের যেই দেশকালবিধিব্রত ।<br />তাহাতে একান্তভাবে হও ভক্তিরত ॥১৬॥
ye aṅgera yei deśa-kāla-vidhi-vrata<br />tāhāte ekānta-bhāve hao bhakti-rata [16]
<span class="e2">ekānta-bhāve</span>–Sincerely <span class="e2">bhakti-rata hao</span>–devote yourself <span class="e2">tāhāte ye</span> <span class="e2">aṅgera</span>–to each practice <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">deśa-kāla-vidhi-vrata</span>–according to its place, time, rules, and rites.
“Sincerely devote yourself to each practice according to its place, time, rules, and rites.
সর্ব্ব অঙ্গের অধিপতি ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ।<br />যাহে তেঁহ তুষ্ট তাহা করহ পালন ॥১৭॥
sarva aṅgera adhipati vrajendra-nandana<br />yāhe te̐ha tuṣṭa tāhā karaha pālana [17]
<span class="e2">vrajendra-nandana</span>–The prince of Vraja [is] <span class="e2">adhipati</span>–the enjoyer <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">aṅgera</span>–of all the practices, [so] <span class="e2">pālana karaha</span>–adhere <span class="e2">tāhā yāhe</span>–to that by which <span class="e2">te̐ha</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">tuṣṭa</span>–pleased.
“Kṛṣṇa is the enjoyer of all devotional practices, so adhere to what pleases Him.
একাদশী-দিনে নিদ্রাহার বিসর্জ্জন ।<br />অন্য দিনে প্রসাদ নির্ম্মাল্য সুসেবন” ॥১৮॥
ekādaśī-dine nidrāhāra visarjana<br />anya dine prasāda nirmālya susevana” [18]
<span class="e2">ekādaśī-dine</span>–On the day of Ekādaśī, <span class="e2">visarjana</span>–give up <span class="e2">nidrāhāra</span>–sleep and food, [and] <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">dine</span>–on the following day, <span class="e2">susevana</span>–fully honour <span class="e2">prasāda</span>–prasād [and] <span class="e2">nirmālya”</span>–the other remnants of the Lord.”
“On the day of Ekādaśī, give up sleep and food, and on the following day, fully honour prasād and the other remnants of the Lord.”
শুনিয়া বৈষ্ণব সব	আনন্দে গোবিন্দরব<br />	দণ্ডবৎ পড়িলেন তবে ।<br />স্বরূপাদি রামানন্দ	পাইলেন মহানন্দ<br />	‘উড়িয়া’ ‘গৌড়িয়া’ ভক্ত সবে ॥১৯॥
śuniyā vaiṣṇava saba	ānande govinda-rava<br />	daṇḍavat paḍilena tabe<br />svarūpādi rāmānanda	pāilena mahānanda<br />	‘uḍiyā’ ‘gauḍiyā’ bhakta sabe [19]
