<span class="e2">śuniyā</span>–Hearing [this,] <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">ānande</span>–joyfully <span class="e2">govinda-rava</span>–chanted, “Govinda!” [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">daṇḍavat</span> <span class="e2">paḍilena</span>–bowed down. <span class="e2">svarūpādi</span> <span class="e2">rāmānanda</span>–Svarūp, Rāmānanda, [and] <span class="e2">bhakta</span> <span class="e2">sabe</span>–all the devotees <span class="e2">‘uḍiyā’</span> <span class="e2">‘gauḍīyā’</span>–from Odisha and Gauḍa <span class="e2">pāilena</span>–felt <span class="e2">mahānanda</span>–great joy.
Hearing this, all the devotees joyfully chanted, “Govinda!” and bowed down. Svarūp Dāmodar, Rāmānanda Rāy, and all the devotees from Odisha and Gauḍa were overjoyed.
ওহে ভাই!<br />	গৌরাঙ্গ আমার প্রাণধন ।<br />অকৈতবে ভজ তাঁরে	যাবে তবে ভবপারে<br />	শীতল হইবে তনুমন ॥২০॥
ohe bhāi!<br />	gaurāṅga āmāra prāṇa-dhana<br />akaitave bhaja tā̐re	yābe tabe bhava-pāre<br />	śītala ha-ibe tanu-mana [20]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">bhāi!</span>–brother! <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Gaurāṅga [is] <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my <span class="e2">prāṇa-dhana</span>–life and wealth. <span class="e2">bhaja</span>–Serve <span class="e2">tā̐re</span>–Him <span class="e2">akaitave</span>–sincerely. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then, <span class="e2">bhava-pāre yābe</span>–you will cross the ocean of material existence [and your] <span class="e2">tanu-mana</span>–body and mind <span class="e2">śītala</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will become tranquil.
O brother! Gaurāṅga is my life and wealth. Serve Him sincerely. Then, you will cross the ocean of material existence and your body and mind will become tranquil.
শ্রীনামভজন ও একাদশী এক
śrī-nāma-bhajana o ekādaśī eka
Serving the Name and following Ekādaśī are one
শ্রীনামভজন আর একাদশী ব্রত ।<br />এক-তত্ত্ব নিত্য জানি’ হও তাহে রত ॥২১॥
śrī-nāma-bhajana āra ekādaśī-vrata<br />eka-tattva nitya jāni’ hao tāhe rata [21]
<span class="e2">jāni’</span>–Knowing <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-bhajana</span>–service to the Name <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">ekādaśī-vrata</span>–the Ekādaśī rite [to be] <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternally <span class="e2">eka-tattva</span>–one, <span class="e2">rata hao</span>–practise <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–them both.
Knowing service to the Name and the Ekādaśī rite to be eternally one, practise them both.

Chapter Nineteen
নামরহস্যপটল
Nāma-rahasya-paṭala
A Collection of <br />Hidden Truths about the Name
একদা গৌরাঙ্গচাঁদ চন্দ্রালোক পাইয়া ।<br />সমুদ্রের তীরে আইল ভক্তবৃন্দ লঞা ॥১॥
ekadā gaurāṅgachā̐da chandrāloka pāiyā<br />samudrera tīre āila bhakta-vṛnda lañā [1]
<span class="e2">ekadā</span>–Once, <span class="e2">gaurāṅgachā̐da</span>–Gaurāṅgachā̐d, <span class="e2">chandrāloka</span> <span class="e2">pāiyā</span>–shining like the moon, <span class="e2">āila</span>–came <span class="e2">lañā</span>–with <span class="e2">bhakta-vṛnda</span>–the devotees <span class="e2">samudrera</span> <span class="e2">tīre</span>–to the bank of the ocean.
Once, Gaurāṅgachā̐d, shining like the moon, brought the devotees to the bank of the ocean.
হরিদাস-সমাজের উপকণ্ঠে বসি’ ।<br />সর্ব্ব বৈষ্ণবের প্রতি বলে গৌরশশী ॥২॥
hari-dāsa-samājera upakaṇṭhe basi’<br />sarva vaiṣṇavera prati bale gaura-śaśī [2]
<span class="e2">basi’</span>–Sitting <span class="e2">upakaṇṭhe</span>–in the midst <span class="e2">hari-dāsa-samājera</span>–of the assembly of the Lord’s servants, <span class="e2">gaura-śaśī</span>–moon-like Gaura <span class="e2">bale</span>–spoke <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">vaiṣṇavera</span> <span class="e2">prati</span>–to all the devotees.
Sitting in the midst of the assembly of devotees, moon-like Gaura spoke to everyone.
শ্রীনামই একমাত্র ও শ্রেষ্ঠ সাধন
śrī-nāma-i eka-mātra o śreṣṭha sādhana
The Holy Name is the best and only practice
“শুন হে ভকতবৃন্দ কলিকালে ধর্ম্ম ।<br />শ্রীকৃষ্ণকীর্ত্তন বিনা আর নাহি কর্ম্ম ॥৩॥
“śuna he bhakata-vṛnda kali-kāle dharma<br />śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtana vinā āra nāhi karma [3]
<span class="e2">“he</span>–“O <span class="e2">bhakata-vṛnda</span>–devotees, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–hear <span class="e2">dharma</span>–about the religion <span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–in the Age of Kali: <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">karma</span>–duty <span class="e2">vinā</span> <span class="e2">āra</span>–other than <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtana</span>–chanting, ‘Śrī Kṛṣṇa’.
“O devotees, hear about the dharma in the Age of Kali: there is no duty other than chanting the Name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
কর্ম্ম-জ্ঞান-যোগ-ধ্যান দুর্ব্বল সাধন ।<br />অপ্রাকৃত সম্পত্তি লাভের নহে ক্রম ॥৪॥
karma-jñāna-yoga-dhyāna durbala sādhana<br />aprākṛta sampatti lābhera nahe krama [4]
<span class="e2">sādhana</span>–The practices [of] <span class="e2">karma-jñāna-yoga-dhyāna</span>–piety, knowledge, yoga, and meditation [are] <span class="e2">durbala</span>–powerless; <span class="e2">nahe</span>–they are not <span class="e2">krama</span>–methods <span class="e2">lābhera</span>–to attain <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–spiritual <span class="e2">sampatti</span>–wealth.
“The practices of piety, knowledge, yoga, and meditation are powerless; they are not methods to attain spiritual wealth.
ধর্ম্ম, ব্রত, ত্যাগ, হোম, সকলই প্রাকৃত ।<br />অপ্রাকৃততত্ত্ব লাভে নাহি করে হিত ॥৫॥
dharma, vrata, tyāga, homa sakala-i prākṛta<br />aprākṛta-tattva lābhe nāhi kare hita [5]
<span class="e2">dharma</span>–Virtue, <span class="e2">vrata</span>–rites, <span class="e2">tyāga</span>–renunciation, [and] <span class="e2">homa</span>–fire sacrifices [are] <span class="e2">sakala-i</span>–all <span class="e2">prākṛta</span>–mundane. <span class="e2">hita kare nāhi</span>–They do not help [anyone] <span class="e2">lābhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">aprākṛta-tattva</span>–spiritual wealth.
“Virtue, rites, renunciation, and fire sacrifices are all mundane. They do not help anyone attain spiritual wealth.
কৃষ্ণনাম উচ্চারণে, স্মরণে, শ্রবণে ।<br />অপ্রাকৃতসিদ্ধি হয়, বলে শ্রুতিগণে ॥৬॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma uchchāraṇe, smaraṇe, śravaṇe<br />aprākṛta-siddhi haya, bale śruti-gaṇe [6]
<span class="e2">śruti-gaṇe</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">bale</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">aprākṛta-siddhi</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–you will attain spiritual perfection <span class="e2">uchchāraṇe</span>–by uttering, <span class="e2">smaraṇe</span>–remembering, [and] <span class="e2">śravaṇe</span>–hearing <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
“The scriptures say that you will attain spiritual perfection by uttering, remembering, and hearing the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
শ্রীনামরহস্য সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রেতে দেখিবা ।<br />নাম-উচ্চারণমাত্র চিৎসুখ লভিবা ॥৭॥
śrī-nāma-rahasya sarva-śāstrete dekhibā<br />nāma-uchchāraṇa-mātra chit-sukha labhibā [7]
<span class="e2">dekhibā</span>–You will find <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-rahasya</span>–hidden truths about the Name <span class="e2">sarva-śāstrete</span>–in all the scriptures, [and] <span class="e2">nāma-uchchāraṇa-mātra</span>–simply by uttering the Name, <span class="e2">labhibā</span>–you will feel <span class="e2">chit-sukha</span>–spiritual joy.
“You will find hidden truths about the Name in all the scriptures, and simply by uttering the Name, you will feel spiritual joy.
পদ্মপুরাণে স্বর্গখণ্ড ৪৮ অধ্যায়, নামরহস্যপটলং, যথা—
padma-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍa 48 adhyāya, nāma-rahasya-paṭalaṁ, yathā—
Hidden truths about the Name in chapter forty-eight of the Svarga-khaṇḍa in the Padma-purāṇa—
‘শ্রীশৌনক উবাচ—<br />নামোচ্চারণমাহাত্ম্যং শ্রূয়তে মহদদ্ভুতম্ ।<br />যদুচ্চারণমাত্রেণ নরো যায়াৎ পরং পদম্ ।<br />তদ্বদস্বাধুনা সূত বিধানং নামকীর্ত্তনে ॥৮॥
‘śrī-śaunaka uvācha—<br />nāmochchāraṇa-māhātmyaṁ śrūyate mahad-adbhutam<br />yad uchchāraṇa-mātreṇa naro yāyāt paraṁ padam<br />tad vadasvādhunā sūta vidhānaṁ nāma-kīrtane [8]
“‘Śrī Śaunaka said, “We have heard that the glories of uttering the Name are greatly astounding. Just by uttering the Name, the soul attains the supreme abode. So now, please describe the rules for chanting the Name.”
শ্রীসূত উবাচ—<br />শৃণু শৌনক বক্ষ্যামি সংবাদং মোক্ষসাধনম্ ।<br />নারদঃ পৃষ্টবান্ পূর্ব্বং কুমারং তদ্বদামি তে ॥৯॥
śrī-sūta uvācha—<br />śṛṇu śaunaka vakṣyāmi saṁvādaṁ mokṣa-sādhanam<br />nāradaḥ pṛṣṭavān pūrvaṁ kumāraṁ tad vadāmi te [9]
“‘Śrī Sūta said, “Śaunaka, listen to me. I will recount for you a conversation about the path to liberation: I will relate to you what Nārad previously enquired about from Sanat Kumār.
একদা যমুনাতীরে নিবিষ্টং শান্তমানসম্ ।<br />সনৎকুমারং পপ্রচ্ছ নারদো রচিতাঞ্জলিঃ ।<br />শ্রুত্বা নানাবিধান্ ধর্ম্মান্ ধর্ম্মব্যতিকরাংস্তথা ॥১০॥
ekadā yamunā-tīre niviṣṭaṁ śānta-mānasam<br />sanat-kumāraṁ paprachchha nārado rachitāñjaliḥ<br />śrutvā nānā-vidhān dharmān dharma-vyatikarāṁs tathā [10]
“‘“Once, having heard about the various types of dharma and the violations against dharma, Nārad, with joined palms, enquired from the peaceful-hearted Sanat Kumār, who was seated on the bank of the Yamunā.”
শ্রীনারদ উবাচ—<br />যোঽসৌ ভগবতা প্রোক্তো ধর্ম্মব্যতিকরো নৃণাম্ ।<br />কথং তস্য বিনাশঃ স্যাদুচ্যতাং ভগবৎপ্রিয়’ ॥১১॥
śrī-nārada uvācha—<br />yo ’sau bhagavatā prokto dharma-vyatikaro nṛṇām<br />kathaṁ tasya vināśaḥ syād uchyatāṁ bhagavat-priya’ [11]
“‘Śrī Nārad said, “O favourite of the Lord, please tell me how the violations against dharma made by the soul that you have described may be counteracted?”’
এই পটলের অর্থ কিছু বিশেষ করিয়া ।<br />বলি স্বরূপ রামানন্দ শুন মন দিয়া ॥১২॥
ei paṭalera artha kichhu viśeṣa kariyā<br />bali svarūpa rāmānanda śuna mana diyā [12]
<span class="e2">bali</span>–I will explain <span class="e2">artha</span>–the meaning <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">paṭalera</span>–of this collection <span class="e2">kichhu</span> <span class="e2">viśeṣa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–in detail. <span class="e2">svarūpa</span> <span class="e2">rāmānanda</span>–O Svarūp and Rāmānanda, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen <span class="e2">mana</span> <span class="e2">diyā</span>–attentively.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu continues:] “I will explain the meaning of this collection of verses in detail. O Svarūp and Rāmānanda, listen attentively.
শ্রীনামকীর্ত্তন কি? ‘উচ্চারণ’
śrī-nāma-kīrtana ki? ‘Uchchāraṇa’
What is chanting the Name? ‘Utterance’
‘উচ্চারণ’-শব্দে বুঝ শ্রীনামকীর্ত্তন ।<br />‘করে’ বা ‘মালায়’ সঙ্খ্যা করে ভক্তগণ ॥১৩॥
‘uchchāraṇa’-śabde bujha śrī-nāma-kīrtana<br />‘kare’ vā ‘mālāya’ saṅkhyā kare bhakta-gaṇa [13]
<span class="e2">bujha</span>–Understand [that] <span class="e2">‘uchchāraṇa’-śabde</span>–the word ‘utterance’ [means] <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-kīrtana</span>–chanting the Name. <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–Devotees <span class="e2">saṅkhyā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–count [their chanting either] <span class="e2">‘kare’</span>–on [their] hands <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">‘mālāya’</span>–on a rosary.
“Understand that the word ‘utterance’ means chanting the Name. Devotees count their chanting either on their hands or on beads.
সঙ্খ্যা ছাড়ি’ অসঙ্খ্য নাম কভু কভু হয় ।<br />‘উচ্চারণ’-শব্দে এসব জানহ নিশ্চয় ॥১৪॥
saṅkhyā chhāḍi’ asaṅkhya nāma kabhu kabhu haya<br />‘uchchāraṇa’-śabde e-saba jānaha niśchaya [14]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–Sometimes <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–they stop <span class="e2">saṅkhyā</span>–counting [and] <span class="e2">asaṅkhya</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–chant without counting. <span class="e2">jānaha</span>–Understand <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–clearly [that] <span class="e2">‘uchchāraṇa’-śabde</span>–the word ‘utterance’ [refers to] <span class="e2">e-saba</span>–both of these.
“Sometimes they stop counting and chant the Name without counting. Understand clearly that the word ‘utterance’ refers to both of these types of chanting.
জপ ও কীর্ত্তন
japa o kīrtana
Japa and kīrtan
লঘূচ্চারে ‘জপ’ হয়, উচ্চারে ‘কীর্ত্তন’ ।<br />স্মরণ-কীর্ত্তনে সব হয় ত’ গণন ॥১৫॥<br />কি প্রকারে নাম কৈলে সুকীর্ত্তন হয় ।<br />শ্রীনামকীর্ত্তনে তাহা বিধান নিশ্চয় ॥১৬॥
laghūchchāre ‘japa’ haya, uchchāre ‘kīrtana’<br />smaraṇa-kīrtane saba haya ta’ gaṇana [15]<br />ki prakāre nāma kaile sukīrtana haya<br />śrī-nāma-kīrtane tāhā vidhāna niśchaya [16]
<span class="e2">laghūchchāre</span>–Soft utterance <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">‘japa’</span>–called <span class="e33">japa</span>, [and] <span class="e2">uchchāre</span>–loud utterance [is] <span class="e2">‘kīrtana’</span>–called <span class="e33">kīrtan</span>. <span class="e2">saba</span>–Both <span class="e2">gaṇana ta’ haya</span>–are considered <span class="e2">smaraṇa-kīrtane</span>–remembrance and chanting, [but] <span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">prakāre</span>–in whatever way <span class="e2">nāma kaile</span>–of serving the Name <span class="e2">haya</span>–there is <span class="e2">sukīrtana</span>–true glorification [of the Lord,] <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly [is] <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–the proper method <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-kīrtane</span>–to glorify the Name.
“Soft utterance is called <span class="e3">japa</span>, and loud utterance is called <span class="e3">kīrtan</span>. Both are considered ways to practise remembrance and chanting, but howsoever the Name is taken, the way of doing so in which there is true glorification of the Name is certainly the proper method to glorify the Name.
কীর্ত্তন সর্ব্বথা ও সর্ব্বদা কর্ত্তব্য
kīrtana sarvathā o sarvadā kartavya
Chanting everywhere and always is our duty
শ্রীনামকীর্ত্তন হয় জীবের নিত্যধর্ম্ম ।<br />জগতে বৈকুণ্ঠে জীবের এই মুখ্য কর্ম্ম ॥১৭॥
śrī-nāma-kīrtana haya jīvera nitya-dharma<br />jagate vaikuṇṭhe jīvera ei mukhya karma [17]
<span class="e2">śrī-nāma-kīrtana</span>–Chanting the Name <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">nitya-dharma</span>–the eternal duty <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of the soul: <span class="e2">ei</span>–it [is] <span class="e2">mukhya</span> <span class="e2">karma</span>–the primary activity <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of the soul [both] <span class="e2">jagate</span>–in [this] world [and] <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭhe</span>–in the spiritual world.
“Chanting the Name is the eternal duty of the soul: it is the primary activity of the soul both in this world and in the spiritual world.
মায়াবদ্ধ জীবের এই মোক্ষ সাধন হয় ।<br />মুক্তজীবের পক্ষে তাহা সাধ্যাবধি রয় ॥১৮॥
māyā-baddha jīvera ei mokṣa sādhana haya<br />mukta-jīvera pakṣe tāhā sādhyāvadhi raya [18]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–It <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">sādhana</span>–the means <span class="e2">mokṣa</span>–to liberation <span class="e2">māyā-baddha</span> <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for souls conditioned by māyā, [and] <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–it <span class="e2">raya</span>–remains <span class="e2">sādhyāvadhi</span>–the eternal engagement <span class="e2">mukta-jīvera</span> <span class="e2">pakṣe</span>–of the liberated souls.
“Chanting the Name is the means to liberation for the conditioned souls and is the eternal engagement of the liberated souls.
ভক্তিহীন শুভকার্য ত্যাজ্য
bhakti-hīna śubha-kārya tyājya
Non-devotional pious activities should be given up
ধর্ম্মশাস্ত্র-উক্ত ভক্তিহীন ধর্ম্ম যত ।<br />ভক্ত্যুদ্দেশ বিনা আর যত প্রকার ব্রত ॥১৯॥<br />ভক্ত্যুত্থিত বিরাগ ব্যতীত যত ত্যাগ ।<br />ভক্তি-প্রতিকূল যজ্ঞ প্রাকৃত বিভাগ ॥২০॥<br />এই সব শুভকর্ম্ম সম্বন্ধ বিচারে ।<br />ভক্তি-অনুকূল বলি’ শাস্ত্রেতে প্রচারে ॥২১॥<br />কলিকালে সেই সব জড়ধর্ম্ম হইল ।<br />ভক্তি-আনুকূল্য ত্যজি’ ধর্ম্ম নষ্ট ভেল ॥২২॥
dharma-śāstra-ukta bhakti-hīna dharma yata<br />bhakty-uddeśa vinā āra yata prakāra vrata [19]<br />bhakty-utthita virāga vyatīta yata tyāga<br />bhakti-pratikūla yajña prākṛta vibhāga [20]<br />ei saba śubha-karma sambandha vichāre<br />bhakti-anukūla bali’ śāstrete prachāre [21]<br />kali-kāle sei saba jaḍa-dharma ha-ila<br />bhakti-ānukūlya tyaji’ dharma naṣṭa bhela [22]
<span class="e2">yata</span>–All <span class="e2">bhakti-hīna</span>–non-devotional <span class="e2">dharma</span>–duties <span class="e2">dharma-śāstra-ukta</span>–mentioned in the religious scriptures, <span class="e2">yata</span>–all <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–sorts <span class="e2">vrata</span>–of rites <span class="e2">vinā</span>–apart from [those with] <span class="e2">bhakty-uddeśa</span>–a devotional purpose, <span class="e2">yata</span>–all [forms of] <span class="e2">tyāga</span>–renunciation <span class="e2">vyatīta</span>–devoid <span class="e2">virāga</span>–of detachment <span class="e2">bhakty-utthita</span>–produced by devotion, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">vibhāga</span>–the section of <span class="e2">yajña</span>–sacrifices [that are] <span class="e2">prākṛta</span> <span class="e2">vibhāga</span>–mundane [and] <span class="e2">bhakti-pratikūla</span>–unfavourable to devotion— <span class="e2">śāstrete</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">bali’ prachāre</span>–state [that] <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all of these <span class="e2">śubha-karma</span>–pious activities [are] <span class="e2">bhakti-anukūla</span>–favourable to devotion <span class="e2">vichāre</span>–by assessment [of their] <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–connection [with the Lord]. <span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–In the Age of Kali, [however,] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–they all <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–have become <span class="e2">jaḍa-dharma</span>–material activities; <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–losing [their] <span class="e2">bhakti-ānukūlya</span>–favourableness to devotion, <span class="e2">dharma</span>–such duties <span class="e2">bhela</span>–have become <span class="e2">naṣṭa</span>–corrupted.
“Non-devotional duties mentioned in the religious scriptures, rites that do not have a devotional purpose, renunciation that is not an expression of detachment produced by devotion, and mundane, non-devotional sacrifices—the scriptures say that all of these pious activities are favourable to devotion because they have some connection with the Lord. In the Age of Kali, however, they have all become material activities; losing their favourableness to devotion, they have all become corrupted.
অতএব কলিকালে নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />বিনা আর ধর্ম্ম নাই শুন ভক্তগণ ॥২৩॥
ataeva kali-kāle nāma-saṅkīrtana<br />vinā āra dharma nāi śuna bhakta-gaṇa [23]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–in the Age of Kali, <span class="e2">nāi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">dharma</span>–duty <span class="e2">vinā</span> <span class="e2">āra</span>–other than <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana</span>–chanting the Name. <span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–O devotees, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen!
“So, in the Age of Kali, there is no duty other than chanting the Name. O devotees, listen!
সে ধর্ম্মের ব্যতিকর যাহাই দেখিবে ।<br />তাহাই বর্জ্জিবে যত্নে ভক্তির প্রভাবে ॥২৪॥
se dharmera vyatikara yāhāi dekhibe<br />tāhāi varjibe yatne bhaktira prabhāve [24]
<span class="e2">bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">prabhāve</span>–With the strength produced by devotion, <span class="e2">yatne</span>–carefully <span class="e2">varjibe</span>–avoid <span class="e2">tāhāi</span> <span class="e2">yāhāi</span>–all <span class="e2">vyatikara</span>–violations <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">dharmera</span>–against this duty [that] <span class="e2">dekhibe</span>–you find.
“With the strength produced by devotion, carefully avoid all violations against chanting the Name that you find.
‘শ্রীসনৎকুমার উবাচ—<br />শৃণু নারদ গোবিন্দপ্রিয় গোবিন্দধর্ম্মবিৎ ।<br />যৎ পৃষ্টং লোকনির্ম্মুক্তিকারণং তমসঃ পরম্’ ॥২৫॥
‘śrī-sanat-kumāra uvācha—<br />śṛṇu nārada govinda-priya govinda-dharma-vit<br />yat pṛṣṭaṁ loka-nirmukti-kāraṇaṁ tamasaḥ param’ [25]
“‘Śrī Sanat Kumār said, “Listen, O Nārad, favourite of Govinda, expert in the service of Govinda! You have asked about the cause of being liberated from this world and overcoming ignorance.”’
তুমি ত’ নারদ শ্রীগোবিন্দধর্ম্মবেত্তা ।<br />গোবিন্দের প্রিয়, মায়াবন্ধনের ছেত্তা ॥২৬॥
tumi ta’ nārada śrī-govinda-dharma-vettā<br />govindera priya, māyā-bandhanera chhettā [26]
<span class="e2">nārada</span>–O Nārad, <span class="e2">tumi</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–You [are] <span class="e2">śrī-govinda-dharma-vettā</span>–an expert in the service of Śrī Govinda. [You are] <span class="e2">govindera</span> <span class="e2">priya</span>–dear to Govinda, [and you are] <span class="e2">chhettā</span>–the cutter <span class="e2">māyā-bandhanera</span>–of [the soul’s] bondage within illusion.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “O Nārad, you are an expert in the service of Śrī Govinda. You are dear to Govinda, and you cut away the soul’s bondage within illusion.
লোকনির্ম্মুক্তির হেতু জিজ্ঞাসা তোমার ।<br />তব প্রশ্নোত্তরে জীব হবে তমঃ পার ॥২৭॥
loka-nirmuktira hetu jijñāsā tomāra<br />tava praśnottare jīva habe tamaḥ pāra [27]
<span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your <span class="e2">jijñāsā</span>–question [is about] <span class="e2">hetu</span>–the cause <span class="e2">loka-nirmuktira</span>–of liberation from this world. <span class="e2">jīva</span>–Souls <span class="e2">pāra habe</span>–will overcome <span class="e2">tamaḥ</span>–ignorance <span class="e2">tava</span> <span class="e2">praśnottare</span>–through the answer to your question.
“You have asked about the cause of liberation from this world. Souls will overcome ignorance through the answer to your question.
কলিতে সকল ধর্ম্মাধর্ম্ম তমোময় ।<br />নামধর্ম্ম বিনা জীবের সংসার নহে ক্ষয় ॥২৮॥
kalite sakala dharmādharma tamomaya<br />nāma-dharma vinā jīvera saṁsāra nahe kṣaya [28]
<span class="e2">kalite</span>–In the Age of Kali, <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">dharmādharma</span>–religion and irreligion [are] <span class="e2">tamomaya</span>–filled with ignorance. <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">nāma-dharma</span>–the religion of [chanting] the Name, <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–the soul’s <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–entanglement in this world <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is not <span class="e2">kṣaya</span>–destroyed.
“In the Age of Kali, all forms of religion and irreligion are filled with ignorance. Without chanting the Name, the soul’s entanglement in this world cannot be destroyed.
অতএব নামে সর্ব্বপাপক্ষয়
ataeva nāme sarva-pāpa-kṣaya
So, the Name destroys all sins
‘সর্ব্বাচারবিবর্জ্জিতাঃ শঠধিয়ো ব্রাত্যা জগদ্বঞ্চকাঃ<br />দম্ভাহঙ্কৃতিপানপৈশুন্যপরাঃ পাপাশ্চ যে নিষ্ঠুরাঃ ।<br />যে চান্যে ধনদারপুত্রনিরতাঃ সর্ব্বেঽধমাস্তেঽপি হি<br />শ্রীগোবিন্দপদারবিন্দশরণাঃ শুদ্ধা ভবন্তি দ্বিজ’ ॥২৯॥
‘sarvāchāra-vivarjitāḥ śaṭha-dhiyo vrātyā jagad-vañchakāḥ<br />dambhāhaṅkṛti-pāna-paiśunya-parāḥ pāpāś cha ye niṣṭhurāḥ<br />ye chānye dhana-dāra-putra-niratāḥ sarve ’dhamās te ’pi hi<br />śrī-govinda-padāravinda-śaraṇāḥ śuddhā bhavanti dvija’ [29]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumār said:] “O brāhmaṇ, persons who are devoid of all virtues, deceitful, uncultured, fraudulent, arrogant, egotistical, addicted to intoxicants, sinful, malicious, cruel-natured, and grossly infatuated with son, wife, wealth, and so forth—even such extremely fallen persons are purified by surrendering to the lotus feet of Śrī Govinda.”’
শ্রীগোবিন্দপদারবিন্দ শরণ যে লয় ।<br />তার সর্ব্বপাপ নামে নিশ্চয় হয় ক্ষয় ॥৩০॥
śrī-govinda-padāravinda śaraṇa ye laya<br />tāra sarva-pāpa nāme niśchaya haya kṣaya [30]
<span class="e2">sarva-pāpa</span>–All the sins <span class="e2">tāra ye</span>–of those who <span class="e2">laya</span>–take <span class="e2">śaraṇa</span>–shelter <span class="e2">śrī-govinda-padāravinda</span>–at the lotus feet of Śrī Govinda <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">kṣaya haya</span>–are destroyed <span class="e2">nāme</span>–by the Name.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “The Name certainly destroys all the sins of those who take shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Govinda.
কৃষ্ণনাম লয়ে কাঁদে, নিজ দোষ বলে ।<br />অতি শীঘ্র তার পাপ যায় ভক্তিবলে ॥৩১॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma laye kā̐de, nija doṣa bale<br />ati śīghra tāra pāpa yāya bhakti-bale [31]
<span class="e2">pāpa</span>–The sins <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of those who <span class="e2">laye</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Name, <span class="e2">kā̐de</span>–cry, [and] <span class="e2">bale</span>–confess <span class="e2">nija</span>–their <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–sins <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away <span class="e2">ati</span> <span class="e2">śīghra</span>–very quickly <span class="e2">bhakti-bale</span>–by the power of devotion.
“The sins of those who chant Kṛṣṇa’s Name, crying and repenting for their faults, are very quickly driven away by the power of devotion.
কর্ম্মপ্রায়শ্চিত্তে বাসনা নষ্ট হয় না
karma-prāyaśchitte vāsanā naṣṭa haya nā
Pious atonements do not destroy material desire
কর্ম্মজ্ঞান-প্রায়শ্চিত্তে তার কিবা ফল ।<br />সে ফল দুর্ব্বল অতি, তার নাহি বল ॥৩২॥
karma-jñāna-prāyaśchitte tāra kibā phala<br />se phala durbala ati, tāra nāhi bala [32]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–What [are] <span class="e2">phala</span>–the results <span class="e2">tāra karma-jñāna-prāyaśchitte</span>–of atonements made through piety or knowledge? <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–The results [are] <span class="e2">ati durbala</span>–extremely weak. <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–They have no <span class="e2">bala</span>–power.
“What are the results of atonements made through piety or knowledge? The results are extremely weak; they have no power at all.
এক কৃষ্ণনামে পাপীর যত পাপক্ষয় ।<br />বহু জন্মে সেই পাপী করিতে নারয় ॥৩৩॥
eka kṛṣṇa-nāme pāpīra yata pāpa-kṣaya<br />bahu janme sei pāpī karite nāraya [33]
[But] <span class="e2">sei pāpī</span>–a sinner <span class="e2">karite nāraya</span>–cannot commit <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">janme</span>–over the course of many births <span class="e2">yata</span>–as many <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sins [as are] <span class="e2">kṣaya</span>–destroyed <span class="e2">pāpīra</span>–for a sinner [by] <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāme</span>–Name of Kṛṣṇa.
“But a sinner cannot commit over the course of many births as many sins as one Name of Kṛṣṇa can destroy.
হেন পাপ স্মার্ত্তশাস্ত্রে না আছে বর্ণন ।<br />এক কৃষ্ণনামে যাহা না হয় খণ্ডন ॥৩৪॥
hena pāpa smārta-śāstre nā āchhe varṇana<br />eka kṛṣṇa-nāme yāhā nā haya khaṇḍana [34]
<span class="e2">āchhe nā</span>–There is no <span class="e2">hena</span>–such <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sin <span class="e2">varṇana</span>–mentioned <span class="e2">smārta-śāstre</span>–in the smārta scriptures (the scriptures that explain codes of piety and rites of atonement) <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">eka</span>–one <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāme</span>–Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">khaṇḍana haya nā</span>–does not counteract.
“There is no sin mentioned in the smārta scriptures that one Name of Kṛṣṇa does not counteract.
তবে কেন স্মার্ত্তলোক প্রায়শ্চিত্ত করে ।<br />সুকৃতি-অভাবে তার কর্ম্মে মতি হরে ॥৩৫॥
tabe kena smārta-loka prāyaśchitta kare<br />sukṛti-abhāve tāra karme mati hare [35]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–So <span class="e2">kena</span>–why [do] <span class="e2">smārta-loka</span>–the followers of the smārta scriptures <span class="e2">prāyaśchitta</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–perform atonements? [Because they have] <span class="e2">sukṛti-abhāve</span>–a lack of spiritual fortune [and] <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">karme</span>–the reactions to their actions <span class="e2">hare</span>–take away [their] <span class="e2">mati</span>–intelligence.
“So why do the followers of the smārta scriptures perform rites of atonement for their sins (instead of chanting the Name)? Because they lack spiritual fortune and their karma deludes their intelligence.
কর্ম্ম-প্রায়শ্চিত্তে কভু বাসনা না যায় ।<br />জ্ঞান-প্রায়শ্চিত্তে শোধে বাসনা হিয়ায় ॥৩৬॥
karma-prāyaśchitte kabhu vāsanā nā yāya<br />jñāna-prāyaśchitte śodhe vāsanā hiyāya [36]
<span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–Material desires <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span>–never <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away <span class="e2">karma-prāyaśchitte</span>–through atonement made through pious activities. <span class="e2">jñāna-prāyaśchitte</span>–Atonement made through knowledge <span class="e2">śodhe</span>–counteracts <span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–material desires <span class="e2">hiyāya</span>–within the heart.
“Atonement made by performing pious activities does not remove material desires. Atonement made through knowledge does counteract material desires within the heart.
বাসনার মূল অবিদ্যা ভক্তিতে বিনষ্ট হয়
vāsanāra mūla avidyā bhaktite vinaṣṭa haya
Devotion destroys ignorance, the root of material desire
পুনঃ কিছুদিনে সে বাসনা হয় স্থূল ।<br />ভক্তিতে অবিদ্যা যায় বাসনার মূল ॥৩৭॥
punaḥ kichhu-dine se vāsanā haya sthūla<br />bhaktite avidyā yāya vāsanāra mūla [37]
<span class="e2">kichhu-dine</span>–After some time, [however,] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">vāsanā</span>–those material desires <span class="e2">sthūla haya</span>–swell <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again. <span class="e2">avidyā</span>–Ignorance, <span class="e2">mūla</span>–the root <span class="e2">vāsanāra</span>–of material desire, <span class="e2">yāya</span>–goes away [only] <span class="e2">bhaktite</span>–through devotion.
“After some time, however, those material desires swell in the heart again. Only devotion removes ignorance, the root cause of material desire.
যে জন গোবিন্দপদে লইয়া শরণ ।<br />নাম লয় কাকুভরে করয় রোদন ॥৩৮॥<br />তার পক্ষে শ্রীমুখের বাক্য সুমধুর ।<br />জীবের মঙ্গল, গীতায় দেখহ প্রচুর ॥৩৯॥
ye jana govinda-pade la-iyā śaraṇa<br />nāma laya kāku-bhare karaya rodana [38]<br />tāra pakṣe śrī-mukhera vākya sumadhura<br />jīvera maṅgala, gītāya dekhaha prachura [39]
<span class="e2">vākya</span>–The words <span class="e2">śrī-mukhera</span>–from the divine mouth [of Govinda are] <span class="e2">sumadhura</span>–supremely sweet <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">pakṣe ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–to the souls who <span class="e2">la-iyā</span>–take <span class="e2">śaraṇa</span>–shelter <span class="e2">govinda-pade</span>–at the feet of Govinda, <span class="e2">laya</span>–chant [His] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name, [and] <span class="e2">kāku-bhare</span> <span class="e2">rodana karaya</span>–cry out [to Him] in prayer. <span class="e2">dekhaha</span>–See <span class="e2">prachura</span>–many [of such words, spoken for] <span class="e2">jīvera maṅgala</span>–the benefit of all souls, <span class="e2">gītāya</span>–in <span class="e33">Śrī Gītā</span>.
“The words from the divine mouth of Śrī Govinda are supremely sweet to the souls who take shelter at His feet, chant His Name, and cry out to Him in prayer. You will find many of His words, spoken for the benefit of all souls, in <span class="e3">Śrī Gītā</span>.
শ্রীগীতা—
śrī gītā—
<span class="e2">Śrī Gītā—</span>
‘সর্ব্বধর্ম্মান্ পরিত্যজ্য মামেকং শরণং ব্রজ ।<br />অহং ত্বাং সর্ব্বপাপেভ্যো মোক্ষয়িষ্যামি মা শুচঃ ॥৪০॥
‘sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja<br />ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śuchaḥ [40]
“‘Abandon all duties and surrender exclusively unto Me. I will liberate you from all sin. Do not despair.
অপি চেৎ সুদুরাচারো ভজতে মামনন্যভাক্ ।<br />সাধুরেব স মন্তব্যঃ সম্যগ্ব্যবসিতো হি সঃ ॥৪১॥
api chet sudurāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk<br />sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ [41]
“‘If even a very sinful person serves Me exclusively with devotion, he should be regarded as saintly, for his resolve is perfect.
ক্ষিপ্রং ভবতি ধর্ম্মাত্মা শাশ্বচ্ছান্তিং নিগচ্ছতি ।<br />কৌন্তেয় প্রতিজানীহি ন মে ভক্তঃ প্রণশ্যতি’ ॥৪২॥
kṣipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā śāśvach-chhāntiṁ nigachchhati<br />kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati’ [42]
“‘He swiftly becomes a person of virtuous practices and attains constant peace. O son of Kuntī, declare to the world that My devotee is never vanquished!”’
অতএব কর্ম্মাঙ্গ প্রায়শ্চিত্তাদি পরিহরি’ ।<br />বুদ্ধিমান্ জন ভজে প্রাণেশ্বর হরি ॥৪৩॥
ataeva karmāṅga prāyaśchittādi parihari’<br />buddhimān jana bhaje prāṇeśvara hari [43]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">buddhimān</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–the intelligent souls <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–give up [performing] <span class="e2">karmāṅga</span> <span class="e2">prāyaśchittādi</span>–atonement and other worldly rites, [and] <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">hari</span>–Hari, <span class="e2">prāṇeśvara</span>–the Lord of [their] heart.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “So, the intelligent souls give up atoning for their sins through worldly rites, and serve Hari, the Lord of their heart.
অতএব নামের ফল
ataeva nāmera phala
So, the Name’s effect
‘তমপি দেবকরং করুণাকরং<br />স্থাবর-জঙ্গম-মুক্তিকরং পরম্ ।<br />অতিচরন্ত্যপরাধপরা জনা <br />য ইহ তান্বপতি ধ্রুবনাম হি’ ॥৪৪॥
‘tam api devakaraṁ karuṇākaraṁ<br />sthāvara-jaṅgama-muktikaraṁ param<br />aticharanty aparādha-parā janā<br />ya iha tān vapati dhruva-nāma hi’ [44]
“‘[Sanat Kumār said:] “The eternal Name—the source of divinity, the fountain of mercy, the supreme giver of liberation to both moving and inert beings—certainly removes the sins of the offenders who go against Him.”’
কৃষ্ণনাম দয়াময় কৃষ্ণতেজোময় ।<br />স্থাবর-জঙ্গম-মুক্তিদাতা সুনিশ্চয় ॥৪৫॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma dayāmaya kṛṣṇa-tejo-maya<br />sthāvara-jaṅgama-mukti-dātā suniśchaya [45]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–The Name of Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–compassionate, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-tejo-maya</span>–filled with Kṛṣṇa’s power, [and] <span class="e2">suniśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">sthāvara-jaṅgama-mukti-dātā</span>–the giver of liberation to all moving and inert beings.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “The Name of Kṛṣṇa is compassionate, filled with Kṛṣṇa’s power, and certainly the giver of liberation to all moving and inert beings.
নাম-অপরাধী তাহে করে অপরাধ ।<br />অতিচার আসি’ নাম-ধর্ম্মে করে বাধ ॥৪৬॥
nāma-aparādhī tāhe kare aparādha<br />atichāra āsi’ nāma-dharme kare bādha [46]
<span class="e2">nāma-aparādhī</span>–Offenders of the Name <span class="e2">aparādha kare</span>–commit offences <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–against Him, [and such] <span class="e2">atichāra</span>–violations <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–come [and] <span class="e2">bādha kare</span>–check <span class="e2">nāma-dharme</span>–[their] practice of [chanting] the Name.
“Offenders of the Name commit offences against Him, and such violations check their chanting of the Name.
সেই মহা-অপরাধীর দোষ, নামে হয় ক্ষয় ।<br />নাম বিনা জীববন্ধু জগতে না হয় ॥৪৭॥
sei mahā-aparādhīra doṣa, nāme haya kṣaya<br />nāma vinā jīva-bandhu jagate nā haya [47]
<span class="e2">sei</span>–The <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–sins <span class="e2">mahā-aparādhīra</span>–of such great offenders <span class="e2">kṣaya haya</span>–are destroyed, [however,] <span class="e2">nāme</span>–by the Name. <span class="e2">vinā</span>–Other than <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name, <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–there is no <span class="e2">jīva-bandhu</span>–friend of the soul <span class="e2">jagate</span>–in this world.
“The Name, however, destroys the sins of even such great offenders. Other than the Name, the soul has no friend in this world.
‘শ্রীনারদ উবাচ—<br />কে তেঽপরাধা বিপ্রেন্দ্র নাম্নো ভগবতঃ কৃতা ।<br />বিনিঘ্নন্তি নৃণাং কৃত্যং প্রাকৃতং হ্যানয়ন্তি চ’ ॥৪৮॥
‘śrī-nārada uvācha—<br />ke te ’parādhā viprendra nāmno bhagavataḥ kṛtā<br />vinighnanti nṛṇāṁ kṛtyaṁ prākṛtaṁ hy ānayanti cha’ [48]
“‘Nārad asked Sanat Kumār: “O best of the brāhmaṇs, what are the offences against the Lord’s Name that destroy and drag the mundane into the soul’s chanting of the Name?”’
নামাপরাধ
nāmāparādha
Offences to the Name
ওহে গুরু সনৎকুমার কৃপা করি’ বল ।<br />নামে অপরাধ যত প্রকার সকল ॥৪৯॥<br />নামরূপ মহাকৃত্য জীবের নিশ্চয় ।<br />সেই কৃত্য যাহে সাধকের নষ্ট হয় ॥৫০॥
ohe guru sanat-kumāra kṛpā kari’ bala<br />nāme aparādha yata prakāra sakala [49]<br />nāma-rūpa mahākṛtya jīvera niśchaya<br />sei kṛtya yāhe sādhakera naṣṭa haya [50]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">guru</span>–Guru, <span class="e2">sanat-kumāra</span>–Sanat Kumār, [chanting] <span class="e2">nāma-rūpa</span>–the form of the Name [is] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">mahākṛtya</span>–the foremost duty <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of the soul. <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–Mercifully <span class="e2">bala</span>–tell [me] <span class="e2">yata sakala</span>–all the <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–types <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–of offences <span class="e2">nāme</span>–to the Name, <span class="e2">yāhe</span>–by which <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sādhakera kṛtya</span>–this duty of the practitioner <span class="e2">naṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–is destroyed.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “O Gurudev, Sanat Kumār, chanting the Name is certainly the foremost duty of the soul. Mercifully tell me all the offences to the Name, which destroy the practitioner’s performance of that duty.
নামকে প্রাকৃত করি’ সাধন করাঞা ।<br />সামান্য প্রাকৃত ফলে দেয় ফেলাইয়া ॥৫১॥
nāmake prākṛta kari’ sādhana karāñā<br />sāmānya prākṛta phale deya phelāiyā [51]
[Offences] <span class="e2">kari’</span>–make <span class="e2">nāmake</span>–the Name <span class="e2">prākṛta</span>–mundane [and] <span class="e2">sādhana</span> <span class="e2">karāñā</span>–make [a practitioner] practise [but] <span class="e2">phelāiyā deya</span>–cause [them] to squander [their practice on] <span class="e2">sāmānya</span>–trivial <span class="e2">prākṛta</span>–mundane <span class="e2">phale</span>–ends.
“Offences make the Name assume a material form and make a practitioner squander their practice on trivial mundane ends.
‘শ্রীসনৎকুমার উবাচ—<br />সতাং নিন্দা নাম্নঃ পরমপরাধং বিতনুতে<br />যতঃ খ্যাতিং যাতং কথমুসহতে তদ্বিগর্হাম্ ।<br />শিবস্য শ্রীবিষ্ণোর্য ইহ গুণনামাদিসকলং<br />ধিয়াভিন্নং পশ্যেৎ স খলু হরিনামাহিতকরঃ’ ॥৫২॥
‘śrī-sanat-kumāra uvācha—<br />satāṁ nindā nāmnaḥ param aparādhaṁ vitanute<br />yataḥ khyātiṁ yātaṁ katham u sahate tad-vigarhām<br />śivasya śrī-viṣṇor ya iha guṇa-nāmādi-sakalaṁ<br />dhiyā bhinnaṁ paśyet sa khalu hari-nāmāhita-karaḥ’ [52]
“‘Sanat Kumār replied to Nārad: “(1) Criticising sādhus is the worst offence to the Name. How can the Name tolerate condemnation of those who spread the Name’s glories? (2a) Those who see differences between Viṣṇu, the embodiment of auspiciousness, and any of His Names, Qualities, and so forth, are certainly offenders of the Name. (2b) Those who see any distinction between any of Śiva’s names and qualities and those of Viṣṇu are also offenders of the Name.”’
নামাপরাধ হইতে মুক্তি
nāmāparādha ha-ite mukti
Liberation from the offences to the Name
দশটী নামাপরাধ ভিন্ন ভিন্ন করি’ ।<br />বুঝিয়া লইলে নাম-অপরাধে তরি ॥৫৩॥
daśaṭī nāmāparādha bhinna bhinna kari’<br />bujhiyā la-ile nāma-aparādhe tari [53]
<span class="e2">bujhiyā</span> <span class="e2">la-ile</span>–If you understand <span class="e2">daśaṭī</span> <span class="e2">nāmāparādha</span>–the ten offences to the Name <span class="e2">bhinna</span> <span class="e2">bhinna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–separately, <span class="e2">tari</span>–you will [be able to] overcome <span class="e2">nāma-aparādhe</span>–the offences to the Name.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “If one by one you understand the ten offences to the Name, you will be able to overcome them.
এই শ্লোকে দুই অপরাধের বিচার ।<br />করিয়া করহ শুদ্ধ নামের আচার ॥৫৪॥
ei śloke dui aparādhera vichāra<br />kariyā karaha śuddha nāmera āchāra [54]
[First] <span class="e2">vichāra</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–study <span class="e2">dui</span>–the two <span class="e2">aparādhera</span>–offences <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">śloke</span>–in this verse [and] <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">āchāra karaha</span>–purely chant <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–the Name.
“First study the two offences mentioned in these verses and purely chant the Name.
সাধুনিন্দা
sādhu-nindā
Criticising sādhus
একান্ত নামেতে আশ্রয় আছে যাঁর ।<br />সাধুপদবাচ্য তেঁহ তারেন সংসার ॥৫৫॥
ekānta nāmete āśraya āchhe yā̐ra<br />sādhu-pada-vāchya te̐ha tārena saṁsāra [55]
<span class="e2">te̐ha yā̐ra</span>–Those whose <span class="e2">ekānta</span>–sole <span class="e2">āśraya</span>–shelter <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–is <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–in the Name <span class="e2">sādhu-pada-vāchya</span>–should be known by the title ‘sādhu’. <span class="e2">tārena</span>–They liberate <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–the world.
“Those whose sole shelter is the Name should be known as ‘sādhus’. They liberate the world.
জড়কর্ম্মজ্ঞানচেষ্টা ছাড়ি’ সেই জন ।<br />শুদ্ধভক্তিভাবে নাম করেন উচ্চারণ ॥৫৬॥
jaḍa-karma-jñāna-cheṣṭā chhāḍi’ sei jana<br />śuddha-bhakti-bhāve nāma karena uchchāraṇa [56]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–They <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–reject <span class="e2">jaḍa-karma-jñāna-cheṣṭā</span>–endeavours based on mundane action and knowledge, [and] <span class="e2">uchchāraṇa karena</span>–chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name <span class="e2">śuddha-bhakti-bhāve</span>–with pure devotion.
“They reject endeavours based on mundane action and knowledge, and chant the Name with pure devotion.
নামের প্রচার একা তাঁহা হৈতে হয় ।<br />তাঁর নিন্দা কৃষ্ণনাম কভু না সহয় ॥৫৭॥
nāmera prachāra ekā tā̐hā haite haya<br />tā̐ra nindā kṛṣṇa-nāma kabhu nā sahaya [57]
<span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">prachāra haya</span>–The Name is preached <span class="e2">tā̐hā</span> <span class="e2">haite</span>–by them <span class="e2">ekā</span>–alone, [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">sahaya</span>–tolerates <span class="e2">nindā</span>–criticism <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–of them.
“The Name of Kṛṣṇa is preached by them alone, and the Name never tolerates criticism of them.
সে সাধুর নিন্দা, তাঁতে, লঘু-বুদ্ধি যার ।<br />বড় অপরাধ নামে নিশ্চয় তাহার ॥৫৮॥
se sādhura nindā, tā̐te, laghu-buddhi yāra<br />baḍa aparādha nāme niśchaya tāhāra [58]
<span class="e2">tāhāra yāra</span>–Those who <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sādhura nindā</span>–criticise such sādhus [or] <span class="e2">tā̐te</span> <span class="e2">laghu-buddhi</span>–consider them insignificant <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly [make] <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–a heavy offence <span class="e2">nāme</span>–to the Name.
“Those who criticise such sādhus or consider them insignificant certainly make a heavy offence to the Name.
যত্নে এই অপরাধ করিয়া বর্জ্জন ।<br />সেই সাধু-সঙ্গ-বলে করহ ভজন ॥৫৯॥
yatne ei aparādha kariyā varjana<br />sei sādhu-saṅga-bale karaha bhajana [59]
<span class="e2">yatne</span>–Carefully <span class="e2">varjana kariyā</span>–avoid <span class="e2">ei</span>–this <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offence [and] <span class="e2">bhajana karaha</span>–engage in service <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅga-bale</span>–by the power of such sādhus’ association.
“Carefully avoid this offence and engage in service by the power of such sādhus’ association.
শ্রীনাম-নামী একতত্ত্ব
śrī-nāma-nāmī eka-tattva
The Name and the possessor of the Name are one
মঙ্গলস্বরূপ বিষ্ণু পরতত্ত্ব হরি ।<br />অপ্রাকৃত স্বরূপেতে শ্রীব্রজবিহারী ॥৬০॥
maṅgala-svarūpa viṣṇu para-tattva hari<br />aprākṛta svarūpete śrī-vraja-vihārī [60]
<span class="e2">viṣṇu</span>–Viṣṇu— <span class="e2">maṅgala-svarūpa</span>–the embodiment of auspiciousness, <span class="e2">para-tattva</span>–the Absolute, <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Supreme Lord— <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">svarūpete</span>–in [His] supramundane form, [is] <span class="e2">śrī-vraja-vihārī</span>–the enjoyer of Vraja (Kṛṣṇa).
“Viṣṇu—the embodiment of auspiciousness, the Absolute, the Supreme Lord—in His supramundane form, is Kṛṣṇa, the enjoyer of Vraja.
তাঁর নাম-রূপ-গুণ-লীলা অপ্রাকৃত ।<br />তাঁহার স্বরূপ হৈতে ভিন্ন নহে তত্ত্ব ॥৬১॥
tā̐ra nāma-rūpa-guṇa-līlā aprākṛta<br />tā̐hāra svarūpa haite bhinna nahe tattva [61]
<span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–His <span class="e2">nāma-rūpa-guṇa-līlā</span>–Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes [are] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–supramundane. <span class="e2">nahe</span>–They are not <span class="e2">tattva</span>–elements <span class="e2">bhinna</span>–separate <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span>–His <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–nature.
“His Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes are supramundane. None of them are separate from Him.
নাম নামী এক তত্ত্ব অপ্রাকৃত ধর্ম্ম ।<br />এ জড়জগতে তার নাহি আছে মর্ম্ম ॥৬২॥
nāma nāmī eka tattva aprākṛta dharma<br />e jaḍa-jagate tāra nāhi āchhe marma [62]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [and] <span class="e2">nāmī</span>–the possessor of the Name [are] <span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–one being; [such is] <span class="e2">dharma</span>–the nature <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–of the supramundane. <span class="e2">āchhe nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">marma</span>–understanding <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of this, [however,] <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">jaḍa-jagate</span>–in the material world.
“The Name and the possessor of the Name are one; such is the nature of the supramundane. There is no understanding of this, however, in the material world.
এই শুদ্ধজ্ঞানলাভ ভক্তিবলে হয় ।<br />তর্কে বহু দূর ইহা জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥৬৩॥
ei śuddha-jñāna-lābha bhakti-bale haya<br />tarke bahu dūra ihā jāniha niśchaya [63]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">śuddha-jñāna-lābha haya</span>–This pure conception is attained <span class="e2">bhakti-bale</span>–through devotion. <span class="e2">jāniha</span>–Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">ihā</span>–it [remains] <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">dūra</span>–far away <span class="e2">tarke</span>–from argument.
“You can realise this pure conception only through devotion. Know for certain that it is far beyond argument.
নিজ শুদ্ধসাধন, আর সাধুগুরবল ।<br />দুইয়ের সংয়োগে লভি’ এ তত্ত্বমঙ্গল ॥৬৪॥
nija śuddha-sādhana, āra sādhu-guru-bala<br />duiyera saṁyoge labhi’ e tattva-maṅgala [64]
<span class="e2">labhi’</span>–You will realise <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">tattva-maṅgala</span>–this auspicious truth <span class="e2">duiyera</span> <span class="e2">saṁyoge</span>–by the combination of two things: [your] <span class="e2">nija</span>–own <span class="e2">śuddha-sādhana</span>–pure practice, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">sādhu-guru-bala</span>–the power of Śrī Guru and the sādhus.
“You will realise this auspicious truth by the combination of two things: your pure practice, and the power of Śrī Guru and the sādhus.
এই তত্ত্বসিদ্ধি যত দিন নাহি হয় ।<br />ততদিন প্রাকৃতবুদ্ধি কভু না ছাড়য় ॥৬৫॥<br />ততদিন নাম করি’ না পাই স্বরূপ ।<br />নামাভাসমাত্র হয় ভজনবিরূপ ॥৬৬॥
ei tattva-siddhi yata dina nāhi haya<br />tata-dina prākṛta-buddhi kabhu nā chhāḍaya [65]<br />tata-dina nāma kari’ nā pāi svarūpa<br />nāmābhāsa-mātra haya bhajana-virūpa [66]
<span class="e2">tata-dina</span> <span class="e2">tata-dina yata</span> <span class="e2">dina</span>–As long as <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">tattva-siddhi</span> <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–you have not realised this truth, <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span> <span class="e2">chhāḍaya</span>–you will never leave <span class="e2">prākṛta-buddhi</span>–mundane consciousness: <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–you will chant the Name [but] <span class="e2">pāi nā</span>–not get <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the true form [of the Name;] <span class="e2">nāmābhāsa-mātra</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–you will chant only a semblance of the Name, [and your] <span class="e2">bhajana-virūpa</span>–service [will remain] imperfect.
“As long as you have not realised this truth, you will never leave mundane consciousness: you will chant the Name but never get the pure Name; you will chant only Nāmābhās, and your service will remain imperfect.
বহু যত্নে লাভ ভাই স্বরূপের সিদ্ধি ।<br />শুদ্ধনামোচ্চারে পাবে পরংপদ-বুদ্ধি ॥৬৭॥<br />যত্নসহ নিরন্তর নামাভাসে হরি ।<br />নামেতে স্বরূপসিদ্ধি দিবে কৃপা করি’ ॥৬৮॥
bahu yatne lābha bhāi svarūpera siddhi<br />śuddha-nāmochchāre pābe paraṁ-pada-buddhi [67]<br />yatnasaha nirantara nāmābhāse hari<br />nāmete svarūpa-siddhi dibe kṛpā kari’ [68]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">yatne</span>–with great care, <span class="e2">lābha</span>–[try to] attain <span class="e2">svarūpera</span> <span class="e2">siddhi</span>–realisation of the true self. <span class="e2">śuddha-nāmochchāre</span>–By chanting the Name purely (without offence), <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">paraṁ-pada-buddhi</span>–consciousness of the highest plane. [When you are engaged] <span class="e2">yatnasaha</span>–carefully [and] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–constantly <span class="e2">nāmābhāse</span>–in [chanting] a semblance of the Name, <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord, <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully, <span class="e2">dibe</span>–will grant [you] <span class="e2">svarūpa-siddhi</span>–realisation of the true self <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–through the Name.
“Brother, with great care, try to realise the true self. By chanting the Name purely, you will attain consciousness of the highest plane. When you carefully and constantly chant Nāmābhās, the Lord will mercifully grant you realisation of the true self through the Name.
কৃষ্ণ সর্ব্বেশ্বর, শিবাদি তাঁহার অংশ
kṛṣṇa sarveśvara, śivādi tā̐hāra aṁśa
Kṛṣṇa is the Lord of all; <br />Śiva and the other gods are partial forms of Him
সর্ব্বেশ্বর কৃষ্ণ, তাহে জানিবে নিশ্চয় ।<br />শিবাদি দেবতা তাঁর অংশরূপ হয় ॥৬৯॥
sarveśvara kṛṣṇa, tāhe jānibe niśchaya<br />śivādi devatā tā̐ra aṁśa-rūpa haya [69]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">sarveśvara</span>–the Lord of all. <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–Herein, <span class="e2">jānibe</span>–you should know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">śivādi</span> <span class="e2">devatā</span>–Śiva and the other gods <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">aṁśa-rūpa</span>–partial forms <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–of Him.
“Kṛṣṇa is the Lord of all; you should know for certain that Śiva and the other gods are partial forms of Him.
সেই সেই দেবের নামাদি গুণরূপ ।<br />কৃষ্ণশক্তিদত্ত সিদ্ধ জানহ স্বরূপ ॥৭০॥
sei sei devera nāmādi guṇa-rūpa<br />kṛṣṇa-śakti-datta siddha jānaha svarūpa [70]
<span class="e2">jānaha</span>–Know <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–this truth: <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">devera</span>–the gods’ <span class="e2">nāmādi</span> <span class="e2">guṇa-rūpa</span>–names, forms, qualities, and so on, [are] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-śakti-datta siddha</span>–given and produced by Kṛṣṇa’s energy.
“Know this truth: the gods’ names, forms, qualities, and so on, are given and produced by Kṛṣṇa’s energy.
এরূপ জানিলে শিববিষ্ণুতে অভেদে ।<br />জন্মিবে স্বরূপবুদ্ধি, গায় সর্ব্ববেদে ॥৭১॥
e-rūpa jānile śiva-viṣṇute abhede<br />janmibe svarūpa-buddhi gāya sarva-vede [71]
<span class="e2">sarva-vede</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing [that] <span class="e2">jānile</span>–if you understand [that] <span class="e2">śiva-viṣṇute</span>–Śiva and Viṣṇu [are] <span class="e2">abhede</span>–nondifferent <span class="e2">e-rūpa</span>–in this sense, [then your] <span class="e2">svarūpa-buddhi</span>–awareness of the truth <span class="e2">janmibe</span>–will develop.
“All the scriptures sing that if you understand that Śiva and Viṣṇu are nondifferent in this sense, then you will know the truth.
ভেদবুদ্ধি অপরাধ যত্নেতে ত্যজিবে ।<br />গুরুকৃপাবলে তবে শ্রীনাম ভজিবে ॥৭২॥
bheda-buddhi aparādha yatnete tyajibe<br />guru-kṛpā-bale tabe śrī-nāma bhajibe [72]
<span class="e2">yatnete</span>–Carefully <span class="e2">tyajibe</span>–avoid <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the offence <span class="e2">bheda-buddhi</span>–of considering [them] different, [and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then, <span class="e2">guru-kṛpā-bale</span>–by the mercy of Śrī Guru, <span class="e2">bhajibe</span>–you will [be able to] serve <span class="e2">śrī-nāma</span>–the Name.
“Carefully avoid the offence of considering Viṣṇu and Śiva different, and then, by the mercy of Śrī Guru, you will be able to serve the Name.
‘গুরোরবজ্ঞা শ্রুতিশাস্ত্রনিন্দনম্<br />তথার্থবাদো হরিনাম্নি কল্পনম্ ।<br />নাম্নো বলাদ্যস্য হি পাপবুদ্ধির্<br />ন বিদ্যতে তস্য যমৈর্হি শুদ্ধিঃ’ ॥৭৩॥
‘guror avajñā śruti-śāstra-nindanam<br />tathārthavādo hari-nāmni kalpanam<br />nāmno balād yasya hi pāpa-buddhir<br />na vidyate tasya yamair hi śuddhiḥ’ [73]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumār said:] “Those who (3) disrespect Śrī Guru, (4) criticise the scriptures, (5) consider the Name’s glories exaggerated praise, (6) consider the Name imaginary, or (7) desire to sin on the power of the Name, cannot be purified by any type of regulation.”’*
গুরু-কর্ণধারের অনাদর
guru-karṇadhārera anādara
Disrespecting your captain, Śrī Guru
কৃপা করি’ যেই জন হরি দেখাইল ।<br />হরিনাম-পরিচয় করাইয়া দিল ॥৭৪॥<br />সেই মোর কর্ণধার গুরু মহাশয় ।<br />তাঁহারে অবজ্ঞা কৈলে নামাপরাধ হয় ॥৭৫॥
kṛpā kari’ yei jana hari dekhāila<br />hari-nāma-parichaya karāiyā dila [74]<br />sei mora karṇadhāra guru mahāśaya<br />tā̐hāre avajñā kaile nāmāparādha haya [75]
<span class="e2">sei yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–He who <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">dekhāila</span>–has revealed <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord [to me and] <span class="e2">hari-nāma-parichaya</span> <span class="e2">karāiyā</span> <span class="e2">dila</span>–introduced me to the Lord’s Name [is] <span class="e2">mora</span>–my <span class="e2">karṇadhāra</span>–captain, [my] <span class="e2">guru</span> <span class="e2">mahāśaya</span>–worshippable Guru. <span class="e2">avajñā</span> <span class="e2">kaile</span>–If I disrespect <span class="e2">tā̐hāre</span>–Him, <span class="e2">nāmāparādha</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–I offend the Name.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “He who has mercifully revealed the Lord to me and introduced me to His Name is my captain, my worshippable Guru. If I disrespect him, I offend the Name.
‘হীনজাতি পাণ্ডিত্য-রহিত মন্ত্রহীন’ ।<br />নামের গুরুতে হেন বুদ্ধি অর্ব্বাচীন ॥৭৬॥
‘hīna-jāti pāṇḍitya-rahita mantra-hīna’<br />nāmera gurute hena buddhi arvāchīna [76]
<span class="e2">‘hīna-jāti</span>–‘Low-class, <span class="e2">pāṇḍitya-rahita</span>–uneducated, [or] <span class="e2">mantra-hīna’</span>–uninitiated’—[those who have] <span class="e2">hena</span>–such <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–a mentality <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">gurute</span>–about the Guru of the Name [are] <span class="e2">arvāchīna</span>–foolish.
“Those who consider the Guru who reveals the Name to be low-class, uneducated, or uninitiated are foolish.
*In his commentary on <span class="e3">Śrī Hari-bhakti-vilāsa</span> (11.522), Śrīla Sanātan Goswāmī explains that ‘by any type of regulation’ (<span class="e3">yamaiḥ</span>) means by aṣṭāṅga-yoga, pious activities, brahminical qualities, or prolonged punishment from Yamarāj.
শ্রুতিশাস্ত্রে অনাদর
śruti-śāstre anādara
Disrespecting the scriptures
যেই শ্রুতিশাস্ত্র নামের ব্রহ্মত্ব দেখায় ।<br />অপার মাহাত্ম্য নামের জগতে জানায় ॥৭৭॥<br />তারে অনাদর করি’ কর্ম্মাদি প্রশংসে ।<br />শ্রুতিনিন্দা বলি’ তারে সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে ভাষে ॥৭৮॥
yei śruti-śāstra nāmera brahmatva dekhāya<br />apāra māhātmya nāmera jagate jānāya [77]<br />tāre anādara kari’ karmādi praśaṁse<br />śruti-nindā bali’ tāre sarva-śāstre bhāṣe [78]
<span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">śruti-śāstra</span>–The scriptures that <span class="e2">dekhāya</span>–reveal <span class="e2">brahmatva</span>–the transcendental nature <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name [and] <span class="e2">jānāya</span>–proclaim <span class="e2">apāra</span> <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the unlimited glories <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name <span class="e2">jagate</span>–throughout this world— <span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–all the scriptures <span class="e2">bhāṣe</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">anādara</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–disrespecting <span class="e2">tāre</span>–them [and] <span class="e2">praśaṁse</span>–praising <span class="e2">karmādi</span>–material activities and other non-devotional practices [is] <span class="e2">bali’</span>–known as <span class="e2">śruti-nindā</span>–criticism of the scriptures.
“The scriptures reveal the transcendental nature of the Name and proclaim the unlimited glories of the Name throughout this world. Disrespecting them and praising non-devotional activities is criticism of the scriptures. All the scriptures say so.
নামে কল্পনাবুদ্ধি
nāme kalpanā-buddhi
Considering the Name imaginary
নাম নিত্যধন সদা চিন্ময় অগাধ ।<br />তাহাতে কল্পনাবুদ্ধি গুরু অপরাধ ॥৭৯॥
nāma nitya-dhana sadā chinmaya agādha<br />tāhāte kalpanā-buddhi guru aparādha [79]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name— <span class="e2">sadā</span>–eternal, <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual, [and] <span class="e2">agādha</span>–unfathomable— [is your] <span class="e2">nitya-dhana</span>–eternal wealth. [Having] <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–the mentality [that] <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–He [is] <span class="e2">kalpanā</span>–an imagination [is] <span class="e2">guru</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–a heavy offence.
“The Name—eternal, spiritual, and unfathomable—is your eternal wealth. To consider the Name imaginary is a heavy offence.
নামবলে পাপবুদ্ধি
nāma-bale pāpa-buddhi
Desiring to sin on the power of the Name
নামবলে পাপবুদ্ধি হৃদয়ে যাহার ।<br />সতত উদয় হয়, সেই ত’ অসার ॥৮০॥
nāma-bale pāpa-buddhi hṛdaye yāhāra<br />satata udaya haya, sei ta’ asāra [80]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">ta’ yāhāra hṛdaye</span>–Those within whose hearts <span class="e2">pāpa-buddhi</span>–the desire to sin <span class="e2">nāma-bale</span>–on the power of the Name <span class="e2">satata</span>–constantly <span class="e2">udaya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–arises [are] <span class="e2">asāra</span>–wretched.
“Those who within their hearts desire to sin on the power of the Name are wretched.
নামে অর্থবাদ
nāme arthavāda
Considering the glories of the Name exaggeration
রোচনার্থা ফলশ্রুতি কর্ম্মমার্গে সত্য ।<br />ভক্তিমার্গে নামফল সর্ব্বকালে নিত্য ॥৮১॥
rochanārthā phala-śruti karma-mārge satya<br />bhakti-mārge nāma-phala sarva-kāle nitya [81]
<span class="e2">phala-śruti</span>–The (temporary, material) results, described in the Vedas, <span class="e2">karma-mārge</span>–of the path of action, [which are] <span class="e2">rochanārthā</span>–for the purpose of attraction, [are] <span class="e2">satya</span>–real, [but] <span class="e2">nāma-phala</span>–the results produced by the Name <span class="e2">bhakti-mārge</span>–on the path of devotion [are] <span class="e2">sarva-kāle</span>–always <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal.
“The benefits of the path of action, which the scriptures describe for the purpose of attraction, are real, but the benefits of chanting the Name on the path of devotion are always eternal.
অপ্রাকৃত নামের মাহাত্ম্য সীমাহীন ।<br />তাতে যার ‘অর্থবাদ’ সেই অর্বাচীন ॥৮২॥
aprākṛta nāmera māhātmya sīmā-hīna<br />tāte yāra ‘arthavāda’ sei arvāchīna [82]
<span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–The supramundane glories of the Name [have] <span class="e2">sīmā-hīna</span>–no end. <span class="e2">sei yāra</span>–Those who [consider] <span class="e2">tāte</span>–them <span class="e2">‘arthavāda’</span>–exaggeration [are] <span class="e2">arvāchīna</span>–foolish.
“There is no end to the supramundane glories of the Name. Those who consider them exaggeration are foolish.
এই সব অপরাধ বর্জ্জনে নামের কৃপা
ei saba aparādha varjane nāmera kṛpā
By avoiding these offences, <br />you will attain the grace of the Name
এই পঞ্চ অপরাধ বর্জ্জিবে যতনে ।<br />তবে ত’ নামের কৃপা লভিবে সাধনে ॥৮৩॥
ei pañcha aparādha varjibe yatane<br />tabe ta’ nāmera kṛpā labhibe sādhane [83]
<span class="e2">yatane</span>–Carefully <span class="e2">varjibe</span>–avoid <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">pañcha</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–these five offences; <span class="e2">tabe</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span>–then <span class="e2">labhibe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–the grace <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name <span class="e2">sādhane</span>–through [your] practice.
“Carefully avoid these five offences; then you will attain the grace of the Name through your practice.
‘ধর্ম্মব্রতত্যাগহুতাদিসর্ব্বশুভক্রিয়াসাম্যমপি প্রমাদঃ ।<br />অশ্রদ্দধানে বিমুখেঽপ্যশৃণ্বতি যশ্চোপদেশঃ শিবনামাপরাধঃ’ ॥৮৪॥
‘dharma-vrata-tyāga-hutādi-sarva-<br />śubha-kriyā-sāmyam api pramādaḥ<br />aśraddadhāne vimukhe ’py aśṛṇvati<br />yaś chopadeśaḥ śiva-nāmāparādhaḥ’ [84]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumār said:] “(8) Disregarding the Name by considering pious activities, such as social duties, rites, austerities, and sacrifices, equal to chanting the Name, (9) and instructing the faithless, the averse, or those who do not want to hear about the Name, are offences to the all-auspicious Name.”’
সর্ব্ব শুভকর্ম্ম প্রাকৃত
sarva śubha-karma prākṛta
All pious activities are mundane
বর্ণাশ্রমময়-ধর্ম্ম ধর্ম্মশাস্ত্রে যত ।<br />দর্শপৌর্ণমাসী-আদি তমোময়-ব্রত ॥৮৫॥<br />দণ্ডী মুণ্ডী সন্ন্যাসাদি ত্যাগের প্রকার ।<br />নিত্য নৈমিত্তিক হোম-আদির ব্যাপার ॥৮৬॥<br />অষ্টাঙ্গ-ষড়ঙ্গ-যোগ-আদি শুভ-কর্ম্ম ।<br />সকলই প্রাকৃত-তত্ত্ব, এই সত্য মর্ম্ম ॥৮৭॥
varṇāśramamaya-dharma dharma-śāstre yata<br />darśa-paurṇamāsī-ādi tamomaya-vrata [85]<br />daṇḍī muṇḍī sannyāsādi tyāgera prakāra<br />nitya naimittika homa-ādira vyāpāra [86]<br />aṣṭāṅga-ṣaḍ-aṅga-yoga-ādi śubha-karma<br />sakala-i prākṛta-tattva, ei satya marma [87]
<span class="e2">śubha-karma</span>–The pious activities [prescribed] <span class="e2">dharma-śāstre</span>–in religious scriptures— <span class="e2">varṇāśramamaya-dharma</span>–the duties of your social role and class, <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">darśa-paurṇamāsī-ādi</span> <span class="e2">tamomaya-vrata</span>–the dark rites on the new moon and the full moon,<span class="e2"> nitya</span> <span class="e2">naimittika</span> <span class="e2">homa-ādira</span> <span class="e2">vyāpāra</span>–daily and periodic sacrifices,<span class="e2"> aṣṭāṅga-ṣaḍ-aṅga-yoga</span>–the eightfold or sixfold paths of yoga, [and] <span class="e2">daṇḍī</span> <span class="e2">muṇḍī</span> <span class="e2">sannyāsādi</span> <span class="e2">tyāgera</span> <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–the austerities of carrying a staff, shaving your head, giving up all your possessions, <span class="e2">ādi</span>–and so on— [are] <span class="e2">sakala-i</span>–all <span class="e2">prākṛta-tattva</span>–mundane. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This [is] <span class="e2">satya</span> <span class="e2">marma</span>–the fundamental truth.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “The duties of your social role and class, the dark rites on the new moon and the full moon, daily and periodic sacrifices, the eightfold or sixfold paths of yoga, and the austerities of carrying a staff, shaving your head, and giving up all your possessions—all these and other pious activities prescribed in the religious scriptures are mundane. This is the fundamental truth.
উপায়রূপেতে তারা উপেয় সাধয় ।<br />না সাধিলে জড় বই কিছু আর নয় ॥৮৮॥
upāya-rūpete tārā upeya sādhaya<br />nā sādhile jaḍa va-i kichhu āra naya [88]
<span class="e2">tārā</span>–They <span class="e2">sādhaya</span>–may be performed <span class="e2">upāya-rūpete</span>–as a means <span class="e2">upeya</span>–to pursue the goal, [but] <span class="e2">sādhile nā</span>–if they are not performed [for that purpose, then they are] <span class="e2">va-i</span>–only <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–material <span class="e2">āra kichhu</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–and nothing more.
“These practices may be performed as a means to pursue the goal (of devotion), but if they are not performed for that purpose, then they are material and nothing more.
শ্রীনাম উপায়, উপেয়
śrī-nāma upāya, upeya
The Name is the means and the goal
নাম কিন্তু অপ্রাকৃত চিন্ময় ব্যাপার ।<br />সাধনে উপায়তত্ত্ব সাধ্যে উপেয়-সার ॥৮৯॥
nāma kintu aprākṛta chinmaya vyāpāra<br />sādhane upāya-tattva sādhye upeya-sāra [89]
[Chanting] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name, <span class="e2">kintu</span>–however, [is a] <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span>–supramundane, <span class="e2">chinmaya</span> <span class="e2">vyāpāra</span>–spiritual engagement. <span class="e2">sādhane</span>–In practice, [the Name is] <span class="e2">upāya-tattva</span>–the means [and] <span class="e2">sādhye</span>–in perfection, [the Name is] <span class="e2">upeya-sāra</span>–the primary engagement.
“Chanting the Name, however, is a supramundane, spiritual engagement. In the practising stage, the Name is the means, and in the perfectional stage, the Name is the primary engagement.
অতএব নামতত্ত্ব বিশুদ্ধ চিন্ময় ।<br />জড়োপায় কর্ম্ম সহ সাম্য কভু নয় ॥৯০॥
ataeva nāma-tattva viśuddha chinmaya<br />jaḍopāya karma saha sāmya kabhu naya [90]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">nāma-tattva</span>–the Name, by nature <span class="e2">viśuddha</span>–pure [and] <span class="e2">chinmaya</span>–spiritual, <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–is never <span class="e2">sāmya</span>–equal <span class="e2">jaḍopāya</span> <span class="e2">karma</span> <span class="e2">saha</span>–to [any] mundane means or action.
“So, the Name, which is pure and spiritual, is never equal to any mundane means or action.
কর্ম্মজ্ঞান সহ নাম তুল্য নহে
karma-jñāna saha nāma tulya nahe
The Name is not equal to mundane action or knowledge
কর্ম্মজ্ঞান সহ নামে সাম্যবুদ্ধি যথা ।<br />নাম-অপরাধ গুরুতর ঘটে তথা ॥৯১॥
karma-jñāna saha nāme sāmya-buddhi yathā<br />nāma-aparādha gurutara ghaṭe tathā [91]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–When [you have] <span class="e2">nāme</span> <span class="e2">sāmya-buddhi</span>–the mentality that the Name is equal <span class="e2">karma-jñāna</span> <span class="e2">saha</span>–to mundane activity or knowledge, <span class="e2">tathā</span>–then <span class="e2">gurutara nāma-aparādha</span>–a very heavy offence to the Name <span class="e2">ghaṭe</span>–occurs.
“If you think the Name is equal to mundane activity or knowledge, you commit a very heavy offence against the Name.
অবিশ্বাসী জনে নাম উপদেশ
aviśvāsī jane nāma upadeśa
Instructing the faithless about the Name
নামে যার বিশ্বাস না জন্মিল ভাগ্যাভাবে ।<br />তাকে নাম উপদেশি’ অপরাধ পাবে ॥৯২॥
nāme yāra viśvāsa nā janmila bhāgyābhāve<br />tāke nāma upadeśi’ aparādha pābe [92]
<span class="e2">upadeśi’</span>–By instructing <span class="e2">tāke yāra</span>–those who, <span class="e2">bhāgyābhāve</span>–lacking good fortune, <span class="e2">viśvāsa</span> <span class="e2">janmila nā</span>–have not developed faith <span class="e2">nāme</span>–in the Name [about] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name, <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will make <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–an offence.
“Instructing those who, lacking good fortune, have no faith in the Name about the Name, is an offence.
এই দুই অপরাধ সদ্গুরুকৃপায় ।<br />বহু যত্নে ছাড়ি’ ভাই নামধন পায় ॥৯৩॥
ei dui aparādha sad-guru-kṛpāya<br />bahu yatne chhāḍi’ bhāi nāma-dhana pāya [93]
<span class="e2">bhāi</span>–Brother, <span class="e2">sad-guru-kṛpāya</span>–by the grace of Śrī Guru, <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">yatne</span>–very carefully <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–avoid <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">dui</span>–these two <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attain <span class="e2">nāma-dhana</span>–the wealth of the Name.
“Brother, by the grace of Śrī Guru, very carefully avoid these two offences and attain the wealth of the Name.
‘শ্রুত্বাপি নামমাহাত্ম্যং যঃ প্রীতিরহিতোঽধমঃ ।<br />অহং-মমাদি-পরমো নাম্নি সোঽপ্যপরাধকৃৎ’ ॥৯৪॥
‘śrutvāpi nāma-māhātmyaṁ yaḥ prīti-rahito ’dhamaḥ<br />ahaṁ-mamādi-paramo nāmni so ’py aparādha-kṛt’ [94]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumār said:] “(10) Fallen souls who, even after hearing the glories of the Name, have no love for the Name and remain engrossed in the conceptions of ‘I’ and ‘mine’ are offenders to the Name.”’
নামের মাহাত্ম্য সব শুনি’ শাস্ত্র হৈতে ।<br />তবু তাহে রতি যার নৈল কোনমতে ॥৯৫॥<br />অহংতা-মমতা-বুদ্ধি দেহেতে করিয়া ।<br />লাভ-পূজা-প্রতিষ্ঠাতে রহিল মজিয়া ॥৯৬॥<br />পাপে রত হঞা পাপ ছাড়িতে না পারে ।<br />নামে যত্ন করি’ চেষ্টা করিবারে নারে ॥৯৭॥<br />সাধুসঙ্গে মতি নহে অসাধু বিষয়ে ।<br />সুখ পায় বিবেক বৈরাগ্য ছাড়াইয়ে ॥৯৮॥<br />এই ত’ নামাপরাধ ঘটনা তাহার ।<br />নামে রুচি নাহি পায় কৃষ্ণের সংসার ॥৯৯॥
nāmera māhātmya saba śuni’ śāstra haite<br />tabu tāhe rati yāra naila kona-mate [95]<br />ahaṁtā-mamatā-buddhi dehete kariyā<br />lābha-pūjā-pratiṣṭhāte rahila majiyā [96]<br />pāpe rata hañā pāpa chhāḍite nā pāre<br />nāme yatna kari’ cheṣṭā karibāre nāre [97]<br />sādhu-saṅge mati nahe asādhu viṣaye<br />sukha pāya viveka vairāgya chhāḍāiye [98]<br />ei ta’ nāmāparādha ghaṭanā tāhāra<br />nāme ruchi nāhi pāya kṛṣṇera saṁsāra [99]
<span class="e2">tāhāra yāra</span>–Those who <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–hear <span class="e2">māhātmya</span>–the glories <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">saba</span>–all <span class="e2">śāstra</span>–the scriptures [but] <span class="e2">tabu</span>–still <span class="e2">rati</span> <span class="e2">naila</span>–have no attachment <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–to the Name <span class="e2">kona-mate</span>–whatsoever; [who] <span class="e2">buddhi kariyā</span>–consider <span class="e2">dehete</span>–the body [to be] <span class="e2">ahaṁtā-mamatā</span>–‘I’ and ‘mine’; [who] <span class="e2">majiyā rahila</span>–take interest <span class="e2">lābha-pūjā-pratiṣṭhāte</span>–in gain, adoration, and position; [who] <span class="e2">pāpe</span> <span class="e2">rata</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–sin [and] <span class="e2">pāre nā</span>–cannot <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–stop <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sinning; [who] <span class="e2">nāre</span>–are unable <span class="e2">cheṣṭā</span> <span class="e2">karibāre</span>–to try [to] <span class="e2">yatna</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–carefully [chant] <span class="e2">nāme</span>–the Name; [who] <span class="e2">mati</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–have no attachment <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–to the association of sādhus; [who] <span class="e2">sukha</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–find pleasure <span class="e2">asādhu</span> <span class="e2">viṣaye</span>–in sinful matters; [and who] <span class="e2">chhāḍāiye</span>–shun <span class="e2">vairāgya</span>–renunciation [and] <span class="e2">viveka</span>–good judgement <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">nāmāparādha</span> <span class="e2">ghaṭanā</span>–offend the Name [and] <span class="e2">pāya nāhi</span>–do not get <span class="e2">ruchi</span>–any taste <span class="e2">nāme</span>–for the Name [or] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–family.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “Those who hear the glories of the Name from all the scriptures but still do not have any love for the Name; who still consider the body to be ‘I’ and ‘mine’; still take interest in wealth, adoration, and position; still sin and fail to stop doing so; still cannot even try to carefully chant the Name; still have no attachment to the association of sādhus; still take pleasure in sinful matters; and still avoid renunciation and good judgement—they offend the Name and do not get any taste for the Name or Kṛṣṇa’s family.
এই দশ অপরাধ নামাপরাধ হয় ।<br />নামধর্ম্মে বাধা দেয় সুমঙ্গলক্ষয় ॥১০০॥
ei daśa aparādha nāmāparādha haya<br />nāma-dharme bādhā deya sumaṅgala-kṣaya [100]
<span class="e2">ei</span>–These <span class="e2">daśa</span>–ten <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">nāmāparādha</span>–the offences to the Name. <span class="e2">bādhā</span> <span class="e2">deya</span>–They obstruct <span class="e2">nāma-dharme</span>–the practice of [chanting] the Name [and] <span class="e2">sumaṅgala-kṣaya</span>–destroy spiritual fortune.
“These are the ten offences to the Name; they obstruct chanting of the Name and destroy spiritual fortune.
‘সর্ব্বাপরাধকৃদপি মুচ্যতে হরিসংশ্রয়ঃ ।<br />হরেরপ্যপরাধান্ যঃ কুর্য্যাদ্দ্বিপাদপাংসনঃ ॥১০১॥<br />নামাশ্রয়ঃ কদাচিৎ স্যাত্তরত্যেষ স নামতঃ ।<br />নাম্নো হি সর্ব্বসুহৃদো হ্যপরাধাৎ পতত্যধঃ’ ॥১০২॥
‘sarvāparādha-kṛd api muchyate hari-saṁśrayaḥ<br />harer apy aparādhān yaḥ kuryād dvipāda-pāṁsanaḥ [101]<span class="e2"><br /></span>nāmāśrayaḥ kadāchit syāt taraty eṣa sa nāmataḥ<br />nāmno hi sarva-suhṛdo hy aparādhāt pataty adhaḥ’ [102]
“[Śrī Sanat Kumār said:] “All kinds of offenders are delivered by taking shelter of the Lord, and two-legged animals who offend even the Lord are delivered by the Lord’s Name when they take shelter of the Name. The Name is certainly the true friend of every soul, but you will certainly fall down by offending the Name.”’
পাপ তাপ অপরাধ জীবের যত হয় ।<br />শ্রীহরিসংশ্রয়ে সব সদ্য হয় ক্ষয় ॥১০৩॥
pāpa tāpa aparādha jīvera yata haya<br />śrī-hari-saṁśraye saba sadya haya kṣaya [103]
<span class="e2">śrī-hari-saṁśraye</span>–By taking shelter of the Lord, <span class="e2">saba yata</span>–all the <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sins, <span class="e2">tāpa</span>–sorrows, [and] <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–the soul has incurred <span class="e2">kṣaya haya</span>–are destroyed <span class="e2">sadya</span>–immediately.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “Taking shelter of the Lord immediately destroys all the soul’s sins, sorrows, and offences.
কলির সংসার ছাড়িয়া কৃষ্ণের সংসার কর
kalira saṁsāra chhāḍiyā kṛṣṇera saṁsāra kara
Leave Kali’s family and join Kṛṣṇa’s family
কলির সংসার ছাড়ি’ কৃষ্ণের সংসার ।<br />অকৈতবে করে যেই অপরাধ নাহি তার ॥১০৪॥
kalira saṁsāra chhāḍi’ kṛṣṇera saṁsāra<br />akaitave kare yei aparādha nāhi tāra [104]
<span class="e2">tāra yei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–leave <span class="e2">kalira</span>–Kali’s <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–family [and] <span class="e2">akaitave</span>–sincerely <span class="e2">kare</span>–act [as members of] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–family <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–make no <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences.
“Those who leave Kali’s family and sincerely live as members of Kṛṣṇa’s family commit no offences.
দীক্ষাকালে অকৈতবে আত্মনিবেদনে সর্ব্বপাপক্ষয়
dīkṣā-kāle akaitave ātma-nivedane sarva-pāpa-kṣaya
Sincere self-surrender at the time of initiation destroys all sin
পূর্ব্ব যত পাপাদি বহু জন্মে করে ।<br />হরিদীক্ষামাত্রে সেই সব পাপে তরে ॥১০৫॥
pūrva yata pāpādi bahu janme kare<br />hari-dīkṣā-mātre sei saba pāpe tare [105]
<span class="e2">hari-dīkṣā-mātre</span>–Simply taking initiation [into the Lord’s service] <span class="e2">tare</span>–destroys <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">pāpe yata</span> <span class="e2">pāpādi</span>–all the sins and offences [that] <span class="e2">kare</span>–you committed <span class="e2">pūrva</span> <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">janme</span>–in [your] numerous previous births.
“Simply taking initiation into the Lord’s service destroys all the sins and offences that you committed in all your previous births.
অকৈতবে করে যবে আত্মনিবেদন ।<br />কৃষ্ণ তার পূর্ব্ব পাপ করেন খণ্ডন ॥১০৬॥
akaitave kare yabe ātma-nivedana<br />kṛṣṇa tāra pūrva pāpa karena khaṇḍana [106]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When [someone] <span class="e2">akaitave</span>–sincerely <span class="e2">ātma-nivedana kare</span>–surrenders themself, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">khaṇḍana karena</span>–cuts away [all] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">pūrva</span>–previous <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sins.
“When you sincerely surrender yourself, Kṛṣṇa cuts away all your previous sins.
প্রায়শ্চিত্ত করিবারে তার নাহি হয় ।<br />দীক্ষামাত্র পাপক্ষয় সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কয় ॥১০৭॥
prāyaśchitta karibāre tāra nāhi haya<br />dīkṣā-mātra pāpa-kṣaya sarva-śāstre kaya [107]
<span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–They do not need <span class="e2">karibāre</span>–to make <span class="e2">prāyaśchitta</span>–atonement: <span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–all the scriptures <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">dīkṣā-mātra</span>–initiation alone <span class="e2">pāpa-kṣaya</span>–destroys sins.
“You do not need to make any atonement: all the scriptures say that initiation alone destroys all sins.
নিষ্কপটে হর্য্যাশ্রয় করে যেই জন ।<br />সর্ব্ব অপরাধ তার বিনষ্ট তখন ॥১০৮॥<br />আর পাপতাপে কভু রুচি নাহি হয় ।<br />পুণ্য পাপ দূরে যায়, মায়া করে জয় ॥১০৯॥
niṣkapaṭe haryāśraya kare yei jana<br />sarva aparādha tāra vinaṣṭa takhana [108]<br />āra pāpa-tāpe kabhu ruchi nāhi haya<br />puṇya pāpa dūre yāya, māyā kare jaya [109]
[When] <span class="e2">yei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–someone <span class="e2">niṣkapaṭe</span>–sincerely <span class="e2">haryāśraya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–takes shelter of the Lord, <span class="e2">takhana</span>–then <span class="e2">tāra sarva</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–all their offences [are] <span class="e2">vinaṣṭa</span>–destroyed, <span class="e2">āra kabhu</span> <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–they never again have any more <span class="e2">ruchi</span>–taste <span class="e2">pāpa-tāpe</span>–for sin and suffering, [their] <span class="e2">puṇya</span>–piety [and] <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sins <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away, [and] <span class="e2">jaya kare</span>–they conquer <span class="e2">māyā</span>–the illusory environment.
“When you sincerely take shelter of the Lord, all your offences are destroyed, you never again have any taste for sin and suffering, your piety and sins disappear, and you conquer the illusory environment.
সেবা-অপরাধ
sevā-aparādha
Offences in worship*
তবে তার কভু হয় সেবা-অপরাধ ।<br />সেই অপরাধে হয় ভক্তিক্রিয়াবাধ ॥১১০॥<br />সাধুসঙ্গে করে কৃষ্ণনামের আশ্রয় ।<br />নামাশ্রয়ে সেবা-অপরাধ নষ্ট হয় ॥১১১॥
tabe tāra kabhu haya sevā-aparādha<br />sei aparādhe haya bhakti-kriyā-bādha [110]<br />sādhu-saṅge kare kṛṣṇa-nāmera āśraya<br />nāmāśraye sevā-aparādha naṣṭa haya [111]
<span class="e2">tabe</span>–Thereafter, <span class="e2">tāra</span> <span class="e2">sevā-aparādha</span> <span class="e2">kabhu haya</span>–someone [may] sometimes commit offences in worship, [and] <span class="e2">bhakti-kriyā-bādha haya</span>–the practice of devotion is obstructed <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">aparādhe</span>–by such offences.
