[But if] <span class="e2">āśraya kare</span>–someone takes shelter <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāmera</span>–of the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sādhu-saṅge</span>–in the association of the sādhus, [all] <span class="e2">sevā-aparādha</span>–offences in worship <span class="e2">naṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are destroyed <span class="e2">nāmāśraye</span>–by the Name’s shelter.
“After surrendering at initiation, you still may sometimes commit offences in worship, and such offences will obstruct your practice of devotion. But if you take shelter of the Name of Kṛṣṇa in the association of the sādhus, the Name’s shelter will destroy all such offences.
*Thirty-two types of offences in worship are listed in <span class="e3">Śrī Hari-bhakti-vilāsa</span> (8.441–8): (1) Entering the Lord’s Temple in a vehicle or while wearing shoes. (2) Not observing the Lord’s birthday and other Pastimes. (3) Not offering obeisance when coming before the Deity. (4) Visiting the Deity without appropriately washing oneself
নামকৃপা হৈলে জীব সর্ব্বশুদ্ধি পায় ।<br />কৃষ্ণের নিকট গিয়া করে শুদ্ধসেবার আশ্রয় ॥১১২॥
nāma-kṛpā haile jīva sarva-śuddhi pāya<br />kṛṣṇera nikaṭa giyā kare śuddha-sevāra āśraya [112]
<span class="e2">nāma-kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–When souls receive the mercy of the Name <span class="e2">jīva</span>–souls <span class="e2">sarva-śuddhi</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–become completely pure, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭa</span> <span class="e2">giyā</span>–reach Kṛṣṇa, [and] <span class="e2">śuddha-sevāra</span> <span class="e2">āśraya kare</span>–take shelter in pure service.
“When souls receive the mercy of the Name, they become completely pure, reach Kṛṣṇa, and render pure service.
সর্ব্বদা নামাপরাধ বর্জ্জনীয়
sarvadā nāmāparādha varjanīya
Offences to the Name must be avoided always
কিন্তু যদি নাম-অপরাধ তার হয় ।<br />তবে পুনঃ অধঃপাত হইবে নিশ্চয় ॥১১৩॥
kintu yadi nāma-aparādha tāra haya<br />tabe punaḥ adhaḥpāta ha-ibe niśchaya [113]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If, <span class="e2">kintu</span>–however, <span class="e2">tāra nāma-aparādha</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–someone offends the Name, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly <span class="e2">adhaḥpāta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–they will fall down <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again.
“If, however, you offend the Name, you will certainly fall down again.
after eating or evacuating. (5) Offering obeisance with one hand. (6) Circumambulating others before the Deity. (7) Spreading your legs before the Deity. (8) Sitting before the Deity while holding up your knees with your forearms. (9) Lying down before the Deity. (10) Eating before the Deity. (11) Telling lies before the Deity. (12) Speaking loudly before the Deity. (13) Conversing privately before the Deity. (14) Crying before the Deity (over a worldly matter). (15) Quarrelling before the Deity. (16) Punishing someone before the Deity. (17) Being charitable to someone before the Deity. (18) Behaving cruelly towards someone. (19) Serving the Deity while covered with a wool, fur, or down blanket. (20) Criticising others before the Deity. (21) Praising others before the Deity. (22) Using foul language before the Deity. (23) Passing air (or belching) before the Deity. (24) Offering low quality articles to the Deity when you are able to provide good quality ones. (25) Taking items for yourself that have not been offered to the Deity. (26) Not offering fruits and grains to the Deity when they come into season. (27) Offering the Deity articles that have partially used by others. (28) Sitting with your back to the Deity. (29) Offering obeisances to others before the Deity (one should offer obeisance to Śrī Gurudev before the Deity, but not to Vaiṣṇavas in general). (30) Remaining quiet and not offering praise, obeisance, and so on, before Śrī Gurudev. (31) Praising oneself before Śrī Gurudev. (32) Criticising the gods.
সর্ব্বজীব-বন্ধু নাম, তাঁর অপরাধ ।<br />কোনক্রমে ক্ষয় নহে প্রাপ্ত্যে হয় বাধ ॥১১৪॥
sarva-jīva-bandhu nāma, tā̐ra aparādha<br />kona-krame kṣaya nahe prāptye haya bādha [114]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-jīva-bandhu</span>–the friend of every soul, [but] <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences against Him <span class="e2">bādha haya</span>–obstruct [the soul] <span class="e2">prāptye</span>–in [their] progress [and] <span class="e2">nahe</span>–are not <span class="e2">kṣaya</span>–destroyed <span class="e2">kona-krame</span>–by any means (other than surrender to the Name).
“The Name is the friend of every soul, but offences against Him obstruct the soul’s progress and cannot be counteracted by any means.
নাম অপরাধ ত্যাগ বহু যত্নে করি’ ।<br />লভে জীব সর্ব্বসিদ্ধি প্রাপ্ত হয় হরি ॥১১৫॥
nāma aparādha tyāga bahu yatne kari’<br />labhe jīva sarva-siddhi prāpta haya hari [115]
<span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">yatne</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–By very carefully <span class="e2">tyāga</span>–avoiding <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the offences to the Name, <span class="e2">jīva</span>–the soul <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attains <span class="e2">sarva-siddhi</span>–all perfection [and] <span class="e2">prāpta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–reaches <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord.
“Only by very carefully avoiding the offences to the Name does the soul attain all perfection and reach the Lord.
‘এবং নারদঃ শঙ্করেণ কৃপয়া মহ্যং মুনীনাং পরং<br />প্রোক্তং নাম সুখাবহং ভগবতো বর্জ্জ্যং সদা যত্নতঃ ।<br />যে জ্ঞাত্বাপি ন বর্জ্জয়ন্তি সহসা নামাপরাধান্দশ<br />ক্রুদ্ধা মাতরমপ্যভোজনপরাঃ খিদ্যন্তি তে বালবৎ’ ॥১১৬॥
‘evaṁ nāradaḥ śaṅkareṇa kṛpayā mahyaṁ munīnāṁ paraṁ<br />proktaṁ nāma sukhāvahaṁ bhagavato varjyaṁ sadā yatnataḥ<br />ye jñātvāpi na varjayanti sahasā nāmāparādhān daśa<br />kruddhā mātaram apy abhojana-parāḥ khidyanti te bālavat’ [116]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumar said:] “O Nārad, in this way Śiva mercifully spoke to me and the great sages about the Name of the Lord, the source of all happiness. Those who understand these ten offences to the Name—which must always be carefully avoided—but still do not immediately avoid them are like children who become angry with their mothers, refuse to eat, and then suffer.”’
আমি পূর্ব্বে শিবলোকে শঙ্করসন্নিধানে ।<br />নাম-অপরাধ-কথা জিজ্ঞাসিলাম মুনে ॥১১৭॥
āmi pūrve śivaloke śaṅkara-sannidhāne<br />nāma-aparādha-kathā jijñāsilāma mune [117]
<span class="e2">mune</span>–O sage (O Nārad Muni), <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–previously, <span class="e2">śivaloke</span>–in the abode of Lord Śiva, <span class="e2">śaṅkara-sannidhāne</span>–in the association of Lord Śiva, <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">jijñāsilāma</span>–asked <span class="e2">nāma-aparādha-kathā</span>–about the offences to the Name.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “O sage, previously, in Śivaloka, I asked Śaṅkar about the offences to the Name.
বহুমুনিগণ মধ্যে শম্ভু কৃপা করি’ ।<br />আমায় উপদেশ করে কৈলাস উপরি ॥১১৮॥
bahu-muni-gaṇa madhye śambhu kṛpā kari’<br />āmāya upadeśa kare kailāsa upari [118]
<span class="e2">upari</span>–Atop <span class="e2">kailāsa</span>–Mount Kailash, <span class="e2">bahu-muni-gaṇa</span> <span class="e2">madhye</span>–in the midst of many sages, <span class="e2">śambhu</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">kṛpā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">upadeśa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–instructed <span class="e2">āmāya</span>–me.
“There, on Mount Kailash, in the midst of many sages, Śambhu mercifully instructed me.
ভগবানের নাম সর্ব্বজীবসুখাবহ ।<br />তাতে অপরাধ সর্ব্ব-অমঙ্গল-বহ ॥১১৯॥
bhagavānera nāma sarva-jīva-sukhāvaha<br />tāte aparādha sarva-amaṅgala-vaha [119]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name<span class="e2"> bhagavānera</span>–of the Lord [is] <span class="e2">sarva-jīva-sukhāvaha</span>–the source of all happiness for the souls, [and] <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">tāte</span>–to Him [are] <span class="e2">sarva-amaṅgala-vaha</span>–the source of all inauspiciousness.
“The Name of the Lord is the source of all happiness for the soul, and offences to the Name are the source of all inauspiciousness.
মঙ্গল লভিতে যার ইচ্ছা আছে মনে ।<br />সদা নাম-অপরাধ বর্জ্জিবে যতনে ॥১২০॥
maṅgala labhite yāra ichchhā āchhe mane<br />sadā nāma-aparādha varjibe yatane [120]
<span class="e2">yāra</span> <span class="e2">ichchhā mane</span> <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–Those who desire <span class="e2">labhite</span>–to attain <span class="e2">maṅgala</span>–auspiciousness <span class="e2">varjibe</span>–must avoid <span class="e2">yatane</span>–carefully <span class="e2">nāma-aparādha</span>–the offences to the Name <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always.
“Those who desire auspiciousness must always carefully avoid the offences to the Name.
সাধুগুরুসন্নিধানে বহু দৈন্য ধরি’ ।<br />দশ অপরাধ-তত্ত্ব লবে শিক্ষা করি’ ॥১২১॥
sādhu-guru-sannidhāne bahu dainya dhari’<br />daśa aparādha-tattva labe śikṣā kari’ [121]
<span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">dainya</span> <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–With great humility, <span class="e2">śikṣā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span> <span class="e2">labe</span>–you should learn <span class="e2">daśa</span> <span class="e2">aparādha-tattva</span>–the ten offences <span class="e2">sādhu-guru-sannidhāne</span>–from Śrī Guru and the sādhus.
“With great humility, you should learn the ten offences from Śrī Guru and the sādhus.
অপরাধগুলি যত্নে জানিয়া ত্যজিবে ।<br />সত্বরে শ্রীহরিনামে প্রেম উপজিবে ॥১২২॥
aparādhaguli yatne jāniyā tyajibe<br />satvare śrī-hari-nāme prema upajibe [122]
<span class="e2">yatne</span>–Carefully <span class="e2">jāniyā</span>–having understood <span class="e2">aparādhaguli</span>–these offences, <span class="e2">tyajibe</span>–you should avoid [them]. [Then] <span class="e2">upajibe</span>–you will develop <span class="e2">satvare</span>–quickly <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love <span class="e2">śrī-hari-nāme</span>–by [chanting] the Lord’s Name.
“Having carefully understood the offences, you should avoid them. Then you will quickly develop divine love for the Lord’s Name.
নাম পেয়ে অপরাধ বর্জ্জন না করে ।<br />সহসা তাহারে দশ অপরাধ ধরে ॥১২৩॥
nāma peye aparādha varjana nā kare<br />sahasā tāhāre daśa aparādha dhare [123]
<span class="e2">daśa</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–The ten offences <span class="e2">sahasā</span>–immediately <span class="e2">dhare</span>–seize <span class="e2">tāhāre</span>–those who <span class="e2">peye</span>–receive <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [but] <span class="e2">varjana</span> <span class="e2">kare nā</span>–do not avoid <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences.
“The ten offences immediately seize those who receive the Name but do not try to avoid them.
অপরাধ বর্জ্জন না করিয়া নাম করা মূঢ়তা
aparādha varjana nā kariyā nāma karā mūḍhatā
Chanting the Name but not avoiding the offences is foolishness
অপরাধ বুঝিয়া যে বর্জ্জনে উদাসীন ।<br />তার দুঃখ নিরন্তর সেই অর্ব্বাচীন ॥১২৪॥
aparādha bujhiyā ye varjane udāsīna<br />tāra duḥkha nirantara sei arvāchīna [124]
<span class="e2">sei ye</span>–Those who <span class="e2">bujhiyā</span>–understand <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the offences [but are] <span class="e2">udāsīna</span>–unconcerned <span class="e2">varjane</span>–about avoiding [them are] <span class="e2">arvāchīna</span>–foolish, [and] <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–suffering [goes on] <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–forever.
“Those who understand the offences but are unconcerned about avoiding them are foolish and suffer forever.
মায়ে ক্রোধ করি’ বালক না করে ভোজন ।<br />সুপথ্য অভাবে সদা ক্লেশের ভাজন ॥১২৫॥
māye krodha kari’ bālaka nā kare bhojana<br />supathya abhāve sadā kleśera bhājana [125]
<span class="e2">bālaka</span>–Children [who] <span class="e2">bhojana kare nā</span>–do not eat, <span class="e2">krodha</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–being angry <span class="e2">māye</span>–with [their] mothers, <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always [become] <span class="e2">bhājana</span>–a subject <span class="e2">kleśera</span>–of suffering <span class="e2">supathya</span> <span class="e2">abhāve</span>–because of a lack of nourishment.
“Children who do not eat out of anger at their mothers always end up suffering without nourishment.
সেইরূপ অপরাধ বর্জ্জন না করি’ ।<br />নাম করে মূঢ় নিজ শিব পরিহরি’ ॥১২৬॥
sei-rūpa aparādha varjana nā kari’<br />nāma kare mūḍha nija śiva parihari’ [126]
<span class="e2">sei-rūpa</span>–Similarly, <span class="e2">mūḍha</span>–fools [who] <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–chant the Name [but] <span class="e2">varjana</span> <span class="e2">kari’ nā</span>–do not avoid <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the offences <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–throw away <span class="e2">nija</span>–their own <span class="e2">śiva</span>–good fortune.
“Like such angry children, fools who chant the Name but do not avoid the offences throw away their own good fortune.”
‘অপরাধবিমুক্তো হি নাম্নি জপ্তং সদাচর ।<br />নাম্নৈব তব দেবর্ষে সর্ব্বাং সেৎস্যতি নান্যথা’ ॥১২৭॥
‘aparādha-vimukto hi nāmni japtaṁ sadāchara<br />nāmnaiva tava devarṣe sarvāṁ setsyati nānyathā’ [127]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumar said:] “Be free from the offences and always chant the Name. O sage amongst the gods, you will attain everything only through the Name, and not otherwise.”’
সনৎকুমার বলে, ‘ওহে দেবর্ষিপ্রবর ।<br />নিরপরাধে নাম জপ সদাই আচর ॥১২৮॥
sanat kumāra bale, ‘ohe devarṣi-pravara<br />niraparādhe nāma japa sadāi āchara [128]
<span class="e2">sanat</span> <span class="e2">kumāra</span>–Sanat Kumār <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">devarṣi-pravara</span>–best of the sages amongst the gods, <span class="e2">sadāi</span>–always [engage in] <span class="e2">āchara</span>–the practice <span class="e2">japa</span>–of chanting <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name <span class="e2">niraparādhe</span>–without offence.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “Sanat Kumār said, ‘O best of the sages amongst the gods, always chant the Name without offence.
নাম বিনা অন্য পন্থা নাহি প্রয়োজন ।<br />নামেতে সকল সিদ্ধি পাবে তপোধন’ ॥১২৯॥
nāma vinā anya panthā nāhi prayojana<br />nāmete sakala siddhi pābe tapo-dhana’ [129]
<span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–need <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">panthā</span>–for any path <span class="e2">vinā</span>–other [than] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name. <span class="e2">tapo-dhana</span>–O Nārad (‘he whose wealth is austerity’), <span class="e2">pābe</span>–you will attain <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">siddhi</span>–all perfection <span class="e2">nāmete’</span>–through the Name.’
“‘There is no need for any path other than the Name. O Nārad, You will attain all perfection through the Name.’
‘শ্রীনারদ উবাচ—<br />সনৎকুমার প্রিয় সাহসানাং<br />বিবেক-বৈরাগ্যবিবর্জ্জিতানাম্ ।<br />দেহপ্রিয়ার্থাত্ম্য-পরায়ণানাম্<br />উক্তাপরাধাঃ প্রভবন্তি নো কথম্’ ॥১৩০॥
‘śrī-nārada uvācha—<br />sanat-kumāra priya sāhasānāṁ<br />viveka-vairāgya-vivarjitānām<br />deha-priyārthātmya-parāyaṇānām<br />uktāparādhāḥ prabhavanti no katham’ [130]
“‘Śrī Nārad said: “Dear Sanat Kumar, we are unruly, devoid of good judgement and renunciation, and engrossed in our bodies, companions, and wealth. How will we stop committing the offences you have described?”’
ওহে সনৎকুমার তুমি সিদ্ধ হরিদাস ।<br />অনায়াসে করিলে নামরহস্যপ্রকাশ ॥১৩১॥
ohe sanat-kumāra tumi siddha haridāsa<br />anāyāse karile nāma-rahasya-prakāśa [131]
“[Nārad said,] <span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">sanat-kumāra</span>–Sanat Kumār, <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you [are] <span class="e2">siddha</span> <span class="e2">haridāsa</span>–a perfect servant of the Lord, [and] <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–clearly <span class="e2">prakāśa karile</span>–you have revealed <span class="e2">nāma-rahasya</span>–the hidden truths about the Name.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “Nārad said, ‘O Sanat Kumār, you are a perfect servant of the Lord, and you have clearly revealed the hidden truths about the Name.
সাধকের নামাপরাধ বর্জ্জনোপায়
sādhakera nāmāparādha varjanopāya
The means for practitioners to avoid the offences to the Name
সাধক আমরা আমাদের বড় ভয় ।<br />অপরাধ-ত্যাগে যত্ন কিরূপেতে হয় ॥১৩২॥
sādhaka āmarā āmādera baḍa bhaya<br />aparādha tyāge yatna ki-rūpete haya [132]
<span class="e2">āmarā</span>–We [are] <span class="e2">sādhaka</span>–practitioners, [and] <span class="e2">āmādera</span> <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–we are very afraid. <span class="e2">ki-rūpete</span>–How <span class="e2">haya</span>–are [we to] <span class="e2">yatna</span>–try <span class="e2">tyāge</span>–to avoid <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the offences?
“‘We are practitioners, and we are very afraid. How should we try to avoid the offences?
বিষয় মোদের বন্ধু তাহার সাহসে ।<br />করিবে সকল কর্ম্ম বদ্ধ মায়াপাশে ॥১৩৩॥
viṣaya modera bandhu tāhāra sāhase<br />karibe sakala karma baddha māyā-pāśe [133]
<span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–Material things [are] <span class="e2">modera</span>–our <span class="e2">bandhu</span>–friends. <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">sāhase</span>–With their audacity, <span class="e2">baddha karibe</span>–they bind <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">karma</span>–all [our] actions <span class="e2">māyā-pāśe</span>–in māyā’s ropes.
“‘Material things are our friends, and they audaciously bind all our actions in māyā’s ropes.
বিবেকবৈরাগ্যশূন্য দেহ প্রিয়জন ।<br />অর্থস্বরূপে মোরা সদা পরায়ণ ॥১৩৪॥
viveka-vairāgya-śūnya deha priya-jana<br />artha-svarūpe morā sadā parāyaṇa [134]
[We are] <span class="e2">viveka-vairāgya-śūnya</span>–devoid of good judgement or renunciation, [and] <span class="e2">morā</span>–we [are] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">parāyaṇa</span>–engrossed <span class="e2">artha-svarūpe</span>–in [our] wealth, <span class="e2">deha</span>–bodies, [and] <span class="e2">priya-jana</span>–companions.
“‘We have no good judgement or renunciation, and we are always engrossed in our bodies, companions, and wealth.
কিরূপে সাধক-মনে অপরাধ দশ ।<br />নাহি উপজিবে তাহা করহ প্রকাশ ॥১৩৫॥
ki-rūpe sādhaka-mane aparādha daśa<br />nāhi upajibe tāhā karaha prakāśa [135]
<span class="e2">prakāśa karaha</span>–Please explain <span class="e2">ki-rūpe</span>–how <span class="e2">tāhā daśa</span> <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the ten offences <span class="e2">upajibe nāhi</span>–will not arise <span class="e2">sādhaka-mane’</span>–in the minds of practitioners [like us].
“‘Please explain how the ten offences can be stopped from arising in the minds of practitioners like us.’
‘শ্রীসনৎকুমার উবাচ—<br />জাতে নামাপরাধে তু প্রমাদে বৈ কথঞ্চন ।<br />সদা সঙ্কীর্ত্তয়েন্নাম তদেকশরণো ভবেৎ ॥১৩৬॥<br />নামাপরাধযুক্তানাং নামান্যেব হরন্ত্যঘম্ ।<br />অবিশ্রান্ত-প্রযুক্তানি তান্যেবার্থকরাণি হি’ ॥১৩৭॥
‘śrī-sanat-kumāra uvācha—<br />jāte nāmāparādhe tu pramāde vai kathañchana<br />sadā saṅkīrtayan nāma tad-eka-śaraṇo bhavet [136]<br />nāmāparādha-yuktānāṁ nāmāny eva haranty agham<br />aviśrānta-prayuktāni tāny evārthakarāṇi cha’ [137]
“‘Śrī Sanat Kumār replied: “If someone offends the Name, out of negligence or otherwise, they must constantly chant the Name and take shelter of the Name exclusively. Only the Name destroys the sins of those who chant the Name with offences. When chanted constantly, the Name is certainly effective.”’
নামেতে শরণাপত্তি যেই ক্ষণে হয় ।<br />তখনই নামাপরাধের সদ্য হয় ক্ষয় ॥১৩৮॥
nāmete śaraṇāpatti yei kṣaṇe haya<br />takhana-i nāmāparādhera sadya haya kṣaya [138]
<span class="e2">takhana-i yei</span> <span class="e2">kṣaṇe</span>–At the moment <span class="e2">śaraṇāpatti haya</span>–someone surrenders <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–to the Name, [their] <span class="e2">nāmāparādhera kṣaya haya</span>–offences to the Name are destroyed <span class="e2">sadya</span>–immediately.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “Your offences to the Name are destroyed immediately the moment you surrender to the Name.
তথাপি প্রমাদে যদি উঠে অপরাধ ।<br />তাহাতেও ভক্তিতে হইয়া পড়ে বাধ ॥১৩৯॥
tathāpi pramāde yadi uṭhe aparādha<br />tāhāteo bhaktite ha-iyā paḍe bādha [139]
<span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–Still, <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">aparādha uṭhe</span>–offences arise <span class="e2">pramāde</span>–out of negligence, [then] [your practice of] <span class="e2">bhaktite</span>–devotion <span class="e2">bādha ha-iyā</span> <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–becomes obstructed <span class="e2">tāhāteo</span>–by that also.
“Still, if you happen to commit offences out of negligence, then those offences will obstruct your practice of devotion.
অপরাধ প্রমাদেতে হইবে যখন ।<br />নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তন তবে করিবে অনুক্ষণ ॥১৪০॥<br />নামেতে শরণাগতি সুদৃঢ় করিবে ।<br />অনুক্ষণ নামবলে অপরাধ যাবে ॥১৪১॥
aparādha pramādete ha-ibe yakhana<br />nāma-saṅkīrtana tabe karibe anukṣaṇa [140]<br />nāmete śaraṇāgati sudṛḍha karibe<br />anukṣaṇa nāma-bale aparādha yābe [141]
<span class="e2">yakhana</span>–When <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–occur <span class="e2">pramādete</span>–out of negligence, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtana</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–you must chant the Name <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–at every moment, [and] <span class="e2">sudṛḍha śaraṇāgati</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–you must firmly surrender <span class="e2">nāmete</span>–to the Name. <span class="e2">nāma-bale</span>–By chanting the Name <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–at every moment, [your] <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will go away.
“When offences occur out of negligence, you must chant the Name at every moment and surrender to the Name with firm resolve. By chanting the Name at every moment, your offences will go away.
নামই উপায়
nāma-i upāya
The Name is the only means
নামেই নামাপরাধ হইবেক ক্ষয় ।<br />অপরাধ নাশিতে আর কারও শক্তি নয় ॥১৪২॥
nāmei nāmāparādha ha-ibeka kṣaya<br />aparādha nāśite āra kārao śakti naya [142]
<span class="e2">nāmāparādha</span>–Offences to the Name <span class="e2">kṣaya ha-ibeka</span>–will be destroyed <span class="e2">nāmei</span>–only by the Name. <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">kārao</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span> <span class="e2">naya</span>–Nothing else has the power <span class="e2">nāśite</span>–to destroy <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–the offences.
“Only the Name destroys offences against the Name; nothing else has the power to do so.
এ বিষয়ে মূলতত্ত্ব বলি হে তোমায় ।<br />বুঝহ নারদ তুমি বেদে যাহা গায় ॥১৪৩॥
e viṣaye mūla-tattva bali he tomāya<br />bujhaha nārada tumi vede yāhā gāya [143]
<span class="e2">bali</span>–I am telling <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–you <span class="e2">mūla-tattva</span>–the fundamental truth <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">viṣaye</span>–in this regard, <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which <span class="e2">vede</span>–the scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–proclaim. <span class="e2">he</span>–O <span class="e2">nārada</span>–Nārad, <span class="e2">tumi bujhaha</span>–you should understand [this].
“I am telling you the fundamental truth about chanting the Name, which the scriptures proclaim. O Nārad, try to understand it.
‘নামৈকং যস্য বাচি স্মরণপথগতং শ্রোত্রমূলং গতং বা<br />শুদ্ধং বাশুদ্ধবর্ণং ব্যবহিতরহিতং তারয়ত্যেব সত্যম্ ।<br />তচ্চেদ্দেহ-দ্রবিণ-জনতা-লোভ-পাষণ্ড-মধ্যে<br />নিক্ষিপ্তং স্যান্নফলজনকং শীঘ্রমেবাত্র বিপ্র’ ॥১৪৪॥
‘nāmaikaṁ yasya vāchi smaraṇa-patha-gataṁ śrotra-mūlaṁ gataṁ vā<br />śuddhaṁ vāśuddha-varṇaṁ vyavahita-rahitaṁ tārayaty eva satyam<br />tach ched deha-draviṇa-janatā-lobha-pāṣaṇḍa-madhye<br />nikṣiptaṁ syān na phala-janakaṁ śīghram evātra vipra’ [144]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumār said:] “The Name, when unconcealed, certainly delivers anyone who once calls, remembers, or hears Him, regardless of whether they utter the Name correctly or incorrectly. But, O brāhmaṇ, if the Name is used for the body, wealth, prestige, greed, or evil, the Name does not produce any quick results.”’
যার মুখে উচ্চারিত এক কৃষ্ণনাম ।<br />যাহার স্মরণপথে এক নাম গুণধাম ॥১৪৫॥<br />যার শ্রোত্রমূলে তাহা প্রবেশ করিবে ।<br />ব্যবহিত-রহিত হৈলে তখনই তারিবে ॥১৪৬॥
yāra mukhe uchchārita eka kṛṣṇa-nāma<br />yāhāra smaraṇa-pathe eka nāma guṇa-dhāma [145]<br />yāra śrotra-mūle tāhā praveśa karibe<br />vyavahita-rahita haile takhanai tāribe [146]
<span class="e2">vyavahita-rahita</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–When unconcealed, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s Name, <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">guṇa-dhāma</span>–the Name which is the abode of all qualities, <span class="e2">takhanai</span>–immediately <span class="e2">tāribe</span>–delivers <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–anyone <span class="e2">yāra</span> <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–within whose mouth <span class="e2">uchchārita</span>–He is uttered <span class="e2">eka</span>–once, <span class="e2">yāhāra</span> <span class="e2">smaraṇa-pathe</span>–within whose path of remembrance [He appears] <span class="e2">eka</span>–once, [and] <span class="e2">yāra</span> <span class="e2">śrotra-mūle</span>–within whose ears <span class="e2">praveśa</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–He enters.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “When unconcealed, Kṛṣṇa’s Name, the abode of all qualities, immediately delivers anyone within whose mouth He is once uttered, within whose remembrance He once arises, and within whose ears He once enters.
‘ব্যবহিত’ এই শব্দে দুই অর্থ হয় ।<br />অক্ষরের ব্যবধানে নাম আচ্ছাদয় ॥১৪৭॥<br />অবিদ্যার আচ্ছাদনে প্রাকৃত প্রকাশ ।<br />নাম নামী একভাবে অবিদ্যা-বিনাশ ॥১৪৮॥
‘vyavahita’ ei śabde dui artha haya<br />akṣarera vyavadhāne nāma āchchhādaya [147]<br />avidyāra āchchhādane prākṛta prakāśa<br />nāma nāmī eka-bhāve avidyā-vināśa [148]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">śabde</span>–The word <span class="e2">‘vyavahita’</span>–‘concealed’ <span class="e2">dui</span> <span class="e2">artha</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–has two meanings: <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name <span class="e2">āchchhādaya</span>–is hidden <span class="e2">akṣarera</span> <span class="e2">vyavadhāne</span>–by separations between His syllables, [and the Name has a] <span class="e2">prākṛta</span>–mundane <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–appearance [to the soul] <span class="e2">avidyāra</span> <span class="e2">āchchhādane</span>–under the covering of ignorance. [Considering] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [and] <span class="e2">nāmī</span>–the possessor of the Name <span class="e2">eka-bhāve</span>–as one <span class="e2">avidyā-vināśa</span>–destroys this ignorance.
“The word ‘concealed’ has two meanings: (1) the Name is hidden by separations between the Name’s syllables, and (2) the Name appears in a mundane form to the soul covered over by ignorance. Considering the Name and the possessor of the Name to be one destroys this ignorance.
ব্যবহিত-রহিত হৈলে শুদ্ধনামোদয় ।<br />বর্ণশুদ্ধাশুদ্ধিক্রমে দোষ নাহি হয় ॥১৪৯॥
vyavahita-rahita haile śuddha-nāmodaya<br />varṇa-śuddhāśuddhi-krame doṣa nāhi haya [149]
<span class="e2">śuddha-nāmodaya haile</span>–When the pure Name appears <span class="e2">vyavahita-rahita</span>––unconcealed, <span class="e2">doṣa</span> <span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–there are no faults <span class="e2">varṇa-śuddhāśuddhi-krame</span>–pertaining to proper and improper pronunciation of [the Name’s] letters.
“When the pure Name appears unconcealed, there is no consideration of faults pertaining to proper and improper pronunciation of the Name’s letters.
অপ্রাকৃত নামে কৃষ্ণ সর্ব্বশক্তি দিল ।<br />কালাকাল শৌচাশৌচ নামে না রহিল ॥১৫০॥
aprākṛta nāme kṛṣṇa sarva-śakti dila<br />kālākāla śauchāśaucha nāme nā rahila [150]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">dila</span>–has put <span class="e2">sarva-śakti</span>–all [His] power <span class="e2">aprākṛta</span> <span class="e2">nāme</span>–in [His] supramundane Name, [and] <span class="e2">rahila nā</span>–there is no [consideration] <span class="e2">kālākāla</span>–of the proper and improper time [or] <span class="e2">śauchāśaucha</span>–cleanliness and uncleanliness <span class="e2">nāme</span>–in [chanting] His Name.
“Kṛṣṇa has put all His power in His supramundane Name, and there is no consideration of the proper time or cleanliness in chanting His Name.
সর্ব্বকাল সর্ব্বাবস্থায় শুদ্ধ নাম কর ।<br />সর্ব্ব শুভোদয় হবে সর্ব্বাশুভ হর ॥১৫১॥
sarva-kāla sarvāvasthāya śuddha nāma kara<br />sarva śubhodaya habe sarvāśubha hara [151]
<span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–Chant the pure Name <span class="e2">sarva-kāla</span>–at all times [and] <span class="e2">sarvāvasthāya</span>–under all circumstances: <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">śubhodaya</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–all good fortune will arise, [and] <span class="e2">sarvāśubha</span> <span class="e2">hara</span>–all misfortune will be removed.
“Chant the pure Name at all times and under all circumstances: you will attain all good fortune, and all your misfortune will be removed.
অসৎসঙ্গ ত্যাগপূর্ব্বক নামগ্রহণ
asat-saṅga tyāga-pūrvaka nāma-grahaṇa
Give up mundane attachment and chant the Name
এমত অপূর্ব্ব-নাম সঙ্গযুক্ত যথা ।<br />শীঘ্র শুভফলদাতা না হয় সর্ব্বথা ॥১৫২॥
emata apūrva-nāma saṅga-yukta yathā<br />śīghra śubha-phala-dātā nā haya sarvathā [152]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–When [He is chanted] <span class="e2">saṅga-yukta</span>–with [mundane] attachment, <span class="e2">emata</span> <span class="e2">apūrva-nāma</span>–this supramundane Name <span class="e2">śīghra</span> <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–never quickly becomes, <span class="e2">sarvathā</span>–under any circumstances, <span class="e2">śubha-phala-dātā</span>–a giver of auspicious results.
“When chanted with mundane attachment, however, the supramundane Name never, under any circumstances, gives auspicious results quickly.
দেহ, ধন, জন, লোভ, পাষণ্ডসঙ্গক্রমে ।<br />ব্যবহিত জন্মে, জীব পড়ে মহাভ্রমে ॥১৫৩॥
deha, dhana, jana, lobha, pāṣaṇḍa-saṅga-krame<br />vyavahita janme, jīva paḍe mahābhrame [153]
<span class="e2">krame</span>–As a result [of] <span class="e2">lobha</span>–greed [and] <span class="e2">pāṣaṇḍa-saṅga</span>–attachment to sinful persons, <span class="e2">deha</span>–the body, <span class="e2">dhana</span>–wealth, [and] <span class="e2">jana</span>–companions, <span class="e2">vyavahita</span>–concealment [of the Name] <span class="e2">janme</span>–arises, [and] <span class="e2">jīva</span>–the soul <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–falls <span class="e2">mahābhrame</span>–into a terrible predicament.
“As a result of greed and attachment to the body, wealth, companions, and sinful persons, the Name becomes concealed, and the soul falls into a terrible predicament.
অতএব সকলের অগ্রে সঙ্গ ত্যজি’ ।<br />অনন্যশরণ লঞা নামমাত্র ভজি ॥১৫৪॥
ataeva sakalera agre saṅga tyaji’<br />ananya-śaraṇa lañā nāma-mātra bhaji [154]
<span class="e2">ataeva</span>–So, <span class="e2">sakalera</span> <span class="e2">agre</span>–first of all, <span class="e2">tyaji’</span>–give up [mundane] <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–attachments, <span class="e2">ananya-śaraṇa</span> <span class="e2">lañā</span>–sincerely surrender, [and] <span class="e2">bhaji</span>–serve <span class="e2">nāma-mātra</span>–the Name exclusively.
“So, first of all, give up mundane attachments, sincerely surrender, and serve the Name exclusively.
নামকৃপাবলে হবে প্রমাদরহিত ।<br />অপরাধ দূরে যাবে, হইবেক হিত ॥১৫৫॥
nāma-kṛpā-bale habe pramāda-rahita<br />aparādha dūre yābe, ha-ibeka hita [155]
<span class="e2">nāma-kṛpā-bale</span>–By the Name’s grace, <span class="e2">habe</span>–you will become <span class="e2">pramāda-rahita</span>–free from negligence. [Then your] <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">yābe</span>–will go away, [and] <span class="e2">hita ha-ibeka</span>–you will attain good fortune.
“By the Name’s grace, you will become free from negligence. Then your offences will go away, and you will attain good fortune.
অপরাধমুক্ত হঞা লয় কৃষ্ণনাম ।<br />প্রেম আসি’ নামসহ করিবে বিশ্রাম ॥১৫৬॥
aparādha-mukta hañā laya kṛṣṇa-nāma<br />prema āsi’ nāma-saha karibe viśrāma [156]
<span class="e2">aparādha-mukta</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–Be free from offences [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma laya</span>–chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa. [Then] <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love <span class="e2">āsi’</span>–will come <span class="e2">nāma-saha</span>–with the Name [and] <span class="e2">viśrāma karibe</span>–reside [within your heart].
“Be free from offences and chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa. Then divine love will come with the Name and reside within your heart.
অপরাধীর নামলক্ষণ কৈতব নিশ্চয় ।<br />সে সঙ্গ যতনে ছাড়ি’ কর নামাশ্রয় ॥১৫৭॥
aparādhīra nāma-lakṣaṇa kaitava niśchaya<br />se saṅga yatane chhāḍi’ kara nāmāśraya [157]
<span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–Know for certain [that] <span class="e2">aparādhīra</span> <span class="e2">nāma-lakṣaṇa</span>–the characteristic of an offender of the Name [is] <span class="e2">kaitava</span>–insincerity. <span class="e2">yatane</span>–Carefully <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–avoid <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–their association [and] <span class="e2">nāmāśraya kara</span>–take shelter of the Name.
“Know for certain that the characteristic of an offender of the Name is insincerity. Carefully avoid the association of such offenders and take shelter of the Name.
‘ইদং রহস্যং পরমং পুরা নারদ শঙ্করাৎ ।<br />শ্রুতং সর্ব্বাশুভহরমপরাধনিবারকম্ ॥১৫৮॥<br />বিদুর্বিষ্ণ্বাভিধানং যে হ্যপরাধপরা নরাঃ ।<br />তেষামপি ভবেন্মুক্তিঃ পঠনাদেব নারদ’ ॥১৫৯॥
‘idaṁ rahasyaṁ paramaṁ purā nārada śaṅkarāt<br />śrutaṁ sarvāśubha-haram aparādha-nivārakam [158]<br />vidur viṣṇv ābhidhānaṁ ye hy aparādha-parā narāḥ<br />teṣām api bhaven muktiḥ paṭhanād eva nārada’ [159]
“‘[Śrī Sanat Kumār concluded:] “O Nārad, previously I heard from Lord Śaṅkar these supreme, hidden truths, which destroy all inauspiciousness and ward off the offences to the Name. O Nārad, even offensive souls who understand the Name of Viṣṇu will certainly attain liberation by chanting the Name.”’
সনৎকুমার বলে, ‘ওহে দেবর্ষিপ্রবর ।<br />পূর্ব্বে শ্রীশঙ্কর মোরে হঞা দয়াপর ॥১৬০॥<br />শ্রীনামরহস্য সর্ব্ব-অশুভ নাশন ।<br />অপরাধ-নিবারক কৈল বিজ্ঞাপন ॥১৬১॥
sanat-kumāra bale, ‘ohe devarṣi-pravara<br />pūrve śrī-śaṅkara more hañā dayāpara [160]<br />śrī-nāma-rahasya sarva-aśubha nāśana<br />aparādha-nivāraka kaila vijñāpana [161]
<span class="e2">sanat-kumāra</span>–Sanat Kumār <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘ohe</span>–‘O <span class="e2">devarṣi-pravara</span>–best of the sages amongst the gods, <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–previously <span class="e2">śrī-śaṅkara</span>–Lord Śiva <span class="e2">dayāpara hañā</span>–mercifully <span class="e2">vijñāpana kaila</span>–taught <span class="e2">more</span>–me <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-rahasya</span>–these hidden truths about the Name, [which] <span class="e2">nāśana</span>–destroy <span class="e2">sarva-aśubha</span>–all inauspiciousness [and] <span class="e2">aparādha-nivāraka</span>–ward off the offences.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu paraphrases:] “Sanat Kumār said, ‘O best of the sages amongst the gods, previously Lord Śaṅkar mercifully taught me these hidden truths about the Name, which destroy all inauspiciousness and ward off the offences.
অপরাধপর জন বিষ্ণুনাম জানি’ ।<br />পাঠ করিলেই মুক্তি লভে ইহা মানি’ ॥১৬২॥
aparādha-para jana viṣṇu-nāma jāni’<br />pāṭha karilei mukti labhe ihā māni’ [162]
[If] <span class="e2">aparādha-para</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–offensive souls <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–understand [and] <span class="e2">pāṭha</span> <span class="e2">karilei</span>–chant <span class="e2">viṣṇu-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord, <span class="e2">labhe</span>–they will attain <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation. <span class="e2">māni</span>–I affirm <span class="e2">ihā’</span>–this.’
“If offensive souls understand and chant the Name of Viṣṇu, they will attain liberation. I affirm this.”
নামরহস্যপটল প্রচার
nāma-rahasya-paṭala prachāra
Preaching this collection of hidden truths about the Name
ওহে স্বরূপ রামরায় এ নামরহস্য- ।<br />পটল যতনে প্রচার করিবে অবশ্য ॥১৬৩॥
ohe svarūpa rāma-rāya e nāma-rahasya-<br />paṭala yatane prachāra karibe avaśya [163]
<span class="e2">ohe</span>–O <span class="e2">svarūpa</span> <span class="e2">rāma-rāya</span>–Svarūp and Rāma Rāy, <span class="e2">yatane</span>–carefully, <span class="e2">avaśya</span> <span class="e2">prachāra</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–you must preach <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">nāma-rahasya</span> <span class="e2">paṭala</span>–this collection of hidden truths about the Name.
“O Svarūp and Rāma Rāy, you must carefully preach these hidden truths about the Name.
কলিতে জীবের নাহি অন্য প্রতিকার ।<br />নামরহস্যেতে পার হইবে সংসার ॥১৬৪॥
kalite jīvera nāhi anya pratikāra<br />nāma-rahasyete pāra ha-ibe saṁsāra [164]
<span class="e2">nāhi</span>–There is no <span class="e2">anya</span>–other <span class="e2">pratikāra</span>–remedy <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–for the soul <span class="e2">kalite</span>–in the Age of Kali. <span class="e2">nāma-rahasyete</span>–Through these hidden truths about the Name, <span class="e2">saṁsāra pāra</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–the soul can cross over the material world.
“There is no other remedy for the soul in the Age of Kali. Through these hidden truths about the Name, the soul can cross over saṁsāra.
পূর্ব্বে মুঞি ‘শিক্ষাষ্টকে’ যে তত্ত্ব কহিল ।<br />এবে ব্যাসবাক্যে তাহা পুনঃ দেখাইল ॥১৬৫॥
pūrve muñi ‘śikṣāṣṭake’ ye tattva kahila<br />ebe vyāsa-vākye tāhā punaḥ dekhāila [165]
<span class="e2">dekhāila</span>–I have shown [you] <span class="e2">punaḥ</span>–again, <span class="e2">ebe</span>–now <span class="e2">vyāsa-vākye</span>–in the words of Vyāsa, <span class="e2">tāhā ye</span> <span class="e2">tattva</span>–the truths [that] <span class="e2">muñi</span>–I <span class="e2">kahila</span>–described <span class="e2">pūrve</span>–previously <span class="e2">‘śikṣāṣṭake’</span>–in [My] <span class="e33">Śikṣāṣṭakam</span>.
“I have shown you again, now in the words of Vyāsa, the truths that I previously described in My <span class="e3">Śikṣāṣṭakam</span>.
যতনে রহস্যপটল প্রচারিবে সবে ।<br />সর্ব্বক্ষণ আলোচিয়া নাম লবে তবে ॥১৬৬॥
yatane rahasya-paṭala prachāribe sabe<br />sarva-kṣaṇa ālochiyā nāma labe tabe [166]
<span class="e2">sabe</span>–Both of you <span class="e2">prachāribe</span>–must preach <span class="e2">yatane</span>–carefully <span class="e2">rahasya-paṭala</span>–this collection of hidden truths. <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–Always <span class="e2">ālochiyā</span>–discuss [it, and] <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">labe</span>–chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name.
“You both must carefully preach this collection of hidden truths. Always discuss it and chant the Name.
নামাচার্য্য ঠাকুর হরিদাসের আনুগত্যে শ্রীনামভজন
nāmāchārya ṭhākura haridāsera ānugatye śrī-nāma-bhajana
Serving the Name under the guidance <br />of the Nāmāchārya, Haridās Ṭhākur
পৃথিবীর শিরোমণি ছিল হরিদাস ।<br />এই নামরহস্য সব করিল প্রকাশ ॥১৬৭॥
pṛthivīra śiromaṇi chhila hari-dāsa<br />ei nāma-rahasya saba karila prakāśa [167]
<span class="e2">hari-dāsa</span>–Haridās <span class="e2">chhila</span>–was <span class="e2">śiromaṇi</span>–the crown jewel <span class="e2">pṛthivīra</span>–of [this] world. <span class="e2">prakāśa karila</span>–He revealed <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nāma-rahasya</span> <span class="e2">saba</span>–all these hidden truths about the Name.
“Haridās was the crown jewel of this world. He revealed all these hidden truths about the Name.
প্রচারিল আচরিল এই নামধর্ম্ম ।<br />নামের আচার্য হরিদাস, জান মর্ম্ম ॥১৬৮॥
prachārila ācharila ei nāma-dharma<br />nāmera āchārya haridāsa, jāna marma [168]
<span class="e2">prachārila</span>–He preached [and] <span class="e2">ācharila</span>–performed <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nāma-dharma</span>–the practice of [chanting] the Name; <span class="e2">haridāsa</span>–Haridās [was] <span class="e2">āchārya</span>–the perfect teacher <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name. <span class="e2">jāna</span>–Understand <span class="e2">marma</span>–the significance [of this].
“Haridās practised and preached the chanting of the Name; he was the Āchārya of the Name. Understand the significance of this.
হরিদাসের অনুগত হইয়া শ্রীনাম ।<br />ভজিবে যে জন সেই নিত্যসিদ্ধকাম” ॥১৬৯॥
haridāsera anugata ha-iyā śrī-nāma<br />bhajibe ye jana sei nitya-siddha-kāma” [169]
<span class="e2">sei ye</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">anugata</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–become followers <span class="e2">haridāsera</span>–of Haridās [and] <span class="e2">bhajibe</span>–serve <span class="e2">śrī-nāma</span>–the Name [attain] <span class="e2">nitya-siddha-kāma”</span>–eternal perfection.”
“Those who follow Haridās and serve the Name attain eternal perfection.”

Chapter Twenty
নাম-মহিমা
Nāma-mahimā
The Glories of the Name
একদিন কৃষ্ণদাস কাশীমিশ্রের ঘরে ।<br />আপন গৌছারি কিছু কহিল প্রভুরে ॥১॥
eka-dina kṛṣṇa-dāsa kāśī-miśrera ghare<br />āpana gauchhāri kichhu kahila prabhure [1]
<span class="e2">eka-dina</span>–One day, <span class="e2">ghare</span>–at the house <span class="e2">kāśī-miśrera</span>–of Kāśī Miśra, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-dāsa</span>–Kṛṣṇadās <span class="e2">kahila</span>–expressed <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–some <span class="e2">āpana</span> <span class="e2">gauchhāri</span>–of his personal feelings <span class="e2">prabhure</span>–to the Lord.
One day, at the house of Kāśī Miśra, Kṛṣṇadās expressed some of his personal feelings to the Lord.
“আজ্ঞা হয় শুনি কৃষ্ণনামের মহিমা ।<br />যে মহিমার ব্রহ্মা শিব নাহি জানে সীমা” ॥২॥
“ājñā haya śuni kṛṣṇa-nāmera mahimā<br />ye mahimāra brahmā śiva nāhi jāne sīmā” [2]
<span class="e2">“ājñā</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–Please allow [that] <span class="e2">śuni</span>–I hear <span class="e2">mahimā</span>–the glories <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāmera</span>–of the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">mahimāra</span>–the glories that <span class="e2">brahmā</span>–Brahmā [and] <span class="e2">śiva</span>–Śiva <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–do not know <span class="e2">sīmā”</span>–the end [of].”
[Kṛṣṇadās said:] “Please let me hear the glories of the Name of Kṛṣṇa, the glories that even Brahmā and Śiva do not know the end of.”
প্রভু বলে, “কৃষ্ণনামের মহিমা অপার ।<br />কৃষ্ণ নিজে নাহি জানে, কি জানিব জীব ছার ॥৩॥
prabhu bale, “kṛṣṇa-nāmera mahimā apāra<br />kṛṣṇa nije nāhi jāne, ki jāniba jīva chhāra [3]
<span class="e2">prabhu</span>–The Lord <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">“mahimā</span>–“The glories <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāmera</span>–of the Name of Kṛṣṇa [are] <span class="e2">apāra</span>–unlimited. [Even] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nije</span>–Himself <span class="e2">jāne nāhi</span>–does not know [them]. [So,] <span class="e2">ki</span>–what <span class="e2">jāniba</span>–can I understand? [I am just] <span class="e2">chhāra jīva</span>–a fallen soul.
The Lord replied, “The glories of the Name of Kṛṣṇa are unlimited. Even Kṛṣṇa Himself does not know them. So, what can I understand? I am just a fallen soul.
শাস্ত্রে যাহা শুনিয়াছি কহিব তোমারে ।<br />বিশ্বাস করিয়া শুন যাবে ভবপারে ॥৪॥
śāstre yāhā śuniyāchhi kahiba tomāre<br />viśvāsa kariyā śuna yābe bhava-pāre [4]
<span class="e2">kahiba</span>–I can tell <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–you <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–what <span class="e2">śuniyāchhi</span>–I have heard <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–from the scriptures. <span class="e2">śuna</span>–Listen <span class="e2">viśvāsa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–faithfully, [and] <span class="e2">bhava-pāre yābe</span>–you will cross over material existence.
“I can tell you what I have heard from the scriptures. Listen with faith, and you will cross over material existence.
সর্ব্বপাপপ্রশমক সর্ব্বব্যাধিনাশ ।<br />সর্ব্বদুঃখবিনাশন কলিবাধাহ্রাস ॥৫॥<br />নারকি-উদ্ধার আর প্রারব্ধখণ্ডন ।<br />সর্ব্ব-অপরাধ-ক্ষয় নামে সর্ব্বক্ষণ ॥৬॥
sarva-pāpa-praśamaka sarva-vyādhi-nāśa<br />sarva-duḥkha-vināśana kali-bādhā-hrāsa [5]<br />nāraki-uddhāra āra prārabdha-khaṇḍana<br />sarva-aparādha-kṣaya nāme sarva-kṣaṇa [6]
<span class="e2">sarva-pāpa-praśamaka</span>–Destruction of all sin, <span class="e2">sarva-vyādhi-nāśa</span>–curing of all disease, <span class="e2">sarva-duḥkha-vināśana</span>–relief from all misery, <span class="e2">kali-bādhā-hrāsa</span>–clearing of the obsta­cles made by Kali, <span class="e2">nāraki-uddhāra</span>–deliverance of the residents of hell, <span class="e2">prārabdha-khaṇḍana</span>–cutting away of the active consequences of previous actions, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">sarva-aparādha-kṣaya</span>–the removal of all offences <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–always [occur] <span class="e2">nāme</span>–through the Name.
“The Name always destroys all sin, cures all disease, relieves all misery, clears away the obstacles made by Kali, delivers the residents of hell, cuts away active karma, and removes all offences.
সর্ব্ব-সৎ-কর্ম্মের পূর্ত্তি নামের বিলাস ।<br />সর্ব্ববেদাধিক নামসূর্যের প্রকাশ ॥৭॥
sarva-sat-karmera pūrti nāmera vilāsa<br />sarva-vedādhika nāma-sūryera prakāśa [7]
<span class="e2">pūrti</span>–Fulfilment <span class="e2">sarva-sat-karmera</span>–of all pious works [is] <span class="e2">vilāsa</span>–a Pastime <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name, [and] <span class="e2">prakāśa</span>–the appearance <span class="e2">nāma-sūryera</span>–of the sun-like Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-vedādhika</span>–superior to [studying] all the scriptures.
“Making all pious works successful is a Pastime of the Name, and the appearance of the sun-like Name is superior to studying all the scriptures.
সর্ব্বতীর্থের অধিক নাম সর্ব্বশাস্ত্র কয় ।<br />সকল সৎকর্ম্মাধিক্য নামেতে উদয় ॥৮॥
sarva-tīrthera adhika nāma sarva-śāstra kaya<br />sakala sat-karmādhikya nāmete udaya [8]
<span class="e2">sarva-śāstra</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say [that chanting] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [is] <span class="e2">adhika</span>–superior <span class="e2">sarva-tīrthera</span>–to [visiting] all the holy places, [and that] <span class="e2">nāmete</span> <span class="e2">udaya</span>–the revelation of the Name [is] <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">sat-karmādhikya</span>–superior to [performing] all pious works.
“All the scriptures say that chanting the Name is superior to visiting all the holy places and superior to performing all pious work.
সর্ব্বার্থপ্রদাতা নাম, সর্ব্বশক্তিময় ।<br />জগৎ-আনন্দকারী নামের ধর্ম্ম হয় ॥৯॥
sarvārtha-pradātā nāma, sarva-śaktimaya<br />jagat-ānanda-kārī nāmera dharma haya [9]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-śaktimaya</span>–all-powerful [and is] <span class="e2">sarvārtha-pradātā</span>–the giver of all desired ends. <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">dharma</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–The Name’s nature is [to be] <span class="e2">jagat-ānanda-kārī</span>–the maker of joy for the world.
“The Name is all-powerful, grants all desired ends, and naturally makes the world joyful.
নাম লঞা জগদ্বন্দ্য হয় সর্ব্বজন ।<br />অগতির গতি নাম পতিতপাবন ॥১০॥
nāma lañā jagad-vandya haya sarva-jana<br />agatira gati nāma patita-pāvana [10]
<span class="e2">sarva-jana</span>–Everyone [who] <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">lañā</span>–chants the Name <span class="e2">haya</span>–becomes <span class="e2">jagad-vandya</span>–worshippable throughout the world. <span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">gati</span>–the shelter <span class="e2">agatira</span>–of the shelterless, <span class="e2">patita-pāvana</span>–the saviour of the fallen.
“Everyone who chants the Name becomes worshippable throughout the world. The Name is the shelter of the shelterless, the saviour of the fallen.
সর্ব্বত্র সর্ব্বদা সেব্য সর্ব্বমুক্তিদাতা ।<br />বৈকুণ্ঠপ্রাপক নাম হরিপ্রীতিদাতা ॥১১॥
sarvatra sarvadā sevya sarva-mukti-dātā<br />vaikuṇṭha-prāpaka nāma hari-prīti-dātā [11]
[The Name] <span class="e2">sevya</span>–should be served <span class="e2">sarvatra</span>–everywhere [and] <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always. <span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-mukti-dātā</span>–the giver of all types of liberation, <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭha-prāpaka</span>–the giver of the spiritual world, [and] <span class="e2">hari-prīti-dātā</span>–the giver of love for the Lord.
“The Name should be served everywhere and always. The Name gives all types of liberation, entrance into the spiritual world, and love for the Lord.
নাম স্বয়ং পুরুষার্থ ভক্ত্যঙ্গপ্রধান ।<br />শ্রুতি-স্মৃতি-শাস্ত্রে আছে বহুত প্রমাণ ॥১২॥
nāma svayaṁ puruṣārtha bhakty-aṅga-pradhāna<br />śruti-smṛti-śāstre āchhe bahuta pramāṇa [12]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name <span class="e2">svayaṁ</span>–Himself [is] <span class="e2">puruṣārtha</span>–the goal of human life [and] <span class="e2">bhakty-aṅga-pradhāna</span>–the foremost practice of devotion. <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There is <span class="e2">bahuta</span>–much <span class="e2">pramāṇa</span>–evidence [of this] <span class="e2">śruti-smṛti-śāstre</span>–in the śruti and smṛti scriptures.
“The Name Himself is the goal of human life and the foremost practice of devotion. There is much evidence of this in the scriptures.
নাম সর্ব্বপাপবিনাশক
nāma sarva-pāpa-vināśaka
The Name destroys all sin
সর্ব্বপাপ নাশ করা নামের একধর্ম্ম ।<br />প্রথমে তাহাই সপ্রমাণ শুন মর্ম্ম ॥১৩॥
sarva-pāpa nāśa karā nāmera eka-dharma<br />prathame tāhāi sapramāṇa śuna marma [13]
<span class="e2">nāśa</span> <span class="e2">karā</span>–Destroying <span class="e2">sarva-pāpa</span>–all sin [is] <span class="e2">eka-dharma</span>–one quality <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name. <span class="e2">śuna</span>–Hear <span class="e2">prathame</span>–first <span class="e2">marma</span>–the significance <span class="e2">tāhāi</span>–of this <span class="e2">sapramāṇa</span>–based on evidence [from the scriptures].
“Destroying all sin is one quality of the Name. Hear first the significance of this based on evidence from the scriptures.
পাপী অজামিল দেখ বিবশ হইয়া ।<br />হরিনাম উচ্চারিল ‘নারায়ণ’ বলিয়া ॥১৪॥<br />কোটি কোটি জন্মে পাপ করিয়াছে যত ।<br />সে সকল হইতে মুক্ত হইল সাম্প্রত ॥১৫॥
pāpī ajāmila dekha vivaśa ha-iyā<br />hari-nāma uchchārila ‘nārāyaṇa’ baliyā [14]<br />koṭi koṭi janme pāpa kariyāchhe yata<br />se sakala ha-ite mukta ha-ila sāmprata [15]
<span class="e2">dekha</span>–Consider <span class="e2">pāpī</span>–the sinner <span class="e2">ajāmila</span>–Ajāmil. <span class="e2">vivaśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–Desperately, <span class="e2">uchchārila</span>–he uttered <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">‘nārāyaṇa’</span> <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–‘Nārāyaṇ’, [and he] <span class="e2">sāmprata</span>–immediately <span class="e2">mukta</span> <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became free <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–the sins <span class="e2">kariyāchhe</span>–he had committed <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">janme</span>–over the course of millions of births.
“Consider the sinner Ajāmil. Desperately, he uttered the Name of the Lord ‘Nārāyaṇ’, and he immediately became free from all the sins he had committed over the course of millions of births.
অয়ং হি কৃতনির্ব্বেশো জন্মকোট্যংহসামপি ।<br />যদ্ব্যাজহার বিবশো নাম স্বস্ত্যয়নং হরেঃ ॥১৬॥
ayaṁ hi kṛta-nirveśo janma-koṭy-aṁhasām api<br />yad vyājahāra vivaśo nāma svasty-ayanaṁ hareḥ [16]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.7)
“[The Viṣṇudūtas:] ‘Ajāmil has atoned for ten million births of sins because he has desperately called out the auspicious Name of the Lord.’
স্ত্রী-রাজ-গো-ব্রাহ্মণ-ঘাতী মদ্যরত ।<br />গুরুপত্নীগামী মিত্রদ্রোহী চৌর্য্যব্রত ॥১৭॥<br />এ সবের পাপ আর অন্য পাপচয় ।<br />হরিনাম উচ্চারণে সব পরিষ্কৃত হয় ॥১৮॥
strī-rāja-go-brāhmaṇa-ghātī madya-rata<br />guru-patnī-gāmī mitra-drohī chaurya-vrata [17]<br />e sabera pāpa āra anya pāpa-chaya<br />hari-nāma uchchāraṇe saba pariṣkṛta haya [18]
<span class="e2">uchchāraṇe</span>–By uttering <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord, <span class="e2">e sabera pāpa</span>–all the sins <span class="e2">madya-rata</span>–of a drunkard, <span class="e2">chaurya-vrata</span>–a thief, <span class="e2">mitra-drohī</span>–a traitor, <span class="e2">guru-patnī-gāmī</span>–one who commits adultery with an elder’s wife, [and] <span class="e2">strī-rāja-go-brāhmaṇa-ghātī</span>–a murderer of a woman, king, cow, or brāhmaṇ, <span class="e2">āra</span>–as well as <span class="e2">saba</span>–all <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">pāpa-chaya</span>–other sins, <span class="e2">pariṣkṛta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are counteracted.
“Uttering the Name of the Lord counteracts the sins of a drunkard, a thief, a traitor, one who commits adultery with an elder’s wife, and a murderer of a woman, king, cow, or brāhmaṇ, as well as all other sins.
পাপ সুনিষ্কৃত হৈলে কৃষ্ণে হয় মতি ।<br />এইরূপে নামে জীবের হয় ত’ সদ্গতি ॥১৯॥
pāpa suniṣkṛta haile kṛṣṇe haya mati<br />ei-rūpe nāme jīvera haya ta’ sad-gati [19]
<span class="e2">pāpa</span> <span class="e2">suniṣkṛta</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–When [the soul’s] sins are counteracted, [the soul] <span class="e2">haya</span>–becomes <span class="e2">mati</span>–devoted <span class="e2">kṛṣṇe</span>–to Kṛṣṇa. <span class="e2">ei-rūpe</span>–In this way, <span class="e2">nāme</span>–through the Name, <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–the soul attains <span class="e2">ta’</span> <span class="e2">sad-gati</span>–good fortune.
“When the soul’s sins are counteracted, the soul becomes devoted to Kṛṣṇa. In this way, through the Name, the soul attains good fortune.
স্তেনঃ সুরাপো মিত্রধ্রুগ্ ব্রহ্মহা গুরুতল্পগঃ ।<br />স্ত্রীরাজপিতৃগোহন্তা যে চ পাতকিনোঽপরে ॥২০॥<br />সর্ব্বেষামপ্যঘবতামিদমেব সুনিষ্কৃতম্ ।<br />নামব্যাহরণং বিষ্ণোর্যতস্তদ্বিষয়া মতিঃ ॥২১॥
stenaḥ surā-po mitra-dhrug brahma-hā guru-talpa-gaḥ<br />strī-rāja-pitṛ-go-hantā ye cha pātakino ’pare [20]<br />sarveṣām apy aghavatām idam eva suniṣkṛtam<br />nāma-vyāharaṇaṁ viṣṇor yatas tad-viṣayā matiḥ [21]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.9–10)
“[The Viṣṇudūtas:] ‘Chanting the Name of Viṣṇu is the best means of atonement for a thief, a drunkard, a traitor, one who commits adultery with an elder’s wife, a murderer of a brāhmaṇ, woman, king, father, or cow, and all other sorts of sinners because the Lord becomes attentive to (the protection of) those who chant His Name.’
ব্রতাদি নামের নিকট তুচ্ছ
vratādi nāmera nikaṭa tuchchha
Rites are useless in comparison to the Name
চান্দ্রায়ণব্রত-আদি শাস্ত্রোক্ত প্রকারে ।<br />পাপ হইতে পাপীকে নাহি সেরূপ নিস্তারে ॥২২॥<br />কৃষ্ণনাম একবার উচ্চারিত যবে ।<br />সর্ব্বপাপ হইতে পাপী মুক্ত হয় তবে ॥২৩॥
chāndrāyaṇa-vrata ādi śāstrokta prakāre<br />pāpa ha-ite pāpīke nāhi se-rūpa nistāre [22]<br />kṛṣṇa-nāma eka-bāra uchchārita yabe<br />sarva-pāpa ha-ite pāpī mukta haya tabe [23]
<span class="e2">yabe</span>–When <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">uchchārita</span>–uttered <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once, <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then <span class="e2">pāpī</span>–a sinner <span class="e2">mukta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–becomes free <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">sarva-pāpa</span>–all sins. <span class="e2">chāndrāyaṇa-vrata</span> <span class="e2">ādi</span> <span class="e2">śāstrokta</span>–Rites mentioned in the scriptures, like the Chāndrāyaṇ-vrata, <span class="e2">nistāre nāhi</span>–do not liberate <span class="e2">pāpīke</span>–a sinner <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–from <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sin <span class="e2">se-rūpa prakāre</span>–in this way.
“Sinners who once chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa are freed from all sins. Rites mentioned in the scriptures, like the Chāndrāyaṇ-vrata, do not liberate sinners in this way.
ন নিষ্কৃতৈরুদিতৈর্ব্রহ্মবাদিভিস্<br />তথা বিশুদ্ধ্যত্যঘবান্ ব্রতাদিভিঃ ।<br />যথা হরের্নামপদৈরুদাহৃতৈস্<br />তদুত্তমঃশ্লোকগুণোপলম্ভকম্ ॥২৪॥
na niṣkṛtair uditair brahma-vādibhis<br />tathā viśuddhyaty aghavān vratādibhiḥ<br />yathā harer nāma-padair udāhṛtais<br />tad uttamaḥśloka-guṇopalambhakam [24]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.11)
“[The Viṣṇudūtas:] ‘Rites and other means of atonement prescribed by the sages do not purify a sinner to the extent that chanting the Name of the Lord does because chanting the Name produces remembrance of the Lord’s qualities.’
সঙ্কেত বা পরিহাস স্তোভ হেলা করি’ ।<br />নামাভাসে কভু যদি বলে ‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘হরি’ ॥২৫॥<br />অশেষপাতক তার দূরে যায় তবে ।<br />শ্রীবৈকুণ্ঠে নীত হয় যমদূতের পরাভবে ॥২৬॥
saṅketa vā parihāsa stobha helā kari’<br />nāmābhāse kabhu yadi bale ‘kṛṣṇa’ ‘hari’ [25]<br />aśeṣa-pātaka tāra dūre yāya tabe<br />śrī-vaikuṇṭhe nīta haya yamadūtera parābhave [26]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–at any time [souls] <span class="e2">bale</span>–chant <span class="e2">‘kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Kṛṣṇa’ [or] <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Hari’ <span class="e2">saṅketa kari’</span>–indirectly, <span class="e2">parihāsa</span>–jokingly, <span class="e2">stobha</span>–mnemonically, <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">helā</span>–neglectfully, <span class="e2">nāmābhāse</span>–by this Nāmābhās, <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their <span class="e2">aśeṣa-pātaka</span>–innumerable sins <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away. <span class="e2">tabe</span>–Then <span class="e2">yamadūtera</span> <span class="e2">parābhave haya</span>–they overstep the attendants of Yamarāj [and] <span class="e2">nīta</span>–are taken <span class="e2">śrī-vaikuṇṭhe</span>–to the spiritual world.
“If ever souls chant ‘Kṛṣṇa’ or ‘Hari’ indirectly, jokingly, mnemonically, or neglectfully, by this semblance of the Name (Nāmābhās), their innumerable sins disappear, they overstep the attendants of Yamarāj, and they are taken to Vaikuṇṭha.
সাঙ্কেত্যং পারিহাস্যং বা স্তোভং হেলনমেব বা ।<br />বৈকুণ্ঠনাম-গ্রহণমশেষাঘহরং বিদুঃ ॥২৭॥
sāṅketyaṁ pārihāsyaṁ vā stobhaṁ helanam eva vā<br />vaikuṇṭha-nāma-grahaṇam aśeṣāgha-haraṁ viduḥ [27]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.14)
“[The Viṣṇudūtas:] ‘Be it indirectly, jokingly, mnemonically, or neglectfully, the wise know that chanting the Name of the Lord removes innumerable sins.’
পড়ি’ খসি’ ভগ্ন দষ্ট দগ্ধ বা আহত ।<br />হইয়া বিবশে বলে, ‘আমি হৈনু হত’ ॥২৮॥<br />‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘হরি’ ‘নারায়ণ’ নাম মুখে ডাকে ।<br />যাতনা কখন আশ্রয় না করে তাহাকে ॥২৯॥
paḍi’ khasi’ bhagna daṣṭa dagdha vā āhata<br />ha-iyā vivaśe bale, ‘āmi hainu hata’ [28]<br />‘kṛṣṇa’ ‘hari’ ‘nārāyaṇa’ nāma mukhe ḍāke<br />yātanā kakhana āśraya nā kare tāhāke [29]
<span class="e2">yātanā</span>–The punishment of Yamarāj <span class="e2">kakhana</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">āśraya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–afflicts <span class="e2">tāhāke</span>–those who <span class="e2">vivaśe ha-iyā</span>–desperately <span class="e2">mukhe</span> <span class="e2">ḍāke</span>–call aloud <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Names <span class="e2">‘kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Kṛṣṇa’, <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Hari’, [or] <span class="e2">‘nārāyaṇa’</span>–‘Nārāyaṇ’ [when] <span class="e2">bale</span>–they consider, <span class="e2">‘āmi</span>–I <span class="e2">hata hainu’</span>–am dying!’ <span class="e2">paḍi’</span>–after having fallen [or] <span class="e2">khasi’</span>–slipped, [or] <span class="e2">bhagna</span>–been injured, <span class="e2">daṣṭa</span>–bitten, <span class="e2">dagdha</span>–burnt, <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">āhata</span>–beaten.
“The punishment of Yamarāj never afflicts those who desperately call aloud ‘Kṛṣṇa’, ‘Hari’, or ‘Nārāyaṇ’ when they feel as though they are dying after having fallen or slipped, or been injured, bitten, beaten, or burnt.
পতিতঃ স্খলিতো ভগ্নঃ সন্দষ্টস্তপ্ত আহতঃ ।<br />হরিরিত্যবশেনাহ পুমান্নার্হতি যাতনাঃ ॥৩০॥
patitaḥ skhalito bhagnaḥ sandaṣṭas tapta āhataḥ<br />harir ity avaśenāha pumān nārhati yātanāḥ [30]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.15)
“[The Viṣṇudūtas:] ‘Having fallen, slipped, been injured, bitten, burnt, or beaten, souls who desperately call out ‘Hari’ never suffer the punishment of Yamarāj.’
জ্ঞানে বা অজ্ঞানে নাম
jñāne vā ajñāne nāma
Chanting the Name knowingly or unknowingly
অজ্ঞানে বা জ্ঞানে কৃষ্ণনাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে ।<br />সর্ব্বপাপ ভস্ম হয়, যথা কাষ্ঠ অগ্ন্যর্পণে ॥৩১॥
ajñāne vā jñāne kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane<br />sarva-pāpa bhasma haya, yathā kāṣṭha agny-arpaṇe [31]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–Like <span class="e2">kāṣṭha</span>–wood <span class="e2">agny-arpaṇe</span>–placed in a fire, <span class="e2">sarva-pāpa</span>–all sins <span class="e2">bhasma</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are reduced to ashes <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–by chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">ajñāne</span>–unknowingly <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">jñāne</span>–knowingly.
“Like a piece of wood placed in a fire, all sins are reduced to ashes by chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa, knowingly or unknowingly.
অজ্ঞানাদথবা জ্ঞানাদুত্তমঃশ্লোকনাম যৎ ।<br />সঙ্কীর্ত্তিতমঘং পুংসো দহেদেধো যথানলঃ ॥৩২॥
ajñānād athavā jñānād uttamaḥśloka-nāma yat<br />saṅkīrtitam aghaṁ puṁso dahed edho yathānalaḥ [32]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.18)
“[The Viṣṇudūtas:] ‘All sins are burnt up, like dry grass in fire, by chanting the Name of the Lord, knowingly or unknowingly.’
প্রারব্ধ অপ্রারব্ধ সমস্ত পাপনাশ
prārabdha aprārabdha samasta pāpa-nāśa
Destruction of all active and inactive sin
বর্ত্তমান পাপ আর পূর্ব্ব-জন্মার্জ্জিত ।<br />ভবিষ্যতে হবে যাহা সে সকল হত ॥৩৩॥<br />অনায়াসে হবে কৃষ্ণনাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে ।<br />নাম বিনা বন্ধু নাহি জীবের জীবনে ॥৩৪॥
vartamāna pāpa āra pūrva-janmārjita<br />bhaviṣyate habe yāhā se sakala hata [33]<br />anāyāse habe kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane<br />nāma vinā bandhu nāhi jīvera jīvane [34]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–By chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sins <span class="e2">hata</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be destroyed: <span class="e2">se yāhā</span>–those that [are] <span class="e2">vartamāna</span>–present, [were] <span class="e2">pūrva-janmārjita</span>–incurred in previous births, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">habe</span>–will take effect <span class="e2">bhaviṣyate</span>–in the future. <span class="e2">jīvera nāhi</span>–The soul has no <span class="e2">bandhu</span>–friend <span class="e2">jīvane</span>–in life <span class="e2">vinā</span>–other than <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name.
“Chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa easily destroys the reactions to present sins, sins from previous births, and sins that will take effect in the future. The soul has no friend in life other than the Name.
বর্ত্তমানস্তু যৎ পাপং যদ্ভূতং যদ্ভবিষ্যতি ।<br />তৎসর্ব্বং নির্দ্দহত্যাশু গোবিন্দ-কীর্ত্তনানলঃ ॥৩৫॥
vartamānas tu yat pāpaṁ yad bhūtaṁ yad bhaviṣyati<br />tat sarvaṁ nirdahaty āśu govinda-kīrtanānalaḥ [35]
(Laghu-bhāgavata)
“‘The fire of chanting Govinda’s Name quickly burns away all sins of the past, present, and future.’
দ্রোহকারীর মুক্তি
drohakārīra mukti
Liberation of the spiteful
মহীতলে সজ্জনের প্রতি পাপাচারে ।<br />নামকীর্ত্তনেতে মুক্তি লভে সর্ব্ব নরে ॥৩৬॥
mahī-tale sajjanera prati pāpāchāre<br />nāma-kīrtanete mukti labhe sarva nare [36]
<span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">nare</span>–All human beings [who] <span class="e2">pāpāchāre</span>–behave sinfully <span class="e2">sajjanera</span> <span class="e2">prati</span>–with the virtuous people <span class="e2">mahī-tale</span>–of this world <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attain <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation<span class="e2"> nāma-kīrtanete</span>–by chanting the Name.
“Even those who abuse the virtuous people of this world attain liberation by chanting the Name.
সদা দ্রোহপরো যস্তু সজ্জনানাং মহীতলে ।<br />জায়তে পবনো ধন্যো হরের্নামানুকীর্ত্তনাৎ ॥৩৭॥
sadā droha-paro yas tu sajjanānāṁ mahī-tale<br />jāyate pavano dhanyo harer nāmānukīrtanāt [37]
(Laghu-bhāgavata)
“‘Even those who constantly abuse the virtuous people of this world become purified and fortunate by chanting the Name of the Lord.’
কোটি প্রায়শ্চিত্ত নামতুল্য নহে
koṭi prāyaśchitta nāma-tulya nahe
Millions of atonements do not compare to chanting the Name
শাস্ত্রে কোটি কোটি প্রায়শ্চিত্ত আছে কহে ।<br />কিন্তু কৃষ্ণকীর্ত্তনের তুল্য কেহ নহে ॥৩৮॥
śāstre koṭi koṭi prāyaśchitta āchhe kahe<br />kintu kṛṣṇa-kīrtanera tulya keha nahe [38]
<span class="e2">śāstre</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">kahe</span>–say [that] <span class="e2">āchhe</span>–there are <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">koṭi</span>–millions <span class="e2">prāyaśchitta</span>–of atonements [for sins], <span class="e2">kintu</span>–but <span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nahe</span>–none of them <span class="e2">tulya</span>–are comparable <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kīrtanera</span>–to chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
“The scriptures say that there are millions of atonements, but none of them are comparable to chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
বসন্তি যানি কোটিস্তু পাবনানি মহীতলে ।<br />ন তানি তত্তুল্যং যান্তি কৃষ্ণনামানুকীর্ত্তনে ॥৩৯॥
vasanti yāni koṭis tu pāvanāni mahī-tale<br />na tāni tat-tulyaṁ yānti kṛṣṇa-nāmānukīrtane [39]
(Kūrma-purāṇa)
“‘The millions of atonements that exist in this world never compare with chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa.’
নামগ্রহণকারীর পাপ থাকে না
nāma-grahaṇakārīra pāpa thāke nā
Those who chant the Name have no sin
হরিনাম যত পাপ নির্হরণ করে ।<br />তত পাপ পাপী কভু করিতে না পারে ॥৪০॥
hari-nāma yata pāpa nirharaṇa kare<br />tata pāpa pāpī kabhu karite nā pāre [40]
<span class="e2">pāpī</span>–A sinner <span class="e2">pāre</span>–can <span class="e2">kabhu nā</span>–never <span class="e2">karite</span>–commit <span class="e2">tata</span> <span class="e2">pāpa yata</span> <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–as many sins as <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">nirharaṇa</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–removes.
“A sinner can never commit as many sins as the Lord’s Name can remove.
নাম্নোঽস্য যাবতী শক্তিঃ পাপ-নির্হরণে হরেঃ ।<br />তাবৎ কর্ত্তুং ন শক্নোতি পাতকং পাতকী জনঃ ॥৪১॥
nāmno ’sya yāvatī śaktiḥ pāpa-nirharaṇe hareḥ<br />tāvat kartuṁ na śaknoti pātakaṁ pātakī janaḥ [41]
(Bṛhad-viṣṇu-purāṇa)
“‘A sinner cannot commit as many sins as the Name of the Lord has the power to remove.’
মনোবাক্কায়জ পাপ তত নাহি হয় ।<br />কলিতে গোবিন্দ-নামে নাহি হয় ক্ষয় ॥৪২॥
mano-vāk-kāya-ja pāpa tata nāhi haya<br />kalite govinda-nāme nāhi haya kṣaya [42]
<span class="e2">haya nāhi</span>–There are no <span class="e2">pāpa</span>–sins <span class="e2">mano-vāk-kāya-ja</span>–committed in thought, word, or deed <span class="e2">kalite</span>–in the Age of Kali <span class="e2">tata</span>–that <span class="e2">kṣaya haya nāhi</span>–are not destroyed <span class="e2">govinda-nāme</span>–by the Name of Govinda.
“There are no sins committed in thought, word, or deed in the Age of Kali that chanting the Name of Govinda does not destroy.
তন্নাস্তি কর্ম্মজং লোকে বাগ্জং মানসমেব বা ।<br />যন্ন ক্ষপয়তে পাপং কলৌ গোবিন্দকীর্ত্তনম্ ॥৪৩॥
tan nāsti karmajaṁ loke vāg-jaṁ mānasam eva vā<br />yan na kṣapayate pāpaṁ kalau govinda-kīrtanam [43]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘There are no sins committed in thought, word, or deed in the Age of Kali that chanting the Name of Govinda does not destroy.’
নামে সর্ব্বরোগ নাশ হয়
nāme sarva-roga nāśa haya
The Name cures all disease
নামে সর্ব্বব্যাধিধ্বংস সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে গায় ।<br />ওগো স্থানেশ্বরী ভক্ত বলিহে তোমায় ॥৪৪॥
nāme sarva-vyādhi-dhvaṁsa sarva-śāstre gāya<br />ogo sthāneśvarī bhakta balihe tomāya [44]
<span class="e2">sarva-śāstre</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing [that] <span class="e2">sarva-vyādhi-dhvaṁsa</span>–curing all diseases [occurs] <span class="e2">nāme</span>–through the Name. <span class="e2">ogo</span>–O <span class="e2">sthāneśvarī</span> <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotee of Sthāneśvarī! <span class="e2">balihe</span>–I am speaking <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–to you.
[Śrīman Mahāprabhu continues:] “All the scriptures sing that the Name cures all diseases. O devotee of Sthāneśvarī! I am speaking to you.
সত্য সত্য বলি, ‘লহ বিশ্বাস করিয়া ।<br />‘অচ্যুতানন্দ’ ‘গোবিন্দ’ এই নাম উচ্চারিয়া ॥৪৫॥<br />কাঁদিয়া কাঁদিয়া ডক শ্রীমধুসূদন ।<br />সর্ব্বরোগ নাশ করে শ্রীনামকীর্ত্তনে ॥৪৬॥
satya satya bali, ‘laha viśvāsa kariyā<br />‘achyutānanda’ ‘govinda’ ei nāma uchchāriyā [45]<br />kā̐diyā kā̐diyā ḍāka śrī-madhusūdana<br />sarva-roga nāśa kare śrī-nāma-kīrtane’ [46]
<span class="e2">satya</span>–Truly, <span class="e2">satya</span>–truly, <span class="e2">bali</span>–I say, <span class="e2">‘viśvāsa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–‘Faithfully <span class="e2">laha</span>–chant, <span class="e2">uchchāriyā</span>–uttering <span class="e2">ei</span>–these <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Names <span class="e2">‘achyutānanda’</span>–‘Achyutānanda’ [and] <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span>–‘Govinda’. <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span> <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–Cry [and] <span class="e2">ḍāka</span>–call out <span class="e2">śrī-madhusūdana</span>–to Śrī Madhusūdan. <span class="e2">śrī-nāma-kīrtane</span>–Chanting the Name <span class="e2">sarva-roga</span> <span class="e2">nāśa</span> <span class="e2">kare’</span>–cures all diseases.’
“I speak the truth: ‘Chant the Names ‘Achyutānanda’ and ‘Govinda’ with faith. Cry and call out to Śrī Madhusūdan. Chanting the Name cures all diseases.’
অচ্যতানন্দ-গোবিন্দ-নামোচ্চরণভীষিতঃ ।<br />নশ্যন্তি সকলা রোগাঃ সত্যং সত্যং বদাম্যহম্ ॥৪৭॥
achyutānanda-govinda-nāmochcharaṇa-bhīṣitaḥ<br />naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṁ satyaṁ vadāmy aham [47]
(Bṛhan-nāradīya-purāṇa)
“‘I tell you truthfully that all diseases die of fright when the Names ‘Achyutānanda’ and ‘Govinda’ are chanted.’
নামে মহাপাতকী পংক্তিপাবন হয়
nāme mahāpātakī paṁkti-pāvana haya
The Name turns the greatest sinners into purifiers of their class
মহাপাতকীও অহর্নিশ হরিগানে ।<br />শুদ্ধ হঞা গণ্য হয় সুপংক্তিপাবনে ॥৪৮॥
mahāpātakīo ahar-niśa hari-gāne<br />śuddha hañā gaṇya haya supaṁkti-pāvane [48]
<span class="e2">hari-gāne</span>–By chanting ‘Hari’ <span class="e2">ahar-niśa</span>–day and night, <span class="e2">mahāpātakīo</span>–even the greatest sinners <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–become pure [and] <span class="e2">gaṇya</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–recognised <span class="e2">supaṁkti-pāvane</span>–as purifiers of [their] social class.
“By chanting the Name of the Lord day and night, even the greatest sinners become pure and recognised as purifiers of their social class.
মহাপাতকযুক্তোঽপি কীর্ত্তয়েন্ননিশং হরিম্ ।<br />শুদ্ধান্তঃকরণো ভূত্বা জায়তে পংক্তিপাবনঃ ॥৪৯॥
mahāpātaka-yukto ’pi kīrtayenn aniśaṁ harim<br />śuddhāntaḥkaraṇo bhūtvā jāyate paṁkti-pāvanaḥ [49]
(Brahmāṇḍa-purāṇa)
“‘By chanting the Name of the Lord day and night, even the greatest sinners become pure in heart and then purify their social class.’
ভয় ও দণ্ড নিবারণ
bhaya o daṇḍa nivāraṇa
The Name dispels fear and punishment
মহাব্যাধি-ভয়ও বা রাজদণ্ড-ভয় ।<br />নারায়ণ-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে নিরাতঙ্ক হয় ॥৫০॥
mahāvyādhi-bhayao vā rāja-daṇḍa-bhaya<br />nārāyaṇa-saṅkīrtane nirātaṅka haya [50]
<span class="e2">nārāyaṇa-saṅkīrtane</span>–By chanting the Name of Nārāyaṇ, <span class="e2">nirātaṅka</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–the soul becomes free from fear, <span class="e2">mahāvyādhi-bhayao</span>–even fear of terrible diseases <span class="e2">vā</span>–and <span class="e2">rāja-daṇḍa-bhaya</span>–fear of punishment by kings.
“Chanting the Name of Nārāyaṇ makes the soul fearless of even terrible diseases and punishment by kings.
মহাব্যাধি-সমাচ্ছন্নো রাজবধোপপীড়িতঃ ।<br />নারায়ণেতি সঙ্কীর্ত্য নিরাতঙ্কো ভবেন্নরঃ ॥৫১॥
mahāvyādhi-samāchchhanno rāja-vadhopapīḍitaḥ<br />nārāyaṇeti saṅkīrtya nirāṭaṅko bhaven naraḥ [51]
(Vahni-purāṇa)
“‘Souls who are afflicted with terrible diseases or oppressed by kings become fearless by chanting the Name of Nārāyaṇ.’
সর্ব্বরোগ-সর্ব্বক্লেশ-উপদ্রব-সনে ।<br />অরিষ্টাদি-বিনাশ হয় হরি-উচ্চারণে ॥৫২॥
sarva-roga-sarva-kleśa-upadrava-sane<br />ariṣṭādi-vināśa haya hari-uchchāraṇe [52]
<span class="e2">hari-uchchāraṇe</span>–By chanting the Name of the Lord, <span class="e2">sarva-roga</span>–all diseases, <span class="e2">sarva-kleśa </span>–all suffering, <span class="e2">upadrava-sane</span>–along with [all] disturbances, <span class="e2">ariṣṭādi</span>–calamities, and so on, <span class="e2">vināśa</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are destroyed.
“Chanting the Name of the Lord destroys all diseases, suffering, disturbances, calamities, and so on.
সর্ব্বরোগোপশমনং সর্ব্বোপদ্রবনাশনম্ ।<br />শান্তিদং সর্ব্বারিষ্টানাং হরের্নামানুকীর্ত্তনম্ ॥৫৩॥
sarva-rogopaśamanaṁ sarvopadrava-nāśanam<br />śāntidaṁ sarvāriṣṭānāṁ harer nāmānukīrtanam [53]
(Bṛhad-viṣṇu-purāṇa)
“‘Chanting the Name of the Lord cures all diseases, ends all disturbances, and pacifies all calamities.’
যথা অতিবায়ুবলে মেঘ দূরে যায় ।<br />সূর্য্যোদয়ে তমোনাশ অবশ্যই পায় ॥৫৪॥<br />তথা সঙ্কীর্ত্তিত নাম জীবের ব্যসন ।<br />দূর করে স্বপ্রভাবে, এ ব্যাসবচন ॥৫৫॥
yathā ativāyu-bale megha dūre yāya<br />sūryodaye tamo-nāśa avaśyai pāya [54]<br />tathā saṅkīrtita nāma jīvera vyasana<br />dūra kare svaprabhāve, e vyāsa-vachana [55]
<span class="e2">yathā</span>–As <span class="e2">megha</span>–clouds <span class="e2">dūre</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away <span class="e2">ativāyu-bale</span>–by the force of wind [and] <span class="e2">tamo-nāśa pāya</span>–darkness is dispelled <span class="e2">avaśyai</span>–invariably <span class="e2">sūryodaye</span>–by the rising of the sun, <span class="e2">tathā</span>–so <span class="e2">saṅkīrtita</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the chanted Name <span class="e2">dūra</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–drives away <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–the soul’s <span class="e2">vyasana</span>–difficulties <span class="e2">svaprabhāve</span>–by His own power. <span class="e2">e</span>–These [are] <span class="e2">vyāsa-vachana</span>–the words of Vyāsa.
“As the wind drives away clouds and the rising sun invariably dispels darkness, so the chanted Name drives away the soul’s difficulties by His own power. These are the words of Vyāsa.
সঙ্কীর্ত্ত্যমানো ভগবাননন্তঃ<br />শ্রুতানুভাবো ব্যসনং হি পুংসাম্ ।<br />প্রবিশ্য চিত্তং বিধুনোত্যশেষং<br />যথা তমোঽর্কোঽভ্রমিবাতিবাতঃ ॥৫৬॥
saṅkīrtyamāno bhagavān anantaḥ<br />śrutānubhāvo vyasanaṁ hi puṁsām<br />praviśya chittaṁ vidhunoty aśeṣaṁ<br />yathā tamo ’rko ’bhram ivāti-vātaḥ [56]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 12.12.48)
“‘When souls hear and chant about the Infinite Lord, He enters their hearts and removes all their difficulties, just as the sun dispels darkness and the wind disperses clouds.’
আর্ত্ত বা বিষণ্ণ শিথিলমনা ভীত ।<br />ঘোরব্যাধিক্লেশে আর না দেখে হিত ॥৫৭॥<br />‘নারায়ণ’ ‘হরি’ বলি’ করে সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />নিশ্চয় বিমুক্তদুঃখ সুখী সেই জন ॥৫৮॥
ārta vā viṣaṇṇa śithila-manā bhīta<br />ghora-vyādhi-kleśe āra nā dekhe hita [57]<br />‘nārāyaṇa’ ‘hari’ bali’ kare saṅkīrtana<br />niśchaya vimukta-duḥkha sukhī sei jana [58]
[When] <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–those who [are] <span class="e2">ārta</span>–distressed, <span class="e2">viṣaṇṇa</span>–depressed, <span class="e2">śithila-manā</span>–disheartened, <span class="e2">bhīta</span>–fearful, <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">ghora-vyādhi-kleśe</span>–afflicted with a terrible disease <span class="e2">dekhe</span>–see <span class="e2">nā</span>–no <span class="e2">āra</span>–other <span class="e2">hita</span>–help [and] <span class="e2">bali’</span> <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana kare</span>–chant <span class="e2">‘nārāyaṇa’</span>–‘Nārāyaṇ’ [or] <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Hari’, [they] <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly [become] <span class="e2">sukhī</span>–happy [and] <span class="e2">vimukta-duḥkha</span>–free from sorrow.
“When those who are distressed, depressed, disheartened, fearful, or afflicted with a terrible disease see no help anywhere and chant ‘Nārāyaṇ’ or ‘Hari’, they certainly become happy and free from sorrow.
আর্ত্তা বিষণ্ণাঃ শিথিলাশ্চ ভীতা<br />ঘোরেষু চ ব্যাধিষু বর্ত্তমানাঃ ।<br />সঙ্কীর্ত্ত্য নারায়ণ-শব্দমেকং<br />বিমুক্তদুঃখাঃ সুখিনো ভবন্তি ॥৫৯॥
ārtā viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāś cha bhītā<br />ghoreṣu cha vyādhiṣu vartamānāḥ<br />saṅkīrtya nārāyaṇa-śabdam ekaṁ<br />vimukta-duḥkhāḥ sukhino bhavanti [59]
(Viṣṇu-dharma-purāṇa)
“‘Those who are distressed, depressed, disheartened, fearful, or terribly diseased become free from sorrow and happy by once chanting the Name of Nārāyaṇ.’
অসীম শক্তিমান্ বিষ্ণু, তাঁহার কীর্ত্তনে ।<br />যক্ষ-রক্ষ-বেতালাদি ভূতপ্রেতগণে ॥৬০॥<br />বিনায়ক-ডাকিন্যাদি হিংস্রক সমস্ত ।<br />পলায়ন করে সব দুঃখ হয় অস্ত ॥৬১॥
asīma śaktimān viṣṇu, tā̐hāra kīrtane<br />yakṣa-rakṣa-vetālādi bhūta-preta-gaṇe [60]<br />vināyaka-ḍākinyādi hiṁsraka samasta<br />palāyana kare saba duḥkha haya asta [61]
<span class="e2">viṣṇu</span>–Viṣṇu [is] <span class="e2">asīma</span> <span class="e2">śaktimān</span>–a possessor of unlimited power. <span class="e2">yakṣa-rakṣa-vetālādi</span>–Fiends, demons, evil spirits, <span class="e2">bhūta-preta-gaṇe</span>–ghosts, disembodied souls, <span class="e2">vināyaka-ḍākinyādi</span>–monsters, witches, [and] <span class="e2">samasta</span>–all [other] <span class="e2">hiṁsraka</span>–ferocious entities <span class="e2">palāyana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–flee <span class="e2">tā̐hāra</span> <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–from the chanting [of] His [Name]. <span class="e2">saba</span>–All <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–distress <span class="e2">asta haya</span>–comes to an end [by chanting His Name].
“Viṣṇu is unlimitedly powerful. Fiends, demons, evil spirits, ghosts, disembodied souls, monsters, witches, and all other ferocious entities flee from the chanting of His Name. By chanting His Name, all distress comes to an end.
সর্ব্বানর্থনাশী হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ।<br />ক্ষুধা তৃষ্ণা স্খলিতাদি বিপদনাশন ॥৬২॥
sarvānartha-nāśī hari-nāma-saṅkīrtana<br />kṣudhā tṛṣṇā skhalitādi vipada-nāśana [62]
<span class="e2">hari-nāma-saṅkīrtana</span>–Chanting the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">sarvānartha-nāśī</span>–destroys all obstacles [and] <span class="e2">vipada-nāśana</span>–destroys dangers, <span class="e2">kṣudhā</span> <span class="e2">tṛṣṇā</span> <span class="e2">skhalitādi</span>–such as hunger, thirst, and injury.
“Chanting the Name of the Lord destroys all obstacles and dangers, such as hunger, thirst, and injury.
ইহাতে সংশয় যথা, নিশ্চয় তথায় ।<br />নামের বিক্রম কভু না হয় উদয় ॥৬৩॥
ihāte saṁśaya yathā, niśchaya tathāya<br />nāmera vikrama kabhu nā haya udaya [63]
<span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–Certainly, [however,] <span class="e2">vikrama</span>–the power <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">udaya haya</span>–appears <span class="e2">yathā tathāya</span>–where [there is] <span class="e2">saṁśaya</span>–doubt <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–about this.
“Certainly, however, the power of the Name never appears where there is any doubt about this.
বিশ্বাসে নামের কৃপা, অবিশ্বাসে নয় ।<br />এ এক রহস্য, ভক্ত জানহ নিশ্চয় ॥৬৪॥
viśvāse nāmera kṛpā, aviśvāse naya<br />e eka rahasya, bhakta jānaha niśchaya [64]
