<span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–The grace <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–of the Name [is attained] <span class="e2">viśvāse</span>–through faith, <span class="e2">naya</span>–not <span class="e2">aviśvāse</span>–through faithlessness. <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–O devotees, <span class="e2">jānaha</span>–know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that] <span class="e2">e</span>–this [is] <span class="e2">eka</span>–a <span class="e2">rahasya</span>–hidden truth.
“The grace of the Name is attained through faith, not faithlessness. O devotees, know for certain that this is one of the hidden truths of the Name.
কীর্ত্তনদ্দেবদেবস্য বিষ্ণোর্মিততেজসঃ ।<br />যক্ষরাক্ষসবেতালভূতপ্রেতবিনয়কঃ ॥৬৫॥<br />ডাকিন্যো বিদ্রবন্তি স্ম যে তথান্যে চ হিংসকঃ ।<br />সর্ব্বানর্থহরং তস্য নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনং স্মৃতম্ ॥৬৬॥<br />নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনং কৃত্বা ক্ষুত্তৃট্ প্রস্খলিতাদিষু ।<br />বিয়োগং শীঘ্রমাপ্নোতি সর্ব্বানর্থৈর্ন সংশয়ঃ ॥৬৭॥
kīrtanad deva-devasya viṣṇor amita-tejasaḥ<br />yakṣa-rākṣasa-vetāla-bhūta-preta-vinayakaḥ [65]<br />ḍākinyo vidravanti sma ye tathānye cha hiṁsakaḥ<br />sarvānartha-haraṁ tasya nāma-saṅkīrtanaṁ smṛtam [66]<br />nāma-saṅkīrtanaṁ kṛtvā kṣut-tṛṭ praskhalitādiṣu<br />viyogaṁ śīghram āpnoti sarvānarthair na saṁśayaḥ [67]
(Viṣṇu-dharma-purāṇa)
“‘Fiends, demons, evil spirits, ghosts, disembodied souls, monsters, witches, and other ferocious entities flee from the chanting of the Names of the God of gods, the immeasurably powerful Lord, Viṣṇu. Chanting and remembering the Lord’s Name removes all difficulties. Those who chant the Lord’s Name while hungry, thirsty, or injured immediately become free from all difficulties. There is no doubt about this.’
কলিকালকুসর্পের তীক্ষ্ণ দংষ্ট্রা হেরি’ ।<br />ভয় না করিও ভক্ত, শুন শ্রদ্ধা করি’ ॥৬৮॥
kali-kāla-kusarpera tīkṣṇa daṁṣṭrā heri’<br />bhaya nā kario bhakta, śuna śraddhā kari’ [68]
<span class="e2">bhaya</span> <span class="e2">kario nā</span>–Do not be afraid [when] <span class="e2">heri’</span>–you see <span class="e2">tīkṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">daṁṣṭrā</span>–the sharp teeth <span class="e2">kali-kāla-kusarpera</span>–of the poisonous serpent of Kali-yuga. <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–O devotees, <span class="e2">śuna</span>–listen <span class="e2">śraddhā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–faithfully!
“Do not be afraid when you see the sharp teeth of the poisonous serpent of Kali-yuga. O devotees, listen faithfully!
কৃষ্ণনাম-দাবানল প্রজ্জ্বলিত হঞা ।<br />সে সর্পের দংষ্ট্রা দগ্ধ করিবে ফেলিয়া ॥৬৯॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma-dāvānala prajjvalita hañā<br />se sarpera daṁṣṭrā dagdha karibe pheliyā [69]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma-dāvānala</span>–The raging fire of Kṛṣṇa’s Name <span class="e2">prajjvalita</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–will blaze up [and] <span class="e2">pheliyā dagdha</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–burn away <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sarpera</span>–the serpent’s <span class="e2">daṁṣṭrā</span>–teeth.
“The raging fire of Kṛṣṇa’s Name will blaze up and burn away the serpent’s teeth.
কলিকলকুসর্পস্য তীক্ষ্ণদংষ্ট্রস্য মা ভয়ম্ ।<br />গোবিন্দনামদাবেন দগ্ধো যাস্যতি ভস্মতাম্ ॥৭০॥
kali-kala-kusarpasya tīkṣṇa-daṁṣṭrasya mā bhayam<br />govinda-nāma-dāvena dagdho yāsyati bhasmatām [70]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘Do not fear the sharp teeth of the poisonous serpent of Kali-yuga. The fire of Govinda’s Name will burn it to ashes.’
এই ঘোর কলিযুগে হরিনামাশ্রয়ে ।<br />কৃতকৃত্য ভক্তগণ ত্যক্ত-অন্যাশ্রয়ে ॥৭১॥
ei ghora kali-yuge hari-nāmāśraye<br />kṛta-kṛtya bhakta-gaṇa tyakta-anyāśraye [71]
<span class="e2">bhakta-gaṇa</span>–Devotees [who] <span class="e2">tyakta-anyāśraye</span>–have left all other shelters [and] <span class="e2">hari-nāmāśraye</span>–taken shelter of the Lord’s Name <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ghora</span> <span class="e2">kali-yuge</span>–in this dark Age of Kali [are] <span class="e2">kṛta-kṛtya</span>–successful.
“Devotees who have left all other shelters and taken shelter of the Lord’s Name in this dark Age of Kali are successful.
হরে কেশব গোবিন্দ বাসুদেব জগন্ময় ।<br />এই নাম সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে বড় সুখোদয় ॥৭২॥
hare keśava govinda vāsudeva jaganmaya<br />ei nāma saṅkīrtane baḍa sukhodaya [72]
[There is] <span class="e2">baḍa</span> <span class="e2">sukhodaya</span>–an arising of great joy <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">saṅkīrtane</span>–by chanting the Names <span class="e2">hare</span>–Hari, <span class="e2">keśava</span>–Keśava, <span class="e2">govinda</span>–Govinda, <span class="e2">vāsudeva</span>–Vāsudev, [and] <span class="e2">jaganmaya</span>–Jaganmay.
“Great joy arises by chanting, ‘O Hari! O Keśava! O Govinda! O Vāsudev! O Jaganmay!’
সদা যেই গায় নাম বিশ্বাস করিয়া ।<br />কলিবাধা নাহি তার সদা শুদ্ধ হিয়া ॥৭৩॥
sadā yei gāya nāma viśvāsa kariyā<br />kali-bādhā nāhi tāra sadā śuddha hiyā [73]
<span class="e2">kali-bādhā</span>–The obstacles made by Kali <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–do not exist <span class="e2">sadā</span> <span class="e2">śuddha</span> <span class="e2">hiyā</span>–within the eternally pure hearts <span class="e2">tāra yei</span>–of those who <span class="e2">sadā</span>–constantly [and] <span class="e2">viśvāsa</span> <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–faithfully <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name.
“The obstacles made by Kali do not exist within the eternally pure hearts of those who constantly and faithfully chant the Name.
হরিনামপরা যে চ ঘোরে কলিযুগে নরাঃ ।<br />তে এব কৃতকৃত্যাশ্চ ন কলির্বাধতে হি তান্ ॥৭৪॥<br />হরে কেশব গোবিন্দ বাসুদেব জগন্ময় ।<br />ইতীরয়ন্তি তে নিত্যং ন হি তান্ বাধতে কলিঃ ॥৭৫॥
hari-nāma-parā ye cha ghore kali-yuge narāḥ<br />te eva kṛta-kṛtyāś cha na kalir bādhate hi tān [74]<br />hare keśava govinda vāsudeva jaganmaya<br />itīrayanti te nityaṁ na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ [75]
(Bṛhan-nāradīya-purāṇa)
“‘Souls who devote themselves to the Name of the Lord in the dark Age of Kali are successful. Kali cannot obstruct them. Kali cannot obstruct those who constantly chant, “O Hari! O Keśava! O Govinda! O Vāsudev! O Jaganmay!”’
নারকী কীর্ত্তন করে ‘হরি’ ‘কৃষ্ণ’ বলি’ ।<br />হরিভক্ত হঞা যায় দিব্যধামে চলি’ ॥৭৬॥
nārakī kīrtana kare ‘hari’ ‘kṛṣṇa’ bali’<br />hari-bhakta hañā yāya divya-dhāme chali’ [76]
<span class="e2">nārakī</span>–The residents of hell [who] <span class="e2">bali kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–chant <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Hari’ [and] <span class="e2">‘kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Kṛṣṇa’, <span class="e2">hari-bhakta</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–become devotees of the Lord [and] <span class="e2">chali’ yāya</span>–go <span class="e2">divya-dhāme</span>–to the divine abode.
“The residents of hell who chant ‘Hari’ and ‘Kṛṣṇa’ become devotees of the Lord and go to the divine abode.
যথা যথা হরের্নাম কীর্ত্তয়ন্তি স্ম নারকাঃ ।<br />তথা তথা হরৌ ভক্তিমুদ্বহন্তো দিবং যয়ুঃ ॥৭৭॥
yathā yathā harer nāma kīrtayanti sma nārakāḥ<br />tathā tathā harau bhaktim udvahanto divaṁ yayuḥ [77]
(Nṛsiṁha-purāṇa)
“‘The residents of hell chant the Name of the Lord, accordingly develop devotion to the Lord, and go to the divine abode.’
প্রারব্ধখণ্ডন কেবল হরিনামে হয় ।<br />জ্ঞানকর্ম্মে সেই ফল কভু না মিলয় ॥৭৮॥
prārabdha-khaṇḍana kevala hari-nāme haya<br />jñāna-karme sei phala kabhu nā milaya [78]
<span class="e2">kevala</span>–Only <span class="e2">hari-nāme</span>–by the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">haya</span>–are <span class="e2">prārabdha-khaṇḍana</span>–the active reactions [to the soul’s sins] cut away. [The soul] <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span> <span class="e2">milaya</span>–never attains <span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–such a result <span class="e2">jñāna-karme</span>–through [worldly] knowledge or action.
“Only the Name of the Lord can cut away the active reactions to sins. Such a result is never attained through worldly knowledge or action.
বিনা হরিকীর্ত্তন কভু কর্ম্মবন্ধ ।<br />খণ্ডন না হয়, মুমুক্ষুতা নহে লব্ধ ॥৭৯॥<br />যে মুক্তি লভিলে আর না হয় কর্ম্মসঙ্গ ।<br />রজস্তমোদোষহীন শূন্য মায়াসঙ্গ ॥৮০॥
vinā hari-kīrtana kabhu karma-bandha<br />khaṇḍana nā haya, mumukṣutā nahe labdha [79]<br />ye mukti labhile āra nā haya karma-saṅga<br />rajas-tamo-doṣa-hīna śūnya māyā-saṅga [80]
<span class="e2">vinā</span>–Without <span class="e2">hari-kīrtana</span>–chanting the Name of the Lord, <span class="e2">karma-bandha</span>–entan­glement in karma <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">khaṇḍana</span>–cut away, [and] <span class="e2">mumukṣutā</span>–seekers of liberation <span class="e2">labdha nahe</span>–never attain <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">mukti</span>–the liberation [in which,] <span class="e2">labhile</span>–when [it] is attained, the soul] <span class="e2">haya</span>–has <span class="e2">āra</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–no further <span class="e2">karma-saṅga</span>–attachment to karma, [becomes] <span class="e2">rajas-tamo-doṣa-hīna</span>–free from the faults of passion and ignorance, [and becomes] <span class="e2">śūnya</span>–devoid of <span class="e2">māyā-saṅga</span>–attachment to the illusory environment.
“Without chanting the Name of the Lord, entanglement in karma is never cut away, and seekers of liberation never attain the liberation upon attaining which there is no further attachment to karma. They never become uncontaminated by passion and ignorance or free from attachment to the illusory environment.
নাতঃ পরং কর্ম্মনিবন্ধকৃন্তনং<br />মুমুক্ষতাং তীর্থপদানুকীর্ত্তনাৎ ।<br />ন যৎ পুনঃ কর্ম্মসু সজ্জতে মনো-<br />রজস্তমোভ্যাং কলিলং ততোঽন্যথা ॥৮১॥
nātaḥ paraṁ karma-nibandha-kṛntanaṁ<br />mumukṣatāṁ tīrtha-padānukīrtanāt<br />na yat punaḥ karmasu sajjate mano-<br />rajas-tamobhyāṁ kalilaṁ tato ’nyathā [81]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 6.2.46)
“‘There is no better means for those who desire liberation to cut away the bondage of karma than chanting the Name of the Lord because after chanting the mind does not become attached to karma again. After all other atonements, the mind again becomes polluted by passion and ignorance.’
ম্রিয়মাণ ক্লিষ্ট জন পড়িতে খসিতে ।<br />বিবশ হইয়া কৃষ্ণ বলে কোনমতে ॥৮২॥<br />কর্ম্মার্গলমুক্ত হঞা লভে পরা গতি ।<br />কলিকালে যাহা নাহি লভে অন্য মতি ॥৮৩॥
mriyamāṇa kliṣṭa jana paḍite khasite<br />vivaśa ha-iyā kṛṣṇa bale kona-mate [82]<br />karmārgala-mukta hañā labhe parā gati<br />kali-kāle yāhā nāhi labhe anya mati [83]
<span class="e2">mriyamāṇa</span>–A dying, <span class="e2">kliṣṭa</span>–diseased <span class="e2">jana</span>–soul, <span class="e2">paḍite</span>–bedridden, <span class="e2">khasite</span>–faltering, [and] <span class="e2">vivaśa</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–desperate [who] <span class="e2">kona-mate</span>–somehow or other <span class="e2">bale</span>–chants <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">karmārgala-mukta</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–becomes free from the bondage of karma [and] <span class="e2">labhe</span>–attains <span class="e2">parā</span> <span class="e2">gati</span>–the supreme destination— <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which <span class="e2">labhe nāhi</span>–souls cannot attain <span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–in the Age of Kali [by] <span class="e2">anya</span> <span class="e2">mati</span>–any other means.
“A dying, diseased, bedridden, faltering, desperate soul who somehow or other chants the Name of Kṛṣṇa becomes free from the bondage of karma and attains the supreme destination—which souls in the Age of Kali cannot attain by any other means.
যন্নামধেয়ং ম্রিয়মাণ আতুরঃ<br />পতন্ স্খলন্ বা বিবশো গৃণন্ পুমান্ ।<br />বিমুক্তকর্ম্মার্গল উত্তমাং গতিং<br />প্রাপ্নোতি যক্ষ্যন্তি ন তং কলৌ জনাঃ ॥৮৪॥
yan-nāma-dheyaṁ mriyamāṇa āturaḥ<br />patan skhalan vā vivaśo gṛṇan pumān<br />vimukta-karmārgala uttamāṁ gatiṁ<br />prāpnoti yakṣyanti na taṁ kalau janāḥ [84]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 12.3.44)
“‘In the Age of Kali, souls will not worship the Lord, by chanting whose Name even a dying, diseased, bedridden, faltering, desperate soul becomes free from the bondage of karma and attains the supreme destination.’
শ্রদ্ধা করি’ নাম লইলে অপরাধকোটী ।<br />ক্ষমা করে কৃষ্ণ, যদি না থাকে কুটিনাটী ॥৮৫॥
śraddhā kari’ nāma la-ile aparādha koṭī<br />kṣamā kare kṛṣṇa, yadi nā thāke kuṭināṭī [85]
<span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">la-ile</span>–When souls chant the Name <span class="e2">śraddhā</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–faithfully, <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">kṣamā</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–forgives <span class="e2">koṭī aparādha</span>–millions of [their] offences <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if <span class="e2">kuṭināṭī thāke nā</span>–no deceit is present [in them].
“When souls chant the Name with faith, Kṛṣṇa forgives millions of their offences if they are free from deceit.
ইহাতে বিশ্বাস যার না হয়, সে জন ।<br />বড়ই দুর্ভাগা, তার নাহিক মোচন ॥৮৬॥
ihāte viśvāsa yāra nā haya, se jana<br />baḍa-i durbhāgā, tāra nāhika mochana [86]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">jana yāra viśvāsa</span> <span class="e2">haya nā</span>–Those who do not have faith <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–in this [are] <span class="e2">baḍa-i</span>–extremely <span class="e2">durbhāgā</span>–unfortunate. <span class="e2">tāra mochana</span> <span class="e2">nāhika</span>–They are not delivered.
“Those who do not have faith in this are extremely unfortunate and will not be delivered.
মম নামানি লোকেঽস্মিন্ শ্রদ্ধয়া যস্তু কীর্ত্তয়েৎ ।<br />তস্যাপরাধকোটিস্তু ক্ষমাম্যেব ন সংশয়ঃ ॥৮৭॥
mama nāmāni loke ’smin śraddhayā yas tu kīrtayet<br />tasyāparādha-koṭis tu kṣamāmy eva na saṁśayaḥ [87]
(Viṣṇu-yāmala)
“[The Lord:]‘I forgive millions of offences committed by anyone in this world who chants My Name with faith. There is no doubt about this.’
মন্ত্র-তন্ত্র-ছিদ্র দেশ-কাল-বস্তু-দোষ ।<br />নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনে যায়, পায় পরম সন্তোষ ॥৮৮॥
mantra-tantra-chhidra deśa-kāla-vastu-doṣa<br />nāma-saṅkīrtane yāya, pāya parama santoṣa [88]
<span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–By chanting the Name, <span class="e2">mantra-tantra-chhidra</span>–faults concerning mantras and procedures [and] <span class="e2">deśa-kāla-vastu-doṣa</span>–flaws concerning time, place, and paraphernalia <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go away, [and] <span class="e2">pāya</span>–one feels <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">santoṣa</span>–the greatest joy.
“Chanting the Name removes all flaws or faults concerning mantras, procedures, time, place, and paraphernalia, and fills one with the greatest joy.
সৎকর্ম্ম প্রধান নাম, তাহার আশ্রয়ে ।<br />অন্য সৎকর্ম্মের সিদ্ধি হইবে নিশ্চয়ে ॥৮৯॥
sat-karma pradhāna nāma, tāhāra āśraye<br />anya sat-karmera siddhi ha-ibe niśchaye [89]
[Chanting] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [is] <span class="e2">sat-karma</span> <span class="e2">pradhāna</span>–the foremost auspicious practice, [and] <span class="e2">niśchaye</span>–for certain, <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">āśraye</span>–under its shelter, [all] <span class="e2">anya</span>–other <span class="e2">sat-karmera</span> <span class="e2">siddhi</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–auspicious practices become successful.
“Chanting the Name is the foremost auspicious practice, and under the Name’s shelter, all other auspicious practices certainly become successful.
মন্ত্রতস্তন্ত্রতশ্ছিদ্রং দেশকালার্হবস্তুতঃ ।<br />সর্ব্বং করোতি নিশ্ছিদ্রং নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনং তব ॥৯০॥
mantratas tantrataś chhidraṁ deśa-kālārha-vastutaḥ<br />sarvaṁ karoti niśchhidraṁ nāma-saṅkīrtanaṁ tava [90]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 8.23.16)
“‘Chanting Your Name nullifies all flaws concerning mantras, procedures, time, place, participants, and paraphernalia.’
সর্ব্ববেদাধিক নাম, ইহাতে সংশয় ।<br />যে করে তাহার কভু মঙ্গল না হয় ॥৯১॥
sarva-vedādhika nāma, ihāte saṁśaya<br />ye kare tāhāra kabhu maṅgala nā haya [91]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-vedādhika</span>–superior to all the Vedas. <span class="e2">haya</span>–There is <span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nā</span>–never <span class="e2">maṅgala</span>–good fortune <span class="e2">tāhāra ye</span>–for those who <span class="e2">saṁśaya kare</span>–doubt <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–this.
“The Name is superior to all the Vedas. Those who doubt this never attain good fortune.
প্রণব কৃষ্ণের নাম যাহা হৈতে বেদ ।<br />জন্মিল ব্রহ্মার মুখে বুঝ তত্ত্বভেদ ॥৯২॥<br />ঋক্-যজু-সামাথর্ব্ব সে কৈল পঠন ।<br />‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ যার মুখে শুনি’ অনুক্ষণ ॥৯৩॥
praṇava kṛṣṇera nāma yāhā haite veda<br />janmila brahmāra mukhe bujha tattva-bheda [92]<br />ṛk-yaju-sāmātharva se kaila paṭhana<br />‘hari’ ‘hari’ yāra mukhe śuni’ anukṣaṇa [93]
<span class="e2">bujha</span>–Understand <span class="e2">tattva-bheda</span>–the difference in nature [between the Vedas and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span>–Kṛṣṇa’s <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name <span class="e2">praṇava</span>–‘Om’, <span class="e2">haite</span>–from <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which <span class="e2">veda</span>–the Vedas <span class="e2">janmila</span>–manifested <span class="e2">brahmāra</span> <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–in the mouth of Brahmā. <span class="e2">se yāra</span> <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–Those from whose mouth <span class="e2">‘hari’</span> <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Hari! Hari’ <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–is heard <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–always <span class="e2">paṭhana kaila</span>–have recited <span class="e2">ṛk-yaju-sāmātharva</span>–the <span class="e33">Ṛg</span>-, <span class="e33">Yajur</span>-, <span class="e33">Sāma</span>-, and <span class="e33">Atharva-veda</span>.
“Understand the difference between the Vedas and Kṛṣṇa’s Name ‘Om’, from which the Vedas manifested in the mouth of Brahmā. Those from whose mouth ‘Hari! Hari!’ is always heard have already recited the <span class="e3">Ṛg-</span>, <span class="e3">Yajur-</span>, <span class="e3">Sāma-</span>, and <span class="e3">Atharva-veda</span>.
ঋগ্বেদো হি যজুর্ব্বেদঃ সামবেদোপ্যঽথর্ব্বণঃ ।<br />অধীতস্তেন যেনোক্তং হরিরিত্যক্ষরদ্বয়ম্ ॥৯৪॥
ṛg-vedo hi yajur-vedaḥ sāma-vedo ’py atharvaṇaḥ<br />adhītas tena yenoktaṁ harir ity akṣara-dvayam [94]
(Viṣṇu-dharma-purāṇa)
“‘Those who have uttered the two syllables ‘Ha-ri’ have certainly studied the <span class="e3">Ṛg-</span>, <span class="e3">Yajur-</span>, <span class="e3">Sāma-</span>, and <span class="e3">Atharva-veda</span>.’
ঋক্-যজু-সামাথর্ব্ব পঠ কি কারণ ?<br />‘গোবিন্দ’ ‘গোবিন্দ’ নাম করহ কীর্ত্তন ॥৯৫॥
ṛk-yaju-sāmātharva paṭha ki kāraṇa?<br />‘govinda’ ‘govinda’ nāma karaha kīrtana [95]
<span class="e2">ki</span> <span class="e2">kāraṇa?</span>–What need [is there] <span class="e2">paṭha</span>–to recite <span class="e2">ṛk-yaju-sāmātharva</span>–the <span class="e33">Ṛg</span>-, <span class="e33">Yajur</span>-, <span class="e33">Sāma</span>-, and <span class="e33">Atharva-veda</span>? <span class="e2">kīrtana karaha</span>–Chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name: <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span> <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span>–‘Govinda! Govinda!’
“What need is there to recite the <span class="e3">Ṛg-</span>, <span class="e3">Yajur-</span>, <span class="e3">Sāma-</span>, and <span class="e3">Atharva-veda</span>? Just chant ‘Govinda! Govinda!’
মা ঋচো মা যজুস্তাত মা সাম পঠ কিঞ্চন ।<br />গোবিন্দেতি হরের্নাম গেয়ং গায়স্ব নিত্যশঃ ॥৯৬॥
mā ṛcho mā yajus tāta mā sāma paṭha kiñchana<br />govindeti harer nāma geyaṁ gāyasva nityaśaḥ [96]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘Do not recite the <span class="e3">Ṛg-</span>, <span class="e3">Yajur-</span>, or <span class="e3">Sāma-veda</span> any more. Always sing the Lord’s Name ‘Govinda’.’
বিষ্ণুর প্রত্যেক নাম সর্ব্ববেদাধিক ।<br />‘রাম’-নাম জান সহস্র নামের অধিক ॥৯৭॥
viṣṇura pratyeka nāma sarva-vedādhika<br />‘rāma’-nāma jāna sahasra nāmera adhika [97]
<span class="e2">jāna</span>–Know [that] <span class="e2">pratyeka</span>–every <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name <span class="e2">viṣṇura</span>–of Viṣṇu [is] <span class="e2">sarva-vedādhika</span>–superior to all the Vedas, [and] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name <span class="e2">‘rāma’</span>–‘Rāma’ [is] <span class="e2">adhika</span>–superior <span class="e2">sahasra</span> <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–to a thousand Names [of Viṣṇu].
“Know that every Name of Viṣṇu is superior to all the Vedas and that the Name ‘Rāma’ is superior to a thousand Names of Viṣṇu.
বিষ্ণোরেকৈকনামাপি সর্ব্ববেদাধিকং মতম্ ।<br />তদৃক্ নামসহস্রেণ ‘রাম’-নামসমং স্মৃতম্ ॥৯৮॥
viṣṇor ekaika-nāmāpi sarva-vedādhikaṁ matam<br />tadṛk-nāma-sahasreṇa ‘rāma’-nāma-samaṁ smṛtam [98]
(Padma-purāṇa)
“‘Every single Name of Viṣṇu is superior to all the Vedas, and the Name of Rāma is known to be equal to a thousand Names of Viṣṇu.’
সহস্র নাম তিনবার আবৃত্তি করিলে ।<br />যেই ফল হয় তাহা এক কৃষ্ণ-নামে মিলে ॥৯৯॥
sahasra nāma tina-bāra āvṛtti karile<br />yei phala haya tāhā eka kṛṣṇa-nāme mile [99]
<span class="e2">eka</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāme</span>–By [chanting] one Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">mile</span>–the soul attains <span class="e2">tāhā yei</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–the result that <span class="e2">haya</span>–occurs <span class="e2">āvṛtti</span> <span class="e2">karile</span>–when they chant <span class="e2">sahasra</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–a thousand Names [of Viṣṇu] <span class="e2">tina-bāra</span>–three times.
“Once chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa produces the same result as chanting a thousand Names of Viṣṇu three times.
‘কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ হে’ ।<br />এই নাম সর্ব্বক্ষণ ভক্ত সব কর হে ॥১০০॥
‘kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa he’<br />ei nāma sarva-kṣaṇa bhakta saba kara he [100]
<span class="e2">‘kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa he’</span>–‘Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa!’ <span class="e2">he</span>–O <span class="e2">saba bhakta</span>–devotees! <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–Constantly <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span> <span class="e2">kara</span>–chant the Name!
“‘Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa!’ O devotees! Constantly chant the Name!
‘হরে কৃষ্ণ হরে কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ হরে হরে ।<br />হরে রাম হরে রাম রাম রাম হরে হরে’ ॥১০১॥<br />এই ষোল নামে সর্ব্বদিক্ বজায় রহিল হে ।<br />সর্ব্বফলসিদ্ধি লাভ এই ষোল নামে হইবে হে ॥১০২॥
‘hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare<br />hare rāma hare rāma rāma rāma hare hare’ [101]<br />ei ṣola nāme sarva-dik bajāya rahila he<br />sarva-phala-siddhi lābha ei ṣola nāme ha-ibe he [102]
<span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ṣola</span> <span class="e2">nāme</span>–By these sixteen Names, <span class="e2">sarva-dik</span>–all directions <span class="e2">bajāya</span> <span class="e2">rahila he</span>–are maintained! <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">ṣola</span> <span class="e2">nāme</span>–By these sixteen Names, <span class="e2">sarva-phala-siddhi</span>–all perfection <span class="e2">lābha</span> <span class="e2">ha-ibe he</span>–will be attained!
“‘Hare Kṛṣṇa Hare Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Hare Hare Hare Rāma Hare Rāma Rāma Rāma Hare Hare’—by chanting these sixteen Names, everything is maintained! By chanting these sixteen Names, you will attain all perfection!
সহস্রনাম্নাং পুণ্যানাং ত্রিরাবৃত্ত্যা তু যৎ ফলম্ ।<br />একাবৃত্ত্যা তু কৃষ্ণস্য নামৈকং তৎ প্রযচ্ছতি ॥১০৩॥
sahasra-nāmnāṁ puṇyānāṁ trir-āvṛttyā tu yat phalam<br />ekāvṛttyā tu kṛṣṇasya nāmaikaṁ tat prayachchhati [103]
(Brahmāṇḍa-purāṇa)
“‘Once chanting the Name of Kṛṣṇa produces the same result as chanting a thousand Holy Names of Viṣṇu three times.’
তীর্থযাত্রাপরিশ্রমে কিবা ফল হবে ।<br />‘হরে কৃষ্ণ’ নিত্য গানে সব ফল পাবে ॥১০৪॥
tīrtha-yātrā-pariśrame kibā phala habe<br />‘hare kṛṣṇa’ nitya gāne saba phala pābe [104]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–What <span class="e2">phala</span> <span class="e2">habe</span>–is the benefit <span class="e2">tīrtha-yātrā-pariśrame</span>–of labouring to visit the holy places? <span class="e2">pābe</span>–You will attain <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–all such benefits <span class="e2">nitya</span> <span class="e2">gāne</span>–by constantly chanting <span class="e2">‘hare</span> <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa’</span>–‘Hare Kṛṣṇa’.
“What is the benefit of labouring to visit the holy places? You will attain all such benefits by constantly chanting ‘Hare Kṛṣṇa’.
কিবা কুরুক্ষেত্র, কাশী, পুষ্কর-ভ্রমণে ।<br />জিহ্বাগ্রেতে হরিনাম যাঁর ক্ষণে ক্ষণে ॥১০৫॥
kibā kurukṣetra, kāśī, puṣkara-bhramaṇe<br />jihvāgrete hari-nāma yā̐ra kṣaṇe kṣaṇe [105]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–What [is the value] <span class="e2">bhramaṇe</span>–of visiting <span class="e2">kurukṣetra</span>–Kurukṣetra, <span class="e2">kāśī</span>–Kāśī, [and] <span class="e2">puṣkara</span>–Puṣkara [for those] <span class="e2">yā̐ra jihvāgrete</span>–on the tip of whose tongue <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Lord’s Name [is present] <span class="e2">kṣaṇe</span> <span class="e2">kṣaṇe</span>–moment by moment?
“What is the value of visiting Kurukṣetra, Kāśī, and Puṣkara for those on the tip of whose tongue the Lord’s Name is always present?
কুরুক্ষেত্রেণ কিং তস্য কিং কাশ্যা পুষ্করেণ বা ।<br />জিহ্বাগ্রে বসতি যস্য হরিরিত্যক্ষরদ্বয়ম্ ॥১০৬॥
kurukṣetreṇa kiṁ tasya kiṁ kāśyā puṣkareṇa vā<br />jihvāgre vasati yasya harir ity akṣara-dvayam [106]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘What are Kurukṣetra, Kāśī, and Puṣkara to those on the tip of whose tongue the two syllables ‘Ha-ri’ reside?’
কোটি শত কোটি সহস্র তীর্থে যাহা নয় ।<br />হরিনাম-কীর্ত্তনেতে সেই ফল হয় ॥১০৭॥
koṭi śata koṭi sahasra tīrthe yāhā naya<br />hari-nāma-kīrtanete sei phala haya [107]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">phala yāhā</span>–The result that <span class="e2">naya</span>–is not [attained by visiting] <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">śata</span> <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">sahasra</span> <span class="e2">tīrthe</span>–millions or billions of holy places <span class="e2">haya</span>–is [attained] <span class="e2">hari-nāma-kīrtanete</span>–by chanting the Name of the Lord.
“By chanting the Name of the Lord, the souls attain a result that is not attained by visiting millions or billions of holy places.
তীর্থকোটিসহস্রাণি তীর্থকোটিশতানি চ ।<br />তানি সর্ব্বাণ্যবাপ্নোতি বিষ্ণোর্নামানুকীর্ত্তনাৎ ॥১০৮॥
tīrtha-koṭi-sahasrāṇi tīrtha-koṭi-śatāni cha<br />tāni sarvāṇy avāpnoti viṣṇor nāmānukīrtanāt [108]
(Vāmana-purāṇa)
“‘By constantly chanting the Name of Viṣṇu, the soul attains the result of visiting millions and billions of holy places.’
কুরুক্ষেত্রে বসি’ বিশ্বামিত্র ঋষি বলে ।<br />‘শুনিয়াছি বহু তীর্থনাম ধরাতলে ॥১০৯॥<br />হরিনাম-কীর্ত্তনের কোটি-অংশতুল্য ।<br />কোন তীর্থ নাহি’—এই বাক্য বহু মূল্য ॥১১০॥
kurukṣetre basi’ viśvāmitra ṛṣi bale<br />‘śuniyāchhi bahu tīrtha-nāma dharā-tale [109]<br />hari-nāma-kīrtanera koṭi-aṁśa-tulya<br />kona tīrtha nāhi’—ei vākya bahu mūlya [110]
[Once,] <span class="e2">basi’</span>–sitting <span class="e2">kurukṣetre</span>–at Kurukṣetra, <span class="e2">viśvāmitra</span> <span class="e2">ṛṣi</span>–Viśvāmitra Ṛṣi <span class="e2">bale</span>–said, <span class="e2">‘śuniyāchhi</span>–‘I have heard <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">tīrtha-nāma</span>–the names of many holy places <span class="e2">dharā-tale</span>–on the earth, [but] <span class="e2">koṭi-aṁśa</span>–one ten-millionth [of the value] <span class="e2">hari-nāma-kīrtanera</span>–of chanting the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–is not <span class="e2">tulya </span>–comparable [to] <span class="e2">kona</span>–any <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–holy place. <span class="e2">ei</span>–This <span class="e2">vākya</span>–statement [is] <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">mūlya</span>–very valuable.
“Once, sitting at Kurukṣetra, Viśvāmitra Ṛṣi said, ‘I have heard the names of many holy places on the earth, but none of them are comparable to even one ten-millionth of the value of chanting the Name of the Lord.’ This statement is very valuable.
বিশ্রুতানি বহূন্যেব তীর্থানি বহুধানি চ ।<br />কোট্যংশেন নি তুল্যানি নামকীর্ত্তনতো হরেঃ ॥১১১॥
viśrutāni bahūny eva tīrthāni bahudhāni cha<br />koṭy-aṁśena na tulyāni nāma-kīrtanato hareḥ [111]
(Viśvāmitra-saṁhitā)
“‘The various and numerous renowned holy places do not equal one ten-millionth of the value of chanting the Name of the Lord.’
বেদাগম বহু শাস্ত্রে কিবা প্রয়োজন ।<br />কেন করে লোক বহুতীর্থাদি ভ্রমণ ॥১১২॥
vedāgama bahu śāstre kibā prayojana<br />kena kare loka bahu-tīrthādi bhramaṇa [112]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–What <span class="e2">prayojana</span>–need [is there] <span class="e2">vedāgama</span> <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–for the Vedas, Āgamas, and numerous other scriptures? [And] <span class="e2">kena</span>–why <span class="e2">loka bhramaṇa kare</span>–do people visit <span class="e2">bahu-tīrthādi</span>–so many holy places?
“What need is there for the Vedas, Āgamas, and numerous other scriptures? And why do people visit so many holy places?
আত্মমুক্তিবাঞ্ছা যার, সেই সর্ব্বক্ষণ ।<br />‘গোবিন্দ’ ‘গোবিন্দ’ বলি’ করুক কীর্ত্তন ॥১১৩॥
ātma-mukti-vāñchhā yāra, sei sarva-kṣaṇa<br />‘govinda’ ‘govinda’ bali’ karuka kīrtana [113]
[Let] <span class="e2">sei yāra</span>–those who <span class="e2">ātma-mukti-vāñchhā</span>–desire their own liberation <span class="e2">sarva-kṣaṇa</span>–constantly <span class="e2">kīrtana karuka</span>–chant <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span> <span class="e2">‘govinda’</span> <span class="e2">bali’</span>–‘Govinda! Govinda!’
“Let those who desire their own liberation constantly chant ‘Govinda! Govinda!’
কিন্তাত বেদাগমশাস্ত্রবিস্তরৈস্<br />তীর্থৈরনেকৈরপি কিং প্রয়োজনম্ ।<br />যদ্যাত্মনো বাঞ্ছসি মুক্তিকারণং<br />গোবিন্দ গোবিন্দ ইতি স্ফুটং রট ॥১১৪॥
kin tāta vedāgama-śāstra-vistarais<br />tīrthair anekair api kiṁ prayojanam<br />yady ātmano vāñchhasi mukti-kāraṇaṁ<br />govinda govinda iti sphuṭaṁ raṭa [114]
(Laghu-bhāgavata)
“‘My child, what is the use of the Vedas, Āgamas, and other scriptures? What need is there for the numerous holy places? If you seek the means to your own liberation, then simply chant, “Govinda! Govinda!”’
সর্ব্বসৎকর্ম্মাধিক নাম জানহ নিশ্চয় ।<br />এই কথা বিশ্বাসিলে সর্ব্বধর্ম্ম হয় ॥১১৫॥
sarva-sat-karmādhika nāma jānaha niśchaya<br />ei kathā viśvāsile sarva-dharma haya [115]
<span class="e2">jānaha</span>–Know <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–for certain [that chanting] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-sat-karmādhika</span>–superior to all pious activities. <span class="e2">viśvāsile</span>–If you have faith <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">kathā</span>–in this principle, <span class="e2">sarva-dharma</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–all [your] duties are [automatically] fulfilled.
“Know for certain that chanting the Name is superior to all pious activities. If you have faith in this principle, all your duties are automatically fulfilled.
সূর্য্য উপরাগে কোটি কোটি গরুদান ।<br />প্রয়াগেতে কল্পবাস মাঘেতে বিধান ॥১১৬॥<br />অযুত যজ্ঞাদি কর্ম্ম স্বর্গমেরুদান ।<br />শতাংশেতে হরিনামের না হয় সমান ॥১১৭॥
sūrya uparāge koṭi koṭi garu-dāna<br />prayāgete kalpa-vāsa māghete vidhāna [116]<br />ayuta yajñādi karma svarga-meru-dāna<br />śatāṁśete hari-nāmera nā haya samāna [117]
<span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">koṭi</span> <span class="e2">garu-dāna</span>–Donating billions of cows <span class="e2">sūrya</span> <span class="e2">uparāge</span>–during a solar eclipse, <span class="e2">kalpa-vāsa</span>–residing for billions of years <span class="e2">prayāgete</span>–in Prayāg [and] <span class="e2">vidhāna</span>–observing rites <span class="e2">māghete</span>–during the month of Māgh, <span class="e2">karma</span>–performing <span class="e2">ayuta</span>–ten thousand <span class="e2">yajñādi</span>–sacrifices, [and] <span class="e2">svarga-meru-dāna</span>–donating a Mount Sumeru’s worth of gold <span class="e2">samāna haya nā</span>–does not equal <span class="e2">śatāṁśete</span>–one one-hundredth [of the value] <span class="e2">hari-nāmera</span>–of [chanting] the Name of the Lord.
“Donating tens of millions of cows during a solar eclipse, residing at Prayāg for billions of years and observing rites during the month of Māgh, performing ten million sacrifices, and donating a Mount Sumeru’s worth of gold does not equal one one-hundredth of the value of chanting the Name of the Lord.
গোকোটিদানং গ্রহণে খগস্য<br />প্রয়াগগঙ্গোদক-কল্পবাসঃ ।<br />যজ্ঞাযুতং মেরুসুবর্ণদানং<br />গোবিন্দকীর্ত্তের্ন সমং শতাংশৈঃ ॥১১৮॥
go-koṭi-dānaṁ grahaṇe khagasya<br />prayāga-gaṅgodaka-kalpa-vāsaḥ<br />yajñāyutaṁ meru-suvarṇa-dānaṁ<br />govinda-kīrter na samaṁ śatāṁśaiḥ [118]
(Laghu-bhāgavata)
“‘Donating ten million cows during a solar eclipse, residing in the waters of the Ganges at Prayāg for billions of years, performing ten thousand sacrifices, and donating a Mount Sumeru’s worth of gold does not equal one one-hundredth of the value of chanting the Name of Govinda.’
ইষ্টাপূর্ত্ত কর্ম্ম বহু বহু কৃত হৈলে ।<br />তথাপি সে সব ভবহেতু শাস্ত্রে বলে ॥১১৯॥
iṣṭāpūrta karma bahu bahu kṛta haile<br />tathāpi se saba bhava hetu śāstre bale [119]
<span class="e2">śāstre</span>–The scriptures <span class="e2">bale</span>–say <span class="e2">iṣṭāpūrta</span> <span class="e2">karma</span>–public welfare works, [even if] <span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">saba kṛta</span> <span class="e2">haile</span>–they all are performed <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">bahu</span>–many [times], <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–still [are] <span class="e2">hetu</span>–a cause [of bondage] <span class="e2">bhava</span>–within the material world.
“The scriptures say that public welfare works, even if they are performed many times, are a cause of bondage within the material world.
হরিনাম অনায়াসে ভবমুক্তিধর ।<br />কর্ম্মফল নামের কাছে অকিঞ্চিৎকর ॥১২০॥
hari-nāma anāyāse bhava-mukti-dhara<br />karma-phala nāmera kāchhe akiñchitkara [120]
<span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–The Name of the Lord <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–easily <span class="e2">bhava-mukti-dhara</span>–grants liberation from the material world. <span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">kāchhe</span>–Next to the Name, <span class="e2">karma-phala</span>–the fruits of [pious] karma [are] <span class="e2">akiñchitkara</span>–inconsequential.
“Chanting the Name of the Lord easily grants liberation from the material world. Next to the Name, the fruits of pious karma are nothing.
ইষ্টাপূর্ত্তানি কর্ম্মাণি সুবহূনি কৃতান্যপি ।<br />ভবহেতূনি তান্যেব হরের্নাম তু মুক্তিদম্ ॥১২১॥
iṣṭāpūrtāni karmāṇi subahūni kṛtāny api<br />bhava-hetūni tāny eva harer nāma tu mukti-dam [121]
(Baudhāyana-saṁhitā)
“‘Public welfare works, even if performed many times, are a cause of bondage within the material world. Only chanting the Name of the Lord grants liberation.’
সাঙ্খ্য-অষ্টাঙ্গাদি যোগে কিবা আশা ধর ।<br />মুক্তি চাও—গোবিন্দ-কীর্ত্তন সদা কর ॥১২২॥
sāṅkhya-aṣṭāṅgādi yoge kibā āśā dhara<br />mukti chāo—govinda-kīrtana sadā kara [122]
<span class="e2">kibā</span>–What <span class="e2">āśā</span>–hope [do] <span class="e2">dhara</span>–you have <span class="e2">sāṅkhya-aṣṭāṅgādi</span> <span class="e2">yoge</span>–in metaphysics, aṣṭāṅga-yoga, and so on? <span class="e2">chāo</span>–You want<span class="e2"> mukti</span>–liberation, [so] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">govinda-kīrtana kara</span>–chant the Name of Govinda.
“What hope do you have in metaphysics and aṣṭāṅga-yoga? You want liberation, so just chant the Name of Govinda.
মুক্তিও সামান্য ফল নামের নিকটে ।<br />হেলায় করিলে নাম জীবের মুক্তি ঘটে ॥১২৩॥
muktio sāmānya phala nāmera nikaṭe<br />helāya karile nāma jīvera mukti ghaṭe [123]
<span class="e2">nāmera</span> <span class="e2">nikaṭe</span>–Next to the Name, <span class="e2">muktio</span>–even liberation [is] <span class="e2">sāmānya</span> <span class="e2">phala</span>–an insignificant fruit. <span class="e2">jīvera</span> <span class="e2">mukti</span> <span class="e2">ghaṭe</span>–Souls attain liberation [even] <span class="e2">nāma karile</span>–when they chant the Name <span class="e2">helāya</span>–negligently.
“Next to the Name, even liberation is an insignificant attainment. Souls attain liberation even when they negligently chant the Name.
কিং করিষ্যতি সাঙ্খ্যেন কিং যোগৈর্নরনায়ক ।<br />মুক্তিমিচ্ছসি রাজেন্দ্র কুরু গোবিন্দকীর্ত্তনম্ ॥১২৪॥
kiṁ kariṣyati sāṅkhyena kiṁ yogair nara-nāyaka<br />muktim ichchhasi rājendra kuru govinda-kīrtanam [124]
(Garuḍa-purāṇa)
“‘O King, what will you do with metaphysics and yoga? You want liberation, O Emperor, so chant the Name of Govinda.’
শ্বপচ হইলেও দ্বিজশ্রেষ্ঠ বলি তারে ।<br />যাহার জিহ্বাগ্রে কৃষ্ণনাম নৃত্য করে ॥১২৫॥
śvapacha ha-ileo dvija-śreṣṭha bali tāre<br />yāhāra jihvāgre kṛṣṇa-nāma nṛtya kare [125]
<span class="e2">śvapacha</span> <span class="e2">ha-ileo</span>–Even if they are outcasts, <span class="e2">bali</span>–we consider <span class="e2">tāre yāhāra</span> <span class="e2">jihvāgre</span>–those on the tip of whose tongue <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">nṛtya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–dances [to be] <span class="e2">dvija-śreṣṭha</span>–the best of the twice-born.
“Even outcasts are considered the best of brāhmaṇs when the Name of Kṛṣṇa dances on the tip of their tongue.
সর্ব্বতপ কৈল সর্ব্বতীর্থে কৈল স্নান ।<br />সর্ব্ববেদ অধ্যয়নে আর্য মতিমান্ ॥১২৬॥<br />এই সব সাধনের বলে ভাগ্যবান্ ।<br />রসনায় সদা করে হরিনাম গান ॥১২৭॥
sarva-tapa kaila sarva-tīrthe kaila snāna<br />sarva-veda adhyayane ārya matimān [126]<br />ei saba sādhanera bale bhāgyavān<br />rasanāya sadā kare hari-nāma gāna [127]
<span class="e2">sarva-tapa</span> <span class="e2">kaila</span>–They have performed all austerities, <span class="e2">snāna kaila</span>–bathed <span class="e2">sarva-tīrthe</span>–at all holy places, <span class="e2">adhyayane</span>–studied <span class="e2">sarva-veda</span>–all scriptures, [and become] <span class="e2">ārya matimān</span>–noble-minded. <span class="e2">ei</span> <span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">sādhanera</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–With the strength produced by all these practices, <span class="e2">bhāgyavān</span>–such fortunate souls <span class="e2">sadā</span>–constantly <span class="e2">gāna kare</span>–chant <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">rasanāya</span>–with [their] tongue.
“They have performed all austerities, bathed at all holy places, studied all scriptures, and become noble-minded. With the strength produced by all these practices, such fortunate souls constantly chant the Name of the Lord with their tongues.
অহো বত শ্বপচোঽতো গরীয়ান্<br />যজ্জিহ্বাগ্রে বর্ত্ততে নাম তুভ্যম্ ।<br />তেপুস্তপস্তে জুহুবুঃ সস্নুরার্য্যা<br />ব্রহ্মানূচুর্নাম গৃণন্তি যে তে ॥১২৮॥
aho bata śvapacho ’to garīyān<br />yaj jihvāgre vartate nāma tubhyam<br />tepus tapas te juhuvuḥ sasnur āryā<br />brahmānūchur nāma gṛhṇanti ye te [128]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 3.33.7)
“‘How glorious! An outcast on the tip of whose tongue Your Name appears is exalted. Those who chant Your Name have performed all austerities and sacrifices, bathed in all the holy places, become virtuous, and studied all the scriptures.’
সর্ব্ব-অর্থ-দাতা হরিনাম মহামন্ত্র ।<br />ফুকারিয়া বলে যত বেদাগমতন্ত্র ॥১২৯॥
sarva-artha-dātā hari-nāma mahāmantra<br />phukāriyā bale yata vedāgama-tantra [129]
<span class="e2">yata</span> <span class="e2">vedāgama-tantra</span>–All the Vedas, Āgamas, and Tantras <span class="e2">phukāriyā</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–proclaim [that] <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span> <span class="e2">mahāmantra</span>–the mahāmantra of the Lord’s Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-artha-dātā</span>–the giver of all desired ends.
“The Vedas, Āgamas, Tantras, and other scriptures proclaim that the mahāmantra of the Lord’s Name grants all desired ends.
হরিনামবলে সর্ব্বষড়্বর্গ-দমন ।<br />রিপুনিগ্রহণ আর অধ্যাত্ম-সাধন ॥১৩০॥
hari-nāma-bale sarva-ṣaḍ-varga-damana<br />ripu-nigrahaṇa āra adhyātma-sādhana [130]
<span class="e2">hari-nāma-bale</span>–By the power of the Name of the Lord, <span class="e2">sarva-ṣaḍ-varga-damana</span>–destruction of all six vices, <span class="e2">ripu-nigrahaṇa</span>–subduing of enemies, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">adhyātma-sādhana</span>–realisation of the higher self [occur].
“The Name of the Lord vanquishes lust, anger, greed, madness, pride, and envy, subdues enemies, and produces self-realisation.
এতৎ ষড়্বর্গহরণমং রিপুনিগ্রহণং পরম্ ।<br />অধ্যাত্মমূলমেতদ্ধি বিষ্ণোর্নামানুকীর্ত্তনম্ ॥১৩১॥
etat ṣaḍ-varga-haraṇam ripu-nigrahaṇaṁ param<br />adhyātma-mūlam etad dhi viṣṇor nāmānukīrtanam [131]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘Constantly chanting the Name of Viṣṇu destroys lust, anger, greed, madness, pride, and envy, completely subdues enemies, and produces realisation of the higher self.’
গুণজ্ঞ সারভুক্ আর্য্য কলিকে সম্মানে ।<br />সর্ব্বস্বার্থ লভি’ কলৌ নাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে ॥১৩২॥
guṇajña sāra-bhuk ārya kalike sammāne<br />sarva-svārtha labhi’ kalau nāma-saṅkīrtane [132]
<span class="e2">ārya</span>–The wise [who] <span class="e2">guṇajña</span>–know the qualities <span class="e2">kalike</span>–of the Age of Kali [and] <span class="e2">sāra-bhuk</span>–appreciate its virtue <span class="e2">sammāne</span>–honour [this age because] <span class="e2">kalau</span>–in the Age of Kali <span class="e2">sarva-svārtha</span>–all desired ends <span class="e2">labhi’</span>–are attained <span class="e2">nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–by chanting the Name.
“The wise who know the qualities of the Age of Kali and appreciate its virtue honour this age because in the Age of Kali all desired ends are attained by chanting the Name of the Lord.
কলিং সভাজয়ন্ত্যার্য্যা গুণজ্ঞা সারভাগিনঃ ।<br />যত্র সঙ্কীর্ত্তনেনৈব সর্ব্বঃ স্বর্থোঽভিলভ্যতে ॥১৩৩॥
kaliṁ sabhājayanty āryā guṇajñā sāra-bhāginaḥ<br />yatra saṅkīrtanenaiva sarvaḥ svartho ’bhilabhyate [133]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 11.5.36)
“‘The wise who know the qualities of the Age of Kali and appreciate its virtue praise this age in which all desired ends are attained simply by chanting the Name of the Lord.’
সর্ব্বশক্তিমান্ নাম কৃষ্ণের সমান ।<br />কৃষ্ণের সকল শক্তি নামে বর্ত্তমান ॥১৩৪॥
sarva-śaktimān nāma kṛṣṇera samāna<br />kṛṣṇera sakala śakti nāme vartamāna [134]
<span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">sarva-śaktimān</span>–all-powerful [and] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">samāna</span>–equal to Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇera</span> <span class="e2">sakala</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span>–all of Kṛṣṇa’s power [is] <span class="e2">vartamāna</span>–present <span class="e2">nāme</span>–within the Name.
“The Name is all-powerful and equal to Kṛṣṇa Himself; all of Kṛṣṇa’s power is present within the Name.
দানব্রতস্তপস্তীর্থে ছিল যত শক্তি ।<br />দেবগণে কর্ম্মকাণ্ডে হইয়া বিভক্তি ॥১৩৫॥<br />রাজসূয়ে অশ্বমেধে আধ্যাত্মিক জ্ঞানে ।<br />সব আকর্ষিয়া কৃষ্ণ নিল আপন নামে ॥১৩৬॥
dāna-vratas-tapas-tīrthe chhila yata śakti<br />deva-gaṇe karma-kāṇḍe ha-iyā vibhakti [135]<br />rājasūye aśvamedhe ādhyātmika jñāne<br />saba ākarṣiyā kṛṣṇa nila āpana nāme [136]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">ākarṣiyā</span>–has drawn <span class="e2">saba yata</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span>–all the power <span class="e2">chhila</span>–that was present [and] <span class="e2">vibhakti ha-iyā</span>–divided <span class="e2">dāna-vratas-tapas-tīrthe</span>–within charity, rites, austerity, pilgrimage, <span class="e2">deva-gaṇe</span>–[worshipping] the gods, <span class="e2">karma-kāṇḍe</span>–[following] the codes for pious action in the Vedas, <span class="e2">rājasūye</span>–coronations, <span class="e2">aśvamedhe</span>–horse sacrifices, [and] <span class="e2">ādhyātmika</span> <span class="e2">jñāne</span>–knowledge of the highest self, [and] <span class="e2">nila</span>–taken [it] <span class="e2">āpana</span> <span class="e2">nāme</span>–into His Name.
“Kṛṣṇa has drawn all the power that was present and divided within charity, rites, austerity, pilgrimage, worshipping the gods, following the codes for pious action, coronations, horse sacrifices, and realisation of the higher self, and invested it in His Name.
দানব্রততপস্তীর্থক্ষেত্রাদীনাঞ্চ যাঃ স্থিতাঃ ।<br />শক্তয়ো দেবমহতাং সর্ব্বপাপহরাঃ শুভাঃ ॥১৩৭॥<br />রাজসূয়াশ্বমেধানাং জ্ঞানমধ্যাত্মবস্তুনঃ ।<br />আকৃষ্য হরিণা সর্বাঃ স্থাপিতাঃ স্বেষু নামসু ॥১৩৮॥
dāna-vrata-tapas-tīrtha-kṣetrādīnāṁ cha yāḥ sthitāḥ<br />śaktayo deva-mahatāṁ sarva-pāpa-harāḥ śubhāḥ [137]<br />rājasūyāśvamedhānāṁ jñānam adhyātma-vastunaḥ<br />ākṛṣya hariṇā sarvāḥ sthāpitāḥ sveṣu nāmasu [138]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘The Lord has drawn out all the purifying power to remove sin situated within charity, rites, austerities, pilgrimage, worshipping the gods, serving the virtuous, coronations, horse sacrifices, and knowledge of the higher self, and placed it within His Names.’
দেবদেব শ্রীকৃষ্ণের সর্ব্ব অর্থ শক্তি ।<br />যুক্ত সব নাম, তঁহি মধ্যে যাতে অনুরক্তি ॥১৩৯॥<br />সেই নাম সর্ব্ব অর্থে যোজনা করিবে ।<br />সর্ব্ব অর্থ শক্তি হৈতে সকলই মিলিবে ॥১৪০॥
devadeva śrī-kṛṣṇera sarva artha śakti<br />yukta saba nāma, ta̐hi madhye yāte anurakti [139]<br />sei nāma sarva arthe yojanā karibe<br />sarva artha śakti haite sakala-i milibe [140]
<span class="e2">saba</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–All [His] Names [are] <span class="e2">yukta</span>–endowed [with] <span class="e2">devadeva</span>–the God of gods <span class="e2">śrī-kṛṣṇera</span>–Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s <span class="e2">sarva artha</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span>–power [to grant] all desired ends. <span class="e2">yāte sei</span> <span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name to which [you are] <span class="e2">anurakti</span>–attached <span class="e2">ta̐hi</span> <span class="e2">madhye</span>–amongst Them <span class="e2">yojanā</span> <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will bring [you] <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all <span class="e2">arthe</span>–desired ends. <span class="e2">haite</span>–Through [the Name’s] <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">artha</span> <span class="e2">śakti</span>–power [to grant] all desired ends, <span class="e2">milibe</span>–You will attain <span class="e2">sakala-i</span>–everything.
“All the Names of the God of gods Śrī Kṛṣṇa are endowed with His power to grant all desired ends. Whichever Name amongst Them to which you are attached will bring you all desired ends. Through the Name’s power to grant all desired ends, you will attain everything.
সর্ব্বার্থশক্তিযুক্তস্য দেবদেবস্য চক্রিণঃ ।<br />যচ্চাভিরুচিতং নাম তৎ সর্ব্বার্থেষু যোজয়েৎ ॥১৪১॥
sarvārtha-śakti-yuktasya deva-devasya chakriṇaḥ<br />yach chābhiruchitaṁ nāma tat sarvārtheṣu yojayet [141]
(Brahmāṇḍa-purāṇa)
“‘For the attainment of all desired ends, chant your favourite Name of the God of gods, the carrier of the chakra, who has the power to grant all desired ends.’
হৃষীকেশ-সঙ্কীর্ত্তনে জগদানন্দিত ।<br />অনুরাগে হৃষ্টচিত্ত সর্ব্বদা সম্প্রীত ॥১৪২॥<br />দৈত্য রক্ষ ভীত হইয়া পলাইয়া যায় ।<br />সিদ্ধসঙ্ঘ সদা প্রণমিত তাঁর পায় ॥১৪৩॥
hṛṣīkeśa-saṅkīrtane jagad-ānandita<br />anurāge hṛṣṭa-chitta sarvadā samprīta [142]<br />daitya rakṣa bhīta ha-iyā palāiyā yāya<br />siddha-saṅgha sadā praṇamita tā̐ra pāya [143]
<span class="e2">hṛṣīkeśa-saṅkīrtane</span>–By the chanting of the Lord’s Name, <span class="e2">jagad</span>–the world [becomes] <span class="e2">ānandita</span>–joyful, [the people’s] <span class="e2">chitta</span>–hearts <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always [remain] <span class="e2">hṛṣṭa</span>–happy and <span class="e2">samprīta</span>–fulfilled <span class="e2">anurāge</span>–through attachment [to the Lord,] <span class="e2">daitya</span> <span class="e2">rakṣa</span>–the demons <span class="e2">bhīta</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–become afraid [and] <span class="e2">palāiyā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–flee, [and] <span class="e2">siddha-saṅgha</span>–the realised souls <span class="e2">sadā</span>–continuously <span class="e2">praṇamita</span>–bow <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">pāya</span>–at His feet.
“By the chanting of the Lord’s Name, the world becomes joyful, the people’s hearts always remain happy and fulfilled through attachment to the Lord, the demons become afraid and flee, and the realised souls continuously bow at the Lord’s feet.
যেই কৃষ্ণ সেই নাম, নামের প্রভাব ।<br />উপযুক্ত বটে তাতে না থাকে অভাব ॥১৪৪॥
yei kṛṣṇa sei nāma, nāmera prabhāva<br />upayukta vaṭe tāte nā thāke abhāva [144]
<span class="e2">sei yei</span>–He who [is] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name, [and] <span class="e2">nāmera</span>–the Name’s <span class="e2">prabhāva</span>–influence <span class="e2">vaṭe</span>–is [always] <span class="e2">upayukta</span>–fitting. <span class="e2">abhāva thāke nā</span>–There is no deficiency <span class="e2">tāte</span>–within it.
“The Name is Kṛṣṇa Himself, and the Name’s influence is always fitting. There is no deficiency within it.
স্থানে হৃষীকেশ তব প্রকীর্ত্ত্যা<br />জগৎ প্রহৃষ্যত্যনুরজ্যতে চ ।<br />রক্ষাংসি ভীতানি দিশো দ্রবন্তি<br />সর্ব্বে নমস্যন্তি চ সিদ্ধসঙ্ঘাঃ ॥১৪৫॥
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā<br />jagat prahṛṣyaty anurajyate cha<br />rakṣāṁsi bhītāni diśo dravanti<br />sarve namasyanti cha siddha-saṅghāḥ [145]
(Śrīmad Bhagavad-gītā: 11.36)
“‘It is all fitting, O Master of the senses, that upon hearing the chanting of Your glories, the world rejoices and becomes attached to You, the demons flee in all directions, and the realised souls bow down.’
বর্ণাদি বিচার নাহি শ্রীনামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনে ।<br />দীক্ষাপুরশ্চর্য্যা বিধি বাধা নাই গণে ॥১৪৬॥
varṇādi vichāra nāhi śrī-nāma-saṅkīrtane<br />dīkṣā-puraścharyā vidhi bādhā nāi gaṇe [146]
<span class="e2">śrī-nāma-saṅkīrtane</span>–In chanting the Name, <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–there is no <span class="e2">vichāra</span>–consideration <span class="e2">varṇādi</span>–of class or caste. <span class="e2">vidhi</span>–The conventions <span class="e2">dīkṣā-puraścharyā</span>–of [brahminical] initiation and preparatory rites <span class="e2">gaṇe nāi</span>–are not counted <span class="e2">bādhā</span>–as barriers.
“In chanting the Name, there is no consideration of class or caste, and the conventions of brahminical initiation and preparatory rites are not barriers to it.
নারায়ণ জগন্নাথ বাসুদেব জনার্দ্দন ।<br />যার মুখে সদা শুনি, পূজ্য গুরু সেই জন ॥১৪৭॥
nārāyaṇa jagannātha vāsudeva janārdana<br />yāra mukhe sadā śuni, pūjya guru sei jana [147]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jana yāra</span> <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–Those from whose mouth [we] <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always <span class="e2">śuni</span>–hear <span class="e2">nārāyaṇa</span> <span class="e2">jagannātha</span> <span class="e2">vāsudeva</span> <span class="e2">janārdana</span>–‘Nārāyaṇ!’, ‘Jagannāth!’, ‘Vāsudev!’, and ‘Janārdan!’ [are] <span class="e2">pūjya</span> <span class="e2">guru</span>–worshippable Gurus.
“Those from whose mouth we always hear ‘Nārāyaṇ!’, ‘Jagannāth!’, ‘Vāsudev!’, and ‘Janārdan!’ are worshippable Gurus.
শয়নে স্বপনে আর চলিতে বসিতে ।<br />কৃষ্ণনাম করে যেই, পূজ্য সর্ব্ব মতে ॥১৪৮॥
śayane svapane āra chalite basite<br />kṛṣṇa-nāma kare yei, pūjya sarva mate [148]
<span class="e2">yei</span>–Those who <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">śayane</span>–while resting, <span class="e2">svapane</span>–dreaming, <span class="e2">chalite</span>–walking, <span class="e2">āra</span>–and <span class="e2">basite</span>–sitting [are] <span class="e2">pūjya</span>–worshippable <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">mate</span>–in all respects.
“Those who chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa while resting, dreaming, walking, and sitting are worshippable in all respects.
নারায়ণ জগন্নাথ বাসুদেব জনার্দ্দন ।<br />ইতীরয়ন্তি যে নিত্যং তে বৈ সর্ব্বত্র বন্দিতাঃ ॥১৪৯॥<br />স্বপন্ ভুঞ্জন্ ব্রজংস্তিষ্ঠনুত্তিষ্ঠংশ্চ বদংস্তথা ।<br />যে বদন্তি হরের্নাম তেভ্যো নিত্যং নমো নমঃ ॥১৫০॥
nārāyaṇa jagannātha vāsudeva janārdana<br />itīrayanti ye nityaṁ te vai sarvatra vanditāḥ [149]<br />svapan bhuñjan vrajaṁs tiṣṭhan uttiṣṭhaṁś cha vadaṁs tathā<br />ye vadanti harer nāma tebhyo nityaṁ namo namaḥ [150]
(Bṛhan-nāradīya-purāṇa)
“‘Those who always chant ‘Nārāyaṇ!’, ‘Jagannāth!’, ‘Vāsudev!’, and ‘Janārdan!’ are worshipped everywhere. Eternally, I bow again and again to those who chant the Name of the Lord while resting, eating, walking, sitting, standing, or talking.’
স্ত্রী-শূদ্র-পুক্কশ-যবনাদি কেন নয় ।<br />কৃষ্ণনাম গায়, সেও গুরু পূজ্য হয় ॥১৫১॥
strī-śūdra-pukkaśa-yavanādi kena naya<br />kṛṣṇa-nāma gāya, seo guru pūjya haya [151]
<span class="e2">kena naya</span>–Whether or not [they are] <span class="e2">strī-śūdra-pukkaśa-yavanādi</span>–women, labourers, persons of mixed caste, outcasts, or otherwise, <span class="e2">seo</span>–those [who] <span class="e2">gāya</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">haya</span>–become <span class="e2">pūjya guru</span>–worshippable Gurus.
“Those who chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, whether or not they are women, labourers, persons of mixed caste, outcasts, or otherwise, become worshippable Gurus.
স্ত্রী শূদ্রঃ পুক্কশো বাপি যে চান্যে পাপযোনয়ঃ ।<br />কীর্ত্তয়ন্তি হরিং ভক্ত্যা তেভ্যোঽপীহ নমো নমঃ ॥১৫২॥
strī śūdraḥ pukkaśo vāpi ye chānye pāpa-yonayaḥ<br />kīrtayanti hariṁ bhaktyā tebhyo ’pīha namo namaḥ [152]
(Nārāyaṇa-vyūha-stava)
“‘I bow again and again to those who chant the Name of the Lord with devotion, be they women, labourers, persons of mixed caste, or even outcasts.’
অন্যগতিশূন্য ভোগী পর-উপতাপী ।<br />ব্রহ্মচর্য্য-জ্ঞানবৈরাগ্যহীন পাপী ॥১৫৩॥<br />সর্ব্বধর্ম্মশূন্য নামজপী যদি হয় ।<br />তাহার যে সুগতি তাহা সর্ব্ব ধার্ম্মিকের নয় ॥১৫৪॥
anya-gati-śūnya bhogī para-upatāpī<br />brahmacharya-jñāna-vairāgya-hīna pāpī [153]<br />sarva-dharma-śūnya nāma-japī yadi haya<br />tāhāra ye sugati tāhā sarva dhārmikera naya [154]
<span class="e2">yadi</span>–If [those who are] <span class="e2">anya-gati-śūnya</span>–shelterless, <span class="e2">bhogī</span>–hedonistic, <span class="e2">para-upatāpī</span>–harmful to others, <span class="e2">brahmacharya-jñāna-vairāgya-hīna</span>–devoid of austerity, knowledge, and renunciation, <span class="e2">pāpī</span>–sinful [or] <span class="e2">sarva-dharma-śūnya</span>–completely irreligious <span class="e2">nāma-japī</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–become chanters of the Name, [they attain] <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">ye</span> <span class="e2">sugati</span>–an exalted destination <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that <span class="e2">naya</span>–is not [attained] <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">dhārmikera</span>–by all pious persons.
“If those who are shelterless, hedonistic, harmful to others, devoid of austerity, knowledge, and renunciation, sinful, or completely irreligious chant the Name, they attain an exalted destination that even the pious do not.
অনন্যগতয়ো মর্ত্ত্যা ভোগিনোঽপি পরন্তপাঃ ।<br />জ্ঞানবৈরাগ্যরহিতা ব্রহ্মচর্য্যাদিবর্জ্জিতাঃ ॥১৫৫॥<br />সর্ব্বধর্ম্মোজ্ঝিতা বিষ্ণোর্নামমাত্রৈকজল্পকাঃ ।<br />সুখেন যাং গতিং যান্তি ন তাং সর্ব্বেঽপি ধার্ম্মিকাঃ ॥১৫৬॥
ananya-gatayo martyā bhogino ’pi parantapāḥ<br />jñāna-vairāgya-rahitā brahmacharyādi-varjitāḥ [155]<br />sarva-dharmojjhitā viṣṇor nāma-mātraika-jalpakāḥ<br />sukhena yāṁ gatiṁ yānti na tāṁ sarve ’pi dhārmikāḥ [156]
(Padma-purāṇa)
“‘Regardless of whether they are shelterless, hedonistic, harmful to others, devoid of knowledge and renunciation, undisciplined, or completely irreligious, those who just once chant the Name of Viṣṇu happily attain a destination that even the pious do not.’
হরিনামগ্রহণে দেশকালের নিয়ম নাই ।<br />উচ্ছিষ্ট অশৌচে বিধি নিষেধ না পাই ॥১৫৭॥
hari-nāma-grahaṇe deśa-kālera niyama nāi<br />uchchhiṣṭa aśauche vidhi niṣedha nā pāi [157]
<span class="e2">hari-nāma-grahaṇe</span>–In chanting the Name of the Lord, <span class="e2">nāi</span>–there are no <span class="e2">niyama</span>–rules <span class="e2">deśa-kālera</span>–regarding time and place, [and] <span class="e2">pāi nā</span>–we do not find <span class="e2">vidhi</span>–any rules [or] <span class="e2">niṣedha</span>–regulations <span class="e2">uchchhiṣṭa</span> <span class="e2">aśauche</span>–regarding impurity produced by food remnants.
“In chanting the Name of the Lord, there are no rules regarding time and place, and we do not find any rules or regulations regarding impurity produced by food remnants.
ন দেশনিয়মস্তস্মিন্ ন কালনিয়মস্তথা ।<br />নোচ্ছিষ্টাদৌ নিষেধোঽস্তি শ্রীহরের্নাম্নি লুব্ধক ॥১৫৮॥
na deśa-niyamas tasmin na kāla-niyamas tathā<br />nochchhiṣṭhādau niṣedho ’sti śrī-harer nāmni lubdhaka [158]
(Viṣṇu-dharma)
“‘O hunter! Neither are there rules regarding the time and place in chanting the Name of the Lord, nor are there regulations regarding food remnants.’
কৃষ্ণনাম সদা সর্ব্বত্র করহ কীর্ত্তন ।<br />অশৌচাদি নাহি মান, নাম স্বতন্ত্র পাবন ॥১৫৯॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā sarvatra karaha kīrtana<br />aśauchādi nāhi māna, nāma svatantra pāvana [159]
<span class="e2">kīrtana karaha</span>–Chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always [and] <span class="e2">sarvatra</span>–everywhere, [and] <span class="e2">māna nāhi</span>–do not be concerned <span class="e2">aśauchādi</span>–about (external) impurity. <span class="e2">nāma</span>–The Name [is] <span class="e2">svatantra</span>–independently <span class="e2">pāvana</span>–purifying.
“Chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa always and everywhere, and do not be concerned about external purity. The Name is independently purifying.
চক্রায়ুধস্য নামানি সদা সর্ব্বত্র কীর্ত্তয়েৎ ।<br />নাশৌচং কীর্ত্তনে তস্য স পবিত্রকরো যতঃ ॥১৬০॥
chakrāyudhasya nāmāni sadā sarvatra kīrtayet<br />nāśauchaṁ kīrtane tasya sa pavitrakaro yataḥ [160]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘The Name of the Lord, the carrier of the chakra, should be chanted always and everywhere. There is no impurity within the chanting of His Name because He Himself is purifying.’
যজ্ঞে দানে স্নানে জপে আছে কালের নিয়ম ।<br />কৃষ্ণকীর্ত্তনে কালাকালচিন্তা মহাভ্রম ॥১৬১॥
yajñe dāne snāne jape āchhe kālera niyama<br />kṛṣṇa-kīrtane kālākāla-chintā mahābhrama [161]
<span class="e2">āchhe</span>–There are <span class="e2">niyama</span>–rules <span class="e2">kālera</span>–regarding the time <span class="e2">yajñe</span> <span class="e2">dāne</span> <span class="e2">snāne</span> <span class="e2">jape</span>–for [performing] sacrifice, [giving] charity, bathing, and [chanting] mantras, [but] <span class="e2">kālākāla-chintā</span>–thinking [that there are] proper and improper times <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kīrtane</span>–to chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa [is] <span class="e2">mahābhrama</span>–a great mistake.
“There are rules regarding the time to perform sacrifice, give charity, bathe, and chant mantras, but thinking that there are proper or improper times to chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa is a great mistake.
দেশ-কাল-নিয়মাদি নামে কভু নাই ।<br />কৃষ্ণকীর্ত্তন সদা করহ সবাই ॥১৬২॥
deśa-kāla-niyamādi nāme kabhu nāi<br />kṛṣṇa-kīrtana sadā karaha sabāi [162]
<span class="e2">kabhu</span> <span class="e2">nāi</span>–There are never <span class="e2">deśa-kāla-niyamādi</span>–rules for the time and place <span class="e2">nāme</span>–to [chant] the Name. <span class="e2">sabāi</span>–Everyone <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-kīrtana</span> <span class="e2">karaha</span>–should chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always.
“There are never rules for the time and place to chant the Name. Everyone should always chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
ন দেশনিয়মো রাজন্ ন কালনিয়মস্তথা ।<br />বিদ্যতে নাত্র সন্দেহো বিষ্ণোর্নামানুকীর্ত্তনে ॥১৬৩॥<br />কালোঽস্তি দানে যজ্ঞে চ স্নানে কালোঽস্তি সজ্জপে ।<br />বিষ্ণুসঙ্কীর্ত্তনে কালো নাস্ত্যত্র পৃথিবীতলে ॥১৬৪॥
na deśa-niyamo rājan na kāla-niyamas tathā<br />vidyate nātra sandeho viṣṇor nāmānukīrtane [163]<br />kālo ’sti dāne yajñe cha snāne kālo ’sti sajjape<br />viṣṇu-saṅkīrtane kālo nāsty atra pṛthivī-tale [164]
(Vaiṣṇava-chintāmaṇi)
“‘O King, there are no rules regarding the time and place for chanting the Name of Viṣṇu. Of this there is no doubt. There are rules concerning the time for giving charity, performing sacrifices, bathing, and chanting mantras, but on this earth there are no rules regarding the time to chant the Name of Viṣṇu (the Name should be chanted at all times).’
সংসারে নির্ব্বিণ্ণচিত্ত অভয়পদ চায় ।<br />হেন যোগীর জন্য নাম একমাত্র উপায় ॥১৬৫॥
saṁsāre nirviṇṇa-chitta abhaya-pada chāya<br />hena yogīra janya nāma eka-mātra upāya [165]
<span class="e2">hena yogīra</span> <span class="e2">janya</span>–For the ascetics [who are] <span class="e2">nirviṇṇa-chitta</span>–indifferent <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–to the world [and] <span class="e2">chāya</span>–desire <span class="e2">abhaya-pada</span>–fearlessness, <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name [is] <span class="e2">eka-mātra</span> <span class="e2">upāya</span>–the one and only way.
“For ascetics who are indifferent to the world and desire fearlessness, the Name is the one and only way.
এতন্নির্ব্বিদ্যমানানামিচ্ছতামকুতোভয়ম্ ।<br />যোগিনাং নৃপ নির্ণীতং হরের্নামানুকীর্ত্তনম্ ॥১৬৬॥
etan nirvidyamānānām ichchhatām akuto-bhayam<br />yogināṁ nṛpa nirṇītaṁ harer nāmānukīrtanam [166]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 2.1.11)
“‘O King, constantly chanting the Name of the Lord is prescribed for ascetics who are indifferent and desire total fearlessness.’
হরিনাম বিনা আর সহজ মুক্তিদাতা ।<br />কেহ নাহি ত্রিজগতে, নামই জীবের ত্রাতা ॥১৬৭॥
hari-nāma vinā āra sahaja mukti-dātā<br />keha nāhi trijagate, nāma-i jīvera trātā [167]
<span class="e2">keha</span> <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–No one <span class="e2">trijagate</span>–throughout the three worlds <span class="e2">vinā</span> <span class="e2">āra</span>–other than <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord [is] <span class="e2">sahaja</span> <span class="e2">mukti-dātā</span>–an easy giver of liberation. <span class="e2">nāma-i</span>–The Name alone [is] <span class="e2">trātā</span>–the deliverer <span class="e2">jīvera</span>–of the soul.
“No one throughout the three worlds other than the Name of the Lord easily grants liberation. The Name alone is the deliverer of the soul.
একবার মুখে বলে ‘হরি’ দু’অক্ষর ।<br />সেই জন মোক্ষপ্রতি বদ্ধপরিকর ॥১৬৮॥
eka-bāra mukhe bale ‘hari’ du’akṣara<br />sei jana mokṣa-prati baddha-parikara [168]
<span class="e2">sei</span> <span class="e2">jana</span>–Those who <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once <span class="e2">mukhe</span> <span class="e2">bale</span>–chant aloud <span class="e2">du’akṣara</span>–the two syllables <span class="e2">‘hari’</span>–‘Ha-ri’ [are] <span class="e2">baddha-parikara</span>–‘girdle-bound’ <span class="e2">mokṣa-prati</span>–for liberation.
“Those who once chant the two syllables ‘Ha-ri’ are bound to attain liberation.
সকৃদুচ্চারিতং যেন হরিরিত্যক্ষরদ্বয়ম্ ।<br />বদ্ধঃ পরিকরস্তেন মোক্ষায় গমনং প্রতি ॥১৬৯॥
sakṛd uchchāritaṁ yena harir ity akṣara-dvayam<br />baddhaḥ parikaras tena mokṣāya gamanaṁ prati [169]
(Skanda-purāṇa)
“‘Those who once chant the two syllables ‘Ha-ri’ are bound to attain liberation.’
জিতনিদ্র হঞা একবার ‘নারায়ণ’ বলে ।<br />শুদ্ধ-চিত্ত হঞা সেই নির্ব্বাণপথে চলে ॥১৭০॥
jita-nidra hañā eka-bāra ‘nārāyaṇa’ bale<br />śuddha-chitta hañā sei nirvāṇa-pathe chale [170]
<span class="e2">sei jita-nidra</span> <span class="e2">hañā</span>–Anyone who overcomes sleep [and] <span class="e2">eka-bāra</span>–once <span class="e2">bale</span>–chants <span class="e2">‘nārāyaṇa’</span>–‘Nārāyaṇ’ <span class="e2">śuddha-chitta hañā</span>–becomes pure in heart [and] <span class="e2">chale</span>–proceeds <span class="e2">nirvāṇa-pathe</span>–on the path to liberation.
“Anyone who overcomes sleep and once chants ‘Nārāyaṇ’ becomes pure in heart and proceeds on the path to liberation.
সকৃদুচ্চারয়েদ্যস্তু নারায়ণমতন্দ্রিতঃ ।<br />শুদ্ধান্তঃকরণো ভূত্বা নির্ব্বাণমধিগচ্ছতি ॥১৭১॥
sakṛd uchchārayed yas tu nārāyaṇam atandritaḥ<br />śuddhāntaḥkaraṇo bhūtvā nirvāṇam adhigachchhati [171]
(Padma-purāṇa)
“‘Anyone free from laziness who once chants the Name of Nārāyaṇ becomes pure in heart and attains liberation.’
এ ঘোর সংসারে, বলে বিবশে ‘হরে হরে’ ।<br />সদ্যোমুক্ত হয়, ভয় তারে ভয় করে ॥১৭২॥
e ghora saṁsāre, bale vivaśe ‘hare hare’<br />sadyo-mukta haya, bhaya tāre bhaya kare [172]
[Souls] <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">ghora</span> <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–in this frightening world [who] <span class="e2">vivaśe</span>–desperately <span class="e2">bale</span>–call out <span class="e2">‘hare</span> <span class="e2">hare’</span>–‘O Lord! Lord!’ <span class="e2">sadyo-mukta</span> <span class="e2">haya</span>–are immediately liberated; [even] <span class="e2">bhaya</span>–Fear [himself] <span class="e2">bhaya</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–fears <span class="e2">tāre</span>–Him.
“Souls in this frightening world who desperately call out, ‘Hari! Hari!’ are immediately liberated; even Fear himself fears the Name.
আপন্নঃ সংসৃতিং ঘোরাং যন্নাম বিবশো গৃণন্ ।<br />ততঃ সদ্যো বিমুচ্যেত যদ্বিভেতি স্বয়ং ভয়ম্ ॥১৭৩॥
āpannaḥ saṁsṛtiṁ ghorāṁ yan-nāma vivaśo gṛṇan<br />tataḥ sadyo vimuchyeta yad bibheti svayaṁ bhayam [173]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 1.1.14)
“‘Souls entangled in the frightening world who desperately chant the Lord’s Name, whom Fear himself fears, are immediately liberated.’
মৃত্যুকালে বিবশে যে করে উচ্চারণ ।<br />তাঁর অবতার নাম লীলা বিড়ম্বন ॥১৭৪॥<br />বহুজন্মদুরিত সহসা ত্যাগ করি’ ।<br />যায় সে পরমপদে ভজে সেই হরি ॥১৭৫॥
mṛtyu-kāle vivaśe ye kare uchchāraṇa<br />tā̐ra avatāra nāma līlā viḍambana [174]<br />bahu-janma-durita sahasā tyāga kari’<br />yāya se parama-pade bhaje sei hari [175]
<span class="e2">se ye</span>–Those who <span class="e2">mṛtyu-kāle</span>–at the time of death <span class="e2">vivaśe</span>–desperately <span class="e2">uchchāraṇa kare</span>–chant <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Names [that are] <span class="e2">viḍambana</span>–allusions <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span>–to His <span class="e2">avatāra</span>–Avatārs [and] <span class="e2">līlā</span>–Pastimes <span class="e2">sahasā</span>–immediately <span class="e2">tyāga</span> <span class="e2">kari’</span>–leave behind <span class="e2">bahu-janma-durita</span>–many births’ worth of sin [and] <span class="e2">yāya</span>–reach <span class="e2">parama-pade</span>–the supreme abode. <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–I serve <span class="e2">sei hari</span>–this Lord.
“Those who at the time of death desperately chant the Lord’s Names that describe His Avatārs and Pastimes immediately leave behind many births’ worth of sin and reach the supreme abode. I serve this Lord.
যস্যাবতারগুণকর্ম্মবিড়ম্বনানি<br />নামানি যেঽসুবিগমে বিবশা গৃণন্তি ।<br />তেঽনেকজন্মশমলং সহসৈব হিত্বা<br />সংযান্ত্যপাবৃতামৃতং তমজং প্রপদ্যে ॥১৭৬॥
yasyāvatāra-guṇa-karma-viḍambanāni<br />nāmāni ye ’suvigame vivaśā gṛṇanti<br />te ’neka-janma-śamalaṁ sahasaiva hitvā<br />saṁyānty apāvṛtām ṛtaṁ tam ajaṁ prapadye [176]
(Śrīmad Bhāgavatam: 3.9.15)
“‘Those who at the time of death desperately chant the Names of the Lord that describe His Avatārs, Qualities, and Pastimes immediately leave behind many births’ worth of sin and attain the uncovered Absolute. I surrender to that unborn Lord.’
চলিতে বসিতে স্বপ্নে ভোজনে শয়নে ।<br />কলিদমন কৃষ্ণোচ্চারে বাক্যের পূরণে ॥১৭৭॥<br />হেলাতেও করি’ নাম নিজ স্বরূপ পাঞা ।<br />পরমপদ বৈকুণ্ঠে যায় নির্ভয় হইয়া ॥১৭৮॥
chalite basite svapne bhojane śayane<br />kali-damana kṛṣṇochchāre vākyera pūraṇe [177]<br />helāteo kari’ nāma nija svarūpa pāñā<br />parama-pada vaikuṇṭhe yāya nirbhaya ha-iyā [178]
<span class="e2">chalite</span>–While walking, <span class="e2">basite</span>–sitting, <span class="e2">svapne</span>–dreaming, <span class="e2">bhojane</span>–eating, <span class="e2">śayane</span>–resting, [or] <span class="e2">vākyera</span> <span class="e2">pūraṇe</span>–speaking, [those who] <span class="e2">kṛṣṇochchāre</span>–chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">kali-damana</span>–the subduer of Kali— [and] <span class="e2">helāteo</span>–even [those who] neglect­fully <span class="e2">nāma kari’</span>–chant the Name— <span class="e2">nija</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span> <span class="e2">pāñā</span>–realise the true self [and] <span class="e2">nirbhaya</span> <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–fearlessly <span class="e2">yāya</span>–go [to] <span class="e2">parama-pada</span>–the supreme abode <span class="e2">vaikuṇṭhe</span>–of Vaikuṇṭha.
“While walking, sitting, dreaming, eating, resting, or speaking, those who even neglectfully chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa, the subduer of Kali, realise the true self and fearlessly go to the supreme abode of Vaikuṇṭha.
ব্রজংস্তিষ্ঠন্ স্বপন্নশ্নন্ শ্বসন্ বাক্যপ্রপূরণে ।<br />নামসঙ্কীর্ত্তনং বিষ্ণোর্হেলয়া কলিমর্ধনম্ ।<br />কৃত্বা স্বরূপতাং যাতি ভক্তিযুক্তঃ পরং ব্রজেৎ ॥১৭৯॥
vrajaṁs tiṣṭhan svapann aśnan śvasan vākya-prapūraṇe<br />nāma-saṅkīrtanaṁ viṣṇor helayā kali-mardhanam<br />kṛtvā svarūpatāṁ yāti bhakti-yuktaḥ paraṁ vrajet [179]
(Liṅga-purāṇa)
“‘While walking, sitting, dreaming, eating, breathing, or speaking, those who even neglectfully engage in chanting Viṣṇu’s Name, the subduer of Kali, realise the true self, attain devotion, and go to the supreme abode.’
যেন তেন প্রকারেতে লয় কৃষ্ণনাম ।<br />তাকে প্রীতি করে কৃষ্ণ করুণা-নিদান ॥১৮০॥
yena tena prakārete laya kṛṣṇa-nāma<br />tāke prīti kare kṛṣṇa karuṇā-nidāna [180]
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">karuṇā-nidāna</span>–the reservoir of grace, <span class="e2">prīti</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–loves <span class="e2">tāke</span>–those who <span class="e2">laya</span>–chant <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">yena</span> <span class="e2">tena</span> <span class="e2">prakārete</span>–howsoever [they do so].
“Kṛṣṇa, the reservoir of grace, loves those who chant His Name, howsoever they do so.
মদ্যপানে ভূতাবিষ্ট বায়ু-পীড়া-স্থলে ।<br />হরিনামোচ্চারে মুক্তি তাঁর করতলে ॥১৮১॥
madya-pāne bhūtāviṣṭa vāyu-pīḍā-sthale<br />hari-nāmochchāre mukti tā̐ra karatale [181]
<span class="e2">hari-nāmochchāre</span>–By chanting the Lord’s Name, [those who are] <span class="e2">madya-pāne</span>–drunk, <span class="e2">bhūtāviṣṭa</span>–bewitched, [or] <span class="e2">vāyu-pīḍā-sthale</span>–diseased [find] <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation <span class="e2">tā̐ra</span> <span class="e2">karatale</span>–on the palm of their hand.
“By chanting the Lord’s Name, even those who are drunk, bewitched, or diseased find liberation on the palm of their hand.
বাসুদেবস্য সঙ্কীর্ত্ত্যা সুরাপো ব্যাধিতোঽপি বা ।<br />মুক্তো জায়েত নিয়তং মহাবিষ্ণুঃ প্রসীদতি ॥১৮২॥
vāsudevasya saṅkīrtyā surāpo vyādhito ’pi vā<br />mukto jāyeta niyataṁ mahāviṣṇuḥ prasīdati [182]
(Varāha-purāṇa)
“‘By chanting the Name of Vāsudev, even drunk and diseased persons attain liberation, and Mahāviṣṇu becomes pleased.’
হরিনাম স্বতঃ পরমপুরুষার্থ হয় ।<br />উপেয়-মাঙ্গল্য-তত্ত্ব পরংধনময় ॥১৮৩॥<br />জীবনের ফল বস্তু কাশীখণ্ড বলে ।<br />পদ্মপুরাণেও তাহা কহে বহু স্থলে ॥১৮৪॥
hari-nāma svataḥ parama-puruṣārtha haya<br />upeya-māṅgalya-tattva paraṁ-dhanamaya [183]<br />jīvanera phala vastu kāśī-khaṇḍa bale<br />padma-purāṇeo tāhā kahe bahu sthale [184]
[Chanting] <span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord <span class="e2">haya</span>–is <span class="e2">svataḥ</span>–itself <span class="e2">parama-puruṣārtha</span>–the ultimate goal of life. <span class="e2">kāśī-khaṇḍa</span>–The Kāśī-khaṇḍa (of the <span class="e33">Skanda-purāṇa</span>) <span class="e2">bale</span>–says [that it is] <span class="e2">upeya-māṅgalya-tattva</span>–the most sought-after auspiciousness, <span class="e2">paraṁ-dhanamaya</span>–the supreme wealth, [and] <span class="e2">phala</span> <span class="e2">vastu</span>–the fulfilment <span class="e2">jīvanera</span>–of life. <span class="e2">padma-purāṇeo</span>–The <span class="e33">Padma-purāṇa</span> also <span class="e2">kahe</span>–says <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–this <span class="e2">bahu</span> <span class="e2">sthale</span>–in many places.
“Chanting the Name of the Lord is itself the ultimate goal of life. The Kāśī-khaṇḍa says that it is the most sought-after auspiciousness, the supreme wealth, and the fulfilment of life. The <span class="e3">Padma-purāṇa</span> also says this in many places.
ইদমেব হি মঙ্গল্যং এতদেব ধনার্জ্জনম্ ।<br />জীবিতস্য ফলঞ্চৈতদ্ যদ্দামোদরকীর্ত্তনম্ ॥১৮৫॥
idam eva hi maṅgalyaṁ etad eva dhanārjanam<br />jīvitasya phalañ chaitad yad dāmodara-kīrtanam [185]
(Skanda-purāṇa, Padma-purāṇa)
“‘Chanting the Name of Dāmodar is true auspiciousness, true earning of wealth, and the fulfilment of life itself.’
সর্ব্ব মঙ্গলের হয় পরম মঙ্গল ।<br />চিত্তত্ত্ব-স্বরূপ সর্ব্ববেদবল্লীফল ॥১৮৬॥
sarva maṅgalera haya parama maṅgala<br />chit-tattva svarūpa sarva-veda-vallī-phala [186]
<span class="e2">haya</span>–The Name is <span class="e2">parama</span> <span class="e2">maṅgala</span>–the most auspicious <span class="e2">sarva</span> <span class="e2">maṅgalera</span>–of all auspicious things [and] <span class="e2">chit-tattva</span> <span class="e2">svarūpa</span> <span class="e2">sarva-veda-vallī-phala</span>–the spiritual fruit from the vine of all the Vedas.
“The Name is the most auspicious of all auspicious things and the spiritual fruit produced by the vine of the Vedas.
কৃষ্ণনাম লয় যেই শ্রদ্ধা বা হেলায় ।<br />নর-মাত্র ত্রাণ পায় সর্ব্ববেদে গায় ॥১৮৭॥
kṛṣṇa-nāma laya yei śraddhā vā helāya<br />nara-mātra trāṇa pāya sarva-vede gāya [187]
<span class="e2">sarva-vede</span>–All the scriptures <span class="e2">gāya</span>–sing [that] <span class="e2">nara-mātra yei</span>–anyone who <span class="e2">laya</span>–chants <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa-nāma</span>–the Name of Kṛṣṇa, <span class="e2">śraddhā</span>–faithfully <span class="e2">vā</span>–or <span class="e2">helāya</span>–neglectfully, <span class="e2">pāya</span>–attains <span class="e2">trāṇa</span>–deliverance.
“All the scriptures sing that anyone who chants the Name of Kṛṣṇa, faithfully or negligently, attains deliverance.
মধুরমধুরমেতন্মঙ্গলং মঙ্গলানাং<br />সকলনিগমবল্লীসৎফলং চিৎস্বরূপম্ ।<br />সকৃদপি পরিগীতং শ্রদ্ধয়া হেলয়া বা<br />ভৃগুবর নরমাত্রং তারয়েৎ কৃষ্ণনাম ॥১৮৮॥
madhura-madhuram etan maṅgalaṁ maṅgalānāṁ<br />sakala-nigama-vallī-sat-phalaṁ chit-svarūpam<br />sakṛd api parigītaṁ śraddhayā helayā vā<br />bhṛgu-vara nara-mātraṁ tārayet kṛṣṇa-nāma [188]
(Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa)
“‘The Name of Kṛṣṇa, the sweetest of the sweet, the most auspicious of the auspicious, the eternal spiritual fruit from the vine of the Vedas, delivers a soul when He is chanted even once, faithfully or negligently.’
ভক্তির প্রকার যত শাস্ত্রে দেখা যায় ।<br />তঁহি মধ্যে নামাশ্রয় শ্রেষ্ঠ বলি’ গায় ॥১৮৯॥
bhaktira prakāra yata śāstre dekhā yāya<br />ta̐hi madhye nāmāśraya śreṣṭha bali’ gāya [189]
<span class="e2">gāya</span>–The scriptures sing [that] <span class="e2">nāmāśraya</span>–taking shelter of the Name <span class="e2">śreṣṭha</span> <span class="e2">bali’</span>–is the best <span class="e2">ta̐hi madhye</span>–amongst <span class="e2">yata bhaktira</span> <span class="e2">prakāra</span>–all the practices of devotion <span class="e2">dekhā</span> <span class="e2">yāya</span>–found <span class="e2">śāstre</span>–in the scriptures.
“The scriptures sing that taking shelter of the Name is best amongst all the practices of devotion found in the scriptures.
কষ্টেতে অষ্টাঙ্গ যোগে বিষ্ণুস্মৃতি সাধে ।<br />ওষ্ঠস্পন্দনেই শ্রেষ্ঠ কীর্ত্তন বিরাজে ॥১৯০॥
kaṣṭete aṣṭāṅga yoge viṣṇu-smṛti sādhe<br />oṣṭha-spandanei śreṣṭha kīrtana virāje [190]
<span class="e2">viṣṇu-smṛti</span>–Remembrance of Viṣṇu <span class="e2">sādhe</span>–is practised <span class="e2">kaṣṭete</span>–with difficulty <span class="e2">aṣṭāṅga</span> <span class="e2">yoge</span>–through aṣṭāṅga-yoga, [but] <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–chanting [His Name is practised] <span class="e2">oṣṭha-spandanei</span>–by simply moving the lips; [chanting thus] <span class="e2">virāje</span>–reigns <span class="e2">śreṣṭha</span>–supreme.
“Remembrance of Viṣṇu is practised with difficulty through aṣṭāṅga-yoga, but chanting His Name is practised simply by moving the lips; chanting thus reigns supreme.
অঘচ্ছিৎ স্মরণং বিষ্ণোর্ব্বহ্বায়াসেন সাধ্যতে ।<br />ওষ্ঠস্পন্দনমাত্রেণ কীর্ত্তনন্তু ততো বরম্ ॥১৯১॥
aghachchhit smaraṇaṁ viṣṇor bahv-āyāsena sādhyate<br />oṣṭha-spandana-mātreṇa kīrtanan tu tato varam [191]
(Vaiṣṇava-chintāmaṇi)
“‘Remembrance of Viṣṇu, which destroys sin, is practised with great exertion, but chanting Viṣṇu’s Name is practised simply by moving the lips. Chanting is thus superior to remembrance.’
দীক্ষাপূর্ব্বক অর্চ্চন যদি শত জন্ম করে ।<br />তাহার জিহ্বায় নিত্য হরিনাম স্ফুরে ॥১৯২॥
dīkṣā-pūrvaka archana yadi śata janma kare<br />tāhāra jihvāya nitya hari-nāma sphure [192]
<span class="e2">hari-nāma</span>–The Name of the Lord <span class="e2">nitya</span>–always <span class="e2">sphure</span>–appears <span class="e2">tāhāra</span> <span class="e2">jihvāya</span>–on the soul’s tongue <span class="e2">yadi</span>–when <span class="e2">dīkṣā-pūrvaka</span>–they have accepted initiation [and] <span class="e2">archana</span> <span class="e2">kare</span>–performed worship <span class="e2">śata</span> <span class="e2">janma</span>–for hundreds of births.
“The Name of the Lord always appears on the tongue of those who have accepted initiation and performed worship for hundreds of births.
যেন জন্মশতৈঃ পূর্ব্বং বাসুদেবঃ সমর্চিতঃ ।<br />তন্মুখে হরিনামানি সদা তিষ্ঠন্তি ভারত ॥১৯৩॥
yena janma-śataiḥ pūrvaṁ vāsudevaḥ samarchitaḥ<br />tan-mukhe hari-nāmāni sadā tiṣṭhanti bhārata [193]
(Vaiṣṇava-chintāmaṇi)
“‘O King, the Names of the Lord are always present in the mouth of those who have fully worshipped Vāsudev for hundreds of previous births.’
সত্যযুগে বহুকালে যাহা তপোধ্যানে ।<br />যজ্ঞাদি যজিয়া ত্রেতায় যেবা ফল টানে ॥১৯৪॥<br />দ্বাপরে অর্চ্চনাঙ্গেতে পায় যেবা ফল ।<br />কলিতে হরিনামে পায় সে সকল ॥১৯৫॥
satya-yuge bahu-kāle yāhā tapo-dhyāne<br />yajñādi yajiyā tretāya yebā phala ṭāne [194]<br />dvāpare archanāṅgete pāya yebā phala<br />kalite hari-nāme pāya se sakala [195]
<span class="e2">se</span> <span class="e2">sakala yāhā yebā yebā phala phala</span>–All the results <span class="e2">ṭāne pāya</span>–attained <span class="e2">satya-yuge</span>–in Satya-yuga <span class="e2">bahu-kāle</span> <span class="e2">tapo-dhyāne</span>–by long-term austerity and meditation, <span class="e2">tretāya</span>–in Tretā-yuga <span class="e2">yajñādi</span> <span class="e2">yajiyā</span>–by conducting sacrifices, [and] <span class="e2">dvāpare</span>–in Dvāpar-yuga <span class="e2">archanāṅgete</span>–by the practice of worship <span class="e2">pāya</span>–are attained <span class="e2">kalite</span>–in Kali-yuga <span class="e2">hari-nāme</span>–by [chanting] the Name of the Lord.
“All the results attained in Satya-yuga by long-term austerity and meditation, in Tretā-yuga by conducting sacrifices, and in Dvāpar-yuga by Deity worship are attained in Kali-yuga by chanting the Name of the Lord.
ধ্যায়ন্ কৃতে যজন্ যজ্ঞৈস্ত্রেতায়াং দ্বাপরেঽর্চ্চয়ন্ ।<br />যদাপ্নোতি তদাপ্নোতি কলৌ সঙ্কীর্ত্ত্য কেশবম্ ॥১৯৬॥
dhyāyan kṛte yajan yajñais tretāyāṁ dvāpare ’rchayan<br />yad āpnoti tad āpnoti kalau saṅkīrtya keśavam [196]
(Viṣṇu-purāṇa)
“‘Whatever is attained in Satya-yuga by meditation, in Tretā-yuga by sacrifice, and in Dvāpar-yuga by worship, is attained in Kali-yuga by chanting Keśava’s Name.’
কলিকালে মহাভাগবত বলি তারে ।<br />কীর্ত্তনে যে হরি ভজে এ ভব-সংসারে ॥১৯৭॥
kali-kāle mahābhāgavata bali tāre<br />kīrtane ye hari bhaje e bhava-saṁsāre [197]
<span class="e2">bali</span>–We consider <span class="e2">tāre ye</span>–those who <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serve <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord <span class="e2">kali-kāle</span>–in the Age of Kali <span class="e2">e</span> <span class="e2">bhava-saṁsāre</span>–in this material world <span class="e2">kīrtane</span>–by chanting [His Name to be] <span class="e2">mahābhāgavata</span>–advanced devotees.
“We consider those who serve the Lord in the Age of Kali in this material world by chanting His Name to be advanced devotees.
